The scuba diving was reasonably interesting with the wreck being the most interesting. The Dive Master, Lee, runs a professional operation. we went bone fishing several times, with local guides (Elvis and Patterson). The fishing was great fun although not particularly productive- the wind made casting challenging. it was a good introduction to what bone fishing can be on Andros. The West Side Excursion half day boat trip through the channel to the flats on the west side is not to be missed- turtles, dolphin, tarpon- amazing environment. The boat captains were consistently great and the boats and equipment first rate. Loved the site of our cabin on the beach and walking in bare feet on the beach to dinner. All in all a great place to stay on Andros.

author: rmhayes
title: A Caribbean idyl with superb food
text: We really loved this place. It's a wonderful Caribbean idyl set along an absurdly beautiful palm fringed beach on an inlet which is only accessible by boat or sea plane. Even though it's only 10 minutes speed boat ride from the harbour the resulting feeling of remoteness made it a wonderful place for us to relax and get away from it all. They have some floating cabanas moored just off the beach where you can read with only the breeze and the lapping of the sea for company. For those who want more action they have a resident dive leader and water sports and bone fishing facilities. We liked the rustic feel of the wooden bungalows and dining area which reflected its eco resort status and lent it great charm. Added to this was some really superb food, fresh fish, lobster, lots of fresh fruit, and the staff were also excellent, courteous and efficient. Overall we thought it was outstanding though of course it's not cheap. But it was worth the money.

author: I1475VKjohnr
title: Great, quiet place with much variety
text: loved this place. staff great, amenities are complete. quiet, low key, great central area facing the beach. Divemaster incredible. great fishing and more. Our only complaint - wine choices were poor - cheap wine, and at incredibly inflated prices, as were ALL drinks. people are very incented to bring their own rather than pay the freight at the resort. Otherwise, we loved everything about it.

author: Y235YOanne
title: Disappointed
text: The Spa did not exist as a Spa we know. There was just one French Masseuse who could not do manicures, pedicures, facials etc. She was supposed to see us at dinner to make appointments but never appeared. Considering that she lived on the island she was never to be found. At the weekend the hotel hosted a promotion for Moet & Chandon champagne. Admittedly we did have a special dinner provided on the Sat but on Sun 30 guests were shipped onto the island for a special champagne lunch. Plus there was DJ who played very loud music for 3 hours which completely ruined the peace & tranquillity of the place. Lunch for us was very very slow as the staff were dealing with all the lunch guests, who got louder & louder the more champagne they drank. Some of the hotel activities were also stopped, to accommodate the party, which was most annoying.

author: 15Mark
title: FANTASTIC!
text: If you want quiet and relaxation ( with opportunity for diving, snorkeling and fishing ); fabulous food; gorgeous water; beautiful sunsets; wonderful staff.... then Tiamo is IT! We stayed in a sunset room (there are 2 of them with a porch), which was very small, but right on the sand in front of the best swimming part of the beach..... my husband is disabled, and this spot was terrific for easy access to everything. Dining was open air, overlooking the ocean, with subtle lighting through palm trees, creating a very romantic atmosphere! Because the resort is so small, the staff treats everyone like family.....truly sincere and accommodating. This is the place to "unplug". We've been to many small beachfront resorts.....Tiamo is at the top of our list. Kathy Sturman

author: davekoller
title: Tiamo- A Magical Place!
text: My husband and I took the trip of a lifetime to this property that I'd been aware of since its inception in 2001. We couldn't have wished for any better. We were pampered from the onset- the staff, the food and the setting were fabulous. We did some snorkeling, bone fishing, kayaking, maasages and relaxing. That's what was so nice about the place. There were so many things to do or you could do nothing Your choice. The week just flew by. Can't wait to return!

author: brigitte_south
title: Perfect Hideaway
text: We had a room with a pool - highly recommend. Perfect location, real relaxation. Great staff, great food. The best snorkelling and scuba. The nature walk was interesting and entertaining. Pesky sand flies so beware! The most relaxing holiday ever. Real battery recharge.

author: ncnyclover
title: Laid back luxury at it's best
text: As a luxury travel agent I get to stay at some amazing properties but Tiamo holds a special spot and I will definitely go back. We had pool villa for 4 nights and enjoyed every minute. Lots of water activities to participate in -free daily snorkeling tour, paddle boards, motorized cat and more. If you are there with your spouse and they want to Bonefish ask for DJ as a guide, my husband had a great time and has made a lifetime friend. Wilfried is a very hands on GM and has made Tiamo a unique destination. The staff feel like family after your first day and make sure all of your needs are met. I was worried with only 2 choices for appetizers and main courses for lunch and dinner but the choices and food are amazing. Perfect for honeymooners, couples get a way and the 3 bedroom Birds Nest is perfect for couples traveling together or a family. I see resorts from an industry perspective and I found everything went beyond what is expected. The extra touches, staff,food and activities makes Tiamo a wonderful place to relax.

title: A honeymoon the way it should be.
text: My husband and I came here for our honeymoon on June. We stayed in a pool villa, our day began with breakfast, and then we lounged in our private pool reading and having quality time together. After lunch we would go on a guided snorkelling trip, our guide was amazing and very knowledgable, he cared about the Eco system which was very important to us. The water was some of the most clear, clean water I have swam in and beautifully warm. We saw sharks, barracudas and so much more beautiful marine life. By dinner time we were ready for a good meal, as a vegan I was worried that I would be spending a week eating the same bland meal everyday, I was so happy to have enjoyed creative vegan meals, the staff were very accommodating. The staff were all very friendly, I hope that they are well treated by tiamo management, because they deserve it. My favorite part of our trip was the privacy and seclusion of our villa and pool, we were content staying in our cocoon everything else was really just secondary.

author: pierrette_gordon
title: Tiamo "Je t'aime"
text: Absolutely wonderful! We have loved every visits (this was our third) and look forward to many more! The Bonefishing makes my husband happy (with a guide or right off the beach) while I enjoy relaxing on the beach with a good book. The staff is always there to answer our every need; even our cravings and our request to cook our catch of the dock! Every meal is well planned, the dinner options are sure to satisfy most discerning traveller. If you can fly with Watermakers Air from Fort Lauderdale, it is even better and not cost prohibitive. We have tried the private float plane from Nassau, a private charter from Fort Lauderdale and a commercial flight from Nassau and each time we thought it easy enough and worthwhile. Our favorite option is to fly from Fort Lauderdale but not always available depending on traveling days and availability. Make sure you bring some mosquito repellant with Deet (the hotel provides but I like to make sure I am covered!) as some part of the day the mosquitos seem to have a hefty appetite.

author: Vicks277
title: A Third Visit Says It All
text: This is really a most delightful little gorgeous resort, hence returning for a third time. All the villas have sea views, and are beautifully appointed. Some have two bedrooms, some one, some have air conditioning, and some have a little pool. The chef is amazing, and lunch and dinner is always a pleasure, I am sure if you have some special needs, he would accommodate you. The staff are all friendly and delightful. The dive master is great, and there is water sport to suit all needs. Sitting on the beach in the evenings partaking of a cocktail, and watching the sun go down, is very special. Bring your own lotions for bugs and those irritating little critters if you so wish, they do also supply. I can highly recommend Tiamo.

author: avadogs
title: Great getaway...
text: Location was perfect. Food was exceptional. Staff was wonderful. Experiences were first rate. Just a very relaxing vacation. Did not want to miss lunch or dinner. Very quiet and private. Sunsets are amazing !!!

author: TXFoodie75230
title: A true escape from it all
text: My husband and I had a very romantic getaway. Individual villas with private pools. Lots of water activities. Staff was so friendly and helpful. Staff to guest ratio whent we were there (August 2014) was 35 staff to 10 to max 20 guests. WOW! However very remote. No cars, no TV , no city, one cab that takes you to the pier to catch the boat to Tiamo--so be prepared for that. Wish I had taken my husband here while he was still working so no phone calls, internet, etc.!! The bugs were a little bit of a problem because all meals were served in the open air restaurant-- came home with quite a few bites :(

author: Andrea6900
title: How to be good to yourself (and your partner)
text: We stayed at Tiamo Resort for a long weekend in April with our daughter. The property is beautiful, the staff warm and welcoming and Julien and Vincent perfect hosts. The Pool Villa is nicely furnished, bed is very comfortable and mosquito nets are around the perimeter to protect from annoying insects. The food was very well prepared and eating around the pool at night was an emotional experience.... not to mention the colors of the sky at sunset. We had the time to try most activities : paddle board, kayaks, sailing boat and snorkeling at a blue hole, etc etc. It all added up to make it a wonderful stay. Only negative point was the continuos presence of mosquitos and horseflies : insect repellant sprays are given complimentary in the room, but the insect don't always seem to be bothered by them.

author: 446chadb
title: Absolute Perfection
text: My wife and I just returned from a 6 day vacation at Tiamo. It was a surprise anniversary/birthday trip and my wife was completely unaware of where we were going to end up. I could not have found a more wonderful destination. The water was unbelievable, the accommodations were top notch, the service was incredible and the food was excellent. I knew from the photos and reviews that it would be great, but everything exceeded my expectations. I loved every bit of it. The place is secluded and so quiet at night. We will definitely go back.

author: krisa325
title: Unspoiled beauty in a secluded location
text: My Son and I took a weeklong trip to Tiamo last month over his spring break. We found the resort to be wonderful in many ways. From the initial introduction, to the meals, activities, and beautiful beach, it exceeded our expectations in many ways. This was a very memorable, Father/Son trip for us and we enjoyed bonefishing with a guide for 4 of the days we stayed. The housekeeping services were impeccable, including a turn down service at night. The kitchen staff did everything to make us feel comfortable. I really enjoyed to small size of the resort too. We'd love to come back and visit again next year.

author: HappyTraveler318
title: Romantic Paradise!
text: We just returned from Tiamo for our honeymoon. We loved every minute of it! It was the most beautiful and relaxing place we have ever been. The Tiamo Team works enthusiastically to ensure that you enjoy your stay and feel right at home. This is a resort staff that truly understands the definition of customer service! We enjoyed snorkeling, fishing, sailing, swimming, looking for starfish and stingrays, and sunbathing. The food was excellent - some of the best meals we have ever had. At night, we could choose whether we wanted to mingle with the other guests (who were quite friendly!) or spend time with just each other. We did not go to the spa but we were so relaxed -- we didn't need to! We recommend Tiamo without hesitation - a great trip and we will return in the future!

author: 888layneb
title: Hidden Paradise!!!
text: There are no words to adequately describe Tiamo Resort! It was the most beautiful, relaxing, and accommodating place that I have ever visited. The staff were absolutely wonderful. Each one greets you and makes you feel like you are part of a family. Since there are only 10 villas and the Eagle's Nest (a 3-bedroom house in which we had the opportunity to stay) with no kids allowed, it is very quiet and relaxing. However, there are water sports available if you wish to take advantage of those. The food was fabulous! We highly recommend this luxury resort for a quiet, relaxing, incredibly beautiful vacation! We were only able to stay for 3 days this time, but look forward to going back....in fact, we never wanted to leave. :o)

author: beach_bum_2011_80
title: Paradise
text: This place is amazing! Heaven on Earth. Beds are incredibly comfy. The food is divine. No detail goes unnoticed. Right on the water, which is as calm and warm as a bathtub! The staff is so nice and accommodating. Highly recommend this luxury resort for an intimate, quiet, peaceful getaway.

author: share3876
title: Have been twice
text: This is one of our favorite places in the world. The bone fishing is outstanding, the food is great, and the staff is awesome. If fishing I recommend Alvin be your guide, he is excellent. One word of caution is the nats, no-see-ums, whatever you call them. Simply liberally apply bug spray especially to your legs and feet from the 1st second you arrive in Andros. You will be fine and have a great trip. If you do not use bug spray, and I stress from the 1st moment you arrive - the end of your trip, you will be covered in very itchy bites. We have been here twice and will be going back again.

author: niagarariverfatman
title: Always great - our fourth visit
text: We have stayed at Tiamo 4 times, most recently in April 2013. We keep coming back because of the world class bone fishing but we also love Tiamo. The resort is small but beautiful and the food is excellent (not the usual resort food but the kind of food you find in 4 or 5 star restaurants). We really love this place. If you are interested in fishing I highly recommend Capt Shine Green. We have fished with Capt Green on all of our trips and he has always puts us on fish. This trip we hooked into 3 bones that were bigger than 10 lbs and many smaller fish. If you want to go in April take bug spray (like OFF deep woods) and avoid all dark clothes. During the warmer months they have some biting flies that are drawn to dark colors.

author: PaulF177
title: Absolutely Amazing
text: My wife and I spent three nights at the Tiamo Resort leaving a little less than a week ago. It was absolutely amazing. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The food was excellent. The rooms quiet and comfortable. The grounds were kept very clean. I will definitely return to Tiamo. The level of service and the seclusion from the rest of the world make it well worth their price point.

author: CarolineS839
title: Piece of heaven!
text: For our wedding anniversary, my husband gave me a nice surprise... He took me to spend a long weekend on the almost deserted island of South Andros, in the Bahamas... Tiamo resort is like a jewel in a natural setting between palms, white sand beach and turquoise sea! It was a wonderful and quiet time, even if we have sometimes been a bit incommoded during the day by the sound of construction work of the new dive center. Nonetheless, it was exactly what I wanted for celebrate this kind of event. The resort also received new transparent canoes, with which you can see some fish and starfish around the location... Awesome! The chef is exceptional; everything was excellent. On the other hand, there are some small details in the service or in the decoration that can be changed for a perfect magical ambiance! But it has been difficult to leave the island!

author: KKLONDONUK
title: Laid back luxury
text: We just returned from another excellent stay at Tiamo. The place is under new ownership and management since our last stay and lots of changes and improvements are in progress. There are new boats for watersports and construction is underway on a new PADI dive center. The main look and feel of the resort is still the same, which is what keeps us going back. Tiamo is the place to get away from it all with lots of peace and quiet and the option to do any number of activities, or just do nothing at all. The bonefishing with local guides is excellent, and you can also take a walk/wade and catch bonefish just off the shoreline if that is your thing. The dining is outstanding, some of the best food we have had anywhere. We found the staff to be very friendly and accommodating. The rooms are simple but luxurious and well appointed (minus a much needed mirror in the main room rather than just in the bathroom). Well done Tiamo, we look forward to our next visit.

author: stewartwj
title: Best food in the Bahamas
text: Food was out outstanding. Special mention to Keith, Tito and Emerald for there fantastically polite and skilled service! Rooms are well air-conditioned (a feature that many hotels struggle with) and simple but very nice. Good wi-fi services and good t.v. (although it lacks some sports channels - strange considering sport is the only real demand for television at such a place). Great bone-fishing and deep sea fishing. Quiet but very friendly place. Beautiful. Great stay

author: Simon07Surrey
title: Wonderful barefoot retreat
text: Just returned from a lovely 8 night stay at Tiamo, and how that idiot in a previous review can compare the food to a pizza menu is beyond me, he must be deranged! It is set on a gorgeous beach with a little jetty the boats come in and out from and is fringed with palm trees. The cottages are right on the beach and beautifully done with a large comfy bed sitting area and shower room. The food was exquisite and some of the best we have had, not overly large portions but when sitting on the beach for most of the day that was all we wanted. Staff were very friendly nothing seemed too much trouble! If you like bone fishing then get DJ to take you wading! Just one little note of caution, the resort is pretty isolated and although I understand there will be some changes shortly, there are no phones in the room, so once the staff have left which is around 10:30 pm you are pretty much 'on your own'. That was fine for us but could be quite un nerving if you were not prepared.

author: niagarariverfatman
title: WOW!! Excellent Food and Accomdations - Great Bonefishing
text: Tiamo is a small, but excellent resort for quiet relaxation and bone fishing. The resort’s cottages are beautiful and very comfortable, and some have air conditioning (which we did not find necessary in January). The staff are all very friendly and helpful. Dinners were a fine dining experience, not typical resort food. The bonefishing around the resort is quite good. Our guide, Capt. Greene, helped to put us on a lot of fish and also helped us to refine our fly casting. All in all, this is one of the best resorts we have visited.

author: KKLONDONUK
title: Best in the Bahamas
text: We just returned from a lovely stay at Tiamo and are already thinking about when we can return. The food, the staff, the accommodation are all top notch. We enjoyed bone-fishing, scuba diving, watching the World Cup (sorry, Germany) and just lazing around the beach and pool. But, more about the food - the menu varied each day and each day it got better and better. We will be the first to purchase the Tiamo cookbook (hint, hint). Best of all, the staff made us feel at home and relaxed - it was just what we needed for our holiday (special thanks to Bill, Romana, Troy and team). One final and important note - the beds - the best nights sleep we've had in a while. Well done, Tiamo, see you again soon, we hope.

author: KatoLondon
title: A hidden gem within the Caribbean
text: Tiamo is a hidden gem within the Caribbean. My boyfriend and I cannot recommend this secluded resort highly enough. Whether you are heading there for some of the finest bone fishing in the world or simply to relax and indulge, in what can only be described as a world class setting, Tiamo will not disappoint. We were both looked after incredibly well by the most hospitable of staff, who helped to create a relaxed and friendly environment. The delicious food, together with beautiful interior décor throughout, was all of the highest quality. Not to mention the exceptional view overlooking the most turquoise and calm of Caribbean seas when eating our breakfast each morning. After a mere couple of days, I really started to unwind and feel completely away from the rest of the world - not a car, road or town in sight! Tiamo, with everything it has to offer, really is the Caribbean at its best.

author: servo
title: Bone fishing paradise
text: Tiamo Resorts, South Andros Island, Bahamas Atlanta Res. 7-9-08 We just returned from enjoying 5 wonderful days of the Bahamian Island experience. I must commit on the outstanding bone fishing and our guide Alvin-the scenery and widlife viewing were great-but boating a bone fish on a fly rod is really special. We participated in all activities-sailing, kayaking, snorkeling, nature hikes and serious sunlounging-the activities staff was very knowledgeable and friendly. The snorkeling trips were unique and beautiful.The staff was very helpful and friendly.The food was very good and reflected the Bahamian lifestyle-one good note, if for any reason a particular meal did not appeal to you the staff would prepare one to your taste.Prior to our arrival we had two concerns 1 How would everyone respond to 18 or 20 strangers dining together family style? This was one of our highlights, we were strangers for maybe five minutes, And met very nice and interesting people. 2 How would we fare without a/c? The nights were beautiful and very comfortable one afternoon was hot so we went sailing.

author: blarsen
title: Absolutely amazing!
text: Tiamo is the perfect place for couples to get away from it all. This resort is truly spectacular; from the staff (helpful, welcoming and unbelievably friendly), to the food (gourmet all the way), to the accomodations (luxury boutique and earthy all at the same time), I couldn't say enough great things about Tiamo. The eco-concierge staff made our trip. There's sea kayaking, snorkeling blue holes, scuba diving, deep sea and bone fishing; you name it and you can do it here. We even went for a morning run with the owner, a staffer and another guest. What an experience and what a place. You won't want to miss Tiamo when you travel to the Bahamas and Andros is spectacular! You'll arrive a stranger and leave one of the family. This is a must do.

author: fiddlercrab71
title: Eco Resort that Means Resort
text: We have just returned from a glorious week at this out of the way eco-resort, where privacy, sun, water sports and really first rate food made for one of the best vacations ever. All bungalos are two person, screened and curtained giving a unique combination of feeling outside and being private all at once. Water activities (including bonefishing), hiking, birding and the like are available as you want them and in amounts that you choose. This is a place with strategically laid out hammocks that encourage just doing nothing if that's what you want too. The dining was superb - unusual when one eats from the same kitchen for a week. We continued to look forward to the next meal and were never disappointed. But what really sets Tiamo apart is the staff, warm, friendly, sensitive and fun. In short order they become like family, and they run the place like family. This is a special place to which we will return.

author: markjchambers
title: a special place
text: We have been to many "undiscovered" places in the Caribbean (St. John) and Bahamas (Grace Bay, Harbor Island) over the years and, sadly, most have been discovered and ruined to some degree. Ti Amo is a true example of development without destruction. It is a small resort on a beautiful empty beach with calm crystal-clear water. The staff is dedicated, the setting is intimate and you are sure to meet interesting people. It's pricey, but I don't know where you could find the equivalent for less. It's a place of quiet , but you can be adventurous, too. Snorkel, kyak, sail, explore.

author: HomecareLondon
title: Eco crazy
text: Whilst we admire what Mike and Petergay are trying to do here with an eco-lodge, solar power and a well constructed building that understood storms with 5" of rain overnight; we feel that living in harmony with nature is also living in support of the locals who live there. Not to maximise opportunities for the local community (80% of men on the island fish) and to import frozen fish and food which was at times inedible was missing one of the true treasures of the Bahamas. There was also a humiliating and embarrasing ritual each evening when the Chef's were made to come out the kitchen before service and announce the evening meal, it was acutely painful for the staff and guests alike. It is a beautiful spot and to include snorkling trips with excellent nature concierges showing us some marvellous blue holes with masses of fish, use of kayaks and sailing boats was a real plus. The bone fishing was fantastic with the most outstanding guide who appeared to know all the fish by name. The bugs were unbelievable one guest counted 40 bites on her leg from the previous night in bed, make sure you take all the necessary precautions including long trousers and burning coils. Whilst we were a little reticent to the idea of eating en-famille we met some wonderful people there and have not laughed as much since I was at school (again trying to work out what we are being fed). Tiamo is expensive but there are limited alternatives to staying in Andros which is a gem in the Caribbean. If you like the real Robinson Crusoe, snorkling, sailing and sport fishing this is the place for you but bring some epicurian snacks and a big cheque book .

author: lwayt
title: Fabulous Honeymoon
text: My husband and I honeymooned at Tiamo and had a wonderful time. Going to Tiamo you need to know off the bat that there is no air conditioning and it can be a bit buggy but if you love being in a beautiful setting with friendly people and are looking for a place that combines water activities, relaxing and excellent food and service then this is the place for you. Once we figured out we needed to use bug repellent then the bugs were no longer an issue. We never felt that we needed a/c because the rooms are well-ventilated. The snorkeling was fantastic and run by well-informed, friendly guides. We took advantage of the sailboats and kayaks as well as lazing around in the hammocks. We liked the communal dining and met lots of really friendly guests. Petagy and Mike are very down-to-earth and were great hosts. Perfect place for those who are looking for an out of the way Caribbean get away that has the elements of a resort (you pay a set price, have planned optional activities, great food) without being too resort-y.

author: KEWLBEANS
title: Disappointing, Over Priced
text: So, I was really excited about going up until we started experiencing issues with the resort's staff and our reservations. Turns out we weren't the only ones. I'm glad we had the experience, but the overall trip was pretty disappointing and the cost is WAY too overpriced for what you get. The local staff was very pleasant but the others really do not 'get it'. After reading the reviews I thought I was going to paradise. This place is NOT on an ocean, more like a lake, not exactly swimmable. The bugs were AWFUL (especially the large black flies). The accomodations were interesting but VERY unpleasantly hot (no a/c and not really a good ventilation system). I guess I would have had a better experience if I thought that the (non)local staff cared about making the experience a good one, but maybe we caught these guys on an off week!

author: gbreetz
title: As close to heaven as you can get
text: We opted to visit Tiamo based on friends who stayed in October for their honeymoon. We came with pretty high expectations and were blown away. Mike and Petagay have found the nicest, highest quality friendly people to work with. From the nature guys (Graham, David and Adam) to the bartenders (Samantha, Ulika and others) to the boat captains and other staff, they are all top notch. The location is idyllic. The beauty of the water, the beach, the mangroves, is as peaceful as it gets. The food is delightful and no need to worry about the lack of a menu or having to eat what they serve. They do an awesome job of accomdating their guests and the food is delicious. We could not have asked for a better escape from reality. Happy to talk to anyone about our experience.

author: CityDweller72
title: Exceeded our high expectations
text: The second we landed on the beach via seaplane we knew we made the correct choice for our honeymoon destination. Petagay greeted us immediately and we instantly felt welcomed. Our bungalow was perfect-no TV, air conditioning or other unnecessary distractions. We enjoyed numerous activities and Graham was a knowledgeable, patient and humorous guide. Eric and the kitchen staff were amazing. We are from Chicago and we’ve had the opportunity to eat at amazing restaurants. The food at Tiamo could hold it’s own against any fine dining restaurant in Chicago. The atmosphere created by the staff lends itself to good conversation and the ability to meet others. The story of how Tiamo came to be is amazing and we were in awe at the amount of hard work and dedication that went into creating such an amazing place-Mike and Petagay thought of everything. We plan to visit again and take friends with us so they can experience the beauty of Tiamo.

author: brandyandbrian
title: Tiamo is truly an island paradise
text: My husband and I just got back from a wonderful 4 day adventure at Tiamo. This place is wonderful. We went snorkeling in crystal clear waters, went sailing, spent a day fishing, and had plenty of time to relax and enjoy this magical place. If you are looking to get away from the real world and spend a few days in paradise, then Tiamo is the place for you. The bungalows are rustic, but luxurious in their own special way. The food is to die for (Chef Eric ~ you are the best). The entire staff is great and they will all go out of their way to make sure you have a great time. We will definately be back.

author: JFWI
title: Tiamo is a mindset
text: We went to Tiamo with three other couples for my 40th birthday getaway. Never has relaxing been so much fun. Guys fished a few days, wives snorkeled and the other day they dropped us off at our own remote beach with some punch, a few beers and some kayaks. We had a great time. The staff is excellent and the food is perfectly balanced. The low-key nature of the place and the private bunglows offer an excellent refuge to just unwind. We have travelled all over the islands and found this to be a jewel in the sand. Cheers to Tiamo and their helpful local staff.

author: Maps4563
title: It's not paradise...it's Tiamo
text: "It's not paradise, it's Tiamo" were the only words my wife Jennifer could use to describe what she was feeling on our first day at this amazing resort. And that feeling only grew deeper as our week went on. Tiamo is a very special place, created by people with a love and respect for their envirnoment, but with standards as high as the best luxury resort. I joked with Mike one night at dinner that I was not going to write one of these reviews, because I didn't want too many other people to know about this place. But, I can't help but share my views about this remarkable resort. Jennifer and I experienced blissful solitude, breathtaking snorkling, exciting sailing, invigorating kyaking, and spectacular dining. The guests are an ecclectic mix, and the staff are warm wonderful people. Kudos to Mike, Petagay, Chef Anna, Chef Jan (the intrepid captain), Susan, John (the biologist wannabe) and the rest of the staff. And, thanks for giving us the best vacation.

author: Roving37526
title: Peaceful & Beautiful
text: My husband read an article about Tiamo in National Geographic Traveler Magazine and surprised me with a 4 day visit for an anniversary present. It is everything it is advertised to be. The beach is beautiful. The bungalows are great and the king size bed is soooo comfortable. If it weren't for the beauty of the island, you would want to stay in it all day. The staff are all very friendly and very accomodating. The chef was terrific and made me special meals as I am a vegetarian. It is a beautiful, serene place and we highly recommend it if you are looking to get away from it all. Tiamo is a great place if you want to lay on the beach, snorkel, sail, kayack or just relax. If you are looking for shopping or a busy nightlife go elsewhere.

author: sandyatwitzend
title: Exceeded our Expectations
text: We've dined at the Mendenhall Inn many times, but this was our first overnight stay. With tickets for Longwood Gardens and Winterthur's Yuletide, we wanted something nearby, and this fit the bill. As someone who's extremely picky, I couldn't find a single nit to pick! Our king room was spacious and the halls were quiet. Bedding was so comfortable the husband slept late; we liked the pillows so much I ordered a pair for home. The bathroom was large, with plenty of space for toiletries. Housekeeping was top-notch -- the place was immaculate. And we were surprised by the choices offered in the Breakfast Room: from eggs with home fries and sausage to malted waffles, oatmeal, cold cereals and fresh fruit, it offered something for everybody. The price was right, and we felt we got good value for our money. Highly recommended!

author: tcodner108
title: Wedding reception and on-site hotel
text: We stayed at the Inn at Mendenhall for a wedding and we were very happy with the accommodations. The rooms were very nice, clean and comfortable. The mini-fridge and microwave were certainly appreciated since we were traveling with our 2 year old. The property is nice and the reception venue was gorgeous! Breakfast in the morning was wonderful and all of the staff from front desk to housekeeping and breakfast room staff were friendly and helpful! The only complaint is that you can hear EVERYTHING from the hallways! There is a lot of shopping around the area. We found the Kids Dream playground for an outing one day. Otherwise, a very nice stay for a family wedding!

author: 942CINDYC
title: A Great Find
text: We stayed one night at the Inn at Mendenhall as we visiting Longwood Gardens in Kennett Square. The hotel is located only a few miles from Longwood Gardens. It was our first visit to the Brandywine area and it was lovely. The room was recently renovated and was comfortable and clean. The staff was helpful and friendly. The breakfast included eggs, sausage/bacon, breads, yogurt, fresh fruit, juice, coffee, pancakes, and cereal. Overall, the price was excellent and we had no complaints. If in the Kennett Square, PA area, I would highly suggest the Inn at Mendenhall.

author: coombsfamily5
title: Near to Longwood gardens
text: We stayed two nights mid week on a visit to relatives in the area. We stayed on the 3rd floor of the newer bldg and were very impressed. We had a totally renovated room with two queen sized beds. The bathroom was nicely appointed with a wide range of bath and body works items. There is a reading room on the second floor that overlooks the reception area, and a very nice breakfast is also provided. We did not eat in the adjacent restaurant so we cannot comment on that. We would gladly stay at this location again. The breakfast room closed promptly at 9:30 am so please ask ahead to make sure you can get breakfast if you want to sleep in.

author: capecodken2015
title: Very Comfortable Hotel
text: We were heading back to Cape Cod from Florida and were looking for a place to stay on our trip. We booked this the previous night and our GPS had quite a bit of trouble finding the location "Mendenhall" or the Zip code. As we got closer to the hotel we finally found it in the "accommodations nearby" list. Hotel room was quite comfortable although could use some upgrading which they were doing in part of the hotel. Restaurant was attached although we did not use it. Breakfast had a wide array of choices including scrambled eggs with and without yolks, bacon, potatoes, waffles, pancakes, fruit, coffee, juices etc. Food was well presented and refreshed often. My only disappointment is the hotel was a good distance from the interstate which is great if you are visiting Longwood Gardens, Winterthur or one of the other local attractions but a bit of a ride on busy, narrow rural roads which add to travel time.

author: xLennaMae
title: Surprisingly good!
text: Ok, why "surprisingly"? Well, we expected rather mid-market comfort given the price and location in the "country". But it was perfectly lovely. Friendly and efficient staff. Large room, tasteful decoration, comfy bed, pretty grounds. Good coffee. Quiet. Full breakfast (eggs, sausage, oatmeal, fruit etc) included. Plenty of parking. And very convenient to Longwood.

author: HC7839
title: Best stay ever!
text: My husband and I just became empty nesters and needed s get away. We have always wanted to go to the Brandywine Museum and Long Wood Gardens. So I booked us a king room at the Mendenhall Inn. Couldn't have been better. Immaculately clean and well kept grounds inside and outside, Typical hotel breakfast, but included, Very comfortable beds and nicely decorated rooms. They are renovating the entire Inn inside and out over the next few months. I can't wait to see what it's like after that. If you have never been to this area, go and stay here. You won't be disappointed! Outstanding.

author: D9867CVsusanf
title: Clean, well maintained but in need of a renovation/refurbish
text: Lovely location, lovely staff, clean rooms, nice breakfast but - other than the lobby - the rooms and hallways desperately need a re-do. Lighting is poor in the rooms, the plastic shower insert is probably 20 years old, and a few of our towels were quite threadbare. I was surprised. The bar has apparently undergone a renovation and our first night, we had a nice young woman (Alicia, I think?) wait on us. The 2nd night - an incredibly rude man by the name of Robert. Unbelievably rude! I would have a hard time recommending this Inn to anyone. There were definitely pluses - as mentioned, but some whopping minuses.

author: maxw380
title: Very nice!
text: This is a very nice hotel. Quiet, very clean, classically decorated. The staff were very welcoming and helpful. Plenty of parking. Located very close to the tourist locations I wanted to visit: Winterthur, Nemours and Longwood Gardens. There's a restaurant which was just average. The decor was very nice, but the food was just average. The service in the restaurant was great, but when I tried to order from room service they did not answer the phone and not even the front desk could get them to respond to me. Other than that, though, great stay!

author: N8642MCamyr
title: Clean, comfortable hotel convenient to all of the area attractions
text: Staff was very accommodating and allowed me to check in early. Room was spacious and beautifully decorated and quiet. Due to heavy rains parts of the hotel had been flooded, but this didn't affect our stay in the least. Included breakfast had great waffles, eggs, sausage, and a good variety of cereals and breads. Coffee was excellent. Hotel is 10 minutes from Brandywine River Museum, 5 minutes from Longwood Gardens, and 10 minutes from Winterthur. Mendenall Inn restaurant is on the property and we ate there both nights. Beautiful dining room with great service and very fine food. There is also a casual pub available. We would definitely recommend this property to anyone visiting the Brandywine area.

author: TJH_03
title: Great Experience
text: We took a last minute trip to the Brandywine area, and stayed for two nights at the Inn at Mendenhall. The location is excellent - it's a few miles south of Route 1, and a mile or two north of the Deleware state line. Longwood Gardens, the Brandywine Art Museum and the Brandywine battlefield are very easy to get to. I could not believe that this hotel was under the Choice Hotels banner. From my past experiences, most Choice Hotels I've stayed at look great when you are getting the rate on-line, but I quickly realize at check in that I've gotten what I've paid for. Not so here. The property was well maintained, the room was spacious and clean, and the bathroom felt modern. The breakfast area was also much better than what I've experienced at other Choice Hotels (and yes, the pancake maker was rather cool).

author: Minimom7
title: ATTITUDE
text: Hotel itself is fine. Clean, rooms are average hotel rooms. Frig and microwave in room. The one problem was that my travel partner had a question about the television he just seemed a little snobby about his answer. I know the question was a little silly but hey...customer should at least feel like they are talking to someone who cares. I had noticed him on the phone earlier when we checked in and his attitude on the phone seemed kind of gruff. He just didn't have a pleasant attitude....like he wasn't very happy about being at work. Maybe he was just having a bad day.

author: RobinSue55
title: Pros and cons of a beautiful Inn
text: We found This hotel as an online special through choice hotels. It is very close to Longwood Gardens and the Brandywine Art museum. The Inn is older but well kept and very clean. The best part of this hotel was the staff. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. There is a " help yourself" breakfast bar where you can make your own waffles and pancakes. There are other hot selections such as scrambled eggs, potatoes, biscuits, gravy and bacon as well as cereals bagels etc. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely visit again when we are in the area.

author: Weez31_8
title: Good place if Visiting Longwood Gardens
text: This is a decent place to stay if you are looking for a rural location near Longwood Gardens. Rooms are clean and neat and of average size with usual amenities for business travelers. One main complaint if the walls are very think; you can hear conversations on both sides of you even with people talking in a normal voice. The dinner was good with large portions. Breakfast was a bit of a disappointment. For instance, flavored creamers were placed near coffee but never was plain cream or milk added. Perhaps I did not hang around long enough for the hot" food to appear. They only seemed to consist of biscuits from the kitchen and then people making their own pancakes. Overall, it was good for what it was - good location, inexpensive accommodations with meals available.

author: 628missyf
title: Ridiculous Policy
text: My husband and I visit Longwood Gardens yearly-- we love it. We were excited to find such a nice hotel nearby. A week before our visit, a snow storm was predicted. my husband called to cancel the reservation and the Inn refused. So now a school teacher and a mechanic are out $300.00 because we cannot make the 9 hour drive in the snow. That pretty much ruins anything we might be able to do on our spring break. We are SO VERY DISAPPOINTED. We would likely have come back year after year, but instead, we will recommend that our entire sustainable garden club NEVER make a reservation with this inn. The manager was a complete tool about the situation.

author: wheatonite
title: Quiet comfortable stay near Longwood Gardens
text: This was my third stay at the Mendenhall. It has become a very comfortable and convenient hotel when I'm in the area on business. The front desk manager offered to move me to a favorite room if I had one when he saw that I've stayed at the hotel on previous occasions. Nice touch. Rooms are very clean and well appointed;, the bed puts me into a deep sleep, a treat when on business travel. It's a short drive to Longwood Gardens and area villages. All wrapped up in a very reasonable price. Worth the stay when you're in the area.

author: johanneglavoie
title: Outstanding care and family values
text: I stay in a lot of hotels and the Mendenhall could have been one more small cozy boutique hotel with charm and a family feeling. What made it unique was to be treated with such personal care. I left my jewelry kit behind, with family memories. I only found out 4 days later. I called all hotels I had been (4) and felt like a number. At the Mendenhall, Victoria Harris, the manager listened, went the extra mile, found my jewellery and shipped them to me overnight. I received them (intact) the next morning and knew she cared. Being received and treated like a family member made the difference.

author: trishc2013
title: Lovely wedding venue
text: We had a wedding and reception at this hotel. It was a lovely outdoor ceremony followed by a wonderful reception. The food was delicious, the venue beautifully decorated. It was a great location where all the guests could reserve rooms so there were no worries about anyone driving home afterwards. The rooms themselves were comfortable and quiet despite the fact that two wedding parties and guests were staying there. Plenty of onsite parking. Hotel staff were VERY helpful especially trying to get us into rooms a little early so we could get ready for the wedding on time. They were also very patient with some of the silliness that went on (nothing serious, just laughable).

author: T0M_R_A
title: A quiet, clean, comfortable stay
text: A quiet, clean and comfortable stay within 10 minutes of Longwood Gardens. The area around the hotel is suburban residential and quiet. Our room on the 3rd floor was a nice size and well furnished. It included a king bed, 2 night stands, a chest of drawers, an easy chair, a luggage rack, a desk, TV, a microwave oven, a larger refrigerator, a closet with iron and ironing board and a safe, and an in-room coffee maker. The bed was very firm and comfortable, and the room was neat and clean. This appears to be an older hotel that has been modernized and updated. Carpeting, appliances, and bathroom fixtures all seemed relatively new. The complimentary breakfast included a wide variety of hot and cold foods, all very tasty!

author: MaggsMNewJersey
title: Disappointed
text: Our lower level guest room had a musty smell, and because of allergies, I knew it was not a place foe me. When we asked for a room on a different floor, we were told none were available. They would not refund our payment. To avoid being ill during our getaway, we left and found another room in a charmining small hotel nearby. I called Expedia through which I made the reservation and they were able to cancel the reservation for us. Hotel staff told Expedia they had rooms ... but that wasn't the story to us. Specify a room on an upper floor.

author: Kevots
title: New and lovely
text: We had not been here in a number of years and picked it for Sunday brunch due to midpoint location for meeting friends from Maryland. We drove right past it, as the old restaurant we recall is replaced. New building is lovely. Brunch was not the best we've seen but pretty close. Service was efficient and pleasant. Certainly not a bargain, but fairly priced for the quality and quantity. Would recommend it to others. Thanks.

author: houstonsue
title: Can't beat this one
text: We booked two rooms for a family get together, and we are glad that we did. This hotel is first-class, despite being a good value for the area. It is almost next door to Longwood Gardens, and the other major attractions of the area. It is in a nice quiet, scenic setting. The rooms are roomy, comfy, and attractive. The service is very friendly. We were amazed at the bargain prices we got when we ate at the hotel's informal Tavern. We ate on the night that they had half-price dinner salads, and we combined these with a happy hour special on carved roast beef sandwiches.

author: coolshop
title: This last minute booking worked out
text: We had a change in our road trip plans and decided at the last minute to go to Longwood Gardens. The Inn at Mendenhall was cheaper than the chain hotel alternatives and seemed to have good reviews, so we booked it early afternoon for a stay that evening. We were pleasantly surprised at what a nice little hotel this is. You can tell this place has been around awhile - the hotel hallways are slightly dated in style. But, the rooms are classy and also SPOTLESSLY clean. I don't think I've ever seen a hotel bathroom so clean before! Also the restaurant on site is pricey but absolutely delicious. We had a wonderful meal there (although I think we were slightly underdressed in shorts and tennis shoes). All in all this hotel was comfortable, and one that I would definitely recommend.

author: worrellrn
title: Lovely!
text: We stayed overnight after our daughter's wedding reception. Staff was friendly and informative. The hotel was spotless and well maintained. Our room was beautiful, clean and comfortable. There is an accordion makeup shaving mirror on the wall in the bathroom. Genius! Self serve hot breakfast was surprisingly good! Highly recommended.

author: Stacielynch
title: Attended a wedding and stayed ovwrnight
text: We attended a wedding at the Mendenhall this past weekend. It was a beautiful affair! We decided to spend the night even though we only live 20 minutes away. We are so glad we did. The bed was so comfortable. The room was clean and nicely decorated. And the nicest part was not having to drive home after the reception! An added bonus was we got to have breakfast the next morning with the bride and groom and their families.

author: T3922FHroberth
title: Equal distance to Winterthur and Longwood Gardens plus a nice place to stay
text: As noted this properties almost equip distant from these two amor locations. Sufficiently close to Kennet Square for meals. Although there is a restaurant on site we have been here often enough that while it is a fine place to eat there are alternatives within reasonable driving distance. Rooms are nicely finished and well kept and perhaps a notch above the standard hotel chains. TV selection is fairly extensive and the fridge in the room is quite large. One tip on the shower. Fire up the water and you say how to I make it move from the spigot to the showered? Answer, pull down on the small ring on the underside of spigot filling the tub. There is a small note on the spigot but you will need your glasses to read it - and you probably aren't wearing them at the moment. There is a free morning breakfast buffet and the woman working this service could not have been more pleasant.

author: chru98
title: Great Hotel
text: Stayed at the Inn for the first time and was very pleasantly surprised how nice and spacious the rooms are. We stayed on the third floor. They do have an elevator. Each room has a good size refrigerator and a microwave oven and coffee maker. The beds are very comfortable and the bathroom has a tub and the shower works great. They have a breakfast buffet with warm and cold items. The Inn is very centrally located, close to Longwood Gardens, Winterthur and Nemours Manion and Gardens, just to name a few. The staff is friendly and helpful. I would recoomend this hotel to anyone.

author: pennyl335
title: My favorite Longwood area hotel
text: Just returned from an overnight at the Mendenhall Inn. We went to an evening program at Longwood Gardens and decided to stay the night. The rooms are quite nice, always clean and the beds VERY comfortable. They have your typical continental plus breakfast in the morning. They have a nice restaurant, although we did not sine there this visit. But I did make a visit to their new bar. It is very nice and the staff quite pleasant. A nice place to stay in the Brandywine Valley area.

author: HarlanJF
title: In the Middle of Everything in the Brandywine Valley
text: I've stayed here twice before, in 2012 and 2013, whenever I was in this area. I like this place a lot. It is quiet, clean well kept and with an extremely helpful and friendly staff. This is one of the top two 'Ascend Collection' hotels that I have stayed in. Many are disappointing. The Inn at Mendenhall is outstanding. It has a large and comprehensive breakfast area with just about anything to eat that you could think of. In 2013, I had about 80 people here for a weekend with dinner and a meeting and not one person complained about anything. That in itself is rare. The food in the restaurant is very good also.

author: J3603MVtoms
title: mid-week stay
text: We spent one night here while visiting Longwood Gardens. The front-desk staff person was fine. The individual handling the morning breakfast area was superb, making sure no offerings ran low, cleaning, and bustling about. She asked a couple of times if everything was alright, and cleared plates away (even though it is intended to be self-busing). The room was clean and quiet (backed up to green space). The bed was exceptionally comfortable. We were nervous about staying here due to some of the negative comments from other travelers. Our exceptionally positive experience probably is due to the fact that we stayed mid-week and did not have to contend with wedding chaos and guests with too much alcohol.

author: 245DaveK
title: Timing is everything
text: We chose to stay here due to its proximity to Longwood Gardens but had we had some trepidation due to some of the reviews. Specifically those that dealt with noise and not so friendly staff. Those reviews seemed to be associated with weekend stays that were concurrent with wedding receptions and other large group parties where alcohol was abused. Those kinds of events are not pleasant for other guests and probably does set the staff on edge. However, we experienced NONE of those problems during our stay. Granted, it was a mid-week stay and so avoided party issues. What we did experience was a clean, comfortable room, (especially the bed!) polite and helpful desk & wait staff, better than average continental breakfast and no noise. We plan to return and time it for a non-weekend!

author: chemist2015
title: Close to Longwood
text: The Inn was quite clean and attractive although a little hard to spot from the road. Once there I was pleased with the room which offered free internet access and breakfast. The breakfast is the typical "free" breakfast type with an assortment of eggs and sausages, cereals, a "make it yourself" waffle machine, coffee and other usual breakfast foods. Seating is in two adjoining rooms or if the weather permits outdoors on a small patio. The parking was convenient although the weekend I was there there was a wedding also and parking was bit hard to find. The Inn itself is located only about one mile from the two places we visited, Longwood Gardens and the Winterthur estate. The inn keepers were friendly and helpful. All in all I would stay here again if I was passing though the area.

author: delorish974
title: If you are ever seeking a getaway with a wonderful ambience and sense of peace
text: This piece of serenity that graces this section of the great state of Pennsylvania is above and beyond what we thought when we booked our room at the Inn. We did a lay over on our trip home to Pensacola, Florida. We were pleasantly surprised!! The Inn still had the historic feeling if you will but with a modern twist !! We walked the grounds enjoyed the calm and quiet it was a dream for us away from the hustle and bustle. The staff from the front desk to the back door we met him bringing boxes!!!! Was a cut above professional, helpful and friendly. Downtown is the same these folks don't meet strangers.

author: 303BarbM
title: Longwood Garden Christmas weekend getaway
text: We have stayed here before and it has been exceptional. The rooms are comfy, cozy, clean was well appointed. We love the bar and usually have our meal there and a cocktail or two. The bartenders are extremely attentive. We love the Chadd's Ford area and would love to stay here in the summer, but it is hard to get a reservation from June on for weekends due to this inn hosts lots of weddings and books up fast. We will try and make a reservation for Easter, however. Full hot breakfast in morning is always appreciated and is complimentary. This is a wonderful Inn.

author: joanng5
title: Nice change!
text: We usually stay on the Wilmington DE. side of the attractions we love to visit but this time decided to change it up some as rates were higher(most likely due to schools beginning in that area)at a hotel we truly like in WIlmington. Inn at Mendenhall was a great find! Mid week quiet, very very clean, since it was not full staff assigned rooms every other down the halls which was considerate.Towels were of good quality. Had not been in a hotel that gave you excess real drink glasses or mugs in sometime!Even the morning coffee selection was better than average! Free breakfast was more that the usual fare with not only small pancakes but also waffles that were 4 to a serving(small nice!).The staff were really swell, helpful. THere is a very good restaurant on sight which was quite busy with local people but we choice to go elsewhere. We will return!

author: H5419CNlisap
title: Highly recommended / Great stay!!
text: Wonderful experience. Our room was perfect and the bed was really comfortable with soft pillows. Quality standards. Great variety of choices for our breakfast which was included. Staff was very friendly. Our stay included dinner at adjoining restaurant and the food was fantasic. Our table was very romantic and the staff was friendly and helpful. The snapper soup was amazing!! We had a great weekend. Highly recommended.

author: RegenMan
title: Vintage out of the way hotel
text: This is a very nice hotel off the main roads. Nice rooms and the staff was very friendly. Free Wifi and free breakfast and a very good price make this a bargain. I do ding one star for the breakfast. Processed re-heated scrambled eggs, one meat - sausage of unknown origin and perfectly cubed processed potatoes. There is ample parking but it is a hike to the hotel entrance. There is a very nice restaurant and bar directly across from the hotel entrance. Sunday brunch is very nice.

author: Wishniki
title: Beautiful rooms
text: We chose the Inn at Mendenhall for an overnight stay when our first choice turned out to be filled. We now have a new first choice! Everything about the Inn speaks of quality and charm. And the room rate could not have been more reasonable. Our room was on the road side but you'd never know it because it was so quiet. Check-in and out were streamlined for efficiency. Every employee we encountered was gracious and total professionals. We had to be on our way and didn't stop to try the breakfast, although we plan to do that the next time we stay.

author: gh788
title: A Lovely Hotel, highly recommend!!
text: Enroute to a wedding in N.J., I booked a 2-nite stay with a guaranteed late arrival at The Inn at Mendenhall because in searching, it's close to the Longwood Gardens (site of my side trip in the journey) and looked comfortable. Due to a (borrowed) misguided GPS that was programmed to avoid toll roads and highways (why??!?!?!), and very stormy weather, it was quite late...ah quite early in the wee hours of the morning by the time I arrived. And I was so tired, I could barely see... The Inn's host at the time of my arrival could not have been nicer, more helpful or more welcoming. He helped me get luggage out of my car, onto a cart and then deposited in my room. Once in my night clothes, I toddled to bed and sank into total comfort. Upon waking later, the first morning there, I discovered my room to be very nice, very comfortable and clean and roomy. Everything about my stay at The Inn at Mendenhall was superlative ~ and I highly recommend this as THE place to stay if you're in the Brandywine Valley...convenient, safe, excellent, comfortable, clean....superlative!!

author: HarlanJF
title: A Hidden Gem
text: The Inn is a delight! The location, right in the middle of the Brandywine Valley, makes it easy to get to anyplace you want. The rooms were clean. The staff was professional and most helpful. The breakfast was complete. You couldn't ask for much more. The on-site restaurant also had very good food at a reasonable price. If you plan on coming up or down this way, this is a great place to stay.

author: 01ritz
title: A Weekend Away for a Family Wedding
text: This was a lovely hotel and very nice rooms. We had a king size bed room. The room had a small refrigerator and a microwave in the room. The bed was very comfortable and very clean. Hotel staff was very pleasant. They have a breakfast buffet included in the price. Nothing great here in that department. The basic cereal, bagel, toast, scambled eggs thing. You help yourself kind of buffet comparable to most hotel chains that are 3 star.

author: carolej542
title: Brandywine Area
text: Spend two nights at this hotel. It's well run, clean and my room, a double was large. Their breakfast was outstanding. Not only did they have a waffle station, but a pancake station, oatmeal, sausage, eggs, etc. Coffee maker in the room (which for me , makes any hotel room, a standout!). Did also eat at their in-house restaurant. All I can say about it is one word, outstanding! Service was perfect, food was excellent. One negative is that it is an older property, but they do their best to make it here and now.

author: egallag
title: Very nice
text: Just completed a two week visit back home with a few nights at the Mendenhall. The Inn at Mendenhall is very nice. The decor is a bit dated and the layout of the Inn is odd but overall it is clean and well appointed. Check in was easy and they allowed us to check in early which was nice. The room has a microwave, fridge and a nice size flat screen TV; room service is also available which is a nice touch for the price. In addition to room service and an onsite top notch restaurant the hotel offers free hot breakfast, served on actual plates with actual silverware :). It is a little out of the way but is a nice quiet spot and you can easily access local attractions. The only thing that stood out as not a good thing for me was the parking and the ability to easily load and unload your vehicle. Because of the odd layout of the property parking was a bit of a walk and no easy place to park to unload your car.

author: cds_SanFrancisco
title: Quiet room, comfortable beds
text: We stayed here for 5 nights on a business trip. The bed was comfortable and the room quiet. There isn't anything fabulous about it, but it worked well for us. You have to have a car, as location is fairly remote. The restaurant at the hotel is good and has a pretty varied menu. Breakfast was so-so. More than a continental breakfast for sure, but not a lot of healthy options, like whole grain bread for example. They did have some fruit and yogurt and the waffles are good, but not so healthy.

author: stargazer7777
title: convenient and comfortable
text: Hubby and I stayed one night in January for a short getaway. The hotel was a pleasant surprise and good value. The room was nicely appointed with new furnishings and linens, all the hotel staff were friendly and helpful, and the location was quiet yet very convenient to local attractions such as Longwood Gardens, Brandywine River Museum, etc. The price included a buffet breakfast with the usual coffee, scrambled eggs, cereals, yogurt and more. They have a cozy tavern and full restaurant onsite. We had cocktails in the tavern (which offered some free munchies) followed by dinner at the restaurant. The decor is charming, the food excellent and the prices reasonable. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

author: likesshortgetaways
title: Convenient for Longwood Gardens
text: I chose the Inn at Mendenhall because it is part of Choice Rewards and because I had stayed at an Ascend Hotel in San Francisco. While not as posh as the San Francisco hotel, the Inn at Mendenhall was clean and quiet. We only stayed one night but the bedding was very clean, very comfortable! We enjoyed having breakfast in the morning. FYI - it ends very promptly at 9:30 I believe. We got there rather close to the end time and the eggs were just about gone and were not refilled. But that was ok, there were still waffles to be made and numerous other choices. Check-in was easy, checking out even more so. We will definitely return to the Inn at Mendenhall!

author: AlwaysTraveling765
title: Good Choice!
text: Was driving south, and ended up being without a hotel due to a convention in town. I called and the desk clerk was very nice and helpful, and I got the last room. When I arrived, well after 1 am, he gave me a deal on the room, since the night was part way over. He was nice and friendly. Room was very clean, bed was very comfortable. Slept in the next morning, and the area/room was very quite. Was an excellent find for this very tired traveler. Would stay there again!

author: Atcruiser
title: Well appointed, beautiful location and great rooms.
text: Loved my stay here! Very nice spacious rooms. Great room rates. Quiet peaceful atmosphere all around. Breakfast options ok, nothing fancy. I'd highly recommend this hotel if staying in this area. Staff were nice enough but didn't seem overly anxious to talk. Restaurant across from hotel very fancy and great food. Bar area was more laid back.

author: dar019
title: Inn-like atmosphere with large hotel amenities
text: After a very long and tiring day at beautiful Longwood Gardens we traveled about five miles to the Mendenhall Inn, Chadds Ford, for a good night's rest. We weren't disappointed. What a find. What appeared to be a smallish inn turned out to have a huge ballroom, pond, a wonderful restaurant, nice sized rooms and outstanding service. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the usual noise from an inroom air conditioner was non-existent, and the hallways were quiet (although there were wedding guests and others at the hotel). The restaurant had a piano player, great service, excellent food and a warm ambience. The complimentary breakfast was ample and well prepared. We will return here the next time we travel through the Brandywine Valley.

author: kzatrini
title: Between Average and Poor
text: I called the Mendenhall and asked for the group rate for a wedding I was attending there. They gave me a rate of $140. Then I looked up the rates on the internet and it was around $110. Guests of large weddings are supposed to get a cheaper rate, but it turned out this hotel is charging more for groups than the standard internet rate. That was very disappointing. The room was clean, nice size fridge and microwave, but nothing special. The banquet room the wedding was held in was very nice and the food was good. The Inn was hosting 2 weddings that night and when I returned to my room after the reception I found about 10 people drinking Bud Light in the hallway by my room. It felt like a college dorm and was about as quiet as a college dorm.

author: Heth25
title: great wedding venue nice rooms
text: Recently stayed here to attend a wedding. We stayed for two nights. We were pleasantly surprised how large the room was and that we had a refrigerator and microwave. The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. They had a crib in the room for our daughter before we arrived. The reception held in the large ballroom in the back was more than exceptional. The food was awesome, the staff was friendly and the location was beautiful.The breakfast which is included was excellent complete with an omelet station. All in all we had a wonderful experience.

author: 361JohnA
title: Home away from home
text: I and many members of my family have stayed at the Mendenhall many times over the years and have always been welcomed. My mother lives nearby and I stay there each time I visit. Although I only stay there two to three times a year, each time I arrive, I am greeted personally by name by the front desk staff. The rooms are nicely appointed and the complimentary hot breakfast is excellent. They make omlets to order and have a wide selection of other choices as well. The restaurant and bar are excellent as is the service. I have had several longer stays there and have found the hotel to go out of their way to be helpful and accomodating no matter what my needs. To my mind, this is the best place to stay while in the Kennett Square/Chadds Ford area.

author: Greygoose_1965
title: Great Place
text: Came here for a retreat with my wife of 10 years and wanted to see Longwood Gardens at Christmastime. While checking in, we met David, who was a very likable guy who knew the area well. He routed us to Half Moon Saloon in the next town over and then to a great place in West Chester called Iron Hill Brewpub. We also liked that David told us to check out Lancaster, as my wife is really into quilting. He mentioned Bird in Hand, which turned out to be a Godsend, as my wife walked away with 3 quilts. We did enjoy the restaurant at the hotel, but we wished it could have been better than advertised. Must highly recommend this place, and the staff is very friendly and professional. The train coming by a few times was a nice little touch, as was the church right across the street from the hotel. This hotel is a total great find and David was truly what made the trip worthwhile and made this a destination for my wife and I.

author: polajoy
title: Outstanding
text: My girlfriend and I stayed at the Inn for one night and had a beautiful room. Clean can't describe the room or the hotel in general. Everything was spotless. Had, as part of the price of the room, an awesome breakfast in their small dining room. Omlet was prepared to order along with a greaat buffet selection. Went to the Longwood Gardens for the afternoon and early evening and returned and went to dinner in their restuarant next door. Amazing food, exceptional service. I would highly recommend this place to anyone and in fact I have done so last week,

author: HugeTraveler111
title: Mendenhall Inn-AVOID at all costs
text: We had a large group involving a wide range. The staff went out of there way to let you know you are being watched and they had the power to remove you at will. Upon leaving the bar at 11:30 pm I was met with a disturbing glare and a most unpleasant face. I am 56 years old and have not had an issue with any authority in my life. Several of the people attending were US Marines, good enough to fight for us in the middle east but not stay at the mendenhall. The manager evicted them with extreme prejudice. The manager was overheard using an awful curse when he became aware they were marines. I have 2 daughters that we are planning weddings. Mendenahll won't be considered.

author: sst03
title: Newly renovated
text: I recently stayed at the Mendenhall Inn for a business meeting and was pleasantly surprised! The photos on their web-site had not been updated so my expectations were low to say the least. When I arrived the front desk staff was very friendly and informative. My room featured windows that actually opened to enjoy the fresh fall air as well as a large flat screen television and a beautifully appointed comfortable queen size bed. The bathroom, as was the entire room, was very clean. The Inn features wireless internet service in the rooms. I enjoyed the breakfast that was included - made to order omelets and a buffet spread that had standard offerings. I enjoyed my stay and would stay here again. Be sure to head up the street to Buckley's Tavern for dinner - yummy.

author: Peabody1117
title: Great service and a lovely hotel.
text: The Mendenhall Inn deserves its No. 1 rating. I doubt that there is a better hotel within 20 miles. We stayed at the Mendenhall for three nights. The staff were perfectly attentive to any needs. The restaurant was very nice quality and the food was well prepared and presented. There are often bus tour groups staying at the hotel, so beware of tourist class groups. All in all, we found the Mendenhall to be a great place for a home base for touring and antique shopping in the Kennett Square-Mendenhall-Chadds Ford area. I would gladly stay there again and would recommend to friends without reservation.

author: T1995GHalans
title: OK Hotel, Nothing super
text: Stayed at the hotel for 3 weeks with work. Firstly, the parking at the hotel is not free (This is normal for the US I hear) The hotel is located beside a railway line so ensure you get a room on the opposite side to this or you will be woken. The rooms themselves are a good size and kept very clean by staff. The staff themselves, are very nice and friendly. There is a small gym on site also. The breakfast at the hotel wasn’t to my taste so skipped it a lot. There is however a little shop on site which is handy. All in all, would I try to stay here again, probably not.

author: NanM862
title: They gave my room away I had booked for 3months.
text: I require a handicap mobility accessible room. I had a room booked for 3months. Got there and they had given my room away. The put us in a hearing accessible room with a bathtub. Would not work for me. Will never stay there for any reason!! They need more accessible rooms. Gave me a bad taste for Residence Inns If there was a way I’d rate this place a zero!

author: scottfI2371GY
title: Great location in the middle of it all, but quiet
text: First of all, yes, there is a train that runs by this hotel. But I can say I never heard it once even though I was in the parking lot when it went through. They don't blow the whistle when they pass through. The drunks in the hall after the rodeo made more noise than anything else. The hotel rooms are nice and spacious. The breakfast was good. Parking could be limited, but they had plenty of spots left even though the hotel was pretty busy. The bed is comfortable and the amenities are all great. I would stay here again in the future without hesitation.

author: TheAboutExperience
title: Great place and great location
text: This place was great to stay at considering the location was within walking distance to the Montgomery Plaza and Crockett Row shopping area. The hotel is located next to a retirement community and condos so the neighborhood is extremely quiet in the evenings and traffic is light since the street leads to a dead end. Our room was very well cleaned, maintained, and spacious. The bed was extremely comfortable and the kitchen area was large enough for several adults to occupy. The staff was friendly and helpful for example, our ice dispenser was not speedy in dispensing ice so I called the front desk to see if there was an ice machine I could access. Was told unfortunately they do not have ice machines but if I came down stairs he would get me some. So I went down stairs and he immediately went to the staff kitchen area and brought me a HUGE bag of ice and said if I needed more just to come down and he'd get more for me. That was just awesome of him, I just wish I could remember his name to thank him. Needless to say, if you are looking for a great, quiet, close to shopping areas and restaurants, and super clean place to stay near downtown Fort Worth this is the place to book.

author: karihrubes
title: A happy place to stay
text: Just spent the weekend at the hotel. Everything was spic and span, staff was always helpful and cheery. Our room With King bed and open floor plan was spacious and very clean. This hotel is ideally located and a short walk to tons of restaurants. Definitely would stay here again. My only complaint was that they did not have decaf coffee as part of the breakfast menu. Staff quickly brewed a pot for hubby and me but one would think decaf would be available. On the day we left the kitchen finally had a carafe available during the breakfast hours.

author: marianacarter22
title: Amazing
text: I loved the stay there! The suite we had was perfect and so beautiful! My favorite part is the pillows! I want whatever kind of pillows it was. Totally comfortable. The staff was awesome. I didn't get to take advantage of the free breakfast but loved that there was one. Also location was perfect for us because it was only about 14 minute walk to 7th street to hit the bars so didn't have to worry about driving and parking. Would definitely stay again

author: elephantastic7
title: Would stay again, perhaps without the dog
text: This was my second stay here this year. The room was perfect - clean, comfortable, stocked with standard amenities. We were able to cook breakfast in the morning, which was nice. The bed and pillows were to my liking and the shower was hot with good water pressure. Staff was friendly and loved our puppy. I knew they charged for parking, but I was surprised at the $100, non-refundable pet fee. I expect pet fees when we travel with our dog, but this was much steeper than I would have thought. If I had known beforehand I may have reconsidered, especially because we were staying only one night. Overall, I still really like this hotel, and would stay here again, though perhaps without the dog.

author: R6213KHjenniferr
title: Easy Access to Museums, Downtown, TCU, and Stockyards
text: Fine for overnight stays. Bright and inviting is their lobby. Warm and friendly is the registration desk. Clean and well staffed they are during their complimentary breakfast buffet. As for their one bedroom balcony suites ... Pros: nice size and colorful sitting room; wonderful large balcony for morning coffee and reading; good WiFi; well equipped kitchen; comfy bed ... Cons: strong cleaning odor when we first stepped in; nasty spots on worn out carpets; rusty shower head; noisy air conditioning; thin walls and ceilings; hearing outside traffic. Things to consider if staying here next: 1) suite/room on top floor only; and, 2) book a studio if we want a king-sized bed! Happy Travels Y’all!

author: 501blc
title: Perfect location!
text: Stayed here over the Easter weekend. The location is fabulous - walking distance to so many things! The staff was friendly, polite and helpful. The maids did an amazing job of tidying up after our first night. Love the crisp, white bed linens - slept like a baby. The room was a great size and layout - but maybe a little worn. The ice maker didn't work and the bathroom light was one of those where a fan comes on and is absolutely deafening. Aside from those (very minor) issues ... I recommend this hotel and wouldn't hesitate to re-book here in the future.

author: MaclayB
title: over priced, mediocre management
