text: Stayed at the hotel for 4 nights in January, total of $850 including $8 per night parking. For $200 per night, we expected a superior place but it was not. We requested long in advance a top floor in a quiet location. At check in, they tried to give us a first floor and only offered a second floor as an alternative. Room was ok but a main light bulb in the kitchen was burned out and the bathroom fan didn't work. No luggage rack for suitcases. We had to tip a cleaning maid to find us two of them. Breakfast was poor: at the "included breakfast", no butter and they often ran out of coffee, the eggs were from a mix and were dried out and tasteless, etc, Have had better at a Super 8. BTW, it's on "Museum Way" but is 1.5 miles from museums.

author: dirkbjr
title: Good location in downtown Ft. Worth, near shops, restaurants and park
text: Tucked away a couple blocks from 7th street on Museum Way in Ft Worth, is the Residence Inn. There are a number of shops and restaurants in easy walking distance, including Montgomery Plaza. It is also apparently a popular place for runners. There is a park nearby and there were lots of joggers around. The hotel was less than a couple miles from the convention center. The parking fee at the hotel is very reasonable, $5. The staff was very good and they readily accommodated my early check in. The room was clean and comfortable. The pool and hot tub were operational and the hot tub was actually hot (not all of them are). The free breakfast was reasonable.

author: kikitup
title: Wonderful
text: Very nice, clean and spacious room. Great value and parking was very reasonable at $5. Nice cozy pool and fabulous hot breakfast is included. They sure need more than one waffle iron. Everyone loves a Texas shaped waffle. On weekends the wait is long. The staff was wonderful. Friday night it rained hard and the front desk girl went to her car to loan us her personal umbrella. I wished they had their happy hour mixer 7 nights a week.

author: Psyd8vee
title: Great place
text: I had a family emergency and stayed here between trips to the hospital. Staff were very friendly and accommodating. They serve an exceptional full breakfast. The room had a kitchenette with a freestanding compact refrigerator/freezer, sofa with ottoman, coffee table, free wifi, and desk. Very comfortable living space if you had to be there for an extended time. Gym is outdated, but I made use of what was there. It's in a prime location. I never want to return under those circumstances, but I would definitely book again.

author: trauts10
title: Best kept secret in Fort Worth
text: Have been here for business a couple of times. I travel about three times a month for work and have to say this hotel stands out thanks to the amazing employees as well as clean and spacious rooms. Every single person I've interacted with on both visits have gone out of their way to be amazingly pleasant and make sure I feel welcome. Tonight, I checked in and the woman working the poolside free dinner invited me to join them outside before it closed. She was so kind and it smelled wonderful. I dumped my bags and joined other poolside diners enjoying an amazing meal and free beverages. I would also say the cleanliness of the rooms has to be one of the best I've seen. There's also a workout room with the treadmills (my machine of choice) as well as a lobby-side snack-for-purchase area. If you're staying in this area of Fort Worth, you can't do any better than this hotel. This is my new Fort Worth base!

author: austinf245
title: Really Bad Service
text: In general a nice facility, but extremely poor service. Felt like they were understaffed and overwhelmed. The fIrst night the AC unit went out in our room. I alerted staff at 2am and they replaced batteries in the thermostat. That didn't solve the problem and the room temp kept going up. Was told "there's nothing we can do for you. The hotel is fully booked." I asked for a fan or something to help cool the room down from 84 degrees but was only told I would have to deal with it for the night. I was assured maintenance would fix the problem in the morning, but returned at 4pm the next day and maintenance hadn't even been to the room. Also lots of small problems like missing door handles on main door into the building from the back parking lot.

author: bobdobilina
title: Bathroom Issue
text: There was a lot to like about this hotel. The location seemed good, amenities were strong, rooms were very good in a Residence Inn way, service was friendly. Unfortunately we had a bathroom issue that was not addressed, explained or even apologized for. There was a constant buzzing sound that came out of the bathoom (like an electric toothbrush or razor). In addition the hot water in the shower was very inconsistent (I'm pretty sure the two were inked as a the buzzing appeared to be coming out of the shower fixtures). Apparantly some other guests in our party had been given this room and moved a day later after complaining. So in addition to them I registered the issue politely with the front desk on consecutive days, but other than being told maintenance will look at it there appeared to be no attempt to address it, no feedback on the issue (if maintenance did look at it), no apology, or attempt to address our discomfort (sleep and a good shower being probably the 2 most important aspects of a hotel toom). Take this review with a rain of salt, as i suspect most folks will have a perfectly good stay. Just watch out if you get rook 441 or have an issue they are disinclined to address.

author: E2702VKericj
title: Platinum Marriott Member Review
text: Room is ok but away from downtown. Have to pay $5.00 to park which is bizarre and a hassle. Have to come in and then return to car with a red paper to put on dashboard to keep from being towed. Workout room is very small with one running machine! I tried this hotel out but as a platinum member I won't return. This is franchise owned hotel by a very cheap company not representative of Marriott's. Don't recommend. Stay at the Courtyard Downtown as a much better experience. Happy hour is very thin as well with a small bowl of salsa and a bag of chips to share. Very cheap owners who will not have my 15 to 20 night a year I have to spend in Ft Worth for business.

author: rokb2013
title: Adequate Place and Conveniently Located
text: The room is roomy, but much appliances are outdated. The bathroom had problem of getting hot-water. I had to request the service to fix it, and it was done in prompt manner. The breakfast is as average as any other Residence Inn, still the most important thing is that it is situated near to-go Restaurants. In the meantime, I did not expect Parking Fee, but apparently, there was. Most of all, I really liked the heated pool. Please try. The gym is too small by the way.

author: BeckyK180
title: It's a good choice all around
text: You can't go wrong with this choice. Great area, lots of place nearby to eat, in the museum district with some great events. The hotel is warm and comfortable. The rooms, spacious and clean. Pros: good breakfast, good wifi, staff was great, ample parking Cons: near the railroad tracks, so if you are a light sleeper, you may hear the train. Also, the hot water never got really hot. It was warm enough... just not hot.

author: susanj354
title: Nicely solid and predictable
text: Location was a major factor in opting to stay here. We were not disappointed. It is wonderfully close to lots of good things. Room was clean, nicely furnished, and included a most respectable breakfast. The exercise room is very limited. So don't be surprised if your plans for a run don't materialize as there is one treadmill. Our only 'gripe' was that our reservation confirmation did not indicate the additional fee charged for parking on the premises. Not a big deal. But deserves mention as one proceeds through the payment/confirmation process. To be told "it's on the website" is not a satisfactory explanation as multiple paths to reservations exist online.

author: shellyb255
title: Not worth it
text: Know that you are paying so much for the location & the Marriott name. I stayed here for one night, $200. The rooms are so small as is the fitness room. It's in serious need of cleaning & updating. My shower wasn't even clean, had soap scum in the soap tray & I was disgusted by an actual shower curtain. People have their dogs with the & while I was waiting for the elevator, a woman came with her huge dog on a leash & I kid you not, the dog started smelling my butt & she just laughed! You pay $5 a day for parking & that doesn't even guarantee you a spot, people were actually parking on the curbs! Don't bother with the one bedroom, that's just a normal room with a wall. The only thing this hotel has going for it is the complimentary breakfast, yes you even have to sit with dogs to eat.

author: mikebR7367JE
title: No parking
text: I arrived late last night. There was no parking available. The manager told me to just park on the curb. Park on the curb??? I saw people parking in handicap spaces ( without the handicap stickers) and along clearly marked fire lanes. The manager on duty told me they don't have enough parking when they are sold out!! So safety goes out the window. There is a parking structure next door with parking but they advised me my car could be towed. Seem like if they cared about guests they could arrange for overflow but they don't. Oh on top of this there is a parking charge on your bill.

author: anacQ2132YE
title: Surprisingly lovely
text: We arrived in the rain and had to dash in. But the lobby was open, bright, beautiful and inviting. The staff were helpful and welcoming, too. The hotel is modern and has a modern boutique hotel feel. Our room was very comfortable, nicely decorated, and the full kitchen was so convenient - traveling with food allergies requires that you bring some of your own things to make. Everything we needed was in the kitchen - fully equipped for reheating and prepping full meals. The small sofa area was very relaxing. The only drawback was the loud A/C unit - it startled me out of sleep every time it came on.

author: Dianna_G
title: Miserable experience! Beyond Belief!
text: Will never stay at this Marriott again! Take your business somewhere safer! Used Marriott points to stay one night while seeing friends play at the Magnolia Motor Lounge! So, Marriott front desk employee asked for our credit card for incidentals. We have our credit card set up for text notification on all credit card charges. 10 minutes after getting to our room, my husband exclaims "Marriott just charged us $1380!" The front desk had no idea, no suggestions, didn't offer to do anything--the response? Marriott employee: "I don't know why". Employee Didn't check to see if she could have entered the wrong room number and we paid for someone else's room, didn't offer to call the business manager, the manager....nothing! So, 1/2 hour at the front desk the day we checked in, 1/2 hour with the credit card company, 1/2 hour with a different person at the front desk that evening, 1/2 hour with the front desk the next morning....priceless experience! And no follow up from the local manager....stay at your own risk!

author: donnaw996
title: A very nice hotel/suite for the money
text: We recently stayed in the downtown Fort Worth area and we chose the Residence Inn Fort Worth Cultural District due to it's location to several areas of nearby sight-seeing. The hotel was conveniently located to several walking distance restaurants as well as a Target to stock your kitchen if need be. For our down time, we chose to visit the Stockyards and the Sundance Square areas. The room itself was great. Kitchen area well stocked with utensils, pots and pans, and dishes. Air condition was cold and the beds at Marriots are always great. The price was very good for the area we chose. Would highly recommend to all travelers.

author: billf76
title: Very nice, clean quiet hotel
text: We were looking for a decent place that was close to downtown but not too pricey. We decided on this Residence Inn and we were not disappointed. I is a great location within a quiet high rise apartment neighbor hood only 5 minutes from downtown and the cultural district. Great places to eat are within walking distance. The parking is tight so I would advise getting there early to acquire a place to park. The hallways are so wide and spacious. It is a large property but clean as a whistle. Staff was very friendly.

author: mmf40
title: Clean and quiet room, convenient location
text: Enjoyed the new look. It's clean and modern while still comfortable. On a business trip with my husband. There were no studios available two days out so we got a one bedroom, same price. My only, but big complaint is that with renovations the bed is now higher and the flat screen TV remains on a lower cabinet. You have to sit completely up in the bed to see the TV. Management, please put something to raise up the TV, don't overthink it, just put a 6 inch platform between the cabinet and the TV. Mounting on the wall will make the room even more of a tight squeeze. Otherwise, staff was very friendly and helpful. Will return, but will be sure to get the studio.

author: JoAnn1942
title: Second time around is still sweet
text: we stayed at this property 5 years ago, going on to state parks in the pan handle of Tx. We used our "free" night to stay here, just hoped it might be as nice as we remembered. This is a glorious property, up scale in every way, we were not disappointed. The associate that really helped us, leaving for Houston,, was Jeff, the front end associate. Gave us some directions and then came over to give us more, as the exit was closed that he first told us to use.. We took advantage of the social hour, so we did not eat out, but lots of restaurants close by. Really special, as we are seniors, and expect more than we should, and we were NOT disappointed. Thanks!!!!!!!!!!!

author: deb-5584
title: Quiet place in the middle of a busy city
text: This place is a gem. Close to everything you can dream off. Restaurants within walking distance, park is right in front of the hotel, and lots of shopping area. Even though the hotel is next to a railroad track, I didn't hear any train in most of my stay. Check in and out was a breeze, the room was big and clean. Oh, I forgot to mention the fruit drinks they provide in the afternoon when we get back after a long work day is so refreshing. A plate of cookies just another icing on the cake. Breakfast were plenty also evening social on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. I definitely will stay here again!

author: mctrvl
title: Great location with a jogging trail close by
text: This hotel really is in a great location. Less than 2 miles form Kimbell Museum, minutes from downtown. What I appreciated was the Trinity Park running and biking trail just steps away for a morning jog. I found out it is very close the the botanical garden on my morning run. The free breakfast is the normal although I did like the yogurt and granola cups. It is walking distance to a very pleasant restaurant area around 7th street in the cultural district. Made it nice to be able to walk to a evening dining experience Rooms were very comfortable. Paul Mitchel shampoo and conditioner is a nice touch

author: FindTheBeachNow
title: Nice property in a good area
text: Nicely maintained property, clean rooms & located in a safe area. Rooms a bit smaller than other Residence properties however they are not small & kitchen is well stocked. Friendly staff. Good breakfast with oatmeal, waffles, eggs, meat, bagels/breads, yogurt parfaits, & fruits with take-to-room containers (a nice option if you have someone who sleeps in). Housekeeping did a great job. One negative; not enough parking spots so staff advised to park on the curb & display the permit or risk a car tow. We were in the area strictly to visit The Stockyards & this hotel was close (only about 15 minutes away). Lots of museums & restaurants very close to the property if that is your reason to visit. We traveled with an 8 & 9 year old and would stay again at this property.

author: karinf175
title: Unpleasant check in
text: I think the renovations helped update this hotel. No more leaks in the halls. My room was a nice suite, comfortable bed and breakfast was good. This hotel is used as an extra bedroom as my parents live in the senior center across the street. They arrange for guests to stay at this residence in almost every month. At $200 a night it doesn't take long to have some healthy bills paid for by a 94 year old patriarch. However, they have changed their way of checking people in and instead of being able to call in his card to pay for the room, they made him drive over, bad knees, walker and all. This seems to me to be very poor business treatment for a long term customer.

author: 10sChick
title: We loved everything about it!!
text: Couldn't have been happier with our stay at this Residence Inn. We had one the smallest rooms you can get (a King Studio), and still it was very spacious, decorated beautifully and had an incredibly nice kitchen with a full refrigerator, dishwasher, stove and microwave. It was a great little open floor plan apartment that someone could easily live in for an extended stay. The hotel itself is very new in a happening part of town not far from West 7th, the trendy eating and shopping area of Fort Worth. There are a few nice bars and restaurants within quick walking distance, but the majority are 6-8 blocks away (still walkable if you're so inclined). The lobby is beautiful and the complimentary breakfast is quite extensive with hot and cold options. Plenty of free parking in well lit lots. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

author: Geenza
title: Still smells new...
text: Nice place... Our first room only had a queen bed and, I swear it bounced when you tried to subtly change positions. 8/ Once we moved to a different room, life got better. The light switch in our bathroom had a short. We reported it, but nothing happened. All in all... Ok stay. Great location as many restaurants within walking distance.

author: HouTexGal
title: Clean and convenient
text: We've stayed at this location a couple of times in the past year. Each time we've stayed in a suite which includes a kitchenette with all appliances. The rooms have always been clean and the staff are friendly and helpful. This hotel includes breakfast which has both hot and cold options. There are a number of dining options within walking distance of the hotel. There is also a super Target across the street to purchase groceries for meals prepared in- room. Only complaints are the pool is extremely small and gets crowded at peak times, parking can be difficult to find when the hotel is booked to capacity, and there is a railroad track adjacent to the hotel with trains coming thru during the night. Light sleepers should request a room on the opposite side of the hotel. Also, this hotel allows pets, so if you have pet allergies be sure to request a non- pet room

author: MNEAustin
title: Great Location, Mediocre Facility
text: Super close to much of what you're going to want to see on any trip to Ft. Worth but not up to Marriott's standards. We did stay on graduation weekend when it was sold out and full of families there to attend TCU graduation events. But that doesn't excuse the toilet that didn't flush well and ran constantly even after the front desk was alerted right after our check in and it was supposedly fixed. Cooling unit sounded like a jet landing in the parking lot outside the window and at 5 am we were awakened by a neighbor talking on the phone next door in a very normal tone of voice ... but we could hear every word. On the good side the included breakfast was more than fine ... though there weren't enough tables for people to sit at.

author: U333DAroberth
title: Family Gathering and Farewell
text: We had a gathering and celebration of life ceremony in Ft. Worth, the staff was most accommodating to all of our needs. Rooms were initially clean (later comment), beds were comfortable and appointments were very adequate. The location is nearly perfect except it is inside a one way development, which adds about 3 blocks more waling to about anywhere you might want to go, advantage not any road noise. Travel time to all the museums and venues around west, Stockyards and Downtown very easy and quick. Only complaint which was sort of understandable, we had to ask both days for the room to be made up. We had the hospitality suite which is sort of part of the conference center and somehow we were not on the agenda. Now on both occasions they immediately took care of it and were apologetic. No big deal!

author: JoellE175
title: Renovations made our fresh suite delightful!
text: They have clean fresh new renovations of their suites. They are still bringing in new furnishings, but have finished the dusty part of the work. We complimented the management for not having a perfume scent in the lobby, or anywhere. Perfume seems to be an unhealthy trend in hotels. There is ample parking, but their van seems to take up loading space at the entrance. Their comp breakfast was above aveage with both hot and cold items. Their coffee was good and "thicker" than most. (We are used to Louisiana Coffee.) We were very satisfied with this hotel.

author: JAR59
title: Another fabulous stay
text: This is an excellent Residence Inn primarily due to the wonderful staff. Everyone is helpful and friendly especially Sergio and Erica at the front desk They always ensure that my reservation is in order and my status is recognized. Theresa at the breakfast area is absolutely wonderful! She makes every effort to make everyone feel welcome and keeps the dining area well maintained. The " Texas" waffles are a nice treat. As a frequent business traveler I really appreciate when a hotel makes me feel so " at home" when I'm on the road. The hotel is also in a good location for restaurants and has a park across the street. This is my favorite Residence Inn.

author: PamelaH839
title: nice service and great location
text: This hotel is in a great location / the 7th Street Cultural District of Fort Worth. Can walk to great restaurants, bars, great park and running path across the street. We stayed in a Queen Suite / very comfortable and they had extra pillows waiting for us. Nothing super fancy but nice. The front desk staff was very friendly and there were good h'ors d'eouvres and cocktails in the evenings. The breakfast was above expected, full breakfast hot and delicious all included. The kitchen in our room was a full kitchen and the suite has a couch and television. Nice clean pool and hot tub too. Would stay again.

author: CharlesH44
title: Home away from home
text: I stayed at this Hotel for 351 days. From day one I felt at home. Everyone made me fell like family. If I where to mention names I would be afraid of leaving someone out. I thank you all for an outstanding job taking care of me. I also have had at least seven other co-workers stay at this hotel and not one of them could say anything bad about the staff, hotel or location. I would like to say thank you to each and everyone of you at the Residence Inn Fort Worth Cultural District. Everyone I dealt with daily was awesome. Everyone from the Cleaning Staff, Front Desk Staff, Kitchen Staff and the Management Team went the extra mile to make me comfortable and happy.

author: KirkW574
title: Right Place, Right Price
text: Uber convenient. Nice enough. Big enough. Reasonable price. In the heart of the Cultural District, easy to get downtown to Sundance Square. Does what its supposed to do. Warning: the pet charge of $100 is a fee, not a deposit. You do not get it back, regardless.

author: leroys73
title: Probably a 4+
text: Very nice and clean place. Staff was friendly and answered any questions we had about the near by area. My wife and I stayed here for two reasons, first it was close to the Kimble Art Museum which we drove to and my wife had enough credits for a free stay. Oh, parking was free. Also the Residence Inns are usually, if not always nice. We could walk to several places to eat. There is a park across the street. I would stay there again without giving it another thought.

author: BethB888
title: Perfect location, staff
text: We recently spent the weekend hosting a wedding in the Cultural District of Fort Worth. We had over 70 guests renting rooms here, including both out of town guests and locals. This hotel could not be better located for anyone wanting to be near the museums, 7th Street area and downtown Fort Worth. We had the first floor hospitality suite. It was perfect for our after reception party, with a separate party room, and a remote location. The room was clean, and afforded plenty of room for our guests. The bedroom portion was spacious and well appointed. The best part of this hotel is the staff. We encountered some transportation problems on Friday night (not related to the hotel) and the staff stepped up to help us. They were pleasant to everyone, helpful and professional.

author: TrojanGal
title: College road trip
text: Love the location. Convenient for TCU. Nice Mexican restaurant in walking distance and Montgomery Plaza across the street has tons of restaurants, shops and super size Target! Rooms are big and clean. Nice outdoor pool. Great staff! Definitely will stay here again! Great value too!

author: renosteve
title: Great gathering place for family
text: Eight of us were in town and this hotel and it's location was perfect. The hotel has a large "living room" off by itself. Bring your wine and cheese down and visit with family. The room was good size and bathroom spotless and well appointed. Our room included a small kitchen area and separate livingroom. Not much of a view but there is a park across the street, which was a nice unexpected bonus. The front desk staff was very helpful and the breakfast each morning filled us up for the day ahead. We'll be back!

author: KidInfiniti
title: Really nice Residence Inn
text: We stayed here on an overnight trip as a family. We had 2 rooms across from each other. We enjoyed our stay. I had a small dog which cost me a $100 non-refundable deposit. I was ok with it. The hotel is very expensive but nice. Breakfast was excellent. Great selection and no, I repeat no noisy crowd. Hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. Our rooms were quiet, clean, well appointed, and comfortable.

author: JPMTRAVELLER
title: OK- ok location but can't walk anywhere
text: This is a solid Residence Inn- just what you'd expect from any Residence Inn. Location is okay--- note that it is NOT downtown. It's close, but separated by several bridges and rivers. I initially thought we could walk to things but you really can't. It is in an area that they seem to be refurbishing/ building up. So, a mix of brand new development (unfortunately with a lot of chain restaurants,etc) and old buildings which seem to be either abandoned warehouses or run-down bars. The route from the freeway to the hotel late at night was a little sketchy on some small dark streets with old bars,etc. The area immediately around the hotel is large apartment complexes, with another one going up right next door- didn't see any construction noise but there could be some. Overall a decent place, but note that it is not downtown- if you want to walk out your door to restaurants and bars,etc. this is definitely not the right place.

author: larryb49
title: just right
text: very nice room with full kitchen and friendly staff. there are food supplies available in the lobby 24 hours and the place is spotless. Shopping including target supermarket in walking distance and plenty of eateries. Downtown is walking distance for the fit. I walked from the station but would not recommend that for most people. nice breakfast room with good variety, coffee, fresh fruit. (please disregard my ratings below. the software seems to be buggy and kept putting terrible in every category)

author: 8BillA
title: Great location and service
text: Stayed 4 nights early March for daughter's dance competition. It was a great location for us, Close to Will Rogers Auditorium. Lot's of great restaurants close, also there is a Target very close to get groceries, etc. Beds were ok but my only real complaint is the pillows, they have like 4 of these 1/2 size pillows on the bed. We stayed in a 2 bedroom suite for 4 people which was perfect. The complimentary breakfast was great, They even had it ready early on the weekends so we could grab something before the dance competition. They had breakfast burritos 2 days and biscuits and gravy 1 day, also had waffles, fruit, bagels etc. Also was close to downtown and only about 15-20 min from Stockyards. I would definitely recommend staying here, especially if you have an event at Will Rogers. Also my daughter and her dance company used the heated pool at night which was great.

author: Timbarter
title: Great location Friendly staff Unreliable shuttle and Taxi service
text: Stayed here and Loved the Staff and Location. Shuttle service is the only low point not reliable and should be considered not availible a majority of the time. They offer a free Taxi when its thier fault but the taxi will not take anything but cash and 2 times refused to take us even we waited for 20 minutes or longer each time. Taxi service refused hotel vouchers and will not go inside to the front desk. Shuttle has a 5 mile limit but takes several 1 hour trips a day to a work site several miles a way for a client and this leaves them availible only limited hours in a day and was useless most of the time. do not rely on any shuttle service or free Taxi offers. They also removed weekend shuttle service recently and so plan on walking. Staff and evening socials are fantastic and Rooms are very clean and Property is kept up very well. Pool area was redone and is very nice. Everything else was awesome and would recommend the rooms and staying there.

author: FloridaTourist_12
title: Good not great
text: Location is great. Hotel was a little better than no e but not fantastic. Bath tub was stained dark but rooms are overall very nice. No special treatment for elite member. No recognition at ck in no paper at the door and no bill under door at ck out. Gym equipment is old and worn and needs replacement. But they do give u a pass to LA Fitness up the road. Breakfast was decent as was dinner. Nothing fantastic

author: CurtT212
title: Ft Worth Nice Stay
text: The hotel was clean and located right next to Trinity Park which is great if you want to walk, jog, or bike. Staff was friendly, but a couple of times the guy at the desk seemed too busy with phone calls to answer a question when I stopped at the desk. So I think they may need to have more than one person at the desk during afternoon hours (4-8 pm) when people are checking in and also coming in from business meetings back to their room. I'm also noticing at my last two Marriott Residence Inn stays both in Orlando and here the free breakfast quality is not as good as it was about 2 years ago with a lot less choice. At least please bring back the REAL bacon! Also noticed at my last two Marriott Residence Inn stays they no longer provided lotion. Not a big deal, but this particular hotel also didn't provide the foldup suitcase stand which is pretty basic in even 1-2 star hotels I've stayed at. When I asked about it the desk I was told the hotel had just never provided them. So I had to put my suitcase on the living room coffee table to unpack it. Recommend the hotel think about providing these suitcase stands.

author: oldcpa
title: Close to the Fort Worth Art Museums
text: We choose the Residence Inn due to its location, close to The Modern Art Museum. We were there to see the Lucian Freud exhibit. The hotel is only a short drive to The Modern and also the Kimbell and the Amon Carter. Check in was quick and easy. We had requested an early check in and this was no problem. Our room, on the east side overlooking Trinity Park was clean and spacious. The bed was comfortable and the extra feather pillows we requested were there when we arrived. The complementary breakfast provided a good selection of both hot and cold dishes. Check-out was easy and our statement arrived by e-mail. The Residence Inn will by our choice when we're in Fort Worth.

author: KCTripster
title: Great value near plenty of night life and downtown
text: Very courteous staff, clean property, close to many restaurants, shopping, and things to do. The room was comfortable and clean. There is some construction nearby, but no related noise on our stay during the weekend. The train was quiet as it came by and generally ignorable, especially if you're used to much louder distractions. It was nice being within walking distance of many restaurants and trinity park. The workout room was sufficient, nothing fancy...but if you need more a few days pass to LA Fitness is available (also within walking distance). The hotel is on a dead end street with a bunch of condo/townhomes so traffic is light in the immediate area. Downtown is within walking distance, although the first half of the walk didn't have much shade so in the summer it's a bit toasty.

author: TalGuy
title: Exactly what you should expect
text: This hotel met my expectations. Their front desk staff was extremely efficient and courteous. As a hospitality professional myself, it was readily apparent to me that management places an emphasis on customer service. My room was precisely what I expected. Breakfast was the same - not great food, but right on par. Workout room is a bit small, but empty every time I walked by. Plenty of well lit and convenient parking. Fantastic location in Fort Worth.

author: cosmotron
title: Great stay - will return
text: We stayed for the weekend and definitely enjoyed our time here. I booked a one-bedroom suite and requested a room on the top floor based on previous reviews about noise from having neighbors above. Yup, just hearing footsteps pounding overhead from the first floor (while waiting for the elevator) confirmed that it was a great tip. Noise seemed to be the only negative for me, so -1 star: Loud noise from doors slamming constantly, and the freight train that woke me up at night. Still, there were many positives for this hotel so I’m not sure I would rule this place out for a return visit – I may just wear earplugs next time if the train’s whistle really bothers me. Pluses: Great location; friendly staff; very clean and well-appointed rooms with nice touches (e.g., equipped kitchen, bag of microwave popcorn); easy parking; good breakfast (e.g., cereals, yogurt, bread/bagels, hot oatmeal with assorted toppings, scrambled eggs, sausage patties, potatoes, pancakes, various hot and cold beverages); and coffee and other beverages available all the time. For those who care: The fitness room is available 24 hours and holds 2 treadmills, adjustable bench, and set of dumbbells – that’s fine just to do a “maintenance” workout at the hotel but there’s always outdoors! Residence Inn has other amenities such as use of bikes, a pass to LA Fitness (on 7th Street – very close), golf clubs, racquets, basketballs and soccer balls – so there are other ways to get your workouts done. We’d stay here again!

author: anniefield
title: Comfortable large rooms, great kitchens
text: Stayed here for a few nights mid September. Fantastic sized rooms, brilliant, well equipped kitchen area. Quite a few restaurants/bars within walking distance and also a Target which we used for last minute drinks and food items for when we were too tired to go out one evening. Free parking, free breakfast, free internet. Friendly staff. Room was cleaned very well each day. Used the shuttle to go a restaurant one night which was driven by a great guy called Brandon or Michael, I think. Would definately stay here again.

author: RichardL843
title: Nice hotel to stay
text: I took a business trip to Fort Worth and book a suite here for two weeks. The room is very clean and the bed is comfortable. Furnitures, TV and refrigerator are in great condition. I am very glad to find a fancy clock with ipod dock on it, so I don't have to worry about charging my iphone every night. The staffs are very friendly. The breakfast has lots of choices, as well as the happy hours. The room service is very nice too. This is great hotel with a decent price, I would definitely stay here again if I have another trip to fort worth.

author: fonsqatar
title: Fantastic
text: Fantastic hotel/residence in a fantastic location. I have been touring the US for 3 weeks now and been to a wide range of hotels/motels and this is by far the best one, at a very competitive price too. $119 is the weekend rate and if you compare it to the $109 I paid in Super8 in Austin, it is an amazing rate. The room was a king size, with kitchenette and sitting area. Comfortable mattress in my opinion although I do like hard mattresses. The property was spotless. The hotel has also got a nice swimming pool and a fitness area sufficient for my treadmill run in the morning. It took me 10 minutes to get to the Stockyards by car and it's 3 or 4 minutes from the downtown. It is definitely the place to be in Fort Worth.

author: djtimmy
title: Good hotel, good location
text: Stayed here multiple times in 2009, for 30+ nights. Nice clean hotel, good layout. Staff was always very friendly and helpful. Occasionally had noisy guests over the weekend (one weekend in particular was very bad) but for normal business travel it was great. Very close to a Super Target for inexpensive groceries, and close to a lot of restaurants, not to mention the museums. Adjacent to trinity park, good for a nice long walk. Would definitely stay here again. Occasionally would hear a train but never disrupted my sleep.

author: Mohsman
title: Better than average hotel near Museums
text: Stayed here two weekend nights while visiting Ft. Worth with my wife. Had our two small dogs with us. The hotel was very bet friendly and charged $100.00 pet fee for the entire stay (regardless of length.) Room was clean and better than average. Small TV with no movie options. Typical Residence Inn kitchen. Bathroom had broken toilet seat anchoring bolt. Breakfast was average, with decent variety of cereals, meats, juices, etc. Hotel had a very nice sitting room off the lobby and a nice barbecue area and pool. I would stay here again were I visiting this area of Ft Worth again.

author: gogrammygo
title: The Perfect Place to Stay in Ft. Worth area
text: Our daughter lives near Ft. Worth, so we visit regularly. We always stay at this hotel. The staff is SO friendly and helpful. The breakfasts are great. Our 1-bedroom suite is always clean and comfortable. This property is located very close to downtown yet in a quiet area where you can get a good night's sleep. We will not stay anywhere else.

author: findthefairway
title: Only one flaw we could find...wish they'd "put it to bed"
text: My wife and I spent the 4th of July weekend here. The location is excellent...the staff is friendly and welcoming. The place is very clean. The only real issue we had is the bedding. The hotel is 5 years old..or so, and apparently the original bedding has never been replaced. We are used to most Marriott family properties having really decent mattresses, etc....but ours was way too soft and you tended to roll toward the middle. If your partner moves at all, you feel it....way too bouncy and just plain worn out. The last morning I happened to ask the front desk clerk the age of the property, and was told "5 years"....when I asked if the bedding had ever been replaced, she said she thought "that was next". So, I certainly recommend the place...as long as they've replaced the bedding. Also, there were a lot of dogs being taken in and out, and for pet owners, that's great, but I would very much prefer to have a room that has never had animals (non-human ones anyway) in it.

author: Mlogs
title: Feeling at Home in the Residence Inn
text: The property staff were kind and professional. The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable. When compared to other comparable hotels, I really have to say Residence Inn has always proved an excellent option. The hotel in addition to the normal amenities, has a worth while breakfast and dinner spread, at no additional cost. For those who enjoy Miller Light (I am not one) you will be happy to know that it is also served on tap gratis with dinner. My only complaint was that my room did smell slightly of smoke. I cannot blame management for this, as the property is 100% smoke free. If some idiot decides to go against the grain there is little they can do until after the damage done. Further, the property did promptly change my room and apologized for the frustration. Bottom line: I would not hesitate to stay here again.

author: NorthWalesMolly
title: could not have been any better
text: Stayed at this hotel for 7 nights and WHAT A FIND. Ideally situated for travelling north, east, west or south of Texas. Complimentry buffet breakfast served daily was just the ideal start, and on Monday through to Thursday there is also a complimentary mini buffet between 5.30pm-7.00pm with drinks (wines/beers included) which is excellent. The rooms are mini suites equiped with a mini kitchen so if you want you can cook in, the suites are of ample size for a couple and ideal for a family as the sofa in the lounge area is also a sofa bed. The pool area is very clean and they also provide towels. Just minutes away from the hotel is a small plaza which contains a magnificent store called 'Target' which sells food and everything else. We flew into DFW Airport at 10.30pm and picked up a hire car, not having been to Texas before we found the hotel very easy to find. Travelling on the interstate highways was very, very easy as long as you know whether your going north,south, east or west, signposts on the highways are easy to read, however watch for the exits as you can be driving along and not realise the lane is an exit lane and off you exit as well. I would DEFINATELY, DEFINATELY stay at this hotel again.

author: tripleff
title: Nice bike trip stop
text: A/C worked well, which is a plus this time of year. Staff is very nice. Rooms are small but functional. Location in centre is great. Good morning breakfast. Free wifi but limited to one device. Free bike storage. Near many restaurants.

author: Mmarymomm
title: Traditional hotel in the city center
text: The good - Wifi was good. Shower stall is always a plus. Bed comfortable. An excellent value. Great location for seeing Portgruaro. Breakfast was good. Staff was nice. The less good - Noisy outside and windows needed to be open. Little tricky to find as it is in a pedestrian zone.

author: Andersen1961
title: Simply perfect
text: A quiet spot near a beautiful river. Nice room with very comfy beds. Very clean. Friendly staff. Very easy parking. The best breakfast I ever had in Italy, simply great quality. A nice town centre for a stroll right outside the door. To be highly recommended.

author: voyagesetmirages
title: The go-to place in Portogruaro
text: This is a wonderful place, lots of charm, right in the city centre. It used to be very expensive, and just about the only gig in town, hence the haughtiness and general lack of friendliness of the staff. I used to be that only VIPs could afford to stay there. Now inflation has caught up with its prices and although not cheap it is affordable. I guess foreigners would expect friendliness and good service, but here people do not cater to tourists; they have a rather cursory attitude than that and they do not feel they have to make an effort. This said, I stayed here several times and when I have guests I usually put them up here. They have renovated rooms, with new bathrooms -- you may want to ask for those rooms when you make your reservation. Also, Thursday morning is market day, and the hotel sits in the centre of the market. Which means that sellers will wake you up at an ungodly hour on Thursday morning, it's kind of inevitable. If you want to sleep in on a Thursday, you are better off reserving somewhere else…

author: maggic
title: Unpleasant welcome
text: We stayed here on our cycle trip. After a long enjoyable day on the bikes we arrived and were greeted in a grumpy fashion. The reception could not have been less helpful. We asked for a drink in the bar but were told no you can get a beer in your room fridge. We asked where the nearest bar was and were directed in a cursory fashion up the road to a bar that had closed. After that he pointed to the centre of town and said try there. Great little town but hotel needs to up its ante in terms of reception. Rooms are clean and tidy and of reasonable size.

author: fionaw145
title: Great hotel, lovely town
text: The hotel was right in the middle of this lovely town. Great location. Hotel was great, rooms looked as though they had recently been renovated. Everything was in tip top condition. Lovely bathroom. My one comment is that we were staying in a room on the upper floor - kind of a dorm room. The window was very high up so we could not look out the window at all. Since we were staying just one night it was not a problem, but you may request a room with a window you can look out of. Free wifi, great breakfast, nice hotel staff.

author: JoJef
title: Fabulous location
text: This hotel is located right in the centre of the picturesque town of Portogruaro. The location is perfect and just minutes from local bars, restaurants and cafes. There is also a huge market in the town on a Thursday which we were lucky enough to see. Our room was of a reasonable size, had a great modern bathroom, a mini bar and overlooked the main street (we booked an economy room). It was spotlessly clean and comfortable. The breakfast was of good quality with plenty of choice and the breakfast room was fairly quiet on the 2 mornings we were there. The only negative point I have was the restaurant, cafe and bar in the hotel were closed due to holidays during our stay. I found this rather odd, I am fairly well traveled and have never come across this before.

author: Jennifer947
title: Great food, lovely staff
text: We recently stayed at this hotel for a few days with a group from the UK. The staff could not have been friendlier. So helpful and welcoming. The bedroom was a little on the small side, but really quiet and the bathroom was an excellent standard and I would guess had been re-furbished recently. Hotel is situated really conveniently in a quiet area but close to shops and bars and some pretty areas. Highlight though, was the food! Beautiful flavours, really good - (memorable plate of parma ham, and a seafood risotto). Nothing was too much trouble in the restaurant to give an alternative if you couldn't eat something in particular. Great waiter in the restaurant and he, the chef and the general manager came and greeted us at the end of our stay. They were given well deserved applause.

author: hoohoolian
title: Great, BUT...
text: I arrived at Hotel Spessotto quite angry. It seems that they are on a one-way street that the city recently decided to keep as a one-way street – in the other direction!!! To get there, I drove on the sidewalk, much to the anger on many church-goers. It’s pretty hard to be happily impressed immediately upon arrival when there is steam coming out of your ears, but Spessotto is beautiful. Flat out: everything had the look and feel of a hotel 2-3 times as expensive. The bed, Furniture and Bathroom were very nice and the hotel lobby is better than most. Parking is good if you don’t have the wrong GPS trying to make you go the wrong way. There seemed to be plenty of life around the hotel, but it was just a transition stopover for me, so I didn’t get out.

author: Canadian_Girl613
title: Everything you could need
text: The hostel is centrally located and it is easy to walk to most main attractions. Staff was friendly and offered maps and walking tips. Room was spacious and clean with daily cleaning. Bathroom also a good size with good water pressure in the shower. Good access to wifi. Only very minor problems - No one buzzed us into the building when we arrived for checking after ringing the doorbell 8-10 times, and this seemed to be a problem for many other guests arriving who did not yet have the access code/key. Being centrally located, it is also quite noisy at night. People were screaming outside the window until 3-4am while we were there but this is something beyond the control of the hostel.

author: Mazio
title: Good comfort, excellent location
text: The hostal is at the first and second floor of a building in a calle which is basically in the very centre of Madrid, the location is really excellent. There's a lift. The reception was correct (I don't think the receptionist is always there, so be sure to tell them the approximate time of your arrival). Room was small but not impossible, the bed was comfortable and the bathroom's furniture and tiling above the average (although... not very practical). Air conditioning worked fine. Soundproofing against noises coming from the outside should be better, because the street can get very noisy. Overall, I would suggest it for someone who wants to visit Madrid without spending too much and without having to take bus or metro to reach the main attractions which are basically at a walk distance from there.

author: mrantsi
title: Location, location, location
text: We stayed here for five nights at the end of August. As the headline says, the location of this hostel is great: Puerta del Sol and La Latina are just five minutes away and the subway is a couple hundred meters from the door. There are also a couple small grocery stores just across the street. The hostel itself was OK, the staff spoke English and were very friendly at all times. The rooms are very small indeed (at least for five nights' stay!), but the air conditioning is just awesome: we had temperatures as high as +33 degrees, but the room stayed nice and cool. The room was also decorated nicely. One big downside of this hostel is that their walls are thin as paper! You can hear conversations from the neighbouring rooms and the corridor all the time since the walls let all the noise through! The traffic didn't bother at all, though. BUT since the price per night was only around 38 euros, I'd consider this hostel to be worth the money.

author: markilee
title: GOOD ACCOMMODATION - EXCELLENT LOCATION
text: The room was spotlessly clean – newly decorated, but very small. Comfortable bed. The bathroom was too small, very difficult to get in and out. Excellent location, close to shopping, cafe, restaurants and tourist attractions. Only 2 minutes to Metro. Wide stairs and a good lift. Nice helpful staff, some with limited English but could still communicate. We were there for 3 nights, being out and about most of the time we found it good value for money.

author: AgnieszkaL556
title: too small room
text: I chose this place becuse of the price and not expected nothing special, but even I was prepared for basic accomodation. it was too basic. Ver, very small room - I work in hospitality sector on Poland from more than 6 years and never, ever seen that small room for 2 people. My bed was blocking the bathroom door, so my friend must jump every time, she need get to the bathroom. In bathroom was destroyed the shower. We asked for extra set of keys (two times) and needed waiting for it many hours. Also it was problems with undestaning the regulations translate into english (translations were probably made by google.translate and it was not good). Staff was not very helpful. Very big PLUS for the location - close to bars, pubs, bus and metro stop and main Madrit' atractions. It was quite a clean in the room and was free wifi, working perfectly.

author: carlavleite
title: Very very comfortable but tiny!
text: The room was very very comfortable: the mattress and pillows were viscoelastic! When we arrived the bath towels were swans shaped. lovely! Though being in an old flat, the interior was modern. The lift is small, it's for 3 average-sized persons, nothing else. It was easy to sleep, even with street noise. The bathroom was tiny but clean! You should learn some spanish before arriving, because the staff's english is not always easy to understand.

author: bex_09Manchester
title: Exactly what we were looking for-cheap, clean and great location
text: I am writing this review from my room as one of the perks of Hostal Naranjos is complimentary WiFi. My boyfriend and I have spent 4 nights here and would certainly return. The exterior is tired and we were wary on arrival. The owners are very helpful and friendly despite the language barrier.The rooms although small, are modern and very clean. The bathrooms are equally tiny but they're private and at £25 a night we weren't complaining. Walls are thin which was the only minor drawback but after a few cervezas sleeping was no problem! The location is perfect, a 10 minute stroll from Sol and a 2 minute walk from the Tirso de Molina tube stop. We have absolutely loved our time in Madrid and it's highly likely we will be back, booking Hostal Naranjos without hesitation!

author: namnam75
title: Good Clean Hotel
text: The hotel room was clean and spacious. Bathroom very clean. Excellent shower. Breakfast very good. The view from their terrace restaurant is breath taking....especially at dawn. Staff friendly and courteous. However there was hot water kettle, no tea, no water or coffee in the rooms (which is usually on the house). This would make a difference for people who wake up early and like a up of hot tea, coffee or simple plain water.

author: Dreamer33107948349
title: Horrible
text: Horrible Staff.Breakfast has no variety same every day. Rooms are small. There was a cigarette in the toilet, staff tried to cover it up by opening up the window when we first opened the room. Pillows were ripped.No garbage can in the room. Lighting very dim. Bad WiFi, false advertising. Lastly, when we complained to manager he cursed me and my family out. Do not go there save your money

author: shoaib291282
title: Not worth it! Could be good if they fixed everything!
text: Our party comprised three Architects on a regular business trip. We booked three rooms advertised at 18sqm each (paid higher rate than the 14sqm option). On arrival were we provided one 18sqm room and two 14sqm rooms. Despite being architects with measuring kit to hand, the front desk was adamant our rooms were of the correct size and tried to brush us off by showing an even smaller option. The showers have been put in without U-bends so sewage smell is constantly present. They routinely cover up these drains with floor towels. The ventilation fan didn't work in one of the rooms. The Wi-Fi internet in rooms rarely worked, let alone at speed, although in the lobby it was fine. Breakfast was weak at best, with no basic service and a limited spread. The hotel overall has charm, is well located and the rooms cleaned daily but I would not recommend given the current problems.

author: vian1031
title: Great Location, Odd Room
text: We stayed for 4 nights. Loved the location as this is a short walk to Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. You can also see both at the rood deck area, however it is too hot during breakfast at the roof deck where breakfasts are being served. If the hotel can close off a portion or half of it to give consideration to those who doesn't want the sun it would be a lot better. We booked a standard or de luxe room, the price is reasonable. Its just that the design is really odd giving us very little room to move around. Bed was pushed to the wall so it is not very comfortable if you are sleeping on the wall side. But overall if you want a great location, and actually service is good as well, then this is it.

author: helen190729
title: Sight seeing visit
text: Very good location with a good view of Hagia Sophia and blue mosque from the breakfast terrace. Clean room, and ours had a balcony , but very small, with little space for storing clothes. Our balcony door didn't close properly, the air con switched itself to cold most times and the toilet didn't always flush. The breakfast was very disappointing , and the staff not particularly friendly or helpful English language was not spoken in the breakfast area. The reception staff are not friendly. I have stayed in other hotels in Istanbul before where reception couldn't help enough. Not the same here unfortunately. The rooftop terrace bar was not well stocked and we had to wait 20 mins for them to go and buy beer, which was served warm. I would not stay here again , I would choose the hotels I have stayed at previously. A good location but too many other negatives.

author: dawoodj295
title: An amazing little gem in the most perfect location
text: From the moment we stepped into the hotel we knew this was going to be a wonderful stay. Sinan the receptionist is probably one of the best hosts I have ever had. We got a free upgrade straight away. His knowledge of the city and the places to visit and eat was perfect. The rooms were nice and well maintained and the showers in the bathroom were awesome as well. One of the best rooftop cafes in Istanbul with some amazing views day and night of the blue mosque and hagia Sofia. The breakfast was decent, with some good selections but one thing I would recommend is ice for the fruit as it gets wayyyy too warm. All in all, amazing place to stay and When I go back to Istanbul I'll be staying here again.

author: Siddked
title: First Trip to Beautiful City of Istanbul !
text: Hotel Burckin is located perfectly in midst of old city of Sultanahmet. Easy access to Blue Mosque, Sophia Hagia and World renowned GRAND BAZAAR. Hotel ambiance is nice, clean and adequate size room. Few rooms having splendid view which I fortunately didn't had chance to stay. Food options very limited and even on paid breakfast I didn't had chance to devour it. You have to rely for outsource for food. Tram station at arms length and all type of authentic food restaurants within a 1/2 mile distance. Nice for leisure walking at blue mosque and sophia hagia garden. Terrace partial open restaurant is good for views and watch city.

author: 788stewartk
title: Great value
text: I have stayed twice in two years at this property. Its very close to everything. Grand Bazaar, Mosque, tram, rest, stores etc. What I really like is the view from the terrace. The staff is very friendly. I felt very welcomed. The included breakfast buffet could use an update and change of menu. Strongly recommend for its location, view and staff. Muhammet Gultekin is a great bartender and Borak so helpful.

author: janetl330
title: Good base for sightseeing but BEWARE !!!
text: The only good thing going for this hotel is the great location. Only one or two staff are friendly enough to speak. The hotel room is extremley small and beware there are no drawers for clothes, just a small wardrobe with most of the space being taken up by the fridge and safe. Most of our clothes were piled on top of the safe or on a stool, some didn't even get out of the case. The rooms are very dark and quite depressing. Some of the toiletries in the bathroom were half used and had not been changed since the previous occupant and there was also an empty tube of toothpaste by the side of the "rose bowl" sink, which had no plug. The so called roof top restaurant is nothing more than a bar and poorly stocked at that. Breakfast is served here and to say the least ,is extremly poor compared to international standards There is a fantastic view from the so called restaurant and that is the only possitive thing I can say about this hotel.

author: saraandray
title: Great view... Especially from the bar
text: We stayed here for two nights while passing through Istanbul. The hotel is well placed and a good base for setting attractions and going to restuarant . I may be bias but I think we had one of the best views from our room. We were on floor five and on the corner of the building so had a clear view of Sophia. The view from the bar was even better and an enjoyable way to start the day each morning as this is where you have buffet breakfast. The only reason why I gave a 4 rather than 5 is that the service want fantastic. Not terrible but room for improvement. Hotel was very clean and rooms serviced each day ( towels could do with an upgrade... High quality but very old)

author: PaulJamesSchofield
title: Great location, good terrace views and friendly staff
text: The location of Burckin Suites cannot be faulted, with it being slap bag in the the middle of Sultanahmet, very close to a tram stop and the blue mosque/hagia sofia. There are plenty of restaurants nearby and the hotel's position allowed us to use it as a very effective base for seeing the sights on foot (and then using the Tram for travelling to other parts of Istanbul such as Taksim). The roof terrace provides great views and the bar was always staffed, open and available whenever we went there. The breakfast is a buffet format, and self serviced; the selection was coffee/tea, cold drinks, bread, a couple of cold meats, some salad, various cheeses, eggs, omelette, a saveloy type sausage and a couple of cerial options. We found breakfast to be acceptable but a little bland; the coffee was good enough for sight-seeing fuel and getting you out and about. Breakfast ran from 7-10:30am. Our room was small but clean and everything worked apart from the shower head-hight adjustment but that was a minor inconvenience. The level of English was acceptable although some staff were more accomplished than others. Booking through laterooms.com, we paid a decent rate for the hotel and so overall then it's a great located hotel with a super view and friendly staff. Breakfast is uninspiring but it will at least satiate you and get you ready for a day of seeing the sights.

author: MissPotential
title: Perfect hotel for our first trip to Istanbul
text: Myself and my friend stayed at this hotel last weekend. Although we arrived in the early hours of the morning a long time before check in, we were still given our rooms immediately. The hotel was clean, modern with an exotic Turkish twist. Our room was slightly on the small side and there was not much space in the wardrobe for storage, however, it was clean and comfortable and hot water was available at all times. From the window we could hear the prayer call daily which we loved. The views from the hotel terrace are stunning. The hotel is ideally located - only a short 5 minute walk from the main sights and in a safe area. We would highly recommend this hotel to anyone!

author: 446melaniem
title: Ideal location and very hospitable
text: The hotel is situated in a very central location (the area of Sultanahmet) and from its terrace you can see two of the most prominent symbols of the city: Agia Sophia and the Blue Mosque and a wider view of the city reaching from the Ataturk bridge to the Asian part. The terrace is a nice space with plenty of light and provides a pleasant space for reading or socialising at all times of the day. My friends and me enjoyed having breakfast there every morning, soaking up the sun and the views of the city. The food was tasty and varied – many types of cheese and salami, cereals, eggs and other local delicacies. We all loved having the seagulls lurking around the glass and at the staring at the buffet with appetite ( I don’t blame them) and watching Sadik feeding them at the end of breakfast. What made the hotel feel more homely was the staff,who were very friendly and accommodating. I was very happy to be greeted with a smile by Sadik and Betu and learn a few Turkish words every day by Ercan and I would like to thank Borek for the quick grammar lesson on the last day. The area around the hotel felt very safe and there were restaurants and corner shops to buy anything we needed during our stay. We could walk to Istiklal and the bazaars or take the tram - everything Istanbul had to offer was at our doorstep!

author: alexb949
title: Nice Hotel, Helpful and kind staff
text: We have spent 6 nights, last October, the hotel is perfectly located in the center of Sultanahmet district, just a stroll from most of the tourist points and nice streets with pubs and restaurants. Hotel room size (501 & 506) were on average across Europe, I did't need much space as only have used it to sleep :-) the room was clean and well furnished. All staff were always so kind and helpful, except the chubby guy. The lady at the breakfast welcomed us everyday with an enchanting smile.... thanks!!! Thanks guys for the nice 6 nights spent with you. Specially Mr. Ercan. WiFi signal was not so good in my room 501, but ok, it worked pretty fine near the door.. it was free of chrage hence this is not a complain!

author: TanyaL557
title: Perfect place to stay for four days in Istanbul
text: My sister and I stayed at this hotel for four days in September and would recommend it to anyone. We would also stay there if we every went back. The hotel organized transport ( at a fee) to and from the airport, which was very convenient. The location is perfect - close to everything, but also quiet. We had upgraded to a room with a balcony and had a lovely view (between two buildings) of the blue mosque. The room was nicely decorated and was clean and comfortable. However, if you want a big room and a big bed, this might not be the place for you! The staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good and served on the top floor, so we had a lovely view!!!

author: elishac256
title: A " Turkish Delight
text: I loved this hotel. It exceeded my expectations. So close to all the top sight seeing areas and many great cafés and restaurants... Although you can't go past the hotel restaurant for a great view and nice food. I was impressed with the overall helpfulness and friendliness of the staff, going above and beyond to give me an early checkin, which was really appreciated after my long flight. Yes, the rooms are small (and I wish the curtains closed completely) but let's face it... You won't be spending much time in the room if you're enjoying all that Istanbul has to offer. If you're looking for comfort, at an affordable price and within a close proximity to all the major sights, you can't go past the Burckin!

author: richardhN9267WF
title: Great hotel
text: I have stayed at the Burckin Hotel on two different occasions. I am reluctant to tell people what a great hotel it is...I don't want to find out next time I visit Istanbul that is is all booked out (which it should be, as it is great value!). They have a wonderful breakfast on their roof-top restaurant with fantastic views across to the Blue Mosque and the Bosporus. Very pleasant and helpful staff and service. Very conveniently located just off the tramway between Sultanahmet and Cembirlitas Stations. The rooms and bathrooms are not large, but very adequately furnished. And they have free wireless internet into the room. I will certainly stay here again when I am next in Istanbul (I usually visit at least once a year...a great tourist destination!)

author: 525amitm
title: Convenient Location
text: It is situated in a very convenient area. The Sofia Agia Mosque, Blue Mosque, Underground Cistern, and Topkapi Palace are all within walking distance. Plenty of eateries all around. I was there during Ramazan so the whole area was alive at night.Just a stroll at any time of day or night is exciting. The rooms are small but adequate for a tourist as you only return to sleep. Bathrooms are compact and well stocked.When you enter the walkways there is sometimes an unpleasant odour. Higher rooms are better and away from the street noise. No warm breakfast but plenty of fruits, nuts bread and eggs with spices. Top floor location of the breakfast area has a nice view of the city and MarMari sea. However it is on the east side and therefore the sun is direct in your eyes in the morning.

author: d0nyb
title: Great location & hospitality
text: Our 3 nights stay at Burckin was fabulous. Based in Sultanahmet, this hotel is situated in close proximity to the well known attractions like Aya Sofya, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern and even Grand Bazaar. Tram station is a stone throw away, and if you allow yourself some 10 mts, you can hit the sea side. The view from the roof top restaurant is spectacular and the breakfast spread was excellent. All the more I was moved by their great hospitality. The only below par feedback I may have would be about the room size, but it should be fine as long as you are not holed up in the room for long hours. The staff was a bit hostile in general but its mostly because of their language barrier I suppose. I would recommend this hotel anytime.

author: 0927rita
title: More than expected!!
text: I have been 4 days in Istanbul at Burckin Hotel and i could not have asked something more. Hotel location is perfect, you can reach everything on foot. People very friendly and nice. The hotel itself is nice and the terrace is wonderfull.....you can have breakfast looking at aya sophia and blue mosquee together! Just one remark...the room was pretty small but really clean. The city is really amazing with a mixture of cultures and a lot of stuff to see and do. Either at night you can go all around and enjoy tipical places. The best way to reach the hotel from ataturk airport is by Metro and then taking tram, it's well organized and easy.

author: AtifGazdar
title: Excellent Location....Great View from Roof
text: Excellent location at the heart of Istanbul main attractions. Great view of Hagia Sophie, Blue Mosque & Bhosphorus sea from the Roof. 2 mins. walk to Tram station,Basilica Cistern and 5 mins walk to Hagia Sophie, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace & Gulhane Park. Great Decoration, lighting inside the hotel. cleaning was superb and rooms are also new. Excellent & professional Staff, very friendly, helpful, smiley & Co-operative. Breakfast on the Roof was excellent with a great view of Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophie & Bhosphorus sea. I would definately recommend this Hotel.

author: frnb1
title: Great Location, great view but small
text: We stayed in the Burckin at the beginning of June and chose it after reading many reviews of Istanbul hotels. Location is important to us and we were not disappointed - it's perfect! The view from the terrace is wonderful (looking out on an uninterrupted view of the Hagia Sofia) The rooms were very small! our first room (601) had the head of the bed against the window and it was against the wall and only just enough room to get in from the other side (It was quiet though) We changed rooms in the morning and we had alot more space (not difficult) but the size was just ok I think this is the norm for many Istanbul Hotels., oh and the shower leaked. We weren't woken by the call to prayer though. I'm afraid the breakfast was poor. A selection of cream cheese balls, bread, boiled eggs, tomato etc.. coffee was good! There was no restaurant but food could be ordered and was brought in (though we didn't do this) However, you are very close to lots of great dining places (Mosaic, Amedros, Khorasani) It appears that to Istanbul owners, great sway is held by trip advisor reviews and it wouldn't be a surprise to us if many reviews were written by "guests" who had more than a passing interest. Staff were pleasant and helpful.

author: jesso79
title: Great location, missing a bit of personality
text: Perfect location for sight seeing and amazing views from the breakfast room. Room was tiny, but luggage easily stored under bed. The major let down for this hotel was the staff. No interest in engaging in conversation and quite dismissive. Staff freely ate breakfast while guests are eating, felt a bit odd queuing behind staff to get food . Breakfast options are limited unless you are a fan of cheese. Don't bother with ordering airport transfer with them, they charge through the roof! Just as easy to flag a taxi off the street. Inject a bit of personality in the staff and it would be a gem of a hotel!

author: Riversdale10
title: Absolutely brilliant!
text: We got a great deal here, which is why we could afford to stay! We only had one night here out of the four we spent in Istanbul. The staff were lovely and the shower was the best I've ever experienced! The room was small but given the great deal, we were not at all disappointed. The bathrobe and slippers were a touch of luxury. The wifi actually worked in the room, another first. All in all, a lovely stay and we would return and pay more for a bigger room if staying a few nights. Istanbul is certainly worth another visit.

author: willfismer
title: Best Hotel in Istanbul
text: Book this hotel! Trust me! Its such good value for money, as the price doesn't break the bank and you are situated smack bang in the middle of the old city (Sulthanamet) overlooking the Hagia Sophia, the blue Mosque and the ocean.The grand bazaar is also in walking distance as well as great restaurants. Mr Hassan, the hotel maitre' d, is so friendly and accommodating and the rest of his staff are super professional and helpful. Ask the hotel for airport transfer as its much cheaper than taking a taxi. The breakfast is a massive Turkish spread and should keep you full well into the afternoon. We were a group of 10 friends staying there for a week and we had a great time! You won't be disappointed. 10 out of 10! Regards, Will from London

author: Sheepo62
title: Exceptional service
text: During a recent short trip to Istanbul I was very unfortunate to have a heart attack on the first night. The response from the staff at the Burckin Suites was remarkable. They couldn't do enough to help my wife while I was in hospital or during the extended stay we had as I was unable to fly home. The hotel was fully booked but they advised us not to worry as they would re-arrange their bookings to make sure we did not have to move. The hotel is in a perfect location for touring all the sights in Sultanahmet and I will be returning here when I am fit and well to do so as all the major sights are in easy walking distance from the hotel. I have stayed in larger hotel rooms but as I spent up to 20 hours a day in the room due to my circumstances without any problems I don't think this is an issue. The breakfast was the best I have had in several visits to Turkey with a very large choice of continental breakfast. The hotel restaurant on the roof was closed at this time of year but would be worth a visit in the summer season for the views over the city. There are many restaurants within a short walk of the hotel and a very decent tram service is only a short walk away. Again I cannot praise the staff of this hotel highly enough for the exceptional service they provided my wife and I.

author: MariaBarbosa
title: A great view!
text: This hotel it is very well located, when I say this I mean is in Sulthanamet near Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and not far from Grand Bazar. On the roof it is amazing the view, really beatifull. However it has several problems, in morning each person that goes to breakfast and close the door will wake up everybody. It is unbelived the noise. The first night they gave us a room and in bathroom we had problems with the bath that did not close well. The floor was all full of water. In the first morning I saw people in several hotels near us eating outside on the roof terrace, the weather was not like in August but it was possible to eat. They did not arrange nothing outside execusing on the fact that the time could change. We felt deceived.

author: mthomas2012
title: Nice room with an amazing view and friendly staff.
text: We stayed at the Burckin Hotel in Mid September and loved it. The hotel room is very clean but small but the view from our balcony was breath taking and the location made up with for it. The AC and bathroom were all in good working order. You are 10 minutes or less walking distance from Agia Sofia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi palace and the Grand Bazzar… just to name a few places. The hotel staff was very helpful and friendly. Arriving at night the first people we met at the hotel was manager Tuna and his assistance Brock. The night shift seem more polite and helpful then the day shift. I had a nice conversation and coffee with Tuna on our last night before we left. He is a very nice person and so was Brock. Without a doubt I will be staying here again on my next visit back to Istanbul.

author: Forte312659
title: Pretty average, but good location
text: This hotel is located in a good area, and is close to nice restaurants and bars. Don't expect to much of the hotel though. Its not bad, but not great either. Breakfast buffet is rather poor. Rooms are very small but clean. The hotel was really noisy from about 6:30am which was also problematic. The staff were generally quite pleasant, however, upon my exit when the manager asked me about my experience at the hotel I gave him honest feedback which he did not like at all. He became extremely aggressive and rude. Rude manager aside, In general not a bad option, but I felt it was somewhat over priced.

author: Cinquantasette
title: Very clean hotel in a great location
text: GOOD points about this hotel: 1) the location, which is at walking distance from Agya Sofia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi palace and next to the tram stop from where you can get to other neighborhoods of the city. 2)The cleanliness of the room: perfect. 3) The bathrooms: new,well cleaned and well equipped. 4)The staff at the reception, kind and helpful. DOWNSIDES: 1)The room's size : some are small, some are VERY small (but then you can ask to the staff to move you in another one; just avoid the rooms at the first floor: you'll hear whatever happens at the reception. 2)The breakfast is quite bad: terrible coffee, lots of cheese (not great quality) , olives, tomatoes and cucumber but if you feel like something sweet you'll have only bread, honey and jam (but everything- at least in summer- served in a beautiful terrace with a breathtaking view). 3) In our room (103) the A/C was a bit noisy. I would definitely come back (but this time, hopefully, in a room with a view!)

author: filmic
title: Amazing Istanbul
text: Had a fabulous 3 nights in Istanbul and this is a good base to visit all the major tourist attractions. The rooms aren't that big but are adequate. Good facilities. Fantastic rooftop terrace with amazing views. The staff were all helpful and polite. Went out at 10am in the morning and returned at 9pm in the evening so room size not really an issue as not in the hotel for long periods. Would definitely stay here again - 3 days is not enough time to explore Istanbul! Looking forward to our next visit.

author: UkTurkeyTraveller
title: Sultanahmet Experience
text: Stayed for 3 nights in a family room at the Burckin Suites. The room was very spacious with two king size sleeping areas, each with a LCD TV. Modern compact bathroom. Very clean hotel, with a wonderful breakfast buffet on the terrace while taking in views of the sea and major historic sites. Having stayed in Sultanahmet on numerous occasions this was by far the best location. Friendly and helpful staff.
