It is some distance away from the city center (which wasn't a bad thing with the different protests that were going on while my friend and I were visiting), the otogar, and the airport -- just keep this in mind if you were wanting to visit a lot of different places (it's not that conveniently or centrally located). It's also nearer to the top of the hill where the Ankara Kale (tower and castle) are located, which means that there is a bit of walking up and down hill. It is very conveniently located by the Ankara Archaelogical Museum (under construction) and the tower/castle. I would say, if you are at the tail end of a trip to Turkey or Ankara and are looking for a few days of leisurely wandering around and relaxing, this is a great place for that. A few places to eat around the hotel -- kitty corner from the hotel is "Meydan Piknik" (trans. "Plaza Picnic") - it has an awning and outdoor seating and is directly across from the dried goods sellers. Cheap but tasty kofte - would recommend if you're looking for a comfortable dinner + good people watching. Also just down that same street on Atpazari Street there is a cute cafe called "Nar Antika Evi and Cafe" - boho chic, great Turkish breakfast + coffee, and even better view on the third floor.

author: baneth
title: Absolutely delightful
text: My wife and I visited Ankara for a three day trip to see the city and enjoy the sights and sounds of the Capital. We stayed at the Divan Cukurhan for the duration of our short stay and we were both absolutely delighted with the outstanding service, atmosphere, wood floors throughout, the authentic pieces throughout the hotel. There are a large number of antique and vintage artifacts from the Divan family that are nothing short of amazing the view and read about. There is a museum built into the hotel with a wide assortment of old cars and motorbikes and family heirlooms from the Divan family and is almost like going back in time. The hotel restaurant is situated right in the middle of museum and the service and quality of the meals and drinks are second to none. We tried a few other restaurants that were allegedly top quality but found ourselves coming back to the hotel restaurant. The breakfast was amazing, they brought out small copper bowls with thinly slices of cooked sucuk (Turkish sausage) with eggs broken and cooked over the top…I’ve never in my life tasted a breakfast item so incredibly delicious. The wood floors in the room looked to be from an old ship, so rich and deep as though the wood was from the ships of the Ottoman navy. If you are looking for an absolutely splendid stay in Ankara with romantic overtones that cannot be compared by any standard, I cannot think of another place that would even come close to this experience.

author: PierreT51
title: Oasis of peace and beauty
text: After a long sleepless flight from Montreal, Canada,we were stunned by the serene beauty of the Divan Cukurhan. An ancient caravansaray,artfully renovated,with historical artefacts from all over,instant relaxation. The location is impossible to beat. Right across from the gate to the citadel, 50 meters from the Rhami Cok museum,on the right, and 150 meters from the extraordinary museum of Anatolian cultures on the left. All 3 are on anyone's must see list. Beautiful rooms, luxurious bathroom with a spa tub and separate shower. Views on the surrounding hills. A wonderful way to start a trip to Turkey.

author: Stacwith8
title: Will never forget...
text: I'm so glad I read the reviews on many of the hotels in Ankara. This hotel had the highest praise - and it indeed lived up to my expectation. I booked it as a surprise get away for my husband and I. The location was great - right up next to the fortress walls, near gift shops, and several dining options. The staff was nice. Our room was beautiful! The breakfast was perfect. The hotel itself is like a museum, so much to discover and see. We are so happy to share with others the wonderful time we had and we would love to go again sometime.

author: lduffy1
title: The place to stay in Ankara
text: What a great hotel, in a great location. Our first trip to Ankara was a pleasure, largely because we stayed at Divan Cukurhan--at the beginning and again at the end of our holiday trip to central Turkey. We experienced two different rooms; both were comfortable and nicely appointed. Breakfast was outstanding--absolutely delicious, as well as beautifully presented and served. Meals come from the restaurant next door; our dinners at Divan Cukurhan and at the restaurant were very good. The office staff and everyone there are friendly and helpful. As for the location, the hotel sits directly across from the impressive Ankara castle. The Museum of Anatolian Civilizations is just down the street; in the other direction is Copper Alley and a host of great shops. The patisserie next door is another bonus; we couldn't stay away. We'll return to Ankara and will definitely stay at Divan Cukurhan.

author: PamelaF340
title: Stylish and comfortable
text: This is a beautifully furnished and comfortable hotel in the old part of Ankara. It is a renovated caravanserai. Within walking distance of the Museum of Anatolian Civilisations. Rooms large, very comfortable beds and bathrooms fantastic, with bath and shower. The lighting in the bedroom was dim - not sufficient for reading. But I could relax and read downstairs in the elegant and comfortable lobby/lounge area or quaintly furnished library (and they would bring me a glass of wine). And I was a little surprised that, in such a modern hotel there was no refrigerator in the room. Wonderful breakfasts. The staff, especially the young men at Reception, were extremely helpful. The restaurant staff also were friendly and provided excellent service to me as a single guest, even in the middle of dealing with conference dinners and weddings.

author: Eaden
title: Oasis of tranquility and works well as a business hotel
text: The Divan has a bit of magic about it. It's calm, tranquil and a really nice to spend time. As a female business traveller, it was a very good experience alltogether. There was an excellent free and calm transfer after a really rubbish and stressful flight connection (the fault of Istanbul's overwhelmed airport). I had a warm welcome and a very clean and attractive room. There was great food in the slightly bonkers-looking museum restaurant (really expected the exhibits to come alive as I dined alone under the biplane!). Breakfast in the covered atrium/courtyard was a beautifully presented and really lovely affair. Wander outside and you are in the castle, with its windy streets and ancient loveliness. A taxi ride into town (okay, it's not central, but links to the business area by taxi aren't too bad (I guess TL25-35), and it is a nice part of town. My colleagues in Istanbul say (quoting somebody famous) that the best thing about Ankara is the airport leaving Ankara to come back to Istanbul, I'd say that the best thing about Ankara could well be this hotel!

author: 1morewahine
title: Luxury in a caravanserai
text: Splendid location, elegant hotel in Ankara's fascinating old town. Although we arrived late, the car that the hotel had sent to the airport for us was still waiting. Our spacious room was tastefully furnished with distinctive and very usable antiques. Indeed, no two rooms in this classic converted caravanserai are alike. The next morning we sat in the former courtyard, now a stylish covered atrium, and had a delicious breakfast with fresh juice, honey, assorted cheeses, great breads, and more. Wonderful staff at the hotel helped us make the most of our days, including an extended excursion to Hittite sites. From our room we looked in the front gate of the ancient citadel, and a short walk down the street were fascinating shops as well as the great Museum of Anatolian Civilizations. The Divan Cukuran is the ideal base for a memorable visit to Ankara and central Turkey and for enjoying the ultimate in Turkish comfort and hospitality.

author: PeterB990
title: A hotel that is definitely above all the rest in Ankara
text: This was my third visit to the Divan Çukurhan and since my first stay I don't even look at other hotels in Ankara. It is out of the ordinary, an experience in itself. I encourage anyone reading this to look at the hotel's website and take my word that it is all it says it is. I described it to the Manager as 'my home in Ankara', and meant it. Peaceful, quality ambience, never crowded even when all 19 rooms are full. Close to city centre and yet above (literally) the bustle and turmoil that surrounds the usual international hotel names. I am warmly welcomed as a friend, by name, by all the staff, nothing aloof and impersonal. I genuinely marked all the boxes as excellent ... the hotel certainly ticks all my boxes and more. I can't wait to justify another visit!

author: SuzyOxfordshire
title: Stylish comfort with history
text: This was an oasis of quiet in this busy city. It is a very special caravanserie building which has been restored with such care you feel quite privileged to have been allowed inside! Because natural materials have been used for the building there is a very comfortable atmosphere inside although in the rooms there is seriously high tech air con and fittings. The location is great for the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations as it is almost next door, just down the hill. We ate in the hotel restuaurant which is in the very odd (but strangely fascinating!!!!) museum, next door, that you access directly from the hotel. The old citadel is just across the street and is interesting to see, even if it is pretty dilapidated. Staff are very helpful. The hotel doesn't seem to have been discovered yet as it seemed very quiet without many other guests. More than one of our taxi drivers were confused to find there was more than one Divan hotel in Ankara so you need to be careful of that.

author: gailwmartin
title: Overnight stay
text: What a gem .. arrived around 9.30pm fire on in the bar.. friendly and so welcoming .. the lodge was cosy and the breakfast fantastic .. and dog friendly too.. can’t wait to go back.. and the best bit.. they had Guinness

author: 240cassandrag
title: A charming cosy place to stay
text: When we arrived we were pleasantly surprised by this place. The staff were very friendly and absolutely loved our spaniel which went down a treat with him! The accommodation is very sweet. It was super warm, clean and cosy, and it was a bit like staying in a log cabin. A big bonus was being able to park right outside your room (a bit like a motel) and I'm sure in the summertime the lovely veranda is a big perk. Breakfast was really good and quick to arrive, always a good start for us hungry bears! I think you get good value for money here as breakfast is included and dogs are welcome at no extra cost, which is difficult to find these days. The only downside of our stay was the issue with having no hot water. We were warned about this a few days prior to our stay but we didn't want the hassle of finding somewhere else and to be honest there weren't many options at this sort of price.

author: Scenic815959
title: It’s a Shocker!!!!!
text: This is possibly the worse place I have ever stayed. We booked a lodge for 3 nights arriving Friday 14/09/2018 Received e mail on Thursday 13/09/2018 informing us that the hotel had no hot water for showers due to burst water pipe. We were told that they were working hard to fix the issue.We went along and booked in on the Friday afternoon.The lodge was dirty smelt of urine the bedding was stained as were the carpets,the shower did not work UK the sink is too small to do anything or be of any use. The toilets in the bar/restaurant area were appalling dirty unable to flush.Evening menu poor availability of food we ended up going elsewhere to eat.Bar ran out of beers poor availability. Hotel felt dilapidated and run down staff looked tired and beaten albeit friendly.On further investigation we found hotel is up for sale and listed in the selling details is the fact that the boiler need completely replacing this would explain the no hot water issue.On looking back and talking to some local people the hotel have not had hot water since August. How do the staff who live on site wash???? How do they carry out a catering operation without hot running water??? Do yourself a favour and book somewhere else this is a NO NO NO.

author: jenniferpG2350DD
title: We should have slept in our car.
text: I've relied on TripAdvisor for YEARS and this is the first time I've felt compelled to JOIN JUST to leave a review of my own. Dirtiest bathroom I've ever seen/smelled. Shower was moldy and water pressure was horrible (not that I would have gotten in the shower anyway). Bathroom smelled so strongly of mildew/urine it was unbearable. I know...you're thinking, why did we even stay? Chock it up to too long on the road and not thinking clearly. Embarrassed to even write the review and admit we didn't ask for our money back immediately and hit the road. :( In hindsight we should have slept in the car....or on the lawn under the stars. Staff was nice, though all seemed tired and a bit downtrodden.

author: christinet339
title: Friendly and basic motel in a central location for sightseeing
text: The lodges are basic and the one we had could have done with a new mattress at the least (was very thin and lumpy). There were a few issues which the staff were quick to rectify. The location is good to get to places and including us as we were using the train! The staff were really friendly and lovely and the food was good and very well cooked. There wasn't a huge choice of food but I'm happy with that as what they did was so good! Just so you know that we stayed 4 nights and the rooms weren't serviced in that time, but apart from having to ask for extra teabags and milk it really wasn't a problem! There was heating (not that we needed it) and they were cosy. The shower had a bit of mildew around the base, and there was enough hot water once you get the knack! Towels and bedlinen were clean. I would say that you haven't paid 5 star prices so don't expect a 5 star place!

author: bumblebee262
title: Tired and in need of renovation
text: The mattress was very worn out, would estimate it is 10-15 years old and dips into the middle of the bed where the springs will dig into your back. The cabins themselves have a very strong tobacco smell despite there being a no smoking sign. We tried to air it out until the midget flies were in too strong a number to have the windows open. The food was very average. Staff were friendly but I would not recommend staying here if you have any other options. Reviews on the web have been positive and negative, suspect some of the rooms are better than others. I stayed in room #1 and a couple in #2 said their room was similar to my experience - it is possible the other cabins have been fixed up but I would ask to see the room before committing to it. The girl that gave me my key asked if I wanted to be shown the room - I declined thinking it was obvious but that might have been her invitation to allow me to say the room was not up to standard before accepting the key. Recommend anyone thinking about booking this place to strongly look at any other option. For a tired traveler this place is better than sleeping in your car, but only just!

author: Happywalker_12
title: Very poor.
text: Stayed here for 2 nights. I arrived back on the second night to find the room had not been serviced - bed not made, towels not changed etc. Supposedly they mention this in an information leaflet but didn’t think to say anything at check in. At £47 a night for a cabin little bigger than a garden shed this is not acceptable. Bar meals were only just passable. Very clearly microwaved catering pack style meals. Breakfast was served at 8am - which is late for a hotel catering to walkers on the WHW. Not too bad but be prepared to wait your turn at the toaster if you want toast. Like the building itself the staff looked as though they could do with a good scrub along with a course in how to deal with customers.

author: stuartgeorg
title: Comfortable budget stay
text: Stayed here 1 night in January. Lodge was compact but had everything needed and was cosy and warm when it was freezing outside. Lodge itself was spotlessly clean however the bar area had a lovely collection of cob webs!!!....not that we minded as it added to character. Breakfast was really good and came to table quickly with plenty of tea and coffee. Had our evening meal in the bar which to be honest wasn't up to much....it was edible but nothing to rave about. I'd definitely go back here as for the money the room was excellent. ...would probably eat elsewhere in village though. All staff we spoke to were really friendly and helpful and made us feel welcome.

author: Jari-Pekka
title: Base for Highland hiking
text: Three night stay for shorter hiking and relaxing after Ben Nevis hike earlier. Nice wooden lodges in cosy village of Crianlarich. Lodges are on the far end of the village yet only few hundred feet walk to the village services. Overlooking to the Ben More and surroundings. Room in the wooden lodge cosy though bit worn out. No WiFi in the lodge. Bar offered all required services, breakfast, WiFi, pool, games, beer and wine. We had two dinners, first one with live music by the fireplace. Nice and always friendly service.

author: ReneReviewer
title: Much needed stopover
text: We stopped here for one night on our way to do the NC500. Must say we were pretty impressed with the lodges. They were clean and cosy with comfortable beds. Tea making facilities. Nice soft towels The food in the pub was good. Amazing sunset. Breakfast was included and was excellent. The staff were friendly and helpful. Little bit of road noise but did not disturb our sleep.

author: Lee_family_219053
title: Great homely place to have a meal
text: We stopped here at Ben More Lodge for lunch on way to Portree, Skye from Edinburgh. The weather was acting up(hail, strong winds) and we break for lunch. Its located along the main road so its a convenient stop along the way. Good fresh made food in big portions. We had the potato/pea soup followed by Steak and Ale pie and Mince and tatties for our main course. Wow! Steaming hot and full of meat and gravy. Was reasonably priced and lunch lasted us till we got to Portree at 8pm for supper. BTW I loved the recorded music mix of gospel and oldies. Lovely little place.

author: garyholtby
title: Winter Corbett bagging
text: Location location etc. Good position for both Munro and Corbett Bagging. Good views from accommodation. Staff friendly food and drink were alright, the bar was cosy, the breakfasts good. They accept dogs and there were a few of em about ,all good natured but the room( no 1) still had pet hairs abound. Not too much of a problem as my wet dirty walking kit was quickly made dry with great room heater. Everything else worked. Shower good.Room was Fit for purpose a bit nosy as close to the main A road and walls to the lodge were thin. I will be staying again as the position is good and for B& B it's a good value price.

author: P3507MClisam
title: Great find!
text: Just stayed here on Saturday night, found it Very dog friendly, owner has a dog, and very accomodating. Really enjoyed my stay, felt relaxed in the bar, friendly staff, and quirky setting. Our meal was lovely too. Cant wait to go back. Just wish there had been live music, as musician had been setting up then decided not to play, had been looking forward to this? But still has good night, cannot fault this place. Clean, Lovely atmosphere, friendly staff. We have been in many hotels etc that claim to be pet friendly and are not, this place is true to the fact :)

author: patriciad640
title: Lodge for pets.
text: Stayed her for one night,couldn't cope with the two I paid for. This obviously suited many pet owners ( dogs mostly) as nowhere appeared to be out of bounds. The lodge itself was small with a very unclean decking area. The divan bed, having no valance showed the sides very worn and threaded( looked like a pet had been scratching at ). The bed had no mattress cover with only a cheap see through sheet covering it.ugh!. The ensuite, was dark with a light over mirror not working,(maybe better this way) the tight fit,curtained shower,grouting was in desperate need of re-doing ,it was awful. There is a bar and "restaurant" serving light meals and breakfasts. The staff were friendly. If you like to have your pets with you and aren't to particular about what you sleep and eat in then fine. The location suited my travel arrangements but definitely never again.

author: Mab11111
title: WHW stop off
text: I stayed here to dry out after a particularly rainy day walking the West Highland Way and was really happy with my choice. £45 for a lodge. It was warm (once I figured out how to use the slightly old heater), comfortable and clean. I really liked the cozy décor I thought it was good fun. I had a good nights sleep. I found the staff perhaps bordering upon being a little spikey but friendly enough once I had sat for a while in the warm bar for dinner. No internet in the rooms but free in the bar. I very much enjoyed their musical entertainment (you guys are fab!) over a glass of wine and dinner. The meal portions are generous. Overall I was happy with my stay and would stay again if in that area.

author: CSJAberdeen
title: Average and expensive
text: We stayed here for one night during September 2016. I had asked for a twin room, there were not any available so they gave us a family room. This was basically a lodge with a double bedroom and a tiny room with bunk beds, We were charged £90. Had we been charged the full rate of £120, I would not have been impressed. The lodge was clean and freshly decorated. The main issue was the smallest shower I have ever been in. I am a slim build and struggled in it. The evening meals are good value, good sized portions after a days walking and are decent enough. The breakfast was average. Not sure I would stay here again but the pub/restaurant is decent.

author: AndrewF861
title: Highway to Hell
text: Ben More Lodge or should I say Ben More Sheds. This place has an identity crises, it's punching well above its weight if it think that the shacks they offer are Lodges. The accommodation is in the car park and your view is of piles of rubble left in the car park and the main 'A’ road just behind. The rooms bed was extremely uncomfortable and the TV kept cutting out. There is also no means of communication between your shed and the main building, this means that when it's chucking it down with rain and you've settled in for the night you have to get dressed in your rain gear to speak to anyone...very inconvenient. The room was never serviced during our 3 night stay ,cups were never cleaned ,beds were never made, towels were never replaced and tea facilities never restocked. When I mentioned this on departure the abrupt reply was " its all in the manual,we don't go into the lodges unless asked" . So there you are, its all my fault. It perhaps might be advantageous if ,when they show you to your room/damp shed they explained their policy to you. Breakfast was awful, please don't ruin your holiday by staying here.

author: Hodgson128
title: Stay in your car !
text: Stay in your car because bed's have no mattresses' ! Geographically in perfect place for touring Scotland. Guess that's why they stopped trying to impress, keep up to date or even open windows ! Rooms smell of damp and decay. Rooms happily called lodges / chalets are cramped un hygienic. Lack hot water....or even fuses for hot water! Worst place I have ever stayed ! Food, actually you will just want to leave as soon as possible, as did French, Dutch, German and Scottish guests. PLEASE AVOID ! Cardboard box in shop doorway would be better !

author: ninebanks
title: Great welcome and good service
text: Stopped here while walking West Highland Way. It was great to get out of the snow and sit by the fire in the bar. Owner and staff very friendly and helpful - nothing too much trouble. Cabin/accommodation was warm, cosy and very comfortable. Good shower and facilities. I ate here and had good pub food freshly cooked. Breakfast was equally good and generous. Although this is not (nor claim to be) a three or four star hotel it offers good honest value for money and comfort. In its own category/class it is at the top end. Scottish hospitality at its best

author: Beefy3
title: The perfect place for any highland break.
text: I have stayed at Ben More Lodge and it has always been perfect. The welcome is always great, the food is just hearty and magnificent and the rooms are good too. As a location, Crianlarich is perfect for the whole of the western highlands, Stirling and Perth with all the main landmarks within 2 hours reach. Ben More Lodge is on the edge of the village and is nice and peaceful. It comprises the main restaurant and bar and seperate individual lodges. Each is great value for money and warm and cosy. It is also pet friendly. I have no hesitation in recommending Ben More Lodge as the perfect place for a stay for any purpose. It is my go to place to stay in the west of Scotland.

author: Atherslad
title: We didn't want to leave.
text: Lovely quiet location with wooden lodges. They were cosy and warm with fairly good bathroom facilities. Food was fantastic and giant portions. Really nice and friendly staff who let us pay for everything (incl drinks) at the end of our stay. Lots of character and a games room with a pool table. Not great phone signal though. Wifi in main building. We will be going back!

author: scotlandfan
title: Good overnight location
text: Stayed here just one night on our way back home to south Wales. The lodges are all within the hotel grounds and were okay for one night. I decided not to use the shower as it didn't look too fresh but there was plenty of hot water for a good wash. The entire lodge was clad inside with timber so was a bit dark and needed the lights on even during the daytime. Right alongside the main road so a little noisy. Very flat, thin pillows, only 3 supplied for two beds!! Breakfast was good with a reasonable selection of cereals and cooked options. We had dinner here and the portions are really good value. Probably wouldn't stay here again but it's fine for one night if you're travelling this way.

author: stuart259
title: Friendly and welcoming
text: Stayed for 4 nights. Room was quite large for just 2 of us. Room was clean and well presented. Mattress was a little hard but OK. Food was basic but very good. The "full Scottish breakfast" was enough to fill me up for the day, especially as wife gave me her black pudding, it was a meat lovers feast! The staff, especially Ian, Doug, Lisa and last but not least Jan could not have been more welcoming and friendly. All the staff were friendly just can not remember all their names! I would definitely recommend a stay here as it was fairly central and about hour or so each way to East coast or West, and the journey each way is well worth it.

author: goodguyGlasgow
title: terrible way to run a business
text: would love to have great things to say about benmore lodge but sadly i dont. first off check in time is listed as 14.00 when i booked i received an email saying checking was at 15.00. we arrived at 15.30 to be told by a gentleman that was leaving that they dont open till 17.00? there wer 2 no. attachhed to the benmore doors and instructions to chap the doors on 1 of the 2 caravans that are situated next to the bar. both caravans were tryed to no avail. my partner then tryed both mobile no's only one answered to which the reply was "im nowhere near its lisa you need to speak to try the caravans" we told the woman on the phone that we'd already tryed she said she would phone her and get back to us, we waited 30 mins with no reply. due to this we where put of staying here and decided to cancel. this left us with a 2hr drive back to glasgow.

author: luckyrabbit13
title: Wonderful Scenery, amazing value for money!!!
text: I cant express how utterly amazed myself and my partner are with this gem! Firstly, the cost, its a steal for what you get! A small lodge all to yourself, plenty of storage, very warm and cosy, nice little private bathroom and shower, and sky tv! The food is outstanding, and we were thinking that we would be stung on bar prices... WRONG! Reasonable, and plentiful :) Great entertainment, FREE wifi in the bar and a pool table at 50p a game... I bloody love this place! So much so, my partner and I have booked in every Saturday for the next 3 weeks :) Great place to stay if your off skiing at Glencoe! The staff are friendly and make such an effort!!!

author: fionas981
title: Couldnt care less attitude and terrible accommodation
text: I booked this online for myself and elderly parents whilst touring in Scotland where the hotel website said 'modern and comfortable accommodation' and 'spacious and comfortable'. Really nothing could have been further from the truth. The welcome we received (or should I say no welcome) was appalling I didn't even receive an acknowledgement that I had spoken before being instructed to follow her to our rooms. We were told in no uncertain terms not to arrive for breakfast at even ten to eight as we would not be served until eight! The rooms were small, damp and stank of stale urine with barely enough room to get around the bed. The showers had mould and I would not have been able to use them let alone ask my elderly parents to do so. When we told the person that had showed us to our rooms that we were not staying, there was no apology, no enquiry as to what the problem was and a couldn't care less attitude. We left to seek accommodation elsewhere and they had the cheek to charge me full price on my card. Don't believe the website, this is very much a case of oversell underdeliver and frankly with the couldn't care less attitude that we experienced from the only staff member that we met I am surprised they are still in business. Go elsewhere.

author: 742hp
title: This is a wonderful, reassuringly friendly place
text: If only more places were like this! I couldn't care less about stuffy facilities, en suites and all the silly fripperies that some people rate - but Ben More certainly got right what is important to us. At this hotel, we were cheerily welcomed after a long drive - kids and dogs welcomed with open arms (and that is rare!). We were shown our cabin style accommodation that in every way suited us as a family and then were ushered into the bar with a good atmosphere where we drank fine beer, chatted to locals and tourists, the children played pool and we listened to an impromptu live band playing informally in the corner. Others joined in the vocals, and our dogs were greeted without the usual fuss and nonsense about health & safety. I can honestly say that this was quite the friendliest place we have stayed for years and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. The breakfast was great, too. If you want a good time rather than all the boxes ticked (how boring!) then stay here - it's worth every penny, and we are recommending it to all our friends with children and dogs. It's a winner!

author: jasmanda
title: Mixed bag
text: I ate in the hotel twice during April, the first with a friend and then with a larger group. On the first occasion, I had fish which was well cooked and good value for money. The atmosphere was great and the staff friendly. On leaving I mentioned that a group of six of us would be coming at 8.30pm later in the week and asked if this would be a problem. We were told it was fine and that food was served up to 9.00pm so there was no need to book in advance. To cut a long story short, when we returned it was like they were doing us a favour. We were given a card to ask us to book in advance in the future, had a reduced menu and the quality was not as good as on my previous visit. Fortunately, we could laugh it off, but the service we got was disappointing.

author: Maltapete
title: A warm welcome!
text: We received a warm welcome from Lisa who promptly showed us to our cozy lodge and was happy to tell us how everything worked. After getting changed we went for dinner which was served in the bar in front of the roaring log fire. We chose the steak and ale pie which was the best we had tasted in years accompanied by a couple of beers. We were joined by the owners and family and friends including Ian, a local musician who kept us entertained by singing and playing the guitar and I joined him on guitar for a few songs and he played the mandolin. We eventually made our way to our cozy room and apart from a little traffic noise we enjoyed a good night's sleep. We opted for the later breakfast which was served in the restaurant and decided on the full Scottish which was excellent. We bade our hosts farewell and departed for the Isle of Skye. We have just booked again for this coming Saturday and we look forward to seeing our new friends again.

author: 125kaym
title: Never again
text: We booked for three nights but stuck it out for only two. The lodge we stayed in No 8. Was not very clean. There was an unpleasant smell. The whole place needs major refurbish. Way over priced. I will not be staying again. :)

author: martin_black
title: Great atmosphere and even better staff
text: Only stopped here by chance due to disappointing experience at a hotel up the road.(sat at a table for 15 minutes, only to ignored) but im glad of that. This place was the opposite. A warm welcome as you come through the door, made to feel comfortable and that nothing was too much trouble. The food was served in a timely fashion and was very nicely presented. The portion size was maybe on only thing I could fault....it was way too big..lol..put on a few pounds after that meal. I can recommend the steak and ale pie. It was packed with steak and the gravy was gorgeous. Will definitely be back.

author: JCharles3
title: Fun place to stay
text: Our room was like a little cozy cabin. The dinner was comforting and good. Breakfast was included with the price of our room. The entertainment in the pub was wonderful and they had no problem including us Americans. Ian was the singer/guitarist and he was incredible! He even got my husband to wear a kilt and one of the servers taught him a Scottish dance! I wish we could have stayed one more day so we could have toured the beautiful surrounding area, which was at a bit of a higher elevation and took us some time to get up there. We would most definitely return to Ben More.

author: Bob54_12
title: Good and not so good ...
text: I,ve actually stayed here a few times over the last two or three years for one or two nights each time - combined business trips with a walking opportunity . The best thing about the Ben Moore Lodge is its location - its surrounded by many Munros ( the larger Scottish Mountains ) and so makes a great base - its central and its reasonably cheap ! Having said that the accommodation reflects the price - its not brilliant - its not bad - it just serves a purpose ! The rooms are smallish and the bathrooms a bit smaller ! Not very modern but perfectly ok. Over the years I must have seen at least three owners ! - but all have been friendly and welcoming and the bar atmosphere when busy is fine - sometimes a bit of live music at busier times of year - and the bar food is average but ok . I suppose I sum it all up as ok for a cheapish night or two but dont expect luxury - the scenery around is magnificant though !

author: ovalanimal
title: Fantastic find if you have dogs.
text: My wife & I popped up to this place for an overnight stay as it was dog friendly. It was great. Nice tidy, clean little lodge room with double & single bed & ensuite. Big fuss was made of the our dogs & there is a large forestry commission walk right across the road which was a brilliant bonus to our stay. We ate a very tasty dinner & a smashing breakfast before heading home. We are already making plans to stay 2 or 3 days next time. P.S. daisymae154 whoever you are. Get a life.

author: mckenzie6996
title: Homely lodge accomodation in lovely scenery. Friendly staff - good for dogs.
text: This hotel has a restaurant and bar separate to some pine lodges that are available for accomodation. The lodge was fairly small but cosy and warm. Beds comfortable and clean. Bathroom could do with upgrading but for the price it was fine. Dogs are welcome and our two were happy. The staff in the bar were really nice to them, even when they were a bit excitable! The bar is not luxurious but atmospheric and informal. Breakfast in the morning was really good. Big portions of full Scottish breakfast and served hot with toast and tea and small selection of cereals. If you are looking for luxury this hotel isn't it, but it's a great base to see the lovely scenery and the staff are very welcoming.

author: KernowDeskadger
title: Very friendly staff
text: We stayed here for 3 nights at the end of a week on Mull to break the journey home. The cabins were comfortable and clean. The staff were very friendly. The rooms were not cleaned daily, but if there was anything we needed, all we had to do was ask. We were offered clean towels and a top-up of coffee, tea and milk. Pets are allowed in the lodges at no extra charge. The shower temperature in our room (10) was unreliable - there were times when it alternated between hot and cold. We ate in the restaurant each evening and the menu had a good selection and was reasonably priced. I would recommend staying here.

author: DonnaM37
title: Great place!
text: We arrived in the early evening to a lovely cosy lodge. The heating had been put on prior to our arrival. The lodge isn't huge but more than ample as a base for hillwalking/sightseeing etc. The pub was great, with an open fire and nice food. You will either love or hate the grafitti on the walls, but you will also find yourself engrossed in the writings of all the travellers who have visited. Great breakfast in the mornings. Fab to find a place where you can bring your dog too. The couple who run the lodge are lovely and very obliging.

author: MargaretB309
title: Birthday treat from sons!
text: Bit concerned on arrival as not quite what we were expecting. We are used to staying in more impressive hotels and this place appeared a little down market. However, we were positive, went for a drink in the bar, started to relax, chatted with the staff and had a wonderful time. Our evening meal could not be faulted and breakfast was excellent. The entertainment was hilarious at times and the music just our taste - thank you Ian! By the time we returned to our room it was lovely and cosy and we had a really good night's sleep. Owners spent time chatting with us over a leisurely breakfast and were very helpful as to sightseeing. Would certainly return.

author: artygal59
title: Glad I didn't read the reviews
text: As the title suggests if we had read the reviews of this hotel before going on holiday we would not have stayed there, happily we didn't read the reviews. At the end of the day we were looking for a hotel that was open we came upon the Ben More Lodge purely by chance and received a very warm welcome. The staff and owners are lovely people and did everything they could to make us feel welcome. The cabin was warm, clean, cosy and comfortable. Obviously a lot of work has been done to improve the Lodge and the work is ongoing. We booked in for one night with no plans to return, however at the end of the next day we deliberately made a detour to spend a second night at the Lodge. The food was very good (we particularly recommend the home made steak pie). We will definitely return again.

author: Moorsel
title: A complete wrong choice
text: Dirty small room hardly fit for 3 adults. Bathroom-carpet flooded with water. Nobody had the courage to use the shower, I even didn't dare to use the sink. The room was damped. The electric heating placed too closed to the bed and the wooden wall. I was very glad that we only had to stay for one night. The food was promising but it did not fulfill my expactations, the tables were sticky! IT WAS A DISASTER, glad we could leave that Scotland beyond us! Our neighbours were probably as glad as we were, to leave; because they didn't even take the time for their breakfast, and left in a hurry.

author: Ginger186338
title: Really enjoyed stay, will gladly return
text: My partner and I were touring around the West Highlands and stopped at the Ben More Lodge, Crianlarich on the chance that we could stay the night. We had seen some bad reviews on the trip advisor website but decided to try anyway. We were really we did as glad that we did as we had a fabulous stay. Seemingly the hotel had only been taken over in June by the new owners and they had gradually been making a lot of improvements to the place. The lodge was very clean and comfortable, the carpets weren't the best but they were going to be replaced as soon as possible. The food was good, the staff very friendly and couldn't do enough for you and the atmosphere was cheerful and happy. There was a local musician playing the night that we stayed, who was excellent and added to the atmosphere. An altogether pleasant experience which we cannot wait to repeat later in the year.

author: loobylooayr
title: Rotten food, poor value
text: Only stopped at the Ben More for lunch on the way home from Skye. First impressions, bar needed a damned good clean. Carpet tacky, tables sticky and glasses dirty. Because kids were starving we ordered sandwiches and burgers with chips. Wish we'd left and gone elsewhere. Our food when it finally came was awful. Poor service and overpriced food. Will never return.

author: PatriciaDerbyshireUK
title: Dreadful room and food
text: I booked this Hotel as it accepted dogs and was on the route to Skye. The reviews on Tripadvisor were mostly good. Well it was far from good it was dire, the girl who checked us in yawned in our faces , the room was horrible a chalet style but so dated everything was old and faded. The basket for tea and coffee was full of used sachets and milk containers, the sofa along the wall was covered in a very nasty stained thing. The ancient tv did not work and despite the guys from the kitchen switching tv and sky boxed never did work. We ate in the restaurant which had as much atmosphere as a bus shelter they had a curry menu which was described as authentic, my choice just tasted of tinned tomato soup. The final straw was the shower in the morinig which was stone cold!!! The owners did have the decency to give us a some cash back. I understand they have just taken over they weem to have a lot to learn.

author: wezNorthEast
title: beautiful lodges with outstanding scenery, cant wait to go back!!!
text: Myself and my partner dragged ourselves away from our two kiddies for a relaxing winter weekend breakaway and i'm so glad we choose the 'benmore'. The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, we spent alot of our time chatting to them at the bar and they really did make the holiday! The scenery around the lodge is simply amazing, we enjoyed lengthy walks and the snow there was like nothing i seen before! Food was lovely, curry was my favourite, do try it...its a must! The whole place has a fantastic welcoming atmosphere where locals and tourists mix. This is apparent on the wall in the bar, which is for all visitors to sign should they wish! I'm not sure when we'll return but we definatly will be back! Its FIVE STARS from me!

author: GingerTotty
title: P!ss poor
text: On a road trip round Scotland my boyfriend booked us into here on our first night, having eaten at the pub 10 years earlier. We stayed in the last available wooden cabin, because they had failed to register our reservation made 1 month earlier. I have never seen anywhere so disgustingly dirty. The room smelt of stale urine, which we initially thought came from the bathroom as that carpet had thick greasy dust all around the toilet. The room was a twin but the beds were pushed together to make a "double", revealing similar levels of dust, fluff and toe nail clippings under where the bed used to be. We placed one quilt on the floor so as not to have to walk on the carpet. Half way through the night we realised the smell of stale urine was coming from the bed and not the bathroom and it took all my powers of persuasion to prevent my boyfriend sleeping in the car. At no point did we dare turn out the lights in case the owners of the numerous webs, got hungry. Quite unexpectedly the food was good but the tables had a very strange sticky coating on them that went an opaque colour when wet from a beer glass. Thankfully our next 3 places to stay were amazing, especially Plockton hotel, and this first miserable night passed into distant memory, never to be visited again

author: rainman1
title: Enigma!
text: I stayed at the his hotel on a business trip, the hotel having been booked by an agency. Terrible, awful and any other expletive you can think of. Staff surly, payment demanded on arrival which isn't surprising when you then see the rooms. Situated alongside the main road so constant traffic noise; when a big lorry passes you can feel the vibration! Cost £66 per night, legal robbery! Now the enigma, the food was great. I had a curry and it must rate as one of the best I've ever eaten. Dining room not too clean, carpets dirty, staff disinterested. Breakfast, just as other reviews have stated, a choice of three cereals, coffee and hot water in large thermos flasks etc etc. All-in-all just don't bother!

author: Jean5388
title: Above and beyond!
text: The management went above and beyond, helping to find lodging, and providing a warm and hospitable dinner! Driving through the Trossachs at Eastertime, I didn't have reservations for the night. Stopped at this homey lodge-style hotel. The barman (I think he was the owner) said they were full for the night, and most of the accommodations in the area probably were as well, due to the Easter vacationers. He got on the phone, called around, and found for me a B&B in the town with one room left, and gave me directions. Later, after I checked into the Glenardran B&B (very nice!) I came back and had dinner in the Ben More Lodge Restaurant. It was crowded with locals, and wonderfully homey and welcoming. The food was great, and an old gentle family dog was lounging around. Next time, I'll make reservations to stay there! [------]

author: shjc1
title: Just don't go there!!
text: Stayed at Ben More Lodge in June 2005 as we were touring round Scotland. Our room was dirty, with a very grubby carpet and drink stains on the front of the dressing table. The toilet seat was broken away (although the owner did fix this as soon as it was noted) and the toilet would not flush most of the time. The shower curtain had mould along the bottom and when the shower was turned on the water came out of everywhere apart from the head!! The bathroom was so disgusting that it made us feel sick to go in there!!! The food in the restaurant was okay, but by the time breakfast came round the next day we couldn't wait to leave. We did think at the time this may have been because the owners had just taken over the business, but having read the more recent reviews, it still sounds much the same, which is a shame. One piece of advice, if you do end up there and a little voice in your head is saying leave, just go..... it really isn't worth it.

author: johncaltours
title: appalling
text: what a dreadful place. was embarrassed to be Scottish taking guests there. my lodge was filthy carpet had not been hoovered for weeks, thick film of dust on the teapot on the inroom tray, dead insects on the base of the shower, cobwebs across the bathroom window. we actually discussed writing off the prepaid booking and moving on but no mobile signal so couldn't phone around to find an alternative hotel. complained bitterly to the manageress but just got a shrug and a feeble 'sorry' . had a one-course meal in the bar restaurant (that was enough) and was shortchanged over £10 corrected on my challenge. breakfast advertised as 08.30 arrived at the door with several others but it remained shut until 08.45 and then had a very poor breakfast. we could not get away from this place fast enough. absolutely appalling. an embarrassment to Scotland.

author: LightPacker8664
title: Awful
text: My 2 friends and I were travelling round Scotland and booked into one of the lodges at the Ben More Lodge Hotel as we were having problems obtaining accommodation. The lodge consisted of one double room and one very small room with bunk beds. The cost was £110 for one night. The room was very dirty, the carpet didn't look like it had been hoovered for quite some time. The bathroom smelt like a public toilet and there was no cold water. When we went to make a cup of tea we found dead insects inside one of the cups. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. Had it not been getting late at night and everywhere else was booked we would not have stayed.

author: Mik_Pati
title: Great place, excellent customer service
text: We cannot talk highly enough of this place. We stayed for a week in May 2013 and it was fabulous. The place is just 5min walk from downtown Baiona and it has great amenities. We had the apartment with separate kitchen and living room and the stone and wood work was stunning and very authentic. The owner and general manager were truly kind, listening to any need that we had. They went out of their way to make our stay very comfortable. We had two other friends staying in other apartments and we all had the same experience. For lunch and dinner, they told us about this local place to eat, the Escondidino, right around the corner. The food was amazing and very cheap, much better than downtown Baiona. Highly recommended.

author: 340kaushikg
title: Enjoy haveli experience at gr8 location
text: We had stayed in this hotel located near Jagdish temple for 3 nights during our vacation in Udaipur. Car cannot reach till the hotel gate since the hotel is located in a narrow bylane. We had to leave our car in nearby government parking area and walk around 5 minutes to reach the hotel. Senior citizens in my group were not happy with the walk and also there was no lift in the hotel. People at the reception was very friendly and helpful. We liked the Haveli ambience and the rooms & attached bathrooms were big with all modern amenities. The complimentary breakfast had limited items and could have been better. The hotel is located at a walking distance of 1 min from Jagdish temple, 5 min from City Palace entrance, 10 min from the lake view roof top restaurants and 15 min from Ambrai ghat.

author: sarit_agt
title: Excellent hospitality
text: I, my wife and our small kid stayed in Kotra Haveli for four nights. The location is perfect, just at the centre of old town. We got clean and spacious room. Each of the staffs was very courteous and helpful. We got excellent guidance from the hotel in completing our sight seeing trips, both inside as well as outside the city. The food prepared by the hotel restaurant is also very tasty and hygienic. We even enjoyed one candle night dinner in their rooftop. Overall, it was a very relaxing and comfortable stay in Kotra Haveli. Definitely we'll stay in same hotel during revisit to Udaipur.

author: mohit91gupta
title: Great location.
text: Great location. Many of the major attractions are in walking distance. Service is great too. Haveli type ambience. Roof top restaurant have great food and ambience. One thing to be taken care of that you have to call them beforehand to send the luggage people to the drop location of of your taxi. Call them, they'll let you know. Not a big deal.

author: shai552019
title: Home away from home
text: We came to stay here four days back. I must say it's been a wonderful experience. The staff here are very cooperative and really very helpful. The staff here are efficient. Weather it's the dining Aria staff or the people who do the cleaning. Me and my friends felt very much at home. The best thing is the hotel location. You can reach almost all the sight seeing places by walk. We will come here again to stay for sure.

author: 78harshb
title: Pleasant stay, good hotel at central location
text: Travelled as a family with kid and stayed there for one night. Check-in was smooth, my family liked the hotel, room has been provided traditional look with modern amenities. Lots of plants inside the hotel gives very good look and atmosphere. My kid is small, learning walking/running and she enjoyed running inside the hotel. Location of hotel is good for tourists, only drawback is, car/can doesn't come directly to hotel. Food is very nice and reasonably priced. Restaurant is there on rooftop, the only thing was, it was not properly ventilated. Overall, excellent stay, clean hotel, very freidnly staff

author: siddheshparab
title: Great place to stay!
text: Pros: - Although a bit difficult to find, but this place is located right in the heart of the city with City Palace, Jagdish Temple, Lake Pichola at walking distance - Big, clean and beautiful rooms - Comfy and big bed - Very prompt and helpful staff. Special mention of Shakti Singh. - Decent breakfast spread Cons: - WiFi is very weak. Virtually doesn’t exist. - The geyser is not upto the mark. Water never turned hot even after keeping the tap open for several minutes on low flow. - Roof top restaurant had great ambience and views. But food taste has scope for improvement - There are no views from room windows, so they have covered the windows with fixed curtains. My take: I would certainly recommend this hotel to fellow travelers who are looking for clean and beautiful place to stay right at the city center.

author: sandepp
title: Right hotel for family to enjoy City palace view.
text: Right place for view to City palace view from the roof top restaurant . Nice and neat rooms , ideal for a family vacation in heart of city . Responsive staff, good hospitality , with nice food in the restaurant. Only thing I was not happy was I had preorder dal batti churma. That s local dish. You don't have to preorder. But ignored that, as I was able to have in other restaurants when going around. Overall. Nice stay in nice wheather, without pinching my pocket.

author: ghoshrajen
title: Pathetic stay at this Hotel. Do not book during Festival time.
text: This hotel is pathetic during Navratra time. There was too much noise and sound pollution.The hotel staff says its till 11 PM however the nose nad sound pollution was till 12:30 AM till 1 AM in the monring. Unable to sleep in the night. Hot water facility stopped for around 2 hours in the morning resulting in delayed travel and excursion. Not so many options for breakfast and they will not compromise on what you want to eat. Breakfast is hotel's choice and not your choice on what you want to eat. Too much nose and congested surroundings around the Hotel. Welcome drink is just like you are given a sip of rooafza to drink when you come and check in thirsty. Not good at all and people are not that open minded and hungry for money for hook and by crook

author: RGNMumbai
title: TRULY A LOVELY PLACE
text: This place is really a haveli. Right in the heart of the old city. Only factor is the approach road. The rooms are elegant, service is quick. The front desk is managed by very knowledgeable people who has the city and places of interest on their palm. Food is very tasty. The breakfast spread is good. The roof top restaurant in the night is just breathtaking especially during Diwali with the lighting.

author: SupriyaA68
title: Best property to Stay in Udaipur
text: Staff is humble and helpful. Rooms are spacious and very clean. All major information was provided by the owner Mr. Mahendra Singh Panwar. He was very helpful and took care of our every need personally.I wanted to carry Lal Maas back home to Mumbai so I enquired (just 1 evening prior to my checkout, indeed a short notice) if it was possible for them to prepare and pack the same for me. Being a Royal delicacy, Mr. Mahendra himself prepared it for us. The Lal Maas and the Royal Thali is a must try here.

author: Excursion821018
title: Amazing experience and good place to stay
text: The best part about this place is the location. The city palace is just a minute walk and it is near to the lake pichola. Most of the sight seeing places are in the vicinity, just few minutes walk. It is in the market area so just a hop away for shopping. The hospitality of the owner and staff is commendable. They were very helpful in deciding the sightseeing and provided us with map so we can plan our trip. The food was good. Overall a very good place to stay.

author: Jet816959
title: In a nutshell it was the best stay ever
text: We really loved the hotel. Talking about cleaninness 10 on 10. Staff was familiar10 on 10 . Food was amazing 10 on 10 . I'd really love to visit this hotel again if I'll come to Udaipur. amazing staff. Amazing food. Perfect stay. 10 On 10 ❤️

author: ShikhaS598
title: Beauty of Udaipur
text: I have never felt so nostalgic as we felt while leaving Kotra Haveli. It was one of the most memorable we have had in the recent past. Right from the moment me and my friend arrived at the Railway station till we left this marvelouavs property, every moment was made special by the kotra staff. As expected, we were welcomed at railway station and were taken straight to the kotra Haveli where in the Butler completed the check-in formalities. Kotra Haveli rooms have an astounding view of the City Palace, Old City, Gardens from the terrace. The size of the rooms is great, with all necessary amenities and they are , traditional & royal at the same time.simply best budgetted hotel Food is amazing. Thanks to Mr. Mahender Ji who helped me and my friend throughout the trip as we both were traveling alone for the first to udaipur .. Each room was designed in such a way that was giving different royal impression ...I will love to come again in kotra Haveli in future ..

author: AkanshaP24
title: My first visit to Udaipur
text: I had this wonderful opportunity to visit udaipur and staying at the hotel Kotra Haveli. Hotel is easily approachable by 100m walk from Jagdish temple, Just lying in center of old City from where you can plan ur itinerary to all the major touchpoints. The hotel is boutique & has unique style to rooms wherein each and every room has different furniture, paintings and lightnings that separates every room from one another and makes u feel different Everytime you come to hotel. The terrace where you can experience light and sound show of city palace, experience a candle light 🕯️ dinner with a beautiful decorated and delicious Rajasthani Thali (some recipes straightly coming from royal family). Thanks to Mr. Mahender for special attention to each and every guest and staff for their ready to help attitude.. Wish to plan many trips there... Highly recommend.. must visit 😊☺️👍👌

author: 646badric
title: Excellent
text: Service is excellent. Food is very tasty and freshly prepared and served. Location is excellent , you are in a old udaipur city. Near to main attractions like city palace, pichole lake, bagore ki haveli and shopping.... Though we had some problems with geyser and hot water, understand that they have some construction work going on. Must have to say the entire group of workers do absolutely nice job. Very honest and down to earth.. Must visit place in udaipur.

author: ChristopherQ113
title: An excellent place to stay where you feel at home
text: My wife and I stayed here from November 10 - 13, 2017. The hotel has a true old time surrounding, with lanes and neighbourhood. The place is homely and has all friendly people, Ajay Singh, Mahendra Singh and the rest of the staff. The food was delicious and had a flavour of Udaipur. The room was spacious and the facility of room service, breakfast at the terrace in the early morning sun among others were a treat. The helpfulness and interest displayed by Mr. Mahendra Singh was remarkable. It's truly a great place to be in as it is centrally located to many of the places of interest. All the best to Kotra Haveli for it's expansion project, which is being undertaken presently.

author: SMenon25
title: Convenient location & a great night view of the old city.
text: Kotra haveli is a superbly located, renovated heritage structure. Its just 500m away from the city palace and opens out into the old city of Udaipur. You can walk right out of your room into a maze of beautiful streets dripping in old world local charm. Streets are narrow and better accessed on foot or by bikes. Its bustling and lively and you can look out from your window to get a hands on feel to local life. Mahendra Singh at the front desk and his family cut no corners if you need any help locally - be it planning an itinerary or booking tickets last minute to a local music and cultural show- You just have to ask! We covered Udaipur as part of a road trip with the kids and though the streets were crowded from the Diwali market and celebrations, we found a well located covered car park a few minutes away. We plan to return with a bigger group of about 10 families in the future- Kotra is adding more rooms due to popular demand.And, they do set up a really cosy dinner on their terrace with candle light accompanied by deliciously spicy rajasthani food and romantic candlelight. We prefer an atmosphere like this more than the highly choreographed and synthetic ambience of star hotels. highly recommended!

author: mayurdhwajs2
title: My second visit after construction finished... Amazing interior
text: We wanted to treat ourselves after 12 hours of a bumpy train Journey and Hotel Kotra Haveli definitely did the trick. The room was spacious, clean and nicely decorated. It was an private Residence of one of Jagirdar from Mewar, now it has been converted in Hotel. I think nothing can be better than Kotra Haveli in udaipur. I would definitely recommend staying at this Haveli in Udaipur, if you want to treat yourself. with a beautiful and comfy environment hotel while in Udaipur! Stayed there as part of Intrepid trip and it certainly was a good choice. Great location, great food, lovely view from rooftop of hotel, palace and whole city

author: 590steffanc
title: LOUD LOUD LOUD!
text: Pros: Staff was pleasant, good Location, Budget price Cons: Hotel had construction at time of my stay. When you walk in, you look past reception and see scaffolding. It is also right outside the room. During daylight hours there is constant nonstop banging and hammering on metal. At night there are dogs barking right outside and a temple playing loud lusic. So loud! (to be fair this is probably an issue at alot of the hotels in udaipur) Shower did not get hot at all. The laundry prices are too expensive. They are double the prices than at this 100 dollar per night hotel I'm staying at in Mumbai. Would not stay here again

author: AvijitG2
title: Decent place with pathetic food
text: From my recent visit to Udaipur, I stayed here for one night. I am thankful that I did not extend my stay here for more than one night because the food quality as well as food service is pathetic in this hotel. We ordered 1 plate noodles for my kid and explicitly told not to put much spice and oil. We also ordered a chicken fried rice. It took them 1.5 hours to deliver this order to our room that too with multiple followup over phone as well as trip to reception. Room was decent and clean but bathroom had certain problems and water was dripping. They had provisioned hot water but there was a time when because of water dripping issue, we could not use hot water in morning. From cleanliness perspective there was no issue in bathroom. What I felt is they are overall not that bad but problem is the accountability of the stuff as well the owner. Probably they had given us a room which was not used for quite some time.

author: 146namans
title: Just Awesome
text: Well this was the best hotel ever. It really was. I took there breakfast meal package and my goodness the breakfast was damn good. I had so many choices and also it was so affordable. Such a great room service, so cooperating manager, staff and the owner himself being so humble. It's situated at the best place in Udaipur. It's two minutes walk from Jagdish Temple, ten minutes walk from Lake Pichola. It's also very quiet and the terrace is the best part. It has a great view of Udaipur, city palace and also of Jagdish temple.

author: sammym532
title: Added to our experience
text: We stayed at Kotra haveli as a family of 5. We loved the experience and loved the spacious rooms. The decor is tastefully done and does justice to the haveli's past. Rooms and bathrooms are clean and well maintained, though they can do with some new towels. The staff are really welcoming and do all they can to make your stay pleasurable and enjoyable. Special shout out to the boy who served us all our meals and room services, top service and really friendly. Food at the haveli is really good too, though we would advise that you order well in advance given the time it takes for them to cook. Which in fact is not a bad thing considering that most of it was made from scratch,to-order. The location smack at city-centre, within walking distance to most of the city sight seeing spots is the cherry on the cake! A big thanks to the guys at reception for all their help and co-operation.

author: 437nikhilg
title: Great VFM hotel
text: We had a great time at Kotra haveli. We stayed here for 2 days. The location is inside narrow streets, but all places to visit are nearby. Rooms are neat and clean. Mr Mahendra is really helpful with all the information for places to visit. Food is also quite good. View from rooftop is also very good. I would highly recommend this hotel. Total VFM.

author: sehjad
title: Home away home
text: We stayed for 2nights at the kotra haveli. We have had an amazing experience. Rooms were neat and clean and so were the bed sheets too. Excellent Wi-Fi connection. We were given very good assistance in terms of places to visit in and around udaipur. Also the breakfast served was decent. Over all food is delicious. The hotel is situated a bit inside..Also the breakfast served was fantastic. Over all food is delicious. The hotel is situated a bit inside..we were disappointed at first with the area but once we checked in, it was a memorable experience and didn't regret one bit.

author: devshreed
title: Excellent hotel and haveli
text: The Kotra Haveli is 5 mins walk away from the City Palace and is located amongst the winding streets. The staff are friendly, the room was very well appointed with a large bed and hot water. Very clean, food was made to order and the rooftop restaurant has great views. Very spacious room with a great view, a four poster bed and beautiful furniture. Bathroom is large and well equipped with lots of hot water ant everything is clean. The roof terrace is to die for and the views are wonderful. The location is good, within walking distance of all the attractions, yet very peaceful. The staff couldn't do enough to make me feel welcome. A special thank you to Mahendra Singh Panwar who was very helpful and who made my stay extra special

author: atul220
title: Good rooms and excellent hospitality
text: Kotra Haveli is one such place which makes you feel like home and you feel you belong to this place as you spend more time here. Hotel is in the by lanes of Udaipur and has they old world charm. Staff is very helpful and supportive. Food is freshly made and very tasty. The terrace of the property has beautiful view of city palace and its good to go there both early mornings and evenings. Rooms are big and well made. Bathrooms are also decent. Wifi is excellent. Couple of things which can be improved are that they can improve the lighting of the terrace as its gets little dark during evenings and if they can reduce the size of their pillows as the pillows are so huge that your neck hurts sometimes sleeping over them. Overall very good.

author: Livingthedream999
title: Simple but good hearted people
text: This haveli appears to cater mostly to Indian people but were very kind to us. Good location in the old city. Simple but spacious room. Hot water and AC worked fine. Good wifi also in the room. Clean. Initially bed only had one sheet but they quickly provided a second one. No public area to speak of. Good value, good people.

author: kallol15
title: A nice stay close to the City palace and Jagdish temple
text: As it is located at the old city area full of so many narrow lanes, the approach to this property could be disappointing. But once you reach the hotel, you are sure to be greeted by very efficient and hospitable staffs. The rooms (total 10) are quite good and nicely maintained with excellent wooden furnitures to take you to the golden days of Maharaja ! In comparison, the bathroom needs to be upgraded to match the rooms. However , it is very clean, well maintained and with 24hrs hot water facility. The terrace gives a wonderful view of city palace and when well lit during the evening , one can actually see the light and sound show. The gourmet served is very good and delicious. This area being so near the temple is not a quiet place , so expect some bothering noise if you happen to be unlucky.

author: vikramsolan
title: Excellent Hotel on account of location and quality of rooms
text: I stayed in this hotel in January 2016 with family. The place, even though in the narrow lanes of Udaipur, is very good. The rooms and room service both are excellent. Food facility is by order only and food that we ordered was always fresh and great in taste. The location is awesome. We could walk to almost all important places like lake palace, Bagor ki Haveli and Hanuman Ghat on foot. The hospitality extended by the owners was very subtle and welcoming. Will definitely stay here on my next visit.

author: kanupriyas2016
title: Nice but not for second visit
text: We were on a trip to rajashtan nd udairpur was our last destination. We booked in kotra haveli near jagdish chowk. I must we were a bit dissapointed as it was located within narrow lanes and we were carrying huge luggage.so keep in mind that if ur carrying tons of luggage then reaching upto the haveli will be a problem. We had to hire an auto. The rooms are spacious and clean but the room service is not good. They did not even clean the room one day during our 2 day stay Upon asking the staff said they forgot to do so. Food was average.basically they are understaff. The only good point is that since its centrally located u can visit all tourist places within minutes.

author: VivekPooja
title: Very good service but poor location
text: Pros: 1. Customer service was awesome. 2. Room provided was also good. 3. Front desk staff was very polite & helpful. Cons: 1. Hotel location was very poor. 2. Complementary breakfast had very limited options.

author: pandey_alok2379
title: GREAT OPTION IN UDAIPUR
text: The only sore point in an otherwise great stay - an extra charge for a room heater . In the peak of winters in Rajasthan, beats me why that should be the case. That said, its certainly not a deal breaker. The location is in a congested alley, but for those of us used to old towns and cities across India , its no hassles at all. Most tourist attractions in Udaipur , the prominent ones, are within walking distance . The rooms are clean , cosy and the hotel owners warm and friendly . Food is a little pricey but good . Tip- ask for the low spice options since people in Rajasthan tend to go a bit overboard on spices ;)

author: vinivik
title: Excellent stay at Kotra Haveli
text: We had booked Kotra Haveli after a lot of research and were very satisfied with our choice. The rooms at Kotra Haveli were very comfortable and we got what they promised from the photos on the website. It was an actual haveli converted and gave that feel from the momemt we entered the premise. Highlight of the place was the food, very fresh and delicious. Puha, Paratha, Poori Sabzi, especially the Puha, were something to die for! Kotra Haveli is at walking distance from the main attractions in Udaipur which made it very easy to cover the attractions mostly on foot. We got the feel of old Udaipur to our liking. Highly recommended!

author: vsdodia
title: Excellent choice in Udaipur
text: The hotel is at an amazing location with almost all tourist locations near to it. Hotel's staff is the best anyone can get with their excellent services they won't let you feel away from home. Ambiance of the room was also good. It is value for money place with service which makes u feel at home and food is also very good. In short it is home away from home and that too at very affordable price. the icing on the cake being the owner taking time out and suggesting popular palces to visit.. over all a great place to stay while in Udaipur.. Highly recommended.

author: kbAnand61
title: Two in one package of Calm stay and bustling City Centre...Kotra Haveli
text: Stayed for one day on 24th/ 25th Nov. The location is superb being walking distance from Jagdish Chowk, the most happening place for tourists in Udaipur. All types of transport available once you step outside. Excellent Haweli, Clean and immaculately kept ambiance, in the lobby and rooms. Mr Mahendra Singh at the Front Office runs his team very professionally. Service is very prompt with room boys delivering with smiles. Excellent in house food....you will keep asking for more. Authentic Rajasthani preparation. Will like to go back to Kotra whernever I visit Udaipur next.

author: Tazzyy
title: Comfortable stay
text: We stayed for 2nights at the kotra haveli. We have had an amazing experience. Rooms were neat and clean and so were the bedsheets too. Excellent Wi-Fi connection. We were given very good assistance in terms of places to visit in and around udaipur. Also the breakfast served was decent. Over all food is delicious. The hotel is situated a bit inside..we were disappointed at first with the area but once we checked in, it was a memorable experience and didn't regret one bit. Although it is right in the middle of the market..it is absolutely peaceful in the hotel room.

author: 195samtam
title: Pleasant stay
text: Most of the touristy places such as jagdish temple, city palace, lake, bagore ki haveli are all close by. Just walking distance from kotra haveli. Rooms are decent. Staff is very courteous and food is just about okay. You get a good view of city palace from the terrace but you can't see the lake. Somehow we misunderstood the location while booking. The approach road is'nt great and we had a little difficulty locating it. But overall it was a pleasant stay.

author: jessc2015
title: Great Value, Location, and Staff
text: Kotra Haveli delivers great views of the palace and city from the rooftop and it's position conveniently in the heart of the old city, but tucked away into a nice, and interesting, little nook. We received nothing but friendly and warm service from all staff members and we appreciated their approach of respecting privacy and space and posting suggested itineraries and locales in the lobby. The wifi connection in our room was one of the strongest we've enjoyed in the past couple of months in India. We had a very nice rooftop meal and our room was perfect! Unfortunately, I got really sick during our visit in Udaipur and couldn't leave our huge room for a few days, but fortunately the bed, linens, and pillows were so soothing and comfortable, the fan and ac were quiet and efficient, and the plumbing in the bathroom worked well. :) The super hot showers felt great and the window reading nook was huge with a large padded mattress and bolsters for relaxing, reading, and napping. I appreciated that though they don't do room service, they allowed me to eat a few of my meals in the room while recovering. We also appreciated the help with arranging transport to the railway in the early hours. I traveled with my husband this trip, but had I been a female solo traveler, I would have felt safe and secure at KH. If we ever return to Udaipur, and I hope we do, we will definitely return to Kotra Haveli for great service and hospitality and to relax in a great room!

author: Ankit110688
title: Very Warm staff and a very well run homly hotel
text: The hotel is in the heart of the city and just stone's throw away from the City palace and Jagadish temple. Very decent and clean rooms with clean beds and fresh linen. Clean bathrooms. Wifi, ac and tv worked perfectly. Complimentary breakfast is good to keep you going till lunch. Extremely courteous and friendly staff and very cost efficient. All in all an excellent, value for money place in Udaipur Special Thanks to Mr. Mahendra who helped me arrange a beautiful set up for my wife's b'day!

author: MeenalYadav
title: Fantabulous stay..!!
text: Rooms were excellent.. Cleanliness was given priority.. Staff were courteous.. Very well managed by Mr. Mahendarsingh..!! Location is a bit congested.. Overall a wonderful experience.. looking forward for a parking space..!!

author: PavanK
title: Excellent place
text: The best part of the place is its location. Stone's throw away from the City palace and Jagadish temple. Nice clean rooms with clean beds and fresh linen. Clean bathrooms. Wifi, ac and tv worked perfectly. Complimentary breakfast is good to keep you going till lunch. Friendly and polite staff. They will arrange for taxis at a nominal rate. All in all an excellent, value for money place in Udaipur.

author: rohitsharma5_
title: Affordable stay in the heart of Udaipur
text: Stayed in 2014 Nov with my wife and daughter. Was recomended by a friend. Haveli is in the heart of the city just opposite to Jagdish temple. Neat, clean and spacious room. Owners family stays just opposite. Breakfast and snacks were good all the time i ordered. Stay was affordable and staff was courteous. Highly recomend.

author: coolh889
title: Great Place to stay with friends and Family
text: I went to udaipur for business purpose. I choose 'Kotra Haveli' after read reviews on trip advisor and review was right rooms are neat and clean. Hotel is located 2 min walk distance from Jagdish temple so its very easy to go anywhere by walk. And main thing hotel staff is very supportive and specially Mr. Mahendra Singh helped me a lot to makes things easy for me. Food was awesome. And good view from terrace. Personally this was best experience to stay at 'Kotra Haveli'. Once again thanks Mr. Mahendra Singh.

author: Raviraj123
title: "My experience was excellent with Kotra Haveli"
text: The hotel is at an amazing location with almost all tourist locations near to it. Hotel's staff is the best anyone can get with their excellent services they won't let you feel away from home. Ambiance of the room was also good.A very humble guy operating at the reception. It a relatively small hotel. I booked this hotel after seeing reviews on Tripadvisor. Mind you this is a hotel which is converted from a Haveli. The breakfast is good and the services are fair. A pocket friendly stay be it you are alone, with your friends or family. My overall experience was excellent and satisfactory! :)

author: Sagar6611
title: fantastic Stay @ Kotra Haveli
