text: It was very nice time when we stayed at Kotra Haveli. From ease at checkin to cleanliness in room and food ….all were excellent. I thanks MahendraJi & Ajay Ji for making our stay memorable. The rooms were spacious and well appointed. We loved the bathrooms and their toiletries. Breakfast is the best meal of the day and I think KH nailed it. They had a huge selection to choose from. My son really enjoyed the delicious Rajasthani Thali (they need at list 2 HRS for preparation)

author: jp171996
title: Nice hotel
text: Nice hotel in budget, staff is very supporting specially Mr. Mahendra Singh. Hotel has a good environment and surrounding is also good. main advantage is the hotel is near City Palace and Jagdish Temple. Other tourist places are also near the hotel. I am so happy that I read reviews and came here. In One sentence - Very Comfortable & Budgeted stay. Rajsthani Thali provided with full feel with test of rajasthani culture and hygienic . Backed with a Homely clean and peaceful environment, Services are very good. And they assist us always when we come from our visit.

author: Ontheflipflops
title: Amazing Stay!
text: Kotra Havelli was a delightful experience in Udaipur. We booked in for two nights but fell in love with the city and the hotel so ended up staying two weeks. This lovely haveli is very well located, close to all main spots but in a nice, secluded cul-de-sac. The staff is very accomodating, breakfast is one of the best we've had in India, we had different choices every day. The hotel counts with a very pleasant rooftop and great wifi connection. The owner is very approachable and the rooms are big and comfortable. We highly recommend this gem in the middle of Udaipur. A & P from Sydney Australia

author: jaisonj126
title: Recommended place to stay
text: Started of an year back. Very courteous and helpful people. Forward looking owner. Nice and comfortable stay. Perfect for family stays. Happy to hear from the owner that they have plans to improve food menu and expansion plans to have a roof top restaurant. and moreover waiting room for customers. Recommended for stay.

author: globetrotter20152015
title: A homely experience in Udaipur
text: Recently, we visited Udaipur and were frantically looking for a nice budget hotel to stay. One of my student booked it at this Hotel Kotra Haveli. It was an amazing experience for all of us. Especially, the owner of the Hotel Mr Mahendra Singh welcomed us by his warm hospitality and generosity. The room was clean and tidy and beautifully decorated in Rajasthan style. The food was delicious like home cooked food and the service was very prompt and efficient. We felt, while leaving the hotel, as if we were leaving our own home. It is highly recommended for any family stay. The hotel is centrally located and can be approached from the railway in short span of time. Overall it was magnificent experience with the Hotel Kotra Haveli.

author: jayita39
title: wonderful stay at kotra haveli
text: A very nice place to be. All the tourist spots are at a walking distance. Rooms are clean, big and well lit. Bathroom is also spacious and clean. Food is excellent. From the terrace you get a eonderful view of the city palace. Mr.mahendra and other staff were also very helpful. Overall it was a very pleasant stay. Coming back for sure !

author: Nik6807
title: Memorable stay
text: Very nice place to stay. The best part of entire stay at hotel is the support & hospitality from Mr. Mahendra Singh. Mr. Singh was very helpful and having detailed knowledge of entire city and around the city. Guided very well for entire three days. Also the roof top dinner was very good with clear view of palace. Rooms are very spacious. In single word:- nice place to stay and homely atmosphere

author: mks1980
title: Nice comfortable stay & great hospitality
text: Undoubtedly most conveniently located as it walking distance to few important places to visit like City palace (5-10 mins walk), Bagore ki haveli (5-10 mins) while it just on the opposite passage to Jagdish Temple which would serve as a landmark (had initial difficulty to locate as Auto rickshaw guys may know as 'Kotra-ki Haveli', so had some confusion). About the hotel, it came true to my expectation as had some prior research on trip advisor before booking it, so found it with very neat & clean room, toilet & washroom. Room furniture & decor gave an ethnic look which nicely blended with modern facilities. Breakfast served was delicious home cooked with choice from Indian & English menu though not unlimited. Owner cum Manager Mr. Singh provided great hospitality and made sincere effort to guide us with plan for daily site-seeing. Also would specially thank him for accommodating our request to serve dinner at room which was against hotel policy as our kid slept early and couldn't have left him alone to take dinner downstairs at dinning room. These small gestures sets a big example of hospitality, so will definitely be looking forward for staying here again when I next visit Udaipur and also suggest the same to others. All the best.

author: coupletraveling456
title: Nice stay in our honeymoon :)
text: We stayed in the Hotel 3 nights. It is a nice haveli really near to all the attractions in Udaipur, Walking distance to everything. The staff is just great. We were spending our honeymoon in India and they surprised us with a chocolate cake as a celebration of our wedding. Since the very first Moment, our stay was Really pleasant. We request a tuc tuc to pick up us in the Train Station and although the Train was late, the Driver was waiting for us. The Manager was always smiling and giving us recommendations what to do in the City and take the most of our time. The City is just beautiful, given that is so touristy is quite clean compared to other cities in India and in General all the People are quite welcoming and not pushy as other places.

author: anandnh
title: Pleasant experience
text: Stayed in Kotra haveli from 21st dec to 24th dec 2014 with my wife and 5 year old son. The first thing which comes to our mind about this place is the cleanliness and personal attention given by Mr M Singh. The haveli is situated in the middle of all attractions Udaipur has to offer. The rooms and the haveli gives you a feeling of staying at home yet on holiday in a luxurious hotel. The breakfast and dinner are cooked fresh and you really don't need to explore outside unless you want to try different food. The staff is extremely efficient and well mannered . Book your taxi/ auto from the hotel itself as it will save you from the hassles. You can walk to the palace , bagore haveli, silver market , jaddish temple and Tibet market etc., This hotel is recommended to all looking for value for money and quite holiday.

author: tinacI8188LT
title: Very neat and tidy
text: We were in this hotel for two days. The rooms were really good. It was giving very fresh feeling. The beds and linens were also very good, the interior was superb with the dim light. The bathroom was very clean. It was very cold in udaipur, however the moment you ooen the door, u will get very good sunlight where you can soak yourself. The staffs were very courteous. If you want to try some Rajastani cuisine, they do prepare it too on request. Now the drawbacks, the path to the entrance of the hotel is always filled with trash. Also the breakfast should include more variety and should be served quickly.

author: 442adityas
title: Fantastic service :)
text: There are many factors that make this hotel special. First of all the location is ideal, close to the city palace, markets, rooftop bars etc. The staff are extremely helpful, always ready to assit you. The manager helped plan our trip well in the short time we had even arranging a rooftop meal for us. The waiter ashish was attentive and took care of us. Lastly the rooms were very clean and hygienic. I would definitely recommend this hotel, great value for money! Its one of the best places I have stayed in.

author: Raibull
title: Cosy and comfortable
text: This place is just about 150 metres from the City Palace and Lake Pichhola which is a great advantage. It is very well maintained with tradiionally, aesthetically and tastefully appointed rooms with all the basic facilities including complimentary wifi. The best part about it is the quality of decor and the outstanding standard of housekeeping. Sine this is not a classic hotel, the menu options are not very elaborate but the quality of preparation and hygiene is outstanding and the rates are very reasonable. You can get the feel of 'ghar ka khana' if you are not fond of very oily and spicy food. And with some advance notice you can get a customised candlelight dinner on the rooftop. The fifth star in my rating is for Mr Mahendra for the way he runs his place and showers personal attention upon his guests. I would love to stay with him again.

author: jaladhiv
title: Best Place at Best Rates...A Place You will never Forget
text: Had a Chance to stay at Kotra Haveli in April, 2014. We had done our booking through Goibibo. The stay was Very Comfortable and the atmosphere over there was Very Homely. The Food served is always Fresh and Tasty. The Management is also Very Cooperative. They helped us to plan our entire trip in and around Udaipur. We visited Udaipur during the Festive Season of Ghangaur. From Kotra Haveli, the City Palace, Jagdish Temple and the Ghangaur Ghat are located at walkable distance. The atmosphere around the area was Colorful and Electric. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND the Kotra Haveli for Comfortable and Enjoyable Stay in Udaipur.

author: manasi1988
title: clean, responsive and warm- great stay
text: The haveli hotel is right in the heart of the city, and still slightly off-set from main road (ensuring no traffic disturbance, while staying connected). Place is walking distance from the palace, and temple. We walked from the hotel to the river bank at night in 10 min. The room and bathroom was super- clean. Any issue (like missing AC remote or extra bed sheet), was taken up by staff (& owner) and sorted in less than 2 min.. The food was amazing- in taste, and quantity (pure vegetarian meal), the attention it was served with, and the reasonable price. Only issue is, the parking is a little away (the haveli having an old fashioned narrow access, typical of old north-indian cities).. the staff however, ensures minimum inconvenience. Would recommend the place, and would definitely visit again.

author: SharvanTolani
title: Atithi Devo Bhav
text: "Atithi Devo Bhav" a old saying in India which means Guests are God, the Kotra Haveli make this true. I stayed there from 13 Aug to 16 Aug, 2014 and the experience was fabulous, the owner is very good person and always wear a smile which say I am always ready to help. We get truly luxury experience there the rooms are well cleaned and good the hotel situation was very good near by almost all travel destination of udaipur. Service is excellent. But beside the service and all the thing that how they welcome, they accommodate their guest is excellent, it is like we are celebrities and getting special care. It is a unforgettable experience for us. I loved my stay and get lifetime memories their. Thank you so much Kotra Haveli.

author: punith2013
title: Hygenic, Effective for site-seeing, homely healthy food
text: Very neatly done and managed property. In close proximity to tourist spots. Hygenic accommodation, homely food made my stay at Kotra Haveli perfect. We dislike commercial food. Appreciate their effective service. Very Indian and modern hotel. Only disadvantage is the lack of elevator. Overall, highly recommended !

author: Yagvendra
title: " Home Away Home"
text: After travelling thousands of Kilometres in Rajasthan finally reached City of Lakes Udaipur. A great welcome for family at Kotra Haveli also very warm staff. I believe its been a great stay with this beautiful property where me and my family experiences " The Royal Rajputana Panache". I will surly intend to return on my next trip to Rajasthan because lots of left to explore. I want to thank Kotra Haveli for a great stay and personalize service for my family. I highly recommend for other travellers to this beautiful hotel where the can experience the Rajputana Service and Mewari Culture. Thanks a Ton team of Kotra Haveli for making our stay comfortable. Cheers!!!!!!!

author: BuddhaBB
title: Freezing and barely any sleep.
text: Was escorted to a side building, after 20 minutes of walking up and down hallways, after being unable to find my room due to the lack of signs... Yelling drunks, running up and down the hallway all night. People yelling, laughing, whistling, revving there engine outside. Couldn't even get a parking spot due to all the trucks surrounding the building and had to walk a good 5 minutes just to get to the room. The room was absolutely freezing. With temps in the negatives outside, the room's temp was a toasty 47 degrees (F). With no thermostat, and a AC unit that turned on once every 15 minutes or so (and ran for maybe 45 seconds,) this was a pretty miserable experience. Bathroom was actually pretty spacious and nice.

author: youville
title: Banquet of Champions !
text: Front desk.Professional & polite.. Rooms ,clean large ,bed comfort excellent..Extra pillows ,white linen. darken drapes. Grande room for this event with delicious buffet for large group.Servers were quick owner-Manager on site,attending to all. Chef overseeing the buffet. We had a room on ground level with access to our car at the front door. with back door opening to the indoor hall going to pool or lobby Coffee maker & Frig & ,microwave . Table & 2 chairs looking at the golf course and mountains. Very pleased with the group rate.... Morning Breakfast buffet for $8.95 with the kindest waitess Real class very pleased Family Run Business 30 mins from North Conway without the mess of traffic like in North Conway!

author: txfordgt40
title: Quaint motel
text: This is a quaint hotel. As a few others mention the hotel carpet and furnishing seem a bit dated and I agree. But it was clean and functional. The TV was a nice LCD and a good selection of channels. picture on tv was good. Bed was large and firm mattress. The room has a mini fridge and microwave. Towels were not the large bath towel that other hotels have and it barely was able to go around me but I can be picky Plenty of hot water in the shower Ask for a room on the back side of the hotel as you could hear the large trucks driving past the motel during the night and early morning The restaurant at the hotel was good. Prices were reasonable and the desserts are good was well. The brownie boat was good and was large The staff was friendly

author: hollysC2934SN
title: What s beautiful spot in the mountains
text: Our goal for that day was the get to this hotel and hope there was a room available. What a beautiful spot. So well kept, gardens and indoor pool and hot tub. Dining room for breakfast and dinners. Breakfast is not included though. The rooms were wonderful. Clean with big windows to enjoy the view People were so friendly Meals were great with wonderful service. Can’t say enough. I already want to go back.

author: jonzy666
title: Friendly Staff, awful pool and hot tub.
text: None of us could stand the pool or hot tub area. It was as though they had shocked the pool and hot tub but refused to close it. The Chlorine in the air was enough to make your eyes red, burn your lungs and nose. My room was 4 doors away from it, and the smell of chlorine in our room was overwhelming. Even if the hot tub had been bearable it was a 4 person hot tub that is like 2' feet deep. We assumed that they had gotten a little out of control with the chlorine on the first night, but on the second night it was even worse. It seems as thought the humidity causes mold and that they are trying to kill it with chlorine fumes. Yuck.

author: Q3550UTkimk
title: Good place to stay and snow mobile right from the hotel
text: Centrally located to snow mobile trails, The hotel offered breakfast which was average, no gluten free options, if you don't like eggs. They had a nice pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room to relax in after a long day of sledding, They also had a bar and entertainment, unfortunately, the trails were poorly marked and we got lost and didn't get back in time to enjoy the bar and entertainment. Rooms were very nice. I was actually happily surprised by the large size and they had a refrigerator. Sheet thread count was probably 200, a little rough and they gave you one towel each, but they do change them every day. They had soda machines and ice machines conveniently located. Lots of rooms for parking with trailers. Very friendly staff, available to assist with all your needs and the front desk is open 7x24. They also had a small work out room and video room for the kids.

author: vgraffam
title: quick overnight
text: We stayed there for a quick overnight and couldn't be happier. The kids loved the pool and arcade and my older daughter and I played cribbage at the bar. The staff was amazing and very accommodating. We had a delicious dinner. The kids (age 14) had chicken Alfredo, older daughter had a chicken sandwich and I had an amazing steak. we all enjoyed our breakfast also. I highly recommend staying there over staying on the mountain for a ski adventure. The price was great and they had everything we needed. The room was nice and very clean. We will be doing it again.

author: troyj2018
title: I want to like their restaurant.
text: I recently moved to the town of Shelburne where the hotel is located so I can only rate the food and service. The service is very good the wait staff are professional. The food is a different story. I ordered the special that was shrimp, and bacon casserole. Ok sound like this could be a tasty meal. When I received my meal come to find out that it was mac and cheese out of a box with bacon and small pieces of shrimp. I wouldn't exactly call this a casserole. I think because the dining room is so beautiful that the food would be more upscale. To improve the hotel the food quality must get better. Because for the price I can go down the street for a better meal.

author: 615retiredteacher
title: Comfortable pet friendly accomadations
text: Stayed one night after an enjoyable day sightseeing and enjoying foliage. We called last minute for a pet friendly room and got one on the ground floor out back with no view. The room was clean and we could not tell it was a pet room. Clean smelling and carpet not stained like some pet friendly places. Fully enjoyed the indoor pool as it was very clean, warm, and uncrowded as well as the hot tub. We also had a wonderful breakfast the following morning of eggs, homemade bread toast, and very crisp homefries. The hallways could use some updating ie. carpet, wall coverings but all in all an acceptable stay as we hadn't been here in around 20 years.

author: KentSharon02
title: Great views, friendly staff
text: Loved the setting of this hotel. Wonderful views, full of colour this time of year. Great rooms with plenty of space and good facilities. Comfy large bed. Great food set in restaurant with panoramic views. Large bar area with evening entertainment. Super friendly helpful staff. Parking outside rooms.

author: stevesL804TY
title: Friendly Staff, Good Location, but a Tired Hotel
text: I want to start by saying that the staff at the Town & Country Inn were tremendous! We were greeted promptly and cheerfully, and checked right in. When we called to add another room, the staff were very friendly and helpful. They really made us feel welcome. This was a big plus. The hotel itself, however, is in need of updating. It felt old, and a bit run down, as if it has seen better days. The room was comfortable and clean, however, and the location is great. We would probably stay here again.

author: 207melissa
title: Visited July 2017
text: Very nice resort. The staff is friendly and helpful. Room was very cozy and clean. The restaurant food was amazing and reasonable priced for the quality of the good. Great entertainment in the evening (Straightaway Band). Pool was clean and the hot tub was clean and hot. It was just a great experience overall. We will visit again, for sure.

author: eileeno849
title: Hotel good, restaurant under staffed.
text: The hotel was decent. Everything was fine except for a cigarette smell in the hallways. They offer dinner from 6-10. Pool was cute. They were constantly out of complimentary towels but replaced them when asked. There wasn't enough staff on either Friday or Saturday night at the restaurant. We ended up ordering food from the bar both nights but staff tried to discourage it. Attention Town and Country management: higher more wait staff. Prime rib was good, lobster rav was okay, baked stuffed chicken was awesome, tuna special was not good.

author: dkchef
title: Service. Friendly. Just not a Marriot etc
text: Great value for a package. $169 including tax and tip for room with dinner for 2 and breakfast for 2. Dinner was very satisfactory, filet and scallops properly cooked and moist. Salad basic but fresh. Not gourmet cuisine, but traditional hotel style. Bread and desserts made in house by long term baker. Outstanding friendly and efficient service. A county inn that has lasted for 60 years. We will make this a planned stopover in future.

author: SeniorTravelME
title: Clean and Handy to Area Attractions/Activities
text: We have stayed here quite a few times over the past few years. This time, we were on a cross-country ski getaway in the Mt. Washington area. The motel has always been clean; the staff, friendly and helpful; and the location, handy. One of the best things was that the motel had an agreement with the ski area, making the trip very affordable! The motel has refrigerators, microwaves, and an onsite restaurant. The rooms on the ground floor have access both from the parking lot and the inside. Ice and vending machines are centrally located and fully stocked.

author: Milford_NHDoug
title: Reliable and consistent
text: Know up front that this is not a Marriott or any other major cookie cutter hotel. It's an old fashioned, family run establishment. It is not perfect, but my many experiences staying here (I love to ski Wildcat) have been pleasant. Rooms are clean, prices are very reasonable and the location is awesome. I used to come up here with friends in my hell raising years and now I go up with my adult daughter. Same great service, every visit. The restaurant is great, nice lounge and friendly staff. We had adjoining rooms on this recent visit and it made for a suite style set up with plenty of privacy. Don't go looking for Marriott style, go for the old fashioned NH charm and simplicity. I'll be back.

author: PapaMinou
title: Good no nonsense value lodging
text: We stayed there for a day during the Columbus day weekend. The main advantage is the location. Strategically, it is ideally placed to start a ride in the Mount Washington area. The room was spacious, clean, well equipped with seats, an a fridge. But we are talking about a basic-type room. We avoided having dinner there, really too basic and not inviting. It was fine for breakfast . The breakfast was honest, well prepared and generous. In my opinion you should order off the menu and avoid the breakfast buffet.

author: judyjudyjudy9
title: Nightmare at Town and Country
text: Recently stayed in this filthy example of a resort on a group bus tour. We were designated stinky, dirty, dated "crew rooms". Excrement in shower, white substance on bedspreads, spider webs, not vacuumed, fridge full of water. Wouldn't leave a dog in there. Lodged a complaint and was offered to have the room cleaned. I suggested an upgrade...only slightly better. Slept in our clothes. Thank God...only one night. Our tour company has not heard the last on this one!

author: Reddog1846
title: Wonderful Resort, all around comfortable
text: I have spent my summer's here in the Northeast Kingdom and my family owns property in the area. Never had a chance or an opportunity to stay here, untill now. This resort is a bit dated, however it is clean and comfortable. The rooms are spacious and well appointed for a family owned property. It is completely handicapped assesable, with great views of the White Mts. The local area is close to all the attractions. The food is excellent and served with a smile. You cannot go wrong with this choce of accommodation.

author: kcgamecock
title: Old everything
text: First off, the mattress was the loudest and creakiest one I have ever slept on. I woke up every time I shifted in bed. The smell of the whole room was just gross and similar to a bad body odor. The ambiance was very dark, not welcoming, and the dark floral comforters were unappealing. It was obvious the room has had little to no renovations. Overall the room was very clean and the staff were quick to help us with requests. The food in the dining hall was decent. Also, I could hear everything in the rooms next to me, in the hallway, as well as the stomping people above me.

author: Grammaofseven
title: Very poor mattress
text: Nice pool. Nice hot tub. Good breakfasts at the dining room. Beautiful scenery while eating. waitresses were good. Poor mattress. My husband could hardly walk after two nights here. We left for another hotel.

author: bobgY6115DW
title: Nice, budget friendly hotel!!
text: We stayed two nights. Room was nice, comfy beds, large enough for our family. Pool and jacuzzi are nice on property. Arcade games were fun too. Housekeeping was great! They serve breakfast and dinner. We had breakfast twice. Good inexpensive meal. We would come back and stay again.

author: LaLauren88
title: Charming Place to Stay!
text: We stayed here for a night while on a road trip. Close to Mount Washington! Moose tours just a few minutes down the road—fun to do at night. Room was very clean, and very spacious. Inn was very charming and quiet. Pool looked great, didn't get a chance to go in though. Breakfast was good— convenient in the morning. Overall this is a great place to stay. I would highly recommend, and would stay here again!

author: AlamedaMarc
title: A Great Place to Stay
text: The Town & Country is my go-to place whenever I travel in the North Country. The rooms are spacious and well appointed. The dining room is also a consistent winner. Try their Lobster Mac & Cheese...It is a hearty meal and prepared with great talent...a lobster lover's favorite! The staff is also very courteous and helpful...impressive, in fact. Also, I find that the Wi-Fi at this hotel is better than most hotels I stay at throughout the country. Their system simply works. The T & C gets 5-stars from me this trip!

author: NHMom603
title: Unfortunately Not What I Remembered...
text: I have never done a review before, but after a recent visit I felt compelled to warn others. First, let me start by saying that tourism in the area around the hotel has been negatively impacted this winter due to a lack of snow and clearly the hotel has had far fewer guests as a result. I am guessing that this has resulted in staff cut backs and I can only assume that this is the reason for the following issues: Only ONE server on for dinner waiting on about 10 parties in the dining room; No towels in the pool area and a completely trashed party room with garbage, food waste, wet towels strewn about( no one cleaned up the next day either: GROSS); Only ONE server on for breakfast (We waited with another party for quite some time before the other party went and got someone from the front desk to seat us.). Its extremely unfortunate that the lack of business this winter is negatively impacting the service that the EXISTING guests receive. Certainly not the same service I remember getting the last time I stayed last winter, or the many times I have stayed in the past 30+ years. I don't think we will be coming back again. In addition, the beds which were terribly uncomfortable and the logging truck going by all night long(while I realize the hotel has no control over that) made sleeping extremely difficult. I will say that the food in the dining room was very good, both dinner and breakfast. It just took forever because of the lack of staff.

author: MaineMom_3girls
title: Dated .... Over priced.
text: Gorham has very little to choose from so we usually stay in North Conway and drive when going to this area. We should have again this trip. Hotel is dated, dark, cold - not comfortable and no where near deserving of the name "resort". Pool area was dirty and poorly lit in the evening. Then was out of towels both times we went. At night there was large group in the pool area drinking alcohol with kids running wild in the pool area. Dangerous and not family friendly. The feeling of the hotel is bachelor party or post large event lodging. Everything is high use, stained, broken, showing a heavy "party" atmosphere. On a positive note, the rooms are large which is helpful with children in the room.

author: X5910LDjohnm
title: Nice rooms and big suites
text: We were traveling with another couple during last summer. With out reservations, we lucked out in getting rooms here. All their regular rooms were full and they gave us this suites at a very good rate. They also have a full restaurant and bar which allowed us to dine and drink with out having to drive some place. This place has a pool and fitness center, ATVs that can be rented and we are told great trails near by. Golf right across the street. Also Mt. Washington is close by. What a trip up we had there!Rooms were what I would call average, but clean. Would stay there again

author: barbaraw87
title: A family place to stay
text: Planning a trip to Santa's Village brought us to the Town and Country for a two night stay. Our family group of 5 easily fit into our room (2 queen's and a cot) A mini fridge and micro were brought into our room at our request. The bathroom was tiny but not a problem. We chose this place because of the indoor heated pool. Our kids enjoyed this immensely and the grownups loved the hot tub, sauna and steam room! Stephanie who took our reservation over the phone was charming and friendly. She also greeted us when we checked in. This is not your typical high end resort, but with a 6 year old who was thrilled that the room had a phone and a remote, we were more than satisfied!

author: jh739
title: Quick business trip
text: I was giving a training session the following day and didn't want to drive early. I found the Town and Country Inn to be within a few miles of my final destination. I arrived after dark and could not appreciate the foliage of the White Mountains. I was very pleased with my room. The hotel appearance is not ultra modern in its decor, but it is exceptionally well maintained and spotless. I was very comfortable staying here and would do so again. The following morning, the local scenery is gorgeous with a golf course across the street. One silly warning for travelers, cell phones simply don't work in this area.

author: 999SusanP
title: Good choice for accommodation in Goreham
text: Stayed one in Town and Country Inn. Always a little dubious about motel style accommodation but we were very happy with the room. Spotlessly clean and comfortable. The staff were very friendly and anxious to make sure you had a comfortable stay. We took the breakfast and dinner package which was very reasonable. The food in the restaurant was above average. Service excellent. Breakfast again was very substantial. Would highly recommend this location and accommodation

author: LiThDr
title: Great Stay
text: First we found this place online while looking for somewhere to rent UTV'S in the New Hampshire mountains. The hotel was very nice, a little dated but clean. The staff was friendly and the grounds were very nice. It is located across the road from the golf course and a nice view of the mountain range. There was a company on site that rented Snowmobiles and UTV'S. I found it a very UTV friendly town. We were able to drive out of the hotel down the public roads to where the trails started. The trails were very nice and we'll maintained. Robert was the employee at the rental company and was extremely helpful. The equipment was in very good shape and we had a great time.

author: E5129PMbrianc
title: Great Gorham stay!!
text: Nice comfortable rooms. A bit dated but clean. Nice pool, sauna, gym area. Large property with lots of room. when its busy it is crazy!!. Nice location, golfing, ATV rentals. GREAT food every day. Nice location just outside of town. Close to Mt Washington and lots of parks.

author: MJ0715
title: Not a place to call home away from home
text: A very loud place to try and sleep. The hotel staff allows groups to party outside the rooms through the night. Multi rooms all with doors open and TV's blaring. Similar to a frat party or a college party on spring break. Room was changed but the problem still went on. Just a different group of people. The front desk basically doesn't care to remedy the situation. They mentioned they are "working on it", but nothing happens. Beds are uncomfortable and carpets are stained throughout the hotel and room. Very poor customer service VERY!

author: andrewrN2455EA
title: Great
text: We booked last minute, due to price and location. Expected a standard 3 star motel, but it exceeded my expectations. Rooms are standard 3 star rooms, but a good size with good amenities. The pool, sauna, steam room and hot tub were all clean and well looked after. Staff was always friendly and the on site restaurant was quite good with reasonable prices. I will be back and would definitely recommend this place to people looking for value, amenities and comfort. Rooms are your typical early 2000s rooms but are well maintained and clean. A/C runs the rooms cold enough to hang meat

author: KellyH81
title: OK, but not for a quiet stay
text: For the money, the facility was dated and worn. The indoor pool was nicely heated and the hot tub was a nice perk. The breakfast buffet was very popular and well-stocked. Our AC was not working when we arrived so the room smelled musty, but was quickly resolved. Hotel staff were very prompt and helpful.Our room was in a building to the right of the office entrance. An ATV/snowmobile rental company uses the parking lot adjacent to the building for their business, and trailheads leading to the Mt Washington area can be accessed there. During daylight hours, there was a constant sound of speeding ATVs past our door. If you are not there to ride the trails, I don't recommend this hotel.

author: D7587YUkarent
title: Warm hospitality, lots to do
text: Lots of trails to walk or ATV, with machine rentals available. Indoor pool. Restaurant is a pleasant surprise. Rooms are clean and spacious. We've stayed here twice a year for about 8 years. Every staff member we (my husband and I) have encountered was courteous and helpful. Also, this is a pet friendly location. The trails make it one of the dogs' favorite stops.

author: LADI1970
title: UNBELIEVABLE SERVICE
text: I cannot believe how brilliant the service is at this Inn. Travelling the U.S. for 3 months and we have stayed in some great and average places and this is up there with the best. I booked for the 4 July weekend as Gorham has some traditional celebrations that as an Australian - I wanted to experience in a small country town. I booked a two double bed room through a third party supplier and when I went to hook in - 3 hours early - and was given a room with only a double bed. I reluctantly went back to reception - something I am usually loath to do - and the lady was so accommodating. On this busy weekend we were given the Suite - where I am now relaxing on the balcony looking at the view. I cannot believe the brilliant customer service and how the staff and manager have accommodated us - this will be the highlight of our 4 July American experience - thank you Town and Country.

author: MBRECED
title: As a business traveler it was OK
text: The pluses: The front desk employees were cordial. No issues with parking. The King bed room was large. Free WIFI The cons: The room was dark, popcorn celings, carpeting that seemed like indoor/outdoor, vinyl tub enclosure, no ironingboard/iron. No soundproofing between rooms so you can hear water and toilet running in the next room! (Hate that!!) This is a motor inn, with parking in front of your door. Although once inside the room I realized there was another door in the back of the room which had a peep hole, so I knew it wasn't a connecting room. I opened that door (which was unlocked!) and it went to an inside hallway -- very odd -- never have seen that configuration. I think the hallway went up to the pool and exercise room which probably is convenient for those using them...I didn't use them or go look.

author: sharig108
title: Group bumped for another party
text: Our TOPs group's annual event was bumped unexpectedly from the nicer meeting room upstairs, to a smaller room in the basement. They claimed they had accidentally overbooked. Unbelievable! I don't know if the organizers were refunded any money, but we all paid for this event with expectations of the upstairs, windowed, room. This was classic bait and switch. The rooms and pool area of this hotel are not that special, older and basic. I will not attend this event again at this location. It was not worth the drive.

author: MKMARINAC1
title: Meets requirements, mostly
text: It's gotta be hard running a motel around here where there's lots of competition. This was our first visit after many times at the #3 ranked motel up the road. On the plus side our room was spacious,clean and comfortable with coffee pot and refrigerator. The pool was warm and it was nice being able to walk to it from indoors. If you're into having a restaurant on site they do here, and being adjacent to an ATV/snowmobile trail. there were lots of customers who brought their ATVs on trailers in the parking lot. The front desk was friendly and they had WiFi although it wasn't always strong (limited access at the pool.) However the hot tub was very small, I liked the other motel's lane-pool better and it would have been nice if the bathroom and sink area were divided by a door to allow 2 at a time use. It didn't matter to me but the TV was small and I always like it when the hotel brews complementary hot coffee in the morning when breakfast isn't included in the room. It's also a little outside of town.

author: 941louisen
title: Great time in the snow!
text: We stayed two nights during the peak snowmobiling time. Loved it. We brought our dog and had a wonderful time. The pool , hot tub were clean and hot. The staff was very helpful nice. We are going to stay here again this summer and again in the winter. Love this place!!! The restaurant was A++++

author: Tiffypop
title: Fun times...no frills
text: We spent one night at the town and country for a ski weekend away. We were traveling with three children. We chose this resort because it was very affordable and it had an indoor pool and restaurant and bar on the property. The rooms were very spacious and clean but nothing fancy and a bit outdated. The kids enjoyed the very heated pool and game room. The food at the restaurant was good but the service was very slow. We probably sat a good 10min before being asked for a drink order. The food did come fairly quickly, I think they were just understaffed as it seemed one waitress was taking all the orders. It was a very similar situation in the lounge, you really needed patience when trying to get a drink. The live entertainment in the lounge was excellent!

author: jamiec159
title: So thankful for such great front desk staff
text: So many people post negative comments. It's my pleasure to post a much appreciated positive comment. What a welcoming greeting from Paula. She was so patient and awesome with our children. Her sense of humor is so comforting. She was so helpful during our entire stay. She took care of anything we needed from our key cards not working to needing a few necessities. .thank you for the much needed hospitality. We will be back because of Paula.

author: marieh226
title: Outstanding service!
text: The service we received here was simply outstanding! I stayed here for a large event over the course of several days. The event filled the hotel for the duration. The owner, Scott Labnon, and his staff went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed for a successful event. We've returned several times for that reason. The food is delicious, the servings are large, and the pricing is reasonable.They are happy to accommodate dietary concerns. It is neat, clean and welcoming. I didn't have a chance to use the pool, hottub, or gym, but they were clean when I saw them. I'll return with my family when we have the chance.

author: Donna29727
title: Return Trip to Town & Country Inn - Excellent!
text: From the front desk personnel to the restaurant hostess, you can't beat the friendly and welcoming staff. Had the pleasure of meeting owner Scott Labnon who further enhanced the overall experience of staying at Town & Country Inn. No matter what you're needs might be, all are there to make things comfortable and right. The food quality was so good (great), I had no desire to eat elsewhere during my Nov 2014 three night stay in the area. Great variety, excellent quality and well presented. Kudos to the chef! Room was great as it was large, clean and the bed offered so much comfort I wanted to unwind early and sleep late -- love the sheets and bedding appointments. Nice! Will definitely be back each and every time I need to be in the Gorham, Berlin, and nearby areas.

author: ktm_scott
title: Very Accommodating to Motorcycles; Super Friendly Staff!
text: I stayed at the T&C for a gathering of motorcycle riders from all over the US and Canada and was most impressed by how gracious and accommodating the staff were to our group. The T&C is American owned and operated by 3rd generation family members who are on site every day. All of the staff were outwardly friendly and seemed to genuinely appreciate our business. The property is not new, so if you're looking for foo foo Hyatt accommodations, look elsewhere. The rooms were clean, the was shower hot, and the air conditioning was cold. The restaurant and bar were well run with a nice variety available for reasonable prices. The indoor pool and hot tub were well maintained and available during my entire stay. The property is a mile or so from the main strip of Gorham with a variety of restaurants, shops, etc. I would recommend the Town and Country to anyone and I would definitely stay there again.

author: kandamyers87
title: The nicest people you will meet!
text: My husband and I used the T&C for our wedding block. The hotel was able to accommodate 100 family and friends for incredible prices during the peak tourist season. The family and staff are so friendly and went out of their way to accommodate guests. They allowed an early check in so folks could change and get to the wedding on time. We had out rehearsal dinner at the hotel And the food, drinks, and service was awesome. Is it a Hilton? No. But you will feel at home!

author: saraPeterborough
title: Adequate rooms
text: Initially the air was very stale and smelled of smoke even tho' there were no smoking signs on the doors etc. Realized that we didnt have a fridge in the room and the day after we arrived asked at the front desk if we could have one and was told "no problem". When it hadnt showed up the next day I inquired and after some discussion realized that I had given the wrong room number.Corrected my mistake and still didn get a fridge..never did get one..left 4 days later never having got one. It was very hot and we had bought some things in Vermont that we felt should have been refrigerated . The day we left wehn we put on the bathroom fan the smell of smoke eminating through the whole room was extremely strong...obviously someone was smoking somewhere.!!! The T and C is conveniently located within walking distance to "down town" Gorham and a short driving distance to the Mt Washington Auto Route and Jackson, Berlin etc. We declined maid service for the 5 days that we were there as my husband was a volunteer on the hill climb and I was on my own for a large part of every day and had lots of time to make a bed and at home using towels and sheets for 5 days in a row is quite normal so didnt feel it was necessary to have them changed. The restaurant had interesting menu choices for dinner each night other than their rather unusual vegetable choices. All the staff was quite friendly especially a dining room waitress who had worked there for 40 years..had seen a lot of history and changes.

author: hcaveman
title: Friendly Staff, Good Rates, Good Food
text: My wife and I recently stayed at the Town and Country Motor Inn because her 50th HS Reunion was being held there. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Our room key did not work consistently, and one of the front desk staff handled the situation well, and we were able to access the room after he adjusted the key. The room was well-laid out with a coffee maker, a refrigerator and comfortable beds. The bathroom area was small but featured both a bath and shower as options. We thought the food was good for our evening meal. The breakfast was reasonable in cost, and there was a breakfast buffet as well as the option of choosing reasonably priced options from the menu. There was a heated pool and spa, but we chose not to use them.

author: stevegV1361NG
title: Not the best
text: The place is run down. The Non smoking room smelled like an ash tray. The bathroom fan was pulling out and sounded like a plane taking off. There was no bed skirt so the box springs were fully exposed and no bed spread just an additional sheet tucked in. Cob webs in the light fixture stained rug. etc. When asked how my stay was I started with the smoke smell and was told that this room had been redone a short time ago. Almost forgot plan on a train going by some time during the very early morning blowing it's horn the road crossing is very near. Will not stay here again.

author: 63frankw
title: Awesome Dart Weekend
text: Each year I come up for the White Mountain Dart shootout and had a spectacular time! The T&C is the absolute perfect location to host this rather large event. I had a great breakfast both mornings in their main dining room and had a delicious dinner at night. The honey scallops are to die for! The room was clean and spacious and just across the way from all of the happening events through out the weekend. The staff was extremely accommodating and friendly and brought me an extra table, so the boys and I could play cards. I can't say enough about how much fun everyone at the event had and we look forward to coming to the Town and Country every year. We are already booked for next year!!

author: RimRock8
title: Value to be had here
text: My family and I stayed here in early March of 2014. The room was basic but clean and comfortable. It's in a great location... about 10 min from Mount Washington and Wildcat ski area and about 45 mins from North Conway and Sunday River. The pool was a decent size and had plenty of room for the adults to sit and relax as the kids swam. The room rate was very reasonable for what you get. We had breakfast at the restaurant and chose the buffet option. The food was good quality and the selections were ample. Good stay at a good value!

author: 404RandyB
title: Ski and Stay, Bike and Stay, Work and Stay`
text: This is the place to stay in northern New Hampshire. I have been coming here since 1985 and started staying here for work, and then I would come for motorcycle and vacation weekends. I have always felt at home here. Last week, I got the urge to ski, looked at the website and took advantage of the Wildcat Ski package. A lift ticket, room, and breakfast for 96.00! Liked it so much I stayed another day. I'm going to try to get back again this season. I had the best days of skiing in years. Since I see that Scott reads these posts, I want to personally thank you for providing this opportunity.

author: cathym339
title: Like stepping back in time – in a good way!
text: We stayed 2 nights at the Town & Country Motor Inn Resort in Gorham, NH. The staff were polite and friendly, and the food excellent and mountainous. The whole thing reminded me of stepping back into the 50s – not that the hotel was down at heal, but the style of the building. I found it very quaint, and could imagine the big old 1950s American cars that would have pulled into the car park in the day. There were drinks and snacks served in the bar in the afternoon, and we had some excellent cocktails before dinner. The hotel is in a perfect place to explore the White Mountains National Park, which is stunningly beautiful. Our first morning were woken a bit early by some noise from a coach party leaving. No fault of the hotel, but a little annoying. That aside, an excellent choice.

author: TonySandwich_MA_
title: Great Place
text: This place was really an all around great stop on our fall leaf peeping trip. we traveled with our little dog and they were very accomodating. the restaurant was fantastic for breakfast and dinner. The bar had a "happy hour with hot treats and the prices were great.The location gies you easy access to the Mt. Washington Valley and the Franconia Notch areas along Route 302. if you go twenty two miles in the other direction you can see Bethel and the Sunday River areas. We went home along Route 26 and found a new casino in Oxford,Maine. If you want a nice clean fun place give it a try. There is also an indoor pool, steam room and gym. very nice owners and a very nice place.

author: Donna29727
title: T & C Great Place to Stay
text: Quite a nice place to stay. Room was large, comfortable and held a wonderful view of the mountains. Restaurant was fantastic with delicious food and reasonably priced. Wait staff very friendly and accommodating. The adjacent bar/lounge is really a nice area to relax either at small tables, the bar or on one of the three couches by the windows. This area brought in a lot of natural light with a view of a golf course and the well kept landscaping and flowers on the premises of the motel. This made a great place after a day at work where I could pop open my laptop (free WIFI) while we had a refreshment and enjoyed the complimentary hot and cold h'orderves before dinner. Each night offers a dinner special and you cannot beat the Family Style dinner night that serves ham, chicken and beef with all the sides and dessert included. We'll be back!

author: stephaniey560
title: Missed opportunity
text: I stayed at this lodge/inn a month ago for a wedding. From the outside, it looks like it would be accommodating. Well the lobby alone would unfortunately be enough to turn folks away. It smelled like smoke so badly I looked around each time to see if someone was smoking. The hotel bar only had one bartender, so when there was a wedding party, the bartender was overwhelmed. The room itself was ok, but they hadn't finished cleaning. So the cleaning person came in and just shoved towels in the bathroom. The only redeeming quality was the restaurant. The breakfast buffet was great, and service was great.

author: 545leeb
title: VERY PLEASED
text: We had our 55th Class Reunion....the Class of 1958.. at the Town & Country Motor Inn and I will tell you it was the BEST FOOD and SERVICE one could ever expect !!! All our classmates commented how great things were. I was the Chairman for this reunion and The Management and Staff provided us with all our needs and was very helpful throughout our stay there. Nice big clean rooms and everyone that stayed there commented how satisfied they were. Our event was held there the 24th of August 2013. J. Lee Boyle

author: Mickey682013
title: Disappointed
text: This is my third visit to Town and County this time I was very disappointed in the accomodations. There were 4 people in the room and we had 3 thread bare towels left for us in the room. When I asked for more the desk clerk told me I had to wait until someone from housekeeping came in - maybe in 1/2 hour or so. No one ever came with another towel nor did they bother to leave any more towels for the next day. The room was not vaccumed and there were spiders in the room. The water in the pool was green and it smelled terrrible. It was extrememly loud in the room-between the guests above us and the out of date air-conditioning system it was impossible to sleep. There are other hotels in Gorham with equally good rates- I'll be staying at one of them next year!

author: erik2343
title: Very nice!
text: I have stayed here on family vacations for many years. This place has so much charm. Not fancy and it is older but a very pleasant place to stay. Dinning room is great. Food is wonderful for price. Great overall value. The only complaint is the bathroom could have been cleaner and they offer wi-fi but it does not work. They need a strong signal. Only works if you are near the office

author: Chris0987654321
title: Fantastic
text: I've been here going on 8 weeks doing work on the power plant in town. As much as I hate having to leave home for days and days on end. Here at the Town and Country they give me something to look forward to. The rooms are always spotless when I come back after work. The pool, hot tub, steam room, and sauna are fantastic. The indoor pool is nice a refreshing and the hot tub is a great way to relax after working all day. I really can't think of a better place I'd rather stay for weeks on end. The staff at the front desk is amazing. The ladies are very helpful, friendly and willing to help with any questions or concerns that you may have. Overall I can't find anything negative about this place and after staying here for almost 8 weeks I don't think I ever will.

author: JandPFamily
title: Fun Affordable Time Up North
text: My Husband and I went to the Town & Country Inn for a weekend snowmobile event. Unfortunately there wasn't much snow (as was most of the state at the time) so we chose not to bring our snowmobiles. We still had a good time. We went out to dinner twice and enjoyed dancing at the inn in the evening. We went there 11 years ago for New Years Eve. Both times the night life was a lot of fun for us! The building are not connected for all activities (the pool and restaurant are in different buildings) but an easy walk for anyone. The rooms are older, but clean. The staff was friendly. Its a convenient location up north and definitely an affordable lodging option.

author: danxy
title: Worn motel, poor service
text: From the front it looks like a good motel, but in back there's a large, ugly parking lot. The motel mainly serves large fleets of tour buses--they have several rooms. The rooms are old and worn--worn carpeting, musty rooms, old bathroom fixtures. Service is poor. I helped an elderly woman lug her luggage upstairs (no elevator). We had breakfast, but had to wait several minutes to be served (waiters ignored us and we demanded service from someone who said it's not her table. Nobody's table apparently). Still, if you only want sleep and don't mind the smell, you could do worse.

author: 49AnnaS
title: We plan to return to the Town and Country Resort
text: We stayed at the Town and Country Resort for nine nights in September. I am certain vacationing at this resort would be enjoyable year round. The setting is beautiful. We were very impressed by the services the resort offered. The staff was very friendly and met all of our requests. My husband hiked the AppalachianTrail for several days during our stay. I felt very comfortable staying there while he was away. Their talented chefs prepared incredible meals for us. We will definitely return next year. I already know what I want for dinner.

author: abcoldgit
title: Disappointing
text: Having seen the website pictures we were looking forward to our stay here. When we arrived, the reality was something different. Instead of the bright, airy room with flat screen television shown on the Internet we were allocated a dark, chocolate brown decorated room with an old CRT set. It was even darker because the main light in the room was broken. Once that was fixed we could see to investigate the room more closely. The bathroom was not good, the woodwork was in poor condition, in need of a coat of paint and housekeeping had neglected to supply all the towels. The main part of the room was in better condition, (but why choose such dark colours in such a big room with little natural light?) though there was a lack of attention to detail, tops missing off switches, a backplate not properly attached. The bed was comfortable and we had a good night's sleep, until that is, silly o'clock when the massed ranks of the bus party tourists were up and about, ready to be on the road when the first rays of sunlight peeped over the mountains. The food was good value for money, a pity they could not provide any fresh fruit at breakfast.

author: courtclerk1999
title: Package Deal
text: My husband is a golfer and stays at your facility every year. This year he and a friend decided to bring their wives back to your facility for a non-golfing adventure. We bought one of your package deals and must say we had a great time. I must say my favorite part of the whole visit was your food. We were very satisfied with all of our meals. The waitstaff were very professional and very friendly, even though gratuities were included we still tipped our waitresses because of their excellent service. The only complaint I have is that our bed was very squeaky! Thank you for making our visit a pleasant one!!

author: Michelle979
title: DISAPPOINTING
text: Definitely disappointed with this location and wouldn't stay again. Rooms are dated and somewhat clean. Pool was yucky and there were never any towels available. Impossible to find anyone for assistance with towels, etc., Owner/staff were less than pleasant/helpful. Restaurant - DON'T eat here! We waited over an hour with children ages 6 and 8 for our food. The food was costly and bland, the service extremely slow. Little apology give, although they did comp the kids meals, we wasted over an hour of our night at this dive. I was not impressed at all with the hotel and wouldn't recommend to anyone. I would however recommend staying in North Conway where there are more attractions, newer hotels (chains), and more things to do.

author: nctravelerharley
title: Nice Hotel near Mt Washington
text: If you are staying near the Mt Washington, NH area, this is a good choice for a family owned property. Front desk staff was very helpful and appear to be very customer service oriented. Nice restaurant and bar on site. Rooms are quite large, small fridge in room and clean bathroom. Furniture is somewhat dated, but not really an issue. Mattress and boxsprings need to be replaced, bed is very squeaky. I did not see an elevator, so if you have mobility issues, request 1st floor. Also the highway facing rooms have a great view. Golf course across the street. Plenty of parking and the grounds are very well maintained.

author: KayTee9
title: Clean, Comfortable, Courteous
text: My husband and I stayed here with a small group of friends while we were on a sight-seeing trip. It was a very pleasant property located in a rural area where I did not expect to find such an attractive, scenic, moderately-priced resort. It is family-run. Our room was clean and comfortable with the added attraction of having a balcony where we could read in the warm summer evening. There is a very nice restaurant, and an indoor swimming pool. The food was good and there was plenty of it. The Sunday buffet had numerous choices, and was an unexpected treat. The waitstaff and dining room manager were very accommodating and courteous. This is a scenic, nicely maintained property which is family-owned. This is a good place to kick back and relax.

author: TravellingPant
title: Average but reasonable price
text: We stayed at the Town & Country Motor Inn Resort, on our was up to Sunday River. I thought the hotel rooms were big, and the beds were confortable. However, I thought the rooms were disgusting, I found hairs in the shower, toilette, and sink. To say the least, I did not even want to think about the room. I thought the hallways were very noisy as well as outside people kept on running the snowmobiles at 8 am on a saturday. THought it was disrespectful, and no one from management came to help. Breakfast is not included. Price was cheap. Overall recommend only as a stopping point hotel not for a extended stay.

author: JanBostonMa
title: beautiful location
text: Average motel but the scenery and location are superb. Rooms are comfortable and clean. Dining room is very convenient with linen tablecloths and beautiful views from the windows. There is a faint odor when you walk into the dining room itself which is stale smelling. I was not the only one to notice this another breakfast diner was overheard to comment on this. I ordered a rib eye steak for dinner and although the sides were perfect the steak was too tough for me to eat. Breakfast however was very good, no free coffee or continental breakfast which travelers have come to expect. Another good thing I have stayed here with my dog and they are most welcome. Housekeeping very annoying kept knocking on the door. Outside door and inside corridor door.

author: Family_traveller103
title: We have enjoyed this Inn over the last ten years
text: We last stayed at this Inn on Sunday August 21, 2011. We always feel good about staying here. It offers excellent value, warm and friendly service and large clean rooms. The view is breathtaking, if you like the White Mountains. The heated indoor pool, sauna and hot tub are always enjoyed by our family. What we like best is that this Inn is family owned and run and the Labnon's take pride in what they do and are hands on in showing that they care. The breakfast is superb. We will continue to stay at the Town and Country in the future.

author: figmo
title: Nice family-run hotel, EXCELLENT customer service
text: We arrived at the hotel intending only to stay for dinner at the restaurant. We decided to stay the night, and the hotel went out of their way to accomodate our two families beside each other. We were pleasantly surprised with the quality of the food and the attentiveness of the wait staff. The rooms, although a little dated, were clean and comfortable. Our children enjoyed the indoor pool. On a special note - the next day I realized I'd left my iPad in our room - and we were 50 miles away on our way back to Ontario. After a frantic call back to the hotel, the manager Randy tracked down the iPad and personally took care of shipping it back to me in Canada. That special act of kindness- and excellent customer service - is why I have no hesitation recommending the hotel to anyone.

author: EnjoyTravelAlways
title: Stay Here and Drive Up Mount Washington
text: We were on a fall color tour and on a budget. We were pleased to find this place near Mount Washington. We had already decided we weren’t going to go out for dinner so the large room was ideal for us. The table and chairs were almost retro but served us just fine. We picked up some things at Wal-Mart and enjoyed the evening. The restaurant was very nice for breakfast. The staff was very friendly. Basic but clean and comfortable. The room we had was huge so don’t worry if you are claustrophobic! We especially appreciated the fact that this was north of Mount Washington and much more sleepy than some of the sites we saw further south.

author: NY2NH
title: Great price and amenities for a budget traveler, but tough location
text: We stayed here for two reasons, my wife used to stay here with her family as a kid and the price was the lowest around the White Mountains that had decent reviews--we also liked that they allowed dogs at such a low fee in case we brought ours, which we didn't. Our stay was scheduled for a Sunday through Thursday at an internet rate and when I called on Thursday to ask for an additional night, they not only confirmed it for me but gave me the going rack rate of $20 cheaper without my asking instead of just charging me another night of the internet rate. As we don't like our room cleaned during our stay, when we called for clean towels, they were there within 5 minutes and they even tied clean towels to the door handle in a plastic bag for us on a few days. The place is clean but keep in mind it is a well maintained, family-run motor inn...nothing fancy, We did use the pool one night and the gym and game room looked nice and updated. The free Wi-Fi was easy and we did not get to eat at the restaurant but the prices seemed great. The only problem with staying here is that it is at least a 40 minute drive to any of the big tourist sites in the White Mountains. We did a lot in North Conway for 3 days and it was a trek to and from each day but we could not have stayed in any other location for the price we paid...so we didn't complain too much. Gorham in general looks like it has been hit hard by the recession...so many restaurants closed down.

author: playspicc
title: Decent Motel--Dog Friendly!
text: I was surprised at the low rates offered here. The room was decent enough to sleep in. They have a very nice indoor pool & hot tub. There's also a game room that the kids enjoyed. Best part was that it only cost $6 per dog per night--best rate around. Only 30 minutes to either Storyland or Santa's Village. Close to many restuarants. Family run, very friendly desk. Would stay here again if we had the dogs.

author: missamy2126
title: Great view, good food, but musty room
text: My husband and I recently traveled to NH with our young children(5 yr old, 6 mo old baby) and 2 small dogs. We purchased a family attraction package which included our stay, breakfast and Storyland tickets. We were happy with everything EXCEPT our room. I agree with a previous review that guests should not be given a second rate room merely because they are traveling with dogs...especially due to the fact that there is an upcharge to do so. The room(#138) was damp, dark and musty. We all woke up with stuffy noses the next day and our clothes smelled of mildew. On the positive side, the view was gorgeous and the restaurant was great! Our servers and food were fabulous! Would definitely eat there again. The value was pretty good, but will make sure we are happy with our room next time.

author: TravelingAllOver46
title: Super place to stay and eat
text: We stayed here 3 nights, out seeing what northern NH had to offer (quite a bit !!). This motel is THE place to stay in the Gorham area. Nicely appointed average-sized room, extremely clean, and a great shower. TV style could use some upgrading, but worked well. Super staff, nice pool, good location across from the country club/golf course. My only complaint was the very poor wireless internet service. What sets this place apart from most of the others is their outstanding dining room. Serves breakfast and dinner, no lunch but you shouldn't be there at that time anyway. Great menu, excellent staff, nice appointments, and pretty good food. We'll be going back here, wouldn't consider any other place in upper New Hampshire.

author: ChickPosseeGirl
title: Last room in town!
text: We drove into Gorham thinking it would be easy to find a room. Without a reservation, it was not as easy as we had thought! The first motel called ahead for us and we drove straight to the Town & Country to get one of the last rooms available. They have a lot to offer, especially if traveling with children. There is a heated indoor pool, fitness room and a restaurant. The rooms are quite large, although the bathrooms are very small. We chose to drive back into town for dinner at Saladino's. If you like Italian food, we highly recommend it! They do not accept any discounts, but have their rooms priced at AAA rates, according to the front desk clerk.

author: NETravelWriter
title: Don't stay here!!!!
text: Don't stay in this dump. Our room was terrible. The only good thing was that it didn't have any bugs. Mostly because I don't think they would survive in the room it was so bad. My wife got sick after eating at the restaraunt. Our whole trip was ruined. We love Gorham, but will definitely stay somewhere else next time. One good thing: The staff was friendly.

author: IsleofWightGolfer
title: Great deal for a two basic stop over
text: I was pleasantly surprised by the great deal I got at T&C. I received an efficient welcome at reception but clearly they were gearing themselves up for the daily arrival of tour coaches. Would suggest checking in early to avoid their arrival and if dining in don't leave it too late for similar reasons. The room was basic and yes a little bit tired . It was however fully functional , clean and no less than one could expect for the price. The indoor pool was great and on both occasions had the place to myself. The resturant was busy but found the service very friendly with a good menu and food quality with prices the same as roadside family resturants. Overall a good experince in a scenic setting and quiet despite the coach parties. Good for a short stay but no more.

author: texasford
title: Great place to stay!
text: My grandson and I spent one night at the Town and Country Motor Inn during our June vacation. The room was large and very clean. My grandson made use of the pool and also the exercise room. We were really impressed with both. The pool area was well maintained and included dressing rooms. The exercise room had a great selection of equipment and also had dressing rooms. Yes, the decor was "outdated", but I never judge a room by the decor, but by size and cleanliness and it certainly does well in those areas. The price was right and the staff were polite and helpful. The location was good and our room was at the back of the property so it was very quiet. If we are in this area again, we will make plans on staying at the Town & Country Motor Inn again!

author: Bennink
title: A nice and quiet motel
text: The Town and Country Motor Inn is a wonderful motel, but perhaps a little outdated. But everything is in perfect condition, it's clean, nice staff and just a good quiet place to spend the night or stay a little longer. You will not be disappointed. Only breakfast was disappointing. They were understaffed the day we were there. When we got our food, it was just small portions and we had to eat fast before it was entirely cold. Perhaps dinner was better, we didn't have it there. But there's not much choice in town either but burger joints.

author: Beanoes
title: Lovely relaxing hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel for one night but absolutely looooved it. We arrived mid afternoon and checked in to our hotel room which was clean but dull and dated. I had to request an iron and iron board from reception - it was quickly delivered !! We stayed in a few hotels during our tour of New England and this one one of our favourites -if not the favourite!!!!!. The spa, sauna and pool was extremely relaxing. The food was fantastic and the evening entertainment was great. In the morning the views were fantastic. This hotel is definately an example of not judging a book by its cover!!!

author: savannah81102
title: staff not very polite
text: Motel was not what we expected from previous reviews. The bathroom had mold on the side and ceiling, the indoor heated pool was very cold. We ordered a refridgerator and it was dirty with a bad odor. When they came to exchange it the staff said they were all like that and she gave it a good spray of Windex. Breakfast was a 45 minute wait for our food when I inquired about the wait the waitress said that there was another larger group and they were priority and if we wanted to cancel our order. I called the front desk for the weather one morning and I was told to turn on the tv to a specific channel. When we said the pool was very cold and got a blank look. On the positive, the view was beautiful, the grounds are very nice and well kept and the breakfast food was very good once it did arrive. The beds are also comfortable.

author: RosemaryG194
title: See you next year.
text: We were a golf group of 18 people and all thought overall the golf package was a great value for the money. Package included room, 2 meals a day, 18 holes of golf with a cart, tax and gratuties. The staff was very accommodating and friendly. They even let us use an empty banquet room to organize a card game one evening. Wide variety of menu items to choose from and the wait staff was wonderful. Only bad comment would be the noisy air conditioning units in the motel rooms, while they cooled the room sufficiently they were very loud especially for light sleepers. However, that will not stop us from coming back next year. This group has been to many other places in over 15 years and the Town & Country rates near the top of the list for overall value for the price.

author: Tourist25609
title: Comfortable--No frills
text: We stayed at the "T & C" in December, 2005. It was our first time staying there in at least 15 years. The place hasn't changed much. Rooms are still clean and comfortable. The heat works well, which was important since it was 8 degrees outside. The restaurant was great for breakfast. The lounge closed a bit earlier than we would have liked--last call was 9:30 on a Thursday night. While we typically prefer fancier accommodations, the price was right, and T&C is definitely the best option in the Gorham/Berlin area.

author: NorthStar636059
title: A must for South Africa experience
text: We had an amazing experience at Mosaic Farms. It sits on the edge of a lagoon, with beautiful mountains in the near distance. You woke up to this spectacular view every morning. The staff is excellent, friendly and was there to meet all our needs. Had a great massage at the spa. The food was out of this world, with the chef using fresh ingredients from their garden. The best wine from South Africa available, as was any drink you preferred. An extremely knowledgeable guide took us on a quad excursion over the property and then to sand dunes to walk the beach. Great place for a venue.

author: 3bubbles
title: Wonderful stay along Whale coast
text: We spent 2 nights at Mosaic during our trip to South Africa. Upon arrival it was evident that we had arrived at a special place. The property is well maintained and has beautiful views from every where. The guest rooms are well appointed and have everything you need. Each guest has their own guide who will customize your stay. We had a wonderful excursion to the beach for sunset drinks and whale watching. All meals are eaten in a beautiful, intimate dinning area, with first class service. I would highly recommend taking advantage of the spa services as well. This was a little slice of heaven, that we could of spent more time at. We will be back someday.

author: deliriousheels
title: Hidden Gem
text: If you’re looking for a luxurious lodge to wind down and relax, you will not go wrong with Mosaic. My husband and I were there for 2 nights in early June as part of our honeymoon and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at Mosaic. The lodge is tucked away in a rather secluded area but that also means that it’s a perfect place for a quiet and tranquil holiday, accompanied with a beautiful view of the lagoon. Our room was luxurious, cozy and clean and had everything we needed and wanted (loved the nuts, gin, wine and sherry in the room!). Every meal was also hearty and delicious. There’s quite a bit of activities to do such as bird watching, walking tour, quad bikes and a private trip to the beach for whale watching (Do bring along your own binoculars though!). What tops it all was our fantastic and knowledgeable guide, Vitalis, who made all the activities that much more fun and enjoyable. The best part of Mosaic is however the staff, like Moses and Vivienne, who really went above and beyond to make our stay such a great one. At the end of the trip, they felt almost like family and we were really sad to leave. Thank you again Mosaic for the memorable experience!

author: 649francesl
title: Piece of Heaven
text: We’ve been going to Mosaic for a while. Such a lovely place to escape from the normal rush of city life. They have very friendly and accommodating staff. The food is great and I personally think they serve the best cheese platter I’ve ever eaten. The views are spectacular. By just having lunch there, feels like a mini breakaway. That is why we are planning to have our wedding here next year. My favourite spot by far!

author: slinky-wp
title: Little paradise not far from home
text: What a gem for just a 2hr Drive from home. The staff are genuinely friendly and do their best to make you sure you’re happy and comfortable . The main area is decorated beautifully and the environment is peaceful and relaxing. Lots of birds around and the rooms face the mountain and lagoon. The elephant walk massage at the spa was unique. The spa products are from Rain and also in the rooms which is a nice touch along with a few other things. There are activities but the lodge is a great place to relax, bird watch, catch some sun and read... Felt very rejuvenated when we left and would definitely return. We tried the only Sinatra Jack Daniels in SA - it was very smooth!

author: bobwatt2018
title: The Great Escape
text: Wonderful reception. Fantastic, caring staff. Brill lodge. Excellent food. Talented guide. Beautiful location. Vivienne and her colleagues just couldn't do enough for us. Vitalis, tailored walks to indulge our love of birds - he knows them all! Simply wonderful. Watching the sun rise, with a cup of tea on our stoop, in the deep peace of the lagoon was an extraordinary experience.

author: SimonSquared
title: A magical place
text: Mosaic is special. Nestled quietly in an enchanted wood by a sparkling lagoon, its five lodges face the stunning landscape of the sweeping Overberg mountains. Each lodge is beautifully appointed and private, with everything you could possibly need to hand (unless you want a widescreen TV - if so, Mosaic might not be for you). The cuisine is individually prepared and charmingly presented. The activities are great fun - quad biking is a must - and really help you appreciate the fabulous surroundings. But the secret to Mosaic’s success is its people. Appropriately enough for an enchanted wood, they have magical powers, somehow making you feel like they’re old friends who you just never met before. We loved everything about this place and have already booked our return trip. In fact we almost didn’t want to write this review... it’s too good to share!

author: stephwags2018
title: Absolutely Incredible Honeymoon!
text: This place is so amazing. The staff treat you like gold and make you feel like your royalty! The food was unbelievable.. there was not a single thing we had that we didn’t love. The daily excursions were all awesome. We loved going to the beach so much that we ended up staying the entire day there and our guide went back to get us lunch and brought it to the beach :). A hidden gem forsure and we highly recommend spending a few nights here if you can. The spa was awesome too, I had a facial and it was sooo relaxing. A perfect way to end our honeymoon.

author: Rubybirkenhead
