title: Great self catering cottages on the side of the lagoon
text: We have stayed at the very special lagoon lodges before but this time we were a large group so we rented out two of the four cottages. Duminy is the large one with two double bedrooms and a loft which has five single beds. It's got great outside terraces upstairs and down and fabulous views over the lagoon. Milkwood 3 had two double bedrooms - one with a small adjoining solace with a single bed. There is now an outside pool on site for the use of all the cottages. We made great use of all the facilities - the spa, quad biking, jeep to the beach, guided wildlife walk. We also had lunch at the Spuikhouse and had their food brought in for breakfast and evening meals. Staff were extremely helpful - fully recommend if you are a large group.

author: shreeyag7
title: Great stay!!
text: It is probably the finest lodge in the area. Excellent rooms, terrific facilities, friendly and courteous staff and superb food. The hospitality was excellent. This is a quiet, romantic and relaxing place to stay. The room had a beautiful lagoon view. There were a lot of organised activities giving best of experiences. Indeed a fantastic place to stay. Highly recommended.

author: DenisePF
title: Perfect end to our holiday in SA
text: We stayed two nights at the end of a month away and found it very relaxing. We had an SUV and if you are driving you certainly need this as the last section of the road for a few Kms is gravel. The signage at the main road turn off , could certainly be improved as our GPS had us going in circles for a few minutes until we worked it out. The staff were very friendly and could not do enough for us, they were there at every turn with a cold drink or making sure we were happy. The rooms were very spacious and plenty of room for luggage. The bathrooms also spacious but could do with a little more lighting in them. We loved the fact that it was small with only a dozen guests and we got to know and talk to the other guests. We had a lovely Christmas lunch but if I was being honest the food for lunch and dinner was more limiting and probably not as of a high standard that we had experienced on the rest of our holiday in South Africa. We did the quad bikes and drinks at the beach and loved the experience.

author: RubenB1815
title: Unsurpassed service
text: My fiancée and I had a fantastic stay at Mosaic Lagoon Lodge. The staff displayed an extremely high level of attention, the suites were fantastic and the serenity of the place is just out of this world. We stayed two nights and did three activities; a beach walk (with pop up bar including delicious bites), quad (ATV) riding and a boat ride on the lagoon. And we both took a treatment of 90 mins at the Rain Milkwood Spa on the premises. I have undergone at least 60 massages and similar treatments in various places around the world, and this one certainly belongs in the top 3. Visiting this place and skipping the Spa I would consider a crime :-) Also, I asked Mosaic to make a special arrangement, because I planned to 'pop the question'. That's a request they know how to handle. They delivered extremely well with a private dining setting in our own suite, filled bath tub, fizzly bubbly and flowers/hearts everywhere. Thanks for that! We have left MOSAIC with a very warm feeling and we do hope to come back one day.

author: amandab463
title: We love Mosaic Lagoon Lodge!
text: This was a return trip for us to Mosaic Lagoon Lodge - we loved it 18 months ago, and we loved it even more this time! It is in the most beautiful location, possibly the most peaceful and uplifting place I have ever been........ Lovely to see some familiar faces from last time - Moses, Maria and Vitalis, and great to meet new people also - Erin, Joanne and Chipo. They all do their very best to look after you from start to finish - not to mention the excellent food provided by chef Adrian - from boat trips on the lagoon, to sundowners on the beach - where we were entertained for half an hour by a large pod of dolphins - to bespoke outings. There is also a lovely spa. It was our wedding anniversary while we were there, and Erin drove us to the highest point on the reserve and plied us with champagne while we basked in the stunning surroundings. We went for dinner at the nearby Springfontein Wine Estate (see separate review) and when we returned we found that our room was covered with rose petals and yet another bottle of champagne was waiting for us! Nothing was too much trouble for them, and I can't recommend Lagoon Lodge enough. It really felt as if we were saying goodbye to family when we left, and we will definitely be back! Thank you.

author: fionao315
title: Unique and unforgettable
text: This place treated us like we were a royal couple, from the time we arrived, to our departure. The personalized treatment here is like nothing we have ever experienced. It’s a great place for a honeymoon, or for people who want to get away from the noise of modern day life. We went here to celebrate our engagement; the other guests we saw were older couples in their 50’s. The only negative, which could be a positive for other people, is the location. It’s off the beaten track in quite an ugly and empty town. If you’re like me and need to know that there are 24hr services, in the closest town, and other things to see and do you may feel a little anxious here. In saying that, I’m a city person who likes cities, so being somewhere “remote” is not my thing. Whether it’s you’re thing or not I’d still recommend coming here for one very unique and unforgettable experience.

author: ginasv2
title: Heavenly
text: We didn't know much about this portion of our trip to South Africa when our travel agent suggested it and we booked it, so we were blown away with the beauty of this gem of a property. Its views of the lagoon and mountains were astounding. We loved the tranquility. The service could not have been any better. The activities were perfect. Our activity guide even helped us see whales way off in the distance at the coast when it wasn't quite whale season yet after a fun jeep ride through the dunes to get to the coast. I can't imagine adding the excitement of true whale watching to this perfect vacation! And the food, well, we were amazed it could be better than the food we had just had on the safari we had just come from, but we all agreed it was! Truly this was a trip of a lifetime, and Mosaic Lagoon Lodge had a lot to do with it!

author: fionag423
title: Peace, Privacy and special service
text: My husband and I celebrated a special anniversary with a 2-day "parent break" at Lagoon Lodge. We were treated royally by all the staff at Mosaic, from the friendly greetings and introduction to everyone as we arrived, to the Amarula-laced hot chocolate when we returned from our quad bike ride, the Mosaic team had thought of everything. They spoilt us with a private dinner, flowers on our duvet, special messages and a small gift for our anniversary - going that extra mile to make special memories for us.Thank you! Despite lodge 2 being right next to the main building, it was private and peaceful. The bed was large and comfortable, the bathroom deliciously decadent and everything available that you could possibly need. The view was astonishingly beautiful and we spent many hours just drinking it in from the deck outside (and being spoilt by our friendly and hospitable butler, Vivienne, bringing us cappuccino or beer whenever we wished). Unfortunately, the weather was not conducive during our stay to some of the activities on offer, but my husband enjoyed the quad bike ride and we both were pleased that the wind relented enough to allow us to enjoy the boat ride on the lagoon. Altogether, an experience to savour and a wonderful treat for a special occasion.

author: Prasadmatkar
title: Absolutely stunning, beautiful setup, great staff
text: Was on my honeymoon and we were literally made to feel like king and queen. What a fantastic place, brilliant range of activities. I forgot the name of the manager lady there (sorry) but special mention for her. Everybody seem to enjoy their job and take pride in what they do. Special mention for the guy who took us quad biking, my wife and I thoroughly enjoyed it, and Vitals for taking us to beach and walking safari. The location was breath taking. My only regret wish I could spend few more days there. But I will come back.

author: BigAl54321
title: Rustic but Luxurious
text: We wanted to stay in the area during our recent South African holiday. The original resort we had booked had a fire and this was the alternative found by our travel agent and it was an excellent choice. It is "remote" but that provides the peaceful charm of the place. My wife was concerned as we drove several miles down a dust road to reach the lodge but her reservations were soon put to one side. The welcome was warm and friendly the room was good and everything was spotless. It's not everyday that you can sit outside having breakfast and watch flamingos in a lagoon. We did a sunset beach walk organised by Bill, the ranger. It was a drive over the sand dunes in a 4x4 and then we walked along a deserted beach at the end of the walk, Bill was already there with the drinks ready. This hotel would not be for everyone but if you want to get back to nature in a luxurious way you could not do better.

author: 436don
title: The perfect place to relax
text: The Mosaic Lagoon Lodge was a very pleasant surprise for us. The accommodations are very nicely appointed and our patio faced the lagoon and mountains. The lodge has a fireplace and a lot of windows so one can enjoy the views while eating breakfast and dinner. A glass of wine, the beautiful sunsets, what a way to end the day!! Lunch is normally served at a fully restored building built around the turn of the century. Daily activities include four wheeling, kayaking, trips to the beach, massages, and guided walks. The food is excellent and beautifully presented. We are vegans and they were happy to prepare special meals for us. We would go back in a heartbeat.

author: 729marcom729
title: like another honey moon (with our kids!)
text: Mosaic Lagoon was our last stop before Cape Town after a week of safari and driving on the Garden Route. the place is amazing. service and staff are super. they have 5 rooms only and you can enjoy quite and relax with yourself and your partner or family. Vitalis is a top guide for your activities; Moses and Maria our restaurant staff were super and looked after us for the whole time Management is great but all the staff made us feeling in a warm place. everythin very clean and tidy. Food is great prepared with care and attention to details by a local chef. enjoy the many attractions around the Lagoon (ocean beach, whales watching, bird watching and quads!!)

author: 2420jime
title: Better than imaginedg
text: We were looking to stay somewhere between the Little Karoo and Cape Town and discovered the Mosaic Lagoon Lodge. On-line pictures do not do justice to this special locale, but what makes Mosaic magic are the people. In no time you feel you've become part of an extended family. We had so much fun. The planned activities are not to be missed; sundowner on a high dune overlooking the Southern Ocean, quad-biking through the dunes, nature walks along the lagoon. The five cottages are positioned for absolute privacy. The food and service are devine. I will return.

author: btamp
title: Spooked then Satisfied
text: A hidden lodge in the hills of Stanford. A few number of things to do on site. Whale watching at the beach(yet the whales were shy that day) and a Quad Bike adventure that was fun. The mountains with the lake right outside of the main meeting area was great and truly relaxing. Food choices were good and very intimate as there were only 4 cabins in this area. Our 1st night of our 2 night stay was a bit freaked out as we assume that one of the employees left our door open during service as we came back to an enumerate amount of mosquitoes. It surprised us greatly yet on our 2nd night the room was wiped clean and mosquito situation was not even close to what it was the night prior so that was better. The staff were great namely Maria, Moses & Jacques. Just awesome and kind individuals that really were genuine and sweet.

author: 116christinek
title: Mosaic Lagoon Lodge
text: If you like nature, you will love Mosaic Farm. It blends in with nature and yet offers all the comfort you require from a 5 star property. It is also a scenic short drive from Hermanus if you have a need for city life. The nature reserve was a spectacle of flowers everywhere we looked. My teenage son and I both enjoyed the quad biking in the reserve. Walker Bay was very windy but we still managed to see a whale in the distance. Our guide was fantastic and eager to explain the secrets of the Cape floral kingdom. Our room had fantastic views of the lagoon and mountain range in the background. The standard of accommodation is top and the service was always with a smile.

author: Atlantan1972
title: A lovely property
text: This lodge is located off of a dirt road about 10 km from Stanford. It has a lovely indoor lodge room with deck which faces a lovely lagoon and provides a view of beautiful sunsets. The staff is very friendly and are constantly plying you with food and drink. The place was looking for a new permanent chef but the temporary chef who was vetting the new chef provided excellent gourmet meals. There is an activity guide who is most knowledgable about flowers and birds and took us quad bike riding, on a nature walk, and on a hike to the coast to watch whales from the large dunes of a local pristine beach. The rooms were nice with a large bath but some things were a little rustic. Heat is provided by a stove which works on pellets, the water in the shower does not have much pressure and the lodge is the only place with wifi. Each room has large shelves for suitcases, a safe, homemade nut snacks, and coffee, tea and sherry. Our stay here was fun and enjoyable.

author: N6656AZsarahw
title: perfect spot to relax
text: A wonderful start to our holiday. An exceptional lodge - our only criticism is that they allowed us to book for just one night - way too short - minimum 2 night stay should be obligatory!!! Next time a longer stay.... The service and attention to detail was superb, very friendly and knowledgeable staff. The room was beautiful, we loved the pellet heater and the bottle of bubbly when the room was turned down. The food was outstanding. It was really lovely that everything is included in the room rate. We just wanted to relax but there's plenty to do should you choose to.

author: Aeraille
title: A Really Great Experience
text: We were welcomed with a glass of bubbly. The basics were explained to us, and we were escorted to our chalet. The chalet is luxuriously appointed with everything you might require, including a high tech wood pellet burning heater. The bathroom is large and includes an oval bath. The toilet is separate. Two easy chairs and a table occupy the open air patio. Service is absolutely excellent and the dining is exclusively first class, although with a limited menu. A number of excursions including quad bikes and a cruise on the lake are included. We were really treated like royalty and full board is included.

author: 235micheleo
title: Romantic astay
text: Wonderful place to stay on a long dirt road out of Hemanus. We loved the privacy ,the excellent food and comfortable warm room. our room had it's own fire place and hot water bottles. We arrived late the first night but still in time for an excellent dinner. All meals were excellent and desserts delicious. The atmosphere is cosy with an open fire and the beautiful view through the big glass windows of the lagoon. We only stayed two nights so we enjoyed a long walk in the morning and a trip to the beach with sundowners in the afternoon. The beach is beautiful and wild and we did see whales breaching in the distance. All the staff were polite and very helpful. We really enjoyed our stay at Mosaic

author: emma716
title: A tranquil oasis - the perfect place to relax in a natural sanctuary with 5*'s
text: What was there not to Iove! The 'hotel' consisted of 5 bedrooms - each with in its own stunning hut complete with an outdoor shower and an incredible indoor bathroom! The rooms were connected to the central area, where we ate stunning food, watched the birds or sipped a gin and tonic (or whatever else took your fancy). In addition we did some fantastic activities including quad biking and a beach walk (sadly the boat was out of action, but there was still plenty to do). We stayed 2 nights which was probably ideal - 3 would be good if you wanted to visit the local vin yards! The team were second to none - and pampered to our every whim! A wonderful stay and the perfect place to star gaze! Ps don't forget to stop to see the Penguins on the way at Betty's Bay!

author: NOMAD070
title: 5 STARS ALL THE WAY!!!!
text: Fantastic experience . The rooms are very clean and the views of the lagoon are awesome. Our guide Vitalis was excellent. He was very patient and knowledgeable. The early morning lagoon walk to see birds is a must do. Quad biking was fun. Moses and the rest of the team at the lodge were very friendly and efficient. Please do yourself a favour and stay at this lodge. You will love it.

author: lschrem
title: Paradise by the River
text: 5 star experience all around. Catherine's team is beyond friendly and kind but not at all over-bearing. Breakfast is beyond, lunch and dinner exceptional, but with a limited menu as one would expect in the very small resort. Setting is stunning, nature guide knowledgable, spa is small but more then adequate for very good message. The architectural details are unlike anything I've ever seen. Wifi is a bit spotty, but you're here to disconnect! It's a bit out of the way, but so worth the detour. Only regret is spending only two nights.

author: travellerplus5
title: Heavenly Sanctuary
text: This wonderful place is about 20min. from Hermanus and a 2hr. drive east of Capetown near the small village of Stanford. The accommodations are 5 luxurious safari-style suites with ensuite bathrooms, sunken tub, outdoor shower (ahhhh). Each suite has a private patio with views of the mountains and lagoon. Meals are included and they are fabulous. Mini-bar is stocked with SA wines..all included. Whale watching--in season--is the huge attraction. Simone and Marcellino are gracious and helpful hosts. Guides are well chosen for activities.

author: emj58
title: Amazing Experience at Mosaic
text: We just returned from a wonderful week at Mosaic - beautiful scenery and birdsong, fantastic food and wine, excellent spa services, and the most friendly, smiling, helpful staff I've ever met. We stayed in both the Lagoon Lodge and a cottage and both were beautifully decorated and comfortable - loved the outside shower! The views across the lagoon, especially at sunrise and sunset, are stunning. We took advantage of the kayaks, quad bikes, pontoon boat ride (with sundowners - sparking wine and fruit crepes) and a guided walk with Vitalis (he is very knowledgeable and has a great sense of humor), and a trip to the beach. We learned all about the fynbos and the wide variety of beautiful birds. We saw flamingos at the water every day! We self catered in the cottage, but the food at the Lodge is definitely a treat - kudu, springbok, beef, fish, and fresh vegetables from their own garden - everything was so delicious we hated to leave and have to go home to cook for ourselves! Thanks to the wonderful staff who made our stay so amazing - Marcelino, Simone, Moses, Vitalis, Sandra, Ernest, Vivian, and all the rest. We will be back!

author: lauramG4252WG
title: Brief but wonderful!
text: We only had 2 nights at Mosaic during a trip in the area, and it was far too short. The setting is gorgeous, and worth the hunt to find. It was such a relaxing atmosphere with the milkwood groves and the separate suites. The food and drink were also excellent. The staff was phenomenal and every detail was attended to. We had an early morning pick-up to get back to Cape Town for a flight, and had a special breakfast waiting for us. When the pick-up driver was late, a staff member offered to drive us the two hours back to town to make sure we didn't miss our flight. Ultimately our driver arrived, but it was a completely unexpected service and demonstrates the commitment to the guests that the staff shows. I would absolutely recommend the lodge to anyone looking for a fun, romantic, relaxing get-away.

author: awilliams229
title: SIMPLY AMAZING!!!
text: We absolutely loved this place! OMG!!! You have to go there. The staff was attentive, thoughtful and friendly. The food was over and above excellent. I cannot say enough about this place. I will be back and bring my husband next visit. Thank you so much!

author: MorePlay
title: Very well managed lodge in great location
text: I can't say enough positive about the place. The location is excellent and is a sort of a hidden gem. Somehow the name "Mosaic" gives one the wrong impression before getting there. It's rustic, comfortable and very well run. The staff are well recruited, excellently trained and managed and do whatever they can to make the visit a pleasure for the guests. Don't expect things that open and shut. There's no TV in the rooms for example - but the place is so much better for it. I spent a weekend there with my wife and I can truthfully say that it's the most relaxed I have been on a weekend. It normally takes about a week of holiday to get me that relaxed! Highly, highly recommended.

author: ChrisSeattle_wa
title: Stunning!
text: Located on the Hermanus lagoon with stunning views of mountains, the service and the rooms are fabulous. This place is located in a remote area as well which we loved as it is naturally beautiful and peaceful but it may not be for everyone. The staff here is fabulous with an attention to detail from greeting you upon arrival to champagne in the room with candles ( not requested). Plenty of options for activities including Walker Bay Beach. Absolutely beautiful beach. Love this place! candles ( not requested). Plenty of options for activities including a visit to gorgeous Walker Bay. Highly recommended.

author: hgools
title: Ticked every box...!
text: Absolute "bush" luxury. From the moment we arrived to the second we left, this place continued to impress us. Exceptional service from all staff, our Guide Rian, Restaurant staff Sandra and Maria and Chefs and Vivienne in management, led by a great Manager who we saw everyday (I'm so sorry but we can't recall his name but he was unreal!) Great activities included in our stay. Over indulged on the breakfast and the all inclusive package we were offered. The standouts for Mosaic were the "one percenters" we really appreciated such as the honeymoon candles and champagne, the gin and the sherry in the rooms, the evening quote given out in the turn down service and the hammock... It was all perfect! Our room was so clean with a magnificent view and it appeared that all rooms had a great view too. Loved every minute of our stay here.

author: peterdQ4971FB
title: Mosaic's the place to stay. Look no further
text: From welcome to goodbye, our experience at Mosaic was nothing short of spectacular. Having used the unique rugged beauty of the Hermanus lagoon and mountain backdrop so sensitively to house the luxurious but environmentally friendly accommodation, the setting is beautiful. The welcome of staff Moses and Maria couldn't have been more genuine and welcoming. Vitalis the ranger guide is well worth spending time with on the sanctuary as he imparts his vast knowledge of local flora and fauna in a way that justs exudes his passion for the local environment. Both dinner and breakfast were a treat. Beautifully presented and expertly prepared, the dining experience will long be remembered. Thank you to the whole team at Mosaic. We will be back soon, and next time for more than just a short stay to enjoy South African hospitality at it's very best.

author: ariettet
title: Fantastic!
text: This is a fantastic lodge to stay with absolute first class service! Our cabin was fantastic, the views are unbelievable, the food is very good. We even got a bottle of champagne in our room, everything you might want in your minibar and all inclusive! The staff was super friendly and attentive! Also there are lots of activities included like quad driving nature walks whale watching in season. They even washed our car windows before we had to leave. We have stayed there for 2 nights but we will defenitly stay longer the next time. Tyvm for a great stay!

author: Nan2274
title: Beautiful setting ,remote & quiet with the friendliest ,most attentive service ever!
text: Mosaic was recommended to me by a friend & wanting a special ,romantic getaway I thought,looking at their website,it would be the perfect spot. the lodge is set overlooking a lagoon ,which is rather far away & not as close ,nor as big as it looks on their website,but still stunningly beautiful. our room was simply furnished & had all we needed. The highlight was the enormous bath which could be enjoyed by candlelight,with a glass of wine in hand,sublime! There is also a wonderful fireplace/pellet heater in the room for the chilly days which is a godsend & a necessity. The staff at Mosaic are some of the most welcoming,friendly & attentive I've experienced at a resort in a long time! A wonderful team ,they were warm & quick at hand to assist with any request. The food at Mosaic is delicious too.You are fed morning till night & everything is of great quality & well presented. My only disappointments were the activities ( I guess I had expected more for what we paid ) & spa ( a single room ).We did not make it on the beach excursion which was probably our own mistake. It's not a cheap getaway,even with food & drink included ,it's pricey but if you are looking to getaway from the city,enjoy nature & beautiful scenery & enjoy superb ,first class service this should be a place to consider!

author: DJANDYHOOPS
title: Beautiful. Friendly. Laid back. By the coast. Great food.
text: We stayed 4 nights. Just enough to totally relax but not get itchy feet. The private rooms/lodges are so cleverly laid out - all about the views and the bed.The staff are amazing: friendly, helpful, chatty and their attention to detail is great. The activities (kayaking, beaches, dunes, walking, quad-biking, EATING) are all easily on hand. The communal areas allow chatting with other guests whereas the private areas are just that. You might want to relay any dietary requirements upfront. I can only think of one downside - the coastal weather can be a bit hit and miss (but that's hardly their fault!). Totally recommended!

author: Merkel53
title: I'd like to keep Mosaic Lodge a secret amongst friends, sensational in all aspects!!
text: Mosaic Lodge is a truly amazing 'resort'. It's location is unbeatable with stunning mountain and lagoon vistas, it's just a little off the beaten track yet easy enough to get to from Cape Town; it's not Hermanus but close enough. Staff are friendly, efficient and helpful but not in your face. Breakfast & dinner in the Loge is first rate and the local wines are excellent and inexpensive. The rooms are stunning (mossie nets over king size bed). Lovely outdoor shower, copper sink in the bathroom ... I could go on. The walks, quad biking, boating, 4-wheel drive to the beach all great. All in all highly recommended but don't tell anyone!

author: Fostmh3
title: Wish we spent more time here!
text: Our travel agent suggested we stay here one night before a shark dive the next day in Gansbaai. We arrived early afternoon (but after the normal lunch time) and were immediately treated to incredible hospitality. Even though we arrived a little late, the staff whipped us up an incredible lunch with drinks, which we enjoyed out on the deck with a beautiful view. Everything had such a relaxing feel and our lagoon lodge was magnificent. Since we were at Mosaic for a short time, we were able to take advantage of only one activity: a Land Rover beach excursion. The trek to the water was a lot of fun and we enjoyed an incredible view of the coastline (with snacks/drinks). Our dinner was amazing in terms of both the food and the service. We really wish we could have spent more time here!

author: JulieOstrand
title: Incredible Experience
text: Wow and wow! This is truly a 5 star experience. We stayed here over the weekend for our anniversary and it was amazing. The accommodations are luxurious, the food is exceptional and the staff offers the best customer service we have experienced in South Africa. Every person on staff is friendly, helpful and goes above and beyond. Of course the scenery is absolutely breath-taking and the entire experience left us feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. There are so many great activities (kayaking, quad biking, boat cruise, etc) - but since I am pregnant it was delightful just to enjoy quiet walks, the stunning view, reading at the Spook Haus, and an amazing massage. We give Mosaic our highest recommendation!

author: BrionC
title: Great off the beaten path lodge
text: Stayed at the Mosaic Sanctuary for three nights as a gateway for whale watching and a trip to Cape Angulhas. While a little out of the way outside of Stanford, the drive was worth the effort. There are five rooms in the main lodge area and a few more self-catered rooms about a mile away. Guides and staff are great and knowledgeable. Service was exceptional. Meals were prepared with our interest in mind and everything was fresh and tasty. The common area had a wonderful fireplace which just took the edge off on a couple of cool nights. Vitals and Johannes were great guides and know the area and its wildlife ad flora. Do the quad bike ride, the afternoon beach drive and take a walking tour with the guides.

author: CoBlueJay
title: A Sanctuary for Solo Travelers, Too!
text: After several long flights, it was such a pleasure to arrive at Mosaic Lodge. It is a beautiful place and the perfect start to my trip. Every member of the staff was friendly and couldn't have done anything more to make my stay more memorable. The weather was rainy on and off, so my cage dive with the sharks was cancelled. Instead, I had a wonderful time quad biking, wine tasting and watching whales in Hermanus. This was the first time I ever traveled solo to another country. Mosaic is known as a wonderful place for romance, but don't exclude it if you are interested in a personal retreat. I loved every minute. I had incredible food, wonderful company and the most comfortable suite. I will definitely return next time I'm lucky enough to visit South Africa.

author: 639michaelj
title: Beautiful and relaxing
text: We spent the weekend in the Duminy Cottage, with beautiful views of the Overberg across the Klein River Lagoon. Travelers should recognize that Mosaic has two parts: The Lagoon Lodge, which has all-inclusive meals and activities, and the self-catering cottages. The cottages are right next to the Spookhuis, where you can get breakfast, lunch, coffee/tea, or drinks. We stayed in the Duminy Lodge, which has two big bedrooms and a loft with five bunk beds. For winter days, the cottage has underfloor heating and a wood stove. We ordered breakfast baskets and braai baskets from the Spookhuis that were delivered to our cottage. So much delicious food! Marcelino, Jennifer, and the rest of the staff were just excellent--always trying to find ways to improve our stay. One note--the cottages are about 6km down a bumpy dirt road, so be ready for that. The trip is worth it.

author: eurohans
title: Great weekend destination, close to Cape Town
text: Our stay at Mosaic Lodge was excellent from the moment we arrived, to the moment we left. Everyone we met was extremely friendly, helpful and professional. Our lodge had a game lodge feel and was equipped with anything you need. Mungo towels and rain bath products added to it. The mini bar had a nice selection and there was even a lemon for your Gin&Tonics (something I have not come across anywhere else so far). The food was nice and there was plenty to do, while all activities were included in our stay. Watching whales while enjoying a glas of wine and some snacks was the highlight of our stay. Lunch at the Spookhuis was nice too, with a table set up under the trees watching the lagoon.

author: shellispevick
title: A surprise treasure
text: What a wonderful place off the beaten track. The setting is idyllic - on the banks of the Hermanus Lagoon (like something out of Swallows and Amazons). We (family of 4, 2 adults and 2 kids aged 8 and 10) stayed in one of the luxurious Lagoon lodges with stunning views of the lagoon. Our friends (also a family of 4) stayed in one of the self-catering cottages (but food is served there if you want) which was also stunning. Simone and her team (particularly Vitalis and Vivienne) could not have done more to make us feel welcome and comfortable. There are lots of fun activities planned to keep the kids amused but brilliant for all ages - kayaking, quad biking, nature walks, sunset trips to the beautiful Walker Bay beach, complete with huge sand dunes. The food is second to none and the team made a fabulous 'Xhosa' hut birthday cake for our daughter's 8th birthday. This is a must-do destination for families.

author: USAtemples
title: Absolutely Incredible!!
text: Our family of 6 spent a couple of nights in one of the self catering units. WOW!!! It was absolutely incredible. Beautiful, high quality everything!! Lots of little extras that just are great. Food fantastic, service incredible, activities great. Our youngest is 7 and oldest was 16 - things to do for all of them. Only regret - we should have stayed a week it is so awesome. Thank you Mosaic!!! When next in South Africa we are coming back!

author: ruthw704
title: A beautiful place to escape
text: Mosaic was recommended by our neighbours who had a fabulous time there and they were absolutely right. We had a fantastic few days there. The lodge accommodation was gorgeous and we especially loved the outside shower under the trees listening to the birds. The service was extremely good - attentive and very friendly without being intrusive. We really enjoyed the company of the excellent local guide Vitalis who had great knowledge of the local wildlife and forna and was wonderful at spotting birds. We must have seen over 20 species whilst we were there which was heaven for us twitchers. The food was lovely and as almost everything including wine by the glass and pre-dinner drinks were included in the price (which we did not realize until leaving) it was actually very good value. Really nice touches like a bath run and bottle of bubbly on our last night. We hope to return one day...

author: joetshanghai
title: Happy Days!
text: We have only great things to say about the Mosaic Lagoon Lodge. There are just 5 lodges and they are well spaced so that you get a great feeling of privacy, when you want it. The views from each lodge are splendid. The lodges themselves are kitted out with every imaginable convenience and the outdoor shower is a special touch. The shared area is also very special---dining room, library, small pool, fireplace and is, itself a great viewing area. The highlight of our stay was the drive down to Walker's Private Beach, one of the most stunning beaches imaginable. The Sundowner was amazing! Our stay was too short. We would suggest three nights minimum in order to take in everything that is around the lodges.

author: pollyc542
title: Stunning location, pretty rooms
text: Mosaic has a lovely feeling of remoteness without actually being very remote and you can watched flamingoes your bed as they pick their way across the lagoon. The rooms are average size but very beautiful and comfortable - at night you can lie in bed and watch the stars. The service is incredibly thoughtful. Every time you get back from any kind of expedition you are greeted with a cool drink. Our guide drove us to the most perfect deserted beach, with crystal white sand dunes, and set up drinks and nibbles as the sun went down. Breakfast is wonderful and on the all inclusive package you are well fed. The menus are not as sophisticated as you might expect after Cape Town, where the food is excellent, but it's tasty and plentiful. The staff are characterful and friendly and create a lovely inclusive atmosphere. It was also really nice to go somewhere high end that was truly interested in making our kids visit nice - not just tolerating their presence! We loved our stay here.

author: 692kimberlyb
title: A beautiful and serene hideaway - awesome place!
text: We had our honeymoon at Mosaic Lagoon Lodge and it was the most gorgeous place to wind down. Looking out onto the lagoon, mountains and bush from our lodge made us feel so in tune with nature. The location is absolutely quiet and the rooms are stunning. Every small detail is thought of and the room was made three times a day in such a beautiful and individual way. We enjoyed many outings during the day and in the evenings, e.g. boat trip on the lagoon, quad biking and our highlight: the beach sundowner tour! The personnel is so friendly and hospitable, thank you for the top service! Also the food was delicious! We will definitely return!

author: BK03
title: Ideal setting
text: Our travel agent booked us into this location on the recommendation of somebody that had been there. The first important point to make is that these are guest house cottages, not a hotel. We were not made aware of the fact that there is no restaurant, although they have a kitchen and can prepare 'food baskets' and will accommodate special dietary needs. We found the service overall to be very friendly, helpful and willing to help with any queries. Getting to the sanctuary requires 8+ kilometres of dirt track, bumpy. in places. The setting is fabulous, very tranquil and peaceful! We would recommend this location, but bear in mind the food situation and distance from shops/restaurants, and they are not an issue you will enjoy the experience.

author: 264anneliel
title: Unforgettable
text: Being from the area we are quite used to seeing the beauty around us. But after our visit to Mosaic Lagoon Lodge we appreciate it so much more. We decided to celebrate our 26th Wedding anniversary at Mosaic and it was amazing. The suites are beautiful and very well positioned it felt like we were there on our own. The morning we made some coffee and spent time just sitting on the terrace listening to the sounds of nature. Our meals were scrumptious and the service 5*. The staff was so friendly and very attentive to our needs. The only thing wrong was that we couldn't stay longer. Thank you Mosaic for making our 26th anniversary one to remember.

author: 121anitab
title: Stunning accommodation
text: We stayed in the self-catering Milkwood 2 cottage at Mosaic Farms for 5 evenings. The setting is breathtakingly serene and peaceful. Cottages have all the amenities and are kept clean by housekeeping services. Baby cot provided had beautifully clean and crisp bedding. Braai area was cleaned every morning. Staff were helpful and friendly. Excellent place for families of older and young children. One drawback was a toilet in Milkwood 2 cottage which did not have proper airing but this did not detract from a wonderful holiday.

author: tomhP3198GA
title: Felt Like Family
text: My wife and I were so pleased with our experience at Mosaic Farm. They went out of their way to make all of the details of our honeymoon so special, including drawing a bath and lighting candles for us two nights in a row! You can really choose the experience you want there...you can go laid back or spend the entire day doing activities. We enjoyed the quad biking, boat cruise, and beach trip so much. We loved our lagoon lodge with private outdoor shower. The view of the mountains was splendid....right from our bed! We didn't even have to get up to enjoy the beautiful views! We really enjoy connecting with people on holidays, and the staff was an absolute pleasure. They feel and act like a big family, with everyone pitching in to help everyone with a smile. Johan, Amber, Nadine, Marcelino, and Simone were just fine people to spend three days with.

author: carefreepat
title: A memorable time at Mosaic Private Sanctuary
text: Mosaic was the perfect sanctuary for exploring and pampering. We felt so well cared for. The staff did everything within their power to please. Accommodations were superb and beautiful, dining was phenomenal, and experiences full of fun. Learning about Fynbos and riding on quads with Jacob was delightful. Amber did everything to make sure we were provided with all our needs. Truly, every detail was tended to. We miss Mosaic, its setting and gorgeous surroundings and would recommend a stay here for lavish acommodations, beautiful scenery, and sundowners at the beach, along with staff doing their best to make the experience so memorable.

author: Safari0813
title: Don't tell everyone ... this is a secret treasure!
text: We experienced the greatest joy on arriving at Mosaic Lagoon Lodge. After a long drive (finishing with a pot holed dirt road), we were astounded to arrive at this 'safari-sheik' lodge. The view over the lagoon to the patchwork mountain range in the back ground is spectacular. Five stylish, well appointed, safari style rooms ( we arrived on a wet winter afternoon and the pot belly had already made our room toasty warm!) are connected by a tree covered wooden boardwalk. The whole place has an outdoorsy, rustic, bush- luxury feel to it. Dinner was included and an absolutely superb experience by the open fire. Five courses which complimented each other to perfection and consisted of locally sourced produce were served with passion and flair. This is amongst the very best food we have had the pleasure to enjoy during our 4 weeks in Africa, a country of fine food and impeccable service!

author: rogerb656
title: mosiac visit baxter
text: Guys thanx for a wonderfull stay!! We thoroughly enjoyed every minute. The location of the duminy cottage is spectacular. We had 2 toddlers with us aged 4 and 2. Although the wheather was great over the weekend , but still cold , i would like to see more kids entertainment especially during winter times to keep them busy ( and give mom and dad a break). Maybe a television for indoor entertainment) Other than that the sights was amazing. We should have stayed longer than 2 nights though. We will come again. keep me posted on any specials. Roger Baxter

author: Mw5wags
title: Breathtaking!
text: The all-inclusive resort made for great fun and a very relaxing vacation! That's because nobody has to be the bad guy saying no to just one more round of kayaking, quad biking or a trip to the beach. I took a wonderful nature jog right next to the lagoon and cooled off in the pool. The sunsets are enough to take your breath away. I couldn’t help but devour the excellent food; it was such a great variety every night. The staff was so sweet. They spoke to us as if they knew us all along, and I learned a lot about the South African culture from their heart-felt stories. Lunches at the Spookhuis under the Milkwoods were so relaxing and fresh. I could go on and on, but I suggest you just go see for yourselves. Amazing….

author: ndenovo
title: Like a well-designed, beautiful piece of "mosaic" art
text: We visited Mosaic Private Sanctuary and so enjoyed its many "pieces." The property afforded us a luxurious lagoon view (always sprinkled with various bird species), as well as beach access by quad-bike (fun!). The accommodations were extremely comfortable and so well-appointed. We especially loved the serenity of our lagoon lodge safari cottage. The staff members were so anxious to make sure our stay was tailored to OUR interests. Also very apparent was the staff's respect for the environment and interest in preserving it. The Spookhuis offered a piece of local history, along with delicous lunch/wine pairings. Our candlelit dinners gave us a sampling of fine South African cuisine. Like a beautiful piece of mosaic artwork, all of Mosaic's "pieces" contributed toward making it an exceptional travel experience for us. Thank you!

author: AmandaCarstens1975
title: An amazing experience
text: Mosaic Private Sanctuary was everything and so much more we expected for our two night getaway to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary. From the moment we arrived we felt so special and all the kind gestures and little details made our stay special and memorable. I said to my husband - If I lived to be a hundred years old, I will always remember Mosaic and Amber, Octavia, Johan and Jurie who played a part in it. A visit to Mosaic is something everybody must experience in their lifetime! Thank you so much. It will always have a special place in my heart. We stayed in the Lagoon Lodge and didn't even get to experience all the amenities, but the 4x4 and boat trip was so nice - despite the foul weather on the Friday, the service and food... a true 5 star experience! We hope to go back next year for our anniversary - and hope to see all the familiar faces still there. Thanks Amber for listening to my furchild rantings and for sharing this passion!

author: Rubybirkenhead
title: Up there with the Lake Palace Hotel in Udaipur
text: This is one of the best holiday experiences we have ever had. A fantastic set-up of five luxury huts on the side of a lagoon, facing mountains. Never been so relaxed as when sitting on our terrace with no noise but the many birds.The shared area houses a small outdoor pool and bar and restaurant/lounge. The attention to detail has been meticulous with decor and comfort. Apart from the setting and the wonderful staff, what helps elevate this is the all-inclusive trips laid on. We had our own guided nature walk, trip to an amazing beach, river trip, quad biking. The staff use every opportunity to provide info, wine and snacks. A four-course evening meal is also provided and the food is five star. I could not recommend this enough, we will definitely return. Thanks to Amber and her wonderful staff for a fabulous, memorable stay.

author: PaulaM368
title: Unbelievable...
text: Words can not describe the experience that I had with 6 friends at Mosaic... The setting is magnificent. Both the natural beauty of the area, as well as the lodge itself. I have never seen anything like it... The staff was the icing on the cake... Friendly, knowledgable, encouraging, accommodating, caring and interested in what would make our stay perfect. We loved every minute at Mosaic. Every time we thought it couldn't get any better, the staff raised the bar. Thank you for everything!!

author: Jenniapforrest
title: Incredible all around
text: We stayed at Mosaic last week with our 2 children ages 10 and 16. We loved our accommodation and the staff could not have been more helpful. The food was unbelievable at the lodge as well as at the Spook House. (and we are not an easy family as we have 1 vegetarian, 1 gluten free Vegan and 1 picky child.) They accommodated us all with delicious food. While we were on a boat cruise they prepared a table outside for us under the milkwood trees for lunch that was memorable. Our sunset trip to the beach was fabulous and we had the beach to ourselves. Nature walk was really interesting in the morning as well. The General Managers were outstanding, taking the time to tell us the history of the place and helping us with the rest of our trip. I cannot say enough about this great resort. We will definitely return...

author: iJontyM
title: Mosaic Farm- Sanctuary on the Hermanus Lagoon
text: Their slogan says it all- it is most certainly a sanctuary on the lagoon. We stayed at Lagoon Lodge and from the moment we arrived we experienced exceptional service,comfort and food. The suites offer amazing views over the lagoon and mountains behind and it was a 'wow' moment when we opened the curtains in the morning. The outdoor shower and huge bath were most welcome and little touches like 'knitting bowl', turn down chocolates and putting the heater on were wonderful. Every meal was superb and choice of local wines excellent.We also loved the excursions we got to experience. The nature walk was informative and quad biking lots of fun. We will definitely be back and I can recommend this place for honeymooners, wedding anniversaries and those just wanting to get away from the rat race. Thank you Mosaic Farm !

author: Lourensriver
title: perfect getaway in the Overberg area
text: We stayed at the farm in Milkwood Cottage No.1 at the end of April and enjoyed our stay. Upon check-in the staff was very helpful with tips and with the restaurant offerings and recommendation for activities. The location is excellent and the cottage was just what we were looking for. Nice and cosy and at the same time light and modern. After arrival we immediately went on a quadbike tour for over an hour and the scenery was breathtaking. My son was in the expert hands of Craig and had a ball. In the mornings we took two kayaks out on the lagune and paddled around. We had coffee, hot chocolates and cake in the afternoon and dinner was also taken care of with a delicious and well presented platter of wraps and cheeses. My son was taken on another long quadbike tour, while my daughter and me were packing. We enjoyed our short drive home with the beautiful memories we made and made plans to come back with firends.

author: Nazlee786
title: Milkwood Cottage 3
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Milkwood cottage 3 with my family over the Easter weekend 06-8APR'12. The reception I got on arrival was warm & inviting. The cottage was clean spacious and ideal for our family getaway. For a self catering unit with an indoor BBQ facility, it was very well equipped, had modern fixures/features and best of all, it offered housekeeping the next morning too which one will hardly ever get in most self catering chalets! There were just 2 things which needs some improvement however, one being the stove which I feel was a bit dated in comparison with the rest of the fixtures and the kettle which was heavily corroded at the element, so we could not use it. Otherwise everything else was perfect! Whilst not on the same level at the Duminy self catering cottage, this unit offers real value for money and is ideal breakaway from the concrete jungle. Unfortunately it rained the entire weekend of my staybut we all had a fabulous time playing boardgames in the lounge/living area by fireplace which replenished with wood every morning. I will definitely visit again in the near future!

author: PetalCT
title: Lots to do in the country side
text: This is a wonderful country retreat but is close to the very beautiful Hemel en Aarde Wine Route, a brewery and a cheese farm so there is tons to do. Added to that the farm offers quad biking and sundowner picnic trips. We stayed at the Lagoon Lodge. The rooms are stunning. The bed is romantically enclosed with a mosquito net and the bath is the size of a swimming pool!The shower is a private open air structure. Our room overlooked the lagoon inhabited by a large flock of pink flamingos. We were the only couple staying at the Lagoon Lodge so had roughly 5 staff serving us. In the evening they set a private table for dinner in front of our room and lit lots of candles for a very romantic setting. The service was excellent. We had a great time but found it expensive.

author: KarenL179
title: Stunning location, great activities, excellent accommodation
text: We stayed here (2 adults, 2 teenagers) in August in two suites at the main lodge. The setting is stunning, with breathtaking views especially as the sun was setting. The rooms are beautiful, extremely comfortable and with everything you could want on hand. We eat in the first night, and had an excellent meal. On our second day we had lots of adventures - kayaking across the lagoon, whale watching at De Kelders, then quad biking back at the farm across the dunes and down to the beach. Difficult to know which of these was the highlight. The staff were all warm and friendly, and Craig was great. Highly recommended.

author: The-Fraters
title: A great escape!
text: We loved Mosaic Farm and stayed there for three nights in the large selfcatering cottage with another couple and their kids. The Cottage is very clean, well equiped (underfloor heating, outdoor shower,comfy beds) and well positioned (close enough to the Spookhuis and lagoon). We had fantastic weather and used the lovely stoep and chairs extensively to catch up with our friends and enjoy the winter sun. The Spookhuis can prepare a wonderfull cheese platter (the best I ever had!) and deliver it to your door to enjoy. We also did a bit of quadbiking, the kids did a bit of paddling on the lagoon (included in your rate) and we also went for very long walks. Stanford is close enough for a bit of shopping (lovely antique stores), dining (Madre's Kitchen) and wine and cheese tasting (Kleinrivier picnics). They also have great staff! What more can I say....we will be back!

author: JDSCapeTown
title: Absolutely perfect
text: A well traveled person will know within minutes of arriving at Mosaic farm that this place is special. I have personally stayed in many top 5 star international resorts and hotels that don't come close. Their service is personal, friendly and exceptional. They did far more than expected to meet our every need. The surroundings are breathtaking and relaxing. Our room with king size bed, private deck, panoramic views of the lagoon and mountains and large bathtub was lovely. Breakfasts and dinners were prepared from fresh ingredients and were absolutely delicious. Guided nature drives with sundowners were a definite highlight. We look forward to our return to Mosaic farm. So a big thanks to Craig, Warren and Tania for making our stay so memorable.

author: Miss_Poland
title: A birding paradise with a real Africa feel and so many extras
text: We stayed here for 3 nights in one of the beautifully designed lodges near the lagoon. What a treat ! The whole place has a fantastic laid back atmosphere that also manages to be very well run ,efficient and accomodating . The views are spectacular and the birds so varied ( 100 flamingos one morning). The staff are so kind and knowledgeable and the interior deisgn fantastic. It's great to just walk from the door but the beautiful Ferrnkloof nature reserve is only half an hour away as is the lovely cliff path at Hermanus. This is a very special place with dark starry skies at night and warm friendly staff who will lay on a variety of excursions by day. or iron your clothes beautifully We REALLY enjoyed our stay and hope to go back Hermanus. hermanus.

author: Kimberood
title: Romance on the Lagoon
text: As Part 3 of our honeymoon, Mosaic Farm was something I was really looking forward to. After enjoying a leisurely drive down from RiebeckKasteel, we arrived in pretty Stanford and made our way to the lodge. Welcoming in thatch, wood and stone, and set in a milkwood forest, it really is amazingly secluded, private and romantic. Our luxury chalet had lovely views of the lagoon out in front, a private wooden deck with lazy chairs, king-sized bed with romantic mosquito nets, a huge double stone bathtub and outdoor shower. Included in our stay was breakfast and dinner, both of which were fantastic, although the portions were quite big - especially when you're eating three courses! Our absolute highlight was the second evening of our stay, enjoying a 30 minute quadbiking ride through the dunes to the beach, where we collected drift wood and had sundowners on the sand... The staff were fantasic, very friendly and welcoming and who were there to attend to anything we asked for. I would recommend Mosaic Farm as an ideal getaway in a beautiful natural environment. It's close to Hermanus for shopping, Stanford for cute coffee shops and of course, a number of wine farms for wine-tasting. A wonderful part of our honeymoon :)

author: echekwumemchukwub
title: Great location and good for a cheap stay
text: Went in a group of 18 to experience an original french feel. Hotel entrance is not conspicous as its in a shared building. Great location, in-between 2 bars, beside a very nice bakery and fresh fruit store, few meters away from the underground rail station. A block away from several nice restaurants and sunday market. Hotel is clean with a small elevator to accommodate only 3 persons. Stayed on the 4th floor in a comfortable twin single bed room. Small rooms but kept tidy and a clean bathroom. Good customer service.

author: Sunshine800609
title: Petite and charming
text: Five of us (of which, three teenagers) stayed at this hotel in early April. It is small but clean and quiet. The staff are very helpful, and the decor imaginative and pleasant. Rooms are simple but have everything that you want. And the breakfasts are excellent. It is situated in an area above the main city - rather like, for example Highgate or Hampstead in London - from where the views are splendid. The Metro station (Croix - Rousse) is nearby, and trains are frequent. Or you can walk down a lot of picturesque Montmartre - type steps - and through parks - to the main city. The area has an extensive street market on some days of the week, and there are good restaurants, bars and all kinds of (quite high - class) shops. We felt that the hotel offered very good value for money; and would definitely stay there again.

author: Herts67
title: Great little hotel in good location - real value for money
text: We stayed in lyon for three nights with our two dogs. The staff were really friendly and helpful and made us all feel very welcome. Decor was lovely in the rooms, reception and breakfast room. A little tired in the corridors but that's hardly a big deal. The rooms are quite small, but they have everything you need, including a hair dryer. The location is good. There's a lovely market outside the hotel and loads of restaurants cafés in the local, yet it was very quiet at night. Great for a short city break in lyon. Would definitely stay here again if we are in lyon. Really fantastic value for money.

author: buziana
title: Some unfortunate bumps
text: My husband and I were pleased to have found a hotel in a completely untouristy neighborhood. It's two minutes to the nearest subway station, so we were able to get around Lyon (on a metro day-pass) with ease. There were some difficulties that were not exactly the hotel's fault, but they could have been a bit more sympathetic to a mature couple. Since there was work being done in the street directly in front of the hotel, there was no place to stop with the car and unload luggage, nor could we reload the car easily at the end of our stay. Dragging luggage is hard to deal with at our more advanced ages. In addition, due to the street work, the hotel's credit card machine did not work. We had no choice but to pay for our stay with cash. Needless to say, what cash we had changed was money we had earmarked for other purposes.

author: 896StephenM896
title: Excellent value for money
text: We have been visiting Lyon for years and have stayed in many of its hotels. On this trip we stayed in this and two other hotels on our way to and from the south. The room prices were 69 (Chartres), 74 (Lyon) and 150 Euros (Fontainbleau). The Croix Rousse was far superior to the hotel in Chartres, and the advantages of the hotel in Fontainebleau did not justify the considerable price-hike. The Croix Rousse district is one of the most interesting and lively areas of Lyon, but if it is your first time in Lyon you will want to stay somewhere nearer the centre - Croix Rousse is perched at the top of a hill and it is a long walk down to the centre (and even further back up). I dissent from the reviewer who says it is perfectly possible to park on the street - finding anywhere to park in Lyon is a nightmare, and in Croix Rousse they have a street market where the stallholders will not be pleased to find your car in their way. Also it should be mentioned that the hotel's car parking facilities are some distance away. But you will find the hotel staff courteous, friendly and Anglophone, and the hotel's facilities clean and modern.

author: Full_suitcase
title: Good location
text: Nice friendly staff, with a good breakfast and breakfast room, and a public area/reception which was ok, but not the sort of place to relax or linger. The location was very handy for the Metro and Croix Rousse is a decent area with superb views. We stayed for three nights and found the beds very comfortable and bathroom clean, but small - just enough space to use the toilet! The bedroom, one of four accessed from a separate little corridor, was of a peculiar shape. Evidently the result of a much earlier conversion and division of a larger space. The rooms shown on the website looked nicer. Even with the window closed (in early March) there was noise from 'Paddy's Corner' below, with people congregating outside to have a smoke with their drink. For this reason I would not be willing to stay here in the warmer months when the window would have to be open. However, the hotel was very much better than my previous Lyon experience and was good value in the bigger scheme of things, as generally, accommodation seems expensive, even compared with Paris or Nice. I suspect the hotel is undergoing a process of improvement and I would give it a second look as long as the room wasn't above the bar!

author: midgers
title: Great value, super location
text: I like this hotel, having stayed here several times before, during and after the recent renovation. After is best. The rooms are small but clean, well decorated, comfortable and air conditioned. Ours had an orthopaedic mattress which took some getting used to on the first night but was bliss thereafter. The hotel is on a busy street but, at least on the upper floors, pretty quiet. The staff are friendly and the self service breakfast is plentiful and good. Location is fantastic – the Croix Rousse is a great part of the city with a village atmosphere and the hotel is a one minute walk from the Croix Rousse metro and a ten minute journey from there to the centre of town. At well under 100 euros a night B&B for two, this is an excellent choice for anyone staying in Lyon. If you happen to have friends or business in the Croix Rousse, it’s a complete no brainer.

author: ConstantinoMorelli
title: Business Travel
text: In Lima for work and was seeking a place to call home for a month. I must say I’m glad that chose to stay here. The hotel is clean, the staff is friendly and will make sure your stay is exceptional. The room was spacious and the bathroom is updated and esthetically pleasing. For those of us that travel for work and have a food allowance the FREE breakfast is a bonus and it’s more than just toast and cereal. There’s also a well maintained coffee bar in the lobby that offers complimentary hot beverages and fresh fruit. After a long day, they have a pool and hot tub to unwind in. The hotel is also pet friendly and have plenty of green space for running your dog. I would like to extend a sincere thank you to Selena and Tim, you both are exceptional at making your guest feel at home. This is my first stay at a Country Inn and I definitely recommend it.

author: /undefined
title: Clean, quiet hotel
text: This hotel was very clean and quiet. Rooms were recently renovated. Location was good, right off I 75. It was a little pricey for one night, but other hotels were booked and I did not make a previous reservation. Hotel staff were very friendly. The breakfast was just ok-chicken, gravy and potatoes, but cereal was available. When on the road, I tend to like eggs and bacon or sausage. Overall a very nice night's sleep!

author: 517mindyh
title: lima stay with Mike
text: We had a great stay at this hotel. It was clean and spacious room for the 5 of us. We had 2 double beds and sofa sleeper. Beds were great and sofa not too bad. We were there for one night to visit grandson in college. Had good buffet breakfast and staff was great. Location was perfect for drive to Indian lake for dinner since we couldn't get hotel there. Would recommend this hotel and will stay again when visiting soon.

author: 441kristinw
title: Good price in a good location for a recent trip
text: This hotel featured a friendly staff, a cute room and a inviting common area. I loved having the fridge and microwave in the room. Our bed was extremely comfortable. The swimming pool was a highlight for my two kids. I was disappointed by the fitness room - one of the three cardio machines had a broken button and was unusable. The room itself was fairly small and had no free weights. The fan in our room's AC unit wouldn't shut off, and there was a musty/moldy smell in our couch. Overall, not a terrible experience, but we might look elsewhere for future trips.

author: /undefined
title: I-75 Gem in Lima
text: First time for my daughter's family to stay in Carlson hotel. Amazed by large room, Wonderful sofa area for kids to sit. Rooms were quiet and clean. Breakfast included cut up fruit and many choices. Did not use pool but liked that they had later time for adult only swim (I will use next time). Staff is polite and efficient. PS Beds are dreamy. Country Inns are a great choice

author: yenwynns
title: Worst Country Inn Ever.
text: Worst. Country Inn. Ever. I didn't stay here for 700 thread count sheets or pristine amenities or spectacular views. My choice to stay here was for the welcoming home feeling that I received in my past stays at other locations. However, the front desk particularly on duty for the morning/afternoon shift exhibits no hospitality experience. I hope this level of service is not the norm to represent Country Inn as a whole. Even though this is not a full service hotel, I did expect customer service one notch above Super 8, the least. Just plain rude. I do will give credit to the polite housekeeping staff that was accommodating and greeted us in our out.

author: VacationQueen96
title: Very Nice Stay
text: My family traveled to Kentucky from Michigan and on our return we stayed at this hotel. We arrived after 8pm and was pleasantly greeted by the front desk staff. She informed me that I had been awarded an upgraded suite and 500 points, this was a great surprise. The room did have red stains on the floor which appeared to be either wine or juice and it was a little dusty seemed as if the room had not been rented in a while however, the beds were comfortable and the rest of the room appeared tidy. We will absolutely stay here again, the breakfast in the morning was great, chicken patties, gravy, potatoes, a variety of cereals, fresh fruit, diy waffles, pastries oatmeal, etc. which left us full for the travel back to Michigan. This was great for our family because we had a 2 queen suite with a full let out sofa bed, the hotel was nice and quiet, the pool area was fair although the jacuzzi tub dial was broken the water was hot. The pool was fun for the children, I only wish that the jacuzzi was working properly. Overall a great stay and very close to restaurants and i75.

author: /undefined
title: Don't stay here !
text: This place is covered up with Bed bugs. HUGE bed bugs! On top of the sheet under the sheets everywhere! We can here on Dec 23rd almost immediately upon arrival to the room we saw that they were bed bugs on top of the bed 4 but the sheets there were more under the sheets they were everywhere huge visible bed bugs. When we notified staff they were not even surprised. I can't believe the lady at the check-in looked me in the face with my three children and allowed me to check into a room with bed bugs 2 days before Christmas. Did she really think I wanted to take bed bugs home with me. Despicable people despicable place.

author: 767reneel
title: Clean and comfortable. Definitely recommend
text: Great staff. Clean rooms and pool area. Nice breakfast. Would recommend to anyone. It was a fabulous price too Easy to find. Would definitely stay there again. It was an overall great experience. Thanks

author: lymiller
title: Easy clean & convenient
text: Best price at the time of booking. Easy location to find. Did not hear any traffic from the highway. American attendants. Check in and check out was quick. Clean lobby, dining area, and room! We did not use the pool but it appeared clean and it good working condition. I would recommend this location and would stay here again.

author: /undefined
title: Average hotel. Nice sized 1 bdrm suite.
text: I stayed at County Inn Lima to attend a track meet. The hotel was average, not horrible, but nothing to brag about. The 1 bedroom suite was a nice size and gave privacy. The room itself had not been carefully cleaned as there was remnants from the last guest still in the room. The hotel was sold out, so moving to another room was not an option. We were in room 215, which was right above the pool...not good when trying to get rest. The free breakfast had your standard free breakfast options (waffle, hot and cold cereal, eggs, fruit). All in all, it was an okay hotel, but I didn't get a good night's sleep due to me being uncomfortable with the lack of thorough cleaning.

author: may0528
title: surprisingly nice
text: I'll admit, I was surprised at how nice the hotel was. Typically I expect an average hotel. The suite was incredibly spacious. The refrigerator was a full size family refrigerator/freezer which saved a ton a money on restaurants. The price was very reasonable for a suite. The room was broken down into 2 double beds in one room and a queen size sofa, desk, kitchen in the other. Felt like a small apartment. Staff was very nice and accommodating.

author: M9406LTnicoler
title: Nice, reasonably priced hotel
text: The hotel was nice with good accommodations and a nice, yet shallow, in ground pool. It was nice to have the fridge and microwave in the room. The breakfast is pretty good too. The only issue I had at all was that the woman that checked me out at the front desk ignored me the first time I went to check out because she was on the phone dealing with a room issue with other staff. I stood there probably 5 minutes and then finally whispered I'd come back after eating. I received an eye roll and slight nod in response. When I did return the same woman was very dry, blunt and to the point with no emotions or even a hint of a friendly smile, let alone an apology for the earlier wait. I'm a very understanding person, but a friendly staff with nice manners can really help the feel of a place and make customers feel at home! All in all a nice hotel and experience though. I'd stay again!

author: /undefined
title: Great place to stay.
text: This is a wonderful hotel. Rooms very clean and modern. Great pool and hot tub. Liked the fact that pool was open at 6 am until 11 pm. It gives you time to go out for dinner and still use the pool. Did not use workout facility on this visit. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Breakfast far better than most hotels. We will definitely stay here again.

author: 374auburnr
title: Snowy day away from home
text: Arrived on a Monday and the snow began as soon as we got in rental. Hotel was new and was pleased. Still not happy to be away from home and then I crawled in bed and knew this was good trip. Sheets were crisp and smelled clean. You know that good smell of clean laundry. Breakfast was not hot the next morning but could microwave it. Service was good and the ladies did great job trying to provide everything we needed. I would rate it 4.5 out of 5 because of cleanliness and the crisp sheets. Breakfast didn't change my mind. I'd stay here again when I come back in a couple of months.

author: jp391
title: Don't like this place.
text: The staff was good and helpful for the most part. The cleaning staff stole money and items from our rooms,the owner and manager avoided us while trying to get this resolved. It took 2 weeks for them to finally resolve the issue. I think they were hoping we would just check out and it would get forgotten. Also,the manager put the wrong club number on my rooms,so I never got points for my stay (6.5 weeks). I was told I can contact the person with my points and have them gift them to me. Are you kidding? I recommend the Holiday Inn across the road.

author: CanadianG_11
title: Needs an update badly
text: We were really disappointed in our recent stay at this hotel. We had returned here after a great experience 5 years ago; however, this hotel has aged horribly. We stayed in a suite, which the front desk told us was the best room in the hotel. If room 109 is the best hotel in the room they are in real trouble. There was a huge bathtub in our TV room, which was a bit odd. There were holes in the carpet and couch, but the worst part was the elevator which we could hear every 5 minutes and throughout the night. They said they couldn't move us because the hotel was so busy, but they also wouldn't let us cancel so we could move to another hotel. We did move the next day to the Hampton which was much nicer.

author: 41heidif
title: Hidden gem in Lima, Ohio.
text: This was our 2nd time in 2 months staying. My daughter had cheer competition in Lima in December and in Bluffton this time. We opted to stay here again and make the 20 min drive to Bluffton. I love that the pool hours, breakfast hours, and check out hours are a little later. I love the affordable, roomy suites with a separate bedroom, which makes it easier for a large family change for swimming. We love the pool area; perfect temperature and very clean. My boyfriend and son thought the hot tub was too hot but I thought it was ok. The kids love the free cookies and hot cocoa. The value is good, considering the free breakfast buffet with something for everyone. We'll definitely stay here again if in the area!

author: /undefined
title: nice place to stay
text: really nice and clean hotel. nice pool. Beds are comfortable. Room was large. Pillows are fluffy. Enjoyable place. Just wish it was closer to restaurants. Would stay again and in future. Check in was easy.

author: /undefined
title: Wonderful stay.
text: Room was clean, Bathroom impeccable. Staff smiled, and very friendly. No complaints!! Beds and pillows amazingly soft! Easy to find hotel. Continental breakfast. Free wifi. Warm pool. Clean workout facility.

author: 539missy
title: Great
text: The stay was great in a good location. Quick service and rooms felt like home. I loved the whirlpool. Rooms were a nice size. Right off highway. New remodeled. Feels like your home. Employees very professional.

author: 152LynnT152
title: Lovely renovation in a reliable chain
text: Stayed in many Country Inn & Suites. Never disappointed. The 3d floor we stayed on was renovated & attractive. Granite tops, new frig , coffee maker, microwave. We got a suite with sitting room, 2 flat screens, great bed & bedding. The view from our room was tall green trees. Nice surprise. Breakfast not your run of the mill "free" one. Pet friendly of course.

author: ShowMeTheMountains
title: very nice stay
text: Had a girls night with my mom and sisters and this was half-way for all of us. Liked that the room was plenty roomy for all 4 of us. Beds were a little stiff, but who wants to roll in the middle? Everything seemed very clean. The staff at the check in desk were all very friendly. Enjoyed the cookies! As another reviewer mentioned, the breakfast wasn't much to speak about, but we didn't go away hungry by any means, just not much variety or freshness. Would recommend staying here.

author: Rahuldb05
title: Best place to stay... away from home
text: Stayed here for more than 5 months. Visited Lima for a business trip and everytime preferd this hotel to stay in. Very friendly staff... very clean hotel. The breakfast was pretty good. Will surly look forward to revisit this place again. If u r looking for home away from home..... this is the place you are looking for.

author: pk751
title: Could not have been happier
text: Stayed one night while driving across Ohio. Excellent facility. Desk clerk showed us our room before we checked in. Everything we needed. Fresh coffee, cookies and fruit too in the lobby. Quiet, clean and comfortable. Breakfast was barely average but free. Would stay here again.

author: IES2011
title: Hotel @ Lima, OH
text: I would like to write a note of appreciation and thanks to the wonderful folks at Country Inn & Suites, Lima, OH. The hotel is above average, even amongst the best, in many categories. But, best of all, the folks there really try to make your stay safe, enjoyable, and comfortable. As a business traveler to the hotel over 3 years, I have never been disappointed with almost anything. There were times when the options I wanted were not available, but, they went out of their way to get me something very close. If the rooms were not clean for any reason - rarely the case, they would immediately help to fix it. I have reached there many times at mid night due to late flights, but, they would still give me the full attention. I am sure experiences vary for many, but, as one who travels 45 weeks out of 50, this one ranks amongst my best places to stay - amongst the courtyards, wingates, hamptons, etc. Thank you to the lima staff of country inn and suties.

author: 1badcatt
title: Smells like male sweat
text: We stayed here 3/16/13 as our daughter was having a baby & this hotel allows pets. We were charged $25.00 for our 6# dog. Lobby & hallways smell like really bad B. O. Huge stains by both beds. Carpet filthy. Tiny little junky TV. We spent about $134.00 for a $65.00 room. The Baby is fine, though.

author: boomer93
title: Nice Place to Stay
text: I've stayed at this hotel on three occasions over the past three weeks. On my first visit, my room had a large, ugly stain on the carpet. I told them about it when I checked out. When I stayed there just last week, I got the same room again and the stain was gone. This really impressed me. Each time, I have been upgraded to a suite at no extra charge. Only thing that is bad is that all of the restaurants that were within walking distance are now closed (except for the Kewpee Hamburger place, and that is quite a jaunt). Good restaurants are close, but on the other side of the I-75.

author: darlynej2017
title: Great Place
text: We stayed at this brand new hotel while dropping my daughter at college. It was a GREAT hotel. The front desk was helpful and the room was immaculate. The pool and jaccuzi was a welcome relief after a long day of driving. The room was well-appointed, with a microwave and refridgerator. The breakfast was fantastic-plenty of selection. The hotel is brand new and they really thought of just about everything. I would definitley stay again while going through Lima.

author: flores_e3
title: Good for short stay.
text: Stayed here for 3 nights as solo traveler. Happy with my stay. Although the advertising photos looks a bit different than in the real life. + Very good location. Close to restaurants, shops. Room was small but very cosy. - Breakfast was quite poor. For €12 it’s better to leave a hotel and have a breakfast somewhere nearby.
