title: Nice but didn't meet expectations this time
text: Very nice rooms - large and comfortable. We've had a very enjoyable time here on a few occasions but it didn't really measure up to our expectations this time. After touring around for the afternoon, we were surprised to find that, although housekeeping had been in the room, the bed had not been made, the towels had not been hung up properly, a cleaning rag had been left behind, and I'm not sure the room had even been vacuumed. We mentioned this at the desk before going out to dinner. To their credit, when we returned from dinner, the bed had been made and the towels properly hung up. I'd also noticed that the hair dryer mounting was hanging loose from the wall, the sink didn't drain very well, and the toilet had some issues with flushing. The rooms are expensive - thus my higher expectations. It seems like the attention to detail may be slipping somewhat. I hope not but I think we'll try somewhere else next time.

author: emsteph
title: Lovely Inn
text: We had originally booked the Jordan House for our 1 night stay, but were graciously upgraded by Sandy upon check in to a Garden Suite in this main inn. Thank you!! It was most certainly a treat to be nestled into a King bed with Jacuzzi, fireplace and patio which was still warm enough to enjoy a glass of wine outside. The inn is immaculate for cleanliness. Well set up for all our needs. Ate dinner at the affiliated Jordon House pub down the road and played some pool with a few drinks. Food was plentiful and adequate. Breakfast was delicious (breakfast is included, but don't neglect to tip the wait staff). Again, thank you for the upgrade as this made our perfect trip that much nicer.

author: CANADIANTEXPLORERS
title: Disappointed Traveller
text: We stayed for one night in a loft suite. Very, very expensive for what you get. Room was stuffy, especially in the loft bedroom. Felt dated and in need of a contemporary touch. Upstairs bathroom was huge but empty and shower was a plastic built-in type with a fabric curtain. Nespresso machine but poorly stocked with coffee and accompaniments. Breakfast was delicious and service in dining room was very good. Wouldn't go back.

author: berneselover
title: Wonderful B&B
text: My husband and I had the wonderful experience of spending a night at this Bed and Breakfast. What a great time we had. From the moment we were greeted at the front desk the staff could not do enough for us. They personally showed us to our room which was a lovely alcove room decorated in tasteful antique furniture. My husband and I had booked massages in the spa which was so relaxing, and I would highly recommend. I just cannot say enough about our special night at the Inn on the Twenty. Cannot wait to go back again. Thanks

author: MelandGary823
title: Honeymoon Haven
text: We absolutely loved our first stay at Inn on the Twenty in Cooper's Cottage. My daughters and I stayed on Thursday night before my wedding. This two floor cottage had plenty of room and privacy. Gary and I continued the stay on Friday and Saturday. The hospitality was great. Sandy at the front desk was delightful and ever so helpful. While the food was tasty in the restaurant the service did not compare to that of Sandy or the friendly gentlemen at the Jordan Tavern. We loved the privacy of Cooper's Cottage and the backyard patio all to ourselves. It was a wonderful stay and we would definitely recommend this hotel to others to enjoy exploring Ontario's Finest Inns.

author: 360cherylm
title: Quiet Retreat
text: My spouse and I were given the gift of an overnight stay at Inn On The Twenty. We found the staff to be very professional and helpful. Our room was spacious, romantic and comfortable with a large bathroom and Jacuzzi tub. It was a truly lovely retreat. Light sleepers would have found the AC unit a bit loud and we were towards the back of the Inn and could hear some traffic noise at night. Breakfast was good, with gluten and dairy free options available, and the restaurant staff were also very attentive and helpful. The wine tasting and tour at Cave Spring Cellars was fun and informative and we also enjoyed browsing in local shops. History buffs should also check out the Jordan Historical Museum down the road from the Inn - it's a great snapshot of local history. Overall we enjoyed our stay very much.

author: saltBrantford
title: Wonderful get-away!
text: My husband and I received a gift from one of our daughters and her husband to enjoy a get-away at the beautiful "Inn on the Twenty". We were not disappointed! Everything was perfect. The accommodation was spacious, tastefully decorated and overlooked a courtyard in bloom. We walked under a vine covered arch to get to the restaurant across the road from the Inn. Dinner and breakfast were absolutely delicious and the wait staff was very attentive. We enjoyed the small town atmosphere and gardens. It was very relaxing! We also found time for the Cave wine tour, time to browse and shop and then time to enjoy a summer breeze and beverage on an outdoor patio. We were away for a short time but felt as if we had had a long vacation!!

author: DebraP1340
title: gift
text: Our children gave us a Shoppers Life Experience gift card for Xmas for this inn, decided to use it it May of 2913. Booked our room and upon arrival found that they upgraded into a lovely room. The unfortunate part about this place is that there is absolutely nothing going on in Jordan. The shops are sad and the only other restaurant I the village closes at 4:00. Had dinner at their restaurant across the road but service was mediocre (waited 45 minutes for the server to take our dinner order) after she took our drink order. that is just not acceptable. There were only two other couples in the place at that time. unacceptable. This is supposed to be a high caliber restaurant Once we got our food, it was very good but overall, not impressed.

author: mmvmm
title: Inn and Restaurant to delight the senses
text: The Inn belongs to the Ontario's Finest Inns group, and more than lives up to that billing. The rooms are spacious, comfortable and well-appointed. Everything is well maintained and luxurious, right down to the bath robes. The restaurant is outstanding - well worth a visit, even if you are not staying at the Inn. The cuisine is generally French, with local ingredients predominating (even in March). The duck dish was the best this side of Burgundy. Impeccable service - very knowledgeable and astute wine suggestions. All of this is complemented with a spectacular view over the 20 River Valley - several feasts at once.

author: Ross-Siobhan
title: Great Getaway from Toronto
text: We spent a weekend in March at the Inn On The Twenty. Check in was seamless and a happy event. The Garden Suite was great (even in the late stages of winter). The suite was warm, nicely decorated, and the king bed was wonderful with a great duvet. Dinner was immediately across the road and was a wonderful evening. Shopping in Jordan Village is a great experience, especially in the off-season when you can get the complete attention of the owner/operators. Breakfast was another treat. Altogether a wonderfuul inn at which to spend a weekend get away only an hour's drive from the Big Smoke.

author: sewlinsey
title: Relaxing in the quaint village of Jordan.
text: We drove through blizzardy snowy conditions to enjoy a stay at Inn On The Twenty for our anniversary. It turned out to be well worth the drive. The hotel and the rooms were pleasing to the eye, very cozy with the fireplace and yet roomy and clean. The staff were friendly yet professional and very down to earth. We had breakfast at the restaurant which had a beautiful view with nice wait staff and a nice variety of breakfast foods. We also enjoyed wine tasting next to the restaurant. We look forward to visiting the Inn On The Twenty again soon. P.S. We loved the triple chocolate cookies they served in the foyer in the afternoon.

author: HenryK285
title: AMAZING!
text: Absolutely amazing. The food was delicious at the restaurant. The rooms were clean, well decorated, and the overall feeling was relaxing. I would highly recommend a trip to Niagara/Jordan. Very impressive! I would return in a heart beat. Cave Spring is surely doing it right! Thank you!

author: Mookie1208
title: Wedding Gift
text: We received a stay here for our wedding (which is such a great idea). We enjoyed the large room and jacuzzi tub. It is very quiet but really nothing to do after 8pm in the town. It is a fair distance to Niagara on lake. The coffee in room was very good. The coffee at breakfast was excellent. Sitting area and fireplace in room very nice touch. Overall very nice stay, quiet, relaxing but a little too far from any town with stuff going on for us. Inn was clean and well kept with is always important.

author: goldie019
title: Elegance and charm
text: Perfect for those who adore top of the line accommodations and love to be spoiled and pampered. In Ontario wine country, Cave Spring Winery on site, offers tastings and tours. Rooms are suites, fireplace, couches, king bed, very large bathroom with jacuzzi tubs for two as well as shower. Definitely opt for the overnight package that includes gourmet 3-course dinner and scrumptious breakfast. Also get a complimentary bottle of wine on check-out.Dinner is absolutely superb with local cuisine, wait staff friendly and very attentive. For a special celebration this spot is amazing. Pricey, yes. Worth it, most definitely.

author: MegCanada
title: Lovely Inn in Wine Country
text: We recently enjoyed a beautiful spring day in wine country and spent the night at the Inn. The rooms are spacious and well appointed with lovely bathrooms, a seating area with a fireplace and comnfortable beds and robes. The reception area is upstairs and there are rooms on the lower level which feel removed from the Inn. The Inn is not owner staffed so there is not the ambience of a country inn but rather of a small hotel. We had dinner/breakfast in the restauant which is across the street. The restaurant is lovely and the food excellent and beautifully presented. While the service is good it could be more polished to equal the the food and charm of the restaurant. The wine list favors Niagara wines. There is not much activity in Jordan especially in the evening so it does not have the vibrance of Niagara on the Lake for younger guests. Definitely a wine tasting, rest and relaxation destination.

author: llhobie4
title: A sure bet.
text: My wife and I had stayed here a few years ago and were yearning to come back. We were not disappointed. As part of the Ontario's Finest Inns family, you really cannot go wrong. The luxury is everywhere,the staff is great, and our package included dinner. The food, selection and presentation were first class, a truly wonderful adventure. Local products are spectacular. We definitely will be back. Prices can be a bit steep, but if you seek off season packages, it is a very worthwhile treat!

author: masterdiver
title: OIl free Vegan Available!
text: We try to get down to the Inn on The Twenty at least once a year. I grew up nearby and love to revisit the region. We always enjoy the low key luxury and the fine foods and wines at the Inn. This year was different as we have both adopted a plant based diet with no added oil. When I booked our room, I asked if they could accommodate our food preferences. The answer was yes. First, when we checked in, there was an oil free vegan plate of baked goods and fruit waiting for us in our room. Then the new chef produced a truly memorable meal. We were thrilled with our dinner and the breakfast the next morning. I cannot say enough about how wonderful it was to be able to eat such a sophisticated meal and at the same time maintain our dietary commitments.

author: neferTT
title: Great stay
text: I stayed at the Inn on the Twenty as part of work retreat. I was in a lovely room (#18) on the second floor, heated by a gas fireplace and with a whirlpool tub and separate shower in the enormous bathroom. More space than I knew what to do with! The complimentary bottle of wine and toiletries in my room were also appreciated. As mentioned in other reviews, I don't think it would matter what room you are in, it will definitely be nice and quiet. It's a great location with a lovely atmosphere. I also took advantage of the spa. I was disappointed that there was not more availability for appointments - it seemed to shut down rather early. The massage I received was quite good, but I was really interested in an esthetics appointment which sadly was not available. Overall, it was a great location for our work meetings, the staff were extremely personable and attentive and I would definitely return there.

author: SunWorship46
title: Relaxing Weekend
text: After a scenic drive we arrived in the quaint Village of Jordan, we had come early and went to the front desk (second floor) just to check things out only to find our beautiful room was ready, the gentleman at the front desk was great. Knowledgeable, helpful and polite, he guided us to our room (suite #11) right off reception and the main foyer. We were a little worried at the proximity but when the door was shut we heard nothing from outside. The room felt a little dated but included a super comfortable bed raised above the rest of the room, the ceilings had to have been 18-20ft with nice crown molding, a great fireplace, flat screen tv, a really big window overlooking the well manicured garden. The bathroom was nicely appointed with modern style, and had a romantic corner Jacuzzi. The rest of the Inn was very well kept and always gave a warm inviting feel. It's placement in wine country was greatly appreciated as so many wineries were a close drive away. We'll come back again for sure, beautiful spot !

author: ReanneG
title: Wedding dreams come true!
text: We would recommend that anyone looking to get married in wine country to check out Inn on the Twenty! The personal service was amazing! The service here was amazing! We were able to personalize pretty much every and any element of our day that we wanted to - every request was met with "yes"! The food - AMAZING! our guests are still talking about it! and same goes for the wine! We would do the whole thing again in a heartbeat!

author: NKLounger
title: Great business retreat
text: I stayed at the Inn of the Twenty for a business retreat. My room was wonderful – large, clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly and professional. We used the Jordan Room over 2 days for our meetings and it was suitable. My only complaint is that we could have used some additional power outlets for our laptops. There was 1 power station at the central table but there were 10 of us so we had to use plugs around the edge of the room, which did not reach the table. That being said, if we had asked, the staff probably would have provided extension cords for us. The lunches provided were very good – salad, sandwiches, meat & cheese plate + dessert (crème Brule!). I did not have time to try the spa or fitness centre. I would recommend this venue for any business retreat.

author: RobbinNicole
title: An absolutely perfect experience!
text: My husband and I spent 3 days and 2 nights in Jordan at the Inn on the Twenty beginning on Valentine's Day and we can't say enough good things about our stay! The staff of the hotel were efficient and personable and completely in tune to all of our needs. The staff at the restaurant were fantastic! Both can be compared to any we have experienced in very high end inns and restaurants in our travels around the world. The etiquette was impeccable as was the service and knowledge of wine. And the food was incredible! And everyone went out of their way to make us feel pampered and in need of absolutely nothing! They also went above and beyond the call of duty to help us get to know the surrounding area. It was three days away that felt like a week! We will return as soon as we can!

author: JoanneAttard
title: Would get married here again in a heartbeat! What an amazing experience!
text: My husband and I chose to get married at the Inn on the Twenty, in Jordan, Ontario -- a quaint little village in the heart of Vineland, Ontario, and we are so glad that we did!! Although I am from Ontario originally, both my husband and I reside in New Brunswick, but with the Inn on the Twenty, that didn't make the planning any more difficult or stressful. I was exceptionally pleased with the event coordinators, and not only was everyone helpful, they were also extremely friendly and professional. The wedding itself went off without a hitch, and the food was the best I have ever had at a wedding! We loved our room and the staff were awesome! We were glad we stayed an extra day and night! We will most definitely return in the future -- probably for Anniversary celebrations!!! A wonderfully, romantic getaway!!!

author: sjf123
title: Just ok
text: I stayed two nights in the Winemakers suite to celebrate my spouses birthday. The main reason to go to Jordan was to attend a concert at Zooma Zooma, so we decided to make a weekend of it. Overall it was ok, but not worth the money we spent. I've stayed in far nicer spots for no where near the price they charge. The Winemakers suite is very dated - really - flower wallpaper?? The bathroom was great with a nice jacuzzi tub. The bedroom was comfortable, although I agree about the tiny, dated tv that someone else mentioned. We had one service issue, during our stay. The room was not cleaned, we just received turndown service. The front desk was apologetic about the whole incident, and reduced one nights rate, but still leaves a bad taste for me.

author: smartlikeafox
title: Fantastic wedding memories
text: We held our wedding reception at the Inn's restaurant (in the Windows room) and stayed in one of their Garden Suites on our wedidng night. In short, it was spectacular. To focus on the suite: There was a beautiful outdoor garden area with a back gate (fantastic for loading up the car the next day!), huge bathroom and jacuzzi tub (heaven), incredibly comfortable bed and wonderful furniture around the room. They charged us a fairly steep delivery fee for breakfast in the room but for us, it was worth it (nicer if it was included though! sort of goes along with the luxurious experience). Wonderful, wonderful staff. Beautiful place and perfect for a getaway treat and a bit of luxury. We'll be back :o)

author: imissukelly
title: Treasure in Niagara Region
text: We got married at Inn on the Twenty in the middle of the Cave Spring Cellars Vineyard. The setting was lush green and the vines were heavy with grapes. It was a beautiful venue for the ceromony. Our reception followed in the Windows Room at the Inn with a cocktail reception for 50 people. All our guests were blown away with the quality of the food served and the attentive staff who oversaw our event. The staff were quick to ensure all our guests were sateed and content. Any request was accomodated immediately and in many cases anticipated without prompting from us. It was our second visit to the Inn and we picked this venue to give us a beatiful place to celebrate anniversaries in the future. Our experience in the Village Jordan-was only enhanced by engaging local vendors for all our wedding related needs. We received the best service from everyone we came in contact with during our experience in Jordan.

author: TorontoMsmac
title: Thunderstorm...great hotel!
text: A short trip from busy Toronto to an idealic setting in wine country. My daughter's wedding reception was at the "Twenty " and I was booked there. A wedding reception inherently has some difficulties. At the Inn on the Twenty everything was flawless. The service was exceptionally warm and professional. The accomodation was luxuriously country , creating a calm delight. The food was equal to 5 star in Toronto - spectacular in a word. The staff meets every need a guest has with a caring smile. A weekend there is heaven.

author: JeanneBonn
title: Nice for a romantic weekend getaway
text: I booked a suite at the Inn for a romantic getaway for me and my partner. The suite we had (I believe an alcove suite) was very nicely decorated, sufficiently large, with a gas fireplace and a nice jacuzzi. Besides, the Inn has a spa right next to it. So it has everything you need for a romantic weekend. The staff is extremely nice and helpful. There are some place to go close to Jordan, like Niagara-on-the-Lake or the Niagara Falls. But if you want to go out at night, Jordan is not the place to be. It is a quiet little village with a good restaurant (Dine on the Twenty), a winery, and some sort of Tavern in which they play music at night (I have not been there). Both of us loved the stay because we came with the expectation of spending a quiet and relaxing weekend there. If that is what you expect, you will not be disappointed.

author: earthangel288
title: Best spa experience!
text: The hotel was beautiful and clean. The staff was friendly and attentive. I would recommend that you book your accommodations with breakfast. It is as tasty as it is elegant. Your visit would not be complete without a visit to the Spa on the Twenty. The people and services were amazing. You will feel “perfectly relaxed” afterwards. I will definitely be back to visit this beautiful town...

author: canalgirl
title: Over Priced but Decent
text: My husband and I have stayed in quite a few lovely inns and while the Inn on the Twenty is pleasant, we did feel that the price tag is about $100/night too high in comparison to other inns. The inn staff are gratious, and the room itself is nice. However, it is over priced for the amenities it provides. Because it is located in Jordan, a lovely village, it is very secluded and the village itself closes down by 6 pm on weeknights and the Inn itself does not provide any alternative activities. There is no games room, libraries, etc as there are in other Inns. The room is nice but not overly lush and luxurious. The toiletries are okay, but could have been nicer (Aveda etc would have been a nice treat) (they charge you for bath salts to use in the whirlpool!) Again, something one would expect for the price. The restaurant is outstanding. But, after enjoying the three course meal, one really needs to have some sort of entertainment / something to do, because one is too full to head right to bed!

author: jimkoh82
title: West Lake is just within walking distance
text: The is big and the bed is very comfy. The building is not tall hence, can't really see the nice view of the place. The staffs are extremely friendly and helpful. There is many nice restaurants near the west lake and there is also some nice pubs which you can hang out after dinner. There's also a very nice starbucks at west lake for those who need their daily dosage of coffee. Oh yes, something interesting that I discovered, you can actually request for the mahjong table. I saw the staffs moving a auto mahjong table up to the hotel room. The breakfast is not too bad, those who need western style of breakfast, they do provide bread, butter, jam and ham.

author: Dovecotedweller
title: Standards have slipped in a year
text: My friend and I visited this hotel last year and had a really good experience but sadly this year things were not the same. Last year we had a fabulous room with plenty of space and some lovely little extras like fruit and cakes with a tiny view of the lake. Unfortunately this year was very disappointing. Firstly we arrived at the hotel and were allocated a room, when we eventually got to the room it was small compared to the one on our previous visit with none of the little extras we had experienced before. It overlooked a private block of apartments and all we could hear was loud karyoke singing. We visited the bar and asked for gin and tonic and again in the restaurant on both occasions this took so long for the waiter and waitress to figure out what a gin and tonic was over half an hour, whilst I appreciate this drink is popular with westerners for an Accor chain this request should be simple and feel more training should be given. Also the additional nibbles we were given last year also appeared to have stopped. The restaurant is very expensive and the menu is not very inspiring, unless you choose the very overpriced buffet. The staff on reception were very helpful and also the guys who handle taxis and baggage. Come on Accor your standards have slipped, we will be visiting again but will think twice about using Sofitel

author: YEGJOB
title: Best part of the Sofitel is the location... all downhill from there..
text: I stayed at the Sofitel during my recent trip to Hangzhou. The location is walking distance to the Lake and to shops and restaurants. Unfortunately, those are the best attributes and they may be enough for you to want to stay there. The rooms and elevators smelled of cigarette smoke. The breakfast food was often cold and inedible. The staff was committed but not very sophisticated as evidenced by their challenges in finding taxis. The bed was hard as a rock. My room view was the apartment building across the street and neither windows were tinted for privacy. Modernizing the property would go a long way toward making it more appealing.

author: /undefined
title: A five-star hotel
text: Hardware and software did not meet the standard of being a five-star hotel. Unsecured booking system and payment procedures - credit card guarantee not accepted at the time of reservation and only prepayment was allowed - not fair to pay in advance at higher flexible rate closer to the time of arrival. Inconvenient location to get to the hotel - difficult for travellers with luggage to walk from Hangzhou Railway Station as they have to go up and down through three disconnected underground tunnels without clear signage. But it is a good location to visit the Westlake. Front desk staff were unprofessional and not helpful in problem solving - pushing guests to move to another “so-called” five-star hotel upon my check-in. I refused due to influence in travelling schedule - struggled a room in the end after ~0.5 hour. I requested the front desk not to do any transaction on my credit card as a deposit since I would pay by another credit card. But I received an SMS from Card Centre that a transaction was made. Not cool enough centralised Air-Conditioning System - sweating at the time of check-in and hot inside the room because temperature cannot be adjusted inside the room - could not sleep well. Lack of confidence in staying at Sofitel again.

author: eteo232
title: Generally OK, but lacking in some aspects
text: Hotel staff are generally very polite and helpful. But the concierge, though polite and helpful, are not forthcoming enough with information. When I enquired about certain tourist spots, they fail to inform me about opening hours, though it was evident that I was interested to go. It is more like: they will only tell what I ask, but lack the initiative to offer obvious or important information to guests. Hence, service is much to be desired here. Rooms are okay, but obviously getting old and can be refurbished. Location is good though: very close to the Xihu lake. Gym is (too) small, but decent enough.

author: akct2017
title: Close but not that close to the West Lake
text: Location of the hotel was several long blocks away from the lake with nice neighborhood. There were hardly rooms with a view with most rooms facing the back side of apartment blocks. Facilities of the hotel were dated. Enough staff spoke limited English to give foreigners guidance. Walking to the West Lake was easy. The city of Hangzhou was beautiful with lots of greenery. Most of the drivers in the streets were courteous, stopping to let pedestrians cross the streets. Local people we ran into are courteous and warm. Wish we had stayed longer to enjoy the city.

author: PhilipE349
title: Good overall package
text: Spent one day for a conference in Shanghai. The hotel is well located, walking distance to most things around the West Lake as well as some business areas. The lobby is nothing special, borderline tasteless, and the check-in process was on the slow side. But the rooms excel. I had a corner suite sort of room (271) which was enormous, spotless, well appointed with an excellent Illy coffee machine and a remarkable bathroom. Wonderful shower (I hear all showers are such high quality), great toiletries and towels. Bedding first class. Very quiet for the location. I slept wonderfully. Decent breakfast, generous buffet and - predictably - perfect croissants.

author: jenniferwM1151QE
title: This should be a 3 Star rated Hotel
text: This hotel is out dated and run down. The lake is across the street and convenient, but that’s the only positive thing I can say about the experience. My waiter seemed put out when I asked for soy sauce, more tea, the check. He was so rude at check out that I went to the front desk with him and told the concierge what had happened. I would not recommend Hangzhou for foreign travelers. I didn’t not feel welcome at all. I had very positive experience on my travels to Hong Kong and Shanghai. This place, Hangzhou and Sofitel Westlake, left a very bad impression. I’ll never come back, nor will I ever stay at another Sofitel Hotel.

author: Jilnick
title: Just OK only
text: One always expect something better from Sofitel i.e.better service, facility, rooms etc. Of course, one should expect to pay more. Except for the room which was roomy & well-equiped, all others were quite ordinary at Sofitel Hangzhou. Service at breakfast was sub-par, waiter forgot about coffee & tea order, a sense of reluctance at egg station. Everybody seems to be in a hurry to close the breakfast service at 10am when there's still 30 minutes more to go. Bellhop was more interested in his smart phone etc. For almost the same room rate, there're certainly other foreign branded hotel choices available. One cannot complain about the location though, 5 mins walk to the lake and close to lots of food options 10 mins walk away. This is probably the biggest plus point for this hotel besides the very nice & cosy rooms. Need to improve on the others.

author: NinaAsia
title: Overall, a pleasant stay !
text: My first time staying in a Sofitel hotel was generally a good experience for friendly, helpful service and very comfortable room. Was delightfully surprised that the bed was soft and comfy. And the non-smoking room was just wonderful. My thanks to : 1) helpful concierge desk who helped arrange to book tickets for "Enduring memories of Hangzhou " show and useful tips about taking a cab back. The following day he even checked with us to find out how it went. A pity I didn't get the name of the concierge. 2) housekeeping department for kindly cleaning our room at short notice because we wanted to rest and they hadn't cleaned our room yet. 3) food and beverage department for correcting our packed breakfast order (only packed 1 set instead of 2) very promptly because we had to checkout at 5am to catch a flight.

author: 769nidhia
title: Amazing hospitality
text: We stayed their for business. It was a corporate event and around 40 Indian guests were staying there. The hotel made all the efforts to provide a comfortable stay. The cuisine, which was a concern for many, offered international food and special efforts were made to incorporate vegetarian food. The stay was otherwise also very comfortable. Its walking distance to the lake and you will enjoy a stroll in morning and evening. Markets are nearby. Location is ideal to explore the city.

author: 9V-SMU
title: Great stay and good location
text: Feel very welcome even before checking in, as the Guest Relation Officer; Ms Marina had send a welcome email 2 days before I was due to arrive. Marina had also indicated in their system that I am interested in getting 2 tickets for the "Impressions Westlake Show" and I was promptly directed to the concierge upon arrival. As my room was not ready, I was also given a choice of leaving my luggage at the concierge. The duty manager also initiated to text me when my room is ready but sadly, it never happen... The purchase of the tickets for the performance was fast. However, the concierge told me upfront to pay a 10RMB tips when I wanted to leave my luggage with them. No issue with giving tips, just that it feel weird that the staff actually request for it first and not wait till I collect the luggage at a later time. Overall, the stay was great and the service was outstanding. I sat down at the lobby one of the night and observed the duty manager walking around, making small talks with the guests. Not something all hotel will do, but definitely a nice gesture.

author: sandyh786
title: Beautiful memorable stay
text: Stayed for 2 nights and felt most welcome at reception, by all staff especially Marina who was like a new cadet to the group. She was warm and friendly and assisted in everything... from maps to little like English tea bags. We were given a nice surprise as it was for my birthday... very nice gesture as Marina came and knocked on the door.... The room was big and bathroom was most spacious with TV at bath. breakfast was good by Chinese standard. Bed and pillows very comfortable.

author: TTle888
title: Good location
text: Stayed here for 1 day for work. The location is nice, just across the road from the nice part of the west lake. Alot of the staff don't speak English which is a shame for a 5star intentional hotel. They have a lovely roof terrace over looking the lake but it was closed due to the weather being too hot. Which I think is a shame as that's the whole point of sitting outside in the heat!. Breakfast buffet was good. It has a good choice. However I don't think the "fresh" juice were fresh.

author: StuttgartWilli
title: Still an excellent place to be staying
text: After quite some time another visit to this nice place. May it be business of private trip, always recommendable. For business a good location to anywhere in the city. Good meeting facilities. For private trips an excellent starting point for walks along the lake, cycle tour around the lake, walking to the shopping area or to intime shopping mall. General: 10 min Walk to reach Metro-station. Nicely upgraded rooms. Good lobby atmosphere. Relaxing cigar lounge. Enjoyable business lounge on 5th floor.

author: samt817
title: Luxury hotel with affordable price
text: Just return from a 3 nights stay in Easter. Everything is great with heaps of smiling faces welcome you. Spacious, clean and tidy room. Buffet breakfast full of choices. Location is the best, we only walk to nearby attractions during our stay. Westlake, Hefeng Street, Yintai Department Store all within 15 minutes walk. To my big surprise the hotel management celebrates my birthday by sending me a big and delicious birthday cake. Highly recommended!

author: paigiriraj
title: Amazing location. Great hotel.
text: The hotel is amazing. Just a walking distance from the Westlake and is a beautiful property. Will surely live here the next time I visit the city. The breakfast spread is good and ends exactly at 10.30am. So the timing is good. Only problem was, I had an issue with my safe and the response was terrible. Nobody turned up. Rest, the hotel was good in terms of comfort and size. Has a good cafe area where you have a space for business meetings.

author: 18lilyy
title: Lovely Hotel , Walk to Westlake
text: Stayed at this hotel for 5 days. Very convenient for sightseeing. Westlake was just across the road. We were on the top floor with access to lounge area. Room was spacious & comfortable. Breakfast offered wide choice & selection in the main dining area. There is a nice Chinese restaurant in the hotel. Staff are very helpful especially Anthony from Concierge who helped planned our day tours around Hangzhou seamlessly. We happened to comment how we enjoyed the special little golden fruit `cumquat' served at the hotel, and to our pleasant surprise, a plate of it was sent to our room with compliments! We enjoyed our stay there and thank all the staff looking after us.

author: 181cameliai
title: Great hotel with great service
text: The rooms are arranged with the smallest details taken into account. Details such as a good coffee self made in the room are really making you feel in a 5 star category. The staff very helpful, professional and nice. We asked them to search a lawyer for us and they made it! Our room was with a view at the Westlake. Wonderful!! The place couldn't be better. Close to the romantic river of Hangzhou and close to the shopping area. Really a nice experience! Worth the money you spend for the stay!

author: halves01
title: Fantastic team could be better on the room
text: The hotel team is absolutely amazing. Very friendly and professional. Without a doubt the best the hotel offers. I was desapointed with the room. It was very basic and far from matching the label of "luxury". The bathroom was max a 3 star hotel level (see pics). I must say that I've changed room immediately after checking in (inicial room was in the 1sr floor facing the back building and therefore I did not want to stay at that room and changed to the 3rd floor facing the street). They did told me the inicial room was an upper level room. Overall nice and cozy hotel environment but room features definitely need upgrade.

author: pratikindia
title: Good hotel at very good location
text: I booked the room online, so everything was ready when I reached there. The check in process was quick. The location is perfect, close to West Lake. One can see the city and lake from the room and it's very beautiful at night. I rated 4 star for one reason. The bed was not neat and was in crumbled condition. It looked like that they had forgotten. It was a nice stay.

author: Icyblue
title: Hotel Staff Went That Extra Mile to Salvage My 1st Day of Vacaation
text: I arrived at Sofitel Hangzhou near midnight on 5 Dec 16 but left my camera and mobile devices in the taxi. What happened in next hour was overwhelming - security staff running through the CCTV recordings and zooming different angles to read the taxi vehicle number on-screen (not so easy), counter manager phoning taxi companies to look for the taxi driver and assuring me that the taxi driver was on his way back to return what I left behind. Much relief finally at 1 am. But nothing beat the care and efforts of these hotel staff, who went their way to helping me (special mention - Mr. Zhang and his colleague of Security Department and the male counter manager during the late night shift). They insisted it was their responsibility and refused to accept any gratitude token. Other hotel staff members, including bell boy Tim Liu, were very helpful in offering travel tips too. With 5 minutes' walk to West Lake side, this hotel is very convenient and yet quiet. Above all, it is the staff who made my first experience with this hotel an exceptional one. Thank you again.

author: PatrickM990
title: Solid hotel, good location
text: I have mixed feelings about this hotel. The room was nice enough, and we really liked the location -- only about 5 minutes walk from the West Lake. The concierge was also very helpful, especially when I needed some RMB changed back to USD -- they went well out of their way to help me make that happen. However, when we checked in we were told that our room wasn't ready (we weren't checking in early) We were told we need to wait about 40 minutes, and were given drink vouchers at their restaurant for our trouble. We ended up waiting more than 2 hrs, and had to keep asking the front desk about the situation -- they did not notify us when the room was ready even though we were sitting a few feet away. The WiFi was spotty, and the pool area was just OK. It's a nice enough hotel, but there were just enough frustrations that I might look elsewhere if I'm ever in the area again. I gave it 4 stars simply because of the excellent concierge help we received.

author: gr8fulmom
title: Exceptional Service
text: Great hotel a stones throne from the lake but still near town and waking distance to many restaurants. Breakfast was wonderful. Large and great quality with lots of western and Asian items available. Good wifi. Staff were exceptionally good! Bending over backwards to anticipate our every need. They even got us out to the rooftop garden to checkout the amazing view despite the fact it was closed due to drizzle. Rooms get luxurious and fairly spacious. Not cheap. But you get what you pay for.

author: 945ninga
title: Very lovely
text: Key word. Upgrade your room. Not only newer but cleaner and more spacious. Definitely worth the $30 a night extra charge. Breakfast was fine. Gym is quite good. Outdoor rooftop is not always open but when open is a nice place to relax and have a smoke or drink. Recommended

author: whamtam1
title: Just OK
text: The Sofitel in Hangzhou is well placed, with a great rooftop bar overlooking the West Lake. Aside from that, the rooms, amenities and other features are just OK. On Check-In, we were told we were chosen randomly as "guest of the day" and given a complimentary upgrade. We double clarified we werent being asked to pay extra with an English speaking attendant who confirmed. Again, the "upgrade" to the Sofitel Club was pretty basic hotel chain stuff, so Im unsure about the quality of the regular rooms. On check-out, we were surprised to find wed been charged $200AUD for the upgrade, and apparently had signed off on it (our mistake - as the attendant on check in told us we were just signing off for the buffet breakfast and didn't clarify they were quoting double what they wrote down for us). Pretty annoyed about their loose definition of "complimentary" as we definitely would not have paid the extra for what we got. Overall, sofitel westlake is just "good enough" if accomodation isnt a big deal to you.

author: rahuljiv2016
title: Good location
text: Rooms are spacious enough. Make sure you take lake view room. Swimming pool is very small. It's like a kids pool. Staff at pool should learn some politeness. Breakfast is no great. It's same like any other hotel of similar kind. Location of the hotel is very good. And almost all taxi drivers knows the name of the hotel. So it's easy to commute.

author: lamyaab
title: a general manager of intelligent and Developer
text: I have spent some quality time in the city hangzhuo China, and this fourth visit me to this beautiful city. I stayed at the Sofitel West Lake Hotel, I stayed in this hotel three times, I was shocked by changes which carried out the hotel, worked a bar on the roof of the hotel is possible to see a spectacular view of the lake and the city hangzhuo, it's a great idea, and Action barbeque grill restaurant with a DJ sixth floor balcony overlooking the lake can not describe the beauty of the scene night. I booked a standard room this time, I was afraid they are small or non-beautiful, but it was spacious Large , clean and beautiful with all the services, and the provision of fruit and sweets to welcome. I like that this hotel managment its way, they have a general manager of intelligent knows how to develop and train his employees happy and makes customers feel as if they were in their home When you enter the hotel sees Director General meets the customers and welcome them, you see all employees Everyone welcomes you, and ask that you lack something was, For a restaurant, a fabulous restaurant is clean, and I thank ( Mr./ Thomas ) Who day we see breakfast and dinner helps to talk in English and explain the content of each meal, and I thank ( Mr. / Adison , lou ) Who does our service daily, and became known why I drink the morning and I prefer to eat, take this intelligent and beautiful train crew Restaurant the hotel The lounge, you can sit quietly, and lovely service I thank Miss / suny my service on a daily . I will come back to visit the city and the hotel. Eventually thank the general manager greeted me when I came, and when I came out of the hotel I thank Mis / Seoul, and Mss. / yona they help me and provide all my needs during my stay in hotel And a great Thanksgiving all employees on all daily services to me . And I thank the people of this beautiful city for welcoming me tourist , I wish I knew the writing of the Chinese language written in Chinese Thanksgiving

author: ChristineE4444
title: Lovely hotel which exceeded our expectations.
text: I stayed here for 7 nights in April for business. The hotel and staff looked after us beautifully. I would like to mention Cheryl in the Club Bar, she was welcoming and warm and friendly to us, also Thomas the Chef from the UK was wonderful. Lastly the Concierge Aaron was very helpful as were the staff in the Business centre. We could always find someone who could speak English which was immensely helpful for us. We actually could see gorgeous Westlake from our suite, the rooms were big and the bed was comfy. The Rooftop Bar was incredible and the view to the temple on the Mountain was divine both day and night, do not miss it! The Hotel exceeded our expectations and we will certainly stay here again on our next visit to beautiful Hangzhou. Christine Eyre Managing Director Silk Islands

author: suedulay
title: Awesome Hotel Great Location
text: We stayed at the Sofitel for 3 nights and its was Amazing!! The location of the hotel backs onto the lake and there is a rooftop deck that has the most Gorgeous Views especially at Sunset and you are able to order cocktails while you are up there enjoying the view 😎 The food was really great! We travelled with a 9 & 5 year who are picky eaters and they were very well taken care of by the chefs in the Kwee Zeen buffet who made them fresh kid friendly cheese pizza, even though it wasn't on the menu, as the staff noticed the children were picking at their food and not eating. Which we take it for granted in North America, but cheese pizza isn't considered a "regular" food item in China so it was Wonderful that they would take care of the children to ensure they were Happy, eating and enjoying their stay. The hotel concierge took care of getting us a private tour guide and car with driver at very resonable rates to take us around Hangzhou. I did visit the Spa whilst staying at the hotel and due to the long flight (11 hours from Vancouver Canada) my legs were quite swollen and my body was very fatigued due to the 14 hour time difference so I booked my 90 min massage and the massage was absolutely Fantastic!!!! She managed to drain the excess water from my body via massage and took her time to ensure every muscle had the knots taken out and the next morning, I woke up refreshed with no swelling in my face or legs and I could see my ankles again!!! It was Bar None one of the Best Massages I've ever had and this is coming from a Spa Fanatic!! All of the staff we encountered were very happy and friendly, a Special Thank you to Stanley and Alice for their Wonderful Hospitality and also to Helen & Ella!! We would definitely come back to Hangzhou and would only stay at the Sofitel, our children's every whim was taken care off and as all parents know "Happy Kids = Happy Vacation"!!

author: /undefined
title: Not bad, but not quite at the top level as expected from a Sofitel.
text: First things first, our room itself was lovely. A nice big room, very nice bathroom, super comfy bed, and generally just a very nice room. But this Sofitel was a bit of a let down in other ways. It is right on a very busy street (a good location near West Lake, but no lake views)., so you most definitely want a room facing back away from the road, not onto the front as we had (despite our room being a junior suite). Our room was quite noisy all night long (I'm not sure the windows are double glazed), so that was a bit disappointing. Our room was also very warm, we tried changing settings on the air con on several occasions, and this seemed to have little, if any impact. We eventually reverted to opening the small windows for a while each evening to cool the room down - which made the noise problem even worse. Overall all, it is a nice hotel, but make sure you ask for a room not facing the main road.

author: peach88ny
title: Location is great but rooms are not comfortable and noisy. Disappointed
text: It's my second time staying in this hotel. I had a great time during my first visit two years ago. This time I had my family with me. Our double rooms are small and old. One of the room is next to the street and very noisy. Some staffs are neither friendly nor professional. They did not greet us or even had eye contact with us at the door. Don't feel it's worthy of my money this time.

author: DianeSHH
title: Acceptable hotel. Let down by attention to detail
text: On a trip to China this was the most disappointing hotel in which I stayed. Rooms are clean, reasonably furnished and a decent size. Situation, near the West Lake is good. But the room was far too hot - I was not the only person in the group who had this problem - but staff were unwilling to do anything about it. Apparently the aircon gets turned off at 6 pm and that's it. Service at breakfast was poor. Difficult to order tea/coffee. And trying to get butter was a joke! Overall the staff were indifferent.

author: Ridwancha
title: Superb
text: This is my third time to stay in this hotel. This time, we choose a luxury rooms. The bed is soft and nicely not like other hotels in china. The services are nicely being display from the bell boy, concierge and check in staff. But still, they need to learn english especially since it is an accor group hotels... It is going to be another plus if the staff can speak english. The lounge is superb. They change the menu everyday and by the 3Rd day, the staff already remember us and give us the usual one that we order for the drinks. Nice touch!! Overall, a little above standard for accor groups hotels.

author: RuthH352
title: Disappointing, but great location
text: This hotel is in sad need of a facelift. The lobby is beautiful and the location can not be beat. In addition, the concierge staff is very friendly and helpful. However, the bathroom, while clean, had a mildew problem in the grout and was very old. The beds were quite hard, and the feather top had all the feathers around the edges (obviously hadn't been shaken in a while). The breakfast was only ok. The pool is a tiny thing, and the gym is also quite tired although sufficient. Overall disappointing for a Sofitel.

author: Hazelmenon
title: Above expectation
text: This is my 1st trip to Hangzhou & i choose this hotel because of the brand & also because i have the accorhotel platinum card. I was there only for 2 nights for business, the West lake being so closed by was a real bonus. I was welcomed by Anna Shi, excellent Guest Experience Manager. She helped made my stay simply wonderful. The gym looked nice even though i did not get a chance to use it. The indoor pool looked nice too but it was too noisy with kids playing in an enclosed space. Can't say much about the food, I only had breakfast & dinner in the restaurant, the flavour is just a too little too salty for me. I'll definitely stay in this hotel again when i come back for my next meeting.

author: Edwinbearlover
title: Typical China level upmarket hotel!
text: Chose this hotel because of its location next to West Lake which was our primary reason for visiting this city, plus the benefits of Accor platinum membership. The hotel is a typical upmarket hotel of a style you find in China. Large functional lobby, rooms with standard but comfortable space and layout. Nothing to wow, but clean and well upkept. Access to the executive lounge was great and the snacks and drinks selection was good. Staff service was in general good, and I was personally welcomed by the General Manager on one occasion during the stay. Renting a bicycle from the hotel and riding leisurely around the lake is the perfect way to see this beautiful scenic spot. One plus point to note is the hotel breakfast, was surprised and pleased by the huge variety on offer at the ground floor restaurant.

author: Sophil888
title: Lovely Hangzhou Sofitel
text: Check-in was smooth, courteous, and helpful. Room was very nice. Club room was excellent. Great hotel facilities. Lovely views across West Lake during breakfast. Concierge team excellent. Bikes for riding around quite good. Check-out very smooth.

author: frasedbv
title: Great Location, right near Westlake
text: My second visit to the Sofitel, Westlake, pleasantly renovated. I opted and paid for the upgrade to the club floor. Room was so small, no space for clothing in the wardrobe. After a very charming welcome, was somewhat disappointed in the service of the club staff on the floor but not so in the lounge. The young staff go all out to assist and are most gracious. Upon departure a lovely lady offered me some congee to take with me as I was not well, how touched I was by this gesture. Certainly would recommend, great location. If travelling into Hangzhou by rail, arrange prior pickup service as there are many illegal taxi vendors, huge queues for a taxi.

author: Elmos101
title: Very comfortable and friendly
text: Nice hotel with friendly staff. All speaking good English. We were upgraded to the club floor at no extra cost which was nice. The room was clean and modern with a view over the main street and a little bit of the lake. The hotel location is very convenient for the lake shore.. but not on it. A short walk through the pedestrian under pass and you are at the lake shore. Ate every night in the local restaurants so cannot comment on the hotel food but the bar was very pleasant with a reasonable selection of local and foreign beers. In short I would stay again and would recommend.

author: FairFair_02
title: Convenient location
text: There are quite a number of hotels by Westlake in Hangzhou. This one is connected to the lakeside by an underground tunnel that crosses the beautiful tree-lined Nanshan Road. A very nice location indeed for strolling. There are two shopping malls nearby with a grocery store and many restaurants. The hotel building is rather plain outside. But the internal decor in the room and in the lobby is nice. The only negative point is that our room on the 4/F faces a residential building and no view of Westlake whatsoever. It is the same for all rooms on our side of the building. The other side of the building faces a major avenue with busy traffic.

author: /undefined
title: Do not stay during construction
text: Nice hotel, good location, but DO NOT stay until they finish the construction. We were warned at check-in about "a little noise", so they "upgraded" to the 5th floor away from the construction. All not true. There was also a note in the room warning of constuction starting at 9:00am daily. It showed management was trying, but not communicating well with the constructionworkers. Truth was at 7:00am on both Sat. and Sun. morning we had loud hammering on the floor directly above our room and strong chemical odors from the contruction on our floor. Upon check-out I just got the typical "next stay upgrade" routine. Nice hotel but I would not say again until the construction is finished.

author: worldlyCanada
title: Service like no other!
text: The true gauge of any good hotel is the quality of its service, and the Sofitel in Hangzhou clearly sets the standard. Situated close to both West Lake and downtown, this newly renovated hotel is small enough to offer a boutique feel but big enough to offer all the amenities of a larger hotel. Suites are spacious and bright with well-appointed bathrooms that have separate showers and toilets. Our suite had a TV in both the main room and bathroom. We also had access to the Club Floor which was spacious, bright, and a soothing sanctuary to which you could retire at the end of the day. Food selection in this lounge was varied and the wine offered was premium quality. Likewise, the main restaurant offered one of the most comprehensive breakfast buffets I have seen in a long time and the quality of offerings was outstanding. But in the end, it was the service that won us over: from the warm greeting of Francois, the Manager to the very helpful and enthusiastic front office staff, everything was first class. And of particular note was the Concierge, Aaron, an enthusiastic and extremely professional young man who seemed to have the intuitive ability to be at our service whenever we needed anything and to work above and beyond what one would normally expect to ensure we were well taken care of. Overall, this is a great hotel with a great staff.

author: Lucky_man2
title: Really let down by indifferent service
text: The whole place is unremarkable except for service. Spoke to Food and Bev manager. Asked why so much food was premade and sitting out getting cold. He told me because they had 150 guests. I asked if he expected them to all come at once. He just said they were Chinese. Maybe he thinks Chinese people enjoy cold and stale food. He checked the grilled tomatoes which were cold and just left it that way. Otherwise the hotel was neither good nor bad. Good coffee in room.

author: 111GeorgeB
title: Spacious room close to the lake
text: I think the room was upgraded because I stayed on the 5th floor. Big room, big bed, big desk, comfortable bathroom. I have never seen such a well equipped room even in better quality West European hotels. It was really very relaxing after the busy days. Ruler, scissors, pen, calculator etc. in the drawer of the desk. The West Lake is on the other side of the road. Wide selection for breakfast on the 6th floor. Also some foods that are more familiar to the European stomach :-) Very polite staff.

author: Seshamani
title: A good business hotel
text: A clean hotel with all amenities. Has a nice lobby lounge which is good for short business meetings. Rooms are roomy, clean and well maintained. Wifi is good and fast. But you need to watch out if you are vegetarian and eating in the restaurant off the lobby. You need to order with clarity. Service is excellent and the server is concerned about doing a good job. All in all a good experience. I would go nthere again, if in the area.

author: james75657
title: Total Disregard of Complaints
text: Since 1999 when my wife and I retired and started traveling, I have chosen Accor Hotels over any other, when possible. After our stay at the Sofitel West Lake, not again! The lack of any A/C in our room caused us to roast like a turkey. Our complaints fell on deaf ears. When we were checking out, we were told that the hotel A/C had been turned off (season change) and we could have opened a window. Not at $300.00 a night, I will not. Since returning home I have e-mailed our complaints to Sofitel/Accor Hotels, home office, four times and North American Reservations three (3) times. seven complaints, no response. If anyone at Sofitel/Accor cares, I still have all documentation and can tell you of approximately 150-200 nights in Accor hotels from Paris to Argentina - Romania to China.

author: OneMagicBox
title: Sofitel's Staff Makes Stay a Delight
text: Rented two rooms at the Sofitel. We heard the daily construction of renovation which the hotel needs to keep up its Sofitel reputation as a luxury hotel - currently the rooms show a lot of wear and tear. The top floor (5th) serves a delightful breakfast, lunch & cocktail hour - not only is the food delicious but the presentation is splendid. There is a lovely patio on the 5th floor with a view of West Lake. Everyone that works there seems to go the extra mile to be helpful and this easily made up for the worn condition of the rooms and lack of Wi-Fi. If staff did not understand us, they found a staff member who could help. After checking out, we realized that we had left passports and a substantial amount of money in the room safe. Returning to the hotel we found that the housekeeper had turned everything in and the rest of the staff were concerned that we were returned everything (down to noting all the bills numbers). The location is superior - within walking distance of the lake and shopping on Hefang Street.

author: RupertH473
title: 4star not 5 star
text: Almost all of the sofitels I gave stayed in in china have been worthy of the term 'luxury hotel', but the hangzhou Sofitel is an exception. If it had been classified as a four-star hotel and priced accordingly, I wouldn't have minded but as it was it was disappointing. The foyer was small, the rooms were old, noisy, tired. The pool was minuscule and so full of chlorine it gave our child red eyes for the next six hours. The restaurant on the sixth floor was crowded and too many tables for the small space. And to top it all, it was very expensive, in the same rice range as the Four seasons on the weekend we were there. An embarassment to the Sofitel brand in china. I suggest giving the hotel a complete makeover or ditching it completely.

author: guillaume22
title: Can be a Second Home in Hangzhou
text: I followed the recommendation of Eyewitness guides to book this hotel, which may be for me the only affordable 5 dollar sign recommendation by Eyewitness guides in all of their series. The service and the room were sharp and French thoughtful. All staff are friendly and helpful. But there are only few rooms have a Westlake view. Most of the rooms either face a traffic heavy boulevard, or have views towards local residents' kitchens (no, no shower room view). The hotel should be good for people needing a solid night life activity, as I heard the hotel may be the five star (World standard) hotel that is closest to the bar district in Hangzhou. You may need to taxi to some high end shopping area if you want shopping, since walking other than along the lake side may diminish your happy experience in Hangzhou. I did not designate an excellent rating was because of the hotel's French restaurant. Their patisserie has much rooms to improve. The Hangzhou cuisine restaurant, however, is superb; with a higher price tag you can eat safely, and save the taxi fare to the famous restaurants in Hangzhou.

author: 413MatthewC
title: Very nice location and excellent staff
text: The hotel's located on a nice scenic area of Westlake, with lots of bars, coffee shops and restaurants nearby. And Ferrari, Aston Martin and Porsche dealers too if that's what you fancy. The train station is about a 20 minute walk and the recently refurbished "market" tourist (mainly Chinese) district is within walking distance too. I also walked round to the "dancing waters" area near some of the other western hotels. The main feature of this hotel though has to be the staff. They all seem proud to work there and offer a really special, friendly and courteous service. The fifth floor Club Lounge is very nice (glad to help with printing boarding cards etc) and the rooms are large and comfortable with a bit of Chinese character.Turn-down service has nice biscuits and the laundry service is quick and efficient, with shirts coming back in a nice wicker box. This is my second stay here and I find it very civilised and without any real faults.

author: StuttgartWilli
title: Waiting for New ownership?
text: It's definitely by fart no luxury hotel and doesnt fit into the Sofitel category. Wait for renovation before visiting. It has been mentioned for at least 3 years it ll be done, but nothing finally confirmed. Rooms facing Xi Hu road are very noisy late at night and early morning. Noise reducing windows need to be installed. Carpets in rooms need to be changed. Bathroom with starting to peeling off. Club lounge sometimes simply closed for unknown reason. Too Bad, its such a Good Location!

author: traveloftenf
title: Needs a good overhaul
text: This Hotel is in a good position close to Westlake and there is a bus stop right outside. The rooms could do with a good overhaul. The furniture is marked and the carpet is dirty. The room itself was nice and large with plenty of drawer space and all the usual amenities. The bathroom was also quite large and the housekeeping was good. Hard to get a taxi who wants to take you to the hotel from the station. Staff were very helpful and pleasant. Breakfast was good with plenty of variety but there were few staff to clear away or refresh tea and coffee - it was a case of finding it yourself. I felt it was quite expensive for the present state of the rooms, and I don't consider it to be 5 star.

author: chuugle
title: Nice hotel on the lake
text: The hotel was not able to offer us a king bed, so we ended up with 2 twin beds. But when they say twin, they really mean USA full size, so that was not a problem. Our room faced the noisy street and you could hear buses and honking so it's not for light sleepers. Luckily, I always travel with earplugs so I was still able to sleep in, but my husband ended up waking early every morning due to the traffic noise. The staff was always very friendly and helpful. The hotel is located just across the Xihu Lake so it was extremely convenient, but it's farther away from the more busy eating areas so I would recommend staying on the opposite side if you wanted to be closer to that stuff. But it's still only a 10-15 minute walk away. And I was very happy to discover that they offer free internet in your room, provided you bring your own laptop. I love when hotels offer free internet!

author: jmkcor
title: Great Hotel
text: Just got back from the beautiful city Hangzhou. Stayed at the Sofitel 5th floor club level. The hotel reminds me of a boutique hotel, the staff went out of their way to help out. There were several staff who spoke great english and that helped out tremendously. Even those who did not speak English tried their hardest to accomodate. I enjoyed the quiet mornings overlooking the lake having my coffee and breakfast on the club level lounge. The breakfast appealed to both english and asian palates. After leaving the Sofitel I spent the night at the Hyatt Grand in Shanghai, I can truly say I missed the Sofitel and all of its little touches.

author: OldChinaHand88
title: pampered in China
text: A long time Far east resident and a well travelled executive I have taken my family to Hangzhou in the Zhejiang Province of China,over the Chinese National Day Holiday last week. Centrally located this venue is a must stay if you travel to Hangzhou, 1 of the 2 paradises in China. The Hotel has staff with an unbelivable level of training and 'savoir-faire', they truly care for you, with a genuine smile but above all get things done for you the foreigner who may need assistance in this far away land. I found nothing but very friendly and efficient staff that greet you with a French touch, distinguishing morning afternoon and evening ( bonjour, bonsoir, bonne nuit ). The sunday buffet and breakfast buffet are world class. An then there was this pleasant feeling when you enter the premises, starting with the lobby as sonn as you come in, a kind of discreet and yet still perceptible smell that seem to give the hotel an olfactic signature. 'I have travlled the world extensively and China more than elsewhere and have to say that the Sofitel Westlake gets my two thumbs up with a particular note for the management whom I can only command for their hard work to put this place on the hospitality map of China and the world. There would be so much more to say, but the best is to just go there and let the Sofitel Westlake's Angel Brigade take care of you

author: kittiestone
title: Good location, nice & clean rooms
text: I stayed at this hotel last week as part of a tour package. I've never stayed at a Sofitel hotel before so I didn't know what to expect. The room was clean and good size. The bathroom was big, with a separate shower and tub behind the same glass door (which is kind of unique). Even thought this hotel didn't give me any special impression that sets it apart from other hotels I stayed during this trip, it was nice and adequate. The location is great. It's right by the West Lake and supposedly very close to a bunch of bars and clubs (which other folks from our group visited). Breakfast is on the top floor, and if weather permits, you get a great view.

author: meamea
title: Top Notch
text: We were very impressed with the Sofitel West Lake. The Hotel is clean and well appointed, and the staff is cordial and professional. They arranged tours and show tickets for us, all by email in advance. If you're lucky, Iris will be on duty as a greeter on check in. She's just returned from 2 years in San Diego perfecting her English and working in the hospitality industry, and it really showed. She made us feel very welcome, including organizing an impromptu birthday celebration for our son. The hotel is across the street from a delightfully walkable area of West Lake that includes a Starbucks and a Haagen Dazs ice cream parlor, as well as some attractive night spots. Hangzhou was hotter than a sauna and it was really nice to have the (well air conditioned) Sofitel as our base.

author: ShanghaiTrio
title: Nice Hotel near the Westlake with great service
text: We had a very nice stay in this hotel with friends. The hotel is very well located near the westlake (walking distance) with very comfortable rooms and outstanding service. Everybody was speaking good english and was very attentive to every request. Though we didn't have a nice view on the lake but on the road, the bedroom was nice and quiet. I really appreciated how fast members of the staff answered our request, like more shampoo, babycot, ice cream for the kids ... ( not the usual 1 hour in other hotel, same category). We particularly enjoyed the lounge club with the outside seating area. The breakfast was great, don't miss the croissants and pains au chocolat, much better than what we are used here in China. If I go back to Hangzhou , I'll be happy to stay in this hotel again. The hotel in itself is nice but has nothing exceptionnal but the service is definitly above the average !

author: limeh0g
title: Good service but poor breakfast
text: Stayed 2 nights in this hotel Dec 2005 Arrived the hotel around 2PM and our room was not available. We were offered free drinks at the lobby lounge. Howeveer, we were told that the room was ready before our coffee arrived. We took our time and finished our coffee before going up to our room. The room is very nice and has everything. Although the hotel is very close to West Lake and bar street, we did not venture out because we have been to Hangzhou many times and the weather in Dec is cold. Buffet breakfast at the coffee shop is poor. Limited variety and the taste also not good. Found out that the coffee shop is operated by a Taiwan chain shop. I will never spend RMB100 for this kind of breakfast (my breakfast was included in the package which costs US$260 per person including Dragon Air HK-Hangzhou-HK, 2 night stay in this hotel with breakfast, on twin share basis which is a very good deal) Staffs at the reception desk are very polite and helpful It is a good hotel overall

author: kimscs3
title: Very outdated
text: Stayed here with adult family and friends very outdated and shabby. Rooms were ok if you were on upper levels at the back of the hotel. Rooms were not cleaned on a daily basis and to get bed linen and towels changed we had to screw them up and leave in bathroom. Staff were not very helpful and food was a lot to be desired. Plenty for the German and other European guests but not much for UK visitors. When you could eat the food was luke warm even if you went in dining area as soon as it was open. We spent more time in another restaurant eating meals. Not good when you have paid for all inclusive. Would i visit here again short answer NO i would steer well clear of this hotel. As for holiday rep we never saw 1 once the whole 2 weeks we were there

author: Larcombe-82
title: This hotel was banging.
text: Really good. Had a really good time. Food really good. I'm going back there again. Nice hot weather. The beach was banging. The shopkeepers were awesome very helpful. The town was a really good & big.

author: 237dianem
title: Great hotel with fabulous staff
text: We stayed at the Golden Sands and had a really wonderful week. The staff were all amazing, the hotel was spotlessly clean, the pool was absolutely gorgeous and the food was pretty good too. With the situation of the hotel just outside Aghios Georgoius it gives you a nice walk into town if you want it. The beach is a stroll down the road, but with the pool and sun beds being so nice we didn’t feel the need to swim there. The Reps organise plenty of boat trips, so if you want a quiet or an active holiday this hotel is perfect for either. Corfu town is well worth a visit, with its cobbled streets, beautiful port and Castle all to be enjoyed with a pint (or two!) of draught Mythos and gorgeous food!! The sunsets to be seen from the hotel, looking over the sea are simply stunning and the Greek people are all so welcoming, we will definitely be back. Thank you to all the hard working staff at the Golden Sands for a really wonderful week!

author: maddoxmob
title: Excellent value for money
text: We stayed for a week. We were blessed with some wonderful weather for the whole week apart from a thunderstorm just as we landed at the airport which was short lived. The hotel is lovely. Yes a little dated but very clean and the staff are amazing. The food is good always fresh predominately Greek and very well cooked, yes there is not as much choice but it’s a small hotel and given how cheap it is I think they do really well although the availability of a coffee machine throughout the day would really improve this. Everywhere was clean and the towels and beds were changed frequently. Overall we have had a brilliant time away in a lovely place and we will definitely be returning. We had a lovely room with both sea and mountain views and were privileged to watch some really stunning sunsets from our balcony

author: hollyd101
title: Best time away!!!!!
text: Beautiful relaxing holiday! Came last week for a break and could not of been more pleased especially for what we paid. Location is amazing, and traditional with lots to do locally. The food was tasty and the room and hotel was exceptionally clean. Staff are willing to go the extra mile...... booking next holiday now! Quad hire next door excellent so you can explore the island, boat trip centre 5 minutes walk. Just great!

author: Dianeyorkshir
title: Great hotel and staff SHAME ABOUT FOOD
text: Just arrived home from a week here. Staff great friendly and welcoming. Cleaners every day. Clean bedding and towels. Pool and gardens well looked after . Bar staff work really hard. BUT FOOD TERRIBLE. me and my husband thought the bad reviews were exesive. BUT we could not eat much just ate eggs for breakfast salad for being meal ( when we stayed in that is) shame the food let it down .

author: jimkY8312WB
title: Everything I expected.
text: We're at the Golden Sands now on our penultimate night and i thought I'd leave a review to counter all the bad ones. As someone else said if you want UK 5 star you'll have to pay a lot more than the Golden Sands charges. What you will get is excellent customer service throughout including the pool bar, incredible cleanliness uninspiring but tasty food (including a limited but pefectly ok vegetarian menu) and local beer and spirits along with a few cocktails. All in all we've had a good holiday in a pleasant hotel with attentive staff. There are sandy beaches within a few minutes walk with free sunbeds if you buy a drink from bar. There are also plenty of bars and restaurants nearby if you want to venture out of the hotel. Would we come back? Absolutely we would.

author: mrmike196600
title: Relaxed
text: Spent a week at this hotel and got exactly what i expected from a 2-3 star all inclusive greek hotel. The food was on a par with other hotels ive stayed in perfectly adequate , the rooms were old fashioned but bedding was changed every day as were the towels , had a mini fridge but no kettle. The pool area isnt the biggest and sunbeds a bit sparce .The bar people need a rocket up there bums but all other employees were really nice and helpful. Out of the hotel , turn right and walk for 10mins or so you reach bars and restaurants of which the ones on the beach side offer free beds and umbrellas free if you use there amenities , go further and you reach the big beach with paid for beds etc and water sports. To summaries....the hotel is ok as long as you dont want luxury and a'la carte dining. The resort is lovely and quiet is thats what your after ( i was ). Over all... a great holiday had by all 7 of us. ( all adults )

author: katieeb1997
title: Very dated
text: Hotel is very dated, rooms were very basic. Had ants on the bedroom floor on arrival. On arrival there was no wall bracket to attach the shower too, went and told Reception and the member of staff (George) was very friendly and said it would be fixed tomorrow, no plugs are given so you cant have a bath so don't see the point in having a bath if you can't have one... Shower is very small and floods the bathroom as the glass shower door is the other end of the bath. Pool is decent sized but not enough sunbeds around the pool. Cocktails are horrible from the hotel bar but there is a lovely bar about a 10 minute walk from the hotel called amazona (Tony's doughnuts). Food is shocking,its greesy, veg is undercooked and still hard, chicken is pink and rubbery and its very much the same food all week. Beds are very uncomfortable and creek everytime you move. Bedding wasn't changed everyday.

author: sophiemA3919PZ
title: Can't wait to come back
text: Can't wait to be back! Me and my husband spend 10 days in Golden Sands. The hotel is excellent. Very clean and tidy. The staff is fantastic. There are all really so helpful and friendly! Good food quality and variety. Free drinks from 10:00 to 22:00 and snacks during the day to the pool bar.... Value for money!!

author: rowe2176
title: Delightfully friendly
text: I have been drawn back to the Golden Sands hotel many times & have always had a very enjoyable stay. St George is a particularly relaxed resort in a relatively unspoilt location with a rustic charm all of its own. It makes an excellent base for exploring the island of Corfu. The Golden Sands hotel is kept immaculately clean & the staff are second to none being very helpful & always welcoming to all. The grounds & pool area are attractive with a relaxing vibe, drinks flowing all day. You need not go anywhere else as there’s always plenty of food as well. Where ever I travel on the island coming back to the Golden sands always feels like a home away from home. I cannot wait for my next visit !! Thanks again to all. Linda & Martin

author: 985helen
title: A lovely time spent here 12th May.....26th May
text: We arrived at a silly hour of the morning, greeted by George, who was efficient and processed our booking in quickly. We had a sea view room booked but when I looked at the shower over the bath I knew I couldn't manage. So at 0700hrs went to reception explained the problem we had a room to look at with walk in shower, so within 5hrs we were settled. Sophia on reception was really helpful, then we didn't have the air con at the right temperature up came Sophia, showed us the way to operate the remote.
