If the service at the rooftop bar improves and if the lighting issue will be fixed I would give this beautiful Hotel 5 points.

author: TurkishGrey
title: Nice, shiny hotel. Shame about lifts.
text: New hotel all lovely and shiny. Given a corner room with a great view of the LA area which alone is worth the price of a stay, particularly for the night time vista. Plenty of facilities and amenities. Wifi was noticeably very fast. Good climate control in the room via a bedside gadget. Lots of attentive staff and security around. The lift situation and having to change via the lobby on the 70th floor gets very frustrating. Whilst it might be a great marketing gimmick to check in at this altitude (and I've even heard this feature mentioned on a LA tour) it gets annoying after one or two times when you can't descend from your floor to get out of the building without going up to the 70th each time and changing to a new bank of lifts just to come down. A few fellow guests I spoke to in my many lift encounters also expressed this.

author: 747francisl
title: AMAZING
text: Had dinner there last night and thought I left my glasses. Called this morning and told the operator who didn't just connect me to the restaurant but offered additional assistance saying that he'll connect me to security dept if needed, after my conversation with the restaurant. Spoke with the restaurant rep who told me they didn't have an glasses but told me that the night manager is in a meeting and will get back with me. Less then 2 minutes later, Gardino from security called me and asked for the descriptions of my 'lost' glasses and where and said he'll look into. Surprisingly, another 2-3 minutes later, he called back and told me they haven't found any glasses but will continue to and get back with me once they do.....This is VERY IMPRESSIVE customer services and follow up. I'm IMPRESSED. As it turned out, I found my so 'lost' glasses. Called back to Gardino and closed the search. Well done Gardino and Intercon LA!!

author: spunge411
title: LA's highest Rooftop
text: LA's tallest building, the Wiltshire Grand(the Intercontinental) with its fab rooftop. Now you can do some serious rooftop hopping in downtown. In the afternoon sun though, there is not a lot of shade up there, so be prepared sweat a little bit. There are not many options for vegetarians either. Views are magnificent!! The rooms were your basic business hotel. they we're going thru growing pain at the time, like no hotel info in the room, no priceless for the snacks and drinks in the room, no menu for room service,...etc. Hopefully its much better now. Obviously I enjoyed being out of the room than in. Parking is valet only, for $50.

author: 646johannak
title: Interesting
text: An Interesting hotel with the check in lobby on 70th floor where you have an amazing view! The elevator was a mess though--very confusing to use and inefficient. Almost every guest in my group suffered figuring out the elevator system. The room was clean and again amazing view of LA. But my luggage which I dropped off earlier didn't make to my room. I had to call and request again. The hotel had a Good energy Because the guests naturally was drawn to the 70th floor lobby to hang out due to the view. I encourage trying the hotel for an experience. The buffet on 69th floor was excellent.

author: GaroVM
title: Dekkadance
text: From the moment we, my niece and I, approached the host, dinning at Dekkadance was going to be a memorable experience. The offerings were off-the-chart selections which was worth a 2-hour dinner, but we had plans for a later event in Hollywood. The service we received from William was clearly genuine coupled with the brief tour of the my favorite part of dinner... Desserts! Seriously, too many options. Let me not forget to mention Martin, who extended extra details in explaining the very special way of how all the different offerings were prepared. Our server, James, was helpful with the selection of wine and more flavorful treats. We're definitely going back very soon...

author: krawimi
title: Spectacular - made it worth staying downtown
text: The brand new Intercontinental downtown is both gorgeous and functional. The room lighting, bathroom, space, storage, safe, amenities, and comfort were all excellent. The service was excellent, so much so that I remember the person who checked me in (Jean Baptiste) as tremendously helpful and professional. Best of all is the lobby. The 70th floor lobby is a work of art. The location is not my absolute favorite in LA; I picked the hotel because this trip it made sense for a meeting. But I am glad I did, because there is more and more coming to downtown. I liked the hotel and service enough that I would strongly consider staying there again even if I didn't have a downtown meeting.

author: 484dagfinnb
title: Top of LA
text: The hotel is brand new. The building is the tallest building west of the Mississippi river. Roof-top bar offers a fantastic view of the city. Rooms are spacious, stylish and very comfortable. Very clean. The hotel is a gem for those who love modern design. The entrance on the Ground floor is decorated with an impressive artwork consisting of 90 000 individual sculptures - must not be missed. Lobby is on the 70th floor. Service is impeccable. Pool-area is on a terrace on the 7th floor.

author: YoYoBumchuck
title: InterStellar!
text: This brand new property in downtown Los Angeles is an architectural gem, which has top shelf customer service, a beautiful pool area, and the spectacular Spire 73. Spire 73 is the bar/observation deck on the roof and it's small plates and big views are not to be missed. It's rapidly becoming a hotspot in LA. The rooms are beautifully decorated and very comfortable, but remember in getting to them it's up to the skylobby on the 70th floor and then down to the rooms between floors 31-68. The hotels skylobby is a sight to behold and the pool area on the 7th floor, is top shelf. The hotel is located directly across the street from the LA Metro train station, which can take you to Hollywood or Santa Monica in no time. I highly recommend this hotel to create your own LA Story. Enjoy it.

author: sm379
title: Not ready for primetime
text: Beautiful hotel - great public spaces, lovely rooms and the views are phenomenal. Everything else is subpar. The service in both the rooftop bar and the lobby bar is terrible--they seem to have lots of time to mill around but will leave you waiting for a drink for 30 minutes. I am a vegetarian and went to all four on-site restaurants and couldn't find anything to eat. No room service menu in the room and front desk could not provide one. The elevators are incredibly hard to navigate. You can't go directly from the floor your room is on to the ground level--you have to ride up to the 70th floor and switch elevators. There is no signage on the ground floor on how to get to the lobby and many people are walking around lost. The staff also seemed generally confused and unhelpful. This is a nice place to visit for a drink if you can suffer the crowds, but there are far better places to stay in DTLA.

author: TiffanyR-NYC
title: Phenomenal!!!
text: Where do I start???!!!... This resort is one in a million! Pictures and reviews do not do this establishment justice. Private secluded villas, private pool, 24hr breakfast with 24hr room service, 2x a day room cleanings, daily restocked mini fridge with soda water and beer, airport transportation, and local transportation. The attention to detail is top notch and the staff is so kind and amazing. I have never felt so welcomed and treated with such sincerity. Our next trip to Bali, we won't even take a second thought as to where we will stay. Kayumanis will be our ONLY pick! Thank you for a wonderful vacation with a lifetime of memories!

author: kema
title: Absolutely the BEST accommodation in Nusa Dua !!
text: We have just spent 11 nights at the wonderful Kayumanis Nusa Dua Private Villa & Spa and without a doubt this would have to be the BEST accommodation in Nusa Dua. This was our 17th trip to beautiful Bali and we have stayed in many different places but can say Kayumanis Nusa Dua is by far our most favourite place to stay. Our Villa was so beautiful, the cleanliness, the attention to detail everything was just perfect. The location is amazing, it is blissfully peaceful, a short walk to the beautiful beach, the local village and Bali Collection ( shopping and restaurants) . Our breakfast was delivered to our room each morning as was high tea in the afternoon and room service is 24hrs a day ..Wow !! the food is delightful you will not be disappointed. We were also very fortunate to be able to enjoy the Spa facilities at this beautiful place and it's certainly 5 star ..We had the best Hot Stone Massage ..EVER !! A special thank you to Ayu, Beny and ALL the wonderful staff at Kayumanis for making our holiday so very special ..You hospitality is amazing and we miss you all so much. We can't wait to come back again !! If you are looking for a peaceful, relaxing holiday look no further than this place ..These people really know the true meaning of 5 star hospitality :)

author: manwaaaa
title: Excellent Villa
text: The staff are very nice and helpful. The Villa located near the beach, only 10 mins to the beach. You can select sunrise breakfast near the beach. The room services are excellent. Multiple selection you can choose for the breakfast and tea set. They also enjoy the SPA with reasonable price with good quality. You will enjoy own swimming pool in your villa, and you can even jump to the pool directly from your bedroom! Very nice staffs and they help me a lot.

author: Lindaandrussell
title: Perfect private getaway
text: We had a fabulous stay in one of the private villas over the christmas period. The villas are very tastefully furnished with large private pools. Every single member of staff were welcoming and friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Breakfast can be taken at any time in your villa or at the restaurant. We always chose to eat in the restaurant and a team of staff would immediately go into our villa to clean up the room and pool as well as replenish our fruit, nuts,biscuits, water and mini bar so we were never disturbed. The food is exceptional and the afternoon tea was an added bonus. It was a lovely quiet environment with total privacy, however, the beach is nearby with lots of other hotels so if you wanted things a bit more lively you don't have to go far. Just 10 minutes walk away there are other shops and local restaurants too.If you didn't want to walk anywhere the hotel provides a free air conditioned car and driver that will drop you off in the local area as well as providing pick ups and drop offs at the airport. All in all we had an exceptional stay here and I would love to go back again. Thank you to all of the staff for making our stay so wonderful, your attention to detail is very much appreciated!

author: deemzett
title: If Bali is the islands of gods Kayumanis Nusa Dua is paradise
text: At first there are not many hotels that have such a warm hearted, friendly and caring staff. Most of them know you by name. The villas are real private and luxurious. Spent half a day in the spa got an excellent treatment and felt reborn afterwards. The restaurant comes with a broad variety of international tasty dishes. Try the mockktails. My favorite Mango whip in the afternoon! The beach is a five minutes walk away and well maintained. If you want to explore the island ask Eka, Bagus or Made the always have a safe bet and are glad to help. Hope to be back next year.

author: cliffandjo
title: Another great holiday visit
text: Just on our way to the airport with Bagus after yet another great holiday at Kayumanis in Villa Secang. The beach bar is fabulous as usually with a great mixologist in Dauh. The F&B continues to impress with the kitchen team led by Astawa and Ketut as the F&B Manager. Great leadership from Astika ensures every stay is more than you expect. Thanks for my birthday party on the beach that was very special. Thanks for taking care of Ibu Jo with her broken elbow. The staff are amazing all round, Julie 1 and 2, Little Susie, Bayu, Eka, Yudi and Yuda, the irrepressible Tri, Lestari the egg Queen and everyone else. Already looking forward to next year. Cheers from Cliff and Jo x

author: markspong
title: Heavenly holiday
text: What can we say about our stay at Kayumanis other than it was delightful. The staff really really could not do enough for us, nothing was too much trouble. The villa was superb with every home comfort, couldn’t fault it, so clean. Our own pool was great and had plenty of sunshine during the day. The food was delicious whether you decided to dine at your villa or the restaurants. There are free bikes you can ride around on and free transport to and from the airport, they will also will take you to other places during the day or evening. The beach is close and easily accessible, night dining on the beach is so romantic. We stayed for 7 nights and were thoroughly spoilt, we would highly recommend Kayumanis. Thank you to all your staff 🙏

author: travelguruNOT
title: Great get away in bali
text: We went to Nusa Dua,Bali for a quick 3 day vacation. Stayed in kayumanis property and absolutely loved it. Great service, beautiful villa and delicious food. Hospitality was outstanding.we had an amazing time. Beach is walking distance from the property and there is a bar by the beach adjoining other resorts. So lot of options to chill by the beach, go for a swim or have a drink. Nusa dua beach is less crowded and more peaceful compared to other beaches.Also, lot of water sports activities like snorkelling,para sailing, jetski,etc happening by the beach. We were unable to snorkel due to weather conditions. :(

author: 114candicew
title: Just perfect! An AMAZING place to stay and we'll definitely be back
text: From the moment we were picked up from the airport until the sad time came and we arrived back at the airport to head home this place was AMAZING! The private villa was peaceful and relaxing, excellently maintained and presented and the staff were so attentive, friendly and helpful. Breakfast was included every day and if we chose, delivered straight to our villa. Twice a day our room was cleaned and tidied (morning and night). We spent most of the time relaxing by our private pool or down on the private beach. If we felt the need to leave then the staff supplied a driver to take us to the surrounding shops, markets etc. They also provide bikes which we used to ride along the beach. In summary we couldn't fault anything! Everything including the restaurants at Kayumanis was fabulous.

author: kristynovak
title: Delicious Italian food!!!
text: Wow, wow, wow. We went for dinner at the Italian restaurant Piasan at Kayumanis and could not believe how good the food was! I had better Italian at Piasan than anywhere in australia. It was so good we went another two times! I highly recommend the carbonara, the gnocchi, beef and any of the desserts. We had outstanding service from Tri who made us feel so welcome. She is a kind person with exceptional service. Thankyou so much.

author: CCWin
title: Not to be missed
text: We had 2 night stay at the one bedroom villa with private pool. It was sensational, super clean, massive private villa, amazing room service and 24 hour open restaurant. Staff were above and beyond. If you want to the city centre, free private car transfer from the hotel to the Nusa Dua city centre. The highlight is sunrise breakfast at the beach. Also love the High tea session. If I visit Nusa Dua again, I wouldn't stay anywhere else in Nusa Dua. The best hotel I've ever stayed in Bali.

author: _suparma1920
title: Excellent place for a romantic holiday
text: It was our second time in Kayumanis. It's a perfect place for a romantic and relaxing holiday. The staff are lovely, they give you special attention and go out of the way to help you. My husband gave me a surprise with a candlelight dinner at the villa. I was thrilled to see the decorations. The pool was covered with flowers and candles and the table was set by the pool. It was just perfect ambience for a most romantic dinner. We had a beautiful time.

author: parmap2014
title: Best breakfast
text: This morning we had the best breakfast one could ask for. And that's not just the food. The food was great and had all the extra touches we asked for. The service however was fantastic. We were hosted by Yuliati and Anita. It felt like visiting family and having breakfast at their home. This is what makes this place very special and unique from the rest. Thank you will never be enough to express our feelings

author: brinc2019
title: Honeymoon
text: Fantastic service and beautiful villas. The service could not be better. Excellent value and the staff go out of their way to help book excursions, cars for long trips, and anything else you might need. Adi also helped to find a phone which my wife managed to lose on the beach. A big thank you to Yuda, Benni, Adi and Devi especially. I recommend this place for honeymoons, privacy and couples etc. The beach is nice for Bali but not quite like the Cariabbean/Maldives etc. Also the constant wedding photography by the beach club can get pretty annoying and noisy.

author: MeganPokluda89
title: Pure Bliss
text: Kayumanis was absolutely breathtaking! Our villa was one of the most beautiful places we have ever stayed. The villa's rooms, outside shower and private pool created the most romantic and tranquil setting for a blissful getaway. The breakfasts were amazing and the staff was so kind and helpful! They have a private beach which was about a 7-10 minute stroll from our villa. If you think you're wanting to do some activities in other areas of the island, the staff can assist you in setting up a taxi for a great fare! We did a couple of day trips from our villa to Balangan Beach (that's a must), Kuta, and Jimbaran, and were quite happy that we chose Kayumanis at Nusa Dua! Thank you, Kayumanis for such a wonderful experience!

author: Dkitlu
title: W.L.K we love kayumanis
text: We stayed 4 days @ Kayumanis Nusa Dua and it has been love at first sight. We stayed at the Gaharu villa, and we liked the big pool, the spacious garden and the beautiful bedrooms decorated in Balinese modern style. The staff is simply wonderful. They are always there when you need them , but with discretion. The breakfast is served "a la carte" with big selection and nicely presented with a touch of French modern cuisine. They offer ( complimentary) a breakfast by the beach at sunrise and it was an unforgettable experience. We have done some excursions/ transfers with them and we found the prices very reasonable . We loved our stay and we will definitely come back if we will return to Bali.

author: williambH7521PC
title: Amazing place extremely private
text: This is the perfect hotel for complete privacy . Don't want to see anyone else go here . Rooms are lovely and amazing outdoor bathroom . Loved it . Staff is amazing . Ride bikes to beach which is about 500 yards away. We had drinks on the beach which was lovely . Not good shopping area

author: laurajI9883OV
title: Honeymoon visit I wish didn't have to end
text: We've just departed from our 3 night stay in Kayumanis... and we didn't want to leave! We could not find fault with the stunning villa (we stayed in Dadap!) we stayed in 3 hotels over 2 weeks and Kayumanis beat them all hands down. The villas are clean, the pool is huge, you're super close to the beach, the staff are beyond helpful, charming and lovely. Free airport transfer, a complimentary 30 minute massage for both of us, allowing us to check out a little later for a reasonable price, gorgeous food - the staff were so accommodating when we asked for veggie options! Free mini bar, plenty of bottled water, 24/7 room service, luxury outdoor bathroom - I could keep going. One thing that stood out was that there are only 20 villas at Kayumanis, which ultimately means you're given a very personal 1:1 service verses one of the giant 5 star resorts. Worth every penny, SO sad we ever had to leave! If you do visit, ensure deet spray is bathed in - mosquitos even with bug spray used me as a human all you can eat buffet (the villas even provide repellent! :))

author: mlv1962
title: Great Experience
text: Just got back from spending 3 nights at the hotel. Without going into details that are mentioned in many of the other reviews - this hotel is a wonderful place to spend a quiet, romantic, and luxurious vacation. If that is what you are looking for then you can't go wrong. Very peaceful, great attention to detail and a wonderful staff that can't do enough for you. Accommodations are very large, clean, and comfortable. My only qualification would be that if you are looking for a big beachside resort with a lot of activity going on by a main pool like the resorts that line up and down Nusa Dua beach, this would not be the place for you. My wife and I were typically one of two or three couples that were at the beach at any given time. No one seems to use the main pool, probably because everyone has their own pool in their villa. One other point that was not an issue with us is that the walk to the beach is around 6-8 minutes. I would definitely stay here again.

author: T5410DRrobertod
title: Amazing experience!
text: Simply said, this is the best place me and my girlfriend have ever stayed. Beautiful villa, impecable service, very friendly people. The food? Delicious just like the afternoon tea. Beautiful villa with private pool, first class amenities, super comfortable bed. Everybody is very friendly and always willing to help. We will be back for sure, we simply fell in love with the villas and all the people that works there. Amazing experience!!!

author: yiwenh2013
title: Absolutely love it
text: Amazing villa and pool. Spa is fantastic. Food in room service is also so good that I don't even want to go eat outside. Staff is very friendly and helpful. They have 24 hour room service. One thing I personally love is that their breakfast is from 7am - 11pm. Yes, 11pm. Perfect for lazy people want to sleep over.

author: katie_acker
title: Privacy and perfection
text: The Kayumanis did not disappoint in any way! From the room itself, which was stunning, to the service, we felt like royalty the entire 10 days we spent with our new friends in Nusa Dua. The entire property is very well maintained each day by a very hard working staff, who were more than happy to fulfill our every request. The property is in a nice location only a short walk or bike ride from the beach or shopping. The food at their restaurants was excellent, with a nice variety to choose from. They offer bicycles, and we went on several nice rides along the beach as far as Geger Beach, which is beautiful with a nice temple on the cliff. Nusa Dua was everything I had envisioned Bali to be... Beautiful and exotic!! However, food and shopping inside the secured area of Nusa Dua is twice the price as outside, and if you want quality and authenticity you'll want to book a tour to some of the local woodcarving and silver shops. We highly recommend The Kayumanis and we hope to return soon!!

author: kayemorgan
title: Our stay at Kayumanis Private Villa
text: I had a very positive, enjoyable stay at the Kayumanis Villas. The Villa was extraordinary, the areas from the TV Dining, bedroom outdoor shower and bath to the separate reading room which could be turned into another bedroom, with it's own amenities to the amazing pool. All this was solely for our private use. The bed room with it's own TV plus a mosquito net over the very comfortable bed was exceptional. The location was easy access via vehicle to all major entertainment locations throughout Bali. I have to say the staff were amazing, very caring and professional. If I had to say anything that was least liked about Kayumanis, for some it maybe because there is no gym, but there are plenty of walks to have and a great spa to utilise. For Bali it is very sad there is so much rubbish on Jimbaran Beach, this is very disappointing to see. Going back to the paradise of Kayumanis Villas made it all worth while.

author: KaraM967
title: Wonderful vacation!
text: My boyfriend and I visited for 3 days in December. This place is beyond wonderful! The service is amazing and the private villas are gorgeous!! The pool was beautiful and the bedroom was very relaxing and spacious. The outdoor bathroom was great, they clean the villa twice per day, so you don't need to worry about anything. We got a deal on the place and for Americans it is really worth every penny. We are dying to go back again! Kara

author: estebanl597
title: Beautiful Villas
text: We had the SUKUN Villa!!! It was excellent, you have to separate places inside the villa one is the main room and the other one is a living room, both with tv and free wifi, you also get bose sound in the living room, you also have complimentary water all day long, as well as couple of beers and cokes. The food was good nevertheless we think that they can improve in that department, we thought they use a lot of vegetal oil to cook and we don't like that very much! It is good to let you know that if you're looking for a resort this is not the place, if you're looking for a quote but excellent accommodations definitely we don't think we could find a best spot! The private beach is like 7 minutes walking, they can lend you a bike but we found that they were always in used by other people so we walked ! At the end we are really pleased with our stay in this hotel! Oh I almost forgot to tell you that they took us to the airport for free on our way back! Check in and check out was excellent on our check in we were offered cold towels and a signature Kayumanis drink!

author: sarojy
title: Amazing
text: I loved the stay at kayumanis. Loved the service. Friendly staff. Definitely would recommend to my friends. Had "beer beauty bliss spa" it was amazing. Food is very tasty. As we stayed for longer days they gave us complementary evening tea with snacks and it was very nice. Would definitely visit again..loved it..thank u kayumanis for making our stay special.

author: silviaz119
title: Honeymoon
text: We stayed at kayumanis nusa dua for our honeymoon. As frequent travelers we have stayed in quiet a few hotels, this one by far the best one. The facilities and amenities were beyond beautiful and clean. Our villa was comfortable and spacious. The private pool was one of our favorite benefits of this hotel. But what really made a difference in our stay was the outstanding customer service from the whole staff. The ladies at the front desk were polite and sweet, went above and beyond to fulfill all of our requests. The shuttle drivers (Arya and Beny) were so kind and friendly, always willing to help. It was thank to them our time in Bali went from amazing to unforgettable.

author: SophLeo2016
title: Perfect way to end an incredible honeymoon
text: We spent the last 3 nights of our 16 night honeymoon visiting nusa dua. We had decided to end with somewhere special and after reading the reviews of Kayumanis we decided to book a private villa there. It was the best decision we made and was way beyond our imagination of how incredible it was. We loved every minute of our stay. The staff were so accommodating to every tiny need and were always available to help. We loved the breakfasts and high teas everyday and the villa was beautiful. We ventured over to the beach as well where the service there was also impeccable and we enjoyed a few cocktails on the beach which were delicious. We both had a 30minute back and shoulder massage and agreed that it was the best massage we have ever had. Overall our stay at kayumanis could not have been more perfect and we would recommend the place to anyone wanting to relax and indulge in the beauty of kayumanis nusa dua. Many thanks to all the staff there- Sophie and Leo

author: Fussey45
title: A different Bali to the one we knew.
text: Having travelled extensively in Bali, Nusa Dua was a very different experience. Golden sandy beaches awash with giant hotel complexes. Now I am not saying they were ugly or overbearing, just that we like our privacy and dare I say, solitude, something I would not feel these type of establishments could give us. This is why the Kayumanis suited us so well. The staff were, as all the people of Bali appear, super friendly and efficient. Very polite and curtious, nothing was ever too much trouble. The accomadation is spacious and having stayed in a few villa complexes, it was a nice touch to have a separate living area, something I did not think I would use, but finished up utilising on a daily basis. Although we ate out most nights, room service both day and night was of a high standard. The bedroom area was air conditioned, which if you have never been to Bali before, is a must.

author: brandonbG4378WT
title: An amazing trip at an outstanding resort
text: From the minute you get to the resort until the minute you leave, the staff do an amazing job of making you feel welcome, as well as going above and beyond to meet and exceed your expectations. There were never any issues and all I can say is that the resort makes you feel like royalty. It will make it extremely hard to vacation at any other location after spending a week in this amazing resort. The private pools for each villa were amazing, the romantic dinner was incredible, the beach is a short 7 minute walk from your room. The staff drove us to local places and did an incredible job making us feel like home. I just wish the flight wasn't so long from the U.S. We will definitely visit again in the future. I would also like to mention how friendly the staff were and how helpful they were no matter day or night.

author: kimwit11
title: MUST stay!
text: My husband and I stayed here on the last leg of our honeymoon adventure and are we glad we did! What a beautiful sanctuary. From the moment we arrived the staff was more than happy to accommodate. The room service was impeccable and the Villas are INCREDIBLE! I would go back to Bali just to stay here. It was truly a memorable experience and the perfect place to relax by your private pool. I will recommend this place to everyone! I'm sad we aren't there right now!

author: Bennyliv
title: Short review
text: I stayed with my wife in Kayumanis for 2 nights on last week. A great applaud for the service of this place. Everyone we met is friendly and they are just happy to serve. During our stay we feel that the service is up to very small details when they prepare for the night spraying for the room. The complimentary transport around Nusa dua and Jimbaran is very convenient and useful for us! The only improvement I can think of is the freshness and taste of the breakfast. Breakfast did not really appeal to us.. but it can be due to our personal stay. Other that that everything is just enjoyable and makes me miss my holiday already.

author: natasham966
title: Perfect start to our honeymoon
text: We spent the first four nights of our honeymoon at Kayumanis and were blown away. We enjoyed the privacy of having our own villa, private pool and lounge area. The rooms were very comfortable, with a table and chairs for dining and a sofa for relaxing. It's only a 10 minute walk along a stone walkway to the beach. Along the beach there there is a long paved walkway the crosses through many nearby resorts. We loved being close to more food and drink options while still being able to retreat to our villa where we had everything we could need. The decor and service at Kayumanis was very classy and we felt as though we got a great value for the price. We had no trouble getting picked up at the airport and 4 nights was the perfect length of stay for us.

author: josephineh737
title: Great place for honeymoon
text: It was definitely an unforgettable honeymoon for us. The villas are close to the beach, and it can't be better that you can choose to enjoy your breakfast just by the sea. All the staffs there are polite and helpful. The room service food is great, too. Not to mention the villa itself, it's clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Although the buildings are not so new, they are still maintained well. The private pools are big and deep enough for adults. Highly recommend!

author: JFT_57
title: A private gem amongst the giant hotels of Nusa Dua
text: This small, intimate resort was a delightful find amongst the giant and impersonal looking resorts of Nusa Dua. A blend of stunning contemporary and traditional architecture set in beautiful, lush contemporary grounds, this resort offers a relaxing and peaceful retreat in an otherwise very touristy area. There is easy pedestrian access to a sectioned off area of the beach which is for the exclusive use of Kayumanis residents, with it's own beach bar which also offers light meals. The villas are well appointed and very comfortable and private, with decent size pools. The staff at Kayumanis were all very friendly, polite and attentive, and made our stay very enjoyable. Complementary massages and afternoon high teas (served in the restaurant or your villa) were a lovely "extra". The building housing the 2 restaurants was stunning, offering outdoor as well as indoor dining with an Italian and Indonesian menu. The service and ambience could not be faulted, however we were generally a little disappointed with the food, which did not seem to be up to the standard of what we have experienced on several previous trips to the Seminyak area. This comment applies generally to our food experiences in Nusa Dua, not just the Kayumanis restaurants. For those who prefer a more intimate, personal and private style of accommodation to large resort hotels, Kayumanis is the perfect destination!

author: zippingeverywhere
title: Luxurious, quiet, private
text: Tucked away in a small corner, Kayumanis is very quiet. If you don't really want the beach (because you have to walk there and the beach is not great for swimming) and don't have kids with you, then this is the place for you. Service and food is great. Everything is cinnamon here - because Kayumanis means cinnamon - so your shampoos, conditioners etc carries the spice. The villas are well maintained and come with your own private pool. The spa staff were good as well. We only had problems with mosquitoes - although mosquito netting, repellants and coils are provided we had one or two that was in the room. As the shower is outside the villa, be sure to close the bathroom door when you are outside. We also had geckos in the room - one was big - and we stepped on its droppings. Not the hotel's fault because these creatures are part of the environment but my suggestion is that you keep the netting around the bed closed at all times.

author: TomiCiglenecki
title: Amazing place to stay for those who want to relax in peace and privacy
text: Kayumanis has amazing staff, always helpful and with smiles on their faces. Kayumanis has two restaurants: Italian and Local one, both offer outstanding food. Kayumanis offer complimentary tea, which can be served in a privacy of the villa or in the restaurant. The beach is only 5 minutes walk from the villa, there is also a nice bar. the beach itself is a good for snorkelling, with shallow water and a coral reef which bursts with life. Kayumanis is near the shopping centre with a wide variety of shops, restaurants and bars. We went to whole day trip to the volcano and driver took us to places of outstanding beauty. I hope we will be able to to visit Bali and stay at Kayumanis in the near future again.

author: ninee2014
title: Excellant villa experience
text: We have stayed for three night at the Kayumanis Nusa Dua Private Villas in mid June this year for holiday. On the arrival at the villa, it looks very peaceful atmosphere and the staff is so friendly and courtesy for welcoming us. Shortly afterwards, the staff brought us to the designated villa which we requested before, he was very thorough to introduced every part of the villa and we are very pleased for his attitude. After that, he reminds us there was a daily free high tea with one time free 30 minutes massage and transport service from villa to airport. It almost excellent service provided even the villa fee was included. The villa was very private which I have unexpected. All the staff servicing their efficient attitude around the villas and the beach are so well. We would definitely come again and highly recommended this villas to our friends or couples for relaxing and experience. So good ^_^ ^_^

author: bikingrenee
title: Amazing second visit!
text: Kayumanis is absolutely the best value for money in Nusa Dua. I have spent many, many hours searching TripAdvisor and other travel websites for the best hotels whenever we travel, and Kayumanis cannot be beat in Nusa Dua (and indeed their other locations in Bali). We stayed at this property in 2012 for another friend's wedding in the area and we did not hesitate to book it again in 2016 for another wedding of good friends. The staff at Kayumanis did not disappoint. They were incredibly friendly and helpful and went out of their way to assist us, like always. There are not many villa style accommodations in the Nusa Dua area, and Kayumanis is worth every penny, especially when you factor in all of the "extras" that you receive: -airport return transfer -use of bicycles -a la carte breakfast (which is excellent and you an basically order how much you want and have it in the villa or the restaurant) -unlimited mini bar drinks (including Bintang) -unlimited waters and snacks in the room (locally made cookies and nuts and fresh fruit) -afternoon tea (which is almost a meal in itself) -shuttle around the Nusa Dua area When you combine all of these things, Kayumanis cannot be beat. Sure, it is not right on the beach (10 minute walk down a shaded path) but you will likely not want to leave the villa much anyway. We also arrived quite late on our first night in town and ordered from the room service menu, which was excellent and ended up being the best meal we had in Bali! We have also stayed at their property in Ubud and highly recommend it. We have stayed at other places in Bali over the years and we will continue to stick to Kayumanis!

author: Lailacs
title: Good
text: Good things about the hotel: Staff is really really great!!! the service is pretty good, the villa is big and clean and you get some nice things like afternoon coffee and free massage. Bad things: we've stayed for 2 days and on both of them we had to leave the beach or move to other place beacuse they were preparing some private party. That was really bad! We couldn't enjoy it! #2: The price is too high! It's a great hotel, but not luxurious. The villa is nice, clean and big but there are many hotels much more luxurious than this. It's not worthy the price! #3: it's not beachfront #4: wifi doesn't work properly

author: NYCDCB
title: Beautiful Villas
text: The villa was beautiful and the private pool was great. Breakfast and high tea were included which was a big bonus. The staff were very polite and respected the privacy of the guests. I wasn't sure what to make of the outdoor shower, but it was actually quite nice. I took a private tour arranged by the hotel which included a 2 hour spa treatment. The driver and tour guide did a great job of customizing the tour to the things I wanted to see and was knowledgeable and provided the right level of interaction and information during the tour. I had spa services two times during my stay and both times were fantastic. Highly recommend staying here - you won't be disappointed!

author: alid430
title: Simply wonderful
text: We began our honeymoon in Bali at the Kayumanis private villas in Nusa Dua, and it was an unforgettable stay! The beautiful villa was amazing, together with the great pool, the services and the privacy, it was just perfect! The staff was so helpful and very friendly day and night! Truly lovely people. We used the complimentary bicycles to go to the beach, which was fun! (2min on bikes or so, otherwise 7min walk which is also fine) Also such great food available! We had breakfast and afternoon tea every day inside our villa, lunch and also dinner a couple of times at the restaurants (they have 2, both great!), all was delicious! Also they have a cookie jar which keeps getting filled in our living room, which were the best cookies ever! :) We couldn't have had a better start of our honeymoon! Thank you so much!

author: IamPatPat
title: Summer Ecstasy
text: What a gem! I'm surprised that I did not discover this place earlier. The compound is tranquil and heavenly. The villa is magnificent- befitting for royalties 😄 Every morning, we were awaken by the chirping of birds and squirrels climbing around the walls of our compound. Bliss ! We were overwhelmed by the warm services of the staff. They go all way out to make your stay comfortable. Call in the wee hours of the night for ice cubes was no trouble and breakfast served in the room anytime of the day! As I write this, I'm feeling sad that my holiday here is ending soon😢. Can't wait to be back.

author: johannab35
title: Highs and deep lows
text: Difficult to write a review with highs and deep lows. The hotel and surroundings are absolutely stunning! The zenish garden immaculate! Lows - they forgot us at the airport. When we arrived no one was there to pick us up, despite confirmation that they would. When calling the hotel no one picked up or picked up and said they couldn't talk to us as they didn't speak English. At the 10th attempt 40 min later my husband came through to be told to take a cab, the hotel paid us for it.Anyway not a god start and welcome. - due to our caotich arrival a lot of essential info regarding the hotel was lost. We didn't have a introduction to the hotel and missed essential info as that the restaurant would be closed for New Year (Balian) - it felt like management was very weak Highs - garden and room- fantastic - spa - friendly staff - nicely made birthday cake Highs

author: Roving601758
title: Honeymoon
text: Kayumanis was a perfect honeymoon stay for us. The staff was really helpful and warm. The welcome was grand. Our private butler guided us to our villa. The villa looks even more beautiful than the pictures on the website. The entire staff addresses you by your name and that adds to the personal attention given to the guests. I would love to visit this place once again on my next visit to Bali. I strongly recommend this property. Dr. Mohammedali Kotal and Sana Kotal

author: TravelTrepid
title: Unique, Superb, Wonderful
text: This unique 'village' is just so wonderfully r-e-l-a-x-I-n-g, a truly delightful development of private villas, all with pools and beautiful tropical gardens. And the resort management and staff - well 10/10 +++, just so friendly, helpful, eager to please. Marvellous Spa and facilities. The in-villa dining, poolside BarBQs even! is an excellent option and probably explains what the resort's waterside restaurant is so little used? The resorts beach is quite a walk away, quite small - but as very much an adults only resort, who needs it? You have pool, completely private villas, state-od-the-art, in-villa dining. Excellent food and service All in all a truly Unique resort that we can heartily recommend

author: pohan16
title: A Heavenly experience
text: We stayed at the Waru Villa. The room was spacious with nicely covered bed and traditional feel. The outdoor bathroom was well maintained, we absolutely loved the shower as it felt like we were one with the nature. The living room was separate from the bedroom and it was nicely decorated. The best part was that we had a private pool. The area was clean and well maintained. The staff was very friendly and they made us feel very welcome. A highly recommended place for a romantic stay! Thank you Kayumanis for our memorable escapade.

author: SwedeMedford
title: Perfection!
text: We were given the Kayumanis Suite which included its own private pool and jacuzzi and king sized round bed! It was stunning, secluded and pristine. Everything you could possibly need was a phone call and smile away. The staff were professional and genuinely wanted ensure our happiness, which they did! We had breakfasts and dinners served in the privacy of our villa and everything was served beautifully, hot and delicious. I truly couldn't have been more content. We each had a lovely upper body message in our villa and I had a private yoga session in the villa which was divine. This was to me the ultimate eat, pray and love experience! Thank you Kayumanis!

author: zimscotoz
title: Tranquility
text: Nusa Dua can be a bit sterile with 'me-too' resorts shoulder-to-shoulder along the beachfront but at Kayumanis there's a different feel. The villas are very private, well equipped and charmingly decorated. The staff are gracious, not intrusive but there promptly if one needs them. The only part of the experience that jarred was the airport pick-up. After ten minutes of looking for my sign, I went over to the information desk to ask them to call Kayumanis. Just as they were doing so I spotted the driver/butler sitting on a bench chatting to a pal at least 25m from the pick-up area. Not exactly customer focussed. So a poor start but overall the experience was great. Recommended.

author: vhjesse
title: Excellent stay
text: Verry, verry good and friendly people of Kayumanis, who will do everything to make it a wonderfull stay. The private villa gives you a relaxed feeling with all the privacy. You can have breakfast/lunch/diner in the beautiful restaurant of at your own place! The spa is also a nice thing to have a massage or beaty treatment. We've done everything with our motorbike but the bikes and transport through the area are a nice opportunity too. The villa got cleaned daily, so every day and night gives you a luxury and fresh feeling. Showering and having a bath outside is wonderful. I would recommend everyone to go t Kayumanis for a few days (we've been there two whole weeks and it was not too long to stay there this long)

author: Akanksha89
title: Luxury at its best!
text: My husband and I spent five nights at the Kayumanis, Nusa Dua and I can tell you that this place is worth every bit of the money you pay. The staff is exceptionally polite, immensely helpful and the villas are nothing short of stunning. The villas are huge, very tastefully done up and the pool is lovely. The breakfast not only comes with a large number of options but each dish we tried was gorgeous (Special mention: The Kayumanis Toast). Don't forget to book their Sunrise breakfast, the moment you check in. While the private beach is nothing great, you hardly seem to miss it, since the villa in itself is beautiful. Besides, the resort offers free shuttle services in all of Nusa Dua and Jimbaran areas. What works for this place is the personal attention provided to each guest. Be it the delightful cookies in every shuttle, the complimentary stocking of the mini bar everyday or the way you're greeted each time you return, Kayumanis is PERFECT. If you're a couple in need of peace and luxury this is the place!

author: 2fionam
title: Kayumanis Nusa Dua Elegant and Private
text: We have stayed in the sister Kayumanis Hotels but this was our first trip to Nusa Dua and it did not disappoint. Considerate but attentive service wonderful restaurant and great beach access as well as our private residence with pool. We enjoyed the traditional Kayumanis Cookies which are a charming addition as is the daily tea which you can order in your villa and a delicious choice of tea and cakes is served. These are complimentary touches which make you feel special and cared for. All the staff are very charming and polite we had a fantastic visit. We were with our 17 year old daughter so the additional option to take bikes to the beach was a winner as well. One of our dinner options was a private BBQ in our villa which was a great evening with an abundance of amazing food and was one of the highlights of our visit. We will return again to Nusa Dua we had a wonderful stay.

author: 75christophr
title: ...just awesome...
text: A really great resort. We've felt like in paradise. Best hotel experience ever. The villa was so excellent. The staff was so friendly and amazing. The restautants were great.. finest cuisine. Thank you .. Tarima Kasih

author: cfhudson
title: Honeymoon
text: Best hotel experience ever!! The staff and amenities are amazing. We are well traveled New Yorkers and couldn't have been happier having our honeymoon here. Don't do Seminyak and stay away from Kuta....this is the real deal. Private, romantic, truly relaxing. And the suites are like none other - private pools leading directly from your bedroom. Delicious food. Beach access. Enough said!

author: MC3T3
title: Perfect end to our honeymoon!
text: We stayed in Kayumanis Nusa Dua for 5 nights as the last leg of our honeymoon. Our villa (Secang) was amazing with a very big and warm pool with good exposure to sunlight. We had the sunrise breakfast on the private beach which was such a nice experience (despite having to wake up very early). Breakfast (à la carte) which could be served in the villa or taken at the restaurant was great with a very diverse choice (loved the eggs benedict!). The Italian restaurant from the hotel is very nice as well, with a very decent price/quality ratio for a resort restaurant. The staff is so kind and efficient, butler service is great, loved the turn down service especially. The private beach of the hotel is smaller than the ones of the resorts around but it is what makes it so much nicer, quiet, and intimate. The complimentary massage on arrival, the free minibar and the free shuttle within Nusa Dua and Jimbaran area were all perks that made our stay so enjoyable from start to end.

author: 119danir
title: Phenomenal! Perfect start to honeymoon.
text: After traveling 33 hours from NYC this was the most incredibly quiet and peaceful sanctuary. This was just the most fantastic hotel I have ever stayed at in my life. You truly feel like a queen and king. The food was great, staff is so friendly and the most exquisite part is the private villa. With three separate areas - bedroom, living room and outdoor bathroom, there is so much privacy and you feel so special. It was the most amazing and relaxing start to our honeymoon. Free shuttle service in the area, daily breakfast at any time, free bike rental and a nice beautiful walk to the beach. Amazing complementary hour massage, gorgeous sunrise breakfast. I absolutely loved it here!

author: Cindyrph
title: Honeymoon
text: The stay in kayumanis was very good. They have shuttle service to bali collection which was very convenient. The spa was excellent. Don't forget to sign up for sunrise breakfast . The view was exceptional. Also, the afternoon tea was very delicious. Even though there was an small accident with the AC. They made up for it. Our overall experience with kayumanis was excellent and we will definitely recommend this place for honeymoon.

author: 911breem
title: WOW
text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for 5 nights and the second we were showed our villa we were in shock of how beautiful it was. Staff were FANTASTIC, always going to extra mile to accommodate and were so friendly. We were spoilt the whole time we were there! Limo service to surrounding areas is great, you also can get breakfast delivered to your villa and you get a complimentary afternoon tea. We stayed in the villa PINIS, where we got visits from bali squirrels every morning! Only downside was the distance from the beach, but that didn't matter since we had such a big private pool to ourselves! Kayu Manis Also offer a breakfast on the beach watching the sunrise, which was a really beautiful experience. We hope to be back very soon, loved every second of our stay here and left kicking and screaming!! Thanks so Much!

author: Jess_zsj
title: Fabulous place to enjoy your vacation!!!
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at this Villa! It was totally worth the money you paid. The services were great, the food was truly exceptional (we dined at the Italian restaurant and the staff had also provided great service). The villa was totally amazing - bedroom and bathroom are located in one building and the living room and kitchen in another, both are facing the pool. The complimentary afternoon tea was great with many balinese and western pastries. And the breakfast by the beach can be booked. The beach is in walking distance of around 10 minutes but free bike is provided for you to get around the beach and villa. They also provide free shuttle bus to Ayana and Jimbaran beach and also from those places back to the villa. The only bad thing is that we only get to stay at this villa for a night which is definitely not enough! We will surely stay at this villa when we have a chance to go to Nusa Dua again!

author: 325deborahp
title: Amazing!!!
text: My partner and I stayed here and were beyond impressed! Our villa was amazing from the bathroom, bedroom to our private pool. I'm really big on peace and quiet which is what we got the entire stay. We did a sunrise breakfast on the beach, as well as dinner on the beach which was quite an experience. The staff were extremely helpful and respected our privacy without even having to ask. The walk to their private beach was about 7-10 minutes but worth it. The entire walkway is closed off to only guests of the hotel and when you get to the beach there's a section only for Kayumanis. The beach is very clean and has staff available to help you get settled. They also have two different places to eat in the hotel which is great to have. Great food.

author: whatagreatlife
title: Top Knotch!!
text: Exceptional in every way! This was the perfect start to our family trip to SE Asia!! Amazing villa, outstanding staff that couldn't do enough for us! They planned surfing lessons, organized picnic lunch, loved the use of drivers, use of the bicycles and the villas were over the top wonderful!! We definitely made the best choice booking this resort in this area!! Wish we had had more time since there is so much to do, but will most definitely be back!! I am missing those addictive cookies already!! :)

author: StephSand08
title: Best Holiday ever :)
text: Our wonderful experience at Kayumanis started by a warm welcome at the airport by our butler. She even had cold towels and refreshments for us. At the hotel, we were escorted to our villa "Santan" which exceeded our expectations: the king size bed overseeing the pool, the sound of water flowing, the trees providing shade for a stretch by the pool and the air-conditioned rooms. The staff at Kayumanis are polite, kind, helpful and always smiling. The candlelight dinner was the highlight of our holiday. Special thanks to all the butlers, waiters (specially Nala) and Staff. The only downside was the sunrise fishing trip which was an unpleasant experience. The fisherman (not Kayumanis staff) was really rude and had no patience. He expected us to know what we were doing when it was our first time fishing. It was the best holiday we had so far and we would love to go back....

author: deanw890
title: Doesn't get any better!!
text: From the moment we checked in, we just knew we were going to have a fantastic time here. All of the staff we dealt with were all very polite, helpful and always wanting to please. The rooms are incredible and the idea of having a door to your own private compund that can be locked makes it that much better. Breakfast can be ordered to your room anytime of the day and it was absolutely delicious. The free shuttle service is also a nice touch. I was also amazed at the housekeeping as we had our towels changed twice a day and had a turndown service in the evening. The bikes available are also very nice and in excellent shape. I would highly recommend Kayumanis to anyone. If you come here, you will not be disappointed!!

author: 613jamiex
title: Treat yourself
text: It was our 5th visit to Bali & while we have always stayed in Nusa Dua, we had never stayed in Private Villa style accommodation. We thought we would give it a try & it was spectacular. We found the service impeccable, without being overpowering which can often be the case. Every time we left the Villa, we returned to find that our room had been tidied, & the amenities etc replenished. We loved the fact that everything was catered for. If you wanted to pop down to the shopping areas they always had a clean cool chauffer on hand. They even supplied cold water & cookies for the drive. Push bikes were provided & the food was excellent as was the coffee. They even allowed us a late checkout & provided a room & shower for us to freshen up before returning us to the airport as part of the service. We couldn't recommend Kayumanis highly enough & look forward to returning on our next visit to Bali.

author: ChrisRooboy1964
title: A LITTLE PIECE OF HEAVEN
text: This is a beautiful restful place to just relax and let the hustle & bustle of life go by. The staff were so helpful and polite and always tried their best to please. The Villa was beautiful and very clean and well appointed. The only thing i would add was another fridge in the lounge/dinning area so you didn't need to go into bedroom wet from pool. The breakfast was perfect and served whenever you felt like it. In room or restaurant. The high tea daily also was perfect and kept you going until dinner. The drivers were also excellent and always at hand. It was my wife's birthday during our stay and the staff made a cake and bought it to our villa singing and playing the drum. Absolutely wonderful.

author: 343shaunc
title: A perfect place
text: There are so many good reviews here, I don't think I can add anything more. We had a great stay here and are thankful to the team for a memorable time. The service is really warm and professional. The food at the restaurant and room service is amazing, much higher quality than seen in other Bali resorts we visited. The rooms are beautiful, the private pool was a decent size. We enjoyed the complimentary sunrise breakfast on the beach, and daily high tea. Nusa Dua is a quiet area, and that's good, but it was still easy to get around to other places with the complimentary drop off service or taxis. Highly recommended. Hope to return one day.

author: tak90
title: Absolute luxury
text: This property is luxurious and private!!! The staff is incredible, the service is fantastic. Each villa has a different design. Accent on private, accent on luxury. Amazing experience and everything is done seemlessly and without effort. Whatever you wish is granted. Just unbelievable and so many freebies are included. Never saw another client in 3 days. Staffs recommendations are right on target. Everyone here wants to please.

author: 329jaydeepk
title: Luxurious and excellent!
text: My wife and I stayed at Kaumanis in Dec 14. We had an awesome and extremely memorable time thanks to the wonderful service provided by the staff at Kayumanis. The villas are huge and luxurious. The staff was extremely friendly and their service was royal.I will recommend the Bali island discovery tour. I think it was not mentioned in the brochure, but they stop at coffee and tea tasting place which we absolutely loved. A 2 hr spa is included with the tour which was extremely relaxing. They also offer a half day tour to Uluwaki and Jimbaran. The staff had cold water, cookies, and even beer for our trips which was really nice. They have bicycles to go to the beach (about a 15 minute walk). I will definitely recommend Kaumanis!

author: Taposhri
title: Fabulous place!
text: Our stay at Kayumanis Nusa Dua made our holiday very special. The staff was extremely kind and gracious. They were always ready to help. The food (Indonesian) was fab! I loved their afternoon tea. The spa treatments were gorgeous. They even provided free massages after we checked in, which was a lovely treat. We would love to go back.

author: 813nirmalac
title: Chirag kakkar
text: Its an amazing property.. pvt villa with the pvt pool was so exotic.. Loved the ambience of the villa.. clean nd superb rooms Excellent food.. pvt beach is amazing.. nd above all the shuttle service was outstanding.. Staff was so good.... Wud love to go there again..u

author: rohans924
title: Absolutely perfect
text: Rooms spotless, the welcome as warm as the air. They were extraordinarily accommodating by moving us to another villa when there was construction noise from the next hotel, and kindness itself when we couldn't check out due to sickness. The entire staff right down to the gardeners were friendly and accommodating. Being from NZ we don't normally tip, but we did here. Worth every cent it cost and more. We would never stay anywhere else if we went back to Bali, and will look at their other locations as well. A perfect couple's retreat. Can't really rave enough...

author: vbattaglia
title: Luxury and privacy in Nusa Dua!
text: Where to begin. I am not one to spend time in a hotel while traveling but Kayumanis makes it difficult to leave! Firstly, I would like to thank the staff for making our stay one of the most memorable. Our butler, Eka, was absolutely incredible and helped me plan a great surprise birthday dinner for my girlfriend on the beach. After a long trip we were excited to be surprised with the honeymoon suite, villa Kayumanis. What an amazing villa, from the pool and hot tub to the tasteful architecture of the glass floating bedroom, it was complete luxury! Very quiet area, all villas were occupied but you had no idea as most people enjoy the privacy within their villa. Staff here is so friendly and helpful, had no trouble booking dinner reservations or spa appointments within Nusa Dua area. I highly recommend staying here if you are looking for a peaceful retreat in the Nusa Dua area. Thank you again for making our trip forever memorable!

author: smurf-DAWG
title: Fabulous place but a little overpriced!
text: A luxury resort, beautiful from every angle. Private villa and pool had a beautiful outdoor bathroom. Nice stonework, nice trees and plants. Fantastic service. Everyone was so helpful, kind and cheerful. The food was delicious and seemed like it was very good quality. We also used the bikes provided by the hotel and only 5 min bike ride (Direct lane from our villa) straight to the private beach. Would love to go back. Only one negative thing, prices are extortionate. *Not sure how the economy works in Bali but I hope that the butlers and staff are paid well (consider the price guests have to pay and the great service ground staff provide).

author: Yoyokps76
title: Great time in Kayumanis Nusa Dua Bali
text: I have been stay before in Kayumanis Jimbaran and i have to stay that was so SUPER, everything went well and i am enjoy so much stay at that time, Now i have a chance to stay in other Kayumanis Nusa Dua Bali and again, another special experience stay i had. for the 1st moment pick up in the airport was on time, no need to wait and the butler show his best afford and all the way to property he´s so friendly (I was arrived very late at night at almost 1pm). Arrived in the property, i have private pool villa in the corner which i love since its far from noisy and nearby with access to the beach. The villa is huge, clean, and everything looks great to me and also i have private pool which i love the most.i even can swim at many time since the pool is so tempting:-) i wish i can spend more days there so i would be spend mostly just in the villa...... Breakfast was great and entitled for you at anytime - this also super, no limit time to take your breakfast so you can woke up late everyday... I also had experience to try free welcome massage at 30 minutes and again its so great, the therapist seem like well trained and really recommended for you to try. Another great offer is free unlimited minibars and also unlimited wi fi with many devices, so no need to worry if you may carry more than 5 gadgets hehehe... This is a fantastic Resort villa and will try to other Kayumanis property in Bali next time and i highly recommended this villas to be your top list villas to stay during your holiday in Bali...

author: 86janicem
title: The best holiday we have ever had
text: So where to begin .... Our friends recommended the Kayumanis Nusa Dua Hotel and for a long time have been asking us to go. so after a rough 2013 we decided this is the year so we went. From the time you are picked up at the airport by young Bayu for us to arriving at the amazing Kayumanis - its beautiful - actually yes it is - the villas are unbelievable - own pool your own living room surrounded by walls to give you privacy. The staff at the hotel make your stay - they love their country, they want you to love it and experience it to. I cannot put into words how amazing, lovely, serene, chillaxing a holiday it was all I can say is - YOU have to go to Kayumanis all the staff will be waiting to welcome you and Bali is a most beautiful country its scenery, beaches and the people if you only go once ... you will be hooked and will go again. We are. So what are you waiting for DO IT! You will have an amazing time.

author: RobertB256
title: One of the best
text: We stayed in the great resort for 8 days commencing on the 6th October. From the time we got off the plane and met by our driver (butler) to the finish of our trip it was superb. The staff at reception, dining, cleaning and the guys at the beach were all first class. The villas were very private and if you needed anything you just had to call "5" on the dial. From the included breakfast and afternoon tea to the small bar fridge which was restocked all day, the the drivers that would drive you around. We could not say enough about them. We had an island tour, a dinner on the beach and a private BBQ in the villa. All were faultless. Thanks to all the staff for making our stay a memorable one.

author: Maryline0709
title: Just amazing, pure bliss!!!
text: We stayed at Kayumanis Nusa Dua for 12 days last August and wish we could have stayed much longer.This is for sure the most enjoyable place I have ever stayed in. Relaxing, peaceful and 100% stress free. Just the perfect place for a romantic holiday.The villas are just amazing, the food served at the restaurants or in the villa is also just incredibly good and always beautifully presented. We did not want to eat anywhere else as it was so good and there was a great choice between Asian and Italian food. But most of all, the service, hospitality and friendliness of everyone working in Kayumanis is just what makes it even more special than all the other 5 star hotel in the area. Everyone calls you by your name (you actually wonder how they remember everyone's name) and everyone looks very happy to be working there. I usually do not like going back to the same place twice but I know for sure I will go back there again. Please do not change anything, it is just perfect the way it is. Big THANK YOU in particular to Yudi and all the staff from the restaurant and the beach. You made our holiday.

author: mlkcSanFrancisco
title: Perfect
text: The villa was so beautiful, private and peaceful. The staff were friendly and accommodating. We felt like we were so pampered and well taken care of during out stay. My daughter lost her new ring in the sand on the beach and the beach attendant went out of his way to find it, and he did! I can't say enough about the level of service. Afternoon tea everyday was a delight! Some people have commented about the 5 minute walk to the beach but it didn't bother us at all. In fact, I liked being somewhat away from it all. Walking back to our quiet private villa was bliss!

author: LohWY2014
title: No Complaints
text: We booked the owner's villa for 2 nights in August. This had 3 bedrooms that could accomodate 6 people very comfortably. The compound was huge, bedrooms were clean and the service impeccable. In particular, our butler Mr Bagus was incredibly helpful. We had no problems arranging our airport transfers and they even provided transport to another villa where we were attending a wedding. 5 minutes walk to the beach. Located within the Nusa Dua Bali Collection, there is a nearby shopping mall where you can buy souvenirs and dine at many restaurants. Overall a wonderful experience and would recommend to anyone planning to visit nusa dua, Bali.

author: travelkeener
title: Excellent service and very nice villa
text: The service is great and the team at Kayumanis has been very responsive to my email enquiries even before my visit. They offer pick up and also seeing off service free at the airport but you need to contact them in advance. The villa I stayed was spacious and nice. It offers a lot of privacy and the room was very cleaned. Breakfast was very good in terms of quality and choices and the good thing was they are being delivered to the villa. It is a very private property so don't expect a lot of facilities of F&B outlets in a big hotel. Good for honeymooners. I would have rated it 5 stars if the toilet is more enclosed with a window panel.

author: 707Lesley
title: Honeymoon was outstanding
text: Stayed here for our honeymoon for one week and were extremely happy with our choice. Nusa Dua was quiet but that suited us for our honeymoon. The staff and the level of service at Kayumanis were above anything we have encountered so far. Always happy to help and very professional from collecting and returning us to the airport to bringing breakfast and high tea to the villa, the staff made us feel very welcome. The villas were immaculate upon arrival and the room clean and turn down service were carried out everyday around our schedule. The butler dropped us off and collected us again from any of our evenings out to local restaurants/shops and reception were happy to call and book daytrips with other providers for us. The food was very good and staff were attentive to dietary requirements. We had the breakfast at sunrise option at the beach one morning which was a nice experience, if a little early. We will definitely be back again, not sure it is ideal for a family holiday but Kayumanis is definitely a great choice if you want luxury, service and privacy.

author: glorialwang
title: A beautiful hotel that well deserves the money you pay for
text: The wonderful experience started with the airport pickup. The driver has waited more than an hour when we got to the car. We were offer cold drinks, cool towels and cinnamon cookies on our way to the hotel. The driver is very polite and talkative, giving us a general introduction of Nusa Dua and Bali, which is quite helpful for people like us who travel to Bali for the first time. We book a two-bedroom pool villa. When the private butler showed us to the room, we are absolutely amazed by the size and layout of the room. The living room is on the second floor which was frequented by squirrel during our stay (and therefore adding a lot of fun to our stay). The service is great, everyone from the front desk to the butler, driver and staff in the restaurant are all friendly and super helpful. The walking distance from the hotel to its private beach is approximately 400 meters (7 minutes ).

author: heya_mark
title: Awesome villas with superb service - a wonderful place to relax!
text: A truly memorable 5D4N experience at Kayumanis Nusa Dua!! The spacious 300sqm villa with separate living room and private pool was great, food for breakfast was great and made even better by being served in our villa at any time of day with orders taken from a large menu the day before! Similarly for housekeeping services, conducted at our own convenient timing. A buggy was even ready at the beachfront to take us back to the villa for one lunchtime breakfast as time approached. Other little perks like free wifi, free daily-stocked minibar and complimentary transfer to/from airport as well as around Nusa Dua/Tanjung Benoa area enhanced our stay. A cake sent to the villa on my birthday capped it off. Best of all, the friendly and hospitable staff with very personalized service, including Bagus, Made, Ayu, Sisca, Dedy and the rest of the team made the stay an extremely enjoyable one!! As our butler said, just “dial the magic number 5” for anything you might want or need!! Thank you all, and we’d love to visit again.

author: hk59
title: Private and Cosy
text: If you are looking for some private time in a world having only you and your partner then this is the place for you. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. They take care of the smallest of nuances mentioned. One to watch for is the hide-away lunch... my husband and I have really enjoyed the quiet scenery up in the mountain hide-out. It was something really special. Just loved staying in here, can't wait to go back! http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=56Bhmg1w5Ns Video

author: Siearra
title: Excellent service and great place!!
text: My partner and I have had the most amazing experience whilst staying at Kayumanis Nusa Dua. Aside from the fact that we were pleasantly surprised to be upgraded to the suite during our 6 nights stay plus being able to have late check-out on the last day, the staffs have really gone out of their way to make us feel special. To deliver exceptional service in a 5 star hotel is exceedingly difficult due to the high standards HOWEVER, Kayumanis exceeded our expectation and have gone above and beyond to meet our every whims and needs.The staffs respected our privacy and would not come in to do their daily clean-up UNTIL we have gone out for breakfast. And we were both touched with the simple things they did such as providing us with freshly cut lime daily as we were both drinking gin and tonic during our stay there. One of the other many things they did was that the staff was more than happy to organize getting soy milk from the supplier as I have a preference of having soy milk with my morning coffee. We were always greeted with a smile and we didn't need to spend on taxi fares whilst we were there as the staffs were always happy to drop us off at the nusa dua main gate (and pick us up) - we absolutely LOVE the fact that we could have breakfast anytime of the day as there were days when we would have a lazy sleep in till noon. We were always made to feel that we should treat the suite as home and for that, we are truly grateful. We rearranged their furniture and brought in outside furniture into the suite to make up a large table so that we could play Axis and Allies and throughout the whole stay, the staffs were conscious in cleaning around the area and left the board alone. Overall, we were very sad by the time we had to leave but we are certain that this is definitely one of the places that we would be happy to come back to.

author: RN911_11
title: Excellent and private.
text: Having visited bali over a dozen times we have stayed in many different resorts and villas. We have definitely found one that we would return to. Firstly to get to the kayumanis from the airport is only 15 minutes with the new toll road ( you pay about 1 dollar extra!) definitely worth it. The villas themselves are quiet, private and there are no kids in the complex. Our villa was immaculately cleaned and serviced daily, and we had breakfast brought to the villa each day. The service was exceptional and nothing was too much for the staff. A definite highlight was the private pool in the villa which was perfect for lounging by and sipping a few bintangs. Another bonus was the free use of the cars with driver for trips in and around nusa dua, it meant we could pop to another resort for dinner and either call or schedule for a driver to collect us when we were done- very convenient and no haggling with taxi drivers! We would love to come back. Well done Kayumanis

author: sourabh_sjain
title: Great experience and great staff!
text: Kayumanis, Nusa Dua is a place to stay in Bali. Having its own beach and chain of other resorts on its belt, it makes a wonderful walk and cycle ride around its shores. Lush green surroundings and aromatic room fragrance will make your nights very relaxing. Staff is very courteous and polite. Good Indian restaurants are around the corner, local market just a walk away and icing on the cake, Resort provides free cab to move around the city of Nusa Dua and Jimbaran. You enjoy all the luxury in house and even the mini bar is free. Overall, you have the best hassle free experience and best relaxing time you could ever get. Thanks to all

author: Belgin120
title: Romantic
text: We went to Kayumanis for our honeymoon in october 2013. We didn't even leave our villa for the first few days (after touring around Ubud, we also just wanted to rest). It was lovely, hanging out in our private pool every day, putting on the music and eating they're wonderful wonderful cinnamon cookies (we even bought some cookies as we were going home, so it's no understatement when i say they're yummy). The staff is great and will do their very best to make you feel comfortable. I loved the fact that you can eat breakfast all day long (so you don't have to wake up early plus they bring it to your villa). The beach is honestly not that spectacular but who needs that when you've got such an awesome villa. We also want to thank Samuel for always stopping by and asking if we were comfortable and if not always finding a solution very quick. Much love, Belgin&Adem

author: utdk
title: Met expectations
text: I came to Kayumanis Nusa Dua with my wife for our honeymoon in Sept 2013 and it met my expectations. It was a very quiet villa (where kids aren't allowed). Our room had a huge detached living room, a pool right outside of our bedroom, king sized bed, comfortable bathroom with indoor & outdoor standing shower. We were first welcomed with a honeymoon cake which is tasty. Their afternoon tea isn't all that great. They give you cookies & peanuts in the living room to snack on which is decent - and we attracted lots of squirrels. The walk to the beach is 10 min (kind of far, but you can take their bike) and there isn't much to do there. Sunrise breakfast was romantic (food again is mediocre) just make sure you can wake up around 5:30AM for it. The candlelight dinner was expensive, food was mediocre, but the atmosphere was perfect and worth it all - poolside dinner, candle lit all around the suite, and pool covered with roses. The hotel provide shuttles to/from Jimbaran Bay for free (good seafood and beach!).

author: 198marianneh
title: Wonderful service and a calm haven
text: We stayed at the Kayumanis Nusa Dua for 4 mights and it was a truly wonderful experience. The genuine, relaxed friendly service from the staff was a red thread through our whole stay and you really felt that this was your (very swanky) home away from home and that you were among good friends. The calm privacy of the villa was so relaxing and one of the most relaxing days in our whole vacation in Bali was when we spent the day by the pool in the villa, just enjoying the great atmosphere and service. The spa experience is also recommended. A very friendly and calming 1 1/2 hours :) As long as you keep your mosquito-incense burning in the bathroom, this place is as perfect as a vacation home can be! One of us had our birthday during the stay and the staff surprised with singing, laughter and a wonderful cake. A special touch!
