A big than you to the Kayumanis Staff for making our stay a truly memorable and rejuvenating experience!

author: AceDx
title: Awesome service~~!!
text: I and my wife have lived in Kayumanis Nusa Dua.(one bed pool villa) We feel they are so kindly. Especially our housekeeper is very nice. delicious food,good people. And super nice private beach view. We got up super early to see sunrise. It's amazing experience for us. And their driver nice too. I'm very recommend this villa. Hope you can enjoy it,too.

author: Ujml
title: Nice place,great design,perfect for couple
text: The service,the pool and room are nice. Friendly staff. Wonderful experience. We enjoyed every moment there. Morning beach breakfast isn't tasty. Indoor breakfast is better. Free shuttle car in Jimbaran. Cleanly beach.

author: SteveAndIvana
title: amazing place, magnificent experiences
text: awesome place. had my wedding ceremony and dinner there. everything went perfect. the staffs did a great job. felt like a special guest there :). the view are amazing, the room is nice and comfort. the first thing came on my mind when i left is "must come back". totally worth it :)

author: tshirtgal
title: Best place to pamper yourself on a holiday!
text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Kayumanis Nusa Dua for five days during our trip to Bali in September 2013 and had a wonderful time there. The place is beautiful, the staff is well trained, friendly and very helpful. Upon our arrival, our personal butler took us on a quick tour and gave us a brief on the services available and the activities we can enjoy in the area. The villa has a private beach area where guests can request a sunrise breakfast by the beach, or a lunch picnic if you wish. The villa offers free drop off and pick up services to any place in Nusa Dua, Sanur and Jimbaran areas. If you like water sports, make sure you ask the hotel staff and they will refer someone to arrange them for you. We had a guy goes by No. 1 that helped us arranged jet ski and parachuting for a very reasonable price. Definitely a place I'll go back again.

author: FelixKaLeung
title: Excellent Honeymoon Trip + Lovely Arrangement
text: We are delighted to spend our honeymoon in this paradise for 5 days, with first 2 nights in Ubud then the last 2 in Nusa Dua. We have chosen the honeymoon package which includes the spa, a hideaway picnic and extravagant dinner along the beachside. Everything is just perfect and simply out of imagination! More important, all the staff are super nice and friendly, they welcome us in a way that make us feel like going back home. E.g. John (the guide in Ubud) drove us to see the rice terrace and volcano outlook while Sisca (the butler in Nusa Dua) arrange everything to us so nicely and proactively….. there are far more to list. Anyway, thanks for all the arrangements and we do have a very lovely stay!!! If you are looking for sth special on occasions, pick “Kayumanis” and we’re sure they won’t disappoint you as this is the gateway for the private celebration of life…. : ) thank you for everything!

author: Rik8
title: Best Bali experience yet
text: We loved everything about Kayumanis Nusa Dua! Location and service exceeded my expectations! Close to shops. Transport by car or bike was as easy walking up to see the friendly staff at reception. So relaxing. Food was amazing and the rooms were a getaway paradise. The tours were well worth it. Had the best time and would recommend to all our friends.

author: 801phillipb
title: Best place we've ever stayed!
text: Kayumanis in Nusa Dua was by far the nicest place my wife and I have ever stayed and we are fortunate to travel quite a bit! First and foremost the staff was an A++ They were always on top of everything from helping us schedule transportation to booking reservations at restaurants. The staff was genuinely friendly and from all the request we put in, they never said "no" to anything. The manager of the property, Sam, introduced us to our Villa upon arrival and went though everything with us in detail...and when we left, he drove us to a local Balinese restaurant before taking us to the airport. It was this kind of personal touch that made us feel welcome and at home. The Villa itself was amazing! From it's high Balinese ceilings to the private pool and outdoor shower, my wife and I felt like royalty...and not to mention the wonderful candle lit dinner we had on our last night...thank you Gede :) A big thank you to the front desk, restaurant and spa staff, you were all superb! We will 100% be back to visit Bali and when we do we will 100% be staying with Kayumanis :)

author: jas0z
title: Kayumanis, simply the best
text: It was very hard to leave this place. Kayumanis was simply the best accommodation we have had. Location, privacy, cleanliness, staff, everything was amazing! This property is an oasis of calm and gentle Balinese hospitality with personalized service. Not many dining options, but the concierge managed to give us good recommendation, such as one of our best dinner, the JuMaNa restaurant in Ungasan. The staff were lovely, always so polite, friendly and helpful, they have all been very well trained, after a couple of days they remembered and knew our preferences. The spa treatments were also very nice.The beach is accessible from a short walking distance. Just be aware that there are many mosquitoes after sunset, so bring your repellent and you will be fine. We will recommend Kayumanis to all our friends and will definitely come back.

author: Rik8
title: Best experience in Bali
text: We have just arrived back in Australia after our wonderful 10 day stay at Nusa Dua Kayumanis! We felt so relaxed and comfortable in the beautiful surroundings with their warm, friendly staff. The service we received was absolutely brilliant. We felt like valued guests at all times. From the front desk, to the room service, spa treatments, restaurants and transport the team at Kayumanis continued to impress. The landscaping and architecture were inspirational and instantly made us unwind in the serenity. The package tours we experienced with Kayumanis were excellent. Our guides from Kayumanis ensured our outings were enjoyable, memorable and made us feel very safe and happy. I strongly recommend these guys and will definitely return :)

author: Namredla
title: HEAVEN ON EARTH a luxury world class experience. Kayumanis Nusa Dua is DEVINE
text: Words dont describe this paradise. From the moment we arrived our expectation was continuously exceeded. The rooms and gardens thanks to bapak Samuel and his team are world class. The food superb. I was privelidged to have acclaimed sous chef Askawa cook a personalised birthday dinner including an 8 course feast of lobster, scallopes, salmon, giant prawns, snapper and tofu panacotta. Thank you bapak Made Karta for an experience that will never be forgotten. We will return soon. At kayumanis we are valued enjoying a perfect balance between luxury service and exclusive tranquility thankyou

author: natbarny
title: Perfection? Pretty damn close.
text: Kayumanis: our 4 day stay began with a wow, the hotel architecture & design is beautiful. The staff at Kayumanis Nusa Dua were perfection: friendly, courteous, helpfull and just damn good at what they did be it gardening, cleaning our superb 1 bed villa & pool or driving us from point A to point B etc. The kitchen staff should get a mention too- we ate in the Italian Restaurant one night & simply put I had one of the best Risottos' I've ever had...yummy. But a huge THANK YOU to Eka on the front desk. Quite simply Eka was magnificent: kind , thoughful, knowledgable and funny. My wife & I were bowled over by how good she was .....someone give her a payrise & promote her. The hotel & its villas are stylish and practical and ouze 5 star quality and have a charming laid back atmosphere. Our only negative comment is the beach but when your villa is that stunning why go to the beach! We left Kayumanis totally impressed and relaxed if a little cookied out !!!!!!

author: Oz_Traveller_1979
title: Great place, great service
text: We spent 4 nights here and it was brilliant. After a couple of minor issues on the first day we called reception and they sent over the General Manager, Karta, immediately. After explaining what had happened, Karta could not have been more impressive. He upgraded us from a standard villa (which was still amazing!) to the 'Honeymoon Villa' which was one of the most ridiculously luxurious places we have ever stayed (!!) and also arranged for a staff member (Samuel) to take us shopping so we could replace the item that suffered some minor damage. We weren't really expecting anything more than an apology, but what they did for us was fantastic and greatly appreciated. It was customer service at its finest. The staff all treated us like royalty (you get a butler 24/7!) and the breakfast each morning was really good and you can order as many dishes as you like. We would definitely stay here again and Karta and his staff should be commended for their exceptional customer service. Thank you!

author: MarshinniL
title: Our Wedding Anniversary staying in Paradise
text: This trip is to celebrate our wedding anniversary. Once arrived, we found the warmest welcome from butler (iced towels, iced water & comfortable car sitting, suitable A/C adjustment), those were impressed us very much. As arrived to our villa, butler is so patient to introduce all the facilities. Then we had told our planning scene to Butler. The most impressed that they always pick you back on time as schedule. Even dinning staff, receptionist, housekeeping, spa staff, butlers, etc. always entertain with a friendly smile & considerable. As this is our wedding anniversary, we were so surpirsed to have our anniversary cake after our dinner. As I like the Bali eating, I do hope I will go again very soon and sure we will stay in Kayumanis again.

author: yudithy_13
title: Great wedding celebration and great villa!
text: We had our wedding in kayumanis nusa dua and also stayed at the villa. overall, we are very pleased to have our wedding there. me and my husband are pleased with the service, food, staffs. they did extraordinary job! helpful too. The room we stayed also good. we love the villa so much. Its just the best decision to have our wedding there and all the guests were very pleased and happy .. and they like kayumanis as well..beautiful villas ! we will never regret for having the wedding here!

author: DonnaH797
title: 25th Wedding Anniversary Celebration - Wow!
text: Just returned from Bali, 4 nights at Kayumanis Nusa Dua and 3 nights at Kayumanis Ubud. I'm usually wary of superlatives on trip advisor but in this case the location, service, food and facilities are truly exceptional. The staff really made a fuss over us and as a result we left Bali with a lasting memory of the place and the people. We each had a 2 hour massage at both locations. Very accomplished massage therapists but with a few subtleties that added a Bali flavour to the experience. It was a short getaway but if you are looking for a great location to relax in complete privacy then this is for you. If you do want to be active, there is plenty to see and do and the chauffeur service makes it easy to get out and explore Bali at your own pace but we always enjoyed a warm welcome home from the staff whenever we retreated to our private villa. The daily high tea (either in room or in the restaurant) was also a lovely touch that added to the service and the sense of indulgent luxury. We are both very keen to return to Bali and stay again at a Kayumanis location. Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Kayumanis Nusa Dua and Kayumanis Ubud for a great 25th wedding anniversary celebration.

author: Hiroadrian
title: Best Villa Ever!
text: First of all, it's really nice that they have airport pickup service. We didnt know about it untill we arrived in the lobby, we didnt read any information about the pickup service when we booked the villa from agoda.com Secondly, we really appreciate the free drinks in the mini bar and unlimited drinking water (aqua). Usually in other villas, the drinks in the mini bar are not free, and if you ask for additional aqua water you will be charged to pay. Third, we love the smell of the whole villa complex, the cinnamon or "kayu manis" smell is everywhere and me and my wife really love it.. Last but not least, we loove the villa design.. we took some great pictures of the villa and uploaded some of them in the pictures area here in trip advisor for this villa. The natural design is really good, lots of plants. Too bad the bathtub doesnt have a jacuzzi..

author: Hyperknight
title: Amazing honeymoon location
text: We had a great experience at Kayumanis Nusa Dua. Our villa literally opened into our own private pool. The butler service is exceptional and the staff are very helpful and polite. The hotel has a walkway to the beach. There is a private area on the beach for Kayumanis guests. Unfortunately during our visit due to the high tide we cold not enjoy this area as much. However our stay was great overall and we hope to be back again! The restaurants have excellent food and the chefs make sure your dietary needs are taken care of.

author: Adam8160
title: Best in Bali.
text: It was best villa in Bali for me. I tried different hotel in different city, but it' s amazing place. The service the best, staff know your name, and it has free shuttle, free mini bar, free fruit plate. Our one bedroom villa is perfect. The private pool is big, and lovely and internet is fast. It has a private beach close the hotel ( 300 meters )It' s paradise. Unfortunatelly Nusa Dua not the best city in Bali. The hotel area is tourist place where you can meet only russian turist. Close the Bali Collection, where you can eat and shopping and every shop's staff can a few russian word, every time use thank you russian version. If you looking private villa in Bali, you should choice Kayumanis.

author: ultraluxe
title: Pure heaven!
text: My husband and I stayed at kayumanis nusa dua on the last leg of our Asia trip and without a doubt we truly saved the best for last! From check in to check out our stay was perfect. The hotel grounds are impeccable, beautiful, luxurious and suitably equipped. The resort is quiet and discrete, So much so that we ate in the restaurant once as we were the only people. Dinner in your private villa is very much the done thing here, and delightedly so as its a fabulous experience that gives new meaning to private dining. However, the food is reasonaly varied given the relative size of the hotel and absolutely delectable. The staff are friendly, polite, personable and absolutely wonderful, ready to cater to your every whim. The wonderful local terms of endearment they give you on arrival add that special touch that really makes the kayumanis stand out from the crowd of other 5* hotels. However the jewels in the hotels crown are the villas which are every bit as beautiful, luxurious and delightful as the reviews and pictures if not more! We wanted a quiet and relaxing break in decadent surroundings and the kayumanis did not dissapoint, we are already making plans for our return visit!

author: 731KristenB
title: A touch of paradise and serenity
text: We stayed in Villa Akasia and we had such an amazing time. The Villa and pool were larger than what we were expecting and it really felt like we were in our own tropical oasis. The staff were superb. They assisted you with everything you needed, cleaned the room beautifully each day and we were always greeted with a warm smile. They go above and beyong in service. We just loved the food. Being able to order breakfast and any time of the day off the ala carte menu is such is such a wonderful idea. We also really enjoyed the high tea each afternoon. The food was 5 star quality as well in taste and presentation. Thank you Karta and all of your staff for making our stay a most enjoyable and memorable experience.

author: VickiL307
title: Trip June 2012
text: This place was a slice of heaven. Nothing was too much trouble and all the staff were cheerful and willing to help with anything they could. Villas were very clean and well maintained. Most relaxed holiday we have had in our 8 holidays to Bali. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to relax out of the hustle of Kuta. Food was fantastic. We will be returning there again. You could have meals in your villa if you didnt want to venture out. they have free vehicle that will drive you round Nusa Dua pick you up or drop you off. Grounds were very clean as well.

author: dianaz489
title: UNIQUE!
text: I highly recommend you stay in Kayumanis Nusa Dua if you want to experience something really special. We travelled with our sons and spent three full days. We went to the beach (the service is excellent). Kayumanis also offers a free shuttle to a complex with shops, restaurants and shows. Also to a local market with crafts. It also offers free transfer to and from airport. But the best in Kayumanis is the service! THE BUTLER, assists you in everything you need. As soon as we arrived to the villas, Samuel, was there with a beautiful smile, ready to show you the place, offer us tours, take us on a tour

author: VinnyI_12
title: Utterly Amazing!!!
text: The pictures don't lie, this is truly a magical place where as soon as you open the doors to your private villa; the rest of the world just fades away. While our butler Sanjaya was giving us the tour of our private villa, we were already making plans to extend our stay! There is a perfect balance of luxury and relaxation with the whole energy of the villa truly capturing the meaning of an indulgent holiday. The meals and spa were with the best I have ever experienced but were outshone by the quality of service. With Sanjaya as our designated butler, he made us feel welcome, gave us a great overview of the facilities, booked all necessary spa treatments and meals and went out of his way to make recommendations while assuring they were executed. His approach to making our stay as memorable as possible was genuine and was more than enough for us to begin planning our next extended stay. The Asian and Italian cuisine was to die for, the cocktails were heavy handed and there is no shortage of different ways to enjoy them. Sunrise breakfast on the beach and a romantic dinner served at your villa with hundreds of candles and rose petals provided are just 2 of the many ways the cuisine can be enjoyed. The Spa treatments lived up to all expectations boasting a vast range of packages for couples. I strongly recommend Kayumanis Nusa Dua to anyone looking for a relaxing and truly indulgent experience while in Bali.

author: SandraT273
title: Very happy Bapak & Ibu T
text: We stayed 5 nights at Kayumanis,and found it breath taking.The staff are warm and friendly and only aim to please,the accomodation was fantastic as to was the food. If staff had missed something it was fixed within a few minutes. I commend each and every staff member on their good english skills and admire their professionalism at all times. The extra special touch such as the note on the turned down bed every night just added to the special time we had. We were able to have 100% privacy with a perfect balance of being provided with our every whim. Kayumanis is for couples who need one on one time in a beautiful location. The only negative was the low beam under the walkway to the resturants, which needs to be more visable for 6foot aussies! We would return in a heart beat.

author: GourgourGT
title: Beautiful hotel. Memorable experience.
text: The hotel premises are great and the design certainly noteworthy. Minimalistic and modern, while very conveniently located in Nusa Dua (with relatively easy access to the sights of South Bali). The service was excellent. We were upgraded to the honeymoon suite, which was trully outstanding: extremely spacious, huge round bed, beautiful bathrooom, pool, jacuzzi and outdoor kitchen. However, the beach was very average (nice to look at but not really for swimming). Our main issue was not with the hotel as such but rather with south Bali as an accomodation location. After visiting several places in Bali, we found that South Bali is overly touristic and the traffic horrific. With hindsight, we would have opted for east Bali for its tranquillity, wildness and stunning landscapes, albeit the more limited accomodation options.

author: Shantanu_dutt
title: A dream vacation at Kayumanis
text: we planned a trip to Kayumanis after enthusiastic recommendations and it surpassed our expectations!. the villa was luxurious and yet comfortable and I have yet to see a private pool so huge that two people could swim in it simultaneously! the food was delicious and we loved every bite.. from the multi course private dinner to the picnic lunch and breakfast on the beach.... a must have! The daily breakfast is delicious and one can order unlimited quantities from a wide selection. Must try the the indonesian breakfast specialities and the special cookies in the rooms. I have no compunctions recommending this place to anyone looking to unwind and relax being looked after the extremely solicitous staff who anticipate and fulfill your every need smiling all the while. I would highly recommend taking the airport assistance provided by Kayumanis that cuts through the long lines at arrival and departure.. worth every penny!

author: BeaHolanda
title: Superb...!!!
text: Our first four days (with their four awesome nights) in Bali could not have been more special, relaxed and luxurious even if we had tried hard to top them....the Kayumanis Private Villas is all they hint towards in their site and some more!. Ours was the Akashia villa...the private pool, the room, the open air shower, the separate living room....whoaho! Loved the combination of traditional balinense thatched roofs with colonial furniture while maintaining an overall minimalistic look over the resort. The service was fabulous. The restaurant simply superb (to the point that we had dinner there twice, while we usually prefer to explore the surroundings)...The beach is just a mere 10 min walk, but honestly, having that amazing villa to our disposal...we left the beach for what it was and enjoyed the privacy and quietness of our place. The cherry on the cake: their breakfast policy: anytime between 7:00 a.m.to 20:00 p.m. FANTASTIC !!!! All in all a fab place to stay, where you hardly come cross other guests, where service is understood in a superlative way and where everything in engineered to let you relax an enjoy every second of the day...!

author: CSarah
title: A truly Fantastic experience!
text: We stayed at Kayumanis Nusa Dua for four nights. It was the most wonderful place to say in Bali. We hired a car for two days and visited The south east coast, Ubud, Seminyak, kuta and other parts of Nusa Dua and Kayumanis was absolutely the best place to be on Bali. It was not just a good location and the villas were amazing but the staff there were so exceptional that you wished you lived there. It was a quiet and away from it all, which when you have your own lap pool and deck you really feel that relaxing could not get any better. The food at Kayumanis was amazing, i looked forward to breakfast every day. The lunch and dinner we ate there were also great indonesian dishes. If you are looking for a week or a few days to get away from it all then head to bali and they will pick you up from the airport then drive you to local beaches and restaurants throughout your stay. My partner and I had a fantastic time!

author: VegasToEssex
title: Great Stay Overall
text: I booked two rooms for my parents and me for two nights at the Lodge, and we had a really nice stay overall. We both received complimentary upgrades upon arrival to king and queen suites, which were greatly appreciated. Our rooms were incredibly spacious, although my mother and I really had to jump on to the tall beds. :) The hotel is within walking distance to all of the main sights in Williams, and the beds were very comfortable. A few small issues - the WiFi was very fussy. My laptop simply would not connect to the WiFi, which was a big issue as I had some work to do. Also, there are some very noisy trains that will wake you up at night (although I am sure all hotels on this side of the road face this issue). I am a sound sleeper, and I couldn’t believe the noise. Lastly, breakfast is too crowded - they serve breakfast for the Lodge and the hotel across the street, and there were not enough tables or room for everyone. If I needed to return to Williams again, I would definitely consider staying at the Lodge again (as long as I didn’t need WiFi).

author: 381marief
title: Great motel!
text: The Lodge was a welcome change from a few rough hotels on our Route 66 trip. Our room was spacious and completely updated as were all the room here. We had a room that was large enough to be an apartment with a full kitchen, separate bedroom, and a fireplace. Very clean and checked by owner before occupancy. It is right in the middle of everything in Williams, AZ, which happens to be a very lively town that doesn’t roll up the streets at 7. The rooms at the Lodge on Route 66 are more suite sized, but if you want something smaller, they also own and have completely renovated the motel across the street. Really liked staying here. Lots of restaurants and shops within easy walking distance.

author: 433soniac
title: Perfect Location!
text: We stayed 1 night at The Lodge after visiting the Grand Canyon and couldn't have asked for a better place. We received a complimentary upgrade to a fully self contained room ('Arcadia' Rm 13) which was fantastic with a full kitchen and sitting room. The room was clean and had everything we could need and was nicely decorated. Breakfast was available but as we had a kitchen we decided to stay in and make our own. The lady on the front desk was lovely and the location is amazing. Right in the main street so an easy stroll to everything Williams has to offer. We even sat on the front porch in the evening and watched the world go by. Highly recommend staying here if travelling Route 66 (they even provide clean rags for cleaning your car/bike should you feel the need!)

author: 1jamal
title: Cozy
text: My husband and I wanted to spend a day at the Grand Canyon so I started looking at hotels in the vicinity. I came across The Lodge on TripAdvisor looked at the reviews and thought we would give it a shot. The room was a little costly, but looked nice. My husband and I arrived late in the afternoon not knowing what to expect. We were pleasantly surprised when we saw the room. People had complained that the rooms were too small, but we felt it added to the cozy and homey feeling of the area. Everything was clean and the room was nicely decorated with all the amenities that we needed. The next morning when we went down to eat breakfast we were impressed by the wide variety they had and the friendliness of the girl at the desk. All and all we would definitely recommend this to anyone and look forward to coming back.

author: 698nital
title: Repeat Customers
text: Our second year here and we like it! Yes, maybe a little overpriced, but it is a tourist town and a Route 66 hotspot! Great location, you can walk up and down the busy streets. Close to railway too, if you are taking the Grand Canyon Rail trip. The rooms are clean, bed comfortable, shower nice. We have found the staff at the desk friendly and helpful. They supply clean rags and hoses for those interested in washing motorcycles!! Nice areas to sit outside. The free breakfast is the usual, but well stocked and good enough.

author: Angiedibz
title: Great Location
text: We stayed one night whilst visiting the Grand Canyon. About an hours drive from there. Williams was a great stop over. The Lodge staff were welcoming and helpful on arrival. The room was ok, although the hair dryer and air conditioning did not work. When we asked at reception, they were very helpful and gave us another room.l, which was actually a suite, so an upgrade. I would say everyone was very helpful, cost was reasonable, although the rooms looked a little dated, they were clean. Good value.

author: 124tracis
title: Nice place for the price
text: This was a nice place for the price. We went in off season so price was much lower than the busier seasons. The free breakfast had a decent selection. The only downside is it was served across the street (they are owned by the same people). The bed was my favorite part; very comfortable. The girl at the front desk on the first 2 days seemed quite annoyed with her job but the woman on the 3rd day was very helpful and friendly. She redeemed the staff part of the rating for me. We stayed in one of the king rooms, only for a couple of nights so didn’t have a lot of luggage, which was good because the room was very small. Only had room for one nightstand. Overall this was not a bad place to stay for under 50$ a night.

author: Hazman54
title: Awesome lodging in Williams AZ
text: When looking for a place to stay, The Lodge had some good reviews so I thought I would give it a chance rather than staying at one of the "company" owned hotels in Williams and we're so glad we did. Upon our arrival we were greeted with a warm welcome and given our room keys and told about breakfast. We parked right in front of our room which is always comforting rather than leaving your vehicle out in the middle of some parking lot next to the signs that say "not responsible for damage or theft". We were pleasantly surprised at the cleanliness and style of the room. It wasn't huge, but we had a couple of very nice queen size beds, large flat screen TV and room enough to move around in. Heater worked great as it got down to 14F one morning. We left our vehicle at the hotel and made the short walk over to the Grand Canyon R/R Station for our day trip to the South Rim. Overall, it was a great couple of days and glad we stayed at "The Lodge on Route 66". Next time we go to Williams we will stay there again and I will recommend it to my friends who may be in the area.

author: TheSatchers
title: True Wild West fun
text: Really clean. Good price. The decor was so cute. All southwestern old school. Cowboys and Indians. Decent continental breakfast. Within walking distance of everything in town. Hotel staff was awesome. They even let me print my boarding passes for the flight home.

author: FireTrier
title: Great small hotel in a great town!
text: This place was wonderful! We stayed in November in the king suite. From our arrival, we found everything about the Lodge to be fantastic. While the room wasn't ready when we first arrived (we were 6 hours before check-in), they directed us to some local restaurants and attractions while we waited. The room was clean and quiet. While a bit on the small side, the suite was well laid out and well appointed. Our favorite part was the breakfast in the morning. It wasn't a huge spread, but more than enough to start off the day. We will definitely be back!

author: 90gurib
title: Relaxing lodge in a charming town
text: Stayed here for three nights. We got upgraded when we checked in, no extra cost. The room was a suite with two queen size beds in the bedroom, and a sitting group an a kitchen in the other room. The room was clean, staff were polite and helpful. We parked right outside the door. Location in Williams were perfect, a charming Route 66 place. The breakfast was continental, the only healthy options were some fruit. Free parking and wifi, breakfast included in the price. Relaxing and quiet place in a good location in a charming small town in Arizona,

author: Skochrose
title: Vacation run on Route 66 in AZ
text: Right on Route 66. Close to the action and all the lights. Clean and comfortable! Love. Walk instead of ride the downtown area. Fun bars and good food await your visit. This was our favorite stop on our trip. Enjoy.

author: sbird1
title: Getting my kicks on Route 66
text: This hotel is amazing. Totally 5 star. Check was quick and easy. Stayed in room 16. The St. Louis room. Bed was great and so comfortable. Even though I only stayed one night I would strongly recommend staying here. Plus there are restaurants within walking distance. Thank you for a perfect stay.

author: X1921AYtracys
title: Great base for Grand Canyon visit
text: We stayed 2 nights as a couple with 2 teens as part of our visit to the Grand Canyon. Very friendly and helpful staff. We were upgraded to a larger room- which was much appreciated, as rooms are generally small. Really clean, cosy rooms and lovely beds. Breakfast included was great with having hungry teens, basic but anything with waffles is a hit for them! Staff helped us to book the Grand Canyon Railway tour. Nothing was a problem. Laundromat just over the road was really handy. Lots of great eating spots throughout town- all walking distance. I would recommend Pine Country Restaurant if you want a mind boggling selection massive desserts!

author: jimmiet2015
title: Perfect stay
text: I love the retro motels. This place is a must stop. I pulled right up to the door of our room. Cabana area out front was great. Fire place and heaters if needed. Love a place where I can have a cigar and a beer on property. Lady that checked us in (wish I remembered her name) was very efficient and helpful. This place is a welcome relief cookie cutter hotels. We will definitely return.

author: ScottyHNLGirl
title: Good value
text: Jamie Lea was very nice and upgraded us at no charge to a suite. I was visiting with my two boys and each of us were able to have our own bed. Our room was Newberry Springs. It had a refrigerator and microwave and coffee maker. Leather sofa bed and two comfortable chairs in the living room. Very very comfortable beds and pillows. Double sink. The breakfast included waffles, fruit, English muffins, cold cereals, coffee and OJ. Very nice location on route 66 and can walk to shops and restaurants. We spent two enjoyable nights there.

author: giavier
title: Cozy and beautiful place on the Route 66
text: Recently renowned this place has been my "home" for 2 nights. We got an upgrade in the suite which was a pleasant surprise. Clean, new and with that Arizona feeling and a nice little fire in the living room. Breakfast is included (nothing super fancy but good to start the day). Staff extremely polite and nice. I would definitely recommend to stop by. On the Route 66 you can find plenty of places to have dinner too and many souvenir shops just out of your door! One hour drive to the gran canyon village and nice landscapes to stare at while driving.

author: Sleevemark
title: Lovely authentic motel on Route 66
text: We have just spent a few days in Williams and used this as a base to visit the Grand Canyon. The Lodge is a wonderful traditional style motel which has been modernised in a pleasing and tasteful way. The decor is clean and fresh and the beds comfortable with soft linens and towels. The bathrooms were compact with tub and shower overhead. We also liked the separate area with the sink. We liked that our room had a coffee machine also. Complimentary continental breakfast was provided and we really enjoyed making waffles! We should also say that the staff were warm and friendly in their welcome. I cannot recommend The Lodge more!

author: patsJ1179SL
title: Cozy and Comfortable
text: This was our first visit to Williams, Arizona. I found The Lodge on line and it looked like a nice place. It was! The rooms have a cozy lodge decor. The bed was very comfortable. This was our best night's sleep during our trip from Colorado to Arizona. They also had a nice sitting area in the courtyard with 2 fireplaces. A great gathering spot. The Lodge is close to downtown Williams and was an easy walk. I would highly recommend this stop!

author: nicolatwig
title: Loved it
text: Heard one train but no big deal. . Room was perfect. Quiet and great bed. Would 100% stay again. Breakfast was OK but just get there early. Great location and really friendly staff. Price was good, less than $100 through booking.com

author: ClaudeH33127
title: Room fine but expensive.
text: Had booked a suite with a king size bed. The bed was good but incredibly high, you actually climb to go to bed ! The first room includes a sofa, TV (also a TV in the bedroom), a table with two chairs, a fridge and a small kitchen (sink, closets, counter etc...). Everything clean. The motel (the whole town) is VERY close to the railroad, hence the horns blowing at 4:30 a;m. Breakfast is taken in a tiny room. It's a continental self-serve buffet. We found a couple of muffins and some coffee.Trash cans overflowing with the remnants of previous customers and nobody around to clean the mess... Not at all in line with the quality of the room and the price (256$/night !).

author: Teniswhiz
title: Nostalgic!
text: We felt like we went back into time. Clean, newly remodeled, enchanting, nostalgic motel off of old route US 66. Easy check in and check out!!! Would definitely stay here again! Quaint shop to buy U.S. 66 memorabilia and other crafty items. Great location. Tickets to Grand Canyon train can also be purchased here. Nice hot breakfast in the AM.

author: Dianedmb
title: Great place for the price!
text: I picked this place based on Trip Advisor reviews for our trip to the Grand Canyon. This place is so cute. Check in was a breeze and the staff super friendly. Although the room we had was quite small (queen bed) it was very clean, pretty updated, and the bed was extremely comfortable. It did not have a fridge though which was disappointing as we had things we were keeping in a cooler and would have liked to be able to transfer them to a fridge, but that was a minor disappointment. I believe some of their other rooms may have a fridge which would be an upgrade. A complementary breakfast is included which was very adequate for what we eat for breakfast! The town of Williams is very cute and has a multitude of restaurants and places to shop all within walking distance on the historic Route 66. I would highly recommend you stay here if you're looking for a clean, comfortable, economical place to stay for your trip to the Grand Canyon which, by the way, is an easy 55 min. drive from the Lodge.

author: O_C0nn0rB
title: Small but immaculate motel
text: We stayed at the Lodge on Rt. 66 in Williams AZ for two nights while visiting the Grand Canyon. The Lodge sits right on Rt. 66 and is very accessible to everything. We had a Queen room that was VERY small but it was well furnished and extremely clean. Even though the road is right out front, it was surprisingly quiet. We did hear a train coming through town during the night but it was not a problem. Would definitely recommend this motel.

author: LadyRider09
title: Fun stay in Williams
text: We have been through this country before. We fell in love with Northern AZ. We are here to look at some property. The Lodge was a great place to hang out and spend some time in downtown Williams. Everything is within walking distance. The rooms are very comfy and cozy. It was snowy outside in March so we didn't spend much time in the outside sitting areas, but they looked very inviting for warmer days. Great service, great breakfast, great motel! There was only one thing I missed in the room....a small kitchenette sink. That would have made it perfect!

author: WDWfan81
title: Great Retro Motel
text: I booked a queen room - we were in Oklahoma. The room is not large but big enough. The A/C works great - cooled room off quickly and kept it cold all night. Spacious vanity area for both of us to get ready at same time. Very clean and cute decor. Great location to walk to shopping and dining. It is obvious the owners take great pride in this place. Even have extra towels outside to wipe off classic car or motorcycle. Since we were travelling Route 66 in 1967 car this place was really fun to stay at!

author: PatriciaJH44
title: CLEAN and SPACIOUS
text: We stayed here (5 rooms) for our 50th anniversary Grand Canyon trip. We were married in 66 so we thought it appropriate to stay on the iconic Route 66 (nostalgic, too). The rooms were spacious and very clean! The staff was great. We really enjoyed having the outdoor area to be together in the evenings. We even used the outdoor fireplace to make S'mores. The classical music piped outside was a nice touch. The breakfast (included) was adequate. Good value for the money. We would definitely stay there again!

author: writingstar40
title: Great place to stay in historic Williams
text: We spent 2 nights at the Lodge. The location was great -- we could walk anywhere we needed to go in town, including the train depot for the train to the Grand Canyon. The shops were open rather late on the main street and we felt completely safe coming and going to the Lodge. The front desk staff was very friendly. There's a nice patio area with a fireplace. We ordered pizza one night and enjoyed the outdoor space. Our room was clean and comfortable, even for the two of us who slept on a sleeper sofa. I would not hesitate to stay here again.

author: SuzieQ25
title: Great Place to Stay
text: Wonderful place to stay. We stayed here one night and one night at the Grand Canyon Railroad Hotel. Wish we would have stayed here both nights. We had one of the smaller rooms, but still had plenty of room for the 2 of us. The room and linens were clean. The bed was so comfy. The breakfast the next morning was great. Thank you for restoring an old treasure.

author: UsingCommonSense
title: Exactly what I expected...good hotel in a good location
text: I booked this motel based on the reviews. I wasn't disappointed. I had a 2x queen bed room that appeared to be updated. It was definitely small...but I expected that based on the reviews. The woman at the front desk was very helpful. The room itself was pleasant and clean. The "downtown" section of Williams is a short 2-3 block walk away. There are definitely newer "chain" hotels in the area that may be worth checking into for lodging. But if you want something on Route 66 right near downtown...this is a good option.

author: Ktown5
title: Great place to stay
text: Had a great stay at The Lodge! I booked a queen suite room for a great price. The room was spacious and very comfortable. I was a little concerned that it would be noisy being on a main street, but that was not an issue at all. It had a small living room and a separate bedroom. The room was extremely clean. The Lodge is in walking distance to some great shops and restaurants, which is a huge plus! The person that checked us in (I think her name was Andrea) was very pleasant and helpful. My only regret is that we only stayed one night! This is on my list of places to come back to and stay at again!!

author: Becksterzzz
title: Cozy Means Small
text: Tight quarters, but spiffy clean and nicely redecorated. Bed was comfortable. Our only complaint was heat/cool device - so loud and erratic AND the light around the blinds in windows made room light. Perhaps it was because I couldn't sleep due to heater that everything seemed worse. The office and shop were nice, the staff was superb - super nice and friendly. Complementary breakfast limited. Great location in town. Can walk to everything.

author: Richalyn
title: Owner of Motel is Humble, Gracious, and Caring
text: I had the opportunity to speak with the owner for about 15 minutes and learned in that experience of her dedication to this property. I knew before heading into my room that I would find the hard work of loving hands. In my King Suite (St. Louis), I found a clean, modern, cozy, and comfortable feel. I told myself, I could live in a place like this, which I don't find happens often in my picky tastes; especially for a motel. This motel is one of a kind, close to the Grand Canyon Train station, or a little over an hour drive. Plus, it is close to a tone of shops & restaurants in Williams. This town is lovely! The Room: There are 2 TVs (which I did not use), which are located in the living room + bedroom, a kitchen table, refrigerator, microwave, kitchen sink + counter, a comfortable couch + living room chair, and a large bed that I recently woke up from 9 hours of sleep. I highly recommend this hotel anyone passing through from the Grand Canyon.

author: LyleW939
title: What a great little town and hotel.
text: We stopped in at Williams just for a stopover between Monument Valley and Vegas to do some washing . What a surprise this little place was. We loved it. The motel room was pretty small but comfy and clean. the staff were freindly and offered a small but adequate breakfast. You could walk up the main street which came alive late afternoon and night. The hotel had some quirky chairs out the front where you can have a coffee and watch the action go by.Wi-fi in the room was good.Laundromat right across the road. Single story hotel so know stairs and easy parking.

author: Carissa32015
title: Great place
text: I read the other reviews, so I decided to give it a try and I'm glad I did. The front desk clerk was very friendly and welcoming. We stayed in a room with two queens, which was very clean and affordable. The breakfast was a nice surprise, since i was expecting just a simple continental. There were plenty of choices, including a make your own waffle station. The only suggestion I have for the hotel is to add blackout curtains. The exterior lights stay on all night, and the blinds don't block the light. Other than that, we had a very nice stay and have already recommended it to family.

author: 240billh
title: Exceeded Expectations!
text: We were looking for an overnight stay in Williams. We read the Tripadvisor reviews and decided to try The Lodge. Check-in was quick and the desk clerk was very friendly and professional. The grounds were nice, the room was updated, spotless, and comfortable even though small. The lodge was pretty full but it wasn't noisy at all! The breakfast in the morning was typical ... fruit, Danish, coffee, orange juice, etc. But there was also a waffle maker and sausage. The breakfast area was clean and well attended to by the host. Nothing but praise for The Lodge!

author: turgonuk
title: Quite pricey but wide range of rooms for different budgets
text: A very well updated motel in the fab little town that is Williams. Williams was the last town to attempt to fight off the Interstate bypass. They take route 66 seriously here, which is just as well as it doing just that that brought us here. We'd selected Room #10 (Amarillo) which was really a suite. Huge bathroom, separate lounge, a couple of TV's.. Wish we could have spent longer here. You can park right outside the room so no problem there. The motel is sited right on Route 66 on the east bound one way section, so you have to turn round further up if you're west bound. Breakfast is included here but is rather average.

author: Pen2paint
title: Classy remodel of an old Route 66 classic motel!
text: I was advised to check this remodel out when I was downtown wine tasting (who would have thought they'd have a wine tasting venue here?) The manager was nice, he delighted in showing me around and talking about their massive remodel, showed me a room or two. The central "pool" had been replaced with a classy event tent - complete with heaters on the ceiling, a large fireplace at each end, tables and lounge chairs. They only had one other guest - so the price was negotiated and I enjoyed treating myself to this. The room was beautifully redone, nice big bed, smooth sheets, all the delights you'd expect in an upscale place. Even though it was chilly at night, I enjoyed the "tent" outside for the evening alone, ipad with music going, a bottle of Cabernet S. and my feet up and relaxed. Love this. Wonderful reuse and remodel of a Route 66 classic, right on the main drag of Williams.

author: Noteworthymom
title: Great place to stay on the way to the Grand Canyon
text: As the name of the hotel states, it is located right on Route 66. While it has a classic charm on the outside, it has top notch modern amenities on the inside. We stayed in room #19 on the end near the road, but it was very quiet. Unfortunately, the wifi was very spotty. We had a queen suite with a pull-out couch in a separate room. We found the bed comfortable and my son seemed fine on the pull-out couch. The suite had a very large counter & sink area that was separate of the toilet & bath. There was a nice size television in each room, but some of the decorations had minor damages. There was a hot breakfast in the morning, but we were surprised that there was no cereal. Overall, we had a very enjoyable stay.

author: JensogSetta
title: Lovely little motel.
text: We stayed for two nights. It was clean on the inside as well on the outside. Check in was fast and really good. Staff was excellent and helpful, ready to assist in any way. It just short walk to all the restaurants and sights on 66. I would like have seen a small fridge in our room, there are also not enough electrical power points in the room. Other than that everything was very good. Will definitely come back.

author: 627matte
title: Nice Hotel
text: Stayed for two nights. Room was very nice and clean. Good location. We liked the separate bedroom and living room with pull out couch for the kids. Only complaint was breakfast. Very few choices and a tiny crowded area with everyone on top of each other fighting for food. Apparently the hotel across the street eats there too. The front desk clerk in the morning was friendly and did her best to answer phones, help customers, and take care of breakfast by herself. But she needed help.

author: RainofStars
title: Room was better than pictured. Staff was professional and happy.
text: We stayed in the only room with a kitchen (13) and it was a full-on kitchen. There was an unadvertised patio off the living room. Bathroom was fine. Bed was a tad hard but were so tired we almost did not care. Fireplace in living room was cheery. Living room and dinning table for 4 was comfy. Serious armoire was high enough to hang my wedding dress and not drag the train. (Happy bride!) We'd hoped to hang out in the courtyard with friends but the weather was colder/rainier than expected. Breakfast was better than expected--sausage, waffles, toast, yogurt, eggs, coffee, OJ. We would stay here again and will tell others it is a good value for the price.

author: dianecC4460MQ
title: Our stay at The Lodge on Route 66
text: This has to be the best place to stay in Williams, Arizona. We recently went on a trip to the Grand Canyon and used this as our resting place. The staff are simply the best, the rooms are amazing, the most comfortable beds ever. The best cleaning and room up keep. Another great perk of this place is in the morning you can go to the lodge and have a great breakfast, you can make your own waffles, they also have scrambled eggs and sausage, oatmeal, all different kinds of breads and muffins along with a variety of fruits to chose from, also coffee variety of teas, milk and orange juice. You are also within walking distance of all restaurants and gift shops in town. Also only 50 miles from the Grand Canyon. GREAT PLACE TO STAY!!!!!!!

author: 9blsd
title: A Must for your Rt 66 Experience
text: What a nice little hotel in a small quaint town. Beautifully renovated with real Rt 66 flavor. The lobby was lovely and the owners provide a great continental breakfast in a quiet were thought out setting. We stayed here after visiting Sedona for the day. Checked in then walked about 2 blocks for a good dinner at Pancho McGillicuddy's. I did not rate this as A trendy hotel, but the decor was upscale and a lot of thought and care was put into the furnishings. Outside in the courtyard area are table, chairs and a gas fireplace for relaxing. Glad we stayed here.

author: luvstotravel08
title: Updated & Comfortable Motel On Route 66
text: We stayed at The Lodge upon the recommendation of a local resident & were not disappointed. We were on a motorcycle trip to the Grand Canyon & like to stay where we can park the bikes outside our rooms- this place fit the bill perfectly. This motel has been extensively renovated & the rooms are extremely clean with white bedding & sleeping bags at the foot of the bed as comforters. Cute Lodge decor definitely added to the charm of this little hotel along Historic Route 66. Breakfast is included with your stay; waffles, scrambled eggs, sausage, fruit & the usual breakfast items were constantly replenished. We were lucky to happen upon this place & even luckier that there was availability (it was full by early evening). We will definitely book ahead next time to ensure we can stay here again. This is a very well-run establishment!

author: JoanneK959
title: Great place to stay!
text: We stayed two nights while visiting the Grand Canyon. Staff were very nice and rooms were spotlessly clean. The breakfast was very good with a wide variety to choose from. The price was extremely reasonable. They have an area outside that has tables & chairs with fireplaces and even "clear" plastic drapes to pull around if chilly or wet. Right on Route 66 and walking distance to restaurants, shops, and bars. We would definitely stay here again. In summer, it is very crowded as are most places in this town.

author: cl3dwards
title: No. 1 on TripAdvisor For a Reason
text: "The Lodge" is No. 1 on TripAdvisor for a reason! Great prices, great staff, and excellent rooms. The room was decorated in a nice lodge setting. We especially liked the comfy sleeping bag that was unzipped at the end of the bed for extra bedding. Recessed canned lights above the bed, beautiful fixtures in the bathroom, a mixture of tiles, carpeting and wood flooring, along with a TV hanging on the wall with satellite TV were just some of the features that we loved. The continental breakfast was great and was the equivalent of what you'd find in a Hampton Inn, but in a more comfy environment. Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay along Route 66.

author: DJ-Reviewer-One-Day
title: Excellent value and room
text: We stayed here during a recent trip to the Grand Canyon. I actually had never stayed in a motel, but wow, what a great place to stay. We had the King suite and the price was amazing. The room was impeccably clean. I also loved the fact that the bedroom had two french doors. My husband and I stayed in the King bedroom and my son on the pullout couch in the living room. Having doors was great to give us some privacy. The complementary breakfast was great and much appreciated before heading to the Grand Canyon. I would definitely recommend staying here.

author: RajatBakshi
title: Very nice hotel!
text: This is the second time we stayed at this hotel. We were there for 2 nights. We had 2 room (one with large Queen with 2 queen beds, and another with 1 queen bed). This is a very nice hotel for a family traveling together. It is very clean, comfortable and tastefully decorated. They have Direct TV and wifi in each room. The Staff is friendly and helpful. The breakfast buffet is generous. My wife and kids like this hotel very much and we will stay here again next time we visit Williams and the Grand Canyon.

author: Dlplatt
title: Great Little Inn in the Desert
text: on a last minute decision to take the northern route back home to Texas, we wanted to see the grand Canyon. Driving down Rt 66 we found The Lodge. Van, the innkeeper, was very informative. We took Room 13 (former manager's suite). As an old motel, this place has been updated very nicely but has kept the 'old look', but not the 'old feel'! Nice hot breakfast. we were able to go to GC and see the sunset and return the next morning for sunrise. Service excellent. wouldn't mind spending a week at The Lodge!

author: Carolynisrad
title: The Lodge is Route 66 perfection!
text: We went to williams to do the Polar Express train and are so happy we stayed at The Lodge for so many reasons! It is clean and newly renovated. The rooms are a good size, we got to stay in the Williams room. It is decorated so cute...love the sleeping bags as throw blankets! The breakfast was beyond perfect! My kids loved that I got to make them waffles with the fun waffle iron. I loved the variety of choices! And last but not least it was a great deal! Skip the hotel at the train depot and check this spot out!

author: Ambermc
title: Fabulous Motel in a Fabulous little Town
text: What a nice surprise to meet the young lady at the desk who was bright, friendly and also very helpful in helping us sort out a problem with our computer! Our room was spacious, clean and comfortable, and ideally situated in this lovely town for an evening stroll, or a morning jaunt to the railway station to see the shoot-out at 9am. (Highly recommend the shoot-out - it was touch and go for a while there however, until the Sheriff came to sort things out!) The breakfast is the usual American fare, which we were becoming used to by now. (Being kiwis our breakfasts are a bit different). But there was plenty to get you going for the day with cereals, yoghurts, toast, and a hot offering too. We would have appreciated some wine glasses, cork screw and bottle opener in the room - just that we enjoyed the Californian reds and Budweisser! Otherwise no complaints, and would not hesitate to recommend a stay at the Lodge on Route 66. (Oh, go to the Red Raven for dinner - fab!)

author: thesmithsuk52
title: Route66 and all that !
text: We stopped here for two nights whilst doing a 15 day road trip. The accomodation was small compared to other accomodation we had chosen but this was a motel when 66 was the road through Williams. Furnishings were adequate and everything worked well. Both nights deposited frost on the car so the availability of a hot food breakfast was welcome. Von on the desk in the afternoon and the ladies in the morning were always smiling and helpful.As there is a railroad crossing in town the horns on freight trains in the night were highly audible especially they sounded at least three times. Each motel room is given a town name on the old route 66. We were in Seligan. Perhaps because I am not american I found Route 66 lacked the passion I had read about and at times parts seemed to have had its history replaced by tacky fake.

author: 662kristinep
title: wonderful
text: Charming place! The double queen room was cozy and clean. Lodge like decor was clever but not over done. Found it to be a great location for our Grand Canyon stop. It is just as the website presents. The staff was very welcoming and helpful. The breakfast selection including eggs, sausage and waffles quite nice. Coffee in room but no fridge or microwave. Highest recommendation...as the sign said...affordable luxury:)

author: rc49456
title: Don't expect too much.
text: I chose this hotel because of the reviews and was expecting too much from a hotel in a small town. The people were friendly, the place was clean, and the web-site was quite efficient. But, since I was there just to sleep one night after visiting Grand Canyon, I chose a queen-room. It was so small that it reminded me of a Japanese business hotel. There was only about 4 feet of space around the bed on three sides, and there was almost no room for luggage. The window air conditioner was too close to the bed so that you could touch it while laying down on the bed, and the noise so close-by was annoying. The bath area was tiny, but there was a little more space outside to stand and get dressed. If you are planning to stay there for relaxation, make sure you get the bigger rooms.

author: LNE44
title: Great Route 66 Hotel
text: This hotel was a pleasant surprise. The staff greeted you, so warm and friendly. When we went to our rooms we thought they were so nice. Great decorations, homey, clean and places to sit and enjoy the time in the room. The location was walking distance to everything in Williams. We were riding our bicycles on Route 66, and this is a gem of a hotel. The morning breakfast was good too, lots to choose from. They also gave us a fabulous recommendation for dinner. If you stay in Williams, I highly recommend this gem.

author: dinkydog99
title: Not disappointed
text: The motel lived up to its reviews. I was traveling with friends from England, and they loved the décor as did I. The rooms we had weren't overly spacious but more than sufficient. They were clean, and the beds were very comfortable. The office staff was very helpful in suggesting restaurants. It's a great base for walking to restaurants and shops. Glad I chose this place. Would like to return someday to Williams.

author: Resque
title: Quaint but modern
text: It looks like a Route 66 kind of place. It is updated. The rooms have a separate living area. They are tastefully decorated with period pieces. The beds are excellent. The town is cool with lots of neon at night. The hotel is located a few blocks form most of it. There was a strong cleaning products smell. There was food left in the refrigerator by a previous guest and the refer was turned off. The breakfast area is very cramped.

author: Sleetlyn
title: Just a nice clean place to sleep
text: The odor of cleaning products was overwheming but opening the door snd putting on the fans took care of that. The room are basic with two queen beds and that's about it. All there was room for. Nice outdoor area and chairs too. The cont breakfast was a little more than I expected with "scrambled eggs" and sausage along with regular waffles, toast, bananas, yogurt... Very crowed in breakfast room though. We took ours outside. We were headed for Grand Canyon train as were most guests so it served its purpose well but I thought a little pricy at $133 with tax for just the basic room it was. Williams, AZ seemed to be on the high side though.

author: 50-and-retired
title: What a great motel in a fun town
text: If you are planning a trip to the Grand Canyon (only 60 miles away) or just a trip down I-40 this is a great place to stop. The town is on old HWY 66 and so is this quaint and clean motel. This place was built with thick walls: no outside noise no next door noise, just nice quiet sleep on a very comfortable bed. Free in room coffee. Free breakfast waffels, OJ, coffee, eggs and more. Only drawback is no place to put clothes, there is good counter space at the sink, but you are dressing out of suitcase. Everything else more than made up for that during our two night stay. Plenty of good food in this 5 block town. Fantastic staff, Carol was a great help with food choices. If I am ever in the area, I will stay here again.

author: lpypeiying
title: Nice Cosy Place
text: We stayed here after our day trip in grand canyon. we couldnt get accommodation in grand canyon itself so we decided to stay in williams for a night. We reserved a room and when we arrived at the lodge at 8pm in heavy rain, we were glad that the room wasnt given to anyone. Nicely decorated cosy room and met our basic needs. It is clean though not very spacious for 2 big luggage. There is free wifi and free breakfast. The breakfast is sumptuous. The reception is very polite and helpful. On the whole, a pleasant stay.

author: annetI2204XY
title: Nice rooms and helpful staff
text: We chose this motel based on the TripAdvisor reviews, and we were not disappointed. We stayed in Room 18, the Lincoln. We had a queen size bed in one room; the other room (with a door that closes between the rooms) had a queen size sleeper sofa, two arm chairs, a pub table and two chairs, a nice size refrigerator, a microwave, and cabinet space. If you were going to be in the area for several days it would be a great room - it is advertised as 400 sq ft. Everything was clean and in order. Our check in was warm and friendly. Breakfast was ok, nothing special but enough to get us going. There is a nice outside seating area with a fireplace. We could hear people out there most of the evening.

author: 19carlaw
title: Perfect! Great place to stay!
text: My husband and spent one night at the lodge on our through to the Canyon. This hotel is by far the best in Williams! It is clean, convenient and adorable. The attention to detail here by all staff is noticeable from the moment you pull into the lot. Rooms are a little small but comfortable. The beds are perfect! There is a covered patio in the centre of the parking lot with 2 fireplaces to provide a place to sit around. Would stay again here and highly recommend it to anyone.

author: kenb972
title: Very nice hotel, centrally located in Williams, AZ
text: We, two grown-ups and our teenager son from Norway, stayed at the Lodge on Route 66 from Saturday, June 21-Sunday June 22 2014. We had a suite (500 SqFt) with two Queen Beds, and the beds were just fantastic and gave us a good nights sleep after an exhausting train travel from L.A. the night before. There was also a nice living-room with a small kitchen section where we could prepare some food on our own. The breakfast was not up to European hotel standard, but adequate, We arrived in Williams very early in the morning, being brought to the Railway station in the town by bus from Williams Junction. From the station it was just a short walk to the Lodge, but the Lodge don't have a nightopen reception, so we decided to call the phone number on our hotel reservation. We got in contact with the owner, but felt terribly sorry to drag her out of her bed that early in the morning, She just came after a while, being very helpful so we could place our luggage in her office and have a walk around the town and a meal at a diner before our room was vacant. Very good service! Best wishes from us Three Norwegians to the owner and her receptionist!

author: Josie06
title: Great place to stay on Route 66!
text: I love Williams and this is a great place to stay! 3 years ago we stayed in Williams somewhere else and I noticed it has since closed, sad because it is a landmark as well. I love the history of Route 66. The owners have done a fantastic job or renovating this landmark motel. The rooms are clean, comfy and I wish I could have stayed longer. Close walk to downtown. The parking is great, friendly staff and they have a good breakfast. The rates are great. Take time to look at their photo album in the lobby, what all they did to make it the lovely place it is today. I would say it is the best place to stay in Williams!

author: carolp119
title: Loved this place!
text: I was excited to stay on Route 66 and didn't know what to expect of this hotel. It was far above my expectations! Our suite was beautifully decorated and well laid out. We had 2 queen beds, a kitchen and living space (which had a pull-out sofa). There were windows on both sides of the "room" which allowed a lot of light and felt very much like a home. The wifi was great, breakfast was more than enough to get us started on the day. The location was perfect for exploring Route 66 and the shops and restaurants. I would definitely recommend and stay again.

author: Cheryal
title: Clean room with new remodel
text: But it is what it was in the 1950's, a small one story motor court motel along the old Route 66. There were about 18 rooms arranged in a u shape with a parking space in front of each room. We booked online and check-in was friendly and seamless. pluses: new paint, new fixtures, wifi, new furniture, organic bathroom amenities and in-room Kona coffee (thank you!) however, the floor plan was the same as most of the motels from that era, no closet, but they did have two luggage racks and two straight back chairs so there was room to put our stuff in addition to some wall mounted hooks and a shelf above them. The room was dim and dark till we found the switch for the new recessed track lighting. The lampshade between the beds had a rip in it, and there was no shower curtain, just a liner so we had to put towels down on the floor to absorb water. if you want an authentic Route 66 experience this is the place for you. For me, having a waist high window next to my bed, and a door facing the small parking lot and the main drag just yards away, I guess it was too close of an access for me personally. But keep in mind the rest of the motels on Route 66 are laid out the same.

author: KadyTravels
title: Great Suite!
text: We stayed one night at The Lodge in a suite with a kitchenette and two separate bedrooms. This worked great so that my husband and I could sleep in one room and my Dad and son in the other. It was nice to be able to watch TV at night! The rooms were squeaky clean and attractive although they are compact! Very cute property with Route 66 nostalgia and modern conveniences! I loved that we could walk over the Cruiser's Cafe for dinner. And there was a nice breakfast provided in the morning if I remember correctly. We ended up paying $173 for the "Large 2 Queen 400 Sqft" room. A little pricey but a very nice stay.

author: Wanagirl
title: Nice little town
text: We have a two night stay at The Lodge. Nice rooms, small but clean and compact. Good bathroom area with separate vanity from the shower area. Interior nicely decorated. Breakfast was included in rate, wasn't great but sufficed. Staff friendly, easy walk into town for restaurants. No laundry on premises but a great public laundry directly across the road. Thoroughly recommend this to travellers on Route 66.

author: jayceemi
title: Surprisingly nice!
text: We stayed here for one night on our way to the Grand Canyon. Our room was a large 2-queen room, with one bed in a separate bedroom. It came furnished with a small refrigerator, plenty of counter space, and two sinks in the bathroom. Check-in was quick, and the lady at the desk was very friendly. The motel also includes a free breakfast, which we weren't able to take advantage of due to our early check-out. The motel is located on route 66, and there were plenty of small gift shops and restaurants within easy walking distance. The Grand Canyon train station is only 5-10 minutes away by foot, too. If you are visiting the Grand Canyon, it is about one hour north, so this makes a great stopover point. The only downside was that wi-fi was spotty, and the price was a bit high. We would probably stay again, though.

author: Piliaka
title: Fantastic Place
text: We were in Williams to judge in a BBQ competition. I tried to book this lodge last year, but they were booked. This year, I didn't waste any time and booked early to make sure we got a room. We were not disappointed. The room wasn't terribly big, but that was fine. It was quaint, cozy and the staff is incredibly friendly. The free breakfast was nice, very typical of the foods offered at most hotels w/complimentary breakfast. We will judge again next year and I won't hesitate to book early again. I highly recommend this lodge.

author: LindamariH
title: Great Grand Canyon base.
text: We stayed here for two night whilst visiting the Grand Canyon. We booked because of the low rate and the location, and were positively surprised! This motel is better than must of the HOTELS we have stayed at along Route 66. Pros: -Cozy lodge -Nice staff -Free wifi and parking -Clean -Rooms are spacious -Rooms doesn't look like they're in a desperate need of an update. They are standard. -Small but good breakfast. -Location -White towels. -Two queen beds in the standard room. Cons: None! Would love to stay here again.

author: Rajamora
title: Great Grand Canyon Home Base
text: The quaint Western period town of Williams priding itself on being the "Gateway to the Grand Canyon"', the Lodge is an excellent base of operations for Grand Canyon explorations from nearby without hitching up at the more costly (and older) Rim accommodations. It is especially convenient for those wishing to enjoy the unique Grand Canyon Railway round trip ride since the Train's Depot is located right in town, just a block or so from the Lodge. The newly renovated, centrally located Lodge rightly touts itself as a superior motel experience ....it's design is in the classic single story mold, fronting a dusty main street (but adorned by a parking forecourt fireplace cabana) - in this case, the historic Route 66, but the interior amenities are distinctly more ambitious: solid plank flooring, comfortable wood furnishings, big screen TVs, travertine bathrooms, thick bathrobes, etc. We booked a couple of nights at the center-situated Executive King Suite whose 500 square feet encompassed an inviting Living area with big screen TV; a small Dining area with a 4-stool dinette, microwave and wet bar; a welcoming bedroom with plush high pillow top bed and a cosy fireplace nook with big screen TV; and a capacious 2-counter all-travertine bathroom with oversized tub and separate shower and toilet stalls (which do need better lighting and heating). The suite is featured on the Lodge's website, for your curious preview. Complimentary breakfast is served beside the Reception Lobby with standard fare of fruit, juices, hot beverages, toast, preserves and assorted pastry. Front desk service was friendly, flexible and helpful. All in all, uniquely non-standard accommodations within the classic motel format.

author: Mrsmac28
title: Great authentic American motel
text: Stayed here for one night as an overnight stay whilst on holiday from Vegas. It was just what we were looking for, an authentic motel on the famous road. The room was small but that was ok, didn’t need anything bigger. It was very clean, my only complaint would be the bathroom was freezing as there was no separate heater for in there. So going to have a shower first thing was a tad uncomfortable! Breakfast was ‘ok’ a little disappointing I guess, but it came with the room rate which is an added bonus for America, so can’t complain really. Williams town was great, really liked it. Check out Trip Advisor first for places to eat and drink, we didn’t do this and ended up at a place called Jessica’s, which should be avoided at all costs!!! Best place we ate was Red Raven – didn’t look much from the outside, but the food, drink, service and atmosphere was fab!

author: Svengali
title: Decent room.
text: I was unimpressed with The Lodge for the price they charge. Unfortunately I had higher expectations. As a room it was fine. Yes, it had been updated (thank God)...Put another way...it is the perfect place to fall asleep. The bedding is comfortable...it was clean etc. Their breakfast was about as lame as it comes. They are completely lazy on the breakfast front. I don't want to dish out that kind of money for a room and then not even get a decent breakfast. So I'd give them a "meh" Next time I'd stay elsewhere for the price. .

author: sandy7599
title: Pleasant Surprise at The Lodge on Route 66
text: What a unique and pleasant stay we had at The Lodge in February. Last minute trip to The Grand Canyon found us in Williams AZ at 6PM without lodging. A phone call to the Lodge was answered by a pleasant young lady at the front desk who couldn't have been more helpful and accommodating. They had a small suite available named the St.Louis room which we found very ironic since that is where we are from. It was very nicely furnished with charming details making it very comfortable after a day of travel. We walked to a nearby restaurant for a great dinner and stroll down historic Route 66 before retiring to a very comfortable bed. Enjoyed a free breakfast in the morning before heading to The Grand Canyon. Free parking, internet, and breakfast plus the charm of historic Route 66 made it a great experience.

author: maryanns669
title: Great Hotel
text: I stayed here, in February, with my dog. It was clean and well maintained. The people are awesome. I will definitely stay here again. I highly recommend it. My dog loved it too. It's across the street from restaurants. Mary Ann Stein

author: delanag2013
title: Nice hotel. Cozy. Friendly staff.
text: We stayed here for one night on a road trip. It was cozy, clean, and conveniently located. the bed was super comfortable. The room was small, but had everything we needed and was perfect for a short stay. The front desk clerk was very kind and accommodating. We would definitely stay here again. And will, as my Grandmother lives in Williams. We are glad to have made this find!

author: IllinoisCookie
title: Great find on Route 66
text: This place was a great find. Its a small place but kept up very well. The rooms are very clean, cozy and the beds are very comfortable.The people in the lobby were super nice and very accommodating. They serve breakfast and have coffee in lobby at all times. They have an outdoor seating area which is covered with a fireplace in it. It was nice to sit there have some wine and cheese with our friends. The Lodge is a great place to spend a night or two on your way to the Grand Canyon. Oh and most important the prices per night are super.

author: Changeable
title: A Little Old Charm on Route 66
text: We are not the first Tripadvisor reviewers to find the Lodge on Route 66 worth a visit. It is a motor lodge with an old fashioned feel. There is no pool, but there is a sheltered patio in the central court with tables and chairs and fireplaces. Our room was clean, simply appointed and had an old fashioned look but the furnishings were not old. It is on the main street of Williams which seems suited out for tourists with several restaurants, bars, and souvenir shops within a block or two of the Lodge. The same office managed the Lodge and a name brand hotel across the way. People used to large rooms and big breakfasts might find this place too much of a change. There was a light breakfast in the office but with fewer offerings than we've seen in bigger places.

author: ttwwy
title: Pleasant Stay...
text: Save some money and stay in Williams when visiting the Grand Canyon. This motel is within easy walking distance to the small downtown area and about an hour from the park itself. The staff was friendly and helpful and the rooms were clean. However, the soundproofing is poor, so I could hear my neighbors easily through the walls. I was also slightly disappointed as I made my reservations several weeks in advance and asked for a quiet room away from the ice machine. We were instead placed directly next to the ice machine and were woken up very early in the morning by guests filling their coolers. And although it's not the fault of the Lodge, most of the guests staying there during our 2-day visit were up very early and were very, very noisy. Banging car doors, beeping car alarms, etc. Once again, not the fault of the Lodge, but if you require solid, uninterrupted sleep, you might need to look elsewhere. Breakfast was uninspiring the day we tried it.

author: ZaraAndy
title: Fantastic Find
text: We planned to go to the Grand Canyon for a few days and struggled with which accommodation to choose until we came across The Lodge. This place is great with a nicely decorated room. You get free parking and free wifi along with free breakfast which had a great spread. The staff were friendly and informative as well. I liked that the rooms were all named after a town that was on Route 66. The lodge is located in the little town of Williams on Route 66 its the perfect location if you want a little slice of what Route 66 use to be like. Its big enough to have a variety of restaurants and shops and is a great base if you want to visit the Grand Canyon. I hope to stay here when we return to the Grand Canyon the future. Thank you for the Lodge on Route 66!

author: 912PaulB912
