One member of staff was there on each of our visits and was really welcoming and gave great local recommendations.1920s art deco style ish. Modern with retro twist, if that makes sense. Quite dark but fits well. Returned 3 times on the visit around 18.00 to 20.00 in the evening. Found a leather winged back chair and could of stayed in it for hours with continued table service. Served pints too. Result!

author: 624StephenH
title: Lovely Boutique Hotel in the heart of the City
text: The Old Care is a real gem of a Hotel for those who like quirky up market Hotels with real character and excellent facilities. The look and feel of the hotel is a mix of industrial chic with 5 star comforts. Very tall ceilings and high curtains cover good views over the central area of Sydney and each room is perfectly decked out with everything from an ironing board to plenty of storage space. The double wash basin was smart and the huge king sized bed had really comfortable high grate Egyptian cotton sheets and a very comfortable mattress for an excellent nights sleep. The TV was top of the range and rooms plenty big enough for a weeks stay. Well worth a visit and everything was easy to get to from here if you want to explore the city. The bar is very trendy and comfortable and there are several top quality restaurants and bars linked to the hotel that are well forth a visit. Overall one of the best hotels I have stayed in.

author: lembaa
title: Hidden Gem!!!
text: I booked this hotel for my sister as a birthday present and WOW!! I'm so glad I did. It ticked all the boxes including AMAZING STAFF !! everyone is so welcoming and the whole atmosphere is inviting. Fantastic high ceilings which I loved and the great furnishings in the room! (Ps stayed in the Connell King Room) I can't wait to come back to actually check out the top bar and pool .I will definitely be back and will tell everyone who visits Sydney to check out the old gal. Good work Team I know there would have been a lot of hard work behind the scenes to put this beauty together but it was worth it. :)

author: stkildachick
title: Great new Sydney hotel
text: I stayed here 2 nights and had a great stay. The staff were really helpful, the room was lovely and the hotel was clean and well designed. My room was on the ground floor but had a beautiful aspect. I had a few drinks at the bar, ate breakfast at Silvereye and dinner at Automata & food and service was consistently above average. On the down side there is a bit of street noise if you stay on the ground floor and I heard other guests complaining about the construction noise from the higher floors. I didn't have any problems as I always carry earplugs. Nothing much can be done about the noise (it is inner city Sydney after all) but this may be an issue for some. Would highly recommend.

author: MarkusH537
title: great hotel but not happy
text: Great hotel and nice design, rooms are spacious and nicely done, beds are very comfy but pillows a little to big for my liking. Service ok but not great, no porter service offered so we took it ourselves which was not a big deal. bar a little noisy and unfortunately has the real pup smell even when you enter the hotel. The real issue is the noise from the road and the construction site next door. No notification was given about the construction site next door and when I say next door it's no more than 5 meters from the room we stayed in. Once we went to bed we thought the noise had finished until 1.30 in the morning when leave blowers started directly outside our window followed by pressure cleaners cleaning the footpath below. After we contacted the reception twice the noise stopped at 3am. Would not stay again even so it is nicely done and rooms are great.

author: bjorker
title: Cute hotel on the lake
text: Great little place with everything you could possibly want in South Lake Tahoe. Our room was super clean and recently renovated with nice wood accents, a stellar coffeemaker, mini fridge and microwave. Parking included. Pool was warm and giant hot tub was nice and really hot. Front desk staff were gracious and helpful—they even got me a toothbrush when I discovered I’d forgotten mine. We don’t have a dog but I think it’s really great when a place is pet friendly and this place is. Conveniently located across the street from the lake and next to Tahoe Bowl (we bowled! 25% off given to hotel guests and we got $3 drinks at Tahoe Bowl’s happy hour), and MacDuff’s Scottish pub (15% off to azure guests—cool little place with great food and drinks). It’s a great choice for any type of stay.

author: justinbV1559CN
title: Horrible
text: We paid $50 more for the upgraded room with a whirlpool tub and when we got there the lady at the front desk said they did not have such rooms and that we could use the hot tub by the pool. She was rude and sarcastic and refused to lower our rate to the standard room rate even though she confirmed that was their only queen room they offered and we were being over charged. This is false advertising by either the hotel or Trip Advisor. The hotel is not as advertised in the photos either. The rooms and grounds were not nearly as impressive as made to look. I will not be using Trip Advisor or the Hotel Azure ever again. Either company could have corrected the issue but refused. Trip Advisor support was patient and tried to get us a refund and we offered to book another hotel from him but he had no luck negotiating with the lady at the front desk and he was only able to provide a 10% refund which is ridiculous if we paid $140 for a $92 room. If the hotel only was paid $92 as she said then I don’t understand why Trip Advisor could not provide more of a refund at minimum or comp another room.

author: Freedom15994247999
title: Good Stay
text: Good spot. Good location. Clean. Friendly. Visually pleasant. Convenient. Microwave and mini fridge appreciated. Walkable to restaurants, grocery, bowling, massage, and Glazed and Confused donuts, Only 2 miles from Stateline.

author: H7009VYcarlosa
title: First Timer to Tahoe
text: The Hotel rooms were very large and beds are comfy. Super dog friendly. Provided a nice doggie bed with a doggie bowl... Complimentary doggie baggie stations outside for convenience.I did not utilize the hot tub or pool, gym or game room. Front desk staff was nice and attentive to all needs. Cleaning staff missed our room on day 2 and had to request an early clean the following day before leaving for slopes the next. The location is perfect - It was very close to Safeway (grocery store) Starbucks and shopping center. Also very close to Ski Resort/Ski Lifts

author: TravelLA77
title: Nice clean hotel
text: The hotel was a bit overpriced at $160 but it was right after New Years. It seems that back in the day, this motel used used to be a [insert the name of any three story motel chain]. However the look remodeled and have interiors comparable to a Hyatt, Wyndham, or Marriott... The room was clean. The bed, sheets, pillows, and comforter were extremely comfortable and relaxing. And they take pets. The next day I checked out and stayed at the Hard Rock down the street (see my review for Hard Rock Tahoe). Hard Rock was a big mistake. I should’ve just stayed at Azure the second night.

author: Excursion15673673724
title: Nice modern suite
text: We stayed one night. The room was stunning. Very modern. Clean. Had a nominal view of the lake.*Oh, man... I need to have a minimum of 200 characters for this review to be considered legitimate. Almost there. Done*

author: Guide26496835654
title: Hit or miss
text: We stayed here one night on either side of our trip to Mammoth. The first time was great. Clean room, comfortable bed, quiet. We liked that they have a special allowing our dogs to stay free. The second time our room was pretty awful. It had a weird smell, and the thermostat was broken and the temp in the room was 79 all night. We were roasting, but the room was on the road side (“lake view” so more expensive) and it was SO loud all night and we couldn’t leave the door open. Others were complaining about the heater when we checked out, so it sounds like something hotel-wide they were trying to fix.

author: NYbruce
title: Great weekend getaway
text: We spent 3 nights there right before the ski season started. It is a great location for the price. It is a short drive to the village. The hot tub was perfect on the cold evenings. The room was clean but a bit cramped even with just 2 of us. We had a nice view of the lake from our balcony. Staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good but if you get the $30 off certificate from sharing on Facebook, be warned that you need the actual certificate from the check-in desk. I would go back!

author: Estelle598
title: Special Treat
text: We decided to treat ourselves to a Lake view room. We think it was worth the cost. It was fabulous to see the lake especially as the sun set. The room was very comfortable and clean and matched our expectations. The room was not completely soundproof but reduced the noise from the highway. The pool and the hot tub area were especially nice. We used the complimentary bikes to get round the area and very much enjoyed exploring it and swimming in the lake. Safeway is within walking distance and we walked to local restaurants. Reception were very helpful and good humoured.

author: greggkaufman
title: Tahoe Vacation
text: We recently visited Lake Tahoe for 3 nights. It's been 30 years since I've been to Tahoe. We had a fabulous stay and packed a perfect amount of activities for us to enjoy but not over extend. We found Hotel Azure to be the perfect place to stay for us. The room was sizeable and everything that we wanted in terms of comfort, cleanliness and amenities. We used the hot tub all 3 nights and found it to be outstanding! I also used the fitness facility and it was perfect for my needs as I forgot my swimming goggles at home. The location was great and all that we did was within 10 miles of the hotel. The view from our balcony was breathtaking! We will definitely be back to Tahoe and Hotel Azure!

author: ronmosher
title: Best hotel in Lake Tahoe
text: We visited Lake Tahoe for a few nights .. we chose azure hotel with out planning .. we were surprised and so happy ! First the service and tips given to us were just the best ! Then the room we got was huge Room number 360 . Location is the best and view of the lake is just amazing ! Rooms are clean with amazing beds . Highly recommend !!

author: 473debbiej
title: Right across from the Lake
text: Positives: Our room was lovely, everything included (large mirror, fridge, coffee, ironing board and bath robes !). The hotel offered a gym, games room and a lovely pool. We used their bikes for free and followed a path along the Lake. There are a few restaurants within walking distance but really a car can make it much easier to get around. You just cross the road and you are at the Lake with beautiful views. Its a short drive to Emerald Lake and other walking trails. Lots of free parking available. Negatives: The whole check-in process was terrible. We arrived after a long drive and our room wasn't ready...understandable but really all the staff needed to do was check to see if it was clean and pop our wine into the room, we would understand if it was busy but it was a ghost town...the staff were just standing around. I really didn't think we were made to feel welcome at all.

author: ronnyroup
title: Great hotel !
text: Great location , great staff ! Great view !! They upgraded our room to a great room 360 .. gave the best tips . Price is fair ! The room is clean , big and very convenient ! Very highly recommended!!! !

author: mariaciti
title: A Gem Hotel in South Lake Tahoe
text: My family spent three nights in this hotel in June, 2018. We booked a lake-view room with two-queen beds. The staff were friendly and helpful. The room was cozy and clean. There is a small balcony facing the Lake, so we could sit there watching the beautiful lake. There is a small swimming pool with hot tub. There are restaurants and supermarket nearby. If you prefer quite environment, this is a nice hotel with wonderful view for you!

author: UnreasonableMan57
title: Let down by greeting
text: Nice place with great location. Carpets etc a little tired but bathrooms brand new and overall very acceptable. Except. Someone on the front desk was having a bad day or two. Cost a star and should be more because the welcome and how you are handled make such a difference. For example, she made a mistake and checked us into an unmade roon. When pointed out she referred in less than helpful terms to “sorting out our problem”. No, actually.

author: hawkrod
title: Lo-o-o-ng weekend in Tahoe
text: Lake Tahoe, still so beautiful. There is so much to do there. Anything and everything is available. And usually not far. Get the app to ride the electric scooter or bikes, they're everywhere. Just hop on and go. We don't live far, so 'been going here all our lives. Never get tired of coming here.

author: bjeannes
title: Beautiful view and spacious rooms
text: Great hotel with a beautiful view if you can get a balcony. We originally had booked a different room, but they had openings for the balcony. If this happens, take it! The rooms are beautiful and spacious. Very modern and updated. Our AC ended up not working but they immediately gave us choices of different rooms. Awesome staff. Go next door to the Bear Beach cafe for a great breakfast (Bacon banana waffle or blueberry short stack).

author: robertfJ9235BN
title: Great hotel near a lot of attractions
text: Stayed four nights at Azure in South Lake Tahoe. I wanted to be near nature and the local attractions and this hotel fit the bill. Located in South Lake Tahoe within 3 miles of the casinos, I found that this place struck a nice balance between the two. We were about 5 miles from emerald bay with access to several nice beaches. It was far enough away from the casinos to avoid heavy crowds with access to several local restaurants within walking distance. Light amenities are available but was sufficient as we wanted to remain outdoors as much as possible. The staff are polite and helpful. I would stay there again.

author: hahabye
title: Pleasant Stay
text: Hotel Azure is located directly across the street from Lake Tahoe. The views are to die for, and the street noise is not an issue. They offer complimentary bike rentals, and discounts at nearby restaurants. This is clearly an older property that has been remodeled. The new decorations are modern and good looking, yet this is still clearly a dated property. That isn't a criticism, just a heads up. The hotel is clean, safe, convenient, and the service was good. I would return to this property if I ever make it back to Tahoe.

author: CharlaC
title: Great for the price!
text: Clean, neat, great location. Room was very large and the bath had a second sink area outside of the bathroom. We had a decent view of the lake. The hot tub was good too. This is really a no frills hotel, but we were very pleased. We stayed four nights. The staff were personable and helpful. The bed was very comfortable and the linens were good quality. For the price it’s a great hotel. And you don’t have to valet park like at so many other places.

author: 187meghanc
title: Love, Love, Love
text: 3 friends, 5 days not 1 complaint. Honestly, not one of us had a single negative thing to say. Rooms are beautiful and clean. Hotel is quiet and peaceful. Views of the lake are great. We loved the pool/ hot tub, bear beach cafe, Tahoe Bowl, and McDuffs. We also found board games at the thrift store next door for a couple bucks. We LOVED this hotel and it’s location. Would 100% stay again!

author: 575vickie
title: Hotel Azure, by the beautiful, azure Lake Tahoe
text: We love this place with a couple caveats. Hot tub is too hot—it’s an awesome two tiered hottub, and you want to sit in it and chat with folks and just be outside surrounded by all that beauty. But You get overheated within a few minutes and have to stand up or sit out, but it’s too cold to sit out for long so you sit back in, and then you’re too hot again. Turn it down to about 102, and it’s warm enough to keep you warm, to ease your muscles, and you never get overheated. Also, there is a big sign inside the pool area that says “no glassware”. BUT the only kind of ware that is provided in the rooms are glass glasses. Oxymoronic. Anyway, the rooms are big and clean and in good repair, the staff are friendly and accomodating, and the location is intoxicating. We will be back again and again. Even if we have to literally boil in the hottub...

author: jpm2085
title: Excellent mountain and lake hideaway!
text: We used this hotel as a stopover on roadtrip between Las Vegas and San Francisco. We really enjoyed it so much we stayed an extra night. Very impressive room, amazing bed and lovely bathroom. Cleanliness was exceptional. Hotel is located in front of the lake with beautiful views. It's just slightly out of town so depending on weather you could walk but we took the car as it was very cold. You can enjoy skiing directly from the town as the ski lift goes from the centre and is very easy to access. Beside the hotel is a great Scottish bar where the food was excellent, especially the home made hamburgers....Very good. We also enjoyed the heated pool / Spa....would definetly go back here. Very helpful and friendly staff!

author: thoux15
title: Nice
text: The room was very spacious with great amenities. Walls were paper thin. We heard EVERYTHING. We were in the building by the pool (far from main Street) but could hear traffic clearly. Neighbors could be heard as well. We were on top floor, I can only imagine how noisy it would be if we were had a room above us. The price was right and the view was amazing. I just like my sleep and quiet rooms.

author: deero0
title: Great Hotel!
text: The hotel check-in was really quick at the front desk. There were a lot of parking spaces available at this hotel. We checked in to a great room that had a spectacular view of the lake! The room was clean and very spacious. The room offered two sinks with one located inside the bathroom and one in the bathroom access hallway. The location was really convenient with less than a 10-minute drive to the Heavenly resort, 3-minute drive to the grocery store and also a lot of restaurants nearby. The hot tub was a fantastic finish in the night after a long day at Heavenly. We will definitely be coming back!

author: moniquer627
title: Great experience!
text: This was my first time staying at Hotel Azure. I was very impressed starting with the front desk staff, to the room, relaxing spa and easy check out. I called to see if we could check in early and the front desk guy (wish I remembered his name) was kind to let us know there were no rooms but to call back in an hour or come by. We showed up and he was professional, friendly and able to accommodate our 3hr early check in. I loved how modern and clean the room was and the bed and pillows were very comfortable! The location is also great. Right across the lake and a 5 minute drive to the casinos and Heavenly resort. I will definitely stay here again.

author: thedogmomager
title: Pet Friendly & Perfect
text: This was our first time in Lake Tahoe & staying at Hotel Azure made it so memorable. Upon checking in, we were greeted with such friendly & courteous staff. I LOVE that this hotel does not have a weight restriction for dogs as well! We were travelling with our pup & they did everything they could to ensure we were comfortable during our stay. Since it was our first time in Tahoe we weren't sure which area to stay in but this hotel location is so prime, it is practically on the lake! Also if you are travelling with your pup, it is nice to note that directly across the road there is a huge campground where you can take your pups to handle their business, huge score! It was really nice to enjoy the newly renovated rooms..comfortable bed, great size bathroom, patio with views of the lake! Our room was absolutely MASSIVE too! Thanks for the great stay Hotel Azure, we will be back! :) Oh and Jessica is amazing!!

author: texasexes2006
title: Gram’s first trip to Lake Tahoe!
text: We brought my mom to stay at Hotel Azure for four nights over this President’s Day weekend and had a blast! Our room #154, a double queen great room, was on the first floor, facing the pool, and the lake, which was fabulous. It’s super easy to get from the parking lot into the building with their luggage carts and was very spacious. I love that the bathroom is behind the wall of the beds so you can turn on a variety of lights and. It wake everyone. The microwave and mini-fridge (way better than a standard mini-fridge!) are housed in a cabinet beneath the TV and the desk coming off that cabinet had a small coffee maker and chair. There was another table with two chairs that was great to play cards and eat breakfast and snacks at! The air and heat worked perfectly and there’s tons of closet space and towels! We spent hours every day in the heated pool and hot tubs - highlight for my kids (ages 11 and 6). And you can’t beat the location right on Lake Tahoe Blvd near Safeway, CVS, rental shops, and tons of great restaurants.

author: 797divar
title: Dog friendly !
text: Second time I’ve stayed at Hotel Azure. The improvements that were done to place is noticeable and look great. Got there late and front desk wasn’t very warm, but pleasant enough. They are dog friendly and that was the appeal to us. The room were nicely done and the beds clean and comfy. Our only recommendation would be better coffee and better creamers. The powdered stuff is nasty. Overall a good stay.

author: beckysM9542DI
title: Nice Thanksgiving Stay & Dog Friendly
text: We just stayed here Tuesday-Friday for Thanksgiving, in a 1 Bdrm King Suite with Kitchen. This used to be the Inn at the Lake, but has been Re-named and Remodeled with modern furniture, new carpets and paint. Best part was that it was easy to bring our dog with us for an extra $25 per night. Windows are still old and not insulated, there was road noise and a bit of noise from the Hot Tub each night. No breakfast here, but there's lots of diners and restaurants nearby. Lake is across the street, and some of the rooms have a partial lake view through the trees. McDuff's Pub nearby was a great dinner. We would probably stay here again with the dog.

author: dupsib
title: Gracious hotel conviently located...
text: We had a Girl’s Week in So. Lake Tahoe & stayed at Hotel Azure. Couldn’t have been more pleasant. We booked rooms with double queen beds which were super clean & comfortable. Each of our rooms were spacious with balconies & views of the Lake. Easily managed environmental controls kept the room at a comfortable temperature day & night. The only negative was the onsite restaurant; staff, food & lack of room service weren’t that great. But easy access to near by cafes/ restaurants, grocery & Health Food stores and shopping mitigated that small inconvience. Plenty of parking close to each wing of the hotel.

author: s2sonam
title: Peaceful!
text: I loved this stay. Calm and nice. Good room and decently priced. A great hot tub. This one has no resort fee, like many others. Neighbor to south lake city. Hard rock cafe and casinos are near by. Good locale!

author: Skier50
title: Great hotel choice in South Lake Tahoe
text: Great location close to everything, but not quite in the center which we preferred. Fabulous view of Lake Tahoe from our room. Staff very friendly and helpful. King suite was huge and comfortable. Bed was also very comfortable. Suite was modern and clean. On a busy road but with the bedroom to the rear it was quiet in the evening. Nice outside deck off living area. We enjoyed our stay very much and recommend Hotel Azure for a lovely stay in the area.

author: k7333
title: Central location with Beautiful Lake View
text: Friendly welcome staff at check in. The room was nice and clean. Loved the balcony overlooking the lake. Be aware of the road noise, but we were happy to have a nice hotel with a view and it was dog friendly too. We enjoyed the pool, hot tub and fitness room. Lots of restaurants and activities within walking distance. Husband, daughter and I all agreed, it was a beautiful, relaxing stay. Definitely will come here again.

author: S9070QFjacobh
title: The Hoover anniversary
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It was a great and beautiful location. We walked over to the lake. We also walked to the pub, bowling alley and to breakfast. We spent time inside the hot tub also. We utilized the laundry. Everything was very convenient to us. The staff was great and informative when we inquired about things around the area. Even when we drove it was a perfect spot and distance to go either direction.

author: arnoldv8
title: Great location
text: Our room was spectacular. We had a one bedroom suite, which had a very large living room, full sized kitchen, and a balcony with a great view of the lake. It was the perfect room to unwind with a glass of wine or hot chocolate, and stare out at the lake. I was traveling with my parents so having a full sized kitchen to cook our meals saved us a lot of time and money, rather than going out to eat all the time. I'd have to say our room is a lot larger than some people's apartments. And the location was great. Other than having a great view of the lake, which was right across the street, Safeway was a block away so you can load up on groceries and gas. Heavenly ski resort was a few minutes drive away. The main shops and restaurants and even the casino on the Nevada side of the boarder were under a 10 minute drive away. The best part of this hotel was they also accept pets, which is probably the #1 factor and deal breaker when I book a hotel.

author: Mi55yBee
title: Great place to stay
text: Loved this hotel. Was exactly as it stated which is an updated boutique hotel. Stayed in the beautiful king suite. Very spacious. The extra sink outside the bathroom door was a great design feature. We booked directly through the hotel website, paid three weeks in advance and received a wonderful discount which made this stay even more lovely. Hotel is in a great location and staff was very accommodating. Will definitely book here when we return.

author: Dkjaffe282
title: A bit disappointed..
text: I booked this hotel for a quick romantic anniversary / birthday get away and called to make sure that I had a Lakeview / quiet room. I was assured that it had a lake view, but really it was a view of the conference center. Even though the hotel is listed as non smoking, we could smell old smoke in the hall and our room. It is also on the main street and gets quite a bit of traffic noise if you want to open the door to the little balcony. I dropped something on the floor and picked it up with several long blond hairs that I guess the vacuum missed. However the room was a good size and the bed comfortable. The bathroom was great with two sinks which was nice. Honestly if I'd of just got the view I was looking for, I'd of been happier. But not getting either of the things I was looking for kind of bummed me out.

author: 838lydiag
title: Better than expected!
text: We walked in to the lobby of Hotel Azure to book a room for us and two dogs on the same night, because they allowed pets and had good reviews. Staff at the front desk were very kind and helpful, and provided a list of dog-friendly places to eat and visit, and the names/numbers of local veterinarians and pet sitters. They also provide pet beds, bowls, and treats, if needed. The ground-floor rooms had fenced-in patios that would keep a large dog in (anything <40lbs could probably wiggle under the fence), and the levels above had balconies, both of which had some basic patio furniture. Rooms/hotel were exceptionally remodeled - very modern and clean style, and everything was in new condition. Microwave and mini-fridge was convenient. We didn't use the facilities, but the pool and 2-level hot tub looked great, as did the gym and playroom. Price, rooms, staff, grounds, and facilities were all great. I will definitely be back here - with or without my pups!

author: N1740DBmichaelc
title: 35th Wedding Anniversary Trip
text: My husband and I enjoyed our week long stay at Hotel Azure very much. The location was ideal for us because the hotel was located on the outskirts of the busiest parts of Tahoe. We welcomed the ease at which we were able to come and go from the hotel. The elevator was always quick. Parking was no problem. The room was spacious and we enjoyed our third floor view of the lake and mountains. There is traffic noise from the road, but being from Chicago, this did not bother us. Overall, I would definitely recommend Hotel Azure. It worked well for us!

author: nikskat
title: Overall good stay
text: We were just here for a quick overnight stop. I'd been seduced by the view into reserving a lakefront room with a balcony. The sunset was awesome, but I hadn't realized how busy the traffic is on that main road between the hotel and the lake, and it was impossible to enjoy the balcony because of the noise. If we went there again, I'd choose a room further back. Having said that, our room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. The reception staff were friendly and helpful. There's a great little restaurant next door for breakfast. Overall, we liked the hotel-- just not the room I chose!

author: 833jennag
title: Not what I expected but nice overall
text: If you're a couple who is bringing a dog (even a small dog like mine) you need to find a dog sitting place. Which all the ones they recommended didn't even respond to me. Anyhow don't bring your dog here if you wanna use their pool or spa because you can't leave the dog in the room alone nor bring it in the gated pool area. Also when they say "lake view" room they'll screw you over and put you with a view of the pool and spa with dozens of screaming children and people BBQing. Just get a normal room not a view room it is NOT worth it. It's a waste of money. I tried to do something nice for my boyfriend's birthday but instead wasted money. Oh well. I'll be back to tahoe just not this hotel

author: KenfromBalto
title: Very Nice
text: The Azure was a nice place in South Lake Tahoe. Nice location, nice room, everything you could ask for. The room was an updated room (the faucets were cool but it took me a few mins to figure out how to use the shower :-)) with fridge and, I think a microwave. Wifi was free and fast. There's a heated pool and a hot tub and free coffee all day in the lobby. They also had free bike loaners which was great. The staff was VERY friendly and accommodating. I'm bad with names but thanks to the over night guy and to the guy that sent us to MacDuff's (again, my apologies - I'm sure the restaurant was good, we just ordered poorly and, as non-meat eaters, it was a bad choice for us. Don't feel bad recommending it :-). Great location near a park for viewing the sunset and even for getting out of town to the south toward Yosemite.

author: Jd38sam
title: Two night get away
text: This property was formally Inn by the Lake. They have done an excellent job renovating the hotel rooms. They have been gutted and totally redone from carpet, beds, flat screen HD TV, to the whole bathroom. The look is more modern but still kind of rustic feel. The king bed we slept in was extremely comfortable. The one are that HAS NOT been fixed, is the heating and cooling system. We set our thermostat to 68 at night because the room was stuffy and the temp reading inside was 74. The system fan kicked on but no cool air came in even though it was 39 degrees outside. We had a 3rd floor room so I don't know if that made the difference. When I complained, the desk clerk said that is a common problem that has not been fixed yet.

author: 996jeaniem
title: Dog friendly
text: Hotels was nice. Three small pet potty areas. Our room was clean and although it's an older place that has been remodeled it didn't smell old or like pets at all. I'm used to a big hotel so it ws different and smaller but we had a lake view and small balcony for a great price. Best part was that my dog could stay and was welcome. Other ppl had dogs too and they were all well behaved. I never heard dogs in our room, only saw them while out on the property. Nice place for a few days away. The balcony chairs were not comfortable but that's minimal.

author: queengeek
title: Dog-friendly, beautiful hotel on the lake
text: We really lucked out when booking our stay at the Hotel Azure. We were traveling with our dog over spring break, so I used the Bring Fido app to find dog-friendly places to stay. the photos of the Hotel Azure were so gorgeous, and it turned out to be exactly as advertised. It's not really fancy, but tasteful, friendly, cozy, with a fantastic staff and great amenities like a wonderful two-level hot tub, pool, and a game room. We stayed in the 1-bedroom with kitchen, so we saved some $$ cooking some of our meals. The grocery is a short walk. We have a view of the lake, and walking near it, in a grove of redwoods in the morning, is lovely. Can't say enough about how great it was for our family. Thank you, Hotel Azure!

author: hanuiamyc
title: Clean hotel minutes from Heavenly, sleep quality not optimal
text: I just returned from a weekend stay here. The location can't be beat if you're planning on skiing at Heavenly (5 min drive) or Sierra (30 min drive depending on conditions). Right by the water and within walking distance to some South Lake Tahoe favorites (like MacDuff's for dinner). The price was very reasonable, and the furnishing are modern thanks to their new upgrade. Unfortunately the infrastructure is still very old, and the walls were paper-thin. I had a tough time sleeping due to the noise from both sides (hallway and outside). The thermostat was also turned up way too high and I made the mistake of not turning it down & sweat all night :( The room did not have a wine/beer bottle opener nor any utensils/plates, which was inconvenient. Staff at check in & check out was friendly, housekeeping knocked on the door quite early on Saturday (around 9am). Hotel Azure wouldn't be my first pick, but it is definitely a great choice for skiers looking for clean lodgings at a good price.

author: CFitzy_12
title: New and Cozy
text: This was my first time staying here. Check in was quick and easy. Staff very nice. The rooms and lobby are newly renovated and the lake view is great. The room I stayed in had a balcony with a view which was a nice way to end the day. The rooms are spacious, crisp and clean and very inviting. The in-room amenities are high quality, the beds comfortable, the linen crisp and towels are soft. I was in town on business so I enjoyed the location, the ease of parking and close proximity to restaurants. I will definitely be back this summer for leisure with the family.

author: nicolesC5787VW
title: My favorite place to unwind with my dogs after great day of snowboarding!
text: This is the perfect place to chill with the family and dogs. The hot tub and pool are phenomenal... especially in the winter. The staff is personable and responsive. The newly remodeled hotel is stylish and super comfortable. I love how the hotel is dog friendly, and with Lake Tahoe right across the street, you get to walk Fido along the most picturesque landscape! The Bear Beach Cafe is right next door and has delicious and hearty breakfasts to help you power up for a physical day on the mountain. And the wifi is fast and reliable when it is necessary to squeeze in some work between family time.

author: 1974business_trvlr
title: Just ok for the money
text: The room is big enough, the lake views are wonderful (if you get the right room) and the outdoor hot tube is working, but that's were it pretty much ends. The set up is more like condo's. There is no bar; or hotel store to get snacks or coffee (unless you count a lonely Keurig in the reception area) with foam cups. A broken vending machine in my building ate a dollar and gave nothing in return when I tried to buy water. Not the best feeling when I saw a few dark stains on the sheets or someone else's hair on supposedly clean pillow shams. The door to the bathroom would not lock and there was a suspiciously colored large stain on a carpet by the window. The overall impression is that this was repainted and sold as something much better than it really is. Btw, the large sign on the road says whatever the previous name of this hotel was.

author: yvonnep522
title: Nice location.
text: The signs still say "Inn by the Lake". We stayed in a suite = full kitchen with pots, pans and more. Second floor, the middle building = the view of the lake was partially blocked by the Event Center, and another building right on the road. Public Hot Tub = room for 2 people. Pool heated in winter and has flat ends = good for laps. Mattress was too firm for my taste. Walking distance to several restaurants and activities. Room was very clean. 24 hr desk.

title: Not bad for the price...(formerly Inn by the Lake)
text: Spent 3 nights at the hotel in January 2017 during the snow storm. The renovations were evident and the hotel is worth staying at for the price. The cost was only $115.00 per night! Thats a deal in South Lake Tahoe for a decent hotel. The room was adequate in size and the renovations were 'Tahoe themed.' This used to be the Inn by the Lake but along with the renovations came the name change to Hotel Azure. It's a quaint hotel located about 5 minutes (less than 2 miles) from Heavenly Valley. If you're looking for a bargain price in a decent hotel, you can't go wrong with this one. The additional upside is the friendly staff...they make you feel welcomed and are accommodating.

author: Chimata-no-kami
title: Nice but Should be Kept in Perspective
text: Let's be clear - this is a nice motel, not a "hotel". It is a big plus that it has just been refurbished, so things are still nice and clean, one has to wonder how the upkeep will develop over time. Although clean, the interior design is a bit too gray/drab for my taste, and the materials are kind of cheap, but commensurate with a motel status. The service is spotty, they seem genuinely to try hard, but one day they completely forgot to replenish toiletries, and when I asked for a TV technician. it took 2 calls to get him. The location was great for me, relatively close to the CA side of Heavenly, across from the lake, and good restaurant choices within walking distance (#1 and #4 on Tripadvisor). The real upside for my stay was the price - $138/day on MLK holiday weekend. I've got this rate with Heavenly directly, I think it was $185 and up on travel sites. This is the bottom line: if one can get this for a reasonable price, it's well worth it, but if it gets close to $200 and above, it's a bit overpriced.

author: Ttttttttttttt7
title: Great value and very thoughtful customer service!
text: I booked at Azure because it was a great price for what you get (updated rooms, location, pet friendly, kitchenette). I turned out my child got sick the morning of travel and we had to cancel, but the room rate was non-refundable since it's the high season. I called them and explained my situation, and they granted me a courtesy refund anyway. I really appreciate that; you don't see friendliness very often these days. Some other hotels only care about fees and revenue - getting as bad as the airlines. But not Azure fortunately. I will return the favor by staying with them for all my future Tahoe trips. Thanks again!

author: matg2017
title: Blown Away
text: I was absolutely blown away by the level of professionalism and humble personalities on my stay on 1/6/17. I Spoke with Ryan and was extremely professional and well informed. He answered all of my questions with complete confidence prior to booking my reservation. After searching for the best rates in the area, I spoke with Amy whom was very polite and was very attentive. Both Amy and Ryan were very knowledgeable. Based on My Experience, I enjoyed working with what seemed to be the most professional people in the hospitality business. Upon my arrival, Alex was very welcoming and took the time to explain all information once checked in for billing. I am very satisfied with my stay. If the excellent service wasn't reason enough to stay, The Updates to this establishment and rooms are superb. I will be staying here every chance I get when i visit South Lake Tahoe.

author: ront313
title: Spacious, Affordable, and Convenient Location
text: My companion and I revisited the Copacabana for a second time. A smaller type of room this time, but the two room suite was more than spacious. The only issue was the lack of air conditioning in the sitting room/kitchen area, which is the larger of the two rooms. Fortunately, our room this time was not facing EDSA, so it was much quieter than the first visit. While the wifi is not free, I found it to be reliable and reasonably priced for my needs. The location near the Mall of Asia with an infinite number of good restaurants within a 15 taxi ride, is great. In addition, it was possible to arrange a car at the front door, rather than a taxi, which was very convenient for an early morning trip to the airport. Given the hotel's proximity While the free breakfast is very basic, it is similar to the offerings at similar hotels. If it is not enough, the restaurant offers additional ala carte offerings. Between the large rooms and the location, the Copacabana will likely be my go to hotel for my future visits to Manila.

author: artfrommanila
title: Nice place Mean Food
text: Went to meet a friend who was staying there and to have lunch. Had a ham and cheese sandwich. Still trying to find the cheese. Bread was so thin and Ham was so low quality. We were the only guests at the poolside restaurant the time but if we required something we had to go find a waiter to get it. Staff. however, were very friendly and if you did not mind the overhead noisy aircraft the ambience was good. Please give better value though for your food orders

author: LGSK82
title: First stayed here 1986
text: Have stayed here each time we have been in Manila. The building looks old but all the rooms, in the last two years, have been renovated. We stay in a one bedroom suite. The main room is large and comprises of a kitchen, lounge and dinning area. The bedroom is also large with wardrobes, marble dressing bench queen size bed and ensuite. The restaurant is on the pool deck and has a good menu. The staff are ALL polite and friendly. Location is great, close to Mall of Asia and the airport.

author: lendus2015
title: My transit hotel
text: Hotels in Manila can be either cheap or expensive. This one is one of the few that is in the meddle. The cheaper hotels are usually dirty or don't have Windows in the rooms. The expensive hotels don't really give you the bang for your buck. This hotel in clean and the higher up you are the better the view. Plus the price of about 40.00 to 60.00 USD, you can't do better for your money. Oh! Just 15 minute straight walking distance to Mall Of Asia and Manila Bay resturants and bars.

author: 25juliee
title: 2 days with no WiFi
text: Located on one of the busiest roads in Manilla but good for getting around. The 1 bedroom was large but no free water and the balcony faced onto the road. Please note the balcony is standing room only with no furniture. The room was clean and bed comfortable with good aircon. If traffic noise affects your sleep you may not want a room facing the EDSA! The pool and surrounds were clean. We ate out so didn't try the Café. What surprised me the most with this Hotel is no free WiFi anywhere (not even Lobby!) (you have to pay), no free water and breakfast not included! Think the Copacabana will have to up their game as there plenty, and I mean plenty, of other Hotels which would include these in the price of your stay.

author: Niko_sta
title: After long flights
text: Hotel is close to Airport, big plus in Manila and it`s horrible traffic troubles. Very clean and security good. Pool area and restaurant very fine. Smoking rooms available. Suite room was spacious. 2000 pesos deposit to mini bar items,.irritating! Can not be swiped with credit/depit card and mostly this hotel is mostly to visiorts arriving into country without pesos. Very slow check in and check out. Traffic close to hotel is really heavy,.pollution too! Smoke and dust everywhere.

author: 927kentk
title: Not great despite good location
text: I checked in here late on my first night in Manila. Had a flight early the next day so the location was right. For me the biggest thing is a hot shower. This hotel was unable to provide that. The room itself is old and outdated. The staff was friendly but that's about where the good ends. The room was big and had potential, a hot shower would have given them 3/5. I ended up staying at the Heritage Hotel on my last night there which was just beside it and it had a hot shower so that is where I would stay next time.

author: gregorian43
title: My fifth stay at this establishment
text: Being in manila on business with my wife for one day I was delayed .so Phoned the Copa where we have previously stayed.Fortunately, they had a vacancy in one of their suites. As always the staff was friendly and helpful. the room was clean and comfortable. Dinner at the restaurant was excellent and well priced. We needed a very early start in the morning. which was no problem? We checked out at 3 am a bellboy was there on time to collect our bags and take them to our car. I'll stay there again next trip. They are not the cheapest place in manilla but the service makes the cost acceptable.

author: tincoll
title: Great Hotel, Central to All
text: Very nice hotel in the middle of everything. Walking distance to Mall of Asia and across the road from the EDSA entertainment complex. Rooms are older but comfortable and large. The price is very good for the rooms. Room service was excellent. I suggest the Pork Sinigang. Amazing! Well worth the money.

author: 404reinierk
title: Overprced underserviced.
text: We needed a pet friendly hotel, it was first class in every way, even the price, what I was disappointed with was the disproportionate price you have to pay for having pets, its like your pets are their price hostage. Without pets its easy to find the same service for 1/3 the price elsewhere. Then the internet left us speechless. 100 pesos per hour, not a total of one hour usage, but starting the minute you activate your card. Then the phone left us wowed too, local calls charged by the minute, i did no write down the rate we simply used our cellphone. The mini bar, priced almost 3x the local prices. The staff were so good they almost made up for the nickle and dimeing done in such an expensive hotel. It cost us 2 adults and 2 Pomeranians, 336.58CDN for 3 nights. We found the restaurant also highly over priced, the pool does not come free that also addon price. I do want to end by saying the staff were amazing, very helpful, very kind, they did their hotel proud.

author: 958charliei
title: Not so good!
text: Used this hotel few times already as it is near to airport and SM MOA. But never again. Weather condition was very hot and Aircondition was not working properly. Paid for a bucket if ice to compensate the heat. 3 hours after check in room was still terrible as aircondition unit still not working. Offered if they could change the aircondition unit. What a hussle. Force to change room. We were ask to pay for the mini bar even though never use it. What a rip off.

author: frencelh2016
title: Pure Business. Money first before your comfortability
text: Though the staffs were helpful and approachable, what they see to their guests were money. Every single thing you will ask them, always corresponds money. I arrived from a 15 hour flight and was sooooooo tired only to find out I was on an early check-in (and I need to pay). They want me to pay right away before I will be settled in my room. So I waited so long in the front desk while she's calculating how many hours I arrived and before my check in time, printed receipts, waited for the room to be cleaned and let me go in the room. Perhaps, they could just let the guest rest first. We will not run because obviously we are too tired. Even the concierge don't want to go not unless you will pay them.

author: Morninglight
title: Careful with who you book with!
text: The hotel room was satisfactory, tv old, and channels snowy at times...only complaint is with the booking company Asiatravel.com. The room advertised for 1803 peso which was fine, however, after giving my credit card my final cost 4800 peso with no acconting for the others expenses that were blindly added on. Contact number in Singapore no longer in service to cancel the transaction and email not responded too till next day. When I arrived at hotel, no booking. Hotel able to access Asiatravel.com who informed me I have to put room on my credit card till they investigate as the address doesn't match. Also stated if it was their problem the room will be free as they would refund my card. It has been five days and no word from the booking company regarding the end result of an overpriced room and their hidden costs when booking hotels with them. Lesson here is use Agoda...great service, and pricing.

author: TravelerFromDenmark
title: A good hotel for the money.
text: A good hotel for the money. It is centrally located and just a short drive from the airport. The cleaning is always in order, but you must remember to ask for sufficient toilet paper. The standard is reasonable, yet there is always something wrong with the drain or toilet in the comfortroom - or to the aircondtioning or television. As soon as one contacts the receptions in these matters, then quickly one or more technicians comes and corrects the errors. I have been to this hotel a number of times, and apparently it is the hotels standard procedure to first rectify errors when guests point out these. The swimming pool and the area around it is fine. The pool is cleaned every morning. It is nice to sit and eat and drink outside the restaurant just besides the pool.

author: Charlemagne92
title: Still one of the best option close to airport
text: We stayed here 2nd and 3rd of December when I picked up my sister in the airport. The rooms are now upgraded where in I was really surprised because all the kitchen utensils are brand new. We have been staying here since I was a child when we have relatives coming from abroad. What I really like about the place apart from being affordable is the fast check in and check out process. You can still cook your own food; the staff are still very courteous and polite. The only problem I had was when we had our breakfast on the 2nd day I have requested the waiter to bill our room instead. I was surprised when they came up and knocked our room while we are about to rest again asking us to pay for a 485 php bill? Also please renovate the pool and lessen the chlorine as it is very painful in the eyes. And the wifi is exorbitant ; it is really insane to charge a customer for the internet like 6,500 a night and yet you cannot give a complimentary internet?

author: SunshineCoastFamily
title: Pirates
text: Shabby hotel in general. Neighborhood very scary. Mostly surrounded by sex hotels. Beware, most of the cheap hotels in this part of Manila are sex hotels but you would not know from the listings on agoda,etc. We booked a family of three but they would only give us one bed. staff was uncaring and rude.The worst part was the wifi charges. They bill several dollars an hour for basic internet and you could easily pay half your room cost again just to keep in touch. I would most definitely give this hotel and the whole area a pass.Look in makati area for safety and value.

author: GoulburnSkydiver
title: Great location, comfortable room, nice staff ...
text: I spent 4 nights at this hotel. It is located about 20 minutes from the airport depending on traffic. The room was huge, more like a suite, mine included a full kitchen and dining room, clean and comfortable. Check in/out was fast and efficient. Huge swimming pool and lovely restaurant. Easy walking distance to local bars etc but be very careful crossing the road outside, Manila traffic is notoriously bad. Short taxi ride to the massive Mall of Asia. Overall a comfortable hotel in a convenient location at a reasonable price.

author: tinadulay
title: Copacabana family stay
text: My second time in this hotel. We stayed here to fetch mother from the airport from her London visit.....rested for one day and one night before heading to our tagaytay-laguna-batangas adventure. It is near the airport, near MOA. I like the location, the place is clean and the family suite was great and we can even cook our food. The kids enjoyed the pool which was a view from our room, 1 floor down. The guards are doing a good job guarding and monitoring people in and out of the hotel. The staff are considerate and approachable. hotel rate is justifiable. I would love to come back to this hotel in the future.

author: 439BrianB
title: Great Hotel Close to NAIA Airport
text: We stayed one night at the Copacabana Apartment Hotel after checking it last time in Manila. It was set up with all you needed for a long term stay, large refrigerator, two burner electric cook top, cutlery, crockery etc. The kitchen/lounge/dining area is separate to the bedroom and makes it a real home away from home. TV could have been updated but still worked OK with a lot of cable channels to choose from. Location is close to all the airport terminals with a taxi fare approximately P250 to P300 to and from the hotel. Didn't try the restaurant or pool but i would imagine that they would be OK. Their are a few places to eat close by but be a but cautious walking the streets of a night time. Definitely will stop here again if i need to stay in Manila.

author: DougH526
title: You tend to get what you pay for
text: I've stayed at the Copacabana Apartment - Hotel many times. I use it as a convenient stop-over on my way somewhere else. I stay there for the proximity to the airport and the Mall of Asia, but mostly for the price. It's a decent hotel with 3-star amenities. Room service is good, the pool is accessible, the kitchens are nice addition and I've always been treated satisfactorily. I recommend the Copacabana Apartment - Hotel. If you want 5-star, please, just go to the Raffles Makati: it's out of this world. However, to save a fistful of pesos, keep your expectations low and enjoy the great location of the Copacabana.

author: 976RichardK
title: An unexpected Gem
text: I originally booked this hotel as a cheap hotel near the airport and I was expecting no more than a room. BUT on arrival I was I was pleasantly surprised and amazed. The Copacabana is very well appointed, with a very friendly staff, great amenities. The pool was a great surprise as well. Near the mall of Asia and in the middle of local life and color. But be sure if wandering around the local markets keep a hand on your wallet and an eye on the surroundings, safe for most but not for all. As with most places if you know what to look for you will be ok. Booked a studio they upgraded me to a standard - same price! Air con onl in bedroom but an extremely large kitchen / sitting area.

author: johnno46
title: last visit here
text: to say i was disappointed would be an understatement. i had stayed at copa suites several times in the last 8 years and always left with a lasting impression of the service and value for money. well this time i left not only vowing never to return but also a lot poorer. first off no adaptor supplied for foreign visitors ( but they will hire you one ) laundry charges so high it is cheaper to go to the market and buy new shirts and shorts and wait for it : yes they even charge you for WI - FI. also this is the only hotel i stayed at that did not supply free bottles of water usually 2 each in other hotels. the hotel is old and in need of repair in some areas. on the up side the staff are still very helpfull and polite and the bell boys and security are the best. to sum up i would not recomend this hotel to my friends as value for money any more. 65 peso for 15 mins wi - fi after staying for a week. GGGRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR

author: r6rider_58
title: 3 Nights in Manila
text: Copacabana is handy to the airport, so if you are just passing through then its an ideal place to stay. The building is old but clean and the staff, like most Filipinos, are very friendly and accomadating. I was on the 11th floor an at the back of the building, which is good as i was away from the constant street noise. An interesting thing about the 11th floor, the elevator only goes to the 10th??? Apparently, sometime ago the floor was added but the elevator wasnt extended. Wifi should be freee. Most places these days offer free wifi and for the price you pay they should offer it. Handy to the Mall of Asia and public transport is easy to catch, from taxis, trains, jeepnees etc. Not the flashes hotel but its clean and comfortable and i would stay there again for a short period.

author: grizzdbear
title: 200p from Airport and just the place you want for rest.
text: I stayed here at the beginning and the end of my month long trip to Phils and I would recommend. As a travel 'newbie' I got stung 1200p for my first cab ride from the Airport to the Copa (you learn quickly) but once there was not disappointed. Staff are friendly AND professional. Rooms are essentially very clean and stylish furnished studio or one bed Apartments with cooking facilities and fridge and represent value. The higher the room the less traffic noise and bedrroms only have A/c but that doesn't detract. The Pool is worth the plunge but I did not eat in. Just round the corner from the Copa I recommend Kenny Rogers for breakfast. Als just around the corner is the 'FRANTIC' Baclaran Market which sets the scene and tests all of the senses for the rest of your stay in Manila. The Copa is a haven for rest in busy Manila.

author: 112KurtM
title: Clean, welcoming and good location!
text: I have been staying at the Copa several times a year for several years. The location cannot be beat for overnights in Manila. The staff is always very welcoming. The rooms are very basic, but clean! Recently the hotel added wifi to the rooms (need to buy credit at the front desk) which has added to points for staying here. This isn't a 3 or 4 star hotel, but for what it is .... a clean, inexpensive hotel ... its very good!

author: Michael_Asombrado
title: old but still very serviceable apartment hotel
text: We stayed here on a short layover on our way to Taipei. The hotel is dated but still very serviceable. The rates are cheap but the value is more than expected. It has newly refurbished rooms and excellent room service. Staff are friendly and very helpful and the location is perfect for short stays and for lay-overs since it is near the airport. It is near to the Mall of Asia as well. They also have a salon and massage clinic as well. They also maintain a pool on the 2nd floor. Overall, a good place to spend your lay-overs. I will definitely stay here again.

author: amosanderson50
title: Overall Good
text: Arrived at the hotel very early morning (past 1am) of December 27, 2012 from NAIA (ride is about around 10mins). Took no more than 20mins to check in. Our room faced EDSA in the middle floors and yes, the traffic noise woke me up at around 5am and was never able to go back to sleep. But I was also excited since I have not been home in 3years. Room is clean and spacious. There is no 24hr room service as the site says. The airport transport has also increased to Php1000 instead of Php800. Overall my one night stay is good. I may choose other hotels if needed on my next trip only to see and experience other hotels.

author: Angelo_The_Explorer
title: Was Ok for a night!
text: Before flying overseas, we decided to stay at this place for a night because we do not want to miss our early flight. The location is perfect for those who are looking for a convenient and near location to the airport found the place a bit old looking compare to other hotels but nicely maintained. The staffs were not as bad as I thought. Very accommodating and did their job well. The room we stayed in was very nice and clean. Simple but you have everything there. The bed and linens were average. It's ok for a night. Nice shower area and the pressure of the water was good and was able to shower nicely. In general, this place for me is average.

author: Hanif-Moksin
title: the hotel was great but only....
text: im from brunei and i went here just to have some rest for a day cause my family there will fetch us up on the other day after. first i went to deposit about USD10 a week before we go to Manila and yes, the management responded very very fast which is very good for me. we arrived at Ninoy airport around 4am so we took a taxi to copacabana hotel. arrived at the hotel at 4.37am so my fiance did the check and it took like 30 minutes for the management of the hotel to allow us in. they provided us the suites and it was very big, i did satisfy with the room but they did gave me extra charges for the extra single bed and yes, there is no wifi so we have to bought the card, well its worth cause the connection was good. and one little problem, they didnt give any free breakfast. the location was good, near baclaran and near to the mall of asia. overall, if you want to stay here for shopping and budget hotel, this is it. enjoy!! maraming salamat po.

author: jonas80june
title: terrible front desk ladies...very terrible
text: all i can say is.... front desk staff are terrible... they're discourteous... they don't know the meaning of total customer satisfaction... ok the hotel, in my overall rating is very good... clean and spacious room and comfortable at that... but really the saddest part of my stay is the front desk ladies... they're really mean and should i say bad... I hope the management will have a seminar for their staff specially those front desk ladies... really....

author: ronrush
title: For the budget conscious
text: Copacabana is a very old hotel and I chose this hotel because I was attending a convention in Manila for a week with a tight budget. This hotel is in Pasay and is very near to Mall of Asia and SMX Convention Center. However, it is not going to be a fun walk so you will still have to take a taxi. The mattresses are bad - no lumbar support and gave me a terrible backache every morning. But since the rooms were cheap, I did not expect fantastic rooms anyway. Checking-in at the reception was a good experience as the Front Desk allowed me to check in at 7am as I arrived really early in Manila. I am thankful that they allowed me to check in so early without any extra surcharges so that I can catch up with my sleep after a red-eye flight. This hotel is very near the airport. If you do not have budget constraints, I would advise you to choose Makati Greenbelt areas because Pasay is quite chaotic and messy....

author: jimlasbury
title: Only worth an overnight stay
text: The rooms are well presented and the equipment fairly standard for the other apartment hotels I've stayed in. The fridge is equipped with a few mini bar style drinks but is easily large enough to accommodate your own stuff too. The windows are only single glazed so the noise from the main road below is loud and pretty constant all night (or it was from the 4th floor). Also there is added noise from occasional low flying aircraft. Poolside room service is until 10pm but there are some fast food joints (McDonalds/Roasters/KFC) and a 7-11 5 mins walk away if you get in later. The business centre which states it is open from 9am wasn't open by 9.30am when we stayed. Also one of the 2 lifts was out of order. Due to the noise and location I would say that this is only worth an overnight stay.

author: aimes66
title: Good hotel near airport
text: We stayed at the hotel for one night only in between flights to and from Manila. It was perfect for our needs. Close to the airport considering we had an early flight in the morning. The room was large to accomodate our luggage. The air-conditioning worked well in our room. During our very short stay in Manila we were also able to visit the Mall of Asia as it was closeby. If we had more time it would have been nice to go for a swim in the pool. For the price that we paid we were very impressed.

author: mfthopesch
title: Good for transfer and budget
text: In terms of value for money a very good hotel, paid 40 USD for a very clean and spacy room. Hotel looks a bit 'frightening' (i.e. old and rund down) at the lobby and in the hallways but the rooms are fine and spotless. Some complain about the noise...yes, true, but if you want a quiet hotel with all the anemnities then you have pay 2 times more. Also stayed at the Shangri-La. Of course much better...but again: in terms of value for money if you just stay for a night when you fly in or out, it's okay. Location is not that bad, there are in fact not many good locations in Manila. It's close to the great Asia Mall. Some people complain it's in a poor area...u, well, the Philippines are a developping country, shall they ship out the poor for you?

author: driftdiver1
title: close to mall of asia
text: Contact information 264 EDSA Extension Pasay City, Manila. www.copasuites.com {--} With no kitchenette, the Studio apartment (2,300p) is more like a hotel room than apartment. It does have a stocked minibar and coffee/tea making for a fee. The 1-bedroom units (2,500p) have fully equipped kitchenettes, though no microwave. The standard 1 bedroom has only 1 A/C in the bedroom so the living room gets quite hot. For an additional 1,000p the deluxe 1 bedroom has a second A/C in the living room. All units have enclosed shower with excellent hot water in both the shower and sink. No complimentary water is provided Street noise is quite noticeable even on the top floor of the hotel There is a outdoor pool with lounge chairs on second floor where the small indoor/outdoor restaurant is located as well as a beauty salon. The hotel is within walking distance of the Mall of Asia (though not recommended in the noon-day sun), Baclaran street market, several fast food restaurants including a Kenny Rodgers Roaster, and is next door to the Heritage Hotel which has a nice but expensive Japanese restaurant. Hotel staff are generally accommodating, though I do not like being asked my room number by the guard every time that I left the hotel.

author: dusthoek
title: Nice and clean, but loud.
text: The rooms were spacious, clean, and well-priced. The pool looked nice and clean. The restaurant had very good breakfast. The main problem is the location. It's convenient in that it's near the airport and Mall of Asia, but it's very loud at night. The hotel is right at a very busy intersection, and if you know Manila, you know that constant horn honking is the norm at all hours. Lucky for me, I was so jet-lagged, I didn't even notice. But I recommend earplugs to anyone staying there.

author: jp2000b
title: good room, bad location
text: Located 1km of Mall of Asia. Along a very busy main road, terribly polluted, 10 strokes! Even at the 11th floor (the last one), at the side, you can hear the cars and horns. Good room, clean, 2200 pesos. Internet: 100 pesos per hour!! but I could find a free one from another hotel, but weak signal (PPC1). There is a swimming pool outside, at the back: looks fine. OK for 1 night if you have to take the plane next morning, not far from the airport

author: Lioness64
title: Good Hotel, noisy location
text: We stayed three nights, in a two bedroom suite. We were located on the 4th floor, and perhaps if we had been higher up it would of been better. Overall everything in the hotel was fine. It was clean and had everything we needed. My only complaint was the noise from the street. Our room was facing the street, and the constant tooting of horns didn't let up at all, and i really didn't sleep well over those three nights. You get your money's worth, with our total cost at around AU$300 for the three nights. The internet didn't work in the room, so we sat at the entrance which was comfortable enough. The cafe was very nice and we had breakfast each morning and one night, dinner. I'd stay again, but in a room at the rear or higher up.

author: Batboy00
title: Good Value for the Price
text: We stayed for 2 nights and had a very pleasant stay. We stayed nearby on our way to Boracay and we were greatly disappointed with our stay at Mabuhay Manor which is near by. The room size was great and we had a separate bedroom from the living area which is what we needed for our 23month old so he could sleep while we stayed up. The A/C unit is only in the bedroom so if you have the bedroom door shut the living area can get warm but was still ok for us. The kitchen was very functional. A microwave would have been handy but there were so many options around the corner and Mall of Asia is very close as well so we didn't really use the kitchen. The cabs out the front will charge you set rates. The normal cabs will also try and charge you set rates. If you walk the minute next door there are always cabs at the Heritage and the ones we had would always use the meters. For example a driver tried to charge us 200PHP to get to MOA when with a meter it's 50PHP.

author: Road802858
title: A Decent Lay-Over Hotel While Waiting For Your Flight
text: I stayed one night, October 22, 2006, in room # 1106. I paid 1,800 Peso's. This was a lay-over hotel for me, while I was awaiting a flight the next morning, from Manila up to Naha, Okinawa Japan. The hotel was nice enough for one night. The room was alright, one large queen size bed along with a single bed. The bed was comfortable enough. The only strange incidence was that the elevator, only went to the tenth floor, after we(bell-hop) got of the elevator, I had to climb another set of stairs to get to my room. Weird. I rate this hotel at a hard two stars. It'll do while waiting for a flight outta Dodge.

author: kanotraveler
title: A Decent Hotel in Metro Manila
text: I found this hotel surprisingly nice in reference to accommodations. The service was above average and the room decent...although the noise from the streets was a bit much at times. There was a lot of space in the room...I gather that is part of the feature of the hotel being classified as a dual hotel/apartment. The restaurant is located adjacent to the swimming pool and has good food and excellent service. The location of the hotel is central to almost anything that you might want to do while visiting Metro Manila. The drive from the airport is approximately 15 minutes during non-peak times, but allow a much longer time when traveling during rush hour. Conveniently located to restaurants, banks and clubs... a short walk takes you to the casino at the Heritage Hotel, if gambling suits your desires.

author: Stu_x81
title: Lovely staff, rooms tired and dated
text: Quick pit stop for a family of four en route home from Cornwall. Upon arrival it was obvious this is one of the older style Premier Inns. The room itself looked a bit tired and dated and we immediately noticed a damp, musty smell which turned out to be emanating from the bathroom. On closer inspection, some of the wooden panelling seemed to be rotting with age which I believe was the source of the smell. It wasn't horrendous but it was enough to make me get out of bed and close the bathroom door. The bathtub itself had a chip in the enamel, presumably were something has been dropped on it in the past, and the extractor fan was noisy and looked old. On the plus side, the staff were very helpful and had left treats for our children hidden in the room, which was a lovely touch and not something I've experienced at a Premier Inn previously. Unfortunately, as nice as the staff were, this place could really do with a refresh as I don't consider it value for money in its present state.

author: WorksopBlue
title: Exactly what you expect from Premier Inn
text: Great location, close to M5 and opposite shopping centre and large costa coffee. Given a lovely spacious corner room on the ground floor with air-con! (See previous review). Receptionist very friendly even though i checked in late. Free parking a bonus. Nice pub next door that did a good breakfast. Would definitely use again as a ‘stop off’ on the way to the South West. Just what a Premier Inn should be!

author: Starbeck-Traveller
title: Unusual circumstances dealt with very well
text: Arrived as a party of 5 needing a family room and a disabled room of which we needed a wet room attached to the latter. Upon check in the rooms were allocated but unfortunately the beds in the disabled room were the wrong height. Communicated back with ‘Aga’ on reception of whom took control of the situation and very politely suggested we go for our tea and in the meantime she would sort. Had food at the Brewers Fayre next door in the meantime taking advantage of the ‘meal deal’ that saved us a couple of quid and was tasty and more than satisfactory. Returned back to the hotel for ‘Aga’ to advise there were multiple options available to us and whichever way she would find a solution. Room selected with us being allowed to use the facilities of the wet room the next day of which ticked all boxes. The great outcome of this visit (this will sound like a training course) is that it is how you deal with a complaint and resolve it to the best of your ability and what you have available. Top marks to Aga, very rare I get an employees name but I am very impressed so made the effort to put her name in lights. Great job Gloucester Business Park Premier Inn 👍

author: lennster1975
title: No actual reason to give it 4
text: I stayed here for 2 nights was booked by my company . I found the place warm and comfortable. Rooms were clean and tidy. Check in was fast and efficient . I didn't have breakfast here but as a tip a short morning walk down to Tesco 5 minutes approx . It's half the price . Anyway there was nothing wrong with the stay and the is plenty of outlets local to here to eat and drink. It's also quiet for a business park

author: 122cateh
title: Ideally situated off the M5
text: On arrival we were greeted with a smile from the lady on reception and after the journey we had was very welcome. Check in was a breeze. The room was spacious and very clean, which has always been the case no matter which Premier Inn we have visited. The house keeping standards are always very high. The bed was extremely comfortable. Wasn't disturbed by any traffic noise. The meal in the adjacent Brewyers Fayre was absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection and served by friendly waiters. This was our second visit and will definetly be calling again.

author: Daviesgoddards
title: Good stopover
text: This Is a good location if you need a stopover near the M5. There are great facilities nearby such as a Tesco, Dominoes, Subway, Costa as well as the Brewers Fayre. I was initially allocated a room that directly overlooked a very busy roundabout. There was no way I would have been able to sleep through that level of noise so I asked for a room at the back which the receptionist sorted out promptly. There were no issues with this room, a little tired looking but spotless and comfortable. The breakfast the next day was great value for money . My stay overall was really good however had I checked in later on and there had been no quiet rooms left, this would have been a different story. For this reason I would hesitate to use again unless I knew I was going to be able to check in early enough to get a quiet room.

author: susanlH9179IW
title: Good Friday stay
text: Stayed good Friday for one night to shop and eat same as we did last year. Friendly welcome from Darek. Given room 10. Spotless room, large enough with fluffy towels and so comfortable bed. Easter card on bed with small packet of chocolate eggs, nice touch. Easy to find, great location with free parking and plenty of nearby shops for supplies. Very enjoyable stay once again. This is an older premier inn but very clean and was told both hotel and restaurant is due a refurbishment. Good breakfast next door at brewers gayer, see separate review.

author: lin34
title: oasis in the snow
text: Caught in the recent heavy snow pulled in for overnight accommodation. Receptionist (Kath) was everything a good receptionist should be. She was a star. Nothing too much trouble. Made our stay very pleasurable. Room clean, tidy and comfortable. The Whittle (Brewers Fayre) was great for our evening meal and breakfast the following morning. Again very pleasant staff. This Premier is in an ideal location for access to the M5.

author: Primms60
title: Excellent Staff!!!!!!
text: We are regular premier Inn customers...everywhere we go we use premier inns because we know the standard will be good. We stayed there Boxing Day whilst visiting relatives and we were very very impressed with the reception staff there. A lady called Catherine gave us such a nice welcome, she is definately an asset to you. The following morning we were due to stay another night but due to heavy snow we decided to cut our stay short and check out early. Again the receptionist ( Chloe) was very very helpful and gave us a refund for the day we did not use....this was totally unexpected and very much appreciated! Again Chloe was extremely professional and helpful. The actual room was not as up to date as our preceding stay at Emersons green but the staff and service more than made up for that. Well done on your hospitality staff...we will return.

author: MargaretMasson
title: you know what your getting
text: The premier inn was 'nice and basically it does what it says on the tin. It was clean and tidy with had a brewer's fayre next door for an ok me a. Staff were nice and pleasant but we're trying hard to upsell breakfast £8.99 and dinner. The room has 2 sockets that you can use above the desk. In this day and age its really not enough. I require a socket by the bed for a cpap machine for sleep apnoea. For some unknown reason my husband had an extension cord in the car so was able to use it. Overall pleasant enough stay but stop with the hard sell,

author: wotsit64
title: Very clean, service with a smile
text: Came for a one night stay with my family a couple of weeks ago (across a couple of rooms). Very clean rooms and up to, if not exceeding, premiere inn’s usual standards. Very affordable rooms and when we came to check in there was a lady at the desk who was absolutely lovely and helped us with our free parking. We also had breakfast in the adjoining pub which was actually one of the best fry ups for a while! Really nice and fresh. SUCH a good price and plentiful . Continental was fab as well. Definitely use again!

author: c1derapple
title: Very nice - room position makes a difference
text: Can't fault a premier inn (usually) and this was no exception. Staff were the usual courteous standard, helpful in the extreme. The room was also the usual mix of furniture and amenities.
