The only MINOR let down was the room position which was towards the front overlooking one of two busy roundabouts, which meant there was quite s bit of noise from 7.30am and beyond meaning I did not get much of a lie in on a Saturday morning. If I had been yo the rear it would have been quieter. Noise like this is beyond the control of the hotel and midweek would not have been am issue. There us a 1 .unite walk to a Brewer Fayre pub, 2 minutes to Costa and 4 minutes to an enormous Tesco's. All in all I would be happy to stay there again.

author: bodders01
title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed here after travelling back from Scotland via Newcastle on our way back to Dorset. It was a 300 mile drive and when we arrived at the hotel we were greeted by a nice friendly man who checked us in and offered to book us a table at the pub next door. We did not eat there as we were meeting up with friends but it was nice to be offered this option. The room was pretty much the same as most family rooms with a king size bed and 2 single beds all of which were very comfortable. The Hotel was very clean and tidy throughout and the front desk was attended all the time. The breakfast at the pub was prepaid and was all buffet style and although it was very busy and the staff seemed a little flustered they were helpful and showed us to our table and showed us where everything was. To be fair I think it was exceptionally busy with pre booked tables and also a lot of people just turning up as it was Fathers Day but the staff seem to handle it well. The only reason I have not rated it Excellent is due to the fact that a member of staff in the hotel reception was parked in a disable bay which I find very frustrating being disabled myself I find this very inconsiderate.

author: floydy1998
title: Extremely unfriendly night staff, (JOBSWORTH)
text: We were disturbed in one of the night staff, we had just got back from a night out, he said we were knocking on the doors of guests but we were actually badly wanting sleep, everyone was whispering and walking on tip toes. He knocked on all of our rooms and was talking loudly and causing more of a problem than us. We decided to go downstairs and talk as we didn't want to wake anyone up, i think we cared about how your guests slept more than him. We went downstairs and he phoned the police because we 'woke everyone in the building up'. We listened to the phone call, he was shouting to the police and they didn't want to know because it wasn't an emergency so they gave him a reference number and ended the call on him. I am disappointed by this staff members actions, it was very, extremely unprofessional. We complained to the staff in the morning and they helped with the situation and reused us that it wasn't just us, they have had a lot of complaints about this man. They said he's a 'jobsworth'. When I eventually got to sleep, the bed was comfortable but only had 4-5 hours sleep due to this problem, and having to check out the room at 12:00. With this said, I am a very under satisfied customer.

author: vbullough
title: A true Yorkshire review
text: I chose to break my journey from Penzance to Halifax with an overnight stop in this Premier Inn (£31 as booked well in advance). As usual with Premier Inns I was not disappointed. Easy to find and located next to a Brewers Fayre with a large Tesco store and petrol station across the way. Free parking as long as you collect a pass for the dashboard from reception. Pleasant staff. Nice room. No noise and adequate facilities. Had a nice dinner in the Brewers Fayre but took breakfast in Tesco! Would not hesitate to stay here again :-)

author: 898tinah
title: Good basic hotel
text: Spent two nights here. Typical of Premier Inn's. Clean and tidy. Very friendly and helpful staff. Had breakfast and dinner in the allied pub. All fine as well. Parking straight outside the hotel which was free on collection of a parking voucher. Really close to a Tesco and other shops.

author: Sharon362
title: Ideal for everything
text: We stopped at this Premier Inn as it was half way through our Journey to Taunton and was literally off the M5. There are signs in the car park of the Premier Inn that you have to pay but if you are a Premier Inn Guest you will get given a car park ticket which will cover your stay so there is no extra charge. There is a Pub next door to the Premier Inn but if you don't want to eat there, plenty of other places are around it. This was the usual Premier Inn Standard. We had a room on the corner of the building, these rooms are massive, so big that the double bed is placed in the window. You could easily get another double bed in this room. Reception Staff very friendly and welcoming and couldn't do enough for us. Had breakfast next door which I have to say was amazing, one of the best by far.

author: WestCornwallNipper
title: Funny looking steak!
text: We stayed for a night & decided to eat next door at the Brewers fayre. My wife & son had the ribs which were not bad & my daughter had the goujons which she enjoyed. I went for the 16oz rib eye which when it arrived looked anemic! I mean how can you cook a steak that thick and get no colour or grill marks on it? It was almost like it was pre cooked in a water bath & warmed up to serve? As a result of the lack of caramelisation the steak lacked any flavour! It was tender but bland. Shame really as apart from that we had a good stay. (We didn't bother with breakfast after that)

author: 348kevinf
title: Good but in need of refresh.
text: Premier Inn is my go to brand when booking accommodation and I have stayed a few times at the Milngavie and Dumbarton Hotels. Both are excellent and easily accessible. My last two stays at the Milngavie Hotel were very good. There has obviously been a refurbishment programme and that brings me to my stay at Glocester Business Park. The building itself is clean and tidy and the staff were VERY friendly, welcoming and helpful. Whilst it is a little nit-picky, the difference in finish in our rooms was very noticable from the room in Milngavie. However, we were at a Wedding and, as a place to sleep comfortably, well and at a very good price, this did the job more than well. Thank you, Premier Inn for another good stay.

author: Nastame
title: Average Premier
text: When staying in a chain I look to see what makes it different to others. The location here is handy for the M5. But limited choice to eat, really no choice other than the distinctly average pub next door. Reception not over welcoming. The bed was comfortable. What irked me was that turning off the shower tap in the morning it didn't work. I tried for five minutes before it went off. Reporting this to reception next morning theh gad reported the fault already but hadn't thought to tell incoming customers that there was a problem. Perhaps they shouldn't gave let the room!

author: bille992
title: Gloucester Business Park
text: Just 5 minutes from the M5. Only 30 yards from a bus stop. 25 minutes into town. No driving. A great breakfast next door at a very reasonable price. £35 for the two of us . . . what more can I expect?

author: 653flipp
title: Got the good nights sleep
text: An overnight visit to see family. Checked in after 11.00pm without any problems. Would recommend on-line check-in prior to arrival for speedy arrival service. Car parking and location easy and convenient. Really clean and beds extremely comfortable. Staff brilliant. Breakfast fantastic and overall a friendly relaxing experience. I have a front line customer service job and l got the service from Premier Inn staff that l strive to give to my clients and rarely get back in my dealings with companies. Well done!!!

author: Maureenta
title: Does what it says on the packet.
text: Exactly what I would expect from a PI . . . does what Lenny says it does. Clean, and comfortable, large rooms. Lovely big bed with fluffy duvet. Friendly, efficient and helpful staff. tea and coffee in rooms. Free parking. Brewers fayre next door.

author: AngelaG385
title: Great Hotel, close to M5
text: We had occasion to say at this hotel on our way down to Cornwall from Yorkshire going on holiday. Our welcome was, as always, warm and friendly. Our room was duel aspect, spotlessly clean and one of the biggest rooms we stayed in at a Premier Inn. It is adjoined by a very good eatery where we joined many others enjoying the Indian Banquet - as much as you could eat for £6.99 (Thursdays only). Very good value indeed. Each evening appeared to have a different food theme and also Sunday Lunches served. The general food menu was very comprehensive as well with good deals for children dining. A very good choice of hotel for us and we would certainly stay here again when travelling south.

author: E1OVO
title: Perfect planned stop
text: Very easy to find. On a business park, lots of shops, right next to a Tesco - very handy. Plenty of free on site parking if you are staying at this Prem inn. Having a lift is a bonus. Quick efficient check in, welcome very nice. Had room 41, very big indeed, soon warmed up with heater on, very comfortable, had a comfy chair, room lovely and cosy. Perfect in every way. Thank you

author: JuleeMango
title: Comfortable Stay
text: we stayed here for two nights whilst visiting the Christmas Markets at Gloucester Quays and friends in the area. This is one of the newer Premier Inns we have stayed in and our room (number 45 on the 2nd floor) was clean, fresh and spacious and was quiet and overlooked the rear of the building. Check in was painless and we were looked after by an older gentleman who was an absolute pleasure to deal with. We had our dinner and breakfast at the Brewers Fayre next door all of which were very good. The majority of the staff we came across were very friendly and gave excellent customer service however there were a couple of ladies on the night shift and early morning shift on Reception that could have done with a lesson on how to speak to customers who are experiencing problems.They did not have a sympathetic tone and neither did they mention the Good Night Sleep policy which was relevant as we had had a disturbed night's sleep when the heating failed yet again. We had to ask again for the Policy to be honoured at check out and thankfully our favourite older gentleman was on who sorted everything out without any problems. There was lots of parking with a pay and display machine but guests get free parking and are given a ticket to display on check in. I would definitely stay here again and have no hesitation recommending it

author: Infrequentluncher
title: No surprises - no complaints!
text: We were given a list of hotels by the organiser of the event we were attending. By far the best value was the Premier Inn and so we plumped for that. And I' m pleased we did. The on line booking is easy and comprehensive, there is ample safe parking, the receptionist was courteous and friendly and the room was exactly as expected - clean and simple. It looked out over the back so we were not disturbed during the night. I had preordered breakfast which takes place across the way. It was fine with a number of families enjoying themselves. Although it might be unusual to stay in a business park, it worked! One collateral benefit is that it is very near a large Tesco so you can do your shopping at the same time!

author: ScubamommaDevon
title: Stopover stay
text: Stayed here again on route to Birmingham. Reception recognised us as repeat guests which was nice. Check in easy and quick. Room spotless, note in room re replacing hair dryers so to contact reception if one was needed. We had all slept quite well until at 5:45 am the room above us seemed to awaken, first there was the loud bang (we thought they were coming through the ceiling) then there was the heavy flat-footed steps up and down, no chance of getting our toddler back off to sleep. We had a long day ahead and really could have done with awakening naturally. Did not mention to reception as I was not sure other guest noise was covered under the good night policy. Would stay again but ask for a top floor to avoid other inconsiderate guest noise.

author: JnKB
title: Excellent customer service, as usual
text: Stayed in this hotel for two nights, whilst attending our son's swimming competition. Staff were extremely friendly and really helpful, as we have come to be used to from Premier Inns. Booked online, so check in was quick and easy. Family room, with a king size and a single bed in it. Plenty of room and spotlessly clean. King size bed was soooo comfortable, I would have loved to have taken it home ;-) Fixed hairdryer had been removed from the room but reception quickly provided another one. Not really cheap at £144 for two nights inc breakfast but at least you know what you are getting! Went to Brewer's Fayre for breakfast on both days and for meal on second evening, all of which were great. Staff there were friendly and attentive too.

author: michaelcB1388SN
title: Great stop-over sleep
text: 5* all round. We were heading to CenterParcs Longleat from Scotland with young children so we wanted to break up the journey and leave only a small travel for the Monday. The location of this hotel was perfect for us as it didn't require a large detour from the motorway. It was directly next to Tesco (incl. Petrol Station) and a few eating places which was perfect for our trip. The hotel was quiet, clean and the staff were very smiley and helpful. Perfect stop-over. We will stay here again on a long trip to the south of England.

author: angelar670
title: A Happy Stay at Gloucester Business Park
text: Our stay began very well with check in done quickly and efficiently by Aziz, the Spanish receptionist who was very polite and friendly. Both rooms were very comfortable and clean. We all agreed that our night's sleep was excellent. We used the Brewers Fayre for our evening meal which was generally good apart from a rather overdone jacket potato. The breakfast was excellent and we thought the idea of having the continental breakfast available to all and then ordering a freshly cooked full English if it had been booked was a good one. All the breakfast food was excellent and the staff were friendly and efficient. Next time we travel to the south west we will definitely book our overnight stop here. Thank you for making our stay so pleasant.

author: AlmostYorkshire
title: October over-night stay
text: Arrived 11pm to find easy parking and friendly helpful staff. 2 rooms, both fine. Air Con. All enjoyed Brewers Fayre breakfast next morning (3 of us had continental breakfast, 1 full breakfast). One member of our party on gluten free diet. Waitress understood and immediately offered toast from dedicated gluten free toaster. Am unfamiliar with Gloucester area but location, fairly close to junction 11A on M5 and close to Tesco Extra and other facilities, had advantages for us. Used this Premier Inn to break a long journey so only stayed 1 night but would stay here again.

author: happymover28
title: Great stay, visiting all the the Lovely places.
text: We arrived on the 6th of August, sorry for this late review, as I have been away on another trip. Staying at this premier Inn for 5 nights, to Visit Bath, Gloucester, and Bristol. It was great nice evening meal at the Brewers Fare, nice and cosy, and great drinks. We normally ate breakfast at Tesco, great value, and ate out at different places We visited Baths, Roman Baths, it was packed with people from all over the world, but was very interesting. We visited Cheltenham, what a lovely spotless place, great shops. We caught the no 10 , to Cheltenham. Park and Ride for Bristol , where we visited SS Great Briton. A good hotel with great staff, so helpful. Will come again.

author: sailorgirlGrimsby
title: Noisy room!
text: We stayed at this inn earlier this week and was pleasantly surprised with the cleanliness of the room/bathroom. We were also allocated a large family room. However, we did phone the day prior to our arrival to request a room in the quiet part of the hotel. On arrival we found our room to be overlooking a roundabout on a business park and With not knowing the area we did not expect it to be as noisy as it proved to be. Later in the evening when we showered we were surprised to see that the bathroom light fitting shade was fitting and the cables were exposed. On our departure we did mention the noise of the room and the light fitting and asked that as we were returning at the end of the week to break our journey, could they make sure we were given a quieter room this time. Apart from those issues we enjoyed our stay. Lovely and clean and in an excellent location.

author: shirleya613
title: Had better stay
text: This was second visit in just over a week. Both stays for my Niece's weddings. Arrived on the Saturday afternoon and single bed not made up and towels for one person not two. We ended up making the bed up ourselves after a three and half hour journey. Lady in reception was very apologetic when she got our bedding as she couldn't help due to health concerns. We were woken up early hours of Sunday morning by a drunken rabble shouting and arguing in the corridor. In all fairness I was refunded the night. Air con a bonus, beds comfortable, shame Wi-Fi wasn't free. Lovely trip round Bourton on the Water on the Sunday and Bird Land, well worth a visit. Quiet night Sunday which was a blessing.

author: Carrie063
title: Excellent stay, convenient location
text: Stayed twice over a three week period at end of May/beginning of June, good to now have air conditioning which was much needed, housekeeping close the curtains in the day which helped tremendously as it was pretty warm during my stay. Also upgraded TVs are great too with a good choice of channels. Rooms are comfortable, clean, beds are firm and just to my liking! Staff very helpful and friendly as always. Conveniently situated near Junction 11a off M5 and near to Tesco Extra, Costa Coffee, Subway, Dominos Pizza and Gregg's Bakers if you don't want to use the attached pub. Only negative points are the terrible mobile phone reception (its bad in the area), and only 30 mins free wifi (free WiFi at Tesco cafe). Still full marks though! :-)

author: IanL349
title: Business trip
text: Stayed at this hotel as it was 5 mins from my first call Monday morning. Arrived Sunday night and the check in was swift and efficient. With a smile as well. Room as expected clean and well equipped. Evening meal was very good, quick service with a smile and food nice and hot. Breakfast was very good plenty of choice and agin very quick to serve. Nice easy stay with no hassle. Parking was ok and free! Unlike some other venues??

author: niksven
title: Friendly staff
text: Stayed for 3 days. Family room large with good facilities. Bed comfortable. Generally, very clean and tidy, apart from a few marks on the wall. Quiet location, and reception staff friendly and helpful. Overall, breakfast was good value for money and tasty. Shame that the wifi isn't completely free during your stay, considering that they're a big chain. Shouldn't affect the price of the rooms when you think about how many small businesses now provide this service. Will use them again.

author: Samiyahh
title: Great Night As Always
text: I've stayed here several times on business and have always slept like a baby! The hotel itself it unimaginative, and reminds me of an American motel more than anything. The rooms are spacious, clean and completely adequate. I often check in late due to the duration of the journey to this hotel, on one occasion I had forgotten my toothpaste - but the covering night receptionist/porter said it wasn't a problem and he would give me some, free of charge. When I got to the room, I realised I had forgotten it, went back downstairs but the night staff member was outside having a cigarette - so not to disturb him I thought I'd wait until the morning. I came down the following morning to pick some up, and the rude receptionist said I would have to pay £3.50, so I explained the situation to him and he essentially said that the chap I spoke to the night prior didn't have a clue what he was talking about! This was frustrating to say the least. Brighter note, a Tesco superstore is round the corner, with Subway, Dominoes, Greggs etc in case you're hungry... which is a God send as the restaurant associated with this hotel is abysmal.

author: Ali417
title: Business stay over
text: This is possibly the best premier inn that I have stayed in apart form Oxford. Staff were corteous and helpful I usually find them as such. Maybe more so because I 'm female and more often than not they are female?? just a thought. Great room such space, and those beds!! never not slept well. Close to tesco's next door and community shopping centre (costa coffee etc.) for all your needs. The only down side was the eater next door Brewer s Fayre, they had no vegetarian option, bar 2 items, and the one I had was hardly edible!! All in all a very pleasant stay.

author: 24Seven365
title: Much better than some reviews say
text: Some of the reviews on here are ridiculous. This is a Premier Inn, so don't expect it to be the Ritz. And it doesn't serve food - only the pub next door; so review that. And if you're sloppy enough to leave items in your room after you leave, then you take the risk they never come back. Wildly accusing people is not credible. Anyway, the review. This is a good honest hotel with an attentive staff. The rooms are comfortable, warm and have an ample supply of hot water, bedding and amenities. For the price you cannot beat it. I will definitely stay there again

author: ScubamommaDevon
title: Good stop over again
text: Stayed here last night for the 3rd time. Good stopping point for us travelling up from the South West to Birmingham. Room was clean and a good size. Noticed the beds were a little bit lumpy this time which made for an uncomfortable night but I never complained which is our own fault, and old tv's in room and no a/c which I'm thinking in the summer would be unbearable. I'm thinking it's now due a revamp. Staff welcomed us back on arrival which was nice to be recognised. Recommend booking the Brewers Fayre next door for dinner if arriving at 7pm ish, it was very busy and hard to find a table. We would probably stay again if the price was right but I'm really recommending an upgrade to the hotel.

author: ErnieTraveller
title: Great nights sleep
text: Single business traveler. I got the room for £35 room only. The room was big, clean, modern and the bed was great. I slept really well. The business park is huge but very quiet at night. There is a huge tescos across the road too. The receptionists were very professional and attentive. The theme pub next door was pretty good too where i bought breakfast.

author: mbryant2016
title: Absolutely awful
text: We booked a twin bedded room but instead were given a double bed with a sofa bed which had loads of broken springs. The room was hot and stuffy because the window was prevented from opening properly by a wire cord. The company seem to think a fan with a cord to short to reach the window will somehow cool the room. IT WILL NOT !! In fact it makes it warmer. Either allow windows to be opened properly or fit aircon. Noise from a drinks machine and rude receptionist added to the awfulness of this hotel and I will never return. Do not use this hotel !!!!!!!

author: bevm337
title: Roasted!
text: If you're staying here, make sure you get a room at the back. We had one night in a front room during the heatwave & it was like an oven, even with a fan. We had about 2 hours sleep & needed multiple showers. We made a complaint in the morning & had our room changed, which was much better. To make it worse, the drinks machine in reception was out of order! The hotel is also on a busy roundabout which is no good if you want the (very restricted) window open & are a light sleeper. We've taken advantage of the 'Good night guarantee' & asked for a refund for the first night, yet to receive it. We saw at least 7 other people complaining about the heat & asking for refunds.

author: rower34
title: Quiet, clean hotel
text: I checked in after a long day of travelling for business, and was greeted by a friendly receptionist who explained everything to me, and also checked if I had parked in the car park, as you require a permit or have to pay to park in the car park. It was explained how I get my meal deal at the pub restaurant next door, and times of when breakfast was. I had a room on the top floor at the back of the hotel. It was a big room for what I was expecting, and was clean and tidy. The only thing I would say is that they could do with having a towel rail for hand towels, rather than having to put them back on the shelf. You can get 30 minutes free wifi per day, and they also have tv's with Freeview. My biggest dilemma when I got to sleep was to have the firm or softer pillows. I don't know if it's the road layout or my sat nav, but when I came off the M5 a J11A it sent me down a dual carriageway and back the other way to get there, i could have possibly missed the turning.

author: r0ckst4r
title: Value for money
text: Please note that I am writing this review purely on the room and the welcome/service I received. I did not eat at the restaurant. Arrived - easily found - at a new building, close by a Costa, Tesco and other amenities. The welcome was very friendly and polite - appreciated after a long day and bit of a drive. Room is big, shower is great. Clean, tidy and everything working. As I say, this is a very basic review of my room and short-term experience here. Paid £29 for the room, decent price, and exactly what it says on the tin.

author: UK-Stu
title: Better than expected
text: Stayed in a family room with wife and two children. The room was enormous! Three good sized beds and the bathroom was clean and practical. Staff were friendly and breakfast the following morning was great. I have read reviews of noise problems. We had no issues at all. In fact, we stayed on a Saturday night and were surprised how quiet it was. There are some rooms on the ground floor which are next to the main door and lift. Probably sensible to avoid these.

author: JohnB791
title: Weekend Away
text: Just returned form a weekend away visiting family. This hotel gives excellent value for money providing you book & pay at least 3 weeks in advance. I can recommend the breakfasts across in the Whittle Inn especially if you have young children. 1 adult having a full eat as much as you like breakfast allows 2 children un 16 years to eat for free. The hotel is situated on a business park so it is quiet during the evening. Receptionist was very pleasant an checking in was easy. There is a lift to all floors and you only pay for the room not per person which makes it very economical if you have children with you. Although I can recommend the Whittle Inn for breakfast the evening meal is a bit over priced for what you get.

author: Daddyduck
title: Very good value
text: Stayed 2 nights in March 13 Travelled with elderly parents, one a wheelchair user. Disabled facilities very good, Wet room excellent. They would have preferred twin beds which wasn' an option. Our room very spacious everything you need, clean and modern. Bed a bit lumpy.Staff very friendly. Resturant next door serving good value for money food. Very close to other food outlets and large supermarket. very good value for money

author: twoteapots
title: Excellent
text: This is the second time we have used this hotel whilst visiting the area. Its a great hotel, offering good value for money and a very convenient location, with good local facilities. The rooms were quiet and everything worked perfectly and was spotlessly clean. Of particular note was that, not long after we checked in, a loud vibrating noise started from above the ceiling (turned out to be an airlock), which we reported as we went out to eat to the receptionist (a very helful and polite young man). When we came back after eating he had engineers up ladders fixing the problem - great service! The Whittle Inn is equally very good and each night they have themed food on offer. On our night (Thursday) they have all-you-can eat Curry night, with a variety of curries, nan bread etc, all for £6 per head. All-in-all a great stay and we will definitely stay there again.

author: KevinN380
title: Good hotel but poor evening food
text: We travelled with my children and my parents who were in a disabled room. Both rooms were clean and comfortable and apart from a bit of noise from above we had a lovely stay. Unfortunately we had our evening meal at the adjoining Brewers Fayre pub on the first night and it was a real disappointment. Service was poor and both kids meals were missing items described in the menu. My own chicken dish was dry and overcooked, so much so it was difficult to cut. Our tables were not cleared of dishes between courses either. However, the hotel was fine, VERY roomy (we had a corner room) and virtually no noise from outside. Big superstore right next door too. I'd highly recommend the hotel but would not take evening meals at the pub. Breakfasts were cery nice and well organised though, no issues there.

author: boobydee
title: Sleeping in a sauna
text: Have stayed here twice and both times the rooms have been sweltering. The room had a fan in but had to get another one from reception, but it was way too hot to sleep, might have managed an hour. Couldn't open the windows wide because of the security chain which is understandable, but the rooms should have air con. Couldn't blame the weather even though it was august because it was raining and windy and at least 20 deg cooler than the room. Room was spotless and staff friendly and helpful. Premier inn do offer a satisfaction money back guarantee, but obviously don't back this up because I have received nothing after I mentioned this. I also complained last year after me another family member were bitten by some kind of bugs in bed which itched for a week but heard nothing. You could say I only paid £29 so why you moaning.

author: Rach_L_UK
title: Perfectly adequate hotel stay, with friendly staff...
text: Stayed here on a Thursday night - travelling on business and booked about 6hrs before I arrived. Check-in was quick and efficient, the front-desk member of staff was very helpful and friendly. Room was larger than I'd expected, and clean. Exactly what you'd expect from this kind of hotel. Traffic noise outside was a little annoying, but not too bad. My only complaint was the shower pressure which was pretty poor, and the fixed head shower didn't help; showering took ages! Check-out was equally quick and efficient as check-in, and breakfast next door was excellent, good choice of stuff and again the staff were very friendly and helpful. Not the most fantastically amazing hotel in the world ever, but what do you expect from a Premier Inn? The staff really made the difference between this being a 'ok, fine' stay and a pretty pleasant one. Would stay again.

author: cherriesfan_9
title: well looked after but noisy location
text: this is a well run and maintained travel inn. Exceptionally clean, and excellent staff. Rooms were standard but spotless. There appears to be some ongoing ventilation / heating problems. this means that if the windows are open ( and are restricted to 3 inches opening). However this property is situated adjacent to a busy roundabout and opposite a 24 hour superstore and petrol station. It is very noisy and thats a shame as the staff were great. Better air con seems to be the only answer.

author: 163KIM163
title: We will be staying here again!
text: Spent 2 nights here. The only noise we heard was during an afternoon when a couple of young lads were using the roads to race their 'hairdriers'! The staff were exceptional in being helpful. The restaurant next door was very good value and the food was better than expected so much so we ate their both nights and took full use of the breakfast! Easy to get into City centre by car but we took the oportunity to use the bus. Not been on a bus for years! They were very clean, driver helpful and easy to find our way to and from the city. We come from North Essex and parents live on coast in Wales and we used this as a midway stop and the chance to have a couple of days away visiting the City. We will be using this hotel and restaurant for all future stops.

author: marieanddon
title: very nice
text: Stayed 1 night in 2 rooms, both were very nice. Clean, rooms. Reception staff helpful. Parking was not free. Brewers Fayre restuarant next door and tescos. Easy to find and from motorway. TV ok, bathroom clean. would stay again

author: lcp100
title: Fantastic, Complete bargain
text: Cant complain! For £29 we got an immaculate clean bedroom with a comfy bed. The fan was on when we arrived so the room wasnt too stuffy. A typical premier inn room, but no complaints. (Not sure if im allowed to say this but much fresher and much much cleaner than the travel lodge i stayed in earlier in the year!) We ate in the brewers fayre next door, which was fine, and the breakfast was just what it said it was! All you can eat everything, with cooked breakfast done to order, as much as you want. And the parking was free too :) Its opposite Tesco extra so cheap petrol and could use their cafe if you preferred or buy just about anything from over the road too! Over all we were very very happy and have no complaints at all. Couldnt spend £29 better!

author: 858terrio
title: Short break
text: This hotel is off the track a bit so car advised. We used train and taxi for an overnight B&B paying with smart box worth 80 but had to pay 20 extra (not informed on booking) . The hotel is nice with very good breakfast and bar food. There was to be music but the musician cancelled so only choice on site was the main dance hall at back of hotel which if you liked jive and line dancing was perfect at 10euro a head (very well attended) . The heating was not very good . We informed the staff and they said they would turn up. In the morning the heating was off and could not get enough water for a shower. Would stay again in summer with transport.

author: Aqua_Risima
title: Not to recommend
text: Staff is very friendly. Rooms need urgently renovation. There is as well an odd smell. Rooms are noisy (traffic from the street as well you hear your room neighbours). Matress out of date as well and caused horrible pain. Breakfast when you travel in a tour very little. 1 egg, 1 sausage and a slice of bacon. Not to recommend although dinner was nice.

author: marymU1113FI
title: Meal at the Rhu Glen
text: My husband and myself stopped at the Rhu Glen on Saturday last at around 4pm. I ordered Fish Pie with Chips and Salad. The Fish pie came to the table with the top completely burned. When I lifted off the top the fish was all dried out. I didn't even taste this but sent it back. My husband ordered a Mixed Grill. This was equally appalling as the bacon, liver, etc were all just uneatable. My advice no matter how hungry you are, go someplace else.

author: 80kieranw
title: Mr
text: Stayed here with booking offer on Pigsback.com Great value. Great breakfast served with a smile Rooms clean and spotless. Soft comfy bed and pillows. Bring your own hairdryer. Hairdryer in bathroom but long air hose is awkward to use. Lots to see in the area. Dunmore East and Duncanon fort a real history find and Waterford City has plenty of places to visit. During the week the bar is very Quiet.

author: sandraleemonaghan
title: Ok for a stopover
text: Myself and my partner were travelling to Waterford so we decided to stay over and managed to pick up a deal to stay n the Rhu Glenn Country Club Hotel for 1 night, the place was grand and i can't really fault it on much apart from a couple of minor things that are easily rectified. One of those things but the most important thing about staying anywhere is the beds, i'm sorry to say the mattresses have had their day, they really need new mattresses, they are thin and there's no support in them whatsoever, we did ask to be changed to a different room but the receptionist stated that all the bed's were of the same quality. Anyway while at breakfast the next morning we got chatting to another couple and happened to mention the mattresses in conversation and they said their mattress was fine and of good quality, so i was a bit mad about this because it obviously pointed to us that the receptionist couldn't be bothered giving us a new more comfortable room because she lied about the beds all being the same. Onto the breakfast room, god it was absolutely freezing in it, so much so that my partner had to go and get me my jacket from the room as did the other couple that were in the room, they went to get their jackets too, i remember that the man said that by the time the breakfast got from the kitchen to the table that the food would be freezing, i just bust out laughing because it was funny and that's how we all managed to get into a conversation with each other. The breakfast itself is sufficient with the usual juice, cereals and fruit salad, there were no pastries like mini croissants etc like other hotels but we didn't mind this. the hot breakfast is cooked to order and is not self-service. We had a meal the night before in the hotel and to be honest we can't fault it, it was delicious. and the staff are really nice. In a summary the place is ok for an overnight stay, the only faults i have with it like i said was the bed and the fact that the breakfast room was like walking into a freezer. that being said the food alone would tempt me back but only if you got a decent bed.

author: patriciakavanagh13
title: Rhu Glenn Hotel.
text: Have stayed here before. It was after a Family Celebration. Lovely food. Staff very helpful and kind. Called in for lunch this time. Carvery beautiful. A busy, homely Pub.Good value. Worth a visit. Good location, and also has a lovely big carpark.

author: seamuso651
title: Golf society weekend in Waterford
text: The location is very convenient to a number of golf courses and waterford city by taxi. Our rooms were very good and clean and warm. For the price it is excellent value. Food in the bar area is very good - pub or inn type quality. Very reasonably priced and very hearty. All of our gang were happy. The staff are very friendly and helpful. A gang of 20 were there and nobody was dissappointed, so thats a first !

author: 286JohnE
title: A friendly very Irish experience
text: We stayed for 3 nights on a business trip. We arrived very early but were able to check in immediately with a choice of ground or upstairs room. We chose to eat in the bar. Food was excellent and reasonably priced. I recommend the beef with all the trimmings. Breakfast was freshly cooked and delicious. I gained 5 lbs during the period of our stay. In spite of a 'country club' on site we slept peacefully unaware of revellers or other guests. Staff at reception and bar were polite and friendly. Yes, we would return if we are in the area again.

author: marzyIreland
title: Delightful Stay
text: This is a lovely little place, away from the hustle and bustle of town but with enough happening to keep it alive. We stayed early in the week mon to wed and there were plenty of people around in the evening like ourselves staying and eating there after travelling during the days sightseeing. It is ideally located as a base for exploring Wexford and Waterford. Food is good and if you are staying here at the weekends there is music on offer. It is also popular with bus tours/groups, they had a full house on monday night. The staff were lovely and friendly and the bar seems to be frequented by the locals who were happy to chat too. Rooms were clean and food was typical of bar food (we didnt eat in the restaurant). Just one thing of note there is no lift in this building (that I could see) and our room was up a long flight of stairs which was only awkward carrying our cases as we are thankfully able bodied. If you have mobility issues please ask for a room on ground floor. We enjoyed our stay.

author: alisont881
title: Stay and dance package.
text: Great stay. Will definitely recommend . Hope to return shortly in the near future. Room clean. Staff very friendly. Food great and plentiful. Beautiful views from room window. . Thankyou Rhu Glenn. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay..many thanks

author: Redsionnach
title: Great food and service.
text: Called into the Rhu Glenn when travelling from Waterford to Wexford. It is ideally located and has plenty of free parking. There is a fine carvery menu and we had the beef and the bacon. The meat was excellently cooked an juicy and tender. The vegetables were lovely and tasty. The home made croquettes are something delicious. Staff are very friendly. The eating area is full of GAA pictures, etc on the walls which I personally dislike. The seating could do with being replaced as it shows the signs of years of use but this would be the only criticism. Overall a nice stop off for a good value meal.

author: ShellGreengirl
title: Nice for a quiet stay
text: The hubby and myself stayed here in March for a quiet break away for ourselves and our baby. Rooms were spotlessly clean and equipped with all you need. They are a little old fashioned and the whole place would be fashioned for the older generation but this is just a matter of taste and doesn't take away from a stay here. The hotel is very close to waterford too so handy for a visit. We had dinner as part of our stay offered from the roast specials menu. We both loved our dinners, big hearty roast dinners and the girl in the bar was extremely helpful and friendly. Breakfast was lovely and served quickly and we had the choice of more if we wanted. My only negative point is that there is no lift and we were given a room on the top floor up two flights of stairs which meant we had to carry our heavy baby buggy and equipment up it ourselves each time and I have back issues. Maybe just offer parents with babies or less mobile guests the downstairs rooms as we didn't want to be pests and moan about it. Overall, we had a nice, enjoyable stay.

author: 75emman
title: Brilliant weekend
text: Stayed here for 2 nights with my boyfriend and it was a brilliant weekend! Spacious room in a peaceful setting which is just what was needed. We had dinner in the Luffany restaurant and it was very delicious, our compliments to the chef! We loved having a few drinks in the bar and Gillian in particular was lovely to chat with and very friendly. All the staff were amazing and friendly though! Breakfast was even brought to our room for us on one of the mornings, which tasted amazing. It's only about 10 minutes drive away from Waterford City but as neither myself or my boyfriend don't drive, it was a bit much getting taxis back and forth. Can't fault the hotel though, would definitely stay there again 😊

author: CarolH678
title: Brilliant stay
text: We had our belated Christmas party here last week. We had an absolutely brilliant time. Gillian in the bar was brilliant. She couldn't have been more helpful. She suggested we go for drinks in Waterford, Booked out taxi for us and sent us to the Reg bar. We had a brilliant night!! Then when we came back she got us bread and butter to make crisp sandwiches at like 3am. The girls on the desk were so friendly. Dinner and breakfast were delicious. Really couldn't rate this place higher.

author: LolabelleCarlow
title: Nice Hotel
text: Just back from an inexpensive 2-night Escapes.ie break at the Rhu Glenn Hotel and Country Club. Have to say it was definitely a lot better than expected for a 3 star and overall we were very impressed indeed. The staff are definitely this hotel's strong point - they were extremely friendly and nothing was too much trouble for them. A special word of thanks to both Jillian and Damien and also to the 2 young ladies who were serving in the restaurant. The Hotel is old style but this added to its charm; the bedroom and bathroom were both clean. The set menu selection with our deal was very limited but we were not disappointed with the quality of the food we received. Also we ate from the bar menu on our second evening and that was equally good. Overall we had a wonderful relaxing weekend and we would definitely recommend it as a place to stay.

author: harleyg98
title: Take your own bug zapper
text: The Rhu Glenn sits on a main road, so doesn't look so appealing from outside – and if you enter from the front, via the bar area, you're heart may sink – mine did. However, once through into the hotel area – which has its own entrance at the side – things begin to look up. It's an easy commute into Waterford – just a 5-10 minute drive – so a night on the town isn't a problem. The reviews for Rhu Glenn on standards seem to be polarised but our room was larger than we'd expected and kept spotless over our three night stay. The staff were very friendly and helpful and the wifi was probably the best we had in Ireland – a very strong and stable signal. Being a country club means weekend 'entertainment' – there was a big event on the Saturday evening and we were anticipating a lot of Gaelic noise. Despite the many coaches that rolled up we didn't lose a wink of sleep – assisted by the really comfortable bed and pillows. My only real issue was with the flies – in our bedroom, the dining room and the bar, in fact everywhere – next time I'll take my own bug zapper. Irish hotels are expensive – so you'll struggle to get many bangs for your bucks. Saying that The Rhu Glenn is really good value for money – if you can live with the flies.

author: marco212091
title: Warm and Friendly
text: Stayed on a two night deal. Bar Food was of a high standard, well prepared, presented and a wide variety of choices at very reasonable prices. Breakfast was excellent with the usual selection of cereals juices etc on offer and a good selection of cooked breakfasts you could order to suit all tastes. The hotel is old world in style and is warm and comfortable. It is very conveniently located near Waterford city which is just a 10-15 minute drive. Hotel room was very spacious homely and clean with all the accoutrements you would need including a good hairdryer. Staff were warm and friendly. Would recommend without hesitation.

author: coralking
title: Just a meal
text: Had promised us a visit to Cobh whilst in Ireland and decided to stop for a decent meal on the way back to Tacumshane. Didn't want to stray from the N25 and this was the first place open that wasn't a burger joint. What a find, T-bone for me and Sirloin for my wife cooked and served with no undue waiting both with plenty of proper chips or roast potatoes with veg. Very good coffee afterwards washed down the steak and beer a treat. Although the place was fairly empty when we arrived it had begun to fill with locals and tourists alike, some with children so I guess that the kids menu was good as well. Staff were very attentive without being overbearing with continued 'is everything OK' all the time. A bill of only €57 I thought was quite reasonable, probably less than the UK and judging by the posters and photos on the walls I guess this place rocks on Saturday nights with live music and the love of hurly on TV. Speaking to one local gentleman on the way out, he was very talkative and proud of his local and pleased that tourists found everything pleasing. I would certainly recommend this for at least a meal and possibly a base for touring. Date of meal Wednesday 24th August 2016

author: Janie_Bop
title: A lovely stay!
text: Last week, we had a lovely 2 night stay in the Rhu Glenn. Everything from check in to check out was perfect! Our room (5) was cozy and spotlessly clean. The staff are all extremely friendly and genuine. A special thanks to the bar man (didn't catch his name!) who recommended a trip to Loftus Hall and Hook Lighthouse to us. A great recommendation. Having staff with a good local knowledge is definitely a bonus! Breakfasts are freshly cooked to order and very generous portions. We had an evening meal also which was simply done but very good, perfect after a day of sightseeing. In short, The Rhu Glenn is a great hotel in a beautiful location at an excellent price and I would be happy to stay there again.

author: gordonr441
title: Poor reflection of irish hospitality
text: Stayed here for two nights mid week. Rooms were basic, but clean. Noise from main road loud. Walls between rooms paper thin could hear next door clearly. Food was average. Put what's with all the fly's in the restaurant and breakfast room. its disgusting. After dinner we were asked to move to the bar, so the staff could clean up. This happened both night's. So my recommendation is find somewhere else to enjoy your stays away from home.

author: AntoC_11
title: Average at best
text: Positives the food was lovely and portions generous which was great. The bar, restaurant and cleaning staff were friendly and excellent at their jobs. Negatives we had a room like an earlier review with a bed which was sinking at the centre and a 1990s tiny TV. Interestingly we also had an escapes voucher like an earlier post and appear to have gotten the same room. No doubt it's a coincidence but since that review in may nothing has changed. Receptionist could do with a lesson in customer service. The hotel seems a little stuck in the past and if it's wasn't for the 3 members of staff mentioned above and food this would have been a 1 star review. Usually places do these voucher deals to increase and encourage customers to their establishment unfortunately this place is wasting it's time I did not leave wishing to return or tell people to go there.

author: brianbP7498XQ
title: Really nice stay
text: We stayed at Rhu Glenn for 3 nights between christmas and new year and were treated so well by the owner and staff, they couldn't do enough for us. Our room was a little dated but spotlessly clean with all the expected requirements available ie. tea/coffee etc. Didn't want to get out of the bed as was so comfortable, wanted to take that mattress home with me. Breakfast was perfect. Had our dinner there 2 out of 3 evenings as wanted to try somewere different in Waterford city but should of had dinner in Rhu Glenn the 3rd evening also as the food was outstanding. All in all would highly recommend Rhu Glenn and will definitely stay here again. I take my hat off to the owner and his staff (sorry i cant remember owners name).

author: janetpH8812EF
title: Puddle of 'water' in the bathroom - blamed on the guest!
text: I spent a night at this hotel with some friends recently - they have both left reviews on this site. I had the misfortune to stay in a room with what looked very much like a large puddle of urine in the bathroom. We eventually got hold of a staff member - it was very late - who came up and mopped it up, and suggested that perhaps I'd somehow tampered with the shower head, resulting in this mess. A quite ludicrous and frankly unbelievable accusation - and one that I see Crystal, responding to my friend's review, has had the audacity to mention again. This was between the toilet and the bath, and yes the shower was incredibly leaky and noisy (which I'd mentioned at check-in earlier in the day too), but this leak was from a human, not from a faulty pipe. The fact that the hotel thinks it's okay to somehow suggest that I was responsible for their shoddy housekeeping is just unbelievable! If it wasn't so outrageous I'd be really annoyed. As it is, it's just pathetic. Sad place stuck in the 70s.

author: KealinMc
title: Avoid
text: Stayed with friends on the night of 7th May. There was a 21st birthday party in the hotel and whilst of course the hotel cannot be responsible for the behaviour of individuals, it should ensure that noise and distribution are kept to a minimum and that any unruly behaviour is dealt with and the responsible people are removed from the area. For over an hour and a half in the early hours of the morning we endured the druken, loud, agrressive, foul mouthed rantings of a group of partygoers. The young men were openly urinating in the carpark also. We looked for the night porter of which there was no sign and calls to reception remained unanswered. When reported to the receiptionist on duty at time of check out the basic attitude was that they had not thought any trouble would be caused by these partygoers. The receiptionist Rita was at best dismissive of the fact that guests had been kept awake until after 3am. Will not be back.

author: lizzie4916
title: Great hotel
text: I have stayed in 4 other hotels in Waterford over a few years & this one was definately this best. Large free carpark, very nice reception area, very clean room & bathroom. The bar was very comfortable & well laid out & the toilets were spotless. Breakfast was freshly cooked & served by Anna who did a great job. The food served in the bar was excellant & served with a smile. We had a relaxing 3 nights here & will be staying here again when in the area. What l liked best was the friendly & helpful attitude of every one of the staff we met. I wish l had a hotel like this near me, l would be eating there on a regular basis.

author: robertwF8407UN
title: Unexpected delight
text: Got a good deal here three nights for price of two and was expecting just a basic kind of hotel. However, on arrival to the very pleasant reception area we were welcomed and shown to our room by the very pleasant receptionist. The room was very comfortable and well laid out. Plenty of tea and coffee packets plus some biscuits were there for us to help ourselves too. The bar/ restaurant was also nicely laid out and cosy. The breakfast room was separate and the waitress was prompt and friendly in getting us seated and taking our order. I had the full Irish and it came hot and it was delicious! Did a lot of exploring from here and all in all a great stay.

author: CahirJosephine
title: A lovely quiet retreat in a friendly surrounding.
text: My daughter my granddaughter and l wanted a quiet girlie break away,and the Rhu Glenn Country Club Hotel fitted the bill to perfection. The break was so affordable,and the Hotel was homely and staff so nice and kind. It's so close to Waterford, Our room was lovely and spacious and bathroom was so clean and fresh. My granddaughter was unwell the first night,we used up a lot of towels and bed linen needed to be changed. A lovely girl in housekeeping helped us with everything,and even came back to check on us,to see did we need any more supplies. They were so nice at breakfast too,and the food served in the bar was lovely. It's like a family place,and children are made very welcome. There are toys there for children to play with and our little girl loved thr jigsaws, The staff gave them to her while we were eating. We really enjoyed it.

author: Con-Mara
title: You won't leave hungry....
text: We stopped for lunch in the Rhu Glenn Hotel, and there was quite a crowd in the bar having lunch. We joined the queue for the buffet, and I was trying to figure out why all the people ahead of me were young men in their 20s and 30s? A jolly rounded lady was serving, knew some of the men by name, and as each made his request, she was giving added value – would you like chips as well as rice with your curry? Would you like roasties as well as mash? She was the ultimate Momma, trying to make sure her boys would not be hungry on the job for the rest of the day. The quality of the food was surprisingly good, from roast beef to curried chicken to deep fried cod, and all main courses were under €10. No nouvelle cuisine here, they give you food like your mother might have given you. They stack ‘em high, and sell ‘em cheap. It may not be the meal you will remember when you are reminiscing at the end of the year, but you won’t leave the Rhu Glen hungry. The local men knew where to get well fed.

author: canadianoutbacker
title: Great place to eat in the middle of nowhere
text: 4 Canadians touring this fair land for 16 days. Doing the circuit by car and staying in B&B's. Looking for a place to eat and ended up here on a recommendation from our B&B hostess. The décor is ok, but for food it is a great choice as the food was awesome. I had the Irish Stew and it was very, very good. My colleagues all had the cod and loved it. Was introduced to Blond beer (lager) and found it to be one of my favorites. If you are in this area I would recommend it highly.

author: 400trudib
title: More Hungry Horse than Country Club
text: Reviewing this as a place to eat not to stay (we were in a nearby B&B). When we read the words 'country club' we were a bit dubious as we were looking for casual dining. We needn't have worried - the pub area was definitely more Hungry Horse than Country Club! The food was okay (we sampled the 'specials', fish and chips and pork chops) but nothing memorable, the service was efficient and smiley and the beer was good. When I didn't want Guinness the waitress recommended an alternative (Smethwick's Gold) that was excellent. We always appreciate staff who are willing to engage with customers and take that little extra trouble. For a quick bite to eat it was fine and was the closest place to our B&B, but we would have been disappointed if we had made an effort to dress up or were celebrating a special occasion. The restaurant may have been better but it wasn't open on the Tuesday evening we visited. The free WiFi was much appreciated to help us plan our next day's travels as we were staying in the middle of nowhere!

author: Jennoc1986
title: At short notice 😀
text: I'm writing this on behalf of my mam and her group of friends who go away 5 tines a year! They had their weekend booked when diaster struck hotel that was booked closed down!!! On behalf of my mam I rang around numerous hotels at short notice looking for the deal they had and can I just say the Rhu Glenn came to their rescue when otters didn't!! And they offered them an amazing deal!!! Off they went and they were blown away not only by the hotel, but the standerd of food provided but the the staff excelled themselves!! The rooms were spotless and very modern.... House keeping was second to none..... We had a party of 14 nothing was too big of an ask from this hotel!! HIGHLY RECCOMMEND!!!!

author: TheMongrel1
title: Homely and hospitable.
text: I have driven past here a few times and it always seemed to be busy. It has a great reputation for homely food. This time I stopped. The lady at reception was very nice, accommodating and helpful. The rates are very good also! The room was clean, cosy and there were even biscuits for with your tea. A big plus these days. Dinner in the bar was as I thought; home style heaps of dinner. If you leave hungry, you need a doctor. I will be stopping here more often.

author: 986colinm
title: disabled toilets
text: On the 7th October 2014 we called in to have a meal on the way to catch the ferry home to Fishguard. My partner is in a wheelchair and without sight so as you can appreciate it is important that disabled toilets are ''disabled''. Before leaving to continue our journey to catch the ferry home I took my partner to use the disabled toilets. The disabled toilets are last a changing room for babies so ty was no drop bar to help him transfer just the hand rail on the wall by the toilet. It meant I had to stay with him to help him transfer from wheelchair to toilet . It was difficult with the wheelchair and clearly no thought had gone into the layout of the toilet for a disabled person in a wheelchair who was also blind. Baring in mind this is a not cheap establishment it clearly was not in line with the requirments needed for disabled people. Lunch was okay but not brilliant seasoning wouldnt go amiss when cooking vegtables

author: Redsionnach
title: Great food in quiet surroundings
text: Stopped here for lunch today. There is an extensive bar menu with specials also. I had the mixed grill which was freshly cooked and none of it dried out as you can get with grills sometimes. My mother had the salmon in white wine and cheese sauce with potato and veg. Both were very filling and tasty. Dessert was apple and blackberry crumble and a Bailey's cheesecake. Along with tea and coffee the charge was €42 which was reasonable. There was no hurry on us from the staff who were friendly. Will all again.

author: leob969
title: Great food
text: We stumbled upon the Rhu Glenn by accident as we were staying close by and needed somwhere for an evening meal. Our host at Diamond hill house suggested the Rhu Glenn and we were not disappointed. This is of course a famous venue for Irish showbands. We got 2 superb meals. Soup of the day was a meal itself. The main course fresh cod served with a lot of extras was excellent and very tasty. The chicken curry was also excellent with very good portions. The price was also very good and it would be hard to find better value anywhere in Ireland.

author: Cha66
title: Great place to stop on a journey
text: Stopped at Rhu Glenn when travelling from England via Rosslare to Cork. This was a great way to revive the body and spirits. Excellent food at reasonable prices. Our children would call it proper food. Meat, vegetables and potatoes, all well cooked and with the added flavour that only seems to be available in Irish potatoes. Great choice also for those who might prefer Oriental or Italian based dishes. Service and ambiance also excellent. Have used this twice now and it has never disappointed.

author: Cmonthebanner
title: Country club? What?!?!
text: Not impressed with the hotel. In desperate need of refurbishment and modernisation. Stayed here for one night only. The room looked liked it could have done with a good cleaning. Stains on the sheets, they had those wooly blankets that hairs and everything stick to- yuck. Went to turn down heat on radiator- cob-webs on radiator. This is maybe a 2 star in need of modernisation. Breakfast was nice though, plenty parking. Would never stay again though.

author: JeyaS
title: Great hospitality
text: Had a great weekend. Simple and homely. Room was very clean and fantastic shower. Had breakfast and dinner in the hotel and food was excellent. Staff were wonderful. Great dancing nights on Saturday nights. Price was very reasonable for food and accommodation. Jeya Samuel

author: CourtneySeattle_WA
title: Newer, centrally located hotel in Tokushima
text: My husband and I were visiting friends in Tokushima and just needed a hotel for a night that was close to the bus station. This hotel is right across the street from the bus station. There is also shopping, restaurants and tourist sites within walking distance. Since we were just staying one night we just booked a standard double room. Hotel rooms are average by Japanese standards but small by American standards. If staying for more than one night I would strongly recommend a larger room. My husband and I each had a roller bag and once we opened them there was not a lot of room left to walk around. Hotel did match TA pictures. We did not utilize any of the hotel amenities but they do have a restaurant and steam baths.

author: Clin2nN
title: Very clean and convenient!
text: This hotel has a nice reception area and friendly staff. The rooms are very clean and have all to accommodations you would expect from this level of hotel. It is not 'fancy' but perfect for anyone just looking for a clean bed and shower plus. There are two restaurants in the second floor. One Japanese and one Chinese. The breakfast was included in our room rate and was very good. Eggs, bacon, rice toast, veggies, etc. I would stay again.

author: LiveNLetLive
title: Comfortable business hotel with convenient location
text: I stayed here for one night (almost) during a recent business trip to Japan. It was almost one night as we arrived at 2am and checked out the same morning by 10am. I guess the main benefit of the hotel is its close proximity to the train station which is walking distance and located on the opposite side of the road. The lobby is on the first floor and on entry can seem a bit hidden. The rooms are small but comfortable and have all the amenities one might need for a short stay. Relatively clean rooms and bathroom. The breakfast spread is sufficient and has a mixture of some Japanese cuisine with some basic international food. Overall it was a pleasant stay and service was good as it is anywhere in Japan.

author: Explore19549373040
title: Average rating
text: Price was good, but you get what you pay for, average. Bedding could have been a lot cleaner. I definitely don’t like seeing hairs that are not mine in my sheets. Especially on more than one day. The towels were also pretty hard. I stayed for 4 nights. I don’t recommend staying there that long. But the proximity to the city was good.

author: Cruiser24070136176
title: LaQuinta Inn and Suites Minneapolis-Minnetonka
text: Love staying at this hotel. They are accommodating to my dogs, who I travel with for competitions. Even though this property is a ways from our competition venue, I seek it out. My dogs and I have always been placed on the first floor, near the door. Potty area is always clean and taken care of. Rooms are clean and updated. Breakfast is good. I have stayed at this location three times and never had any issues.

author: JoshFromOhio
title: Great Stay, Great Staff
text: Drove to the Minneapolis area from Ohio to go to the Vikings game this last Sunday. We got to the hotel extremely early and the front desk staff was able to get us checked in right away! I had a great conversation with the GM Jacob, who really goes out of his way to make sure their guests have a great time. The front desk staff, every time I spoke with them were friendly and approachable. The breakfast really hit the spot each morning and was really good! We took an uber to the Vikings game and back, about 9 miles or so to Downtown Minneapolis, and it was much more convenient then driving to the game. Rooms were very clean and beds were extremely comfortable. Many restaurants nearby, and a few shopping places as well! The hotel is located in a nice quiet area as well! I will definitely be back next time I'm in the Twin Cities Area.

author: cptb2013
title: Half and Half
text: On a positive note;The rooms were good, and the A/C worked well enough to keep the entire room cold. On a negative note; we did not appreciate returning to our rooms after a long day at 1645 to find that the maid had only just started cleaning our first of two rooms at 1652!. It may be a 100% smoke free hotel, but when people are allowed to smoke at the entrance of the hotel, the obnoxious odor permeates those going in and out and it enters the lobby. Cigarrett smokers also don't have bins located for the disposal of their butts, which compels the lazy sods to leave their butts on the ground and sidewalk. The guy in charge of getting the breakfast bar up was late-probably because he was taking food out to a friend who was in a truck. So I guess next time we'll just get in our Veh to get curbside breakfast delivery. The Orange juice machine either needs to be cleaned and sanitized or they need to get some fresh OJ!!! Nasty.

author: GTW76
title: 2nd time 'round...
text: This is my second time staying at this hotel. The first time was roughly 3 years prior, the hotel was great then and is still a wonderful middle-of-the-road place to stay. The rooms are very clean & comfortable, and the staff are friendly, and eager to answer any and all questions. My only real complaint is that breakfast is a little on the lame side. While the room where the breakfast is served is clean & modern, the two hot items were microwaved bacon (yuck) & eggs. I guess if I could make a suggestion it would be to add more items, fresh fruit, etc. There is no pool at this hotel, but they do offer a shuttle to the local YMCA. Access to 394 & Hopkins Crossroads is quick and easy - and there is shopping at Ridgedale Mall very close. I'd stay here again!

author: ktmanpa
title: BEST DOG FRIENDLY HOTEL
text: First, for a dog friendly hotel - this is extremely clean and well maintained. Very impressed with how clean it was. We just love La Quinta's for allowing dogs. The staff is always extremely friendly and eager to make your stay as easy as possible. The breakfast was awesome. Lots of food and good, never ran out. Keep up the good work. Plus they gave us a ground level floor. Thank you for that too. That is a huge help with a dog.

author: M5935EUpeterz
title: Dissatisfied patron.
text: Beds were below standard for price of room. Bed actually was dirty on side of mattress which tells me they have not been upgraded for some time. All rooms checked for change had same saggy mattresses. I felt when I told the manager that he would show more concern other than just an apology. I have been a LaQuinta Rewards member for many years and a regular guest over the years at this property as well as other LaQuinta properties. The fact that something other than apology to any guest let alone a Rewards member is not satisfactory and shows little concern for the guest. The other point on the mattress is that I had told him I had back surgery several years ago and the quality of the mattress was always a concern when staying at hotels. This is first time that beds have been below standard. I actually told him I slept on the floor due to mattress quality.part of the night which was less than a good nights sleep. I told him that I would not be returning to that hotel again> I was surprised that no other comment was offered or any adjustment on room cost due to my experience.

author: FreqTrav401
title: Not a good experince
text: I booked one room with two-queen bed for two nights stay about couple of weeks before the journey. They sent a confirmation email. When I reached at the hotel, I was told that no such room is available as 'they have overbooked'. I had no other choice but to settle for a room with one king bed. The front desk person did not even bother to apologize for that. I was travelling with my wife and daughter. Next day when we retuned, I was told that we have been checked out as there was 'a note in the front desk left by the previous person' to check ourselves out!!. I did never experienced such happening before though I travel quite a lot. This was the first time I stayed with La Quinta and will try to avoid such hotels in future.

author: MissJennieLP
title: Very nice, especially for the price
text: My friend and I joined her family for July 4th at their lake house in northern Minnesota. We had to stay after over after our flight arrived before driving north. I looked for modestly priced accommodations near the airport or downtown and was disappointed that most of them that appealed to me were charging more than $200 a night. I found this La Quinta Inn & Suites on the route toward the lake and made a reservation for about $100 with some confidence that it would be OK. I'm a dog owner and I've stayed in many La Quintas because they accept dogs with no additional charge and the rooms -- particularly at the Inn & Suites division -- are generally clean and pleasant. This one was no exception. In fact, it was very nice and well located in a area of offices. We walked to a nice restaurant for a very good dinner. We didn't have breakfast, but we passed by on our way out and it looked good. All in all, an A+ effort.

author: pattih566
title: Quiet, Cozy place to stay
text: My husband and I and our dog stayed here on a spur of the moment trip. We arrived a little before midnight but our room was ready. Room was clean. Bed was comfy as we both slept all through the night! The shower provided plenty of hot water. Would have liked to have had a refrigerator in the room. Liked the constant fan feature on the air conditioner which kept us plenty cool. Lots of green spaces to walk the dog. Loved the wooded setting but still easy access to the interstate. Could use a little more parking but would stay here again if ever in the area.

author: shoeboxdriver
title: Clean, Quiet, Comfortable!
text: The rooms are very nice. The only thing missing is a refrigerator. I missed the refrigerator. We had a cooler along as we knew the rooms did not have refrigerators, but they are messy and heavy. So much nicer to be able to pop the items in the fridge. I also have a medicine that needs to be refrigerated. The rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable. I would stay again!

author: N4942BRdennisk
title: My stay
text: We really enjoyed the hotel and the staff. The breakfast was very good with lots of selcedtions. The rooms were very nice, the bed was very comfortable. We slept very well! The staff was exceptional. Everyone there was very nice, friendly and helpful. Would recommend this hotel to anyone. We try to stay at LaQuinta's whenever we can!

author: Lacibeau
title: Great Pet friendly hotel
text: Found hotel with help of Bring Fido app. Hotel in beautiful location but right off the freeway. No additional charge for pets. Hotel clean with a great atmosphere. Nice area to walk dogs and station with supplies to clean up after them. The neighborhood behind the hotel is quiet and made for a nice walk with the dogs. Breakfast offered hot and cold food. Food delivery available for dinner and several restaurants nearby by car. Would stay again.

author: 222sungs
title: Excellent place to stay
text: I always look for La Quinta since it is a genuinely pet friendly. I have a small dog that never bark or release himself inside a building. He follows everywhere we go. So La Quinta is our choice if it will be in the proximity of where we are heading. So we came to this place. This is one of better hotel among those we have stayed lately. It is quiet and comfortable place considering it is situated in a big city urban place. The building is not new but quite authentic and looking good with warm beige and orange brick exterior, Inside is clean and spacious so it feels welcome. Over all, it is a quiet and pleasant place to stay a night. I would certainly stay here if i come to visit Minneapolis again.

author: pathY1310GV
title: Great place to stay!
text: We stayed here the night before a medical appointment. Our room was on the backside which looked out on trees and a residential area so was quiet, no traffic. Our room had been renovated so was very inviting with new colors. Room size was good, bed and pillows were comfy...best sleep in awhile! Breakfast was great, a few different choices, Denver omelets and French toast. Not all rooms have a fridge and microwave so be sure to request a room with those if that matters to you. Lobby was large, open, and very inviting. Definitely recommend and will come again!

author: Andre-RT715
title: Nice hotel and friendly stuff
text: Nice hotel, friendly stuff, comfortable and clean rooms, reasonable breakfast, and good location. Two of us stayed there for 3 nights visiting Minneapolis - for a concert, some shopping and reuniting with friends. This hotel is relatively well priced, with free breakfast and WiFi. Everything was as expected. The only thing they don't have is a pool albeit they offer complementary passes to YMCA nearby. Anyway, a better hotel would likely cost 50% more, would charge for breakfast and WiFi. Which would quickly cost us a few hundred extra. They have couple of opportunities for improvement: 1) replace small pillows with regular sizes and 2) move the coffee maker from the bathroom into the room. I would stay there again when I travel to Minneapolis.

author: TammyeC3
title: Me and My Furbee's
text: This hotel was recommended to me by my Aunt who stayed the previous week. When I told her I had to find me a hotel that had pets, she told me she saw pets at this hotel. I immediately went on line to read the accommodations. Was very happy that no pet fee was required. The staff was nice and friendly. Placed me close to the 2nd floor stairs and made it really convenient to take them in and out. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. Nice that they served hot items for breakfast. Me and my furbee's enjoyed our staff.

author: khonish
title: Pleasantly surprised - great stay
text: My wife and I stayed here for one night with our medium sized dog. I admit up front that I am not the biggest fan of the Quinta Inns. I have had some mediocre to bad experiences in them in the past. However, there are not a lot of reasonably priced choices for pet friendly hotels in Minneapolis. We were all pleasantly surprised! The entry area was clean, open and inviting, with a gas fireplace and Lounge area. The room was very clean, the bed was extremely comfortable and the room in general looked like it had been kept in very good shape. The night's sleep was quiet, even though the hotel was fairly full and is located near the highway. We will definitely stay here again, and look forward to doing so.

author: 95ronaldl
title: La Quinta for value and accessiblity
text: Good location to see Minneapolis and St. Paul sights. Clean and well maintained. Great accessible room. Good size room and bathroom. The staff was friendly and responsive. There are good restaurants nearby. Access to the highway is close and easy. Trip from the airport by rental car was quick and easy.

author: kateschro13
title: Clean motel with a great continental breakfast!
text: The ladies at the desk were so helpful. The room was very clean and smelled clean too. The bed was comfortable and well made. We slept very well! The breakfast in the morning was delicious! Scrambled eggs, sausage link, hot oatmeal, waffle maker, cereal, fruit, yogurt, pastries, juice, coffee...etc. Nothing negative to say! It was a great place to stay!

author: jwabers
title: Very nice stay-and I don't like hotels
text: We were very happy to stay here for 4 days and 3 nights. The back of the hotel backs up to a pretty little wooded space. They allow dogs. The staff was as friendly as could be. The price was right and the rooms were very nice. My only complaint is that our room smelled musty, but we were able to open the window a bit and it was tolerable. I really don't like hotels but we will likely come back to this one. They did a nice job and tried to make the stay special. Nice work!

author: Suerae59
title: uncomfortable bed
text: The night didn't start out bad although I had to wait for the desk clerk to realize there were customers (2 of us) waiting at the desk (around 9 p.m.). Received out room key with no problem, went up to the room and when we walked in we noticed the beds looked very soft (too soft) but we had had a long day and were extremely tired. The beds resembled a sway back horse but we crawled in and attempted to get some sleep. As we thought the bed was very soft apparently from many travelers laying on it. About the time we were falling asleep the smoke detector started going off (2:15 a.m.). We called the front desk and thankfully the woman on duty came up right away and changed the battery. The beeping stopped and we returned to our attempt to fall asleep. The next morning we went to the breakfast buffet - it was very good. When I checked out I told the front desk gentleman about the sleepless night exacerbated by the smoke detector and the beds. Not sure what I expected but he really didn't say much and simply asked if I would like a receipt.

author: 265AmyB265
title: Great service!
