text: This room and hotel were just what we expected, with comfortable rooms, clean facilities, and the typical continental breakfast. However, what sets it apart is the service. When my friend and arrived, our Hotwire reservation had not gone through correctly. With the help of Jenny and Justin, though, everything was finally worked out. They kept us entertained, offered alternative solutions, and made costumer service calls while we waited for Hotwire to get its act together. We had theater tickets, so we had to leave before everything had been settled. But, we returned after the show to discover that Jenny had taken care of the situation while we were gone. Great location and lovely staff!

author: MaggieM53
title: Very welcoming and safe
text: We stayed at the hotel for 1 week. We had to bring our cat on this trip. We chose La Quinta because they are pet friendly and there's no extra pet charge. Front desk staff was extremely helpful and nice. When we returned to the room on the 2nd day, we found a greeting card, a can of cat food, and a cat toy left by the TV. They were presents to our kitty from Brandon the front desk and the entire team! It was a very nice surprise that we didn't expect. And our cat appreciated the toy very much as we had forgotten to pack his toys. Highly recommend this hotel and will stay her again!

author: ma103of1
title: Are the elevators working...
text: Stayed overnight on a weekend. The room was quiet and neat. Breakfast was adequate. When we checked in we were told we were on the 4th floor (highest floor) and that the elevators were not working. They were still not working the next morning. A suggestion for better customer service would have been to offer another room or some perk for the inconvenience. Average stay with better customer service I would probably return. Hotel is conveniently located next to interstate.

author: AndreaBradH
title: Weekend trip in the cities
text: We have stayed at a lot of La Quinta's, all ranging from not that great to super nice. This one ranks at the top. We stay at La Quinta's a lot because we find good rates a lot of times plus my husband can get an additional corporate discount plus we like to bring our pets along sometimes and they are pet friendly and there is no pet fee. We usually stay at one closer to the mall but we had a free night that we couldn't use at those La Quinta's so we decided to check this one out. This one is a nicer than those, although they are not that bad. Our room was super nice, spacious and clean and it was nice and quiet. The breakfast was also good, a nice variety between hot and cold choices. If you are planning on activities downtown but don't want to actually stay down there this is a very nice location right off of 394 with easy access to the downtown. The only down fall with this hotel which isn't a huge deal to us but might be to others especially with kids is there was no pool or hot tub.

author: donnaa296
title: Mom's Surgery Recovery
text: My family stayed at this hotel following my 84-yr old mom's eye surgery between Dr. appts. The hotel staff was friendly and made us feel very comfortable and safe. It was clean and quiet. The soft comforters appeared lumpy, but the pillow-top mattresses were super! The rate was reasonable. Hot breakfast bar provided lot of choices and great coffee. Just what we needed.

author: amm1313
title: CSR needs TLC
text: Clean and very spacious rooms. Given I had stayed at a La Quinta in Madison, WI a couple days prior I expected the same service. Was disappointed. Upon entry I was not greeted. Asked for and provided name. CSR then highlighted fields on a sheet then pushed it over the counter to me - without explanation (albeit it was obvious). Was given wrong room but different CSR handled it quickly upon discovery. Decent selection for breakfast food. Outside of poor customer service, nice place to stay and well priced.

author: Niffy3am
title: A good deal
text: We didn't want to stay downtown Minneapolis, so we decided to stay in Minnetonka. We went for a shopping weekend, and this was our home-base. It was not too far to any of the outlet malls that we planned to shop at. This hotel offered a hot breakfast, had lovely grounds, and friendly staff. Our only complaint was that the elevator was hit or miss. It seemed to have a mind of it's own, but not all the time. We told the staff, and they kept getting maintenance to look at it. But bottom line, I would stay there again. The rooms were spacious, and it was clean.

author: BW228
title: A good value
text: This older property has been updated / remodeled and is very nice. The room and bath were both clean. The bed was comfortable with high quality sheets. Lot of nice hot water in morning shower. Room had fridge and microwave. But the quality of the flat screen TV was poor. And other model that has seen better days. The staff were friendly. Did not try the breakfast. Rates are attractive compared to nearby newer properties.

author: MarLee_12
title: Average
text: Short and sweet review. The good? Average La Quinta furnishings and breakfast. The front desk checked me in quickly although she looked like she had a lot going on...maybe a little too quickly since when I came back down to use the microwave she needed me to sign a piece of paperwork. The bad? The front had grass for days but the back where you are designated to walk your dog...mud. It is possible to avoid it but why can't the grass grow there as well? Other than that, the place was fine. Nothing to write home about BUT I would stay again.

author: birchtre2015
title: Lovely place to stay
text: Slept like a baby. Nice and quiet. Very comfortable bed. We loved this place, separate bedroom and living quarters. Very nice. We were right next to the elevator and ice machine and loud neighbors that had the TV on loud and when we closed the door to our room all that noise vanished. In the outer room we could only hear when someone was talking directly outside our room in the hall. In the bedroom with the door closed, we could not hear a thing going on. It was like we had the place to ourselves. And a peaceful view out the window as well.

author: birchtre
title: Very satisfied. Great bed!
text: Very nice people, very very nice room, great bed! Needed a little step up to get into the tall bed because I'm so short, but best night's sleep anywhere. Beautiful site, easy to get to, and extremely quiet. Got the two room suite, a/c in the bedroom but it was also very quiet. We love this place! It is our new favorite! This was our first stay at a LaQuinta and like DavidK wrote, it will not be our last. Don and Marilyn

author: W4895SZdavidk
title: First stay at any La Quinta, will not be the last:)
text: Very nice place. Great staff. Great room. Great breakfast. Dog friendly. Good rates for being at the edge of a major city. Very positive experience. Looking forward to the next time we can stay at a La Quinta.

author: S2772JPmaryg
title: Great place to stay!
text: Overall, an excellent value for your money - clean, updated property with exceptional customer service. Rooms are beautifully decorated and the breakfast was nice in the morning. Also, pet friendly - saw folks bringing their dogs in and they seemed pretty happy. Unfortunately, I had to travel for tragic circumstances due to my friend loosing her son in a car accident. When I told the front office person of my reason for traveling, she was very empathetic. After going to the wake, I came back to my hotel room with a sympathy card and some flowers. I could not believe the kindness the staff (Tatiana) showed to me - it was incredible. I thought to myself - there are still good people in this world. I have never experienced such a kindness in the hotel - it was incredible. I would recommend this hotel without exception- you will not be disappointed.

author: rochesterNEWbie
title: Friendly stay, reasonable price.
text: A small group of friends and I recently stayed in Minnetonka at the La Quinta hotel. Our weekend plans included an annual dog walk and a stop at the Mall of America. As I'm sure you know your pets are not allowed in the mall which made our decision to choose the La Quinta. With their pet friendly rooms, outside dog area, and reasonable prices, it was a no-brainer. Their rooms were spacious enough to fit a dog kennel without disrupting the room. Being able to stay in a comfortable place alongside our furry friends was obviously the big selling point for our group but I was also quite happy with the rest of the hotel and staff. The breakfast area was large and offered a nice variety of foods. I'm not sure what the La Quinta could do to make our stay better but because there is almost always room for improvement I would stick firmly to the 4 star rating.

author: Thundercat1234
title: Need bigger beds, otherwise great!
text: Just stayed at the La Quinta as part of a group tennis event for my kids. My only beef was the room options for my family of 4 - wife and 2 kids. You could get a King suite that had a pull out couch (not great for 12 year old kids to sleep on). Or you could get a room with 2 double beds which is what we settled on. Well, it's been a long time since my wife and I slept in a double bed! Why they don't have queen beds, I don't know. Otherwise the place was great. It was spotless, very clean. The free breakfast was terrific and with my AAA rate, the price was unbelievable. So overall great value, but I'm not sure I'd stay here again just due to the limited bed options for my family (aside from booking 2 rooms).

author: knitwhit
title: Pleasantly Surprised
text: The price of the La Quinta Inn was nearly half that of surrounding hotels, so I was a bit leery of the actual quality of the hotel. I was very pleasantly surprised! The rooms were modern, extremely clean, and spacious. We stayed in the Executive King room and there was plenty of room for myself and my two daughters. The bed was comfy, the bathroom roomy enough for us all to use the mirror at the same time, and the view out the window (facing the back of the property) was lovely. The in-room fridge was large with a freezer and crisper drawer which was perfect for us as we needed to pack lunches for our daytime activities and it held everything we needed.We needed to be out the door long before 7:00 each morning so we did not get to take advantage of the breakfast. The front desk staff was very pleasant and helpful. We'd definitely stay again!

author: Urcnsuz
title: Refreshing & tasty
text: Kudos to the very pleasant staff, even the maintenance man & cleaning staff met in the elevator! You all made it easier to relax. My co-workers & I were offered coupons for local restaurants as well as a pass to the local YMCA. The rooms are spacious & the bed & bedding were comfortable. To top it off, the breakfast provided has something for everyone from waffles, cheese omelets, biscuits & gravy to already prepared oatmeal & a variety of cold cereal choices, juices & coffee! I expect I'll be back for another business trip in June! Thank you to all, even the manager who greeted us at breakfast to see how our stay was! Keep up the good service & clean rooms!

author: Citizen63
title: Working with Bethany was Great!!
text: We have recently stayed at the La Quinta Inn & Suites Minneapolis-Minnetonka. Great rooms, furnishings, and quiet. Oh, BTW did I mention a GREAT breakfast and facilities? We decided to pop for the rooms for our guests at my daughter's college graduation. We selected the La Quinta Inn & Suites Minneapolis-Minnetonka for good location, and a wonderful earlier experience. Bethany really made it happen!!! Professional all the way, friendly and made the price very attractive. Hard to find GREAT folks like Bethany. Gratefully, Greg

author: johnrU3469ZK
title: A super nice place
text: We had an excellent visit at this hotel. I highly recommend it. Our rom was very clean and comfortable. I loved the Wi-Fi and the charging stations in the room. The shower was super nice and it made us feel really nice. The breakfast was terrific. It looked like they took pets. I chose this LQ over the other branches in town just because it seemed like the best one.

author: davidnG3038BZ
title: Great Location, Great Buy
text: I have stayed at this location many times. For our purpose it is very close to what we visit Minneapolis for which is business. It is clean, good beds and in the middle price range. It does not have a pool, which for us doesn't matter. The building is an older structure but has had major renovation. The area of town if very quiet and close access to major freeways I394, I494 and Highway 169. Shopping is very close and their are some good restaurants in the area. We have stayed at this location for approximately 18 years.

author: TimothyH215
title: Good For Price
text: Unfortunately, I just stayed at Hampton Inn prior to staying here. It is not a Hampton. The staff was very helpful and pleasant. First, I went to a soda machine and lost my money. (was reimbursed at front desk) then I purchased one from a different floor. That one was hot. The last night the power went out and the elevator did not work afterwards. All in all, I would still stay there if the price is right.

author: USTraveler2015
title: A bit of drama...
text: Sorry for the late review. Changing our plans at the last minute, we found ourselves here in Minnetonka for our final stay of our Mid-West Trex. After an extremely long day in the car (had breakfast in Kansas City, lunch in Des Moines and dinner in Minnetonka) we decided to stay at the new LQ using my points. When we arrived we got checked in quickly and headed to our room - which turned out to be a king bed with a pull out couch. Hmm, I had booked 2 queen beds. So calling the front desk I was then told by the boy that was all he had. I then had to get LQ on the phone to assist me. All of a sudden a room with 2 queen beds magically appeared for us. I made sure to let the manager know of the situitation and terrible serive of the boy at the front desk. I hope this isn't the practice of this property and the manager assured me that he would resolve it properly.

author: 1115RC
title: First time but not the last
text: Stayed at the La Quinta Minnetonka on 7/11/14 . First time I've stayed at a La Quinta but will not be the last. The staff at check in was very friendly and professional. Room was fabulous, clean and comfortable. plus very roomy. Only complaint I might make about the room is that the sitting chair was wanting. The breakfast area was nice and clean in the morning, but the breakfast was OK. Only real gripe was the coffee which was weak and rather tasteless. Sadly that seems to be a norm in hotels. Still it was a good hotel and a good value

author: reneanddick
title: Last minute late night reservation
text: We got into the Cities late--around 9 pm on a Sat. nite. We love LaQuintas because most if not all are pet friendly so when we stay places, even without our dog, we like to stay where they allow them. Were looking for a restaurant and drove past this hotel so called from the restaurant. They said they were out of standard rooms so we ended up with a King with a sofa sleeper. Got a decent AARP rate. The room was large, spotlessly clean and the bed was divine. And we saw a lovely little French bulldog as we were coming thru the lobby. We're loving these new LaQuintas in MN--booked a few weeks later in Rochester but unfortunately, we had to cancel. We'll be going to FL in March and plan on seeking out LaQuintas along the way.

author: perryfamilyAZ
title: Good Hotel
text: This is the best La Quinta I have ever stayed at. We stayed here for 5 nights in June while we were in town for a friends wedding. The room was large, clean and updated. The breakfast was good. I had a great price thru Hotwire and had no problems checking in. The hotel is not within walking distance to any restaurants, but there are two shopping centers close by. The hotel is easy access from the freeway and a short drive to downtown Minneapolis. I did notice that housekeeping was slow to get our room cleaned, but the hotel was sold out a few nights during our stay.

author: Maryloyola
title: Good stay
text: We came to Minneapolis to see a show at the historic State Theatre and to sightsee. The hotel was very clean and quiet and was staffed with friendly and helpful employees. The only problem we had was with a maintenance man. My husband asked a woman cleaning rooms for a liner for the ice bucket. As English was not her first language she didn't immediately understand what he was asking her but gladly gave us the liner once he made himself understood. A maintenance man working nearby took it upon himself to interject himself into the conversation. He was very short and rude with the worker. His "help" was neither welcomed nor appreciated. My husband complained about him at the front desk, I certainly hope he did not take out his anger on the worker as she did absolutely nothing wrong. I hope he's not in charge of these workers as he seemed extremely harsh and bullying.

author: 632ronad
title: O.K hotel outside Minneapolis
text: The hotel is located at Minnetonka, outside Minneapolis. the location is no problem if you don't mind using public transportation. There is a bus station not far from the hotel, and it is a 30-minutes ride to the city center. Because the hotel is out of the city there is free parking. the hotel itself is a little bit run down, nothing to write home about... However, it was quite clean and the front desk people were very helpful. In sum- cost effective. There is a shopping center 15 minutes walking distance. It is a good hotel for businessmen and there is a free shuttle to the business center.

author: X-CtryGirl
title: Just watch the key locks and faucets
text: This hotel is so clean, well appointed, and quiet! Staff is super helpful. Suburban setting is a plus. But note that sink faucets turn left for cold and right for hot. And your room key card might not work---ever. They have 1983 analog door locks. I will happily stay there again once they switch those door locks to 21st century models. I felt bad having to ask a front desk clerk to open my room door for me umpteen times.

author: Robin1038
title: Nicest staff!
text: Hotel recently became a La Quinta (fmrly Hampton). Within last 6 months, all new beds and new carpet in the rooms. Hall carpets to done by year end. Nice breakfast assortment. But the most outstanding thing about this property is the people! so helpful and willing to offer suggestions on places to go. Shuttle was great and if it wasn't, they would cover the cost of a taxi to pick you up. Cannot say enough nice things.

author: KarenC260
title: Room Key Cards Wouldn't Work
text: There appeared to be a problem with the machine that programs the room key cards. Every time we wanted to get into our room, we had to have the front desk re-program the cards. We were not the only ones having this problem. There appeared to be several others that were having the same issue. One staff person suggested that this was happening to us because our room key cards were put into a pocket/purse next to a cell phone, which was NOT the case. Since we were on the 3rd floor of the hotel, it was a hassle going up to our room only to have our key cards NOT work, go back down to the front desk to get new keys and go back up to our room... every single time we needed to get into our room. We will not stay here again.

author: T7625QGkevinm
title: Great use of points
text: Use two free nights with points. After a lot of research of the other La Quinta's in the area. This one had the best rating and the overall the best appearance. Pretty easy to find. The elevator did take forever, but we did use the stairs most of the time. Wireless was a little difficult to figure out. Very clean. My only complaint was finding the fitness center, no signs to lead the way. Great breakfast. THE BEST COFFEE, served all day!

author: UncleScooge01
title: Beauty and the beast
text: This hotel is a paradox. New & pretty, but hard to get to ( the hotel is one of those you can see from the highway, but how do you get to it?). Hot food in the breakfast buffet, but the food servers didn't come to work so the ad hoc food servers were SLOW. Friendly people at check in, but no one at the front desk when I went to check out. New plumbing fixture in bathroom sink, but the plumber hooked the hot/cold water up backwards (and the sink drains slowly). Wireless internet is free and fast, but the AT&T service went out the night we were there ... so NO internet until the next day. I did like the clean room, comfortable bed, beautiful lobby, the shower & the hair dryer worked great, and very good coffee in the morning.

author: 413tamaraf
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: Newly remodeled and modern hotel. Very attractive rooms and clean! No dust bunnies along edge of room. No Hotel smell. Quiet area. Near by pub with wonderful outdoor seating. Breakfast staff welcoming and friend. Would definitely stay again.

author: Diane0957
title: Bed was super comfy - Room was well appointed, quiet
text: Our stay was excellent. We arrived early and were able to check in to our room without waiting. We found the room to be a perfect size, very comfortable, and the bed was great. The A/C unit was installed so that it does not blow air directly towards the bed, and it was quiet, too. The view from our window was of a wooded area -- not a parking lot, interstate, or industrial zone -- a surprising benefit. Both of us slept well, and we enjoyed a very nice breakfast the next morning. Got a great price via Hotels.com, too! We would stay here again in a flash.

author: thomasbI2812AB
title: A Pleasant Surprise in Minneapolis
text: The La Quinta Inn is not a new building but they have modernized and updated the Inn to a very high standard. The rooms are large and the beds are comfortable. And everything works. We made our reservations for a three night stay beginning on Saturday night. The quoted room rate was $90 per night. But afterwards I discovered that $90 per might only applied to Saturday night and they bumped the rate up to $110 per night for Sunday night and Monday night. I think the La Quinta reservations systems could be more forthcoming on their changing room rates rather than waiting until you had actually reserved the room. The Inn served a good hot breakfast but the staff was having problems keeping up with the demand. Sometimes, you had to wait 10 minutes while the staff restocked the hot food. In summary, we had a pleasant stay at the La Quinta Inn and would stay there again.

author: 28jerryt
title: Quiet comfortable room
text: This place is very clean and quiet. One of the better La Quinta Inn and Suites that I have stayed at. Staff was very accommodating. Asked for a room in a specific location of the hotel and the staff gave me exactly what I asked for. There is no pool or workout center but for me this was not a big deal for me. If you are looking for a nice quiet safe comfortable room I would recommend. Breakfast was nothing special. I travel a lot and I have only found one hotel that has a breakfast that has a person making fresh omelets with your choice of ingredients.

author: williamp9974
title: Very helpful staff
text: Originally 3 of our family was staying here after a long flight. One of the family missed a connecting flight and was stuck in Charlotte, NC overnight. So my wife and I checked in about 12:30 a.m. Right away we asked about changing from 2 beds to a king- no problem. Then this morning I mentioned to Melanie at the front desk that I usually read the Minneapolis Sunday newspaper, which they usually don't have. About 20 minutes later, she handed me the Mpls Sunday newspaper. Made my morning. Breakfast was OK. Will stay there again.

author: margaretl0isj
title: Staff and Mattress!
text: A delightful stay. The staff is outstanding. The hotel is conveniently placed with regard to the Interstate (as in taking 394 into downtown...about 5 miles). Had I needed to use the bus service into Downtown, the bus stop was close. My friend had business meetings and I had an exhibit at a downtown hotel, so we were very pleased with the location. The mattress...what a good sleep. I was on a 12 hour work day, so having a good night's sleep was important. The internet service is consistent. I was very pleased with the entire experience.

author: 841nancym
title: Jason
text: Jason did a great job of solving the TV issues in my room. He was knowledgeable, efficient and courteous. His attitude was friendly and professional. Great job, Jason! Kim sets up the breakfast area and is friendly and does and excellent job in her area. I find all the employees helpful with a welcoming attitude and a willingness to help in any situation. They will solve the issue at hand. I would recommend this hotel to my friends in the Twin Cities. This maybe a site for a future gathering of a group that I belong to and will be meeting in this area.

author: elliev476
title: Wonderful Breakfast attendant!!
text: This Hampton is a small, but busy gem in Minneapolis, and Kim, the Breakfast Attendant, was so friendly and helpful. We were there for 7 nights, and she would bring Orange Juice or coffee if we needed it. A ray of sunshine at the Hampton. Beds were wonderful, and our room faced the woods, nice scenery! Great location, too. Bill Godbe, the General manager, was also extremely helpful. In fact, all the staff were friendly and helpful. We will stay there again, as we visit Minnesota at least once a year.

author: kawidd
title: A little older Hampton but ok
text: This Hampton is just a bit older and not as spiffy as the newer models. The staff is super friendly and polite. The rooms are smallish but ok in appointments and cleanliness. It is not a great hotel by the best standard of Hampton but it is just fine. There is a fridge and a microwave in each room. The parking is good. The air-conditioning is loud which is not so good. Overall it meets general Hampton standard although not the top one by any means.

author: 406patriciah
title: Lovely hotel in Minnetonka
text: My mother and I had a great stay in this hotel in August. The desk staff was very helpful and friendly, and the breakfast staff was top notch. Our room was very clean and wifi worked great. The hotel was very quiet. I never heard another guest. Breakfast was tasty. Very convenient to the highway. We were without a car and this is more out in the suburbs of Minneapolis, so we had to rely on family for lifts. No airport shuttle that far out. With a car, however, it was a quick and easy ride to the airport or Mall of America.

author: Mecro108
title: Outstanding!
text: Being an HH member, I always stay at hotels in the Hilton chain. I choose this hotel because it is close to my new job. Of all of the HH family of hotels, this one was by FAR the MOST PERSONABLE. Hilton hotels are always clean and helpful... but Marissa E. at the front desk went way above and beyond. When she learned that our family is moving to MN, she took it upon herself to track me down the next day when I was in the common area and give me a small packet that she had herself put together on all of the family friendly things to do in the area. I've never been treated to well/personably during a hotel stay. Kuddos to Marissa, Bill the General Manager and this hotel staff!

author: chadwickm805
title: Excellent Service - Clean and Tidy Rooms
text: I was very impressed with the service. When i arrived the General Manager personally went up to my room before I completed my check in to ensure the room was cooled. He also explained all the services provided, including access to a YMCA nearby. The evening staff was also wonderful. I encountered three different front desk staff persons during my stay. They were extremely nice and helpful. Always asking if they can assist me in anything. I could not have asked for a better experience!

author: cariosello
title: Not as good as other Hamptons
text: We stayed overnight myself and four kids. For some reason we couldn't get two rooms but had a choice between a king room or a king with pullout couch? Unlike all the other Hampton Inns there was no mention or offer of a roll away or extra bed linens. The staff seemed exasperated. Maybe because there was a large group of teenage volleyball players running wild through the place all night? They managed to break the elevator so we walked up the stairs to our fourth floor room a few times. They descended on the breakfast the next morning, so by nine there were no eggs, and other breakfast items. On the plus side, the room was clean, the price was good and the location worked for us. I wouldn't say it was so bad I wouldn't return, but it wasn't as good as the other Hampton Inns we go to, and we only stay at Hampton Inns.

author: GaryC725
title: Breakfast with a Champion
text: My wife and i traveled to Minneapolis on business. I attended a business meeting in the morning and Jill took advantage of the continental breakfast. The food was fine, but she was very impressed with Kim. Kim was very positive, friendly and made Jill feel very welcome. Jill said that Kim had a true servant heart... not just someone who had to do a job. Very impressive!... thanks Kim

author: 722EricS
title: Horrible Customer Service at Check In
text: When I went to check in on 3/19 I arrived about 5 minutes early. Stephanie at the front desk made it seem like a big deal because check in time is 3pm. She had to call to make sure the room was ready. I can't believe that 5 minutes early is really that big of a deal to have her huff and puff and stomp over to the phone to call housekeeping. Most hotels I've stayed at accomodate me if I get there 30 min. early or more. Stephanie needs to drop the attitude. There's plenty of hotels in the area, I could easily take my business else where. I wrote to Hampton Inn and all they said was that they would speak to the staff. So much for 100% guarantee satisfaction.

author: Droolinglooneytunes
title: Excellent choice in MSP
text: Clean rooms, great service, staff and manager were very accommodating. Breakfast was very good. Nice choice of items from healthy to not so much. Nice variety of coffee. We had a minor issue with our room and it was resolved promptly and effectively. Rooms were comfortable. Beds firm, pillows soft. Got a great rate on a discount travel website too, but the hotel would be worth the standard rate which they charge.

author: shamrock123
title: Just ok.
text: Excellent price! But... The property is pretty dated - they really need to start planning some renos. The entire hotel was over saturated with air freshener that left me with a migraine in the morning. The lawn sprinklers are very poorly placed - they were literally soaking every car in the parking lot. Because of the sprinklers, we couldn't load our car until my husband pulled out of the spot we were parked in. Of course, in order to get into the car, he had to walk under the sprinklers. Good breakfast though and really awesome coffee.

author: cbtren05
title: Great Service!
text: I stay in a lot of Hampton Inns but service at this one was exceptional and will definitely bring me back. I needed 8 Double AA batteries and when I asked the front desk where the nearest store was that sold batteries, instead of sending me off, they pulled 8 batteries out of the extra TV remotes at the desk and gave them to me. The next morning was pouring rain and I had forgotten my umbrella. the front desk person gave me his personal umbrella to go get my car and pull it under the overhang. The property was very clean including the bathroom. It is also very close to restaurants and shopping at the nearby mall- also a Traders Joe and Macaroni Grill less than 5 minutes down the road. Location is right off the highway and very easy to find. Great staff and great location!

author: bk_t1
title: Nice property choice for the area - Good Value
text: Stayed here on a Sunday night for business in the area the following morning. The hotel generally did not appear too full. Check-in was a breeze and the room was nice; breakfast was nice, wifi was free. Large area near the desk, and LCD TV's, but mine was not programmed for HD. The bath was nice, large counter space which is a pet peeve of mine. The property itself is ok. The property probably needs a good refurb at some point - looks old-ish from the outside and hallways, etc. The service team was great to deal with. My only issue was the business computer software was way out of date. But, for the price paid, the value is pretty solid.

author: endre_pe
title: Nice staff, but no Internet!
text: I stayed at this location for business for two months. I complained to the manager that the Internet is available but it is so slow that I can't read emails, never less do anything else. I ended up using my Verizon data card to perform my business responsibilities with my computer from the room. Scott, the manager acknowledged l it, and explained that it is like this for months, and they already changed internet providers but it remained the same. One day, on a Tuesday, the only elevator they had broke, and when I checked out on Friday, it was still out of order. Nice that Scott, the manager cooks something simple for the guests on Tue (or Wed) evenings free of charge. For closing,-- the Hotel is very nice and very clean, and very close to highways. But not having internet for months while I was there put a huge dent into my rating here.

author: MMJ01
title: No hot water?
text: I travel very frequently for business and often choose Hilton brand hotels. Sorry to say but this Hampton was a disappointment. Check-in was slow. However, the gentleman at the front desk was moving as quickly as possible. He was accommodating and honored my request for a room away from the high school soccer players staying that evening. Two reasons why I believe I'll stay elsewhere only next trip to Minneapolis: one, no hot water on a Saturday night. Even by Sunday morning, the temperature was still not adequate. Two, it was a bit noisy with doors opening and closing.

author: LisaC19
title: Perfect for Business Travel
text: The hotel is quiet and the staff is respectful. The cozy, hotel lobby has a business center and a fireplace. Since they have free wireless internet, I was able to get some work done comfortably in the lobby and the breakfast area. The hot breakfast ensured I had enough energy for our morning meeting. I noticed that the coffee and tea service was available all day, which was great! The free shuttle to my collegues and I straight to our meeting, which allowed us to really focus on preparing rather than worrying about traveling, breakfast, etc. There were no screaming kids, or loud groups; it was all professional people who seemed to be really enjoying their stay. With a good night sleep, hot breakfast, endless coffee, and a free shuttle we had a successful business meeting. We will stay here again when the opportunity arises.

author: parityerror
title: Good hotel all round
text: Location: I had someone pick me up and drop me off, but it didn't appear to be too close to public transport. Plenty of parking if you have a car Rooms: Fairly large room with all the basic requirements - iron, big bed, desk, etc. Breakfast: Free breakky, but not a very big range. The juice was good, they had some donuts too, but they didn't have much variety of cereal, hot food, etc. Cookies: They had fresh cookies on the front counter during the day. These were just magnificent!!! All round, not too much else to say really. No problems, I would happily stay here again.

author: LoggingMoreMiles
title: Excellent Hampton Inn!
text: I stayed at this hotel for one night on business in July. The front desk staff was friendly and welcomed me to the property. I always request a room in a quiet location, and they had saved a great room for me. Although this is an older property, it was obious that the management and staff took pride in keeping it clean. Everything was in terrific condition. The staff explained to me that they were switching to the new Hampton bedding soon, which would definitely benefit the hotel. They did give me a down pillow upon request, which was much appreciated. I will stay at this hotel again-- it was comfortable, clean, and quiet, and also had efficient, friendly employees.

author: emilygriff07
title: Stunning views but food and drink expensive
text: We stayed for 3 nights and found the food and drink expensive, but that could be standard prices for Phuket. Its up in the hills, hence the incredible views, which means the nearest shops and restaurants are a 15 minute walk down hill with no footpaths, and walking back up to the hotel is hard work in this heat! They do run a free shuttle throughout the day though. The pool is brilliant, and the views from the end are spectacular, however be careful with the first step in the pool as it is well hidden and I fell down it and landed on my knee and elbow. The bar service was very good, but the cocktails are mediocre, and again, expensive. We had breakfast included and there was plenty of choice. The Roy Dee resturant had a good choice of food, however the first time we ate there they had no chicken at all, which was annoying as all the dishes I wanted were chicken. I loved the elephants throughout the hotel, and if I didnt have limited room in my rucksack, would have definately bought one!

author: divinaria74
title: did not meet expectation
text: I selected this hotel as the last of our 1 month trip to South Asia, I really liked the idea of a boutique hotel, I expected to be pampered, but since arrival we didn't fell any particular care or interest from the staff. Before arriving I emailed them asking about some information and if it was possible a room upgrade (wanted to make a surprise to my husband) and never got a reply. Upon check in I double checked if it was possible and the girl just said: "your room is nice enough". The room actually was well equipped, forniture is good and bed comfortable, though the lightning has to be improved (especially in the bathroom) but if I ask for a room upgrade I expect at least a proper answer and that someone cares my request. When I contacted reception to book a restaurant for our dinner they said that I had to come downstairs to do it,.... which is ridiculous. Breakfast was also not the top, internet orribile. So the overall experience was so so and did not meet my expectation of going to a world luxury priced hotel.

author: amini54art
title: Beautiful Hotel and a Wonderful Experience
text: We were smart to book the corner suite, for a panoramic view of the Kata/noi bay. The hotel is about 10-15 minutes walk up from Kata beach, and all of its bar/restaurants. It is well worth the short walk cos the high location provides a perfect view from the room. We only had a few days and found it difficult to pull ourselves away from the beautiful view of the room, to explore the beaches. In case the reader want to visit the beaches, the hotel has 2 shuttles an hour to take you down the hill to Kata beach (and back). But we find the Katanoi beach to be much quieter, although the restaurants are mostly on Kata beach. The staff is friendly and attentive. We had assistance for everything we needed. It was a wonderful stay. Thank you very much!!

author: N4478PWadrianp
title: Really nice but noisy pool
text: We had a pleasant stay at this hotel. The staff is really helpful, room spacious and clean. Plenty of choice at the breakfast. The only thing that the management MUST work on is the fact that every morning the swimming pool becomes a Chinese kindergarten. Too noisy. People come to your hotel to relax not just to sleep at night. Otherwise all good, but in my opinion not a 5 star hotel. Maybe 4.

author: Coastal07053914700
title: What an amazing view
text: Really nice and modern hotel with an amazing view over Kata Beach and a really cool infinity pool. Clean and nice looking rooms with a very comfortable bed. Shuttle service brings you every hour to the beach for free. Only two small minus points. The fitness center is more a fitness chamber without a window and not that much training possibilities. The breakfast was good and there were a lot of different things to eat but it was more for chinese guests. I missed typical sausage and cheese for the bread. But, we had a great week there and also Kata Beach is really nice.

author: Fej51
title: An incredible stay
text: We booked the panoramic room, which was located on the corner of the hotel, and it was exactly as we expected and then some. A beautifully and thoughtfully appointed room with a view that was incredible... Seriously, where we live our house has a million dollar view and we were impressed with the one we got at Nook Dee. But the view was nothing compared to the staff. Every staff member was the absolute best, so helpful, nice and always upbeat and in good spirits. We lucked out and stayed there during Loy Krathong and the hotel put on a really fun event that night, with such amazing food, where the staff were so engaged and competitive with each other for float decorations and the miss nook dee (men and women) competition. Beyond the hotel and staff, the location is great. If you want to walk to things, shops and restaurants are close by, and the shuttle to the beach is very reliable too. We stayed only for two nights because we were moving around Thailand, but I wish it were more.

author: amandabR7247DP
title: Amazing Resort!
text: Stayed at NookDee for 4 nights in October. This is the first time I have ever written a review but the service was so exceptional I want others to enjoy the same experience. The staff will go out of their way to accommodate your needs from including a beach bag with towels in the room to providing all the supplies necessary to shower after a day trip (even after we had officially checked out). I would especially like to thank Apple from reception. She was more than eager to assist us with any inquiry and always with a smile. The only negative is that the resort is on a massive hill and the shuttle only comes to take you to the beach several times a day. Prepare to either make the hike or hire a tuktuk for 200-300 baht just to take you down the hill. Would definitely stay here again! Oh and the breakfast buffet is the best we had in Thailand. Lots of variety and extremely delicious!

author: ruechaponp
title: Great Experience with authentic Presentation
text: This is the combination of modern and authentic Thai Style in room decoration, amenities as well as Food and Beverages. The resort presents Elephant fabric dolls in the lobby to welcome guests and on the bed as well as Bowl of Siamese Fighting Fish at the table lobby with Longan Juice as welcome drink. It obviously represents Thai unique Style. In addition Thai textile and Shino-Portugese tile floor are used in room decoration together with modern furnitures as well as see through glass- shower room. So impressive and incredible!!. Although the resort is not connected beach, but routine shuttle car is arranged to Kata beach. For food, You can feel intention in taste and texture of each dish. If you are looking for the place to complete your stay with meaningful concept, I would recommend "Nook Dee" Boutique Resort. (You can enjoy learning Thai native vocab during stay)

author: XantheD9
title: Perfect relaxing stay
text: Breath taking views and truly beautiful Staff, lovely, well appointed rooms kept spotlessly clean during our whole stay. Stayed for ten days here, great sense of the staff being a close team which resulted in a great atmosphere and happy friendly service. Food in the restaurant whilst is comparable to English prices was the best we ate the whole holiday. Breakfast was great with enormous amount of choice. Hotel is a difficult walk to town but a shuttle service provides ample scope for popping in. The situation of the hotel means that you get the most stunning views The only thing I’d like to see is the sky bar opening times more widely publicised as it’s a bit hit and miss wether you’ll get a drink in the evening. We were turned away with some other guests on a perfectly dry evening at 9.45. If we knew we would perhaps of stayed in town longer on the nights it was closed. That said I would go back again and again if it was possible.

author: selomania
title: Ok
text: We stayed for 5 nights. Pros: tastily decorated rooms, especially the ones with view are pretty. Cons: The hotel is located at the end of a steep hill which is impossible to climb under the strong sun of Thailand. Each time you take a taxi to the hotel it is 200 baht. The bar is under soft renovation so closed. Pool area is small without the view of the sea and lacks sea breeze while being protected under the hotel’s shadow. If you are light sleeper avoid room 304 and near by rooms, you keep on hearing the lift and the weird sound it makes. As a recommendation pay a bit more and stay in a villa hotel, nevertheless the rooms with view indeed have a nice view seeing both kata noi and kata beach.

author: Pauly26
title: 8 Nights - Nook Dee Hotel,Kata Beach,Phuket
text: The hotel location is set within the hillside over looking a view of the Andaman Sea(if you get a sea view room of course),otherwise you will still have a great view from the other room of all the greenery of the hillside. I arrived @8.30pm after a 90min journey from the airport,so it’s not a quick transfer due to traffic etc,but check-in was quick & smooth. The staff at the hotel can’t do enough for you,nothing is too much trouble. Location of hotel is built into the hillside and about 20mins in a taxi to Phuket Town where all the bars & clubs etc are. The hotel supply a 2hourly free shuttle bus to both Kata Beach & Kata Noi beach which were nice but when I was there the water was too rough to swim in. The infinity pool over looking the hillside & facing the sea is a great photo opportunity. Food in the hotel restaurant is good but pricey compared to walking 10mins down the hill to where all the other restaurants are,if your fit walk back up the hill or pay 200thb for a tuk tuk to bring you back up. My only small issue is the staff try their best to get everything right for you during your stay but English isn’t their first language,so you may have to speak to someone else who’s English is a little better. Don’t let the hillside location,the walk down to the restaurants or the language barrier prevent you from staying @ Nook Dee Boutique Hotel,it is a great place to stay at if you don’t want to be in the thick of it in Phuket Town itself.

author: prince-junior_s
title: Wonderfull Hotel View 360 degree
text: It was a nice place that i have been visit. This hotel has a wonderful view which is 360 degree and romantic venue for a couple. The room is also really truly Thai traditional design. Staff were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good and BBQ buffet on friday is so nice, seafood is fresh had thai food and international for selaction, the price around $30++ per person. We recommend go to sky bar at rooftop. The view is very nice and you can enjoy cocktial with paronamic view and sunset. I highly to recommend this hotel for your trip in phuket. We will back soon.

author: victorkwan23
title: Good place to stay in Kata Beach area
text: A good place to stay in the Kata Beach area. A bit far from a lot of places. Hotel is located on top of a hill and thus has a great view. However, can be a bit far to walk to convenience stores, etc. Food is excellent. View is great. Rooms are clean. Overall a very pleasant stay.

author: EkatarenaA
title: Everything was excellent
text: The breakfast was very generous and delicious, we use to eat also in the night at the hotel restaurant because the food was delicious and not expensive. The staff was friendly and kind they even gave us the possibility of a late check out for free. You must this beauty with your eyes, certainly I recommend it ! We stayed at Nook Dee Boutique Resort for 3 nights. It was beautiful. The staff are amazing. So friendly and helpful. Great location. We will be back very soon.

author: Luca_Bongio
title: Very good hotel, excellent view.
text: I visited this hotel during my honeymoon, I wrote them explaining it and I expected a special welcome, but nothing special arrived, not even a bottle of wine, like every hotel is used to do. I was a little disappointed. But this is only a little detail that doesn’t count in the whole judgement. Personally I felt very well and comfortable, the personnel was very friendly and very smiling. The rooms are quite well designed, according to my tastes, breakfast excellent, astonishing view. The swimming pool has a beautiful view and also the solarium area is comfortable. Some details to improve the noisy, especially in the morning doors slamming, the lifts sounds, people walking. Generally I like it.

author: Yunmimii
title: Very bad experience
text: Don’t go to this hotel. It’s a very small hotel, can’t even courts 5 stars. Staffs are not friendly, location is bad and prices are not fit this hotel. They didn’t answer my email about airport pickup, when I arrived at airport I chose go by myself. However, when I arrived at hotel they told me they already sent someone to pick me up. I asked her I sent your guys emails several times, but no answer at all. She didn’t say anything, JUST LET ME PAID THE 1300 TBH. When I checked out, I picked one laundry bag for my wet swimsuit, they also charged me 150TBH.

author: Fearless698476
title: Fantastic
text: Recently just returned from a 7 night stay at Nook Dee Resort. I would recommend this hotel, everything was fantastic and the staff where very friendly. We did have a slight issue with the scooter the hotel organised for us. The hotel do not rent scooters this is done by a company who are based just before the entrance of the hotel. Please beware these scooters are not safe, myself and my wife very nearly had a horrible accident. We where advised by a Ambulance driver the tyres where not safe and must return the scooter. We decided to get a tyre replaced as we where 30 mins away from the hotel. When approached the company with photo evidence of the tyre and a receipt he refused a refund in which we decided to return the scooter. Please do not let this put you off this Hotel the views are fantastic the rooms are very good and staff are doing a great job!

author: scpancspan
title: It's all about the view from the room
text: It's all about the view from the room with this hotel. I got the panoramic corner room which provided the perfect view for sunsets from the balcony. Apart from this, the room was large and comfortable as was the bathroom. The property is well maintained. Food was okay; it would be nice if they had a few more vegetarian options. Service can also be a bit better but some of the issues in that are likely due to miscommunication. The hotel also provides a shuttle to nearby Kata Beach and Kata Noi Beach which is needed because the hotel is situated up a steep road that offers no room to walk on. Overall, I'd recommend couples and families looking for a hotel that provides all the amenities and is a short distance away from the noise of Kata Beach.

author: keepsakejournal
title: Love at First Sight!
text: This place is a true gem in the heart of the Kata district. We arrived to two refreshingly cool welcome drinks and wet towelettes which were perfect to combat the humidity of the night. Check in was a breeze with service being quick and efficient. We were shown to our room within 10 minutes of arriving and had our bags carried in for us by a lovely staff member who I unfortunately forgot the name of! We stayed at Nook Dee for a total of 10 nights and the highlights of our stay were definitely the cliff face pool, the food at the restaurant and pool bar, the cocktails and the customer service. The staff at Nook Dee go beyond to satisfy your every need, even cutting our fruit by the pool when we brought some goodies home from the night markets. We definitely recommend joining in the night markets that Nook Dee hosts exclusively for their guests and do spare a moment to try the food at their restaurant. By far the best Massaman curry I have ever had. Definitely check out their roof top bar for exclusive use to their guests only and enjoy the views of Kata Noi and Kata Beach from afar. Thank you for making our trip so memorable and we will definitely be staying at Nook Dee again in our future Phuket travels.

author: TravellingWillboury
title: Great way to start the holiday with the best sunsets ever ☀️
text: Get the slight improvement points out of the way. -more shuttle pick ups is a must and I don’t know why you are not listening to the guests on this -walk back up the hill in the heat is a killer, so avoid at all costs -reception too chilled they forget your waiting or that you are even there. -pool is freezing in the windy days, so heat it, it’s supposed to be 5 stars and I get out blue! +pool is amazing and clean, views at the end are great if you can get passed the posers taking a million selfies 😎 +breakfast is nice and coffee/tea is good. If you don’t mind Chinese/Japanese food the choices are many. +restaurant next door is nice and cheaper than hotel for a meal +mini bar is ok value and they check on exit, so you can stock up from 7 eleven +++rooms are great, we had deluxe sea view (#202) and oh my what a view, I could and did sit there every sunset. Bed is very comfortable and the pillows are supper soft. Also the bed is massive, so my son (6 years) slept with us but the sofa is also a good bed so no need for an extra one. Would go back. 👍

author: PeteSedge
title: Lovely hotel, good location
text: just returned from a 2 week stay in Nook-Dee. Firstly the views from the pool/chill out area are spectacular looking over the bay below and mountains above. The pool was big enough and a nice bar handily located just next to it. We were able to get a sun lounger even when sleeping in until 11am although they weren't overly comfortable. Great for sunbathing however the sun goes behind the hotel at about 4ish which limits sunbathing from this time, but watching the sunset from the end of the pool is a must! The room was not overly big, but nice enough with a big comfy bed which is a must for me. The TV had a decent range of channels and the room decor was ok. Breakfast was decent enough with a good selection of scran available. We didn't sample any of the evening meals, although the poolside food for lunch was decent, albeit quite expensive. The hotel didn't wow me enough to return but is certainly a great place for a nice holiday.

author: Alexander012
title: Good hotel.
text: Excellent and stylish hotel! Located in the jungle, with the tremendous pool! Beautiful view of the sea! Tasty breakfasts and very friendly personnel! Room in hotel very stylish, clean! Spa salon, gym, all top-level! I advise all this fine hotel! I surely here will arrive to the next holiday

author: rkim511
title: So much potential, but disorganized and disappointing
text: I had high expectations for this place but overall was disappointed and have communicated my feedback to the management team - to their credit, they were incredibly receptive which makes me feel that there is still potential to turn it around! Pros: - Beautiful view of Kata/Kata Noi beach from the corner rooms - Well manicured and cute grounds, with lawn area - Infinity pool overlooking the beach view - Many activities available, such as Friday night BBQ, cooking classes, offering alms to the monks, wet market visit, etc. Cons: - Mediocre food - Weak English level from majority of staff (though there were definitely some exceptions) - Sewage smell and lack of privacy at the spa (as the only dividers are curtains) - No towels provided at the pool (in fact, the staff member behind the bar told me to just go back to my room to get a towel as I stood there dripping wet) - Constant need to sign-in to wifi as it automatically logs you out - Key card input to turn on electricity was not reliable; everything kept going off and coming back on again in the middle of the night so they sent someone who didn't speak English - Rooms felt quite cramped Location: - It's on top of a very steep hill which gives you great views, but it's not an easy stroll to the beach. They do provide shuttles but it's not as frequent as one would hope. This hotel also caters very much towards the mainland Chinese customers. There were three different parties of families staying when we were there and it was quite noisy (especially in the spa), so it was a bit difficult to feel relaxed. The staff in general were friendly, if not ineffectual. But their heart and attitudes were definitely in the right place. I would probably prefer to try somewhere else next time I am in Phuket.

author: 630paulom
title: THE PERFECT STAY IN PHUKET!
text: Before say anything else let me congratulate the manager. He knows every guest by his name, and every day try to make your day goes pleasent. The hotel has great views to Kata beach and Kata-Noi beach. From your room you can see the amazing sunrise... Breakfast is prescious, and we love the interior design of the rooms. Diferent, trendy, cosy, vibrant... Just one wish: increase the shutle from the resort to the beach... A gap betwen 5PM and 9pM is too much, and you should even have a least one later, 10PM I TRYLY RECOMMEND!!! I WILL CAME BACK

author: polapola17
title: Lovely Place to Stay, Cute Boutique Thai Style Resort
text: I had a pleasant stay at the resort for 3 nights in a Deluxe Panorama room. The view from my room is fantastic and it was a relaxing stay. The service was generally good as well. Apart from breakfast, I tried a dinner at the resort's restaurant too. It was nice and the price for their seafood basket for 2 persons is amazingly cheap. And because we have to leave the resort very early in the morning to the airport, we gotta skip breakfast. So the staff suggested us to inform them in advance and they prepared us a cute take-away breakfast boxes. This is so impressive :)

author: janicecY9485JR
title: Could be better for arrangements
text: My hubby and I stayed in the Jacuzzi room for two nights. Before my arrival, I emailed the resort to confirm my booking, but I didn't get a reply for more than 3 days, until I find them in Facebook for urging just a reply. Then the Jacuzzi wasn't clean at all when I arrived. It's a bit disappointing. However the restaurant Roydee is really a yummy choice for us. And the spa was marvelous too. We love the"infinity" pool as well although weather was not as good as expected. It turns out to be a nice experience in phuket. Thanks.

author: pannnup2017
title: Amazing view and friendly environment
text: We have stayed in Jacuzzis suite with sea view and the view is breathtaking. Staffs are very helpful and friendly. The sunset view from the roof top is so amazing and breathtaking. Pool is very good since not chlorinated and shady so that in the afternoon also can swim ,with no worry about hot sun. Breakfast is good. It is on the top of the hill so that still need to walk 10-15 mins to beach but the hotel provide shuttle bus every other hours. Very quite and peaceful. Recommended for those who want to relax and peaceful environment with good view.

author: loral899
title: Don't get your laundry done here!
text: Don't get your laundry done here! They charged us $89 U.S. dollars. We could have stayed another night at the hotel for that price. All we got washed were our gym clothes which are very small and thin, not like I got my wedding dress cleaned. The hotel was clean and the free breakfast was great. Bit of a hike from the beach. But based on how I feel taken advantage of by the price of laundry prices I won't stay here again.

author: qchoi
title: Unacceptable air conditioning
text: The view is amazing. However, The air conditioning is unacceptable. The power cut off at least FIVE times per day, even in the midnight! We can't sleep well during our stay. The water supply is not stable. It's just too weak. I would rate it as a 3-star hotel max. Not worthy at all

author: 110kingn
title: Gorgeous ,Nook Dee boutique resort
text: Ocean view from your window. Sunset and sea breeze on rooftop good on happy hour Drinks. The pool is so cool with jacuzzi. Free shuttle bus to the beaches KataNoi then Kata beach every one hour from 10.00 to 17.00 ,then no bus on 1800,1900,2000. The last at 21.00. / nice spa located at Basement 3 but you need to book in advance. Free wifi for every areas in hotel. Enough parking lot under lobby. Hotel location is upper hill - rent a motor pad Or a car with tour desk is at the lobby Phi Phi island trip is really recommend. Ask King Dee for any traveling question.

author: watermelon99
title: excellent
text: We stayed as a couple for a week at Nook-dee and had an excellent experience. We loved the view from our room, the infinity pool, and while eating breakfast on the balcony. The breakfast selection was amazing with both western and Asian choices. Our room was clean and staff were polite and helpful. There were kids at the hotel but we did not find it too noisy. The shuttle goes once per hour to the beaches, but sometimes can leave a little earlier than schedule from Kata beach. So be sure to get there early if you are planning to take the shuttle back from the beach. The hotel is up a little hill and takes about 5-10 minutes of hiking if you miss the shuttle. We were happy to pay some price to exercise for the amazing views from the hotel.

author: VoyageuseDeCanada
title: Loved It
text: Spent a fabulous week at the Nook Dee Resort. I did send an email to the hotel beforehand to ask about transportation and never got a response which was disappointing. However, everything from our arrival to when we left was wonderful. Loved the clean and spacious rooms. The infinity pool with a view of the ocean was amazing and the staff were friendly. The breakfast buffet was plentiful and we often didn't need a full lunch. We ate at the pool and in the restaurant a few times and everything we had was tasty. Also, recommend the restaurant just outside the restaurant called Chomley. Like others we made use of the shuttle service to the beaches and do wish the shuttles continued through the evening. All in all it was a very good stay and I would recommend this place to others.

author: Shayanbkk
title: 5 star all the way
text: What can I say about this place but really, really nice things. I always tell everyone, it's the beauty and magnificence of a hotel that draws me to it but what impresses me is the service. If it the service and experience is good, it's why I will keep coming back. At Nook Dee that is exactly the case. The staff were sooooo friendly and helpful. Always smiling and asking how our stay was and if we needed anything. The rooms, the views from the pool and sunset deck are all amazing. No question. The seafood dinner was also delicious as we paired it with a Thai wine they had suggested - scrumptious! Really awesome stay - dee dee maak.

author: travelyql
title: Awesome stay
text: This hotel was great. We loved that it was a small hotel, and the view is lovely. The shuttle to the beaches ran every hour and was very convenient. There were always chairs available by the pool, and the pool has an awesome view. We really enjoyed the breakfast, great variety of food and awesome service. We also ate at the restaurant for lunch and dinner and all the food was amazing. Would love to come back for the mango sticky rice. Overall the staff was always courteous, and asking how everything was, and eager to help with any arrangements. I hope I have the pleasure of staying here again.

author: LarsoMarianne
title: Nice resort on the hill with fantastic sea view
text: We stayed at the resort for 3 nights. We arrived in the evening and everything was prepared so the check-in went smoothly. The room we got on the third floor had a fantastic sea view on Kata Beach and Kata Not Beach and the room was well equipped as we expected. Since we arrived late we were a little bit hungry and the arrangements at the resort was a BBQ in the garden and the restaurant was closed. We felt it was too much with a BBQ so the staff organised a light meal for us which we appreciated very much. The breakfast was good. There is a shuttle service to the two beaches but on Kata Noi Beach they stop on the north end of the beach which might is not the best alternative since you have to walk 300-400 meters if you travel with kids in a trolley. The other alternative is to use the steep stairs to the beach.

author: rachelenab
title: Nothing short of amazing !
text: Had an amazing time in Nook Dee!! To my surprise , I was upgraded to a private villa for free ! The room was amazing and nothing was too difficult for the awesome staffs there ! Thank you for an amazing time . The infinity pool was really worth taking a dip in ! The buffet spread was extensive as well! I will definitely stay here again and recommend this place ! A special shout out to Joe- Dee who was really knowledgable and friendly ! Thank you :)

author: 54sunilb
title: The best hotel ever!!!
text: Amazing boutique resort, Enjoyed stayed at nook dee. Staff were very friendly. All room was nice,very clean, comfortable, decorate and have special design we love it very much. The resort have amazing view from the room and infinity pool. BBQ seafood on Friday night were fantastic with fresh seafood and delicious Thai dishes. Breakfast were good selection of healty food. Big thank to General manager she make our tour incredible. I would absolutely stay there again..

author: z302
title: Wonderful visit!
text: Perfect for a slightly secluded getaway. Located at the top of a hill, with a couple of other restaurants very nearby, you can either stay up on the hill and hide from the rest of the world (a great option) or walk/take the shuttle down to town nearby. We had an ocean view room with a spacious balcony. There are many places around the property to sit and relax. The staff was amazing. When my husband started to get sick, they made sure we got to the pharmacy, had tea, and that he was okay. We really felt like they were looking out for us. Loved the endless breakfast with tons of options including egg station, noodle station, western and asian hot dishes, pastries, and more. Can't wait to return!

author: AndrewH5624
title: Great service, great pool and amazing vista
text: We stayed at Nook Dee for 5 nights and were really happy with our choice. Nook Dee is a boutique hotel perched on the hill looking over Kata Beach to the north and Kata Noi Beach to the south. For us this was a perfect location to base ourselves to explore Phuket - situated around equal distance from Patong and Phuket Town, Kata Beach is a very cool area of Phuket and one of the more beautiful beaches on the island. Being situated atop the hill above Kata Beach means that it is a fair trek to walk up all the time if you are on foot so I recommend hiring a motor scooter to get around from here which is very cheap in Phuket (around 250 baht a day) - otherwise, taxi or tuk tuk. The housekeeping at Nook Dee was some of the most detailed I have ever seen in a hotel - clothes folded, bags arranged neatly, toiletries arranged neatly in the bathroom - it was above and beyond! Staff were extremely helpful and friendly and the pool was amazing. Breakfast was also a highlight. We would definitely stay here again!

author: vrindanandagopal
title: A beautiful resort for a memorable vacation
text: Situated on a hilltop, Nook Dee offers an excellent view of the Kata beach and surrounding hills from the room. We were one of the very first guests (I guest third set of guests) of Nook-Dee and we were told the resort had opened only a couple of days back! The rooms were peaceful and very comfortable with modern amenities. we were welcomed with a stuffed cute little Nook Dee elephant :) .The staffs were very polite and extremely friendly.The wonderful restaurant had calm ambiance. We being strict vegetarians, the staff made sure my family and I had a sumptuous vegetarian meal throughout our stay.The Tom-Yum soup served in the restaurant was yum-yum! There is a salt water infinity pool with Jacuzzi. The list is endless so are the memories from the stay! We had stayed here for a period of 4 days and 3 nights and would love to go back anytime :) Special thanks to Ms. Bee Dee for her warm hospitality.

author: SoniaG3953
title: Amazing Everything!
text: - Extremely friendly service. Staff are always greeting you and checking up on you to make sure you are satisfied - cleaning staff does an amazing job!! Always folding our clothes and keeping the room nice and tidy. They fold any clothes lying around. - the infinity pool is beautiful and it has an amazing view - breakfast is great! They have an egg station made fresh to order. - everytime I call front desk for additional toilet paper, they arrive in under a minute - the room is a good size and it has a nice layout - happy hour from 2:30 to 3:30 and 5 to 7. Buy one get one free

author: MK09XI
title: Amazing place with flawless service
text: Went to nook dee after reading all the amazing reviews and it didn't disappoint. We rented a car so going to beach only took about 3 minutes or so. The views from nook dee are just breathtaking. Love the architecture and the cleanliness standards at this resort are top notch. Loved the daily buffet breakfast. All in all an amazing place to stay if you want to relax, enjoy drinks by the pool and just take in the amazing scenery. PS The pool alone is enough reason to stay at this hotel. 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

author: Gabriele_Lele_Guidi
title: Amazing
text: Hidden gems of Kata Beach NookDee Boutique Resort ,best location of sunset view point upthere rooftop and your rooms window. Good welcome with cold lemongrass towel and Longan juice. The room is really beautiful faced to both Kata beaches ,recommend all room at the third floor Orn Dee receptionist will bring you helpful. You can hire a car and motorbikes or any trip recommend from King Dee(friendly lady at the front desk) Car Parking is large ,downstair you can park your cars and motorbikes. Elevator is available here. Highlight of Every Saturday night is Seafood BBQ buffet with nice view of KataNoy beach. Nan Dee ,lovely and politeness lady at the restaurant. Thanks for all your help fills my best holiday inPhuket.

author: Bradmg
title: Good value for money
text: Stayed 4 or 5 nights as solo traveller. Lovely large room, nicely decorated. Great bathroom and had a balcony with view. Breakfast good but not great. Attentive staff. Location is a little out of the way, which was nice to escape from hustle and bustle, but sometimes a bit inconvenient and difficult to walk up the hill, although there were shuttle service but mostly during the day. For the price would recommend. Very comfortable.

author: denisseee03
title: Wonderful hotel with amazing views, design and service
text: Had an amazing stay at Nook Dee and couldn't be more happier booking this hotel. It was the perfect end for our Phuket trip. The design of the hotel was gorgeous, modern minimalist with a touch of Thai design. Perfect. The swimming pool was amazing with the view of Kata Noi. The location was on top of a hill but there are shuttles every now and then that brings you to Kata. The service was excellent, the people are really helpful and friendly. There was a rooftop place on top for a great view of the Kata Beach, perfect for sunset. I really did enjoy my stay in Nook Dee and I would recommend it to all my friends and family and would also come back here when I visit Phuket again. Beautiful!

author: josepc978
title: I'm back again (*;*)
text: I've stayed here a year ago. I love it here, it is a very special place. Reception is very good. Welcome drink and cold towel change is also featured here, I stay here five nights, my room is upstairs. A sunset view from the room. I have a good travel Wonderful restaurant I promise if you stay here, it's definitely worth it. Thanks to all employees The rest of my family is wonderful. Our thanks Front Man for a beautiful room. And the service is wonderful for our family.

author: sarheshinik
title: From the welcome till the bye bye.. Was great😍😍😍😍
text: Was there on 14th till 17 july. Was great stay.. With warm welcome.. The room was clean n great with sea view.. Food was really good with touch great Thai love n not to forget The great pad Thai by the pool. The staff are so polite and helpful.. Will go there again. Thanks guys.. Keep up the good vibe n keep smiling... 😘 😊😀😃😄

author: 586kings
title: Excellent
text: There was only one drawback to this hotel was the location. It is on a steep hill and it makes it difficult to walk to if you don't feel like paying for an over priced taxi. Now that the bad is out of the way EVERYTHING else was good from the infinity pool, to the breakfast, and the view of the beach. I regret not staying there my whole time in Thailand. I'm on my 3rd hotel and none of them measure up. I just tried to book the rest of my stay there but they were sold out. In closing, i highly recommend this place. If im ever in Phuket again Nook Dee is where I'd stay.

author: MMagdalena
title: Decent Hotel in Kata Beach
text: On our recent stay in Nook Dee, I came with a group of 4 and booked 2 separate rooms. One was a standard ocean view room and the other was an upgraded Jacuzzi sea view room. My biggest regret this trip was paying the additional money for the jacuzzi room which was not worth it at all. The room is down numerous flights of stairs that don't have an elevator, which doesn’t bother me as it is good exercise, but the jacuzzi in the room is in a corridor and the view is not what they make it out to be in the photos. Yes you see the sea, but you have a huge cell phone tower that stands in front of it obstructing the view. Otherwise, the pool is fantastic, the hotel restaurant is a decent meal and breakfast has enough options for anyone. It is a short walk from Kata beach but not a walk I would recommend doing at night because there are no sidewalks and walking up that hill and curvy roads after dark may not be the safest idea. Unlike Bangkok and most other places, Tuk tuks and taxis in Phuket do no bargain rates with you much, so be prepared to pay 200 baht to or from town back to the hotel which is under a 5 minute ride. If looking for a more luxurious stay, I would go elsewhere but if a basic hotel with a good ocean view and not right on the beach is what you need, then this is the place for you.

author: hojiny984
title: 좋음
text: I and my partner stayed near the Patong beach and moved to Kata beach looking for some quietness. Kata beach was amazing, the weather was perfect and there are many shops and restaurants near the beach just no hectic parties at night. Staying in Nook Dee was also amazing. The staff were all smiling and served us with the welcome drinks when we got there. they also upgraded our room to Deluxe room so we were very happy. Spent all day in the swimming pool and had nice sleep in comfy bed. Breakfast was good, too. Would like to visit this hotel again. Only one downside is that it is not really walkable to the shops at nights. they had shuttle service but it finished at like 6 pm.

author: 662ivye
title: Breakfast is bad, hotel is overrated.
text: Good view of the Andaman sea, place is relaxing but there are several negative things about the hotel that makes it not worthy pf the price. Breakfast menu is the same everyday. Bacon, sausages and bread. We stayed for 5 days and 4 nights so variety for breakfast would have made a difference on our experience. This place is not for long stay. I believe the hotel is overrated. Far from the beach, though, they offer shuttle service but the latest ride is at 6pm. Also far from groceries and kata center. The location is uphill so you need a tuktuk ride to buy necessities or even food.

author: ngngoc
title: memorable
text: Nook Dee is a new hotel with amazing space and passionate staff. We get a free upgrade to deluxe room which is really nice. They have the comfiest bed ever, make you want to lie down all day. And the welcome drink is very tasty after a long trip. One bad side is that the hotel is up on a hill but they have the shuttle bus 4-5 times a day. However, renting a scooter is a better idea to explore the town. There are many motorbike for rent store right down the hill with the price of 150-200 baht per day. Would recommend it to everyone.

author: HotplateOntario
title: Nice ,clean, modern but expensive food and stuck up on the hill
text: Stayed 3 days in June /16 Modern, only 1 year old resort, the breakfast is good, well worth it if booked free with your stay otherwise you will be paying 550 baht each. Drinks is good from 5pm to 7 pm Happy Hour for ½ price drinks around the pool. The pool is nice but dangerous for kids; it would be so easy for a kid to accidently climb over the side of the pool and drop to his death. For lunch and supper, we found the restaurant very expensive, A great option is a local restaurant called Cromley just a minute walk away has good food a ½ the cost, you can also order food or beer/ drinks to go at ½ the price of what the resort charges. Otherwise you need to go down the hill. They only have 4 shuttles per day – 10am, 1 pm 3pm, 6pm down the hill to the beach. These shuttles are usually packed. Ideally they should 1 per hour during the day into the evening but I think the resort wants people to eat at their restaurant.

author: joelchang
title: Celebrated our one-year wedding anniversary here!
text: 1) Perfect hotel to celebrate our one-year wedding anniversary 2) Located on the top of the hill so you can see a beautiful view of the beach 3) Delicious all-you-can-eat breakfast accompanied by the most helpful staff! 4) Book the Superior Room Deluxe - highly recommended if you want this to be a luxurious stay. It’s a great deal! 5) Movie night on the lawn adjacent to the check -in counter in the evening! 6) Rent a scooter - it’s the best way to get around the city and to the beach for such a cheap price. 7) A far drive from the airport to the hotel (about 1200 - 1400 baht per person). Make sure you book this in advance so that you don’t have to deal with getting ripped off by the drivers at the airport 8) The tour packages in the hotel are quite expensive. I suggest that you explore better deals when you are in the city. There are multiple tour guide shops set up for your convenience.

author: bsl88
title: Amazing view and good service !
text: Definitely value for money ! The view is exceptional. You get both sea and mountain view from the infinity pool. Suprisingly crowded for such a new hotel. Our room was the deluxe Panorama Corner Sea view room and was on the right wing of the resort hence part of our view from our room was the nearby construction view 😕 but nonetheless it was still a good experience. At night there were fireworks from our room too ! Spa was average but for the promotional price, it's not too shabby. Go over to nearby kata noi beach for sunset , the sand are fine and clean ! Perfect sunset spot

author: dameous
title: Far beyond what I had expected!
text: What a great place! Friendly staff, modern feel and an amazing view on top of a hill! First time in Thailand and couldn't of picked a better place.
