Shops and restaurants just about 10 min. walk. Taxi available just outside should you want one(about 300 baht)...so we really just walked most of the time. Don't miss out on the roof top sunrise, sunset view complete with garden benches facing "the view". My very first infinity pool experience as well and it felt amazing floating there watching the sunset. a lot of firsts with Nook Dee will return for sure!

author: nataliea625
title: Friendly, Clean & Relaxing !
text: My partner and I recently stayed 9 nights at this beautiful boutique resort. The staff were amazing & so friendly, especially Pok :) The rooms are very clean and the view from our room was lovely ! It is on the top of a hill, but after the first walk up its really not that bad (we are used to walking a lot anyway and enjoyed burning the calories) otherwise it's a 200BT minimum for a taxi or tuk tuk. The hotel offers complementary shuttle bus to and from Kata beach, which is super handy on the hotter days. The pool has the most amazing view and is very clean and quiet. The whole time we were there, there was always a sun lounge available by the pool (unlike a lot of hotels around Phuket where you have to fight for a seat) and there was only ever one or two people in the pool at the same time, which in my opinion is ideal. We have been to Thailand over 10 times combined and have stayed in many hotels, this has been in the top 3 so far. I couldn't recommend it enough ! Thank you for having us and we hope to visit again soon 😊

author: marryamk13
title: Secluded property
text: Lovely little property. Good secluded location. Hike to walk to the hotel. Small bar and small restaurant menu. Not too many late night dining options. Great infinity pool. Rooms are unique and clean however slightly small. Beautiful views from balcony.

author: Kit927
title: Lovely little hotel up the hill
text: This lovely little hotel which I would recommend to anyone coming the phuket, the nice staff and general experience well worth the inexpensive rate per night. The hotel is about 5-10 minutes walk uphill from Kata beach, we were driving so it was not a problem for us at all. it was not one of those large scaled hotel but every thing was just right and comfortable. The rooms are clean and well designed and comfortable. I loved the quality of the bed and pillows that I would like to sink into it all day long. The staff are very friendly and helpful that makes me feel like home all the time. The pool is not big but it has a good view of the beach below and I can see sunset from the infinity pool. The breakfast tastes good and it was nice eating outside on the balcony. Would be nice if there are more thai cusine choices but I can't really complain about it.

author: soapim
title: Great Hotel and staff
text: Stayed here with a group of friends and we loved it! the room was fantastic and the food amazing! if you eat at the restaurant you have to try the braised beef. The pool is great in the afternoon when the building over shadows it which will give a perfect temperature to laze around in. The view is remarkable and the location is beautiful. The hotel is situated right next door to Foto Hotel and close to the shops and restaurants, the only problem is that its located up a very STEEP hill. There is a shuttle bus which drops you off right in front of kata beach. last bus runs at 6:30pm so you'll have to catch a taxi or a tuk tuk back. ( I wouldn't attempt to hike up the hill) Overall a fantastic hotel and would recommend to all. (the hotel is fairly new and is still under construction in some parts)

author: ChristieC499
title: Gorgeous
text: This place is on a hill overlooking the bay and is beautiful. The staff is very friendly. The rooms are spacious and modern w/ a small balcony. The infinity pool overlooking the water is incredible. The only downside is that you can't walk to town, the hill coming back would kill you and with the traffic very dangerous. The hotel does provide a shuttle a few times a day, but the last is at 6:00pm. We would take the last shuttle into town and then a cab back. The price was very reasonable, I would highly recommend this lovely hotel

author: Robdoggy
title: Going to get popular!
text: Stayed here for a week after seeing the resort being built last year. Got a lot going for it. New, clean and the view,the view, the view!. Room 301 would be the no. 1, but any room on the 3rd floor facing west are good. Room 307 has a good view of both kata and kata noi beaches. The breakfast and service are very good,especially service from Daeng. The Roy Dee restaurant also serve a great steak. A word of warning, don't buy the "Tom yum" cocktail( bloody hot!!!!). Will be back!

author: iamjanm
title: Beautiful new hotel with Best view in Phuket
text: Nook Dee is one of the best hotel in Phuket. Hotel is located on the hill top of Kata which give the best view 360 around. Room is well designed by good architect with touch of Thai, very unique, colorful, charming. Staffs are very friendly and helpful. Breakfast is amazing has very variety and taste good. Infinite edge swimming pool is incredible especially at sunset. The fun part also at the end of the pool has clear acrylic that you can see through the ocean underwater. I have to bring under water camera next time. This is incredible good hotel definitely the best 4 star which much better than many 5 star. I definitely recommend to everyone and can't wait to go back there again.

author: LittleMissVacationer
title: As chic as it sounds...
text: I stayed here during my work trip in Nov and I wished I was on my holidays instead! The location was serene and my room had a perfect view of the sunset when the weather was good. The rustic feel of the resort (the walls, the vintage tiles, the welcome gift I received) made me feel like I'm back to my childhood days. The design of the hotel is very unique and traditional but they also included modern design elements in the bathroom area. The bed is so comfortable too and I really hated it when I cannot enjoy it as much because I was there to work and had to be up early morning. The restaurant serves decently nice local Thai food but I wish they can include more Thai dishes. Love the ambience in the evening when the weather cools down. Looking forward to returning to this hotel in the near future!

author: Lucasmba
title: Excellent New Hotel!
text: The hotel has been opened for less than 6 months. So everything is very clean and well preserved. The best parts of the hotel are the beautiful architecture and the fantastic pool. Just for the pool it would be worth staying in the hotel. Although, been a new hotel also brings a few issues that can be easily fixed. For example, we arrived at the hotel after 23hrs and there was nothing to eat (except for an apple and two small tangerines). It would be nice if the hotel could offer a small snack for late arrivals. Also, the hotel is relatively close to Kata and Kata Noi beach, but to walk to the beach you must pass by a very steep road with no sidewalk, so it is not a nice walk..The hotel does provide a shuffle to the Kata beach, but it would be nice to provide this service every hour and also a shuttle to the Kata Noi beach. Finally, the staff is very well intended, but they still need a little bit more training and to improve their English. All in all it is an excellent hotel and I highly recommend it.

author: Storyteller63934
title: AMAZING VIEW & friendly customer service
text: We stayed at Nook Dee for three nights and loved the view from the ocean-view room. The resort is located at the top of the hill so there was nothing to block the view. Loved the beautiful deco with local fabric in the room and the entire resort. Although it was just opened about three months ago the hotel staff are well trained and very friendly. The food, both breakfast and room service, were the best! Every day offered different items and really delicious. We will be back! 3泊4日滞在でしたが、満足！です。お部屋もホテル全体もインテリアが凝っていて綺麗です。まだオープンして3ヶ月ですが、スタッフの動きも良く子連れ(4歳男の子)の家族に皆さんとても親切でした。食事も美味しくて毎朝の食事が楽しみでした。お部屋のバルコニーやレストランからの眺めは海が一望できて最高。標高の高い丘の上にあるので、思ったより暑くなく、風がとても気持ちいいです。また来たいと思います。

author: lindenforbes
title: Best in Phuket
text: Simply amazing view!! Breakfast was the best we had and each day it offered different items, loved it!! Staff all very friendly and helpful. Pool is amazing and was never many people in there and great spot to watch sunset. As we had a scooter the hill to and from Kata was never an issue. Can't get a bad room and all would have a view of beaches but the higher the better. Only one think to make it even better would be the roof top bar!! We will be back again.

author: TackleML
title: A pleasant stay in Phuket for holiday
text: The hotel is surprisingly good, arrived in the midnight and staff's were still actively welcoming us. Room is clean and tidy, mini bar with drinks (soft drink, beer and jelly) provided for free in our room. All staffs in the hotel are nice and friendly, smile and say hello to you every time when you walked pass. The infinity pool is good with amazing sunset view in the evening!! The hotel is located at mountainside, take around 10-15 walk from hotel to Kata Noi Beach or main street near Kata Beach, good for couples or family if you are look for some quiet at night time. (Shuttle bus provided between hotel and Kata Beach but not very frequent). Breakfast provided by the hotel is very good, lived in many other hotels in South East Asia, I would say this is the best experience of hotel breakfast I ever had. We had a really good time during our staying in Nook Dee Hotel. Highly recommend to anyone who is interested to visit Phuket for holiday!! And I sincecly hope the hotel can keep these services up in the future!

author: DavePajero
title: A new Kata gem
text: Kata Beach is our choice of places to stay on Phuket and a new gem in the area is the Nook Dee Kata Beach Resort. It's new and only opened in Nov 2015 but we loved the place. The rooms are well appointed, spacious with great views, huge bed, down bedding and super housekeeping.The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Pool is fantastic with great view. Located up the hill away from the beach area the restaurant view for breakfast is stunning across Kata Noi. Gym and spa in place but cosy décor to follow. This hotel has been well planned, thought through and is managed well. We're going back!!

author: m7nners
title: Unbelievable service and views
text: What a fantastic stay at Nook Dee. The views from the room, pool and rooftop are spectacular. They should definitely have have a roof top bar to enjoy their happy hour with the sunset! The food was great particularly in the restaurant. Just such a shame there weren't more people eating there but I guess this is because the hotel was so new. Particular thanks to Dang and Kung whose service was fantastic and also Bank who went far far out of his way to help us. Thanks guys. Couldn't recommend Nook Dee enough!

author: 217jenniea
title: Fantastic hotel
text: I can't speak highly enough of Nook Dee. We stayed recently, with our children and had a fantastic time! The hotel decor is beautiful-very colourful modern Thai style. The rooms are outstanding, the most comfortable beds! The pool is stunning with great views and great for sunsets also from the roof top. The menu available at the restaurant is really good, great choice and beautiful good. The staff were very helpful and attentive. Highly recommend this hotel if visiting Phuket.

author: annakamm
title: Strange hotel poll
text: I really disliked my stay at this hotel, although the beginning of my stay was alright the second day came the disaster. The hotel staff asked to charge me because of alleged "stained" bed sheets, and they said the bed sheets could not be washed off. Not have I never heard of this ridiculous policy, I have never ever been faced with such horrendous attitude from the hotel staff. Despite of this, I agreed to pay, since it was my fault. The next day, my friend and I got henna tattoos - which are very very common in Thailand. After another nice relaxing morning, the hotel staff once again ruined my mood by telling me there are stained bed sheets, yet again. First of all, henna tattoos can be washed off and second of all the hotel house keeping manager immediately said "we need to charge you" the moment I walked into my room. This did not just ruin my mood, but I felt like she was accusing me of something - which is never a great feeling. On a side note - the hotel location is terrible unless you can drive do not book this hotel as it is a hassle to get to and does not really have that much of a spectacular overview.

author: 918nats
title: Excellent stay
text: I've known this hotel from a travel exhibition in BKK and decided to book it even the resort didn't finish yet. There, I also get the room upgrade as well. When arriving, I got the refreshment drink and cool towel - good for the hot weather and gave a thai typical souvenir. The food at Roydee restaurant is wonderful and the room is so great with the seaview and welcoming fruits. All staff are friendly and nice. They are always willing to help and keep asking how everything is well going. The management, GM, takes care customers well and thanks to him for a small elephant doll as a gift. The Thai massage is wonderful - I like it. Most importantly the swimming pool is so cool and you will see the great seaview from there. I will definitely go back to Nook-Dee for the next vacation.

author: emriej
title: Amazing new hotel
text: It is a new hotel and great value for money, probably because we got the opening season offer. We stayed in this hotel for 3 nights and it was amazing. The staff are extremely friendly with spectacular hospitality. The rooms are specious with comfiest beds. The views from the room and the pool were hands down amazing! Breakfast was tasty Roydee. The gym is not ready yet so we decided to run to Kata viewpoint 2K from the hotel. We would recommend this hotel to anyone. 10/10

author: MLiz62
title: Ticked all the boxes
text: Stayed for 2 nights in twin room room 4. A lovely light spacious duel aspect, nicely decorated room with a large bathroom with window and walk in shower. Both were spotlessly clean and lovely and warm on a cold January weekend. We appreciated the table and 2 chairs in the corner. Loads of storage...wardrobe, drawers and dressing table. We went for room only as we were staying for a sports event and needed to be out before breakfast was scheduled but this suited us well. We ate downstairs at the carvery one evening which we would do again. Service was helpful and friendly throughout. This ticked every box for my daughter and i and we will most certainly be booking again next year.

author: malcolmt460
title: Excellent value for money
text: The staff were delightful, friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and the sea view was wonderful. Just a couple of draw backs. The shower had no power, so it was like popping yourself under a dripping tap. Breakfast is restricted to between 09-00 and 09-30. The air conditioning is a small fan and if you did open the window, unfortunately you not only overlook the sea but also all the customers drinking, eating and smoking below your room until closing time. Oh yes and the mattress was a bit like a trampoline, in that if I turned over, my wife on the other side of the bed bounced into the air! Happy days.

author: 22Cinders22
title: Don’t even bother!!
text: Decided to go out for a family meal. On arrival we were ignored by two members of staff who were stood at the bar and then disappeared. When they eventually returned we were ignored again. No acknowledgement from any staff as we waited. No eye contact, not an apology for keeping us waiting!!! So, don’t even bother!! The food may have been delicious but the customer services was apsolutely appalling!! Being local to the area we will not be recommending to any friends either. Very VERY dissatisfied and disappointed!!

author: pauljL9784GF
title: lovely break
text: Frequent visitor to the Royal. Room 5. Superb view of lawns , coastline and sea. Very comfortable room. Good breakfast. Friendly staff.Theatre just over the road. Cliff railway down to beach. Ideal base to explore local area.

author: helencT4062ZD
title: Lovely place to stay
text: This is the second time we have stayed here, book for the theatre which is two min walk at most, . Lovely place to stay food fabulous,staff very polite and helpful, this time we stayed in room 3. Which we knew didn't have a view. We were happy with this as didn't plan to stay in the room other than to sleep, yes there was background noise from the kitchen which they also tell u about it was all quite by the time we went to bet a 10:45. Breakfast was amazing. Will be keeping an eye out at the theatre for more thing to come and see. And we will definitely be booking to stay here when we find something to come and see. Would like to th and all staff they were simply amazing. Can't wait to return soon

author: 636brucep
title: Busy Saturday Night
text: We arrived in Babacombe on the Saturday evening and ventured out to explore the sea front, when we came across The Babbcombe Royal Hotel. A wedding reception was in full swing and the place was very lively. This didn't stop us getting a sandwich, as in a previous establishment. The food came quickly and was very nice, as was the real ale. We were so impressed with the place we went back later in the week for a proper meal. We were not to be disappointed.The place was quieter that previously. No wedding party this time. The meal was excellent, and, again the real ale. Would thoroughly recommend.

author: ginachilds
title: Very nice!
text: Stayed for one week in July. Fab area. Great views. Babbacombe beach very peaceful and nice place to eat. Hotel room very clean, quiet and spacious. Staff friendly. Parking ok. Only slight issue was the Wi-Fi never seemed to work...maybe my IT skills weren't up to it! Overall, an enjoyable stay.

author: CatB316
title: excellent
text: We stayed here for four nights. We had room 8 which I believe is the biggest room. The bed was huge and so comfortable. The room was nice and large and clean and tidy. The bathroom was a decent size too. We didn't have breakfast but ate there once in the evening which was good. Lovely clean restaurant. The bar staff were always very helpful. Overall an excellent stay.

author: charmed01
title: Amazing hotel
text: Stayed here for a night as had a night out with friends in Torquay. Lovely place, so clean and friendly. Room was huge, nice touch with the bottles of water and shortbread. Good stock of tea,coffee etc. Everywhere was lovely and clean. Bed so comfy,slept like a log. Had full English breakfast, very tasty. Nothing was too much trouble for our waitress Jan. Def will return.

author: crystalBakewell
title: Heartless Hotelier
text: I was booked in to stay here for one night last week. I live in Dartmouth but wanted to attend the party on Oddicombe Beach. Unfortunately, the week before my stay, my Father was taken into hospital after suffering a fall and his health was deteriorating rapidly. As he lives in Lancs I needed to travel & visit him asap so rang the Royal & asked if, in the circumstances, they would refund the cost of my room. The person I spoke to said "no" and in any case "You can't cancel by phone, you need to cancel online"... So much for human kindness and humanity... It obviously doesn't exist at this hotel. Will not be staying in the future !!

author: grocklePooleUk
title: Nice room
text: Stay here for 3 nights in room 5 overlooking the sea. Nice size room, plenty of draws & hanging space for clothes. Room was Clean bathroom had nice shower. Breakfast was included. It was a nice cooked breakfast . Staff were very friendly. There was plenty of parking space. My only reservation was that breakfast service did not start until 9am I had to be somewhere every morning before 10am so It was a bit tight & not a relaxing breakfast.

author: MikeBrawn
title: Very good carvery.
text: We haven't eaten here for some time but as the food was always good we decided to give it a try, pleased to say we had a very good meal. We were a party of four and all had the carvery. There were several meats to choose from pork, ham, beef etc. and an excellent choice of vegetables. Several of us had the beef which was very good. Wines were reasonably priced and good quality. Service throughout was friendly and efficient. We had a table in the window so had lovely views all around the bay, will definitely be back.

author: pauljU2349IL
title: Babbacombe Bliss
text: We loved everything. The hotel and all the staff were great. Food good.Beer good. No parking problems. Huge green across road that also stretches 200 yards to left and right. Best beach access via cliff railway, whose cafe sells tasty ice cream. A theatre is on the green to the right of the hotel. Shops a short walk away.. We can;t wait to return.

author: 64gailb
title: A short but very positive experience
text: As we were visiting friends for a night out we booked into the hotel for one night only. Having lived in Babbacombe for 10 years until recently and walked the dog frequently passing this hotel we were more than pleasantly surprised. We were given a warm welcome upon arrival and shown to our room which had fabulous facilities and a wonderful sea view! Our request for an ironing board and iron was promptly met an delivered to our room without any fuss. The room and ensuite were spotless, the mattress very comfortable and the towels fantastic - big, fluffy and very white! It added a touch of luxury to a very short one night stay! Only one thing to pick on - very small but very important for vertically challenged people - I'm a very petite 5' 2" and the bathroom mirror was a little too high for me - well actually - when not wearing heels - which you tend not to do when you've come out of the shower - I couldn't actually see anything from my forehead upwards! Not a problem in our case as we had a very useful mirror on the dressing table. A short but very positive experience!

author: MrsFaris
title: Amazing Stay
text: Apologies it's taken me so long to write about the amazing stay we had back in August for a family wedding. The service from booking to checkout was five star all the way. The management and all the staff were really accommodating when we said we needed to be at the wedding by 10 and with young children provided us with breakfast earlier than advertised. The room was immaculate and had everything we needed. The wedding reception was at the hotel and the chef, staff and management especially Jan went above and beyond in providing a fantastic reception and making sure everything went smoothly. The carvery meal was delicious and the service was first class. And the breakfast!!! Locally sourced bread and meat and it showed. I'd love to return again soon. Thank you xx

author: sdgale
title: Great
text: Positives- Hotel was in a great position for Babbacombe and nearby Torquay town. Room 6 had great sea views. Nice and spacious room. Comfy bed. Very clean througout. Staff friendly. Niggles- rattly sash window and shower not very powerful. Overall very good and would definately stay again.

author: Greatbreakssdgale
title: Great!
text: Great hotel. Room clean and nice size. Shower nice, with free shampoo & gel etc. Bed comfy. Staff friendly. Food GREAT. Location beautiful. Lovely walk along cliff top just across the road. Close to Torquay. Hope to return next year.

author: CarolF207
title: Excellent value
text: We stayed at the hotel just for one night, the room was spotless and very comfortable. Bathroom was small but ok for us as we are are small people. Plenty tea and coffee in the room and nice biscuits. Parking was ok but we were in Feb I guess it may be difficult in the summer. Staff were friendly and helpful. The bar prices ok standard pub prices I would say. We did not stay for breakfast, but it looked ok. And the Restraunt is popular.

author: leeh553
title: great view, great value
text: I recently had 2 stays here and it was very comfortable, in a lovely location, friendly staff. I picked it due to its proximity to my mother and would have no hesitation about staying again. Good food in the dining room too. Spacious room, lovely sea views, tho I stayed in the cheaper back room as well and it was still a very good room. Modern and clean bathroom and separate guest entrance. The only drawback is no lift or telephone in the room but it is a small hotel with only 5 or 6 rooms and this is to be expected. Staff were always willing to help with luggage when on duty. Early mornings were a problem as there was nobody there to help me with my luggage down the stairs but in all other respects a great place to stay. Thoroughly recommend it.

author: debs043
title: Lovely 3 day break!
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our short break at The Royal. Room 6 had stunning views across Babbacombe Bay and was a good size. Bed super comfy, shower a bit lacking in power, but still did the job! Very clean and all you could need except for a bedside alarm clock! We breakfasted each morning, which was again excellent. We ended up eating each night in the bar because it had a good menu, well priced, friendly staff and delicious! Thoroughly recommend the lamb shank -yummy! Finally the excellent staff provided us with a wonderful break, away from the hustle and bustle of Torquay.

author: grocklePooleUk
title: Ok for 1 night
text: We stayed in room 3. It was clean & of a good standard The bed was comfortable but was very high? . However the window overlooked the Venting duct from the Kitchen, I would say that this room was slightly cheaper than the other rooms, so they do take this into account. I had the window open all night & there was no noise. The staff were welcoming. We ate there in the evening & the food was good Breakfast was good too. OK for 1 night, maybe a room overlooking the sea would be better for a longer stay.

author: 341Sue
title: Sue
text: We had a comfortable 3 nights stay at this hotel and wonderful weather. Location is lovely and didn't use the car at all. One criticism is it's possible to hear the television etc through the walls. Also as the hotel bar is open til midnight I should imagine it would be very noisy outside in the warm summer evenings until quite late. It is also a bit of a rush to be out of your room by 10am. However, the service was excellent from all staff especially the young lady who served us breakfast. Be good to have a set meal price for an evening meal for residents. We had a really good short break and would recommend this hotel to friends.

author: Crackie103
title: A beautiful location.
text: This hotel is located on the Babbacombe Downs which gives it beautiful views over bay. The room was fine with comfortable beds and they erected a camp bed for our 9 year old son. The ensuite bathroom was clearly new and very clean. The staff were very helpful. The cooked breakfast was delicious, but it was served from 9-9.30 am and we were expected to check out at 10 am. However we were allowed an extra half an hour to enable my husband to shave. There are no shave points in the room, but we were lent an adaptor. My family used the private room for a function which worked very well and as it was a sunny day many people sat outside on the terrace which was lovely. I would recommend the hotel, it was good value for such a beautiful location.

author: Mookie285
title: Disappointment
text: From the name and location, you feel that your getting value for money. The room facilities and the view from the window were nice. We asked for a quiet room, but you can hear the television from the room next door and we were above the bar of the hotel. On returning to the room from a evening out, the noise from the bar/pub was awful. The customers were rowdy and uncouth. The noise didn't cease till 1am in the morning and I didn't see any actions from the staff to control the loud noise levels for staying residents. The staff were pleasant and the next morning, the breakfast was good. The hotel really needs to decide if it's going to be a pub for Chavs or a hotel for tourists.

author: sandyh758
title: great stay
text: The hotel is located at the top of a cliff with view on the green promenad and the sea. It is worth asking for a room with sea view. There is a pub and carvery at street level. There was live music in the afternoon and we could hear them from the room, so beware that the afternoon nap might not happen. The welcome was warm and the room was very spacious and clean. I would highly recommend this hotel and would go back without hesitation. it was quiet at night. We didn't have the breakfast so I cannot comment on it.

author: Brackmeg
title: Pub with accommodation
text: Overall this hotel ticked most of the boxes for me, I wanted a bed for the night and able to get food. The barmaid doubled as receptionist, she was very helpful even though she was busy serving in the bar. They serve food from 6.00 pm in the evenings, the staff were very friendly, the food was OK. The room was large, warm and clean , with a modern bathroom ( no shaver point) . Comfortable bed but small TV. The water I used for a brew tasted funny, but that could have been me who is used to a soft water area. Breakfast is only served between 9 and 9.30 , and was cooked to order. The lady who served breakfast was polite and efficient .

author: alicante2013
title: fantastic friendly hotel
text: had a fantastic weekend here with my fiance. the staff are all so friendly and happy to help. They never seem to tire but seem to be here all the time.. room very nice clean linen daily very comfortable bed .the food excellent at the royal. we pre ordered breakfast but could seriously only manage to have one on the first morning here as they are massive full english with cereal and extra large slices of fresh bread toasted.. could not eat it all so decided to have scrambled egg on morning number 2 with cereal.. the coffees are lovely aswell.such a brilliant service from all members of staff at this hotel..cant wait to go back and we only got home 5 hour ago. thank you royal hotel and carvery and keep up the excellent service you provide

author: SteveH894
title: Lovely spot to find for a carvery!
text: On holiday in the area and looking for a carvery. Quick search on the internet, and it showed us the Royal. We called in without booking, and just timed things right. Right from the start we were treated very pleasantly, ordered our drinks, and got our carvery! Good choice of meats, that also tasted good, and with all the veg you expect these days. Can't complain at all about the whole evening we had there. Thanks very much, well done. Will use this again.

author: richcraft
title: Clean and spacious
text: We spent one night here as a break en route home from Cornwall. The staff were friendly and efficient. Room 5 was large, well equipped and very clean and the bed was really comfortable - with decent pillows too! The blackout curtains made for a good nights sleep. It would have been nice to have had separate bedside lights, rather than having to have both either on or off. The view was beautiful and despite sleeping with the window open, we were not disturbed by noise.The only downside was the people smoking by the front porch, which was directly below our window. This did rather spoil our pleasure when sitting by the open window, admiring the view. However, we would certainly use this hotel again, hopefully for a longer break.

author: CardiffTheresa
title: A good stay
text: We stayed at the Royal Hotel on 26 and 27 October 2012. The sea view was so lovely, and we really enjoyed the friendly atmosphere in the bar and restaurant. There was a local band playing on the Friday night - Knocked Out Loaded - a trio, blues-y band and good (if you are in the area and see them advertised!). It was a shame that the audience was small but we made as much noise as we could! The food was excellent. We didn't bother, therefore, to look for anywhere else to eat. The only downside is (as a previous reviewer has mentioned) that the heating was low or off, and the room quite cold. Otherwise, a hit.

author: Beefy1
title: Great room - bit noisy!
text: Arrived for a couple of nights - shown to a great room. Size wise - huge - it was Room 4 with great sea views out of two sides. Lovely bathroom, although Shower very weak. Room also needed bed side lamps as the overhead spotlights were far too bright. Beds great, room furniture nice, not cheap or nasty, good quality TV. Noisy at night as directly over the bar and also very noisy as next to fire door to main landing which made a loud bang every time it was opened/closed - already had a damping mechanism but far too strong! Didn't eat there so can't comment on the food. Looked like typical seafront hotel fare - carvery etc.

author: 834Claire30
title: Outstanding value for money
text: We stayed at the Royal during the jubiliee bank holiday weekend, while attending a friends wedding. We wanted somewhere relatively cheap and comfortable for our one night stay and this hotel didn't disappoint. We were in Room 3, priced at £44 for the evening. It was spotlessly clean with a neat shower room (and a surprisingly large shower) furnished with all the necessary mod cons (flatscreen tv, tea & coffee making facilities) and the bed was lovely and comfortable. We were warned of the noise of the generators(?) near the room, but it was honestly hardly noticeable. Staff were cheerful and friendly upon check in. Everything you could want for a budget overnight stay - we will definitely be using again and next time will stay for the tasty looking carvery! :-)

author: francesco1491
title: Amazing experience
text: Well..beside the thing that I had to come back in Europe, everything was PERFECT!! I'm definitely going back at "El Misti hostel Ipanema" because I really felt at home.. the guys at the reception, young and nice people (they know more than 10 languages most probably), the atmosphere at the hostel, which is, useless to say, one of the most amazing thing the crew managed to create.. the beach is really close to the hostel..restaurants, bars and "fast food" are too..I would say that the structure is placed in a really nice area, not a lot of worries if you staying there :))) during my experience at El Misti, I had the opportunity to get to know many people from many part of the world, but a big "THANK YOU" is for Steve, Livia and Rodrigo..thanks to them and their organization and their nice welcome.. you have a "to do list" for each and every day of your staying. From parties on boats to sunset party, to disco, sight seen...I had the chance, thank to Steve, to visit the "two brothers mountains", going through Vidigal favela..the most exiting experience of my life!! (thank you again for this)..they are really taking care of you..for any question they give you the right answer/suggestion..about Rio, I think, there is nothing I could say...about the Hostel, whoever is reading this should know that THIS IS THE RIGHT PLACE, if you travel alone (like I did) or you travel with friends/family..rooms are big enough, each and every room has their own bathroom (everyday cleaning lady comes to clean up); every room has A/C and windows..some of them have also a balcony..Go there, at El Misti Ipanema, you won't regret it at all..and, most probably, as I'm going to do, you will try to get back ASAP or even try to change flight in order to enjoy a couple of days more with this nice "multietnica" family :)))) guys, thank you for making my holiday THE HOLIDAY!!! see you in April!

author: ABLJ
title: great location, relaxed place
text: I had a private room which was small but clean and surprisingly quiet. The people who said it's like a 5-star hotel are high as a kite, but it's a cool place, friendly staff, good tips on activities, safety, restaurants, etc. Water, air-con, etc. all work quite well. It's neither a super-luxe hostel, nor a super grubby one...it's a clean, well-managed, simple place to stay. I met some cool people there too. Just one complaint—the internet is close to useless. Really slow. I had to work in coffee shops.

author: briea2019
title: 5 start hotel service
text: Staying here was like staying in a 5star hotel. The staff is extremely helpful! I lost my phone in Rio and Andre help me find it. He also help me organized activities, tours and anything that I had an interest in. Anything I wanted, he made it happen for me. My room was clean! Each evening there was always an event that you could go to. Loved staying here!!!! : D

author: I7523TKbens
title: El misti Ipanema
text: Great location right between the beach and the metro. Especially for sightseeing/beach. For going out, you will still need to catch a taxi home so that could add to your expenditure. Staff were fantastic with recommendations for food/activities. They particularly helped me out with getting to ilha grande when the transfer was mixed up because of the clocks being moved forward 1 hour. Facilities were really good for the price. Breakfast (not included) was a bit bare but the Bartender makes a killer caipirinha. Would stay again.

author: haydnhhd
title: Great hostel!
text: Stayed here for 7 nights and couldn’t fault it at all. Bearing in mind this was the first ever hostel I stayed it, I was unsure what to expect. But I couldn’t fault them. Good aircon, WiFi, food and drinks. The hostel is very clean and tidy. German the owner is brilliant and super friendly as well as all the rest of his staff. Great place to meet new people. Would definitely recommend!

author: MariaD333
title: Amazing location, wish the hostel was better
text: We stayed in a private room. The disadvantages are: The shower could be a bit cleaner, the towels and bedding sheets very old and full of stains. There is no shower gel or shampoo in the private room, the breakfast and the towel is not free and every time you want to enable the ac you need to come down to reception and ask for it, which is super annoying if your room is on 3rd floor! Overall the room didn't feel like spending much time in it and the hostel felt cold and impersonal, maybe because it is a chain. Advantages. LOCATION! The ipanema beach is a very safe and fun place to stay. the hostel is right at the beach center, close to good coffee shops and other shops, banks, metro... The crowd is young and social, good place to meet people, Brazilians and others.

author: G9624SVfrankk
title: Great staff/location
text: This place was really great to stay in. The main benefits are the location - ipanema is a safe area and the hostel is less than a 5 minute walk to the beach. It is also right beside the metro. The staff were fantastic! Very helpful. The place has a good buzz and the small bar is usually busy and a good place to meet other travellers. The downside is the towels and bedsheets aren't very clean. Bring your own towel, toilet paper!Drinks/breakfast are cheap and they give you a free cocktail each day

author: lesliep323
title: A great hostel all round
text: I stayed in El Misti for 5 nights. The place is in a fantastic location! Right next to the beach, a train station, a beautiful park, and the Main Street of Ipanema. The room was as described (air conditioning was fantastic!). The USB chargers by every bed and large storage space for luggage were very much appreciated. Most of all, the staff were incredibly helpful! From helping me find a bank to recommendations of local street parties. They were always happy to help and down for a friendly chat. A great welcome to my first time in Rio!

author: hoodsamantha223
title: Good times!
text: I take with me the best memories of Rio de Janeiro! I had an incredible time in this place. Full of amazing people. Smiles and laugh. The hostel is situated in the best spot! Check it out! You wont regret it! Amazing breakfast!

author: nineislands
title: Easy, cheap, and great location
text: This hostel gets five stars for value. We just needed a place to crash before heading out for an early morning flight, and El Misti was perfect for that. Some tips for travelers: El Misti charges for towels, so bring your own. This is a hostel with shared rooms, so bring a lock of some sort to keep your things safe. No lock? They'll sell you a cheap one for R$15 or so. A/C gets turned on at 7pm, so the rooms can be hot during the day. The desk attendant who assisted us was very nice and was able to communicate with us in Spanish, Portuguese and English. I would stay here again.

author: MollyJJM
title: Terrible even for a hostel
text: This place is the worst place I have ever stayed at. The staff are incompetent. We checked in and stayed the night. Got up and spent the day in Rio. When we came back at midnight there were two people sleeping in our private room. We went down to the desk and they told us when we checked in the night before no one checked us into the system. They did charge our credit card and now we cannot get the money back as they charged us twice. This place sucks. STAY AWAY.

author: claires774
title: Brand new hostel!
text: This hostel had only been open for 10 days, the opening party was on the Saturday night I was there. Everything is brand new! The staff are so friendly and helpful. Location is great, 1 block from Ipanema beach. Breakfast included fresh fruit and juice. Each bed has a power socket and a sub charger so no need for an adapter! Every room has air-conditioning. Lights in the bathroom are on sensors and are a bit annoying! Keep going off when in the shower... All in all a great hostel!

author: 596nikiz
title: A new hostel in a great location
text: Due to the hostel being new, the beds, mattresses, bathrooms etc. are new and therefore in great condition. Each bed has their own socket as well as two USB ports. All rooms have good air conditioners. The atmosphere was really friendly, helpful and welcoming. The bar offers great drinks, fresh orange juice as well as Pizza and small other foods. The breakfast is good for a hostel, with fresh juice and fruits in addition to bread, cheese etc. So far the only thing missing is a lounge area but it seems that they're still working on parts of the building (which did not interfere at all with my stay e.g. my sleep). So maybe that will be added soon.

author: 10lens
title: Great business hotel
text: The hotel is co-located with the convention center and across the road from Kigali Heights mall/shopping center, in park like surroundings. I traveled in the week before Genocide Remembrance day so the roads past the hotel were blocked off, so traffic was non-existent. The hotel is clean, modern and has all the facilities and services one would expect. Staff are friendly, efficient, helpful and speak clear English. The gym is well equipped and well supported and provides a great after work, workout. The spa looked inviting. Don't approach the guys in uniforms carrying guns around the convention center - they do not speak clear English and are not friendly. The little bit of the city I saw - beautifully clean and neat, good roads - unlike any other country in Africa I have been, including my home country.

author: DawlishRed
title: Delightful staff in a nice location
text: Stayed at the Radisson Blu while attending a conference and was very impressed by the hard working, friendly staff. Rooms were nice and clean. Breakfast was very good with an excellent range of options. Kigali is a great city full of lovely people who are dealing with the trauma of the 1994 genocide and talking to the wonferful staff brings it home how utterly awful it was. But, like so many others I met in Rwanda, They were optimistic and forward looking. Wonderful people. The only thing that let the hotel down was the Business Centre. The IT wasn't too good, the printers were troublesome and there was no shredder. The staff did their best but were hindered by the lack of investment. Recommended.

author: 262eunicek
title: You were my ‘stitch in time’ thank you!!!
text: I am very grateful to your team, in particular Teddy (service) and Maria (Tailor) who literally stitched up my torn dress 20 minutes before a session I was presenting in. I accidentally tore my dress at the back while in Auditorium Club 1 today (March 7) as I was preparing to moderate a session during the Africa Health Agenda International Conference. Teddy spotted me, we went to the toilet to assess the dress and quickly said I shouldn’t worry that it would be sorted. She led me to the basement, where I met a cheerful Maria who offered me a robe as she worked on my dress. In 15 minutes or so minutes my dress was stitched up and they offered to iron it only that I was time barred. Thank you so much Teddy and Maria! I’m eternally grateful. Ahsante, you are amazing.

author: middlegam
title: 3rd visit to the Radisson
text: I’ve been coming to Kigali since 2012 for business and for convenience to the airport now stay at the Radisson. Yes most hotels are convenient in Kigali as traffic isn’t too bad, although getting busier each time I visit. All staff friendly and engaging. Rooms of a high standard, large and good amenities. Ironing board is good to have. Breakfasts great with wide selection, lovely pool area, great gym. Bar area buzzing as attending the Aviation Africa conference and as hotel full they did well to handle so many guests. Bar staff efficient and friendly. Yes the hotel is expensive but most guests are here on business. I would return.

author: shefflad38
title: Business trip
text: Nice, stylish and non-pretentious. Everything from check-in to departure was handled with extreme courteousness. Really comfortable rooms. Nice location. Number of dining spots within a 10-15 minute walk. The staff were attentive and really helpful. Jean-Pierre gets a special mention. Helped me and my team locate our contact in Kigali on Sunday (was a no car day). Walked us all the way to our meeting point.

author: ivanam25
title: Beautiful, modern hotel, even better staff, looots of thanks to Gustave Barihe
text: I had a wonderful stay in Radisson Blue hotel in Kigali. My first impression was “what a stylish hotel”. I was amazed by the polite and friendly staff. Seems like everyone is ready to help with just about anything. In the hotel gym I came across Gustave Barihe, leisure and sport manager. His professional approach and the vast knowledge left me speechless. If you ever need a personal trainer, or you want better results in the gym, he is the right person to contact. You can always email him on gustave.barihe@radissonblu.com. Health is our precious gift, which we have to maintain. This is why I’m writing this review.

author: aminaokafor
title: Amazing Facility
text: I have attended the meeting of COSECSA meeting. I was very amazed by the view and i amazed when i first got into the complex, small sport car that moved us from the gate all the way to the entrance of Convention Center. During the event everything was really excellent, in terms of services, staff friendliness and quick problem solving. I would like to thank all the staff that served us. They were all helpful and friendly. And the thing that amazed the most is the MOSQUE.I didn't even bother to ask if there was one. But one lady named Nawal, she approached as she was among the people who were helping us with some of the small changes of the room setup, she asked if i have prayed the noon prayer, then i said no and then she took me to the Mosque which is so beautiful. She helped me with the clothes and helped with other few things. But the mosque still needs few things; Like slippers, a sign that shows the Qibla (direction of prayer), lotion and also small jug or jerrycan for the Washroom use. Generally i had an amazing time.

author: Kysmetrgm
title: Excellent stay
text: I usually have a great time at the Radisson Blu Hotels, but this time surpassed it. Went to Rwanda for a huge conference, hosted at the Kigali Convention Center and stayed at the Radisson Blu, right across. Right from check in which went smoothly despite the late hour, it was an awesome stay. I was too busy to take pictures of the room, but it was very very nice. The staff was fantastic, from the reception team (Irambona, Diana & Hortance), to the restaurant staff (Betty was a darling ), they all contributed to a wonderful stay. The food was excellent, both breakfast and dinner. Internet complimentary and worked great. My only wish was a more robust selection from the room service menu, and that’s really thinking hard for something to correct. All in all, truly a five stars hotel with great staff. Looking forward to staying there again.

author: Jeff0712
title: Perfect location, great smiles and family atmosphere
text: The staff at this hotel gives you more solutions than problems, which has become rare in big hotels these days. Very professional. Especially when one (me) loses their room key every 5 minutes and you are still greeted by smiles at the reception as they tirelessly assist you. You can't help but remember receptionists such as Mouna, who coincidentally was always there to welcome you with a smile and patiently provide you with a quick service whether it is information where to go in Kigali...or just a new room key. Thanks to Diana and my friend Godfrey. The hotel is secured and perfectly located. The Convention Center,where most conferences and events in Kigali take place, is just across. In my case, there was a feeling of coming back home after a long day at work. There is always a taxi around to take where you need to be, room service is fast and the cleaners do a great job.

author: jonatanc849
title: Excellent hotel.
text: I stayed in Radisson Blu for 4 nights and it is really an excellent hotel. The room has everything that you need. The washroom has all you need for your shower. The people are friendly and professional. The breakfast is delicious with a lot of options. Check in and check out very fast. Everything that I needed they were there to attend me. Very safe place to stay.

author: 345avm
title: Staff at the Convention Centre was very helpful during some chaos....
text: I was attending a conference, where organizers didn't allocated enough space for sponsors and VIPs. People were not happy, so a large room was converted into a meeting space. The hotel staff helped me secure a section of that room for our VIPs, get the area cleaned up and presentable literally minutes before our first VIP meeting. Lead by Mr. Honestus of the Radisson - their crew saved us from a lot of potential embarrassment. He even took the initiative to get a "Reserved" print out in a plastic stand for us to use to preserve our space. Thank you, Mr. Honestus, for working so hard so we could be at our best!

author: rickmE9582VH
title: Outstanding in every way!
text: It is my first trip to Kigali so I wasn’t sure what to expect. Radison Blu is attached to the convention center. I travel for my work and I immediately fell in love with this hotel! Clean rooms, contemporary feel. The staff are among the most friendly I have ever experienced. The linens and pillows are really nice and the bed is king size and comfortable. The breakfast has so much variety, even as a vegan/vegetarian there are plenty of options! Today I worked out at the gym and coach Alphonse helped me and my colleague have a really tough workout. The gym is tops with all Technogym equipment. I love the hotel, the food, and the gym!

author: cobit38
title: Exceptional experience!
text: I spent one week at this amazing place. Hotel was at highest standard, probably the best hotel in Rwanda. All was clean and very well maintained. Breakfast was huge and tasty. I especially want to mention the exceptional front desk staff, which always went the extra mile. They were of immediate, fast and perfect help at any problem or situation. Special thanks to amazing Shekinah, Gisele and Junior! Thank you, you made my stay unique and precious. Can't wait to come back!

author: luthob
title: Amazing, warm and friendly staff!
text: A very beautiful environment, with amazing people. All the staff members put your needs first, as cliche as this may sound, they make you feel at home. The food is also quite good. I enjoyed my stay here, particularly meeting the people here and learning a new language. A big thank you to these guys, you are the best! Mupenzi(coolest and kindest human ever) Irambona(Super welcoming and a great sense of humor), Junior( great sense of humor), Patrick.K, Patrick. R, Alphonse( super calm and composed), Alexis, Rodrigue( cool chef), Monifique, Jean de Dieu, Satosura to name but a few. Murakoze chana to all of you and everyone whom I have not mentioned. Your work is appreciated. # Niyemza# I am beyond satisfied.# Keep up the good work and keep on spreading the love.

author: EVerghese
title: Can't fault this hotel
text: So, having lived in Rwanda (and being married to a Rwandan), I can fairly say that the country isn't renowned for its customer service. This hotel is one of the exceptions to the rule... We stayed in the hotel for 5 nights with our young daughter and baby. The staff couldn't be more helpful and accommodating - they assisted us with extra beds/mattresses, and were lovely with my daughter, always playing with her, chatting to her etc. The rooms are clean and modern (not massive), the pool is great (though not heated, so prepare to feel the cold!), and the gym is large. Breakfasts are fantastic - a wide selection of hot and cold food, pastries, made-to-order omelettes, pancakes, waffles, fresh fruit and juices etc. There are some on-site restaurants, the best of which is the Italian - really good pizza and meat and not prohibitively expensive. The location is ideal, being in Kimihurura area, walking distance to Kigali Heights where there's a Java café/restaurant, shops, good Italian ice cream place etc. Although it's an expensive hotel, this one so far beats the lot in Kigali and is worth it if you fancy a bit of luxury with great service. A big thank you to all the fantastic staff - we will be back!

author: /undefined
title: My very comfortable stay in Radisson Blu Hotel
text: The combination of hotel and convention centre is very good idea. The hotel surroundings and security is excellent. The hotel services are remarkable. Staff is very friendly. The food is equally good for all religions. The cleanliness is good and could be improved further. For example bathrooms have smell from drains. It will be good if bathroom smell is investigated and removed.

author: helgah479
title: It was amazing!
text: This establishment has a great team of people who are helpful and hospitable. I definitely felt like it was a home away from home. Particularly the fitness centre was very exemplary, when the team was very helpful and friendly and approachable. It made me want to workout more and improve my fitness levels. Look out for Jack! he is a fantastic trainer! The food at the restaurant is also very high quality and very delicious. The rooms are really comfortable as well. Keep up the great work!

author: wanyoikeb
title: VISITED THE HOTEL WHILE ON A BUSINESS MEETING AT THE CONVENTION CENTRE
text: Good reception. welcome refreshing drink. Room is great and I cant ask for more. Location is superb and cosy green well spacious surroundings. Breakfast is the best ever. I loved the cardio machines at the health club. One day there was noise from the roof and was informed it was house keping but on reporting it was well ahndled. I apprecate Sophie, shekinah and Esperance in front office and Napftali Concei'erge. Exceelent experince Benson Mwangi

author: maimunataal
title: An amazing hotel
text: I had the pleasure of visiting the beautiful country of Rwanda and stayed at the Radisson Blu hotel. What an amazing experience. I felt so special and proud being in Kigali. The people of Rwanda were very kind. The hotel was immaculate, and the service was exceptional. From the moment I arrived in the country, I realised that it is a special place. The food was excellent and the facilities at the hotel were terrific. I have never seen a country so clean. Well done Rwanda. Thank you to the staff of Radisson Blu, Kigali.

author: /undefined
title: satisfacoey
text: i was not sure what to expect when i was told i was booked at Radisson blu hotel.. on arrival i noticed high level of security at the main entrance which gave a sense of a secure environment. The reception was very welcoming although i must admit i expected a welcome drink or water at the reception. Needless to say the service was friendly and efficient. The rooms are well kept and very clean.. i particularly appreciated the late afternoon room monitoring check.. was good to experience this level of interest in the comfort of clients.. The breakfast was very good with friendly staff

author: Josien_Dennis
title: Very convenient hotel
text: Stayed here for 3 nights recently for a business trip. Only 15mins away from airport and also close to town (easily reachable by taxi). Rooms are modern and clean. Staff is very friendly. Nice outdoor swimming pool. There is also a spa and a gym. Both are worth a visit as well. Also nice italian restaurant at covention centre side. Had great lunch there.

author: Pookiekare
title: Amazing! I would definitely go back :)
text: The hotel is based 10 minutes away from the city centre. Very beautiful, convenient, spacious, modern and easily accessible. The service is swift and excellent. The employees are very friendly and quick to assist in any kind of way. The business lounge has an access to the best view while enjoying your meals. The rooms were always cleaned and well maintained. I cannot forget that everyday the reception would call to ensure we had anything we required or just to check up on us. Murakoze Radisson for the best stay in Rwanda! I would definitely recommend the hotel to my friends and if i go back to Kigali, this would be my 1st choice. Keep up the good work .

author: jimlI6825YR
title: Caring about my outcome during the AU Meetings
text: While I was not here in Rwanda this week to be apart of the AU meetings at the Kigali Convention Centre, I did stay at the Radisson Blu anchored to the Centre. It took me three hours to travel to the hotel from the city center a trip which should have taken minutes. Roads were closed for the various African leaders and the secondary roads were over capacity. By the time I got to the RB, I was stressed out and tired. Upon my arrival, you would have thought I was a head of state. I am from San Francisco. The staff was so attentive and welcoming. Giesele, Sophie, Jean Pierre and several other staff members greeted me and wished me a pleasant stay amidst the very hectic pace of the AU meetings. Since I come to Rwanda at least once a year, the RB is now my go to hotel!

author: /undefined
title: Excellent services
text: Very satisfactory, staff are trained to serve to their best. They will always have a smile on their faces which makes you feel at home away from home. Services offered are excellent in the hotel room are the best. Restaurants have extensive range of dishes meeting your expectations. Meeting rooms are well prepared to meet international standards. In general, both Radisson Blu Hotel and Kigali Convention Center, though are two separate entities, but serve well the clients as a single entity to the highest possible state of organization. For all the times I have visited these two places, I feel well served and secure. Though in most cases I come for Business, I do come quite often with my wife and children to enjoy ourselves. I have also brought in friends or other family members whether local or international and they have also appreciated the services rendered there. My humble request is that you keep up with this spirit of compliance at all levels

author: multimillionareu
title: Outstanding staff
text: My husband and I loved the hotel ambience and the friendly staff. Being our anniversary your package was outstanding and beautiful. Special thanks to Claudette who checked us in and was able to keep the secret of the anniversary surprise and very responsive and follows up. Divine the guest relations is very helpful. Mouna checked us out very fast and efficient. Esperance assistant front office manager was so kind to follow up on the earlier shower issue we had. Beautiful and responsive staff reason me and my husband chose to be members. We can’t wait to come back. Thank you for the Anniversary Card it’s for keeps.

author: Kono14
title: Isolated and Difficult to Access...What a Hassle
text: Stayed 2 nights on a business trip. Although in the heart of the city, its connection to the Convention Centre renders immense security, with blocked roads and a security procedure like an airport before you even get into the parking lot. This makes it a massive pain entering or exiting the hotel so difficult to have meetings here, a pain to go out for dinner, etc. Staff were friendly and certainly tried to be accommodating, but the sheer inaccessibility of the place left a bad taste in my mouth. Gym well equipped. Breakfast offering excellent. Spa was very clean and professional. Rooms extremely small....had a euro-airport-hotel feeling to it. Dont bother trying to pay with AMEX unless you have 30 minutes to spare.

author: dagi143
title: Best for leisure and business in Kigali
text: I travel frequently but I have never felt at home away from home-- until I checked into Radisson Blu Kigali. Was it the staff, the ambience or the rooms? Everything. The staff, especially at check-in/out, are awesome --- young, energetic and friendly with infectious smiles. The rooms, well, words won't do justice to the experience. Well, I didn't lunch at the Ladder, I had a culinary experience. And if you have a late flight, this is the place to be. I checked out at 6pm at no extra cost!

author: FreshaMombasa
title: Best Convention Centre in East Africa
text: Top range facilities, service and accommodation. I attended a forum at the Convention Centre and was totally taken by surprise by the sheer size of the centre...massive! tastefully decorated and well equipped with all the latest gizmo's and tech displays. Service and food was of the highest quality. We also attended a reception hosted at the hotel...what an absolute delight. food stalls around the pool with the most mouth watering finger-food and show cooking displays. Well done Radisson Team! what a success! Of course the local entertainment was very good and enjoyable. An absolute must for international and national conventions!

author: galan05
title: When in doubt, stay here
text: New, ultra-modern hotel with adjoining convention center. Not cheap, but worth it. Not a great tourist hotel because there's not much to do or see in walking distance. For business travelers, however, hard to beat. Rooms and public spaces top-notch. Hotel restaurant is not to be missed. From front-of-house to housekeeping, the young staff is unfailingly friendly, helpful, professional. You expect a capital city to have lots of upscale, well-run hotels, but this one stands out. If you have a hard time deciding where to stay in Kigali, just stay here.

author: yudistrad
title: That's what I'm talking about
text: About a week's stay. A base while we travelled around a bit. Excellent (I don't use that word lightly). Responsive staff. Resourceful, problem solving. Good food. Good rooms. P.s. some of the lady staff are gorgeous!

author: wrcrew
title: A perfect stay
text: This is a new Radisson Blu. And they say it's a 5 star, but the only Radisson Blus I know are 4 stars. Still, it was totally 5 star service. All of it. I especially like the amount of public spaces. So many little corners to choose from. And we used the business center a lot of quiet meetings, and this worked well. This is a great asset for Kigali, and I can not recommend it high enough. I would not stay any place else in Kigali.

author: ulanbeka2015
title: safe place and very good hotel in Kigali
text: I stayed three days in this very good hotel and would. like to mentioned that inside the hotel you do not feel that you left your country. Everything is good and reliable except breakfast. The food in the morning is poor choice. The dinner and lunch are ok, I loved the tuna salad most. The drinks at the bar are overpriced, you have to pay 8 USD for glass of simple South African vine. The hotel is trying to sell parter company services as an independent taxi when you ask to call a city taxi. It is overpriced by 4 times in average. The elevators are almost not useable except the main one as if you try to use others you want be able to go through corridors as they are locked and your room key does not open any corridor door except your level. the location is outside the town so you do not see anything of Kigali.

author: Guili88
title: Excellent welcoming and services.
text: I really appreciated my stay at the Radisson Blu Kigali. I felt at home. The staff were friendly, professional and very helpful. Jean Pierre was my star in terms of Customer care. The variety of the breakfast was enjoyable and the Felini restaurant delicious. Superb conference facilities with employees more professionals. The spa was a moment of joy and peace. Thank you for taking care of all 120 of us, I will come back.

author: melvinda2017
title: Value for money and conveniently located
text: The better appeal of the facility is its contemporary look and newness. Arguably the best in room lighting in my recent memory. the ambient lighting is superb, the shower soothing and the access to balcony refreshing even at an entry level accommodation. I simply have nothing critical to say about the hotel and staff. the breakfast is good. i did not assign a five-star rating because the lunch and dinner menu is below par. the room service menu is even more pathetic. Please work on the food; variety and taste.

author: jillhU7813KU
title: One surprise after another
text: Having just frequented the Marriott Hotel the preceding day, I was curious to compare the atmospheres of these two hotels. While living in Kigali in 2015, I watched the Radisson go up and was fascinated by its exterior (apparently inspired by the activity of local basket weavers). Last month, I returned to Kigali and happily took three local friends there for lunch. The buffet was superb and the grounds lovely. We all marveled how extraordinary such a place was for Rwanda. The hotel lobby made its own impression and I couldn't help but get the sense, that every guest would be acknowledged and name remembered. The Radisson has a distinctly personal feeling to it. Someone even offered to give us a private tour of the adjoining Kigali Convention Center, which opend last year and cost $300 million to construct. A real coup for Rwanda. 100% worth the visit to both!

author: apiispa
title: new and nice hotel, but check-in procedures are not up to speed
text: Hotel facilities are very modern and in good order. BUT .. be very careful when checking out. I stayed for 4 nights. Hotel charged for two nights during check-in. Then during check-out, the hotel charged by mistake for my full stay again. When the mistake was noticed, the hotel was unable to make a refund to my credit card. A month and countless emails later, the refund seems to be finally processed. So be careful and read the bill in detail before making payments to the hotel.

author: Caeseke
title: Caeseke
text: A real 5 start hotel, brand new with a fantastic look and location. Specious rooms very modern with all amenities you would need. Small issue is warm water which takes a couple of minutes after opening the tap. The hotel has a very good breakfast with lots of choice, in addition the restaurant at the bar has fantastic food too. Wifi is available in the rooms however I personally had trouble with the Internet connection, iPhone, iPad and HP laptop could connect and stay connected with the WIFI system however internet dropped very regular, it was impossible to work from the room, alternative was working from the lobby which was failure free. The hotel is very well secured, i would say a bit over the top, taxi's and or drivers are not allowed to drop you at the front door, alternative is hotel transport by golf cart or walk, any guest you want to meet have difficulties to enter the main gate of the hotel; very inconvenient. The hotel personal is very very friendly, helpful and react instant to any questions or issues. As heavy travel all over Africa this hotel is far out the best i have seen so far.

author: dominicw909
title: Stunning, absolute beauty & world class
text: I stayed at this magnificent hotel from 25th October to 29th October and I would say my stay was breath taking. The ambience is refreshing, while the room epitomized what beauty is all about. The welcome note on TV display was memorable as was my stay. The service was world class and staff we always there for the guests. This was even made seamless by one staff by the name Adeline. She was welcoming, respectful and always making enquiries on customer feedback. I would say, she values service excellence which is a key pillar at the hotel. See you next time....

author: strinconio
title: Amazing service
text: I spent 9 nights at the Radisson Blu in Kigali for accommodation and convention. Great pickup from the airport with a kind and smiling welcome, thanks Vincent!. The hotel facilities are excellent, rooms and restaurants very clean and comfortable. Convention facilities are excellent. All staff are professional, attentive and friendly. I would definitely recommend the hotel to friends who want to visit Rwanda. Congratulations to the team and in particular to Papy who was always ready to welcome me at the hotel with a big smile and always available to solve any request. Thanks a lot Papy for your kindness and your services.

author: ollon
title: New hotel setting a high standard
text: Spent 2 nights here for accommodation and convention. Great pickip from the airport. Congratulations to the team! The hotel facilities are excellent, rooms and restaurants very comfortable. Convention facilities excellent. Some minor wifi issues in certain areas of the convention centre, but overall comfort is excellent. Staff are professional and friendly. I will be back again.

author: keepitrealtravel
title: Business trip with a touch of Blu
text: I was told about the Hotel by a friend who insisted that i try it out on my next visit to kigali. I must admit it the experience did not disappoint at all. The checkin was superfast and efficient and they were able to quickly notice my membership card details.The room was modern with great views of the hilly landscape of kigali. The room was also more spacious then normal. Internet for me is key and that did not disappoint too. Reliable, fast and accessible from almost anywhere in the convention center meant I was always connected. The SPA was still under construction along with the swimming pool but the gym was operational, though i was told more equipment was still to be delivered. However with what was available I was able to get a complete workout and once fully kitted out it will definitely be one of my favorite gyms around the globe. Food was plenty with amazing selections all prepared to extremely high standards.(I particularly enjoyed the sushi) overall I would recommend this hotel to any business traveler or family traveler and even a couple on a honeymoon it meets all the necessary requirements. Well Radisson Blu.

author: victoriacO7012LQ
title: Good hotel save for security check
text: I stayed here a night and i liked the staff most. I checked in a disgruntled guest after going through what i felt was an inefficient security check at the gate. It takes no less than 7 minutes to go through the gate if coming in with a vehicle and i felt it could be more efficient. That said, the staff blew me away with a 'ready to be of help' attitude. Gatsobe and Stella made my whining about security seem a genuine complaint, and i like that they said i hope we are reason enough for you to be back. So i will be back! And before i forget, my credit card did not work when checking in and so i had to leave a cash deposit. I forgot to collect the cash even after paying by card at check out. I left and Moses very kindly called me to inform me i had left cash and we worked on an arrangement to get the same since i had left Kigali. 5 stars for the staff but i put 4 stars for hotel until they improve on management of security at gate - which can be improved to be a little bearable for guests.

author: Wamukhula
title: Very good hotel.
text: Great new hotel. I received a warm welcome on arrival and hustle free check in. Staff are very friendly and helpful. The room was ultra clean, spacious, bright and had a lovely balcony. The best hotel bed and pillows i have ever experienced! Wow! Food was great with large variety at buffet. Highly recommend!

author: 10_Traveller1968
title: Great Stay!
text: Had the pleasure in staying in this hotel for 1 day. The stay was absolute fantastic. The room was excellent with very comfortable beds, one of the best I have ever slept in. In addition the room was spotless. Large bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower. Check in/out process was flawless and with lovely staff behind the front desk. Tried the Dinner Buffet which was an experience in it itself, delicious; great variety with both local and international dishes. Attentive staff with a very friendly and professional attitude. Definitely the best hotel I have stayed at in Kigali. Can absolutely recommend this hotel and will for sure stay in this hotel should I need accommodation in Kigali.

author: 797ebrua
title: A Hilton Hotel at A Nice Location
text: The Hilton Garden Inn is 4 star hotel of the Hilton Group. It has a nice location at the new City of Mardin on the way to Kızıltepe/Airport. You can reach to the hotel after app. 20 minute taxi driving from the airport. It has a swimming pool and spa facilities. I especially like the terrace of the restaurant. However, the management of the hotel has some failures. Although, they have very friendly staff, the service quality is fair.

author: lizscot2016
title: Disappointing for a Hilton
text: Had an overnight stay en route to Northern Iraq for work and was rather let down after having high expectations from reading the website. Appreciate that this is a local hotel but none of the staff spoke much English which whilst understandable I found odd being a Hilton chain. Lots of sign language in order to get drinks and an evening meal. Quality of food is reasonable and cheap considering normal Hilton prices. Breakfast was a reasonable selection of continental style plus a few cereals and bread. Coffee machine didn’t work at breakfast but managed to get Nescafé packets from the room so problem solved. Rooms are very spacious and clean and once you can figure out the AC you can get a decent nights sleep. I think it must be the off season as I think there were only 20 guests in the entire hotel! I wouldn’t say not to stay here but I would say to keep your expectations lower than you would for a regular Hilton.

author: msvendsen
title: Don't expect normal Hilton Quality
text: Rooms are clean and pleasant. Breakfast buffet has a wide and tasty selection. Thats the end of the good news. Any other meals are best eaten elsewhere. Food is bad and service is terrible. Internet service is slow and intermittant. Desk staff are pleasant but not terribly helpful. My reservation was recorded incorrectly and took two days to correct. When leaving the hotel I was grilled by a desk staffer about payingbecause the reservation system apparently didn't show the fact that I had paid earlier in the day.

author: Serbese
title: Clean, affordable and comfortable...
text: First of all the pictures that are shown at TA website are not of the actual hotel in Mardin. In Hilton Garden Inn's there are no bellboys or anyone to park your car. However the prices are well balanced and sometimes cheaper then any unknown local five star hotels in that area. I had stayed at Konya Hilton Garden Inn in 2011 and was very pleased with it. So when trying to find a good hotel at Mardin I didn't think for a second when I saw Hilton Garden Inn and booked this hotel. The hotel is very clean, comfortable, not too pricey and very well located however what impressed me the most was the staff all around. Reception personnel Fırat and the others were all helpful and very friendly. There is a small swimming pool, sauna and a fitness center as well as a laundry room all free of charge. If you can afford it my advice for you is to book your stay at this hotel.

author: mattressgirl2011
title: Smoke Smelling Room, Location Saves The Day
text: I was expecting a boutique hotel, but Hotel Tahiti presents itself more as a business hotel. Unfortunately for us, our hotel room (partial ocean view) reeked of cigarette smoke. We notified the front desk worker who had accompanied us to the room and she denied the smell of smoke, insisting that none of the rooms could possibly smell like smoke because the property was smoke free. The folks in the room before us must have been smoking on the balcony with the window open because the smell stayed for all 3 days we were there. Nothing was done to accommodate us even though we were unhappy with the cigarette smell. The location on Es Pujols, however, really saved the day. Many many many Italian restaurants abound. The one directly at the base of the hotel,Boca Salina, is exceptional. The buffet breakfast selection is also really wonderful. One star for breakfast, one star for location, one star for some of the friendly staff.

author: pauleB8493ND
title: Amazing Hotel
text: We had the pleasure of staying at the Tahiti for a week’s break in June. The Hotel is simply beautiful. The staff are all so friendly and efficient, nothing is too much trouble. Breakfast is a very comprehensive buffet with plenty of variety and fresh produce. The bar / evening restaurant has a limited but very good menu - the quality was top class. We must make a special mention of Manu - the evening bar manager - by the end of the week, it felt like we’d known him for ever - what a truly lovely Guy! The Hotel manager - Robert, displayed a calm and relaxed omnipresence from first thing in the morning to last thing at night - not sure if he ever eats or sleeps?! We can’t recommend this Hotel highly enough - will definitely look forward to our next stay - as long as the rest of the world hasn’t discovered this little piece of paradise first..

author: CheshireDave33
title: 5 star in every way
text: Beautiful hotel in a perfect setting. Staff all amazing and friendly, contemporary public areas with high quality furnishings. While hotel is immaculate and clean. Breakfast is stunning with so many choices. Freaky baked pastries are as good as you get in Paris. Rooms are comfortable and clean. Bedding changed every day. Great shower. Pool area nice and secluded with padded sun beds and towel service. Faultless stay.

author: ARRomeIT
title: Hotel Tahiti FOREVER
text: Hotel Tahiti is a precious jewel of Formentera. There is a beautiful harmony of warm&lovely atmosphere, quality of service&great location, impeccable manners&welcoming of the people who work with dedication&passion. I am not a guest, I feel at home at Hotel Tahiti.
