I can consider myself a citizen of the world, I adore traveling and discovering new places...there are only three places in the world I need to visit each year. Hotel Tahiti is one of those three. I can't wait for next summer to come back to see the adorable smiles and feel the warmth of Hotel Tahiti! Ciao! A presto!

author: Watford_EnglandLelly
title: Beautiful hotel in a great location
text: We have just returned from a fab week away staying in Hotel Tahiti. The hotel is great, very beautifully decorated and very modern and clean. Breakfast is very good with a wide variety of choice. Pool is lovely and plenty of beds and umbrellas. Room was very comfortable and if you ask for a kettle and tea making facilities they will bring it all up to your room on request. The hotel is in a great location right on the beach and near plenty of bars, restaurants and shops. The hotel has a lovely shop selling clothes and nicknacs etc. We never ate dinner in the hotel as we prefer to go out and try local restaurants every night when on holiday. Lovely resort indeed and would highly recommend a stay here.

author: arowleybrereton
title: Better than ever
text: Have stayed here several times, has always been good. The hotel has had a huge makeover and is now very modern and relaxing Rooms have a lovely sea view from the balcony, comfortable beds and a good bathroom. They provide complimentary soft drinks in your mini bar, replacing any used each day. Beach towels provided each day from the pool bar. Breakfast is very,very good. Better than most 5 star hotels we've stayed in. Good beach bar belonging to hotel. Only complaint, no information in room we didn't know hotel had a restaurant on the terrace till end of holiday. Definitely recommend if staying in Es Pujols.

author: LaurieZ80
title: Great location but misses a soul
text: This hotel has a lovely location right on the beach and could be one of the best on the island. However it somehow misses something for a boutique hotel, it feels more like a chain hotel but perhaps that is just our taste. The main issue we had was that you can not eat outside on the terrace and are forced into a very small air-conditioned room that is not exactly very "beach" feeling. We were greeted by a rather stern kind of security guard at the entrance making sure that we are guests of the hotel and it was not the most friendly of ways to start the day. When we went to take the food outside they insisted that it was not allowed. So even though we paid for breakfast in the room rate we decided to eat at the cafe next door where you could eat on the terrace looking at the sea . When we complained to the hotel they went to great lengths to justify why we were not allowed to eat outside but it still was not clear why and there were many places all around where you could eat outside so it didn't make sense at all. No refund was offered either. A boutique hotel by the beach should offer a way to start the day enjoying the outside view of the beach that is so offered in their hotel promotion.

author: Jilllian
title: Amazing
text: Not a lot of people from the uk in the whole of the island, never mind the hotel, which was nice and made you really feel like you were really on holiday. Room overlooking the beach was excellent. Had everything you could possibly want; loads of towels, kettle, safe, fair few hangers in the wardrobe. Breakfast was absolutely excellent as was the food served at the pool bar during the day. Plenty of sunbeds around the pool. Clean beach towels provided daily. Fab pool bar for lunch and drinks. All in all a fabulous hotel.

author: B52s
title: Something missing.
text: In many ways it is difficult to fault this hotel, modern, clean and fragrant with rooms of a reasonable size, comfortable beds and a good in bath shower. As has been said, the breakfast is very good indeed, lots of choice and good produce, as a bonus it is available until midday. Housekeeping gave a faultless daily service. The pool area quiet and has an adequate supply of sun beds, free towels are provided each day.We were also pleased with the poolside service, although a little pricey. The hotel location is good - the beach is only a few metres from the door and a pleasant stroll to numerous restaurants, bars and shops. But for all of this, for us the hotel seemed to lack a 'soul'. A couple of further negatives, the WiFi although free is very slow and sometimes not available at all. Also I was astonished to discover that international calls cannot be made from the hotel landline. In an emergency I was reduced to making a personal call leaning over reception to use the staff telephone. For these reasons the hotel fails to achieve our very good rating.

author: victor030
title: Looking forward to another stay!
text: Great boutique-type hotel in an excellent (and peaceful) location at the outskirts of Es Pujols, separated from the beach by a scattering of beach restaurants. Es Pujols with its large choice of shops and restaurants is within easy walking distance. The hotel itself is medium-sized, well maintained and very clean. Most rooms have a sea-view and are of a sufficient size, air-conditioned, with a good quality bed and compact bathroom. Excellent breakfasts are served between 8 a.m. and noon. Very friendly and helpful staff. During our stay most other guests were either Italian or German. Looking forward to another stay! Highly recommended.

author: pompey63
title: A little bit of modernistic style
text: Rooms are very clean if not large, they're plenty big enough don't get me wrong just not big. The bathroom is quite small with a shower in the bath. Could do with changing the bath for a decent sized shower cubicle. The seating areas around the foyer are very nice and a good place to relax. the breakfast buffet is a feast to behold, although there is no English tea. the nearest you will find is black tea. A bit of a shame that they don't do evening meals. The staff could not be more friendly or helpful. a lovely place to stay.

author: Emilijakab
title: Simply perfect
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed there last year in July and this year again but in August. Both times it was amazing! The hotel is beautiful, the stuff is very kind and helpful. Breakfast – NOMNOM!:) Believe it or not we couldn’t wait to get up in the morning and go to breakfast haha. The guy that gives towels near the pool is one of the funniest and nicest. The beach is also perfect, very clean, not too crowded. Food in their restaurant was also very tasty, I just wished they had a little more to choose from – one menu for lunch and dinner, around 20 things to eat. Last thing I’m gonna say: don’t you all go running to Tahiti hotel, so there is at least one room for us because we are definitely going back a couple more times.

author: sallysY195XX
title: Fabulous Hotel!
text: Stayed here for a week in late July 2015. It's a lovely hotel with helpful staff, the rooms are gorgeous with fantastic beds! The pool and the sun beds were luxurious. We were the only English speaking guests in the hotel, and in the resort as far as we could tell. And as such I found it a little bit isolating. The only fault with the hotel was that there wasn't any English channels on the TV this would normally be an asset but I was a little bored with no other English speakers here. Fabulous location, the two hotel restaurants are above standard. This would be a great place for a honeymoon (especially if you speak fluent Italian as this resort is a favourite for people from Milan.

author: leonardov670
title: Thanks Tahiti!
text: I visited Formentera with my wife and our little boy (15 months) last June. Hotel Tahiti was the bet choice we could have ever done! Direct access to an amazing beach, swimming pool, all you cm can eat quality brunch served till noon every day! Personnel always extremely kind, and everything was always kept super clean with an intriguing perfume always in the air! We didn't try the restaurant , not included in the price, but we had couple of drinks in the hotel terrace! WOW!! Super tasty Mojoto by the way! The room was not superbig, but who wants to stay in when you are in Formentera?? Next visit I will definitely come back to this super little gem!

author: GFR2011
title: Excellent hotel in all its aspects
text: Just returned from a short break on this beautiful island. Third visit to this hotel and hopefully not the last one. The hotel Tahiti offers great comfort, convenient location with direct access to the beach and a superb breakfast. Our room was equipped with flatscreen TV, safety deposit box, tea & coffe-making facility and a minibar, which was daily replenished with soft-drinks, still water and sparkling water. The bathroom features a comprehensive set of amenities... too many to list them here. The hotel offers probably the best breakfast on the island. Quality and variety are way above average in this sort of beach hotel. Best of all, breakfast is available until noon, so no need to hurry if you get a late start into the day. I wouldn't even think about looking for any hotel on Formentera other than this one.

author: FudgeNortheEast
title: Superb hotel,lovely setting and very attentive staff.
text: On early arrival,staff showed us not only where to store our luggage but where to shower and change to use the pool until check in,so a very warm professional welcome straight away. We had stayed here 3 times previously and the hotel has been upgraded since our last visit in 2009,with beautiful outdoor decor. Our room was modern with a lovely view of the ocean with amenities such as TV,fridge ,toiletries ,tea/coffee making facilities and bathrobes. The free wifi is a plus too. Breakfasts are served until 12 and cater for most tastes including cava which is a great start to the day. The hotel rooms and general areas are immaculately maintained,all the staff are approachable,pleasant and go out of their way to help,a credit to the owners. The hotel is located in a picturesque location,a beach immediately infront and further beaches a few minutes walk reached via wooden walkways,Restaurants and bars are also a few minutes walk away.The hotel also has a chilled good sized swimming pool which also has a hoist for less abled guests. Would highly recommend and would rate it far higher than it's official rating.

author: Ellbee84
title: Shhh...keep it a secret or everyone will want to stay there!
text: ...but that's not the point of Tripadvisor so I should really spill the beans. The online photos don't do this hotel justice. But not only is it a very pleasant surprise when walking in to Tahiti, it's staff are also amongst the friendliest I've experienced in a hotel, as good as a luxury 5 star. The room was extremely clean with a great array of toiletries including a lovely exfoliator and after sun treatment. There was a mini-bar filled with soft drinks that were replenished every day free of charge, comfortable beds and luxury bath robes. Breakfast was also fantastic with almost anything you could want and with service until 12pm it was ideal for mornings when a lie in was preferable. Location wise it was perfect. In the smarter end of Es Pujols there are several very nice restaurants nearby. Tahiti's own beach bar has stunning views which can be enjoyed over lunch or a cocktail at the end of a hard day on the beach. Hotel Tahiti - can't wait to go back!

author: T6434VWangies
title: FRONT DESK PERSON NEEDS A LESSON IN HOSPITALITY
text: I stayed at this hotel for one night after discovering there were bed bugs in the hotel I was originally booked in. Friends I was traveling with were booked at Tahiti and luckily had a 3rd empty bed. They graciously invited me to spend the night in their hotel with them - Hotel Tahiti. In the morning, the front desk person offered everyone breakfast which is free to guests. After getting a cup of coffee, she came over and insisted that I am not allowed to eat anything because was technically not a guest of the hotel. I can understand that policy, but it's pretty tacky to single out one person over a cup of coffee. At the very least, give me the option to pay for it. This lady needs a real lesson is couth, especially if you're going to advertise "our high level of customized service, turns your stay into a truly unique experience."= uniquely rude.

author: Jeanna1857
title: Great Hotel
text: We went to this hotel the first week in September we had not been able to book with Thomson's they did not have availability so I did some research and discovered a company called Astbury's who are on the island but also have an office in York so we booked with them and booked our own flights we can't complain Astbury's did every thing for us, including ferry tickets and transfers it worked perfectly. The staff are very friendly and helpful our friends who were with us had been before so we knew what to expect they did travel with Thomson's it helped booking our own flights because we live in Leeds but would have had to go from Manchester with Thomson's so it worked quite well. We had a nice room with a sea view not all rooms have a sea view so you would need to request one. The breakfasts are by far the best I have had and we have travelled every where great choice of everything you would be hard pushed not to find something you couldn't eat. For those of you who do not know the beaches are Naturists beaches I think they could have a few beaches where the Naturist can go and if you don't want to go there then I think there should be an option especially for families with children, the only thing I could complain about with the hotel would be the fact that on our last day their was one guy sat in the bar by the pool with a towel around him but nothing else sat there naked from the waste down with a towel that didn't fit around his body and showing every thing to everyone who was sat in the bar this I think should not have been allowed by the hotel staff they must have noticed we all got up and moved and there was a family sat by the bar with a young child. This is not acceptable and should not have happened. We had an evening meal in the hotel and this was especially good, there are some great restaurants in Formentera and the hotel is situated so you can stroll along the board walk on an evening we really enjoyed our holiday we ran most days early so it was nice to go on the beach when it was deserted for obvious reasons I am not a prude but do not want it in my face every one has the right to make a choice mine would be to stay around the pool except of course if the guy who frequented our hotel whilst we were there had not been there. I would however go back to this hotel if we were to go again but would not put up with a nude person in the bar.

author: BillyteeSheffield
title: Faultless
text: We have just returned from Hostal Tahiti after spending a memorable week there to celebrate our silver wedding. As all other reviewers point out the breakfast is an event, and because it's 8-12 allows lots of flexibility to organise your day. The staff are always polite and helpful, and the hotel is never less than spotless. Es Pujols is a lovely resort but it is like Little Italy! However we never saw any trouble and to be fair the daily soap opera of Italian lives provides lots of entertainment. Although the staff in the hotel speak English, be prepared to speak a little bit of basic Spanish (or Italian) when in restaurants or you might find it difficult. The resort is expensive, infact the whole island is, but in our opinion it was worth it. As far as eating out is concerned we particularly enjoyed Bar Tahiti (near the hotel) for the grilled fish and breathtaking views, Oliveras for a cracking pizza, and S'Averdero for top class steaks. All in all we loved the hotel and resort and we will be returning

author: Heath08
title: Excellent hotel
text: Having come back to EsPujols with the same friends we visited with over 25 years ago it was an absolute delight to find this hotel. Officially a 2 star it was very much like a four star! Ok the rooms are a little dated but the hotel itself is wonderful. Warm friendly staff welcome you and look after you during your stay. Sun loungers, outdoor seating by reception and the bar are lovely with the canopied seats and the tear drop seat which holds 4 at least. The breakfast is to die for - our rep gave us the best advice and I'd recommend it to anyone - get up early - go for was walk and pop in to a beach bar for coffee and a pastry, have a swim in the sea, then shower and get ready for brunch - yes, breafast is served til midday and there is plenty of it right up til 'closing time'. Sparkling wine is a lovely touch too. You cannot go wrong with this hotel - we love it!

author: redlady75
title: Fantastic Hotel, and hilarious staff - cant wait to go back
text: This was by far the best holiday I have ever been on. The hotel was spotless, the rooms were lovely - (would prefer double beds though). The room had its own fridge with drinks filled up at no extra cost. There were towels by the pool for both the beach and the pool. The bar staff were fantastic, the evening staff made special cocktails for us. The People bar on the beach which is part of the hotel made our Engagement on the beach very special with Champagne opened with a knife and photos taken on cushions on the beach. The Bar round the pool was such fun with Leonardo and Antonio and their fantastic personalities. We cannot fault this hotel and would go back every year and hope to go back this year. Ove it!!

author: SAFCDURHAM10
title: An absolute gem !!!
text: After extensive internet research and having read the very favourable comments on Tripadvisor, we chose the Hotel Tahiti ( booked through Thomson holidays ) for our week long August holiday to Formentera. We were returning to the Island after an eighteen year gap and were pleased to find that it hadn't changed too much. The Tahiti is situated in a fantastic position, literally on the beach, five minutes walk from the centre of Es Pujols. It is a modern hotel with comfortable rooms, all air conditioned. Extra touches were the free mini-bar which was restocked every day with soft drinks and water and the loan of hotel towels to take to the swimming pool or beach. The staff were always helpfull and attentive, but by far the best part was the so-called breakfast/brunch buffet which was served from 8am 'till 12 noon. Every conceivable taste was catered for, as well as the traditional hot English, there was a fantastic, large and varied selection of cheeses,hams, bread, fruit, cakes, pastries and pancakes. This hotel is an absolute gem!! I would recommend it unreservedly, perhaps for a special occasion or anniversary treat.

author: elaineLeedsUk
title: wonderful and relaxing
text: The Hotel is situated on a beautiful beach only a few feet away from the main building. The staff were very polite and eagar to make your stay enjoyable. nothing seemed to be too much trouble. The breakfasts were excellant and set you up for the day, we stayed for one week and may be would have tried of the variety if there for longer. the rooms were cleaned and fresh towels daily also the minifridge was stocked up with soft drinks and water daily. The pool area was clean and pleasent to bathe and for swimming plenty of sunloungers and brollies. easy get to other parts of the island by bus, stopped outside hotel or by bikes/mopeds. Holiday to suit couples of any age but not suitable for teenagers. Very little in the way of nightclubs on the island.

author: Hayleyrebeccaxx
title: Think about the price you pay
text: If I was paying extortionate prices then I wouldn't be happy with my holiday however, we paid £1300 10 days all inclusive including flights transfers and luggage for me my partner and two children. The rooms was cleaned every other day, we got fresh towels on request, we was over looking the pool. Yes you have to pay for the beds by the pool but least you don't have to rush for one and fight through crowds like most all inclusive resorts. The drinks was basic in the day but as it was a family holiday a soft drink and the odd beer was fine by us then the spirits start from 8pm in another bar. The snack bar is good if you are a fussy eater, breakfast wasn't the best food but snacks opened at 11am so I was happy with a coffee some mornings then waiting until 11am. Me, my partner & the kids didn't go hungry. The life guards are very friendly, as was all the staff we interacted with. There's also a lovely Irish bar next door which does nice cocktails. That all said, on the last day we seen a cockroach on the floor in the bar.

author: Happiness664264
title: Awful
text: We stayed here for 2 weeks & never again. It is so outdated really needs a makeover. The rooms were not clean. I wished I read reviews on the hotel before staying here. We stayed in the complex across the road from the actual hotel with the reception, pool so& restaurants so anytime we needed anything we had to go across the way. There are very little tourists mainly Portuguese locals that stay and live in the hotel. I would really recommend to not stay here. The only good thing was the location you are about 5-7 min walk from the strip.

author: G4072FHrosieb
title: The best hotel ever
text: Ignore all the bad reviews! Club Praia da Rocha is a fantastically run and wonderfully located hotel suitable for all ages and circumstances. I’m 20 and went with 2 friends and we had the best time ever! The food was really nice and there was a lot of variety (despite usually having to wait at least 10 mins before being seated). Additionally, the room was spacious, the staff were absolutely lovely and you definitely get what you pay for with the all inclusive deal; the food is available nearly all the time and a large selection of drinks including alcohol on offer. Finally it’s in a great location near the shops, bars and beach. Top tip if you want a quiet spot on the beach just keep walking along the right hand side: It becomes much quieter and is really quite beautiful. The only downfall of our stay would be that the cleaners didn’t change our bed sheets and we had to ask for new towels which is an inconvenience. However, in the grand scheme of things it really wasn’t a problem. All round a wonderful hotel!

author: 843kerriew
title: Great hotel for families
text: Honest review … great hotel for families the pool area is brill and the set up for the sun beds is brilliant. Yes you have to pay for them but you’ve the peace of mind that you have them for the day and you can come and go as you please and not have wars over them! The food yes it’s basic and repetitive but plenty of it all day with the restaurant and the snack bar but that’s pretty standard on most all inclusive I feel and the location of the hotel is so central you’ve only a short walk to the strip and the beach where you have eateries in abundance. Rooms basic but spacious. Really don’t know why this hotel has got a slating on here. We were in the main bloc 1 however so my only advice would be to insist you are in there or Bloc 2 or I guess maybe my review might of been a little different. Slide and splash worth a try too but you won’t have time to do all the slides in one day just in case you want to buy a two day one. Great hotel for what we paid in my opinion and would defo book again.

author: JamesBD11
title: Poor
text: Visited between 14th and 24th of August, me and my family stayed all-inclusive yes it was a cheap deal and you get what you pay for so let me start Pro's- pool was great for all nice size, was able to watch our younger kids from pool side while we relaxed and older kids and adults could dive in the deep end 2.6m. -location is good close to strip and the beach. Con's- food was repetitive and struggled to feed kids anything other than chips. My kids are not fussy eaters. - Quied for all the meals and drinks. - the hotel has privately owned appartments which dogs are allowed to stay in one morning some one had walked dog mess all through the hotel ground. - entertainment was shocking - rooms/ hotel was run down - towels were changed once in 10 days. - bedding was changed once when we requested. - some very shoddy wiring in luggage room. Honest opinion use as a base only and that is it.

author: gladioli1
title: Club Praia da rocha
text: After reading reviews was quite worried. However we enjoyed our stay. The hotel needs updating but it was clean and the rooms had plenty of space. It would benefit from air con particularly in bars and restaurants and the food isn’t great. However the pool area although busy is great for kids and all the staff were lovely. Pool had lifeguards who were professional but friendly. Very central and lovely resort. Overall it was a lovely holiday- basic but enjoyable.

author: ElaineT2201
title: Self catering
text: Ok where do i start - pool area great although u have to pay €1.50 for each sunbed and parasol u use which can take a chunk out of your spending money if not accounted for. The rooms are clean although they are tired and need decorated. We always go self catering but there is no kettle, toaster, remote control etc. If u want a kettle etc u need to hire them so the facilities are poor. If u enjoy full english breakfast then go to squash bar just outside hotel to left run by Jose and Maria who are both lovely and Sandi the cook of course. The boat trip is enjoyable. We went with Captain Cave and it cost 30 euros each. It can be windy at night. If you are going all inclusive then be prepared because everybody complains about food. I hope this helps.

author: emmacarters
title: Very unpleasant
text: So my friend and Inhad 4 days here for a short break. I agree you get what you paid for BUT this was on another level, we arrived just after midnight after a 90 minute transfer check was quick, we found the man in reception was very rude, we asked if we could get some water from any where to which he pointed to the vending machine €1.50 for a small warm bottle of water. We was taken to our room Block 3, 7th floor by the night staff, across the main road. The room was of good size but had a very damp smell and little silver fish over the floor and the beds, it wasn’t dirty, the smell was horrendous. They changed our room the next day to block 2 6th floor wow what an improvement, but no air con. The pool area was clean and yes you pay €1.50 per day for the sun lounger €1.50 for the parasol, I didn’t mind just meant we didn’t have to do the 0600 dash for a Sun bed, the pool opens @ 09.00 and is in an enclosed cage like area. Food was basic and very raely hot and repetitive, you wouldn’t stave here but I would expect more from a 3 star. Drinks were okay but spirits only served from 8pm till 10pm and that’s none of the name brands, staff at the bars and snack bars are RUDE, as soon as the know your English that’s it attitude. The location is amazing short walk to the Beach which was spectacular, local bars and restaurants, I would rate this hotel as 1* The view from block 3 and the view while at the pool. Please don’t waste you money.

author: S6282MGannd
title: False advertising
text: I know it says 3 star but you really need to read reviews before you book this kip. I didt we were put in block 3 across 2 main rds no pool no reception. No mention of this block on the Web site. It was flithy blood on bed clothes.. bath had footprints in it paint peeling of walls. We booked into a hotel the first night couldn't stay in it. Staff were really rude especially the girl wouldn't listen to us. Only i have a friend in Portugal who got us sorted with apartments we would of had a holiday from hell. Trip advisor should send someone to look at this block as it is so dirty and unsafe. If u book and a they tell you a bus is taking you to your block RUN😠😠😠

author: danih220
title: A dirty and sad hotel
text: Please listen to the bad reviews. Worst experience at a hotel I’ve ever had - we were in block 3 over the dual carriage way with no facilities or staff and felt so unsafe. Room was very dirty and shower didn’t work properly with barely any hot water. Staff were very rude and unhelpful all throughout the week and said they were used to complaints but wouldn’t do anything about it. Food was edible but not enjoyable - ate out as much as we could. Lost my appetite by the end of the week just from the smell of the restaurant when walking in. Local area is beautiful but a lot of offers for drugs so I don’t think I would be comfortable as a family there with young children. All inclusive is not true - you still have to pay for sun-beds at the pool (shocking), to use the safe, tv remote, hair products, kettle - everything. Checkout was the easiest part of the stay as they cut off your guest band and say goodbye - I don’t think they would dare ask if you enjoyed your stay. Don’t ruin your holiday before it even starts - don’t go to this hotel!

author: aliciabrowne70
title: Honestly the best place we have stayed in Portugal
text: I had seen all the negative reviews and was skeptical but hey we were looking for a cheap week away and weren't too fussy so booked this place on a whim. We were not disappointed. Staff were spot on, facilities were great, and location awesome! We were at the hotel just once for breakfast so can't really comment on the all inclusive food. But we saw nothing wrong with what was on offer. They had bacon, eggs, cold meats, cheeses, yogurt, so many different breads and pastries, cereals, hot and cold drinks and a fruit cocktail. Ok I would have liked abit of fresh fruit with breakfast but I didn't leave hungry either. We have been to Portugal 3 times and this hotel is the best so far. Most definitely (and finally) have found a hotel we will rebook on our return trip to Portugal again!

author: 548lindsaya
title: It is what it is
text: I stayed here for 4 nights with a group of friends to celebrate a friends birthday. The night before we flew I read the reviews and I was really worried about what to expect. If you are due to stay here please don’t be put off by these bad and unfair reviews. During our stay I realised just how unfair the nagative reviews were. The rooms, not the best I have stayed in but they are spacious, have a balcony and is someone to lay your head at night, had no issues with our room. The Food, you get what you pay for, I think people have forgotten that when writing their reviews, I had no issues with the food and out of the whole holiday there was only 1 lunchtime where I didn’t really want anything that was out but just waited until 15:00 and got burger and chips from the snack bar 😊 my favourite was breakfast, certainly no complaints there! although the all inclusive is a bit restrictive we still got drunk and had a great time, we’re well fed, it is what it is and what you make of it! The staff were friendly, outside pool area clean and hotel ideally situated close to the beach and night life, ideal for a 4 night stay 😊

author: 306SamC
title: Dreadful horror hotel.
text: Was cheap so wasn't expecting much but whilst I don't mind basic accommodation, my standards stretch to somewhere clean, on arrival we were met with used cigarette buts on the(unlit)balcony, Smashed glass on the balcony and towels were really badly stained/some of which we couldn't use. Shower attachment broken so had to use it, put it off, then once washed yourself put it back on to rinse the soap off?! Went out early, came back to no room serviced, wet towels still on the floor, had to go down to reception several times to get clean ones put in the room. This is cheap but by no means cheerful..it's like somewhere I would have stayed when 18 years old, it certainly looks like it should still be in 1991, very dated. Whilst I wasn't expecting the world for the money. Somewhere clean, with air conditioning and a shower that works would have been good, oh and no lock on the safe so had to carry all my euros around with me. This place is by no means a "3 star". Avoid at all costs.

author: clairehZ8792OP
title: It was ok...
text: My gran, daughter and i spent a week here on the 12th of May. We were all inclusive, as said, the rooms are dated, old tvs which we didnt pay for a remote for, we just pressed the buttons. The room had a fridge with a freezer compartment and for the amount of time we spent in our room it done the job, maids came 4 out of 7 days. I didny mind the sheets not being changed as i change them weekly at home anyway. I found staff polite and helpful but really rushed off their feet. The food was repetitive and needed more choices, fish or chicken/pork and potatoes or chips. There were a couple of nights my daughter only had chips for dinner. Breakfast was ok. Evening entertainment was ok, kids enjoyed it, but would have been good to have a mini disco, or music on later than 11pm. All 3 of us enjoyed our holiday, my daughter would love to go back.

author: Dirishgirl
title: You get what you pay for
text: Provided you get a really cheap deal, you get what you pay for. The room was filthy and wasn't cleaned during our stay, we asked for clean towels and it was like I was asking for gold bars. No facilities in the room only a few plates and cutlery. No kettle or hairdryer. The reception staff were rude and unhelpful. The pool area is ok, lifeguard on duty and a slide for kids, staff there are nice, you pay for sun loungers which we didn't mind given the cost. The pool toilets and showers are pretty awful. Lots of really nice restaurants in the area so a good location.

author: edshirl16
title: Needs a Refurb & maybe new Cleaners
text: This was our 2nd time staying, last time was good, not great but good. This time we got a room that was so dusty we were both coughing all week and when we got back. The beds were single which we would normally accept, as you do as a couple we push them together. The problem here was that they had a high frame (Like a cot) around them. This made it difficult to get out of bed as well as the many times we banged our feet or legs on it. Every time you moved even a little woke the other up as it was the very thin mattress was sitting in a sheet of ply wood. It was 2013 when we were last there and nothing has changed, meaning furniture or décor. The shower went cold pretty much straight away, no matter what time of the day. We wont be returning to the hotel, although we will always go back to Praia Da Rocha. We didn't let it spoil our weeks holiday.

author: Z9920SWamyk
title: Dont let reviews put you off!!
text: Just returned from a 4 day break at this hotel. After reading reviews we were all dreading arriving at the hotel. We were pleasantly surprised when we arrived. Yes its dated, basic and could do with a freshen up. But its clean, the maids were in EVERY day (some reviews claim they were never there!) We didnt eat in the restaurant after hearing reviews from people staying at the hotel do cant comment but went to the pool snack bar. If you like burgers, chips etc youll be fine. Hotel is in a great location, only approx 10 min walk to the beach which is beautiful 😍 People who expect more from the hotel need to be willing to pay more. You definitely get what you pay for and we were more than happy with our stay!

author: hollyb338
title: Great mini break!
text: My friend and I had booked to stay here as a mini break/catch up trip. We were really sceptical before we arrived and had 0 expectations of the hotel. We’re here just now and looking around we cannot understand what people have been complaining about?! Our room is spotless (although very cold!) and really spacious. The food is good with lots of choice too, even the comments about unhealthy options we can’t quite get our heads around given there are huge salad bowls on offer?! The staff are pleasant enough, especially if you treat them with respect like you would expect to receive in your own job. The location is excellent and your just a short walk from all the bars, cafes and shops. Please do not be put off by negative reviews. We are two girls, late twenties and we’re having a fab time!!!

author: donnamK4951VY
title: Don't waste your money
text: Returned Tuesday and tbh I cudnt wait to get home! The hotel was awful, there was a crack in our room window, crack in the balcony window, bidet had been ripped out and not replaced, all pipes still in place. Indoor pool was closed and the outdoor pool was freezing,tiles in the showers by the pool were broken and just left laying around. Food was the same stuff most days and everything tasted the same. Went all inclusive but only wine and beer available before 8, spirits had to be paid for before 8. Drilling from the above apartment the whole time we were there so cudnt relax in the room. Only 2 glasses in the room for 4 ppl. We were turned away frm the restaurant 1 nite even tho there were free tables. All in all not a good holiday at all and I wouldn't recommend it to any1

author: clairerZ268UE
title: DO Not book with SUPERESCAPES.CO.UK# REALTRAP
text: This hotel/ apartment must be closed down ASAP. Everything in the 1 bedroom apartment I was staying with my sister and 2 nephews was very very filthy, rusty and the toilet stunk. Cleaners don't do their job well! How can a mope bucket be kept in a place im staying??? The heating was rusty....the curtains were falling apart... the beds were not comfortable...i actually woke up with a back ache....the food was so dry horrible and chicken mixed with pork chops. The T.v. is too small after living in the 21st century didn't think again if these tv's still EXISTED.HORRIBLE HOTEL PLEASE DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY

author: 762jodim
title: 2015 stay... reviews never change!
text: Me and my partner visited here in 2015 and even then the reviews were the same... terrible!! I was so scared about going as it was our first holiday abroad together and wanted it to be amazing! However, the reviews scared the life out of me! But we learnt quickly that the reviews must have been from very picky people as we had a great time and felt the staff were great, it was clean enough and if you didn't like the look of all inclusive food the surrounding restaurants were dirt cheap anyway!! We are visiting again this year in July and the reviews are making me nervous again... but if its as it was 3 years ago then we will have nothing to worry about!! You get what you pay for and if people expect 5* for budget price they must be dreaming! Or, they know a trick that I don't when getting exclusive for budget!! Great hotel and great location!!!

author: tomcapstick
title: Bad holiday
text: Hotel very dirty and dated. Needs more than refurbishing as the rooms look like they haven't been decorated for at least 40 yrs. Went all inclusive and most of the food i wouldn't have given to my dog. No ice cream served for kids, entertainment no good, karaoke or animal show 9:30 at night when most kids too tired to care. Would definitely not visit again. Pool area grubby and had to pay for sun loungers every day €1 each. Would recommend avoiding this hotel. Very boring with nothing much to do.

author: jamie155
title: Brilliant stay
text: There are many negative reviews regarding this hotel, but I can honestly say my wife and I had a wonderful stay. We paid £300 each for a weeks All Inclusive........that was superb value. I suspect some on here expected the world for the cost....and think that speaks more about them than the hotel. The staff were pleasant and friendly, the room was spacious and accommodated our needs perfectly. There are reviews regarding the food....let’s be honest here, this hotel accomodates many nationalities, as such, the food must accommodate also...if you want fish and chips, nip down to the strip or go to Blackpool. We saw one person drop a plate of chips, leave it for the staff to clean, whilst they dutifully replenished the plate. The staff aren’t rude, the guests are. I cannot stress enough how much rubbish the staff put up with, and not only do they deserve 5*....they deserve 24 carrot gold stars.....the location is a very short walk to an incredibly picturesque beach....my advice to travellers to this hotel...learn thank you and please (Obregado and Por Favor)..... it goes a long way... we’ll done Clube Praia Da Rocha, and thank you for a lovely time.

author: lorainef33
title: You get what you pay for
text: Reception staff not very helpful with room mix up on arrival. Put on 13th floor when lower level requested. Room was dirty(floors, curtains, furniture, wardrobes). Looks like all rooms need total revamp. Other guests' requests to move due to complaints about condition of rooms not entertained at all. Were told hotel was full when it clearly was not. Breakfast was included but had to stick to cereal/bread as hot food was not very appetising. Yogurts were not cold and fruit was canned. Only plus was pool area which was well managed (€1 charge per bed or umbrella per day). Short walking distance to fabulous beach.

author: Leocdonald1983
title: It ain’t that bad
text: Here at the mo and it not as bad as people make out yeah the staff seam to be pretty rude am really out going and thought ya know what am off to make more effort with them do now the guys at the pool are like my pals ha they just do there job if you have a laugh with them they open up. The rooms are basic but massive we’re in room 520 over looking the pool. Not eating in here as we’re self catering so eating out all time. Squash bar Just round corner Jose owns it he’s a really nice guy. Irish eye does the best breakfast taffys does a mean meal yet to try there breaki. It’s cheap here forget bout the faults r shower was broke I fixed it myself one thing for sure the views on the beach day and night are breathtaking and free so if ya fed up of hotel go look at the scenery will blow you away. On the beach 6bottles for 10euor I’m bucket of ice looking at that sea is amazing. I always say to the wife best things in life are free the views the love u have for the people your on holiday with family’s scenery lap it up enjoy get drunk have fun I am. O and I walk a lot on my own every time am alone I get asked if I won’t some Charlie I have even had a laugh with them on strip I don’t use drunks and they ask you and leave u alone but when am with the wife and kids they don’t even bother you.

author: Sboswort
title: Wow
text: Well stayed here for the weekend (all inclusive). My expectations were really low and it didn't disappoint, being brutally honest for what I paid it was fine. Down points, paying for a sun bed 1e shocking, bed was horrible in my room. No beach towels for a around the pool, toaster in the dinner room was poor and just warmed the bread, food (have eaten worse) again for the price it was fine. Now the positive elements, my apartment was massive, the hotel was clean and tidy, it had four lifts. Amd the beer and drinks were free. Would I go back? nope, would I recommend hmmm. Nope but I have stayed in worse. It a nutshell, it does disappoint but you get what u pay for.

author: beckyb698
title: Meh
text: I'm not one to usually write reviews on my travels, but this felt very necessary. I'd like to firstly point out that my holiday was lovely and the area, beach, restaurants etc are gorgeous! The downfall started when myself and my partner arrived very late at night, and finally arriving upon the hotel we were in need of some sleep, but were told we needed to see the man out front and he will take us to our room, which we had to take a small van across the road to our apartment, the apartments in the third block are .. • incredibly dated • dirty • beds are solid (didn't sleep much) The curtains in the room don't actually fit the window, so you're awaken with bright sun in your face every morning. The cleaners that are suppose to come 5 days a week, plus give you cleaners towels twice a week never came in the whole duration of us staying there, which was a week. We went all inclusive as it was apparently cheaper than going half board, but in all honestly the food was terrible, unless you like soup, dry chicken and fish every night you're in for a win. The last thing that really irritated me was the fact you had to pay for the sun beds at the hotel, I mean you've paid all inclusive so surely you should get everything, right? Not only that but the staff were so rude, I wouldn't bother asking them anything because they speak to you so poorly, and don't seem like they want to be there, the guy who gives you your sun bed would literally throw them on the floor and walk off, thanks then? I guess.

author: stevegell
title: Awful hotel, Awful Food, Dated Rooms... but good for a bed and good location.
text: We have just returned from this hotel, group of 30 older lads (average age of 45-50) and we already knew what to expect from the reviews. Yes the food they have one meat, one fish but it really is barely edible. We only used this hotel as somewhere to sleep and have a few watered down beers before we left the hotel to eat and visit some of the great bars which is only a short walk away. Its already been said there is a squash restaurant (Irish type bar) that does great food for a fair price. The ONLY good thing about this holiday is the location. You don't need to go all inclusive here. Rooms are very tired, enamel peeling off the baths, not the cleanest rooms either. Pool was dirty with yellow, green scum around the edge... In the resort its like a running joke when they see the hotel band on your wrist as its called the "hotel of horrors"....

author: nickw719
title: Excellent for the money
text: After reading the horror stories on here we phones our travel agent to try and change hotels, and we were unable to change, and I'm so glad we didn't!! Check in was very quick and easy, the staff were brilliant and made a big fuss of our 6yr old. The rooms were a bit dated but very clean and functional. The food was very nice but it was a bit more like full board than all inclusive because at certain times there isn't an option to get anything to eat (we checked in just as the snack bar was closing so couldn't get anything for a hour or so until the restaurant opened for dinner. The breakfasts were a little repetitive but we never went hungry. The pool area is lovely, and the 1£ for a sun lounger works perfectly, you can come and go as you please without worrying you'll loose your place. While it's true the housekeeping dont come everyday I'm an adult and fully capable of making my own bed. We all loved every second and wont hesitate to come again. a little tip, the supermarket built into the hotel is a bit expensive, come out of the main doors, turn left and a few feet away is a smaller supermarket but LOADS cheaper.

author: Debbiecool
title: Holiday august 2017
text: After reading so many bad reviews on here really didn't know what to expect especially when we got there about midnight to be told we were in block 3 however our apartment was amazing, not sure if it was one of the refurbished ones. We had to walk across the bridge but it didn't take long to get from our apartment to the main hotel. Staff were always helpful and to be honest going and asking at reception for the maid to leave clean towels and toilet paper was no hardship. Food could be better especially breakfast but there was always something you could eat. The squash bar next door do a lovely b/fast for 4€ and a section of toasties for 4€, the shop next to the squash bar had all the extras you might need 5 litres of bottled water only 1€ and the spar good value for money. The beaches what can I say absolutely stunning and very clean, had so much fun in the sea and sunbathing. Pool clean and lovely to cool off in, pool bar good my only issue was spirits were only available after 8pm and cocktails you had to pay for, never had this before as included in the 'all inclusive' package at other hotels I've visited. All in all we had a fantastic holiday

author: 835lorraineh
title: Enjoyable
text: Location is very good but not suitable for anyone who has mobility problems.. My mother was not able for the hill to get into the strip. I got a blow dry from hair dresser in the complex and I have to say it was the worst blow dry I have ever had... Awful... next day I went around the corner and got it redone and had a lovely curly blow dry from very professional hair dresser..The apartments are very spacious and we had everything we needed.. the beds could be more comfortable....It was great value for money however, paying a euro for sun lounger and a euro for umbrella every day does not sound like much but it added up and would need to be taken into account especially for families who might be watching how they spend their money. I enjoyed my stay. I would recommend clube praya da rocha, but would avoid the hair dresser.

author: 945janines
title: DONT DO IT
text: The fact it is 10mins from the beach is its only plus. We were all inclusive and the food was diabolical. No deserts just watermelon every day. 1 fish dish and 1 meat dish with carbs. Rice rice and more rice. Breakfast was hot dog sausages that were burnt and mass cooked. Ques horrendous, waited 1.5 hours for dinner one night. Get what you pay for I guess. Just don't bother!

author: kwsmith1960
title: Fab Holiday!
text: There were 18 of us traveling to Portugal for 10 days for my daughters wedding, we needed somewhere cheap and cheerful to stay and that is what we got! All these people moaning about this hotel were probably not moaning when they paid the price...you get what you pay for!! Rooms were very dated but liveable beds were OK sheets were changed when needed! Our room was swept a few times a week but there was a sweeping brush behind the door if you wanted to use it. Towels were changed regularly so no qualms there..food was edible some of us went out to eat breakfast but I didn't mind what was on offer.we had to pay €1 per day for our sunbed which I think is a great idea stops rif raf and no need to fight for one we always got a good speck all 18 of us together lol. The staff were ok they worked long and hard hours so can't be cheerful all the time but nobody was disrespectful..the pool was fab the children in our group really enjoyed themselves..entertainment wasn't up to much but you neednt stay in for it daytime was ok with water aerobics and volleyball..all in all to please 18 people at once is an achievement and they did! We will all be returning next year for another wedding and staying here. My daughters wedding was a fairytale so it prompted another couple to propose!!!!! Fun was had by all...I must just say I'm registered disabled and can't walk to far the hills to the strip and beach are very steep and slippy I had a few people to help me but did have a nasty fall on my way back from a meal out one night and no I don't drink so it wasn't the alcohol lol just be careful.

author: 423kerryl
title: Family holiday
text: A wipe you feet on way out kind of hotel, was there for 10 days not one cleaner came into our apartment. Had to ask for clean towels..got 2 clean sets in the whole 10 days... Staff (except dining room and pool bar) very rude, everything for them is too much like hard work. Food absalutly terrible, half of it unedible the other half boring and bland. Spaghetti Bolognese on menu 8 times out if 10 (unedible) Theres always chips though. Queues everywhere, staff slow with little or no motivation. Pool was decent size, sun beds 1 euro each, not too bad I suppose. Would we go back?? NO definatly not. Stayed in many hotels and this has got to be the worst.

author: c0pey5
title: Pleasantly surprised - ignore bad reviews!
text: Having read the reviews on build up to our recent 7 day holiday we were very concerned as to what to expect. We visited as a family of 4 and to be perfectly honest fail to see what all the bad publicity is about. Yes the rooms are basic (we stayed on the 13th floor of block 2) and in need of some TLC but perfectly functional and in no way were detrimental to our trip. Our children (aged 9 and 12) absolutely loved the pool and games room!! the food was simple but tasty and certainly no sign of any food poisoning..... never had to wait more than 5 minutes for beers or soft drinks in any of the bars and the staff were all superb and worked extremely hard. The hotel is a 5 minute walk from the beautiful beach and bustling town which offers a great variety shops, bars and restaurants. If you want a budget all inclusive holiday in a great resort then in our opinion this is perfect. I honestly have no idea where all the bad reviews have come from as this is certainly not what we experienced. Thank-you Clube Praia da Roche.....

author: 276lesleyh
title: Health and safety risk - steer clear!
text: I stayed in this hotel ten years ago and it was a nice hotel. Came back and was extremely disappointed. They tried to put us in a room in a hotel across the road which had empty pools and no security or lighting and broken lifts. After waiting and wasting a whole day of our one week holiday they moved us to the hotel we booked. There are many apartments for sale and some tenants have dogs which bark all night. My son came across some dogs muck on the stairs!! I was very disappointed with this hotel as we paid all inclusive. I contacted on the beach and they told me that the hotel said you get what you pay for!!! I should have checked the reviews first.

author: briansU7874JX
title: Great holiday
text: Just had 10 fantastic days at this hotel, we stayed all inclusive and couldn't fault it for what we paid it's definitely 2 maybe 3 star hotel but not sure what some people expect for such a cheap hotel. We enjoyed the food and the snack bar is brilliant there is something for everyone, you can only get beer wine and soft drinks through the day and then spirits from 20:00 till 23:00. We stayed in block 1 and the room was lovely for the time we spent in It, yes they are very dated but who goes on holiday to sit a room all day? I did here some bad things about block 3 which is over the road and after having a walk around it I can understand why, but people who were put over there were moved within a day or two. You also have to pay €1 for sunbeds and €1 for a parasol we found this ok because you are guaranteed to get a sunbed where you want them. The restaurant's can also get busy which you should expect, for breakfast it opens at 08:00 we went down about half 8 and never had to que at all the same went for lunch and dinner. The bar at night can be quite busy but again when you are all inclusive should expect to que up a bit I didn't find this a problem I always managed to get a drink and didn't find the wait to long. We also went to a fantastic bar next to the hotel called the squash bar it's €2 a pint and €7 for two cocktails, the bars and restaurants on the strip are also very cheap and only a 2 min walk from the hotel, the beach is also a 2 min walk from the hotel and it is absolutely stunning. I would definitely stay here again, and remember your holiday is what you make it so go with an open mind and enjoy your self, don't listen to all the negative comments because some people just love to moan.

author: paulrob1961
title: Great for all types of travellers
text: This is a large hotel and even though they have many rooms it was still a great place to stay and relax. Good pleasant staff who actually smiled and made you feel welcome. The entertainment at night was good, there was a separate bar for the adults while the kids were entertained in a large room with all sorts going off for them each night. They have a massive outdoor swimming pool and a good size heated indoor pool. the food was good with plenty of varieties to suit all comers. The drinks were served in plastic cups but they would serve you a couple at a time. Just up the road from the hotel is the beach not for the faint hearted as you have to walk down steep steps to get to the beach but the views are breath taking. There are many shops and bars along the top of the cliffs great for shopping, drinking and eating. A good hotel to suit all especially families. Would I stay there again definitely yes.

author: 297haidees
title: Lived off the snack bar
text: Just got back today from our family visit to this hotel, the hotel itself was fine for what we paid however the food was inedible and bland. Also flies were forever hovering and diving into the food which put us off but the staff seemed uninterested anyway not that we bothered saying anything as they were on their phones serving people! The hotel was packed, not that this can be helped although the pool looks big, not big enough for the amount of people staying there. We wanted to go to the entertainment room but we couldn't even enjoy a drink at the bar as no air con just like everywhere else in the hotel. We had children with us too and even they couldn't enjoy it. Our towels and bed sheets were only changed "once every 2-3 days" which wasn't the case as one of family members had nothing all week until the 6th day when she had to go down to reception just to ask for new towels. This was very inconsistent. Staff overall just looked unhappy or always on their phones, or just simply looked uninterested. We loved the sites of Portugal and where we were however I wouldn't recommend this hotel at all and I certainly won't be coming back.

author: Mo2009
title: its a 3 star
text: we stayed in 3 good sized decent rooms, all on the same floor. rooms donr have aircon so slept with windows open but our last night there wasnt a breeze so where attacked by the mosquitos. hot water for the shower is heated by the geezer in the kitchen and ours wasnt working so we let reception know and it was fixed straight away. pool area was always busy as was bar- constant queues. reception staff where helpful, no problems- same for housekeepers and childrens entertainers. what i didnt like was the 2 lifeguards sit on the bridge that runs approx half way along the pool area and both sat with their backs to the kids pool all the time. great location, 2 mins walk to main area. if i was going back to PDR would stay here again- self catering only though.

author: billt430
title: Good value holiday
text: Stayed here for a 10 day self catering break June 2017. Overall, quite satisfied as we only took advantage of the apartment as a base for our holiday. Beds were made daily and the apartment was cleaned regularly. Ok it may have been a bit dated, but that did not put us off. The beds were comfy and the shower was nice and powerful. Cannot comment on the food or drink as we spent our time away from the hotel. The only gripe we had was the hire of a kettle at the rate of 1 euro per day. Come on Clube Praira da Rocha that was MEAN!!!!!! - especially as we were Self Catering (Surprisingly, the apartment had a microwave for no extra cost !?!) *Tip* - take a cheap kettle with you !!!

author: nicolab778
title: very good for the price
text: we went in the easter school holidays, excellent deal. Yes its not all inc in that you have to pay for sunbeds and can only get spirits at certain times, but for the money who cares? The rooms are massive, have washing machine and kitchen in, even though we were all inc. Staff were lovely. Surrounding area and beach gorgeous. It got busier towards the end of the week and another restaurant was opened. in high summer at full capacity not sure we would have enjoyed it, as people did queue for food, which was the same as all, all inc - plentiful but samey! Kids club was ok, as was entertainment. It isn't five star and I can imagine it being too busy, but for what we paid, everything was lovely. Mixed nationalities, English, Irish, portugese, Spansih.

author: lesleys91
title: NOISY
text: Room very basic but clean. Clean towels 3 times in the week we were there. Very very noisy, especially if your room is looking onto the road. Bin men came early hours of the morning, banging and throwing stuff around. Cars and motor bikes racing up and down the road at all hours. No air con so had to have balcony windows open which made it worse. Food basic but ok. Lady behind the bar very very miserable and rude. Could only get certain drinks on all inclusive deal and had to pay for kids slushes etc. No ice creams or anything for kids.

author: F7497FQdebbiem
title: Disgusting and dirty
text: Just returned from a weeks stay here and was disgusted with the state of the apartment we had and the 'facilities' at the hotel itself. Our room was in an apartment complex across the road from the main building. You are lead up a dark, steep hill through what looks like a war zone into a dilapidated building which looks as though it should have been demolished years ago. It's quite scary walking up there at night and not somewhere i would go on my own. Our room was very basic but also dirty and run down. The on site facilities in the main building need serious improvement, broken tiles, mould and mildew seem to be having a lovely time there and multiply daily. The food was stale and inedible so we ate out for all meals even though we had paid for breakfast. I would never return to this complex, very disappointed and not worth what we paid.

author: Deniseannemarie
title: Great hotel & location for families
text: We really enjoyed our stay in the Clube Praia Da Rocha. Our room was kept very clean every day by the very nice housekeepers. They changed towels and sheets on request. The bar staff were very friendly. Entertainment is very organised around the kids if you are not interested, plenty of seats to sit outside or in other bar like we did or nice walks along the shopping strip in the evening. Food was fine, however if we were to go back and go all inclusive I would plan a couple of meals out. The restaurant Squash beside the hotel was very nice. The Pool area was extremely well managed, you do have to pay a euro for a bed but we think it took the stress of people scrambling for chairs early. I would recommend to friends and family. Remember it is a 3 star but with a very good atmosphere, especially for kids.

author: 1970hedge
title: Great weekend away
text: Just spent a long weekend here from Friday to Monday with a group of mixed aged friends. From the time we arrived mid morning we were welcomed by friendly staff at reception and told couldn't book in but could leave luggage safe and get our all inc tags on so we could eat and drink. The hotel is slightly dated and things may look a tad grubby but overall it is exactly what was needed for a few days away. Food was limited but hot and tasted good, beer was cold and didn't give you a sore through after 2 days and staff were helpful and accommodating. If you want the ritz and all the trimmings then go book it, if you want a cheap no frills break in a resort that has a cracking beach and nightlife then you can't beat it. Would I want to book a two week family holiday here....... probably not....... would I have a great time with friends old and new....definitely.

author: 24neilj
title: Don't believe the reviews
text: I have just returned from 4 days away at this resort with 5 friends, aged 19- 56. Having read some of the previous reviews I was a little apprehensive. However we were all pleasantly surprised, the pool area is clean- yes you do have to pay 1 euro for a sun-bed, but at least that guarantees you can get one. The food although they didn't have massive choices it was always good and edible, the snack bar also was good, with the usual burger/ hot dog etc. The queues for the bar were occasionally busy but you never waited too long, And the beer was excellent and definitely not watered down. I really do think you get what you pay for, and speaking to other guests, no one paid too much... all in all, the staff were friendly and for a few cheap days away in the sun, I thought it provided a good value break... we would all return again.

author: Heighford
title: Return breakaway visit
text: Value for money, basic but clean rooms, clean communal areas, helpful friendly staff, buffet style meals suited my fussy tendencies never went hungry; at these prices you can always eat out if you wish. We got fed up hearing whinging people who'd paid three star prices but expected 5star, happy to return again (our third visit) and son has been twice, staff were prompt sorting wobbly toilet seat, also sorted us out with daytrip to Seville with a picnic in lieu of missed breakfast. Each visit we have seen improvements around the hotel. We were happy with the clear terms of 'All Inclusive' Tea/Coffee beer & soft drinks suit us till later in the day when spirits are then available. We're happy to pay the €1 per day to hire a sunbed as it stops the annoying holidaymakers who reserve a sunbed at dawn with a towel then only use them for a couple of hours in the afternoon! Yes happy to recommend and return. Thank you Clube Praia du Rocha. Do your research then you know what to expect.

author: dscorpio72
title: STAY HERE AT YOUR OWN RISK
text: My first review of this hotel wasn't published because the language I used wasn't appropriate so I'll just say this. DO NOT waste your money by going all inclusive at this hotel... Most of the staff were good, but as a place to stay, DON'T DO IT PEOPLE. If you were backpacking and wanted a place to crash for the night or couple day then maybe The rooms are ATROCIOUS, we booked 2 rooms as we were a family of 5 Rooms only got done once in 7 days, ran out of toilet paper as housekeeping was non-existence All inclusive but you CAN'T get any for of alcohol apart from beer before 8pm and the bar closes at 11pm You have to pay for wifi but you can't use it in your room Poolside loungers and parasols cost 1 euro each TV remote is available only from reception, 10 euro deposit... Here's the joke of this. You don't really need a remote to watch a TV do you... OH YES YOU DO... They have removed the channel buttons from the TV so you're unable to watch it without one We had other disasters but I can't speak about them without being inappropriate

author: 729kymc
title: Awful
text: Broken tiles on the floor near the pool area both of my children cut their toes open. When asked for a plaster all they had were napkins! Good job I brought my own! Only 1 clean towel in a week and when asked for them the cleaner didn't speak very good English and was rude to me! No clean sheets in a week! In fact I had found other people's rubbish left in the room including old condoms! Not something my children should be exposed to! Absolutely disgusting place

author: O2271JErobertw
title: nice get away
text: stayed here for a week beginning of April. arrived quite late at night and staff we fabulous and very helpful. we had 2 apartments which were massive and had everything you needed, washing machine,oven,kettle, tvs. pool area was lovely only down side you had to pay euro each day for sunbed. all inc wasn't up to much not much variety of food and the drinks were poor only beer or wine till 8pm at night. the restaurant is quite small for the size of the hotel and you have to que up outside.the snack meals were nice. few minute walk from a lovely beach and strip. overall i would go back for the price.just be advised if booking for begining of april they have approx 200 students in adjoining hotel who are really loud and take most of the room around pool, and this happens every year.

author: marinaturley123
title: Avoid at all costs
text: Booked this holiday through on the beach was looking for a quick get away , should have stayed home ! Pictures did not resemble this hotel at all , it was awful ! Please avoid at all costs . Rooms in a poor state , hygiene awful ! . Bedding and curtains full of holes , long queue for meals and dinning room very small for size of hotel and food poor . Ended up leaving within 2 hours and lost all our booking costs ! No refund at all , disgusted !

author: dalawtuba
title: hotel not good, but i diddent pay much for the holiday
text: Booked for myself ,wife and 2 teenager children, . Room very basic and looks like its not been updated since the 70's, expected 4 beds but got 2 single beds and a sofa. diddent get the towls changed for 3 days, only allowed 40lts of hot water per day, Disappointed that you had to walk out front entrance to get into restaurant for both breakfast/evening meal. Don't expect great dishes or Portuguese food. Meals did get slightly better throughout week but desserts was same every night consisting of fruit, cake or ice cream. and the norm leftovers mixed meat pie ect, Good swimming pool not heated and had to pay for wifi, loungers and parasols considering was all inclusive. Hotel was full students(aprox 300) thats caused havoc inside and out all night long,every night and the hotel did nothing about this. The staff that worked here were very friendly (apart from reception). the beaches nearby are amazing. all inclusive alchol drinks are superbok and wine, though vodka, rum ect only avalible from 20:30 till 23.00 Wouldn't go back.

author: shann0nj22
title: Nice enough
text: Stayed here last time I was in Portugal and it was relatively good. The pool area was lovely, nice and big and had no problems with the room. There were 4 of us in the apartment, myself and my sister and my parents and we had enough room. The balcony was lovely and had a nice view over the pool area. We stayed self-catering and couldn't complain, it was cheap and cheerful and you got what you paid for. We prefer to stay in simple accommodation and spend more money outside the hotel so this was perfect for us. Would definitely recommend this hotel if you don't spend much time in the room as it is well priced and nice enough. I would also return if I go back to Praia de Rocha.

author: ExPatpieMon
title: Rubbish
text: We read the reviews before we went and we went with an open mind. We love Portugal and the Portuguese. This hotel tested that love to the limit. All the bad reviews are true. The worst hotel we have ever stayed in. Miserable staff, diabolical food, long queues for food and drink. Our room / apartment although functional was extremely dated and tacky There is no concept of cleanliness. It is rough and ready. We would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: P4894THlisar
title: Basic reasonably priced hotel
text: Booked by my husband as surprise birthday present, on first arrival looked pleasant and friendly. Room very basic with not much storage or hairdryer! but of ample size for two - we had a large lounge/apartment with fridge and cooker rings. Disappointed that you had to walk out front entrance to get into restaurant for both breakfast/evening meal. Don't expect great dishes or Portuguese food. Meals did get slightly better throughout week but desserts was same every night consisting of fruit, cake or ice cream. Good swimming pool but shocked had to pay for loungers and parasols considering was all inclusive. Hotel was full of kids even though went out of school term and other guests were extremely loud so ended up staying at beach every day. Wouldn't go back.

author: cassied23
title: DO NOT STAY HERE
text: This hotel wants shuts down its disgusting we stay here for a week the food is awful we had food poisoning from eating in the restaurant. The rooms and stair case were filthy there were rat pellets around the place. Towels don't get changed neither does bed linen. I've creams r not included or cocktails. The sourest r only available from 8-11pm. I have nothing to say about this hotel it was a disgrace and wants shuts down immediately. I would not go back this hotel ever again. Beware DO NOT stay here

author: W3680BUerich
title: Basic apart hotel, 2 electric rings. no electric kettle, no microwave 2 cups, plates etc,only 1 of 4 lifts working
text: room on 11th floor. 1 lift out of 4 working in block 2 have to wait ages. charged €1.50 for hotel to confirm airport transfer, €3 per day for Wifi in lobby only. very basic kitchen. charged €1 per day for sun lounger and €1 for umbrella. only plastic glasses served in bar, prices higher than local bars. not on seafront and a lot more than 50 metres from the beach, !!! area around pool very dirty, needs a good power washing, there was supposed to be an indoor pool but it was all locked up. this in middle of October ! no lock on door out to veranda.

author: 827darrenm
title: You get what you pay for
text: Just back from 9 days stay here (altough we spent 2 if those nights in other resorts) We paid €17 a night for room only. For what we wanted it was perfect it's in a great location with a bus stop right outside the door and a 2 minute walk to the strip and 2 supermarkets practically on site. Now it's very very dated and your room facilities couldn't be more basic... but you can rent your toaster,kettle,hairdryer,iron,ironing board, all for €1.50... a day. We didn't bother renting anything and just brought a small travel kettle with us. This is the Ryanair of accommodation every creature comfort is extra even the sunbeds and parosols... but being perfectly honest if you just want somewhere to put your head down its grand. Oh and there is a little trick with the hot water boiler so you have all the hot water you need😉

author: lynne72
title: Lovely stay
text: My husband and I stayed here from 8th to 15 th October 2016 . The rooms are basic but on the good side they were spacious and clean . We were all inclusive it didn't cover ice cream or spirits but they were cheap enough to buy. The sun beds were 1 Euro each but it was a good thing cos you could leave your bed for as long as you liked and still come back to it again . Location was brilliant as you were a couple of minutes Walk from the strip and the beach and 5 mins from the marina. The food was good it was buffet and there was choice for everyone you also had the snack bar for burgers, chips, sandwiches etc... the staff were very helpful as well. All in all we had a lovely enjoyable stay here and would definitely go back!!!

author: anthonygZ4244QM
title: Please avoid.
text: Awful hotel. Pool was dirty, not all inclusive as you have to pay for sun beds by the pool, You have to pay to use the games room. The food was awful. Made school dinners seem like a Gordon Ramsay restaurant! The all inclusive drinks start from 8pm-11pm. It's full of load noisy 18-25year olds. It's as basic as you can get. I would avoid this place at all costs.

author: allibongo
title: Hit and miss
text: We are currently at this hotel and the only fault we are experiencing is the food .we are all inclusive ...the breakfast is shocking either little red Spicey sausages or fatty bacon depends on the day ya don't get a choice ....scrambled eggs which twice this week have run out of had to wait a while for another tray to come out .... bread rolls are lovely . Lunch and dinner not as bad but only one choice of either fish and one meat dish every day , only chips pasta or rice and a veg to accompany them .. Rooms are large and clean towels changed once only cos I caught the maid in the room. Shower lovely for first user then goes cold on second . Pool area is brilliant and I had a message at beginning of holiday for €20 which was lovely . Drinks not bad the Bailey's is lovely . All in all this experience hasn't stopped us having a brilliant time I've stayed in better hotels and also worse ..a holiday is what you make it 😊😊😊

author: PABaldwin
title: 3 Star Basic
text: We have just returned after a week AI - not a bad hotel just the décor and the food lets it down. It's our 2nd time here so we knew what to expect. The food could be better - a week of scrambled egg for breakfast and tomatoes swimming in oil gets a bit much and the choice of soup is an experience - The Green Cabbage and Pumpkin were actually OK although the Cream of Vegetable was not. The Snack Bar which opens at 1530 hrs is good for Burger and Chips which is handy as dinner is not served until 1900 hrs which we found is a bit late as breakfast finishes at 1000 hrs and luch at 1400 hrs. The rooms are cleaned everyday except sunday so no complaints there. You do have to pay 1 Euro for a sunbed and umbrella but this does stop the race to save a bed and then not use it. The beautiful beach is only a 5- 10 minute walk away as is the 'strip' where the there are many bars and restaurants. The AI service finishes at 1030 hrs on your last day even if your return home is not until late in the day - however you do receive a ticket that entitles you to lunch where you can still get larger and wine and soft drinks. Overrall not a bad hotel for the price you pay. I must mention the exceptional Sports Bar next door - Jose welcomes you with friendly banter and will stay open until the early hours - the reason we returned for a second visit to this hotel.

author: 689shaniah
title: Do not recommend this hotel!
text: This hotel is absolutely terrible! I paid extra for all inclusive when I had to pay for most of stuff! Cocktails, ice creams and treats all had to be paid for! You only got half a cup of alcohol, if you wanted large you had to pay, this is ridiculous as I paid a lot of money to be all inclusive when clearly it wasn't! Also the food was disgusting, I got a burger for my daughter and the bread was mouldy, absolutely vile! I reported all of his to the reception in the hotel and nothing was done! I definitely do not recommend this accommodation to anybody! It's unacceptable!

author: debbie19632014
title: 2 week stay at clube Praia da Roche Hotel
text: Certainly not a 3 star hotel, more of a 2 star. Since when does all inclusive not mean all inclusive, just one example, sunbeds have to be paid for daily. Within a 2 week stay towels changed only once, bed sheets not changed at all. Beds very creaky. Would not walk on floors with bare feet, as ... Show more » floors were filthy and when it was rarely mopped it was with dirty water. The apartment including bathroom area was very grubby even the bottom of the toilet was black. I would certainly not recommend this hotel to any of my family or friends. Also why does all inclusive finish at 10.30 am on day of departure when this has been paid for, especially when your arrival time was way after 11 pm when all inclusive had finished and you have to vacate your room at 10 am.

author: neetaprakashhindocha
title: Worst hotel
text: We booked an all inclusive for one week at this Clube Praia da Roacha by ITC Hotels & Resorts, Portimao. Worst experience of our lives. The hotel is very outdated; lighting both within the apartment and out in the corridors, and all the other areas extremely poor; reception staff (with the exception of 2 girls and one elderly gentleman with glasses) extremely impolite to the point of rudness. Totally unhelpful. Domestic staff the same. Food was the most boring and awful. Being a vegetarian and diabetic, we just ate for the sake of it. Not at all appetising or appealing. John, the young chef, once made a nice pasta for me as he could see how upset I was. Would never go back nor recommend this place to anyone.

author: T3217MMsarat
title: Would stay again
text: Myself and my boyfriend stayed here in the self catering room at the end of July for a week. The hotel and rooms are basic and dated but very spacious and do the job. The pool area and entertainment is brilliant and is the perfect place for families with kids! Clube praia da rocha is about a 3 minute walk to the lively strip and the beach which we found very handy as we like to try different places for dinner every night.
