Towels are replaced everyday in the room, unfortunately the bed linen doesn't get changed well not within the week that we stayed but can be changed by yourself if you ask at reception for new sheets. Also hairdryers can be rented for €1 a day and a €10 deposit rather than carrying one in your luggage! Sun loungers are €1 a day to rent which i think is a great idea, there are plenty of loungers so you are almost guaranteed getting one no matter what time you arrive to the pool. Overall we extremely enjoyed our stay in Praia da Rocha and would be happy to return to Clube praia da rocha.

author: Mooselena
title: Cheap and cheerful ! You get what you payed for !!
text: My wife and I booked this very last minute from the 18/8 - 23/8 A/Inclusive Have read the reviews post booking we were not filled with hope due to the negativity surrounding this hotel It is a 60 minute private transfer from Faro airport and is situated in a location surrounded by many hotels restaurants and gift shops It is a 500 meter walk (some uphill) from the simply beautiful beach The hotel itself consisted of two monolithic tower blocs each consisting of hundreds of apartments and private residences The premises itself has decor from the late 80's early 90's and could do with updating We stayed in block 2 floor 7 Our apartment consisted of a bathroom shower and bday bedroom with 2 single beds pushed together a fitted kitchen with full sized fridge freezer sink and cooker and living room with sofa bed and TV The hot water comes from a stand alone boiler holding 80 litres of hot water which was more than enough for 4 of us. The room was cleaned twice in the five days we stayed here. We were very clean anyway so this sufficed but more toilet rolls and clean towels were always readily available The rooms are not air conditioned but even in 30plus degrees this was okay as our floor was airy As we had two toddlers the built in kitchen proved a god send as did the fridge. Bear in mind that goods in this area are very expensive far more excessive than other European countries we have stayed in. The meals were very good in my opinion with a lot of variety. There were 2 restaurants one in each block which were never packed and we always got a table for 4. Spirits were available for free after 8pm which in my opinion is a good thing as you don't get drunken idiots running around at 12noon knocking your kids over. But if you want to pay before hand then you can do so The snacks are available during set periods during the day which are the standard burgers etc The pool area was fantastic and a real plus You have to pay for your sun lounger and umbrellas but this is a good thing as you don't get people fighting over them first thing The nearest shopping Center costs around 8 euros in a cab and has a mcds primark etc The strip with all the souvenir shops and restaurants is a 300 meter walk from her hotel and also has various eateries Souvenirs are very expensive for the cheap rubbish they are but if you walk to the right of the strip past the nightclub you'll find markets where goods are a tad cheaper The weather was fantastic as were the locals and hotel staff. You'll probably waste most of your time waiting for the lifts in the blocks which are very old but this was the only down side The entertainment was catered for the kids as this is a very family friendly hotel and your kids will not get bored Please note that the doors can easily be opened by little fingers and hands so take care on the balconies With kids It's noisy till about 11pm but after that it all seems to die down. Check out is at 1030 on departure date Please also note that 99% of the shops in the area are not buggy friendly and the curbs are quite high so be warned The water parks are not really catered for children (mine are 2+5) so think twice before spending your money All In all a fantastic holiday; I'm being as honest as possible based on my experience so hope this helps you

author: caitkeeton1
title: Keep your expectations realistic and you will have a good time!
text: We have been here on and off (always self catering) for the past seventeen years and have always enjoyed our stays, and are always made to feel very welcome. The only thing we did not like this time was that you had to pay for sunbeds and umbrellas around the pool area; people were queuing up from 8.30am, but there are plenty, and the beautiful beach is only five minutes walk away. Yes, the hotel is basic and its decor somewhat dated, but for the price it is well worth it. It is clean and comfortable, and the staff, particularly reception staff are friendly and extremely efficient. It is close to the most beautiful beach we've ever seen, and to Praia da Rocha's many bars and restaurants, also right next to two little supermarkets. The hotel staff are friendly and extremely efficient, dealing with any requests or concerns immediately. It is equally good for families of young children, groups of young people, and couples there is a lovely mix of ages, and always a pleasant, fun-filled atmosphere. If it is occasionally a little noisy at night (I am a light sleeper) the noise is never abusive or aggressive it is good natured banter, and somehow just adds to the atmosphere. Put it this way, the seagulls at 6am in the morning are far noisier!

author: 558jader
title: Never again
text: Stayed here with family this month, and its fair to say we wont be staying again. We had an apartment for 6 people and it well less than basic.. Outdated would be an understatement , the sofa bed in the 'Living area' was filthy, the lamp shade in there had stains all over it and the tiled floor was filthy. Below our balcony was the bottom floor with a plant area, this had a pair of dirty knickers in it and bags of rubbish that weren't moved the whole time we was there. Anything this hotel can charge you for they will, kettles, toasters, sun loungers, fans because there is no air con what so ever in the rooms. We had a late flight home and weren't being picked up from the hotel until 5.30 so asked at reception if we could keep our room a few hours later than the 10.30 check out time, which we was willing to pay for and we got a no, just a point blank no, didn't offer us a shower room or a different room to get ready for out flight home.. nothing. How this hotel has got 3 stars is beyond me! I read the reviews on here when we booked hoping people were being too fussy, but they really weren't!

author: markpR8460JE
title: Loved it!
text: Cannot help but notice many bad reviews of this hotel!.. so, we stayed there in July 2016 full board on an all inclusive deal. We found all staff very helpful and friendly. In particular the restaurant staff were fantastic, paulo simones was particularly good! I have to eat gluten free, which is usually a challenge anywhere, particularly in a foreign country. But Paulo was only too happy to help! Our children loved the pool with water slide and ate well in the restaurant. We did stray to a local search food restaurant for a couple of evening meals, to experience more 'bespoke' Portuguese food. I have nothing negative to say. Mark

author: 278hollyd
title: Wouldn't recommend
text: Hotel location is great, close to the beach which is lovely. The hotel itself is ok, rooms are adequate although the hotel could do with a refurb. The pool is great for the kids but the water is treated with salt and has scum around the edges with black muck in the overflow. Beds are charged at 1 Euro per day per bed, they're excuse for this is to prevent people from reserving beds. No ice creams included in all inclusive and no spirits during the day. Food is unsatisfactory and there's nothing really what kids enjoy apart from chips. Rice and pasta is served daily, some days didn't feel satisfied after meals. Wouldn't recommend to go on any board basis probably best to go self catering.

author: NWBlue2
title: Interesting week..........
text: Chose the hotel on our budget and got what we paid for a weeks stay. All staff always helpful and friendly from checking in to checking out. Great base from which to enjoy and relax in Portimao and Rocha. The rooms were large spacious, safe, clean, functional, nice river view high up. Great moon and sunrise. We had 2 water problems which were fixed no problems. Never used any facilities as was self catering. I would stay their again but my fault 2 reasons need to change air conditioning and time of year but that is my choice I knew what I was letting myself in for.

author: siobhanb162
title: great location
text: Just to say from the get go, I don't know why this hotel has gotten so many bad reviews. our apartment was huge, the staff were lovely, it's in extremely close proximity (4/5 minutes walk) to the beach and strip, which is full of shops, restaurants and pubs. The hotel and pool are very clean. The lovely German man in the night reception was especially friendly and funny. All the staff are extremely helpful. I had to unfortunately cut my holiday short due to my little girl not liking the sun! and the staff tried every avenue to assist us and make up change our minds. but unfortunately the only problem we had, was the heat and there was nothing to be done about the glorious sun in Portugal. If you in all inclusive the food will always have something you like, but if your a major foodie go half board and venture onto the strip in the evenings for dinner. There are also lots of day trips and activities to take part in and they are well organised.

author: SarahW130
title: Clean and great location
text: We stayed here self catering as a cheap long weekend break and having read the reviews i was concerned. The room was large and while yes it is dated we were hardly in it and it was nice and clean. Staff were polite and friendly. There is security on the pool entrance but he just glances at your wrist to see if you have a wristband on so no problem there. The hotel location is great, short walk to the bars, restaurants etc. The pool area is great and plenty of space, we rented the lounges and thought €1 a day was fine as you get them for the full day. My only small complaint would be the lack of air con, the night time temperature was approx 25 degree and even with the hire of a fan it was still difficult to sleep. I judged this hotel against the price we paid for it and saw it as good value for money.

author: stuartgN8192DP
title: clube praia da rocha
text: Bit Disappointed here. Didn't expect much as it was only £500 for 1 week in July. No Air Con ( Come on now ) Would have been nice to get WIFI in rooms and better tv situation (only really sky news) Shocking Pillows (if you could call them pillows) more like stuffed bits of foam in a pillowcase. Luckily went self catering so we eat out every night.and we found a quality pub the squash bar right next door 2 euros a pint. staff were nice and helpfull but with a few tweeks it could be a good hotel. Anyway beautiful area prai da rocha with superb beaches and restaurants. if you can put up with no air con and dodgy pillows then its ok. im glad we only stayed for 1 week though. dont think ill be rushing back to this hotel anytime soon.;(

author: IrishAine123
title: ''The Tans will fade but the Memories will last forever''
text: Booked this holiday with Travel Republic and got a great deal which saved my friends and I a lot of money for our trip €€ It is such a fantastic hotel to stay in especially for a family holiday with kids. The location is perfect with a less than 5 minute walk to the main strip of Praia Da Rocha with lots of pubs, clubs, shops and beautiful restaurants and an amazing beach. There is lots of fun things to do in the hotel there is an amazing pool area with a slide as well as some fun activities to do in the pool such as water aerobics and volley ball provided by staff. There is such a great atmosphere in the hotel at night time. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Possibly the best holiday I have been on. I will definitely be back to stay in this hotel next Summer. Thanks for everything CPR <3

author: ABarkerMiles
title: Dated hotel with exceptionally rude member of staff...
text: Girls holiday to this hotel in July (6th - 11th July), wasn't expecting a spectacular hotel from the reviews & therefore our expectations were met. The hotel itself is very dated and the facilities in the rooms are not a great standard - but if you only use the room as a base then its tolerable. The lack of air conditioning is not tolerable and actually made being in the room unbearable at times. The hotel served its purpose and we had a great week away. This is however, until the time we checked out of the hotel and the incredibly rude member of staff we had to deal with. We booked a taxi 48 hours in advance for 5.45am to take us to the airport.....the taxi was 45 minutes late and the hotel reception man was very rude, patronizing and quite aggressive to us. He told us its not his problem and we wont help us any further - even though we booked the transfer through the hotel. He told us to get out of the hotel and leave him alone!! This is absolutely disgraceful and unacceptable. We will never stay at this hotel again and I suggest they have a serious word with that member of staff!!

author: dot590
title: Don't believe all reviews
text: After visiting this hotel end of June beginning July, I had read all reviews and I was a bit dubious. Take no notice, we had a lovely stay there. Beds clean, apartment clean and towels changed nearly every day. The pool area was clean alongside other areas. We at stayed all inclusive and food was good. You get 3star treatment which is what we paid. Couldn't fault staff all were very attentive.we were on 11th floor and no problems with lift. We go back again.

author: kevdoc
title: Holiday from Hell
text: Cassidy Travel Dublin sold this establishment as a three star. Would not make a one star. Furniture was antiquated, initials carved on dinning room table. Went down for breakfast first morning had to queue outside to gain entry, when inside you had to squeeze in and iut to get to tables. Grossly overcrowded. If one needed a hairdryer it had to hired out at €1.50 a day with a €10 deposit same with tv controls and electric kettle. The final insult was when I went to reception and asked for fresh towels only to be told that I was not entitled to any as they only change them every three days. I had one drink in the public lounge only for it to be served up in a plastic container. I left the hotel a day early and went to an excellent hotel in Villamoura. 27 days after coming home I am still waiting for a response from Cassidy Travel.

author: petermK4345RW
title: We were unsure of this hotel until we arrived
text: We visited clube Praia Da Rocha in May 2016 and again in August 2016. After reading some reviews we were very unsure of this hotel but we were completely wrong. The rooms are fine for anyone whose not fussy. The view from the front of the hotel isn't great but hey, you were never guaranteed a good view from the start. The food was ok, we survived and there was always an option for all of us. The hotel is a 10 minute walk from the beach where you'll find markets and clubs also. Reception provide tickets to events for purchase such as splash and slide the water park which was great! (I would recommend) over and all, we didn't have 1 problem with this hotel.

author: CathyT823
title: Cheap and cheerful
text: Let me start by saying I would definitely not class this as a 3 star. The pool area was great but rest is lacking. Rooms are dated, floors were dirty and bedding and towels are full of stains. Plus you had to hire everything at an additional charge even locks for the safe! The breakfast left much to be desired, but the coffee was great! We made the best of it and if you don't mind roughing it you will be fine. Room was after all just for sleeping. It is also a very noisy place don't know if it's just where our room was but not very great for kids to be woken up by drunks acting like hooligans at 4 am EVERY morning.

author: 1968AleCop
title: Stay Here With Caution
text: Just got back 2 days ago. Massive but very basic rooms, has a kitchenette but nothing in it (anything you want you have to hire), was there for 9 days and the room floor was not swept once, bath not cleaned and no clean bedding. Towels only changed couple of times on request, pool area is ok but again have to hire everything (sunbeds and parasols), food is absolutely disgusting, had chicken pieces one night which was still red inside, called manager who just nodded and took the plate away, chicken stayed in the tray for others to take, we lived on burgers or rolls from the snack bar which only opens for a couple of hours a day and although food is ok in there its not brilliant (burgers/cheese burgers, ham/cheese rolls and chips and salad). Staff in general were ok, the Manager is an absolute waste of space and is totally disinterested in anyones complaints/opinions which is quite apparent from his response to the negative comments on here, he just doesnt care its a money making machine to him. Its not widely advertised but this hotel (confirmed by the manager to me is 60% holiday makers and 40% privately owned (people living on site). We stayed in room 1307 and in room 1305 a private owner was renovating his apartment, each day he started work at 8.45am and carried through banging, drilling, pneumatic drills etc, all day long until early evening, no peace and quiet at all whilst in room, this is happening in various rooms around the hotel, manager said he could have moved me to the sister hotel, which is an unused hotel, directly across the road (now used for private flats) with no pool, restaurant etc, and a dual carriageway between it and the Clube Praia Da Rocha, as I said he doesn't care, he just smirks and makes you feel like an idiot for complaining. Make sure if you do stay here you go self catering then it may not be too bad as you can eat out. The entertainment girls do the best they can (probably with the budget they have) and are all lovely girls and good fun. The F & B Manager again exceeded my expectations and had his chef bake a cake for my husband's birthday + our 25th wedding anniversary and didn't charge me a penny for it, he made a point of wishing him a happy birthday and congratulating us on our anniversary and each time i saw him he acknowledged me and was very polite and friendly, shame the overall Manager doesn't take a leaf out of this guys book. I could probably write a book but will leave it at this.

author: Wackyshamrock
title: Cheap and cheerful!
text: We stayed for 2 weeks in August 2015. Was very apprehensive after reading some of the reviews but have to say our experience was a good one! yes rooms were quite basic but had everything we needed. Booked on an all inclusive basis but room had a little kitchenette, very handy having a fridge to keep drinks in. No air conditioning but as we were on 10th floor we were able to leave the windows/balcony doors open which gave ample breeze. Food was very basic but always able to find something. The best part about this hotel is the location...a stone throw away from the beautiful beach and local shops and restaurants. Lovely walk every evening! I would Deffo stay here again as for the price it was a bargain. Forget about the negative reviews and go with the intention of making the most of a sun filled holiday near to lots of irish bars offering good 'craic' drink up and have fun!!!

author: Konradoz
title: Good place for trips but that's more like it
text: They charge for what they can extra. Food is cold and tasteless. Small choice of booze- mostly one lager and wine, between 20-23 you can have few spirits but there's one bartender so you have to que. they reuse leftovers that ok to do but nothing eatable- salmon and soybeans salad with apples, really ? As well we are in Portugal and they serve canned fruit to everything, cheap ones. As sides there are frozen vegs. Cakes are very good but same all time, tiramisu style. One more thing NO WIFI.

author: meganhB5149PQ
title: A great family hotel, very affordable and excellent staff!
text: We've just got back from a wonderful 2 week all inclusive family holiday at Club Praia Da Rocha and we could not have asked for a better hotel for the price. The staff were really lovely and always happy to help, from the moment we arrived to the moment we left, especially Junior, Mario, Paulo and Micael. The apartment itself was basic but had everything we needed and was immaculately clean, with plenty of space for 3 of us and plenty of hot water. The food was really good, with a huge variety that changed every day alongside the snack bar, which opened twice a day between meals. The pool area is excellent, you have to pay a euro for sunbeds and umbrella's but we didn't mind at all because it meant we didn't have to rush down to secure one every morning. The hotel is in a great area, really close to the beach and about a 5 minute walk from all the shops, restaurants and bars. Overall, we had a fantastic time at Club Praia Da Rocha. It's a very laid back, down to earth hotel and ultimately you get what you pay for and with this hotel, we were pleasantly surprised and will definitely go back again.

author: samo438
title: Excellent 'budget' holiday
text: Yes, very basic! But for what you pay for it is perfect. Excellent staff, beautiful pool. Could maybe do with a bit of a decorate but for what you pay, it's amazing. People reviewing CPR badly need to realise that you get what you pay for, if you want more then pay more? Would recommend to anyone who is looking for a beautiful but cheap week in the sun. Also located a 5-10 minute walk from the main strip and beach front, the restaurants as bars are as cheap as chips and are brilliant. 'On The Rocks' were fantastic and offer 'Happy Hour' from 9am-9pm. Get yourself to CPR soon.

author: Linhbass
title: Great Hotel for price
text: This is our 4th visit here. Yes it's basic but for the price we paid for a family of 4 for 9 days , there is no way we could have got anywhere else for the price abroad ALL INCLUSIVE . Yes the hotel needs updating, but they are deffinately trying. The staff are lovely , the pool is good , yes you pay a euro for a sun bed , but at least you don't have the hassle of waking up at stupid o clock to put your towels down to beat the others . The food is also basic but hey your not gonna starve and I am a fussy eater !! I think the people writing negative reviews need to SERIOUSLY remember the price they paid for CPR, if you want a 4/5 * holiday make sure you book one , as the CPR is deffinately what you pay for , a base in a lovely resort , with the cheap enough option to go AI if you choose to and if not restuarants are cheap in the resort. We will certainly book again at CPR in fact looking at easter 2017 when the flights get released. Please be aware this is a basic hotel for basic money,and we as a family of 4 have no complaints about this hotel :) Ignore the NEGATIVE reviews

author: edscape
title: It does what it says on the page
text: Club PDR has had it's share of negative press through the years, but has steadfastly refused to buckle under it's criticism. Even last year there were rumours that it was facing imminent closure. I reckon that most of the bad press is due to people not doing their homework on PDR. It is a huge holiday residence with pretty down to earth facilities. It is kept clean, the food is what you would expect from a cheap as chips hotel, and it has more pools than any other complex in Praia da Rocha. It does tend to be noisy, but with the volume of people it accommodates that is only to be expected. There is an all inclusive package available and is a great deal for families. Do your homework if you are considering this facility, and if you keep your expectations clear you will have a great time in the Algarve.

author: katie1249
title: Great place!
text: Stayed in club praia da rocha twice now (1week each time) for 2 years in a row... The apartment complex is great value for money. Very clean and staff very helpful which is always a plus! All inclusive and caters for everyone's needs... Has indoor and outdoor pools, with a water slide!!! Only down side is you have to pay for sun loungers and umbrellas (kinda ridiculous)!! Games room on site... Minutes walk from the main strip and beach... Perfect place for family's/couples/groups to stay something to do for all... Will be back for sure...!

author: kennedy8
title: You get what you pay for
text: We were here last April and I personally had a brilliant holiday. The rooms are dated but massive and the largest I have ever stayed in. The food is ok. We are out a few times. Considering what we paid to stay here we enjoyed it. There is a brilliant spa on the complex and a girl did my nails and they were amazing. Overall I would stay here again for a cheap second holiday and I have to say the staff worked hard and tried. As long as you don't want any frills go.

author: johnboyhammers
title: Enjoy your holiday
text: I am just home from Clube Praia Da Rocha for the fourth year in a row. It is great value for money. We went all inclusive. Take the negative reviews with a pinch of salt. A holiday is what you make of it. The hotel has been repainted recently and it is obvious that more work will be done soon. The room we had was huge, cleaned every day and had a brilliant view of the pool. People had said that their rooms were dated !!, how long do u spend in your room?, the staff are really helpful and polite . Drop them a Euro or two into their tip jar in the bar, they really do deserve it. Any questions just ask !!, cheers JB

author: gerrys851
title: You get what you pay for!
text: This is a huge complex with two very sizeable blocks surrounding a swimming pool area. I had stayed there once before on a self catering basis but this time we went with friends on an all inclusive basis. I was surprised to find that although we were all inclusive we had to pay extra each day for sunbeds and umbrellas. The food in the restaurant was edible but lacked imagination, was very bland most of the time and was very repetitive. We had chips every lunchtime and dinner time seven days a week. Whilst there was pasta and rice as alternatives there was never any other variation of potato. The rooms were spacious and functional albeit in need of some redecoration but comfortable none the less. Entertainment in the hotel was very poor and we therefore used a very good bar next to the hotel on an evening called The Squash Bar which had all variety of televised sport and extremely good prices for the drinks. As the title of the review suggests you get what you pay for and as this holiday was not very expensive we got what we paid for.

author: 930eilish
title: PART INCLUSIVE
text: Allinclusive should be all your drinks not just beer, red and white wines but spirits were from 8 to 11 which is wrong. Bathroom stunk, one of our beds were broke. Food some days were cold breakfast was the same EVERY DAY and desserts were the same every meal ok if you like tin fruit and cake. I for one didnt like the area it were hilly no night life and loads of steps down to the beach. You pay for sun beds and brolleys on site. Loads of Spanish go here and are very ignorant to the English. We would NOT recomend this Hotel or Area. The Hotel needs a lot of money spent on it.

author: 501pashur
title: AVOID This PLACE
text: Absolutely horrible. We booked an apartment for 4 adults, we were given one room and a sofa bed smaller than a single bed in the living room. When we requested a bigger room we were told it was our fault and we would have to pay an extra €200 to "upgrade". The beds were horrible and the bathroom was disgusting. I had read all the reviews too late. Do not go here unless you're on a lads holiday where you don't care how, where or when you sleep. The staff were extremely uncooperative and unfriendly. Over all, I'd rather sleep in a car !

author: denise55uk
title: Hotel from hell
text: Where do i begin? !!!! after reading reviews on here we decided that as we had already booked we would take the bad reviews with a pinch of salt !! HA HA HA . How they can say it was a 3 star is beyond me the all inclusive is a joke.. the food was the same every day... yuk!!!! (and disgusting) all inclusive well larger and wine from 10.30am -11pm spirits only from 8pm-11pm. we could have put up with the dated rooms if the food had been ok. i can honestly say if i was offered a free week there i would not go.

author: sergiobastos2015
title: Won't stay there again......
text: Me and my partner have stayed for 7 nights on a prepaid package, however when we have checked in the apartment given to us was absolutely terrible with great view to the main road which gave us a nightmare of a terrible sleep!!!!! That was loose tiles across the apartment, the toilet seat was loose and the toilet features were very old and rusty. Have reported to their main reception staff which was very helpful and have apologies however nothing was done, changed or neither been offered to move apartment. The kitchenette was fine. We had a small electric cooker and some crockery in order to serve us. The Laundry service was only made every four days, however the housekeeping did do the cleaning pretty much every day, apart from Thursdays and Sundays, where no housekeeping service was offered or made, so if you stay there please ensure you have hanged your towels to dried it off and drop your rubbish outside the hotel into the mains bins provided. End up staying the rest of the night using a loose toilet seat, brushing my teeth in a rusty sink!!! Defensively won't stay there again.....

author: kathleen173
title: Terriable
text: Wow where do I start. The rooms are very basic, as for the food well you get a choice of meat or fish only one choice if you don't like either you go without. The food is warm to cold, I don't eat meat so i asked a member of staff do you cater for vegetarians he looked at me and his reply was no we do not cater for that. We booked all inclusive we had to eat out, not only for me but the choice of food was terrible, ok if you liked salad and chips everyday what you had a lunchtime was put over at tea time and chips again. I asked a member of staff do you do boiled potatoes grated cheese all I got was no. if you want cheap cheap then book and I don't think they know what a fried egg is always scrambled which is ok on my last day we went down for breakfast to have scrambled egg they had mixed bacon or ham in it hence we went out again and payed for a breakfast at a local café we spent over 400 euro's extra on having to eat out because the food was unacceptable. You had to purchase your teabags and coffee and milk for the room we were in, you payed for a sunbed by the pool, you had to pay for your tv remote, pay for wifi, I asked about the indoor pool as it was heated the reply was sorry its closed for the season hence you couldn't go in the outdoor pool albeit many young one's did my age I would of had an heart attack it was freezing. So can someone tell me how they call this all inclusive is beyond me and I would defiantly not be returning.

author: Tonzcfc
title: Overall good value but not for the posh.
text: Just returned from 10 nights all inclusive (4 Sept 2015), 4 adults, 1 room. Truthfully when we first arrived we were a bit taken aback by how much the place need to be refurbished, everything was a bit dated and the beds are the worst I have ever slept on, I spent 15 years in the Army and slept on better camp beds, also the pillows were just laughable, a sack stuffed with sheep's wool that was really uncomfortable. We asked the reception if they could change the beds for my 2 sons (18 & 23), as the pull-out beds were not really adequate for strapping lads, admittedly they did bring in 1 single bed which did the job and that was basically how the hotel was run, everything was just about adequate to do the job. The food was actually ok, breakfast was really good, plenty of choice, both lunch and dinner has amazing soup and the bread/rolls were lovely, the actual main meals were edible but I mainly just had the soup. If you weren't keen on the food in the restaurants then the burgers and chips from the snack bar were very good. You had to pay for the sunbeds and parasols, 1 euro for each item, so 5 euros a day, wasn't expecting that at an all inclusive and when you are getting nearly 200/300 people around the swimming pool daily you think they could clean the place up a bit with the profit they are making. The swimming pool was a bit manky around the edges but it was a good size and plenty of space for everyone. No Wi-Fi in the hotel but you could buy a coupon at reception for 5 euros which lasted an hour, or use the computers in the games rooms for 1 euro for 15 mins, the table tennis also cost, 1 euro for 7 minutes, so we didn't have a warm up and went straight into the game. The staff were brilliant and nothing was too much trouble for them and they do work long hours serving the guests in this massive hotel. As for Praia De Roche as a holiday location, brilliant, nice and clean, has a good strip with a good vibe, even a niteclub that closes at 7am, a huge casino and plenty of bars and restaurants, the sand on the beach is one of the finest I've ever come across and the beach is gigantic, would definitely go back, there is a lot of Portuguese with their families that use this hotel and if its good enough for them, then its good enough for us.

author: st3phenyoung
title: Great Value Hotel
text: Just returned from a 9 night stay (self catering) at Club Praia Da Rocha and as the old saying goes, 'you get what you pay for'... Yes the hotel is dated and could do with some TLC, yes there is sometimes a strange sewerage smell early in the morning but it only lasts about an hour and yes the pillows are pretty bad, actually really bad but for what we paid it was a bargain. Our room was cleaned 3 times during our 9 night stay and we got clean towels each time which we thought was pretty good. Pool area is huge, the pool itself is salt water and very cold but we loved it and spent pretty much every day in it. As others have said, you do have to pay for your sunbeds but we actually preferred this as no need to set the alarm in a morning. The hotels biggest asset by far is its location, central to everything and only a 5 minute walk from one of the nicest beaches we have ever seen. The staff were friendly, helpful and nothing was too much trouble. What else is there to say, it's a great value hotel and we would definitely go back.

author: 654philip
title: bloody awful 1 star at best
text: Lets start with the rooms .Beds cheap and dirty mattresses hate to say what stains were . fridge still had old food in . bathroom smelly moldy ( good shower}. pool .area. looked like most city centers with paveing slabs not laid correctly .food nice but if you dont like chips and salad your buggered food just warm but tasty,coffee machine in block 2 kept going off . a few mornings if you went to the loo,s they were left dirty from the night before. I,ve never stayed any were as bad . not even butlins in the 70,s the resort is full of grafftie .on the plus side beech is stunning and it,s not far from airport.

author: denzil_anne
title: Denise
text: After reading reviews I was a little nervous about staying here but for price we paid I cannot fault it.food was basic but always something you could chose from. Drinks were limited to 2 per person, lager&wine was only alcohol available until 8pm, no spirits until 8pm. Cocktails/sangria were extra. Loved the idea of paying a euro for sun beds as no rush to put towels down early. Hotel was clean, staff were very nice. Entertainment wasn't great but we stayed for AI until 11pm & went to the strip for a few drinks. The hotel is nowhere near a 5 star but for the price I wasn't expecting it. I would be happy to stay here again.

author: corall269
title: Mediocre Hotel
text: I visited this hotel in September 2014 and I did have a great time, mainly this was due to spending quality time with family! However I find the entertainment very good and the bar snacks and self serve drinks easy and good quality. The actual hotel needs some work. I struggled to find any surface comfortable to sit on! The rooms were basic and the towels weren't changed regularly :( we were disappointed at first but in the end we had a good time. The staff are lovely and the pool is nice. I liked the sun bed scheme where u paid 1 euro a day for it which is a small price and stopped people reserving them at the crack of dawn! There is a local ameretto on the all inclusive which was awesome, great trips available at good prices and not too far from the beach. I would definitely go back to the algarve again but I would try a different hotel. Still had fun though :)

author: jane_pisces
title: Great Apartments
text: It was a few years ago I stayed here but these apartments are really good, they are 5 mins away from the main strip/beach. They are very spacious and even had a cupboard in the hall which was great to store the suitcases. I cannot honestly say anything negative as I really enjoyed my stay here, only downside is the coach transfer took 2 hours from the airport which is a bit long but worth it. The beach is beautiful but very very steep to get down to but once there it is lovely. Plenty of shops and restaurants which were good, there was a little place on site which does fast food which is handy. Staff were very helpful and polite. Rooms were cleaned nearly every day to a high standard. Would recommend these apartments except for the bin men who came every morning at 5am and the noise of the empty bottles was not fun.

author: amandathomson
title: Its OK basic but cheap
text: After reading reviews I were unsure what to expect. We have 2 kids and they had fun as so many other children there made loads of friends and the pool is massive and great for children. Hotel - basic and need refurb. But they are trying Food - Basic and not much choice but always something to eat (Breakfast/dinner and tea) ALL inc drinks - beer/wine and soft drinks all day 10.30 / 11pm spirits after 8pm No ice cream for kids inc, but is cheaper than supermarket next door! Staff friendly and helpful I can not knock the place as you can see they are trying to bring it back up and when you pay a reasonable cost for a 11 night holiday I can not winge at all. End of the day its a 2/3 star property and they don't suggest there any more than that. They have had cut backs due to hotel going in administration so we were told. We met some fab people here, and praia rocha is beautiful and a buzzing place. You get what you pay for, if you want 5 star pay for it. :)

author: novad424
title: Won't be returning
text: On arrival we entered a lovely lobby with air con however this is the only area they seem to have maintained. Rooms Our room was shabby looking even graffiti on one wall. Our family apartment consisted of 1 bedroom and a living area my poor daughter had to sleep on what looked like an oversized draw with a mattress in it. My other daughter slept on the sofa (which was more comfortable than the beds). Maid service was them emptying the bins only I had to ask for clean towels and even mopped the floors myself with the mop and bucket provided in the room. Facilities We received no hotel information on arrival or in our room so we were very surprised to find people queuing to buy sun loungers for the day around the pool. The girls enjoyed the pool with the slide however it contains salt as well as chlorine so goggles were a must. Food We went all inclusive but again the is very basic meals and only a selection of drinks which your not informed of and the food is edible JUST with very little choice. I have stayed in budget hotels however the service and accommodation here are below thestandards you would expect its safe to say we Won't be returning.

author: JodieC1981
title: Dirty pool, disgusting food and old tired rooms
text: DO NOT STAY!! Luckily we had a car and moved around....we have booked only as a base but thank god we did!!! It is vile!!! The pool is full of scum and dirt round the edges and the water stinks like a pond! The food is the same every day....the people who had booked for all inclusive must have been so bored!!....powdered egg at breakfast and hot dog sausage every single day! Even a dog wouldn't have liked it!!!!!.....there are other places near by that are miles nicer!!! Beware.......was ok for 2 nights but do not plan to eat there at all!!!!!........I'm not fussy and have eaten street food whilst backpacking! This food is by far the worst I've ever seen and I'm quite well travelled in poor places!!!

author: scall92
title: Cheap and cheerful
text: Just back from a weeks stay here. Rooms are basic but what do you expect for the price you pay? We went self catering as I don't think there is much point staying around a hotel all day when there's lots of restaurants things to do and a beautiful beach on your doorstep. Staff were always very friendly and had good recommendations about which day trips to go on. Pool was clean and grand for a swim. Sun loungers and umbrellas were 1 euro to rent but we just brought towels to the pool area. I don't understand why people say it's so bad. If I had to complain about anything ir would be that the matresses are in definite need of replacing and the lift stops on every single floor on the way down and up! But all in all worth the money

author: K2842PDkellyb
title: Good hotel for the price.
text: D Varee Xpress Makkasan is a good hotel for the price. It is also within a short walk of the Makkasan train station and the Phetchaburi MRT station. It is also a little cheaper than the FX Makkasan Hotel, though FX is closer to the train stations. The room and bathroom were large and clean. The room had a safe, TV, mini-fridge, and a huge bed. The bed was as comfortable as any bed I slept on in Thailand, though that isn't saying much. The Thais like to give you hard massages and even harder beds! There is a connected restaurant and you can add breakfast to your room charge. I did not opt for that, but had a good cup of coffee and omelette there. I would have rated this hotel higher, but the hallway carpet looked filthy and had huge stains.

author: Vikramsamal
title: Good location
text: But limited food. Small rooms. But clean. Near Indra market. Easy access to taxi tuk tuk bus or metro. But beware of traffic. One thing they need to improve is communication with foreigners. Lots of foreign people people come and they need to improve their English.

author: CheckOutMyTrunk
title: Not worth the money
text: We stayed for one night after arriving from Europe. Positive: Location of the Hotel is good, you can exit at the Metro Station/ Skytrain Station Makkasan, next to the Hotel is a 7-Eleven, where you can buy food all day and night. also Negative: Ist was very loud, the room seemed to be old and was torn down. Our room was dirty (Hairs on the floor...) and there was no Soap to wash our hands. The breakfast was terrible and can hardly be called by that name: They only served toast, some glibbery stuff that might be some sort of jam and eggs, that were nearly/ half raw. Two sorts of thai food were served but were not very tasty. The juice and mainly the coffee were awful. Better skip the breakfast and go somewhere else. I would not stay here again. Spend a few more Baht and save yourself from this place :-)

author: gavinxyz
title: Not expensive and good stay
text: This hotel is around 5-10 minutes walk from Phetchaburi MRT station and Makkasan Airport Rail station. There is a 7 eleven next door to the hotel and it is very convenience. The room is really basic and not too old. Standard room are with floor to ceiling window view which has natural sunlight and bright. Bed is ok and aircon is ok too. However, the bathroom is a bit old and small. There is 2 bottles water provided and no coffee or tea in provided in the room. Internet was fine and no problem in my room. If you are looking for a room to stay and shower while traveling in Bangkok, this hotel is fine for you. If you are looking for very comfortable and want to stay long time in room, this hotel may not suitable for you especially the standard room is not spacious.

author: SlowLifeThai
title: Ideal location. Basic budget hotel, you you get what you pay for
text: Perfect location for my wife and I. Her office is a 5 minute walk away. And 5 minute walk to Petchaburi MRT and Makkasan Airport Rail Link. So it's ideal for arrivals and departures from Survanhabmi Airport, which is about 20 minutes or so away using the Airport Rail Link. The MRT links with the BTS at some stations, so it's perfect for getting around and/or exploring this beautiful amazing city that is Bangkok. My wife and I have stayed here several times and will be staying again in August/September this year (2018). It is a basic budget hotel with basic rooms, you get what you pay for. Great value, friendly staff, nice and reasonably priced restaurant, 7-11 literally footsteps away. This will always be my base in BKK.

author: ananthnarayan_1
title: A perfect location
text: Conveniently located. Very friendly staff. Smooth check-in and check-out. No advance security deposits. Concierge who attended to us was very friendly. The floor corridors were a bit stuffy. I recommend to keep the fire exit doors open so that the passages are well ventilated. The sit out provided behind the hotel was relaxing. Tour bookings are also done by the hotel staff. It was a pleasant stay.

author: Stay_Strong_Thailand
title: Some might not like it hot!
text: This is a rather quaint hotel, particularly the lobby. However, can't say the same for the rooms, which can look different, with different layouts. Also, depending on which room one gets, it can get awfully hot, especially in the afternoon, early evenings, and even at nights - the air-con are not strong enough, or can cool the room fast enough. It's best for like an overnight stay, I would think. Coz, most rooms don't have a rack to place the luggage bag. Oh, I was even locked out from the hotel one day, was the lock malfunctioned. On the positive side, most of the staffs are friendly and helpful, except for one female staff who can be rather temperamental - she's probably not very well suited for this job as a receptionist. Oh, and free wifi is limited to only 2 devices, if this is a concern. Anything more than that, one will either have to go the lobby, or forget the network of one of the devices. It's also very close to the Petchaburi MRT/subway (@10 mins walk) as well as the Makkasan Airport Link station, which is really great.

author: 151vineethv
title: A very basic accommodation facility
text: Still not sure I can call this place as a 3* hotel or not!!! Very small room with no basic amenities, from my travel experience so far all the 3* categorized venues will provide at least a dental kit, coffee or tea making amenities. Also all the rooms are non smoking. Even if u are staying in the seventh floor u need to come down to the reception to smoke. The break fast choices are way too limited, everyday same options. Some how few of the day shift reception team were friendly and helpful, apart from that the restaurant and reception team had no clue what is hospitality.. Only good thing about the location is MRT station is on walking distance. They need to improve a lot in their guest relation, and room facilities.

author: ryan750il
title: Bangkok adventure with mom's friends
text: My mom's friends are the ones who booked the place. It's not my typical Bangkok coz I always stays at Silom. But it's a new place to explore. Stayed for 3 nights. I can say it has good location. Very near mrt, airport link n boat. So I experience the different transport system here in Bangkok. About the hotel the room is kinda average. The only thing I don't like is its kinda dark even if the lights are all turned on. The restaurant nxt to it I like the coffee :)

author: VijaykumarK51
title: Not very courteous
text: Stayed for 3 nights. Decent place but, the hospitality leaves a lot to be desired. Did not have breakfast for 2 days. Just one of the days, went for breakfast (which I had paid for in the room rate) but, there was no vegetarian dish at all. On speaking to the chef, she said that is all they have. No courtesy to see if they could help in any way. I asked for some fruits and they said I would have to pay extra. Not happy with the way they handled the situation.

author: MuhdAqid
title: Splendid Stay
text: Though it was just a small hotel, my stay here was excellent. The room was just nice and the check-in was smooth. Though I forget to hang the makeup room sign, I still came back after a long trip with a clean room and replenished amenities. The service given is remarkable. Had problems getting an Uber driver to bring my friends and myself to Ancient City which located quite a distance from the hotel but Mr Noy from the front desk offered help and get for us a taxi which cost cheaper than an Uber. He definitely went an extra mile and his effort is definitely commendable. The location was good as well. Other than getting Uber, my friends and I enjoyed using the train which is walkable distance from the hotel. The location of the hotel is just nice as it is not situated in a busy environment though it is situated beside a highway. Will definitely recommend this place to people.

author: jaskireths2016
title: Awesome place!
text: Rally nice place. A little bit away from the hustle and bustle of the city. About 25minutes walk away from the main shopping district. Has a really nice cafe downstairs. Simple and sweet. Really clean place for family. Good wifi! Really nice massage place nearby as well!

author: SS1803
title: Low Budget Category
text: Rooms are clean, but old and noisy (the ones facing the road). No cupboards. The bathroom is fine. The wifi had technical issues but got sorted out. Breakfast was pathetic, please dont plan based on this. The bed was not good. No Tuk Tuk or Taxi knows this place. They will not give second key to a room without an additional deposit. At best can be considered a low budget hotel category on facility. If it is just for a night you can adjust here.

author: tretjak
title: Good price
text: Competetive price. Convenient location if you want to stay near the airport link and/or MRT. You can walk to Sukumvit area in 5-10 minutes or the Pratunam area in around 15 minutes. WIFI somewhat unreliable (worked on my Android surfpad but not on my Android phone). Beakfast/lunch/dinner can be had at the neighbouring restaurant. Good quality and prices there. Shower and bed was nice. Safe available in room. All in all: Good.

author: AsianH1
title: Great Hotel
text: Located in a proper place and overall service of the hotel is very much exemplary. staff were well mannered. Check-In was quick, we had booked a triple room - the room was clean and spacious with all the basic amenities. Obviously being in a city we were not expecting any great views from the window but at least there was open space, so that was good. The hotel in general was a bit worn down. The hotel corridors had a very unpleasant smell. Big let down was that the hotel does not have a pool. Breakfast buffet offered by the hotel is just bad, there were no veg options except bread and the non veg options provided were very limited

author: Emer202
title: Great stay for access to the airport
text: This hotel was ideal for us as we just needed somewhere to stop over before our flight. We arrived using the airport rail link and got off at Makkasan. The hotel was a 5 minute walk from the station and is also located beside a metro. We also decided to head into Khaosan Road for the evening and used the boat taxi which was a 5 minute walk from the hotel and took 20 minutes followed by a 20 minute walk. The boat cost 10 baht each way per person and was an experience in itself. Proper Thai transport. Warning: don't bring luggage, the boat waits for no one and you have to jump on and off at each stop, literally! Hotel was lovely overall. Very clean room, big comfy bed and hot shower, safe and free wifi. The next morning we used the airport rail link to get back to the airport, 35baht, 20 minute journey.

author: francescaf89
title: Great!
text: We stayed here unfortunately only one night. Is a really great hotel. Well designed and clean. Is such in the photos. The room was big and the bed too comfortable. Have a really great connection with the international airport. Really great staff! They helped us with the check in. The only negative thing that I can say is that they should renovate the hallway in the 6th floor.

author: ssk1984july
title: very small unfriendly nothing works
text: dont know how it has such high rating. very small rooms, no space to move. lift doesnt work. bathroom locks dont work. no coffee or tea provided. no good food either. no indication on breakfast dishes wether veg or non veg . and staff doesnt know english. safe provided doesnt work either.

author: Mendigo13
title: Cheap, but can get much better for the same price in Bangkok
text: This place is located conveniently near the Makkasan station which connects to Suvarnabhumi airport, and is also next to the Petchaburi metro station. We booked it for our last night in Bangkok as we had an early morning flight and wanted to take the airport train. The room is extremely basic, which was expected, given what we paid. However, some things just weren't acceptable. The wifi stopped working an hour after we checked in and the reception told us it was because it was raining. It didn't work until late in the night. The toilet flush was leaking water and the toilet generally wasn't very clean. Sure this place is cheap (we paid 1400 baht without breakfast), but one can easily find better places in the same area for the same price.

author: pardsb
title: Average..
text: It was not the easiest hotels to locate by car or foot. Taxi drivers were confused. Hotel reception team were welcoming upon arrival and quickly sorted out the air conditioning, which did not initially activate with my room key. Good night sleep. Comfy bed and shower was OK. It's about half hour by taxi from the centre. Best to go via the highway but you'll need to pay a 50b toll. It's fine for one night upon arrival into the country. There are better and more convenient hotels that I may have chosen in the future.

author: Fl2219
title: Nice budget hotel with convenient location!
text: We stayed here for one night just to catch the early flight. It's more of a budget hotel. The room and bathroom was OK, and has all the facilities needed, but the room is a bit small. It's close to the airport rail link Makkasan (very easy to reach if you arrived at suvarnabhumi), and 3 minutes walk to petchburi BTS skytrain. If you wanna catch an early flight or arrive late at night, it's a good choice. Or if you're staying out the whole day and just looking for a place to sleep, it's a decent place to stay. There's only one elevator, sometimes may need to wait a bit. A nice cafe and a 7-11 are right next to the hotel, it won't be a problem if you need a coffee or some night snacks. All in all it's a nice hotel with good values.

author: estebanj76
title: Ok but not great
text: This hotel is a good 10-15 minutes from the airport express makassan station. The hotel is simple without fuss. Its good for a night in transit. It was nor clean nor dirty. Carpets were very dirty on the outside of the rooms. The plus of this hotel it has a 7/11 @ his doorstep and the breakfast is taken at the coffee shop within the building premise. It was good and simple for quick breakfast. There are not much around the area of the hotel. The mrt petchaburi is close about 5/7min walk. I will will return only the hotel closer to the metro is not available.

author: ChipolatasandMash
title: Good value
text: We stayed here as a couple and we were pleasantly surprised. It has the feel of a budget Ibis hotel. The room was clean and spacious. It has reasonable wifi. Bathroom a good size, with a partition between the shower and toilet. There is a 7/11 next door and also a cafe attached. All in all, a pleasant stay. We would recommend especially if you're on a budget.

author: jax0214
title: Nice Budget Hotel with reasonable price & pleasant environment
text: Hotel is located few minutes walk from closest MRT and Airport Rail Link station at Makkasan. The staff is polite & friendly. There is 7-11 at just outside of hotel. Room was nice, clean & filled with aircond, hairdryer, safety box, TV, hot water in the bathroom & WIFI as well. Most importantly,everything working well. The dissatisfaction is the TV lacks some sport channel & the WIFI is unstable but after all its a budget hotel, maybe we should lower the expectation. Ps: just a suggestion, maybe D Varee can consider to change the door to auto sliding door for more convenient for us. Stayed October 2015, travelled with family.

author: florencet231
title: Formerly known as FX Hotel Makkasan
text: Nice place to stay. Quite near to famous Chatuchak, train station just walking distance & right behind the hotel. Smoke free room. Welcome drinks were served whenever you are back from trips. Maybe I will only be negative around the pond area. Lots of mosquitoes. The directories we're creative and I still kept them. Useful informations.

author: Xaviar84
title: Good location that's about it
text: Stayed here for about a week. Location is close to Phetchburi MRT which is good. The hotel is in the business area so there are very few restaurants and shops around this area although Terminal 21 is a short ride away and there is a 7/11 right next door. The girls on the front desk were generally very helpful however there was not much else to write home about. Rooms were not very clean (see photos)... shower was broken, dirty and the water was rarely hot, no hand soap in the bathroom, internet rarely worked properly and when it did it made you log in every few hours which was very annoying. TV had limited international channels, no tea and coffee provided in room, gave laundry in multiple times and it was never brought to the room so I always had to go and chase the front desk staff for it. Housekeeping didn't really do a great job of cleaning the room each day. Overall there are far better places to stay within the area for the same money.

author: MartynaC541
title: Ok for one night
text: We wanted a decent hotel convenint to the airport, that's why we have chosen D Varee Xpress hotel. First of all, the hotel staff were quite friendly and helpful, check -in went really fast. The room itself was rather shabby, desperately needing repainting and some new furniture. The floor is concrete , which gives a real shaby look to all the room. Bathroom quite old but rather clean. Wifi doesn't work in the room (fifth floor). The hotel is located in a busy street, which was quite annoying at night. Breakfast was really nice, apart from coffee. In overall, it was ok for one night, very good value for money, however I would hate it to stay there for a longer period of time. A bit disappointed after seeing the official photos of the hotel.

author: dvaytw
title: Regrettable choice
text: When we arrived at about 9:40 pm, there was only one person on staff and he was away. No one helped us with our copious luggage. We had to wait for more than ten minutes to get checked in. There were no towels or tissues in the room. There was a smell of natural gas from the bathroom, and the room was too dark. The night-time guys (one other arrived later) were unable to tell us where to find food nearby. The walls were thin (though this is common in Bangkok). On the positive side, the breakfast buffet was nice, and the lady at the desk in the morning was apologetic, friendly and very helpful.

author: johnlQ4263RP
title: Good value
text: Staff are friendly, polite and helpful. Room is clean and has flat screen tv and kettle. Number of TV channels rather limited, no BBC. When first arrived there was no internet, a room change resolved this. One irritating thing, the room acces card expired after one day in spite of the fact we had prepaid for three days. Electricity only comes on when card is inserted just right into card reader on wall. Water was cut off without warning for a while this afternoon. If you don't mind putting up with these little problems it is still a good value hotel for the area.

author: 717cyrilm
title: Affordable and Good
text: Notice : The name have changed, it's 'Hotel Link' now. I went just to sleep at night, for 4 nights, it's a normal place, It's OK. The hotel entrance is nicer than rooms, but rooms are also normal, I chose a simple room, It was clean, secure, the only drawback is the windows condemned (to probably prevent any suicide) but there is an air conditioner (but it takes long time to acclimate). 2 small water bottles are given, and renewed every day after cleaning staff. Each room contains its bathroom and it is OK too, It's clean, you have a washbasin with soap and shampoo, WC, shower with water heater. Bed is Really Comfortable with clean sheets and pillows, but sometimes there is a little hole in these sheets. There is a flat TV, there is about a Channel per foreign language. There is a Little Fridge (no freezer), a Safe, a boiler, a close desk.

author: isabellesu
title: Warning!!!
text: Worst hotel in bangkok, not like hotel,just hostel type, bad customer service, rude staff, very dirty, not stable wifi. Curtain cannot fully close. So every morning outside light go in and cant sleep. Too noisy. Car moving sound and sound of people walking from corridor can hear from the room. They cut off the wifi for our floor because only few rooms at our floor. Cant connect wifi from other floor also. Windows and bathroom are dirty. Room service put back the bed cover and towel, although we told them to change. No shopping mall near by.

author: PAUL_Ratchapol
title: Great Location and Service
text: I had stayed his hotel for 2 nights with my friend and booked undfer standard room from 3 - 5 May 2014 with special rate from Expedia.co.th This hotel had changed their name from FX Hotel Makkasan to Hotel Link Makkasan so if you can't find Hotel Link Makksan please be note that it's same hotel that you booked for your stay. This hotel is far away from MRT Petchaburi by walk about 4 minutes and from Airport Raillink Makkasan about 8 minutes by sky walk from MRT Petchburi to Airport Raillink Makksan that mean this hotel is very comfortable for who come from Bangkok Suwannaphumi International Airport. on arrival date I checked in around 5.30 pm and was surprise that I had got free upgraded from Standard room to Superior room, the room was spacious for 2 persons and comfortable. Bathroom seperate with toilet and have white clean towel with shower get & shampoo. In room safe big enough for put my notebook in and 5 cloth hangers are enough to hang my clothes. In my room had Cable Television with refrigerator and 2 complimentary drinking water, the view from my room that you can see Airport Raillink Makkasan Station that is so amazing! Breakfast like a continentail breakfast that you can have light meal before you go around bangkok. For me this hotel had anawer all of my request and meet my satisfication. Thank you for all staff of Hotellink Makkasan especially Khun Paula who is very nice lady with smiling face all time. I'll be return back this hotel again in nearly future!

author: joannamaries
title: Friendly staff, good service
text: One thing i like is the friendliness of staff. They can answer my questions and granted our request for early breakfast. Food at chookdee is nice. Accessible to MRT but far from shopping mall. Massage is expensive. Better go to pratunam. But overall i like our stay there. I like the lobby as well.

author: tdevinda
title: Bargain hotel.
text: Transport was the easiest. I'd recommend to take either the Airport rail link or the MRT to Sukhumvit station from the airport and walk from there. No use taking an expensive taxi. And take out a hotel card in case you want a taxi to drive you back, those dudes' English is darn poor and communication is very hard. If you're going towards Pratunam Market, if you want to take a taxi, cross the road and take it. Otherwise the one way system will drive you all round town. When coming to the hotel from Sukumvit station, take the Don Muang exit so that you dont need to cross the road. Included breakfast is from the Chokdee restaurant next door. The hotel has no kitchen. But the food was ok.

author: jingxuanl_12
title: Not too Bad!
text: I think its pretty decent and not as bad as what some reviewers have commented. The room was clean. There's a dim sum restaurant located just beside the lift at level 1. 7/11 is just outside the hotel and the Petchaburi MRT station is less than 5 minutes walk from the hotel. There was this male staff (in his 30s-40s) whom we thought was the friendliest in the hotel and he advised us on where and which transport to take on our designated location for 4 days! Here's the negative part of the hotel: 1.) Staff was friendly only to Caucasians than to Asians but it didn't bother us that much 2.) There are no closet for you to keep your clothes. Only a black bar with 4 hangers if you are staying in a double room. and it was quite frustrating as we do not have enough space to keep and hang our clothes 3.) The walls and partitions were pretty thin and you can hear foot steps and noises outside the room.

author: 759joels
title: Good enough...
text: Before I came to this hotel, I've read several reviews that said how bad the location of the hotel is, and the horrible customer service standard. However when I actually came, I was pleasantly surprised, the attitudes of the staff were really good, on more occasion the manager even helped us hail a cab when we were asked to wait in the hotel lobby, not bad for a budget hotel eh? As for the location, I'm not gonna sugercoat it, it is pretty bad, there is pretty much nothing around, except a chinese restaurant that serves subpar food and a 7 seven-eleven nearby. The only redeeming quality is that there is a massage parlour and mrt station about 5 mins walk away. So the gateway to greener pastures is but a mere 5 mins walk away. Cab drivers are also reluctant to drive to this hotel, due to it being out of place and having bad traffic, so they tend to jack up prices. So either you have to accept the additonal levy or simply return by mrt, which may not always be convenient. Overall the hotel is a good stay, but my advise is to stay in a hotel closer to the Pratunam area for greater convenience.

author: WincyTee
title: An ordinary hotel for rest
text: Stay in this hotel for 3 nights, and what we experienced the most is 4 out of 5 tuk-tuk has lost their way on looking for this hotel. The wifi service is super lack, which we will need to disconnect and reconnect over and over again. You can only order 1set of breakfast from 4 sets of choices. Another things is the room service. We requested for tissue and toilet roll in room to be top up, and what we get is half packet of opened packet tissue sent to us!! Not to forget about the power plug in the room. You will have to deposit a 100baht with the front desk in order to receive a normal 3-pin power plug to charge your phone. Will not stay in this hotel again for my next visit to Bangkok.

author: jooei
title: Simple and comfortable hotel
text: Stayed here for 3 nights with 3 friends and we have 2 comfortable bedrooms on the highest floor 7th floor, 704/706. facing the back of the hotel. Air conditioner was super strong and there is a hot water boiler in every room. Checked into the hotel at midnight , check in counter was efficient and we get our room immediately. There is a chokdee dim sum restaurant next door with free wifi,food was inexpensive and is 24 hrs. Next to the restaurant is a 7-11 where we grab more mineral water for the next few days. We have never use any subway though the station is nearby as is convenient for 4 of us to travel by cab, about 70-80 baht to pratunam . Overall the hotel stay were clean and comfortable except that is no shopping mall or any eatery nearby, to any shopping malls or tourist attraction you have to catch the train or cab.

author: Lorant80
title: Good value for money, very good hotel, large room, fridge and free WiFi, comfortable bathroom
text: We have spent here two nights in second half of December 2011. It was a good location, close to the Airtrain stop (direct connection to the Suvarnabhumi International Airport) and to the metro station (direct connection to the centre of Bangkok). Breakfast was not included but we have not required at all. It was good value for money, as the hotel room was cheap (ca. 30USD/night). The room was spacious, with a large fridge and large new flat screen TV (although we have not even started). The bathroom was comfortable and practical. Next to the hotel was a 7-eleven shop, where we could buy some food and drink. The staff was friendly and helpful, it wasn’t an issue checking in at 3 am.

author: JeffreyC45
title: Friendly staff who makes you feel welcome
text: Fantastic place with good, clean and airy rooms. The only negative is the lack of eating places within the vicinity of the hotel and shopping centres. I also had noisy neighbours in the next room and you could hear them all the time speaking loudly in some sort of Indian language - most inconsiderate. This was my first time to Bangkok and because I was going solo, it was initially a bit intimidating, what with everything in Thai and inadequate English signage. The staff tried to compensate with their friendliness but even then hardly anyone knows how to speak English. It was daunting to say the least but I manage to survive for the next 5 days. I think for first time travellers to a place, probably the back packers locations where there's a huge population of English speaking travellers ease the sense of anxiety one gets from travelling alone. Anyway, this hotel is highly recommended with the caveat that you know your way around in Makkasan or willing to dish out bahts to get to where you want to go. Walking to most destinations is out of the question - in my honest opinion.

author: Bex_on_holiday
title: Great for the airport link
text: The real plus of this place is how close it is to the Makkasan airport link. It is just a 5-10min walk, which with a backpack was easy but with a heavy suitcase, could be a small challenge as the route involves crossing a railway line, busy road and walking across gravel. This hotel is very new, so everything is clean and working. It really is a budget hotel though, facilities are super basic, but if you're only staying for the one night before flying then im sure this is something we can all live with. Although I appreciate it's a new hotel, i didn't think the price at the time reflected what was offered. One peev, there was a bad smell in bathroom. Being so new, im sure it was just a teething problem though. All taken into consideration, it is still (in my view) the best hotel close to the airport link, so for this i would still give it a thumbs up.

author: LoveCip
title: Very good location by MRT and Airport Link
text: We selected this hotel because of its location, a walking distance to MRT and Airport Link. It was quite convenient when we arrived back from Myanmar and one of us had a morning flight to Chiang Mai the next day. (Access to MRT could make it possible to go to the Chatuchak weekend market, but it was closed due to the flooding situation in Bangkok.) We both liked the free, refillable, refreshing Green Hale's Blue Boy welcome drink in the lobby. Booking via Expedia Japan and we could get unlimited free wi-fi internet access account which is great. However, they limited only one account per room not per guest. So we had to share the account and couldn't use wifi internet at the same time. Although the location was good by MRT and Airport Link but there was nothing around the area except a 24-hour service ChokDee Dim Sum place downstairs. The room was basic but new and clean. We paid only around 350 baht (via Expedia Japan, from a very special 1500-yen-discount code), at this price, it was surely great value for money.

author: sq_cpilot
title: Basic 3-star hotel. You get what you pay for.
text: We paid about USD 45 per night including breakfast but you should look for online deals where you only pay about USD 30. The room is very basic in size and amenities. We would actually prefer to stay in a slightly nicer hotel but one great thing about this one is that it's very near to Petchaburi MRT train station which is very convenient. For example, traveling to Chatuchak Weekend market only cost us 35 baht per person one way, so no need to take a taxi and get caught in Bangkok's infamous traffic jams. It is also quite close to the main shopping area like Platinum mall/Pratunam which cost us about 60 baht in a taxi/tuktuk. The air-conditioning was very weak. Like someone else said, ask for a room facing the back of the hotel (the courtyard) so that the noise from the main room is minimised. We requested for a double bed and got one, but it was actually just two single beds pushed together. Not sure if they have rooms with proper double beds. The staff are very friendly and helpful.

author: Xxkylie
title: Very poor
text: Such a shame! I’ve been to to the kings arms for years and as of last night I’ve been completely put off and won’t be eating there again! The menu was extremely limited and expensive for what it was! But the most infuriating thing was how the waitress treated us! My Nan was worried of asking her to bring sauce to her! She had got my nans order slightly wrong which wasn’t a problem but my god were we made to feel like it was our fault! We also had our dogs with us and we had brought a roll out blanket to sit on I thought it was exceptionally rude the way the waitress kept kicking my dogs blanket out of the way. She had a massive attitude problem and I felt like she was going to jump down my throat every time she came over. Not returning!

author: 351kevinp
title: Disappointing
text: Having previously visited the Kings Arms and enjoyed a lovely meal we booked a Friday evening with friends & were very disappointed. On our previous visit we had selected from a specials board but on arrival there was no specials available this time, only one menu. Two of us had the pie of the day which for £12.50 arrived with a very small amount of peas & chips. The pie itself was more pastry than meat. One person had the salmon (£12.50) which was supposed to be with watercress sauce. However it came with a plain white sauce and the salmon was over cooked. Finally our evening was spoilt further by the fact that despite the pub bring extremely quiet with many other vacant tables the staff placed a group of young lads next to us so our table was very noisy. (Not the lads fault) On leaving we did inform the staff of the issues but there was little response other than to say they were changing menus and they would put us on a different table if we came again with no reduction on the bill which was a reasonable amount of money. The four of us are local to the area but it is highly unlikely that we will return to the Kings Arms in the near future.

author: 691jmm123
title: Not worth the money at all
text: Stayed here over the Christmas period for 2 nights. Originally chose the Kings Arms as I was visiting family and they were the closest hotel that still had rooms. Bedroom was nothing like the picture and the bed was absolutely awful - so uncomfortable, springs were jumping around every time I moved and the whole thing was very loud. Shower would just dribble water and every time you changed temperature it would move between boiling hot and unbearably cold, worst shower I’ve ever used. Breakfast was fine, no problems there. Didn’t eat any other meals at the pub but have heard the other food is good. Staff were fine but didn’t really see much of them. We paid £100 per night and I would honestly say the room is worth £40 per night max. Due to the limited choice of hotels in the area, they can probably get away with charging that much and still not lose any business which is unfortunate.

author: GedT331
title: What a little gem
text: I have been travelling here every year for the past 14 years but this was the first time I had arrived the night before so I needed a hotel. What a little gem this place is. I had a fantastic stay they had a Christmas quiz on and whilst eating my dinner I got drafted into the team at the next table (and we won) the meal was very good and tasty I had the chefs pie with mash which arrived in good time. It was hot and very tasty. The Guinness was very nice obviously who ever looks after the beer lines know what they are doing. I ended up having 4 mmm. Breakfast was very nice and quantity and taste. I have read through some of the reviews on here and I am amazed that they are true as what I found from the moment I entered to the moment I left after breakfast was a very well run place with very attentive staff with big smiles. I shall definitely be staying there again. Well done

author: Cfc1212
title: Birthday
text: First time, and was very impressed. The lady server could have been a little dress abit better, but was very friendly and professional. We had the salmon which was good and well presented. The fish and chips was wonderful and the burger was the best i have had for a long time. The only let down was the gammon wasn't as good as we had at Greendale farm shop. I would say the food was freshly made and the time from ordering to receiving the food was incredibly fast. Definitely a pub I would travel too. A nice atmosphere and clean pub. Well worth a visit and dog friendly

author: E6735WZpeters
title: Single beds for a couple is not a winning formula
text: I think that if you book a double room you can reasonably expect a double bed. We were surprised to find a room with two single beds. The room was also very cramped and hence the three bubbles (stars) The good news is that the breakfast is out of this world. The inn owners also have a farm and a farm shop. All the meat served at breakfast is straight off their farm. I cannot stress how healthy and delicious this breakfast was. We also enjoyed a very good meal the night we arrived in the restaurant of the Kings Arms. The village of Otterton is quite attractive and only a short drive from Sidmouth

author: 290stuartt
title: Decent Room but Poor Food
text: We stayed over a weekend. Our room had a comfortable bed and excellent bathroom, but was quite small and had nowhere to sit except one stool at the dressing table. I thought it was rather over-priced. The restaurant food was very unimaginative, with few dishes not served with chips. My wife had a fish pie with a filling that might just have been fish. My salmon and prawn salad was nothing but leaves topped with flakes of fish and second-rate prawns, which, I suspect, had preeviously been frozen. "Home made pies" were sold out at 7.30 pm. Breakfast on Sunday was a buffet of fried food kept warm and not very appetising. On Modday, breakfast was cooked on demand and was better.

author: Inspire555682
title: Not very good I’m afraid!
