I never hear anything . The rooms are newer . Hotel also has good hot tub and seasonal pool . Limited / not great breakfast . Seems to be a Hampton issue . Some have better breakfasts than other .

author: jeanettev2018
title: OK accomodations
text: Off the beaten path. Easy access to freeway. Parking is inadequate for larger vehicles. Do not bring a trailer, or any tow. Desk staff can be stubborn, so stand your ground. Elevator (just one) is slow. Vending prices are ridiculous. Get your coffede from Dutch Brothers down the street.

author: sarahc0achs
title: Great value; they are updating
text: They are updating rooms while I was there. I was on the 1st floor so I can only speak to that. Room was spacious with plenty of updates. However trim missing as part of update.The Bluetooth didn’t work on the end door which the staff immediately addressed. Fitness center small- 2 cardio equipment only and small medicine ball rack. However food and pool were great! Perfect location convenient to other eating and highway. Staff wonderful! Perfect value.

author: B2493DYkathyl
title: Reliable Hampton Inn
text: Attended a wedding in Woodland and many family members stayed here. This is your typical Hampton Inn, nothing outstanding with the hotel - but it did have some nice things going for it. The location, only 10-15 minutes from the Sacramento airport, the pool and hot tub, and that it was a fairly quiet hotel. The room was very nice with a frig, micro, and coffee pot (tea bags should be in every room). The hotel was mostly full every night and that caused some logistical programs at breakfast in the morning - things ran out. Hot water, bread and bagels, milk, juices, etc. They should have two people working breakfast when they know the hotel is filled. They also need bigger plates for the waffles. Syrup ran off of almost everyone's plates. They also have a nice little pantry to buy snacks, micro-meals and ice cream.

author: 308brucew
title: Hampton Inn in Woodland CA - It's ok....
text: We only spent one night and to be fair we arrived late. The night clerk was interesting and though efficient, it was clear we were interrupting her work. The room was very clean and as the hotel is undergoing renovations, we suspect it was newly remodeled. Nice sized room and did I mention clean? Super clean! The staff was less than friendly though and the view from our room - 216 - was of the portico and part of the roof! Not a stellar view. The breakfast area was clean and reasonably well appointed but the hostess was simply going through the motions and not up to Hampton standards. Easy to find from the freeway but far enough from the road so that we heard no noise.

author: PinkFloydActuary
title: Overnight stay
text: Great stay for me - I arrived in Sacramento at 10 pm and needed to drive out to Sonoma, so I stayed here to get the early start. About 10 minutes west of the airport - there's a few stores and other hotels nearby. In the dark, it was a little confusing to get into, but it was late. Groceries and Wal-mart as well as a number of restaurants within a few minute drive. Room was clean and quiet. One of my favorite parts of Hampton inns is their breakfast and this one did not disappoint. Scrambled eggs and ham, oatmeal bar, waffles - you can really stuff yourself. Easy checkout and back on the highway in the morning. Recommended!

author: Jim1133
title: great hotel
text: This is a great hotel less than 10 miles from the Sacramento airport. The room was very spacious, well lit and had plenty of electrical outlets for changing devices. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. The room included a coffee maker, refrigerator and microwave. The breakfast was very good, typical of most Hampton Inns. They have the digital key system, which I like, but it is a little slow to update. When I did not have my key by 4:00 PM I checked in the normal way. I got my digital key around 7:00, but then my regular key card did not work. Very small issues. Overall very good stay.

author: S2376VJbrentm
title: Hampton Inn & Suites Woodland CA
text: Location is fair for Woodland and fair for Sacramento. There are no decent restaurants nearby and there is no appreciable view. If you like to have a window open the freeway is 40 yards and can be noisy, but if the windows are closed it is reasonably quiet. Note: The hotel was under renovation when we stayed there, hopefully, they will update the AC as our was very noisy when the compressor kicked in. If you are looking for good food it can be found a couple miles down the road in historic Woodland or in Sacramento. The rooms/suites were clean as was the fitness center, pool, and hot tube. Breakfast was acceptable. For those of you that have electric cars, I did not see any charging stations.

author: michaelbP8862US
title: Get Reservation Details in Writing
text: This Hampton is similar to most other Hampton properties -- good clean rooms and nice breakfast. It is a good place to stay if you are in the area and the hotel provides a free shuttle to the Sacramento Airport. They have a special Park and Fly rate where you pay for the room and can park your car for up to 21 days while traveling out of SMF Airport, with shuttle back-and-forth provided. We were somewhat upset by incorrect information provided by the hotel prior to arrival. I booked a room with Hilton Honor points and was told that I could park the car during a trip by paying an additional $12 per day. When we checked in, we were told that wasn't available and I had to convert the reservation from points to a paid Park and Fly room rate. They were inflexible about adhering to what had been offered in the earlier phone discussion. So, make sure everything is "nailed-down" in writing.

author: MomDot2
title: Clean and cozy
text: I went to this hotel after a long flight and was pleasantly surprised with my room. It was very clean and I quite enjoyed the plus white cotton sheets . Very clean and comfy. I also had different pillow density to choose from. There was a microwave, fridge and coffee maker. There was a blow dryer in the bathroom and plenty of towels, not to mention complimentary shampoo and conditioner. It was quiet and had s window overlooking the parking lot. Staff was helpful snd referred me to Mojos restaurant in Woodland about 10 minutes away. Great stay! Sad I missed the complimentary breakfast.

author: sstadle
title: Nice Staff okay hotel
text: We stayed overnight before "Picnic Day". We drove to Cache Creek and came back quite late. Slept well little noise. Lots of room in our suite. I loved the microwave popcorn! Nice touch. Breakfast was great the next morning. I would stay again if it was a short trip. Hotel staff were awesome

author: wdlloyd1
title: Completely unresponsive to customer complaints
text: Had to check out in less than 45 minutes after check-in because of noise from laundry room personnel. I was given no other options. That is the best part. Since then, the hotel manager and Hampton Customer Support have ignored all requests for a refund. Customer Support (an oxymoron in this case) keeps passing the buck back to the Manager. The Manager ignores all calls and continues to stonewall, passing the buck back to Customer support. The classic Catch 22. Either go elsewhere or just hope that you do not have any issues with this bunch of incompetents because you will be stuck holding the bag.

author: lilizmom
title: Very Good Value and Very Clean Hotel
text: We had a short one night stay. The room was great - big, clean and very reasonably priced. If in the area again, I would definitely pick this Hampton again. Front desk staff was courteous and very professional. We got in very late and got to the room within minutes. Breakfast area is very large with lots of selection. We appreciated the extra electrical plugs near each night stand. Every hotel should invest in those.

author: Aok98
title: Don't Miss the Exit
text: The hotel itself was fine. Pretty good quality control when it comes to Hampton. The staff was very nice and the wi-fi worked fine. Being a Hilton Honors member will get you free wi-fi here. The room was clean and it was a newer place in a row of chain motels. There's a shopping center across the freeway including a Costco with gas & Starbucks. If you are coming from the North, watch for that exit. It is the exit for Road 102. You'll see Costco on the right and if you miss that exit, you get to drive about 4 more miles before you can turn around. Otherwise I'd stay again.

author: 5BarbaraO
title: One night before Cayman Islands
text: We stayed here on a Friday night before a 6am flight to Grand Cayman BWI. We had to be at the airport at 4am. Less than 10 minutes from Sacramento Airport. It was quite and peaceful. We where on the 3rd floor which I think was the best. I found the rooms very plain. For one night it was fine. Nothing to brag about and I would not stay for a long trip.

author: 240jacqulineh
title: Noisy rooms
text: We arrived around 6:00 pm after driving almost a thousand miles that day. We were greeted very nicely. We then went to dinner. When we came back we watched a little TV and went to sleep around 9:30. The people next to us came in around midnight obviously been out partying. The party continued in their room with others until around 3 am. The walls are paper thin because it was like we were in their room with them. We could hear their whole conversations and laughter.

author: Jackwad22
title: Great Stay!
text: On a work road trip between California and Oregon. Was greeted by friendly desk attendant. Knowledgeable about Woodland. There are old photographs of area decorating the lobby. He had info about the area which I appreciated. The room was clean and comfortable. Fairly quiet. Got good rest. Would recommend.

author: Questsci
title: Needs a good cleaning. However, staff is helpful.
text: I would say that the hotel is understaffed. The management and staff does try to be accommodating. The staff is friendly and helpful. However the windows in our room were not clean. Also, the carpets were not clean. In addition, the sign in the elevator was damaged. These things may not seem important, but when spending $170.00 a night, I expect these things to be better. This is just me. I just think the staff needs a better maintenance schedule to keep the hotel up.

author: anonymousduck725
title: Clean and comfortable
text: We stayed at three different hotels during a recent California roadtrip and this was definitely our favorite. The two queen room felt spacious and clean overall and I liked the large bathroom. We enjoyed the clean pool and hot tub area and the plentiful towels right there. The beverage bar downstairs offered tea, coffee and hot chocolate all throughout the day and the free breakfast was excellent. The breakfast attendant was very warm and friendly and kept the area tidy and well-stocked. Although there was no meat, I was pleased with the options including real oatmeal (and some delicious topping options such as different dried fruits, nut slices and strawberries), belgian waffles, scrambled eggs, potatoes, hardboiled eggs, boxed cereals that were handy and fun for the kids, and more. Would absolutely stay here again on a future trip through. It was wonderful heading north in the morning knowing we didn't have to deal with any Sacramento traffic, as Woodland is just north of it.

author: christianbG1671PC
title: Average Stay for a Hampton
text: Hampton Inn and Suites a few minutes from Sacramento airport.... great location if needing access to the airport. Not a lot of choices to eat around the hotel that are not fast food options. Hotel staff was average at best and not reflective of what I've usually experienced at other Hilton properties, breakfast was very much lacking and probably girded towards an elderly clientele since the cooked options were few and the ones there pretty much tasted like hospital food... again not reflective of other Hilton properties. Gym was lower than basic... seen where other Hampton Inns have gone above and beyond by just adding good equipment, and even a few free weights... this property lacked either and the one treadmill there was broken... Property and staff definitely need some TLC

author: dextrip
title: Good Airport Hotel
text: Stayed here the night before a early morning flight out of Sacramento International. Rates were a lot cheaper than in the Sacramento area. The hotel was very clean and had a pool with hot tub. Everything looked new. We were in the middle of the building facing the pool and had no noise issues from the highway. There are a number of restaurants and a Target nearby for shopping and food. We were up and gone by 5am so we did not get a chance to try the breakfast but they did have the to-go bags at that hour with fruit and breakfast snacks inside them. Would stay here again as it was only about a ten minute drive to the airport.

author: katubaldy
title: Staff were great, hotel was a bonus.
text: Stayed at this hotel, mid July and pleased with the amenities and the price. Breakfast came as part of the deal, continental and a limited but tasty hot option. Rooms were reasonably spacious and came with a fridge. Nice surprise to be able to book quality accommodation in a fairly remote location. Pool and spa were greatly appreciated in the elevated summer temps. Overall we had an awesome stay and would book again in a heartbeat. Would recommend it to anyone who's looking for an oasis in Northern Californian town during the height of summer. Handy to a nearby casino as well.

author: GauchoRugger
title: Nice Hotel for the Soccer Team
text: I was at the hotel for 7/7-7/11/16 for a soccer tournament in Davis. The hotel was perfect. Very clean and very nice. They even had warm cookies in the evening. It is a nice location, near a Target, Starbucks, Red Robin and other places to eat. Just a short drive/walk over the freeway. The only downside, was that the soap dish that is supposed to be affixed to the tiled wall of the shower unexpectedly fell to the ground and smashed my son's toe. He wasn't grabbing it. It just came "unglued" and fell to the ground. Weird.

author: K7630NWrobertf
title: Great stay
text: Nice big clean room. Staff was great. Helpful. Breakfast was pretty good. About as good as you would expect. Quiet rooms. I would stay here again and would recommend it to family and friends. Nice tv as well.

author: coco-n-gordon
title: Hampton Inn Woodland Ca.
text: Right off the freeway. Easy access. Quite a few restaurants close by. And there was a Walmart and a Costco for getting supplies. The staff at the hotel were A1. They helpful ,attentive and accommodating . The room was clean, comfy and roomy. The breakfast bar had a little something for everyone. They even had a little pool and Jacuzzi with a nice collection of patio furniture to chillax.

author: MaryN949
title: Welcoming Hampton in Woodland
text: This hotel was conveniently located just off of interstate 5 north of the Sacramento airport. I stayed there on business and was very satisfied with the friendly staff, clean and spacious quiet room and comfortable bed. There was also a refrigerator and coffee maker in the room. This hotel was less expensive than comparable hotels in Sacramento (which was about a 20 minute drive away) and the room included complimentary breakfast. The complimentary in-room wifi worked fine to check my email. Premium wifi was available for $4.95. Although I did not use them, there was an outdoor pool and hot tub as well as a room with fitness equipment. There was a shopping center a few miles away and it had restaurants and coffee shops. I will stay at this hotel again if I'm in the area.

author: 302janetv
title: Outstanding Service!
text: Earlier this month I stayed there as part of the Park and Fly package with airport shuttle to Sacramento Airport. As my niece were taking the shuttle to the airport to start a week trip to Mexico, I realized I had left two necklaces in the room. I immediately called them from the airport and they checked the room, while I was still on the line, and assured me they would keep them until I returned. Sure enough, it was there a week later. This was a very sentimental set of necklaces, not replaceable. Thank you Hamptin Inn. See you next week while we take off from there on our next adventure! Excellent breakfast too.

author: I2851YQstevens
title: Business Stay
text: If you have Connie Garcia-Grahling working the front desk when you make your reservation, or when you arrive, you are most fortunate. She is a gem when it comes to customer service. She helped us with our reservation, with places to eat, and our check out process. She is a jewel! We had only passed through Woodland before. This time I was teaching a class for Yolo Transit. The location did not seem central, but it was within 10 minutes of everything in town. For those who drink Starbucks, be sure to try Dutch Brothers Coffee. the ER-911 will last you all day. Several students in the class started with Starbucks, but switched to Dutch Brothers during the class.

author: 66marip
title: wonderful
text: Friendly check in, room smelled and looked great. large and accommodating for 5 people. Breakfast was awesome. Room was very quiet. Chose Woodland for an overnight stay with family who were attending an event at the Sleep Train Arena. Was on and off the Freeway very easy, and minutes to the Arena. I will never stay near the Arena when I can stay at this Hotel. The only negative thing and that was not a big deal, was insufficient parking, which I have found at most hotels anyway. Found a spot on the street which was fine.

author: GerryKurl
title: Filthy Carpets 3rd floor/CIGGY stench
text: Here we go again, another Hampton Inn that is not being properly maintained. I have stayed in many, this one is at the bottom of my list. If you don't believe, take a walk on the 3rd floor, and inspect the carpet from the rooms to the elevator, YUCK. This is a disgrace to the Hilton chain. Also, it was a rainy night, and the carpet around my HVAC was soaking wet. (closest thing to a cleaning I guess) Parking is always full if you go out to dinner, and return. BTW, the highest award in the Hilton Chain is the LIGHTHOUSE award for Hampton Inn properties. Once you stay at a Lighthouse winner, places like the Woodland will be off of your list. Please also note that this HAMPTON STILL ALLOWS SMOKING in some rooms, so it can have the ciggy stench, if you get near those rooms. Breakfast, simple Hampton style, staff friendly,

author: 178lorir
title: Would Stay Again
text: Clean. Nice staff. Very comfortable. Had tea, coffee and hot chocolate and cookies 24/7. Like breakfast right there and included. Location was convenient off freeway and not too far from dining, gas...... Airport only 10min away. Good park and fly program.

author: 202franke
title: Hampton Inn - Woodland, CA
text: Terrible Customer Service, lumpy Beds, Flat Pillows and parking lot was always full in the evening. Would not stay there again. There is a brand new Choice Comfort Suites right next door. Much nicer place, better service and a lot less expensive. We stayed at the Hilton Hampton Inn Woodland for a Wedding, had several rooms reserved and paid for by me. Pretty much all quests in our party felt the same way. Hilton needs to step up their quality control. I've been a Hilton Honors Member for +10 years and will be making other arrangements in the future.

author: limjoco
title: Glad it was just one night
text: We only stayed at this hotel for one night. The hotel itself is adequate. What turned me off is the wad of blonde hair that I found stuck to the wall when I got in the shower. This made me feel as if the room wasn't completely clean. The fitness room was small - only one treadmill and a cross-trainer. So for one night, this was good enough. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. I have absolutely no complaints about the staff. All-in-all, this was fine for one night, but if I would have stayed longer, I would have asked for another, cleaner room.

author: JamesDMo
title: Still Not Quite Up to Usual Hampton Standards
text: I reviewed this hotel about a year and a half ago. It is still true that the room was clean and well-appointed, wireless worked well, breakfast was good. In many ways a typical Hampton Inn, which in my opinion is a very good thing. i was disappointed to see that staff was still an issue. At most Hampton Inns one is greeted warmly upon arrival, thanked for being a Hilton HHonors member (if it applies), and asked if anything else can be done to help make the stay go well. Here I felt like I was interrupting the front desk clerk. No greeting. Nothing other than essentially "here's your key". Being located along a busy Interstate in a town not particularly known as a tourist destination, perhaps they figure everyone is just passing through and may not return - so why make an effort?

author: SusanP148
title: A Gem!
text: Rooms were spotless and attractive, staff smiling , efficient and friendly. Complimentary breakfast was simple but bountiful, refreshed regularly and continuously cleaned. Bright and sunny. Lobby is inviting with complimentary coffee and tea. Excellent robust coffee. Comfortable, clean bed. They even called from the front desk an hour or so after check in too see if everything was satisfactory. Wonderful lodging I an adorable little town.

author: 617erican
title: No surprises
text: My two teenagers and I had a great stay at the Hampton Inn- Woodland. We all enjoyed the pool which was very clean. The kids appreciated the easy wifi access. The room was beautiful, spacious and sparkling clean. Everything in the room and the hotel was in top condition and very comfortable. The breakfast had fresh fruit prepared by hand including pineapple and papaya! We stayed there because I wanted a place with no unpleasant surprises or complications so we could relax in the evening and focus on getting to the airport at 3:30 a.m. the next day. I also noticed that the online reservations, check-in and check-out processes were seamless.

author: 649joelg
title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful stay. Great Breakfast. Helpful staff. clean rooms. everything you expect in a hotel only better. Will stay here again on my next trip. The rooms were clean and quite. The pool was clean and not over chlorinated.

author: rhemagirl
title: Perfect stay, park, fly option
text: We opted to do the stay, park, fly option here and I am so glad we did. The hotel itself is great on every level. Rooms clean, breakfast wonderful, front desk was very helpful. What impressed me most was the shuttle service offered to and from the airport. The morning we flew out a very very nice taxi service picked us up promptly. The hotel staff informed us we didn't have to pay them anything. They took care of it. When we arrived back 8 days later the hotel can picked us up within 15 min and we were resting in the exact same room we stayed at a week previous within less than an hour of landing. Travelling with our one year old son was challenging but this part of the process was a breeze! Highly recommend and will be staying there when flying in the future!!

author: small_trip
title: Comfortable, clean and convenient
text: I am a big fan of the Hampton inn chain and this one lived up to expectations. Great place for a work stay. Large room which was good as my colleague and I had to share for 6 days. Decent breakfast, tea/coffee always available in lobby, washer/dryer to do laundry, fridge in room. Everything was clean and well maintained. This hotel is right by the freeway so 10-15 mins drive from airport, Davis and Sacramento. There is a Target on the other side of the freeway if you need anything. Also a gas station right by hotel so you can fill up a rental car there before returning to airport.

author: stanley443
title: Okay for elsewhere, good for this area (limited choices)
text: If you're wanting to stay around Davis and don't want the 2-star choices, then this is one of the few options outside of staying in Sacramento. Room was nice-sized, nice bathroom. Exercise room was small and poorly equipped. Breakfast was decent but the same boring spread as everywhere else. Beds and pillows were very good. Towels were cheap and scratchy. Fairly expensive for a Hampton Inn but probably reasonable for the area (Northern CA is stupid-expensive). Check-in was poor with some guy in jeans and t-shirt. Not sure if he was even an employee but I got a key so I guess he was. Need some training here.

author: calflyer80
title: An Ordinary Hampton
text: This property is a rather ordinary Hampton with nothing extra to add. It is located adjacent to I-5 slightly to the east of central Woodland. It does have easy access to Sacramento Airport. There is very little competition in the area thus the cost is higher than the value offered. The parking lot is limited thus when busy you may have to park on the street as I did. Overall the customer service is good, the rooms are clean, and the bedding is fine. Just what you would expect at a Hampton. Very good quality at a slightly elevated price given the location sums it up.

author: 430donnaf
title: Hampton Inn in Woodland, CA
text: I booked my reservation in advance and they gave my room away. They said that they were booked up, yet they gave me a room with two beds for one person. Didn't seem to care either. My room also had an adjoining room and I could hear the neighbors talking, coughing, etc., that was uncomfortable. This hotel is too noisy which made it difficult to sleep. I was awakened at 3:30am the first morning, and throughout the night for the next two nights. This hotel is also next to the freeway, so if you don't like car noise, don't stay here. The bathroom needs to be cleaner, especially shower walls.

author: juliesV3615TO
title: Best free breakfast
text: Quick business trip landed us at the Hampton Inn. Everyone was super nice & the free breakfast each morning was really good & nice variety. Over heard a man at the front desk asking what their best rate for the night was. He was told an amount that was $18.00 less than what we paid. I asked to have that same rate & they changed it for us. Thanks Zeehan, you rock!! Rated Averaged on Sleep Quality cuz I'm spoiled by my adjustable bed....so no bed is good enough!! ;)

author: paulcH6312VG
title: Nice Hotel but Paranoid about sports teams
text: Nice hotel with good rooms and great breakfast, but very paranoid about sports teams. Required two page form for you to sign when you entered. Hastled my kid about being in the hall when he was doing nothing but coming back to the room. May have seen other kids on their video but guilt by association. Did not clean room and change towels one day. Claimed they did but we put covers back over the beds and still had dirty towels on bathroom floor. Claimed kids went to pool but they did not let the kids use the pool. Very defensive front desk. It was not the customer friendly attitude I would expect from a Hampton Inn. Not sure what business they have on weekends, but needs to change if they want the sports team business over at Woodland sports complex on the weekends.

author: taunim2014
title: Good stay in Woodland
text: The room and facilities were very clean. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel is conveniently located and easy to access from Interstate 5 and a short drive from the Sacramento airport. The breakfast has a good assortment of options and the coffee is decent, especially given they have a "robust" option. My only complaints with this hotel woudl be that the bed was pretty hard and not the most comfortable, but certainly not the most uncomfortable hotel bed I have ever slept in. The fitness center is a tiny room with an elyptical machine and a treadmill, with a mat on the floor and a few medicine balls, and that is all. I woke early so was able to get in a bit of a workout each morning, but there were plenty of people who looked in and saw there was no room for them. There is the option of a small fee to work out at the very large gym that is located near by. I did not take advantage of this, but someone atttending the same conference as me did and thought it was a very nice gym.

author: JamesDMo
title: Not Quite Up to Usual Hampton Excellence
text: Hampton Inns are one of my favorite places to stay when on the road. This property had the usual clean and well-appointed room, a good wireless signal, a great free breakfast and a generally quiet environment. Where this property fell down in my estimation involved staff, usually a high point of my stay at other Hamptons. Upon check-in the attendant seemed pretty disinterested and I had to ask if they had my Gold membership on file and whether there were any amenities. When there was a problem with the phone messaging system malfunctioning the desk clerk the next morning said they'd take care of it. That did not happen and no follow-up occurred to let me know it would continue to malfunction. Unfortunately for me, the desk clerk working when I checked out was TOO efficient. I gave him my key and, though he saw me going to breakfast, he turned off my wireless access so fast I couldn't use it at breakfast. Some other reviewers have had good luck with staff at this location. My less-than-stellar experience was mid-week, if that helps.

author: chico92
title: Better than expected
text: Hotel stay was better than expected. Easy access off the freeway and there are restaurants nearby. Check in was quick. The room was very clean. No noticeable stains on carpets or walls. Very small exercise room. Breakfast was average at best but the coffee was good. The only drawback was the A/C unit that blew up into the curtains all night and there was not a wall thermostat. It was hard to regulate the room temperature.

author: chat89
title: Convenient to UC Davis, but don't sleep on the couch
text: While visiting someone at UC Davis, I stayed at the Hampton Inn in Woodland because all the hotels in Davis and Vacaville were booked because of a major event at the school. Turns out Woodland is actually closer than Vacaville and you don't have to drive on I-80 which is nice. My trio stayed in a suite with a pull-out couch. Everything about the room was just fine, clean, modern and comfortable. The front desk was very helpful and the breakfast is above the norm for those free breakfasts in the lobby. It had fresh fruit, waffle maker, biscuits and gravy, hot bacon as well as all the usual stuff. The only drawback was the pullout couch. It was torture. I don't know why hotels even bother to advertise these, they are almost always horrid and this one was especially uncomfortable.

author: 663paula663
title: Very Good Hotel
text: Very clean and relatively new with friendly service and convenient location. The breakfast is complimentary and the grounds and overall property were very nicely kept. I stay at this hotel regularly and I have not had any issues. The breakfast offerings include items for adults - not just kids cereals. The hotel is located very close to I-5 on/off-ramp - but not so close there's any noticeable noise. There is a complimentary USA Today newspaper in the lobby and a small "store" that was neat and fairly well-stocked for a hotel offering. Check-in and out was very efficient and the entire stay was geared toward business travlers like myself. I recommend this location and appreciate that Hampton Inns remain a consistent offering everywhere I travel in the U.S.

author: Sierra_Gray_Wolf
title: Good place to stay in Woodland, CA
text: If you go to the Scottish Games in Woodland, this is a good place to stay. When I checked in, they had me on the first floor, but moved me to the third (top) floor when I requested. The rooms are decent and it is clean. Extra towels in the bathroom. The breakfast is actually okay for inclusive-buffet type. Woodland is not known for great hotels, so this might even be the best in town. It is the best one I've found. There are cheaper ones, but I prefer to spend a couple of bucks more for a decent night's sleep and a clean, modern facility.

author: FinallyTime
title: Good Service, Clean Room
text: When I review I start with "Excellent" and deduct from there. In a four day stay I didn't find anything to deduct. The room was clean and ready for my late arrival. It was cleaned daily. I didn't find any dust, nothing was missing, nothing broken. Staff members from front desk to cleaning crew were pleasant. Bed was a little soft, but that's an individual preferance. Internet connection was a little slow, but is that a reason to downgrade a hotel? All in all it had what I was looking for; clean, comfortable, convenient, free internet, and good choices for breakfast,

author: j2552
title: BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL.
text: My wife & I stayed here in June 2012. Got two calls from the manager on my cell after we left asking me to call back which I did twice. Her VM stated that she would be charging me for "damage to the room." - this supposed damage was a crack in the tub. How we were supposed to have done this is unknown to me (we do not weigh over 300 pounds together-but we did not take a shower together so not an issue). In both of my VM back to her I stated that we did not 'damage the room' and to please call me back. She never did. They charged my credit card $250 for this 'damage.' BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL. TAKE PICTURES OF YOUR ROOM & BATHROOM IF YOU STAY HERE. I have been a Hilton Honors member since 96, have traveled all over the world for the last 20 years and this is the first time that I have ever had a hotel charge for such a thing

author: minimyzr
title: Staff is Top-Notch
text: The staff here are among the most helpful I have ever dealt with. I'm a Diamond member, and travel 100% so helpfullness is a high commodity. The BCenter printer cartridge was out --- the site is unable to find replacement cartridges. The counter staff was more than accomodating to get me through this issue. I needed a wine stor for a dinner party.....again, they hit a home run, finding all stores on the route I was taking....we actually found one that was so much more convenient than my GPS indicated. What a pleasure to stay here. Friendly and personable. Highly recommend the Woodland, CA HI!!

author: AKO75
title: Functional, Close to the Airport
text: Overall: This was a less than 12 hour stay. My business colleagues and I needed a place to stay close to the airport so that we could drive to our business meeting in the morning. Check in: Not a problem, we checked in fairly late, around 9:30 PM on a Monday night. The person who checked us in was functional; however not the most friendliest. He got the job done. Rates: Room rate was $129 no resort fee. Room: I stayed in 110. Layout was fine, lighting was dim. There was a faint body odor smell that was pervasive in the room. If I had stayed more than one night, I would have asked to change rooms, but for one night I could live.

author: pipermama
title: Very convenient location.
text: We stayed 2 nights at this hotel to attend the Scottish Highland Games in Woodland. It was very conveniently located to Yolo County Fairgrounds. We could walk to a couple of fast food places. Within close proximity to restaurants and shopping. The hotel itself was clean, comfortable, and quiet. I only give it a rating of 4 because the elevators were super slow. Also, every time we went through the lobby there was no one at the front desk. I thought that was strange and rather inconvenient. Otherwise. A very nice place to stay.

author: Tidsreisende
title: Nice Hampton, very convenient
text: I stay here regularly when I'm taking the early flight out of SMF. It's better than the Natomas places in my opinion and a much better value. The staff is great and very friendly. The rooms are clean and comfortable. I leave too early to have breakfast but I'm sure it's as good as the rest of the experience here. I've used their airport shuttle a couple times and it was very good. This was the main reason I started staying here, but now I stay even though I don't use the shuttle just because I like it better. There are some decent chain restaurants close by to grab a bite for dinner.

author: Bearjammies
title: Great hotel, but the one next door was cheaper.
text: We stayed in this hotel on our way down to Long Beach and then in the Holiday Inn Express coming back up. Both were very similar in amenities. Both had very similar rooms and fairly large bathrooms. The Hampton uses white sheets and coverlets which is always pleasing as far as cleanliness goes. They also provide a really great continental breakfast with fresh fruit, biscuits & gravy, eggs and a large selection of pre-packaged food. On the downside the outdoor pool is really small and very deep even in the 'shallow' end. This hotel was also $40 more than the one next door and we had a problem with our tv in that only every other channel had sound. We didn't bother to complain as the channel we mostly watched was one that happened to have sound. We really enjoyed our stay but if I had to choose again I'd choose the other one.

author: momziekins
title: Amazing Palace in the desert
text: When trying to drive from Seattle to L.A., thru miles of nothingness, its good to stop and rest in a scrumptious motel! And I have found it! This is my 2nd Hampton Inn experience and won't be my last. Lovely inside & out with terrific staff! Night desk was especially kind & comedic when my mother & I locked ourselves out of our room! Free breakfast was far above average. I am so spoiled now that I always will want a fridge & microwave in my room! I truly will look for Hampton Inns first whenever I need a motel in future! (They even have the cutest lap desks for you to work from while in bed! I used mine to write postcards!)

author: GeoffH280
title: Glorious location in an extermely interesting town
text: The hotel is easy to find on the banks of the river rigjht in the mioddle of the old town. Yes the hotel car park is often full but there is plenty of free parking further down the road so no problem. the rooms aren't huge and traditional but spotlessly clean. We stayed for 6 nights - the first night was at the back of the hotel but we upgraded to the front with a balcony for an extra 20 euros a night which was well worth it - and the wonderful friendly staff actually moved our luggage for us. The new room 222 was right underneath the swimming pool pump which went continuously from 8.00 am until 9.00 pm but only a problem if you wanted an afternoon doze and actually no louder than the (very effective) air con. Not all of the riverfront rooms have a balcony and our balcony was not covered in which was a shame as we had considerable rain (mid August). Although facing the old town we found the hotel very quiet A fridge would have been nice but shops are close by. We didn't have breakfast at the hotel and only ate there one lunchtime but the 3 course meal was pretty good and excellent value. A lovely stay, lots to do and see close by and the annual music festival in August is worth catching. Can thoroughly recommend this hotel.

author: SunnySenior
title: Great place to relax after a day of sightseeing
text: We stayed here for two nights while on a two week trou of southern France. We were very pleased with everything about the hotel. When coming into town, just remember to turn left shortly before the river, or you'll miss the hotel! Our room overlooked the river and the town on its other side. After an easy check-in, we were off to roam the old town and find a place to have dinner. Located an excellent pizza restaurant just a block or so into the town area, and dined both nights there. There is a charge for hotel parking, but the lot is just across the street, and while not large, we didn't have a problem finding an empty space. Figeac is well located for day trips out into the river valley and the Best Western Le Pont d'Or is the perfect choice for a good night's rest after touring.

author: TravellingJan
title: A great place in a great location!
text: This hotel is perfectly located for sightseeing in Figeac! It's just across the main bridge from the medieval town, so it's a 2 minute walk and you don't have to get into traffic or narrow streets at all. There was parking across the street, so we dropped our car, checked in, and walked into town. It was so easy to come back and relax over wine in our room with a view of the river and the town, then walk back into town for dinner...but then we looked at the terrace where the hotel restaurant was serving, overlooking the river and the town, and decided to eat there with the wonderful view. The foot was great and the ambiance was even better. We walked into town after dinner and then again after breakfast to further explore. The hotel was quieter than I expected being so close to the bridge, but it's on a side street. The room was very nice, the front desk staff helpful...all in all I really liked this place much more than I would have expected from a chain hotel and would stay there again. A hassle free and very nice place to stay in a very interesting city.

author: 408micahb
title: Dirty as hell
text: The whole hotel is very dirty. The cheap laminate floors are all worn and peeling. The whole room smelt of drainage. The decorative bed blanket had sex juices on it from previous guests and the cleaner kept putting the same dirty one back on the bed each day after I threw it on the floor. The walls, curtains and headboard all had stains on them. The shower was not only old and dirty but also had a door broken off. The walls are very thin so you’ll hear all your neighbour’s conversations and activity. Only pros were that all the receptions were lovely and the location is great. And that they gave us a room with a nice balcony like we requested.

author: georgiosb854
title: Great location - nice hotel
text: Nice hotel located 3min walk from a metro station. Also it is walking distance from Montmartre (20min walk) or Opera (30min). The rooms were clean but can be small or huge - we were two couples and one had a tiny room, while the other one had a huge one. The bathroom was clean and they provide shower supplies as well as a hair drier. The hotel has elevator, so no issues with heavy luggage. We haven't tried the breakfast, so I cannot comment on that. But there are many bakeries, supermarket, cafes and restaurant in the neighborhood. Small surprise was that on Saturdays' morning there is a farmers market one block away with fresh products. I will definitely booked it again if I visit Paris again.

author: 106tripk
title: Nice Small Hotel
text: October 2017 we took a trip of a life time. It started here at Hotel B Square. We stayed here our first couple of nights in Paris. It was a very nice small hotel. The rooms were small but comfortable. Décor was nice. Good breakfast. The proprietor was helpful and even let our luggage while we waited for our rental car was getting ready. Would go back if we ever make it back to Paris.

author: endrebremnesa
title: Small room, scruffy, smelly, warm, humidity, but with a location we liked.
text: We kind of expected a small room because of the "norm" in Paris, and we were not "disappointed". It was very small. The main problem was, however, that our room (104) was warm, had humidity problem, no air con, cracked (spaced) floor boards and floorboards with serious water damages (big lumps). I even suspect that the room has some toxic black mold issues..Trying to open the windows to get some "fresh air" (it`s next to a busy road) meant not being able to sleep. So you had to choose..No sleep because of noise/some sleep but wake up coughing and with heavy chestpain etc.. But the location was good! We liked the neigbourhood. Nearest street being Rue de Dame with nice atmos, cafes and small shops. Not far from Montmartre etc.

author: nandos1988
title: Really good hotel can't fault it
text: I was very pleased with all aspects of my hotel, me and my girlfriend went away for her birthday to spend a few days in Paris. The hotel was very close to many bars and restaurants and just as close to the Paris metro. The hotel itself was clean and tidy providing a quite small but lovely room. It was decorated well and in a road that wasn't very loud. They provided a fridge which I thought was great and decent heating was a pleasing added touch as it was very cold outside. The bathroom was small but effective with a great shower (really great). I used the breakfast once as 11 euros per person seemed steep, however it was a decent quality also and the dining area was small but lovely. If I was being picky, the pillows were my frustration with awkward shapes and softness. The lighting wasn't great also but I really can't see this as a problem as I would definatly use this hotel again and probably will as would love to go back to Paris.

author: Lo_0920
title: Very nice hotel with kind stuff
text: Hotel is placed in a great neighborhood close to metro. Staff was helpfull. They even checked us in before check in time and also took care of our baggage on our check out. Room was cosy and big enough to enjoy and to have a rest. Everything was very clean. The only problem was when you open a window you look in other wall. Not so big deal for us but the air could not circulate well so we had to turn on the air condition which I hate. Anyway we had a great time!

author: SamH4589
title: Helpful, Comfortable, Very Good
text: My girlfriend and I visited for her birthday in July 2016. We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. The staff were incredibly helpful with everything we asked them and spoke very good english. We paid for a kingsize bed and bath and they were both very nice. The room is small but, it is just a hotel room at the end of the day. The bathroom was very nice and modern. The hotel could do with a bit of a deeper clean behind the sinks in the bathrooms and a touch of paint along the bottom of the walls. And a ceiling light rather than just the lamps but minor things to improve on after an excellent stay and a very enjoyable holiday. Hotel is really close to the Rome metro station. We bought 7 day passes for the metro and RER across paris for €26 each which took us from the airport around paris on the metro and to disneyland and back and allowed us to get on busses although we chose not to...

author: 549elmaa
title: Small but good
text: We were a couple staying in Hotel B Square for 2 nights. The rooms were clean and good air conditioner, but the room itself was extremely small. One small room only and tiny bathroom. Dont know if it was only our room or all of the others aswell. The people who worked there was nice though! 10 minutes walk from muilin rouge. Would reccomend stay there for 1-2 nights only. Perfect for that.

author: 222villaf
title: Pleasantly surprised and satisfied
text: The hotel was easily accessible from the underground. The surrounding neighborhood was very nice and walking a couple of blocks either way gave some interesting sightseeing. :-) The hotel was about a 5min walk from the main road but the hotel was in a quiet location so no noise issues. The room size might not be up to everyone's expectation but most important it was clean, neat and you really just want a place to sleep - not live in. Any room on the 5th floor is great as it has a little balcony with chairs and table, great to enjoy a pre-drink before wondering the streets of Paris. The staff was very nice. The breakfast was traditional, but tasty and clean. We really enjoyed our 3 night stay at Hotel B Square.

author: IvyGar
title: Small comfortable Hotel with great location and very friendly staff
text: Had read other comments before booking this Hotel. Have to say from our own experience that we were extremely pleased with the Hotel. When we arrived, after my partner had his wallet stolen on the Metro (please be very, very careful) that the staff were most helpful, allowing us to use their telephone to sort out banking and credit cards in England. The room was small but more than adequate for our stay. Clean, had tea and coffee making facilities, hair drier, toiletries. Bed comfortable. All requests dealt with immediately. Breakfast very good. Ideal location. We would most certainly visit this Hotel again.

author: Tomaszeks
title: Nice but be careful
text: The hotel is nice and tidy. Well located and breakfast was decent. Rooms quite small but again nice and cosy. The toilet is in the separate chamber to the shower and sink so this might be an issue for some. Why such low rating so? Because we have been overcharged, looks like we been charge twice for breakfast. Upon complaint the issue was recognised and a written note left for the manager. We been assured that they will charge according to the invoice and then issue a refund for incorrectly charged amount. After credit card statement arrived, yes you guessed it, the full, incorrect amount was charged and no sign of the refund.

author: Dermy76
title: Good for Paris
text: Good value 3 star hotel with really good staff and service, clean, good located (between Place de Clichy and Rome metro station, next to Bvd. Batignolles, in the Rue de Batignolles),in the 17th arrondissement, in the heart of the former village of Batignolles famous for its English-style square, shops and many small restaurants. Metro lines 13 and 2 are within 5 minutes walking distance. Ideally located close to the Moulin Rouge, Montmartre Nice surroundings, although the real Parisienne life is happening at least 5 minutes walk away. So it is good located and really good value. There is a bit noise from the street, but if your balcony windows are closed it would not be bothering at all. Higher the floors are, less is the noise. Breakfast is basic, costs 11€, good coffe, yoghurt, fruit salad, ham, etc. Clean hotel, wi-fi was working ok, staff was friendly, prices were more than nice for Paris, rooms quite average, but this hotel was renovated in 2012 so it is refurnished and functional.

author: DerStreuner
title: Excellent Hotel in comfortable Environment.
text: We stayed at this hotel for 5 Nights in august 2014 and had a quite nice stay there. Yes the room is small, but it's Paris and they even fitted some more furniture in, The hotel is well located in northern central Paris, montmatre. There are 2 Supermarkets near by and you even got a minibar to store some food in. As well as a safe.(Which did not work for us, because it was broken) Especially the shower was nice, "Raindrop"Shower. The Breakfast was quite charming,too. You had more than just a croissant, you got some baguette plus some variete of cheese and ham. Marlemleda etc. To summerize it all, we had a really good stay here too the Price of an Hostel. Would recommend it ever again. cheers folks

author: Werckmeister
title: Good location, amazing staff
text: Hotel B Square's rooms, like many small hotels in Paris, are pretty small. But despite the lack of size, it was still quite cozy - I slept well, and even had a nice view from my room. The rooms do have some wear & tear, but nothing to be concerned about. Location is amazing - lots of nice restaurants, and very near to the Rome and Place de Clichy metros. Breakfast isn't a big selection, but it was fine. Wifi was spotty at times though. But the staffs is what made it memorable - a young lady checked me in, and she was very helpful and courteous. She also let me check out late, which I was thankful for. So overall, I'd recommend it for the location and the service.

author: fay0108
title: Happy with the choice
text: Being the first trip to Paris, I was pleased with this selection. We came prepared for a small room (which is common in most parts of Europe) hence there was no surprise there. We had small struggles with storage / wardrobe as we had quite a few winter clothing with us. Pleasant to find toiletries in the bathroom when we had been "warned" it is not such a standard thing in Europe as practiced in most other countries, and the fact there was heater too. It is clean and bed was comfortable for us. Had some troubles locating the hotel at first, but once we had our bearing figured out, it was easy - and hotel is situated about 5 minutes walk to Rome Metro station. Do practice a few basic French like hello, thank you ... they take you a long way.

author: FEBennett
title: Great remodel - great service - exactly as advertised
text: Having stayed at the old Hotel Batignolles Villiers which was old and very tired, I am pleased there is much more behind Hotel B Square than just a name change! Staff is friendly and helpful. My single on the top floor was small, but spotless, with a flat screen and nice bed. The family suite on the ground floor was perfect for the weekend with four people. Very roomy for Paris standards. Nice that the "kids bed" was around a corner from the main bed, giving everyone a sense of privacy. Yes, the location IS away from the tourist traps, in the lovely 17th district. This is a neighborhood, really a village feel. Metro is convenient to go to all the sites. Pleanty of restaurants in every direction (I recommend Ripaille around the corner).

author: MargotS980
title: Perfect room, average location, reception ok-ish
text: Me and my friend stayed here for 2 nights. The room was nice and clean. The save didn't work and when we called the reception the answer was "I'm too busy sorry, I will come tomorrow". Unfortunatly that was the same answer we got the next day. Also when we asked for help to call a taxi for us or at least give us a taxi phone number we got a "No". (We were stuck in snowy Oberkampf. Apparently it's not easy to get a taxi at night in Paris.) The hotel itself is in a nice area. Enough choice to have a nice drink or dinner, get a pain au chocolat and also handy: your cash. The metro station is a 5 min walk.

author: Marleen1974
title: Very good hotel, friendly staff, good location
text: Hotel B Square was everything they said on their website. They have very clean rooms, and the bathroom was very clean too. Room was Paris size, small but comfortable. Bathroom was rather spacious for Paris standards. Location of the hotel was very good, not close to most major tourist attractions (except for Montmarte and Moulin Rouge region), but Metro will take you everywhere in town. There's a car parking across the street in the Mairie of the 17th arrondissement. Metro station Rome was very nearby, only a few minutes walking distance. In the neighbourhood were lots of cafés, restaurants etc. Breakfast was good, fresh bread, croissants, pastry, hard boiled eggs, juice, fruit, yoghurt, cereals and of course coffee, even decaf if you want. I would definately recommend this hotel to everyone.

author: ALKEW
title: Comfortable & Convenient
text: stayed 3 nights and is satisfied with the service rendered. Room is very clean with modern deco, a very simple bathroom with rain shower but no bathtub for mine, but its not a problem. Although the room is without a view, but it was ok as i am out and about most of the time. Huge Plasma TV with a very comfortable bed and pillows that can make you snooze right away. The only downside is that the internet connection although is an in-room wifi but it kepts disconnect for few hours and you have to log-in again.Well the speed of wifi is ok. And the room is without much amenities except for the tea on top of the minibar, unless you will be staying in the room most of the time then its an issue, if not, its still adequate for me. Reception is small and only one person at a time to attend to guests on most time (since the hotel is smaller in scale), but they are helpful , friendly and very accommodating. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Paris, but be sure to get the street right before arriving or you might not have a clue where its exact location is like i did. This hotel is right behind a bus stop (for bus service 66) which is super convenient for leisure guest going for shopping at haussmann or printemps as it goes to he Opera direction. Metro is only a 5 minutes walk away and i would suggest travellers who will be taking the RER to CDG to be ready to carry your luggage down the stairs to the metro as Rome station has no elevator or lift , well for most stations in Paris there aren't as well.

author: AngelicaS299
title: Pleasantly surprised
text: This was my second time in Paris and I was not familiar with the Place de Clichy area where this hotel is located. As I exited the Rome metro station, I was a bit disappointed, but the closer I got to the hotel, the more I could see it was definitely a lively area. There was enough going on where I felt safe, but not too much that it was over-run with tourists. The Place de Clichy metro stop is very convenient and it's just 2 stops from the St. Lazare metro/train stop. My wi-fi wasn't working the first night, which was a bit of a drag, but it was quickly repaired by the next morning. I would definitely recommend this to a friend. I am a solo traveler, so safety was my number one concern, and this was located in a really good area, and I never felt unsafe.

author: Firecracker29
title: Lovely Chic Hotel in Place de Clichy
text: My new husband and I were looking for an off the beaten path boutique hotel for our 3 days in Paris on our honeymoon. Affordable but not too far out of town, Batignolles was perfect for this! The room was much more chic than we were expecting, stark whites and deep reds, but the bed was comfortable, the bathroom was clean and everything was very modern. It was a small room, and even though the bathroom was modern, it was split in two and the sink is in the room with the shower, which is slightly inconvenient. The concierges were always courteous, gave us great ideas of good places to eat nearby, and they even loaned us a very nice umbrella on a rainy day and an iron and stand for my dinner dress! It is close to Moulin Rouge and the Sacre Coeur, and in between two very convenient Metro stops. Nearby, on Sundays, is the the market with fresh fruits, veggies and even meats and cheeses. Most places aren't even employed by people who speak English well. If you want to stay in a nice boutique hotel and experience Paris like the locals, while still being close to the sights, this is the perfect spot!

author: 656CarolH
title: April in Paris
text: I found this hotel more or less by accident, browsing online, and I'm so glad I did! It is located with an easy walk of two Metro stations, and very close to Montmartre. My room was quiet and comfortable, and my stay was most enjoyable. The staff were lovely. On arriving I was given a guide booklet which I proceeded to use constantly for the next 5 days. The breakfasts were great, and the breakfast room was clean, bright, and inviting. I also appreciated having access to the guest computer to check email. Merci, mes amis!

author: cristinaf_12
title: Spotless! Very nice staff.
text: Stayed there as I had to attend a conference in that area. The hotel is modernly decorated in a tasteful manner. Conveniently located, the metro is a 3 minute walk. I was impressed with how clean they keep everything (you can see your reflection on the floor, lol!). Staff was truly nice, and helpful. They also let me check out earlier, which was appreciated as I had a 18 hr flight! Only complaint is that it was a little noisy, walls aren't very thick and they were also doing renovations. I'd stay there again. Good value.

author: GeorgiaNZ89
title: Good value in an expensive city
text: My partner and I stayed at Batignolles Villiers for 5 nights in February this year. The location was good, a bit far out of the central city but for the price it was good. It is located near the Rue de Clichy and the Moulin Rouge, great for a night time adventure, and within walking distance of Montmartre and Sacre-coeur. For excursions that are a bit further afield the metro was perfect, located a short 5 minute walk away. There were plenty of places to eat in the area, from mcdonalds and kfc to great restaurants, and supermarkets for self catering. The room itself was clean but quite old, the decor was dated, panels in the bathroom ceiling were missing so you could see the air conditioning ducts. However, this was the first hotel I have seen in Europe with tea and coffee making facilities and a fridge, a major plus for travellers on a budget. The staff were friendly and helpful. It was clean and comfortable and very good value, you couldn't expect much more for the price you're paying.

author: Emer58
title: Affordable hotel with hard-working, friendly staff
text: We've been before in this hotel, but since the beginning of this year (2012) it has new owners. They are redecorating the hotel at the moment, but they keep the hassle for the guests to a minimum. The breakfast room is already done, and it's marvellous. A Jura coffee machine makes all the types of coffee you want, there is a chocolate milk machine, several kinds of marmelad and of course eggs, cheese, ham, yoghurt. All rooms have a flat screen TV now and the possibility to make your won cup of coffee/tea in the room. The hotel is quiet, but in the immediate surrounding of the Place de Clichy and there are several metro lines, so it's always easy to visit one of the many attractions of the city. But, last but not least, all the hotel staff is very friendly. They speak English very well and they do their utmost to make you feel comfortable. Of course, don't expect a four-star bedroom, but the place is clean and the beds are comfortable. We will definitely come back and recommend this hotel to our friends and colleagues.

author: myz1210
title: great boutique hotel and friendly staff
text: The hotel is very conveniently located and the rooms are very clean and comfortable enough. The hotel staffs are very friendly and speak English very well. They are always available and willing to help guests with their needs: from recommending good place to eat to helping guest finding out their ways to see the sights... We booked a total of 7 nights with them and it was during the new year holiday. we had to check out the hotel on new year eve because the hotel was completely book for that night. we left our luggage with the staff and checked in another hotel outside of the city on new year eve. upon our return on new year day, we were pleasantly surprsied that the staff has already moved our luggage to our new room. We definitely enjoyed our stay there and would most certianly recommend this hotels to our friends. Can't wait to go back visit Paris again and I would definitely stay there again.

author: marissann
title: Lots of potential
text: Stayed here in January for 3 nights got a really cheap deal. Was very apprehensive about going.. Room was very dated needed a good clean & refurbished (though from reading some reviews maybe in the process of being refurbished) but it was spacious we didn’t use any of the kitchen facilities as we only were there for 4 days though I’m not sure I would of used them very old. Our room backed on to the main road if I was staying here longer I I would of asked to be moved but we didn’t spend much time in the room). Pool area lovely and spacious one pool seemed to have been refurbished but the other 2 needed a bit of tlc & receptionist friendly & helpful. Just had the one drink at the pool bar again staff friendly pleasant. Enjoyed the Zanzibar just across the road friendly staff. I really think this place has potential and if was refurbished it would be ideal for families. I will definitely return to Caleta de Fueste I really enjoyed this quiet beautiful resort I would return here again if I got the same deal though there is lots of other reasonably priced accommodation nearer to the main resort.

author: by_norkute
title: Value for money - recommend!
text: This is a complex hotel with quite big area including 2 outdoor pools, bar, market, laundry service. Accommodation is around all area in white one floor bungalow apartments. One bedroom apartment had outdoor terrace with table and chairs, main room with sofa and small kitchen (including necessary things to cook), bedroom (with double bed, wardrobe, night tables), bathroom. The bungalow is not new, there is smell inside, so we left the doors and windows open during the day. If you expect really clear and new apartments, do not go, but if economy style with quite clean room but old inventory is not a problem, when visit and book definitely. Because price and value is really suitable. Hotel area is nice, green and clear, next to complex hotel is big Dino super market. The way to the ocean is about 10-15mins walk. The hotel is on the hill, so you can see nice panorama.

author: Emmabeck78
title: Don’t bother
text: Room one clean in a week. Was dirty when we arrived everything faulty. Flys all over due to the uncleanliness of communal areas. Room by road and bottlebank so noisy. Chavs bring Loud in bar. Topless bathers please stick to nudest beach. Will be complaining to tour operator as reception useless. Not even worth paying the cheap pennies we did. Will never recommend or return.

author: TreeR27
title: Get what you pay for
text: This was and still is a time share resort. There are bungalows that are rented out to holiday makers but they are not the standard owners should be given. Many people are complaining however as owners we would prefer holiday makers to respect our site that way things would remain in better condition. We pay yearly maintenance for the upkeep of things for example new sun beds etc. Therefore please respect things when you visit and remember you only get what you pay for in this life. As owners we would prefer a non smoking area of the bar although our requests have been ignored. Maid service is fantastic if you’re an owner you are not automatically given this as a regular service if you have come on a budget deal. Stop moaning people because as owners we are the ones with the rights to complain not you.

author: MichelleHill33
title: cheap break
text: we stayed in room 25, we arrived on 3/11 for 7 nights. The rooms are what I expected they was clean enough although a little dated. I did do my own deep clean though as it smelt a little damp in the room. Soon sorted that out. The service we received from the reception staff Lola and Brenda was exceptional and thank you for the help in sorting our few nagging details when we encountered a few difficulties with our accommodation. The pools where clean and plenty of sun loungers around them. The area is a short walk to the town and the beaches. We had an overall pleasant experience .and would stay again. Just a tip if your expecting the ritz its not the place for you however it is just a place to sleep. Plenty of places to eat in the town our favourite was Aberdeen Angus.

author: Annaskiing
title: 1 Star, 2 Star Tops - Terrible start saved by Flavia in Reception
text: We arrived in the pouring rain both inside and outside our apartments. We had no 72 (water pouring through the ceiling in the bedroom on the floor and the bed) and no 73 (slightly yellow water coming up through the floor). I was moved to the "emergency" apartment no. 79 - I wouldn't recommend this box but at least it was dry and we mopped up no 72's floor as best we could. We went back to reception in the morning and thankfully after some hard work by Flavia (not helped by her management) we were moved to two different apartments. They were still pretty basic but at least we could concentrate on enjoying the holiday rather than taking in the musty smell from our original apartments and the noise from the bar that was right next door. The main pool is in dire need of refurbishment, I wouldn't be surprised if there haven't been some injuries from all the broken mosaic tiles. I would definitely not stay here again if you paid me.

author: jent332019
title: GOOD...READ
text: Stayed here for a week, got back yesterday. On arrival & throughout our stay the reception staff were amazing & can english well. Our apartment (#10) was a 2 bedroom apartment was very clean (the fridge had been bleached)...sign of wear & tear but nothing was unexpected. Downside the sheets weren't cleaned often enough, the curtains were voils & the wooden doors didnt feel secure. Was slightly concerned after booking then reading the reviews to be happily surprised. The complex has 3 pools which 2 are exceptional, the main pool is being renovated very soon due to the mosaics tiles being loose. The complex is situated at the top of the hill, the paths are awful if disabled or in a pushchair,but i have heard there being tarmac'd. There is a train which picks up close to the supermarket charging €2 each n takes you down to the beach.The supermarket is close by along with many bars/restaurants. I defo would recommend these apartments and would happily stay again.

author: castofthousands
title: Relaxing stay, fantastic staff!
text: After reading some of the reviews on here I thought my Missus was going to kill me upon arrival here BUT it couldn't have been nicer. Reception staff greeted us, gave us advice on things to see/do etc, our apartment was lovely, no problems with bugs etc, clean, tidy and for the price we paid top value for money, we've stayed in more expensive places elsewhere which were not as nice. Pool area and bar were great, loads of sunbeds for all and bar great for snacks and drinks. Supermarket/ bars/restaurants just a couple of minutes walk away and downtown a leisurely 15 minute walk. We had one issue during our stay when our kettle died, I called over to the lady on reception to report it and went across to the shop for a few items, by the time I had got back a new kettle had been delivered! For anyone with mobility issues, the walk uphill from town might be a problem but taxi's are plentiful and cheap, €3 including a tip will get you back from most places or you can use the road train for €2 per person, it stops just beside the Hiperdino supermarket across from the complex. All in all the true test of a place is 'would I stay here again?', the answer is definitely 'Yes'. If you want 5 star luxury then pay the extra and stay elsewhere, if you want a cheap, clean,tidy base with all you need then this place ticks all the boxes.

author: elliottholiday
title: Clear signs of ongoing renovation - overall good value
text: I spent four nights at Fuerteventura Beach Club in early September and had overall a positive experience, for the price we paid. We pulled the short straw staying in one of the more dated apartments, we had a issue with bugs in the apartment which probably wouldn't have been an issue if the windows and doors were double glazed as the neighbouring apartments were. The balcony furniture hadn't been cleaned and was covered in pigeon crap. Everything else is what you would expect for a cheap break, usual stuff in the kitchen and a clean bathroom. Similarly to the divided apartments, there were two pool areas, one with a bar and the other which had recently been renovated and kept very clean. Pool bar was well priced and offered a good selection of food and drink. Reception staff were very helpful and accommodating, we had an issue with our toilet flush upon arrival but the engineer arrived within 5 minutes! Again, I can see the complex is on its way up with clear signs of investment so I would imagine my review will be out of date before 2019.

author: SamM341
title: Great cheap family holiday
text: We stayed here in August for 2 weeks and had a wonderful time with a couple that came with us. This hotel is very dated and the rooms really really need a good sort out and even a decent paint touch up would make a bit of a difference... however this didn’t take away from a great holiday. We stopped by the quietest pool which was beautiful, we were there every day! The zanzibar was brilliant, staff were lovely and very helpful, they ordered food for us and we were able to eat it at the bar. No entertainment however we weren’t overly bothered about that as the acts the bar provided made up for it. Loads of bars and a really good supermarket was only 100m away from our front door. All in it was a really good holiday, basic accommodation but friendly staff and an attitude to take everything as it comes and find the positives rather than the negatives is needed x

author: GeorginaM1185
title: Okay
text: We arrived 12th august for a 2 week stay. A family of 4 2 adults 10 year old and 22 month old baby. I was crying the night before we arrived because of all the reviews and seriously was stressing that we would have to book somewhere else when we arrived. We stayed in apartment 58 by the pool that has been done up. Room was very dated but it was clean. Maid came 4 times in the 2 weeks towels changed twice and bedding once. We did request clean sheets to do the bed ourselves from reception. For the price we paid we couldnt moan and we would stay here again. We walked most nights into the main town food was lovely. Gutted we found chaplins 2 nights before we left which was a couple of minutes from the apartment staff lovely and food was amazing especially the fish and chips.

author: 692suzannea
title: You pay for what you get
text: Ok so first of all this place is really not as bad as many people say . Yes it's tired it's dated and really could do with some tlc but I paid £240 for a week in August everywhere else was far more expensive . Staff are nice well the ones that I had to deal with . Nice pools ,pool bar looked nice wasn't in it but was busy enough . We did experience a good few cockroaches in the apartment but it's to be expected and there is spray in the rooms to get rid . Cleaner came once throughout our stay and gave fresh towels , yeah in other self catering apartments iv had a cleaner in about 5 times throughout my 7 day stay but there was a brush and a bucket and mop if your really that bothered about it. This hotel is up a hill so if your not to great at walking wouldn't advise although plenty of places to hire scooters if needed . There's the centre about 2 mins along the road few bars and restraunts which we used a few times and also nestors and the Zanzibar which we didn't use as we are fit enough to walk up and down to the main centre although on a roasting hot day was hard work . Overall had a lovely holiday and yeah may return again unless can try somewhere else for same price . Do not come if expecting 5 stars as you won't get that here

author: TripCrazyTracey
title: My husband, myself and our two teenage sons had a Wonderful time!
text: I booked through booking.com, this is the best way to ensure a better elite villa. I was a bit apprehensive after reading some reviews but the site is really great. First of all - if you book a cheap deal through a cheaper site you will get more simple and basic accommodation, it is definitely you get what you pay for. The little villa we had was lovely, beds were comfy and my two teenage sons never complained about any of the accommodation for the whole week. There were loads of channels on the tv to keep them occupied and the swimming pools were lovely. One pool has missing tiles and definitely needs more upkeep. The other pool (the left one) was perfect The staff were very friendly and helpful The location was enough out of the main part of caleta that it was not noisy, but close enough for a nice easy walk into town. The supermarket hyperdino is right across the road and there is a brutish supermarket for things like teabags I would definitely come here again, and intend to next month!

author: Leanne_Cochrane
title: Leanne Cochrane, East Lothian.
text: We have just returned from here after staying for a week. We cannot fault it at all. For the price we paid it was lovely and will more that likely definitely return. It was myself, husband Thomas and kids Carmen (10) & Brad (7). The kids spent the majority of their time jumping in and out the pool. We stayed in apartment number 58, was perfect and the balcony over looked the pool, with steps to the side to take you down (as you can see in photo). The staff were all very welcoming. First time to Fuerteventura and will defo be back.

author: suetithecott
title: Pre war beach huts
text: Just spent a week here. Never ever again. The 'Bungalows' were so old and tatty and the furniture was fit for the bin. Couldn't sit on the sofa at all as it was falling to bits. Had a hole in my mattress with a big broken spring sticking through. Had scratches all over my backside. All the flower beds were inches deep in cigarette butts. Cleaners came once and never even changed the towels. If I had booked longer than a week I would have moved elsewhere.

author: melaniea35
title: Great resort 😬
text: Arrived 2 days ago! Staying in apartments 4 & 48! Don’t listen to bad reviews! Spotless and staff wonderful! Elite pool bar amazing and food is great and very good prices! Will definitely return! Not tried Zanzibar as only had our first proper night here last night but looks good with entertainment most nights. Such a shame that people put in bad reviews. Considering we mostly do 4 or 5 stars this really is excellent for the rating and was just a last minute get away to the sun. Only 10 minute walk to centre or taxi just u Dee 4 euros 😬

author: avmanUk
title: Just a Tip
text: We are here now. We looked at all and other reviews, here is ours. Got here on a very... Very Cheap holiday for 10 Day's including flights. In short, works have been done (ask for chalet's 30's to 40's). Pool has been renewed and is very good. Rooms (ours) is very clean, tidy, good bedding, and towels. Early in season so very quiet. I will review Town over the time we are here.

author: vickim257
title: Great week away
text: I was a little bit nervous about arriving at apartments after reading the reviews, but my boyfriend and I had a great week away. We were in apartment 73 across from Zanzibar and were quite happy. The apartment was clean and tidy and had everything we needed. Yes, I agree with some comments about the cleaners, we only had them in once during the week, but we went to reception and asked for clean towels and they were supplied no problem. The Spanish and uk supermarkets were literally a minutes walk from where we were. Also When booking don’t book transfers, it was roughly €13 for a taxi from airport straight to apartments. Nestors restaurant was incredible and I would highly recommend! I had 2 of the best meals all week and actually wished we had went there for dinner every night as on one occasion we went to an Indians and I got served raw chicken. Would definatly return to apartments.

author: paulnM572BM
title: Ok for the price
text: We like to have a lot of low cost holidays rather than blow all of our money on one luxury holiday so we don't expect too much for the price we pay for accommodation. The Fuerteventura beach club is not the best place we have stayed but also not the worst. The rooms are tired and in need of a refurbishment. The complex looks as though it would have been very nice a few years ago but is in need of a total refurbishment. They where doing work on one of the pools and it looked like some parts have been improved so far. The location is fine with around a ten minute walk to the main resort but again the area around the hotel is all tired and a bit run down. There is a good supermarket just across the road and a bar and restaurant in the middle of the complex that looked ok but we didn't use them as there are plenty of good places in Caleta.
