The housekeeping only changed the sheets and towels once in the week . The pool area is nice with a few loungers and a little bar but again we didn't spend much time there. We have stayed in Caleta a few times before and really like the resort, i would still consider staying at the Fuerteventura Beach Club again as long as it stays cheap or if they give it all a makeover .

author: lauralbryant
title: Cheap and very chearfull. In a good way
text: We came back from a 7 night stay in these apartments. Myself and my 12 year old son. Rooms are dated yes but clean. We only used the room to shower and sleep room14 Pools were great despite tiles missing. Pool bar was great with good food. We were next to the pool bar so really handy 😁. 10 min walk to the main strip down a hill but not a problem shops pubs and restaurants within 2 minutes. What more do you need for a cheap winter holiday. Would definatly return as staff were amazing and nothing too much trouble

author: P5485FMstephenp
title: Def worth the low price
text: Lots of reviews putting this place down, but location is excellent. 2 nice pools. Nice food/drink from pool bar. Yes is a bit shabby in places. Yes rooms are a bit dated BUT and a big but........clean. Functionable. Near everything. Great terraces in the sun and for the price would def come back.

author: martinshaven
title: not fit for purpose
text: a friend was booked in here. We visited ... awful smell of ??.. damp??made worse by cleaner obviously spraying fresh air spray ..! .dark, lights not working, shower not working, noisy neighbors through the night .. least said !!...and a real hike up the hill from the centre ..... would only book if needed really cheap accommodation and desperate .. maybe not even then .. friend checked out to other accomodation, no refund .. think thy may be used to that ..

author: 743MarkR743
title: Good for the price !
text: Honestly ! Some people book a one star apartment and expect five star quality, it was basic but functional and well situated with a short walk to the local amenities and the beach. OK - let's start with the negatives - other posters are correct it's a little past its sell-by date and the bathroom was a bit shabby but the kitchen, living/dining area and bedrooms were ok. For noise phobes unfortunately Caleta de Fuste is on the flight path to the airport so there are regular low flying aircraft but to be honest you soon get used to that. On then plus side reception all speak English and are very helpful, there is a passable restaurant and two bars on site. For the Brexit brigade there is a supermarket on site that sells British only brands and for the remainers there is a fair size supermarket opposite that sells a variety of British and European products. The bus stop is a short walk and there are buses to the airport and Puerto del Rosario roughly every 15 minutes. We were a party of three and had a really great time.

author: mrssydfarm
title: Lovely location
text: I stayed here with my 62 Y/O Mum and my 8 Y/O Daughter for 5 nights. I have to say that we thoroughly enjoyed our stay, we stayed in apartment 47, which suited us perfect as it was at the end of the complex. All amenities were adequate, shower worked and had hot water every time, the beds were comfortable and the balcony was a plus. Not sure why this place would get any downbeat reviews, it is a 3 star stay, and more than hits the right buttons. Swimming pool was cold, but you get used to it, eventually. The staff were very friendly and helpful, especially the lady with glasses, sorry I didn't get her name. the Zanzibar is an added bonus, beautiful looking bar with exceptional service. Would definitely go again and stay at the Beach Club.

author: sisterbyheart
title: Ok, served its purpose
text: Just had a 1 week stay at the fuerteventura beach club, and overall I'd say it's somewhere to stay, and served its purpose. The girls on reception are absaloutly spot on, and are probably some of the most polite, helpful and friendly reception staff I've ever come across. Upon arrival, our room faced onto a busy road, and so got the option of another room which we took. The room which we got moved to faced directly onto Zanzibar, which was worse, as the noise was very loud and just when you got to sleep, the binmen came to collect all the recycling from the pub which was very early in the morning. We were offered another room round by a quiet pool area the following morning which was great, room 38. First nite great, second nite..... very very loud Spanish neighbours, loud music and nobody seemed to be able to talk quietly even after 2pm, so I took it upon myself to knock next door and ask politely to be quiet......didn't work, but they'd gone the next day anyway. The room did not get cleaned/fresh towels/bed linen in the whole week I stayed here, which in my opinion is basic, and I know the complex was busy, but you pay a higher price to stay anywhere in premium periods, so in my opinion, the cleanliness of the room shouldn't change because it's "busy"? I probably wudnt stay here again.

author: Joesmettem1111578
title: Great place to stay self catering great value for money ignore bad reviews people need to remember it's a 2* not a 5*!!!
text: After reading a lot of reviews saying these bungalows were terrible we arrived with an open mind....however we found our bungalow (no 12) perfect and considering it's a 2* resort and Was a cheap holiday it was a bargain. Bungalow was a stone throw away from supermarket bars and restaurants and the pool and pool bar were practically on our doorstep. There was another 2 pools we could use but we stuck to the one outside our room. Beach was a 10-15 walk away. Rooms were cleaned every 3 days with fresh towels being provided. Iron and hairdryer in room too. Eating out is really cheap and there are loads of lovely bars and restaurants. We had a great time and are hoping to go back later In year and staying at these bungalows again.

author: 280KevinF
title: CHEAP WEEK AWAY
text: My wife and I decided to book a cheap week away and booked through Travel Republic, we had read a lot of reviews and were expecting nothing exciting and nothing more than a two star accommodation. We arrived at reception and booked in and where given a room near the main bar, we asked if they had any where that would be less noisy and where given room 58. To say the front door of room 58 had a rustic look was an understatement but it was then outdone by the balcony doors which had major gaps top and bottom and hardly any paint left on it. The room was reasonably clean but the wardrobes did smell musty but on the whole the room had every thing we needed. The room really needed a drastic overhaul and refurbishment but we cannot complain to much as we paid budget price and at the end of the day, you get what you pay for. On the plus side, the staff were great and there was all the amenities that you required on site or in the near area. If you prefer a bar without a television, then we would recommend the Pickled Palm for restful atmosphere and great food, also Nestors restaurant on site for good food. The Bollywood Spice Indian Restaurant is probably the best Indian food that I have eaten in a long long time. The hotel is what you want it to be and caterers for all taste, for us it was a base to come back to from exploring this wonderful island and was only a short walk into the town and the amenities available. Would we come back to this hotel, well may be in a couple of years or so I think.

author: crouse18
title: NEVER AGAIN
text: Firstly I would like to say the staff are lovely and couldn't be more helpful. The apartments themselves need some serious attention. We had 3 different rooms the first one was literally infested with bugs of all kinds to the point they was all over my 2 year old son. Our 2nd room was ok but was woken at 3am to a man breaking in the window and was in my room which the manager dealt with very quickly and we was moved within the hour. The third room was covered in bug and cockroaches wires hanging out the walls and very dated. Also the sofa beds are not suitable for sleeping on extremely uncomfortable just to sit on. The owners need to give this place some major tlc. Well done to the staff dealing with all the issues.

author: rail007
title: Lovely Place nice and spacious
text: Lovely place good size pools, there three pools sun beds or free. Apartments are good. Two pool bar the best is the Elite bar the bottom pool. Zanzibar is the main bar, large beer 2.50€ which is good. Also has live music each night. Good atmosphere. Nice views from balcony over the sea. It's about 10.15 minutes walk to town and the beach or get the wee road train down to town or harbour plus catch it back up the hill ...lovely place I've been many time.

author: tracydenman
title: Cheap sunshine break
text: Our last day..... apts very basic bit a typical case of you pay for what you get. That said we weren't expecting to return to a river in our room after a rain storm due to the patio doors not hung / close correctly! Three great pools to choose from with free sun loungers. Maid service twice during our stay thou the clean towels have a musty smell to them. Two pool bars, miserable barman at the top pool! Thou we never tried Zanzibar and Nestors they were always busy. A nice steady 10-15 min stroll to the beach, centre. Not great for less abled walking back . All in all, fab cheap break and would return

author: 880SharonL
title: Relaxing chilled
text: Stayed as a last minute deal for Easter. Absolutely fantastic from start to finish. Arriving at the apartments where all the staff are extremely welcoming and helpful. The apartments are fine and easy access to everything. 3 wonderful pools and loads of sun beds. The bars there are great apart from the one near the gym where they also hold a quiz and barbecue only because the woman is a miserable beggar, but the elite bar and all the other pools are fab. Always happy to see you. Great place can't wait to go back.

author: Lea-R-Manchester
title: Everything you need is within a 10 minute walk.
text: We recently stayed here at the beginning of April. The apartments are a great size but could do with a bit of improvement to the decor. The bed settee was old and had seen better days and we had a problem with ants. The staff are very helpful though and will come straight out to help in any way they can. The hotel is perfectly situated about 10 minutes from the beach, town, bars and shops. It has everything you need, so found this ideal. We didn't eat from here as there are many nice restaurants in the town, but we did have a couple of nights in Zanzibars and the drinks were reasonably priced and the staff very friendly. There was 3 pools and we had 1 just outside the apartment door which was never too busy and you could always get a sun lounger. I would love to come back to the area again. Great time!

author: Mumbleberry
title: Great value and service, needs attention
text: This is a great value place to stay. As someone accustomed to bunk houses and camping, the apartments offer, good value, a great location and friendly, helpful staff. My expectations were set accordingly to the price I paid. My only grumbles? Our apartment had a worn out sofa bed which had seen better days. Try as we might to piece it back together in its original form, the sofa had a constant forward tilt. I suffer from lower back pain which meant that in combination with the lumpy beds (I wasn't fussed as I slept), my back did suffer though. A cheap second hand sofa bed replacement would do the trick, Only other issue is that the sewerage was kicking up through the toilets/standing water, and the apartment did not look as though it had been cleaned over before our arrival. So it was a but smelly but I had come prepared with lavender oil (my friend joked I was exorcising demons as I peppered it throughout the apartment). All in all, good value, looking forward to returning at some stage.

author: tigritigr
title: Fuerteventura Beach Club has surely seen better days...
text: Nice spot, nice pools... BUT... hard to find. The wifi wasn't working. There were ants in the bathroom. The bed was extra uncomfortable. Fuerteventura Beach Club has surely seen better days. At least it was quite cheap.

author: christate2015
title: Quite relaxing resort
text: Stayed for a week in October on an RCI exchange. Had a lovely bungalow apartment by one of the three pools. It is on the direct flight path into the airport so can be aircraft noise, but that would apply to most of the resort. There are a couple of pool bars and a very nice restaurant on site. A supermarket across the road and a commercial centre with a number of bars and restaurants. On a hill side location but there is a pedestrian path down to the town. We had a wheelchair but it was not too bad, taking about 15 minutes. A taxi back up the hill only cost a couple of euros.

author: ShazandGazxxx
title: Lovely relaxing stay
text: A lot better than some reviews ive read. Basic bungalows but clean and tidy. Could do with updating but everything you need. Reception staff really helpful and pleasant. 3 lovely pools to choose from and 2 pool bars. Zanzibar really nice with outdoor terrace and entertainment. Supermarket and other bars only minutes away. Would definitely book again

author: Kellyafullthorpe
title: Perfect
text: My husband and I stayed in apartment 59 which is right near to the quiet pool and we had a lovely time here. The apartments are very basic but you pay for what you get! There was everything you need with a bar and restaurant and supermarket at the end of the road. Our door locked fine and I felt safe when in the apartment. There was a selection of bars just 2 minutes walk away and the main area for shops and restaurants about a 10 minute walk with the beach about 15 minutes away. The ladies on reception were incredibly friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Would I stay here again? Yes without a shadow of a doubt, this apartment had everything we needed for a weeks break and was perfectly located. Ignore the negative reviews

author: chicken194
title: You get what you pay for!!!!
text: We booked this hotel as it was very cheap for 4 adults as we only wanted a base to sleep and shower and we were happy with what we got. We were very worried before we arrived and was expecting to have to find another hotel to stay in but everything was ok. 2 bedrooms, living area, kitchen and balcony dated and slightly grubby but no cockroaches and only a few ants were found in our bag of sugar but that's no big deal. Towels were not vet good and only changed on the 4th day. 3 Pools all were freezing so couldn't stay in them. Shops and bars very close by and 10-15 min walk to town and beach little train 2 Euro each or taxi €3 to get back up as it's all uphill on way back. Not an awful lot to do but there is kareoke and singers on in a few bars. I would stay there again but would look at other places first, but if it was cheap again then would definitely book.

author: Cbd1984
title: Very pleasant stay - cheap & cheerful
text: I was a bit anxious on arrival as I read some of the reviews beforehand - the last bad one was about room 11&14 and myself and my group had a bit of a laugh hoping we wouldn't get these rooms - you guessed it - we were given those exact ones!! I was pleasantly surprised ... the room was clean, spacious - yes a little outdated and musty but open the windows , air it out and enjoy the holidays!! Perfectly located right beside pool and elite bar. Staff around the whole complex were polite and friendly. A nice walk to the town - about 15-20 mins , or a cab up and down for €4. Only worry was the airplanes flying so low over head !!! - but u can get over that! You want the ritz - you pay for the ritz - this is an ideal location for a low budget holiday ! Thanks for a great stay :-)

author: sandramcloughlin
title: Depends on which room you get
text: Room 11 no internet or tv, no fan or air con the room get far to hot to sleep in, so you have to buy a fan, €15 with €15 deposit, Mould/damp on the wall next to the bed, other things splattered on the walls, kitchen cupboards hanging off, dangerous plugs with holes in, back door unlocked untill i locked it! The musty smelly itchy bed was rock hard and i couldnt sleep on it, the room smelt, no black out curtains, dirty sofa bed, kettle that turned its self on without switching it on, blood stains on the pillow cases and blankets, smelly towels, no microwave, lights in the bedroom made a electrical noise when you switched them on and flickered on and off(dangerous) i asked to be moved but had to wait till the next day, so didnt sleep all night, they moved me to room 14 which was slightly better but still i couldnt sleep on the bed and the sofa bed had a wooden slat that stuck in my back, the staff have been lovely with me but said they are full, it seems theyre some really nice appartments on one side of the complex then the other side is so run down people shouldnt have to stay in them, you are expected to know how to use the tv, hmmm well the maintenance guys had to show me, you press the on button then another button on the tv then dont use the tv remote, hmmm seems straight forward not! The pool is nice apart from the tiles all coming up! I wouldnt bring small children here they might lose a toe or worse around the pool, so all in all its a bit of a shame if the company took a bit of pride in the accomadation it could be a great place to stay! Seems they try and put you in the worse room possible to see if you will put up with it, as i was told ive been put in the worse room! One of the guys around the pool showed me his room number 8 it was lovely, comfortable and clean seems ive been mistreated maybe as i was on my own. There is a mini market next to the hotel, do not use it! Walk down to atlantica is about 20 mins walk and get a taxi back €3.

author: lyndamcpheat
title: Very disappointng
text: We booked our holiday for the first week in August 2016. We appreciate that it was a reasonably priced holiday so weren't expecting 5 star luxury! However we were expecting clean. Bedding was worn out grey and stained. The wardrobe was mouldy and stank of urine. It was so bad we did not unpack.The cupboard doors and drawers in the kitchen area were hanging from their hinges, the worktop was burnt, crockery and cutlery sparse and unclean. The bathroom was disgusting smelly and the bath unfit for purpose. To summarise, the apartment was filthy and smelly. Staff were unhelpful when we asked to be moved, however we did move apartments but things were only marginally better in as much as we now had a toaster and felt we could step into the bath! After four nights we checked out.

author: 616hazeln
title: Cheap but not too cheerful
text: We booked this property through holiday club, we were put in number 36, it smelled musty as soon as we opened the door and the smell from the drains was awful. The bed settee was broken underneath, it got fixed but then fixed again twice by us, the cover was old and full of cigarette burns. The curtains needed a good wash. We had 9 cockroaches during our stay and we were given a tin of spray to do it ourselves, the cleaners did come regularly, made the bed, washed a few dishes, changed towels maybe 3 times during our 2 week stay, the floor got washed once , the shower never , there was still sand in the shower, so you could tell it wasn't cleaned. The site was full of rubbish, needed a good sweep, the tiles round the pool of the elite bar were in a poor condition, lots missing, the umbrellas are in need of new ones. The reception staff, on a better note, were wonderful, if there was some equipment missing or you had a complaint it was dealt with immediately, but everything should be there and checked before arrival. Food at elite bar was good, there is very little entertainment either for children or adults, and as it's quite a hike down to the main centre it would have been better. Food was good at nesters, if a little expensive, but you had to book, other than that no food was available on site after 5 pm. The whole site urgently needs upgrading. You get what you pay for, but we paid a three year deal, and this is the only place that was free in the weeks we could go, so not so cheap for us.

author: scotbrenn
title: Average
text: If you're going to this property best advice Is book a private rental,we went through on the beach room was just about OK if you're only sleeping in it don't try cooking even the smallest of meal's equipment rubbish! the private rentals are far far superior,.. The apartment's are set at the top of a very large hill away from the centre as they say it's within walking distance! yes on the way down!!get taxi back very cheap..staff were very helpful printed off our boarding passes no charge,hair dryer no charge! no complaints about staff,cleaner comes now and again! think about 3 times in a fortnight.. there is a restraunt on site called Nestor's looks lovely just a shame that the food is awful and vastly over priced it doesn't help when the owner who is English can't take criticism and is very very rude so if you want crap overpriced (frozen)food with rude host this is the place for you!!!avoid at all cost.. would I go back to calleta de fuste probably not to many karaoke bars etc custom built for tourists and it shows corralleo much much better more local bars,restraunts and locals !!.....

author: lukec909
title: Why's everyone complaining?
text: We've just got back from 2 weeks in this hotel. We were expecting the worst after reading reviews but we were pleasantly surprised. We arrived to a warm welcome from the receptionist who gave good guidance to where our room was. We entered the room and found it smelling fresh and looking clean. The room is decorated like the majority of budget hotels you see abroad. I'm not sure why everyone is complaining about the hotel. The three pools were all clean and staff friendly. We will be coming back.

author: miamigirl2010
title: Disgusting
text: We booked with on the beach.com. thought we had found a bargain at £250 for 2 weeks self catering. We arrived and were given keys to apartment 11. We opened the door and the smell from inside literally took our breath away. It smelt of stale cigarette smoke, urine and damp. We were horrified. Understanding that our bargain break was now a get what you pay for nightmare, we promptly left the hotel and spent some of our spending money on better accommodation. Please take heed of these negative reviews, the place is disgusting, dirty, and not safe. We saw a child standing by the kids pool urinating in the water! Says it all really!

author: sparky97
title: needs closing down and refurbishing
text: arrived at resort at 9.30 in the evening and were given room 79 opened patio doors to view car park of Zanzibar pub with rotting jaguar car infull view . apartment had no kettle no microwave just a toaster apartment is in a filthy condition and has loads of cockroaches ( you could see the darting in and out from under rusty fridge . went to reception and asked to be moved , receptionist ( whom we later christened DONT KNOW ) who told us we would have to go back next morning cos she didn't know if any were available . we then asked for a kettle and she told us she couldn't get us one cos she didn't know where they were kept !! went back next morning parched as we couldn't make a brew and were told to go back at 10.30 ( another half day wasted as we didn't unpack anything ) we were eventually offered no 81 which we had to take as there were no more available .this was slightly better but we only got it because another guest had refused to stay in it !! we put our clothes in the wardrobes and the following day they were all damp we got towels changed only once and cleaner only once and that took all of 10 minutes to do cos we were there when she came , didn't get bedding changed all week . do yourselves a favour do not put money into the pockets of the owner of this complex . if you look around the area there is much better accommodation to be had for similar cost .DONT STAY HERE !!

author: Suegray2014
title: Room stank
text: This was a 3 night stay before heading to the mainland. Never again. The island was cold and windy. The resort Caleta, was full of old people and bad restaurants. The hotel was up a huge hill. This place seems to be allergic to fruit and vegetables as all they served was refined and fried. The prices in the bars were high. The room in the hotel had an awful musty smell and the lady in reception was not prepared to help.

author: LeckieD
title: Holiday
text: Basic aparthotel. On arrival lady in reception was nice and took time to explain where our place was. Basic one bedroom apartment needs refurbishing, cracked sink in bathroom although it didn't leak etc, shower piece kept coming off wall, cupboards in kitchen need replacing in my opinion, damp smell in wardrobe so never put our clothing in it. Damp stain on the wall in bedroom seems to be maybe a leak from bath ? Kettle, coffee machine and toaster provided, although toaster needs replacing as handle has broken and plastic has melted. could do with thicker curtains in bedroom and better pillows. We were in room 78 next to Zanzibar which would have been OK but deliveries were early 6am every day and then bar staff moving kegs around, going back to sleep was hard. Cleaner came round once in the week. Although a few grumbles we didn't pay 5* prices and really only rested our head. Reception staff knowledgeable about excursions and how to save money, we will return though.

author: 611allanahf
title: Good hotel, get what you pay for!
text: The staff at the hotel were lovely. Espically in the Zanzi bar, we had a few accidents and the young man who works there was very helpful and friendly. Accomadtion is ok. You get what you pay for. Its ok as a base if you are planning to go out most of the time. Rooms were clean, but had ants and a few cockroaches. If you want 5* accomdation dont book here. But perfect for people on a budget and travellers. The staff make up for the accomodation.

author: 572grahamb
title: Our relaxing stay at Fuerteventura beach club
text: The good points. The appartment was spacious an clean ,we had a nice size balcony over looking the pool with a lovely view of the sea and countryside it had everything we needed two hob cooker microwave ,kettle,even a iron an board. Tv with a few english channels .The complex had three decent size swimming pools an bars ,the main bar which has a large balcony was my favourite does alsorts including bingo all the staff were very helpful . It is a 15 minute walk down a gentle hill into town with bars an shops on the way,with a market that is held twice a week (Tuesday & saterday) half way down the hill .there are loads of bars an restaurant s to choose from ,we found fados steak house amazing! There is a road train that will take you into town for 2euros or taxi for less than 3euro for four people! Right the bad points. The appartment was very tired an well used but you get what you pay for an it was clean so we were happy with it. Wfi very patchy but good in the zanzibar( main bar)The complex is in the flight path which we didn't mind because they started about 8am an finished about 9pm I hardly noticed it . Over all we had a lovely week an are looking forward to staying there again ! Hope this helps.Graham&Deb

author: Sandyrandy76
title: STAY AWAY FROM THIS HOTEL
text: We've just come back from this terrible hotel 2 days ago - you need to stay away. The rooms were so disgusting with ants crawling around and cockroaches everywhere. The sink tap was hanging off, the shower was either too hot or too cold. The cupboard doors were mouldy. The bed had mites in them. NO WIFI in rooms or around resort only in the reception area which was a mission to walk to every time. The food was disgusting apart from the desserts which were ok. There was nothing to do what so ever for the kids. The swimming pools were freezing. Apart from the weather being 23 degrees that was the highlight of the holiday.

author: cmo556
title: You get what you pay for!!
text: Stayed October 2015 one bedroom apartment behind Pool Bar it was as basic as basic can be but to be fair, if you want top starred accommodation then pay for it!! Cannot complain about how nice the lady with glasses is in Reception and the pleasant blond lad working in the Elite poolbar. All staff did their best. We found the comfy sunbeds/pools amazing. Major downsides for us was the location, it was a bit of a trek into the main resort where the good bars and restaurants are. There is a bit of a complex across the road but only mediocre pub grub and family type bars there, not for us I'm afraid also far too many kids around for beginning October for our liking we make a point of booking holidays where they are in school so we can relax without squeals screams and whining disturbing our peace!! What's that about thought people got fined for taking their offspring out of school these days obviously not fined enough!! Overall enjoyed the holiday.

author: jackiep68
title: Absolute Gem at bargain price
text: We paid under £500 for 10 days (including flights) for 2 of us so I wasn't expecting too much to be honest. I was amazed - we had the most wonderful time. We stayed in a bungalow that unfortunately didn't have a ceiling fan but I believe a lot of them do so it was very hot to sleep - but as this was the only down side I'm still rating this as excellent. We walked into town most evenings as it was downhill but got a cab back (approx. 4 euros) Wonderful selection of bars and restaurants. Zanzibar is on site (free wi fi) band also had entertainment every evening and is open until 1.00am. Nestor is the on site restaurant (not open Saturdays) the food was wonderful but be warned - do not have a starter as the main course is huge!!!! Lovely friendly staff - even when we returned home at 1.00 am after an evening out and our boiler had leaked and our room had flooded -the problem was dealt with quickly and efficiently - we had temporary accommodation for one night and the next day everything was as it was before. Absolutely recommend this for a cheap relaxing break. Fantastic

author: DianeP346
title: R & R
text: My third visit but my husbands first. Friendly helpful staff. The Elite pool bar is great for meeting new people, a refreshing drink and delicious reasonably priced home cooked food. The salt water pool is surrounded by comfortable new in 2014 sun beds. The rooms are dated and in need of updates but are clean. Remember the price reflects this. The resort is situated near a local supermarket and an English supermarket. There are plenty of bars and places to eat near by or you can take a casual stroll 10 to 15 minutes down to the main town. We have booked again for September.

author: 791sharonw791
title: Nice Place, But Needs Updating
text: We stopped at the Beach Club the week beginning 21st March, when we got there we noticed the fridge was leaking & was a bit rusty, the lights weren't working in the main living area and the patio door wouldn't lock, so we went over to reception initially to change rooms but the maintenance man came straight over and fixed the door & showed us the lights did work! Not sure what we did! & replaced the fridge with a brand new one, so all good. The kitchen was a bit dated & not very clean but we bought some fairy liquid & scourers & gave it a good going over. Beds were fine, TV had 3 english channels, bathroom was ok but does need updating. The maid came twice in the week to change the towels & make the beds. Where our appt was situated - no 53 - was in a great position as it got the sun all day out the back & was fairly private. The reception staff were lovely & really helpful. We probably would go back as it is a nice place, and you can't expect 5 star when it is so cheap to stay there.

author: sarahkeepsmoving
title: Elite??!
text: Titled 'Elite' club resorts gives the impression of something special! Do not be fooled..this resort is not particularly well maintained, unfriendly staff and a lack of any 'holiday spirit'. We found this place to be mainly occupied by long-stay pensioners with next to nothing going on in December. The beach itself is long and pleasant- my only saving grace from the total boredom of the 'resort'. Its CHEAP for a reason..if id payed alot as do many have to with children, id have been furious. The apartments walls are paper thin-i could literally hear next door coming in and using the toilet! The furniture is shabby and needs complete upgrading. Don't waste your money going!!

author: LAT72
title: Very dated
text: I stayed at the Fuerteventura Beach Club for a week in March. I didn't pay a lot for the holiday and I read a few of the latest reviews on Tripadvisor so I sort of had an idea of what I was heading for. The complex is quite large with 3 pools, various pool bars and there are other bars, restaurants and supermarkets close by. The grounds looked quite nice although certain areas are showing their age and lack of maintenance, i.e. uneven steps, ponding water etc. The studio was fine size-wise but that is about the extent of anything positive. All of the fittings (apart from the bath tub) were very dated and in poor repair. The cleaner made one appearance during the stay and that was just to change the bed and towels. Overall it wasn't a particularly pleasant stay although the weather wasn't great which doesn't help. It should be said though The reception staff are very helpful and pleasant.

author: glenn_london44
title: OK Clean and Quite
text: This was the time here, rooms clean if Spartan. Just make sure you get a pool view, as my chalet was right next door to resort bar (noisy), nice pools and clean the main bar Zinzibar has entertainment nightly, but not for the younger set, lots Karaoke and Bingo, tells it all. They say 10 mins to beach took me nearly 25mins, go figure. There is a very good pool bar located on reception side, really good all day breakfast, well worth a visit. There is a fantastic restaurant under the main bar, Nestors, food is out of this world, but make sure you are hungry as portions are HUGE but great steaks and good service, medium prices but would recommend a visit. You can get a Taxi from resort to town for 3 euros, much better than trying walk back as all uphill. This is a very quite family friendly resort, as even in the town not much to do. A few bars and restaurants but seems more expensive than other islands. All in all a good rest but I would not be returning here. Hope this helps you.

author: AnnieB023
title: A Lovely Value-for-Money Holiday
text: The resort is currently being extensively refurbished and we were fortunate enough to be in part of the complex that has been done. The standard of the apartment was very good - very comfortable, HUGE bed, well equipped kitchen, fab shower, extremely comfortable bed-settee, lovely position - couldn't fault it. The 2 pools we used (in the lower part of the complex), although cold, were lovely with plentiful, very good quality sunbeds (some of the best I've seen). The landscaping was looking scruffy when we arrived, but during the second week a very hard-working lady was clearing it all, and what a difference it made! The staff couldn't have been more helpful, and the Elite Bar is excellent quality and value. Zanzibar has entertainment every night and a lovely atmosphere, the food at Nestors is outstanding. A good supermarket just over the road, together with bars and restaurants, but we preferred mainly to go down into town where there are restaurants and bars of all kinds. We did not have a bad meal the whole time we were there (2 weeks), and have also found this in the past. Will we go there again? Hell yeah!

author: stephenbA6947QV
title: Very Pleased
text: My wife and I returned from Fuertaventura Beach Club on the 4th December.2014. I have read most of the reviews and read a few before we went. We had no high expectations as the Price was for Budget accomodation. On arrival we couldn't believe how nice our Apartment was ( No 77) It did have a couple of little problems, the front door stuck due to the wet weather and a wooden slat broke on the sofa bed, but both problems were dealt with immediately by the maintenance team. Bearing in mind that one goes on holiday to enjoy the sun and not sit in an apartment all day we had a great holiday and are going back next year. Every member of staff we met were lovely and special mention has to got to the Elite Pool Bar Girls, The Bar Staff in Zanzibar and an extra special thankyou to Aziel in Reception. We didn't expect 5 Star Accomodation for the price, but neither did we feel uncomfortable at any time. We met many people who had said that any complaint they had had was dealt with professionally and courteously. We never met anyone who said they wouldn't come back. So, if you want a Bargain Holiday and the company of lovely people....Go to Fuertaventura Beach Club.

author: geranium1
title: Accommodation
text: Just spent five days here late, low cost holiday. We were given apartment 47! None of us expected luxury, just a basic clean place to sleep. The apartment was very run down and shabby to say the least, Dirty foam pillows and mattresses. Taps hanging of the wall in the bathroom and smells of sewage in the garden. To top it off we had unwelcome guests on 2 occasions in the form of cockroaches. We did complain and were offered another apartment but it was of the same quality. Thank goodness for the pool and the beach. The club is situated in a beautiful quiet location, come on guys this place needs some TLC!

author: edinchavez
title: Great Place to Stay
text: I spent a week here and I really really liked it. It was nothing fancy but the location and the way its set up is really good. I had a rental car so getting around was a breeze. The Beach is walking distance and the place is really cozy. They have washer and dryer making things easy for travelers like my self. The airport is also really close, you can drive there to drop off your rental car in about 5 minutes or take a local bus there that takes about 10 minutes. Be advised the wifi is terrible. I would stay here again.

author: melaniep993
title: Fab family holiday
text: We are a family of five, we had to get 2 bungalows but the reception made sure they were close together. They were very clean, basic but well equipped. A totally chilled out resort which I am booking again for next summer, there is a supermarket facing which is cheap, a fabulous restaurant on the complex called Nestos which is unreal, and a very reasonable pool bar. It is a 10 minute easy walk to the main town with a great beach and lovely restaurants, slight incline coming back up but great to help digest the lovely meals we had. Totally recommend this complex. Across the road was a commercial centre with quite a few bars and restaurants, the Argentinas for pizzas was excellent! Will defiantly be returning. The island is cheap to eat out and drink, thumbs up x

author: jim186356
title: Excellent value for money
text: Great place. Maybe needs some attention . However u get what u pay for.. Would I return.. without a doubt. So relaxed. Met lots of lovely people.. Food at Eclipse is very nice and also very cheap.. Trish is lovely .

author: StevieI
title: basic self catering
text: Just arrived back from a week at this resort and having read the reviews was very apprehensive. On arrival way plesantly surprised at reception and walk to apartment but when entering apartment could see why some bad reviews. On the plus side our apartment had a great pool side location the bedroom and bedding was clean the bathroom was ok as was the sitting area but the kitchen area left a lot to be desired. Units were tired and dirty fridge was rusty on outside broken shelf on inside and utensils very basic. Just as well we had no intention of cooking . The pools and grounds are great sunbeds at our pool numerous and all new the bars in the complex zanzibar very good value and nice service and place. Could go on moaning but all in all if you want cheap holiday in sunshine this is what you get . Good bars and restuarants in the resort about 10 minute walk tex mex steak house good value and sizzling pig at square outside nice reception and good elvis and blondie tribute night . These apartments with some investment could be great would we return probably not.

author: 410joshw
title: Very Cheap, Little Much Else
text: The first thing that must be said about this hotel is that it is incredibly cheap. My friends and I spent roughly £60 each to have 3 of us to stay in a room for 9 nights, which we thought was a brilliant price. The complex also has several very good pool areas with bars and decent sun beds, but it can be difficult to find shaded sun beds during the hottest times of the day. However, whilst the price is very cheap, we did have a few issues whilst staying here. Firstly, we were told our apartment would be cleaned every 2 days, and it was cleaned only once during our 9 day stay. Furthermore, whilst I wouldn't go as far as to say the room was dirty when we arrived, however there were certain aspects which could have been better (Dust and small amounts of sand in room corners). Also, we were not given enough towels and due to the fact our room was cleaned once we had the same bedding for five days.The apartment also only has 2 actual beds, and with the three of us sharing I had to use a sofa bed, which was not particularly comfortable. Overall its hard to criticise the place because it is so cheap to stay here. However, personally I would not recommend it to families. Whilst it was fine for three 19 year old's who wanted a cheap holiday, I feel that most people looking to have an enjoyable holiday would be slightly disappointed.

author: CarolineF235
title: sun , sea, cheap n cheerful
text: I have just returned from a 7 day break from this great place! Basic apartment with a terrace that got the sun up until 5pm , bliss. We had a pool view which was great and the supermarket was a 3 min walk away. The Tuesday and Saturday market has a great buzz about it and I bought some nice wee bangles . If you are looking to escape away from the rat race and go to the sun with a lovely breeze and don't mind basic living for a week then this is a great find! Can't fault this resort, loved the short walk - 10mins to the beach front and there is lots of cafes and more. You can get 2 breakfast for 6 euro, bargain! local large beers are around 2 euros and it's nice to sit and watch the buzz in the square. There is a bar at the front that does events and live music if your into that it's varied from Blues to pop etc.I will return to the sun here as so cheap and the area is good. The area does have cats and a charity looks after them well.

author: 654ritae
title: Winter at Elite Club. Fuerteventura
text: Rather worn but complaints dealt with promptly. Our apartment didn't have the benefit of the little sunshine that there was although it was very conveniently situated right opposite the supermarket. It felt rather damp. TV not a lot of good but WiFi available all over the complex without charge. Entertainment every night and lots going on. If you don't mind putting up with a site that's desparately needs updating then this is fine. There was a rat running around the pool at one time but the cleaning lady dealt swiftly with it - rather funny really. Our garden was unkempt - broken glass there for the duration - we stayed there for 2 weeks and had a car. Good location of you want to play golf. 5 minutes in the car.

author: Ladyval360
title: Great for a quick breakaway
text: Very pleased with this resort so clean and friendly. We had a two bedroom bungalow which was a little tired in decor but had everything we could want for cooking, sleeping and washing. Staff were very helpful and requests (extra blankets) were dealt with promptly. Restaurant was excellent for choice value and staff very attentive. Zanzibar bar was comfortable and clean reasonable prices and excellent free entertainment. The surrounding area was very clean and had a huge selection of bars and restaurants and the local motor train was a bonus providing transport to and from beach. Caleta de Fuste town is so clean no timeshare touts or pressure leaflets. Can recommend to any couple for a grea twinter break

author: nigelc18
title: Fuerteventura Beach Club
text: Excellent resort. The staff are freindly, helpful and polite. The owner of the resort, Jose, is always around and if you have any questions or queries he is only to happy to answer those for you. The reception staff are English or English speaking and can not be faulted in any way at all. The resort is away from the crowds but only a 10-15 min walk from the beach. Ideal for a quiet holiday in a relaxing atmosphere. Very Good. I would atay again.

author: discreto
title: Not a good holliday
text: We stayed for the first 3 days only and I was happy I had not booked for a longer time. The main problem was the noise from the neighbors. Well, I do not know, perhaps this is normal for the British tourists to act this way but to tolerate constant drinking till the late night is not what I do. Some pensioners had a party without caring about anybody else and it was not possible to sleep till 2 am when their stupid drunk laugh ended eventually. So I think this is the main problem in the bungalows all around the island as we stayed in apartments as well and it was not so bad in terms of the noise around. The room number was 305 and it was not kept well and was very basic as I expected. It is always the lottery who Your neighbor will be. Fuertesol bungalows were more convenient and people seemed to be more quite.

author: RichardF84
title: Was once very nice
text: The down turn in the economy has had impact on these well designed bungalows. Maybe in high season they will be able to invest in a little refurbishment and get AC. It was OK but needs TLC. They have good deals so you stay for a very low price but if I went back I would pay a little extra for the extras. With so many choices in the area, if an establishment loses it's edge, I think the slope to obscurity come quite quickly. Did not try the restaurant as it was low season and there are many items in town. Walking to town is easy 15-20 minutes and the airport is a 1 minute drive. No Internet except in the check-in is not so good in 2013.

author: We_Love_holidays74
title: Its what you pay for.......
text: Basic yes, cheap yes, Clean ok, but for £60 a week, who can grumble. Reality is, this place is a little tired, needs a refurb and some investment however is not the place people make it out to be. If you want daily maid service, and immaculate bathrooms/bedrooms, don't stay here, if you want tidy, reasonable rooms with a cheap bar only 10 mins from the main action, then book. Simple. Work this our before you make you booking and leave feedback. Would use again at £60 per week, simple! Nice people. nice bar, sky sports, internet etc...

author: kirstyc573
title: cheap and cheerful
text: Was surprise by how nice the resort was concidering some of the reviews we read before we went. 3 lovely pools - the best of which in our opinion was the welsh bar. Phil and Gaynor made us feel very welcome and make the best cheese burgers and sangria i've ever had. Self catering apartment was clean and functional - we didn't spend much time in there anyway. The main bar on the resort was a good bit cheaper than down the town. Food was excellant there to, with a varied selection on offer. And the entertainment in the form of Paul Reno was excellant. Altogether a relaxing, sun filled, and fun week - which was affordable. Points to note - don't get the airport transfers offered (for a charge of about £40) only found out when we were there that taxi was around £10 and would take half as long as the transfer. was july 2011 we went.

author: winnipeg19
title: Lovely Holiday
text: After reading reviews about this complex I was really apprehensive about going. I must say all my fears were unfounded as it was lovely. We had room 38 which was right next to the quiet pool. This pool was good if you wanted a peaceful swim and sunbathe but we preffered the busier one with the elite bar. All pools were spotlessly clean. Yes there was a bit of rust on our fridge and the sofa was a bit saggy but the matresses were brand new, sheets lovely and white and maid came in once during the week to change everything. For the price we paid we thought it was excellent value for money and would definitely go back again. The restaurants were all reasonably priced and would recommend the Aberdeen Steak House for their 3 course meal at just under 9 euros a head. It was a lovely meal.Also must say the buses are very cheap at just 1 euro 30 to the airport and 1.40 to the next resort of Rossario. Would certainly not pay airport transfers next time.

author: 849DavidW
title: had a great time
text: after reading some of the reviews for these apartments i was starting to think i was going to faulty towers. when we got there we were pleasantly surprised yea sure the door could do with a lick of paint on the outside but the inside of the place was grand. lets face it with the price of the holiday i wasnt expecting a lavish it was simple and everything worked. We we in apartment 13 which is just behind the elite bar, i dont understand other reviews about the bar but i found all the staff to be friendly and help full, they host bingo and table quiz which were great fun. happy hour from 1to5 and who can complain about that. the music and entertainment in the Zanzibar is terrible. eat in the restaurant under it one night food was good no complaints. if your going to this resort you must go to a restaurant called nestors food, service, price and staff are all amazing. so we had a great time if your in the elite bar tell them 10shots sent ya

author: paul67_11
title: Please read before you book
text: i stayed here with my daughter for 1 week the end of august 2012, we didnt expect 4 star because it was cheap but at least expected it to be clean. we had to wait for our room when we arrived which wasnt a problem and the receptionist was very helpful and friendly the whole time we were there. we was in room 11 near the Elite bar which was handy for the pool. the first impression of the room was that it wasnt ready, it was dirty run down and should not have been rented out, the pillows looked like they had been used to clean the floor and the patio door was pot luck if it locked it was rotten, the kitchen didnt get used once the doors were hanging off and the fridge leaked, we did look at another room to move to but that was in even worse condition. so we stayed where we was and made the most of it. the pool area is lovely but is really let down by the Elite bar and the constant smell of cooking fat all day which makes you feel sick after a few days, they hardly stocked anything and everytime you wanted a drink it was such an effort for the brittish workers to put thier fags out and finish the chat they was having sitting in the sun and the constant moaning about how hot it was, compare this to the bars in the resort and the friendly smiles from the spanish waiters who could not do enough for you made the brittish working in Elite look useless and totally not interested, no entertainment was put on for the kids they just couldnt be bothered. it was also cheaper to go to the super market across the road for cold drinks and ice creams. the resort is a very clean friendly family resort and would go again but to a different hotel, we never had a bad meal while we was there and all in all had a great holiday only let down by the hotel we had booked, please dont expect too much from this hotel it is what it is and you get what you pay for at the end of the day and is in desperate need of a refurb.

author: NormanR801
title: Apartments very mixed quality- pot luck what you get!
text: We were initially in an apartment looking over the resort, 58 I think it was, very shabby from the external door which really could do with a coat of paint down to the electrical socket which had no outer casing to the loose kitchen tap which was mended twice in our first two days before we managed to get moved to E7 which was substantially better. Cleaner came only twice I think in two weeks. We travelled with On the Beach and it was comparatively cheap, when we asked for a move because of the first apartment we were told that there were 5 standards on the site and we had the lowest. Shame as the pools were good, clean, sunbeds only at the pools and a lot of them are damaged and are not comfortable. Pool bard are very good, Malibu Bar in particular, lovely folk who run it,the main Bar on site also very friendly staff who are very helpful. Reception staff are very good, requests for repairs were dealt with very promptly although should not have been required! Our request for another apartment took several days until the Manager came back to site after the weekend, Reception Staff appear to have their hands pretty tied, we did hear various people requesting room changes and all were given the same script- wait until the Manager comes back! Also were unable to keep apartment on our departure day, our flight was not until 21.00, told apartment was booked, we witnessed the key being handed out at 18.00, would not have been too difficult to let us stay in apartment until 15.00! We were fully aware of the Trip Advisor comments when we booked so were not overly surprised by our findings, please be aware if booking to come here that the standards are not great- no issues regarding security though, bit of common sense folk though, keep your windows closed, use the Safe and dont leave your valuables on display, all will help!

author: DeniseV405
title: Lovely holiday shame about the apartment!!!!!!
text: These apartments are definately not 3*. We stayed in apartment 12 that really was not fit enough to rent out. Saying that we did not complain as it was only my husband and I and we only needed somewhere to sleep. There is no way we would have accepted this if we had our children with us. The beds were literally falling apart (seams coming undone so that the stuffing was coming out, no microwave, patio furniture that had large pieces of its plastic missing, fridge that had about three inches of rust up the door, bathroom fittings coming off the wall, doors and windows had been forced open on several occasions which had been fixed really badly, i could go on but what is the point! We accepted it. Plus side the pool was brilliant, bar was brilliant and the staff were great. We would go back but we would pay more money for a better apartment.

author: kimmy_ste
title: dreadful hoilday !!!
text: upon arrival everything seemed ok - we were booked in quickly no fuss and was pointed in the direction of the apartment, i went away with my sister and her 2 young children, In the apartment we noticed it was extremley basic, we didnt worry too much the children were tired so we went food shopping and settle for the evening, we noticed the fridge was broken at first which is not good when your self catering,the balcony door had been badley damaged and didnt shut properly you could see some effort had gone into it on fixing it so it would lock, we had 1 tv chanel, there was an open damaged socket in the bedroom, and no fire alarm (The fire alarm had actually been removed from its base) i have taken pictures will i will post aswell - there was no air con when we were told there was, and no microwave which we was also told there was, the ketle and toaster were not on the kitchen surface but placed on a small table by the sofa which again with young children isnt safe! the tap was broken which burnt yor hand every time your turned the tap by - The next morning we went to reception and was greeting by a very rude man, who just brushed us off huffing and puffing - after around 20mins he said he was fully booked which was obviously not the case becuase there was hardly anyone there! he agreed to move us next door which was awful and the back walked onto waste land leaving us no option to accept what we had been given! - we felt cheated and just presumed all the appartments were the same, 2 days before we came home a young girl a couple doors away said we could have a look at hers - she had a fan, microwave brand new kitchen flatscreen tv and was a dream compared to ours, we was so upset that all week we had no air conditioning or fan so at night was awful we hardly slept we couldnt open the windows becuase of feeling unsafe being too youngs girls and the windows opening wide,all of our food went off by the morning so the self catering was a joke! and had to eat out most of the time which we did not budget for! it was an awful experiance and the place was so damaged and very risky to the children, we work hard and didnt expect our hard earned money to be wasted! also sorry to keep going on but i could! dont believe it when it says your close to the beach this hotel is a good 15-20mins walk to all the amenities with children in that heat not good! i hope this helps

author: charliebubbles099
title: yes yes yes
text: now first things first im rating this property on what my partner and i paid which is fair . probably the cheapest going back 30 years i would say thank you to the owners because this was the difference of staying home or going abroard as this was an extra .yes the place is outdated but we enjoyed our stay it was very quiet a fair walk to beach but lots hidden nearby . supermarket and saturday market just over road we been home 2 hours heating on and no ice cold large beer go on book those cheap flights . we would go back . but remember get your wallet out if you want 5 star . some tips zanzibar nice to chill sports tv if req .tony romas rib house the quietest one .the bell with gorden found this last day very fair prices . miss america s yep right name miss it menu not what you get . the windmill fair thank you

author: smiffy0609
title: Dont look to much into the reveiws, well impressed...
text: Me and my partner have just returned after spending a great wk (19/03 - 26/03) at the complex. We were worried after reading the previous reveiws, but on arrival wa greated by a very freindly receptionist who was only to helpful answering questions, and been helpful.. We stayed in 75 which over looked a lovely pool area and backed on to the Zanzibar, which isnt loud and noisey at all on the night.. We needed extra blankets as cold on a night and also kettle was missing, after polite word at reception, 24hrs later we were supplied with what we needed...The Room overall was Large, Clean and supplied everything we needed, Bath/shower, microwave/oven, hob, kettle, tv ... The Zanzibar offers great entertainment, every nite and the complex is so freindly altho its on an older age scale, but never aless we are in our 30's but still meet great people and made plenty of freinds.. I did bring up the subject of safety and security as other reports did worry us, but was shown new CCTV Cameras around complex and also a Security Guard was patrolling the complex every night!! I would really recommend this Complex to all, and yes you do get what u pay for but we felt that we got more, and would to visit the lovely Island again some day, as plenty to do and see, and also the cost of meals and drinks are great value... Lovely break... Thank you Neil and all Staff... Andy Smith Hull

author: PaulkCornwaall
title: best value holiday for many years
text: We just spent a week in the elite beach club and it was great! We paid a very little for our holiday and it went off without a hitch. Airport was super efficent, airport transfers were clean and on time, very friendly drivers. Reception staff were friendly and helpful. Weather was fantastic. If I had any comments it would be that the pools are far to cold to use and the laundry looked like a bomb site. Loads of great places to eat , all offereing value for money. We will definately be returning but for longer.

author: franicus
title: Run down, shabby in need of refurbishment
text: We spent a week at Elite Fuerteventura Club recently, which is all part of the Fuerteventura Beach Club and Monte Castillo complex. We are time share owners and this is by far the worst place we have ever stayed in. Our apartment had a patio which overlooked a car park, with a rubbish skip directly outside, we had a cockroach in the bathroom and the whole apartment was dark, not particularly clean and the "90s" swags and tails were thick with dust. After complaining, we were told that if we upgraded our time share to their latest marketing "ruse" then we could immediately be moved into a very nice, modernised beautiful bungalow - we obviously did not fall for this and eventually after quite firm discussions, were given another apartment overlooking the swimming pool. The pool is freezing cold (unheated) and the whole complex is under the flight path of arriving planes, which are constantly arriving. The complex is also quite a long walk to the centre and the beach and is okay on the way down, but you need to get a taxi (3 euros) to get back, particularly at night. The entertainment in the Bar leaves a lot to be desired, and also it was full of people smoking indoors, which was unbearable for non smokers. The reception staff were very pleasant indeed but one night we did have particularly rowdy neighbours who kept us and other people away until 3.30am - when we complained to Reception, they told us there is no security on site but if we had any problems in future, we could ring a the mobile number of the Manager day or night - like he would have got out of bed at 3.30am to tackle 4 noisy teenagers! All in all, we cannot recommend this resort unless it gets a serious makeover and we will certainly not be returning.

author: Bernie0505_11
title: cheap and cheerful
text: Basic but clean apartment , with 1 double room living area with dining area . Kitchen area had double hob with plenty cooking utensils, also kettle,toaster,coffee maker , juicer. The apartment had t.v. and cd/radio . hair-dryer and iron were also in the apartment . Outside had a patio area with table and chairs and was a real sun trap. Only downside was that the Beach club apartments are located at the top of a steep hill and are not suitable for some people . Taxis in Caleta De Fuste are not expensive

author: alanjcg
title: a really good value apartment
text: I stayed here for a week in May and came back for another week in June because i found it great value and relaxing. The rooms are not luxurious as they are clearly tired and in need of a makeover but they are spacious and single storey. The room was cleaned twice in My week in May and once during my June Stay. There is a small terrace to sit out on. there are 2 pools and a larger pool on the adjoining Montecastillo complex. This gives the choice of a quiet or more active pool. The staff are helpful and until the "entertainment"begins at 9.30 the Zanzibar is a comfortable bar with a large balcony and a great view out to sea. The town centre is a 15-20 minute walk downhill and a 5 minute taxi ride back (2.8 euros). if you are looking for a peaceful no frills holiday this will suit you.

author: Hulmeman
title: WORK IN PROGRESS!
text: Came back from this venue on the 28th May. There is work going on, but it's not intrusive. Mainly cosmetic stuff around the pools. We had a very nice stay here, our appartments were well appointed if a little dull. Our appartment had a musty smellvon arrival,which the cleaners sorted out the next day and they left us an air spray! I have read some comments about rusty baths,well ours was a shower only and perfectly clean/acceptable. The Zanzibar, was a nice place for a drink but the entertainment was awful, real club turns! Cez Moi restaurant served decent food, big portions! However, there is a complex adjacent which houses some "english" bars, the bell et al. Avoid at all costs unless you arenused to drinking in the smell of stale chip fat!!!!

author: cbasker1975
title: Paradise on a budget!!!
text: after reading reviews about this place i was nervous to say the least...but i needn't have worried. We had a 2 bed Apartment with all facilities needed for self catering, we even had a stereo so we could listen to music whilst lounging on the terrace. The place was clean and tidy and had no signs of wear and tear. The cleaners came 3 times whilst we were there and left us with loads of towels..they only changed the bedding once, but lets be honest who does it more than once a week at home?? I had two children aged 9 and 5 and they loved the place. The entertainment was ok but they had the same 2 singers on a rota so if you stayed in the club bar every night you would see them both 3 times.We were self catering and went into the town most nights for dinner, i would recommend the chinese restaurant in the centre and the wild west bar for eating out. It was about a 10 min walk to the town and the beach, but in the sun(which was out all week) is a nice walk. Really enjoyed our first visit to this island and will definitely be back......My advice is dont always believe bad reviews....some people are just never happy!

author: Welshwasp
title: Don,t be put off, do your homework and then relax
text: Read other reviews and knew what to look out for. Firstly tried the back / patio door and I could force it. Reported it to reception and with the repair and an extra bolt before the room was accepted it was sorted ( along with my improvisation) and extremly secure. How previous occupants could have stayed there I do not know. Re: complaints about rusty microwaves - well we did not even have one ,so checked and a new one was brought the same day. Towels fine including Beach Towels ! Any other niggles were sorted out by extremly helpful reception staff and maintenance staff. Were some cockroaches about if you were not careful but little in evidence and we saw some in the Main Barcelo hotel (were we went for our entertainment). The place needs money being spent on it , especially the patio doors but felt more at home in these traditional Canary style bungalow apartments than would have in town in more expensive square blocks. Were in the Elite area but I doubt that it made any difference and had no problems with the bar although it could be heard some evenings.

author: holidays074
title: Very relaxing holiday
text: Read some of the reviews on here before we went...was abit scared of arriving, but we actually really enjoyed it, it was quiet but thats to be expected in October & thats what we both wanted. Was about 10 mins away from bars but it was a nice walk down there abit of a up hill walk back but when you have been on the jugs of sangria you dont remember the walk! Would defo recomend The old sports bar the food was excellent there espcialy the combo for two. The Sixtys Bar had a good astmosphere Billy Spears was a great singer and the karaoke was good they get everyone involved. The 15 Bar sold excellent litre jugs of sangria and you can sit outside & watch the live shows in the Pieros Bar. Getting back to the apartments the maids came every other day they cleaned & left clean towels, the pool was ok apart from afew chipped tiles. The only complaint we had was i was ironing with the iron what is left in the room when i had a electric shock off a a bare wire we told the lady on reception & she sorted it. Over all we had a fantastic holiday and would go back there.

author: Angelafromuk
title: Forget it
text: We stayed in one of the "posh" suites! Our visit was rather disappointing. OK November/December is out of season, but the pool was freezing and the surrounding area was a very dirty. You could not sit around the pool to enjoy the sun, the loungers were filthy..enough said. We stayed in our "posh" suite instead. Nothing wrong with that except the loungers were falling apart, the jacuzzi was too full of chemicals and stank, the TV only had Eurosport no Sky Sports or British channels. No entertainment on site & the restaurant was closed. Oh dear. All in all it is a pity there is no TLC with a site like this. We decided NEVER AGAIN there are much better places to stay in this world than this DUMP!

author: Sheridan23
title: Butlins in Spain!
text: We have Just returned from a weeks stay at the Fuerteventura Beach Club and had a nice relaxing time. Myself and my partner are both reletivley young (23 + 26) and found the resort to be relatively quiet but that could coincide with it being out of season. The appartments were clean and well equpiied. ( iron, microwave,cooker, toaster etc...) There are 3 bars in the resort, of which the elite bar is the best, Tommy the owner is a top man who makes a pukka breakie! Zanzi bar was quiet but relaxing, the secret garden bar was closed.. the swimming pool was non heated, I only got in it once and it was freezing! we preffered to stay by the jacussiz, although one was not working!overall i would say this is more of a place for young famillies and older people, although for a weeks sun for £200, you cant go wrong! 8/10 - for families 8/10 - for old folk 7/10 - for couples 3/10 - for singles

author: mojoCumbria
title: ok but watch out for the thief who steals from locked safes
text: We did a internal exchange with our timeshare. On arrival the staff were very accommodating. The bungalow that we were put in was very nice, overlooking the pool and the secret garden ( end bungalow no 65? ) Everything going great till we had money taken from a locked safe. Obviously someone has got a spare key to the safe. Management not interested in this theory. And could not grasp the fact that we were robbed from a locked safe.Said someone must of picked the lock of the safe to open it and then picked it again to lock it !!!!!!! I dont think so. Realy spoilt our holiday

author: WorldloverSantaFe
title: Outstanding service
text: I admit that when we drove up to the hotel, I didn't have high hopes. The outside is uninspired, the lobby is tiny, and it is right on the road. The rooms are tiny, but very clean and modern and ours looked over the fjord. AND... the staff were superb - as good as at any high end resort. By the way, it seems that most hotel and restaurant staff were not Icelandic, but mostly for eastern European countries. They were very helpful. When we arrived, we asked if they could suggest any hikes and the young man suggested a couple and gave us very clear directions regarding how to find the trail. I highly recommend the hike that is just behind the hotel and goes up the ridge to overlook the next fjord (Talknafjodor).

author: sezarcstaffs
title: Great food, great people!
text: We stayed here one night last week (September) on a trip to the westfjords, and had travelled all day to get to there. The hotel was clean and comfortable, with a beautiful view of the water from the front of the hotel, including the restaurant. We were too tired to look for somewhere to eat in town, so decided to eat at the hotel restaurant. The service was friendly and the food was amazing! Two of us had the 'black cod' which we agreed was fresh and really, really good. The table was also served with bread freshly baked by the chef. In the morning, breakfast was good, typical cold cuts, more fresh bread, freshly baked rhubarb cake, yoghurts, fruit, cereal etc, but what was helpful was that for a reasonable price we could make sandwiches from the breakfast cold cuts for our day, which were then packed with chocolate biscuits, fruit and a juice box. That was really useful as it is quite remote in that area and stores are few and far between. Most of all, the staff were very warm, helpful and accomodating, and my husband stopped at the front desk on the way out to compliment the manager. We highly recommend this hotel as a place to stay in the westfjords.

author: RanaMarie
title: If I could give them a negative rating I would
text: We book our hotel at 5:56pm and realized shortly after that we couldn’t make it as far as we had hoped and the hotel was only giving us a twin bed. I say US because their were two of us. The confusion came from how they mention “breakfast for 2”. Once we saw the error we called the hotel directly. (About two hours after res was made and the hotel hadn’t even received the order yet it turns out). They were rude and unhelpful, next we called hotels.com, they were helpful but could do nothing. In fact they called the hotel as well and the hotel said they would bring up a bed but in a manner that even the hotels.com lady said, “yeah they won’t bring u a bed”....seriously? Worse customer service, in a country with wonderful ppl and wonderful service we hadn’t expected this. We will be telling our friends and their friends to avoid this place at all costs. Most disappointing experience during our whole Iceland trip.

author: cresned2440
title: Very welcoming staff
text: This is a great place to stay if you are travelling along the westfjords. The staff were exceptional. Reception staff so friendly and full of good advice on local hot tubs and sights. Restaurant staff were excellent, friendly chatty and good at their job. We ate dinner in the restaurant and were happy with our meals. Rooms large, modern and well equipped. Quite a bonus having a mini fridge for picnic provisions. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here thanks to the lovely staff

author: KayakLadyFL
title: Beautiful and Clean, Nice Location
text: We spent one night at the end of Sept here. It was a beautiful hotel, across from the harbor. The room was nice and clean. No heated bathroom floor though, or it wasn't on. We enjoyed a great dinner here as well. The room was clean, nicely decorated, warm and had shampoo, conditioner and blow dryer. Very nice. Would stay here again.

author: jlamb27613
title: OK -- a few things would make it better
text: Was just OK due to various annoyances, such as nowhere nice outside of the room to sit -- lobby too small to hold more than a couple chairs, no outside furniture. Wifi was worse than terrible, too slow to even retrieve e-mail, visiting website was an exercise in frustration. Only 2 TV channels, neither worth watching. I've been in rented RV's that had larger showers. Shower curtain hung outside of the shower stall, causing a minor flood on floor. Our room was on sunny (water) side which meant that the full blast of the sun hit the room until 10pm(ish), making room unbearably hot -- no A/C to cool it off, only 1 little window would open but opening it made for too much noise to sleep due to road just outside of window. In-room fridge made such much noise and was so hot (i.e. on its outside) that I ended up unplugging it. Very nice breakfast included in price of room. Staff friendly.

author: WunderlustForever
title: Good hotel
text: Not much atmosphere but comfortable room. Functional hotel, modern and central location. Best available in Patreksfjordur. Very average breakfast. Friendly staff. Clean and quiet. Parking easy. Nice view from the bedroom

author: stonellas
title: Very good modern hotel
text: This is a small modern hotel on the outskirts of Patreksfjodur built on 2 floors. We had a room on the ground floor which was more than adequate for a one night stay. The town itself is very small but the hotel was full the night we stayed with individual travellers. The bedroom besides a flat screen TV had a kettle , no fridge or mini bar. And was of a reasonable size. The bathroom had a hair dryer, shower but no toiletries. The rooms were spotlessly clean. There was a breakfast buffet which was up to Fosshotels normal standard with hot & cold fold, tast, cereals and fruit etc. There is internet throughout the hotel but we found it flakey. Other than that everything was more than satisfactory.

author: diannedavis
title: Lovely hotel stay in a tiny town
text: This was our first trip to the West Fjords. Glad we stayed at this Foss Hotel in Patreksfjorder. Small place as you would expect but nice, sparkling clean rooms. Food was very good. The hotel is right on the fjord with gorgeous views of Latrabjarg Cliffs. There is a gas station next door which is a real plus in the western fjords. While you're in town treat yourself to a trip to the area swimming pool. It's inexpensive and you can swim, Hot tub, and sauna!

author: W4735ZOkevinc
title: Modern hotel in the remote Westfjords, with exceptional customer service
text: After a day driving through the remote beauty of the Westfjords, we were surprised to discover such a new and wonderful hotel at the end of the trip. The rooms were bigger than expected and comfortable. The bathroom was great, with a separate / partitioned shower area. Breakfast buffet was as is typical. At the time of year that we visited, there were no other dinner options in the area (beyond the gas station cafe) so we opted for dinner at the hotel. We both got the seafood linguine which we both enjoyed. The weather changed for the worse overnight and we had trouble in the mountain pass leading out of Patreksfjorder. The front office staff was exceptionally helpful and accommodating, allowing us to wait out the weather in the lobby (and even offering us coffee and tea) before we made a 2nd (and successful) attempt through the pass later in the day. We wish to thank the staff for their remarkable hospitality and enthusiastically recommend this hotel to other travelers.

author: janev934
title: Out of the way new hotel
text: We drove here. One can't be faint of heart driving the mountain road here. We arrived in a wind and ice storm. Someone at the registration desk was kind enough to rescue me from being blown out to sea. We only had breakfast here which was the same buffet we had come to expect. It was fine . It was a beautiful location right on the sea. Staff was helpful when we returned 2 hours after our departure. We got lost. The young lady at reception sent us on our way with yet another map and a chuckle.

author: JarboeSF
title: Great hotel at stay in Patresfjordur
text: Hotel is new, nice and clean. Staff is friendly, especially the front desk. Check-in is speedy even though there was a line. We requested a non-ground floor room but was not available, even though the 2nd night, the hotel is running low occupancy. Nevertheless, we still enjoyed the hotel stay and recommend this hotel. We enjoyed the bisque soup, the lamb chops and fish and chips and the burger. Food is expensive but good, except for the seafood pasta is bland and mediocre, should have more seafood in it. The breakfast is average, can be improved with more hot food.

author: Joe106
title: Very nice newer property in West Fjords
text: New property located in the remote area of West Fjords. It is bright and cheery, with ample parking near the door. The staff was friendly and courteous and very efficient. The room was spacious when compared to most properties we booked on our two week tour of Iceland. The dining room staff was very efficient and cheerful. The dinner menu is typical of Iceland, fish, lamb and not much else. Our meal was excellent in flavor and appearance. This was one of our best hotel room/dining experiences of our 12 nights in Iceland.

author: sebastiang888
title: Good Hotel
