text: We stayed only one night during our trip through the western fjords. We had double room which was nice, the bathrooms are little small though. Generally the hotel is very nice, rooms and beds are good, comfortable beds, rain shower, free shampoo and shower gel... Good equipped. Food in the restaurant is not the best in the world but ok. The service is great, lovely people, very helpful. Tv, who needs TV in Iceland? If you do be prepared you only get 10 local channels of which 3 are in English ;)...

author: 417danz
title: Westfjords visit
text: We landed at Keflavik International Airport at around 6:45am, picked up our rental car and headed to the Westfjords. Originally we planed on the long drive around the Fjords but instead we caught the Baldur ferry in Stykkisholmur and crossed the Breidafjördur Bay to Brjanslaekur. It saves some time and the ferry is a fun experience. We arrived in Patreksfjordur at our hotel, the Fosshotel, had dinner and drinks and explored this tiny fishing village of about 800 people. The town was named after Saint Patrick who was the spiritual guide of Örlygur Hrappson, the original settler in the area. Its economy is mainly based on its fisheries. We immediately felt the warmth and hospitality of the locals and had a wonderful stay in Patreksfjordur. Thanks to all at the hotel, you have a beautiful town! Dan and Phyllis Denver, CO

author: redbaron12016
title: Excellent place
text: Located just outside of Patrehsfjodur this is an excellent place to start or finish your tour to the Westfjords. Newly buikd, everything is in perfect condition. The rooms are modern but cosy, nicely decorated with plenty of space. The staff goes to extra mile to assist guests with their needs. As we arruíved late in the evening and all tables were booked we already thought that we would not be able to get dinner. The receptionist made arrangements with the kitchen so they stayed open longer. It is the little things that make the difference. Keep up the good work, we will be back.

author: alanwB1378DL
title: Small place - clean Scandinavian design ( IE : AS IF Ikea DESIGNED HOTELS ;) great though !!
text: Everything was very nice. The staff i superb. The breakfast , self-serve - very good. Dinner in the restaurant was terrific. The room was clean and spacious - we had a standard then moved to a suite since I packed like a Saudi princess. Nice soft blue cove-accent-lighting was a very chic touch in the rooms. Very sharp bathrooms as well. Stone , pretty. WiFi was erratic and slow as can be . There WERE bad wind storms....but I think they need to upgrade their WiFi.

author: DJDxMKD
title: Clean & Modern in a remote location
text: Stayed for one night during our trip around Iceland. This was probably the 2nd nicest facility we stayed in during our trip (the first being the Fosshotel Vantnajokull). It was obviously recently built and is very clean and modern in the styling. We have a front room overlooking Patreksfjord (though it was rain/cloudy so, but I'm sure the view is spectacular in nice weather). Checkin was efficient and we have fast wifi in the room. There is a N1 station right next door. We had dinner at the restaurant which was excellent. I had the seafood soup and the lamb which were both fresh and tasty. Thanks go to Marco for excellent service. Despite the fact he was the only one working the front end of the restaurant he did and excellent job and kept everyone happy (he was taking orders, serving, making cocktails and working the front desk!) The 2 Fosshotels we stayed at were excellent and when I go to Iceland again, I will definitely make an effort to hit more of their hotels.

author: kristenq2013
title: Worth the trip. Gorgeous property with terrific staff
text: It was no easy feat just getting to this town. We had to navigate 3 hours of twisty turny roads up the west fjords. But it was all worth the trip. The staff was so welcoming upon our arrival and showed us how to get to a local attraction...natural hot tubs which are free to all. Our room was so beautiful and comfortable. The free breakfast inclided a variety of healthy, fresh foods. You must try the yogurt in Iceland. I would probably risk those roads once again to see return here.

author: supernovea
title: Good for a 1-night stop
text: Hotel is decent, but nothing amazing. I'm happy we got a good deal (in terms of Iceland prices). Room was clean, but too small for a recent hotel; rooms were bigger in all other hotels we stayed. So it's ok for one night, but it would have felt too cramped (with suitcases and everything) to stay several days. Bathroom is very small, you almost can't move in the shower and have no space to put your toiletries. Wi-fi was the worst I've experienced in Iceland. It almost never worked and employees seemed aware of the problem but nothing could be done. Dinner was very good; expensive but normal for Iceland. Breakfast was quite nice.

author: frankl44
title: A nice hotel with an excellent restaurant
text: Our superior room was as advertised with a panoramic view of the ocean from the second floor. The rooms are small, but well appointed and comfortable. No complaints, except perhaps the oft noted slow wifi connection. The restaurant was surprisingly well beyond expectation. In two nights we enjoyed the Salmon Ceviche, Cod, Spicy Lamb Chops, and Salmon on Seafood Risotto. All were perfect. This was matched with tasty local beers and impeccable service. For a hotel deep in the West Fjords, we were pleasantly surprised and recommend this hotel highly.

author: alexcastellarnau
title: Great restaurant service
text: We stayed at the hotel and also had dinner at the restaurant. It's a very convenient option if you are in such a remote location, it's a new functional hotel. This review is to thank you Veronique, the waitress that took care of us over dinner. Being the only restaurant in town there were a lot of people waiting. Veronique was the only person taking care of the tables and she never lost her smile. She kept checking on all the tables and making sure that even if the food wasn't coming out of the kitchen at the desired speed we all had our drinks. She handled a difficult evening with grace and made the experience much better than what it could have been. Thank you Veronique!

author: fadamek
title: Endearing
text: Friendly and helpful staff, no pretensions, clean, comfortable, and quiet. The hotel is new and modern. However, our room obviously had a rough previous tenant, but I am sure they will repair the damage. The breakfast was top notch. Hopefully they will take my wife's advice for them to put the scrambled eggs in a more visible location. I was full by the time I noticed the the scrambled eggs. WiFi was slow, but it may just have been a bad day As is normal at all hotels in Iceland, supper was pricey by Canadian standards. Just a few minutes walk next door is a fast food place that sells more affordable hamburgers and pizza. Beware, the portions are large.

author: kyle10014
title: Solid and welcome addition to hotels in the southern Westfjords
text: This was where we stayed the night we drove from Reyk to the Westfjords to begin our time there. Solid, well-maintained hotel consistent with quality of the Fosshotel chain. Rooms were clean and serviceable. Breakfast was fine. Town is small so saying the location is good would kind of apply to anyting and everything in town, but with that said, the location was good. Our room was ground floor but had view across the road of the sea. Despite being on ground floor by the road it was very quiet. Staff were friendly and reservations were easy.

author: ExcellentAdventures
title: Excellent property in Patreksfjordur
text: We spent two nights at Fosshotels Westfjords in Petreksfjord. It served as our base while exploring the beautiful attractions in the area such as Rauosandur (the red sand beach) and the Latrabjarg bird nesting cliff. The staff members were friendly and professional. Our room (no. 202) was excellent as it was at the end of the hallway and offered a great view across the fjord. The room was spacious and had two twin beds, a small refrigerator and coffee/tea making facilities with the coffee/tea supplied. Free wifi (was excellent - strong signal and very fast) and a buffet breakfast were included in our rate. The hotel did have an elevator (lift) which makes it easy to access the upper floor with luggage. The complimentary breakfast buffet included brewed coffee and teas, various meats and cheeses, boiled eggs, a variety of breads & crackers, cold cereal, juices and some sweets such as cookies and pastries. We highly recommend Fosshotels Westfjords to other individuals exploring the area.

author: 850stephend
title: What a surprise
text: What a surprise to come across such a fine hotel in the far NW of Iceland. Modern rooms, well appointed in a typical Scandinavian simplicity and superbly comfortable. Breakfast, although simple, was very good. Their fresh, warm, home baked bread was the standout. Avoid the scrambled eggs however....not sure how they got them so bad. The evening meal was very, very good. Based on a simple menu, it was delicious. Just as well, as there is very little other options in Patreksfjordur. Highly recommended.

author: Rich_Toria
title: Comfortable rooms, rude staff.
text: Stayed here for 2 nights as we explored the Westfjords. We arrived on Saturday evening, and greeted by a rude receptionist who couldn't find our booking. After showing her out email confirmation she gave us our room key and off we went to room 113. Don't stay in room 113. It's directly outside reception and opposite the entrance to the hotel, so really quite noisy. The room itself was comfortable, and the bathroom was good. The advertised free wifi is unusable, couldn't even send an email with a picture attached. The breakfast was good, pretty standard with no surprises. The morning we checked out we were again dealing with another rude member of staff.

author: 197rhondad
title: Good hotel, but....
text: This is another Fosshotel where the rooms are factory built and erected together with a crane. Our room was very small and cramped. The beds were very inexpensive and uncomfortable. The bathroom is like a cruise ship bathroom. And the wifi was weak and slow (or stop). We had to sit in the lobby (along with several others) to use the wifi. The staff was friendly and helpful. Tha breakfast was a full one and we enjoyed it. The hotel was clean.

author: JaeYoung79
title: Nice crews and clean room.
text: I've been there in May. 2015 and stayed 1 night. I found that the westfjords had most beautiful sceneries in Iceland after my trip. The staff, 'Lulu' and 'Patrick' was very kind and well-trained. Room was very clean and quiet. Breakfast was not to much, but above the average. If I go to Iceland again, I'll stay westfjords for serveral days. And I hope to see those outstanding staff, lulu and patrick, again.

author: poimiroo
title: Surprising Westfjords
text: The Westfjords of Iceland are full of surprises, including this new, immaculate and well-managed property. All the rooms are compact, though the single Queen room provides ample comfort and comes with a room safe, refrigerator, desk and side chair. The restaurant serves prix fixe gourmet dinners and a substantial breakfast. The village of Patreksfjordur is the tourism center for Iceland's northwest Westfjords region. Tours of the fish packing facility can be arranged at the visitor center, as well as to a local French fisherman's museum. A key reason for visiting the Westfjords is the Puffin nesting area, a half day's drive southwest at the westernmost point in Europe. The superb Iceland Sea Monster Museum, a Westfjords museum, the impressive Dynjandi Falls and numerous smaller waterfalls can be visited in the area. Rigorous hiking trails are throughout the region, though should be attempted only with knowledge of the trails. Sea angling (sport fishing) for cod, haddock, Atlantic char and salmon is available in Patreksfjordur. Dining opportunities in the region are limited, though each village has at least one good restaurant, serving fresh fish and Icelandic specialties.

author: erere
title: Recommend
text: My wife and I spent one night in this hotel, between the 18th and 19th August. We were allocated a modern, spotless double room on the front with a wonderful view of the fjord. The room itself was not large but comfortable enough for us. Good sized bathroom with shower, hairdryer and very small sink. Seems these very small sinks are the trend in Iceland because almost all the hotels we visited are equipped with these micro-sinks. The breakfast was abundant and very good. Cannot comment about the value because our stay in the hotel was part of a tour package. Although we stayed only one night I would recommend this hotel and would gladly revisit should the opportunity arise.

author: zigeunerin
title: Very accomodating hotel!
text: Had a wonderful time at Fosshotel West Fjords, in spite of the rainy foggy weather. The hotel sits right on the edge of the water. The rooms were spotless and the dinner was superb! The seafood soup was wonderful! The ling cod was super fresh! Breakfast buffet was quite extensive and hit the spot! We could not have asked for more! The staff could not be more helpful. We had a number of questions about the roads and they very patiently explained which ones were gravel and which ones were paved.

author: SoCalTravellers
title: Clean and contemporary
text: We stayed for two nights in July. The hotel is contemporary and clean. Our room had a view of the fjord, which was very nice. The breakfast and happy hour were very good. Hrafnhilder (we apologize if we spelled it wrong) at the front desk was unbelievably helpful with a tire problem we had. She was very helpful with everything else, too! Also, the hotel manager was very friendly and helpful. We would recommend this hotel and would stay again if we returned to the area.

author: littledsheff
title: Nice rooms and helpful staff
text: We stayed here for 3 nights room was really nice and very clean, downside was that we didn't have a sea view as all these rooms were taken on our first night. Staff were very helpful in terms of advice about the area and road conditions. Breakfast is very good and plentiful. Only other minor thing was the shower curtain in the shower as it didn't really stay In place so the floor got quite wet, but this was a minor issue and overall the room was excellent. We ate in the restaurant 2 nights, the first night the food was extremely salty so the next night I asked for less salt and got none which was preferable. Food was pretty nice though I found the steak very chewy and couldn't eat most of it. My partners meal was still very salty on second evening so I think this is something the chef/hotel need to give consideration too as not everyone will appreciate this level of salt in their food. For this reason I have given it very good instead of excellent.

author: RalphL_13
title: Nice new hotel. Expensive restaurant
text: We stayed in room 204, which had a great view over the fjord. The rooms are nice and modern. The staff was friendly and helpful. The restaurant was good but quite expensive. Breakfast in the morning A+. Just like the other visitors, we seriously disliked the fact that wifi was not free. Its been a long time ago since ive seen this. There was a public Internet pc available downstairs, however.

author: herbert_eins
title: A very new but very cold hotel / Ein komplett neues, aber leider sehr kaltes Hotel
text: The Fosshotel Westfjords is a completely new hotel - at least it seems like that - the building right next to the sea and the rooms are very modern and appear to be pretty new. The hotel was quite pricy, which leads to my first complaint - how can a hotel cost that much and still try to rip off their customers by offering wifi on a buy-only base? This is not acceptable in 2013. My second complaint will also affect people who do not care about wifi - the room was very cold. The room itself had only one radiator below the window, which was deactivated when we came into the hotel. The problem is, the only way to avoid people from looking into the room (ground floor) was by closing a heavy curtain (you also need the curtain against the short darkness( - which covered the radiator as well - and so the heat could not get into the room. In the bathroom there was a very cold stone floor which looked like it would have a floor heating - but it did not. The hotel was nice, but for this price I expect a warm room and free wifi.

author: jtcase
title: Brand new hotel
text: We spent one night here at a discounted price because the Radagerdi hostel had an overbooking problem (for what's worth, it looked like an honest mistake on their part). It's a brand new structure, with clean and modern rooms. Our double room with bathroom had a big and comfortable bed and offered a beautiful view of the bay. They charged for the use of WiFi. Also, WiFi signal coverage was quite poor in the rooms. However, there was an Internet workstation available for free in the lobby. Breakfast was pretty standard. As usual in Iceland, the staff was very nice and helpful. This hotel is in a great location for visiting Breidavik and seeing the famous puffins. There's also a nearby public bath with a beautiful view and a small supermarket in case you don't wanna eat at the hotel restaurant.

author: Dawne03
title: Great hotel
text: We stayed here for one night in mid June and thoroughly enjoyed it. The room was very clean and comfortable and we really appreciated the heavy curtains. It was incredibly quiet. In the hall, our neighbor's tv was very loud but in our room, we couldn't hear it at all. The restaurant was excellent. We had both dinner and breakfast there. The staff were friendly and helpful. Of all the places we stayed in Iceland, this was our favorite.

author: mphtravel
title: Good place for short stay
text: I stayed here for 3 nights. Location not the best area in the city but I travelled by Grab. Very nice pool area on the 20th floor. In the distance you can see the Petronas Towers. I booked the room by Airbnb. Self check in after 9 pm. Room was furnished in modern style with half open bathroom (shower and toilet behind milk glass doors). Because I only paid around 20 euro p/night I can say Value for Money.

author: Budakampung
title: Great room but mix experience
text: D'Majestic is located near the old part of Pudu/KL, near Pudu plaza and lots of eateries around. But, some may feel a bit uneasy as it is surrounded by old shops but not modern township setting. The room has great view of the new tallest building in KL which is still under construction. It comes with separate toilet and bathroom which is great! Nevertheless, it would be great to have a hanger inside the bathroom. Cleanliness should be improved further as both towels got stains and looks a bit worn out, hair was found on top of the bed sheet. You should bring your own toiletries too as only body and hair shampoo is provided. The safe in the room was not usable. Also, do note that this is a service apartment that run by property management company but not a hotel, hence they only has staff at the reception area from 9am-9p.m and special arrangement needs to be made prior to arrival if you arrive early or late. Some units are managed by different Airbnb operators, hence best to check on the check in/out process during your booking and there was no house keeping service.

author: krystiann214
title: Great value
text: Great hotel, the staff were very helpful and knowledgeable. The saunas, gym and rooftop pool with some great view were definitely an advantage. We found 24/7 convenience store in the building very useful. The hotel shuttle bus service takes guests to several POI scattered around the district. Overall, very good value! After some time the toilet started to smell, which was a pain in the neck. A/C was uncontrollable and quite cold - completely no difference between 22°C and 30°C. The room could have been maintained a little better for 50$ a night, found some dust where we wouldn't have expected it, but we are quite sensitive about that. No sockets anywhere near the bed.

author: romanianwanderer
title: The pool and terrace are the only good parts
text: The pool and terrace are really nice! The view is amazing. The room however... We rented it through Airbnb and it has been horrible. The shower is clogged and we couldn’t get the cover off to unclog it. There are ANTS everywhere in the room! We moved the bed and it seemed like someone spilled something sticky on the floor so the ants really liked that spot. That also means they didn’t fully clean the place... hot water is also limited. the lobby is nice and, again, the pool is really cool.

author: thyesengl
title: Beware of KL Shortstay
text: Some of the rooms are from KL ShortStay, they bought a few rooms and rented to tourist but the management is different from the hotel. Please avoid booking them even the price seem cheaper than the hotel itself. First of all, they collect cleaning fees, when added up total, it is the same price as booking the hotel, so might as well book hotel rooms as you get a better service from the hotels. Secondly, their Manager is very rude and have attitude problem, he do not understand what is good quality services. He can raise his voice to talk to me as a guests and even ask me to get lost from the apartment. We are tourist, we come here to enjoy not get humiliated. My room's heater was switched off by the Manager just because I had some arguement with him earlier. Please don't try to save some money and book from KL shortstay, really not worth the money, and the room they gave you is not good also. Stick with the hotel. Sincerely hope you guys don't fall for the same trap as me.

author: eugeneg345
title: The great hotel for 4* in Malasia
text: Who made this hotel bad rate? If you ever been in Asia - this hotel is like Asian 5*. From 1st floor with great reception till 20th with the fantastik view and large chill zone, where are lots of place for everyone. High gym 24 hours and great big pool with amazing view. And hotel is very true because of real peoples life around hotel. 3 min walking to metro, 7 min to monorail. Many shopping center around. Perfect place to stay for 4 star hotel. Will stay only there in next trip to Kuala Lumpur.

author: noorula535
title: Hotel with infinite pool
text: This hotel is easily 5 stars for me, staff all spoke english, security is at reception and on the 20th floor where the infinite pool is. The room were stayed had the city views which was basically waking up and seeing the petronas towers and other skyscrapers. The room was cleaned every day and in good quality. We initially stayed for 6 days then moved onto Phuket, Thailand. We had one day back in KL so we decided to stay here again as we were so used to this hotel, felt like home! Convienance store is next door to the hotel which is open 24 hours! Very good hotel get booking! You won't regret this.

author: benhN9218II
title: Average hotel, exceptional pool
text: The main feature of this hotel is the pool. It offers great views of the city and the Petronas towers. It is also open till 22:00 so great night time views to enjoy too. The hotel itself is pretty average but good value for money. The staff were helpful when needed and the rooms were smart. The location was good enough and close to lots of public transport to get around the city. There are a few restaurants within a mile or so radius so no shortage of walkable places. A few improvements I’d say are that the cleaning staff need to be quicker, as one day we had been out for the whole day and he decided to turn up at 18:00 as we were getting ready to go out. They were also pretty stingy with the free shower gel/shampoo which we relied on as we were travelling around South East Asia for 3 months so obviously didn’t want to carry loads of toiletries around with us.

author: liamd1998
title: Worth a stay
text: Me & my girlfriend decided to stay in this hotel for 3 nights mid feb, upon arrival we were very politely greeted by friendly staff. The rooms are very nice & spacious and have a very unique design, the view from our room was amazing (straight onto the twin towers) other rooms I expect aren’t as good dependant on which side of the hotel you are on. The only downside of the rooms were the shower, it was very good and modern but it was very smelly and made the room smell disgusting at times. Our TV didn’t work to start with so we called the maintenance guy, he was amazing, so friendly and helpful and a credit to the hotel, TV sorted within 10 minutes (just needed a new wire). Another disappointment with the hotel was one of the maids, a female lady who was very rude on the phone, our room wasn’t cleaned by 4pm (we left the room at 10am). By far the highlight of this hotel was the pool area, it was amazing, clean, excellent views & a good place to eat (we often ordered take away and sat and enjoyed the view/sunset) it’s never often too busy either, there’s 6/7 sunbeds and the busiest we saw it was 5 being used ! We enjoyed the hotel and Kuala Lumpur massively and ended up getting a further 2 nights in the end.. recommend this hotel, good value, but the maid needs sorting out and the shower smell.

author: clubpurser84
title: Nice apartment and pool with City view
text: Stay 1 night but not under Hotel Side but under owner unit. 2 bedroom apartment with full kitchen utility + washing machine wash and dryer. Wifi using Unifi so no problem at all. They have very exclusive outdoor pool with city view. Open up to 11pm. Just a bit disappointed with they security from nepal or Bangladesh at pool area. Very rude. Really rude. Besides that all ok.

author: adomo13
title: Disappointed
text: My boyfriend and I were really excited about this hotel for Christmas as the photos online and were amazing and this hotel was ranked #3 in Kuala. When we got here the staff was ignorant right off the start. They didn’t give us the room we booked. It took 5 hours for house keeping to come to our room to clean and we still had to call the reception and ask what the hell is going on. The security guard on the roof top pool is rude. And the pool isn’t even infinity all the way. The room is bright as hell in the morning. Disappointed for the amount of money we paid. Merry xmas 🙃

author: Harlouquin
title: Christmas let down
text: First of all this hotel tried to cancel my booking before I arrived and it was a pain contacting them to try and sort it out as I was recieving very little response. Then they asked me to supply them with my credit card details via email which I told them was dangerous but they insisted. Upon arrival I was looking forward to a nice swim on Christmas day in a lovely hotel. The room itself was nice and one member of staff (Vishnu) was very helpful, however it was dirty with what looked like splattered milk on the cupboard and sneeze marks on the mirror. I explained this to the staff and they said it would be released as there were no other rooms available with a double bed as I had requested. I waited an hour for hour for them to clean it, only to go back up and find that it smelled nicer and the mirror was clean but the cupboard was still dirty. At this point I knew I wouldn't enjoy my Christmas here and simply went downstairs and asked for a refund. The manager insisted he couldn't refund me at first because of booking.coms commission until I mentioned that my reservation had been made directly through themselves because they cancelled my booking.com reservation and they then said they could only refund me half as they would be losing money. So the hotel is alright, a bit shabby, the staff are not great and my room wasn't clean, Merry Christmas :(

author: AnkitB778
title: Beautiful Swimming Pool, good location, average service
text: Positives: - Rooms were spacious and had a nice composition. - Open bathroom concept was really nice, specially for couples. - Location: It's walking distance from Times Square street, which is famous for its night life. - Infinity pool at the top floor had an awesome view of the Petronas towers, pool area is the highlight of this hotel, it's big and we spent all our late nights taking a dip in the pool and looking at the night skyline. It's a great sunrise point as well. - Other facilities include: Steam room, Jacuzzi and a well equipped gym. Negatives: - Breakfast buffet is a very BIG improvement area. It used to be a big let down everyday. - Staff is not helpful and inflexible

author: yourchoiceholidaysy
title: IDEAL Distributor stay for 02nights
text: First of all we like to say the hotel in the heart of city centre of Bukit Bintang, very near to Berjaya time square for shopping. The property wise and the rooms are amazing but the service in front desk has to improve more and more, Our group arrive in the hotel at 16.00hrs but we had the same problem has been faced here also the booking for 20rooms but till 16.00hrs not even one room has been ready, wenn we asked the manager at front desk Mr. Vigneshwaran the answer given check inn stay from 15.00hrs onwards but dont worry we issue all the rooms key with in 02hrs, wenn we heard this information from manager i dont know what to stay. The entire group members all waiting with baggage in the lobby for rooms key. At last at 18.00hrs we got all the rooms thank god. But the the second problem started once the group members check inn the rooms. Not even an single room have bath towel or hand towel we have asked many times to Housekeeping and laundry they answer please sir will get you with a mint. But the members waitied more than hour no towels has been placed, finally we all went for dinner once we back the towel has been placed, apart from breakfast menu and the hotel facility was good, but we dont know what was the issue the hotel house keeping department has to be improve more and more. We dont accommodate here after any groups in this hotel first and last..

author: 87lydiak
title: Poor hotel
text: Manager was rude. Room was not clean at all. Towels had holes in and stained. Location not the best if you want to be in the city centre. We got the train everywhere but no where is within walking distance. The only good thing about this hotel was the rooftop pool. P.S what ever you do, don't look under the bed... probably hasn't been cleaned since the hotel started.

author: 739parags
title: A HOTEL TO BE AVOIDED WITH THE CURRENT STATE OF MANAGEMENT
text: It is a good property, well built but wasted under the current staff. Housekeeping was lousy, staff was incompetant and outright rude. Reception and Housekeeping dont even answer the phone. Rooms were not made up even though we checked in at 18.00 hrs and we were still handed the keys. We were a large group of friends on holiday and everyone had some bad experience or the other. Towels not in place, Air conditioning not working, dirty toilets, and to top it all totally unresponsive staff. The elevators were supposed to have a capacity of 15 persons, but only 5 were allowed at a time. When questioned the security guy literally told me " dont talk too much, just do as you are told". I dont think any Hotel guest has ever been spoken too in this manner.

author: ThomasFrank1989
title: Ride Staff, Dated Room, Charged me twice
text: The pictures you see online are misleading the rooms are dated as is the lobby. The staff are rude. Our first room smelt like sewers before I had to ask to move. Second room was better in terms of smell but the rest really wasn't up to standard. This was once I can see a beautiful hotel but it just hasn't been looked after. The one saving grace is the pool a really beautiful view and seems to be well kept. I paid in cash in full upon arrival as requested and have now found my credit card charged also. Have sent 3 emails to no avail. No surprise really as the staff were useless.

author: Wilfred_the_Brit
title: So much potential just very few tweaks here and there.
text: The price was unbeatable and the roof top swimming pool is a triumph that were the reasons I booked this hotel and I don't regret it but, there is a lot of room for improvement. For starters the direction the hotel gives you are not the clearest or best. They advice you to stop at Hang Tuah metro station and walk and not very friendly walk, alongside major roads with very fast traffic, while stopping at Pudu station is a lot nearer and much more straight forwards. Jus give a quick google maps and you'll see my point. The room was huge, more like an studio apartment but scarcely furnished. Again, a interior designer can do wonders. And three, the breakfast, that was a let down. repetitive and lacking of some basics like coffee, hot... there were morning that it wasn't even there. As i said the gym and swimming pool are a triumph, they just need a bit of a bar with some drinks and it would be heaven after a day around the city.

author: 986CrystalS
title: A great stay. Worth it.
text: Stayed in Luxe for 2 nights. Room and amenities are excellent. Staffs did their jobs well. Location is great. But the car park isn't as expected. The entrance is very narrow. Please be careful. Car park is chargeable at full rate even though you have the "discount voucher" from the Reception, as there is some error with the kiosk asp the Reception. Overall the hotel is worth the price.

author: Billericay2017
title: Enjoyable stay
text: Friendly security staff. Great roof top pool. Easy walk to Imbi monorail station, and Pudu LRT is just over the road. Only a couple of dollars by taxi to the Pavillion at Bukit Bintang. Only a $1 breakfast (teh tarik and egg roti canai) at Ali Corner House in street next door. Great one hour massage for 45 ringgit at Thai massage place at 14a Jalan Kancil just round the corner from Ali Corner House. If you like Cantonese music try New Peng Wah Food Court behind ASEAN Hotel and One Stop Food Court at Jalan Gelang. Don't eat there but the beer is fine and reasonable for Malaysia

author: HappyTravellller
title: Paradise get away in the city
text: They have the best infinity pool in KL. Beautiful view of the city skyline as well as a awesome view of the sunset when I check in late at 6pm. I was staying in the hotel studio and I was very surprise by the space! My room is at the corner and i feel a lot of privacy! The room is really SUPER SPACIOUS, open bathroom which make me feels like room and there is a bathtub tt oversees the whole bathroom area. The bathroom size is almost the same as my bedroom size. I love the living room as well, it gives me a lot of space to do yoga n simple work out when i feel like it. Afterall, it is definitely a place that I'll be back !

author: HarsimranS76
title: Kuala Lumpur Trip
text: It was my Honeymoon Trip, and first we visited Bali, and then on the way back stayed at this Hotel. Hotel was really nice and clean and the room had a unique architecture, which we both loved. Also, we could see Twin towers out of our Windows which was awesome view at night. It was a short and a sweet trip, although we had just 2 days here we were almost able to complete major sightseeing in KL and that too because of De voyager global tours in Malaysia, and guide named 'V'.. trendy name though.. was very helpful and informative. It was a trip to remember. Thank you guys. :)

author: 820lener
title: Wonderful pool, bad breakfast
text: The best about this hotel is with no doubt the big rooftop swimming pool on 20th floor with an unsurpassed view of KL. The pool officially opens at 7 in the morning, but in reality it may not open until 7.30 due to maintenance work. Spacious, clean rooms. Even on the top floors there is a lot of noise from traffic and near-by music in the evenings. The breakfast buffet mainly includes Asian-style food. There is white bread only and a poor selection of cereals. The black coffee does not taste good. Coffee lovers are recommended to order a cappuccinno which is well worth the extra cost of 10 ringits. The hotel is new and modern. It is located in a poor neighbourhood, safety may be an issue here.

author: 757isabelo
title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed here twice. The first time to recover from a long flight from the UK and the second time, to prepare for the return flight! The hotel is beautiful - lovely lobby, large and well presented rooms, a stunning rooftop infinity pool and views across the city. It bookended our budget trip perfectly. Our first stay was very reasonably priced (about £32 UK for a large twin room) but the second was more expensive (about £45) without breakfast. We overlooked the fact that tax and service were charged on top of the advertised price (Booking.com). However, having a lovely time by the pool between shopping and sight seeing still made it worth while. We had an economy breakfast in the Indian restaurant on the corner in the square behind the hotel. Delicious fresh roti with egg plus a cup of coffee for just over £1.00 for two of us.

author: patricialT1871TV
title: Do not book this hotel!!
text: We stayed one night and it was a terrible mistake. Our room had a strong moldy odour and looked liked it hardly got cleaned. Our glasses had stains on them, our TV and phone didn't work. The breakfast hall is located in the centre of the hotel and dish noises echo to all of the rooms. The website we booked on said they offered a shuttle service but they dont. The only thing good about this place is the roof top pool. Otherwise pictures are completely deceiving. Avoid this place!

author: korndamned
title: Great place to stay.
text: This is more like a serviced apartment type. I have stayed in the standard and the deluxe. Deluxe comes with full facilities in kitchenette and washer and dryer. Room is nice and spacey. What I really like is the surrounding. You are located in the real downtown Kuala Lumpur. If you're into real local Chinese food. You're in for a treat. Just so a food tour using the in-house food trail. Splendid.

author: IwanBaser
title: Good location, average room, slow check-in
text: The -ve: Tight parking entrance, parking lot is too short for big car. Room is average, Pillow is too soft and not very comfortable. As "genius" status guest, i was given 2 hours early check in by booking.com and I already request earlier for early check-in. I only arrived at the hotel 30 minutes before check-in time (1.30pm) but my room wasn't ready until 2.30 and I was given another room. My card key was deactivate before 12 noon, and I cannot access my floor using the elevator when coming down from the rooftop pool. The +ve: The rooftop infinity pool and the view. Good location, Near to IKEA and Pudu LRT Station. 7-11 store under the building. KFC across the street.

author: Sooky2022004
title: Great rooftop View ever!
text: I can highly recommend this hotel to anybody who wishes to visit Kuala Lumpur. It is located quite close to PUDU train station ( 5 minute walk ) and the area itself is surrounded by local food shops and small businesses. The highlight of this hotel is the view from the rooftop! The view of the city is spectacular especially the well-lit Petronas Towers. I was already happy with what I saw that I need not go and see them up close! The room we had was really nice and clean that we didn't want to leave. The staff are so warm and speak pretty good English so it is a big plus! When I get a chance to visit KL again, I'll definitely stay here.

author: suffian
title: "d'majestic"ally Homey
text: The best hotel (so far) within the Bukit Bintang area. The room is way too spacious for my small family of 4. The bed is ultimately comfortable. The kitchen and washing machine is well function. The bathroom is heavenly raindrop. Bonus point : The kl skyline infinite swimming pool with wading pool for kids. Cons : 1. Kitchen tools - no suitable wok/pot to use 2. No place to hang towel in toilet and bathroom

author: DyllahG
title: The staff is rude...
text: I booked a 2D1N stay in this hotel. Booked a total of 3 units of the 2 Bedroom Suite. Upon check in, 1 of the room was not ready so we park all our belongings in another room which is at level 14 as we need to go out for some other activities as plan in our itinerary. According to front desk, our room will be available within 1.5hours. We came back to the hotel at 10:30pm and went straight to our room. At about 11:30pm, we wanted to retrieve our luggage from another room at level 14 (our room at level 12) so we went down to the lobby to get assistance from the hotel staff but was turn down rudely by one female Indian staff instead of helping us resolve the issues. If it's not because of your rude staff, I've would have enjoy our stay here... Definitely not coming back...

author: frankv262
title: Noisy, no atmospere
text: We booked this hotel because it was very new and the price was good. Room interior is ok. Very noisy location. You could hear the busy road very good. Had to wear eardops at night. And this on a holiday ?! The hotelhallways are at the end open (no wall) so the noice of the street enters you room through every direction. Hotel is big but you see almost no personnel or other guests=> no atmospere. The pool on top of the roof is super. The direct area around the hotel is not interesting at all !

author: SasaNemanic
title: Rooftop pool with a view
text: Amazing value for money. Spacious and well equipped rooms, good location. Rooftop infinity pool with a view of Petronas Twin Towers and KL TV Tower is amazing. Sauna and fitness if a bonus. Good Wi-Fi. Friendly staff. Please just add some towel hangers in there! ;) Highly recommended!

author: uig8
title: Best stay of our entire travels!
text: Arrived at this hotel and was greeted by smiley staff. Requested a higher floor if possible and what a room we got! The staff told us we would like what they had done for us. We went up to the room not sure what the "surprise" was. On entry to our room on the high floor we had requested, was the d'majestic suite, a free upgrade to a huge room with everything you could ask for. A beautifully designed room and so clean and maintained. A gorgeous view of the pertronas towers. Perfect. Thank you D'majestic.

author: waikit_0789
title: A relax and cosy stay!
text: It's New Year Eve and 8 of us just decided to join in the hype to countdown in Kuala Lumpur City; We booked a two bedroom D' Majestic Suite for a night. The overall stay is good but we are disappointed with the management of the hotel. Firstly, the pool which located on the rooftop is closed when we decided to head there to countdown the last moment of year 2015. We didn't expect this as we thought it would be a nice place to countdown while watching the fireworks and stars on the sky. Secondly, the air-conditioning on the suite is not functioning properly; there's only 2 units of 1HP Carrier and 1.5HP Carrier air conditioning powering the 500-700 SF living hall. The air conditioning in the room ain't functioning well though. The free wifi in the room ain't functioning though. Other that that, it was a pleasant stay.

author: ABUBAKAR2735
title: Nice hotel but should improve further
text: The hotel's car park entrance is quite small. Need to be extra careful. I love the swimming pool and gymnasium at level 20. very beautiful view at night. The pool closed at 10pm, compared to other hotel, at 7.00pm, thus more time to swim. The wifi not functioning in my room. No restaurant open for lunch or dinner, luckily there is a mamak restaurant nearby, and a 7 eleven attached with the hotel building. quite close to Bukit Bintang commercial area.

author: bossapaul
title: What u see is not what u get.
text: Booked the hotel for 2 nights initially, but had to cancel 2nd night n move ourself to another hotel. The hotel rated 4 stars, but the building was a bit small to be i think. Check in was a bit slow, den couldnt tap my key card for the lift, but counter staffs were kind n friendly to help us with the problem. went into the room n realise it was totally NOT what we saw in the photos, room was very small, no sofa, no bathtub, more like boutique 3 star hotel. The Shower has no hot water, bedside lights pops out of order when we try to switch it on in the middle of the night... wake up in the morning n realise something bite my back n my wife's legs. Overall although the hotel staffs were lovely and helpful, but the hotel is totally not up to swiss garden's standards. We had stayed at other swiss garden before and were impressed by them, but this hotel seems more like a cheaper version but with premium rates.it lacks the quality n experience of their brand.

author: 720libbyn
title: Lovely new hotel, superb swimming pool
text: Only spent one night here, but it was great! Rooms themselves are very modern, few very minor detail errors but overall very well-designed. Pool and gym facilities are great-all new and well suited. Lovely staff. Not super central but given taxis are so cheap this wasn't an issue. We chose this hotel because of the rooftop pool-needed somewhere to cool down and relax for the day, which the pool was perfect for! Fantastic views from here in the evening. Hopefully as time passes the hotel will become more popular and the rooftop bar will open. Would definatley recommend to friends and return ourselves in the future.

author: laysoonl
title: Family trip in KL
text: Room is well designed and very spacious and modern designed. With the price paid is equivalent to 5 star hotel . The sky view swimming is beautiful .Good location .walking distance to Kuala Lumpur shopping mall such as time square and bukit bintang shopping mall and KLCc. Easy to find food especially local delicious food . (Local famous fish curry restaurant is just a few shops away )Many local food stalls are surrounding the hotel especially if you loved local food .local bus stop is just right in front of the hotel that make easy to visit other place if you are familiar to the local bus service and you are in budget . Hotel staffs are friendly and helpful . MRT station is in walking distance . Strongly recommended for short stay in Kuala Lumpur and also for family trip as the room is big .

author: Navigator27387593136
title: Great Hotel / Gran Hotel
text: The hotel was very clean, comfortable and quiet. The staff were very nice and professional. It’s modern and if you are on holiday in Barcelona and don’t want to stay in the centre, it’s perfect. Just a short walk to the Metro with a train every 3 minutes. I highly recommend this hotel. El hotel estaba muy limpio, cómodo y tranquilo. El personal era muy agradable y profesional. Es moderno y si estás de vacaciones en Barcelona y no quieres quedarte en el centro, es perfecto. A pocos pasos del metro con un tren cada 3 minutos. Recomiendo altamente este hotel.

author: eoliva207718
title: Very comfortable hotel, close to the sea, supermarket, restaurants and transport links
text: Stayed here for 11 nights in July/August. Very hot, even for the season and the air conditioning was much appreciated. About a ten minute waslfrom a long, sandy beach with a lifeguard patrol and crystal clear water. We had booked a B&B package and the breakfast buffet had some nice variety. There was a sizeable supermarket just around the corner so self-catered most of our meals and occasionally ate out, or in the restaurant bar on the 2nd floor terrace. Staff were very friendly and the standard of cleanliness was good. My only quibble was the lack of tea and coffee making facilities in the room. Given that we were here almost two weeks, we bought a small electric kettle and some souvenir mugs from a bazar, down the road.

author: Ali921
title: Good hotel if you want a more authentic catalonian experience
text: The hotel is located at the end of the L2 metro line (about 10 min walk) so away from main tourist area. Some of the main benefits of staying here are that you experience a more authentic catalonian atmosphere, cheaper prices, and less crowds. It's only about 10 minutes from the old town which is full of shops/bars/restaurants. Although the hotel has no pool its close enough to the beach to not be an issue. The rooms were clean and tidy but with some quirks: strong shower but the screen was too small so water sprayed out of the bath; sink design is so odd if you're not careful water splashes all over the place; no soap dish; and not quite enough storage space for two peoples wash bags. That said the A/C was easy to control and worked strongly. Breakfast was continental and cooked food. Service always polite and efficient. Overall a good functional hotel.

author: Chiz1098r
title: Great 14 day stay
text: We were here with a team of Scottish players. We were playing in Barcelona but preferred Badalona to chill in as it's far quieter. The hotel rooms were great and even though 4he bar was small it was prompt service. The buffet breakfast was top notch with the option of bacon. Eggs. Beans and mushrooms if you wished. Nice seating area on the 14th floor with great views. The hotel us by the motorway but the rooms well soundproofed . Staff were superb .The metro is 8 minutes walk away.

author: newrozsindy
title: Deam in BADALONA .
text: Badalona is a Mittel town. There are Not so man tourist. You van see how live the native Person from there. Beach ja direlt in tue near. Shopping mal also. You habe Everything what do you need. Ich liebe raus town. I wann to Go there Everytime . ...

author: ale2501ale
title: a step away from Barcelona
text: Very good hotel in Badalona, near the city center. The metro station connects to Barcellona in few minutes. Friendly and helpful staff. Great breakfast. Spacious and modern rooms. Impeccable room cleaning. nice view from the terrace. Great experience

author: Llubi
title: The best hotel in Badalona
text: Lovely hotel, nice, spacious, clean hotel , the stuff were so helpful and nice, everything that I ask they did. The views of the hotel are nice from the top roof, there is not pool facilities only a terrace to take some sun and have drinks. The breakfast buffet is good, lots of choices like sweets and salty food. From healthy to unhealthy. You can easy walk to the beach is only 15 mins walking distance the same distance to the metro that takes you to Barcelona city. The hotel has a Gym but is very basic not work out machines only cardio but is okay for a holiday stay. You can enjoy the sauna. I do recommend this hotel I did have a nice experience.

author: nicoleu179
title: Very nice modern hotel
text: We stayed here for a few nights whilst visiting Barcelona. The hotel is situated near a highway but you couldn't hear the traffic in the room. The room itself is a modern style with the bathroom sort of open to the rest of the room, contemporary I believe. It still had the privacy by doors which were frosted. A short walk to the shopping area and beach in Badalona. We caught the metro into Barcelona which was reasonable in price and gave us a feel of local life. The bar in the day was quite and took time to get a drink, but when we went there in the evening about 12am there were quite a few guests sitting and enjoying beverages and so the staff were there ready to take your order. Overall very nice and would consider going back again.

author: EwB0
title: Enjoyable stay
text: We had a good size room, despite of facing the road, it was quiet, the beds were comfortable. There were plenty of electric sockets, I counted at least five. No tea/coffee facilities. In the bathroom the basin had no plug. It was a bit ironic- the hotel put sign next to basin "please save water"but it is difficult to save water when you are using basin without a plug. Our friends in the different rooms also didn't have plug so we were not the only one. Breakfast for me was okey but my husband didn't enjoy freezing cold eggs and bacon. The town has a nice old town and a lovely beach not very far from the hotel. The supermarket was approximately 5 min away and metro station was about 15 min. We stayed in this hotel for three nights and we liked it.

author: butterscotchnom
title: Brilliant!
text: Welcoming and friendly staff that are always helpful and seem to be working hard to make sure you enjoy your stay. There's no pool and the roof terrace is not always open (much to our late night disappointment). The rooms are fantastic, and the showers lovely and hot. Breakfast is a continental affair mostly, but they do cater for allergies so remember to let them know when you book. There's a small tourism tax to pay on checkout, plus anything you had in the mini-bar. The location is not a far walk for a healthy person to the beach, or the Metro. It's a nice beach too, with lots of sun and sand and space. Maybe you'll also choose to stay in Badalona rather than heading into the busy Barcelona, but if not, it's only a short distance.

author: suzeq31
title: Good hotel, friendly staff, excellent stay.
text: We stayed here for one night when we went to Primavera Sound. The staff were exceptional (special mention for Muthandu) and the room was perfectly equiped for a weekend stay. Excellent shower and very comfortable bed. The air conditioning worked perfectly and was lovely and quiet. My only complaint would be that the hair dryer was totally ineffective, and I have short hair. (It might just have been in my room though.) If you have long hair, don't take the chance, bring your own! We had lunch here before we left and the set menu was excellent. I would recommend trying the restaurant.

author: Coulddobetter_13
title: Food substandard
text: Breakfast is dreadful scrambled eggs cold every morning. Bacon is just slivers of fat and no meat. Fresh fruit salad appears to be tinned fruit. Went to Restaurant on second night asked for two well done steaks came out rare sent back and were sent out the same steaks a couple of minutes later which had been cut in half and put back on the pan.while this was going on the veg was left on the plate to go cold. So we were presented with our cooked steaks and our cold veg second time around. I asked for the bill and left not paying for the steaks. On a positive side rooms are spotless. Just do not eat there

author: christiansN9736HN
title: Nice hotel for a Barcelona trip
text: We chose this hotel for our trip to Barcelona, since it was much cheaper than comparable hotels in Barcelona City. Since it is located close to the final metro station, it was easy to go to Barcelona in the morning and get back in the evening. The room was large enough and got tidied up every day perfectly. But though the hotel was established only 8 years before, there were obvious signs of usage all over the room, especially in the bath room. Since the hotel is located at a multi-lane main road, our room on the 12th floor was very noisy even when the window was closed. Nevertheless, we had no problems to fall asleep. The breakfast was okay, but compared to other **** hotels at most average. Wi-Fi was for free, and pretty fast.

author: GIORGIO65_P
title: Less than average
text: I stayed one night on a business trip. This hotel I'm sure was very nice 10 year ago....now it is suffering for the age mainly in the rooms. Location is not nice though in 10-15 minutes you can walk to Badalona's center that is nice with a walking area. Breakfast was less than average in term of selection and the presentation looked like a fast food buffet. Coffee and cappuccino were awful. The restaurant is underground in a small room compared to the number of guests the hotel can host, no windows. It looked like jail. The price is definitively too much for what you get.

author: Ger0nim0
title: Peaceful Escape from Barcelona City Centre
text: My family and I had visited Barcelona and wanted somewhere near the Beach and City Centre. The journey from the airport was very straightforward and from Badalona Station it's about 25 minute walk. The metro station is closer and around 15 minute walk. Badalona beach is very nice and not so crowded and there are lots of shops and markets conveniently located nearby. The hotel was very nice and the rooms were very spacious and clean. The breakfast was included as part of a weekend deal and this was very filling and had a variety and the staff Parker was very pleasant and welcoming. Sylvia at reception was very friendly and helpful and I cannot fault this hotel at all. It took about 30 minutes to get to the city centre and if you don't mind doing this the hotel is great value and to have the same hotel in the city centre would cost a lot more. This is the only slight downside in terms of location but if you are prepared to overlook this you will have no regrets. I highly recommend spending a full day and visiting Monserrat it was the highlight of our trip.

author: Jimmy_monk
title: Very good service and nice hotel
text: I just went back from my trip to Barcelona. I stayed in this hotel for 7 days. The thing I impressed the most is the excellent service of the stuff. Kind and professional. The hotel is clean, with good atmosphere. The disadvantages of the hotel is the location far from the city center and has no pool. This hotel is recommended for those who renting a car during stay, or not mind to use the motor to the city center for about 25 min. each side.

author: jen_love_10
title: Nice, clean, modern hotel
text: I stayed here whilst visiting Barcelona and the recommendation of a family member. The hotel itself was lovely, clean and well maintained with nice spacious and well furnished bedrooms/bathrooms. Breakfasts were very substantial and plenty of choice. The price of the stay was much more reasonable than similar hotels within Barcelona itself. The hotel is near to a quite beach which is nicer than the beaches in Barcelona itself. Very few people within Badalona speak English which made eating in local cafes very difficult for non-spanish speakers. I have nothing negative to say about the hotel itself, although the location is a little out the way and adds 30+ minutes travel time on the journey into Barcelona and 30+ minutes back. If I were to visit Barcelona again I would probably chose a city centre hotel as at the end of a long day sightseeing a 30 minute metro ride and walk is a little tiresome.

author: Trina1990
title: Excellent city and beach location.
text: We arrived late on Friday night to a very warm welcome at reception. They were very helpful on check in and remained this way through the entire stay. Our room was spacious and was cleaned everyday. The beach is a 10 min walk away, which is clean and beautiful with lots of bars dotted around for day or night use. The metro station is also a 10 min walk away which takes you straight into Barcelona in about 15 mins.. we bought a 10 trip ticket which was very good value and you can also use it on the busses and trains. The breakfast was vast and tasty- a great start to our day. We ate dinner once as it was pricey but completely worth it, so delicious and well presented! All in all this was a fantastic hotel and a great location! Thank you!

author: Kasia1184
title: Great !
text: Absolutely great! Will recommend to anyone! Great stay in badalona to chill and relax . 15 min walk to tube stationfrom hotel and only about another 15-20 min on tube to very centre of amazing barcelona. Hotel luxcorious, clean and just amazing! Staff efficient and helpfull at all times! And breakfast!! Wow! Simply great!!!!

author: RachelH338
title: Perfect if you want the best of both worlds
text: I stayed here for 5 nights with mu boyfriend. We have planned a trip to Barcelona. We found this hotel perfect as it gave you the best of both worlds. you could catch the tube which is only about 30-40mins to the centre of Barcelona and enjoy all th city has to offer. Or you can stay in Badalona and enjoy a day at the beach. The hotel was clean and we stayed on bed and brekfast basis and had no complaints. There are lots of lovely resturants in Badalona especially an italian thatsz tucked away on a back street, we actually thought it was the best italian we have ever had and we actually visited Rome earlier in the year. All in all a nice hotel. I would give you directions from the tube but its a while sinces I stayed (july 2012) so cant rember, but do look it up before you go as we had to ask many locals, most didnt speak English

author: EmsCardiff
title: Good modern hotel with friendly staff.
text: We stayed here for three nights in march. The reception staff were very friendly and accommodating and the rooms were a good size, clean and modern. As per the other reviews on here the bathroom set up is unique and I guess it could be a tad awkward if it was your first trip away with a new partner. Having said that you can easily draw the curtain across for a little more privacy. It is easy to get to the hotel from the airport you need to get the train from terminal 2 to passeig de Garcia station then get the purple line 2 to badalona. Passeig de Garcia is a big station and the walk to the metro line platform takes around 5 - 10 minutes. When you get to badalona the hotel is approx 10 minutes walk away, head to the museum and then turn left heading towards the motorway. Get a T10 train ticket it's really good value around 9euros 50 and that is for 10 separate journeys that can be used for multiple people, this includes your journey too and from the airport.

author: JK887
title: Rafaelhoteles Badalone - EXCELLENT!
text: We stayed in Rafaelhoteles hotel in Badalona for 3 nights and it was excellent. The reception staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were lovely and modern...and there were a lot of English speaking channels on the TV! Breakfast was good and varied. But the best bit was the hotel's location. It was about a 10 minute walk from the nearest metro station and similarly about 10 minutes to the beach which we preferred to the Barcelona beaches like barceloneta beach just because there were so many people constantly trying to sell you drinks, etc. In contrast, the Badalona beach was nice and chilled. Also, we were lucky to have a room where you could see the sea in the distance and gave amazing views of the sunrise.

author: lefteris2706
title: So Good Hotel!!!!! Amazing place to stay!!!
text: I went to this hotel on 15-19 August of 2012!!! i dont have to say something bad about this hotel!!! room were so luxurious, has safe,fridge...Rooms so clear!!! Staff was friendly!!! The breakfast so tasty and many things to choose!!!! I was in 9th Floor and view was amazing....the only negative : Wifi was not FREE for 4 days told me to pay 10euros..metro station was 10minutes by walk, and to go to pl.catalunia u need +-25minutes......Amazing hotel!!! Badalona is beautiful too to visit!! I recomend it to all!!

author: Steve-And-Barbara
title: Great Hotel, Great Location, Great Staff
text: Stayed here for 3 nights and thought it was perfect for what we wanted. 10 minute walk to the train station in Badelona and then 15 mins by train to the very centre of Barcelona - which in turn is only 15 mins from the airport by train. I emailed a week before we arrived and asked for a room with a view and they put on us on the 12th floor with a lovely view of the city and the sea. Room was big enough for the two of us, A/C was good, had a fridge to put water in, TV, full bathroom with a speaker in the ceiling so you could hear the TV whilst in the shower - this was a nice touch. Bed was queen size so we both had a very good sleep every night. Staff were friendly and very helpful too, but I find that typical of all Spanish people anyway :) Breakfast was the typical continental breakfast with hams and cheeses, salad, hard boiled ^ scrambled eggs, sausages, pastries, fruit juices and a coffee machine which did hot chocolate too. The beach was also nowhere near as packed as Barcelona and was only a ten min walk from hotel. If I was to go back to Barcelona again I would definitely check out the rates for this hotel. Very pleased with everything. *top tip* To get to station, come out of hotel and turn left, stay on that road all the way to the beach, then turn right and you'll get to the station.

author: StephJ91
title: Brilliant hotel outside of the busyness of Barcelona.
text: Both times we've visited Barcelona (Apri 2010 and April 2011), we've stayed in the Rafaelhoteles Badalona. It's a 5 minute walk from the nearest metro station, which means Barcelona is within easy travelling distance. The hotel is modern and classy, and the staff are all extremely helpful. We've never had any issue with anything about this hotel. In fact the staff are willing to go out of their way to help in any way they can, we found this out, when my father had his wallet stolen and needed to file a police report (none of us can speak any Spanish), a member of the hotel staff helped my Dad call the police station and find a member of staff who could speak English, and therefore help him. The rooms in the hotel are small, but modern, clean and serviceable. Breakfast is fantastic, with plenty of variety, with something for everyone. I'd recommend this hotel to anyone wanted to go to Barcelona, who wishes to stay out a little bit, away from the busyness of the city. Steph.

author: robinsoniiia
title: Very Nice place to stay
text: I enjoyed staying at this hotel. It does not have all the extras like a swimming pool, etc, but it is clean, enjoyable, and the staff is courteous. They even allowed us to check in early and arranged our transportation each day. I do have to agree that the internet connections are slow, and the food in the restaurant on site is not great. Another plus is that they can exchange money if you need it. Please note that the rooms in Europe are not a large and this place is no exception but i was very satified. The beach is 10 minutes away walking. Wonderful views from the rooms with minibars.

author: Q1694ZEdavidp
title: Be careful when staying at this hotel
text: The hotel is brand new and is nicely equipped but be careful with the following points: 1) If you park your car in the underground car park it will cost you 15 Euro per night ! and you have to tell them the night before if you want to cancel. 2) The cable internet connection in the rooms is free but the quality is very poor considering this is a new hotel. I gave up using it as it breaks down so often. They give you a wireless login if you complain but this is even slower!! 3) The food in the restaurant is quality - but very poor value for money. Dont go there if you are hungry. Some reception staff try very hard to help if you have a problem but they are not backed up by management (who you never ever see).

author: drbajji
title: Very good hostel
text: We stayed here 3 nights in an apartment. Fully furnished with kitchen, washing machine, bedroom, sofa convertable to a bed. Very well located. Close to supermarkets and bus station. We were lucky to get a ground floor apartment. Not sure about the elevator. This place is a hostel. Not a hotel. The front desk might not be there always but are very helpful. Change of towels and sheets is every 3 days.

author: MelissaWF486
title: Economical option in a convenient location
text: This hotel checks all the boxes, but it's very basic. We chose to stay here because it was economical and would allow us to spend the same amount on three nights as we would pay for two nights at many of the other hotels we looked at. It's also in a good location, walking distance to almost everywhere we wanted to go. However, it was advertised as air conditioned, but be advised that they do not run the air conditioner during the day. So it was hot and stuffy in the room during the mornings and afternoons. Each night, we had to ask someone at the front desk to check the air conditioning because it wasn't working. The staff was helpful and fixed it each time, but it was frustrating nevertheless. It was not the most comfortable stay, but if you are on a budget in Sevilla, this may be a good option for you.

author: Adaldt
title: THE PENSION (HOSTEL) FROM HELL!
text: To start off, they put us up in a room on the fourth floor of the hostel, having to walk four flights of stairs and no elevator! You can forget about WiFi or Television, although the hostel promises WiFi, one pretty much has to go all the way down stairs to see some signs of WiFi. Imagine coming to your room and having to find that you can not post any of your beautiful pics you took that day for your friends and family to see or even look up a place to visit the same night or the next day or look at a map for directions. When I asked about the WiFi, they said that they had to reboot the router, but it was all a lie to calm me down. When we left the sign for the room to be cleaned, someone must have just swept the floors. No clean towels or sheets were left for us. Our room was next to the common bathroom and there was lots of noise, also noise from the rowdiness of the younger people coming back from getting drunk in Sevilla every night, slamming doors and speaking really load with no consideration for the rest of the guests. If you want some peace and quite, this is not the place for sure. The only positive thing is that it is strategically placed in the Old City Center of Seville.

author: butterflyrach
title: Cheap, but you get what you pay for
text: I knew this hostel is basic but not realized how poor it was. Hard to find, it took us 45mins walk from the bus station around the backroads of the barrio before we found it. It is about 10minutes to the Cathedral/main square but without a map it's impossible to arrive. No common areas, we had only 2 beds, wardrobe and bathroom with dripping sink and sliding door. No kettle/fridge. There are many pension accomodations in Seville so maybe city standard, but next time I will research more. Staff seemed friendly but we saw no other guests. Area not too noisy but quite a walk and can be hot as air con/heaters controlled in office.

author: DaleCheshire
title: Basic and shabby
text: It's cheap but the room was very shabby. The shower was broken and the shower screen came off the rails. We had to ask for blankets as I could not sleep as it was so cold, and then again for more blankets as it was still not warm enough! We had asked for a double room but they had put us in a twin. They let us change but the room smelt so strongly of cigarette smoke that we decided to stay with the twin. The towels were almost threadbare. A different person was on reception every time we came or went. The only good things about the pension were cheerful staff and hot water.

author: 256samip
title: You get exactly what you pay for
text: This place is in an amazing location, with much of Seville within a 10 minute walking radius. It's located in the Juderia (Historically Jewish District). The price is extremely cheap, but so are the room's amenities. We had a balcony room facing the courtyard on the street in front of the place. They virtually stole parking from us, as we were promised 24hours of parking in the adjacent garage for a hefty price (Maybe €24, but then were charged an extra €12 because we kept our car for few hours after checkout but still within the 24hours originally promised). The room didn't have its own bathroom, and a weak air conditioning system. The day staff spoke no English and couldn't even tell us about the free tours they listed on their website. The night guy spoke English (he was either Peruvian or Chilean) and turned out very helpful in giving us information on how to get around. Also, no elevator so getting your bags up those narrow steps is a pain. Its more set up like a hostel as we had to share a bathroom as well.

author: Vannegen
title: A very basic spot with a good location downtown
text: All right, if you book a double room in a peak season in Seville for 40 euro, you shall not complain over the quality. And, indeed, I am not. Just wanted to share the obvious truth that 40 euro per night means a basic room with very outdated pieces of furniture. Frankly, there weren't too many of them, in there...; actually, hardly anything else than just a bed to sleep on, a small basic and a hole in the wall turned into a wardrobe. The room we had did not have any bathroom or toilet. Thus, we had to use the "open one" at the end of the hallway, that was both big enough to accomodate even more than one person at once (provided, such a need would ever be requested...), and outdated enough, so as to make us rather avoid using it unless absolutely necessary. The good thing about this guesthouse (it isn't a hotel) was its proximity to the major attractions of this splendid city, as well as a short walking distance to the St. Justa train station and the bus to the airport (some 10-15 min in each case). Summing up, I may recommend this spot to young or undemanding travellers that do not really need anything more than a bed to sleep on after a busy day downtown.

author: SlabbyBelgium
title: Very good hotel in the Perm region
text: Stayed in this hotel as part of a business trip visiting a customer in Perm. After arriving at the airport we had a transfer booked to the hotel. After a 15 minutes drive arrived at the hotel. Smooth check-in and very helpful staff at the reception. Very comfortable room with adjecent bathroom with all nessary amenities. Though we found the bed rather small... it provided a good sleep and didn’t bother us. The Karin restaurant serves a good breakfast in the morning and is well known for its good kitchen for dinner. Which we can admit. Overall a very good experience!

author: Voyage_harbours
title: Very friendly service. Excellent treatment of Diamond members.
text: The front desk and restaurant staff were very friendly throughout our stay and so willing to help us. I would particularly like to thank front desk trainee Stepan. The hotel treats Diamond members well: we received two complimentary drinks vouchers (free glass of house wine or beer in Karin restaurant), a welcome gift (green apples and 2 bottles of Valser sparkling water) and a welcome letter from the GM. The welcome letter explains that the hotel offers complimentary room upgrades where available (which is more generous than the standard Hilton Garden Inn treatment of Diamond members). Hilton HHonors members receive a 15% discount on food and beverage spending at Karin restaurant/lounge bar and on room service (which is available from 5 to 11pm). The breakfast buffet is available in Karin restaurant between 6-10am (weekdays) and 7-11am (weekends). In addition to the buffet, it was possible to order a number of dishes: eggs (omelette/fried/scrambled/poached/boiled), French toast, pancakes and waffles. There is a gym (open 24/7) on the 3rd floor, a self-service laundry room on the 4th floor (free of charge, with complimentary washing powder available as well) and a Turkish hammam. The hotel is not located in the city centre. It takes around 15-20 mins by car/tram (6 km) to get to Gorodskaya Esplanada in the city centre, and around 10 mins by car (4 km) to the main railway station (Perm-2).

author: G1795GBjamesj
title: An Amazing Hotel with an Outstanding Restaurant
text: I have been working In Russia now for 16 months, staying the whole time In the Hilton Garden Inn Perm. Also when I return to the UK I use different Hiltons during my UK stay, so I have something to compare it with The hotel is excellent in each and every department, to the room cleanliness, reception staff, restaurant staff and even the cleaners and maintenance. They have truly made my stay here very comfortable, nothing is too much trouble. The Management in each department are first class, when I have any issues these are sorted very promptly and without fuss. The only issue I have is, I’ve put on a little weight due to the outstanding restaurant. The food is amazing, the chiefs have a very personal touch and come and ask you how your meal was, I quite like that. The restaurant staff are also first class, happy, talkative first class service. I have tried many other restaurants in Perm, and this is the best. Well done to the whole Hilton Garden Inn team, you all work very hard.

author: H8946NOrichardt
title: Excellent hotel, expat headquarters
text: Excellent hotel with location optimized for the industries west of town. Desk and restaurant staff extremely helpful, bi-lingual (Russian/English), and eager to please. A very comfortable place. The center of town is a 200-300 ruble cab ride away. The guest list seems dominated by expats, many on extended business stays. Adjacent to the Yuri Gagarin cultural center and the Stilitsa (Capital) Mall. Sberbank next door, drug store (Aptyeka) across the side street. Buses and street cars, you just get on and the conductor collects your 16 ruble fare.

author: 488ClaudioB
title: Very nice place to stay
text: The hotel is nice. People are very friendly and try to help as much they can. For example my flight was delayed and they help me to contact airline to keep me updated. Shuttle bus from/to airport is complementary and waiting even the flight is delayed. Hotel can provide you TAXI service with nice cars and very cheap. Breakfast is very good with fresh orange juice every time (prepared only when you join the restaurant). I had some dinner and the food is delicious although a bit expensive. WiFi connection free and fast (and stable). Hotel strongly suggested in Perm.

author: W5284ZRjustinw
title: First-class hotel in Perm
text: My second stay at the Hilton Garden Inn Perm was for six nights in a standard room. The room was very comfortable and well attended. I had breakfast in the Karin restaurant each day and highly recommend it both for the high-quality buffet and complimentary made-to-order items, as well as the excellent service. My family also had a birthday dinner at Karin and the experience was top notch. During my stay, I used the fitness center, business center, guest laundry facility and massage service. All were convenient and met my needs. Thank you to the friendly and helpful staff. I hope to return to the Hilton Garden Inn Perm soon. By far the best hotel in Perm.

author: Vicecolonel66
title: Hilton - even in Perm is a high end hotel!
text: I've stayed in this hotel several times when I was on mission in Perm. First of all, it must be said at once that Perm in terms of roads - it's quite confusing city. But I'm quite easily and quickly, without the help of the car-navigator found the hotel, after analyzing a city map before. Pleasantly pleased with parking space, which is monitored by video surveillance protection directly opposite the entrance to the hotel.Despite the fact that I came almost in the morning, I was met not sleepy but cheerful and attentive personal with a smile. Another pleasant circumstance was the presence of non-smoking rooms. About the room even nothing to say - lovely bed, clean bathroom, even blackout curtains from the sun. Upset only one - long to connect online. Choice of buffet for breakfast pleasantly surprised once again. In general, I liked to live in this hotel. Although the cost was also in the style of "Hilton".

author: 800JimL
title: Nice Hotel with Excellent Staff
text: When one travels half way around the world, we all hope for a pleasant stay at a Hotel. The Hilton Garden Perm is that. The rooms are spacious, clean and the bathroom quite nice. We did have a slight issue with hot water in the morning but was only temporary one day.
