The bedding was good with quality linens but they may be a need a mattress change at some point in the future but was manageable. What makes this place is the Staff. They work very hard to accommodate your wishes. They work hard at speaking and understanding English and in the eastern of part of Russia, that can sometimes be difficult. The restaurant was also very nice and pleasant again with excellent staff. Kudos to all at the Hilton Garden Perm.

author: AngusRodrigo
title: Given the location, its excellent...
text: Hey, definitely not your brand new hilton on the outskirts of Dallas, but what do you want? Plenty good. My first time to Perm and I was pretty anxious about what I'd find, but was set up here by my local contacts and had read the reviews to the hotel. The hotel is close to the airport for a quick sleep. I found it to be very quiet. Has all the amenities in the room you want (iron, tea kettle), although its pretty hot (you can turn down the radiator, I found, by the window). Good food and restaurant. Friendly people. Just about as close to the West as you'd want in this very distant place. There is also a mall next door, but I didnt go there.

author: rrrrustyman
title: Small beds, Wi-Fi not working, front desk disorganized
text: Do NOT expect the same quality as Hilton Garden Inn in America. After checking in, we saw the double bed and knew it wouldn't work - so asked for a room with larger bed - queen or king. Front desk said, "Go to dinner and we'll have it for you on return". Upon return, new crew at front desk explained all beds are the same PLUS Wi-Fi is not working for two days. Because we must work on line in our hotel - we had the front desk call another hotel and we cancelled this one at 9:30 pm. Of course we had to pay for the taxi to the new hotel. Quite a fiasco. As a Hilton Hhonors member for 15 years , this was a BIG disappointment.

author: Rustyman14
title: Unacceptable
text: First, this hotel should not be permitted to be part of the Hilton Garden Inn chain. It is NOTHING like a hotel by that name in the U.S. In appearance, amenities, and service this hotel does not measure up to it's name. The worse offense was that it took four dishonest reception clerks from 8 pm, when we checked in, until 11 pm to finally fess up to the fact that there was nothing bigger in any room of the hotel than a standard-sized bed, a bed that would be called a "double" in the U.S. It's a longer story than I want to tell, but we kept getting story after story until the truth was told. We even went to dinner because one clerk said she was very busy (except for us lobby was empty) and needed more time to find us a room with a bigger bed.To add insult to injury, we learned that internet service was not going to be available for the two nights/days of our stay. At 11 pm we found another hotel and promptly left the tiny, utilitarian rooms, tiny beds, and no internet. NEVER AGAIN!!!

author: irka_v
title: Great place if you're must be in Perm
text: Nice hotel with nice reception stuff. Not in the city center - but who needs the city center of Perm? They can pick you up at the airport if you tell them you need their free transfer. They even waited for our flight which was delayed. Breakfast was really, really great and they even have coffee to go for paper cups coffee addicts :) There are tea/coffee facilities and free bottled water in the room. Note that you'll find everything you need in the bathroom except toothbrush and toothpaste. There is 24x7 supermarket across the street though - basic but quite safe. Cards accepted.

author: Mjos
title: most hospitable reception in russia
text: I ended up in the Garden Inn by chance. When i walked in, i received the most hospitable reception i got in the whole of Russia! Friendly, professional and very service oriented. Kudos. The rooms are good, spacious enough and have everything a (business)traveller needs: good bed, wifi, good bathroom. The whole hotel was clean. Breakfast in the morning nice, buffet type, with good coffee, and fresh stuff. Breakfast staff needs some extra training from their reception collaegues though

author: RosieE116
title: Unclean Hostel
text: Check in: Staff will not allow early check in, even if you are less than 1 hour early, instead they offer a waiting area with lockers for your case which you have to pay for. Cleanliness: When we finally got our room we pulled back the bedsheets and found lots of hair on both the beds, clearly the sheets had not been changed. The walls are covered in black marks, which could be washed off with a warm wet cloth and soap, but there seems to be a lack of care. Staff: Uninterested. When we told them the sheets were dirty they responded with ‘ok?’ As if asking what the problem was? We weren’t made to feel welcome despite paying for the pleasure. Noise: the walls are very thin so you can hear a lot of doors slamming, people talking loudly and suitcases being rolled around in the early hours. There is a gap under the front door (shown in pics) which allows light and noise through in the night. Ok for 1 night but not relaxing and didn’t feel welcome.

author: windsongmama
title: Just What We Needed
text: Hostal Atenas was just what we needed for our Granada adventure. Centrally located and easy walking distance from the Catedral and public transit to the Alhambra and Albicin. The staff was friendly and very helpful with suggestions and directions to local dining, shopping, historical experiences and bus routes. They were even able to pre purchase our tickets for the Alhambra long after they were sold out online. Know before you go... The rooms are clean and ours was quiet. The beds were two twins. There is very little extra space. This was not a problem for us but if you are a big person or have active children you might consider the room a little snug. We only were there to sleep and shower and the Hostal Atenas was a great value and very convenient for our trip to the magical city of Granada.

author: O9750VAjoanneh
title: Ideal Location
text: You can't fault Hostel Atenas for the location, excellent staff and great value. We stayed for 4 nights in a superior double room at €168. The room was clean and serviced every day. It's within walking distance of the cathedral, Albacin and the Alhambra. During check in, the staff were extremely helpful and immeditely pointed out the best places to eat and points of interest, providing a city map to help with directions. Staff were extremely helpful and friendly throughout our stay. Although there are no restaurant facilities, there were a few reasonably priced and well stocked vending machines in a lounge area and a couple of nearby cafes where you could buy a reasonably priced breakfast. Our room was on the ground floor, and near to the main road, which meant we couldnt leave the windows open due to noise, however, this wasn't a huge problem to us; I am sure that if we had requested a change of room this would have been done. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone travelling to Granada.

author: mwhzzi
title: great expectations let down by reality
text: whilst many of the reviews on Tripadvisor introduced me to the Hostal Atenas, many of the reviews nonetheless gave me a sense of expectation that my experience could be good. Alas! it was not to be the case. The room was very basic but very clean however the shower area which was clean had mould growing in the grout between the tiles which made it look quite yucky! We had a room which its window opened onto the internal space which meant it was quiet from outside noise. However, let me warn you, previous reviewers were spot on about the deplorable noise penetration from both rooms next door and particularly from those above. The first day we had a spanish gentleman blaring his big voice all through the late evening and eventually stopped later at night. On the second night we had a wonderful selfish and loud woman who must have worn flamenco shoes because she never stopped walking around in them until just before midnight and whilst we thought that was the end of it after 12:00 midnight, we were not surprised to be awoken just before 5:30am with her loud voice and flamenco shoes as clearly she was returning from a night out!!! Lastly, one good thing to say about the hostal is that the front counter staff were very helpful and friendly Tip 1: with this particular hotel its is probably in your best interests to book directly with the hotel rather than with your normal booking agency, as the hotel has continuous offers at a rate of up to 50% off what the booking agency advertises. Tip 2: if you can avoid staying here then please consider doing so, otherwise you do so at your peril.

author: johne375
title: Cheap room
text: I wouldn't call this a host a as it's nothing more than your own private room..saying that it's cheap and right in the centre. .5 minutes walk to the shops and 2 minutes to elvira St. . The room was clean with towels provided. No daylight at all but it was adequate for what I wanted. I would use this again. The reception staff were there just to book you in and nothing else. If you want a room only it's fine

author: Miguel81
title: Does the job, good value for money, close to Albaicin / Arab quarter
text: On checking in, we were given a little slip which had a wifi username and passowrd, one slip per device, so if you have more than one device, i think you need to ask for more slips. On entering the room, it appeared clean. I stayed in a twin double which had two single beds in there. I checked the bathroom, it had a walk in shower, toilet and sink. No soap block or shampoos or extra complimentary cosmetics BUT it did have two dispensers: one near the basin and another in the walk in shower. I think its general soap liquid, would not advise using it on head as we dont really know what it is. The tiling work and plaster seemed like a no.2 job, odd blatent fix up and cover ups were present, you can tell this is a budget hotel. Receiptionists could speak english, some better than others, cleaners slight communication problem but we got there eventually. The breakfast is served two doors away in a cafe ( they must have a contract) where you were allowed to pick either; Baguette sliced in two (served with margarine and jam) OR a Danish Pastry, for drinks you get One Cup of Tea (or coffee) and a glass of Orange Juice. Pretty basic, not your full range regular continental breakfast but it did the job, can't complain really.

author: pztianx
title: Great value!
text: Booked a quadruple room for one night. We arrived quite early, and the lady at the front desk was very nice and checked us in right away. The room was basic but very clean. Good Wifi signal. We slept very well that night. Next morning, check-out was fast. We stored all our bags in a big locker in the lobby for 2 euros. All main attractions are within walking distance. We will stay at Atenas again for all it offers and the very reasonable price.

author: Kattyann2014
title: Absolute Bargain!!
text: I stayed here for one night in January with some friends. Normally we would have booked a hotel but we wanted to do a one night stay on the cheap. We paid forty euros for a four person room for one night. The room was extremely clean, modern and spacious. The beds where comfortable and the bathroom had a walk in shower and included towels. The reception staff where friend,y and helpful and the location of the Atenas Hostal was great as it was central to everything. The only niggle I would have with staying here, was the rooms where very cold with no heating and quite badly lit. But for the price we paid it's hardly worth mentioning. I would defiantly recommend anyone who is travelling through Granada to stay here.

author: adamn975
title: Excellent Value
text: Stayed here for a night in January with some friends for a one night visit to Granada. We weren't sure what to expect, however we were very surprised at how good the hostel was. Rooms were very spacious and the whole place was clean. Great central location, and an absolute bargain for the price we paid. The rooms are en-suite and towels are provided. Car parking is €17 per day, however this is cheaper or in line with anywhere else you will find to park in Granada. the car park is also owned by the hostel and the car will be safe in a locked garage. All in all a very enjoyable stay, and I would definitely stay here again if visiting Granada.

author: narfnotlob
title: hotel in a great location
text: I stayed in this hotel while I was on a tour. The hotel is very clean, air conditioning, close to the bus station. It is perfectly situated in Granada for walking everywhere. Shopping across the street and the city is full of history everywhere you walk. No meals available however there are plenty of places to eat nearby. There is a cozy sitting room at the back of hotel. I found the staff to be quite friendly as well. Once we walked around the city we realized how perfectly situated this hotel is. Great price as well.

author: Flygirl3786
title: Not a Hostel, but very nice
text: A friend and I stayed here for one night in the middle of July. The location is perfect - everything is within walking distance or to the bus station. There are roomy lockers were we could keep our things for 2 euros a day, which was nice. The room was clean but sparse. We didn't need much however. The air conditioning worked perfectly which was great. It was a nice place to stay but it isn't a hostel - it is definitely a hotel. Breakfast was not included and there is no "hangout space" Overall a good stay and I would stay again.

author: FionaHJ
title: Super noisy hotel
text: Stayed here whilst traveling with Intrepid. Hotel is located on the main street of Granada which is very busy,traffic never stops. Room was OK, a reasonable size and bathroom was OK as well. However, the main drawback was the number of backpackers who stayed here and spent all night running up and down the hallways disturbing other guests. They even tried to get into the room of one of our fellow Intrepid travellers. Management did nothing when complained to, they couldn't care less. So if you like to have no sleep then this is the place for you. Even earplugs didn't help as the slamming of doors reverberated thought the night. Truly dreadful.

author: bluewrenrest
title: Bad Service
text: One leg on my bed was broken. It was propped up against the wall. I ended up sleeping on the floor. The wifi would not work. In the end I went to reception where they begrudginly helped me. Signal strength was poor so I had to sit by the door to use it. Reception were not helpful. A broken bed seemed quite normal to them!

author: ndkingdom
title: Cheap room in a good location
text: I stayed in a single room for 3 nights. The room was small with a twin bed, tv, AC and a little balcony with a view of the Alhambra. There was a small ensuite bathroom with a very small shower. There was free wi-fi but it was very slow. Also some traffic noise from the busy street below. I could sleep through it, but bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper. The hotel in in a very central location- you can walk to the Cathedral, the Alhambra and many other places. Overall it was a good stay, and I think it was a good value for the very low price.

author: loopy_smith
title: Fantastic Base for Exploring Granada
text: If you want something cheap and clean with an excellent location for exploring Granada, this is the place! We are a family of 4 comprising 2 adults and 2 small children and we loved this Hostel. We stayed here during Holy week in April 2011 and loved it. We paid €50 per night for the 4 of us (room only) there were 6 single beds in our room and an adequate ensuite bathroom along with soap, shampoo and towels at TV and aircon! The hostel is within 5 minute's walk of the centre of town and there are lots of places to eat and drink. I would reccommend that you ask for a room at the top of the hostel as we could see part of the Alhambra Palace from our room over the terracotta roof tops. Although, do be aware especially if you have small children that there are tiny balconies that are 6 floors up where children would possibly not be safe. We kept our windows locked so that the children were safe and there was aircon in our room so we didn't need to open the window. All in all this place is clean and great value for money. When we return to Granada we would stay here!

author: Travelgal_5219
title: Decent place near all that you want to do
text: We stayed here as part of an Intrepid tour group. My room smelt heavily of washing detergent since I was very close to the housekeeping area/washing machines. Since I basically used the room as a place to rest my head and spent absolutely no time in my room - this was fine for me but if you get a room close to this area I would reccomend trying to change. Overall my room was clean, towels had been laundered but one of them had a bit of a stain so I exchanged for a new one, the size of the room was adequate for two average sized adults however I have to say the shower stall was very compact! I am a petite female and it was tight for me but I managed - maybe a bit of a challenge for other travellers. Other than all this the location was fantastic - walking distance to all the sights and restaurants, there is actually an alley right behind the restaurant which is home to tonnes of restaurants. A good stay overall, in that hostal staff were friendly, wifi connection available with a code, a great little cafe for breakfast right next door. Don't expect luxury if you are staying here and at the same time (although we saw lots of backpackers) this is not a hostel but rather a hotel with no frills.

author: Mona77
title: Basic stay with a great location
text: I've been there twice, this time on my own, the other one with a friend. The location is very good, it's very close to the center of the town and to the most important places, shopping, restaurants. It's a simple hotel, but also quite cheap. The single room was a bit small and minimalistic, same for the bathroom, I have better memories of the double one, that one was bigger. There's wifi for free but it was incredibly slow, it was almost impossible to use it. You can use a computer with internet I the lobby, but you have to pay for it. If you want to use the remote control for your tv, you have to leave a deposit. The lift is a bit slow, there's just one for a big building shared by different hostels. No breakfast offered. I had a better experience there a couple of years ago, for the price I paid my latest stay was ok, too.

author: LoreleiJ
title: Basic very cheap room in the centre of Granada
text: I stayed in this hostal with 2 other friend for 2 nights. We were a bit unsure what to expect considering all the bad reviews but we ended up pretty happy with the place. We paid 40 euros a night for a triple room (with bathroom) which I think was extremely cheap. Both the room and the bathroom were quite large and everything was clean. The bathroom especially was spotless and they changed our towels daily. The room overlooked an interior courtyard so there was no noise from the street but I presume during the day it didn't have much natural light either. That has not bothered us as we were in Granada to see as much as possible in our short time there but it might be a problem for a longer stay. The staff was ok, hey answered our questions and gave us directions when needed but we did speak with them in spanish so language was not a problem. All in all I would definitely recommend this place for people who want a very cheap, clean room to sleep in for a few days while seeing Granada and of course the Alhambra which I have to say it's a must see for anyone.

author: Mike-Wiesner
title: Paid only 30 euros with aircon & bath, so can't complain
text: Well, the other reviews all talk about the great location. Only a 15-20 minute walk from the train station, and easy walking distance to all the sites & restaurants. One thing that surprised me (for this price) is they give you a card-key, which you use on an outer door for each floor, as you leave the elevator or stairs (extra security), to get to the winding hallways and your room (which uses the same card). I really liked this. The rooms are small, clean & basic, with aircon & bath. For me, the traffic on the Gran Villa acted like white noise, and the windows kept most of it out. However, the paper thin wall can be a real problem if you get noisy neighbors. I was lucky, clearly some other folks weren't. They asked me to pay in advance on arrival (I found it just walking from the train station). This is not bad if you are on a budget - but I would not stay here again.

author: cwmmh
title: Mediocre at best
text: Hostal Atenas is conveniently located on the main street of Granada and it was easy to walk to restaurants, bars, and other landmarks from the hostal. I wish I have something nice to say about the hostal but I don't. The room smelled like cigarette smoke, was dark, and had zero soundproofing. I heard the people in the room next to us talking and watching TV. The bathroom was rather old and the door wouldn't close all the way. The staff members were not friendly at all and answered our questions reluctantly. Thankfully, we only stayed there for one night. I will not be staying in the hostal again and will not recommend it to anyone. There are plenty of other hostals in Granada.

author: Trintravel
title: Just a roof over your head
text: What this hotel has going for it is location, location, location. The Gran Via is one of Granada´s main commercial streets, with load of bus connections, easy walking distance to nearly all the sights but is also noisy and busy. The rooms were clean. That is most important in a budget hotel! I had no problem of outside noise, as some other reviewers had. My problem was noisy gusts having a party until 3am in this badly insulated building. Also light sleepers might be disturbed by the elevator. The staff spoke good english (reception) but they seemed to be there to do their job only, and that doesn´t include smiling. I paid 35 per night for a single room.

author: Stars_b
title: surprised!
text: I stayed there with my boyfirend for 4 nights and we had a great time. True, the staff are not particularly friendly but we did not have much contact with them after checking in. Our room on the first floor seemed to be newly decorated with flatscreen tv and airconditioning. We did not request the remote for the tv as we spent most of our time sightseeing. The bathroom was large and it was cleaned to a high standard every day. It was more like a 3* hotel room. It sounds like there are varying standards of rooms in this establishment. The only complaint I have is that we were looking out over the Gran Via and it was very noisy. As we were exhausted every night it did not bother us too much however!

author: 42budgies
title: Give this one a miss!
text: We booked two rooms next door to each other 8 months in advance and received confirmation that the rooms would have nice views and be close together if not next door. On arrival in the afternoon we were given rooms on separate floors. We complained that this was not at all suitable as we had two children with us - as it shares the same building with another Hostal, the rooms are on locked floors - you get a key to your room and a key to the floor you are on. Needless to say, we had no views! Not only was the receptionist totally unsympathetic, he was positively rude! He told us that rooms were given out on a first come first served basis at check-in, no matter what requests had been received. As it was August and we were only there for one night, we made do by demanding a key to the other floor. The rooms were grim - badly cleaned, hole in the door, poor beds and bedding, unpleasant bathrooms - and unsafe for children. One room had a rickety balcony, the other had a window opening onto a five-storey drop. Don't drive in Granada, don't go in August and certainly don't stay in this place!

author: /undefined
title: Good option in Rio city center
text: It's difficult to find a different standard on a Ibis hotel. They are quite the same. Simple, but comfortable enough. The location, if you want to stay in the city center, is very good. Close to the subway station Carioca, to Lapa nightlife and also to two theaters. Very convenient. A taxi to or from Santos Dumont airport will cost between 12 and 20 reais, depending on the flag and the number of pieces of luggage. The staff is surprisingly friendly and the breakfast (paid separately) is good enough.

author: pierreo606
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
text: Standard business stayof 3 nights (29/6-2/7) at a IBIS however 2 upsetting details I want to emphasize that are not up to the Accor Standards. 1- No TV5 Monde on the TV bouquet, nor CNN, just a standard basic brazilian bouquet (all in portuguese). Called the reception and was answered very unplaisently that it was like that, the hotel doesn't provide an extended bouquet and definitely with international channels, period! Knowing that this is mainly a business people hotel (due to location) I find it very odd! 2- No cofee available before 6 AM! I went down and the attendant said he had to charge me for a small expresso! Ultimately seeing me upset, he gave me a cofee longo out of compassion, and he made it very clear! Unacceptable behaviour towards a client in general and a Le club Accor Platinium client in particular! 3- The check out attendant was totally incompetent and abnoxious, it took for ever. Conclusion: I will never go back to this hotel nor will recommend it to anyone!

author: shentim0110
title: compact hotel , good location
text: Spent 2 nights at this hotel . room was compact, but clean. I had a problem with safety deposit box and the handy man came promptly to fix it. front office lady was helpful with the advises for sight seeing and direction. breakfast was reasonably priced , but taste good with some selections of hot and cold dishes. Loved the scramble egg. located not far from unique Cathedral _ Red lit at night as well as 15 min walk to Rio Opera House. Bus stop located right across the church which can take you to Ipanema and other beaches. Worth the money paid.

author: hardcorewolf
title: The best Ibis I've stayed in!
text: I tend to travel a fair but so often need to keep costs down with less exotic hotels so am well accustomed to basic Ibis hotels but this one stands out. Without doubt the best Ibis hotel I've stayed in. The location isn't fantastic, it's a little further out than I usually prefer. I used taxis to get around down to Centro and Copacabana however it's very close to Santos Dumont airport for those using internal flights and there is an underground station close by. The hotel itself appears to be new and therefore very modern. The lobby is well presented with an eatery and a bar. The rooms are very spacious and well laid out, the beds are super comfortable and my room had a cracking view out across the city. Really good place to stay to minimise the cost as Copacabana is far from cheap! Recommended.

author: /undefined
title: Stay at IBIS, Centro Rio
text: This hotel had friendly staff and food was good too. The rooms were of average size but good for budget travellers. Centrally located, you had access to all places from here easily via the city bus, Metro or the cab. The only issue was with the currency exchange. I had used up all of my Reals and wanted a few more on the last day. The Hotel wasn't able to help me with this and so I had to pay the cab in Dollars after quite a discussion. He had given back less change than he was supposed to. They should be able to accomodate these facilities for the benefit of the tourists.

author: Mitokesi
title: Its the usual standard for Ibis
text: We have stayed for a couple of nights for 252RS a day (booked online because was cheaper)... we have been in room 869... good view... aircon + tv + wifi... all works well... also good central position very close to the ferry for Niteroi... on friday and saturday night the disco down the road made the nights a little bit restless and the church bells across the road chimed on the hour, but that was pleasent... we recommend this hotel

author: 251iraklik
title: Adequate for the purpose (World Cup)
text: Stayed for 5 days. Very clean, daily room service. Could see both the stature of Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf from the window. The room and the bathroom are small, yet larger than similar (price-wise) accomodations in Europe. Breakfast is OK. Ate a supper there once - would not do it again. WOULD NOT walk from the subway station to the hotel after dark, but it's perfectly safe during the daytime. Be aware that downtown Rio is deserted on weekends. It take about 35 minutes to get to Copacabana (hotel-subway-beach), and about $15-20 by taxi (depends on the time/traffic).

author: LionelFernandes
title: Decent, Value for Money
text: Hotel shares the same building with IBIS Budget. Located in downtown Rio. The Metro (carioca station) is a 5-10 min walk away.. Uruguaiana market is 10 mins away for those who enjoy street shopping Interstate Bus Station is about 10-15 mins away by cab. Lapa is 1km away.. Domestice Santos dumont airport is closeby as well... Decent breakfast spread in the mornings... Good, Clean rooms... Good English speaking staff, quite helpful when needed.. overall good value for money..

author: alicel783
title: Don't stay here!!
text: I had a nightmare with this place. It was booked by my company, and I was travelling with a colleague and meeting my partner in Rio for the night we were staying there. It should have all been booked and paid for in advance (2 double rooms) and I called twice to let them know that my partner would be arriving before me leaving his details and explaining he'd be checking in first which they said would be no problem. We arrived off a flight at about 11pm and not only had they not let my partner into the room (he'd been waiting in the lobby for 2 hours) but they had lost one of our bookings and said the hotel was full. After arguing for half an hour with reception they finally found the second room - with name spelt wrong. They also refused to accept that the rooms had been paid in advance and so I ended up paying again for the rooms just to be allowed to go up and sleep, although the refund takes about a month so I'm still waiting for the money back. As if this weren't enough, the rooms are tiny and dark, there's no minibar and no room service so if you want drinking water then it means going all the way down to the hotel bar in your pyjamas. As for the area it's not safe to walk around at night, it's convenient for central/north Rio but I'd recommend taxis any time of day and especially at night.

author: Blackheathbloke
title: Does what it says on the tin, reliable, good value
text: After a few nights in a rather disappointing hotel onm the beach, I moved here as it was closer to the airport for my fairly early flight. It's located very close to the Lapa viaduct and Lapa district which is a hotspot at weekends with plenty of bars and restaurants. As with many areas in Rio, you need to know where you're walking as some of the areas here are a little 'shady'. Check-in was very quick, and I was given a room on a high floor. The lobby is standard IBIS, with a large bar/breakfast area on one side and the reception on the other. Room was also standard IBIS, double bed, flat screen TV, and the usual bathroom pod in the corner. Wi-fi was free and the reception was quite good in my room. I had breakfast included, and although the selction is slightly limited it wasn't too bad to start the day. Check-out was a little slow, so I just dumped my key and ran as I didn't have time to hang around. Overall, no problem with this place, typical IBIS standards and seeing as it cost less than a third of the very shaby place I stayed on the beach, I was very happy.

author: RobP163
title: SINGLE NIGHT DURING CARNIVAL
text: Prices ramped up for carnival - but staff not ramped up accordingly. So not good value on this stay. However, it would likely be a lot better value in low season. On checkout could not process my bil and then returned 2-weeks later to resolve on an afternoon trip. Good location. Rooms OK size. Breakfast OK of you wee not facing human avalanche. However, better review would be when carnival not on.

author: Jule2008
title: Frustrated expectation
text: In my mind when I think about an Ibis hotel I expect a fair cost-benefit deal, at least for the not cheap rate I paid. It was a 1 night business trip to Rio and a lot of problems/obstacles. First it took a while to check-in than I was told they didn't offer service room (it means if you want a bottle of water you have to go to the restaurant and take it yourself). When I just open the room’s door a very strong bleach smell met me. To end up the experience I had to take what they call ‘earlier breakfast’ at 6:15am. Old food, very few options and non-talking staff to assist you. Interesting point: I thought Ibis was supposed to be a business trip hotel so breakfast should start at least at 6:00am, but it doesn’t, it starts at 6:30am. I was 15 minutes from the ‘full breakfast’ and I could take it!

author: kendagail
title: Clean and quiet basic dorm room
text: The hotel staff was very helpful. The hotel was in the business district. The room was clean, quiet with efficient black out curtains and a small refrigerator. There was free WiFi. There was one towel for each of us, one small chip of soap and a tiny bottle of shampoo. The beds and bedding were comfortable. We would stay here again although we would not go back to Rio. Dirty city with terrible streets in need of repair. Do not see how they can host the Olympics in four years.

author: komaromig
title: Very good on weekdays
text: The hotel is a very good quality for its price in Rio. It is clean, has a good service, the rooms are functional. We stayed there twice, both on weekends. Once in a room facing the streetfront (most of the rooms do), and once in a room facing the sidewalk. There is an open-air disco located near the hotel, and on weekends the sound is heavy. It is not possible to sleep on the streetfront rooms then, not even with earplugs. The rooms on the other side are fine even on weekends. If you get a room on the correct side, the hotel is a very good choice.

author: nelliehagerty
title: A good choice
text: Nothing but good to report. I arrived from an early plane and as a room was free was given access to my room before 12.00, which was very welcome. The room was very clean and comfortable. Very good value for the price. The staff were extremely pleasant and very helpful - they organised a complicated printing job for me. The breakfast and the dinner buffet had lots of fruit and salad, and if not gastronomic was pleasant. The position is good - close to many of the historic sites. Easy to get buses to Copacabana and Ipanema. Also possible to get a bus to airport - take a taxi to the domestic airport (close by) and then the bus between the airports to get to the international airport. Much cheaper than the $45 which is the official price for taxis direct to airport

author: foodiesarah
title: Great value for carnival
text: We stayed at this hotel during carnival. It was about AUD$160 for a double which was great value for carnival. Hostels near the beach wanted AUD$100 for a dorm bed. We had a bar fridge in our room so we were able to buy food for our breakfast. They do offer cheap breakfast and food downstairs. It was really close to the train station which was convenient for getting around during carnival because using the buses takes too long because there are people all over the streets. It is far from the beaches but the hotels near the beach cost more than double what we paid and they were only 15 minutes away on the train, so not too far. They ran all night and there was good security on the trains. I wouldn't pay the extra money to be near the beach because there are parties all over Rio during carnival.

author: Diveva
title: Not great area, not great service
text: First the good stuff: the breakfast buffet and the evening buffet are both good quality, and the catering staff are a pleasant and helpful bunch. However, on the down side: reception almost always had a queue, and hardly any of them speak English. We asked for our air-con to be fixed, and the guys came up straight away to stop it leaking, but it then carried on leaking anyway. One of the lifts was out of order. The beds were not comfortable for a 7 night stay. This is an unsafe area after dark. On 4 occasions we asked for the national drink and on 3 of these occasions were told by the bar staff that they didnt have one of the main ingredients. There are signs stating that bedding is changed every day, but it is not. They got our 2 rooms constantly mixed up so we all ended up paying for each others stuff. The worst Ibis I have ever used...not actually awful, but not up to the standard Ive seen elsewhere.

author: KTonline
title: Rude, unhelpfull staff, broken aircon
text: My partner and I stayed here for 2 nights and would not recommend it at all. The staff were very rude and unhelpfull. Wifi use was only free in reception and only for an hour at a time - so you had to queue at the reception desk every time you wanted to use it. Check in and out process was very slow. We queued for 25 minutes to check out and when we asked for them to call a taxi, we were told to just find one on the street. The first taxi driver refused to use his meter and then tried to charge us extra for our luggage. Obviously we got out and waited for another. There is a reason for hotels calling cabs for you in rio.

author: AlwaysonRush
title: Good for short business trip to downtown clients.
text: I stayed at this hotel due business in downtown Rio. There is no beach in downtown Rio and I could only indicate to a quick trip. It's quite new and the best solution if you are only in business and wants to walk to any client in downtown. The rooms are very simple and clean and the shower, even for a small bathroom, is large and with a strong pressure. All the room have wood floor. I had problems at restaurant twice with the meal that always delay due a fair service. If you want your meal is better to pressure the waiter instead to wait to him to come to your table. By night the neighborhood is not so good so I could avoid to walk around. The best think is to take one of the good taxi drivers from the taxi station right in front the hotel entrance.

author: 212ianl
title: Great unusual hotel
text: The rooms at the hotel look out over the drive in movie. The reception staff were helpful and courteous. The room was large and spotlessly clean. Comfy beds, smallish bathroom. Large uncluttered breakfast room with a full selection of USA breakfast staples. Only downside is it is located out of town and restaurant choice is extremely limited should you not want to drive. We took our own drinks and picked up food to eat before arriving. We watched the movie from our room, a first!

author: kentennen
title: Ready for Restoration
text: I’m not sure how this motel remains part of the Best Western family of facilities. It has a great gimmick which, if it actually worked for us, might have been worth the inadequacies of the motel’s “plant” or “structure.” If there were such a thing, this would qualify as a Best Western Minus motel. Persons with disabilities and older visitors might want to request first floor accommodations, as the rusting / rotting / rocking-and-rolling treads of the staircases constitute an accident waiting to happen. Many of the treads had become loose and a few had lost all of the screws holding them in place. When informed of this danger, management seemed unaware of the seriousness of the situation. I hope they have a good insurance policy, as this is a catastrophe fast approaching. The cute gimmick is that you can watch movies shown on the two screens of the adjacent drive-in movie theater. The only problem for us was that the sound in our room did not work. If Colorado Department of Public Health & Environment happened to drop by for an inspection, I’m afraid they might close access to the second floor, pending repairs to the staircase sets.

author: Phil225
title: BAIT AND SWITCH
text: The hotel rooms were adequate but the movies were not available and the television did not work. The bathrooms are tiny. Was told the movie was Mission Impossible but was stuck with Teen Titans 2 instead. The sound for the movie in room 112 was non-existent and what you could hear was distorted. Reported the problem to the lady at the front desk. She was indifferent and couldn't even muster an apology. Poorly managed property. Really a big let-down. Bathrooms are too small.

author: Paladine5
title: Unique stay
text: Old style motel. Rooms are large, beds are soft, pillows fluffy. Rooms were clean. The breakfast is both hot cooked and has healthy selections. Two screen drive in movie next door. You can watch 1 screen from your room(it has speakers that you can turn on in the room). If you want to watch the other screen, you have to take your vehicle into the drive in using your room key as admission. Very unique. I highly recommend.

author: 560cherylt
title: Vintage but updated
text: We booked a stay here with our granddaughter on our way thru Colorado. The staff was friendly and helpful. The rooms are spacious and they face the drive in where they play first run movies. It has a vintage but updated feel. The decor is all movie themed including star names in the concrete at the entrance. All the rooms have star names along with numbers.They have a great sense of humor too..the exercise room is the Arnold Schwarzenegger ! Lol ! The movie screen is a bit far away to see but you do get a free pass to go into the drive in with your room key if you prefer.There are movie audio volume controls in each room. The breakfast was delicious with good choices and the view at breakfast amazing. We would definitely recommend this motel.

author: hilariog967
title: Vacation
text: Everyone was right! Deidre was awesome! She set us up and took very good care of us. She was awesome! It’s not fancy, but it was homie! Got up for breakfast and it was one of the best we have had at a Best Western ever! If your ever around and need a place to stop. Deidra will take care of ya! Thank you Deidra! 😜

author: karenbK7353RH
title: Drive Inn
text: Drive Inn motel is something everyone should experience. Mine was excellent. Bed comfortable, clean room. You watch a drive inn movie right through your large window, with the speaker switch at in your room. How great is that!! Hostess made you feel part of the family. She smiled and made you feel welcome. Was a wonderful stay.

author: karencW7761ZJ
title: Unique freindly. Old but good
text: Surprisingly nice for updated motel. Friendly staff. Good beds. Clean room. Very nice Breakfast. Talked to owner in the morning and learned of the history. Very interesting story. Drive in movie screen outside your window. With sound in your room. Would stay again.

author: davec431
title: Good stay to see the cranes
text: We traveled to Monte Vista to see the Sandhill Cranes and stayed at this hotel. We were quit impressed with the cleanliness and remodel of an older motel. The staff were very courteous and kind. The room was very clean, up to date, comfortable and quiet. Our only complaint would be that the heater was noisy and turned on and off constantly. It was to noisy to sleep so we turned it off and then got cold in the night... an extra blanket would have been helpful but there were no extras in the room. The breakfast was very good and better than expected.

author: 993terresah
title: Off-season awesome!
text: Movie Manor is fairly quiet during the off-season (winter). I recently added this overnight stop in beautiful Monte Vista, CO to my rather short commute from my residence to my parents home. The location is serene and quiet. Great sun and moon rise views, wonderful sunset views if you step out the front door. Late February and March might yield a glimpse of Sand Hill Cranes! Rooms are clean and comfortable. Staff are warm and welcoming. I'm sure it is great during "movie" season, but it is awesome during non-movie season too!

author: JaeN_13
title: Good value hotel with minor things to consider.
text: This is unique hotel that apparently has drive in theater, and you can watch the movie from the rooms (you can get rooms with large windows that you can see the screen along with volume/speaker control). It was winter so drive in was not operational. Arrived after sunset - entrance was bit difficult to locate, and may be missed if not careful. Location - right off the open highway, 5 min drive to town area. Because of the building arrangement, I drove to get breakfast in cold morning. May not be an issue during summer. Rooms were clean, spacious, but bit old/outdated. Beds & pillows were comfortable, shower and sink worked fine. Staff seemed professional and caring. Good value.

author: jnoriega1131
title: Staff
text: I would stay here even if it didn't have movies, golf course, great breakfast, nice rooms or a concession stand. Because of the family and staff that run this place. They treat me like family every time I stay here. Staying is a fun experience. The rooms are very, very clean and cozy. The location is safe and quiet. The breakfast is very good, especially the waffles. This is a must stay for southern Colorado.

author: brianrU4388XZ
title: A Unique Experience!
text: I stayed here with my wife on a recent road trip. I had read about what a unique place this was. I convinced here to stay here. She thought I was joking with her until we arrived and she saw the drive in movie screens! My only complaint is that not all of the rooms allow you to lay in bed and watch the movies, in some of them you need to sit in the chairs. All in all a great experience! We will be back! The employees and staff are very nice!

author: jscharg
title: how is it that we had never heard about this place???
text: We stayed here during a family road trip. We wanted to stay somewhere close to the Sand Dunes, and a friend recommended this hotel as a very unique and fun family experience. What an awesome recommendation! It was so much fun to sit in our hotel room and look out the window at the drive-in movie screen and watch Despicable Me 3 (or Spiderman, if we so chose) from our hotel room with the sound piping in through the speakers inside our hotel room. The kids loved it! And so did my wife and I. Free breakfast the next morning (before we head out to visit the Sand Dunes) was a great amenity. The buffet had plenty of hot and cold breakfast options for kids and for adults. I can't believe we have lived in Denver for 15 years and never heard about this unique and fun hotel. We will definitely go back here again!

author: 327elizabethv
title: Love this place
text: We visit here almost each year. Nice, clean and newly carpeted rooms. Hotel staff is great. Nice full complimentary breakfast each morning. Great location. Two movie screens to watch. One movie can be watched from your room, the other movie requires you to drive your vehicle in. Movies are always new releases.

author: sschafe5
title: Loved the Movie Manor
text: I have wanted to stay here for years. I am so grateful I did. The experience was excellent. Watching a drive in movie from my room was a hoot. The room was comfortable and clean. I found the coffee maker and was ready to go in the morning. I also had a fine BBQ brisket sandwich from the adjoining restaurant. I had a great time here and look forward to returning.

author: 419lorik
title: A blast from the past!!
text: This is a very fun place to stay. We were there for dirt drag race weekend the first of June. It was so fun to be there with all of the old cars,... great atmosphere. Nice little bar with a very friendly bartender. Beautiful view of the mountains. The rooms were nice in a retro sort of way. Would absolutely stay there again.

author: 723lynnettem
title: A Blessing!
text: Mike saved my family & I, from not having a place to stay! An unfortunate situation with the Sandhill Inn & Suites overbooking left us with no where to go, and a 3 1/2 hour drive from home with 3 small children. We really enjoyed our stay here! The rooms are clean, free wi-fi, breakfast was delicious, the staff is so polite, and the overall experience was wonderful. We also attended the drive-in theater, that is unique to this to this hotel. They have 2 different screens for viewing, a great concession stand, and right next to the hotel. I highly recommend this hotel, from personal experience. Thank you Mike! -Lynnette Marquez-

author: melanielC3582BY
title: A Most Unlikely Gem
text: In the small town of Monte Vista, CO is a Best Western hotel that doesn't look like much. It's attached to a drive-in theater and is a bit out of town. The Best Western Movie Manor is the unlikely gem, because it is such a great place. The staff is terrific, very friendly and very helpful. The rooms are much larger than other hotel rooms that we've stayed in, with plenty of parking. All appliances were in working order, the beds were comfortable and the room was immaculate. Each room was named after a star and faced a drive-in theater. When the theater is in operation, the room occupants can tune into the movie with the push of a button. The breakfast area was large, airy with a great view of the mountains and had a substantial variety of food to offer -- and all for free. If you're ever in southern Colorado, just east of Durango, give the Best Western Movie Manor a try, it's an unlikely gem.

author: ladydrake
title: Unique for sure!
text: We visited this motel in 1991 with our kids and were pleased they were still open so made a return visit! I give it a 5 star rating because the whole concept is just so fun! The place is very clean, very Americana, very kitsch and a very nice staff! It is true.... you watch a movie through a huge picture window looking at a drive-in screen! The sound is piped in through speakers in the ceiling! In some rooms, you can do while lying in bed.... in others, you need to pull up the chairs! I would suggest to the motel staff to put ottomans in those rooms for a more stretched out comfort position! Love this place!

author: josht405
title: Hunting trip
text: We stayed at the Best Western Mobie Manor on 3 separate nights during an Elk hunting trip. We were forced to book rooms due to weather issues in the mountains. The front desk/owner were very friendly and accommodating. The hotel was nice and comfortable. It featured a drive in theatre that you could watch from your picture window with speakers in your room to Listen to. The rooms were adequate for our needs and clean. The breakfast was also adequate with some hot food. It was a decent hotel for a small town, the only downside was it was a bit pricey but they were close to full each night so we took the room.

author: reginalds842
title: Awesome Hotel - a must stay here kinda place!! Big Rig parking also.
text: We had reservations and check in went smooth and easy. Our very fairly priced room was on the end of the far building but we had a great view of both movie screens (watched Nemo) you can listen to the audio in your room and choose either movie. The room was very spacious and clean with acres of parking space right outside - Big Rigs welcome here!. The bathroom was a good size with a powerful and hot shower. Wi-Fi worked excellent. It was super quiet location and we got an awesome nights sleep on the big comfortable beds. Breakfast was a really good spread including hot items with an attendant keeping everything re-filled and clean. From the breakfast room there is a very nice view of the mountains - must be awesome when there is snow up there!! Sad to leave and we will definantly stay here again if we are in the area.

author: Springfield_ORJhowe
title: 2 night stay in a wonderful motel
text: My husband and I were visiting CO to connect with long ago relatives and stayed at the Best Western Movie Manor. We booked our reservations on an online site and experienced some difficulties. The owners Mike and his wife were immensely helpful in getting the problem resolved. Our room was spotlessly cleaned and this facility has the added bonus of being part of a drive-in movie. We were able to watch the movie, "The Secret Life of Pets" from our room with the audio piped into the room. Breakfast was served and had many options both hot and cold. The breakfast room was large and spacious. Again, Mike and his wife were AWESOME and we can't recommend BEST WESTERN Movie Manor more highly.

author: TrvlLovrs
title: Only One
text: What can you say about the experience at a good motel with a drive in? You can stay in the comfort of your room and enjoy a drive-in movie!??- It's the best.- Grew up coming here to the drive-in and stayed a room a few times for fun and when company came to visit. Great to come back with our family now. They LOVE it! The new owners work tirelessly to see that all their guests have a superb visit. They were in the concession stand and at the front desk the next morning. Hats off to you! Can't wait to visit again one day.

author: 463garrettg
title: Fun, Unique Stop
text: Stopped on our way to Yellowstone. A stay unlike any other. Speaker in room ceiling with volume knob and on/off switch on wall, very good quality sound despite our room missing the volume knob. We could still adjust volume by turning the metal rod. Window for watching movie clear and large. Screen somewhat far from room but guests can use their room key to drive right up to the screen or to buy concessions from the drive-in's stand. Playground equipment also present at the front of the screen for kids or adventurous adults. :) Sunrise was beautiful and made me wish I had brought golf clubs and balls to play on the small driving range a little. Breakfast was filling and well-stocked.

author: mbrown477
title: Fantastic place - especially if you like Drive In movies; one of a kind experience
text: This place was on my bucket list and my wife brought me there as a surprise for my 60th birthday. John and Sammy at the front desk when we checked in were fantastic! They treated us like Royalty. They made sure we had the best room in the place for watching both Driving Screens. The Rooms are named after movie stars. We stayed for two nights (both movies). On Sunday when we checked out Mike became a friend in less than 5 minutes. We are checking the movies and when we see a good one we will be back!

author: 540clementem
title: Fun for families
text: One of the most novel places I've ever stayed at. The rooms are all themed by movie stars and it was fun to watch a drive in movie from our big hotel room window. The sound was controlled in the room and it sounded great. They do have a concession stand but we were too full from dinner to try it. The rooms are nice and clean, the beds and pillows were comfy and the customer service was excellent. Breakfast in the morning was very good and filling. Great experience for movie lovers. I would definitely return!

author: cynthiawW3482RW
title: Clean, affordable, pet friendly, and close to the Sand Dunes
text: This place was GREAT! Spotless room & bathroom. Comfortable bedding, easy check-in, quiet. Included breakfast was even nice! Having the Drive In theater there was icing on the cake. What fun! The room rate was very affordable and only $20 extra for our dog. It's about an hour from the Great Sand Dunes and about 10 mins outside of downtown Monte Vista. Perfect place to stay for families with pets or kids. I highly recommend!

author: MRBTravels4
title: Surprised by this cute motel
text: Ok, I admit it. I am a bit of a hotel snob. I don't like exterior doors or other aspects of motels. But we were tired and ready to sleep somewhere. Call me surprised! From Rayenna (I hope I spelled that right) at the front desk who offered to carrymy bags upstairs when I asked about an elevator (wow) to the family fun we had watching new release Star Trek from our room (they even have a concession stand--it's a real drive in like the ones of yore--you have stereo in your room and face the screen), I was pleased with each part. Finally, many places "say" they have hot breakfast, but this place offered many hot options. Clean. My son said it was the best place of the entire trip!

author: robingX1425NG
title: So Fun!!
text: This hotel was such a cool place for our family when we visited Great Sand Dunes. The property is in a very nice setting in the Valley with plenty of outdoor space for kids to run around. There is also a vintage playground near the Movie Screen that our kids enjoyed playing on. The motel was very clean, and the beds were comfortable. Before the movie started, we got dinner at the concession stand. The food was surprisingly good! The movie viewing experience from the room was so fun. The sound was great, and the view was excellent. Free breakfast the next morning was tasty, and the view from the breakfast room was beautiful. I highly recommend this place!

author: AGoingGal
title: Watching Drive In Movie Unique
text: This is an old (from the 60s) hotel. The rooms are small but appointed nicely, there is even a refrigerator and microwave in the room. There are not many outlets available except at the desk but this place wasn’t built for all of our current electronics. We ran out of hot water at 2000 in evening when I was drawing a bath. The issue was most probably an undersized hot water heater but this wasn’t the normal time of day a motel would run out of water. We lost the sound in our room for about three minutes while watching the movie. We scrambled to try and tune in the sound on the radio but it was weak and full of static. The room speakers came on again as mysteriously as they went out which was a relief as the speaker in the room works really well and the sound was crisp and clear so that was the best way to listen. This motel is an activity in and of itself with the movie theater. As a motel it is average with average amenities, an average breakfast, way above average price and average staff.

author: Floodguy
title: High point of movie was missed due to audio problems
text: The audio in the room went out 4 times throughout the movie. It took 5-10 minutes and a call to the front desk to get the problems addressed. The audio went out just when the climax of the movie happened and we missed the whole thing because we were trying to get ahold of the front desk. The plumbing was also an issue. The plumbing went out and the kids could not take a shower, brush their teeth, or even get a drink of water. Plumbing was out for over an hour. In my opinion, the room was overpriced for all the problems we had. The check out clerk didn't even care. She told us it was not her problem.

author: beckys468
title: Good accommodations, good fun
text: Although it's otherwise a standard motel, the Movie Manor Inn's gimmick of viewing movies from the rooms was really entertaining. It's basically a motel situated next to a drive-in theater. The screen was pretty small but directly centered from the vantage point of our window. The sound system for the movie ostensibly has multiple settings, but ours basically had quiet and loud with no gradations between. There are two movie screens: the one facing the motel plays family-friendly films, and guests can view the other for free as a drive-in movie. The accommodations were comfortable and reasonably clean (although a previous guest's open Coke can was left in the mini fridge). The complimentary breakfast included a variety of hot and cold options, and our kids loved the waffle iron. Our family enjoyed staying here.

author: MarlaS458
title: A few glitches but lots of fun!
text: This place is worth the stop! With that said, there were a few glitches that would have been nice had they been fixed. When we came back from dinner, the water had gone out in the hotel. This is not the fault of the of the hotel just something that happens. Front desk staff was very nice about it and the water was back on within an hour. However, the audio to the movie went out 2 times during the movie. This is why people go to the movie Manor Hotel. I'm sure it was a minor glitch but let's get that fixed folks!

author: jillybeanjks
title: Unique & fun!
text: From the outside, it doesn't look all that wonderful (except the giant movie screens, of course!), but the rooms were really great! I don't know if all the rooms have it, but I loved the entry of room 225 - a raised, carved-out space for all our luggage. If you have 2 beds in your room, I don't think there are rooms where you can easily watch the movie from the beds. However, Room 225 has a straight-shot view of a screen. The kids layed on the bed sideways to watch, and the adults moved the chairs to get a good view as well. (I would request a room with the best available view of the screen you want to watch when you call in your reservation.) The playground and the popcorn were both huge hits with the kids! The breakfast was great, with many options. Word of caution: I'm not sure how, but we somehow ended up with tiny burrs all over our floor. If you walk around the grounds, you may want to check your shoes before going back into your room - stepping in those things with bare feet is no fun!

author: Berwicky
title: Suprisingly Neat and Unique
text: We were hesitant to stay at a motel advertised as "Themed" by Best Western. However, we loved it. One of the cleanest hotels ever visited in 50 years of traveling by car. Updated rooms, great breakfast area and friendly hosts. A wonderful story of the man who build his dream. And surprise....a first run movie viewed from our room through one of the biggest windows imagined. This place is a motel and a drive-in movie theatre combined. We have experienced very bad motels and great luxury hotels and this is our first "themed" motel. We would go there again just to re-experience the fun, history and very good breakfast.

author: bksmrt
title: More about memories than movies
text: First, the room was immaculate. I mean, spic and span. We were there on a road trip from Denver, and had only heard of the Movie Manor. Stayed in room 208 - one of the prime rooms for being able to view the movie from bed. The speaker is in the room, and the sound is incredible. The bed was really comfortable! Breakfast was what you'd expect - waffles, fruit, pastry, cereal, etc. So here's the thing, the movie was "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles." Now, we didn't pick this place based on what was showing, but if you're going to watch the movie, I'd stick with a known venue. Also, the concession stand was a little lacking - really helpful, but not full-scale. Overall, if you're looking for a quick overnight for the family, with the fun and kitsch of a drive-in movie in your room, this is the place.

author: DuffyM_11
title: Nice stay
text: This is a special place, not very often can you lay in bed and look out a big picture window and enjoy a drive-in movie. Oh you can also do it old school and drive into the lot. This motel has been there a long time so the design in older but that's where it stops. Our room was VERY clean and the accommodations were very nice and modern. Front desk people were friendly and great on recommendations to eat in town. I would highly recommend staying here. A tip, avoid a room on the curve if you want a better view of the movie screens, there are two, showing different movies. For all of us who grew up with drive-ins, this was a blast from the past. We're planning on bringing the kids and grandchildren back for some summer fun! PS there's even a playground

author: bully719
title: Great Experience!
text: Location is great! Fishing, hunting & hiking near by. Very well kept, large clean & comfy rooms. In spring & summer months u could watch movies from your room, drive-in is located right out your room window. You can see & hear movies in your room. Many amenities close by. Great breakfast! The owner's are very nice.

author: johnbF6280QT
title: Wonderful place
text: This is a unique and very cool property that incorporates a drive in theatre with an old school, very well-kept roadside motel. The room was fairly small but very adequate for the two of us; actually "cozy" is a better description. It was clean and the queen bed was extremely comfortable. The girl who checked us in was excellent and she had a great demeanor about her. When our room keys didn't work and I had to return to the front desk, she joked that it was part of their "get to know you" program. Really great way to handle what could have been an annoyance! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the free breakfast was also very good, with fresh-cooked scrambled eggs and bacon. I definitely recommend this little gem of a motel and hope to have the opportunity to visit again.

author: ErikaAnn303
title: Never seen anything else like it!
text: Watching a just released movie on the big screen with the whole family tucked into bed? Yes please!!! The property itself is well cared for and clean. And the staff was so friendly, welcoming and knowledgeable about the area. The accommodations aren't fancy but perfectly comfortable. If you are going for the movie, be sure you check to confirm one is playing as they are seasonal. Also, the restaurant adjacent to to property is seasonal as well. Oh, and since the movies play at a drive inn open to the public, there's a concession stand. Popcorn and a movie in my hotel room. Love it!

author: ritae616
title: Comfortable, clean and friendly
text: I just enjoyed a wonderful weekend in Monte Vista seeing and photographing the Sandhill cranes but part of that was staying at this hotel. Just about 15 minute drive to the refuge so convenient but where else can you watch a drive in movie right from your room. Speakers are installed in each room to control your sound!! The rooms are spotless and comfortably furnished with water and snack provided. Mike is extremely accommodating, he even provided a wine cork so I could enjoy wine I had purchased locally. Thanks for a great stay. Anyone who stays here won't regret it. Oh and a wonderful breakfast buffet including waffles included!!!

author: 612taras
title: Great service and family friendly!
text: Our family decided last minute to take a ski vacation. We wanted to stay somewhere affordable and within driving distance to Wolf Creek, Co. We booked our rooms online for 4 nights at a very affordable rate. We arrived in the middle of the night Monday and were greeted pleasantly. The rooms were comfy and clean. Every morning there was a hot breakfast, bagels, cereal, juice and coffee. The service was exceptional!! They remember guest's names and go out of their way to be sure that your stay is pleasant. This small town of Monte Vista is a great place to visit, beautiful views and close to a variety of national parks. When you go be sure to stay at the Best Western Movie Manor to experience a cozy and relaxing vacation!

author: aabbxc
title: Great motel!
text: We had to be in Monte Vista for a family funeral. We needed to rent multiple rooms. Mike the manager went above and beyond to take care of our family. He offered us the use of the breakfast area to meet with the family and share memories with family from out of town. They made coffee for us and provided some treats as well. In our time of sadness, it was wonderful to be taken care of by the staff. All of the rooms were clean and very comfortable. We would recommend this motel to anyone needing to stay in the San Luis valley. We would like to return at a later date to enjoy the movie theatre experience of this motel.

author: michaelbS630WC
title: Great view of the mountains
text: We where very impressed with our stay their. We stayed their for four nights in October. We always had very clean room everyday. The breakfast was good, but they needed to change their breakfast menu every morning instead having the same every morning. We went to the bakery their in town and had their fresh pastries "fantastic" Could not watch the movies in the theater because they stopped showing because of lacking costumers at the time we where staying their. That is understandable. They did call me a week before we arrived to let me know about not showing movies. You will be very pleased staying their. We will stay their again. Everybody working their was very nice.

author: connies611
title: Weekend Trip
text: We love little weekend trips through southern Colorado,especially this time of the year. This was our second stay at BW Movie Manor in Monte Vista. Although both the drive-in theater and the restaurant were closed for the season, the spectacular mountain views that we had from our room and from the breakfast room with floor to ceiling windows were better than any movie. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The pet friendly rooms are in a separate building with a very large grassy area for your convenience. We found a lovely little place for dinner in Monte Vista--The Sunflower Cafe with very good simply prepared food and a friendly staff. Our breakfast at the motel was enjoyable. Our room was comfortable and very clean, as was the bed & pillows. We will certainly stay again.

author: JamesS884
title: Not just your ordinary hotel room and a movie.
text: Good stop off the beaten path. Was lucky enough to speak to the owners, who really take pride in ownership, emphasizing customer satisfaction. A nice room that faces the screen of the Drive In next door. There are speakers wired in your room, so you can sit on the edge of your bed, eat some popcorn and see a current release. After being on the road for almost a week, just staying home, relaxing in a comfortable room and watching a movie was just what the family needed. Of course, we visited the concession stand before the flick, we had microwave popcorn packed but why use that when you have a theatre right there. Continental breakfast was good, not just heat up some already cooked eggs, tasty home cooking. Spoke to another couple at breakfast who say they always stop here, even though it's out of the way for them. Cannot recommend them enough!

author: jonj271
title: Another unforgettable stay
text: If they ever write a book entitled "Doing things right", this wonderful property should be featured. Absolutely spotless facility, wonderful old-school charm and incredibly helpful staff and management. Pleased to meet Mike, the general manager, the day of checkout. Shared our family's legacy at the property and countless fond memories there, over the decades. The only improvement would be the removal of sticker bushes around the playground at the drive-in. This is a can't-miss lodging experience in Colorado. Looking forward to our next visit at the Hot Rod Dirt Drags early next summer. Pure excellence.

author: moontraveler9999
title: Personable service
text: Mike the GM and the staff are very friendly, personable and engaging. I actually thought it was a typical BW out dated... however upon arriving this BW is neat, clean and well cared for. Mike was very pleasant in conversation. I was very impressed with the cleanliness of the room and the up to date look. They take pride in the appearance. I really enjoyed the outside drive-in movie theater having the sound in the rooms while watching the current movies from the room window. Thx Mike & team!

author: moparmesa
title: Clean rooms, Super staff and owners, DRIVE-IN movie viewing from room a great plus.
text: I can not say enough about Dawna (spelling) at the front desk. Just the perfect lady to check us in. The owners Mike and Sangita really could show other hotels how to operate! Great breakfast and no complaints. Movie time from our friends room was just what we needed traveling in a group. 4 of us sat and enjoyed the big screen while having snacks and beverages. We will stop here every time! And bring your kids, this will make there trip too. Please note: I generally don't give many 5 stars.

author: 460terrih
title: Excellent Hospitality
text: From the moment we arrived we were shown exceptional hospitality by front desk manager Sangita. Both her and her husband Mike were friendly and helpful. The rooms were clean and had all the amenities needed, including a refrigerator that came in handy for our beverages and leftover meals, and a microwave that we used for re-heating food. A full delicious breakfast is included. The rooms face the drive-in theater next door, and we were surprised that the movie sound is piped into each room with the push of a button. The rooms are named after famous people, including the fitness room named after a famous body builder. We were very happy to have found this Best Western in Monte Vista, and will definitely stay here anytime we are in the area. Thank you!

author: vtoler
title: Great experience
text: We were looking for a place on our way between the Royal Gorge and Durango on our Colorado vacation. We found this place tucked away from the town with decent reviews and decided to give it a go. It was excellent. The rooms were modern and very clean. The beds were superior (best beds of the whole trip).The movie experience was awesome. We watched the new Mission Impossible movie from our room. I've heard some people say they problems with the sound but ours worked perfect. The breakfast was also very good. I highly recommend this place.

author: paulsR2232JD
title: Movie Manor
text: Awesome. Fun. Great for kids. Watched new Impossible movie,. Sat outside for a drink, watchded a great sunset, and played guitar. Kids played at the old school playground and watched movie from room. Food was very good.. Staff very nice. Easy in and out.

author: paulinakarbo
title: Fun new experience!
text: This Best Western was definitely unique! When we first arrived around 4 PM, it was pretty empty, and we were worried that there was a reason for that! We stayed in this hotel mainly because it wasn't too far from the Great Sand Dunes National Park, so we decided to go there right after we checked in. It was only an hour drive which was nice. The hotel is kind of in the middle of nowhere, but once we got back from the national park, there were plenty of people there. The rooms were clean and spacious. There were some issues with the sound for the movie in our room, but nothing extreme. The breakfast was a standard hotel breakfast, but the dining room was very nice! Overall, we really enjoyed our stay at this hotel, even though it was only for one night.

author: F1126OUrichardl
title: Not just another Best Western...
text: Lucky for the four of us, we stumbled upon this unique and fun Best Western in Monte Vista, Colorado. We unfortunately, only stayed one night, but were delighted to be able to relax in our room after a hard day of travel and watch a first run movie from the comfort of the bed. The room includes a speaker to be able to listen as you watch the movie. The room itself was clean and comfortable. The breakfast was super delicious with all the things typical of a good full breakfast and the set up of the serving and eating areas are well laid out with plenty of room for everybody. The owners spent time talking with us the morning after we checked out. They seemed to be truly genuine good and thoughtful people. We are happy to recommend this special hotel to anybody coming through the beautiful southern Colorado area. Even our teenage boys said they really liked their stay and asked when we can go back!!!

author: WayneF568
title: Differnt for sure
text: Everybody should do this at least once in a lifetime. Neat idea, stayed two nights but only around for one movie. There for the Sky High Stampede, Trace Adkins concert. Had a really good time here. Full up every night but no problems with noise or crowding. Always had table space for breakfast. Really enjoyed watching picture show while in the A/C comfort of a very nice room and eating fresh popped corn from room's microwave. Would stay here anytime in area.

author: 67deannag
title: Fun Time for the Family
text: The drive in from the hotel room was very fun. The movie was a new release that they were showing for the drive in. You can use the drive in or watch from your room. We could see very well. There is a set of play equipment from the 60's. It sure was fun to go over and play. You can take chairs over to the drive in also. Then the kids can play at the playground. The breakfast was fantastic. The lot and rooms were clean.

author: TammyV980
title: A Nice Surprise
text: This hotel was a nice surprise to a very long travel day. The gal at the front desk was great, she helped us find something to eat late at night and was friendly and warm. Our room was immaculately clean and looked to have just been remodeled. A nice note from the housekeeping staff greeted us on the table. The drive in movie was a fun surprise! It is an older hotel, so the rooms on the second floor would be quieter. The hot breakfast was a nice plus. Eggs, sausage, waffles, fresh fruit, yogurt, juice etc. We will be returning!

author: davidhW2649SE
title: Now This is a Big Screen
text: My husband booked this hotel prior to our CO trip and we had no idea why it was called the Movie Manor. I assumed a western had been made in the area and it would have memorabilia in that vein. We were delighted to find it was adjacent to a drive in which you could attend in your car or watch from the large window of your room (a speaker in the room took the place of the speaker you hang in your window) as part of the cost of lodging. The movies were current as well. We watched Jurassic World. The continental breakfast was also quite good and there was room on the grounds to go for a walk. If the opportunity arises again we will return. Written by Jan Hopkins

author: ramillerf1
title: The place to stay in the San Luis Valley!
text: This hotel was way nicer than I thought it would be. It all starts with the wonderful proprietor, Sangita Suthar and her hard working staff. This large, sprawling property has a large lawn area, a nice restaurant serving good food, a place for motor homes and trucks in the back along with its signature duel drive-in theater in the front. You can watch the theater from the comfort of your room as they pipe in the sound. The included continental breakfast was one of the best I've ever had. Everything was available and the supplies were constantly replenished. I asked Sangita about visiting Great Sand Dunes National Park and she told me about a shortcut that shaved an hour off the time my GPS said. A great facility starts with great owners...

author: Mattunruh379
title: Would love to make this a weekly stop.
text: I'm an over the road truck driver, an was recommended by others to stay here. First, they were very friendly and polite. Like I said I'm a truck driver an they accommodate that very well. They have a nice, clean, safe, & big lot to park my truck. That's just the start. I never thought I could watch movies from the comfort of my room on a drive in theatre screen an listen in my room. The rooms are very clean an cozy. 100% satisfied. Definitely going to try to make this a regular stop.

author: ManeeshinR
title: Best West
