text: Nice Hotel, Great staff, Scenic views. We were planning to try scenic byways. Great location to access silver thread byway, highway of legends and even great sand dunes. Price is great. Why not...movies, new experience from hotel room. Internet was bit slow. Breakfast was great. Well cleaned room, no odors.

author: coloradomike2015
title: Amazing Movie Manor !!
text: This place RULES! One of the original's! The Movie Manor is 60 years old and fantastic. The rooms are super clean, the drive in and play ground are super clean, So AMAZING! To top the our stay, the owner was telling us they are having a 1950 theme weekend June 12-14, 2015. There will be vintage Hot Rod Dirt Drags, all cars from the 50s! We are so coming back for that! I found the website here http://hotroddirtdrags.com

author: minnloft
title: A new favorite place
text: The Best Western Movie Manor was our gathering spot for a weekend of birding highlighted by thousands of Sandhill Cranes. Mike and Sangita Suthar were terrific hosts and showed a birding related move, Fly Away, on their drive in screens ahead of the schedule opening for the drive in. The room was very clean and included toiletry supplies and a microwave and mini-fridge. There were chairs for watching the movie through a large window and there was a speaker for the sound. The complimentary breakfast was way beyond the typical bad orange juice and Fruit Loops offered by many places. Even make your own Belgian waffles. The rooms all had door plaques with movie star names and stars' names were written in the concrete area in front of the main entrance. I will definitely return.

author: hlhodges
title: Fun Get Away Place
text: My husband and I stayed at the Movie Manor Inn for our anniversary in June of 2014. We had a fun time staying here and loved the movie theme of the rooms. The show sound plays in the speakers in the room, controlled by a switch. There was the option to either watch the show playing from our room window or to drive our vehicle to the other screen to view a different movie. We stayed in our room but the bed was slightly off center to the window, so my husband sat in a chair and I watched from the bed. This was a little disappointing. Also disappointing was the restaurant. Their menu was fun and had a large variety of dishes all with fun movie-themed names, but they didn't have the fettuccini noodles for the fettuccini Alfredo I ordered. I agreed to having spaghetti noodles, but was still disappointed in the sauce as it reminded me of canned sauce. For those reasons I didn't rate higher, but we had so much fun, we would go back again!

author: debm817
title: Clean, comfortable and friendly!
text: We'd driven by the Movie Manor for years always meaning to stay the night and catch a movie. We finally spent the night there last weekend. We assumed that the reason for staying at the Movie Manor was for the experience of relaxing comfortably in your room while watching the movie of the week on the big drive in movie screen outside the window. We didn't have high expectations for the actual accommodations. But, movie season was over for 2014 and to our surprise the Movie Manor stands on it's own with or without the movie experience. The rooms were very clean, comfortable and affordable. The owner and staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming. It's obvious that they take great pride and care in the presentation and operation of their establishment. We will definitely go back again and still hope to catch a movie there one of these days!

author: Icaretwo
title: Cannot wait to go back in summer
text: We stopped late at night on our way home. We were greeted by a lovely lady who was kind and friendly. We found our room spacious and spotless. It is winter so there are no movies playing but you can see that in the summer, it must be a blast to stay here. The room has a movie theme with cool pictures and fun wall paper. The big picture window is cool and appears to serve as a great place to see movies in the summer. It appears to be a slow time so we were thinking that breakfast might be a scaled down version based on the few rooms but not so. There was a great spread and served in a breakfast room that has floor to ceiling windows and an amazing view of the mountains. The staff in the morning was friendly as well . Cannot wait to go back.

author: brayt0nh
title: Great Hotel But Watch Where The Trucks Park
text: Night one fantastic rest and enjoyable stay. Staff was so very helpful with finding me help in town for shipping some unneeded travel items home as I was on a motorcycle. She also knew the good places to eat and how far the long walk into town was. Wonderful!!! Night 2 tractor trailer with refrigeration unit cycling on and off all night right outside room even after notifying desk clerk young man. They have assigned truck parking but don't enforce policy so guests suffer. Not good at all waking up 4 times during night before long travels. If it was not for the truck's generator cycling on and off right outside and the fact I reported the problem with apparently no action to correct, rating would be without complaint. Loved the area and the hotel, otherwise.

author: bikenbees
title: DONT JUDGE A MOTEL BY THE EXTERIOR
text: This motel is top class and top rated. We were stunned at the rooms. Very clean, very modern, updated beds,pillows etc. and you can watch a movie in your room. The breakfast room is fantastic rivals any of the big chains. Very clean and lots of selections. they have done a great job here. I think they want to keep it looking like a 60's motel because of the drivein movie theme but don't let that fool you. THIS IS A TOP CLASS PLACE TO STAY.

author: cassieb623
title: The Best Motel We Ever Stayed In!
text: This hotel is such a great place to stay. I grew up in the San Luis Valley and always wanted to stay here. The service cant be beat. The staff is so friendly and will go out of their way to make you comfortable. The rooms were so clean and beds very comfy. It was also so neat to be able to watch the drive inn movie from your room. We stayed 2 nights and did not want to leave. I love how the rooms have a hollywood feel and are named after celebrities we stayed in Clint Eastwood. Everything was perfect and we will definitley make this our stop when we come to Monte Vista. I highly recommend this hotel.

author: elizabethcK6550HW
title: Fun Hotel
text: This was a novel idea! Watch a drive-in movie from your room!! The room was a nice size. We are a family of five. The beds were super comfy. If you love movies this is the place to stay. The decor is movies, the room doors are named after movie stars. I didn't eat in the restaurant, but picked-up a piece of pie and the decor is all "Holllywood" and movie stars. Had fun trying to remember old movies and names.

author: miriahs2014
title: Worth the stop!
text: Perfect little hotel right outside of town. You're able to see a drive in movie or watch another film right from your room. We had room 106, so unfortunately we weren't able to both see from bed, (but the idea of it is great), and there are rooms you can request with better views. The sound turns on or off right from your room. Overall, staff was excellent. The room had a fridge and a microwave. One of the best breakfasts we've had from a hotel. Waffles, eggs, sausage, cereal, fruit, bagels/muffins/rolls, coffee and juice. We would definitely stay again if ever back in the area, and we would request a room with a better view!

author: relambjr
title: Fun property and perfect for kids
text: This is a really neat hotel, and a good choice I decided upon, based largely on other reviews. The movie aspect makes it worth it if you're traveling with kids. It is a classic motel that is adjacent to an operating drive-in, so the rooms have a view of one of the movies, and in-room sound. Perfect for children and together time. The staff was all very friendly and helpful in ideas to do and service. The hotel is west of town on 160 and not immediately near anything but close enough to Monte Video. Note i tossed up between this hotel and the BW in Alamosa. I am very glad I stayed in the Movie one despite a bit of extra driving. Breakfast was very mediocre, but was suitable enough.

author: gerryo977
title: Great Experience!
text: We were very pleasantly surprised. Small town, Best Western...we weren't expecting much but it was a treat. The man that checked us in was extremely friendly and helpful. The lady that corrected our rewards program points and checked us out, was just as pleasant. We rented three rooms and all were clean and spacious. Watching the drive-in movie from our room was a bonus. Our son opted to drive the car to the 2nd movie (Transformers). The free breakfast was good, the same as you get at most hotels. The Eating area was well maintained. The staff started things off right with their friendly and hospitable nature and the entire experience was one we won't soon forget.

author: leroym2013
title: Leroy-Greeley, Colorado
text: Great hotel overall. Rooms were very clean, comfortable beds, Continental Breakfast was fantastic. The hotel restaurant food was great as well. Great location away from town. I would recommend this hotel. Prices might be a little steep for seniors with tight budgets. Not enough queen beds for their hotel. Could tell their guests about the Incidental charges.

author: 444kirstyp
title: Wonderful Place
text: Stay Here! It's amazing!! This hotel is a gem tucked away in rural Colorado. We were desperately trying to find a place to stop for the night over 4th of July weekend on our way down to New Mexico, and most places we called along Highway 285 were booked up and quite rude about it. Enter in the Movie Manor and its super polite and helpful staff; We were able to get a great room on short notice. The room was super clean, spacious, and comfortable. Pet friendy hotel too! Strongly recommend.

author: VisitingfromUS
title: Drive-in Movie from your room!
text: Where else can you watch a drive-in movie from your hotel room?! Monte Vista is a bit out of the way, but if you are in the area, you have to give it a try. Don't expect the Ritz Carlton. The hotel is a basic hotel, but they do a good job keeping it up. It has more of a motel feel than a hotel feel. I feel like I took a little journey back in time. Each room has a different movie star's name on the door. Better view of drive-in from second floor rooms in my opinion. Amazing view from the breakfast room!

author: tsandco
title: Top 99.9 % for Best Western hotels
text: I travell for business and find myself in many rual communities. Best Western is a fair hotel chain, usually the top of the budget line, the difference between motel vs hotel. The Movie Manor is, without a doubt a great hotel. The grounds are very very clean. New concrete parking surface, ample lighting. The office/breakfast area is newer clean and the staff is very friendly. Our room was large, very clean on the ground floor. The large window allowed us to see the drive in screen very well and the speaker was as loud and clear We hope to return to the Movie Manor

author: DouglasA_12
title: Drive-in movies in your room
text: This hotel was better than average for a Best Western. The room was clean and spacious. You really can watch a movie from your room. The screen is a bit distant, it's like watching a 19 inch TV. The air conditioning worked great. Breakfast was ok, nothing great here. Front desk help was very nice and check-in, check-out was easy. It is an exterior entrance type motel so security is not so great. We had a ground floor room and didn't have much noise from other rooms, but we did have the fan on all night. This is a nice stop in Southern Colorado.

author: Travelling_Willburry
title: Clean, nicely maintained property
text: We stayed for the weekend while visiting family. The rooms were clean, and the movie feature was cool! I enjoyed the beautiful scenery around the property, as well as the amazing weather that weekend. The breakfast was typical microwaved egg disks and sausage pattys. There was a waffle bar, but the line wasnt worth the wait. I interacted with the head housekeeper who was very helpful and friendly. A lady who worked the front desk an evening, and the next morning was very helpful. I still cant believe my ears though... Upon check in, "Raj" was asked by the lady ahead of me where a good place to eat might be. His response "I dont know, I dont really like it here." I think mom and dad own the property, and Raj doesnt wanna work there!

author: Lwr1818
title: Very nice.
text: Very nice. New rooms and friendly staff. Quirky but fun. It was fun with kids. The rooms are very updated. No pool but a interesting movie experience. Very affordable. Watched Malificent. New furniture and good breakfast.

author: MariB73
title: A Quirkie Gem
text: How fun! Saw a drive-in movie from the comfort of our room with piped in sound. It is included in the stay. Our room was neat and very clean. Not fancy, mind you but all the essentials including very good wi-fi service. It was a welcome respite after spending time at the Great Sand Dunes National Park. There is a restaurant on site with a varied menu. Good food. There was also a complementary breakfast in the morning. ALL of the facilities were well maintained and very clean.

author: momindenver23
title: This is a unique place to stay, great value, and personable, friendly service.
text: This is the second time I've stayed here for the Monte Vista Bird Festival. It is the best and most convenient to the festival. Most people stay in Alamosa. I love the rooms with their unique movie motifs and the free movies are a gas to watch from your room! They played some great bird docs during my stay. Rooms are large, neat, and clean. The manager and staff is very welcoming. I intend to come back next year and wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

author: kitty33388
title: Fun Family Weekend
text: Took our 8 year old twins and our Bichon to Monte Vista for the weekend. Didn't know whether they would be as impressed with it as I. To keep it short...THEY LOVED IT!! The motel is upgraded, clean and charming with it Old Hollywood Theme-which is tasteful-not over the top. Dog and kid friendly. Lots of space and grass to walk the dog and a kids' movie playing: Mr Peabody and Sherman. Also staff was very gracious to call and offer to mail one of the kids' toy to us...even before w realized that we'd left it behind! Mike is a very gracious host. We will definitely go back!

author: acopperqueen
title: Very Rude and not willing to help customers
text: We had booked a two bed room and when we got to the hotel, they gave us a single bed. We noted the mistake and they charged us extra for the double bed. When we moved to the new room, it had not been cleaned. We let them know and two men with shop vacs came in a vacuumed, and that was it. Our key kept locking us out of our room and the bathroom door did not latch or lock. There was a gap that anyone could see in. I later got a very rude email from the manager that said we made the mistake and we were lucky they let us stay there. I would not recommend this hotel.

author: 949michaela
title: The People are Fantastic
text: It's all people that make or break the quality of the stay. Walking in and checking in with the night clerk – she took care of us. She pleasantly introduced us to the hotel and the rooms. The cleaning staff did a beautiful job preparing our room for the night and the next night. The breakfast staff prepared a beautiful repast. It was clean and smelled scrumptious. Finally the owner, who we spoke with on our departure was pleasant and appreciated our visit and comments to him about his staff. We are looking forward to our next stay.

author: Sandi5020
title: Older, but worth it
text: From the moment we walked into the lobby we were welcomed and comfortable. Not an easy thing, considering we were four motorcyclist, all decked out in our black leathers. The gentleman that checked us in was warm and friendly, and joked around with us. We went to our rooms, but found out that we were not close to each other. They were quick and willing to rearrange us so that we could be closer. We ate at the restaurant next door. Not fancy, but food was good. Music was a little loud for holding a conversation, but they were accommodating in turning it down. This is one of the unique places you have to try. There are not many drive-in theaters left, and I doubt there is another where you can watch the movie from your room.

author: Hillmo
title: great place to stay!
text: I had heard from many family members over the years that we needed to go and stay at the movie manor. So my Mom and I and 3 kids hopped in the car and drove down for a quick overnight getaway. Let me say it was great! The room was over sized for a double queen and it was very clean. The staff is wonderful, very friendly and helpful. Once we got settled in our room the movie started and what a unique experience that is. you can lay in bed and watch a drive in movie. The kids loved it. They also have a nice warm breakfast in the morning. We will definitely be back.

author: MichelleC293
title: Perfect family stop
text: I stayed here with my 2 kids in early August 2013. It was the perfect place for us. Clean, quiet, and our room was huge! We had a 2 queen room in a separate building in the back. It was a short walk to the main building. The free movie at the drive in was fun for the kids. A coupon was provided for the restaurant as well. The owners or front desk couple were kind and helpful. Breakfast in the morning was in a nice dining area with large windows. I really enjoyed our stay here!

author: Ridge86er
title: Retro Cool: Good & Bad
text: Take away the Drive In Movie, and this place is a mediocre motel. But with the Movie Theatre it's pretty amazing. It's somewhat clean and has a weird retro vibe, that your'e not really sure if it's Cool Retro, or just Dated! There are fun movie photos/drawings in the room, and each room is named after an old celebrity which is fun. The sound from one of the screens is piped into the room, or you can listen via the clock radio to the other screen. They will also let you drive-in with the other cars when you show them your hotel key. There were a few flies that we're not sure if they were in there before we got in, or came in when we opened the door...but they became super annoying and unkillable! Didn't have have time for the continental breakfast, so can't judge that. Had to deal with staff that was being trained...but not a problem they were great.

author: mamagoos
title: What a pearl!!!!
text: We were on a road trip in Colorado and by chance found this wonderful motel. It is very close to the Great Sand Dunes.The office was pristine and Mike was friendly and very efficient. We learned that we could watch the drive in movie which was located right out side of our bedroom window. The sound is piped in, should you chose to turn it on. There was no traffic sounds or any disturbance at all from having it right next door. What fun to watch a movie....a recent one, now playing in movie theaters, while you relax in bed. The room was older but extremely clean and well appointed and the bed was great. This stay was not only fun.....but very comfortable. The breakfast was excellent with many choices.

author: Sageyly
title: Super fun
text: I went with my son for a southern Colorado vacation and had heard about the Movie Manor from a friend and decided to try it. We had a blast. The owners were personable and helpful. The staff was clearly treated well, as everything was clean and organized. Everyone had a smile and was happy to help. Watching a movie from the hotel room was a treat- the sound piped directly into the room. Both the linens and matresses were of much higher quality than I expected. Breakfast was much better than the usual 'free breakfast' fare. Super glad we went, we will be back.

author: trvl2usa
title: What a great experience
text: We booked the room and didn't really know what to expect. After checking in we checked out our room. We were surprised how clean it was. We watched the movie from our room. The sound effects were great and we had a great view. I had a good night's rest and when we stepped out of the room the only thing we saw was the nature. The restaurant by the hotel was okay. We had better but we definitely had worse. I would recommend this hotel to all of my friends. Overall it was a great experience and stay.

author: Teresa634
title: Interesting
text: My daughter and I were traveling around southern Colorado for a trip this summer. I wanted to stay here as it seemed like an interesting concept. The other people staying here were very nice and my daughter enjoyed watching a drive in from the hotel room. She has never been to a drive in and didnt get the concept:) The room seemed clean and in good condition, until I found a rat crawling on my hand in the middle of the night. I didnt not sleep the rest of the night, but did not want to alarm my younger child so told the front desk person when she was distracted. I would have called at the time but like I said did not want to alarm my child so that she would refuse to sleep the rest of the trip. The front desk said they would notify the manager and then overcharged me. Needless to say we wont be staying here again. This is my first time staying in a best western I think I will try to avoid them in the future.

author: BoulderLyons
title: Weirdly wonderful
text: I don't know how I first heard of the Movie Manor but once I did, I knew I had to stay there some day. I got my chance when we couldn't find a room in Alamosa. Thank goodness! I wasn't expecting the rooms to be so spacious and contemporary and the bed so big and comfy! We couldnt wait for it to get dark and for the movie to begin. Of course, given the comfy bed, I promptly feel sleep but my movie-loving hubby wouldn't stayed up all night if the movies kept playing. The staff was helpful and attentive. The onsite restaurant was a disappointment, warm chardonnay and a very limited selection, but that certainly won't keep me from coming back!

author: dianeg947
title: this place was very nice definately advise staying her WILL AGAIN
text: this place is very nice and clean, you can;t tell it is an older motel. i love the idea of the movie theater where you can watch from your room. unfortunately it was in March and they did not have the movies going. need to go back in May. i was there for the sandhil cranes and everyone i met was staying there and they all raved how nice and clean and reasonable this was. the beds are the most comfortable i have ever stayed in in a motel. not sure if the mattress was new but sure felt like it. loved this place and the restraurant is right next door in the same parking lot and they give you a 15% off coupon. will definately stay there from now on. even the parking lot was extremely clean.

author: ColoradoGuy1125
title: What a memorable treat!
text: My wife and I (and our little dog) had a nice trip to the Alamosa area for the Labor Day weekend for sightseeing. The best part of the trip turned out to be our hotel complete with Drive-In movie! For sound, instead of the old window speakers, you just dial-in the film on your FM radio in your car. We had a convertible so with the top down it was a lot of fun. Gees, you could even talk during the movie, imagine that? Very nice support staff in the hotel and the nearby restaurant also. Very quiet and a rather massive area. Even has a chipping green. I'll bring my clubs next time. There's also a playground area if you have kids.

author: Andrews_mom_12
title: Family fun
text: We had a great time. Traveling with 3 kids age 9-11. It was fun to share the nostalgia of a drive in with the kids. We drove in with the car rather than watching from the room for the full experience (cost included, just show your room key). Movies are first run. They started the film before it was dark enough outside, but it was fine once the movie started. For us this was nice because we were able to get the kids to bed that 15 minutes earlier. The room was clean and comfortable, exceeded my expectations for a two star hotel. We had breakfast at the nearby restaurant, got 15% off our bill. It was good, priced a little high as you would expect for a travel restraunt.

author: Colorado53
title: Novelty Hotel - Not That Much of a Novelty
text: I suppose the idea of having a hotel that doubles for a drive-in movie theater is pretty cool, but there's a reason drive-in theaters are going the way of the 8 track tape player and so is this hotel. The beds are not comfortable, the bed linens are worn out. The heater/ac fan made a serious racket when the unit came on. The bathroom fan made a racket when you turn it on as well. Not a comfortable nor quiet place to sleep. The owners have refurbished the place and the exterior is clean but overall, you won't be clambering to stay there again. By Best Western standards it is poor. But, if you're in Monte Vista and looking for a hotel, it's in a good spot on the highway. I'd recommend you stay somewhere else though.

author: SimpleGuy80
title: Great Place to Stay!!
text: This is the scond time that we have stayed at the Best Western Movie Manor hotel. We booked the room online through Best Westerns website and made one special request which was taken care of before we arrived. We enjoyed every aspect of our stay from start to finish and the front desk staff at the hotel were awesome. Our room was A+++ clean upon check-in and we had excellent wireless internet signal through out our stay. There is an onsite restaurant that has decent food which is pricey but, they do provide a 15% off (one time use) coupon upon check-in. The hotel is very quiet and the view of the surrounding mountains from the door of our room were beautiful. The price we paid was a good value for the amenities offered considering the only comparable cheaper option was a hotel 20+ miles away. Definetly the only hotel I will stay in while visiting Monte Vista...

author: DebraA20
title: The only place we wil stay in Monte Vista
text: What a great place. Stayed downtown in July and was NOT happy at that place - very dirty.I was a little afraid to stay anyplace in Monte Vista but this place is a gem. The room, the grounds every thing about this hotel was spotless. Our room was so clean and the people at the front desk were very helpful. It is so quiet there and not a lot of traffic noise even though it is close to the road. I can't wait till we have to go back to stay there. Only draw back was the restaurant - not that good. Lovely hotel and the movie part was fun too.

author: MarthaAndMary
title: An unexpected pleasure!
text: The room was clean and very spacious. We were on the 2nd floor, but there were stairs every 10 rooms or so, so we could park very near the the steps we needed to take. Also, the steps were very wide, & a low height, so walking up them with suitcases was super-easy! We totally enjoyed our stay here! We booked the room just the day before, intending to go to the Great Sand Dunes National Park the next morning. It was a delightful surprise to find out we could see a movie from our hotel room. The room was much more spacious than most hotels with 2 queen beds, so there was plenty of room for me, my husband and our two teenaged daughters. The beds and pillows were excellent. We did not get a chance to visit the restaurant on the premises, but that is a very useful feature.

author: Jwanderer57
title: A fun place to stay
text: The reason we booked a room here was to take advantage of being able to watch a "drive-in" type movie from our hotel room. Unfortunately we did not realize that movies are only shown seasonally and since it was the middle of winter there were no movies showing. Despite this, the Movie Manor Motel was a fun place to stay with a "Bate's Motel" type feel to it (in a fun way rather than frightening). The room was clean and beds were comfortable. There was even a complimentary fly swatter left in one of the drawers (which luckily we did not need). The restaurant did not have a very wide selection so we ended up driving a mile or so to get some Chinese take out which was surprisingly good. Even though we did not get to enjoy a movie (and with no A/V jacks on the TV we could not play our own movie either), there was free wifi and cable television including HBO. Monte Vista is a very small town and after days of traveling we really appreciated the comfort and peacefulness of the Movie Manor Motel. I would stay here again if I am ever in the area.

author: nothometoday
title: just fine
text: This was our second stay in 4 months. Movie Manor is a good, basic, clean motel, and during drive-in movie season, it's fun to watch from your room. Not all rooms are at an angle to allow you to watch from your bed, but you can pull the armchairs up to the picture window. Things we like: cleanliness, the good luggage storage spot when you enter the room, the sink is separate from the shower and toilet, and the gorgeous view when you come out of your room in the morning and look across that open field to the moutains. Things that aren't perfect: tiny bathroom, (but his is an older vintage motel) and quite firm bed. The restaurant offers good basic fare, and the people are so nice. When we arrived late by towtruck in the rain last spring, they stayed open a bit late to see that we got fed a warm meal. Their breakfast burrito is wonderful!! Great green chili!

author: bcdewitt
title: This Pace is GREAT, FUN, and made for lovers
text: This is one of the best places that I have ever stayed. It is fun clean and the customer service is the best in Colorado. The Movie Manor is a one of a kind and not be missed by any tourist in Colorado. If you are looking to rebuild your love this is the place. You can watch the drive in from your room with excellent sound. This is a great place for your family or you and your partner. STAY HERE YOU WILL NEVER FORGET IT. The people are very friendly and this little town is great.

author: CowardlyLion
title: O.K., but a bit disappointed
text: We had high hopes for this motel, but it was a bit of a disappointment. The room itself was o.k., clean and quiet, but nothing special. The biggest disappointment was the movie itself (You, Me and Dupree), which was lousy and not exactly family friendly (and I'm no prude). The movie was of no interest to, and not appropriate for, our 5- and 7-year-old kids. Strangely, the beds face the wall rather than the screen, so you have to lie with your head at the foot of the bed in order to watch the movie. No big deal, but not really a common sense set-up. Nice exercise room, but again, all the equipment faces away from the movie screen. We had breakfast at the restaurant next door. The food was edible (barely), but the service was lousy.

author: ColinD184
title: BEWARE - company has gone bust
text: We were booked into a Scotia Grand Residence apartment for a two night stay to take part in the Edinburgh marathon (reserved through Hotels.com). Upon arrival at the Quartermile on the Saturday afternoon, the Scotia reception was locked up and empty. A representative from a nearby company informed us that the local franchise of Scotia Residences had gone in to liquidation. We called Scotia and were told that they would look in to the matter with someone from the Edinburgh franchise - but the call back was never received. We spent three hours of the Saturday afternoon on the phone to Hotels.com and dealt with the most incompetent call handlers who were unable to find us alternative accommodation. We eventually found ourselves a bed for the night and returned home early the next day. We are now trying to recoup our money from Hotels.com Scotia Residence are an absolute disgrace. We were informed that the local owner is Scott Coleman. He should be ashamed of himself. Stay well away from Scotia Residence - and indeed Hotels.com

author: Shab1000
title: DO NOT STAY AT THE Q-MILE THROUGH SCOTIA GRAND
text: I arrived with my young son at the apartment on two hours early on check-in day and was told there was water damage in one of the apartments but to come back 2 hours later and all should be fine. I received a phone call from someone in the office 10 min before check-in who informed me the damaged apartment was the actual one I was meant to be staying in and could I spend one night at the Mariott which I duly did as it was only meant to be for one night and was promised an apartment the following day. Scott Coleman the managing director of Scotia grand did not come and find me as promised - but instead I had to chase him on the Thursday as to what was going on - ideally I should have been in the apartment the day before but was told by Scott to wait another 15 minutes. 25 minutes later, I again with my young son went off to find him bearing in mind i had now checked out of the Mariott so had luggage with me only to be told by Scott that there was no apartment now and that could I stay at the Mariott Hotel instead - which was one room as opposed to staying in a one bedroom apartment! (not comparable in any way, shape or form) Scott informed me that there was nothing he could do and that was it - when i told him thats not good enough he walked away saying "well we can't resolve this so goodbye".....i actually asked him if he was fine walking away from someone who had booked and paid for an apartment and arrived from London with a child and his response in more or less words - yes! I found Scott incredibly aggressive and he came across as if he was doing me a favour by suggesting the Mariott hotel but after staying there the one night it was ok but certainly not worth the amount i had paid to book the whole apartment at the Q-mile as opposed to a room in the Mariott. Scott obviously has no care or concern regarding his paying customers - i understand water damage occurs without any prior warning but the way Scott handled the situation with me was unprofessional and horrendous. It partly ruined my stay in Edinburgh as finding something last minute with a child and luggage in tow not ideal.....had Scott been honest with me on the first day of check in, I could have had time to search for another apartment rather than stand outside trying to find somewhere else to stay. My booking was for wednesday 17th Feb but i noticed Scotia grand tooK payment out on the Sunday 14th Feb....(3 days earlier than check-in) and i'm still waiting on my refund! Having now looked other people's review regarding scotia grand/Q-mile, I have noticed that there have been a few other complaints about similar problems - whether it be water damage or fire damage.

author: jean706
title: made Edinburgh a breeze
text: All around great. Location is walking distance to Old Town even as a disable individual with a cane. Easy access to taxis and buses. Google maps are accurate as to which bus to catch. Quiet all night but city noises in the am as expected for a city. Good kitchen set up. Complete grocery store downstairs. Laundry is a bonus in the appt. TV difficult to figure out with no directions but not a deal breaker on a vacation.

author: M5777ETsharonm
title: Disgraceful
text: I'd booked an apartment for my friends birthday night out. On the morning of our trip we received an email saying that they were unable to honour the booking. When I called I was informed that a system error had resulted in significant over booking and that there was nothing they could do. They did however apologise. This was one of the busiest days in the city and it took me hours of stressful searching before I managed to get a cancellation at another hotel. It ruined the day and the gift. I find it bizarre that I then receive an email asking how my stay was. Not impressed.

author: mmww2015
title: Disappointing
text: Customer Service and attitude unbelievably poor. Booked 5 apartments 10 months prior to trip arrived to be told it was Booking.Com's fault that the accommodation I booked was not available. The management team could not find the payment I had made of nearly £3000.00 and told me I had not paid it at as payment collected on completion of stay. I had the payment details with me and was able to prove the payment had been made. I asked for apartments close to each other or at least in the same block this did not appear to be even acknowledge by Scotia Grand as a request. We were expected to pack and relocate on the last night of our stay and was offered accommodation for 8 of the guests in the party to an apartment with 4 bedrooms and a token gesture of reimbursing the payment for the last night. I will not be booking with Scotia Grand again. Very disappointing.

author: NPGL
title: Great apartment and location
text: We had a three bedroom apartment for a week and were travelling with three teenage children. Check in was outstanding, friendly and very informative (great to meet someone who knows his stuff). The apartment is very spacious, well appointed and very comfortable. Very clean and modern, doors could do with stays (but a minor niggle). The internet was fast, TV good with a great selection of channels. There is a supermarket downstairs, coffee and restaurants all within a few minutes walk and a short stroll into the old town. It really was the perfect spot for nearly a week in Edinburgh, great amenities and an excellent location. Strongly recommended.

author: H5712LRmarkm
title: Recent stay
text: I arrived early around 9.00am so no problems leaving my luggage there while I explored Edinburgh. The apartment was very clean and modern and had a great outlook over the park. Very close to cafes and grocery shopping at your door step. Access to the main attractions in and around the royal mile is only 10mins away. The main railway station at Waverley is about a 20min walk. The walk from the apartment to the top of Arthur's seat took about an hour and certainly worth the effort. From the top of Arthur's seat to the Royal Yacht took about an hour to walk via Royal Palace. Then the bus back to Waverley Station from the Royal Yacht took about 20mins. I would certainly stay there again.

author: TheWanderingEater
title: Perfect alternative to a hotel when you need space.
text: These apartments are simply great. They are perfectly clean, very well appointed with a full kitchen, washing/drying facilities and cable TV. The 3-bed apartment was very spacious with lovely rooms. There was one en-suite and one main bathroom. The open plan kitchen lounge area was very nice and very comfortable to spend time in. 3 of us went which normally means 3 hotel rooms. This place meant we were able to spend a bit more time together in a relaxing environment rather than setting meeting times in a hotel lobby. There's local shops if you want to stock up on food and drink, but Edinburgh is all about exploring and eating out.

author: 936gagans
title: Great Location. Nice apartment.
text: We were two families traveling together, had booked 2 bedroom Premium apartments Garden overview. But when we reached we got one Premium and one standard apartment that too were on the higher floor. Apart for this which was however not ethical or professional everything else in the apartment was excellent. Very near to all tourist places. Just 15-20 min walk to the castle & St. Gilts Church. Supermarket was in the GF of the apartment block itself. Very convenient. Just 2 min walk away from the city park.

author: 117val
title: excellent choice
text: I stayed in this hotel with two friends for a night. It is actually a proper flat with two big bedrooms and a big living room with a fully equipped kitchen and a great view at the park. Very clean, comfortable, value for money, in a great neighborhood only a few minutes walking from old town and Royal mile. I enjoyed my stay a lot, I wish I could stay more. I strongly recommend it for couples and families. The staff was also very friendly. They gave us a city map and explained us the surroundings. Great choice!!!!!!

author: NicheRay
title: Fabulous apartment - exceeded our expectations!
text: We booked the apartment at fairly short notice as our regional rugby team Newport Gwent Dragons in South Wales had been drawn against Edinburgh in the European Cup semi-final. Now this is beyond our normal standard of rugby and therefore worthy of travelling to Scotland to watch them! We also decided to make a weekend of it and visit the sights of Edinburgh My wife and I together with our adult son wanted to make the trip so 2 hotel rooms were quite expensive and not ideal for the 3 of us to spend time together for the weekend. An apartment seemed an ideal solution We wanted something close to the city and tourist attractions but not in the middle of it and therefore, noisy. The apartment was ideally placed a short walk to the Royal Mile and the Castle. When we walked into the apartment we were blown away! It was huge, immaculately decorated and furnished and fabulous views over the park though the floor to ceiling and wall to wall window. Beds were comfortable, showers were powerful and spacious, kitchen was modern, clean and stylish. It was good to pop to the Sainsbury's a short walk away, buy some fresh fruit etc for breakfast and return to eat it in the 'luxury apartment' The wifi was very good, a speed test on my iphone was downloading just under 20meg Overall, if we need to return to Edinburgh, we would not hesitate to book the Scotia Grand again The only downside of the weekend - our rugby side lost :( Good luck to Edinburgh in the final :)

author: bbt16
title: 1 Night stay
text: Check in was easy and theres no trouble at all. We also booked parking space which was £10 per car. We booked a 3 bedroom apartment. It was very large and spacious and well equipped, good for group of friends or family since you'll be spending most of the time in the lounge. Also convienently located next to starbucks and sainsbury which we made good use of. Check out was also a breeze. I happen to forgot my iphone charger in the apartment and only realized after we've left. After a couple of emails the owner, very kindly, sent the charger in the post back to my address in the UK free of charge. I would highly recommend this place because of its good service, room, location and value for money especially if you're traveling in a group of 6 like me.

author: danielsE7600PB
title: Stay away from this place
text: We planned a stay for 3 nights and chose this place due to the kitchenette and the location. The kitchenettes refrigerator did not close due to a big chunk of ice blocking the door. I had to chip the ice off to get the door to close but it never quite worked. I didn't have time to defrost the fridge. The beds were the worst I had ever slept on. I travel a lot and have to say that the beds were not real beds but more like roll aways. Also, parking is not included with the stay so you will have to pay for that separately. When I confronted the managing office about the fridge, they said they would discount my bill by 25% since I was checking out early. When I did settle my bill on checkout, they changed their mind and said I would be charged the full three night rate instead of the two nights with the 25% off that they had promised. They are very dishonest and I will never stay here ever again and I strongly suggest passing on this property if you're considering it.

author: Pastis2000
title: Great apartment in very nice area close to the city
text: Modern and well equipped apartment with two bathrooms and two bedrooms. High standard and very modern. Super good wifi connection. Clean and tidy. We had everything we needed in the very modern kitchen. Very nice situated near the University with trendy cafés and grocery store nearby. Within walking distance to the city. Extremly helpfull staff! I would absolutly stay here again!

author: 389kellyo
title: Great location, lots of room
text: The staff could not have been more friendly. Rooms are spacious, clean and modern. Has everything you need. We just had to go downstairs to the grocery or Starbucks. Great park close with playgrounds (3) and a nice place to run. Easy to walk to the sites around. It's only downside was the quality of beds and pillows. They were not very comfortable, skimped a bit on the quality. Surprised us as everything else is spot on.

author: emmad491
title: Fantastic Stay
text: Having stayed in Edinburgh before we wanted somewhere close to everywhere. This place was perfect! Quiet area but lots of places to eat right beside us cafes, restaurants and a small Sainsbury shop close by. A gorgeous park was located just behind us. A ten minute walk to princes street and not to far from the castle. The apartment itself was immaculate. Fantastic value for money and the staff were lovely and friendly. Would highly recommend a stay here and we would definitely stay here again if we returned to Edinburgh.

author: acjbutler
title: Really good stay - definitely coming back
text: The flats are ideally situated near the city centre, in a nice quire area with lovely views. On the ground floor there is a mini Sainsbury's supermarket, which made it very easy for popping out to get milk, bread etc. When we arrived one of the staff was there to greet us and guide us into the underground parking (£10 for the night) and she was very friendly, helpful and keen to ensure that we had everything we needed. Excellent customer service. The apartment is modern, spacious and and a delight to stay in. It was beautifully clean with anything you may need to use conveniently provided. We arrived in the evening, so the situation was ideal for finding a restaurant as there are loads nearby. Although this was a one night business trip we definitely plan to come back for a couples break later in the year.

author: Bassiaa
title: Excellent! Great location, great quality, great service!
text: The title sums it up. Our stay was nothing but fantastic. The flat was very spacious, modern, good quality items, well equipped, bright, comfortable. And the view... So wonderful. The entire wall was a window into the park - quiet, green, peaceful. The customer service was excellent, they made sure we got all information about the flat and were eager to give their recommendations regarding the city. I can't recommend it enough!

author: hayley820406
title: comfortable stay
text: I stayed here as it was attractive to me due to available parking. It took 10 minutes to walk to royal mile. The location is on the Opposite side of railway to prince's street so takes about 15 to 20 minutes to walk there for the main shopping. Area good for sightseeing and close to the older side edinburgh close to university campus. Small sainsburys below so all amenities on hand if you want to cook rather than eat out. Apartment good size, beds comfortable and available washer/dryer. Booked a one bed and when got there we ended up in a two bedroom, decent size bathroom only problem was shower didn't drain away quick enough and first shower ended up nearly flooding bathroom. So rest had to be done in stages and keep knocking shower off to let water drain away before finishing off. Confusion also with car parking when left Ignore the instructions in the room as you need the pass to get out of car park and you need to take keys back to the office and not leave in the apartment as stated. Overall was enjoyable and would stay in these apartments again if visited Edinburgh again.

author: hnoramczyk
title: Beautiful and comfortable space
text: Three of us chose to stay overnight in Edinburgh in an apartment as it was cheaper then renting two rooms at a B&B. Scotia Grand Residence is in a great location - it sits along the meadows, is very close to the University, and is about a 15 minute walk from Waverley train station. The apartment was quiet, clean, comfortable, and warm (a very good thing in January!). The showers were wonderful and the building was quiet and secure. Bedding was a bit tough but it all depends on what works best for you. It can be a bit tricky to find on foot (and google wasn't terribly helpful) but the staff sent out directions before our arrival that were very useful. The black cabs knew exactly where we were staying so getting back at the end of the night was simple. We wished we could have stayed longer!

author: Scenic804548
title: Feels like home
text: It is really a big great apartment with an excellent location within walking distance of Royal Mile. Staffs are friendly and facilities are excellent. Cooking accommodation at it's best and reasonably priced. Lots of restaurants around, as well as a supermarket and a starbucks. Very convenient for whatever you want. I am a single visitor and I really hope to come back again with more friends. That would be better to stay together in an modern apartment like here! PS: It is a little bit hard to find where the apartment is, especially when the weather is raining and windy at night... So if you can make some instructions more clearly towards the main street that would be better. I can't find it when I arrived so I call the reception and then the staff come to lead me and show me my apartment, he is very nice and helpful.

author: LJaneSingita
title: Great place for Xmas break
text: We were upgraded from a two bedroom to a four bedroom penthouse which was fabulous. The flat was very modern, spacious and well equipped. Superfast wifi was great and was included in the price. The master bathroom was very large and well appointed. The staff were very welcoming and helpful. The underground car park was very convenient. There's a Sainsburys Local, Starbucks, Peter's Yard (bakery/deli), restaurants and two gyms all within a couple of minutes walk. Why would you stay in a hotel when you can stay in an apartment like this? We've already booked our next stay.

author: W1228XUkarenb
title: Won't bother going again until the building work is done!
text: We stayed in a smaller flat last year - but because it was very nice and the location was good - we decided to book a luxury flat this time. What a waste of money. Out entire view was the building yard which our first floor flat looked directly into - and all the workers could equally look straight into the flat - all only a pavement width away from us. It was like staying in a gold fish bowl. We were woken early with the truck movement and flashing lights. Flat was a bit bigger but very basic. The shower was covered with mildew - despite it being so new. Hallway paint work was scaffed and dirty. I won't be going again until the building work is finished - very dissappointing

author: Tripper1984
title: Super Apartment
text: Stayed for 3 nights in a deluxe one bed apartment.Block 18 apartment 16 which doesn't overlook the park (I knew this prior to arrival) but had an open view over the old hospital site currently under construction. It was nevertheless quiet. Communication with staff during booking, on arrival, departure, and during our stay was great. All staff were friendly and helpful. The directions we received prior to our arrival enabled us to find the residence with ease after our walk from the station. Our apartment was bright, spacious and clean and had everything we needed for our stay. We didn't cook during our stay but the local sainsburys provided for all our nibbles, drinks etc. It's location was fine for all the sights and we were fortunate in that the weather was exceptionally mild for November with only a few specs of rain. Similarly the huge choice of restaurants were close to hand. I have no hesitation in recommending this accommodation( rebranded this week as Scotia Grand Residence)

author: aliciao253
title: Amazing
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed here for one night and we found it amazing. We were given one of the newest ones (Ikea furniture unassembled in a cupboard), and it was just the house I would like to be able to buy some time soon. Everything was clean, no noises from the outside, the windows were huge and amazing but could be covered at night. The bed was very comfortable (I hit the board at its feet every time I passed by), and the bedroom smelled of lavender, very relaxing. The heating was on and the whole house very warm. The bathroom is small but good and modern, with a wide head shower. We didn't use the kitchen but found it very complete, set of tea and coffee was enough for us and the furniture and appliances better than at my own home. Big living room with a comfy sofa and we didn't use the TV but there was one. I would definitely recommend it.

author: IbizaChick
title: Great Location
text: We stayed for two nights in a one bed apartment. Our room was on the fourth floor but you could see into the apartments across the way and had a lovely wake up call thanks to the loading bay for Sainsbury's being directly below! However, due to sun going down early, we wanted to make the most of the sunlight. The apartment was clean though and was much better than ones we have stayed in previously. The guy took us to the apartment, showed us how everything worked, pointed out where we were on the map and answered any questions. I can't fault the location. It is about a 5/10 minute walk to the Royal Mile, with loads of cafes and restaurants on the way (including The Elephant House where JK started Harry Potter). We ate at the Italian (Vittoria) recommened by the apartments one night which was on the way back and it was delicious, you even get 15% off with your key token. I'd stay here again but ask for an apartment away from the loading bay!

author: NOMAD070
title: Not as good as expected. Dirty
text: We arrived in the evening to find our apartment sink was not very clean. The stove had black marks all over it and the bathroom was not very clean. The shower area and the commode were dirty. We complained and were shown another room which was dirty as well. We were NOT happy to pay close to 100 GBP to stay in a dirty place. We could have easily stayed in a clean B&B for a much lesser price. The staff were OK. It was the most expensive place we stayed in during our holiday to Scotland and it did not provide us value for money... Very disappointing.

author: 449sandir
title: Excellent location, wonderful apartment
text: We loved this apartment. The location was absolutely fantastic, about a 10 minute walk to the Royal Mile and 15 minutes to the train station. It is right next to a park with multiple kid's playgrounds and there is a Sainsbury's grocery store and Starbucks just below the apartment. The apartment itself was very new-looking, clean, well-equipped, and very spacious for a city apartment. The staff was friendly and helpful. The downside of having Sainsbury's downstairs was that the deliveries started promptly at 7:00 AM. They weren't too loud, but it was enough to wake up our light-sleeping toddler. Also, the apartment has beautiful floor-to-ceiling windows with built-in shades. Unfortunately the shades don't block out all of the morning light and there is no way to hang a blanket or sheet to block out additional light. Overall we really enjoyed this apartment and would recommend to anyone,

author: Peej23
title: Convenient and comfortable
text: Thistle Apartments are very centrally located within walking distance of many attractions. There is underground parking but it costs £10 per day. The apartment was a good size though not a lot of room in the bedroom. The living area is very attractive with a good, well-equipped kitchen. the bathroom is nice but lacking a decent light for the mirror. Good shower though. Floor to ceiling windows throughout (frosted glass beside the bed) but these look directly into the apartments opposite. There are slatted blinds for privacy. Reception is not open all the time and the apartments are a little remote from it but this was not a problem. We would definitely stay here again.

author: LeeanneJWallace
title: Thistle residence. Great location!!
text: We really enjoyed our stay. Clean. New. Great location. Walking distance to the old town. Handy shops near by too. Sainsbury delivery trucks were a bit noisy early in the morning but apart from that everything about Thistle was terrific. Staff were really helpful too. Would highly recommend.

author: HBM_26
title: Great choice for The Fringe
text: We rented a two bed apartment to share with another couple and it was a perfect base for the Fringe Festival. It's close walking distance to major venues across the City. Apartments have all you need and are surprisingly spacious. Sainsburys Local and Starbucks downstairs. The only downsides are that it can be a bit noisy outside if you sleep with windows open but that's just life in the City. Also, there was only one shared bathroom with toilet. We made it work for two couples. Friendly greeting on arrival from Scot at Thistle Apartments. Recommended.

author: Simylou
title: Luxury!
text: Loved this place! Abs loved the glass windows on one wall of the living room - divine! Very luxurious and clean. Great access to virgin TV and wifi. Great location! Handy Sainsburys round the corner with great access to Royal Mile and the festival tents. Would suit all types of guests no matter what type of holiday you are looking for. Would stay here again!

author: Virginian18
title: Excellent, large apartments
text: We stayed a few nights as a base for visiting Edinburgh and going to Glasgow for the Commonwealth Games. Location was excellent for both - Waverley Station is only 5 minutes (uphill) walk. There are good Starbucks and Sainsbury's on the ground floor (Peter's Yard cafe is pleasant but expensive). Our apartment had a large living room/kitchen, three comfortable bedrooms and modern bathrooms. All very clean. Good Virgin Media TV. My only reservation is over some noise from the street - actually not a road but a pleasant walkway (other apartments may face onto quieter courtyards); and the curtains were very far from blackout. So if a long and uninterrupted sleep is a requirement, ask for an apartment not facing onto Meadow Walk.

author: tuna13
title: Great Apartments!
text: We stayed in three types of apartments as we were a family of 10 people. The two apartments had awesome views of the park and the cliff. But all were in good condition and spacious. The only thing is we were expecting serviced apartments but during our 3 day stay we didn't receive any service or towel change. The location is walking distance to Grassmarket and Castle and to many good restaurants. There was a Sainsbury and Starbucks under the apartments making life easier. The management arranged a private car and driver/ guide for ten of us upon our request and that was great. Our guide/ driver, Andy, was great, nice and easy going and became friends with our young members.

author: AveburyBlue
title: Good Location
text: I stay in Edinburgh on a regular basis and this is the first time I have stayed at these apartments. It is in a good central but quiet location on the site of the old hospital. Some of the apartments are in the original building but I stayed in a new block. There is no check in facility after 7pm but they did arrange for a driver to meet us at the airport with the room keys. The apartments are compact but have all the facilities you need. The wi-fi is free and easy to access. There is no fan in the bathroom which has no window which is odd and the apartment was looking a little worn & tired. I would use again if the price was right. Good places for breakfast close by.

author: 975tatianas
title: Nice apartment in a nice location.
text: Everything was nice. Good very central location. Nice big apartment. The only negative experience was broken bed. My husband was forced to fix it in the middle of the night. And microwave did not work. But we were not too suffered fro that. Stuff was very helpful.

author: rajparam
title: great location, spacious apartments
text: we stayed in a 1 bedroom apartment at thistle residence for 4 days in May. The apartments are very spacious, modern and well equipped. The location is excellent, a Sainsbury's, Starbucks are just 5 minutes walk. The Meadows, a lovely park, is right behind the property. The apartments are located in Old Town, which is undergoing a bit of a face-lift, and the new modern buildings look lovely against the backdrop of the older buildings. The bed was only a double and not big enough for 2 adults and a young child, so staff was very good to provide a new twin bed in addition. The kitchen is well equipped, had no trouble with any of the appliances. Highly recommend this place, especially for families. Its a very safe neighbourhood. Lots of young families living in the apartment buildings.

author: 673roset
title: Thistle Quartermile Apartments Review Rose & Barbara
text: We found the Quartermile Apartments modern, light, well equipped and spacious. They had a Sainsbury Express right next door which was really convenient and several coffee shops. The staff in the office were friendly, welcoming and helpful. Only a short walk from the apartment and there were shops,pubs and restaurants. The only downside was the side on the bathtub was high and wide. This made it a bit difficult to get in and out of the bath/shower. We had a two bedroom apartment with two bathrooms. It would have been better for less agile people if one bathroom had a walk in shower, I would stay there again.

author: 98199cf
title: Very modern & spacious, great location
text: 6 adults (all family) stayed in a spacious 3 bedroom, 2 bath apartment at the end of a 10 day visit to Scotland. It was nice to have a common area (living room, dining room, kitchen) to sit down at the end of the day and talk about our Edinburgh experience. However, the constantly slamming doors (bedroom, bath, closet, hallway) in the apartment were very annoying. It was obviously a problem for other travelers staying here, as most doors had a rubber doorstop to prop the door open. The shower/bathtub was so tall that it presented a real challenge getting in & out of the tub (again, obviously a problem for others as there was a very insecure suction hand rail to use). Great location, easy walk to most sights, although difficult to find when first arriving in the city. The staff was very helpful, and we were able to leave our luggage at the reception office for awhile after checkout (especially helpful since checkout is at 10am). On the surface, appears clean, but caulk in baths is already discolored and walls, doors, light switches look grimy, making this apartment appear to be much older than it is. And the 3 pieces of "putty-like" substance (gum???) over one doorway did not enhance the overall appearance/impression of the apartment.

author: kakijalan
title: Excellent base for a wonderful city
text: I was traveling with my parents and sister. Getting an apartment makes more sense than getting rooms as we could do our own cooking and laundry. The apartment is just 8-10 minutes walk to the Royal Mile, next to the Edinburgh University. Very well equipped, with all the comforts of home. Our apartment was a duplex (kitchen & dining upstairs) with 2 bathrooms, which was very handy when getting ready in the morning. Quiet area with several restaurants and cafe in the area. There's a supermarket in the nearby building to get all the items we needed. Finding the office was not very easy, so make sure you get the directions from them before arriving. Staff was very helpful and friendly. Parking also available upon request (GBP10 per night).

author: 359adrianr
title: Excellent apartment, very friendly welcome
text: I stayed at the Thistle Residence (Quartermile Apartments) for one night on business. Firstly, I'd say that the reception staff were extremely helpful. I needed to check in late, and they arranged for someone to meet me on arrival. I had a 1 bedroom apartment that was spacious, modern and had excellent facilities. There was a TV with cable (Virgin Media, I think, although I didn't use it), and there was fast free WiFi. The apartment had a cooker, toaster, microwave etc etc which was extremely handy. There was a separate bedroom, and also a small desk area where you could work. The location is perfect, very central. I would have no hesitation in recommending Thistle Residence, and I will stay there again next time I am in Edinburgh.

author: jjjjtravels
title: Great in every way!
text: We stayed in a Deluxe 2 Bedroom apartment for a weekend with our kids ages 5 and 2.5. It was great. The apartment was spacious and spotless on our arrival. The location was great, walking distance to so many things. There was a Sainsbury's right by the building which was useful for picking up snacks and breakfast items. We found the management to be super helpful. They even helped to arrange an airport transfer for us, with car seats for the kids, which was terrific. We wouldn't hesistate to stay here again on future visits. Hopefully our next visit will be in warmer weather!

author: elektraomara1979
title: Outstanding in every way!
text: I was wowed by this apartment! It was cosy and inviting, It felf like home. It also had the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. If you stay in Edinburgh then you must stay here. it is also in tbe heart of Edinburgh with free parking (thanks to Thistle) right opposite the apartment. service was warm and friendly also. Excellent all round. Many thanks and I will see you again soon. X

author: MJBHdG
title: Beautiful deluxe apartment
text: Spent 4 nights (mid-week) in a deluxe apartment (Simpsons Loan no. 18, flat 16, 4th floor) at Thistle Residence. A very convenient location for walking into the centre of Edinburgh (or take buses 23 or 27). After 2 nights the apartment was cleaned and towels replaced. Pleasant management in nearby office, where, on our last day before flying back home, we could leave our suitcase (bus 35 to & from airport stops very close). Heated towel rail and underfloor heating in luxury bathroom. Even a washing machine present. Fitted sheets, better mattress and separate duvets would make this apartment perfect.

author: mikewardontv
title: A wonderful stay in a great location
text: It's not always easy to find a place to stay in a major city that's both conveniently located and peaceful. The Thistle Residence, however, ticks both those boxes – within easy walking distance of all the main attractions, and yet located in quiet and attractive surroundings. The facilities within my apartment were first class. The place itself was light, airy and spacious. Unlike a lot of apartments I've stayed in, it was also fantastically well equipped. The guys overseeing the place, Scott and Craig, couldn't have been more accommodating and friendly. Any problems were minor and quickly rectified. All in all, I can't recommend it highly enough.

author: PhilApperley
title: Stunning location and apartment
text: We were upgraded to a 2 bed deluxe apartment on arrival and as others have said, it was immaculate. Very high spec throughout. Location was perfect and our bedroom view looked out onto Arthur's Seat. Area was full of top restaurants and lovely cafés. It took a 5 mins walk to get to the National Museum and 10mins to the Royal Mile. Our only problem was, although shown, we couldn't quite work the heating properly until the second night. However once sorted all was perfect. Staff couldn't do more to help and were extremely friendly with great knowledge of the city. I would definitely stay here again.

author: jayrea
title: First time booking apartments but not my last
text: Me and my girlfriend spent a few nights here. I have to say it was a great place. The apartment was so clean and had everything you needed and fast wifi and digital tv. Really was like a home away from home. The staff were all very helpful and very pleasant and location wise it was great. About 10 mins to the castle and 15 mins to the city centre all by foot. There is a Starbucks downstairs but we loved the coffee shop/bakery on the corner called "peters yard" it had an open bakery that you could see into and was very nice. And next to that was a sainsbury's with all the essentials. I would defiantly stay here again.

author: jessmct
title: Girls weekend away
text: We stayed in late January - although the weather wasn't anything to go by the great quality apartment was. A spacious 2 bedroom apartment with open plan lounge and kitchen area. Bathroom with bath and separate walk-in shower gave us plenty of space for the whole weekend. The bedrooms themselves were a good size (pretty sure they were king size beds), walk-in wardrobe in the larger room and plenty of mirrors and lights for the girls to get ready. We made use of the heating due to the cold weather and there was even extra blankets on the beds. Scott and Craig from Thistle Residence were extremely helpful in directing us to the apartment and helping us out with parking. We were in a great location in The Old Town with a 5 minute walk to the nearest pub. I recommend the Italian Divino restaurant, it was amazing food and the service was great. Pretty, idyllic settings and so much to do in the area. Handy supermarket and coffee shop right on the doorstep we shall definitely be back.

author: sally_stanwell
title: Great location and customer service
text: Between Greyfriars Bobby and the Meadows, few minutes walk to National Museum of Scotland. There's scandinavian bakery/coffee shop, Starbuck, local supermarket on ground floor, bookshop with coffee round the corner. The number 35 bus from airport to Holyrood/Ocean Terminal runs right past the door (hour to airport round the houses though). No heating or hot water on arrival. Staff turned up promptly, couldn't fix, but kept us informed, sorted out alternative apartment, bigger than one we booked with views to Arthur's seat. But original though smaller would still have been fine for four of us. We would go again but probably would try and get apartment with separate shower rather than over bath - latter v high/wide tiled edge - hard work if you have short legs or are a bit creaky. We were able to arrange a 11 am checkout too

author: gillianm110
title: Absolutely Perfect
text: We rented a family apartment. It was quite luxurious. There were two rooms, two bathrooms, a living room, kitchen and dining room. It was clean and modern and very comfortable. It is a 10 minute walk from the city with many restaurants and a supermarket nearby. Great Wifi! The manager was very accessible and accommodating. You won't be disappointed!

author: CherylS541
title: Staying at the Thistle Residence was a great choice!!!
text: I visited Edinburgh for the first time in mid-to-late June with my family (husband and two kids) and a friend who decided to join us. We rented one of your two-bedroom apartments and we were really very pleased with our choice. The tasteful decor and cleanliness of the apartment were excellent. There was plenty of room for all of us without feeling crowded, and having a laundry machine in the apartment was a gift! The apartment's location was very convenient. Everything we wanted to see in the city was an easy walk, and it was only a short cab ride from Waverley Train Station. Having the Sainsbury market, the bakery, and the Starbucks right downstairs made our stay (with kids) very, very easy! The staff members we met were extremely prompt, courteous, and helpful. We will, without a doubt, be back. We can't thank you enough for adding to our fabulous experience in your truly magical city...

author: TheExpensiveFailure
title: Brilliant short stay apartment!
text: We stayed here for two nights in June and loved the apartment, which was recently refurbished. The rooms were clean and tastefully decorated with full length windows offering views of Arthur's Seat! The location of the apartment was also fantastic, with a Sainsburys just round the corner. It's within walking distance to Edinburgh Castle but also well serviced by buses and a taxi rank within 2 mins' walk. Scott was responsive with our queries beforehand and also met us on the day of check-in. Very approachable and helpful. He also dropped us an email the morning after our first night to check we were doing alright, which is a nice touch. Would be more than happy to stay here again and would strongly recommend it to others. (not sure if this is typical in apartments, but perhaps it would be good to have some basics provisions in the kitchen like oil, salt, foil and cling film etc. We left ours there when we left)

author: BlackCumin
title: Faultless
text: A big thumbs up here. Highly recommended. The apartment is in a great location in the heart of Quartermile, near The Meadows and the City. On the doorstep, there is a coffee shop and a Sainsbury. The apartment felt secure, was modern and well furnished and was spotlessly clean. I was met on time and effortlessly given keys for the apartment along with parking and access instructions. This was a bang-on, faultless experience. Well done!

author: bristow78
title: One night stay, perfecto!
text: I stayed for one night, but it was a lovely experience. The room was a one bed king studio with a little kitchen, desk area, fridge, flat screen, couch, full sized shower, nice sized closet and two large windows. If I had to stay longer, it would've been a home away from home. The room was clean, quiet and the bed was super comfortable. The staff checking me in and out were very sweet and helpful. The breakfast was very delicious. The holiday decor, fireplace roaring and comfortable and clean eating area was a welcome to the morning. I highly recommend this hotel for a weekend, or even staying for a week if you are in town for business. The mall is right across the street and HUGE! I would not bring your credit card :0)

author: ericaa845
title: Dirty
text: My family and I have stayed at this Hyatt location 5 times in the past and unfortunately, we will not be going back. Upon arrival, the lobby and front desk was dirty. It appeared as the floor had not been cleaned for a while nor had the countertops been wiped down at the front desk. Once getting to the elevators we realized they were not working, the front desk did not inform us of the issue nor did they show us where the stairs could be located. Once, getting to the room there were red stains on the comforter and stains on the sheets. We asked the front desk for new bedding and they brought us a comforter and it was even worse condition than the first one. My husband and I went to the front desk to cancel the reservation and even though they canceled with no issues, we noticed another gentleman was also asking for a room change and someone else was complaining about the elevator. Extremely disappointed with the conditions of this Hyatt and will not be going back!

author: krismcg9
title: Another delightful stay at a Hyatt House!
text: I had points I had to use or lose, so I booked myself an evening away. Everything was quite lovely - the room was quiet and clean and the bed well made - plenty of towels and a HUGE bathroom. Nice little fridge & microwave - giant TV. I love the electronic check in process from my cell phone - all I had to do was run in and pick up the key! Free breakfast in the AM - tastey and something for everyone (although I was wishing for waffels, but pancakes are a good second!!). In love with the 12pm check out time!!!!! Really helps not having to rush to get out of the room and the housekeeping staff wasn't banging on the door, which was a plus! Another excellent experience! Thank you everyone for a lovely stay!

author: Daydream41556406986
title: Best Hotel Stay in AWHILE!
text: The Hyatt House in King of Prussia is second to none! After one night in the worst hotel I have ever stayed in (Hilton Double Tree-King of Prussia PA), I was in a pinch for a quick switch, for the duration of my work training. I was so pleased to find my new favorite KOP hotel, the Hyatt House. The staff is so friendly, the rooms are MASSIVE and spotless (the beds are so comfy), the bar/restaurant serves great food and drinks and has an amazing staff (Dina and Chad). I cannot say enough good things about this hotel. LASTLY, the breakfast is complimentary with an omelette station and the widest variety of breads, fruits, yogurts, etc. that I have ever seen any complimentary breakfast contain! The proximity to the KOP Mall and outside restaurants is fabulous + you are just about 20 miles from the city!

author: julielO8491AM
title: A new year for Squash trips
text: In town for a Squash Tourney. Overall our stay was comfortable & easy. The 2 queen delux suite was spacious for 3 people. The beds were comfortable. The full kitchen was a nice compliment to store beverages, etc. The gym was well equipped & a good size. The omelette station was an added feature to the standard breakfast Buffett. The full bar was convenient as well. The location was perfect for visiting the mall and resturant nearby.

author: wbtjoe
title: Good with some disadvantages for busiioness travel
text: So yes, overall a good hotel and I paid a fair price. Clean, good service, friendly bar tender and receptionist. The disadvantages: no safety deposit in the room - take your valuables with you our deposit at the front desk. Room is nice, but airco/heating is loud at night and starts every ten mins. Mayb this is standard in the US, but in case you come from other parts off the world it is taking away your sleep. Breakfast is ok, - little buffet and sometimes they prepare an omelette based on what you like - but nothing really exciting and usually a bit filthy. They never really started at 6.30, come 6.45 a.m. and all is set.

author: thexplodingboy
title: Probably the Best in the Area
text: I have travel to the King of Prussia / Wayne area frequently for work, so I’ve tried all the options. This property is easily one of the best. Large clean rooms. Friendly staff. Very efficient checkin. Great location across from the mall. Countless restaurants within easy walking distance. A great choice.

author: Lisa46920
title: Not so clean or pleasant
text: We stayed for one night at Hyatt House. Our stay was very unpleasant. We often stay at Hyatt Hotels and are holders of Gold Passport. Sink in room did not drain correctly and maintenance needed to be called. They did respond, however sink had an unpleasant smell. When the room key stopped working after a few hours ( and was in a separate place in my purse) I had to walk back down to the desk to have it reset. The host at the desk was matter of fact that this is “ not a problem and happens all the time.” She was unapologetic...frankly, in this day and age when everyone carries cell phones, a system that doesn’t work and continually inconveniences guests should be addressed. Would NEVER stay at this Hyatt again.Overall, very dissatisfied.

author: 82SteveS
title: Wonderful accommodations!
text: I stayed at this location for 3 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it! From the time I walked in, the staff was friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and the bed comfortable and shower flow was strong. The room was quiet even though I know there were neighbors as I saw them in the hall as I was coming and going. The bar was comfortable and bartender friendly the one night I made it to the bar. The breakfast was plentiful and good choices. I especially liked the make to order omelet. All in all excellent visit. Would stay again! Thanks!

author: amykH9202NR
title: Thank you for making things right
