text: We received last minute call from hotel saying they could not accommodate our reservation due to a lightening strike resulting in no AC. They were transferring us to a hotel in Malvern I had never heard of. I was upset because I am not from the area and had no idea where Malvern was or what kind of hotel they were offering. We were taking our daughter to college to start villanova and got the call right as we pulled onto the campus so I didn’t have much time to argue. As it turns out, we had a wonderful experience and management at Hyatt house did everything right to fix the situation. They transferred us to a beautiful, clean, safe hotel called the Desmond Inn by Doubletree and covered the charge for the room, taxes and a lovely full service breakfast. There was no hassle, no explaining and no confusion. We gave our name at the desk and it was all taken care of. Thank you for doing the right thing Hyatt!

author: 419samanthan
title: My Home Away From Home
text: Always a great stay, whether business or personal travel. Super convenient location, great gym, good breakfast buffet and food/service. I will say however.... whenever I’ve requested late check-out, that message never seems to reach the housekeeping staff. I’m ALWAYS interrupted, which totally defeats the purpose of late check-out. Please... please, for the love of all frequent business travelers such as myself - find a better system to communicate with your housekeeping staff so that this stops happening. Apart from that... see you guys soon! (:

author: raeza
title: Perfect Stay
text: Was in town for 4 nights for my sister's wedding. Travelling with my father, mother, sister and nephew. We booked two Studio (King Bed) Rooms and used the sofa beds to accommodate everyone. The rooms were clean and well equipped. The main beds were very, very comfortable, but the sofa beds were quite soft (best for kids only). The A/C units were a bit noisy, but the white noise actually helps put you to bed! The staff were excellent, and the breakfast was perfect. Ample parking spaced was a bonus. The hotel was clearly busy, but never felt too crowded. All in all, a good experience.

author: Saminusa_12
title: Great Bang for your Buck
text: We stayed at the Hyatt House as we were attending a graduation at Villanova University. The hotel is very nicely decorated throughout. All staff were friendly and accommodating. The room was clean and spacious with a kitchenette and a full size refrigerator. Shower was a good size and there were plenty of towels and washcloths. Toiletries were small but not an issue as I always travel with my own. I'm sure they would have brought more if requested. The free breakfast was plentiful and also featured an omelet station. The bar area is nice although the bar is only open in the evenings and closes at 10pm We usually stay at Marriot properties but was impressed with this Hyatt and would stay here again. We definitely got more bang for our buck!!

author: basketgala
title: Highly recommend
text: First time staying at a Hyatt House and was pleasantly surprised. Rooms were clean. The king bed suite with mini kitchen was a great size. Granite countertops and a full sized fridge too. Breakfast buffet was well stocked and had an omelette made to order station. Beds were comfortable. Hotel is close to the mall and lots of restaurants. Would stay here again.

author: MakebaH
title: Great Stay at king of of Prussia
text: Great stay! Friendly staff. Clean rooms. Great lounge area. Planned a mall trip for my daughters 14 Birthday, we stayed at the Hyatt house for 2 nights. It was close to the mall and the casino. Perfect location and clean pretty hotel. I’d definitely stay there again next time

author: CHERYL04248
title: Fantastic Family Getaway!
text: My family spent 2 nights here just enjoying being together for Christmas. The proximity to everything is unbeatable. Shopping, dining choices are endless. The rooms are large and well appointed. Beds are very comfortable also. Complimentary full breakfast was always delicious with lots of choices. Everyone I encountered on the staff was very nice and always helpful. I especially liked talking with Valerie at the front desk. We have stayed at this hotel before and look forward to again in the future!

author: /undefined
title: Hyatt and its Staff at K of P
text: THE HOTEL INDUSTRY IS ALL ABOUT SERVICE! THE HOTEL (5 Star) & GROUNDS - A Great Hotel in a Great regional location - It is Very Clean, nicely furnished and sensitively decorated. It is a great contemporary Architectural design. The spaces are well planned and very functional. STAFF - The staff is very Loud, lazy, impersonal, poorly trained, and needs serious refinement while dealing with and serving the public. (ex. when a guest's personal egg-order at breakfast is ready, the cook (chef?) shouldn't yell out the customer's name across the room for a pick-up as if you are in a take-out-order-sub-shop.) He needs to be less lazy (especially when he is not busy) and should bring (serve) the order to the guest. This is all about service and it will usually provide a good tip. FOOD & DRINK DEPARTMENTS - Great quality and variety!

author: DnagsCrew
title: Great Place to Stay in King of Prussia
text: The Hyatt House is a tremendous place to get away for a long weekend. The hotel is located directly across the street from the King of Prussia Mall and allows for your shopping needs. The hotel has a nice pool and hot tub area with spaceous rooms. The friendly staff, Baye at check-in and Deanna at check-out answered all our questions and were very helpful. The morning breakfast with an omelet bar is first rate and starts the day right. As I stated the room was spaceous with a couch, comfort chair, and two queen size beds. The full size refrigerator and kitchen area made life real easy. The room was extremely clean and well kept which is a big factor in our choices. The mall and surrounding area have many choices of resturants that start at casual to elegant. Enjoy the Getaway!

author: /undefined
title: Yep I would stay here again
text: A modern, clean hotel with the convenience of pet friendliness, spacious rooms and in-room kitchenette. I struggle with the air conditioner / temperature control and it is really very loud. If you are a light sleeper, prepare to be awake all night. There is no hotel kitchen since the room offers everything for you to be able to prepare meals for yourself - fridge, microwave, stovetop and the mall located across the road allows for you to shop for groceries. The breakfast diner is boring. Cook your own bfast if you can otherwise eat what you are given. There is nothing special about bfast except that you are not cooking it yourself. Much nicer than the Hyatt Place which is also within the vacinity.

author: 286genec
title: Perfect overnight stay
text: I had the best sleep ever at this hotel! The bed was comfortable and the room was dark. None of the annoying illuminated light switches and clock lights or other lighted items that other hotel room have that keep me awake. The curtains blocked the outside light effectively. It was quiet too! Even the window opened slightly to let in fresh air. So since I have described the perfect dark room for sleeping, the only problem was, where is the off button on the remote? We fell asleep while watching tv and could not see the remote or find the power/off button in the dark. I had to use the iPad light to find it.

author: uwgrimlock
title: Spacious suite, few minor issues
text: We had a one bedroom suite at this hotel and had a great one week stay. It was very convenient to be right across the street from the king of Prussia mall but well designed in its location to be tucked towards the back of the lot past trees to be nice and quiet. The room was very clean and well maintained and the housekeeping staff were even kind enough to leave a reminder note one day to call for housekeeping when their normal routine had not aligned with our time away. The hotel has a large conference space and the weekend we stayed over it seemed a large reunion or group going to the football game was staying. They were generally quiet but were unfortunately quite loud when disembarking from their big bus. We would recommend requesting rooms at the back of the hotel. The morning breakfast was decent with usual options of fruits, cereals, breads and hot foods. Our only complaints were that the omelette station used far too much butter and on the weekdays the breakfast was supposed to close at 9:30 and parts had already begun packing at 9:20 or even 9:15 on a few occasions. Otherwise we would recommend this place and look forward to staying again if we are on the area.

author: timothyg101
title: Don't stay at a Hyatt
text: Terrible room cleanliness. I took photos of the room. If you do stay check you bed and take a look at the air ducts in your room. I took photos of mine. I would not recommend signing up for the chase Hyatt credit card! I was provided invalid information by representatives before planning previous trip to NY to stay at the park Hyatt and I found myself without a hotel room and stuck with a non refundable $400.00 pair of train tickets. Thanks Hyatt/Chase. They did nothing about it but waste hours of my time on the phone.

author: newyork145_9
title: Never Disappointed in a Hyatt!
text: We have never been disappointed when staying in a Hyatt Hotel, and our first stay at this particular one was no exception! The hotel is in a perfect location for shopping at the KoP mall! Room was excellent, and beds were comfortable. We stayed overnight on a Saturday, which resulted in a very crowded breakfast buffet at 9 a.m. Sunday morning! The hotel staff was trying their best to keep the breakfast items and utensils stocked, but the mass of people didn't make their jobs very easy. And as nice as it was to offer a fresh made omelette station, that poor chef was running ragged trying to keep up with the orders! So, stay at this great hotel, but partake in the breakfast buffet before 9 a.m, on a weekend!

author: sublunary
title: Wonderful Stay!
text: I highly recommend this hotel! From the moment we checked in, we were made to feel right at home. The hotel itself is beautiful with great amenities, plenty of free parking, and a great location at King of Prussia mall. We asked for and received a double-bedded room with a bathtub. The room itself was spacious with plenty of storage, comfortable beds, and a large bathroom with plenty of counter space. The breakfast was great as well, but what sets this hotel apart is the people who work here. The hotel let us keep our car in their lot for several days after our departure while we explored Philadelphia, and from the front desk staff to the shuttle bus driver, every person we spoke with was so kind to us! I really appreciate it, thank you so much for making our stay so wonderful and worry-free!

author: 395viviank
title: Nice rooms, but needs a little work
text: Attended a wedding. The bar/restaurant does not open until 5 PM, which is a bit inconvenient if you want a drink or a snack before going out in the evening or to grab a quick lunch. However, the free breakfast is great with lots of choices. Rooms are spacious with nice kitchenettes, which is great if traveling with kids or want to bring your own snacks and beverages (which is important since the bar area is only open in the evening). TV channels are lacking. Pool area is a huge disappointment. Floor was dirty, shower leaked and big puddle on floor that was slippery and dirty. Water was frigid, like they just filled the pool and did not turn on the heater. Overall, rooms and lobby areas are very clean.

author: jamessD4550BL
title: A Comfortable Stay
text: We had a comfortable stay at the Hyatt House. The Hyatt is pet friendly. Our dog enjoyed his stay as well. They charge a one time fee for having your pet stay here. Tip alert. The indoor pool is small. Another tip, one side of the hotel is right along the noisy freeway. Ask for a room on the other side for peace n quiet.

author: 965claudiat
title: The best of everything!
text: Imagine creating a hotel with none of the inconveniences of being in a hotel...this is it. Our 4th or 5th stay here "just because". Across the street from the 2nd largest mall in the U.S., but you'd never notice it once you're inside the Hyatt House. Rare for King of Prussia, this Hyatt has a gorgeous, under-utilized, indoor pool and hot tub opening onto a patio area. The patio off the bar in the lobby has a fire pit and there's a pool table by the bar. Plenty of well-lit parking. Only downside is proximity to the turnpike noise in the back, but the rooms are well sound-proofed. Bonus: they will accept small pets!

author: MeAndTheLittleWoman
title: Great breakfast but...
text: First my wife insists that I mention the the (free) breakfast was probably the best one we've had at any hotel anywhere. We were there every day and each day there were different omelette specials and various other hot foods. They also had plain yoghurt which is our preference but is hard to find at hotels. That's the good part. The bad part is that when we arrived at the hotel and were assigned a room on the first floor, I asked about the noise level and I was assured that since we were away from the elevator that it wouldn't be a problem. They failed to mention that our window was about 40 yards from a busy highway and that there was significant road noise 24 hours a day. So first hint- don't get a room on the even room side of the first floor (or perhaps any floor). Second hint - if you are going to stay here, bring your own pillows because while there was some give, the almost square pillows in the room were rock hard. It was like trying to sleep on a rock covered by an inch of dense cotton.

author: /undefined
title: Don't eat the chicken pot pie
text: Very good hotel in prime location within walking distance of the King of Prussia Mall. Kitchen is limited & Food is not that great. The microwave meals available in reception are a trap. Cup-a-noodles are safe. In-room air conditioning system does not turn off, which is how legionaires disease is spread. Terrible for people with throat infections or breathing issues. to get the thing to turn off, turn the heat all the way up. The system will self-regulate and turn off when it is has reached its desired temperature; too bad if you don't like living on the equator. Hotel staff generally helpful except for 1 woman on reception who does not appear to like her job, see if you can pick which one. Overall I would return again, unless there is room at the Sheraton Valley Forge.

author: /undefined
title: This a True Factual Experience Review
text: Good Afternoon Natalie, Just was blown away by what you did going the extra mile wow. I thought I was good in customer service, but you out did myself. I got my old digs back, room 114, and my refrigerator was loaded with my favorite beverage Yerba Mate. Please allow me to share this with all of your social media, and upper management team. From now on I will only stay in Hyatt House when I'm in KOP. Once again thank you sooooooooo much you and your staff have treated me just like I was family. Wow I am in such awe. Respectfully Yours, Blue Gomez Deployment/Implementation Analyst Certified HIPAA Compliance Analyst-Xerox Digital Field Service Technician HealthCare Team MRC Smart Technology Solutions

author: karen53130
title: Disappointment
text: Beds were clean and comfortable. Furniture was threadbare. Housekeeping didn't clean the room for two of the three nights we stayed. After the first night we asked to make sure that our room would be clean, but it didn't happen. The breakfast staff wouldn't announce that breakfast was going to be removed, just did it as fast as possible. Staff couldn't keep coffee carafes full. Site looked nice. Indoor pool was too cold to swim in, whirlpool controls didn't work correctly. Pool area was cold.

author: TimothyQ627
title: Great hotel near King of Prussia mall
text: I could not believe how much I enjoyed this hotel. The room was great, especially the bed. I have never slept better in my life in this kind of bed. The bathroom was good, the only drawback was the daily amenities of shampoo and soap, they don't come in the flip-up open cap type, you have to unscrew it. The daily free buffet breakfast was a big plus! I really enjoyed the breakfast on both days of my stay. The customer service was very enjoyable. I even enjoyed using the shuttle bus to take me to the King of Prussia mall so I can do my shopping. I will probably stay here again on my next trip to King of Prussia.

author: /undefined
title: First Timer - Will Gladly Return!
text: It was my first time at a Hyatt House. I was in town interviewing for a job. I got in tired and anxious about the following day. The courteous staff did everything I asked for: recommendations for quick, easy to-go dinner from the downstairs bar; business center to print out my presentation; and quick, easy driving directions the next morning to my interview. I was impressed with the size and style of room. It was bigger than my first apartment back in my mid-20s! There is some road noise on the highway side of the hotel but it was not a big deal. I hope to get the job so I can stay here again! Thanks for a great first-timer experience!

author: Kaseycan
title: Excellent hotel by the mall
text: This hotel was not only priced well for it's location and all it offers, but also extremely comfortable, clean, and inviting. It is right by the mall and will even shuttle you over if you'd like. The room had a kitchenette and sitting area. The shower was large and awesome, and the sink was outside of the shower/toilet area. The bar area in the hotel is comfortable and serves food and drinks until 10 pm. The breakfast had a great selection, including made to order omelets, which I enjoyed. I didn't use the pool, hot tub, or exercise facilities, but I saw them and they looked great. I can't even imagine staying at a different hotel when in King of Prussia area. This one is the place to stay!

author: /undefined
title: King of Prussia Hyatt House
text: First time staying in a condo like hotel, and it was definitely unexpected! Loved the features and it's definitely a place like home! Even though it's a studio size guest room, there was plenty of space for my family. Check-in was a breeze. Room was neat and clean plus walking distance to the King of Prussia Mall. Although you can hear a slight noise from the highway, it was tolerable and we were able to sleep thru it. The free continental breakfast was better than other places we've stayed. Loved the made to order omelette station! Staff was friendly.

author: kmack24
title: Excellent Hotel
text: This hotel is excellent. Is one of the cleanest, most well kept hotels I have ever stayed in. Staff was friendly. Would stay here again in a heart beat. Keep up the excellent work. My only complaint would be with the heating/air quality. The rooms seem to get a bit dry at night as it caused me to become very stuffy. Other than that, everything is was great.

author: I30JIjamesr
title: Great stay
text: Great weekend experience. Easy check in and out. Top notch staff. One of the best rooms I've ever stayed in including 5 star rooms at 5 times the price. Conveniently located close to first class food and shopping. Nice in house bar. Free breakfast was great as well. I can't think of any downside, will stay here again and recommend to friends when in the area. Thank you for a great stay

author: christinefD2479HS
title: Another wonderful stay
text: A definite must for relaxation and friendly staff. Breakfast is delicious. The pool was clean and refreshing. You can't beat the accommodations for the value. We didn't even have to leave the property for the time we were there (2pm until 12pm the next day)...We used the pool, gym, walked across to Joe's Crab Shack, came back and relaxed. Had bfast then checked out. Second largest mall right across the way, many restaurants, movies, etc. Awesome location. You won't be sorry

author: SudhanshuGupta2000
title: Convenient n good place
text: I stayed for 3 nights on Business visit n had attended the conference in the hotel. I wud rate rooms to be v good n spacious. Gym is well equipped n all equipments are working well. Breakfast is good, I loved the cheese omlets during breakfast. Hotel is very near to kop mall which can be walked across though not advisable to walk there since there are no walkways n it cud be bit unsafe to walk down to this however small distance. However hotel provides shuttle service to mall every 30 min. Which is v convenient. Lota of good eating joints are at the mall.

author: killinyouk
title: Great Hotel
text: For a Hyatt House this hotel is big. The rooms are great. Staff was very friendly. The have an omelet station for breakfest. I will always stay here when I'm in the area. Even though they put me at the end of the hall. But that's ok! I loved my room.

author: msilvers50
title: Nice find, fair value, good location
text: Hotel: Modern, spacious lobby, attractive public spaces, friendly front desk staff. Room: new-looking, clean room, spotless shower/bathroom area, nice glass-enclosed shower, huge HDTV. Breakfast buffet: Standard food assortment cereals, breads, fruit, hot foods, coffee. Hot foods--as usual for these types of buffets—fresh but just warm in their warming trays, not as hot as they could be. Having a microwave available so French toast, eggs, etc. could be better heated would be a good addition. And watch or ask for omelets being cooked to order. We only noticed that after eating our early breakfast. Location: Behind huge King of Prussia shopping mall and numerous restaurants Price: Fair and reasonable. Would definitely stay here again.

author: 253ankes
title: Nice for longer stays
text: I've been staying at the Hyatt House about 10 times a year for 10 days each. It's modern compared to some other hotels in the area and offers a kitchenette and full size fridge which is nice if you are staying longer and don't plan on eating out every night. Many restaurants and one of the biggest malls literally within walking distance. Breakfast is ok but gets a little monotonous. Try to get a room away from the freeway and it will be quiet enough to open your window. Normally the housekeeping service is good and in over 2 years I've only had a couple of unsatisfactorily cleaned rooms. They do forget to restock the coffee frequently so I write a note. Parking is no issue and it's close to the freeway and about 35 min from Philly (with no traffic). Become a bit of a home away from home.

author: eMOM_2002
title: Clean, convenient, affordable with breakfast included
text: We were in PA for a sporting event for my son over a weekend. We found it to have reasonable price, convenient location (right next to King of Prussia Mall), new, clean, and overall experience had exceed our expectation for this type of hotel. It is good for family. The room is a good size. We had a 2 - double bed room. Breakfast is included and it is more than typical breakfast that other hotels in this grade offers. In addition to the hot breakfast and other usual pastries, yogurt, fruit, there are also omelette made to order. We will be going back to stay here again in this hotel when we are in the area for other sporting event.

author: V6780JUmatthewh
title: Very nice!!!
text: Comfy rooms. Kitchenette a nice feature. Separate bedroom area. Nice pool and work out facility. Very good continental breakfast included. Would recommend to families. Very close location to mall and valley forge historical site. Not too far to downtown.

author: giusef2015
title: Nice hotel. Indoor Pool!!!
text: Nice hotel . Modern . Energy efficient. Clean. We love the indoor pool. Has hit tub also. It's in the King of Prussia mall so there are Resturaunts & stores everywhere. There is even a Walmart near by. & They offer free breakfast.

author: /undefined
title: Very comfortable.. excellent staff
text: Staff surprised my daughter with a small gift bag of treats for her birthday hotel party weekend.. I requested my other friends to be on the same floor. They tried to accommodate but couldn't. The pool was fantastic.. so relaxing.. warm.. hot tube nice and hot.. very clean.. great pool tiles - non-slip..

author: JohnET50
title: Nice Stay Close to KOP Mall
text: First off, the price for this hotel was very reasonable. You get a nice, clean room in a very convenient location. The staff could not have been nicer and they were very helpful during our stay. You can walk to the mall from this hotel. The only bad thing was I thought the couch and chair in the room were worn and dated. Other than that, the rest of the room was great. The complimentary breakfast was nice also. This is not a luxurious, off the chain hotel. It is a newer, clean and reasonably priced hotel. When I am back in the Philly area, I will stay here again.

author: 1981reneej
title: King of Prussia experience
text: Our stay at Hyatt House was pleasantly nice. We arrived at the wrong hotel first which was Hyatt Place and it was a dump. So when we arrived at the right hotel it was a relief at how nice it was. I was expecting it to be this nice since it wasn't a Hyatt Regency hotel but it was. The room was clean, updated and nice. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was huge. The free breakfast in the morning has plenty or options and ran until 10. We would stay here again in a heart beat.

author: C1055NRsjw
title: Decent hotel
text: We stayed at the Hyatt House for one night while travelling back through the Philly area. The hotel is in an excellent location, with a large mall across the street and plenty of very good restaurants close by. The hotel itself was very clean and rooms large. Hotel staff was helpful. We requested a feather-free room when booking due to allergies and when we arrived the room had already been prepared as requested. This is unlike our experience at almost all other hotels we have stayed at where we have had to re-request a feather-free room on arrival. Internet connection was strong and pool and hot tub were very clean, although both closed a bit too early for our liking (10 p.m.). Overall, we recommend this hotel highly for both business and family travellers.

author: 543ginav
title: Wow! This hotel is a destination!
text: A quick run to and from Philadelphia in the largest shopping mecca in the east. The hotel is beautiful with plenty of convenient parking. Our room was enormous, including a queen bed and a fold out sofa, chest of drawers and desk, full size refrigerator, 2-burner stove, dishwasher (of all things!), toaster, dishes, coffee maker, microwave, etc. The shower was great...I'd love to have it at home---very powerful flow, hot water, large shower that didn't drip on the floor, plenty of handholds, thirsty towels. The breakfast (included) was fresh and delicious. They make omelets to order!! No nasty overly sweet pastries -- just good food. The seating in the breakfast room and in the lobby was very comfortable. The front desk people were super friendly and helpful (Phil was delightful and welcoming). I love this place!

author: /undefined
title: reLAXing at the Hyatt House
text: Went down to Philly for a field lacrosse tournament. This hotel is great. Small kitchen in the room if you want to cook in, or have doggy bags to reheat. Breakfast was included and was very good. The location if perfect! Lots of shopping and restaurants around. Close to highways if you need to get some where. Bed was very comfy. I can't think of one negative about this place. All good.

author: nsquare
title: Pleasant stay, all the comforts of home
text: We stayed 1 night. Booked the studio King. Room layout was very nice. I liked the vanity/ dressing area separated from the bathroom. Very comfortable bed. We faced the turnpike on the 4th floor. You can hear the traffic, but it's not bad at all. Breakfast area had lots of seating, even though they were busy. Good omelets. Would recommend the Hyatt House while visiting the Valley Forge National Park.

author: bigbabyrose3
title: Stayed for tournament weekend
text: The hotel was great. Great location. Breakfast was standard and it had an omelette station which was pretty nice. My only gripe is the ice machines were only on floors 2 and 4. When I arrived the 2nd floor machine was not working. By Saturday the 4th floor machine was not working. Considering out entire team (along with other teams) I would have liked to see the hotel work alittle quicker at getting those fixed. Other then that, we had a great stay.

author: /undefined
title: Great hotel for such a good deal!
text: Great location and service! The hotel is located right across from the Mall of Prussia, 5 min walking distance. Many great restaurants are around the mall, never run out of dining options. Loved the spacious guest room and upscale decorations. Free breakfast! I would stay here every time I'm in the area. I have stayed at other Hyatt Regency hotels and Marriott hotels. This is one of the best!

author: josefgecijo
title: Had my iPad STOLEN!
text: I'm a loyal Hyatt customer who has been staying at Hyatts for years all over the US for my work travels. I am a current Diamond Member and for the first time during my stay in Hyatt House KOP on 6/14 my ipad was STOLEN from my room. I have been leaving valuables in my rooms for years and I have never ever had this problem! After reporting the incident to management all they can tell me was that I can file a police report! What is a police report going to do???? That's not going to return my iPad! I dont feel secure in this hotel and was truly disappointed with how management handled the situation! I will be going back to KOP for the next 8 months and will not be returning to this hotel!

author: JoePollard3
title: 2 night stay to attend a reunion out on the Philadelphia mainline
text: Using a very good routing app on the smart phone "WAZE" travel time was never more that 20 minuets .It was close to a very major mall so shopping and eating was never a problem. The check in desk staff (D.D.) was most helpful and pleasant. She provided a proper explanation regarding parking, hotel services and the free breakfast. As this was "Hyatt House" the room features reminded of the Marriott Residence INN. The room was very large, well appointed with all the things need for an extended stay. However the iron did not work, and the ice machine on our floor did not have ice for 2 days, even after being reported. Baggage carts were available, which I appreciate. Everything was clean

author: /undefined
title: Stay at Hyatt King of Prussia
text: The service, room, and food great and by being a club member gave me additional money off my room which is alway a plus!! The service from front desk and the person whom made my omelette was excellent. The breakfast has many options for everyone to enjoy! The room was clean, spacious, and quiet during the night! I love the kitchen in the room this hotel gives you options, to eat in or out. The location is great because of the many restaurants and even shopping is close by. I also enjoyed that they offered where you can buy snacks such as ice cream or popcorn to name a few. The Hyatt at King of Prussia has everything to satisfy everyone needs for an enjoying stay!

author: Lovetotravelforfun
title: Too Noisy!!
text: Decided to try here again. As much as the hotel has a lovely breakfast, I will not be staying here again. I did ask to stay in a room away from the highway. My request was honored however the noisy fan from the heating and air conditioning unit was more than I can take again. It cycled on and off all night long and it was VERY loud! I'm stayed here a number of times over the last two years. It's time for me to move on. Sorry Hyatt!

author: /undefined
title: Nice rooms
text: We stayed in a studio room. It was a nice size room. The room was clean and nice. My only problem, there was only one TV. We had to turn it 190 degrees to face the bed. If someone was sleeping on the sofa bed, they would not be able to watch TV if we were watching it in the bed. I still liked the room. I would stay again.

author: /undefined
title: Nice facility but the noise from traffic makes it a no go....
text: The facility is a nice one and, generally, the idea of the Hyatt House is a good one. By that I mean, they really have it set up like a small apartment. Living arrangements are logically laid out and things are clean and well maintained. There is a very nice mini-kitchen, including a real life-sized refrigerator and the working area is set with all the plug-ins you would need, regardless of the work assignment. However, although the hotel is conveniently located near the Pa. Turnpike, the problem is, it is really near the PA. Turnpike. Right beside it to be exact. The road noise was equal to the worst I have experienced in a hotel and I have stayed at quite a few. I would definitely recommend a Hyatt House but, sadly, not at this location.

author: 768Dave
title: Great night's stay and breakfast
text: Rooms were large and clean. Furnishings were new and very nice. Bathroom was clean and very nice. Conveniently located to the mall. The breakfast was extremely good and staff great. Front desk service was good, but not great. Seemed to be more interested in their phones than greeting visitors. Online reservation can be difficult as I wanted two rooms on one reservation, but couldn't reserve different sizes so just went with two larger rooms.

author: Brittany322
title: Great Experience, Nice Rooms, Clean Hotel
text: Recently spent 2 nights here for business. They were very accommodating on letting me check in around 10:30 am. I got a king sized bed on the 6th floor. Room was clean, offered a sofa/lounge area/ desk work/center. Spacious bathroom/ counter room and sink. I slept well both nights. They offer a nice continental breakfast in the morning. Not even a 5 min car ride to the KOP Mall. If staying in the area- I would highly recommend. Valley Forge casino is 2 traffic lights away.

author: Elainest
title: Simply Excellent!
text: I spent a week here for business. The place is managed well. The staff is helpful, friendly and interested. The facility is very clean and comfortable. I stayed in a studio which provided me with a full size refrigerator and a cook top as well as microwave and dishwasher. Extremely comfortable. The breakfast choices were excellent -- omelets cooked to order and great oatmeal. I would have liked brighter lights by the bathroom sink and I mentioned that to staff. I will stay there again.

author: dtowntravler
title: nice stay
text: The room was large, clean and quiet suite. The bed and pillows very comfortable. Our room had a nice kitchen area with full size fridge/microwave and dishwasher. I would recommend this hotel if in the KOP area. Breakfast included too. The check in could have been a bit better. We came just after 3:00PM check in time and rooms were not yet available. Had to wait to check in. Joe's Crab Shack in the adjoining parking lot and Capital Grille next door too. lighting conservation in rooms.

author: tracyd812
title: Great stay but disappointing breakfast experience
text: Overall, I must say that my stay at Hyatt House was great. The hotel is walking distance to the mall and movies; the room was clean and very nicely furnished; and the pool and hot tub were good. The only issue I had was my interaction with the breakfast servers. During breakfast I went to get pancakes out of the hot plate, but they were not hot. So I went over to one of the servers and asked if she could warm up my food in the microwave and she replied no. I feel that if it isn't their policy to warm people's plates then the food should be hot. To make a long story short, I had to get on the elevator and take my food back to my room in order to enjoy a hot breakfast. I was very disappointed by this.

author: 969kendrar
title: Excellent Hotel Experience
text: My stay was excellent! The check in process was very simple & quick since I pre-paid. All the hotel staff were amazing. The breakfast buffet was super yummy. I enjoyed my stay greatly. Checking out of the hotel was even simpler. The area is in a convenient location right by the King of Prussia mall. I would absolutely stay here again.

author: Sunnybay40
title: Average-ish
text: This was our second stay at the hotel. Stay of 5 days this time. Room 224 is close to the highway, but not too noisy. Our problems were with basic cleanliness. The shower had black and red mold growing in it, the sheets were not changed, even after requesting, the room was not cleaned on a daily basis, and the breakfast buffet dishes and serving utensils were grimy. Very unappetizing. A little disappointing as I don't remember these issues from our first visit. The gluten free option at the breakfast was two pieces of white bread in a plastic pouch, frozen or microwaved depending on who was serving. It was not even possible to request an omelet because the employee was so overwhelmed with his orders. The check in process was no problem, and the employees were cheerful.

author: Sweetsunshiny
title: Awesome location friendly staff great hotel
text: Rooms were very spacious. Offering kitchenettes and nice showers. Great location to everything. Shopping dining and a few minutes in the car and we were in downtown Philadelphia. Great trip for a couples get a way for the weekend. Good breakfast is included although go early to beat crowd. They offer a little of everything. Staff was very friendly and helpful.

author: M8451VZdianeh
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: This hotel is beautiful. The amenities such as the high ceilings and automatic shade/curtain was an added touch! I have stayed at many hotels. When we walked in the room, we were in awe of the size of the ceilings and the beautiful decor. Kitchen, huge shower, large television and excellent customer service. Realizing it was my birthday, while we went out for a movie, upon return we found that they left me a letter wishing me a Happy Birthday. There were gourmet chocolate chip cookies for our enjoyment! I would definitely return and will highly recommend it to family and friends!

author: 12Greg
title: Very nice property and enjoyable amenities
text: Room was clean and spacious. Recommend getting a high floor away from the Turnpike traffic. Don't forget to bring or buy your favorite beverages and food since you have a fridge and kitchenette (with all the utensils, etc). The pool is good size from 3 feet to 5 feet deep. Hot tub is good sized. Work out room is next to the pool in the lower level. Breakfast is awesome if you like freshly prepared omelettes. They rotate the buffet meats and fruits day to day (to give variety). Hair dryer was acceptable.

author: 596hasp
title: Was not the type of service I expected
text: The staff was mediocre. The rooms were clean, however the a/c was not very good. The thermostat read 10° F lower than the room temperature. This led to an issue when the room says 65F, and the temp control only goes to 61, you can't get it any cooler than 75°F. This was very uncomfortable as it was humid during my stay. The room had a musty odor too. Unfortunately there were not a great deal of hotels to choose from in this area so it is one of the better ones, I guess. Hyatt Place had better customer service though.

author: 790mitchw
title: no problems
text: I stayed here on business. I've stayed here many times. There are no surprises and no problems. It's fine, it's clean, it's comfortable and it's convenient. The rooms are large and nice and the wifi is included. It's certainly nothing special so I wouldn't give it 5 stars. There is one real negative and that's the breakfasts. They are really weak and there are no good places that are very close to have breakfast.

author: PugWyoming_Pa
title: Nice hotel!
text: We stay here every year thanksgiving weekend. Hotel is very clean and convenient to the mall. Great breakfast buffet!!! Nice indoor pool and excersise room. Nice efficiency rooms. Bar in lobby but pricy as one would expect. Very friendly staff. Great deals if you search for them.

author: Bradg1998
title: Great for a family weekend getaway
text: My wife and I recently spent a night at Hyatt House with our two young children for a weekend getaway to Philadelphia. It was perfect! The staff was very friendly and accommodating, the room (we had a 1 bedroom) was spacious and clean, and the free morning buffet was plentiful. The small "convenience store" was perfect (as we were able to buy milk and snacks for the kids), and the pool was large, clean, and well maintained. Our room didn't come pre-stocked with sheets or towels for a family of 4 (as the kids shared the pull-out couch), but a helpful housekeeping staff member gladly provided these items after a simple request in the hallway. No problem! The hotel was about 25 minutes from the Philadelphia attractions. We'll definitely be staying again!

author: mikekU902TX
title: Nice but overpriced and under cared
text: We love the King of Prussia area. Being retired we can travel weekdays or weekends. The area has a great mall, unbelievable selection of restaurants, a nice casino, and isn't too far fro lots of Philadelphia sites to visit. The hotel wa s clean but not kept. The shower stopper needed fixing, housekeeping didn't clean the room until after 3 PM, they didn't put toilet paper on the roll, they didn't refill the Kleenex. All little things but important. The other disappointing thing is the buffet breakfast. Nice selections but all cold. A shame! We would go back again because of the wonderful location but attention to detail was missing

author: thomasdJ8628KW
title: Great Stay
text: Excellent location! Room was clean . Very close to mall. Great place to stay if your shopping or going to casino. Breakfast very good. Staff quite nice. If in the area will stay at location again. Rate this hotel a nine.

author: penngirls
title: Great family place!
text: We stayed for one night while in the area. We arrived after a long day at the Philadelphia Zoo. The staff was wonderful and got us in our room right away. They also were able to promptly get us the pack & play we needed for my daughter to sleep in. The room was clean, and comfortable. The indoor pool was a huge hit with our 2 year old and nice to have to help tire her hour even more! My only complaint would be to have the pool open a little earlier. Nothing like having to convince a 2 year old she had to wait to go swimming the next morning. Loved the resturant right in the parking lot of the hotel. We will definitely be back next time our travels take us to King of Prussia.

author: MichaelMC23
title: Perfect mid level hotel
text: I've stayed at this hotel 4 times now while attending an annual conference at the Valley Forge Convention Center and Casino. I had stayed once at the Radisson that is connected to the Convention Center, but had a very bad experience and found this hotel about a mile away. This Hyatt House is superb in every aspect. The staff members are extremely friendly and helpful. Check in was quick. Room ( I had a suite) was very well appointed and comfortable. Some reviews complained of the noise, but I found the room quiet (and I was on an end unit that was near the Interstate). I didn't use the gym equipment nor take advantage of the breakfast since I had a fridge in my room. There's a huge Wegman's 1/2 mile away to stock up on if you're staying for a few days. Great hotel!,

author: nicolal328
title: Very enjoyable stay
text: Myself and my husband spent a week at the hotel. We booked one of the suites complete with a mini kitchen as my husband was on business for the week so I spent more time at the hotel. Suite was very clean and comfortable and the mini kitchen was well stocked with utensils. Staff were very helpful and drove us to get groceries in the nearby Wegmans grocery store as we had no car. Breakfast was great each morning, we mostly opted for fresh fruit and oatmeal but there were plenty of other options available including freshly made omelettes which were delicious! The hotel is a 3min walk to the huge king of Prussia mall and there are plenty of places to eat around this area. The staff also drove and collected me from the Valley forge national park where I spent the day visiting all of the points on the trail around the park. All in all a very enjoyable stay. They also have a gym and pool, I used the gym most days and again had a range of fitness machines and weights for use. Would definitely stay here again.

author: evansvuk
title: Girl's Weekend
text: Booked a room for a quick girl's shopping weekend. Staff at Check In was super friendly. Hotel is fairly new with modern decor. Small bar which serves small plates and snacks. Pool table in lounge and outdoor fire pit provide a nice place to unwind before settling in for the night or heading out for dinner. Room was clean and spacious. Wine glasses and cork screw were a plus. Very quiet with lots of parking. King of Prussia Mall located right across the street. Perfect hotel for a short stay.

author: richardwV8391PI
title: Exceeded My Expectations
text: This hotel exceeded my expectations. Every area of the hotel was clean, well maintained, and recently updated. Everything in the room worked well. The staff was very friendly and check-in/check-out were both a pleasure. The pool, Jacuzzi, and workout equipment were all high quality and functional. The location of the hotel is amazing! The kitchen in the room was well furnished. The breakfast assortment was good, the food was fresh, and except for the made-to-order omelets, everything tasted good.

author: marksO7687VA
title: Great Hotel & Great Location
text: We recently stayed 2 nights at this hotel for a basketball tournament in King of Prussia. The hotel is beautiful and looks new. Severals families from our basketball team stayed there. The 14 year old boys loved the pool table and TV's in the lobby/bar area. We at dinner at the hotel one night and the food was very good. The bartender was excellent and very friendly. Breakfast was great. The rooms were very nice. The location was excellent, right across the street from King of Prussia Mall. I would highly recommend this hotel.

author: matfromdelco
title: Update: Prices has gone up since 2014
text: I used to remember when you could get a deluxe suite( with a King size bed) for around 100 dollars give or take , This last year- in 2014 the prices have gone up to at least 116( minimum) usually the prices were $134 - $160 etc but nothing has changed same service and all. Not only that, the Hyatt House has been sold out for like 6 months straight- To be honest the only thing that Hyatt House has that most restaurants dont is that it has full kitchens in the rooms and a bar/restaurant , as well as a pool What i dont get is Hyatt House used to be almost the same prices as other hotels around the area and now its gone up for no reason. Plus its still just as noisy- those damn quite room central airs? You can hear a pindrop outside. kids /teens running around at all hours of the night. Latino families yelling in the next room ceilings are still thin ( you can hear almost anything above you in the bedroom All in all its not recommended. There are quieter and cheaper hotels in the area that offer nearly as much as they do... They got greedy . bad sign in the middle of a recession. Not recommended until those prices go down

author: RichardG550
title: Very nice hotel close to mall
text: Hotel seems fairly new and is in very good condition. Rooms are nice and spacious. A very small number of rooms (maybe 2 or 4) have a "double-height" ceiling over the bedroom area - very nice. Great shower (no tub in the rooms I've stayed in), but some will leak onto floor due to the glass door not closing properly. Also, they appear to have soft water, so your skin will feel a little slippery in the shower (mine did) and getting that "squeaky" clean feel is a little more difficult than usual. Breakfast is above average for this type of hotel - omelets/eggs made to order, hot food bar [usually] with eggs, bacon, potatoes, pancakes - assorted breads/pastries, oatmeal, drinks. Self-service except for the made to order eggs (they'll bring those to your table when finished). Very nice indoor pool and exercise room on lower level. It's located next to a major highway/interstate, but I've never had an issue with noise. Staff is very nice and friendly - especially Jerome (usually on the night shift).

author: 586annl
title: Great place, close to Philly
text: I traveled here with my four children over spring break. We had a wonderful stay! Everyone from the front desk clerk, to the breakfast attendants, to the housekeeping staff were wonderful. Everyone was very accommodating and welcoming. We had a great day and would stay here again. We went into Philadelphia everyday. We just made sure that we left after rush hour traffic and stayed a little later into the evening. That way it was only about a 25 minute drive from the hotel to the visitor's center, door-to-door.

author: Caroline331
title: Cheap, clean and close
text: Stayed here for Temples alumni weekend with my friend and her 3 yo son. Hotel was clean and updated. Hotel itself was quiet but is right next to the highway and I was able to hear traffic while going to sleep. Indoor pool is a bit small but suited us just fine. There's a gym right next to the pool and actually looks into the pool through glass windows which could be useful if you wanted to workout and had older kids. Breakfast was the usual free breakfast. They did have a man who would make omelets. Close enough to the city although you have to travel on the schukill. Would stay here again. Also directly across from the mall.

author: PennaGrl7377
title: Suburban Chic
text: My hubby and I stayed overnight for a local convention, and we were not disappointed. The check in was very efficient and hotel is clean and modern. The decor reminded us of the "W" hotel chain. Our hotel room on the first floor faced the highway, so it was a little noisy for those who are light sleepers. We had the king junior suite and it was spacious enough for a couple. The breakfast was great but you should try to get there by 8am to beat the rush as seating can get limited on busy weekends. The patio area with a big fire pit was a nice welcome after a long day. The hotel seems a draw a lot of families over the weekend, so the pool table near the bar area gets noisy with kids staying out late into the night. Perhaps, there should be a separate game room so as to not disturb the guests who want to enjoy a quite glass of wine at the bar. Overall, really nice hotel experience and would stay here again (perhaps on a weekday).

author: horstvonmuiskaak
title: It was OK.
text: There were a few issues with the room choice at check-in but the guys at the desk handled them after a few trial and error attempts. The hotel was good overall but make sure you stay on the non-highway side if you are a light sleeper. Also the only other thing that was even mentionable was the cleanliness. My wife had to plug in her phone charger behind the nightstand and it was disgustingly dirty back there. I don't think that had been moved in years. Beds were very comfortable though I had great night's sleep. Also the first room they put us in was not clean- the desktop, the bathroom both had some gnarl going on. The next room they moved us into was good except for behind the nightstand. I might stay there again due to value alone.

author: 532lisas
title: Sanctuary
text: We live in king of prussia but our house flooded out in February from broken sprinkler system. We are fortunate to stay with family. However, We needed to be close to our house with renovations starting. I did not want a standard hotel. The hyatt house Kop is incredible!!!! Comfortable and beautiful rooms. But the best part is the staff! Troy and Angel made us feel like family. We are staying again at the end of the month. This is home away from home.

author: ChooseToThrive
title: Surprising hotel in an excellent location
text: Came in late at night, tired after long drive and reservation mishap at another property. Front desk staff member was very kind, friendly, quick and helpful. Fell into comfortable beds in very clean and comfortable facility. Breakfast was great with good variety of cold and hot items, including MTO omelets. Only minus was that the coffee wasn't on all night-insomniac spouse likes to wander around and drink java at 3 AM. Great location, walking distance from Joe's Crab Shack, casino and shopping mall. Hotel staff didn't miss a beat even with late-season snow-- parking lot was cleared quickly. Would absolutely choose this property next time.

author: Dee70471
title: Wonderful rooms in a great location
text: My daughter & I stayed here while in King of Prussia & loved it. The rooms are spacious with a kitchen, living room, beds and bath. The decor is modern. The rooms were clean & new. The complimentary breakfast offered a wide selection including hot foods & specially cooked omelets. The staff couldn't have been friendlier. We had a room right off the lobby that wasn't too noisy. A room farther away might be quieter but we weren't bothered. The hotel is tucked away off Mall Road but right next to a restaurant. It made it feel like we were farther from the mall than we were in terms of quiet.

author: LittleRussie
title: Great place/Great location
text: Wife and I stayed here for a valentines getaway. Hotel was perfect for our needs. We frequent Philly a lot, but didn't want to lock ourselves in the city for the weekend as it was supposed to be cold. Hotel was awesome. Rooms were great, very unique suites. Bar was effective. The only slight would be that breakfast was average. Mind you, average, not bad. I would stay here again in a heartbeat

author: zerolife
title: Good but there are better Hyatt's in the area
text: I normally stay at the Sheraton down the street or the Hyatt House Plymouth Meeting about 10 minutes away but decided to check out this Hyatt House in King of Prussia as well as a Hyatt Place nearby. While this hotel is satisfactory, I would nevertheless recommend the other two Hyatts in the area over this one. Good: - Front Desk staff were efficient - Great location right across the street from the mall - Property looks fairly new Bad: - Had two conditioner and no shampoo in the room. A simple mistake from housekeeping but major annoyance. I had to skip shampooing as I did not have time to request replacement bottle in the morning. - House keeping knocked on the door twice within 30 minutes despite telling her the first time that I'm not ready. Minor annoyance but I would preferred if she waited a bit longer before trying again. - Has the new Hbar instead of Evenings Social. Hyatt's Evening Social buffet is not gourmet dining but it's still a step better than what the Hbar offers and most important it is free. Hbar is a great example of hotel cafes that offer mediocre food at a high price point for the convenience of not having to leave the building.

author: Kristy_Burns
title: The only choice for King of Prussia
text: We stay here at least 2 times a year. I love the fact you can see the mall from the hotel. I love the decor, very modern. We always get great rates especially for all the amenities they have. Breakfast is AWESOME! They even have an omelette station. We have never had a problem with noise, except for the ice machines in the refrigerator. When that thing drops ice, it wakes you up!

author: NickWarman
title: One night but we will be back
text: We were on our way to our niece's wedding Sept. 25th, and the halfway stop is about King of Prussia, PA. Stayed for first time at the HYATT house, and have nothing but positives about the place. Clean, quiet, heating/cooling was built-in and was unnoticeable, unlike so MANY hotels. Spacious room, comfortable bed, and a welcome relief from the highway traffic. There were a number of people in for a conference/meetings at the same time, but other than a line for the bar(!) it was the best hotel we have stayed at when travelling. Only the Fairmont Chateau Laurier in Ottawa Canada and the Holman Grand in Charlottetown PEI Canada were better, and they are several price points above the HYATT house - kudos to the hotel and hotel staff, you could not have been better! The only word of caution: Your GPS will probably get lost in the area and not give good directions for the hotel - the driveway is NOT where one would expect it - so watch the signs and you should be fine. Also, if not very knowledgeable about the area, check your maps before leaving, as your GPS will not probably respond quickly enough to get you BACK on the highways, in the direction you would wish to travel. And neither of those points are the hotel's fault.

author: Coder
title: Gr8 Place 2 stay!!
text: Stayed here for a week while visiting Philly. Ideally located right across the street from King Of Prussia Mall (Great restaurants & shopping) The HH/KOP is a great place to stay and made our first trip to Philly both memorable and comfortable. We got a king suite with an equipped kitchen, ideal sized bathrooms and closets and a TV in the living space and bedroom. The bed was more than comfortable. This establishment also has free breakfast service, and a very nice one BTW and a bar/Grill right across from the lobby. Front desk and staff was more than helpful and nice which we always appreciate. This hotel is located about 40 minutes from downtown Philly. With the pricing we tend to stay on the outskirts of the big cities. If you're looking for something like this, I'd highly recommend this hotel. Thank you to the staff for a memorable stay.

author: sweetbabiet
title: Perfect stay in every way!
text: perfect stay, perfect hotel, perfect location....no exaggeration! My family and I had a great stay. The location is literally in walking distance to King of Prussia mall. Free breakfast (with all hot food) pancakes, scrambled eggs, owlets, fresh fruit etc, free wifi and not just in the lobby and best of all our pet was welcomed! The rooms are spacious, updated, nicely decorated and comfortable. I was able to visit the gyma and my kids went to the pool. No complaints. The gym is larger than most and included a nice selection of equipment. The staff was very attentive and friendly. We more than enjoyed ourselves and was very pleased with the rooms as well as service.

author: 635timothyh
title: Great hotel.
text: Great nights stay. Bed was extremely soft and comfortable. Loved all of the extras. IE cook top, micro wave, full size fridge, dish washer, and sink (kitchen). Only part not real clean was shower. Spots on handles and glass. Not a big deal. Liked the fire pit. Didn't get to use the pool or fitness area. Would definitely stay again.

author: wendala64
title: Nice, but smells
text: I stayed overnight on 9-13-14 in the Hyatt House. The hotel and studio suite room looked good and seemed clean. The minute we opened our room door you could smell a weird (maybe musty?) smell. It was a strong smell. After we went to dinner and returned,,decided we didnt want to just live with it. I called front desk and complained, he came up and sprayed 'Febreze" on the carpet and stated that is ALL he could do. In hindsight, I think that they could have offered us another room if there was one available. I dont know, just seemed like they didnt care too much and could have tried to do more. Unsure if I would go back-I am sour now.

author: JoeFlip
title: Comfort from all around
text: The location of this hotel is prime. It is adjacent to a Joe's crab shack, a five minute walk to a movie theater, and in the general vicinity of the King of Prussia Mall. The hotel itself, inside and out, is very clean, modern, and up to date. The common areas are filled with a pool table, hotel bar, and small mini-mart. The hotel also has an indoor pool (which we did not use), outdoor seating areas that include a fire pit, and well maintained interior corridors. The rooms were very comfortable with a microwave, refrigerator, and a fully stocked kitchenette. The TV rotates toward the seating area or the bed, there was a stand-up shower with a glass door, and a vanity area separate from the bathroom. The room itself had a relaxing atmosphere. If I had to find one drawback from our stay it would be that the hotel does not offer in room movies.

author: ChristieP
title: Excellent hotel in King of Prussia!
text: I stayed here for a week-long business trip, and I can honestly say this was one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. My colleagues and I were all impressed with the decor and comfort of our rooms. Everything was in perfect condition, and my room had all of the comforts I needed. My only suggestion about the rooms was that the Pennsylvania Turnpike side of the hotel did get some road noise at night. The hotel staff were very helpful and eager to please. On the day of my arrival, the hotel van driver gladly took me to and from Valley Forge National Park, and throughout the week, they ferried my colleagues and I back and forth to our office. The breakfast buffet was really nice. I loved having the cooked-to-order omlettes every morning, as well as coffee available throughout the day. Several of my colleagues ate and drank at the hotel, and they all said the bar in the evening was nice. I look forward to my next trip to King of Prussia, and another lovely stay at the Hyatt House!

author: Dkthompson
title: Great Hotel
text: This is our second time at a Hyatt House and it was a great hotel again. Good location with a Joe's Crab Shack in the same parking lot as the hotel, makes it an easy spot for dinner and drinks. The room was excellent, staff was great, overall another good experience at the Hyatt House. Only reason I didn't give it five stars was because the breakfast area was very chaotic in the mornings. All the food was fine, we had to wait on a couple items like coffee and silverware, they need more than one toaster, and the omelet station needs more than one person. People were waiting 45 minutes for an omelet. All was good, just need more staff and equipment to ensure people can get in and out of the breakfast area. We will definitely continue statying at a Hyatt House whenever possible.

author: taiaitai
title: home away from home
text: We came here for our daughter's summer program in Bryn Mawr college which is 6.5 miles away. We stayed 14 nights in July there. This property is right next to the King of Prussia mall which offers shopping and plenty of restaurants. The hotel itself has a decent gym, pool and guest laundry facilities. The whole crew at this hotel knows what they are doing. The only problem is that there is no oven in the ketchen. It would be nice to have an oven to get pizza made in our own room. This is an excellent hotel. We love this place and will definitely return.

author: natem714
title: Good Stay
text: Was here for a week for business and overall I enjoyed the stay. The rooms are very clean and well kept. The area that the hotel is in has many options when it comes to food and entertainment. Many of the restaurants are within walking distance and so is a very large mall across the street. The hotel also has an agreement with the gym just a couple hundred yards away. While the gym (Bally's) is older but gets the job done when you're away on business travel. You get in for free...I used it a few times. This is a good hotel and I would recommend it

author: MykeI
title: Great stay
text: Very comfortable. Great breakfast. Top notch service for a great price. Booked on expedia and was very happy with my stay. Was greeted with a smile right away. Pool was a little small but was comfortable. Location is great. Within walking distance to the Mall. Couldn't of asked for a better location.

author: Jkrsiny
title: Good choice for business or pleasure.
text: This hotel exceeded our expectations. All staff were pleasant and accommodating. Quick and easy check-in and check-out. All our special requests, regarding the rooms, were made available. The rooms were clean, comfortable and well equipped. Although we did not use all the amenities available, the complimentary breakfast buffet and lounge had ample selections and the food was very good. There is plenty of free self-parking. The mall is very close, so there are many options for food. I would not hesitate to stay again or recommend this hotel.

author: LesleyC591
title: Great place to stay
text: This hotel is just perfect! Nice big room, comfy bed, full kitchen and an awsome shower with nice size towels to dry off on. Breakfast in included in your stay. You can get an omlette made to order which I thought was very good and of course all the ususal, fresh fruit, cereal and nice selection of other hot items. We went out for dinner and took the free shuttle service which was such a treat. The pool and big hot tub is very nice after a long hard day of shopping!! The mall is right across the street and there are lots of restaurants in the area and there are a few within walking distance. The Premium Outlet is only 25 minutes away and really easy to get to. Staff is very nice and friendly and the cleaning people keep the hotel very clean. We will definitely stay here next time we come shopping in King of Prussia.

author: Rosie21797
title: Great hotel!
text: After spending the day in Philly, we came to King of Prussia. The hotel was very clean and the bed was comfortable. We stayed in a Studio Suite, which was very large and had a mini kitchen. Check-in staff were very friendly and the process was fast. We had breakfast the next morning which included a nice variety of choices (fruit, cereal, bread, muffins, donuts, scrambled eggs, sausage, potatoes, french toast, and freshly made omelets). The breakfast area staff were very nice. The hotel is conveniently located near the mall and there are a lot of dining options. The only complaint about the location is that the one side of the hotel is by the highway. This didn't bother me, but it did wake my husband up a few times. We will definitely stay here again!

author: mainlinenewb
title: Beautiful hotel with all the amenities
text: We stayed here for 3 nights right before moving to California and it was an overall pleasant stay. The room was tastefully decorated and we had a pull-out bed and a pack n play ready for our 4-yr old and 1 yr old. The only reason I give it 4 stars is the lack of a bathtub which made it a little difficult to bathe the little ones. The had all the great amenities: pool, laundry room, great breakfast and hotel shuttle to the mall. Customer service was very helpful and courteous - always with a smile. We only used housecleaning once but it seemed very adequate. If we ever come back, I'd definitely stay again. Great value for a hotel.

author: Kristy_Burns
title: Best around!
text: We love this hotel! This was our second stay, and it was as good as the first! We like the free breakfast, which has so many choices and includes hot food. The rooms are so comfortable. They feel larger than a normal hotel room. You feel like your in a little apartment. They put us in a room that was right off of the elevator, so in the mornings it was hard to sleep in with everyone right outside the door talking, but slept well through the night. The location is so convenient to the mall and also to hop on 76 to head right into Philly. This is our favorite place to stay!

author: nurns28
title: Home away from home
text: Rooms are brand new, clean, and spacious. Most have a granite/stainless kitchenette and full fridge - perfect if you are on the road all the time and get sick of eating out. The hotel is right behind the King of Prussia mall - walking distance - which pretty much has any store you'd ever need. It is also right across the parking lot from The Capital Grill and Joe's Crab Shack. But what really makes this place great is the staff. They are amazing!!! During a recent snowstorm every single restaurant in town was closed, and this hotel is not set up to be a full service restaurant - more like a Courtyard Marriott cafe. The hotel manager and bartenders (one was 8 months pregnant) worked the kitchen and bar like nothing I have ever seen. Many employees could not make it to the hotel, so these women went above and beyond to feed and service a massive crowd of hungry, stranded hotel guests. Medina at the bar is a gem, but the whole operation is pretty darn excellent.

author: joec545
title: Green or disgusting?
text: I understand that hotels change sheets less often in an effort to save money and sell this as a "green" environmental concern. That is fine but what would you think of a hotel that does not change sheets in between guests? Disgusting. I was shocked to pull back my blanket and see a human discharge stain freshly left on the sheets. When I went down to the front desk they called the housekeeper. She stated that she "checked" those sheets! Is "checking" the sheets in between guests the standard! Housekeeping staff here does a lousy job overall. Gross. Not clean at all.

author: MZondo
title: Exactly what you expect, even under difficult circumstances!
text: I was there at the end of the storm and outages. We were traveling with a sports team and the hotels in the area was packed. While we had a good experience, the staff had a hard time getting the rooms turned in the expected times. Check in is at 3PM and we had a few rooms not available until after 5PM. Irritating but not fatal. The remainder of the stay went well. Rooms clean and breakfast well done. I would try it again.

author: behappy27
title: Excellent place to stay in KOP, PA
text: Really loved staying here. The service was very nice and the room was so spacious. Definitely splurge for the one BR if you have kiddies with you. The sleep sofa and the king size bed served us well. I loved having the kitchen b/c we got back late and ate in the room. The hotel is across the street from the mall which is SUPER convenient. We got a great rate online. I will definitely stay there again, highly satisfied.

author: AndyH626
title: This place is better than the already great reviews
text: My Wife and I slipped away to this place for a night without the kiddo. Great online rate, the studio room we were in had a full kitchen and a massive changing and bath area. Located right behind the restaurant we ate at and two seconds from the mall. Staff when out of their way to be happy, and offer assistance. Bar Tender Toby was really cool and the egg station for breakfast was the best. We are already trying to figure out when we can get away again to this place. Of all the hotels I've stayed in this was hands down the best surprise so far! Great Job Hyatt House staff!

author: Lee2345
title: The reviews are accurate - Great hotel / INCREDIBLE staff
text: This is my first review for Tripadvisor... I couldn't not comment re: my recent stay: My wife & I stayed here for a quick anniversary getaway - the property is great. Cool, contemporary vibe from the shared spaces to the rooms. But what made it so great for us was the staff... they made our little getaway feel really special. Eddie (who inspired us w/ his 27 yrs of happy marriage) took extra care to ensure that our stay was special - he went above & beyond for us - then Jerome surprised us w/ a thoughtful & generous gesture. You can tell that all of the staff care about the experience. This stay has prompted us to make this an annual getaway.

author: bjplmp
title: Great stay
text: Great location, great staff, great facility, great room and a great breakfast. Our room faced the highway and was very quiet. The staff and the girl making the omelettes were very friendly. We had a studio room with a very comfortable king bed. I will provide one piece of advise for the guest staying. If you check in late. Do not turn the ice maker on in the freezer. It will start making ice in the middle of the night and will scare the crap out of you. When we stay at a hotel, we try to stay somewhere that is as comfortable as home or more, this hotel was great.

author: 418christyc
title: Great location, nice modern room
text: This hotel definitely exceeded our expectations! The location was perfect; we were able to walk across the street to KOP Mall, and the Capital Grille is right next to the hotel. Valley Forge Historical Park is also only a short drive away. The property was clean, with a nice fitness center, and our room was well decorated and comfortable. We did get a complimentary suite upgrade, but I would imagine that the other rooms are great, too. Breakfast in the morning was included in the room rate, and was a bit better than your typical hotel fare because they had a build-your-own omelet option. We stayed at this property for 6 nights, and I have to say that the staff was very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again if we are in the area.

author: JIMCHI
title: Great Breakfast
text: We booked a one bedroom suite. Upon arrival we found that ALL of the one bedroom suites are connecting rooms. Years of bad experiences (noise from adjoining room) with connecting rooms forced us to take a studio room instead. It's hard to believe that a hotel would have ALL of its suite connecting to other rooms. The studio was OK but a bit small. The front desk tried to tell me that the studio was the same price as the one bedroom I had reserved. After we got to the room and checked Hyatt.com we found that to be totally untrue and there was a substantial difference. I had to go back down to request that they adjust the rate. I've given the hotel a 4 star rating only because of the terrific breakfast, the made to order omelets in particular. The lack of non-connecting rooms would have made it a 3 star otherwise.

author: sgc1224
title: Oversold my prepaid room
text: I prepaid for my room three weeks ago and was astonished when I arrived and they simply said oh we have moved you to the Holiday Inn Express, it is a comparable property. Suffice it to say, it wasn't a comparale property. They then lied to me and told me that there were no hotels in all of Philadelphia at any price. One phone call and I found a room which they did agree to pay for. It was late in the evening and we were exhausted so even though we ended up at a nice place it still wasn't worth the hassle and consternation. If you prepay a room, isn't it yours? How can they sell it twice? Horrible practice and I will never ever stay at the Hyatt chain again.

author: 104ericc
title: Great place
text: We stayed at Hyatt House when we recently visited Philadelphia to see the historical sights. Hyatt House was clean and comfortable. The pool and spa area was great for our family. The hotel seems relatively new. It is next to the mall and many good dining options. We received a complimentary buffet with our stay. The buffet was great! If we return to the Philly area someday, I would definitely consider staying at Hyatt House again.

author: BethRossi
title: Excellent
text: Everything about this property is excellent. Spacious, clean rooms. Comfortable beds. Near freeway but limited noise. Nice pool. Delicious breakfast with omelette station. Great customer service. This was our second stay. Family friendly but upscale - don't bring noisy kids.

author: JEFFYG10
title: A step above a Marriott Residence Inn
text: Very well layed out hotel. "Green" lighting system with a "room key" slot that "saves" lights from being left on when you're not in the room. Spacious, modern bath and shower. Spacious kitchen/ living area. Very comfy bed! Ice machines are in a seperate room so you never have the dreaded "room by the ice machine" noise. We were a lttle apprehensive walking down the hallway to our room...we could hear conversations emitting from the doorways of several of the rooms. But, inside the room, we weren't disturbed by noise from the adjoining rooms (we also had a 1 bedroom suite, which may have cut down on the noise). Delicious omlette station offered @ breakfast along with a hot breakfast buffet. Will definitely stay again!

author: BostonJandP
title: The best in the area
text: We stayed in a king suite which was very well appointed with a two burner stove, refrigerator with ice maker, toaster, microwave, and coffee maker. There was also plates, cups, and cooking utensils for 4. The bed was one of the most comfortable we have ever had. Breakfast was also one of the best with excellent Starbucks coffee and made to order omelets. The staff was very pleasant and helpful. As it was Villanova's graduation weekend everything in the area was pretty well booked and prices were a little higher than usual. If you are on a tight budget and don't need quite all the amenities there is another Hyatt about a mile away which is almost as good and about $50 a night cheaper. That said, the Hyatt House was certainly worth the price.

author: JJLNY4321
title: Excellent Property
text: First time staying at a Hyatt House. We generally stay at HomeWood by Hilton. This hotel was outstanding. A few differences that we liked was the bar in the lobby and pool table. Geared for the business traveler as well as families. Kids loved the pool table in the lobby. The indoor pool was great as well. Kevin from the front desk was awesome. Excellent service drove us to and from dinner which was a great added bonus.

author: stockgirl75
title: Is This Really A Hyatt? I'd Live Here.
text: Fancy hotels has a lot to learn from the Hyatt House Hotel. Spacious rooms, free breakfast (with omelet station), free wifi, ridiculously friendly staff, a bar, walking distance to The Capital Grille (yum) and one of the better malls in the nation (yeah!). Why would I stay downtown? This is a business travelin' gal's dream of a locale. To be sure, I will be on the lookout for more Hyatt House properties in upcoming trips. Can you transport one of these to Manhattan!??!? Ask for the fourth floor. LOVE the extra height in the ceiling.

author: Rmcrawford05
title: This hotel has everything.
text: I stayed at the Hyatt House for work for a few weeks. Everything about this hotel exceeded my expectations. First of all, the rooms are spacious, and the bed was extremely comfortable. This was important to me because of working long hours. The room was very clean, and even had a mini kitchen with full refrigerator, small stove, and dishwasher. The breakfast was outstanding - they had a staff member making omlettes! All employees were extremely friendly and accomodating. I did my laundry with the coin machines on-site. I was here for work, but would definitely recommend the hotel for families, couples or groups visiting the area for fun!

author: dawnyjackson64
title: Gorgeous hotel convenient to everything!
text: We stayed overnight at this hotel for just a quick getaway. We usually stay out Bensalem but i wanted to try someplace different. So glad i choose this hotel it was absolutely beautiful and smack in the middle of everything. Plenty of restaurants to choose from and the hotel has a shuttle that will take you within a 5 mile of the hotel. The hotel has free breakfast with a made to order omelet station. The only negative i have is that we only planned to stay 1 night. We will definately return but will stay at least 2 nights. We booked the 1 bedroom 2 room suite.

author: Kristy_Burns
title: Great find!
