text: This hotel is so convenient to the King of Prussia Mall. The decor is modern and very clean for the price. I felt like I was in a ritzy hotel without the ritzy price. They have a cocktail lounge that you can have drinks or a bite to eat at and the decor in the lounge area makes you feel like you are in a club in the city. They have a free continental breakfast in the morning that was great. They had french toast, eggs, sausage, and a build your own omlette bar. There is also an indoor pool, hot tub and fitness center. We only stayed one night, but I wish we could've stayed longer.

author: MarkS614
title: A quiet, well-run hotel in a very busy mega-mall area
text: My wife and I have stayed at this hotel twice (4 nights in June, 2012 and 1 night in December, 2012). It is right behind the King of Prussia Mall on Mall Drive. It is new within the past few years and is very comfortable, quiet, clean, and moderately price. The staff is very friendly and they serve a very good buffet breakfast included in the room price. There is a well-maintained fitness center plus a small indoor pool. The rooms are average-sized with very comfortable beds and 42-inch flat panel TVs (no movies on demand or DVD players, though). The hotel seems business oriented but families are staying there also. Decor is ultra-modern urban dark, not my taste, but very widespread now.

author: pickylady35
title: Excellent Stay
text: Great hotel! Great staff, nice hotel, pretty clean, free parking, good location etc. My only complaint, I left note for housekeeping to change sheets and vaccuum but he/she did not do so. That irritated me. Other than that obvious oversight it was a good stay. I will say that I stayed during the holiday but still service should not go down because of that. Again, very nice place, I hope they do not let people trash it because this will be my go to hotel every time I visit family. Generally, Phila. area hotels leave a lot to be desired. Thanks for an overall good stay.

author: JerseyboyCaligirl
title: A return visit confirms excellent rating.
text: We had a king room with kitchenette. Very clean, stylish and comfortable. The bed was extremely comfortable and cushy. My only complaint is that they should provide one of those new absorbent bath mats for stepping out of the shower. The door sends a cascade of water that soon pools. The towel mat is not sufficient. We love the made to order omelets each morning. Breakfast is complimentary. We needed a couple days to relax and recharge and Hyatt House is the place to go. Very close to the mall and movie theater as well.

author: 371JayK
title: Pet friendly and peaceful.
text: My wife and I stayed here for a little weekend getaway. The location is perfect if you are a shopper, but is actually a little irritating to get in and out of if like us, you didn't want to go to the mall. However, they get bonus points for being the only pet friendly place around that area. We spent the day hiking at Valley Forge with our corgi. All of us were beat when we reached the hotel, so the big shower and large cloud-like bed were a welcome sight! Aside from our dog barking at the sound of people in the hallway, we all slept great. Outdoor fire pits, amazing FREE breakfast, dog "potty" area, really made this place stand out. it's a bit pricey and expect to pay an additional $150 if you bring a k-9 companion. Still, I highly recommend!

author: 418DavidD
title: Clean spacious rooms and excellent breakfast
text: Stayed at the Hyatt House and was nicely surprised to have a wonderful room with a refrigerator, stove, and spacious shower. Yeah the shower was nice and big, could be nice for a couple. The location is right in the King of Prussia mall. The bed and pillows are soft and homey. If you are on vacation or work as I was, I found the hotel to be an oasis. Take the hotel up on their free shuttle service to area attractions. This saves on finding a place to park, navigating unfamiliar roads, and allows you to enjoy a bit of wine with no worries. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Jill2Travel
title: Consistent, comfortable and convenient
text: I have now stayed three times at this hotel and will retun. The rooms are modern, clean and comfortable. The beds are particularly good. The location is very convenient being a very short walk to the famous shopping mall. Food options are limited but it is near several restaurants with the excellent but pricey Capital Grille right opposite. For a longer stay try a suite - they have a well equipped small kitchen. Staff are very welcoming and helpful and there is a free shuttle service. Very good value overall.

author: PHOTOG3513
title: "Stay here when you go to King of Prussia!"
text: Awesome place to stay! Clean,modern and comfortable. Rob and Mathew at the front desk were friendly and helpful! Have never had such wonderful service at a front desk. Was origanally going to stay just one night but loved it so much we came back for another. The room was beautiful and well taken care of. Loved the walk in shower! Then to finish a great stay you have a wonderful breakfast! Everyone was so friendly, even the women making omeletes took the time to talk and smile! we will stay here again on our next trip to King of Prussia!!

author: ToddB47
title: Nicest hotel in King of Prussia
text: We stayed at the Hyatt House King of Prussia for pleasure on a trip to the mall. This is a great option for doing just that. It's conveniently located within walking distance of the mall. The hotel itself is about a year old so it's in great shape, clean and well cared for. Our King room was large enough and the bathroom was very nice. The staff was helpful and friendly. We didn't use room service or any meals at the hotel. This is definitely the place to stay in King of Prussia and we'll be there again soon.

author: Bladerunner30
title: LOVED OUR STAY!!!
text: We loved every part of our stay! The staff was very helpful and friendly, the room was very modern and clean. I love the fact that that they have a complementary hot and cold breakfast, and trust me the breakfast wasn't just acceptable, it was fantastic! They had a breakfast buffet that had everything from cold cereal to eggs and pancakes. They also had someone there that custom made your omelette to your specification. The lounge was very nice, with a pool table, fire place and bar. They have an indoor pool which is nice because weather is never an issue and the Jacuzzi next to the pool was a nice touch. Location was great, there is a huge mall across the road and a lot of food places in the area, including a great sea food place right next to the hotel called Joe's Crab Shack. We were only about 25 or 30 minutes from Philadelphia which was nice because we made multiple trips to the city. Overall, me and my family's experience there was fantastic and if we ever plan to visit the Philadelphia area again, this is the only hotel we will considerer staying at.

author: Moosinator
title: Superb
text: This is always a good experience. Spotless. Nice staff. Great breakfast. And comfortable mattresses. Love it here. We have stayed here half a dozen times and will continue to do so. I am very impressed at how spotless it is.

author: BillL451
title: Second Stay and Excellent Place to Stay in KoP
text: my new go to place in KoP. Its really a Hyatt branded Residence Inn BUT much better. They have standard hotel rooms or ones with Fridge, MIcrowave, Stove, etc. Very big rooms with very big HD LCD TV's. Its very close to the new Wegmans for shopping and all the other resturants around the KoP Mall; Its right next to Eat at Joes but the new Capital Grill is walking distance. The breakfast is better than most. I did not choose the Omlette station but the hot breakfast was very good. Great and friendly staff. And, the price was very good for KoP area. I am a Marriott person, for the most part, but trading in the Fairfield Inn for KoP Hyatt House.

author: kiawah
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: We stayed here for several nights while on summer vacation with our kids. We love the atmosphere and all the neat outdoor touches (grill, firepits, outside seating). I hate being stuck in a hotel room so enjoyed being able to sit outside. The room was huge and perfect for travelling with the kids. We really did not cook but the regular size fridge, cooktop and dishwasher would be perfect if you wanted to. Breakfast was a step above the normal complimentary breakfast. I will gladly look for this type of Hyatt in the future. Loved it!

author: joflohayes
title: Much more
text: of everything. From room design/decore to hotel amenities, all were beyond what I was prepared for. First of all, I fell in love with my room . . . it reminded me of a super nice, NewYork style, efficiency apartment. I didn't want to leave it. But when I did, the hotel lobby lured me as well, with its plentifull breakfast menu to the afternoon happy hour to the mini-food store, plus all the usual hotel comforts. And, not to be overlooked is the superb staff who were very helpful and efficient, and even acknowledged me by name everytime I walked by.

author: a_mom23
title: Yes!
text: A beautiful modern and clean property. Professional, friendly, and ample front desk staff made for a quick check in and a feeling of security at the main entrance. The king studio room was well equipped in all areas except be aware that there is only one chair for the desk/table... in case you are a couple planning to eat a meal. The couch with coffee table ottoman is a comfortable option for eating or relaxing in front of the huge flat screen TV. The bed was very comfortable and the room was quiet and easily darkened by the sleek window treatments.The morning breakfast buffet was highlighted by the made-to-order omelet station but could have benefited from two chefs, since the line got very long due to some guests ordering multiples for family members. There are so many nearby restaurants, it was hard to choose and The MALL is right across the street. We will be looking for Hyatt House properties for future travel!

author: 2CatherineS
title: Clean and quiet - good value.
text: We were here for two nights visiting family in the area. We were traveling with my 90 year old mother who had a very large comfortable handicapped accessible room in a quiet location which we had requested. My husband and I had a king suite. Good stay, all requests were answered promptly and courteously. Didn't love the breakfast and they seemed to have trouble keeping up with a busy weekend. We would have liked some more healthy choices - lots of sugar in everything, nothing whole grain, bananas were so green you couldn't eat them. However a good value overall - we would definitely go back. One caution. There was no way to shut down the air conditioning/heating system which kicked on and off all night. Can be disturbing to sleep.

author: RDE411
title: Good Location & Great for business trips.
text: Stayed here for 6 nights on a business trip in the area. Room was spacious with a Fridge, Microwave, hob and dishwasher, however I did not use these. Bed was very comfortable and enjoyed some good nights sleep. However traffic was busy on the highway outside so I would suggest requesting a room away from the highway side. Wifi was free and signal of good quality Hotel has a very basic and limited bar menu, however due to the hotels location, this did not pose a problem as lots of good places to eat in the area. Hotel is directly across from the King of Prussia Mall and hotel offers a shuttle service to local area's. Staff were very friendly. Point to note, the hotel bar only opens from 5pm to 10pm and is closed on Sunday's. There is no room service available, Breakfast is basic, and the queue for the omlette station can be lengthy. Downside at breakfast also is plastic glasses are provided for juice.

author: Adventures0fAandL
title: Very Pleased
text: My 3 daughters and I stayed here for a pre-Christmas shopping weekend. The staff at the front desk and the room were excellent. Had I known how nice the kitchen was we would have brought more snacks/groceries and eaten in a few times. We all loved the room - trendy and very comfortably appointed with sofa, good lights for reading and a large flat screen TV. The beds were comfy with nice linnen. The breakfast was very good and we especially enjoyed the outdoor firepit near the bar. The food and beverage waitstaff seemed overwhelmed several times but I believe that was because the hotel had just opened a week or two prior to our stay, so, of course, everyone was new on the job. Very happy with our stay and will certainly return.

author: RollOnYouBears
title: Great Value
text: The Hyatt House (formerly Hotel Sierra) is a new 5 story (ground + 4) property next to the King of Prussia Mall and not far from the Valley Forge Monument. Easy to get to from the highway and took about 35 - 40 min north of the Philly Airport. Looks like a version of a W Hotel or another upscale place. Almost all the rooms have a kitchenette in them with pots and pans, dishes, etc and a dishwasher so great when you get tired of the typical road food. Kingsize bed was super comfy and the TV was a 50 flatscreen LCD type. Nice bar on the main level complete with pool table (I think it was a Brunswick), a great breakfast room and buffet (custom omelet) and a fine pool and exercise equip. The workers seem nice too. My boss says they always remember his name (if that matters to you) I think it was great value since the room was once of the cleanest and most comfortable I have ever stayed in but was only $110

author: mrsjetsetter
title: Great location and service!!!!
text: We went with 3 couples for an overnight for our 30th anniversary to shop at the King of Prussia Mall, have dinner locally, and then headed to Atlantic City next day. Booked directly with the hotel and found excellent prices for our 3 room ( king beds). Andrea checked us in and after we settled into our rooms she had called each of our rooms and asked us how we liked our rooms and if there was anything we needed. That was a first for us to be asked how our room was and the hotel and rooms felt really new. Very modern decor, good size shower and comfortable bed. They even had a shuttle that runs you over to the mall across the street , no need to fight for parking spaces. Just call the hotel for a pick up when you're finished shopping. Breakfast the next morning was plentiful with hot and cold items. The only thing I would recommend is to have 2 people fixing the omelets to avoid a long line. Would definitely be back if I am returning to this shopping mall again.

author: JMcVeigh67
title: Loved this place...will go back whenever I can.
text: My husband and I had to go to King of Prussia for a group celebration and decided to find a place to stay overnight instead of driving home (only about 1 hour away). We are so glad we found this place. From the moment we got there, Andrea at the front desk was extremely courteous and helpful. The room was clean and spacious. The lobby was great to - from the fireplace to the pool table, we loved it. The only constructive criticism I could give would be to have the breakfast buffet better staffed during peak times. The employees that were there were working extremely hard to satisfy all requests, but they only have two arms and two legs and there were A LOT of people evidently hungry around 9.30 on Sunday morning. What we did have was good, but we ended up skipping the omelette station because of the wait (and I was looking forward to that part of the breakfast too...oh well, next time I suppose). So, if you need a place to stay in KoP, this is the place to go.

author: classactforever
title: Great even the critics would agree!! Stayed February 24-26.
text: When you write reviews you should tell something about yourself that way others know the type of person writing the review. I am a business professional, age range 30-35, I've travelled a lot and stayed in many hotels for business and pleasure and make it a point to read trip advisor reviews before selecting a place to visit and a place to stay. Pros: Staff extremely attentive (I'm a Hyatt gold member and my room was upgraded when I got to check in the minute they realized), the rooms are incredible spacious I had a 2 queen suite equipped with kitchenette, 46 inch LCD swivel tv, sofa and an armchair. The bathroom was large with separate sink area, very large closet and enough hangers. Breakfast hot and delicious, omelet station. Surroundings King of Prussia mall right across the street, movie theatre and a myriad of restaurants to chose from and a hop skip and jump from the pa turnpike, easy access to Philadelphia. Decor was modern and crisp very very nice. Con: walls are thin the neighbors next to us were loud and rowdy in fairness the hotel people behave badly but we could hear them clearly through the walls.

author: mrskmom
title: Would Definitely Stay Again
text: Stayed at this hotel (now called Hyatt House) this weekend. Took a roadtrip with my mom and sister for mom's birthday to see the King of Prussia Mall. Stayed in a two queen studio. The room was clean and spacious, and nicely decorated. Front desk staff were very friendly. Breakfast setup in the H bar off the lobby offered a good selection of food, and breakfast staff were efficient and friendly. Location of the hotel couldn't be better. It was right across the street from the mall. Overall a great experience. Would definitely stay again!

author: JerseyboyCaligirl
title: Hotel Sierra is now Hyatt House
text: Thank you fellow reviewers for highlighting this property. It was fantastic! We stayed there this weekend and loved everything from the contemporary design, comfortable furnishings to the large common area with fireplace and pool table.. They offer a complimentary reception in the evening where they serve beer and wine and a complimentary breakfast that is, hands down, the best we've seen with scrambled eggs, bacon, biscuits and gravy, waffles, fruit and cereal and...made to order omelets. I was able to get an egg white omelet with veggies. My husband said the blueberry muffins were the best he'd ever eaten. We checked out the pool and fitness area and noticed they even have a coin laundry area (with a little counter area where you could be on your laptop while you wait- free wifi). Large workout room with lots of equipment.

author: zenexplorer2
title: New Property - Great Staff and Very Service Oriented Staff; Some Minor Physical Issues
text: This property is stylish and very well appointed, with a "moderate hip" sensibility. The staff was extremely friendly, helpful, and service oriented. The room (in our case a one bedroom suite with kitchenette) was spacious and well designed, and the complimentary breakfast was well-presented and tasty, with omelets made to order. The Hotel Sierra (now a part of Hyatt) is adjacent to the massive King of Prussia mall, with easy access to the highway. The heating system in the room was a bit slow to provide warm air (it never got particularly warm). This may be a technical glitch as the property is only weeks old at the time of this review, or the result of modern energy management technology. Lastly, the room was subject to some intrusive external noise, though I am rather noise-sensitive, and II suspect this varies by room location. Overall this property offers an attractive and stylish facility, a gracious and welcoming team, and a convenient location for many.

author: andiamo123
title: Excellent Hotel!!
text: We recently stayed overnight while on a holiday shopping weekend. in the past, it had been difficult to find a nice hotel near the mall. This year we were pleasantly surprised to find the Sierra! The rooms are spacious, clean and very comfortable. The complimentary breakfast was a nice bonus!! I would definitely return whenever in the King of Prussia area as it was very conveniently located and close to the mall! Two thumbs up!! Give it a try!!

author: Tonylayandro
title: Great hotel, great location
text: Stayed at absolute bangla for 7 days. Great location. Located in patong. Bars, restaurants, night markets and the beach are all within walking distance from the hotel. Room was clean, cozy and tidy. Room rate also acceptable. Staffs were nice, approachable and helpful. Will definitely stay there again when in Phuket.

author: justenef
title: perfect location
text: What can I say. This motel is nestled just off Bangla Road. Perfect place, close to all the bars and shopping center, short walk to Patong Beach. Best bed I have ever slept in, double glazed windows which makes it very quiet. Spa on the balcony. I was very satisfied with the quality and class of this Motel. Staff are fantastic and very helpful. wonderful rooftop pool. Loved loved loved it. Can't wait to return for our next holiday.

author: 903alainea
title: 7 Day Holiday
text: We were greeted at the airport and transfered to out Resort just off Bangla Rd. The staff that greeted us were very pleasant and since we were too early they checked our bags and off we went exploring until 2pm, when we could enter our room. Our room was on the far side away from Bangla rd and we had no outside noise at all. The room was maintained everyday. A standard in our room every day was 2 bottles of water. After a few days we were upgraded to a penthouse suite with was bigger as it had a loungroon/kitchen and a bedroom ensuite and a spa on the balcony. everything was amazing and well catered. the staff were very friendly and always willing to please. We will go back and stay againg.

author: G0hH
title: If you don't mind the price.
text: Very good. Comes with big bathroom with Jacuzzi. Simple kitchen complete with oven and microwave. Bed very comfortable. If only you can get extra pillows that would be wonderful. They also provide you dvd movies for free. Location is right in Bangla road. Food and entertainment is endless unless you on budget holiday.

author: jatinp973
title: Good location, good staff but timeshare
text: One star for the location. In middle of all the party scenes. Good for party lovers bad for families. One star for the services.especially the reception staff. Rooms=ok, nothing extraordinary,dark and need renovation.food=climax restaurant, too expensive, staff again good. Timeshare= Not 90mins but about 5 hours, aggressive marketing. Felt humiliated by comments from the sales person.but happy that I didn’t take the membership. Overall not bad but could have been better without timeshare.

author: 294dylanp
title: Family holiday
text: Great location just off Bangla road. Near patong beach. Close to large shopping district. Rooms very clean and serviced daily. Climax resturant excellent. Bar staff excellent and friendly. Poppy makes best cocktails. Nice swimming pool for children.

author: 127cc
title: Check the fine print
text: This is a time share situation which was not told to us upfront. We thought we were getting a good deal at a good establishment however it wasn't a the case at all. After two days of traveling and arriving at midnight we checked in successfully. At 830 am the telephone rings off the hook asking us to meet in the lobby for a briefing of tourist info. I told the lady that I was on vacation and wanted to sleep in and we need to reschedule our meeting for the next day. The next day I was told I was disrespect for missing the meeting the following day. This is when I started to realize this was a time share situation. We were told that if we didn't go to another property for a tour that our credit card would be charged a crazy amount of money. We decided to go to the presentation however when we got to the property they had us eat lunch which then turned around and gave us a bill. This place is a scam and not what it appears, please be warned.

author: ruthtaylor93
title: Trip away
text: Great location, maybe a 2 minute walk to the beach. Never had any noise issues from busy Bangla Rd. Our room was at the front and never heard anything. Shopping, eating, more shopping. Don't think we walked more then 10 minutes to anything, more a leisurely stroll! The staff were all lovely, very friendly and welcoming. Had dinner at the roof top restaurant a few times and each meal was wonderful. The suite we had was very roomy and having the spa outside on the balcony was good. Rooms were cleaned each day to a very high standard. I would stay there again and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it.

author: JoolsAustralia
title: A1
text: The staff at Absolute Bangla Suites are extremely friendly,fun happy and efficient in their service. Nothing is too much of a problem for the staff and they are very eager to help. The rooms are extremely clean, modern and spacious. If you are thinking of staying in Phuket we highly recommend to stay at Absolute Banlga Suites. The location is excellent, central to the heart of Patong. It is very close to the beach and main shopping complex. All in easy walking distance. You will be very happy if you stay at Absolute Bangla Suites.

author: Marius_and_Johann
title: Party Location
text: Located just a few meters from the famous buzing Bangla road, this is an ideal location for the young and retless! The staff is helpfull and fliendly and they will always do what ever they can to assist you. The colour scheme of the hotel might not be to everyone's liking, but that is about the only negative. The beds are huge and firm. The mid size refrigerator is very convenient if you choose to go the self-catering way. Relax in you own Jacuzzi bath in the bathroom every night or take a refreshing shower. Double-glazed sliding doors keep all the noise out and thick curtains will keep the room dark if you need to get a few more hours sleep during the day. The pool on the rooftop is a welcome retreat after a warm day out, which alo has it's built-in jacuzzi We enjouyed a few complimentary meals at the restaurant but chose to eat at the markets and elsewhere as it is a bit expensive. Just keep in mind that if you rent a scooter or vehicle, that Bangla road is closed off at about 18H00 every night for the daily street party and you will have to push your scooter to the hotel.

author: 358tiagon
title: Close to everyhthing and calm and quite at the same time
text: I spent one week in Absolute Bangala Suites and i had an amazing time there. The quality of the bed is very good. I could sleep very well and comfortable. There is no noise coming from the outside of the room that i could hear. The pool with Jacuzzi and the restaurant/bar on the top of the building ate the cherry on the top of the cake. Great place to enjoy beach. Bangala walking street buzz and in my case also very well located in Phuket to get to the amazing golf course Phuket has. I want to be back.

author: piggywills
title: Convenient for Bangla road
text: The room was fairly reasonable.. 150 aud. the main issue I had was that the air con did not work and the room was absolutely boiling. I also found the staff to be fairly rude and not very helpful at all. They wouldn't even provide us with a towel at the swimming pool and there were none in the room! Really helpful. On the plus side... happy hour has very cheap drinks and if you want to party in Bangla then a great spot. Overall pretty good but have stayed at lots of different places and definitely felt a complete lack of hospitality here.

author: hosseinj2013
title: Absolutely perfect!!
text: Stayed here for 7 nights. The staffs were amazing so helpful and respectful. The room was fabulous. The hotel restaurant was really good with reasonable price. It is in a perfect location. However, the street were the hotel located was a bit disappointing (not clean). But, everything changed when you enter to the hotel (clean with great decoration. We can find everything in the room (large fridge, oven, microwave, cooktop, all sort of cooking facilities). Rooftop Pool and bar were perfect. Definitely recommended.

author: PieterB461
title: Dec Stay
text: Absolute Bangla is an ABSOLUTE must for the traveler, that want to be in the absolute heart of EVERYTHING. Their rooms are spacious, luxurious apartments. We even had a Private Jacuzzi in our room. Party Galore is less than 100m away in Bangla Road. You are close to shopping mall and all the street markets. Fine dining just go to the roof for the Klimax Restaurant. Swimming pool on roof top for relaxing. From 16:00 - 19:00 every evening the bar have happy hour, where you will probably get the cheapest drinks in Patong.

author: glburatowski
title: Great Location and staff
text: This hotel may be boutique but there is a lot to like about it. As an owner of a unit share I stayed on level 1 in a large room with kitchenette lounge and spa bath. It was close to all the night life and beaches and Jungcelyon shopping centre. Markets were all walking distances. Access to other hotels was perfect. Amenities at this hotel were excellent and and the staff at reception were very helpful and accomodating. A guard was present at all times. Thank you to staff for making my family welcome . Taxi assistance was free and useful.

author: aliciaashton01012016
title: Brilliant service ... beautiful rooms
text: We came back from Thailand last week, it's the 2nd time me and my husband have stayed here together and this time we went on a couples holiday with our friends and was at Bangla suites for 2 weeks. I can not thank the staff enough for being so kind and welcoming. Especially Mauy on reception, she truly went above and beyond to ensure we had a fantastic stay and was fully satisfied at all times. Mauy and Mim and the rest of the team are truly lovely and make you feel at home from the minute you walk in. The rooms are very modern and extremely well presented they are very clean and very quiet considering how close they are to the night life. I would recommend to friends and family and will 100% return again! It's in a perfect location for a fab break In Thailand so close to both the beach and night life also surrounded by market and close to access to all day trips. Absolute Bangla suites gets a 10 out of 10 from us every time Mr and Mrs Ashton

author: 653fionar
title: All about location
text: My husband and I stayed for 1 week on a voucher deal. If you are looking for a hotel (rather than resort) that is close to all of the Patong Beach action, then this is a great option as it is situated in an alley off Bangla. We had a studio suite on the ground floor which was good and unbelievably quiet! Whilst the apartment style room itself is not large it is clean and well maintained. Reception staff were really good and nothing was too much trouble. Whilst we had no meals at the Climax restaurant, the roof top bar and pool was good. Best was that between 5 - 8pm they had beer and cocktail of the day for 50 baht each which was fabulous value. Lifts are being renovated so it was a bit of a hike up the stairs but worth it when you arrived. Free wifi throughout the hotel but it was a bit hit and miss. As we had a voucher deal the value of the apartment for a week was awesome.

author: JohanO492
title: Real unpleasant surprise for sophisticated traveller
text: This is a place for those who like the seedy type of late nights and revelry. It is located in an alleyway off the main "party" street of Patong. Very noisy at night and PLEASE NOTE only 25% of the rooms actually have a view, the rest look straight into walls of adjacent buildings that have not seen paint for a decade or two! Not the place for the more sophisticated traveller. What was really disappointing, however, was the inability (perhaps ignorant) treatment we got when we asked for alternative accommodation elsewhere in the proliferation of Absolute resorts here. No can do. For a company with so many resources, it shows a scant disregard of good customer service. (They had the opportunity to make a few extra "bucs" out of me for alternative accommodation, even had a chance to sell me some timeshare). Blew it in a spectacular display of ignorance. What a shame!

author: Zeeroo
title: Close to everything and loads of space
text: For some reason we were upgraded to a penthouse, which was marvelous! We had two opening windows & a great view from the bedroom window. The staff were friendly & helpful and the rooms were spacious & comfortable. We did notice quite a bit of wear & tear but nothing that affected our stay. Climax restaurant was lovely with the roof top pool, and the staff were very helpful - the salmon was delicious. I attended the towel folding and the fruit/veg carving which was awesome! The property is so close to everything, which we loved, and yet was not too noisy given the roaring night life just 50m away! All in all we had a great stay and will definitely go back. The 'Vegas' style decor was not really my cup of tea but it suited the property and the minor disadvantages of being in the busy centre are far outweighed by being so close to the hub of Patong. My holiday is shopping, beach & nightlife - and all of those 3 are within a couple of minutes of the hotel!!

author: 274storms
title: Excellent
text: Stayed for 1 week everything about this place was excellent. outside the timeshere quiet noisy as to be expected as it's just off bangla road but inside very quiet can't here the club's. It's a very nice neat place best I have found in Thailand. We had a dubble room with 2 dubble beds each with own large flat screen TV and DVD player free Internet all over but bad signel when u did have signel very fast. Had a fun minor mantenince issues witch we told reception about were fixed quickly and hassle free. All staff very helpfull and friendly. Rooftop pool very nice a clean with mini waterfall great views from up there bar very good if u go there between 5 and 8 half price very cheep. would stay there again anytime loved it.

author: E1958XCstephens
title: Excellent stay
text: Enjoyed a seven night visit to this excellent accomodation right in the centre of Bangla Road. The staff were friendly and had a great grasp of the English language. The hotel had a wonderful fragrance of lemon grass upon entry and we were met with cold towels and a refreshing fruit drink. The room was clean and maintained very well. I had read reports that the noise from Bangla Road could be heard at night time but only found the slightest of noise which became less noticeable as the stay progressed. The food on offer on the roof top was of good standard and was not over priced. The bed was comfortable compared to other hotels we have stayed at in Thailand. The bar on the corner of the hotel entrance is full of wonderful and friendly staff and adds a bonus if you have to many drinks as it is only 30 metres from home. Overall a very good stay and would recommend this accomodation if you want to be in the heart of Bangla Road and within close proximity to everything.

author: GraceAds
title: Very disappointed
text: We recently stayed at the Absolute Bangala Suites through a time share deal we had. We were utterly disappointed with everything about our stay here... The online photos are very misleading, the hotel is cheap and I would rate it a 2 star accommodation. When we arrived we were shocked as the photos had looked so promising.. We were assigned a room on the ground floor, with the night clubs right outside our room... We requested a room on a higher floor, willing to pay more for an upgrade, however we were told there was nothing they could do and treated us terribly because we were 'time share customers'. We were horrified at how we were treated throughout our stay. During our time here, the furniture in our room was changed when the cleaners made up our room, and a few of our personal possessions 'went missing'. When we reported this to the front desk they didn't seem concerned and didn't compensate in any way. I would defiantly not recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: ColetteKirk
title: You too can be a Bangla Rd attraction.
text: Something we didn't expect - be mindful that the bathroom glass can be seen through. My partner went downstairs whilst I was showering and could see everything by looking through our first level window. When mentioned to an Absolute sales rep, he said...well, it is Phuket. Good location if you want to be where the action is. If noise bothers you, ask to be on the quieter side. The rooms are lovely (we had to move part way through our stay due to a plumbing issue). The bed and pillows are super comfortable! Staff are helpful...most have enough english to get by. Food in the restaurant upstairs is really nice. Pool is nice.

author: 618renaem
title: Very very Average!
text: The location of this hotel is great, it is so close to everything! Some might dislike that the hotel is on the party street of patong but I am not a party person & it did not bother me at all. I was actually surprised that I could not hear all the noise from my room. Besides the location everything else was very average! What i am extremely disappointed about is that one night I took off my gold diamond necklace & placed it inside my bag, I was going to put it in the safe but it totally slipped my mind. The next day after the cleaners had made up my room I was trying to find it, I literally turned my room upside down & it was no where. I spoke to the hotel management about the stole necklace and they did NOTHING at all to help me. I was shocked & very upset. It was my fault for not putting the necklace in the safe straight away but I would like to think that cleaners would not go through my bag & take something that is not theirs! Anyways, you can find great hotels in Patong for the price of this hotel or even cheaper!!!!

author: Simsmile
title: Don't waste your time or money!!
text: Am SO disappointed with this 'resort'. Been here only 4 days & just can't wait for the week to be over. As an absolute member I really expect more & this experience has just confirmed why I will never pay them a cent more & upgrade my membership. I can't help but feel this is punishment for not purchasing the upgrade they spent 5+hrs trying to convince me to purchase last week. I was very tempted & seriously considering it since our first week at Twin Sands was lovely (despite some less then desirable construction noise which I we happy to overlook as I understand the area is still developing) however the timing is just not right (currently in between jobs) and thought I would upgrade as soon as my financial position improved. This experience at Bangala Suites however makes me never want to return to Phuket!! No point in reiterating what every other negative reviewer has said other then to agree with it all. Noisy, dirty, 'Vegas style' accommodation that is uncomfortable & very unenjoyable.

author: dahenwood
title: Wish we were younger
text: The position of the apartment block is not the best and is accessed off the famous Bangla Road which is very vibrant at night. The position of our bedroom was on noisy side of the building next to loud...ish music which goes on until 4.00am....next time I will ask for a room on the quiet side. The one bedroom apartment was pleasantly spacious, well decorated with all the necessities in the kitchen area. The staff were wonderful throughout and very obliging and the roof top pool, bar and restaurant provided seclusion from the surroundings. The food was excellent and value for money with staff with smiles of their faces all the time. For a couple of our age (65-70) and our first visit to Thailand, the experience of the Patong area was quite acceptable as there is lots to do and see in the surrounding areas. For those of us from Britain where fruit is not always juicy and sweet as it should be, the supermarket is full of succulent fruit. I will probably return someday for the continuous sunshine as Scotland does not have much throughout the year..

author: jmorgan29
title: Warm and friendly service - fantastic
text: This was out first trip to Phuket and it was fabulous. The hotel staff are very friendly and helpful. The rooms very chic, roof top bar and pool, very relaxing and a great place to have some happy hour cocktails. Shopping - side walk markets and the shopping centre at your door. We are not party people and I was concerned about the noise etc but it was fine, maybe if you are on the side joining the clubs next door you may get the vibrations. The only annoying thing about the trip is being hassled by people working for Absolute (and other hotels )in the street giving you 'scratch and win cards' - it's time share. .. we did not participate and the in house 'sales guys' have some arrogance about them to.

author: lizmac01
title: Good if you like hustle and bustle
text: Stayed for a week in a junior suite, lovely big room living room, separate bedroom and a bathroom with huge bath tub. But no balcony. Luckily our room was at the back of the hotel, go for even numbers if you want a chance of sleeping. Great hotel if you are looking to be right in the thick of everything, Bangla Road is not everyone's cup of tea, but is definitely worth a look. Close to beach, shopping, restaurants and nightlife. Do not book into this hotel if you are looking for a beach resort with views and a quiet nights sleep. With its red and black decor it is certainly not thai in theme, but clean and very modern. Restaurant was very good but a bit pricy. Staff very friendly and very helpful. All in all a good city centre hotel.

author: scottaus46
title: Great location
text: I was lucky enough to have a friend stay here and I stayed over 1 night. Could not complain about anything. The staff were friendly and helpfull at all times. The climax restaurant is a little bit more expensive than other places but it is worth it. Wasn't small portions but wanted more after purely because it was sooooo nice. The room was spacious and we didn't have any problems with noise even though we were facing Bangla rd. clean linen and the room was serviced daily (to a high standard) Shower pressure was my only problem the water was very hot but depending when you showered the pressure would change but I have had this problem on many hotels and I just accept it (life is too short to worry about little things)I hope to get the special rates that people keep talking about ($184 for a week) even prepared to sit through a time share meeting if I have to. Hope to stay here in sept for 2 weeks. Awaiting an email response. You will love this place.

author: Steasssya
title: Terrible service.
text: Stayed here for a week, booked the jacuzzi suite on the balcony, balcony was facing the main road (bangla road) where there are many clubs on the road, so jacuzzi had no privacy whatsoever, did not even have any screen covers/blinds on balcony to cover jacuzzi area, did not show that in photos or was aware of it, didn't use the jacuzzi once due to this. Would ask for towels from reception, the staff would be very rude in regards to it and we had to always wait an hour for it and also had to pick it up ourselves rather than the towels get sent to our room which was of our inconvenience, toilet tissue had the same problem. We stayed with free breakfast inclusive, free breakfast menu was very minimal (4 choices and small servings), first time round was good, a few days later they changed their policy on letting us replace food choices. Also, food isn't cooked properly. Everytime we'd ask reception a question they'd mumble under their breath and make us feel very uncomfortable. Shower keeps going hot and cold randomly, and also wouldn't stop running even after we finished for about 2-3 mins so you could continuously hear drops. And finally, the elevators were down. Apart from the negatives, the only positive thing I can say about this hotel is that the location is great, close to everything and on the main road, however, at night, being on the main road, it is very loud and music wouldn't stop until 5:30am. Other than that, all in all our stay was terrible due to the service, we had just come back from bangkok which had the best service ever and to come to this was just horrible. Would not stay here again and definitely wouldn't recommend it.

author: Wen87
title: Absolutely Terrible Stay !
text: 1 week before my stay, I sent an email to Absolute Bangla Suites requesting for airport transfer and I received an reply email from their marketing department that they have arranged for the airport transfer when I arrived. However, to my dismay, there was no vehicle waiting for me and when I tried to contact the hotel, they say they received no request of airport transfer and told me to make my way to the hotel. I would expect the very least that they could offer for the airport transfer but sadly no. In room jacuzzi was dirty with dust all over and I had to clean it throughly before using it. More outreagous was that during the 2nd night of stay, the housekeeping cleaned up my room and when I return in the evening, there was no clean towels provided, not even one face towel. When I call the housekeeping, they still tell me "Why you call so late !", I was so angry that I hanged up the phone and call the front desk instead. Another issue is during check out, I told them that the air dryer was already in the room when I check in, but the front desk insist that it was different type of air dryer placed in the room and also insist that there was laundry bag provided in the room even though I said don't have. They still dare to give me those despise look as though I am a thief. This is absolutely ridiculous and I will never stay there again !

author: amation
title: Schizophrenic, but OK
text: Had a couple of nights here recently during a business trip. The place seems to lack identity and the market segmentation seems really odd! The hotel itself is located at the end of a run down soi off Bangla Road. Being a no go zone for traffic at night can present it's own issues with check in or out at these times. The hotel is modern and comfortable with good bars and common areas. It has a rooftop swimming pool that is surrounded by the restaurant which serves some pretty good international food. If you don't want to venture out it's as good a place as any to while away the evening. The rooms themselves are on the small side but adequate, that said they are comfortable and standard is pretty good, some have Jacuzzi's too! Staff are generally attentive and polite, no issues there.

author: Scview
title: 5 Star exerience on Bangla Road
text: We just enjoyed a weekend at the Bangla Suites resort in Patong, this location is just fantastic - to be able to walk out the front door and down the small private road emerging into the action of Bangla Road is just awesome.. AND then once you've been satisfactorily enteratined on the street its nice to have that 5 star luxury to retreat to and relax. The rooms are quite unique with a red and black theme probably inspired by the excitement of the bars and entertainment nearby - and the blue LED ceiling lighting certainly sets the mood ;) The rooms are clean, modern and well equipped with Jacuzzi, big shower, massive bed, lounge and ipod dock. Also discovered dozens of TV channels on the flat screen TV all in several different langauges. The upstairs roof top pool, bar and restaurant is the best feature of the resort, providing a poolside experience and cold beers whilst watching the afternoon sunset. Only improvement suggestion would be to clean or improve the elevator, the floor is really dirty and it is very slow. Nights can be a little noisy from nearby clubs and pubs but that is to be expected in a location like this. Great location and very sexy, modern resort. Not reccommended for families be great for couples or solo travellers.

author: kiwibrent1968
title: Located right in the heart of the action
text: This hotel is based in a great location if you want to be in easy walking distance of the Bangla Road action and beach, markets, etc. Staff were friendly. The rooftop bar and pool is a great place to hang out and has a two hour happy hour. We didn't particularly like the layout of the hotel room and the bathroom. Our bathroom needed some maintenance work and the 'clean' daily towels often turned up with stains. We stayed on level 2 and the noise from Bangla Road wasn't a problem so long as the bathroom door was closed. The hotel offers free wifi, however, we couldn't get access in our room. We ended up using the hotel Internet in the lobby. The hotel offers large American and English breakfasts on the rooftop for 200 baht - the coffee is incredibly strong. A good kick start to the day!

author: Dabelyea
title: Home away from home
text: Our stay at the Bangla Suites has been a fantastic base location for exploring the sights of Phuket. We have found the staff friendly and attentive and the environment quite relaxing for a location which is bang, smack in the heart of it all. We were impressed with the room and although staying In an odd number - quiet! The pool and bar are fantastic with views to the beach and Bangla Rd. A great spot to watch the nightly fireworks, the lanterns and share a drink with bar staff that care about making your experience a good one. Special thanks go to David and Simon and the girls up at Climax. Food was excellent as well - special compliments to the chef. Overall a great place to stay and I'm sure we'll be back when next in Phuket.

author: nbccollins
title: Great accommodation
text: We had heard various things about staying on Bangla Rd, but spending a week at Absolute Bangla Suites was ideal. We had 2 children and as long as you stay in an even numbered room, you are away from the night club noise. The windows and doors are double glazed so any noise is blocked out while you sleep. The best part is that you are staying in the heart of Patong beach and everything is so accessible and easy to walk to - markets, shopping, the beach, convenience stores, atm's, bars, night clubs, taxis, took tooks. The staff at Absolute Bangla Suites were so friendly and accommodating. They would do anything for you. Your room is seviced every day, with free water bottles supplied each day and the concierge, Jaeb will do anything for you, assisting booking day trips and attending to any requests. There is no fitness centre in the accommodation but when you're on holidays, who wants to exercies!? Would highly recommend your stay here.

author: SammyA138
title: AMAZING!!!
text: If you love classy, 5 star hotels this is the place to stay!! After checking out (did not even stay for 1 night) of Graceland resort & spa we chose to come here... Staying on the ground level in the studio room this room is modern, clean & perfect. Staying here with 4 friends (2 rooms) it is so nice not having to catch a tuk tuk to and from Bangla road every night, the walking distance is so convenient. Nothing less than amazing! They warned us it would be loud, but we fall asleep every night not hearing anything as you can close a glass door that blocks out the noise. Breakfast option is limited but the pool, lunch menu & cocktails on the roof top are awesome! Also free wifi in the rooms is a plus! Special compliments to Jeab, the tour desk & bell captain, he is so helpful & nice!!

author: darrellhilton
title: Smart design, friendly staff + Excellent location in Patong
text: If you want to stay in the vibrant Patong area you can't do better than here. Some reviewers have complained about the noise factor but we found, considering it to be in the heart of the action, surprisingly quiet. As members of Absolute Vacation club we used our weeks entitlement to stay here & were happy with the choice seeing they upgraded us to a suite which was spacious & smartly designed with all mod. cons. The roof top restaurant for breakfast was pleasant [although the menu a bit ordinary] & the pool area next to it we saw nobody use while we were there. The staff were extremely friendly & helpful. One small tip, if you are booking local trips/shows book outside in the street for a better deal than the in house travel desk. Overall though - Recommended.

author: TimothyR818
title: Right in the prime position
text: Beautiful hotel right in the middle of the action on Bangla Rd. The staff are magnificent - particularly the restaurant staff. A late night drink on the top deck is a must. The room was fantastic - highly recommend room 213! Quiet, particularly as it got later, it's away from the street and most of the party noise. Room decked out in red & black with neon lights for mood lighting! Spa was great and the pool on the top deck is awesome. Housekeeping twice a day. Really great option to see Patong at its heart!

author: azrul
title: Love it!!!!
text: We stayed here during our holiday in Phuket and we can't ask for a better place to stay. Yes, it is near to clubs and can be a little bit noisy but maybe we are ok with it. The room was luxurious!!! With jacuzzi at the balcony. There was also a rooftop pool. Very very nice. Location was a short walk to the beach. Also near to Jungceylon Mall. Many places to eat and shop.

author: Bigruss57
title: Great location, right in the heart of Patong -handy to everthing!
text: Stayed here recently for a week. Rooms were very clean, tidy, well furnished. Had large 2 person private spa bath, shower and toilet, Kitchen well equipped if you wish to do any cooking - microwave, full size fridge, hotplates, pots and pans etc Serviced twice daily - fully cleaned/beds made in the morning, beds turned down and tidy up in the evening.Towels changed daily - even beach towels provided as well. Hotel colour scheme amused us somewhat - a bit porn style we thought...with the red and black, plus blue ceiling mood lighting lol Location is great!! You are in the heart of it all...really close to everything, night life/bars, 100's of restaurant/eatery choices, mini mart, the beach, shopping - both street/market vendors and upmarket shopping malls. A great rooftop pool and spa with a nice restaurant and bar- nice views from up here -especially at night. Happy hour by the pool 4.30 -6.30pm with half price drinks each night is great. Hotel staff were fantastic -very friendly, helpful with great service. Would quite happily stay here again - just request a room further back from the street entry side - to minimize the nightlife noise...it's only real down side.

author: chad_watson
title: Absolutely the way to have a holiday!
text: Absolute Bangla Suites are great! A comfortable Kingsize bed, large flat screen TV, dvd player and hot-tub come as standard features of this awesome accommodation. The staff are very friendly and helpful, the hotel is located just off Bangla Rd; so its close to all the shopping, nightlife and beaches that Patong and wider Phuket have to offer. I admit that I was initially sceptical of the free week accommodation I won on my Phuket holiday last year...considering that all it was going to cost me was a booking fee (less than AUS$100) and few hours of my time (1.5hrs upon winning and 1.5hrs when using the accommodation)... but now that I have just (reluctantly) completed the 2nd presentation with Stephan, I can confirm that the Absolute promotion is 100% legit and a great deal; despite the fact that I didnt buy into the vacation club / timeshare offer (which I am very tempted to do next year, when I am more financial)! I cant believe people get on sites like this and try to discredit such a great company, simply for doing good business and giving away free gifts; one of which is likely to be a free week stay in one of their Absolute hotels / resorts. Its like spitting in the face of someone who has just given you AUS$1000! (WHAT A DOG ACT!) Try and book a week in Absolute Bangla Suites and check the prices for a single room...then you can see how much this company is willing to stand behind their product when they give away free accommodation! I will recommend Absolute to all my family and friends in Australia without hesitation...and I will quickly defend this company against any and all haters..."keep your BS offline!" Love Chad!

author: m5clt
title: pictures look better than reality
text: My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights. The hotel is in a great location for nightlife, but that nightlife keeps going when you are ready for bed. It is audible most of the night. For a place that is still actively selling timeshare weeks, I would think they would make sure the hallways look pristine. I found them to be clean, but the walls in the halls and rooms seemed to have been banged up quite a bit. The rooms were spacious and modern but were also very musty smelling. I did not want to sit on the furniture as I could only imaging what must be growing in it. I have stayed in much nicer places for much less, and there are other placed in Patong that would have been a better value

author: ianm635
title: BANGLA SUITES, PATONG
text: This is our 6th visit to Phuket and our 3rd trip and stay in Patong. We continue to be drawn here for the simple reasons of the great location, the beautiful Thai people and of course, the price. We are in a penthouse suite in Bangla which is as good as you will find anywhere, with nice new furnishings, chrome fridge and cooking area, so basically fully self contained if that is your go. NOT OURS. We love the Climax Restauraunt on the top floor with the outdoor bar and swimming pool all as one. The food is great and for around $15 per head, your can have a beautiful 3 course dinner or for just $7 each your breakfast is served. We are in our mid fifties so the noise would put some people off staying here, but when you are 1 minute from the main drag in Patong, Banla Road, it is the perfect place to stay, with a multitude of bars and restauraunts to choose from. A short walk away is Junkceylon, a huge shopping centre with a large supermarket for all you in-house dining, plus 3 floors of everything you need for your stay.

author: JulieF120
title: Do not waste your money
text: Have stayed in several 4star hotels in Phuket and was very disappointed with this one, rooms are well laid out with very modern fittings but look outside your window and all you see is a concrete wall, to top it off you get to hear the sound of jackhammers for hours 1 metre from your window. Will not forget this experience and will tell everyone who may want to visit Patong to give this one a very BIG MISS !!!! Food not fresh, breakfast very boring. Cleanliness of rooms was very poor, forget to replenish items eg coffee, sugar and water. Observed several Absolute salesmen parading prospective buyers through hotel every day and couldn't help but wonder what brings these people in??? As room is roughly 30metres from a nightclub the constant thud of techno music does not finish until 4am every morning so any chance of a good nights sleep is non existent. The ONLY people this hotel suits are people who intend on partying through Bangla Road and are looking for somewhere to drop at the end of the night - forget tropical there is not a garden or tree in sight!!! Worst stay ever and will by no means be returning to another Absolute property again! Do not waste your money people this 4 star hotel is no more than a 2..

author: ChampangneMonster
title: Bangla La La
text: We stayed at Bangla suites as part of our holiday club membership it was our third time to Phuket/Patong we love it. Bangla suites is awesome for location, big rooms studios/ spa on the balcony and the staff are amazing. We did have two issues though, we paid for our meal in the restaurant then they told us we hadn’t paid the full amount, which we know we had cause we counted out the money! so we gave them another 1000 bht (30 dollars aussie) cause we were getting nowhere with trying to explain to them that we had paid. That spoilt a nice night. And the room itself was very noisy Bangla rd is open till 4 or 5 in the morning with night clubs and bars and if you stay here, then expect the noise to keep you up if you are not a party animal. Not much opens before 10.00am for breakfast in patong apart from McDonalds so brekkie at the hotel for 8.00 is good value. i would stay again no problem but i would request a room at the back and in the middle away from the noise.

author: rogertarnutzer
title: Good service and Location
text: I like this hotel when I had to check it. My favorite place to facilitate good and everything is real. For those who like entertainment and shopping.Hotel Service was very good, I appreciate it. Now I see the check in staff was extremely welcome, but before reaching the entrance. Which I was very impressed. Very clean room and good staff,good service, her is name OOM. Delicious breakfast and good service. It's a very good hotel and relax for a hotel like this. My room penthouse.

author: dican64
title: In the middle of it
text: We stayed at Bangla suites from the 6/8/11 until 20/8/11 in a 1 bedroom condo. My sister and her husband also stayed in the same suite. The suite had a 1 bedroom king bed, a very large bathroom with spa and a kitchen, dining table and l-shaped sofa. The hotel were fantastic and we had 2 single beds set up as a double for them in this area as it is quite large. Whilst we were in the thick of Patong Beach night life the hotel was at the end of a laneway and we never had any issue with noise. The room was luxurious. The hotel restaurant on the 5th floor "Climax" was 5 star and an open air restaurant. The meals were superb and the cocktails and beer were flowing. The pool was next to the restaurant, refreshing. Any issues we had over the 2 weeks were dealt with professionally and I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel.

author: fff_10
title: Best hotel, fantastic location. Highly recommended.
text: We travelled all over Thailand and this was by far the best hotel we stayed in. The hotel was absolutely beautiful, everything was crisp clean and new. Our room had icy cold air con, shower and jacuzzi, huge flat screen tv, dvd player ipod speakers, wifi, fridge, microwave, stove what else could you ask for. Location was perfect right in the heart of patong. Hotel is right next to Bangla rd where all the nightclubs, bars & pubs are located. 7eleven and mcdonalds right across the road. There is a small shopping mall at the end of the road which has a great food court, big plate of noodles or rice for 80baht. You really can't go wrong here. We would definately stay here again it was my favourite!

author: bbjl
title: www.aocap.org
text: I travel in and out of Phuket and I've stayed at many of the high end hotels in the Patong beach area. Bangla suites is an excellent boutique hotel and it is the one venue I would recommend above all others. Rooms are good size and all have Jacuzzi's, with DVD players and plasma screens in both the bedroom and the living area. Food & wine on the roof top poolside bar (climax) are excellent and reasonably priced for this type of hotel. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Often they have good deals on their website. There is a large gym two minutes from the hotel. The broadband is quick (very important for me) and the wireless is free which is accessible throughout the hotel.

author: wookienz
title: Location Location Location!
text: Recently stayed a couple of nights and enjoyed every minute. The rooms were well appointed with great mod cons, including a B and W iphone dock. This shows the high level of appointment the team has put into these rooms. Kitchen, spa pool, giant bathroom - what more could you want. Facilities on the roof, restaurant, pool and bar we excellent. Great views to b had from atop Phuket while winding down that day. Location is perfect: nite life, shopping, beaches and business district only minutes walk away. Will stay again.

author: acly88
title: Truly a great place for holidays
text: We travelled with our whole family with 2 seniors & 2 young children. It is such a fantastic place to stay as it’s very well located and you’ll find something to do for any age of the family. We had two garden view suites with two put me up beds in the living room. As it’s off a side road on the main street of Patong therefore it’s easily accessible to many places and not affected by the bustling street. Our children slept so well and they particularly love the light design & had so much fun with the jacuzzi on the balcony (have to watch them as they can easily climb the rails). My parents are 70+ & they enjoy relaxing on the beach or next to the pool & stroll around have a drink or 2, beautiful Patong Beach is just a few mins walk from Bangla Suites & they’ve a cool rooftop swimming pool and restaurant so my parents happily spent the holiday sunbathing & went for a stroll on famous Bangla Road. I love shopping and Jungceylon (the biggest shopping Centre in Phuket) is just 3 mins walk from the hotel and there’s supermarket right across the street of the hotel. My husband likes massage & there are good & clean massage parlors around the area & also in the shopping mall (I also had my manicure & pedicure done there & it was sooooo cheap and my daughter loves her pleads done on her hair!). As there’s a big Carrefore in the shopping mall, we sometimes buy food to cook at the hotel (there’s kitchen in every units) but most of the time we eat out as there’re such a variety of restaurant around the area from fine dining at the rooftop to pizza place, Thai Food restaurant & even some of the street hawker food are nice (we love the barbecue skewers & grill corn on the street!) However, I do not recommend anyone to drive here in Phuket as the hotel is so easily accessible to anywhere & Tuk-Tuk (local taxi) or hire a driver with car is so cheap & convenient, we’d rather be able to relax & have a drink during meals without worrying to drive! We enjoyed our stay at Bangla Suites & would definitely recommend the larger size suite we had to anyone.

author: JeffreyJonesJohnson
title: I’d rather the Bates motel.
text: Front desk was not friendly at all. The first night there were Meth-heads in the elevator. The second night the elevator was broke so we had to haul our three kids up 3 flights of stairs, which now smelled of weed to find our room key didn’t work. So another three flights down then back up and not even a “sorry about that”. When we arrived we had no hot water. We had to turn it on ourselves under the sink. They bathroom must be a “work in progress” as you can see in the picture. I think there might be some kind of breakfast but based of what we saw in the lobby I am not certain of it.

author: jenniferw695
title: Could have been better.
text: The room was clean. But there was an odor in the entire place. Under construction. The beds were awful. Sagging. The clerks just said oh, I'm sorry about the experience. Cold breakfast only. This was my second stay. They made cosmetic upgrades. But I'd rather sleep in my car next time.

author: duanef327
title: not going to stay there again
text: Check-in seemed fine. I booked the room online and paid for it online, but the front desk person stated I did not pay for the room. Well, upon checking my bank statement the next week, I was charged twice. The room stunk very bad. The toilet was clogged. I went to the front desk to inform them of the clogged toilet and was handed a plunger. I unclogged the toilet and two hours later, it was clogged again. The hair dryer overheated and stopped working after 30 seconds, we went to the front desk and they stated they will find another one, but never brought one.

author: /undefined
title: Desperately needs TLC
text: We have stayed here several times because we have a large dog and the location is close to family. The rooms have varied between ok and not great until our last visit. The room smelled odd and the carpeting was scary. If we hadn't been in such a time crunch I would have requested a different room. Also the area to walk the dog was full of dog poop as if nobody ever checks out there to see if it needs cleaning. This area is right at the side entrance so it's unpleasant for everyone not just dog owners. The staff here have always been very friendly & helpful so due to that, the location & dog friendly rooms we will probably stay there again. I would like to suggest that the management be notified or advised to seriously assess the condition of the rooms; fresh paint, new carpet and bed linens could do wonders. I would also suggest at least a trash receptacle at the dog area so those of us that do clean up after our dogs have a convenient place to dispose of it. The next time we stay I will talk to the management rather than just putting up with it and writing a review after the fact.

author: mcg0wans
title: Very poor customer service
text: Requested a late check out on check in. Was told by staff member that that would not be a problem and to notify staff in am. Prior to leaving for an expected outing that required a late check out, was told by staff that I could not check out late. This individual actually argued with me. I informed him what time I would be checking out whether he liked it or not, based on the promise given me by the check in staff. When I returned to the day, my key no longer worked. I had to return to the desk and demand a working door key. Room decor is dated. Mattress terrible and bathroom not clean with dark hairs in tub.

author: /undefined
title: room was dirty, to go lids begind stand and beside bed, stamdimg water in tub that smelled horrible, dirty wash cloths!
text: Room was dirty, togo lids behind the stand and beside bed bathtub had standing water that smelled horrible had to "sleep" with the bathroom door shut ,the bathroom sink took forever to drain and smelled whenbit finaly did drain, dirty wash cloths that lookes as if someone whipped their half washes hamds on them. Felt like I had bugs crawling on me all night even after tearing the bed apart MANY times checking for bugs! The breakfast was very little and the milk for the cereal was warm, the oj looked to be 100 yr old and tasted as it! Over all I am NOT happy took pictures of room showed the front desk at check out only to find out the guy was not even the "front desk" person but part of house keeping/ food area! He looked at pics and said he wrote it all down and a manager wld contact me, have not heard anything from anyone! My family will NEVER stay here again! Oh not to mention when we walked out of our room the hall way reeked of pot! A guy was at the front desk arguing with the desk guy about his mail the hotel wld not give him over all VERY unprofessional place and people working there!

author: 170MartinC
title: Days Inn & Suites of Morris
text: The Days Inn in Morris, IL. is old and clean for a Days Inn. It is an inexpensive place to stay while passing through. It is surrounded by trucking distribution centers, Costco being one. Great place for a trucker to get a good nights sleep if he wants a good shower and a night out of his sleeper. There are plenty of places to eat in Morris and there is an I Hop right next door. You get 10% off if you show your room key. You can also enjoy a dip in the indoor pool. They take dogs for a fee.

author: /undefined
title: This hotel sucks
text: We had trouble checking in-- none of our information was correct. Room was supposed to be non-smoking yet stunk of tobacco. There were burns on the bathroom counter & holes in the bedspread. The bathroom door was broken, suggesting that it was forced open & never repaired. The parking lot was flooded. Walls are paper thin. We were kept awake until after midnight by the occupants of the next room. Enough. We will not be using Days Inn again.

author: jillsN6161UB
title: Was not happy at all with this motel. When we arrived the...
text: Was not happy at all with this motel. When we arrived the room was terribly cold, (they knew we were coming, why didn't someone turn up the heat?), and when I did, the wall mount heater was not working...blowing cold air only. When we complained to the desk clerk, (whose accent was hard to understand), he didn't seem to know what to do or how to remedy the situation. He called his manager and it was suggested we move upstairs to a different room. I'm already unpacked/undressed and under the covers as we arrived late. Finally, a space heater was brought into our room. The bed was terribly soft and it had a very sharp cord/edge that you had to grind into the back of your thigh to climb up out of the sunken hole your sitting in. Then, I see in the morning, our shower head holder is broken off and the hand-held shower head has to be poked behind a bar (that is too low) to hold it, so I can shampoo my hair doing a slight back bend. Continental breakfast was so-so. We were NOT happy with this motel.

author: rodm316
title: A quick place to sleep
text: Nothing spectacular. Unenthused person at check in, no responsive person at checkout. Room needed a refresh. A remote with no writing on it, limited outlets and 2 Bath Towels in a King Room. No clock I'm my room I had to ask to get one from another room. Breakfast was non existent. Stale bread and old cereal. The coffee was good. Disappointing performance. Not sure if I will consider a Days Inn in the future,

author: /undefined
title: Dumpy Days Inn
text: We booked here because the Super 8 nearby was full. The Days Inn is a smoking motel, and the hallway smelled of smoke, although our room did not. if is a darkly lit motel. Dingy looking rooms, but clean. The A/C unit blew very smelly air. Fortunately, we could open the window instead. The coffee was cold. Nex time, we will go elsewhere.

author: MehlvilleHS
title: Inexpensive hotel...No frills.
text: I received pretty much what I expected. We were given a decent, no frills, King room. Everything was plain and simple, but adequate. The price was excellent compared to other hotels in Morris. The hotel reception staff was efficient, but no personality...no welcoming greeting...just business and then the clerk recluse do again. I give him a 1 out of a 5. However, the check-in was quick and correct---no problems...no mistakes. Just no personality.

author: rickf342
title: Not very good
text: Checked into room 117, A/C didn't work. Front desk moved me to room 121. Key didn't work. Clerk got another key that worked. Went to desk in the room and the phone didn't work. I asked the clerk if the rooms were checked or inspected for serviceability. She told me they could not get good help because no one will clean rooms for $3.00 per hour. I told that surely isn't the guests' problem. She said they are working on it. This place needs help!!!!!!!

author: /undefined
title: Night before cruise stay
text: Good place to stay for a night before or after cruise as we did. The room was clean and comfortable. Half updated. Could use new door and carpet. Main reason we chose Days Inn was for free shuttle from airport and free shuttle next day to cruise port. They supplied both these trips with no problems. Have to mention the first shuttle driver from airport to Inn had evidently had a long day as he was VERY rude to all of us. Driver to cruiseport next day was good.

author: Stavanger99
title: Average hotel at good price
text: Stayed here for several nights, and the location was perfect for me. Easy access to the freeway, restaurants nearby etc. This is not luxus, not even close. It is more like a motel than a hotel. But the rooms are spacious, with a large bathroom and shower. Yes, it definetly could need some refurbishing and modernizing, but it was clean and pretty quiet. The towels were awful, and you could listen to the neighbours having a good time. So if you want a cheap accomodation in the Morris area, I could definetly reccomend Days Inn.

author: Termite911
title: thoroughly UNimpressed
text: Dirty, Dingy, stinky. Visited Morris for a funeral and went to the hotel first to check in and suit up. Room assigned smelled HORRIBLE, with musty, molding terrible smell. I didn't complain because I was running late. I did however, complain, when i returned later that evening and switched rooms. The second room smelled better, fresher, but all the other dirtiness was present there too. Nasty carpet, run-down furniture, etc. There was even a used bar of (single serving) soap left on the bathroom sink. If you stay here, bring shower shoes and slippers to wear while you're in the room, wouldn't advise socks or barefoot. I've stayed in $6/night European hostels that were better kept than this place.

author: maliz7417
title: Just horrible
text: I stayed at this motel for business. This place is just horrible. The hallways are smokey and dirty. When I reached my room I checked the bed for bed bugs. No bugs but the mattress was smaller than the box spring. It was covered in hair and what looked like dried blood. The bathroom appeared to be relatively clean but there was old urine around the base of the toilet. Not a good place to stay.

author: Tsheehan
title: Transit type hotel
text: Stayed 5 days at this hotel for family visits. This like a transit hotel people hanging out in front of the door smoking day and night. The breakfast is all carbs no eggs or meat. We had to clean the filter on the air conditioner because it smelled so bad . Bathroom we had to fixed the flushing on the toilet because it kept on breaking . If you want to just flop for a night go ahead. Beds metal rod on mattress was broken had to fix it so it didn't stab me at night. Was cheap I paid for what I got. I won't stay there again seems Days Inns are going down in style. Flop housr

author: idabob5426
title: Clean and dog friendly
text: We stayed here for a few days during a local dog competition. The front desk clerk was friendly and efficient. The room was clean and large. It included a microwave and a refrigerator. The bathroom was spacious with plenty of counter space. My first floor room was convenient to the parking area as well as to the grassy area to exercise the dogs. There were several restaurants within a mile or two of the hotel. I will stay here again when in the area.

author: /undefined
title: Terrible stay
text: Beds were horrible. Place was dirty. People in the room next door were extremely loud, running in and out numerous times through out the night. We could not get any sleep at all. When I told the front desk, apparently they had already switched their room because there was a problem. Nothing like fixing the problem, no, just made us miserable. Internet connection was horrible, it took over an hour just to get logged on. Also, I was never asked for my rewards card or even if I was a member.

author: 788clarkb
title: Days Inn, Morris, Illinois
text: This hotel was at a convenient location, as it was right across the bridge from Walmart, and there were many nearby restaurants. It has an IHOP and a gas station right beside it. The people working at the front desk were very friendly and helpful. If I ever had any problems, it was solved immediately. I would give the room I had an 8 out of 10. The beds could be updated, as could the furniture. The tv was a flat screen (nice resolution), the A/C and heater unit worked great and the bathroom was very spacious. If I ever come back to the area, I will be staying at this hotel.

author: 884terim
title: Took the grandkids to the hotel. Staff was fantastic...
text: Took the grandkids to the hotel. Staff was fantastic! Kids loved breakfast! They loved that it had a pool. It was FREEZING!! 2 yr old wanted to "swim" but was too cold for more than a few minutes. Was hoping for a heated pool. Carpets in room could stand a cleaning.

author: flyermontana
title: Good value, nice room
