text: While this hotel looks pretty run down from the outside and the hallways didn't impress me with their cleanliness, it turned out to be a pretty good deal for a night's stopover--I paid about $58 including tax after booking on Priceline. Shopping is very convenient, WalMart etc right down the road. The front desk clerk was very nice and helpful, gave me change for laundry (washer and dryer worked great) and a very nice room. Fridge and microwave, big flat screen TV with lots of channels, good wifi, nice toiletries and towels, VERY clean bathroom with excellent shower head and water pressure. My room was clean and smelled good, and the thermostat/AC worked well. Breakfast had a good variety of options including waffle maker, yogurt and fruit and muffins... I didn't use the pool but it looked clean. I would return here when passing through the area.

author: J4851DZlaurab
title: pool nice, rooms ok,
text: The rooms were ok, looking a little worn. It was fairly clean. could have used a bit more cleaning but not the worst. The pool was nice, had many families using it. The breakfast was ok. There were also many families trying to get food at the same time and the food ran out fast than they replaced it. It room was mostly quiet. The air cond worked very well. staff was friendly.

author: /undefined
title: Terrible
text: We have stayed at Morris, IL 60450 for several years and this time was bad. We found ants and went to the front desk and told them there was food on the floor and an empty jelly container behind the endstand. We had to plug the light in and found it. Then a day later the ants were all over my bedspread that I put on the floor. They finally moved us and we will never go back. What a mess, housekeeping is the worst. No one even vacuumed the room before we got there as we never ate a thing in that room. Got the coffee in the lobby because the coffee pot was so dirty we wouldn't use it. You need to clean up your act because we have been going to the same Days Inn and will never go back to this one in Morris, IL.

author: /undefined
title: Messed up reservation
text: My friend and I reserved a 2 queen non smoking room online. At our arrival we were given a smoking 2 queen room. Due to my asthma we aren't able to use that type of room. The front desk clerk was very courteous but informed us the computer assigns the rooms. He was only able to find us a single king non smoking room which was acceptable. That room was clean, but hallways needed vacuuming and elevator reeked of smoke. Probably because whole 2nd floor is smoking rooms. Breakfast was marginal. Will not stay here again.

author: MP830
title: Basic but Good
text: This is my second time staying at this hotel. Price is right. Rooms very spacious and comfortable. Clean and quiet. Staff friendly and efficient. Slowest elevator I've ever ridden. Breakfast was really basic: waffle iron, cereal, juice, coffee, store bought muffins. Pool crowded with kids, but that is to be expected.

author: Bcamp1
title: bad
text: Stayed here for one night on a road trip. Motel was filled and only had a room with King size bed and jacuzzi for us. Room was fairly clean with amenities. The suitcase rack was rusty and sticky. Yuk!The bed was very uncomfortable with only two small very flat pillows.Bedspread was aged and needed to be replaced I can not make any accusations, but I did not feel comfortable using the jacuzzi. Maybe I am paranoid, but there were mirrors on two walls around it. When we checked to see what was on the outer wall, we found a utility room. In my opinion it seemed to be to easy a set up for a two way mirror. Just saying.

author: scottd403
title: Terrific for People with Disabilities
text: Room 117 was a very good room. The room and bathroom was large enough to maneuver with a wheelchair. The roll-in shower had easy access to the built-in seat and the hand-held shower fixtures. The shower curtain went all the way to the floor assuring that water would stay in the shower area. The king-size bed was very comfortable. The room and grounds were very clean. Staff was friendly and helpful. I will stay at this hotel if I am ever in Morris, Illinois again.

author: ZowieR
title: Worst hotel I have ever stayed in.
text: There was caulking smeared all over the bathroom vanity. The mattress was an old fashioned spring mattress. The mattress spring frame was broken- very uncomfortable. The carpet was so dirty that my white socks turned almost black. The tv was an old fashioned 20" tv. The channel guide was wrong. I had to call the desk to find out what channel was HBO. There was a large crack in the plaster above the air conditioner. And the room smelled badly.

author: 165stevew
title: Will return!
text: We stayed here for a week and will stay again when we return to this area! You just cannot beat the price!! We stayed in the suite and it was HUGE! The staff was accommodating and very pleasant. The breakfast was VERY good and the pool was nice as well!! You cannot beat the location which is right next to the interstate and numerous restaurants and Wal-Mart. The only reason I didn't give it a 5 star rating was it says there is a "sofa bed" but the bed is wired shut and you cannot pull the bed out of the couch. Also, you cannot see the TV from the living room area which was a minor inconvenience. The A/C was a little irregular and hard to regulate but again just a minor issue.

author: lindaf942
title: A disappointment
text: I arrived around 430, room wasn't clean, had to wait, they put me in a smoking room which I did not want and I had to ask to be moved. The bed I slept on had a broken metal piece poking through the mattress that scraped my leg when I got up and the shower curtain had a big hole in it. I have stayed in this particular Days Inn on several occasions. The people are VERY nice. The place, though, seems to be deteriorating. There was no plug in available to charge my laptop battery -- they were all in use by other appliances. Although my room was (eventually) non-smoking the entire second floor literally reeked of smoke. Overall, the experience was that I was staying in a poor, dingy, down-on-it's luck place that used to be quite nice and now was slipping. Positive note - staff did try to address any concern I brought to their attention in a friendly manner.

author: amanc_12
title: worth the money if you wanna stay in morris, il
text: My girlfriend and I stayed here 1 night in march, 2012. The room was nice. it was really nice selection and just what we needed to get going quickly and save us time! Wi-fi was accessible in the room and everything was clean and well-kept. A super value for those not wanting super luxury and super big price tags. person who was working at the front desk was very nice and polite during check-in. I checked in a little early without a problem I was impressed with the decor when I walked in. the place was in nice shape and very clean. I had plenty of towels and hot water. The breakfast was even good.I got such a great rate on the room, i am happy with my stay

author: CentralLTraveler
title: Not very pleasant
text: We stayed here last summer (sorry for the late review), and I made the unfortunate mistake of booking by price! The hotel is okay, but not very clean and not american-owned (if you know what I mean). The breakfast was cheap & shabby, and many of the items were always out. It seemed to me that the owners were skimping on how much they wanted to put out for guests, so they weren't going to provide more than they had to! Most of our group went over to the I HOP next door for breakfast. If you are in desperate need to stay somewhere, and nothing else is available, feel free to stay. However, if you can book at the Holiday Inn Express just down the road, please do! You will pay a little more, but its nicer, cleaner and more comfortable. Not as generic as the Days Inn.

author: jedigoddess
title: Beautiful Room & Wonderful Staff!
text: First off, they really took care of us at this property. We had the Junior Suite and the room was roomy, plush and perfect for 2. It included a fantastic view of the city, so you felt like you were a true Parisian. You are also in walking distance from of some of the most amazing Boulagerie's and cafes that one could desire. The metro is also in walking distance too and your about 20 to 30 minutes from major landmarks like The Louvre and The Eiffel Tower. The hotel staff is bilingual, super helpful, professional and really made us feel right at home. Anyone who has given this hotel a negative review should have their review privileges taken away. Nuff said. I look forward to returning soon!

author: Blue1201
title: Home away from home
text: We stayed five nights in two rooms. It was well furnished, clean and comfortable. The reception staff, in particular, Latisha from Brazil, were fantastic. Suggested restaurants and tours and then booked them for us. Even got us into a fun restaurant on New Year’s Eve. She was concerned about taxi service on New Year’s Eve so wrote down other options to get home, include possible train stations. Espresso machine downstairs. Free wifi and very homely. Restaurant is close to good restaurants, opposite hop on hop off bus and plenty of night life.

author: karlieyz
title: 5 star stay
text: This hotel is hands down my favorite. The staff was friendly and helpful for tips on what to do and where to eat. My room was perfect! The beds and pillows were a dream. Not to mention when you walk in the door the smell fresh flowers sweep you off your feet. Very clean no issues whatsoever. I definitely plan to return. I highly recommend this hotel.

author: KristiE435
title: Perfect!
text: Great hotel. Perfect location...walked almost everywhere and the Hop on Hop off bus stop was just steps from the front door! Plenty of restaurants nearby! The staff were fabulous and very helpful with booking tours, giving directions as well as day to day assistance at the hotel. The property is very clean and well maintained. The breakfast was plentiful and the service was very good. Our room was very well appointed with lots of room for 2 adults. Overall we enjoyed it very much and would easily stay again and recommend to others.

author: Vincent_at_Lux
title: Good location, great service, good breakfast, very good wifi, comfy beds.
text: We had a 3 nights / four days stay on November 2018 with my girlfriend to visit Paris, which I already know very well, having lived there for several years. I m pretty picky about hostels, as I am used to the Luxembourgish & Austrian standards : pro service, hogh quality food, multilingual staff, straightforward & honest attitude : => I guess that many hotels in Paris, if not in France, shall follow the steps of Le Royal : - their staff is absolutely pro : from counter to kitchen maids, they know what they do, and they convey the right attitude : kindness & know how. - everything worked correctly in the hotel and bedroom !!! - the Wifi ( free, note it ) worked seamlessly and with high debit. What else ? - the breakfast, which is often a pain in France for German-oriented customers like me was varied ( salty & sugar ), of very good quality, enough quality ( they refilled the plates, whatever time you show up for breakfast ), and the breakfast room was comfortable, not noisi, and had natural light. And the kitchen maid was very cool, althoug she was very busy keeping the place clean and the plates , filled. TO top it all, the price was absolutely decent. This hotel really had me believe there are still honest business-owners in PAris, who know their job ontop. COngratulations.

author: AkuMike
title: Exceeded our expectations
text: We had room 68 on the top floor. Extremely quiet and comfortable. Large enough for my family of 3. Getting anywhere was easy and relatively quick and cheap. Lots of restaurants, bars, patisseries close by. Breakfast was good. Staff was friendly and helpful. I`d definitely stay here again. Tip: try the fondu restaurant across Raspail. Went out of curiousity and convenience and ended up being a highlight of your visit.

author: mayasoma
title: Would stay here again!
text: My daughter and I stayed 6 nights.We booked directly with the hotel and we were upgraded to a deluxe room with balcony..it also had a mini bar. Room is very spacious by paris standard. The service at the hotel is top notch. They go out of their way to assist you. Breakfast includes very nice scrambled eggs,cheese, cold cuts, fruits,juice ,croissants and anything else needed for a nice breakfast. They have an espresso maçhine all day included. The location of the hotel is conveniently located next to metro stations and many many restaurants. The hotel is very clean and the lift was a bonus.

author: GoItaly2011
title: Ooo La La what a pleasant surprise.
text: First, I want to apologize for being so remiss in taking 2-1/2 months to write this review. Having said that, it was because of other intervening events in my schedule and nothing to do with the entirely wonderful experience we had at this lovely hotel in Paris. The neighborhood is Parisian and not a tourist area which we were very happy about. All of the staff were extremely helpful and accommodating, including allowing us to check in extremely early on the May 1st Holiday, helping us with dinner recommendations and ticket purchases, internet use and of course ice for our evening cocktails. The breakfast was more than adequate which a nice variety of choices. We were charmed by the small elevator but grateful nonetheless as I was suffering with a bad knee at the time. The neighborhood abounds with patisseries, charcuteries, cafes and restaurants galore, not to mention a grocery store and shoe repair shop all within a short walk from the hotel which we took full advantage of. There were also two different metro stations, bus stops and taxi stands a few blocks away. The room was small but equipped with all the necessities and very comfortable. When ever I am able to return to Paris I will definitely stay here again.

author: Kassoulet
title: Cozy hotel in great location and with friendly staff
text: I had a EUR180 budget per night for a business trip, which is not a lot in Paris. Yet I found this hotel to check all of the boxes within my budget. First, the room was ready when I arrived in the morning, which was immensely helpful as I had just had a sleepless night on a transatlantic flight. Granted, this was luck more than anything, but still nice of them to let me check in early. Second, the place is very easy to get to from either airport on the RER B, which was again most helpful as I had to catch flights at both CDG and ORY. There is also plenty to do within walking distance, with restaurants, Montparnasse, Jardins du Luxembourg nearby. As for the premises, the room was small but very efficiently appointed. Despite facing the boulevard, it was very quiet. The breakfast room was also very nice, and the free espresso in the lobby a nice touch. Overall, this hotel is excellent value for its price range.

author: Kate423
title: Wonderful boutique hotel and location
text: Wonderful boutique hotel and location. 2 minute walk from Vavin station, which has amazing restaurants. We walked from the hotel to the Notre Dame, Eiffel Tower, The Lourve, Av. des Champs-Élysées, everywhere in about 40 minutes (max) and the routes are very scenic and quiet . You come across some amazing boutique shops and restaurants, patisseries en route. The hotel itself was extremely clean and well looked after. Amazing decor and the beds were so comfortable!! I would highly recommend for a central Paris break, the neighborhood felt safe and prestigious, loads of local people and great french food, especially seafood. Thanks for an amazing stay!

author: King8195
title: Wonderful hotel
text: We stayed for two nights over the bank holiday weekend. Only a 10 minute walk from Port-Royale RER station the hotel is situated in an area surrounded by restaurants, cafes and bars. We were able to check in two hours early and had a free room upgrade, great start! The rooms were comfortable and had everything you needed but no tea or coffee, that was down stairs and they asked that you didn’t take it up to the room (previous issues with ruined carpets?). The hotel was spotless and very well maintained and the staff were always friendly, helpful and polite. We didn’t do breakfast. The metro station is only a few minutes walk away but as the weather was warm and sunny we walked everywhere. The Eiffel Tower is around 2 and a half miles away, took us 40 minutes and is an easy route. I’d definitely recommend a stay.

author: sillecat
title: Great place
text: This hotel was wonderful! Only down sides are the elevator and rooms are very small. Which is understandable in keeping the hotel authentic. I love history, so updates and remodeling would ruin this hotel. That's not saying that the hotel is rundown, it's the opposite, very well maintained. The staff was very attentive. We had a problem with our car pickup time, front desk staff was kind enough to help me call the driver and translate for us. There was a great market on the street behind the hotel, it was a great walk, fresh produce was beautiful. there were several markets on the streets with antiques, it was such a great area to get out and walk the streets and see paris. Easy access to public transportation, I would recommend this hotel and location!

author: nathanaellhe
title: Great Service, Very comfortable
text: A very nice smaller hotel. The staff were very friendly and helpful! We had an issue with a bed on the first day, but the man at the front desk went out of his way to make sure everything was fixed. Excellent customer service!! The rooms were quite nice and the beds are very comfortable. Very accessible to metro and buses. The lift is small but adequate. Overall I would definitely recommend.

author: DutchWayne
title: Excellent place to stay
text: My wife and I just returned from a 4 day visit to Paris and we stayed at Le Royal. The place is a Hidden Gem as others have said. The staff are awesome. The two young ladies at the desk went out of their way to help us from everything we asked to offering local advice for food and travel. Thank you Ladies! The rooms are very clean, if you get a room worn a balcony the view is fantastic. You cannot go wrong. The metro is a block away, restaurants every where and just an amazing Location.

author: 218nicoleh
title: Family vacation
text: Very lovely hotel with excellent customer service! Quaint and perfect for any stay. All personnel at the front desk were so helpful from giving us directions, advising on best places to visit or dine. Elevator is super tiny but everything in Paris is very minimalistic. No washcloths (not sure why) were strange but not major with the other Linens. Beds were very comfortable for a prefect sleep. Free continental breakfast was nice. The hotel is in a great area with wonderful places to eat nearby.

author: assafberz14
title: Excellent hotel!
text: I spent five days in this hotel with my father in October 2017. The hotel was excellent! The service was courteous and polite. The receptionists helped me with all my requests efficiently and quickly. Breakfast was delicious and rich (I would be happy if there was a vegetable supplement and more vegetarian food). Our room was spacious and clean, with a pleasant balcony. The beds were very comfortable. The location of the hotel is excellent! There are three metro stations nearby and a lively entertainment area around. In conclusion, I would love to return there in the future.

author: MelissaM927
title: Still a winner!!
text: This is our second time staying in this wonderful hotel. The rooms are very nice. We stayed in their triple/junior suite room which was very large and quiet at the back of the hotel. Staff was very nice and helpful. Wi-Fi was awesome. This hotel is in a great spot a little south but very central. Just outside the 6th arrondisement in the 14th but there are 2 metro lines you can get to that are within a half block of the front door. Tons of restaurants nearby. This is my go to hotel in Paris right now.

author: 68lisef
title: JUST PERFECT !!!
text: I was there for work and vacation and the staff at the hotel was so helpful ! Thank you to Denise which was so nice !!! The hotel was so perfect, clean, cosy and quiet. Even if my room was front to the street we didn't hear anything. The breakfast was good ! It was really easy to take the bus and subway from the hotel only few steps. I hardly recommend the hotel !!! I lookforward to going back. :)

author: marksutcliffe
title: Long Weekend In Paris
text: Spent 3 nights at the 'Le Royal' hotel. Excellent service - we did have an issue with our first room, however mentioned this to the staff and they moved use. The staff are extremely helpful - they go the extra mile (or kilometer). The room was very clean and air conditioned. The breakfast is excellent - cereal - pastries and eggs and fresh fruit. Love it. The location of the hotel I really enjoyed - a short walk and you have plenty of lively bars and a street with the most amount of crêpe restaurants I have ever seen. The hotel also benefits from being on the direct line to the airport, so it really is as simple as a 1 train to the airport. I am unable to pick faults in this great hotel. Well done to the 'Le Royal ' team.

author: HollyHalina
title: We loved it!
text: The staff was beyond attentive! They took great care of us! The rooms are so cute and clean! Love the laCroix pillows! Breakfast was amazing and it's close the two metro stops and the jardin du Luxembourg and the catacombs! On our last day the concierge made sure we had (a very early) taxi and opened the breakfast early so we could eat before our flight! That's quality service and care!! Thank you!! We will be back!! Amazing hotel!!

author: Mariskaa24
title: Excellent hotel!
text: We spent 3 nights in this wonderful hotel. The people at the reception, breakfast room and cleaning were very friendly and helpfull. They'd help you with anything. The room was very clean and spacious (we even had our own little corridor before getting at our bedroom and bathroom) which was also recently renovated. It was very quiet in the room and the beds were very comfortable. The breakfast also good; lots of choice at any time! The location excellent; a number of busses and metro stations nearby and lots of restaurants from any price range. We would 100% go back to this hotel when we return to Paris!

author: Flyingmoth
title: Paris Stay
text: Very helpful staff. Hotel was comfortable and clean within urban city limits neighborhood feel. Close to hop on hop off and Montparnesse Central Train Station. Breakfast was good and plentiful but limited variety. Walking distance to Luxembourg Gardens a must! One block to metro. Many restaurants, shops in neighborhood. Would stay again.

author: johnnih399
title: Very easy to find from the Rail station and great neighborhood.
text: As a solo traveler this was a great find. I had a tiny room that was so cute. Beautifully decorated and the bed was fantastic. Front desk staff very helpful. Coffee always available in the lobby, I never ate there, too much to see and do. It was quiet, clean and a great central location. Away from most tourist and crowds. I was lucky to have found it.

author: CD_BKNY24
title: Lovely hotel in a beautiful quiet neighborhood!
text: I had a lovely stay in this hotel! This hotel is located in the Montparnasse area, 4 minute walk away from the Raspail Metro stop. There are many cafes and restaurants located in the area. The hotel staff was very helpful. You have to leave your key with the front desk while you are out, and my last night on my way in the manager confirmed I was checking out the next morning and asked me if I needed help making arrangements to get to the airport. He scheduled a Taxi for me, informed me of the price, and provided a wakeup call, as well as a call to let me know my taxi was outside. The room was a quaint, clean, and modern room in the 6th floor with a beautiful street view. The area is very quiet but I felt safe getting off the metro late. The shower was very small and just worked for a 5'6" woman, so not sure how difficult a taller person may find it. Overall wonderful stay!

author: AlexandraV1366
title: great hotel, helpful staff
text: what a nice hotel to stay in. We had a very pleasant time there. We stayed 5 days in paris and it was very easy to commute there. There is a train station just by the corner and the neighborhood is very friendly and with plenty of options to dine. The room was very clean as well as the toilet. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was included and even tough it wasn't plenty of choices of food, it was very nice. I would strongly recommend this place!!

author: sappel417
title: Paris in 3 days, well situated hotel.
text: Desk staff is extremely helpful, excellent English, especially the night manager. Breakfast was a typical European continental, with coffees from machines, pastries, meats, eggs, toast, jams, yogurt. The metro was one block away and many nice restaurants in the area. Excellent location near Latin Quarter and Luxembourg Gardens. I am giving this hotel a 5 star because when we arrived at 8am, we expected to store our luggage and slug around (tired) for 6 hours. As it happens our room was ready and they let us in early with no charge. They did not have to do this and I would be surprised if that happened in the US. Also, she said our room was upgraded. I do not know why, it may just have been availability. The room was in front of the building, 5th floor, so it was quiet.

author: 189sandyd
title: Good choice for the Left Bank
text: We stayed at the Le Royal at Christmas. It has a good location near Montparnasse. It's located right on a major bus route (one of which goes right over the river), and is right between the Vavin and Raispail stops on the Metro. There are a number of neighborhood shops nearby, along with the well-known Le Dome and La Copoule restaurants. The large department store, Bon Marche, is a short walk away, as is the famous coffee shop, Les Deux Magots. The rooms are small and clean. There is a good breakfast each morning and the staff is helpful. A good value, particularly if you're staying on the Left Bank.

author: csantos89
title: Decent hotel
text: We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. train station and pharmacy down the street. bus stop in front of hotel- convenient location. One downfall was the iron, we had to go to the basement laundry room to iron our clothes, it was super hot down there, I'd sweat while ironing my clothes. hotel staff was ok, not too welcoming. Air conditioning wasn't that cold. very clean. breakfast was ok.

author: barneybear66
title: Excellent choice for Paris weekend
text: This hotel has many positives. The location is really useful with a great combination of metro and bus lines close at hand. The RER at Port Royal is a straightforward 10 minute walk away. The staff are friendly and efficient. We requested a room at the front in advance and this was arranged for us (very quiet with the window closed). The room was spacious and comfortable. Our only small niggles were the rather odd pillow (more of a cushion really) and the occasional cough, bang and splutter from the neighbour's bathroom plumbing. Breakfast was varied and available in a pleasant space (not the cellar which makes a nice change). All in all a real winner and we would return tomorrow.

author: 742leiryt
title: Excellent 3 star hotel!
text: Hotel Le Royal is located couple of blocks from the metro and buses. There's a tour bus that also stop a block away. It has a modern outlook. The triple room are carpeted very spacious with huge bathroom. The toilet has its own privacy. You can select from taking a shower or a bath. The rooms as well as the hotel is very clean. Breakfast offers boiled or scrambled eggs as well as a variety of cold cuts. The staff makes an effort to source the best of everything! Worth staying if you are no interested in pool or gym area!

author: Bazbomb
title: Short weekend break
text: We stayed here after arriving on the euro star! I emailed the hotel to see how close I was and they gave excellent directions. Vavin station is literally round the corner. Metro great to travel on so much easier than London and cheaper! Hotel room clean and opened out to the Main Street. When windows closed it is very quiet. Fab location to get to each attraction. Breakfast good and free water and coffee all the time. Staff very friendly, they have an ironing room to iron your clothes. Would recommend this hotel!!

author: Mzahn13
title: At End of Longer TripShort Visit To Paris
text: The Hotel was excellent. The staff was always helpful. The location was very nice. The room was attractive and clean. Bathrooms were modern. Air conditioning worked well and beds were comfortable. Breakfasts were fine as well. Numerous places to eat close by. On Metro line and taxi not too expensive to major locations. Would definitely stay here again.

author: vueann
title: Good service
text: We were able to check in early. Front desk was always friendly and helpful. Many times, they assisted us with routes for the metro. The room was small but that's normal in Paris. It was clean. Didn't like the shower because of the floor. It didn't have a separate floor, so it was always wet. Breakfast was good too. Would stay here again!

author: 758keeleyb
title: Great Stay
text: We were in this hotel for one night only. Upon arrival the very friendly receptionist was very helpful and informative. We were on the 6th floor and the room was lovely and big compared to other Parisian hotels I have previously stayed in, decorated to a very high standard and a lovely bathroom. Not minding a walk we walked from Gare de Nord, through the city, stopped off for lunch just past Notre Dame and then a short walk through the Jardin Luxembourg and we were there (probably just over an hour without food and beer stops). A great location for local restaurants a little way from the madding crowd. Breakfast was excellent value, I really can't see why people were complaining, we got down with 10 minutes to spare and well past the 10.30 cut off the lady was bringing out fresh scrambled eggs, fruit and meats - there was plenty to choose from. You could have coffee anytime of the day and night through an nespresso machine in the lobby, no tea and coffee making facilities in the room, but with that option it was fine. We would definitely stay there again.

author: PasiT87
title: Great hotel with excellent location and silent rooms
text: We stayed in Paris for six days in April-May 2016. We chose this hotel based on the recommendation by our travel agency. And we really made the right choice. The location of the hotel was excellent, within walking distance to metro stations and many wonderful attractions. We felt the neighborhood safe and, thus, we could let our teenagers wander the streets of Paris also by themselves. The hotel rooms were clean and, especially, silent so we all got good sleeps every night of our staying. We enjoyed the good breakfast as well as the friendly service from the hotel staff. As many said here, we'll choose the same hotel also for our next Paris visit.

author: micheldng
title: Classy hotel in a residential district
text: Hi everybody !!! I have friends from Charlotte,NC,USA and each time they come in Paris they stay in this hotel .The rates are very affordable and one important is the size of the rooms. If you reserve at least a superior/deluxe room you will have a spacious one so that you won't feel cramped!!!. If it's OK with your budget reserve a junior suite large enough to accomodate 4 people; One of the best room of the house is the room 63 having both views on the street and the courtyard plus bathtub and shower. The montparnasse neighbourhood is surrounded by bars, restaurants ,movie theaters with some of them having films in english. To summarize the best value-rate compared to the Champs Elysees , Latin Quarter , Montmartre . Not to mention that you have access to the Latin Quartin just by crossing the Luxembourg Gardens within 10 mn. Enjoy Paris and Montparnasse!!! Bestofreceptionist.

author: TJG628
title: A Very Good One Night Stay
text: Booked a twin room for a brief trip to Paris with my adult daughter. The staff are very welcoming and the hotel is clean and comfortable. The location is excellent. Close to both Metro and RER stations with an abundance of restaurants just a few steps away. We walked to Pont des Arts in 30 mins at a gentle pace. The walk is slightly uphill on the way back but the incline is gentle. Our room was perfect for a short stay with a great view of Boulevard Raspail from the small balcony. I would highly recommend this hotel for its location and staff. I would return.

author: lenaed
title: PERFECT FOR OUR FAMILY, WONDERFUL STAFF, NEAR RESTAURANTS AND METRO
text: We took our three grown children and their families to Paris for a week. We had four rooms, all newly decorated and large.Most with french doors that open like a balcony overlooking the busy lives of the Parisians in the area Wonderful neighborhood, we always felt safe , even late at night.The staff was so helpful and friendly. They have a free breakfast and made special arrangements for us to eat early and late on different occasions so we could make our tours. Housekeeping was wonderful and Estelle at the front dest even helped us find a pharmacy open on Sunday to get medicine for a sick grand baby on the day we were going to fly out. They had baby beds brought in for us. it is a petite hotel with a warm french flair. We loved the area and ate most nights in walking distance. There are grocery stores, cheese stores and pastry stores within a block.Thanks so much to the staff an for a wonderful trip.

author: RMuckey
title: Great hotel!
text: My fiancée and I were on a two week vacation across Spain, Italy and it ended in Paris. This hotel was very nice and the staff was fantastic! The hotel room was very nice and the bed was very comfortable with a balcony door to the street. The morning breakfast is quite nice. This hotel is about an hour drive from the airport (CDG), and we used Uber which cost us €50. (I'm sure that was less than what a cab would have cost). The gentleman at the front desk advised me that they had a shuttle that would take us back to the airport for €18 per person. We used it for our return trip and it was great. If you plan on staying here, call ahead and have them get you:)

author: 782reemas
title: Not a pleasant place to have a sleep over.
text: The owner was pretty rude. We were travelling from Canada, on arrival when we asked for a phone adapter to charge our cell phones. He refused to provide us saying " we should always have one while travelling". Before that, we stayed in London, Uk and we were given the adapters by the hotel and the breakfast was also included. This hotel was expensive plus included NOTHING for their guests. Owner was very rude. Thye had NO hot water. We had a shower with extremely cold water.

author: 363Brenda
title: lovely hotel close to metro
text: I stayed here from Aug 12 the to Aug 21st. A lovely hotel close to metro. My room was small but as expected in France. Decor was inviting and the bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was wonderful each morning. Coffee maker in lobby for instant nespresso.. Staff very friendly and helpful. Elevator very small, just large enough for one person and luggage. Overall a lovely experience.

author: RaeA367
title: Clean, friendly, close to multiple metro lines
text: Most importantly, my room and bathroom were clean when I arrived and stayed that way my whole stay. A small, boutique hotel with fluent English-speaking front desk staff, it is on a quiet street (great for sleeping) but within a few blocks from many restaurants, grocery stores, shops, parks, boulangeries, (*cough* 2 Starbucks) and many metro stations so it was quick to get anywhere in Paris. I happily filled up every morning with their breakfast (pastries, bread, cereal, hard boiled egg, scrambled eggs, cheese, meat, tea/coffee selection, fruit, plus complimentary coffee/tea in the lobby throughout the day). My room on the top floor was a good size for one person, nice view, comfortable bed, but could have used a chair to relax on (throw clothes...) and plan for the next days adventures. A few days in I discovered copies of the International New York Times in the lobby lounge. Big plus: free wifi! A/C in my room. Only con: the bathroom is terribly designed. The shower was so ridiculously small I had to leave things on the bathroom counter, getting water everywhere every time I had to grab something.

author: 97wa
title: Returned to friendly, comfortable, super Paris location
text: The two of us stayed at Le Royal for four nights near the end of June at the start of our holiday in France, and returned to the hotel for two nights prior to our flight home on July 6th. The staff was extremely helpful and friendly, and the location excellent—pleasantly active, part residential neighborhood. If you are a walker, the Luxembourg Garden is a stroll away, and the Ile de la Cite, not much further. Two different metro lines open within 100 yards of Le Royal (Vavin and Raspail), and the direct train to CDG is a 10-minute walk away (Port-Royal). Boulangeries, cheese and fruit shops, and a grocery store all operate within a block or two of the hotel. We had excellent dinners at three of the several restaurants in the immediate neighborhood. The front desk personnel conversed with us in English, kindly offering any assistance we needed, along with restaurant suggestions and useful metro and airport transportation advice. The rooms we occupied were well appointed and ours, on upper floors and facing the courtyard, were entirely quiet and comfortable. For a couple, we would recommend booking a deluxe room for a multi-night stay, as we counted the additional space worth the added expense. We enjoyed the complimentary coffee/tea and daily newspapers in the lobby.

author: Roberts08
title: We keep coming back!
text: We have stayed at this hotel three times, and it will continue to be our choice of hotels in Paris. Reservations are no longer done directly with the hotel but through an on-line system for the "best deal". I fought this system for a while and finally gave in! Eric recognized us when we walked in which was nice. We were upgraded to a jr. Suite which we enjoyed. The extra 13 euros for breakfast is well worth it. A/c, wifi, comfortable bed, nice room and bath, great location, helpful staff, easy walk to closest RER station to airport----obviously a good choice!! Restaurants abound, several metro stops within a block and on and on-- you won't regret your stay.

author: bryanl591
title: Great Hotel
text: What a nice place to stay!!! Our room was upgraded and had a king size bed and was newly renovated. Huge room compared to other places we have stayed. AC worked great as well as the free wifi. Never had to relog in every few mins like the other hotels. Good breakfast and the front desk people were awesome. And spoke English. I would definitely stay again . Only steps to number 4 and 6 metro line

author: Lizuhrig
title: Paris for Valentine's Day
text: We spent a wonderful week at the Hotel Le Royal. It was a very beautiful well kept hotel. The room was clean and tidy. Staff was very kind and was easy to understand. Continental breakfast was very filling. Every morning my hubby would bring me breakfast in bed. The walls were a bit thin, and the bed was to hard for my taste. All in all we would recommend this place to friends :)

author: Minnesota85
title: Comfortable Paris hotel
text: I spent six nights at Le Royal, on business. The reception desk is welcoming and helpful, and the staff was very responsive to a few small issues in the room. Room #33 on the large side for a European hotel, and the bathroom (with tub) is well sized. The decor ia updated and attractive. Wifi is reliable. This particular room faces the street, so there's an average amount of street noise with the windows open. Breakfast is convenient and in a spacious, bright, sunny room, though it's a iittle pricey for what it is (coffee from a machine; hard-boiled and scrambled eggs, just OK croissants, yogurt, cereal, etc.); if you have time to spare you might as well go to a nearby cafe. The location of the hotel is terrific - the neighborhood is buzzy and busy but not completely clogged with tourists, and it's easy to get wherever you need to be via metro or bus, or on foot. There are plenty of restaurant options nearby. I would happily stay here again.

author: Snowpiste
title: Good hotel good location
text: Hotel is great location with 4 metro stops, multiple bus stops and gare Montparnasse all within walking distances. Many restaurants and cafes very close. Several small groceries, patisseries, frontage tie and close is a Monoprix. Hotel is nice with friendly staff. Rooms were avg for Europe in size, clean and nice. Breakfast was not exceptional, but a decent variety. We were there 8 nights, and could get to all the major Paris attractions on one or two metros. We originally were in for 7 nights , but a transport strike in Brussels caused us to arrive a day early and they were able to accommodate. Raspail blvd is busy, yet we were back facing and could sleep with our windows open every night. Recommended!us

author: Departure803201
title: A very pleasant experience
text: We stayed for 3 nights in early March. The hotel is very well located near a Metro station (Vavin) and only 7 mins walk from the RER station (Pont Royal) on a direct line to the CDG airport. The hotel is very good quality 3 star. Reception was particularly friendly, our room was very pleasant overlooking the Blvd Raspail, with a small veranda - warm and comfortable. Breakfast was way better than we have experienced in French 3 star hotels - choice of cold meats, eggs boiled and scrambled, croissants and bread, fresh fruit salad, yoghurt and limitless fresh coffee. In the evening there are masses of restaurants within a 5 min walk. We sampled a couple two mins walk away, both small family run with extremely interesting menus around for 25 Euros. Very good wi-fi reception in the hotel. All in all a very good find.

author: Travelgirl082290
title: Great Value, Great staff
text: Recently stayed here with my now fiancée and we had a wonderful time. Rooms are updated and a great size for Europe. Staff was super friendly, only wished they wore name tags! We had three different people work at the front desk during our stay and they were all amazing. Hotel is closed to metro, and most importantly some really nice cafes. Ask the people at the front desk for recommendations they never disappointed! Careful with the shower, don't crank the pressure too much other wise it pushes the shower head to face the wall. Beds were a little rough but I am a bit more sensitive than others. Breakfast was as expected and worked great. Highly recommend the place and I would love to go back!

author: petermK7077FS
title: Frequent visitor to Hotel Le Royal
text: I travel to Paris a few times a year for business and, if staying for a number of days, usually stay at the Hotel le Royal. It is an easy trip to our office in the south of Paris on the Metro and RER and I can then take advantage of the restaurants in the area in the evening. Hotel Le Royal offers a good mix of quality and convenience at a reasonable cost. The location is excellent, just south of Blvd. Montparnasse, with its many restaurants and close to Vavin and Raspail Metro stations, so it is simple to travel anywhere in Paris from there. The hotel is comfortable with good rooms and en-suite bathrooms, free internet and a good breakfast. The staff are very friendly and speak excellent English, so communication is no problem. This hotel has become my regular "home" in Paris and I recommend it for business or tourist accommodation.

author: sharonp379
title: great service
text: great experience. Centrally located. great breakfast; had something for everyone. very clean. helpful staff. very close to metro and that is very easy to use. we did not hear noise from other rooms. very comfortable beds. we felt very safe there.

author: sallywt
title: A little bit of luxury
text: Absolutely loved this hotel. It had everything you could possibly want from incredibly attentive and helpful reception staff to the biggest and most comfortable room I've ever had in Paris. We were greeted by an extremely helpful young man on reception who very kindly gave us a free room upgrade. The room was large, warm, clean and very comfortable with everything you could want. I was a little concerned to see that the room was on the first floor and at the front of the building which overlooked a busy road but there was no need to worry. We barely heard a sound at all times of the day. The area was filled with a huge choice of bars, restaurants and bistros and just 2 minutes walk from the nearest metro station. The Montparnasse tower was only 5 minutes walk away and central Paris just 15 minutes. We will stay here again without a doubt and highly recommend this lovely hotel

author: Olya111
title: Great all around!
text: I was in Paris to celebrate my birthday and stayed at Le Royal for 5 days. Great location - both the area and the proximity to everything in Paris! Very centrally located yet in a quiet area with lots of cafés, bistros, and restaurants around. Literally around the corner from Vavin metro stop. Great service, clean rooms, and good value. We stayed in a standard room, which is not large but very cozy and the bathroom is actually quite large and very clean. More importantly, the staff were very accommodating and a pleasure to deal with. Overall, a great stay - would definitely stay again!

author: B3412WTrachelh
title: French Boutique Hotel
text: My husband and I just spent our honeymoon in Paris. We were placed at the Hotel Le Royal through our travel agency Go-Today. We were worried because we did not know if we would like where they booked us. We did not need to be worried. The room was clean and so was the bathroom and there was enough room for all our stuff. Thew free breakfast was just enough to get our day started. The staff was extremely helpful and courteous. The area was very safe and in walking distance to the metro. We enjoyed our stay and would be happy to return to Paris France again and go back to this Hotel.

author: 92614Momof4
title: Great Hotel!
text: Great location and wonderful staff! Rooms were comfortable and clean. Breakfast was good. Located close to metros, cafes and shopping. My nine-year old daughter and I were very comfortable in a twin room for six nights. For a winter stay, request a room facing Blvd Raspail. Lovely view and extremely quiet with the windows closed. I highly recommend this hotel and look forward to staying here again!

author: Furry1208
title: Elegant
text: This a very nice hotel in Paris. It was chosen for me for a work trip and i wasn't disappointed. The room wasn't huge but it was big enough, clean and had stylish decor. It had everything you'd expect from a 3 star hotel. Breakfast was nice too and the place to eat it is nicely done up and clean. The staff are very friendly. Check in and check out was fast. You have to pay a visitors tax, about 2 euros i think.

author: jjlondon1975
title: Fantastic hotel!
text: I've just come back from an overnight trip to Paris (as I regularly do) and this is the only hotel that I would both recommend and happily stay in again. In fact, it is now my hotel of choice The hotel reception is nice and big, with very helpful staff. This was both the day and night staff The room I stayed in was on the main road so obviously noisy, but the veranda doors when shut do a fantastic job of cutting out the noise - it was like throwing a switch! The beds were very comfortable, with extra pillows available in the spacious wardrobe. The addition of a large safe meant there was adequate space for the laptop, iPad and other stuff The bathroom was big, with plenty of towels and huge mirror. There was plenty of hot water at 9:30am, and the pressure was more than adequate. In fact, the bath had run surprisingly quickly Staff were available 24/7 so no need to worry about lost key cards or keys - especially useful when out on the town Breakfast was plentiful, with a more than adequate range (for continental breakfast). The orange juice was good, not at all 'watery' as you sometimes get. Check out was a breeze, and was more than efficient All in all, I'd highly recommend this hotel. Except that is, when I next return - I'd hate for it to be full on my next return :o)

author: alexmY5193BN
title: Service could be friendlier in many ways!
text: I took my partner on a birthday treat to Paris and ordered a double room. We got a twin and when we went to complain nicely, the gentleman's response was "most women want a twin" - well we are not most women - imagine my embarrassment and annoyance that either this gentleman or someone at the Hotel had decided to assume we didn't need a double room, because we were two females. It clearly stated it on the booking form. He did apologise and the girl the next day said it would be sorted, not clear what was happening, but they did change the bed in the same room. For a romantic trip, this was not the start I wanted and this wouldn't happen in London in 2014. For a 3 star, the room was disappointing, the toilet separate from the shower and sink, which was a little odd and it was more two star quality. The service at reception wasn't particularly helpful throughout our stay or welcoming. We have experienced better service and facilities at two star Hotels in Paris. Good points - The breakfast and lounge area were good and so was the breakfast, the location Montparnasse was excellent for restaurants, Metro, but overall this Hotel and the service was disappointing and we would certainly not go there again.

author: th1world
title: Our favorite Paris hotel on recent trip
text: We stayed here in September 2014 for two nights. We stayed at two other hotels in Paris during this same vacation and hands down this was our favorite by leaps and bounds. One of the hotels we stayed at was a famous four-star hotel and this was far superior. The staff, both the woman during the day and the gentleman during the evening, were especially accommodating to our requests for directions, restaurant recommendations and arranging for a taxi. The room is spacious and elegantly decorated. The room was more like having our own quarters. The bathroom was decadently large compared to others we saw and was also nicely updated. The hotel is very close the famous La Coupole restaurant and also conveniently located to the metro stop and Gare Montparnasse. If we come to Paris again, we will stay here for sure.

author: WanderinB
title: Perfect hotel for me and my teenagers!
text: I've just stayed here for three nights with my teenagers, and had a lovely time. The Hotel very kindly made sure my children had a room overlooking the Boulevard as I had emailed them prior to arriving to see if that may be possible as it was their first time in Paris and I had read that some of the rooms (as mine) had no view at all. Both of our rooms were very comfortable. I didn't have a view at all, but that wasn't a problem for me; everything was so clean and the service very pleasant and helpful. It was lovely and my children thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience there. Plus they slept so well that one morning I had to ask the kind receptionist if she could please call them as I couldn't stir them! We walked EVERYWHERE, which may not be to everyone's tastes, but we found everything to be pretty accessible, though obviously some things are much further away than others, but if you don't want to walk there are two Metro stops within metres. I think one of the previous reviews says to stop browsing and book it - I would agree!

author: hippo432
title: Paris with no problems
text: a good location 10 minutes up Montparnasse from the RER station from the airport ,although it 's 50metres up avenue Raspail rather than on Montparnasse itself. quiet spot yet only 2 minutes to a wide range of bars and restaurants. nice rooms (we had a superior room 14) which are at the front of the hotel overlooking the street. very quiet with no disturbance to sleep and well furnished with a small hall separate toilet and separate bathroom and for Paris a decent size bedroom with king size bed and a flat screen tv. Plenty of wardrobe space. while not a world renowned authority on croissants the buffet breakfast we found to be satisfying with plenty of choice and certainly set us up for the day,coffee machine on the go all day in the lobby plus tea. Reception staff were excellent and very helpful and whilst appreciated your French did speak excellent English. All in all a stay without any problems.

author: Hevandsteve12
title: Perfect!
text: We have just visited Hotel Le Royal for 3 nights and could not have been more impressed with both the hotel and its staff. We stayed in room 43 which was spacious and overlooked the treelined street. The hotel is situated a 5 minute walk from Port Royal RER and has numerous restaurants, patisseries and cafes. There are metros nearby, however we decided to walk to the Eiffel Tower as the weather was beautiful. We found it easily and it took approx 45 minutes gentle stroll from the hotel. Would just like to say that there are signs 'beware of pickpockets' everywhere but we had no issues whatsoever when travelling on both buses and metro. In fact one evening unbeknown to us I had dropped my purse in the back of a taxi we had hailed at midnight, the following morning the kind gentleman on reception informed us that the taxi driver had found my purse and returned it to the hotel as he recognised the picture on the driving licence and obviously remembered the fayre. Thank you so much (not sure if this would have been the case in the UK) Will definately use this hotel when we next return to Paris

author: jenhigh
title: Everything catered for.
text: Just walking into this hotel was like a breath of fresh air! We arrived in Paris on a very hot day and was immediately confronted with a lovely relaxing and rejuvenating base. The reception staff were very friendly and helpful and checking in went very smoothly. The room on the fifth floor was so welcoming, a well designed good sized room, lovely bathroom and air conditioning that was a real godsend! I had read about rooms in Paris being tiny but this was quite spacious with the added bonus of a balcony overlooking a pleasing tree lined thoroughfare. We decided to try the breakfast and wasn't disappointed. Of course you have to pay but where could you find eggs two ways, various cold meats and bread, cheese, croissants, fresh fruit salad, yoghurts hot and cold drinks for so little?? You can also keep going back and 'filling up'. The whole experience made our holiday knowing you could come back from an exhausting day and just relax..... will definately be returning to this little gem.....

author: Logistical
title: Great location
text: We got upgraded to a luxury from a superior room. This was great but suspect the ordinary rooms are a bit small. The room was well equipped and the shower was good. Reception was helpful and efficient. Air conditioning was noisy but very necessary, it broke down one night and it was 32 celcius. Breakfast is lack lustre, had better bread in an Ibis and the meats were of the reformed pressed variety. Coffee was poor, the Nespresso in the lobby a better option. Service somewhat offhand. Location is excellent, easy access to metro and buses, plenty of restaurants.

author: RockyMountainGrrl
title: Adorable hotel outside Paris!
text: We had the pleasure of staying in this hotel recently and truly enjoyed our stay! The rooms were very well kept, clean, and quite spacious for a European room. Also, we had a shower. Not many do! There was a great complementary breakfast, with fantastic wait staff to help you prepare your food. The location was great, just outside of the city, we were able to experience local living. And, although outside of the city, we were close enough to many landmarks to walk and really enjoy our surroundings. Definitely will use this hotel next time we are in Paris!

author: Kiki2194
title: Definitely recommend
text: Stayed at this hotel for 5 days at the end of April for my birthday, as soon as we arrived the staff member at reception was quick to check us in & upgraded our room as it was my birthday! The hotel is decorated beautifully & is very welcoming. All members of staff on the reception were very helpful & friendly! Our room was spacious with a comfy big bed & a view of the street, the bathroom had a good shower too! Housekeepers came everyday & did a good job. I can't comment on breakfast as we chose to go out instead. The hotel is in a good location for many shops & restaurants, a cinema & also Montparnasse tower, it is also a couple of minutes walk from 2/3 metro stops. I would recommend this hotel to anybody as it's in a great area, beautiful & clean and staff were extremely helpful & friendly.

author: Lesley131
title: A 'Big Birthday' Break
text: We spent a long weekend at Le Royal to celebrate my 60th birthday, travelling by Eurostar. The hotel was very comfortable, not at all cramped, and although the room overlooked the boulevard, there was no appreciable traffic noise. Staff were courteous and helpful and speak good English, and service was excellent. Breakfast was adequate but nothing special. The hotel is perfectly situated for exploring Paris, close to Vavin Metro station (Line4), and if you are a walker, you can be at Notre Dame in about half an hour. The hotel offers a brochure of suggested restaurants within easy reach, which was useful (would recommend Aux Deux Oliviers at 22 rue Vaugirard, just the other side of the Jardin du Luxembourg, near the Senat building, and there is also a good selection of restaurants close to the hotel). We bought metro tickets at the Gare du Nord on arrival - the queue was not particularly long. There is a pharmacy just up the road from the hotel. I found other reviewers' comments helpful in making my choice, and would happily stay there again.

author: Rach49_13
title: Lovely little gem
text: We stayed for 4 nights over Easter at the Hotel Le Royal. This is our third trip to Paris, third hotel, so here are my thoughts.. Positives: - Largest room we have had in Paris (Remember they are all fairly small, but that is the charm of Paris) - Fridge in room - Free tea and coffee in reception all day - Free breakfast - Lovely chap work works behind reception, we arrived early and there was no trouble in looking after us, allowing us to check in early - great location, near metro, both line 4 and line 6 - lovely little restaurants around - little supermarket around the corner, handy is you want to pick up a few things - nicely decorated hotel - clean rooms Negatives - breakfast was a bit hit and miss, very busy and some days items were out and others not, so you have to ask for something which proved to be quite difficult as staff were very hard to find in the breakfast room. To get round this we got to breakfast at 7:30 and that was fine, but if you leave it for another 30 minutes it will be busy and they are not the quickest to clear tables - I found the lady working on reception to be quite rude. on the occasion I asked for the hot water to be topped up for a cup of tea as it was cold she was quite rude and it appeared to be a big ask for some fresh hot water I would stay here again, the best hotel we have stayed at in Paris. I would just have breakfast early everyday, which gives you more time out and about to be honest so works well. A mix of cultures staying which was nice. Thank you for a lovely weekend

author: 597louisee
title: Lovely place!
text: Stayed here for 3 nights on a nice trip to Paris with my partner! we couldn't ask for anything better! the rooms were very clean, smart and have everything you need! couldn't believe how nice and spacious the bathroom was! would stay again! very happy for a 3 star. The only negative i would state is breakfast. Its nice quality food, however service is very slow during busy times, having to wait for clean plates and tables to be cleared, maybe they could do with an extra pair of hands during breakfast!

author: Car0193
title: Lovely hotel
text: My friend and I spent four nights in two single rooms, on the top floor, overlooking Boulevard Raspail. This was our second stay at Le Royal. We had the same rooms four years ago and my room had been redecorated since my last visit. The room was very clean and comfortable with excellent soundproofing and the bonus of air conditioning and free WiFi. Breakfast was very good and all the staff were friendly and helpful. My friend's TV broke and the Manager came straight up and sorted the problem. The location is excellent - numerous local bars, restaurants and shops along with several nearby Metro stations and a direct line from Gare du Nord. The nearby SNCF station has trains to Versailles, the journey takes 15 minutes. I would certainly stay at Le Royal when I next visit Paris.

author: CPv2
title: Le Royal Montparnasse
text: Just returned from a 3 night stay in Paris and would like to say a big Merci to the staff of the hotel for a most pleasant stay. Reception staff were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was more than adequate and the Scrambled Eggs were superb. Room comfortable and tastefully decorated. Location couldn't be better and just a couple of minutes walk from a huge selection of some really excellent restaurants. A 'Franprix' supermarket is just a couple of minutes walk for any supplies you may need, like a 6x 50cl pack of water for €1:26. The L'Open Tour hop on hop off bus stops just down the road and the Montparnasse Tower is a 10 minute walk away, for the most fantastic views of Paris. As others have mentioned, the Metro is just along the road. I would have no problems staying at this hotel again. The only drawback, like many European hotels was the a lack of a decent cup of tea, so if you are like me and enjoy your tea and you plan on visiting this hotel, I recommend taking a few of your favourite tea bags along.

author: Voyageuse038
title: Vive Paris au Royal
text: My daughter and I travelled to Paris in June of 2012. We were very pleased with Le Royal, as it was located very close to Boulevard Montparnasse, the bustling main street of Montparnasse. The subway, the restaurants, a café with amazing baguettes and reasonably priced espresso, la Gare Montparnasse(train station), outdoor market, and several sights were within walking distance of the hotel. The hotel staff was very pleasant and attentive to our needs. A hearty and varied European breakfast was included and we were surprised that some hot entrees, such as hard boiled eggs, were a part of it. The room had a newly renovated large salle de bains (bath room with tub and separate shower) with a separate room for the toilet. We also had free wi-fi. It was rated as a 3 star hotel, but its amenities, staff, washrooms, cleanliness and location were closer to a 4 star. It far surpassed the North American 3 star hotels where I would never stay. My daughter and I were very pleased with our trip to Paris and the informative, attentive staff at Le Royal helped to make it a more pleasant experience.

author: TerriP511
title: Perfect Hotel for a short visit to Paris
text: Stayed here with 3 of my friends to celebrate an 18th birthday. The hotel staff are all very friendly and willing to help. Excellent location - a direct route from Gare du Nord where the eurostar arrives, and a direct line to Bir Hakeim where the opera house & Eiffel Tower are located. There is an array of restaurants, bars etc near the hotel and a short walk away, in Montparnasse itself, near the tower, there is a shopping centre with many shops and it was surrounded by a market whilst we were there. The rooms were a good size, clean and there is free wifi too. Breakfast was sufficient - pastries, scrambled egg, ham, cheese & bread, and yoghurts and fruit, and machines were available to make tea or coffee all day. Overall, a very a pleasent stay. Would definitely return.

author: Marnie09
title: Perfect again!
text: For the third year in a row, we stayed at this wonderful hotel. It is convenient to the Métro, within walking distance of the Jardins du Luxembourg, the Edgar Quinet markets on the weekend, there are lots of great restaurants and the staff is very friendly and helpful. After just our second day, the young man at the desk would hand our room key without our saying the number. He was always so nice and really made our days start out or end nicely because of his smile and friendly manner. The cleaning and dining room staff work hard, quickly and with a smile. We very much appreciate all their hard work to make our stay a good one. We love the street sounds, the lights and will happily stay there again. Merci to all at the hotel!

author: 12JillK
title: Great hotel
text: I have stayed here twice and would be happy to do so again. A clean and comfortable hotel. Good basic continental style breakfast. Most pleasant staff in reception and dining room. A little out of the central area although you could walk in. But located a couple of minutes walk from the Raspail metro station or Vavin. Montparnasse is a quieter area with nice shops and restaurants. Am happy to make this hotel a 'pied a terre' in Paris.

author: Crispin94
title: I love this place......
text: We went to this hotel last August to celebrate our silver wedding. We enjoyed it so much, we came back this year with our daughters. We've been upgraded on both occasions. The rooms size is fine - from looking at pictures of other Parisian hotels, many seem to be very small. The point is, if you are a tourist in Paris, how much time will you be spending in a bedroom anyway? The are clean and tidy The staff are brilliant, very friendly and helpful. The lady in the breakfast room - I'm so sorry, I've forgotten your name - is lovely, always cheerful. There is free coffee in the downstairs lounge. All in all, I can't recommend this hotel highly enough. Thank you for a great time

author: wendyj202
title: Outstanding!!
text: We stayed 5 nights at the Hotel Le Royal and could not have been in a better place. Besides being in one of the most affluent areas in Paris, it was safe and close to the Metro stations. The staff was outstanding!! They were so helpful and dead on when they would give us directions and where to go to avoid lines. They were so helpful and nice. We didn't have to want for anything. The rooms were very clean and updated. I will for sure stay there again when I go back.

author: wesleyl509
title: The staff. Wow!
text: We spent 6 nights here in May and I was absolutely stunned by the amazing staff. They were always to helpful. If you needed even the slightest thing, they were there to help you. I absolutely loved having that at our disposal. Everyone spoke good English, which was helpful. The rooms were kinda small but we managed. They even ended up upgrading us because of some issues with the cleaning of the front of the building. That was almost over with when we left though. Overall, I was very impressed with the staff. I would definitely recommend this to others.

author: stuartnufc
title: Great little hotel
text: Visited in February 2013. Staff extremely helpful and spoke good english. Spent a lot of time to help us get out bearings and let us know where to go and how to get around. Situated cose to a Starbucks :-) and the Metro which is fantastic for getting around paris. The reception desk even gave us an underground map which is a must. Breakfast was great, rooms are small but normal for paris. Very nicely decorated and clean. It was valentines day when we vivsted and we had gist of chocolates left on our bed. The only downside was no view from our room window, however we did pay for hotel with airmiles so the best room was not expected.

author: turnbullsofcolumbine
title: Very friendly hotel in great location
text: The receptionist (male -sorry didnt catch your name) was extremely helpful and friendly, even upgraded us to superior room on 5th floor. The whole place is well decorated and the bedroom was really nice. The location with Metro very close and the RER (from CDG) walkable even with a small wheely if you dont want to change from RER to Metro. The area is more residential than touristy but it is on edge of tourist area. Choice of restaurants is good with prices lower than in the centre. The coffee machine in the lounge makes up for lack of a kettle in room. Our only problem was that the lift broke down on our last night and wasnt fixed when we left next morning ! One of those things but we will go back when we visit Paris again.

author: MelissaM927
title: Small - quiet - wonderful
text: This is in a great neighborhood just out of the 6th arr in the 14th arr Montparnasse. Rooms are small but newly renovated. Bathrooms tiny - it's Europe!! The street was quiet and very neat - bar at the corner and tons of restaurants within walking distance. We were here for 4 nights and loved it. Close to 2 metro stations so it is very easy to get to the sights. You can walk to the Tour Montparnasse - a very ugly building with stunning views of the Eiffel Tower and all of Paris - I prefer it over the Eiffel Tower view since you can see the Eiffel Tower from the Montparnasse Tower. The staff was lovely and very helpful - held our bags after checkout since we had a late train. Breakfast was very good - lots of options and tasty. Would definitely stay here again!!

author: morganbrg
title: Good hotel for a Paris city break
text: Hotel le Royal was booked as part of our Eurostar package for a two night break in Paris. The hotel is perfectly adequate, with clean comfortable rooms and friendly helpful staff. The location is good, close to the metro and within 20 minutes walk of the Seine. It's reasonably basic - rooms are small, and although there is a mini-bar, there is no facility to make drinks in the room (although coffee is available in the downstairs lounge). A basic continental breakfast was part of the package, There is no restaurant, but this is not a problem as there is a wide choice in the surrounding area. If you are looking for luxury, go elsewhere. But is you want reasonable accommodation at a fair price. Hotel le Royal fits the bill.

author: RobertK579
title: Nice place to stay for two
text: We stayed in the Le Royal in Feb. The hotel is nice but has small rooms for three people. The beds and rooms are very comfortable and clean, The morning breakfast is nice and light. Breads, cold ceral, yogurt, hard boiled eggs, meat and cheese, juice and coffee. I suggest that if you have more then two people, rent a second room. Also the hotel does not have any clocks in the room or lobby or a hotel bar. There are bars located close to the hotel. You can catch the metro to go to all of the popular locations.

author: jimmy55bellies
title: Friendly service
text: We stayed here for 2 nights and very much enjoyed our stay. Although the location is not 'central' it is a 1 minute walk to the metro and so Notre Dame and other sights are reachable in 10 minutes. Our room was apparently an 'upgrade'. Despite this there is no doubt that it was very small - you could just about get around the bed. The bed, however, was comfortable, the location seemed quite peaceful and, contrary to some reports, I found the free wifi signal very strong. What probably made this a decent stay as opposed to an average one was the service. In particular, the chap on the front desk (who seemed to be always there) was very helpful and friendly. He made us feel welcome and that he wanted us to enjoy our stay. Breakfasts were fine too - buffet style with croissants, pain au chocolats, salamis, fruit salad etc. Recommended.

author: GailandMarkH
title: Would stay here again .
text: This hotel was amazing <3 <3 <3 My stay in Paris was made even more special by this hotel. The service was welcoming and the reception was warm and cosy. Rooms were clean and comfortable and the shower was very good. Breakfast excellent and a great selection. Perfect for a stay in Paris would recommend it to anybody. It always smelt beautiful of Orange blossom. A fantastic, not too loud location with the right Parisian buzz ! Would stay here again any time.

author: Allnatural99
title: My first trip to Paris
text: First the good, this hotel is an absolutely lovely neighborhood. We didnt get to explore paris as much because we loved all the bars and cafes within walking distance of the hotel. The front desk staff were super nice and helpful. The rooms were decorated nicely. Now the bad, the rooms were very small. We were in a standard double, but i would recommend a deluxe double because our room was just too small. There is some construction nearby and it was noisy in the mornings. The doors closed really hard, so you would hear when your neighbors went in and out. None of the bad however would prevent me from staying here again. I absolutely loved Montparnasse area!

author: mebates00
title: Wow! What a find!!!
text: Really very pleasantly surprised! On arrival we were upgraded to a deluxe room which was remarkably spacious for Paris!! Left Bank location home to writers such as Hemmingway... Very bohemian! Free Nespresso coffee in reception... Lots of restaurants near by. Great. C'est la vie.....

author: RainVictoriabc
title: Excellent Staff
text: Eric on the front desk was extremely friendly and helpful during our stay (answering questions, making phone calls, providing directions). He was very professional and courteous and a credit to the hotel. Another stellar employee is the woman of African origin who worked in the breakfast room (I'm sorry I don't remember her name). Every morning she greeted us with her wonderful smile and a friendly "Bonjour". By the second day she remembered our room number. There were times when she obviously needed some help cleaning tables, doing the dishes, replenishing the food while still working with good grace. I would suggest management provide sufficient help when required. The room we had was very small but I understand that is the norm in Paris. Our stay was very enjoyable and I would stay at the hotel again.

author: LindaD63
title: Great Location and Close to Metro (Vavin)
text: My adult son, daughter and I stayed at this hotel from May 9th to May 13th and were thoroughly happy with the hotel, the staff, the room, the breakfast, everything. The Metro is right around the corner and for me that is a treat as I am older and walk with a cane. Staff extremely helpful in making local calls to reconfirm tours, etc. plus help with Metro destinations. Since we needed a triple room with separate beds, we were very pleased with the size of the room and accommodations. I would stay there again if in Paris. Lots of great restaurants very close by for sitting outside with snacks and adult beverages! But no coffee/tea in room.

author: Crossie10
title: Excellent hotel
text: we stayed in room 32, bit small (compact) but very clean and most important the bed was very comfortable. sheets were cleaned everyday. The only 2 drawbacks were a lack of mirrors in the room, not important but there was wall space for at least 2 and no tea/coffee making facilities, although you could help yourself to free expresso in the entrance lobby. We didn't have to travel far for food, there was a vast assortment of bistros, bars etc all within easy walking distance. Hotel staff were polite and accommodating spoke English and even remembered what room we were staying in, key ready upon our return. Breakfast was plentiful, lots to choose from, selection of fresh pastries, eggs, cheeses, cold meats, fresh fruit salad, cereals, yoghurt, fruit juice, coffee and selection of teas. Everywhere throughout the hotel was clean. There are 3 close Metros, the closest being Vavin and Raspail, you can choose between either station depending upon direction to reduce the amount of times you need to change. Will stay there again, highly recommended!!!

author: Buntybrydon
title: Little Gem
text: We loved this hotel, although it has 60 rooms it feels like a little intimate hotel. We were in a small standard room which had the small window opening into the central court yard area with no view apart from a wall, the room did get warm but the air con cooled it down. The room was beautifully decorated and clean, the bed very comfortable. Great shower in very clean bathroom. Continental breakfast was sufficient, the location of the hotel was superb, near the metro and lots of great bars and cafes around, the hop on hop off bus had a stop just 2 minutes up the road. Our main critism was the lack of coffee making facilities in the room, there was an expresso machine in the lobby but this broke while we were there. This was no great use anyway as we like coffee with milk so kept having to nip to starbucks on the way back at night. This is the first time I have stayed in a hotel which did not have these push flasks or somewhere to get coffee or tea if there were no facilities in the room. I would stay in this hotel again, the small room didn't bother us much as we were rarely in it apart from to sleep and shower and the staff were extremely pleasant, just sort out the coffee and we would be very happy.

author: Marnie09
title: Perfectly French and we loved it!
text: We stayed at Le Bréa last Christmas but the hotel was full for our September trip. Air France Holiday Services told us that Le Royal was the "sister" hotel, 1/2 star better and only a block away. It was a great place to stay! The rooms were larger and the staff every bit as nice as Le Bréa. Our rooms were kept very clean by extremely sweet cleaning ladies and the desk staff was always helpful and very nice to us. It is on a busy street but the windows keep out the street noise if you prefer. We love being on the front of the building and hearing all the French sounds with the window open! It is close to the métro, about 3 blocks to Jardins du Luxenbourg, there are many bistros from cheap to expensive in the area. We would most definitely stay there again.

author: MyrnaPlantation
title: very good hotel, superb location
text: The hotel is idealy located a short walking distance from all forms of transportation , it is very unique from the outside and at night the purple lights are just beautiful and it stands out. It is very clean with good service, the staff was very friendly and professional and spoke excellent english and provided us with good suggestions and excellent directions .Eric is just great and was especially helpful. TV was mostly in french, CNN and BBC in english. Our room over looked Rasparil blvd. and at night the panoromaic view was breath taking. We were pleased with our room and breakfast was very good. A special thanks to Eric. We would definitely recommend this hotel to friends and others. Myrna and Madge

author: ChipJ_11
title: Great Boutique Hotel in wonderful Paris Neighborhood!
text: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Le Royal in Aug. 2011.
