We had a deluxe double room, overlooking Raspail Blvd. It was spacious, had plenty of closet space, was close to two metro stops (Vavin and Raspail) and a train station to the airport (allow ample time, CDG is a ways away - allow 45 min. to 1 hour to get there by train). The staff was attentive, the hotel was very clean, nicely updated, and was in a nice but not so touristy neighborhood (which is what we were looking for). Twelve euros seems really high for what was provided at the breakfast and we would recommend skipping that (we were glad we did after seeing the buffet). As with many hotels in Europe a double bed is two singles pushed together (thus the slight nock on the "sleep" category). Overall, we would highly recommend Hotel Le Royal to anyone considering a trip to Paris!

author: zuikozoom
title: Fantastic, can't wait to return
text: Fantastic hotel. Welcomed by extremely friendly staff who all spoke excellent english. Our room very clean and comfortable and bathroom very clean. Breakfast excellent with plenty of fresh fruit, beverages and choice of alternatives. Good location equidistant from Vavin and Raspail Metro Stations. Less than 5 mins away. If arriving at CDG the Air France le Cars shuttle coach line 4yellow is great value and drops you a 10. Min walk away at Montparnasse Gare. Good Wifi 5MB great for Skype

author: RosTou
title: Wonderful!
text: My husband and I recently stayed at Le Royal for the second time. From start to finish, the experience was wonderful. Eric, at the front desk, immediately recognized us from our previous stay. He welcomed us warmly and went out of his way to make us feel comfortable. The hotel is clean and attractive; our room was great. Le Royal is centrally located. It's within walking distance of the Jardin du Luxembourg and some wonderful cafés and restaurants. The breakfast was delicious, too! We look forward to our next visit.

author: beadish
title: SUPERB
text: Fabulous hotel. Reception staff very helpful and friendly. Got upgraded to a deluxe room as staying for 3 days. Room16. Clean,lots of space, great beds and large bathroom. Breakfast -bread, cheese, hams,eggs, coffee, tea ,juice. All fresh and well presented. Can't understand the negative reviews,we couldn't fault it. The metro was about 5 mins walk. Will definately stay again when we visit Paris.

author: AlexNCollins
title: Great location, beautifully renovated, amazing staff
text: We loved the Hotel Le Royal. The hotel and rooms were beautifully updated. The location was great -- minutes walk from a couple Metro stations. Staff were extremely helpful when it came to events and directions. The breakfast served was also lovely. I could not be happier with our experience. My only small complaint was that our bed was two single beds pushed together, which wasn't the most comfortable arrangement, but it was very minor. I loved this hotel.

author: Podolano
title: Good Stay at Hotel Le Royal
text: I stayed at the Hotel between Dec 31 2010 and Jan 06, 2011, with my wife and two kids (7 and 5 years old). The hotel was undergoing some refitting and repainting, of which we have not been told before. But anyhow, there was not a single noise that could be heard from the work being done there (only a little fresh paint smell). We stayed at the Junior Suite, which was well equiped, but lacked a bit of comfort, since the beds were not what we expected. The staff was good, with an honorable mention to Eric, who was very helpful all times and aided us in finding restaurants, giving advice about attractions, transportation, etc., besides being very friendly and courteous to guests. We really appreciated that. Hotel location was good, though in a Boulevard, quiet and only less than 5-min walk of a subway station. We did not have breakfast at the hotel any day, so I´m skipping this comment.

author: LCubano
title: Merci; we will be back!
text: We selected this review based on a package price, reviews and location. Our daughter scouted a month earlier and enjoyed everything about the accomodations. My wife and I arrived and were quite happy with the reception we received and the atmosphere at Le Royal. I will not tell you that I have stayed in hundreds of hotels but can tell you I do Quality Management for a major hospital enterprise. Our package price was unbeatable and we opted to upgrade our accomodation to Le Royal based on it's location. The breakfast buffet was superb, the wait staff was always very pleasant and courteous and together made for a great start to another day in Paris. Coming home after very long walking days, we were always warmly welcome and our room was perfect. We would return to this location for all of the aforementioned reasons and then some...merci!

author: Parisselect
title: Warm and welcoming...
text: Absolutely loved this hotel! The location is fantastic, all sorts of lovely places just about two steps away! The people at the reception desk were very friendly, as were the cleaners. I did not have breakfast in the hotel as there are so many wonderful cafes around there. The Jardin de Luxembourg is just around the corner, as are loads of lovely shops, restaurants and cafes. Le Select became quiet my local. I loved the cleanliness of the rooms too, as previously in Paris I had not been so lucky on that account. Liked as well how easy this hotel was to get to from the Gare du Nord. Am saving up frantically to return as soon as I can!

author: AtmNorthernIreland
title: I would definately go back here and recommend to everyone
text: A very clean and well organised small hotel. Standard room was compact but clean, nice ensuite, aircon, great blackout blinds and one of the best beds that I have slept in! Fronting a quiet road, adjacent to a really great busy area full of cafes and restaurants. So easy to get to from Charles De gaulle airport, train straight to Port Royal and then a 5 minute walk. Two metro stops are also close by, easy access to the City and Eiffle Tower. Continental breakfast was really lovely, you can eat as much as you want, staff also very helpful. Free wi fi and internet use, Flat screen Tv etc. All I have to do is save up for returning to it!

author: trev1uk
title: Good Service & Good Base. Not Always Quiet Though.
text: The Hotel Royal is a small hotel but is in a good location for exploring without paying ridiculous prices elsewhere. The staff are generally friendly and helpful. I'd booked a single room, which was small even on that basis, but it was definately clean and the bed was comfortable. The in-room TV picture reception was quite poor. The first night, those in neighbouring rooms were noisy, and on another it seemed that - at 2am - a member of the hotel staff was going round all the empty rooms and checking them - with each door slamming shut as they went. The hotel offers a small selection at breakfast - continental buffet with juice and coffee - and you can have free coffee throughout the day. The hotel also offers free use of the single computer as well as free wifi - although there connection problems with both when I stayed. Out and about, you're not far from anything:- metro, restaurants, the usual sights and attractions, shops, bars, grocers and markets. All in all, this hotel offers quite good value given its location, and it is clean, tidy and comfortable. If you can live with the occassional late night noise, it offers a good base to explore Paris.

author: Albyn66
title: Does what it says on the tin. - A no frills hotel which serves as an excellent base for exploring Paris
text: Location: Based in Montparnasse near three metros, giving easy access all parts of Paris. Around the hotel are several reasonable bars and bistros. (Though to be honest, better ones are found a short metro trip away in St Germain). Down some of the smaller streets are also some nice boutique type shops. Jardin du Luxembourg is also a short walk away. Getting there: We found this hotel easy to reach, a simple train ride on the RER from the airport (CDG) to Port Royal and a 5 min walk to the hotel. The Hotel itself was very comfortable and clean. We had a junior suite so the room was spacious The Staff were also very helpful. They dealt with all enquiries in an efficient manor, especially with checking in online for the journey home.

author: theworldgoround
title: Excellent hidden gem in Pairs
text: An excellent hotel. Normally we stay in 4-5 star four seasons, starwood or radisson hotels. This time we decided to just do it differently. So we booked hotel le royal. This was an excellent suprise. We were greeted on arrival by name without identifying ourselves. The room was a bit small but excellent in terms of cleaning and completness. Even the bed was fine. The reception was very friendly and went out of here way to be of assistance. Booking a diner cruise, providing the name of a nice restaurant near Even today when checking out the service was excellent.

author: ahlavenka
title: would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay there again
text: This hotel was perfect. It was clean, neat, air conditioned and rather a good size for Europe. Stay in the twin bed rooms which have been updated - the double room which I caught a glimpse of are much smaller. It was in a good and safe neighborhood which we walked around until late in the evening. There are multiple cafes, restaurants and bistros right around the corner with such great choices. It is about a hundred feet away from two metro stations ( you will be at any of the attractions and sites within 5 - 10 minutes.) Although in a bustling area the rooms were soundproofed and we could not hear any noise coming from the street. Staff was wonderful and helpful. Breakfast was a good way to start the day. If I ever go back to Paris I would stay here again.

author: odziggel
title: best value in Paris/Montparnasse without comprimising quality
text: I spent around 4-5 hours on trip advisor looking for a hotel for 2 nights for a weekend trip to Paris. In the areas we were looking at (Montparnasse/St Germain/Quartier Latin) this hotel definitely represented the best value-for-money BY FAR (around 1/2 the price of equivalent hotels) without wanting to sacrifice the quality and comfort of Western-style accommodation, and did not disappoint. The location was fantastic (50 yards from the nearest metro station; a no-more-than-5 minute walk to a major one with several lines running through it etc) and was conveniently located just off Boulevard Montparnasse, making it easy to find and/or describe where it is. The lobby was air-conditioned, clean, friendly staff, locked at night (with someone at the front-desk to let you in.) There is also a computer for guests' use with free internet access. The receptionist was even kind enough to allow me to use it several hours after we had checked out to book our train tickets home. The room was small - as is to be expected of all hotel rooms in Paris - but very clean, modern, well air-conditioned, mini-bar available, WiFi with a strong signal - everything was covered flawlessly, to the point where you ask yourself what other comparable hotels could possibly be doing to charge twice the rate. The bathroom was the same - small but modern and clean. All in all I was 100% satisfied with our choice of this hotel, and was very relieved that it did not disappoint in any way. This would definitely be my choice of hotel if I were to return to Paris (unless I wanted to try something new just for the sake of staying in a different part of the city etc.)

author: andrewbLondon
title: Small room, but spotlessly clean and friendly staff
text: The room was very small - bathroom had a shower, no bath. Rooms were cleaned every day to a high standard, staff were very friendly and helpful and went out of their way to make your stay pleasant. Coffee is available at all times, but breakfast was additional cost but I didn't have any so can't comment. Free wifi was extremely convenient as well as computer in the lobby. Lobby also has very comfy chairs and sofas for visitors. Not cheap, but by paris standards a great price for a 3* hotel. Lots of restaurants in the area and metro is extremely closeby. All in all a clean, friendly place to stay but not overly luxurious or romantic.

author: Momplustwo
title: Friendly, comfortable hotel at a great location in Paris
text: We booked this hotel as part of an Air France Holidays vacation (after checking TripAdvisor, of course!). We had a triple room (hard to find in Paris). The hotel was clean, quiet, comfortable and well-located in a quiet residential neighborhood of the 14th Arondissement. It has a courteous English-speaking desk staff. Two short blocks away is busy Montparnasse Blvd. with many restaurants and shops. There two Metro stations within two blocks. The breakfast room was bright and airy, with good food and friendly fellow travelers. The only drawback (?) was a tiny elevator, to be expected for a European city hotel in a stately older building. I highly recommend this hotel.

author: Benbjy
title: Great Hotel, Fantastic Location
text: We stayed three nights at this hotel for the start of our honeymoon. Unknowingly until we checked out we were upgraded to a superior room and it was excellent. The reception area makes the hotel look a higher standard than it is. The room we had was spotless and the bathroom was massive with a bath and very powerful shower. We loved the location of the hotel. There were plenty of bars and restaurants within a 100 yards of the hotel. The area has a real buzz and there were two metro stations with in walking distance. The hotel does not have a bar but as the manager said there is one next door. If you are looking for a hotel as a base for sight seeing and do not mind leaving the hotel to eat and drink this hotel will be hard to beat.

author: gizzmo00
title: A small clean hotel, ideal for sightseeing
text: Situated in the Montparnasse area with all the bars and restaurants this hotel is small, clean and very quiet. The staff are friendly and helpful. Roomes are typically small as are most in Paris. Free Wifi was a welcome bonus. The breakfast was average and to be honest a little repetative and we had to ask for meats and croissants to be refilled however this was willingly and quickly done. We had a room overlooking Rue Raspail but heard little noise due to good sound insulation. Metro was just around the corner and this gave us easy access to the rest of Paris. Well recommended

author: BernalBot
title: Wonderful Hotel, Great Location!
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my 4-night stay at the Hotel Le Royal. The location was convenient to the Metro and was walking distance to cafes, shops and other sites. The staff was friendly and helpful. They took the liberty of upgrading our room was extra special. There was a misplacement of our room key and they gave me a new key, and eventually found the original. The continental breakfast was wonderful and offered quite a variety beyond what you'd find in the U.S. I loved the extra amenities such as the Nespresso coffee machine and free WiFi. The room was a good size, quiet and clean (high points!).

author: brambling_10
title: Excellent hotel, excellent location
text: Lovely hotel with charming management - we were greeted by name when we arrived. Our children had a fantastic room at the front of the hotel overlooking the street. Our room was at the back and very quiet. The breakfast was ok and enough to keep us going through the day. The area is great - there's a fantastic bistro (Bistrot des Campagnes) just across the street and along Rue Léopold Robert, and plenty of others within easy walking distance - could have spent a month there just exploring the local eateries. Would I stay there again? Definitely! (I was also present in the lobby when the the previous reviewer's wife was complaining about lack of wi-fi. To be honest I thought she was being unreasonable and, to my mind the management were dealing with this difficult customer with great courtesy.)

author: clairevdb
title: fantastic hotel and great base for all the sights
text: I would highly recommend this hotel for a leisure or business trip. The hotel was well located being 10 mins easy walk from the Port Royal RER stop making it quick and easy to access from the CDG airport. The Hotel had a very smart frontage and foyer with very friendly front desk staff ( a change from normal parisian experience). The room itself was spacious for a city hotel and beautifully decorated. More importantly it was spotless with a large clean bathroom, a power shower and an excellent powerful hairdryer. There are restaurants and bars close to the hotel, we found it very easy to walk to many of the sights and it is also located on 2 metro lines so very accessible to many sights. We really enjoyed all of the main sights and particularly walking around the St Germain Boulevard where we ate 2 nights, I would definitely recommend Le Pub St Germain for a coffee or cocktail. We also loved relaxing in the sun in the Jardin De Luxembourg on the free sun chairs they provide.

author: Victoria_Voyageur
title: Good value for money in a great location.
text: Front desk staff were very helpful—even the guy who kept trying to sell us boat trips on the Seine. The a/c actually worked, which is more than one can say for many other Parisian hotels (the lobby of the Holiday Inn near the Jardin du Luxembourg, for example, was a sauna). The rooms were very clean and elegantly appointed, and the bathrooms were full size and comfortable. As for the location, it was perfect. Just a few blocks from the Luxembourg gardens, a couple blocks from the Tour Montparnasse (be sure to go up on top for the view) and mere steps off Boulevard Montparnasse. If you stay here, check out the Italian restaurant next door. Free wireless is available, but slow and you need to ask for more (it's given out in doses of two or five hours at a time for some unfathomable reason). The room was quiet and the bed was very comfortable. We'd stay there again. The only downside: no hot breakfast (but the coffee and croissants in the breakfast room were superb).

author: AMW2kids
title: Great hotel, great location, friendly staff equals VALUE
text: We arrived at noon and our rooms were ready. Staff were quite helpful and even told us which Metro interchange to avoid (since we had kids with us). The rooms were good size & comfortable and we were pleasantly surprised with the bathrooms. Our rooms faced Raspail (major street) but the windows were sound proof. The breakfast, although the menu was the same everyday, was quite hearty. The best part about Royal Hotel is its LOCATION. Close to 2 Metro stops with lots of cafes of different price points within a block. It is also close to Luxembourg Gardens & one the the Lafayette Galeries. We will definite stay there again. It was perfect for our family (with preteens kids).

author: Barry17
title: Paris in Spring
text: We stayed here on the recommendation of my brother. Comfortable without being swish. Staff were friendly and generally got by with English. Able to walk easily to the city centre and underground very close. Lots of eating places around, some very expensive and some delightfully inexpensive. We ate a couple of times at a little Italian place just around the corner that gave good quality at a reasonable priceBreakfast was a bit ordinaire but not too bad for european standards in this level of hotel. Bit noisy if you slept with the window open, but nice to be able to get fresh air.Easy to find and proximity of underground was great, with a direct line to Gare du Nord. Very clean and no issues. Would happily stay there again

author: lovelouisa_8
title: Great location!
text: My husband and I have just returned from a 3 day break at the Royal Montparnasse. When we arrived we were given a room with no window or daylight. I complained to the very helpful receptionist and was immediately given another room which was perfect. It looked out onto a school and had good views of the Montparnasse Tower. The hotel is simple but well furnished, clean and very comfortable. The location is excellent with Metro station Vavin just across the road. The station is on a direct line from Gare du Nord line 4, which is very useful if you are arriving by Eurostar. Definitely recommended but don't accept the 'darkroom.'

author: MariCanari
title: nice hotel, good location
text: We just returned from a week's stay in Paris at Hotel Le Royal. It was a very nice and charming hotel in a very central location, easily accessible by the metro. There are also numerous restaurants on Montparnasse blvd which is its main intersection. We criss-crossed Paris every day to see the sights and easily used the metro every day. The staff were helpful and friendly and also spoke excellent English. While our room was small in North American standards, we adjusted to it and found it comfortable as we were really only using the hotel as a place to sleep! Our breakfast was included in our package and it was quite good - croissants, fresh coffee, juice, pains au chocolat, fruit. Overall, I would definitely reccommend this hotel for the budget conscious traveller looking for a friendly and comfortable place to stay.

author: piggytailchick
title: Great location - very clean and comfortable
text: We travelled on Eurostar to Paris - Gare Nord, and got the metro to Le Royal, (Really easy, Line 4 and jump off at Vavin should take about 20/25mins). Hotel is about 1 minute walk (if that) from metro but as the paths are tree lined, you cannot not see it from the metro exit…. Look out for the large (and impressive) seafood restaurant on corner it is very close/about opposite to that!!! Check-in very swift, room a fair size, and very clean with quite dark décor but contemporary. Excellent double glazing, the street was quite busy in morning, but you could hardly hear it at night and we were on the front of the hotel. Floors a bit squeaky and the doors to the guest’s rooms shut with rather a thump, but not a problem…. Breakfast good and served til 10.30am ….. croissants, fresh baguettes, honey jam, lovely fruit salad, coffee, and juice, really simple but plentiful! Overall really pleased with hotel and location, I would recommend this to friends and stay there if we visited Paris in the future! Do wander round the Jardin de Luxembourg (Large gardens very close to hotel) it is very beautiful and have a drink in the news café on corner...very relaxing!) One warning …..the food and drinks in Paris are very expensive…… (especially with the poor exchange rate at the moment!!)

author: Kwasibo
title: Lovely stay at the Hotel Le Royal
text: We had a lovely time in Paris an this enhanced by an excellent staty at the Hotel Le Royal in Paris. The location was excellent. It was easy to find and a couple of minutes from two metro stations. Also it is on the CityTours bus route and hence makes taking the tour and seeing the sights easy. The staff were excellent and always willing to help as well as informative. The breakfast was continental and adequate. The room was contempary but homely and the shower very clean. For a 3* the general standard was excellent. Would definitely recommend.

author: Friesh
title: Fantastic Week
text: My wife and I just returned from our first trip to Paris. We stayed at the Hotel Le Royal, a fabulous little hotel on the second longest street in Paris. It was clean, well kept. Even though we spoke a little French, the desk clerks all spoke English. The desk clerks were all courteous and helpful. Our stay included a continental breakfast every morning which was always fresh and delicious. The room we had was small but very comfortable. The bathroom facilities were modern and clean. We had a fantastic time and would stay there again.

author: glassofred
title: A great hotel - perfect for a weekend getaway
text: Booked this hotel through Airmiles for my daughter's 18th birthday treat. Despite this being a freebie (covered by Airmiles) - we were made to feel most welcomed and the hotel made no attempt to get us to upgrade to a more expensive room - and no need to. Great location - direct Metro from Gare du Nord. Nice size room and quiet location despite overlooking a large Blvd. Lots of nice restaurants just around the corner and fun Fondue restaurant just across the street! Excellent hotel staff, thank you Michel for taking such good care of us and recommending a nice restaurant in the Latin Qtr! Breakfast was very nice, typical Continental and never very busy. Decor of hotel and rooms was very modern,clean and soothing to the eye after a long day in Paris. We will definitely go back. Closest Metro stop is Vavin and is just 5 mins walk away.

author: jbp19
title: Modern Hotel, Great Location
text: We stayed here for 7 nights as part of a vacation package to Paris. The room was clean (especially bathroom/shower), functionally arranged, and of good size for a European hotel. The entire hotel was sparkling clean, and the concierges and hotel staff were most helpful with giving directions in the area, and answering any questions. The hotel is very close to the Metro line 4 (stop: Vavin), with quick access to the center of Paris and all attractions. Gare Montparnasse is also nearby. Hotel breakfast offered croissants, pain au chocolat, cereal, bread, yogurt, etc. Lots of good restaurants in the area, for all budgets, including moules-frites, fondue/raclettes, Breton creperies; great patisseries for quick lunches. The hotel offers wi-fi usage for guests at a small, reasonable fee. We were very satisfied with our stay, and will return on our next trip to Paris.

author: keen_traveller0150
title: Okay hotel
text: I treated my husband to a trip to Paris for a special birthday. We stayed at the Le Royal. The room was very nicely decorated, but quite small. The shower screen door would not stay on the bath, consequently you had to hold the door away from your body all the time whilst showering. Although we mentioned this a couple of times to the receptionist, nothing was done about it. The breakfast was okay, nothing that special. We found a very good restaurant called Chez Fernand which was just along the road from Le Royal. Although the menu was in French - the waiter kindly translated into English. I had a very good goat ravioli, followed by duck in a cassis sauce and to finish Nougat ice- cream. I would highly recommend this place.

author: travelnyc78
title: Great Location - Not Disappointed
text: Le Royal Luxembourg/Montparnasse is well located, close to the number 4 train (2 mins walk), close to most major sites of Paris. A few good restraurants just around the corner. I recommend La Coupole strongly. We Stayed in the Classic Triple Room for 5 nights. The room is spacious and clean with AC and Plat panel LCD TV. What we like the best is the bathroom. It's big and has 2 sinks with a separated toilet with a door. It also has one shower and a separate bath tube. The breakfast was good and typical, the staff were friendly and helpful. I would stay here again.

author: imperialtopaz
title: Good location and value
text: I stayed here for six nights in late March in a superior room. I needed to be in the Montparnesse area, so I picked it for the location. There are some great restaurants nearby. I actually thought the breakfast was fine, by Paris standards, and I had mine served in the room. Book a superior room, since the regular ones are small. First time visitors to Paris might not be as happy with the location, since it is a long walk up to Notre Dame, etc. Metro nearby. What I like about this location is that it is not overrun with tourists. Hotel recently redone in modern, bold colors--great for those who don't like all the florals.

author: Londontraveller033
title: Stay at this hotel!
text: My 10 year old daughter and I stayed at this hotel in April 2004 for 4 nights. It was wonderful. It seems to have been recently refurbished and the room we had (no.15) was not particularly large but beautifully furnished and the shower and loo were separate which is unusual but nice. Our room was at the front of the hotel on busy Boulevard Raspail but the sound proofing on the windows was amazing - we hardly heard a thing. The staff were really friendly to both of us. The breakfasts were fairly good, the croissants were excellent although the fruit salad would have been better had it been fresh fruit and the coffee arrangements could have been better. The hotel is in an excellent location, just a few minutes walk from the Jardins de Luxembourg and near some really nice restaurants and patisseries! The only drawback for my daughter was that although the tv was advertised as being satellite it was all French or Arabic although there was a channel allotted for the BBC which didn't work. We asked for it and were told that it was something to do with the satellite being pointed in a certain direction! But we had a fantastic time and having a great hotel certainly contributed to that.

author: Fiametta7
title: A well-placed hotel
text: The hotel, on the Blvd Montparnasse, is very central; very near our favourite part of Paris, St. Germain-des-Pres. Overall the hotel was excellent. The reception staff (with one exception) were pleasant and helpful and the chamber-maid was one of the nicest we ever came across. Where we felt there could be some improvement was the breakfast - come on, a thermos of coffee in Paris! And that was never hot!! And if they happened to have run out of yoghurts - tough!! Tinned fruit salad would also not be high on our want list of breakfast items. Still the rooms were large (for Paris) and extremely comfortable, although a word of warning, our safe eeriely opened without being asked several times. Verdict: Elegant hotel; great location; could do better on the breakfast front.

author: BecCoop1
title: Beautiful resort
text: This is a small resort with tons of charm and excellent service! We had a 3 bedroom unit with 2 bathrooms - a fill kitchen -living room and washer and dryer. Cindy will take care of your every need- she can set up fishing - scuba- snorkel - taxi - golf cart - advice on where to eat and what to do. Her staff quietly takes great care of everything! Rob is much more than a bartender! He can help with everything and is an entertainer too! We really enjoyed this location. The only negative is that this is about 2 miles from most everything. That being said- I really did not see anywhere else that would have fit our needs that was closer. To stay in town would be loud and they did not have the beautiful pool dock and ocean view from every unit!

author: leishac2019
title: Great Getaway
text: Great staff and very nice place! The condo was very well appointed and clean. Nice outdoor patio/porch facing the ocean. The property is south of town and a bit secluded but that appealed to us. The only negative (and this doesn't just apply to Athens Gate) is that at times there is a very strong seaweed / sulfur smell. The staff at AG keeps the beach in front of the resort clean and free of seaweed and there is a nice palapa on property to swim off of. They also provided paddle boards and sit on top kayaks that you could use to paddle to the blue water. Overall, it was a great trip and I highly recommend this resort.

author: X249LNdanielleg
title: Amazing vacay this is the place
text: Most wonderful time at Athens gate the Rooms are clean, spacious, beautiful and have everything you need! We adore the staff Rob at the bar not only makes the best drinks but is knowledgeable on the island and always willing to help you with anything you need! Cindy is always there too and is kind with her generous hospitality! She will help you with accommodations and all your excursions! Also i have to say Lewis the security guard is the best! So on the spot with his assistance on property but also a super sweet man that we loved chatting with! We will be back we will stay at Athens Gate! The place and the people are the reason!!!

author: jaystaystill
title: Why even stay anywhere else?
text: Simply put, this place felt like home since day one. From our very first interaction with the resort manager Cindy, to our bartender Rob, and the rest of the staff, I could not have dreamed up better service. I'm a very low maintenance person and this was exactly what I was looking for in a resort. With only 12 rooms I felt like we had the resort was to oirselves all week long. The drinks at the bar were phenomenal, and Rob always helped us tray out new drinks. The full kitchen made cooking up breakfast and other meals super great. Very clean facilities, and the use of the paddle boardd and kayaks werw just the icing on the cake. Speaking of icing, an unprovoked birthday cake and balloons were left in our room for when we arrived back on my birthday! Thank you again so much Cindy, that was what made it official that this was a place I would tell all my friends and family about! I hope to come back again, Athens Gate will be my home away from home again and again.

author: IdahoMiner
title: Beautiful view, great location, accommodating staff
text: We had an amazing stay at Athens Gate. Our family of four (2 adults plus kids 9 & 11) were in condo #11: a beautiful condo with everything we needed to prepare simple meals. The pool is smaller but was never crowded. The staff in attentive but not pushy (they don’t try to sell you drinks, services or tours, but they are very knowledgeable if you need anything!) The location is south of town (yes, you will need that golf cart) which was wonderful for us because it was less busy and very relaxing. All of our snorkel/boat tours picked up right from our dock. Speaking of our dock, what an unexpected bonus! We swam and snorkeled there, watched the rays leap out of the water, saw birds dive for fish, and my son caught a red snapper right off our dock! The staff provided poles and bait, and the bartender even cleaned the fish when we were done. Overall it was the perfect place for us to enjoy our time in Belize.

author: vchane1955
title: Private paradise close to the action
text: Beautiful, private boutique hotel but close to many restaurants and town. Cindy and Rob are amazing. They go over the top in taking care of you and making stay enjoyable. Only negative is in the 2 bedroom, the 2nd bedroom is very small. Didn't bother us but might matter to some. Grouper and red snapper fabulous everywhere. Don't miss Robin's for jerk chicken. Out of this world and $7 US dollars for lunch.

author: Diane10216
title: Athens Gate
text: We loved the location, the small size and the staff! They were all so nice and helpful. Cindy was our personal concierge and made restaurant recommendations and reservations, booked our inter island flights, golf cart, airport transportation, and excursions. The private day with Oliver was amazing!! Between Derrick, Robert and Cindy, our vacation was fabulous! they made us feel like family! Great drinks at the bar too! We wouldn't have had to leave the resort but Cindy provided so many great suggestions. We'll be back!

author: islandseeker5
title: Leave everything up to the staff
text: I'm not used to this level of service. we always do our own search for activities and places. Not here, you mention it aand it happens @ no extra charge. You want jet skiies, they bring it to dock. You want to do do yoga, they calll and reserve the place for you. You want to go to the blue hole, tickets are reserved, I could go on and on. We are so spoiled now since they have set the bar so high. Best of all was the fishing excusrion, The boat is @ the dock, you go fishing, they take you to an isolated beach, cook the fish, feed you and take you snorkling. This would cost over $1000 on other islands. Make sure you ask fro Gavino

author: Star69cwak
title: Stay here and learn to love Belize! Wonderful vacation.
text: We traveled with our adult daughter and were looking for a resort where we would have an extra bedroom and bath for her. This was perfect, actually a full condo with lots of space, kitchen and view of the ocean. The location is great, about 15 minutes by golf cart (rent one) to center San Pedro and restaurants in walking distance as well.The staff here raises the experience above the ordinary, however. Cindy booked everything for us: dinner reservations, snorkel trips, dives for our daughter, snorkeling, catamaran trips, everything including a recommendation for secret beach, and every single choice was excellent. We felt like we really knew the island after a week. We appreciated the in unit washer dryer and the maid servce. The beach was in perfect shape and the internet was adequate enough to allow me to work on my computer. We will definitely return.

author: Deejoh
title: Great family getaway!
text: We are here and loving it!!! Slice of heaven!! Rob and Cindy are taking care of us!!! The condos are spacious and clean!! Rob spoiled us with a variety of perfect cocktails. Cindy took care of golf cart, dinner reservations and awesome excursions! Our favorite day was on the catamaran to Mexico Rocks. We made our reservation for a return trip next February! We love the quiet and view!

author: Extraordinary764010
title: Terrific!
text: This is a great place! Nice-sized three bedroom condo with kitchen and a beautiful balcony. The pool is good and you are right on the beach. The pier is dreamy. We watched sunrise over the water from the end of the pier, in very comfortable chaise lounge chairs, a couple of mornings, and it felt like we were in paradise. Cindy and her whole team were extraordinary: kind, helpful, thoughtful. You’re nicely removed from the buzz of town but just a short and easy ride away via golf cart. It was absolutely perfect for our family of five. We would love to come back one day.

author: Safari42340642156
title: Great place and super staff!
text: One of our favorite vacations! The rooms were furnished beautifully and we had everything we needed. The pool and beach area were great to hang out if you didn’t want to go to town. Our group was so well taken care of by the entire staff! Anything we needed or asked to have help with was not a problem for the staff to handle. Best service I have experienced! Also a great location to be near town but not right in the middle of it. Will be back for sure!

author: E4848AVstevek
title: Great Resort and even better staff
text: Stayed at Athens Gate for 7 days. From the get-go the staff took care of us. Cindy booked all of our excursions and even arranged travel from Belize City to San Pedro as well as the shuttle to the hotel. Upon arrival she had all of our excursion paperwork set up. She made this vacation phenomenal. The cleaning staff was amazing as well. The hotel is located south of the airport which was in my opinion the best area to stay. If I ever go back to Belize I will be going back to Athens gate for sure.

author: Kareng9800
title: A.M.A.Z.I.N.G!!!
text: If you are searching for a place to stay- look no further! Athens Gate was terrific but the staff was ever better! They all went above and beyond! Cindy took care of everything- transfers, golf cart, excursions, reservations etc. And Rob always made sure we had the most delicious drinks- Luis who keeps a watch in the evenings was the sweetest. The cleanliness of the room and the property shows the care that the staff takes. We can not wait to return! Thank you for a wonderful vacation!!!

author: Ambassador762343
title: Amazing trip!
text: The place was amazing! Cindy, Rob, Luis were so helpful and friendly. Clean and large rooms, pool, games and awesome bar! We did 2 tours and relaxed at the hotel. Everything about it was so great. we enjoyed the slow pace south of the busy city. Short golf cart ride to the city, or a nice restaurant,lonestar across the street. We'll be back, the staff is like family to us. Loved it!!

author: ntrpriz1701e
title: Repeat customer - will do it again!
text: If you like something, do it again. If you love something - stick with it! That is this location. The location is south of San Pedro (the better side in our opinion) but close to places to eat, a drive into town. It is quiet (if that is what you want) but supports the good times you come for. Different groups there from families to adults!. Great places to walk on the beach. Great attentive staff Cyndi, Derrick, Robert, and of course Luis - all make sure you stay with them is great! You can't go wrong staying at Athens Gate...

author: MariaPau333
title: Athens Gate Beach Resort was wonderful
text: I loved my stay. The staff was wonderful. Rob, the bartender was awesome and very friendly. He was always nearby to make us delicious cocktails. Cindy was also so great. She was very thoughtful and super helpful with tips. She also helped me out after hours when my brother got sick. Overall Athens Gate was great and I highly recommend it.

author: galty75
title: I will keep going back
text: Athens gate is a beautiful beach front property. I stayed a week with my friend and my daughter. I rented a 2 bedroom, the layout is spacious and very comfortable. The staff is amazing and takes care of everything. Rob and Cindy made our trip outstanding. If it’s your first time visiting the island I would definitely book with Athens Gate because they help you with everything on the island. I loved and will keep going back. My daughter loved the pool. You can swim off the dock or just chill on the dock. Amenities include: security, a/c, washer/dryer, nice people, chill vibe, golf cart rental, taxi, they will arrange all of your excursions for you as well.

author: mikecathy1
title: First Belize Experience
text: We had a wonderful week at Athens Gate Beach Resort, it can be as quiet and tranquil or as busy as you want. Athens Gate provides a very personal experience which is made possible by the staff who treat everyone like family and go above and beyond to make your stay enjoyable. Cindy was amazing and assisted us with the booking process , inter island fights, golf cart rental snorkeling tours, restaurant suggestions and I could go on. Rob and Byron took care of us at the pool bar, nothing was to much trouble. Even helping some younger guests round up little hermit crabs from the beach! We tried quite a few of the local restaurants , and utilized the full kitchen which is really well equipped. The room was really nice and roomy with very comfortable beds and a huge balcony. San Pedro is a 15 minutes golf cart ride away , but there are restaurants within a closer distance to Athens Gate too. Some of the ones we liked were Hidden Treasure, Pier 366, Black Orchid.We tried Robins for a taste of local BBQ, and Pelican Reef the sister resort close by for lunch.Can't wait to go back!

author: wloek573
title: Athens
text: The place was wonderful. The bartender Rob, great. The front desk, Cindy, couldn’t help more. Literally the only complaint I had was room temperature. The thermostats are locked in at 74 degrees. You can’t set them lower. When you first went to bed it was warm. Note, we had a top floor unit which might get hotter. When I asked I was told the AC units freeze up below 74 degrees. By 2-3 am everything was fine.

author: runningmomof5
title: perfect location!
text: Our two bedroom condo was spotless and well appointed. The views from the 4th floor were amazing!! The location just south of town was just far enough for a little quiet but not too far for a quick golf cart ride to town. Cindy, the concierge, did a great job organizing our activities, golf cart rental, transfers, etc... The pool side bar was perfect and the entire Athens Gate staff was very attentive. We especially loved lounging on the chairs on the dock. There was great snorkeling right from the end of the pier. I can't recommend Athens Gate enough!

author: 230cherm
title: beautiful stay
text: the condo was very roomy, stocked with everything we needed. very small boutique resort so you get to know everyone on site. Danny & Amos were awesome. Danny is a great mixologist. Amos helped with all my questions, etc. The pool was beautiful. we had a great time. There is a security guard on site so you feel safe. he was the best!!

author: christinaaS1412EG
title: Awesome Resort, Friendly Staff!
text: Loved this resort! Everything was perfect. We were assisted with our bags and had the bartender bring our drinks up to our condo. First one was free! They also deliver food to your resort as well. We had the 3 bedroom 4th floor condo and the view was unbelievable! They provide you with everything you need. Towels, kayaks, paddleboards, bikes, Wifi, etc. Definitely returning to stay there again!

author: gwynneg2015
title: Beautiful view; clean well-appointed rooms
text: Athens Gate far surpassed our expectations! It is about 10 minutes by golf cart from the noise and chaos of San Pedro during spring break time. The room is more like a beautiful apartment. The beds in the 2 bedrooms are comfortable; the 2 bathrooms are huge; the kitchen is well appointed with stainless steel appliances. There’s even a blender for smoothies in the morning! We dove with Belize Pro Divers. Cindy was so helpful in helping us set up a dock pick up in the morning of our first dive. Our group of 10(3 families) have absolutely loved our stay here! We highly recommend Athens Gate!

author: victormJ437ZV
title: Amazing location in paradise.
text: Athens Gate is an amazing resort hidden away south of San Pedro. Quiet location away from the hustle and bustle of town. The staff is so attentive to your needs. Cindy is your hostess and makes sure everything is perfect. Danny ,the bartender at the private bar by the pool makes some amazing drinks and if talk to him real nice, he has some mad skills with ceviche too! Dennis seems to never stop working making sure the property is beautiful . The staff wants you to have a great time, and it shows. They went as far as to set up a private beach concert to help celebrate our wives birthday!

author: Elliehd
title: Great place and service
text: It is the beginning of our stay, but things have been great. Someone if always around if you have a problem. They can book trips for you and give advice. Towels at the pool. Pool and beach toys for the kids. Small enough that we never had a problem getting a chair on the beach or at the pool. They have a bar at pool, which seems to be unusual. The rooms are great and stocked well. The “light” room cleaning was more then I expected. Highly recommend a stay here.

author: G8043ONdanielc
title: Far from town, not a usable beach
text: We stayed in unit 6 for three nights, a family of 4 with two college age kids. While the unit was beautiful and spacious the location is a problem. You are 2 and 1/2 miles from San Pedro town, so your options for restaurants and nightlife are to cab it or rent a golf cart for about $70/day, which we did. The ride into town is sort of fun for the first five minutes but then you realize that you are inhaling exhaust fumes from the all the other carts (no there are no electric golf carts). A gas mask might not be a bad idea! As others have mentioned, the water off the beach is murky and the bottom is covered with sea grass. Access to the clear aqua water is possible at the end of the long dock. This is okay, but the space is small and means you’re crowded with other guests, who might be chill or loud drinkers (we encountered both). The staff are really nice and helpful but overall we found the place overpriced, not very special, and inconveniently located.

author: stephATL1
title: Absolutely LOVED!
text: A beautiful 2bd condo with the most beautiful decor and comfy beds. Epic views! The staff was so friendly and helpful. Cindy helped us with all our tours and dinners, and Danny the bartender was so nice. We just loved everyone there. There are nearby restaurants and you can rent a golf cart to get around town. The days we weren't exploring, this uncrowded very chill resort was perfection! Highly recommend!

author: elise_sanchez
title: You Better BELIZE It!!!
text: From the moment we arrived at the property, the staff was what made this stay simply amazing! This was a girls trip with 4 great friends and Glen and E could not have taken better care of us. From the drinks at the pool, to the local lunch/dinners, and the fun fishing excursion with Alex Escalante...it was all wonderful! This property is off the beat and path, but that is what makes it so special. It's small, private, and somewhat secluded, but it has every single amenity you need. We like to cook, so the full kitchen has everything. A golf cart is a must if you want to venture into town. We were very fortunate to have found this gem and we will definitely return for more rest, relaxation and FUN!! Thank you all Much love from the "Texas Girls".

author: BobboD1968
title: THE ONLY DOWNSIDE OF THIS AMAZING PLACE WAS HAVING TO LEAVE IT
text: My family recently had a fantastic stay at the Athens Gate Resort. We rented a three bedroom condo, which was spacious, clean, and well-decorated. It had a full kitchen, a large balcony with a stunning view of the Caribbean, and even a washer and dryer. A real home away from home (if you happen to live in paradise). The staff was friendly, helpful, and pampered us like rock stars; the pool was beautiful and helpfully abutted a fully-stocked swim-up bar; and other amenities were provided by the hotel (paddleboards, snorkeling off the pier, bikes, etc.) to keep our three kids constantly entertained. The one downside with the place, if you can even call it that, is that you are about two miles south of San Pedro, where most of the restaurants, bars, and shops on Ambergris Caye are located. However, there are some very solid restaurants within 1000 feet of the hotel (Lone Star, Black Orchid, etc.), and the upside you get from being removed from the maddening crowds of San Pedro, in my view, definitely outweighs the inconvenience of the 10-15 minute trip that you have to make if you want to venture into town. I would strongly recommend this place for families or for anyone looking for an upscale place that is bit off the beaten path in Ambergris Caye. A little pricey, but well worth it, particularly if you are looking for a place to accommodate five guests or more.

author: christophermB7090LN
title: UN-BELIZE-ABLE
text: This was one of the best trips I have ever been on mostly due to service and resort at Athens Gate. This is a very small boutique style property that offers everything one would possibly want. From the moment you walk on the property you know you are somewhere special. Within a couple days we knew the staff by their first names. 'E' runs all guest services and will put you with the best operations on the island as well as some unbelievable restaurants. Glen and Willie take great care of you at the swim up bar or any of the many resort amenities. Luis takes care of security and the beach and property spotless. We loved this place and got to call it home in the week we were there. If ever back in Central America this will be on our home again.

author: BIGLIFE
title: THIRD TIME IS THE CHARM
text: We have stayed at Athens Gate 3 times. All three times it has been great. The staff is wonderful. What ever you need they can help with, if it is scuba, fishing, day trips, you name it. The security guard Louis always has a flashlight shined for you if you get home a little late. Bartender William does a great job with the drinks. The house cleaners are top notch and don't miss anything. " E" the manager will try to get anything you need or answer any questions. The rooms -YES they really are that nice. We go to Belize at least once a year and will always stay at Athens Gate.

author: CocoBellTravel
title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: Athens Gate is a lovely boutique hotel towards the southern end of Ambergris Caye. The staff was friendly, attentive and helpful with any and all requests. Our 3-bedroom suite, located on the ground level, was spacious, well-equipped with modern amenities and impeccably clean. A private front porch looks out to the ocean and is as close as you can get to the edge of the water. The water here isn’t ideal for swimming/wading as it is shallow and your feet sink deeply into the sand. However, you are surrounded by beautiful scenery and snorkeling/fishing expeditions are plentiful on the island (they’ll even pick you up dockside at the hotel). I recommend booking a few excursions of each! It’s that much fun. A golf cart is a must so be sure to request one for during your stay. The center of town (San Pedro) is a 15-minute ride from the hotel and roads throughout the island are very bumpy.

author: Mindy612015
title: Beautiful Spacios Condo
text: We spent three nights where. Our room was great. This is a small complex right on the beach. There is no restaurant on property but a very short ride by golf cart to town for some great places to eat. My only complaint was losing power multiple times. Once was island wide and planned, then a couple of short times next day. Completeness generators. Also had water pressured issues

author: SharonD270
title: Lovely views, great bar and pool, stellar service
text: Ask at the desk when checking in for their sail adventures to snorkel the worlds second largest Great Barrier Reef. The fishing is good too. Ask the captain to filet your fish. Rent a golf cart to get around. The rooms are 2 or 3 bedroom condos that are very nice. You can go out on the porch. There is a washer and dryer in every unit. This is my second time here and each time I enjoyed this resort and everyone associated to it.

author: shellydixon
title: Very Nice Resort-great location and Spacious Accommodations
text: This was our first trip to Belize. We didn't know where to stay so we just picked a place. We chose the right place. We stayed in the 2 bedroom unit and it was very spacious with beautiful views. All the rooms have great views. This place was awesome with a great swim up bar and William the bartender is excellent. The staff too, was very accommodating, "E" made sure we had everything we needed, like restaurant choices, set up fishing trips etc. The owners of the resort were there and we got to meet them and visit. Very delightful people. Would go back here in a heartbeat.

author: kansas2017
title: The perfect escape!
text: My wife and i booked a last minute trip to San Pedro and couldn't have selected a better place to stay. Only 12 rooms, so the place never seems overly busy even though they were 90% booked while we were there. Most folks are off on an excursion somewhere, so it stays really quiet. Honestly i selected this place because you can walk into the water. Some of the other places had a retaining wall and a couple steps in, but we wanted a beach. Hammocks over the water, paddle boards, snorkeling gear, lounge chairs every wear and swim up bar that is also accessible from the beach! The staff was amazing, i really couldn't have asked for anything more. They helped us book some excursions, ensured we had reservations wherever we wanted, and would even order lunch in for us when we were lazed out on the beach! It was the perfect spot, and we will definitely go back. I would give this 6 stars if available.

author: lynnlX4891FG
title: Vacation in Paradise
text: Our room was an incredible condo! The rooms were amazing and we loved having a condo to ourselves. The bedrooms were excellent as were the bathrooms and kitchen. We really loved the balcony. This was a perfect place for our family of four. We also loved getting to know E, William, Glenn, and Dennis. They employees were fantastic and treated us well. We would highly recommend this to others.

author: dkotil
title: Unbelizeable trip
text: We loved staying at Athens Gate. It is a beautiful place. Our condo was nicely decorated, roomy, and fully stocked. I loved the views from the balcony. Everyone was very accommodating. Candra and Shannon were especially helpful in booking our condo, airline tickets, and golf cart. E, Will, Glen, Luiz and Dennis helped make our stay enjoyable. They were awesome in helping book our excursions, giving good dinner and shopping ideas, etc. It is a great place to stay!

author: C2554EGrogerw
title: Tasty Waves
text: No doubt the accommodations and view are superior (5-star), exceeded my expectations. The staff in particular really impressed me. They were there to help us in every regard. Glenn helped us with suggestions and organizing all our events. He did all the leg work, we just walked out to the end of the pier and a boat showed up. William made us some Ceviche from a barracuda we had caught fishing. To die for! The staff made this vacation special.

author: NoraP_WI
title: Amazing stay!
text: My friends and I just returned from an 8 night stay at Athens Gate and we already want to go back! We rented room 4 which is the 3 bedroom suite on the 4th floor and we loved it! Beautiful accommodations and beautiful views make this an excellent place to relax and unwind. All of the hotel staff were friendly and helpful including William the bartender (who we got to know very well from the pool bar!), and Luis the security guard. The whole suite, including the bedrooms, was spacious and very clean. If I had to make one minor complaint it would be that the balcony only had 4 chairs and we had 6 people so more outdoor furniture would be nice. Everything else was amazing though!! Thanks for the great stay!

author: fafaaway
title: Great Hotel stay
text: We just finished a stay at Athens Gate and can't say enough great things about the place. The hotel is made up of a series of condos with complete kitchen. Staff were amazing and would organize tours, golf carts, and transportation to the dock and airstrip. There isn't a restaurant on site, but there are a couple close by. Housekeeping did a great job and came every day. The beach is "natural" with significant seaweed. This is common in San Pedro and is actually very environmentally conscious as it helps protect the beach and supports the health of the bay. The entry into the bay is very shallow and is good for small kids if the pool isn't enough.

author: keithtI6338MF
title: Great reviews are true
text: Great setting with sea and pool and beach and dock. Great staff. Massage. Room spectacular. Paddle boards and kayaks to borrow. E super helpful with excursions and golf cart. Roads bumpy. Watch out for taxi costs.

author: BDTravel01
title: Heaven!
text: Athens gate was perfect in every way! E was a great help, William made delicious drinks and all of the staff was friendly and helpful. It was small enough to not feel like a huge resort. It was close enough to town but not too close. The beach was perfect, the pool glorious! We stayed in #10 and it was huge! Nicely decorated, very nice patio, not a bad hike up the stairs. Perfect place to stay and enjoy Belize!

author: KJKH
title: Awesome condo for the family!
text: This is south of San Pedro city - about a 10-15 minute golf cart ride. The condo was spacious and had everything we needed to make meals and be comfortable. It had an amazing ocean view on the 3rd floor of our 3 bedroom - plus overlooked the pool. We didn't reserve any excursions through the hotel, as we wanted a more intimate setting with just our family of 5. (we choose No Worries Tours Mario & Mario!) It was a little harder to find food that we all liked & didn't break the bank, so we grocery shopped to save on a few meals in the condo. The beach does have a lot of sea grass (but they all do due to the barrier reef) and sand fleas only came out at dusk/ evening. We didn't put bug spray on - as we didn't sit on the beach at night. Since the fleas (or sand flies) do fly, you also can't open your doors - or they'll get into your place, too! No matter - We would stay here again if traveling with our 3 kids. It was worth it!

author: DavidR14344
title: Wonderful relaxing vacation
text: This place was so relaxing and very quiet. Our room was more of a condo than a hotel room with the amenities of a fully functional kitchen, spa tub with jets, central air AC, etc. The staff (ie Glenn, William, E) were super accommodating from setting us up with restaurant reservations, ordering us pizza, planning our next day excursions, arranging for transportation to/from the airport and restaurants. We rented a golf cart for 24 hours which I would highly recommend at a minimum to anyone as it was fun to drive around town (like a go kart) and get to know the locals and the island's culture. Also, recommend to newbies like us to checking out secret beach. William's cocktail concoctions were super tasty and he was even willing to cook food purchased from the store around the corner or any seafood catches. The dirt road leading to the property was a bit difficult to maneuver due to numerous huge potholes from the rainy weather. Also, it would have been nice to have a restaurant at the resort but there were plenty of other options close by. The Pelican Reef (a five walk away) had a decent breakfast and lunch if you want something quick and easy. Would highly recommend the catamaran snorkel and sail to Caye Caulker with James from Searious.

author: kellysbeach
title: Outstanding Accomodations! 5 stars
text: We had a fantastic stay at Athens Gate. The property is gorgeous and well maintained. Although it is only 7 years old, it looks brand new. The entire team, which you will get to know well during your stay, Eliazar -know as "E", Glen, William aka "Chilly Willy" and Dennis "the Menace" go out of their way to make your stay perfect. They have a very special thing going on there - the best of both worlds - condo environment with hotel service. It is a small resort that has its own pool bar, beach, and pool. It doesn't have a restaurant but there are several within walking distance and many within a short golf cart ride. Wonderful vacation - we would definitely return!

author: CJS5108
title: Wonderful experience from beginning to end!
text: My husband, three daughters and I visited Ambergris Caye in Belize and decided to stay at Athens Gate based on prior reviews. We were not disappointed! Because of hurricane Earl, we had to push back our plans by one week. Lori took care of everything and put my fears to rest. She also booked our Day at Sea with Captain Oliver (highly recommend). William and E. took care of any request including golf cart rental, kayaking, snorkeling, etc. This was truly a trip of a lifetime - thank you Athens Gate!!

author: T6752MIjamieb
title: Great Stay At Athens Gate!
text: Had a wonderful stay at Athens Gate. William and E took great care of us. We stayed in a 2/2 condo and it was very nice. Very clean, spacious and well furnished. All of our needs were taken care of right away. The dock was really nice with a hammock and chairs. The place is perfectly located away from the busy city center. I would definitely stay here again.

author: DHawkins12
title: Awesome Mother/Daughter Bonding Vacation!
text: I wanted to find a location that would allow my daughter and I to spend quality time together before she started her new journey as a college freshman. Athens Gate was perfect! William, E, and Glenn worked together to cater to our every needs, Luis kept us safe through the night, and Carlos chauffeured us everywhere we needed to go. The rooms were clean and absolutely fabulous!. Full kitchen complete with plates, cups, silverware, pots & pans, dining area, Family room, King and queen bedrooms, two full bathrooms, large screen tv's, ceiling fans, fully furnished balcony overseeing the pool and ocean - our new home away from home! The staff arranged all of our excursions and made all of our dinner reservations. They arranged for our mother/daughter massages to be done on the dock, which were fabulous and arranged our full day snorkeling cruise with Island Dream Tours within minutes of our arrival - just by making a phone call. Talk about service! We plan to come back to Belize and we will stay at Athens Gate again and again!

author: juliehG3091QF
title: Great location, wonderful staff, perfect view!
text: This was my third trip to Belize but my first time at Athens Gate. Excellent, clean, lovely accommodations! The view from the 4th floor was amazing. Perfect family accommodations for our large family. We felt so at home, and the staff made our stay even more enjoyable. William opened fresh coconuts & made us the most amazing drinks with the coconut water! E made our stay more comfortable and it was evident that our safety and comfort were a top priority! We have stayed further outside of town on previous trips and it was nice to be close enough to town to shop & dine, yet still feel like we were "away from it all". As usual, Ambergris Caye did not disappoint. Compared to the over-crowded, over-touristy all inclusive resorts we have visited in Mexico, this low key island is my favorite destination!

author: txgirlsmom
title: Exactly What We Were Looking For
text: We have stayed many times on the far North end of the island. It's beautiful up there, but felt too remote for this trip because we brought 4 teenagers (15, 17, 18, 18) with us and needed easier access to town. The 3 bedroom, 4th floor condo at Athens Gate was the perfect size and location for our group. The beach is beautiful, the rooms are stunning, and it's close enough to access town easily, but still be far enough away to avoid the noise/crowds in town. E runs a tight ship, making all go smoothly at the resort. He really goes above and beyond for his guests. We had a great time with William, mixing drinks at the pool bar, and the rooms were cleaned impeccably by the cleaning crew. Transfer to/from the airport, as well as renting our golf carts on site all went smoothly. We won't hesitate to stay here again, and our teens are calling this past visit to Belize "The best vacation they've ever had".

author: JenniferW5807
title: Perfect vacation!
text: We just got back from one of the best family vacations we have ever been on! I can't say enough hood things about Belize and about Athens Gate and both E and William. The communication before we arrived was excellent, and upon arrival, our wish was E's command. The pool and bar (ir, bartender, thanks William!) were beautiful! Our condo was huge, well decorated and stocked, and perfect. Our snorkeling as well as our fishing tours were arranged by E and picked us up right at our dock! Our experience couldn't have been better. We will be returning...

author: I3382OQashleys
title: End of May Visit- Excellent
text: A group of gfs and myself stayed here for 3 nights and we were completely blown away. The staff was so accommodating (ordering golf carts, setting up tours, bringing drinks to us beachside ;) -- the place is absolutely amazing. The views are beautiful and the interior of the rooms are just as the pictures look, and very very spacious. We stayed in the 2 bedroom and there is plenty of room, plus the kitchen space is great if you want to make breakfast or dinner. This hotel is on the south side of the island, away from the main strip (5-8 min golf cart ride). Highly suggest renting a golf cart for partial days when you go exploring. Again, I cannot express how much larger the rooms are than at other locations, plus they are completely updated. Highly recommend :)

author: 362justinei
title: Amazing vacation
text: Awesome property. E and William were fantastic hosts. Our condo exceeded our expectations. Nothing but ocean views. Very quiet area. Free kayaks and use of snorkel gear. Not too far from town but you will need a golf cart if you want to go into San Pedro. Highly recommend.

author: Arobled
title: Bday getaway girls trip
text: After reading all the reviews, I was very happy with our stay at both Athens Gate and Pelican (sister hotel). Most definitely felt like home away from home. Ocean view and clean rooms; we stayed on the 4th floor and no elevators but it had an amazing view. Staff carries your luggage upstairs and brings down for you at time of checkout. Since the time we arrived both Eleazar and William were very friendly, welcoming, attentive and accommodating. Any questions we had or requests were met to the fullest. From booking our activities to assuring our drinks were never empty. They were always on top of it. Can't wait to go back and stay at Athens once again

author: EatnGrapes
title: Great resort!
text: I read the reviews online and hoped that Athens Gate would be as advertised. It was! The rooms are very large, super clean and very well furnished. I can't think of a single thing that was missing. The best part about the resort - the staff! How can a small resort like this have a full time concierge? With two people always available for anything you need it couldn't have been better. They booked all of our dive trips and made sure that we always had everything we might need. I highly recommend Athens Gate.

author: WendyIrwin
title: The perfect place
text: Athens Gate was absolutely gorgeous both inside and out. We stayed in the two bedroom condo and had a fantastic view of the ocean. Granite counter tops, mahogany wood cabinets and beautiful walk in shower made it a premier place to stay. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was spacious to cook every day. Service was great with E and William! Ask William to make you a dirty banana at the bar and you won't be disappointed. We cooked on the pit outside several nights. The property is south of San Pedro so we rented a golf cart for a week to go in to town. The pool was fantastic, the hammocks were relaxing and my husband took the kayak out. Thanks for a great stay at Athens Gate, we hope to be back.

author: Yankeefan1A
title: Paradise
text: Athens Gate was amazing. E and William will help you with anything you need. William is the bartender and makes great cocktails. E can plan your tours and make reservations. The tours were fun. My daughter loved shark ray alley. The weather was perfect. We also did the whole day snorkel, fishing, and beach bbq with Captain Oliver. My family thought this was the highlight of our trip.

author: mbcsofasnacht
title: Excellent service!!
text: My family of three teens and my husband and I stayed here last week for seven nights. E, William, Daniel, and Lewis were awesome hosts. Anything we wanted at any time of day, they made sure we got it. They took care of all of our excursions so we felt very safe and pampered. The resort is a short drive from town, so you'll want a golf cart. There are police and EMTs posted just down the road from the resort which made me feel even safer, but I never felt scared regardless. You have to make sure you make a stop down the road a ways to get fresh bread and pastries from the bakery called The Baker! The villas are beautiful and very clean. It's a quiet resort and very relaxing. I definitely will recommend Athens Gate to everyone!

author: ColoradoTraveler420
title: Excellent place to stay!
text: Very spacious 2 bedroom unit with exceptionally nice living room, master suite and balcony. Fully equipped modern kitchens. The staff was great. E took care of our every need including golf car rental, dinner reservations, excursions taxi's and travel arrangements. Soto, the bar tender is also a magnificent personal chef and Lori was great to work with coordinating travel to and from Athens Gate. There is a decent restaurant right across the street and a small market a couple of blocks away. Short ride on a golf car to San Pedro (2.5 miles). The beach feels very secluded and the view of the reef is great. I would stay there again and recommend Athens Gate to friends and family.

author: KGVacay
title: Fun Island Getaway
text: The accommodations, staff, pool & beach were fabulous. Athens Gate is a 12 unit complex with 2 and 3 bedroom options. We had a 2 bedroom and it was more than enough room for the 3 of us (myself, husband and 19 year old son). The master suite had a king bed, large en suite bathroom with two sinks, separate tub and shower. 2nd bedroom had two twin beds, its own TV and a hallway bath with a shower. There was also a full kitchen with granite counter tops, dining room open to a large living area. The condo was furnished as if you were at home away from home. The pool area was immaculate and beautiful. E or William were always around to answer questions, tend bar, or plan excursions. Athens Gate will help you plan your vacation start to finish including booking your Tropic Air flights from Belize City to San Pedro and renting a golf cart and having it ready the moment you arrive, to contacting and planning any excursions you wish to take.

author: 2babsi
title: Athens Gate w/ my Friends
text: Hello fellow travelers, the property at Athens Gate is remarkable! We enjoyed the peace and tranquility of having our own private beach at our feet w/ breath taking views. The staff was very professional and made us feel extremely welcomed. Much wasn't needed because the home was fully stocked with appliances and amenities from cookware and dishes to wifi and an ipod docking station. The unit also included a washer and dryer. 5 of us stayed in the 3bd room unit and there was enough space for 2 or 3 more people! If you're staying on a high level floor (4th is the highest), be prepared to walk up flights of stairs, there is no elevator, but its a good work out! I recommend renting a golf cart or a vehicle to transport you to the main part of the island to the residence because the walk is a little far by foot especially if you plan to carry groceries back home. All in all, I highly recommend this place, definitely a home away from home!

author: JayShennum
title: Wedding Desitnation
text: My niece got married on the beach at the property. It was small, private and quaint. The staff was very hospitable. We got to meet a lot of the locals who would walk their dogs on the beach. Everyone was friendly. We stayed in a 3 bedroom condo which exceeded expectations. Often times the commercial pictures in the brochures don't look anything like the actual rooms. Not the case here. The resort is somewhat off the beaten path from the center of the city, but rent a golf cart and you are there in less than 10 minutes.

author: Pdale8858
title: Perfect family vacation!!
text: Our family of five just spent a wonderful week at Athens Gate. We were greeted upon our arrival by "E ", Ruth and Javier. They told us everything we needed to know about the property and throughout the week, booked our excursions, made us delicious drinks and just treated us like very good friends. E was able to get us out for some fishing or snorkeling within an hour of us asking. He seems to know everyone and everything about the island. My daughter wanted ice cream one day, he told us the best ice cream shops. My son caught a 14 lb. fish one day and they cooked it up for us on the BBQ. We also enjoyed our 3bedroom condo on the third floor. Very spacious and comfy beds.

author: WFT-SLT
title: Highly recommend!
text: We stayed here for our first trip to Belize (birthday trip). My husband and I were so happy when we were greeted with drinks and shown our condo - high end finishes, beautiful views from the front windows, large spaces throughout, just perfect. We wound up spending a lot of time indoors, with unseasonable weather (rained most days) and the resulting road situation (holes) and outdoor bugs. Gorgeous views, friendly staff, cute little poolside bar downstairs, and a couple of restaurants within walking distance...nice and secluded, away from the busyness of San Pedro. We had provisions delivered ahead of time, which allowed us to relax and enjoy cooking in the fully equipped kitchen. Ruth & E really take care of you here, and you feel "looked out for." On one trip into town, a local we met, who seemed to know everyone/everything on the island, had not heard of where we were staying. The other local got serious and said, "At the south end - first-class!" I think that says it all. This is your place if you want quiet, high-end, beautiful, romantic Ambergris Caye. Perfect setup for a girls or guys getaway too!

author: 311amyk
title: Island Paradise
text: First time to Belize and I can't imagine staying anywhere else. Such a paradise setting and the staff -- especially ' E ' is amazing! All you need to do is give him an idea of what adventure you are looking for and he arranges it. Diving here is incredible! Went fishing and caught 2.5 lbs of fish. It was cut for cooking and ' E ' gave us a short shopping list and he cooked the fish on the BBQ for us. It was as good or better than the meals in town! So much fun for the family. I would recommend Athens Gate to Everyone coming to this picturesque town of San Pedro, Belize.

author: JenniferNB
title: Your private paradise!
text: Athens Gate is small, but wonderful in every way. The service here is impeccable! The staff will arrange anything you would like as far as restaurant reservations, excursions, fishing, you name it. The beach is private and serene. The pool is very nice. Our condo was nicely furnished & in perfect condition. Here is a picture from our living room. What a view!

author: 413alysonm
title: Excellent
text: We stayed here for 4 nights and loved it. 1. Amazing space - well designed and thought out and lots of rooms for a family of 5. 2. Great staff - helpful, friendly and accommodating 3. Great location - about 2 miles from town which is easily accessible by a golf cart. Golf carts are the main mode of transportation on the island and you can rent directly from Athens Gate. Lester the bar tender was exceptional.

author: CletaS2014
title: Superb, Gorgeous and a Must on your Bucket List!
text: If you are even thinking of traveling to Belize, you MUST stay at Athens Gate. Rhonda and Joe have made this resort into a paradise. The setting is absolutely gorgeous and the staff couldn't be more friendly or helpful. We got married at the resort and it was such a wonderful day for us. The amenities are better than first class - much more deserving of 10 stars than only 5!! It's quiet, yet enough of a night life or excursions for anyone's taste. We will be going back and there is only one choice for us - Athens Gate! Thanks to everyone, especially Rhonda Lawrence and "E" who made it such a special occasion for us!

author: Sianapowl
title: Will not stay anywhere else
text: I've already submitted a review but cannot find it. In any case, Athen's Gate is worth reviewing twice. The room was hands down the most beautiful room I've stayed in. The woodwork and decor are in excellent taste. The customer service is second to none. Lori was so helpful with the reservation and the island hop flight and Eliazar "E" provided that sense of security and handled any type of reservation you could imagine and you knew it was handled. There was an episode on House Hunters International the other day that showed Grand Caribe (my original choice until I found Athen's Gate) and two other locations that were over priced and lacked the sleek, beauty of our condo here. If I were to buy in Belize, I wouldn't hesitate to purchase at Athen's Gate.

author: stenfam
title: Wonderful Place to stay
text: We enjoyed absolutely everything about Athens Gate. The staff, and especially "E" make it all so easy for you. It really is a no stress holiday. There are restaurants nearby and going in to town in the golf cart is fun and easy if you want more variety. We had a 3 bedroom condo and it was beautiful and well appointed - the kitchen has everything you could need if you choose to eat at the resort.
