The grocery stores are expensive and the one we used did not have everything we had hoped to find, but the baker across the street had wonderful things! The Caye Coffee is one of the best we've tried and we enjoyed that every morning on our own balcony overlooking the beach. We can't wait to go back!

author: ANNIE0118
title: Beautiful resort
text: Athens Gate is an exceptional Resort! My husband & I visit there every year we go to ambergris Caye! We always have to go to the lighthouse bar &. Visit with Eliazar, (best bartender) who can meet any drink to perfection!! Eliazar can arrange any trip you would like to do: snorkeling, diving, ruins, or tubing!!! The resort is right on the water and had sunrises!! The pool is perfect, condos absolutely beautiful!! We just love this resort!!

author: 786bernicek
title: Great place to vacation
text: We Loved Athens Gate , it's a wonderful boutique hotel, on the island. E is the go to person, he takes care of all your needs. He had our golf cart waiting for us. He booked all of our day trips. One day of snorkeling, zip line and cave tubing for us Incredible :-) this boutique hotels rooms , are so spacious, they are 2& 3 bedrooms condos. Very morden clean & beautiful. We enjoyed our daily trips into town, on our golf cart. We leave Monday, we can't wait to return to Belize, and stay @ Athens Gate.

author: polebender
title: Great week
text: Have been back home now for a couple of weeks but have very nice memories of our stay at Athens Gate & Belize in general. Our stay was the week before school started and there were only two other couples at the resort. It was almost like we had the place to ourselves. We were greeted at arrival by E & James who thoroughly explained the facilities, rented us a nice golf cart & carried our bags to our room. Each room is either a two or three bedroom with a large balcony and great view of the ocean. Our room was very modern, clean & well furnished...all the comforts of home. The pool & bar area are somewhat small but very nice as is the beach. James & E gave us a lot of helpful advice about things to do & places to see & were 100% on places to eat. I would recommend getting a golf cart as it is the best way to get around the island & also fun. When we go back to Belize, and we will, the Athens Gate is where we will stay.

author: Maria41067
title: A True Paradise
text: Athen's Gate is a hidden gem. We enjoyed the location and accommodations were top notch! E & James were very helpful and nice. Anything you need they were there to help. The view from our villa was incredible! They were very spacious and clean. Totally recommend this place without a doubt! Thanks Guys!

author: 4pamalama
title: Ahhhhh just the perfect place!
text: We spent half of our trip at another property in Ambergris Caye. We are so happy we decided to spend the last half here at Athens Gate! The property is located in a very quiet part of the island and offers the peaceful, beautiful atmosphere we were seeking. E and James met us with a rum punch and were very attentive to our needs. As we were lying by the pool, the owner, Joe and his wife stopped by and said hello. They are fellow Texans and so very friendly. The 2/2 rooms here are approx 1800 sqft and have everything you could ever need. We left five beautiful (and noisy) kids at home and were looking for relaxation and we sure found it here! I'm lounging by the pool right now, posting this and recommending this property to friends :)

author: rhoop123
title: Always a wonderful stay
text: Joe and Rhonda Lawrence sure know how to build a first class intimate resort. The accommodations are spacious and well appointed. Eliazar ("E") has been with the developer since the beginning of Athens Gate and previously with Athens sister resort, Pelican Reef. We have stayed multiple times at both and have always experienced personable, courteous, attentive and professional service. E and James took care of our every need from arranging our fishing\snorkeling trip to serving ice cold Belican beer and many tropical drinks. Ask E to make a "bushwacker" for you! We can't wait until our next trip. Don't pass Athens or Pelican Reef up - these are definitely the places to stay on Ambergris Caye. Both are only a 5 minute golf cart ride to the middle of San Pedro.

author: Relax804634
title: Amazing stay 5 Star all the way!
text: I don't even know where to start! The resort is beautiful well kept clean and so modern! The drinks amazing James was our bar tender most of the week and the Piña Coladas to die for! E made all of our excursion reservations and recommended great restaurants the hospitality here is like none other! Oh don't let me forget the beds so comfortable we stayed in room 7 overlooking the Carribbean Sea the balcony is huge the rooms are big I just can't say enough great things about this resort! Rhonda the owner helped book this and anytime I had a question before we got there even right down to the weather she had it covered a true doll! James and E were amazing host made us feel at home and so helpful! They set up our excursions with Tuff E Nuff and those guys were great! All together this vacation was a blast we are a family of four our kids are teens and had so much fun the pool is always clean and the beach is sooooo clean the doc is beautiful we had such a blast hands down a 5 Star resort!!

author: 412ReneeS412
title: Absolutely amazing!!
text: Just home from a short but wonderful stay in Belize at the MOST beautiful place on the island, Athens Gate. You can't go wrong here. I don't even have enough time to write about all the great things to say about the place but the staff, OH MY!! They are simply and amazingly AWESOME! E and James were at our beck and call and treated us like royalty. I wouldn't even consider staying somewhere else on a return trip! Best bartenders around! If it is your wish, it is their command. They are ALL THAT!! RS

author: mkmyers
title: Athens Gate was perferct.
text: We spent 7 days at Athens Gate and it exceeded our expectations in every way. We are a family of 6. Children are 10-17 yrs old. The accommodations were wonderful. The staff was extremely helpful; setting up tours, recommending restaurants, taking care of our every need. The island is wonderful and the people extremely friendly. We attended church with a local congregation and all made new friends. The diving, snorkeling, fishing and sunsets were perfect. Tuff e Nuff tours took us on our diving, snorkeling and beach adventures and they were all first rate. We can't wait to go back.

author: 2gone
title: I want to live here!!!
text: Well where to begin. The location is great not in down town but not that far either. The grounds are beautiful with immaculate landscaping. The staff is just incredible everyone bends over backwards to be sure you have a great time. The condo was just beautiful, spacious and well decorated. Everything works and the A/C is great. It is so convenient to go on your excersion or dive trip right from the beautiful dock. I did not want to leave. I highly recommend this location for couples, friends and families. I look forward to going back again!!

author: Leofam_12
title: Perfect vacation
text: My wife, our four kids (aged 22 to 13) and I just spent a week in paradise. We stayed in a 3 bedroom villa on the 4th floor with what has to be the most spectacular view on Ambergris Caye. The accomodations were as advertised - attractive, well-appointed, comfortable and clean. That description also applies to the entire property. I cannot say enough good things about the staff -Eliazar ("E"), James and Jonathan are very friendly, professional and talented. "E" arranged all of our excursions and gave excellent advice on activities and restaurants. We spent a lot of time in San Pedro, but we were all glad we decided to stay just outside of town, and the south end of the atoll is the place to be. If you go to Athens Gate you will not be disappointed. We will return.

author: Drodgers34
title: The best destination wedding in history!
text: Athens Gate hosted our recent destination wedding for a party of 50 guests. The owners, Rhonda and Joe Lawrence, are excellent hosts and made sure that every detail was covered and performed in a first class manner. Their leadership and professionalism reflects in the overall atmosphere of the venue. Words can't express our gratitude to Rhonda and Joe for their work to plan and execute a wedding event that seemed almost stress free and effortless. The wedding was a wonderful event and all in attendance were awed by the Athens Gate facility, staff, and overall experience. The catamaran, fishing, and snorkeling trips organized by Athens Gate are spectacular. We were impressed by the genuine friendliness and caring attitudes of the staff which includes Eliazar, James, and John. These three gentlemen and the cleaning staff were key players in an effort to make our wedding and honeymoon the best in history!

author: Dxarms22
title: " An experience you will never forget!"
text: Beautiful place and the service is the best!! Joe and Rhonda have a first class operation. "E" the concierge is magnificent, he was very organized and always hooked us up with the best of the best!! Fishing, snorkeling, restaurants, golf carts, you name it we ask he had it set up in no time!! And then James the bartender was wonderful!! Piña coladas to die for, Rum Punch and Coco Politicians were great too! The Villas were well equipped with all state of the art appliances, furniture and beautiful views of the reef!! My brothers wedding was one we will never forget!! Rhonda put it all together and made it so special for them!! I will definitely be going back!!

author: Di15
title: Home Away From Home.....but with maid service
text: Loved staying here!! The personal attention was unbelievable! I've stayed at the Waldorf in N.Y. and the Beverly Hills Hotel in Beverly Hills. Athens Gate is now my favorite! Thanks so much Joe, Rhonda, E and James....y'all are the best!!! We will be back to stay soon!!! The Browns Poetry, Texas

author: packed_bags
title: An Outstanding Stay
text: Our family of 5 spent a week here and absolutely loved it. Our second floor unit was beautiful and spacious and the grounds were beautiful and very well tended. The property Manager, E and his young helper Jonathan are happy to help with anything. E arranged golf cart rental and a snorkelling tour and Jonathan even helped my kids open up a coconut that fell from a tree on the beach. The bar at the pool serves up tasty drinks and is a great place to meet others or have a chat with E or the owner, Mr. Joe. This spot is located just south of San Pedro however we didn't find the distance to be a problem. We rented a golf cart for most of our stay but the grocery store is only a bike ride away and there is a restaurant right across the street so this isn't a necessity. And lastly, the beach here is outstanding by San Pedro standards. We will definately be back.

author: hatetopackme
title: Belize Me!!
text: Our second trip to Ambergris Caye and our first time at Athens Gate. Both will not be our last. We stayed at the resort in March for a week on the third floor ocean front condo. Loved it. The property manager, E, his sidekick, Jonathan are a joy. They go above and beyond expectations. The condo, the grounds, and the beach are cleaned daily. We rented a golf cart from the resort for the week we were there and that was even cleaned daily! You will NOT be disappointed, Belize me!!

author: AlexY95
title: Fab place!
text: My family stayed there for two weeks in January 2012 and enjoyed the condos immensely. We did NOT want to leave! It was beautifully decorated and had everything. Elizar, the guy who works there, was wonderful. We enjoyed chatting with him. He is very accommodating and friendly. The condo area was always kept clean. We enjoyed using the pier for snorkeling and swimming. We will recommend this to other friends if they plan a trip to Belize!

author: Dennis3d
title: First Class
text: Joe & Rhonda operate a First Class resort. The rooms and the grounds are immaculate and everyone wants to take care of your every need. If you are used to 5 star treatment but want some privacy from an overcrowed large resort this is the place. Eliszar, or "E" is the man who can hook you up for fishing, snorkeling, food or anyone or anything on the island. He knows the best tour operators and they pick you up at the dock. This is a family operation, so everyone is treated as a family member. Can't say enough about how well we were treated, they took care of everything, just gave Rhonda our flight info and she took care of everything else. Thanks for taking such great care of my family.

author: null
title: Absolutely Loved Athens Gate Resort
text: This place is heaven. We stayed at Athens Gate Resort during what is considered the "slow season" and it was absolutely great. It felt like we had the whole place to ourselves. Eliazar is the go to guy around the place and makes everything absolutely magical. The rooms are very elegant, spacious and comfortable. We spend most of our time around the pool, at the bar, and on the beach. They also have a great restaurant called Lone Star Grill & Cantina, and it is just what it says.....great Texas cooking. The verandas on the patios are so spacious and there is always a sea breeze. Besides, Eliazar, there is Joe, Rhonda and Jesse that are always on site and ready to help with anything. Can't wait to get back....it will be like coming home....

author: Caryl1950
title: Athens Gate was Great!
text: Our group of 15 friends & family had a wonderful week at Athens Gate. This is a new condo resort next door to and owned by Pelicans Reef, The units, both two & three bedrooms, are all very spacious with fully equipped kitchens. The location is 2.5 miles south of San Pedro in a very quiet area. During our stay, Mr. Joe ( the Texan owner/builder of both resorts), opened a small, casual, eponymous restaurant across the street. All of our activities from scuba-diving to dining to yoga, were arranged by Eliazar know as "E". Eliazar is the heart & soul of Athens Gate. So friendly, pleasant and helpful, he epitomizes what is best about the people of Belize. Thanks, "E"!

author: CookieSA62
title: Old grandeur- an oasis away from the hustle of Durban city
text: We have used this B&B before and we delighted that we could again. The two rooms we hired were lovely and gracious and had everything we needed. The breakfasts are delightful and served by the cook who is a lovely lady and has been working there for the owners for many years. The hosts are gracious and discreet. The accommodations were clean and beautifully decorated. Lovely pool and garden. We highly recommend this B&B and would not hesitate to use it again in the future. Long may such accommodation last!

author: Q5333HWjohnp
title: Beautiful Essenwood
text: We stayed eight nights with John and Paddy and their fabulous staff at Essenwood House. For our family of five, (parents and three grown-up children) John booked us into the two rooms at the far end of the house from the car-park. As soon as we arrived from our nearly 24-trip from Lyon we were enchanted with the location, overlooking the Durban skyline with the Indian ocean beyond, the architecture, early twentieth century colonial pile mansion, and the beautiful bedrooms, spacious, clean and very tastefully furnished. The bathroom was bigger than our bedroom at home !! We were in the upstairs room, with a lovely balcony, and our three kids were in the downstairs room, just a hop, skip and a jump from the lovely swimming pool, impeccably maintained by the house gardener. I see other reviewers have commented on the breakfasts. Seems funny to say, but it was possibly the nicest part of the experience, being waited on by the irreproachable Mbongi, Florence and Mumsi, who were unfailingly courteous, friendly and discrete, all rolled into one. We were slightly sad to leave a day early as John had somehow double-booked us, but he bent over backwards to find us another place to say and offered us a bottle of champers to sweeten the pill - which was most appreciated. Oh and yes, we went to four days of the cricket out of five and England won - icing on the cake ! Many thanks to John and Paddy - we would definitely like to come back.

author: 975alastairm
title: Good Value Guest House
text: On arrival this was slightly different to what I expected. It is as advertised a house and not a lodge per se. The staff are welcoming and the rooms are well thought out with loads of space. Attention to detail was noted with too many examples to note. Wifi was very good quality and the outside balcony had good views of the ocean and surrounding neighborhood. I found the driveway was not for fainthearted although this is not their fault at all. The traffic on the main road during peak periods is a bit hectic so plan your trip accordingly! Best suited for the mid-range to executive traveler.

author: MargaritaConSal
title: Lovely and Upscale for a fair price
text: we left our jungle lodge two days early and decided to check out Durban. Were lucky to get a room at Essenwood house for two night and as soon as we arrived we knew we chose well. Our room was very spacious and faced the Durban skyline which was a great view. The bathroom was large and even had a towel warmer. John, the proprietor went out of his way to help us with taxi's, restaurant reservations and suggestion for sight seeing. Breakfast had delicious french press coffee and fresh croissant as well as eggs cooked to order. Excellent value. They even had a pool area but it was too cool when we were there.

author: customerknowsbest
title: The best B&B ever
text: We visited Essenwood House for 6 nights in May. What a great place. If you were to define a pleasant vacation experience starting at the planning stage, then Essenwood House would be it. Despite communicating from the United States all the way to Durban, South Africa via email, John and Paddy were both exceptionally responsive to my questions regarding not only local logistics, but the political environment as well. Once arriving, they couldn't have been more helpful. Essenwood House is both a beautiful house as well as an outdoor paradise with stunning tropical gardens and a lovely pool. Our breakfast was delicious and the staff couldn't have been sweeter. John was most welcoming to our daughter who was studying abroad there for a semester and although she didn't stay with us, he invited her to breakfast every day and even offered Essenwood House as a haven should she need support during her time abroad. Visiting Essenwood House is like visiting family. I would highly recommend this location for people wanting to be in a quiet neighborhood, looking for a relaxing respite.

author: 951gittek
title: perfect place
text: Essenwood House is a perfect place to stay in Durban. It is fantastic to go out to the veranda and have such a stunning view over the skyline . The rooms are convenient, spacious and very clean. We enjoyed a delicious breakfast. The pool is in a garden which is unbelievable with all the exotic planta, trees and flowers. Thanks for your good advices Paddy and John,for example our trip by bike along the beach front was really great. When we come back to Durban, we will come back to you. Gitte and family

author: kevina177
title: Best B&B in the business
text: If you go to Durban and want a bit of old world charm and grace stay at Essenwood House. The service is impeccable, the rooms are enormous, the house is stately and you get a view over the city you'd pay a fortune for anywhere else. But most of all you get something you'll never get in a hotel, the luxury of staying in an old Dutban mansion - from the wooden floors to the staircase to the ballustrades to the dining room to the sash windows - all original. The outside areas, garden and swimming pool all fabulous. Our host Paddy was charming and warm and very welcoming. Also very reasonable rates. Breakfast excellent. Cannot recommend it highly enough.

author: malcolmp765
title: Lovely time thank you
text: A fantastically tranquil hotel in the centre of Durban. With some beautiful weather to aid us we so enjoyed spending the morning in the gardens. The staff deserve a fantastic mention and nothing was too much trouble. The rooms are spacious, scrupulously clean and comfortable and there is a well stocked mini bar with plenty of choice of soft and alcoholic drinks. We weren't charged for the soft drinks which was a great touch. The hotel is on a small scale which means you really get the personal touch which I think sets it apart from most of the hotels I have stayed in. The owners were chatty and helped provide tips for the local area. All in all a really lovely stay in a peaceful hotel.

author: aussiesJandP
title: A gracious and comfortable place to stay
text: I was delighted to stay at Essenwood House, a gracious, spacious and welcoming B&B in Durban. John & Paddy are warm and helpful hosts and their staff looked after me with quiet attentiveness. Nothing was too much trouble. Paddy's love of colour and fabric bring a liveliness to each room within the house, and the space, light and attention to detail in rooms and bathrooms was a treat. The garden is lush and attractive too. I agree with the reviewer who said "the property is gorgeous". Florida Road - with the delicious Spiga D'oro - and the Musgrave Centre are easily accessed and the morning drive into the International Conference Centre was without hassle. I look forward to returning with my husband and introducing him to John & Paddy and to the delights of Essenwood House. JCS

author: nopolony
title: Wonderfully welcoming
text: My wife and I have stayed at Essenwood House three times now, and every time has been wonderful. The house is beautiful and the location perfect, but the main attraction for us as been the welcome afforded us by the home's owners John and Paddy. We are a (relatively) young couple from Cape Town via England who have two young boys now aged 4 and one. It's fair to say that at the moment the children are a bit of handful. Every time we have stayed at Essenwood, Paddy and John have gone out of their way to make sure we and the kids are happy, including offering to cook nice but simple suppers for the kids...and then us a few hours later. Somehow, despite the fact that Essenwood House is a posh, English-style colonial house with lovely furnishings, the kids have felt perfectly at home. I would highly recommend Essenwood to anyone staying in Durban. We will certainly be back.

author: 747Anna
title: the best in Durban
text: My husband and I recently spent 12 nights in Essenwood House and highly recommend this immaculate B&B. The location is very practical, you can reach the beaches and all the major Highways within minutes. Our hosts made every effort to make us feel comfortable and welcome. We had a beautiful, large room on the first floor, it was worth the extra cost. The large bathroom was very well appointed, we felt very much at home. The breakfast choices with fresh fruit salad, assorted cereals and freshly cooked hot food of your choice gave us both a great start to the day. This is the best B&B we have ever stayed in in South Africa, and we have travelled around quite a bit. If you plan to stay in Durban, this is the place to stay.

author: 652michelled
title: Essenwood House - a beautiful location for a holiday
text: This was our second stay at Essenwood House. We stayed here a few years back and enjoyed it so much we returned for our 10 day holiday this year. Our beautiful room felt spacious and included its own private balcony overlooking the gorgeous garden and pool. The view from our room and balcony was simply stunning due to Essenwood Road's commanding location high up on the Berea - you can see right across the city centre, all the way to the durban beachfront with its breathtaking ocean. Every morning was a treat as we sat down for a delicious breakfast of fresh fruit salad (consisting of only the most delicious fruits), a selection of cereals, yoghurt, egg & toast, fresh orange juice, croissants, filter coffee and a selection of cheeses. What more could you ask for ! All the staff were fantastic and so gracious. We will definitely be back !

author: Pinkfiece
title: Gorgeous House, Luxurious stopover
text: My mother, husband, and 6 month old son stayed at Essenwood on a quick stopover through Durban. We were quite surprised it turned out to be such an elegant oasis. The house is beautiful and well maintained. Our rooms were extremely well appointed; the hosts have thought of everything, which is how a B&B should be. Our bathroom was palatial! The veranda & views were amazing. Yard, garden and pool really nice. Breakfast perfect - hot, good selections, fresh fruit. I could have stayed at Essenwood happily for a week. Thank you - we hope to come back!

author: CanberraFamilygirl
title: peaceful haven
text: I couldn't imagine wanting to stay anywhere else in Durban. The garden is just glorious and you feel as though you are on acreage miles away from the bustle of the city. Not that the Berea area is that crowded - it is a beautiful area of Durban and very convenient. The staff are friendly and Paddy and John are the perfect hosts. We loved the fruit salad at breakfast and all the rest of it as well. Rooms are big and comfortable and have everything you need. It was a total luxury to be able to hand over a bag of dirty washing and get it back that evening perfectly washed, ironed and folded. A special mention of the four footed friends as well - beautifully behaved dachshunds, with Miss Bella only giving a tiny woof at breakfast in case you had missed her. In addition the occasional visit from monkeys - these are of course total pests, but for overseas visitors how exciting to see a long tail hanging from a tree and a cheeky face peeping out at you! Thank-you Paddy and John - we hope to return next year!

author: GeraldineC874
title: Essenwood House on the Berea is a haven while staying in Durban
text: Boundless Africa recommended Essenwood House to us while were were in Durban for a couple of days. We are always researching best practice so that we can make sure we are delivering excellence at our luxury accommodation in Australia, Basia Mille. We learnt many things at Essenwood House, being particularly well looked after by John and Paddy. John was an excellent host, driving us a short way to dinner at local restaurants, giving us advice about where to go, and making sure everything was working well. The accommodation was delightful. The room was large and the outlook towards Durban's city lights and the ocean was gorgeous. The breakfasts were delicious and the staff very accommodating. We had dinner in one evening and it was very pleasant.

author: BW666
title: Felt Like Home Away From Home
text: Essenwood was recommended to us by our friends and family in the area. The accommodation was beautiful, so clean, comfortable and safe. The morning breakfasts were always spot on and catered to our preferences. John was so welcoming when we arrived we felt like we were returning home from a long trip away. Essenwood Guest House is central to many attractions, however, we often felt that the beautiful views and the pool/garden area was enough to keep our entire family entertained. After a horrible experience at a nearby B&B I would not recommend staying anywhere else in Morningside other than Essenwood. Thank you John for a wonderful time at Essenwood! We will be back!!!

author: travelbabe40
title: If I could live at Essenwood House I would.
text: This was my third visit to this beautiful guest house on the Berea. John, Paddy and the staff are so lovely and look after you as soon as you arrive. The house is absolutely charming with the most beautiful big spacious rooms with the most breathtaking views. The garden is a delight and although I often seem to be there when it is a bit cooler the swimming pool always looks so inviting. Amenities include a very well stocked mini bar, red wine, snacks, fresh fruit etc. Hairdryers and robes in every room. Nothing has been left out and this is the detail that is so important. And the rates are very good too, much better than a city or beachfront hotel in all aspects.

author: ReidBethany
title: Home Away From Home
text: We have stayed at many B&B's over the years of travelling and rate Essenwoodhouse as a standout. The setting is in a high end area of Durban. The colonial architectural style of the residence is most welcoming. It is situated on a hillside overlooking the whole City of Durban with a forefront of beatiful landscaping and a gorgeous swimming pool. The location provides perfect solitude only broken by the far away sound of Indian Ocean breakers on the Durban beachfront. The spacious home has 7 bedrooms all enjoying 12' high ceilings. The bedrooms are equiped with all you could ask for---satellite TV, fridge stocked with ice, mixes, wine, liquors, coffee/tea making facilities, phone and laundry service. Our room and our friends room had a lovely balconey which overlooked a view you could die for! A very hearty breakfast was served on the patio or dining room depending on the weather by a very friendly staff. Of course all of this was created by Paddy and John Chance, our most hospitable hosts, who have been providing a Home Away From Home for travellers like us for many years.

author: Gaynor16
title: Old world charm
text: We stayed for a week. We could not have received better hospitality from the host. We had a corner room with a deck with fantastic views over Durban. The room was spacious, the bed and bathroom huge, with high quality sheets, etc. The location is perfect- high up on the Berea;and the property is safe, with easy parking. The gardens are superb and the pool area a 'cool' place to be. The colonial furniture, pictures and artifacts are fascinating, though beware the chiming grandfather clock-the latter tells you the time sometimes when you least want it! Breafast was either out on the deck by the garden or in a splendid room-high ceilings, historical painitngs, and, occasionally, the three dogs pay a visit to nudge one's leg just in case people are generous enough to part with any of their breakfast! Nothing was too much trouble for our generous hosts. We wish the latter a continuing successful stay in the hospitality industry!

author: AmberPretto
title: Peace and tranquility awaits you at Essenwood House!
text: We stayed at Essenwood while on a business trip to Durban. Our room was spacious with a wonderful balcony overlooking the gardens and pool. The location is great as you are a quick 10 minutes from downtown and secure parking is available. The gardens are a tropical paradise. The breakfeast is fantastic with many choices for a nutritious start to your day. We enjoyed the fresh bowl of fruit in our room each day! The owners are very helpful with eating or shopping directions. Also if you are there on a Saturday, the Essenwood market is a 1 km walk away!

author: janloism
title: Ultimate B&B
text: This is our 2nd stay at this beautiful guest house. The property is located at the top of the Berea has a lovely garden with pool and a view of the city and Indian Ocean in the distance. Our room was extremely large with a very comfortable king size bed, and plenty of closet space, and of course had an en-suite bathroom. Little extra touches make this a special place to stay. Coffee and tea available in room, with cookies and fresh fruit supplied daily. A wonderful large hot cooked breakfast was included so that we often only needed a snack for lunch. The property is secure and we felt very safe staying there. However it's best to have your own car to get around.

author: SonjaB546
title: Don't look any further
text: What a wonderful place to stay in Durban. Very friendly and warm welcome. Rooms have got everything you need plus more. Very clean and comfortable. Pity we could not stay longer but hope to be back. Fantastic view, beautiful and neat garden with pool. It's very central. In the middle of a busy area and yet it is not noisy A very big plus is the very good security.

author: AndreaD325
title: My stay at Essenwood House
text: I have stayed at the Essenwood House on the Berea a number of times over the years, and the welcome and hospitality on this occasion was as warm and frinedly as ever. Rooms and bathrooms are very generously sized and very comfortable. The views are great, and the location provides a secure and quiet piece of paradise, while being located within easy striking distance of restaurants, shops and town. There is also plenty of safe parking. Breakfast outside on the patio also provides a great start to any day. Paddy and John and their staff are great, with nothing being too much trouble. See you both next time I am in Durban. Andrea

author: ELEANORY_12
title: Home from home.
text: We attended a family funeral and eight members of the family stayed here. We were all warmly welcomed by John. My husband and I had a lovely bright room,comfortable bed, wonderful views over Durban especially from the large balcony at night. The TV had all the channels we required, including the cricket from UK. The breakfast was outstanding and Paddy and her team faultless. It is situated in a delightful area, within easy reach of Durban beaches, shopping centres and city and easy to find from the.airport. We live in England and certainly will stay here again and will strongly recommend it to friends. .

author: LorenJB
title: Utterly charming
text: Tucked away just off one of the busiest streets on the Berea who would have thought we would have found such a little treasure! As an ex-Durbanite now living abroad I am nothing but full of positive things to say about this tucked away little piece of heaven - the brochure does not do it enough justice. The room we stayed in had fantastic views of Durban bay, a spacious balcony to relax, huge bedroom which more than comfortably fitted a superking bed, one single bed for my daughter, one cot for my son and plenty more room for luggage! Not to mention that lovely large en-suite bathroom. Unfortunately we only had the opportunity to stay one night but Essenwood House went out of their way to make us comfortable and happy. John, the owner, is a charming English expat who's interesting family history hangs in paintings on the wall next to all sorts of antiquities and ornaments. Essenwood House buzzes with character, charm and adventure! I hope you enjoy it as much as we did!

author: travelbabe40
title: Beautiful Original Durban home
text: Just spent 5 nights at Essenwood House on the Berea. What a beautiful home. Rooms are HUGE, bathrooms too. VERY comfortable. Views to die for, you can see right down to the beachfront and the lights at night are spectacular. John and his staff are great, nothing is too much trouble. Breakfast outside on the patio with the newspaper of the day are a must. Very well located, close to restaurants, shops, movies and town. Will be back soon.

author: jasperk_12
title: Visit the Essenwood House
text: Last week me and my girlfriend stayed in the Essenwood House. It was a wonderful experience. Thanks to the excellent host: John. John is very helpfull to help you to go to good restaurants. We went to an Indian restaurant which was excellent. The house is very nice and the rooms are amazing. The swimming pool brings nice refreshments. For us it was the last day in South Africa. But one day we will come back to durban and again like to stay in the Essenwood house.

author: TravelNor
title: As close to heaven as possible!
text: We stayed at beautiful Essenwood house for five days, and enjoyed every second. The owner is truly making every effort to make us feel comfortable. Due to a delayed bus, we arrived in the middle of the night, but he got up to let us in with a smile, even though we were supposed to be there five hours earlier. The rooms are spacious, clean and gorgeous. Fresh flowers, fruit and that little chocolate on the pillow every afternoon made us feel very welcome. The owner knows everything there is to know about Durban, and happily arranged taxis and recommended restaurants to us. The breakfast was fantastic, and they can even arrange other meals such as lunch and dinner on request. There is also a wonderful garden and a pool, great for relaxing. We would not consider staying anywhere else in Durban!

author: Annawatercress
title: 9-night stay in this tranquil place
text: I had booked a trip to Durban and, being a woman alone, wanted secure and peaceful accommodation in an area where I could walk around safely by myself. Essenwood House was just perfect. The house is restful and clean and bright and I walked around the local roads (Musgrave, Florida, Currie, Essenwood) with no problems. John Chance, is the perfect host - striking the perfect balance between caring that everything is going well for you and leaving you alone! (He saved me absolutely by lending me his SA/UK charger for my camera on my first night.) My big room was totally fabulous with its own long balcony; a large bathroom and wetroom, PLUS a study area with a nice desk and a lovely view through the palm trees and garden right across to the city. At night, the lights were magical. I would have loved to stay for 6 months and finish my PhD there! I will be going back that's for sure.

author: JDL62
title: Fabulous
text: I have now stayed at Essenwood House twice. Once in winter (July) and once in summer (December) . On both occasions we had the most fabulous stay. John and Paddy together with their staff Florence, Joyce, Bongi and Pinkie are gracious and welcoming hosts. Nothing is too much for them. The rooms are clean and comfortable with views of the sea. The breakfast is large and substantive. In summer we swam and sat at the pool. Their are added bonuses like they will do your laundry (for a fee) and the property is extremely secure. I would highly recommend this property.

author: mich74Switzerland
title: Beautiful place on the top of the hill with view of see and Durban skiline
text: We stayed 4 nights at the end of May 2011 and we loved the quiet position of Essenwoodhouse on the top of the hill only 5-10 minutes away from the city centre with taxy. The rooms are spacious with balcon or veranda and beautiful view of the small tropical garden and swimmingpool. At nigth you can see Durban skyline lights and during the day the beautiful indian ocean. Breakfast is tipical south-african with big portions and fresh fruits. John, the owner is very gently and helpful in every moment.He can provide to organise the taxy tranfert from the airport to Essenwood if you desire. Tipp:to move in the city use "Eagles Taxy", they are very efficient and have cheaper rates than other(John can give you more informations). When we are in Durban Essenwoodhouse will be our choice!!! Michel and Anna( Switzerland)

author: marthaiwest
title: An absolutely beautiful and comfortable large guest house in Durban
text: It was an absolute treat staying at Essenwood House whilst we were in Durban. The house itself is beautifully decorated and maintained, with wonderful views of Durban, the sea and the horizon beyond. We felt we'd hit gold when we first saw the house, our rooms and where we'd be staying for the week ahead. Not only was the house lovely to stay in but the owner was incredibly kind and generous, and always checked up that we had everything we needed and were comfortable - which we certainly were. The staff too were very friendly and provided us with some delicious breakfasts, with lots to choose from each morning. There were also some very appealing resident dogs, who often greeted us on our arrival home each day and kept us company at breakfast. I would definitely recommend Essenwood House to anyone visting Durban, whether visiting for the first time or returning. I know I would love to stay there again in the future. Many thanks to all at Essenwood House.

author: BarbadosBart
title: Comfortable and friendly
text: John is a true host. He explains everything and makes certain that you understand that he can and will do almost anything to make your stay as pleasant as possible. The house is beautiful and our room was decorated with many items that must have come from his personal collection. Little things like a good selection of fruit, biscuits and wine were great. The gardens and pool offer peace and are meticulously kept, the view is gorgeous. After touring S. Africa for 5 weeks we stayed here 3 days and it was idyllic with warm and friendly staff. With the exception of having to log on and pay for a worthless internet connection I am sure we would have been hard pressed to find a better place to stay in Durban.

author: jrq
title: Very glad we chose to stay at Essenwood House
text: I can't thank John enough for being such a gracious host. Our stay at Essenwood House was wonderful. The directions from the airport were spot on and it was lovely being able to stay in Durban with easy access to some excellent restaurants and sightseeing spots. The rooms are very spacious and beautifully furnished. We appreciated the amenities in the room which made our stay very comfortable. John was a great help in booking restaurants. We especially enjoyed our dinner at Palki, a local Indian restaurant which John recommended. The breakfasts are delicious and the staff very friendly and accommodating.

author: SiljeA
title: Pleasant stay
text: Stayed at Essenwood House for two weekends in February 2011 together with my husband and toddler. It has a perfect location in a very nice area, close to Florida rd and big parks, a zoo and the botanical garden. Great view and the rooms are spacious! My toddler loved the three dogs and John also provided some toys for our son. It was great sitting outside on the verandah when the little one was asleep, and John is really helpful with everything from ordering taxis to food. The breakfast is superb, and you also get the news paper. The only minus was that the garden (which is really beautiful!) is quite steep, so our son could not run around there much without us helping him not to fall. I would love to stay there again.

author: Jimmyma2
title: Soulless staff, great location
text: Where to start? There was zero welcome from the receptionist and got annoyed because I didn’t understand the instructions on how to get to my room in the building opposite. So after the slowest elevator arrived to take me to the first floor you had to cross a bridge between the two buildings. The next issue I’d the stupid key system, it involves aligning a faded arrow on the key ring with a hidden slot on within the door handle, then turning the whole mechanism. The rooms are very very dated as was the bed covers, like something your Grandmother would have in the 1970s . Worst unsecured WiFi ever and the slowest. in its favour, very good location. That’s all though. Won’t go back to this Hotel.

author: LiiliK2
title: Good location and surprising breakfast
text: Hotel is in very good location. It is easy to get there from Chopin airport. Culture objects, parks and shopping centres are at no grate distance. Hotel is clean but the rooms need refreshment soon. Rooms are quite big (you can do there your yoga exercises). There is all you need during your short trip to Warszawa for reasonable price. Service in the hotel is good and people are very friendly. The breakfast choice is remarkable and food is very tasty.

author: mrslister116
title: Excellent location
text: I booked this hotel as we were visiting Warsaw to do the marathon. One of the reasons we chose this hotel was for the ‘spa’ as listed on booking.com. The location of the hotel was excellent, everything was within walking distance. Well placed fir many vegan eateries (very important). The room was fine, but it was quite noisy with the usual city centre sounds and people playing the musical instruments in the nearby park. But onc3 I got used to the noise it was fine. Reception and check in was adequate, the bar was fine, but the lady would go missing for up to half an hour at a time. Breakfast as a vegan wasn’t too good but I expected this and as I said there was plenty of great options outside. It seems the ‘spa’ is a beauty salon over the road so I would say this was our biggest disappointment. Also we had a kettle and cups in our room but no coffee/tea was provided

author: whatsintgefridge
title: What can I say
text: So let's start with location, perfect really. Great restaurants and bars near by - very well located. The hotel itself is a bit tired, the rooms need returbs and although the rooms are very clean, you could fix the toilet seats. I changed rooms and both had broken seats! Also beware of the 6th floor it can be extremely hot up there, and aircon, well that just doesn't work I think it's past it's date. Staff here are ok, they seem to flip a lot of rooms here with business and large groups of tourist so sometimes it feels like they don't really care about you. The breakfast here is great, well done to the kitchen they change the cooked food daily so your not eating the same boring thing everyday! Overall it's an ok hotel.

author: GarethJ350
title: Working Holiday in Warsaw
text: Stayed with our choir on a mini concert tour. The hotel has been recently modernised. Our twin bedded room was perfectly adequate, spotless, with comfortable beds, and a decent shower. The bar was small and not terribly well located, but the staff were first class, helpful and friendly. Tip: there is one lift and a triumph of design over function! If you are not good with stairs, try for a room on the first floor. The hotel is located on a square with shops close at hand and an excellent chocolate shop on the corner! It's a ten minute walk from the 'old' town. There are many restaurants and cafes within a short stroll, and a Kantor (currency exchange) in the same block. All things considered this hotel is good value for money.

author: Kim1307
title: Centrally located 3 star hotel
text: A little drab looking building in the center of Warsaw. The hotel has an uninspireing bar and a restaurant decorated as a polish farm house. Had booked a double room for 3 nights, got a 3 bed 2-room with 2 bathrooms. Good standard and clean, must have been renovated recently. Room # 145 on first floor. 1 Elevator (Very slow). The food in the restaurant was averagely priced and ok (nothing fancy). This hotel can be recommended for being centrally located and economical. Its difficult to get a smile from the personnel.

author: szedreseperke
title: Cheap and poor
text: This hotel is a good choice if you are looking for a cheap place with minimal service but if you want more go for another one. The overall expression is very 80's, stuck in the last days of the communist era unfortunately. Old fashioned, aged furniture everywhere, receptionists without proper English knowledge and nothing more that is mandatory in a 2 (3?) star hotel. We stayed in a "Business Double Room" which was in the newer building that you can enter only from the 1st floor of the old building and the elevators are annoyingly slow so it was a very unpleasant activity every single time. The room itself was very spacious but dark, overheated as hell (we are not able to adjust the temperature at all) and had a dirty wall-to-wall carpet. Also it was way too noisy, we could hear everything from the streets during nights which was a little bit terrifying on the first one. The breakfast is OK if you are into eating all kind of sausages otherwise it contained very few sweet choices and size of the glasses were 1dl meaning you need to run for a refill quite frequently during your breakfast. The location is great if you would like to stay close to the center but not that optimal if you want to stay around the Old Town instead. Public transportation is very good though so you can get to most of the touristic places from here in 30 minutes maximum.

author: YohaiBenAmi
title: Excellent location, friendly service, bad management
text: The Gromada Centrum hotel is located at the center of Warsaw, it is within walking distance from both the main railway station and the old city. The staff is friendly, speak English and tries very much to do its best. However, the hotel was built in 1937 (it says so on the signs), and it feels like the management (either locally or at the network level) is trying to spend as little money as possible in order to make it fit to the 21st century. We had problems with the elevators, there was no air condition in the room (in September they only have heating!), and instead of keys cards, there are those big metal plates that one needs to insert in a very particular angle for the door to open. Also, they are supplying one kind of liquid soap, not sure if it is a Shampoo or a body soap (it is coming from a box on the bath's wall, which is friendly to the environment, but hey, what is it?). The breakfasts are big, but tend to repeat themselves. I felt sorry for the staff, who I imagine has to face a lot of complaints because of decisions that are made by higher levels in order to cut on costs. If, for some reason, you need to stay in this hotel in the summer (and in September too, apparently), ask for a room in floor 1, in the wing where the reception is (the other wing is interconnected via an aisle that you have to cross by foot), and avoid rooms that face south: they boil at midday.

author: lizzyillustration
title: A Soviet Era Hotel
text: As a tour guide, I stay at a lot of hotels in Poland with my groups, and this hotel was the one they liked the least on our last trip. It is a throwback to communist times, with a cavernous, bleak fluorescent lit lobby, and only one elevator going upstairs. Our group of thirty people had to wait a long time to finally get up to their rooms, as only two or three could enter the elevator at a time. Getting to our room on the 3 floor involved a very complicated trek of going up and elevator, crossing a bridge, and going up another elevator to arrive to the room. The keys were very odd, and too some fiddling with until I entered my room. My room was old and tired with a thin mattress on the bed, and a plastic sheet under the regular one that felt cold and clammy all night. The room was clean, however, and quite large. Breakfast was bland without a lot of options, and the windowless basement breakfast room was not a place you wanted to linger in too long. As others have mentioned, the location is good, and for Jewish groups who wish to have a kosher meal, the Warsaw JCC, it is 3 blocks away from the hotel.

author: FOTIS9
title: Very nice hotel at center of Warsaw.
text: Location is excellent at very centre of Warsaw. Very clean rooms and nice modern furniture. The room was in the renovated section of main building (this with reception at ground floor) at 3 floor with view at main street. Also had an effective air-condition. At room was available coffee, tea and bottled water (with gas and no) at no additional charge. Reception employees were fast, polite and effective. Breakfast which was served at -1 level was great with almost all kind of food. The only thing we didn’t liked was the very slow elevator. We were very satisfied overall. I forgot to mention the fast free wifi.

author: TrondH282
title: Great price for great location.
text: We stayed there for one night. It was a bargin. Close to the centralstation. Only 10 minutes to walk. And a 15 minutes walk to the old town. Normal good breakfast. We ate in the restaurant in the evening. Better than we would belive.

author: yli147
title: only location is good
text: Pros: good location, close to the main street. Stayed there because its proximity to the University of Warsaw. Breakfast is satisfactory. Cons: (1) there are mosquitoes! The room could be too warm at night on warm days and I was afraid to open the windows for long time because mosquitoes would enter the room, and thus the sleep was uncomfortable because it was warm in the room. Of course there is no air-conditioning. (2) mattress too soft in my room so I had to flip it (3) comforter not long enough (4) curtain does not block light and the sun rose very early (~4am) in the summer and woke me up (5) no hair dryer in the room And the TV sets are old too -- they are CRT monitors instead of LED ones... My room is opposite to some residential building and was noisy on Friday night because of some parties with loud music in the residential building.

author: astudyincontrasts
title: Worst hotel - bar none!
text: This hotel was awful in every possible way. The decor is 1980s communist style. The bathroom shower was filthy with mold in the tiles. The bed was a futon on a wooden platform which was most uncomfortable. The breakfast food was inedible and the service was decidedly subpar. The wifi was very sporadic. This is literally the worst hotel I have ever stayed at in any country. Avoid it at all cost.

author: Carlos_Jorge_Santos
title: Good location, but don't expect much more
text: The Hotel is very well located in city centre, a short 15 min walk to Old Town. It has Wifi available for all guests and it works very well. Breakfast is included buffet type, choose whatever you want, continental or English, with many variety. The Hotel is a bit old, and needs some remodelation. The matress wasn't very comfortable and the cleanliness of the room has many space for improvement. The floor carpet was worn and full of stains. If you're driving, the hotel has a payed underground parking. If you're looking a comfy room, this is probably not the most recommended Hotel.

author: tekaiar
title: old soviet style well located and low price
text: very well locate at only 5mn walk from centrala station and 15 mn from old center. Old soviet style with big beton building and obsolete furniture. We were at 2nd new extension as old fassion as initial one. you have to take lift till &st floor ( only modern element but so slow;;;;), then bridge corridor then another lift to reach very old equiped room, well sized, but old,y good not really good bed and minimalist bathroom. Breakfast is located in depressive basement but quite correct for the place and don,t expect to have croissants. staff is average, answering at minimum level at questions. Price is the most competitive to have fast visit of the city center. correct for the price and location.

author: jannicel2017
title: Lovley
text: This hotel was great! Big Room, clean and cheap! Breakfast ok! Close to everything in town! We spent most of the time in the old town! Simply love Warzaw! Will be back thats for sure! The view from our Room was amazing so make sure you get a Room at the top! They also had lunch however we never tried that out! Yet the menu looked good and it was ridiculously cheap!

author: orindagc
title: Not your best choice in Warsaw
text: Our room was clean and looked like it had been renovated fairly recently. The problem was that the sheet used to make up the bed (and was supposed to cover the mattress!) was too small. It extended perhaps 2 inches past the top edge of the mattress and did not reach the mattress bottom. It was impossible to sleep on it and not wake up to find that you were sleeping on a bare, uncovered mattress. Twice over the course of 3 nights I explained the problem to the front desk, saying that a wider sheet was needed- but to no avail. Sleeping on a bare hotel mattress is unacceptable! A second concern was with the breakfast. The choices were extremely limited and the quality was poor.

author: Stavush1
title: Nice old good service and great location
text: The service was very good. My mother was located in a room far from the elevator and they replaced the room in the morning. Very clean! The breakfast is very good and they refilled all food before it ended. The hotel is located between the old city and the center of warsha and many bus stations around. Good and safe location. For those who want a casino there is no casino in the hotel. The rooms we've been to were old but clean and the bad comfortable. We'll definitely come back to this hotel.

author: MiguelEPJ
title: Non turist hotel. Good location.
text: The hotel is fairly big and the lift was not working. The room was located at a significant distance from the reception - 2nd floor at the end of one of the halls, which I didn't mind because I like the exercise but it could be complicated for people traveling heavy. The hotel decor probably dates back to the Berlin wall ages, which I found it interesting and it added a certain charm to my stay, but on the other end the room carpets and furniture were nearly worn-out and I in my opinion the Hotel urges a renovation. The room was reasonable clean and the mattress was not comfortable. Breakfast buffet ranges from typical continental breakfast choices to some of the local flavors. Beware, the hotel is big and at peak hour in the morning it can be quite crowded in the breakfast room. I didn't find many tourists here, the majority of the customers seem to be local. Hence, as one would expect, the hotel rate is very competitive.

author: melparkin
title: Not one good thing to say!
text: Well where do I start?! Firstly ignore everything it says regarding a spa, casino, room service etc as its all lies!! The rooms are so basic they don't even have a kettle, fridge, safe or soap! Beds are horribly uncomfy. We asked for extra blankets and were refused. We asked for a room service menu and they said no. The food in the restaurant is beyond awful. We had someone walk straight in to our room while I was In bed, a member of staff and the door was locked, no knock, she just walked in then saw me and left, not even an apology. Seriously bad I wouldn't stay here again if it were the last place in Warsaw give me a stable any day of the week.

author: cerir577
title: Excellent Location-great value for money
text: This is five minutes away from Nowy Swiat which is the main area for bars and restuarants. The hotel does need upgrading but for the money we spent per night then I have no complaints about this hotel. The breakfasts were varied and even had hot sausages, omelettes etc. The staff were very helpful and although they may seem abrupt at times-that's just the polish way. They are not... The rooms were very basic with two campbeds in them but clean and suprisingly big. We had room 164 which had an okay view but was a smoking room which we requested. All in all an excellent hotel for the price you pay.

author: ronh481
title: Good value in central Warsaw
text: I have stayed in this place before (first in 1976, before it was a commercial hotel), so I knew what I was letting myself in for. It still smacks of the communist era, although I was staying in a modern annex on both my last visits. It is cheap and not particularly cheerful, but it is superbly located, a kilometre or so from the main station and from the main shopping area; convenient for the Old Town and for buses to the airports. (I assume visitors are able to walk up to half a mile without too much difficulty.) The rooms are very basic, and in high summer it can be unbearably hot. The beds are OK, the furnishings basic, the bathroom just up to standard. The self-service breakfast (included) is not exciting, but adequate. There was no wifi in the rooms, and connection in the public area proved problematic. This is not for the traveller who needs luxury or pampering, or for business travellers who need reliable communication. But for those who want a good location, at a good price, from which to explore Warsaw, it serves its purpose well.

author: 904monicat
title: An acceptable budget hotel in the centre of Warsaw
text: The hotel is located conveniently in the very centre of Warsaw and considering the central location the price was very reasonable. The service was good, the food was fantastic (if you like traditional Polish cuisine), the hotel room was clean and well-equipped. On the down side, the bed was creaky, uncomfortable and well past its retirement age. I obviously cannot speak for beds in other rooms; perhaps we were just unlucky. The main complaint was the Wi-Fi. We came for a business trip and access to fast internet was of paramount importance. The internet in the hotel kept disconnecting and once it went down completely for several hours, which made our lives very difficult. The hotel seems to cater predominantly to package tours, school trips, and public sector conferences. We wouldn't recommend it for business travellers but as a cheap option for a recreational stay it's no too bad.

author: kenhsieh5555
title: Good location and breakfast.
text: This hotel is at very good location of city centre. We stay here for 5 nights the price is unbeatable with the good breakfast and good service. The room is very clean and towel change everyday. The room I stay was on the 3rd floor and back of the hotel face to the back yard. The only problem of the room is the mattress is not very comfortable for sleep. We have to go to the reception asking for one more blanket to put on top of mattress. Bottle water been replace everyday. I will come back here again next time.

author: 789janda
title: Really not good
text: We booked this hotel as part of a cheap deal, so we hadn't expected too much. The room was very old and dirty. The carpets and mattresses were unbelievably stained and grim, so pleased we didn't look at the beds until we were leaving as there's no way I could have slept on it if I had. The mattresses were thin with springs so close to the surface that we woke up with clear spring circles up our arms and legs. The bathroom was old, cracked and mouldy with a broken shower attachment over the bath. That said the water pressure was good and the water hot so if you'd contorted into the right position it was usable. Being city centre it was noisy with people walking past at all hours, we'd expected this and it was fine, however the incredibly thin curtains did nothing to keep car headlights out and as we were on the main road the room lit up all night long. The breakfast was ok, really nothing special and the staff dour and not keen to engage. The decor throughout the hotel was woodchip and cheap carpet, there really wasn't anywhere comfortable to sit and relax. On the plus side it was in a great location and because of the terrible conditions we made the most of this lively and hospitable city.

author: 36irfans
title: Decent hotel with a good central location
text: The hotel lobby gave me the impression that it was a luxury hotel, but the room was a bit disappointing after the lobby. I was staying in room 101 which is on a corner near a busy street so at night there was a bit city noises, but not that bad unless you're a very light sleeper. I'm a city boy through and through so for me it was soothing, but if you are ask for a room on the other sides which are quite side streets. The bed was creaking, but ok once you found your sleeping position ;) WiFi signal was a bit unstable and slow in the room, but overall it worked fine. Breakfast was ok with enough choice for a hotel in this price range. I've hard better at cheaper hotels, but also worse at more expensive hotels. The staff was friendly and helpful when I needed them. Location is great because Central Station and the public transport is within walking distance and if you walk the other way you're at Nowy Swiat which is a nice street with lots of restaurants and such leading up the "old" city center. (The old city center was destroyed during WOII, but after the war rebuilt using paintings/pictures). Because of it's location you can easily get to the hotel from either airport using public transport or shuttle transfers to the city center.

author: GosiaMS
title: Nice place to stay
text: The Hotel is not the newest hotel in the neighborhood, but the quality of rooms and service is very good. Rooms are spacious and clean, better in the new part than in the old one, this is understandable. There are elevator in each part. Reception service is very good, there is free luggage storage if you come too soon to get to the room or have to stay longer in the city. No too varied but tasty breakfasts, however black pudding for breakfast was a surprize ;) Grreat location! The hotel is in walking distance to city center. It takes only 10 minutes of nice walk through Nowy Świat to Warsaw University. Prices are quite high, but not higher than in other hotels in this location.

author: AnaO10
title: Very good choice!
text: If you are looking for a fancy hotel this is not the place for you. But if you don't mind that the furniture is a bit outdated and the carpet a bit worn up and if you are looking for a decent and comfortable place to stay, in a great location, at a very reasonable price, Gromada Centrum is the best choice.Comfortable beds, big rooms, clean.Very good breakfast with a good choice of meat and cheese, eggs, fruits,vegetables, croissants,etc. The reception staff is friendly and helpful, will answer any question you have and help you with all the details. There's only one elevator and it's very slow, but I didn't mind, actually I found it funny and charming: was calling it Grandpa Elevator. We only had dinner once at the restaurant and the dishes are huge, tasty and at a good price.The location is excellent. Right in the city center, surrounded by restaurants, shops and bars. You can reach the Old Town by foot (15 minutes walk). To get to the hotel from Chopin Airport, take bus nr 175 and get off at DH Smyk stop. The hotel is very close, 5 minutes walk. I would definitely stay again at this hotel and recommend it to my friends.

author: G3693QWjanes
title: Good deal, best location
text: A large well run hotel. Very basic (yes, strong soviet overtones) but clean and convenient. I was able to walk everywhere. Took the bus from the airport to the central train station and walked from there. Staff was helpful. The lock on my room was very difficult to open and they moved me to another room. Large breakfast if you like that stuff. Wifi was ok in the room.

author: 303muratd
title: Average Quality
text: Good location, 2 minutes to Nowy Swiat avenue and 7-8 minutes to Central Railway Station (Warszawa Centralna). Free wi-fi. Clean rooms. Reasonable breakfast. Furniture is a bit old and not comfortable. Hotel staff are ok but don't expect too much. You get the exact value for your money. There are better hotels around in Warsaw.

author: JC991
title: A reasonable budget stay
text: I visited Hotel Gromada as a solo visitor spending a couple of days in Warsaw. The hotel is within a reasonable distance of the train station, perhaps 20mins walk away with the use of a decent map. On first arrival, I noticed that the picture on here is slightly misleading: the modern building at the forefront of the picture is not where the majority of the rooms are held, they are within the distinctly Soviet-era building to the right of the picture (not that there is anything expressly wrong with that beyond the fact it is less modern). In the hotel the staff are friendly and speak English well. The rooms are comfortable and entirely inkeeping with the cost of the visit. Breakfast is served in the basement and has a good selection of hot and cold food and drinks, with something to suit everyone. There were plenty of staff to assist people eating. I would probably compare this hotel to a Travelodge or Holiday Inn in the UK: does the basics well but don't expect all the luxuries that some hotels offer.

author: 490JanF490
title: Cheap hotel and accordingly rooms
text: I've booked this hotel for a short business trip in late July 2013. Arriving at the reception there was a cue of approximately 12 persons. Just one attendent working. Took about 15 minutes to check in. Checking my (I must say economy booked) room it was very small. About 10 X 10 feet. Warsaw that day had a heat wave of 32 degrees next day to be expected 36+ degrees. No airco in the room, glass window at the South-West side and just a small window which could be opened. I've never checked out earlier from any hotel than this one....

author: bliebetty
title: GromadaDom Chlopa 25-29th May
text: A nice hotel for the price. ( we paid £18 each for a twin room bed and breakfast) Good location and not too difficult to get to from the main train station...very close to the centre and within walking distance of the old town. Room was basic, but perfectly adequate..clean..I've seen that some people say the lift was slow..but can't say I noticed that ? Was a bit noisy, but then there was a wedding reception the night we stayed, so may be quieter normally! Smart reception area and entertainment room..lovely outside patio area if you are lucky enough to get nice weather! The only down side was the staff..reception was short staffed and couldn't cope with the amount of guests ( it is a huge hotel!)..it took a long time to get to speak to someone and they were a little abrupt and not ever so helpful..I asked for an extra pillow which I didn't think was such a big request ?..and although they did get me one, they didn't seem very happy about it :( Also in the restaurant they were short staffed too!..a lot of tables needed clearing and the waiters didn't have time to change the table cloths when dirty, so in the end we had to clear a table ourselves and just sit with a dirty tablecloth. We had to ask for the milk to be replenished, also the orange juice, for bowls, glasses and cutlery!..I felt a bit sorry for the waiters as I'm sure they were doing their best,but simply couldn't cope with the amount of guests! ( I was a bit worried about eating the hot food such as bacon and sausage as it seemed to have been sitting around for quite a while, it certainly wasn't replenished regularly) There would, however have been a good selection of items available when it was all there! ( eggs, bacon, sausage, cold meats, cheese, salad items, cereals, rolls, jams etc) If you are on a budget and want just a simple basic hotel, handy for city centre, I would recommend a stay here.

author: jnwLeicestershire
title: Very Good
text: I do not know which part of the hotel we were in new or old, the room was 3rd floor straight up in the lift from reception. It wasnot the cheapest smallest room, just one grade up (size of room) The room was great, nicely decorated , great bathroom , everything we needed (except a kettle -but we are british and like our cuppa). The matresses are old but clean and the rooms were serviced every day (not something you get everywhere) Reception was good , spoke good english and very helpful, quick check ins and outs. Breakfast was good with plenty of choice, cereal, bacon/eggs/sausage cold meats and veg etc as well as fruit juice tea and coffee. Personally I don't like streaky bacon and would have preferred more croissants etc but this is eastern europe and not France or Spain. It was very good. Only warning is do not jaywalk, use the crossings/underpasses and wait at the lights. We had one issue on the last night when our room lock broke, but the security got in and gave us another room without question. All very pleasant.

author: /undefined
title: Excellent. Recommended
text: Good location. Excellent rate price/quality. Very comfortable. Breakfast complete and good for all tastes. Friendly service. Nearly to the central railway station. I will come to this hotel again in my next business trip. I'm totally sure.

author: Junebear
title: Great value for money, friendly staff, great location
text: I took my 80 year old grandma on trip to Warsaw and we stayed here for 3 nights at the beginning of November. I think we were in the old part of the hotel (not across the walkway) and I had no complaints about the room. The rooms are of a decent size, the beds were comfortable and the bathroom, with baths, was a little dated but absolutely fine. The breakfast is brilliant- cooked bacon, sausage, boiled eggs, meats, cheeses, cereal, croissants, including some polish food, and goes on until really quite late 10.30/11 (I'm a vegetarian and still felt there was plenty for me to choose from)- couldn't have asked for more. The location's also great, me and my grandma walked everywhere from the hotel- to all the major attractions, and also to the train station- the stations a bit of jaunt, maybe 20 minutes, but is do-able with cases on wheels. The staff were lovely and helped with any info I asked for. Similar to other reviews I can say that the free wifi worked in the reception area but didn't quite reach the room. I have no complaints whatsoever about this hotel, it is big, but personable, in a good location, and is priced accordingly- I would stay here again.

author: GXtripper
title: Get new beds!
text: I spent two nights here last week. I stayed in a room in the old original building rather than the new block that appears in the photographs. The room was tired and and very out of date. The radiator was boxed in and I was not able to turn the heat down. The two beds had old mattresses and I could feel every spring. I did not sleep much rhe first night because of the mattrress and the noise from the street outside. There is only one lift and at busy times it was easier to use the stairs. The staff in the breakfast room could learn to smile, especially the lady that wants to see your room key before you enter. The best thing about the hotel is the location.

author: MariaA447
title: Very good hotel for reasonable money
text: I've stayed 3 nights at this Hotel at october 2012. First of all the hotel is really big. Though it is very clean and nice. No glamour, just ordinary sleeping quality with clean bathroom. The personnel was welcoming. The location is great, Gromada Chlopa is located 3 min walk from all Warsaw nightlife (Mazovetska street), 5 minutes walk from the Central rain station and shopping and in walking distance to all places of interest as Old town and others. Only one minus: I couldn't connect to wifi from my iphone. In other western europe you would pay no less then 100 euro per night at such quality of hotel. So I can really reccomend it for stay in Warsaw.

author: johnwhoever
title: large, decent hotel, no frills
text: I was here for five days on business in July 2012. It's centrally situated, but the massive roadworks for the new tram system caused a few detours and general inconvenience. The staff were friendly and efficient and there was always someone around who spoke English. On my laptop, the free wifi didn't seem to work with Google Chrome, only Firefox, but otherwise fine - you have to ask for the new code each evening at reception. The room was smallish, but clean and with all mod cons except air conditioning (a bit of a problem in mid-July but at least I could open the window in two different ways!). Breakfast is in a large windowless room in the basement. An excellent comprehensive breakfast buffet, including hot food, but the post-communist Poles haven't really cracked how to make coffee (I preferred the old kava naturalna!). As with any mid-range eastern European hotel, it represents excellent value for money for Western travellers.

author: Sanna2888
title: Great location, comfortable rooms
text: The biggest reasons for choosing this hotel were the central location + very affordable price. Based on previous reviews we weren't expecting much but ended up pleasantly surprised. The room was clean and comfortable with modern bathroom with a bathtub. Breakfast was good, all the basic things were available (sausages/bacon, eggs boiled and scrambled, bread with toppings, salad...). Staff didn't seem overly friendly, but I didn't mind. The location is indeed great, there's only a short walk to Nowy Swiat and the Palace of Culture and Science. It's easy to get to the more remote places in the city as well, because there's a lot of bus stops on Nowy Swiat. It's true what the other reviewers say about the beds though. They're quite hard indeed! I didn't mind though, I slept very well every night.

author: Basiunka
title: Good all round tourist hotel v.centrally located
text: I'm a baffled by some of the reviews of the hotel as I had a good experience here. This is a centrally located tourist hotel that is good value for money. My room - including the ensuite bathroom - was clean and tidy and vacuumed on a daily basis. The decor is neutral and non-offensive, towels were spotless. Breakfast buffet choices were wide-ranging, covering hot/cold/vegetarian options extensively, so much so that guests were walking away with small mountains of food on their plates. Staff were polite, friendly and accommodating; the last minute changes to my booking were hassle free, and when I couldn't find an internet cafe I was able to use a staff computer to complete online check-in. The hotel is centrally located making all of central Warsaw within walking distance, which was good for late evenings out. If you're looking for a 5 star experience best to go to the Bristol, but if you want a good all round centrally located tourist hotel at a reasonable price, this ticks all the boxes.

author: Sarastus
title: Very good location, but ugly decoration
text: I made last minute reservation this this combination hotel+flight for price, free breakfast and very good location. Hotel looked like somen has been decorated it with bad taste. Thank god there was only shower, no tube bath, room was quite spacy, hot and quite quiet. MATTRESS WAS VERY HARD FOR MY BACK. Breakfast was very tasty, this is one of my criteria to choose hotel in Poland(breakfast is not including generally). Interesting old town was nearby, hotel is in centrum, lot of beautiful cafees ,restaurants. Staff was friendly (litlle bit lazy), but sometimes there was only one person to serving customers on reception, reception is the heart of hotel and customers make notes staff serve guests. Best regards that Polish gentleman who helped me at the Airport of Warsaw saturday evening. I do not choose this hotel anymore for hard matress.

author: rbbrno
title: 3 nights here
text: I have stayed 3 nights in this hotel. It has good position in city center. Receptionists are polite and english speaking. Room was quite ok, bathrooms clean. I didnt like the very slow and failing - the longest uninterrupted internet session took 10 minutes! So its useless. Breakfest buffet consist of dried off peppers, cucumbers, müsli , baked goods from previous days, cheap chemical juice,.... Next time i will stay rather in a hostel than this.

author: Esaak
title: It was ok
text: Interesting a bit soviet atmosphere. Very helpful and polite staff. The cleaning-lady came even at afternoon ask if we need new towels (in the morning we didn't). Bartender can even let you smoke in 'playroom' near bar! The room was ok, the strange odeur in rooms could easilly get rid of by ovening the window. They have room for smokers - great! The polish restaurant is also nice and the hotel is situated near everything. Security was good: cameras, 24/7 reception and guard also 24/7. We liked this hotel very much. But remember: if you smile, everybody smiles back!

author: VooVeek
title: Be prepared for young tourists
text: Visited this hotel twice. Rooms, while renovated after drop down of communism, still have some "atmosphere" of that time. Rooms are clean but rather small, equipped with furnitures that used to be modern some 30 years ago, carpets too.
