Beds are clean but not extremely comfortable - double beds are made of two single ones. Bathrooms, while kept clean, also are already a little bit devastated. In my opinion one of the reasons is big number of tourist groups, also composed of school children. It means that at 7 am you are waked up by shouts and children running up on corridors. The hotel has a lot of rooms so be prepared for waiting at reception desk - anyway, the desk crew was helpful.

author: Noriko78
title: Location and helpful staff make Gromada special
text: My husband and I stayed in Gromada for one night earlier this month. We arrived at the hotel from the train station very early morning and despite it was before check-in time, they let us go to the room. The room is big enough to have luggage for two people. There were two bottles of water - complimentary. The room is basic, yet clean and I have nothing to complain about. Receptionists are very very helpful. Breakfast buffet is a lot better than some other 3 stars hotels. It is very easy to get to transportation from the hotel. I feel we got more than what we paid for. I don't hesitate to recommend this hotel to anybody.

author: aaroundtheworld
title: A bit too old
text: A bit too old. Looks like from communists time. Not as modern as should be for its price. But good location and friendly staff. If you dont spend too many time at the hotel enough, but if you want to relax or couple of days choose another hotel. And remember that they have different types of rooms. Some are not renovated. Price makes no difference but comfort for sure

author: addiefifi
title: My Thoughts
text: This is the second year in a row re have stayed at this motel for Memorial Day Weekend, and we will continue to return to it. It is located on a side street right off of Rt. 9 where all the attractions are. Its less than 10 mins to the village of Lake George where all the action is. The Front Desk associates have always been very kind and professional. Our rooms have always been clean and well stocked of towels. The motel has been safe and quiet. There is also an outdoor swimming pool for fun, and vending machines for snacks. The price has always been fair and affordable, especially when traveling on a holiday weekend. Would recommend this motel, and look forward to visiting again soon.

author: Gonzo2182
title: Best Deal Before Tourist Season
text: I booked for a Saturday night, traveling alone and looking for something to do while my kid attended a writer's conference in Vermont. The off-season rate was $49.00 and the room was huge with two beds, a big bureau, a sitting area with a two chairs and a table, a decent couch, decent flatscreen, a very nice bathroom with tub and shower, and a balcony facing the pine forest in back. The front deck overlooked the pool and mountains. Coffee machine, hair blower, everything you need and very clean. Management was classy and gracious. I would go back in a heartbeat. Great area for families or just to chill and walk around, before a great night out at some of the local clubs. Beautiful and restful stay.

author: RaeAnnP383
title: just stayed for a week
text: We would definitely go back again. Nice quaint place. On the main strip but yet it is set back into the woods in back. Very Quiet, nice pool good size rooms. We stayed in the newest buildings which had 2 queen beds, microwave, fridge, coffee maker and blow dryer. Bathroom and room were pretty large and also had a couch, table and chairs, and a nice little balcony with another 2 chairs and small table facing the pool. Bring some charcoal and burgers since there are multiple grills and picnic tables. The office staff was friendly and accommodating.They even acted as a travel guide and no questions too big or small. Never had such good customer service.

author: lovestotravel769
title: Great family escape!!
text: This was a great find, little ways out from the city but close enough to get anywhere. I assume the man that served us upon arrival was the owner and he was very nice. Real helpful on things to do and see. We had a standard suite with kitchenette and this was a great choice for our family. The room was clean, beds comfortable, even the pull out couch was comfortable. The view (mountain view) from our room was beautiful, so peaceful and relaxing. We didn't get to the pool because we were out, but, it looked perfect. All this wrapped in a great price and I would definitely recommend this place to everyone. I will be back for sure since we plan to visit Lake George regularly and make this our regular spot.

author: yumm2011
title: A bit old but great value and location
text: Furniture can use an upgrade. Can't beat the location and price. Staff was very friendly. Pool was clean. Spacious and clean room. 5-minute drive to the village/mini gold (several of them)/restaurants, 15min drive to Walmart superstore. Unfortunately they are closed during off season so we'll need to look for another accommodation for Winter Carnival. But for next summer, we'll probably go back to Studio Motel.

author: katiepL9393ES
title: Studio motel of Lake George New York
text: I stayed here with my children for an entire week. The staff was incredibly accommodating and extremely nice. Everyday we came back to our room it was always tidied up and my kids stuffed animals were set up in different places in the room. We got a chuckle out of it everytime. The pool was amazing!!! I loved how it was tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the main strip but close enough to everything when you wanted to venture out. My room also had a little kitchen in it and it was perfect. The only downfall was that the beds were extremely uncomfortable but I spoke with the owner and he told me that all the beds would be changed out by the end of the season. If you are thinking about staying here don't think about it for another second and just book it!!! Great place!!!

author: canadagrl77
title: The 2-star rating is accurate; it has pros and cons
text: I enjoyed the motel for the fact that we were off the busy Canada Street area of Lake George. It's definitely accurately billed as a 2-star hotel, though. We were on the 2nd floor, and our a/c worked well, but the walls are paper-thin and I could hear everything said by the family next to us. There are also plastic chairs out in front of each room which is nice on the 1st floor but on the 2nd floor, it requires you to climb over other guests repeatedly - it's a nice idea but just not wide enough to be practical. The rooms were clean enough, but I was very disappointed in the description of having them offering utensils - they gave us about 6 sets of very cheap plastic forks and knives like you'd get in a restaurant, and flimsy cheap disposable plastic cups. The fridge did not work well - the ice cream I bought before checking out the freezer situation was ice cream soup by the end of day 1 - and the shower head was hanging out of the wall in the bathroom. Some pros were the very nice pool area (bring flip flops though because the stones are like little daggers in your feet!) and the BBQs and picnic tables outdoors. The Wifi is also very strong. Overall, if you're on a budget, it's not a bad place, but do have reasonable expectations when you arrive.

author: macman2
title: Great price, clean place
text: It is a 2 star motel, upgraded to three stars because of the price and wifi. The room is very basic, clean, with refrigerator. Double bed was springy. Has a built in air conditioner and heater. Bathroom is so small that you have difficulty going to the bathroom without keeping the door open. Lots of towels. Quiet setting. Didn't try the outdoor swim pool, but kids look like it was fun. A nice feature is a covered overhang in front of the room encouraging people sitting outside. Since you are supposed to be outside, the room meets the basics.

author: lucial63
title: Amazing stay!!!!
text: I enjoyed this motel so much. The man working there was very helpful and kind. Room was clean, nice and very useful. I would recommend this motel to my friends. Lake is very close and whole motel area has amazing atmosphere. Couldnt choose better. -p.s. thank you for caps! Lucia & Jana

author: PSGarage
title: Another great stay
text: Just got back from lake george for the aderandack nationals car show . Again we had a wonderful stay here. The owners go above and beyond to take care of our large group. Making special accommodations for our cars and car haulers. It's nice having the suites with the kitchens traveling with the family , it allows the ability to stay in and hang out at the facility there and eat in. There is plenty of room both inside and outside to eat and barbecue . The kids love the heated pool. The motels location is well within walking distance to the downtown area yet because it's off the main road you get the peace and tranquility of the the being in the woods. We have been staying here for a long time and will continue to return Thank you again to the owners for another great stay

author: nyupstate
title: Great Location
text: Booked 4 nights for the long labor day weekend. Our 2 Queen suite-without kitchen- was quite spacious and well furnished with plenty of drawer space for clothes, a fridge, microwave, flat screen TV, a round table with 2 comfortable chairs (separate from desk/work area), a small private balcony (overlooking the pool/parking area), and very large bathroom with tub/shower combo and granite counter top. Strong (free) wi-fi signal Location is ideal for peace and quiet - yet only 1/2 mi from the Million Dollar Beach and a mile from the village proper. Within a short walk (0.2 mi) from popular Garrison Pub and the East Cove Restaurant. Housekeeping was excellent and unobtrusive - thoroughly cleaning the room and leaving plenty of fresh towels and bath supplies each day. Great pool area, well maintained - extremely clean with plenty of comfortable chaises/chairs and even a couple porch swings. Like stated elsewhere in these reviews, the beds were extremely soft - however quite comfortable once settled in. Climate control also excellent - A/C had no problem keeping the room cool in the midst of 95 degree heat-wave. Curiously, there is a closet area with poll/rod for hanging garments, but we had to ask for hangers which were readily supplied. Overall a great value for a relatively new property, especially when compared to some of the more costly, run-down, and loud motels which line the street in the village center.

author: lovingtheemptynest
title: peaceful, playful, & affordable!
text: What a lovely & accommodating place! The price was so affordable that next year we plan to go back for a week. We were in one half side of a cottage, though most of the rooms were in motel units. The room was immaculate, with laminate flooring and a new bathroom with shower unit. The room had a refrigerator and coffee maker, as well as a tv. The swimming pool was refreshing and clean , in a relaxing and peaceful part of the property. There were outdoor grills and picnic tables and a small playground. Staff was wonderful. We were very pleased. Although we travel as a couple, this isa great place for families, too.

author: DonnaCH
title: Economical, aging motel 1 mile from Lake George Village
text: Located in a very quiet area not far from the Lake George public beach. Very uncomfortable beds, carpeting that seemed damp, and a very small shower stall. The inside of the bathroom door was badly damaged by water from the shower. There is free Wi-Fi, a flat screen TV, and a small coffee maker in each room. If you are looking for a less expensive motel and would not mind staying in a place which is definitely dated, this may be the place for you. We paid just under $100.00 for one night including taxes. George's restaurant, very close by, is worth considering if you prefer not to battle the downtown crowds. Prices were slightly high but the food was good.

author: tsegnit
title: Amazing owner
text: On a recent trip to Lake George, we stayed at the Studio Motel for the second time. Beautifully landscaped, really nice pool, BBQ areas, playgrounds for the kiddies, polite and courteous staff. I was not feeling well, and my teenage son was getting hungry (surprise) but I did not feel like driving. Harim overheard us talking and volunteered to drive him into town and back. I did not know at the time that he was the owner. How good is that? Town is only about a mile and a half away, and the trolley stops at the property, so it is not a hassle to get into town, but the location has spacious parking and you can enjoy the scenery and quiet of the area if you stay here, not like other properties on the main drag. Two thumbs up for Harim and the Studio Motel!

author: Traveler03NewYork
title: Tried it again.
text: My second time hear. This time I had a room with a kitchenette, which was the best thing about the room. First the floors and walls must be made of cardboard, you can hear all the noise and running if you are on a lower floor. The pillows are like pancakes, you might as not have any. The bathroom like in my first review had no place to keep any toiletries, also there were no hooks to hang your clothes. There is only one towel rack and it's holding your wash cloth and face towel, so we're do you put your bath towel. This might sound trivial, but it is an easy fix and not very costly. Again the only plus was the kitchen and fridge was really cold. Wi-Fi is decent. Signal goes in and out.

author: norm371
title: A Great Place to Stay!!!*
text: We got a GREAT deal through tripadvisor.com; and we could not believe how beautiful this place is, and this is no exaggeration! For the extremely low rates we received for an entire week, we got more than our money's worth! Very, very, very CLEAN, and the cottages and motel rooms and clean daily. The pool is fantastic, and clean!!! We were right by Million Dollar Beach and all of the stores and festivities in Lake George, as well as, being minutes away from Queensbury and Glen Falls. The food is EXCELLENT in these areas, and there is much to do. July 4th was awesome seeing the fireworks on Million Dollar Lake. I was glad I did a search because we would have paid $149 per night; however, our rate was SUPER LOW, and we really got our money's worth! All of the staff was very professional and nice. I can only rate "Studio Motel o Lake George" five stars, but they deserve 20 Stars!!!

author: amys701
title: Bargain basement but still a comfortable stay
text: This place was ridiculously cheap through Priceline (think- under $40) so there isn't much one could complain about. The room we stayed in was small, with a set up more like a cabin. Bed was small but comfortable, room was kept cool with air conditioning. There was a TV and table as well. Shower was lukewarm at best, and teeny. No breakfast, but you can't expect too much!! The front desk staff were really lovely too, and seemed to hold great pride in their lodgings. Overall, if you want a bargain stay that gives you a little above what you would expect for the price, this will suit you!

author: W9805OSjamesw
title: Basic, clean
text: Located next to a swamp and across the road from the American Legion if you need a drink, room furniture by Sears. Room clean, sleeping area cramped with clothing rack overhanging one bed, oversized dresser. Kitchenette with refrigerator, microwave, two burner cooktop , coffee service. Second floor with tight balcony and no elevator. Friendly front desk, they close the office at 11pm. Pool is clean and heated. Fairly convenient to beach, parking good. Minor maintenance issues: bathroom sink barely attached to wall, hole in outside of fiberglass bathtub.

author: TamilPayani
title: Surprisingly very good
text: We stayed here just for a night and we wished we could have extended the stay. The full price was not much($60) and we expected it to be just like a 2 star hotel. But it was like a very clean studio apartment. Beds, room, restroom were like very new. There was a coffee maker, half size refrigerator available. We also got a duplex house apart from the other buildings. Locationwise, it's away from the congested city, but at very walkable distance from the Lake George Beach. Wifi was at decent speed. No complaints except that the heater was only in the main room and the rest room was very cold.

author: lindylouwho76
title: first lake cruise
text: first time here. friend recommended. the motel was very clean and up to date. the owner was more than pleasant and extremely helpful. very nice peaceful grounds. Pool looked like it would be nice,but we were to early for that. Prices were great per night. definitely would stay again and recommend to others!!!! thank you for a wonderful stay.

author: Haete38
title: Excellent Motel and Excellent Surroundings
text: We've been going to Studio Motel for 5 years now. We like staying at Studio because it's a nice, quite, clean, comfortable and affordable motel and if you like to walk everywhere , like we do, this place is walking distance to everything. The rooms and the pool are very clean. The service at the front desk is great and the staff is very friendly and helpful. Finally, if you love being surrounded by nature, you will fall in love with this place. it's surrounded by trees and the view is phenomenal. We're going back again for Halloween and we're bringing friends with us. We would recommend this place to anyone that wants to travel to Lake George.

author: ChanP652
title: Nice clean motel
text: Second time we stay here. Stayed September 12-14, 2014. Pool was closed. It was a cold rainy weekend. We stayed in a 2 queen bed suite. Beds were not comfortable plus we had a herd of elephants staying above us, who paced and banged on the floors until 11:00 pm. When we stayed here 2 years before, it was summer, pool was awesome, plus we stayed on second floor, which was much better. Not too far from Great Escape. Good bang for your buck!

author: Moe_Ipak
title: Great Stay
text: I can't find anything to complain about. The motel is not on Canada street, and if you really want to walk to the Lake you can, but it will be a little hike. The rooms were great, next time I would book the renovated rooms with the small kitchen. There is plenty of parking. There are grills all over the place, had I known this, I would have taken the appropriate steps to grill every night. There is a small swing set/play ground in the back for the kids. There is a small but convenient pool on site. There is a Rite Aid and Stewart's and a Gas Station very close. The owners were great, and the service was amazing.

author: JohnDolheimer
title: Quiet, Wonderful Motel Property, Close to Million Dollar Beach
text: This was our second stay at Lake George, having stayed at another property the last time. We were in the middle building, built in 2008. We had a spacious room with 2 beds, fridge and microwave. Two nice chairs outside of our front door, as well as out back on the balcony. Very nice pool, and there are also nice picnic tables, charcoal grills, a play set and a volleyball net for those who would use them. We used the inexpensive on site washer and dryer which worked well. Staff were efficient and cooperative. We will definitely stay here again!

author: garyralph
title: hairs in the bed OMG!
text: this motel looked such a lovely place. From the outside it was pristine, freshly painted, with a lovely pool. Imagine our horror when at bedtime we pulled back the sheets in our room to find hairs on the sheets of both beds. Horrific!! A night sleeping on our bath towels was not good. We had just decided to try book another night there before this, as it looked so nice from the outside. Needless to say, at 7am the next morning we were out of there. The biggest let down on the whole of our USA road trip.

author: 463Barbara
title: Absolutely great find in Lake George!
text: Just returned from July 4th weekend at Lake George. Found Studio Motel thru other reviews on TripAdvisor but was a bit skeptical because of the very reasonable price. We could not have been more pleasantly surprised. Our room was beautiful, very large, very comfortable and very clean with private terrace. Quiet location on a side road but close enough to walk or short drive to center of town. The owners were very accommodating and so pleasant. Would definitely stay here again and recommend very highly, especially for families. You definitely get your money's worth at Studio Motel. The motel itself was very nice looking, especially compared to some on Canada Street that looked very shabby and seedy. Really a gem!

author: 138ronaldb
title: Clean & Comfortable
text: This is where I stayed during Americade. Its close enough to all the attractions, far enough away for a quiet place to rest. The room was clean and the outside was picture perfect. I didn't have time to swim but pool looked great well maintained also. The rooms all had decks and chairs to sit on a really nice set up. I would recommend this to others. I will be back next year for Americade. The motel staff very friendly

author: Trystelle
title: Great Value
text: This motel is kind of kitschy. It is reminiscent of the 1960's. It is clean and spacious. Each room has a balcony. It is a lovely wooded area but is just a few minutes from the town center. When we first arrived one of the bed sheets had a stain on it. The owner himself came to change it and was very apologetic. The bed seemed brand new and was very comfortable. This is not luxurious accommodations by any means, but has the charm that you don't find in chain motels.

author: umarw2014
title: What a experience!
text: Studio Motel’s location was very convenient. The motel looked much nicer in actual than on the website photos. The front-desk person was very friendly, helpful and welcomed us with a big smile. The rooms were spacious, clean, nicely decorated and housekeeping did a fabulous job. Swimming pool was wonderful and super-clean. It was an excellent experience staying at Studio Motel for two nights. Best service you can have for the price you pay. I would definitely go back to Studio Motel in future.

author: amyw867
title: Loved Every Minute
text: I was really happy I chose Studio Motel for my stay at Lake George last year. It was just what I needed to relax. Everyone was really friendly from the moment I checked in. I loved the beautiful view of the woods from my room balcony. The atmosphere was peaceful yet lively as there was always someone having fun in the playground out in the back or grilling. The price was very reasonable and my room was very comfortable and clean. Would recommend to everyone! Beautifully landscaped and a great price for all the services that are available; wi-fi, heated pool, grills... Excellent place to stay for singles and families.

author: paulieinBrooklyn
title: A reasonable stay
text: As a regular visitor to Lake George(en route to Montreal) I usually avoid a summer trip. When I do pass through at the height of the season I like to stay in a reasonable place , off the beaten track. The Studio Motel of Lake George is very good. It is reasonable (book directly) and convenient to Georges restaurant and the East Cove Inn. two of my favorites. I stayed in the older section.The walls are thin and the facilities very basic. But for a night it was just fine. The newer section seems better and I would recommend it for longer stays.

author: timnjessd
title: Perfect vacation spot!!
text: Love this clean and quiet motel. Just of the strip (Canada St.), this is a perfect location at Lake George. Short walk to the beach and all the downtown fun. We rented the kitchen suite so we could save a little cash by eating breakfast and snacks at the motel. The price is extremely reasonable and the rooms are extremely clean. The pool is crystal clear and the perfect temperature for all ages. Just a quarter mile up the road is a beautiful paved biking and walking path that brings you to the beach. The staff is friendly and accomodating. I wouldn't hesitate recommending this motel to anyone looking for a wonderful time in Lake George.

author: Darko08
title: The Best Place to stay in Lake George,NY
text: I visit Lake George every summer, I have stayed in few good hotels , every summer in different one. But, that thing is about to change, because i finaly found the Best Place to stay in Lake George. First of all, this place is so peacefull , has very clean and big rooms , big yard with playground area for the kids, and wonderfull pool . The pool hours are form 10 am to 10 pm, and the water is constantly warm , beacause, the water-heater is working all the time. There is free wi-fi , and free parking in front of your room. There are also many barbacue areas. The staff members are very polite, especially the owner , he is very helpfull and friendly. The prices are very affordable, so go ahead and book your room , before it is too late.

author: PSGarage
title: awsome as normal
text: We stayed again for the Sept. car show, and as usual it was great. The people there are always nice and go above and beyond to accomodate us. We had 6 rooms this year and everyone had a good time. They have beautiful grounds, and there is plenty of room and they always make sure to make room for our car haulers and trailers, something that alot of other places can not do. The motel is just of the main drag, which is nice during the car show, because the noise on the main drag could get unbearable. but they are still walking distance from the downtown area. We will definately be back next year!

author: MariosDaddy
title: 2nd time here and looking forward to next stay
text: Dad and I have travelled to Warrensburg for the annual "World's Biggest Garage Sale" since 1995. Last year I forgot to book a motel for the weekend but was fortunate enough to find a room at the Studio. If I thought last year was good, this year was great. I rented an efficiency for us and we were very pleased with the room and the property in general. The owners are extremely friendly (even upgraded us to a larger unit at no charge) and always willing to please. VERY comfortable beds and dad got so comfortable on the couch that he spent the night there. Due to very inclement weather (rain for 2 days straight), dad decided that he wanted to leave early Saturday morning after spending only one night. We are already looking forward to next year and another stay at the Studio. Oh, almost forgot, the owners were so accomodating that they allowed us to check in and get to our room 2 1/2 hours early. How's that for customer service!

author: angie1130
title: clean but bed too soft
text: We were greeted by gracious man at front desk. Checked us in and walked us to our room. We were in 32 which was spacious, had a regrigerator,coffeepot, microwave. Shared balcony at the rear looks onto a peaceful yard w/playground for children. He let us know that there would be no maidservice, which wasn't a big deal for us. Room and bath spotless. Only complaint was the beds were way too soft. Sit on the edge and slide right off to the floor.

author: ChiChe0827
title: Excellent Motel
text: We've stayed at this motel several times while visiting Lake George. The property is very clean, grounds manicured and the pool is immaculate! BBQ's available. We have stayed in both the older and the newer rooms, both are very clean. The newer rooms have more upgrades. Since the Studio is off the major road, it is quieter. George's Restaurant and The East Cove restaurant are very close by. Highly recommend this motel.

author: VivianC264
title: Comfortable, Clean, & Affordable
text: My husband, four kids and I have stayed at the Studio Motel 3 times and each time we've experienced a very pleasant stay. They have a varierty of rooms available and each are very clean comfortable, spacious & most of all affordable. The property is well manicured and the heated salt water pool is beautiful. Sparkiling!! The property also has a number of picnic areas to enjoy a nice BBQ, a small playground, and a place to play volleyball. All though the property is not located on the Lake, we found it very easy & convenient to walk to the lake and into town. Each year we have noticed wonderful improvements to the property and can't wait to see what new things we will find next year. Naeem & Tanya (the owners) take great pride in their property and offering guests a stress free stay.

author: CDE9522
title: Friendly, clean and good value
text: Making arrangements to travel here with friends, I got an error when I tried to book online. I called later only to discover that the less expensive rooms were full and so opted for the higher rate because we were traveling together. When we got to the hotel the owner recognized our names and had upgraded our friends, gave us a discount and put us in adjoining rooms - how's that for customer service? Rooms were a good size, clean and though the beds were a little soft for my taste it did not prevent me from sleeping. Fridge, microwave, shower with good water pressure. Lovely, sparkling clean pool. Grounds well kept. All in all a nice haven from the madness of Main Street, Lake George and definitely would stay there again.

author: adkcupcake
title: An enjoyable stay...
text: Stayed two nights on a budget...they allowed 7 of us (4 children) for an extra fee, which was reasonable. Everything was nice and clean and the room was large enough for all of us to stay, even with an air mattress. The pool was clean and very enjoyable. My only complaints would be knowing that there was 7 of us, perhaps putting us on a ground floor would make more sense? It was a challenge getting all of our stuff and four kids up and down stairs. There was also no extra linens or pillows for the sofa as well as only 4 sets of towels for again, 7 of us. What exactly did I pay extra for? However I'm sure they would have accommodated if I had said something. Everyone was friendly and it was very clean and we would certainly stay again.

author: DouglasF556
title: Our Choice for Americade
text: We stayed here for Americade this last week. The motel was a very short drive down the road from the main street of the Villiage of Lake George. It was quiet, clean, newly renovated and the parking lot was freshly paved and painted. There was adequate parking for car, trailer and bikes. There was always a fresh supply of towels, soap and shampoo and our room was always clean. The hosts were always available to help with whatever our requests were. The site is quiet and the view of the mountains is wonderful. This place easily tops the other hotels in the area

author: Pookamunga
title: A Hard Nights Sleep
text: We stayed at this motel for 5 nights and although the room was clean and there was a fridge, microwave and recliner the bed was hard as rocks. It was a soft mattress on boards(not a boxspring) My husband and I were quite tempted to put the mattress on the floor for a better nights sleep. We had a large TV but the amount of channels you were able to get was terrible. The shower is small but the bathroom was clean. We had fresh towels daily. The lady who greeted us was very polite. We had originally wanted a room with the kitchenette but due to the events of the weekend all rooms were booked. I think the room we received is intented for handi-capped people because of the bars in the bathroom, shower and near the bed. There is an out door pool but we didn't actually get a chance to use it. If you like to stay in a clean place then this is the place to stay for sure.

author: kathy5836
title: " I would go again!!!!"
text: First and formost I was greated warmly and customer service is a plus! I stayed in room 13 on the back side. The room was very large, and clean. We had a balcony outside our door and there was a beautiful yard! How great was that for my 2 year old grand son! The pool was very clean. They had grills and picnic tables and what appeared to be a fire pit in back yard. I really felt that this was a family friendly place to stay. On the negative side the tv in the room was only a 20 inch, the heated pool was not warm, and they only had coffee in the morning with powdered cream, and coffee that was not kept filled. I think the price is actually the only reason I may look for another place...$120 a night was a little steep I thought.

author: Jennymomof2
title: Okay, but avoid the "old building" for longer stays
text: We were only staying in Lake George for 1 night, so we opted for the less expensive older building. The room was small, as expected, and the bathroom was tiny - barely enough room to shower our 3 and 5 year old children before bed. The other concern was the door to the room. It was an interior door (not an exterior), and it only had a thumb lock - no deadbolt or chain. It also had a gap of ~3/4" between the bottom of the door and the frame, so we could see sunlight shining in under it- and wondererd what bugs could also crawl right in. Luckily, the room was otherwise very clean and didn't smell too musty, so we just placed a rolled towel under the door and dealt with it for the night. The pool was clean and well-maintained, and the staff was very friendly. The newer rooms looked from the outside like they were iin better repair, so it is probably worth the extra money to stay in one of those

author: tracey759
title: Great place to stay.....we'll be back!!!
text: My Fire Dept. stayed here for the Hudson Valley Firemans Assoc. Convention for four nights. The rooms are clean. The Units we all stayed in were just built in 2009. The owners are very accommodating. I can’t say we've had one issue. I would definitely recommend this motel to anyone looking to enjoy what the Lake George area has to offer at a decent price. This motel is even close enough to downtown to walk to the lake or to do some shopping.

author: Justin-T64
title: No frills, but a good spot to be near Lake George without the crowds
text: We stayed 3 nights in the newer building (looks to be only a few years old). Room was clean, although rather bare, with one huge wall having a TV and no other decoration. Bathroom also very clean, but free of anything to make it more homely. Mattresses on both queens seemed cheap, but we all slept well. Microwave and fridge fine, but no coffee pot or mug to boil water in the microwave. WiFi not accessible at all within the room, but was fine just outside our door. Swimming pool looked very nice but we didn't have time to use it. On a quiet stretch of road largely surrounded by woods, even though its very close to the heart of Lake George, so you can get a peaceful break from the busy town center.

author: ajsgarage
title: Home away from home
text: We have stayed at this motel going on 5 years now. Accomadations are nice as well as the staff. You can walk to the attractions and there are 2 resturants near by. We have recommended this place to our friends and family. The rates are reasonable and rooms are nice. The pool is beautiful along with the grounds. The staff here make our vacation feel like we are at home. We always look forward to coming back.

author: FRlmtl
title: Bugs everywhere
text: Great location, nice wooded area near Lake George Village. Unfortunately, the room wasn't up to expectations. Bug where crawling out off the sink and bathtub drain during the night. The last night was horrible, bugs where crawling on the beds. Not sure if those where bed bugs... New fluo compact lights installed, but the room was very dark, couldn't see anything inside. Had to open the shades to have more daylight. Some of the towels and pillow heads where stained, there was dust collected behind the bed and sofas. Great location in the woods, but looks like the bugs and critters, decided to live inside the room instead than outside in the woods, I should have gone camping instead!

author: maddyman
title: This place was a disappointment.
text: Other than a rod with limited hangers too hang clothes on, there was no place to put anything; no draws, no bathroom counter space, not even a hook on the inside of the bathroom door! Worst of all, we had many tiny ants in our rooms. We stayed because there were no other rooms available anywhere, and we felt we'd tolerate it for two nights. When we told them about the ants, they acknowledged that they knew about it. That was it. Not even an apology. The A/C worked marginally on the max, and all kitchen dishes, cups, pots and pans are stored in an unorganized pile in a dish drainer under the sink!! Whoa, that was really sanitary. Bed and pillows were of the lowest quality and we all had difficulty sleeping. Would not go back.

author: RicardoRabinovich
title: GOOD APARTMENTS, BUT MIND THE LOCATION
text: If you are not wishing to enjoy peaceful walks through the wonderful seaside of Salvador (be very careful, please), nor it's nice beaches (mind your personal belongings), nor the natural pools for snorkeling (attention with fishermen in the middle of diving areas), nor the old quarter (not for night time), nor the port (caution!), then this apart-hotel complex maybe the ideal for you. Flats are ok, clean and comfortable. WiFi is perfect. Attention is without complaint. Everything is tidy. Wake-up calls are respected. Breakfast may not be legendary, but is well enough (finding table may be somewhat complicated in rush hours, but nothing epic anyway). Elevators come in reasonable time. The kitchenette is poorly provided, as if they supposed no one is actually going to use it, which is, by the way, absolutely true: no one does).

author: ERICJ450
title: Nice hotel in the middle of Salvador
text: The hotel itself was very clean and nice. It had a bedroom that was separate from a small living room with a work desk and mini bar. The location was pretty far from all of the tourist things but there was always taxis available for quick service. We would be just about anywhere in the city for less than R$40. The pool was fun and overlooked the street in front of the hotel. They severed a pretty good breakfast buffet that is included in the price of the room. The dinner buffet was expensive but had a nice variety of good dishes. The only real complaint I had about the hotel was how expensive the food was for the other meals/room service. This was not uncommon throughout Salvador but the extra R$100 just for room service on top of the food already being too expensive left us leaving somewhat dissatisfied. Overall it was a pleasant experience, I just didn't like them trying to squeeze me for every last penny they could charge me for.

author: Bosfurus
title: Good Hotel, good food, convenient for world cup ! (Just checkout was weird )
text: We stayed here to watch the Brazil-Italy game... didn't pay a fortune, it was cheap compared to many other options (made reservation 3 months before).. and to our surprise the Italian team was hosted there, very nice !!!! Hotel is not close to beach, but very very close by taxi, also distant to stadium but Fifa had free bus that stops 4 blocks from hotel, very very convenient !!! Food at restaurant was very good, enjoyed moqueca and tapioca, and nice good restaurants are 5 min drive. It had lots of security. Rooms were big and clean. Only negative was checkout, i didn't have my room key, the receptionist gave a bad look and sent a security person to the room to look for the key, what a joke !!!!! Still recommend it !

author: bubbaliz65
title: Super 8 Oceanside
text: Very clean room, extremely comfortable beds and pillows. Larger room than expected, very nice. I would definitely stay again. The location was close to restaurants, gas stations and Oceanside Pier and beach. The hot tub was a bit hot, but was okay for a 15 min. dip. Pool was clean. Good service, but beware of the incentive charge, this was not explained in detail.

author: ChristinaM358
title: Horrible place to stay!
text: We had a room in the Conference building. When we were walking in, a homeless man was walking out. As you're walking the hallway it smells of urine so bad that it made me nauseous. We get in the room and it's so outdated and the carpets are nasty! The fixtures were so old that my 8 year old couldn't even turn on the sink without my assistance. I'm not usually too terribly picky about where I stay, but this one was on another level. Then I had an issue with my reservation (they checked my in to another person's room with a queen bed instead of a king) and the front desk staff were awful. The manager Ross, and the 2 ladies that were there. Just plain rude and not willing to help with correcting this issue. Would not recommend to stay here at all!

author: ryan563
title: STAY FAR AWAY!
text: I contacted Customer service regarding our reservation and unacceptable accommodations. Was told there's nothing we can do. My family is out 150 dollars and we didn't even stay at the hotel. Asked for an ADA room, none available. Carried my disabled son upstairs as no first floor rooms available. My son crawled around the room for 5 mins and his hands and knees were black! Wife used the restroom and toilet didn't flush. Holes in walls that needed to be repaired, missing molding. Broken furniture WOULD NEVER STAY HERE OR USE PRICELINE AGAIN!!!!

author: /undefined
title: Dissapointing
text: The first room they put us in the plaster was falling off the walls, the curtains had half the hem out & the room smelled. When we complained they changed us to another room. The next morning we attempted to take a shower & there was no water in the tub. The stool was also leaking. When we reported this they offered to change our room again which we refused. They fixed the shower but the stool was still leaking. The breakfast room was dirty & trash was over flowing both trash cans & the tables. I do have pictures on my phone of this.

author: rashel2018
title: worst hotel experience
text: the key we get doesnt open door so we go back the get it "fixed we go back to room that is already occupied to my embarrassment! Front desk apologizes then we get another room. That is how people get their stuff stolen!!! Our room was gross and I didnt even take my socks off afraid of the carpet plus I didnt shower because it looked really grimy. There were homes digging in trash and cops rolling through parking lot while we were unloading. This ruined my whole trip that was supposed to be our first night away from our baby!! Worrying if someone was coming into our room we locked every lock and put stuff against the adjoining doors! The pictures online are not what it looks like at all!! Im not done with this and will fight for my refund!

author: /undefined
title: The woman at the front desk was great! The rooms not so...
text: The woman at the front desk was great! The rooms not so. When we 1st arrived there were many homeless people in front and a couple in the eating are of the lobby. When you walked into the 300 bldg., the ceiling was dirty and full of cobb webs. Had 2 rooms: Room 1 was missing the covers for the electrical outlets, carpet was missing by the door which causes a trip hazard. Room 2: The carpet had a large square piece that looked like it was either burned or tried to be replaced by melting it together. Was afraid to take off my shoes and walk barefooted. This hotel is in DESPERATE need of a facelift and some TLC.

author: 167nathanr
title: Horrifically awful
text: I usually prefer divey motels to luxury properties, but I would avoid this place like the plague in the future. In fact, I feel fortunate to have not contracted the plague, after seeing the dismal and unhygienic conditions, from holes in the walls and a stopped-up sink to residue and stains on the bed sheets. We reported the brown residue on the sheets to the front desk immediately upon discovering it at 1 a.m. and were told that the agent would "be right there in one minute" to replace the sheets. After waiting half an hour, we had to go to the front desk and obtain clean sheets and re-make the bed ourselves before we could go to sleep. We could clearly hear one neighbor's phone call in between her phlegm-hacking sessions, and other neighbors' late night smoke session through the walls. A dip in the hot tub would have helped us feel we'd gotten more value, but it closes at 9 so that wasn't happening unless we skipped our dinner plans. The front desk agents were completely preoccupied with other matters, including other upset guests and their own payroll calculations, every time I interacted with them. They offered zero apology at checkout upon learning of all of our problems and informed us that we'd have to contact the third-party booking website to obtain a partial refund, although we'd already been promised one by another employee. Overall, just a truly awful experience.

author: 973merryk
title: hotel in need of upgrades
text: we were here with a group. we had the best room by far. the second night we received a new nice comforter on our bed. asked for extra pillow, quickly delivered. breakfast was crowded as hotel was full, but fine. carpets dirty and no air in halls. we did not spend much time in hotel. others had rooms needing paint, ours was fine.

author: sergiyo94
title: Horrible stay!
text: Oceanside has been my vacation destination for years, my family & I have been coming here for 7 years now, spending a week here we wanted something reasonably priced ( family of 4 kids and 4 adults) so we needed 2 rooms. The reservation process itself wasn't a probelm, when we got there, we checked in and payed for the first room, when we tried to pay for the second room the front desk manger said "sorry your card was blocked because we had to use it more than once" over all checking in took about 40 minutes... when we got our rooms it was impossible to open the door, they said you needed to do a special movement of "moving the handle up, then inserting the card, then putting the handle down then removing the card then pulling it up again" this was a struggle and half the time the magnetic strip didn't work.....our view was an RV dump yard which is fine....the bathroom counter was cracked in one of the rooms, the wallpaper was peeling, the computer chair had a gigantic hole in the middle, the little dining table leg was broken so it was prepped against the wall, I took pictures of all of this and showed it to management and he said "I'll be sure to get it fixed tomorrow " I stayed there for 6 days and nobody ever mentioned anything.....now in the second room, the tv wasn't controllable, the remote didn't work at all, the towels that we got were ripped (literally torn in half) maybe they were the cleaning towels, the microwave was broken....so overall it was horrible, the pillows there are rock hard if you want a decent sleep please bring your own pillow! Never ever staying here again, it's so worth to pay extra and have a better hotel and service, you get free breakfast which is nice just don't expect anything fancy, they offer: waffles with syrup, apple and orange juice, 2 kinds of cerial or a raisin roll. There's only about 6 tables(2 person) in there so you really can't eat there when it gets busy and they don't allow you to take your breakfast to your room...the floor maybe? When we came the pool was extremely dirty and green with bugs everywhere, the spa was being shock treated as well. The stairs to the second floor are very very very dusty and gross. I ordered this hotel 3 months in advance, and asked for 2 rooms next to each other, but got 2 rooms on 2 different ends. Over all, definitely needs a lot of work.

author: /undefined
title: Make sure front desk employees have better attitude or service to customerd
text: I forget my makeup case at the room. I called two hours after check out and manager very nicely confirmed makeup was founded. Manager told me I can return at night (because I was Legoland) to pick up my makeup. So when I arrived, ufortunately manager was not there and a rude employee was there. She told me she was busy to look up where was my make up. I wait for almost two hours. I understand sometimes a day could be stressful for an employee but I was really nice with her. I don't way to say names but at least I would like to leave a feedback for a better service because every customer deserve. Finally I could not get my make up that day I called next day and I spoke with manager. She apologized, it was a mistake and after 3 days I could get my makeup case.

author: ronchelleb
title: Clean, comfortable, budget hotel, delicious breakfast, satisfactory.
text: Firstly, you get what you pay for. I've stayed in many budget hotels and this was reasonable. We wanted a comfortable bed and clean bathroom to relax in after our long days at Legoland, and that is what we got. The breakfast was a welcomed bonus, with a wide selection of toast/bagels, waffles, cereals, fruit, juice and coffee/tea. All amenities worked in the room, and we felt safe (2 tiny women). The manager Sam, was super friendly, and helpful when we couldn't get the shower to turn on (just a different knob than what we were used to). Uber to Legoland is under $10, so convenient. Nearby small store for basics, but delicious Mexican restaurant next door.

author: texasgirl626
title: Sherry
text: Worst dump ever!!!!!! I'm not sure what the smell was!!! I wasted a whole bottle of body spray trying to get rid of it. Air conditioner didn't work, carpet was nasty, and giant marks and wholes throughout the room! Wyndham should be ashamed!!!! Way too expensive! Sleep in your car before you waste your money! Only thing missing were the bugs, which I'm sure they are there some where!!!!!

author: 4krisr
title: YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED! The most repugnant motel in the solar system!
text: This place resembles a crack house or a junkie haven. I checked in late -- at 11 pm and Tyler, the inhospitable, unsmiling front desk person greeted me with a surly and nasty disposition. He insisted I booked a smoking room -- which I DID NOT-- and refused to upgrade me. Then he complained about his hours -- 2 til 11 pm, mentioning that he woke at 3 am to "commune withthe spirits instead of stupid people." STAY AWAY -- unless you enjoy sharing your bed with bedbugs, ants and a various array of disgusting entities. The lamps were broken, with only one bulb that functioned. The walls were full of holes. The toilet did not flush and the water in the dirty shower didn't work properly, running endless amounts of wasted H20. Sam Patel, the "manager" of this vile dump, was unavailable -- he should be fired for his general uselessness. STAY IN A DUMPSTER before you stay here. You have been warned!

author: pattym518
title: Worst motel I have ever stayed in
text: This motel was dirty. The toilet paper holder was broken so they had the t paper on back of toilet. Patched walls that were not painted. People hanging around like they lived there all the time. Cement stairs going up were all broken. Tv did not work. Surprised Wyndham had their name on this. Would not think of eating breakfast there.

author: witikap
title: Kicked out
text: My daughter was told that her room was only reserved for 1 night and that the hotel was booked up and she had to leave. She is 17, and unable to get a room for herself. Is out there seeing her boyfriend who had to go on "special ops" at last moment. He reserved and paid for the room for 2 nights. At first they even refused to let her get her luggage from the room. At this moment she is sleeping in a car by herself. The funny thing is that there were rooms available via Expedia when I looked. Liars put my minor daughter on the street.

author: /undefined
title: Don't stay here!
text: I had a terrible experience here. The room smelled horrible. The towels were dirty. I asked for clean towels in the morning and they were even more dirty looking. The bedspread had holes and the carpet felt gross. I had no TV for my two night stay because there having problems with there cable. I was very upset and they didn't seem to care or compensate me. They didn't even move me to another room to see if the cable worked.

author: pholland7
title: RUN!!! DO NOT STAY HERE. STAY IN YOUR CAR INSTEAD!
text: Remember in "The pursuit of Happyness" when Will Smith and his son slept in the bathroom of the bus station? That would be a better option than this motel. If you go to their website it looks pretty nice. IT IS NOT! There were holes in the wall that mostly had been patched but not repainted, hair everywhere on the floor, shower was so disgusting we just left and didn't use it. About 10:30 at night, a drunk guy started banging on our door looking for "john" a big brawl started when he found John in another room, this went on for a while, homeless people with their carts were parked right outside. Everything is filthy, dirty disgusting. The room rate was $150!!!!

author: /undefined
title: terrible experience
text: Traveled there with family had 2 rooms. The person at desk was rude at check in. The heated pool was not heated at all the hot tub needed painted and had way to much chlorine in it. The pool is one reason picked this motel. Lady the week before told me yes heated and nice. Was told twice could have adjoining rooms. Get there was told not available but yet several empty rooms that night. One of our rooms the door wouldn't shut you had pull hard to get it to close. The gap under door was big and floors in hall ways was discusting. Beds was ok

author: /undefined
title: not good
text: The last night we stayed there, I was woke up by a rat eating through a Styrofoam good container. I have pictures! I was up the rest of the night. I told the representative when I checked out. Her response was, the rain must have brought them in.(as if that makes it OK? ) She offered me a free night. (I'll pass) then when I got home and unpacked, I discovered they had been all through our luggage, they left their evidence. I am totally disgusted.

author: Nicole_ZackC
title: Our stay was wonderful
text: My husband and I and his younger brother had an absolutely awful experience at a motel 6 in Oceanside and refused to stay another night so we found this little place. At first I walked in,and I made comments about it being a tad dirty and the man at the front desk had over heard me,at first him and the other guy seemed unapproachable but they ended up having me and my husband DYING of laughter and explained they were short staffed and they understood it was a tad messy and apologized. They were super helpful because wed never been to oceanside before so they gave us some pointers on some good beaches and cool places to look around at. The girl clerk later in the day was also extremely sweet. So far all of you reviewing about their "common courtesy" or "horrible customer service" maybe YOU'RE THE PROBLEM. You won't always receive kindness when you're a complete jerk to people. The customer is not always right! As for the room, I will say it wasn't the best,but it was clean,we had a place to shower,and cold ac blowing on us! Atleast we weren't sleeping in our car. I'm thankful.

author: 899jcs
title: They scam you if you leave your credit card info as a deposit.
text: The staff was extremely rude and they stole money from me. They used my credit card as a deposit and charged $100 because they claimed my room smelled like marijuana. I was there on a soccer tournament with my daughter. It's really insulting that they would do this. They could have said anything else but that is likely the last thing I was expecting to hear. The rooms are very dingy and dirty, the whole place smelled like cigarettes in general. They have central air and of course the air circulates. I would advise to look for another hotel, I would have preferred to sleep in my car if I knew all this about this hotel. Worst experience I've ever had.

author: JonFromSoCal
title: Super 8 Oceanside July 2016
text: I stay at this property occasionally. I like the relatively quiet location, continental breakfast and the pool. All in all, this is a very good budget motel. On this particular stay, I was placed in a room the was extremely hot & the air conditioner was not working properly. After 4 hours, I contacted the front desk and spoke with Tyler. He came to the room and pretty much told me I was out of line, that the air conditioner was working, and that there was nothing more he would do for me. I asked Tyler if there was another room available, to which he said, "No, we're sold out". Not satisfied with this, I contacted another member of the front desk staff who told me that there were rooms available and that she would be happy to help me. Again, I like this property. My chief complaint (beyond the air conditioner not working) was the lying, short-shrift treatment I received from Tyler.

author: /undefined
title: poor customer service
text: we booked our room a month ahead. check in time is 3:00pm. we got there at 2:30pm. After 2 hrs have passed rooms aren't available yet and needs to be cleaned first. we offered them to pay our room and we'll just get back and get the key later around 6 or 7 but this guy receptionist refused. as soon as this guy finished his shift we asked this lady if we can pay and come back later so we can go to the beach instead of waiting for hours and she said absolutely! not happy with it. i don't recommend this motel.

author: ssny2016
title: Not clean
text: The first room I was assigned d looked like it hadn't been cleaned. The tub was filthy and even the manager agreed it was unacceptable. The second room had stains on the carpet floor and I also felt the tub did not look clean. Manager said the marks were only wear and tear. There were no other vacant rooms so I had to stay in the 2nd room. I did not shower or sleep well due to the lack of cleanliness. When I checked out I only received a quick apology for my poor experience. Management did not adequately address my issue in my opinion.

author: /undefined
title: Craft Beer Tour
text: This property is located near a few breweries, so good for a brewery tour. We stay at a lot of cheap motels in a lot of "interesting" areas, so we don't expect much. As long as the bed is clean and shower and toilet work we are satisfied. The room was clean, toilet worked and the shower was okay, slow running drain, but, fine. This particular property made us feel uneasy. There were men hanging out in the parking lot watching us unload our car. We had bikes on a bike rack we felt we had to remove immediately because we were being watched. We rode our bikes to a local brewery and worried about our car being broken into while we were gone. Also, expect to pay a $100 deposit if you are not using a credit card!

author: H8116PSkeithc
title: Very dirty bad location
text: The room smelled so bad that we had to have the air conditioner on all night. The carpet was wet by the refrigerator and my socks got all wet. There was only 1 bath towel which we needed 2. The bed was so uncomfortable, the head of the bed was slanted down so I had to sleep at the bottom of the bed. There was a BIG bug in the bathroom. I WILL NEVER book this hotel again and don't recommend this hotel. I did tell the clerk at check out about everything. I have to say that the clerk was very kind.

author: azbullrider
title: One word... DISGUSTING....
text: The best thing about this place is the bathroom sink.. dirty dirty dirty.. the beds were broken the TV was older than my 15 yr old. It stunk awful we wouldn't let our kids walk without shoes or socks... ONE handicapped parking spot... kid at front desk was very indifferent.. in asked him when the last murder was his eyes opened very large and he said I'm not allowed to discuss that... the doors were very loose the dead bolt lock barely worked you had to lift and push door to get it locked kids open door in morning some weirdo standing right outside food smoking blows smoke in my son's face ughhhh... get something else if at all possible

author: 355jeanneh
title: Too many changes
text: We had to move out of 2 rooms. The first one wasn't made up. The 2nd one, the water came out orange. We ran it for 20 minutes and it got more orange! They moved us to the 3rd room, which was much smaller, but workable. Then the breakfast area, to get your food, was 2 ft by7 feet. Therefore only two people could be in there at once. I will never stay there again!

author: stefanieafields
title: My stay
text: I would recommend this hotel to anyone who comes to visit oceanside or anyone who just wants to get away for the weekend. There prices are reasonable and there staff is amazing. Front desk clerk Tyler is awesome, and honestly so is the rest of the staff and management. They make you feel right at home and you wouldn't want to go anywhere else. Rooms are clean and updated and they also serve a Continental breakfast every morning. They have free WiFi, which a lot of other hotels don't or if they do you have to pay extra. I give this hotel 2 thumbs up and 5 star's. If you're ever in oceanside go to super 8 marty's valley inn.

author: rhondah932
title: Old Hotel, High Price
text: This hotel was pretty run down. The back section was improved. No security at all. Says truck parking, there might be if no trailer. Not much of a breakfast. Trash everywhere. Would not be recommending this hotel. May be good for $30 a night but charge $110.00 a night.

author: /undefined
title: first and last
text: You probably heard the comment: "you get what you paid for", well I don't think the place was worth what they were charging us. It could have been lower considering we stayed on a Wed and Thurs night. The carpet in the room felt dirty, the air conditioning unit was too loud, the bathroom tub floor was peeling off, the ironing board fabric cover was stained & tattered, the lampshades were very dark-toned which made the room gloomy, the room door didn't have a good fit in the doorway because you can see sunlight coming thru the entire side of the door, AND the entire room smelled of cigarettes/tobacco though I requested for a non-smoking room. Aside from our disappointing room, the breakfast area was very cramped, the grounds surrounding the hotel seemed dirty (trash & trash bags, cigarette butts, empty soda & plastic bottles, all lying around), people banging their doors shut loudly even after midnight, AND on our second night, a police car came into the parking lot and we could hear the officers questioning someone (due to the thin walls & being so close to the parking area) then knocked on the door of the room right next to us, at 3 a.m., regarding a vehicle in the parking lot registered to the occupants (again we could hear conversation due to the thin walls and crack in the door). This was our first stay at a Super8 and we're definitely never going back there or any Super8 again. What a waste of money, we could have stayed at other similar size hotels a few blocks away. On a positive note to be fair, the front desk folks were friendly and helpful, even spoke patiently to a rude customer (while I was waiting for my room keys),they replenished the food items promptly at the breakfast nook, and I appreciated that there were cameras all around the rooms and parking area which made the property seemed somewhat secure. I would have rated this property on the lowest scale: "terrible" but I sympathized with the staff who have to work there daily with undesirable conditions, so I chose the next rating: "poorly" instead.

author: /undefined
title: total dump
text: This inn was horrible , first off there was no one at the frint desk when we got there ... took us 30 minutes to check in . The room smelled aweful and the AC unit was broken and gad rat feces on it . The room seemed to have not been cleaned from the stay before. The TV was so old it was hard to see , the remote didnt work and was taped up . The staff in the morning was rude and rushed up to our room when we didnt hear their phone call , the clerk ( a young africian american male)barged into our room and started scolding our children .... I yelled at him and made it clear he had no right . Very unprofessional and very wrong . I will never stay at on of these properties ever again and I will make sure no one I know will either . Worst place ever .

author: 406lauretteh
title: Just OK
text: I attended a conference here, the conference room and restrooms in it were nice enough. They were disorganized and not very professional behind the check in desk. Which is tolerable. But what wasn't tolerable was how filthy the carpet was in my room, and the room smelled like a locker room. The carpet was so old and wrinkly, spots and stains in many places. My shoe even stuck to one big sticky spot and came off when I was walking across the room. Eeeew. But I did appreciate having a fridge and a microwave, everything else was OK (except the toilet that ran off and on all night). Still half the price of the nearby Marriott. Oh well, we lived to tell the tale.

author: annagT2156AJ
title: Left In Under 5 Minutes
text: I have never in my life refused to stay in a hotel room, until this weekend at the Super 8 in Oceanside. I chose this hotel because it was close to a wedding venue I was visiting for, and was pet friendly. Here's what I found: Blood stains on the carpet, along with so many unidentifiable stains on the carpet, towels, etc. The door frame was broken like someone smashed down the door. Burn marks on the tables. You can only imagine the kind of stories that took place in this hotel room, and I did not want to be the next. We were in that room for 5 minutes. I did take pictures, but I'll spare you the visuals. It's not a place I would recommend to my worst enemy.

author: /undefined
title: Not a good option...
text: Asked 4 times over a 2 day period for an extra blanket before one was available. The carpet was coming up & needs to be replaced. The TV was full of static & the WIFI was so slow or not functioning that it was unusable. The blow dryer did not work (requested repair 2 times & was never fixed). The shower was not functioning & that was repaired after the first request. They seem to have some kind of conference center that had loud parties both nights we were there. The party crowd seemed to be local & hung out in the parking lot all night. Overall was not a good stay. I had booked another week next month & I cancelled my reservation at this hotel to change to another one. Overall it felt unsafe, dirty, poor location, and bad service.

author: Unlikely2say
title: Clogged up shower and sink
text: ive stayed here several times and noticed the decline. The bathroom shower floor paint was coming off, the draining was clogged up and couldn't really get the hot water working along with the cold water. The bathroom sink also kept getting clogged up. You also get an old T.V. That has poor reception. The air conditioner smelled like mold. I was really neglected to sleep in the bed because I found a baby cockroach roaming the bathroom floor. Shall I say more?

author: lindakW3957TL
title: Worse stay ever
text: On April 24th we booked room on line, checked in, 10 minutes later checked out, and did not get our money back. Just could not stay there after seeing condition of the room. It was filthy, rug was so dirty you wouldn't want to walk on any part of it without shoes on, 2 chairs had huge black marks on them. They should have been thrown in the garbage. The door was in bad shape, the peep hole was half out, where the lock was you could se outside. Didn't feel safe. Pool was dirty. What a disappointment! And out all that money! Will not stay at any Super 8 or affiliated hotels!

author: 506tricias
title: pleasant graveyard service/grouchy am staff
text: Tyler exceeded my expectations when I checked in at 1 in the morning. Not only was he courteous and friendly. He was super informative of the surrounding area and gave honest feedback on surrounding attractions for my kids. Dissapointed in the continental breakfast b/c the only thing available was carbs and more carbs...pancakes, cereal, toast, pastry. No fresh fruit, yogurt etc. And the breakfast bar was so cram packed into a closet on a busy weekend like spring break it took over 45 minutes to wait in line to make your pancake. They pull the bar down promptly at 930 so dont be late to breakfast because the am staff will not accomodate even a pastry a minute past 930. My kids and I went next door to YUM YUM donuts which was affordable and delicious.

author: Travel442416
title: horrible
text: I don't know how to explain this place. We stayed here last year it wasn't so. Saw a drink girl falling all over the place and kids recording her. This time it just got ridiculous. First night had the water running for 15 mins no hot water and the next day same thing. Later on the night our friends saw a girl and her man pulling her in the hallway and rip her shirt. Police was called... never will we stay at this dirty place. Get what you paid for lol

author: Helomech1969
title: Small budget, good deal.
text: This place fit our budget for a quick out of town, overnight stay. Though the facility is old, they have gone through what appears to be great lengths to bring the quality to a newer fashion. The beds aren't horrible nor luxurious. They were satisfactory. All of the amenities, to include the in room coffee pot were satisfactory. There were no issues. The old saying applies, " you get what you pay for". If you're on a budget and want to stay near the ocean, this is a good place for s mall budget.

author: /undefined
title: Maybe my first an last stay
text: I felt that the rooms were very outdated. The carpet was the worse. The bathroom was more dated. But when we went to use the hot water the water was brown!!! We had to run the water for a short time for it to clear up. But with running the water we then noticed that the tub drained very slow. Last the tv remote only turned the tv up an down. If only the rooms were as great as the customer service it would definitely go back. Try were awesome.

author: LinseyB471
title: Popular Motel
text: We chose this motel based on price/ value and we got what we paid for. We have also stayed at the Days Inn Oceanside and for a few dollars more got a better out look and quality of room. I would recommend this motel if you are on a budget: if you are not spend the extra dollars and get something more up market. The motel itself could do with a big make-over to make it appear fresh. We could not fault the staff and they were vey helpful. The breakfast area was very small and the choice very limited. OK if you are in hurry. For quality coffee and donuts visit the Yum Yum donut shop about 150 yds. up the road.

author: robinquentin
title: Should have listened to the reviews!
text: Grandkids wanted a Jacuzzi. We got that and more. Transients renting rooms and shady people on the street. Empty shower bottles not replaced with new. Vending machines take money but don't deliver. But the best part was at 1:44am when one of the"residents"came home to find his girl with another guy. Beatings commenced. Cops called. I had to barricade myself and grandkids in a corner afraid of stay gunshots. Not an area our a hotel I'd EVER stay at again!

author: travelingLindaK
title: NOT STAYING HERE AGAIN
text: we stayed 2 nights visiting family in the area. The ceiling was dripping water from the room above showering. Not something new - because you could see different stages of drying and patch jobs. The sheets were clean and that's about it. Carpets old and wrinkled from wear and shampooing over SEVERAL years. The walls and doors were dirty. Only had one bath towel and one hand towel and 2 washcloths. Was directed to laundry room to get more towels. WOULD NOT STAY HERE AGAIN. We relocated down the street closer to the beach for a couple $'s more at the Motel 6

author: yolandar235
title: Awesome Customer Service
text: Great place to stay for the price! Very clean inside, microwave, refrigerator. Close to beach. Excellent Customer Service. My husband left his wedding ring on the night stand and we realized it when we were an hr. from home which we live 8 hrs. away, so he called the hotel and informed them, they called back immediately and told him they found it and we received it in the mail in 2 days! I would definitely recommend this hotel!

author: Larson-7
title: Needs Care and Attention
text: Stayed at this facility in April for 2 nights to do a return visit to Oceanside. The hotel is located a few miles off the highway and was easy enough access to drive to the pier and beach areas. The facility is showing major signs of wear and tear and neglect. The outdoor areas ( stairs, parking lot , pool etc are dirty and unkept. The room itself was just okay for a short stay with worn furniture, poor linens and pillows. The breakfast area is crwoded and has a very minimla offering versus other SW US Super 8s. Additionally some of the people hanging around the staircase and upper hallways looked as if they were meeting others there and not paying guests....hard to say for what purpose ? The young desk attendent was pleasant when we requested extra pillows and an iron. Clearly we would not stay here again !

author: /undefined
title: Bypass this one !
text: I have stayed at this property 4-5 times over the past few years. It has consistently deteriorated during that time. This latest transition from Best Western to Super 8 shows a marked decline. This was the designated lodging for our group (CA Blacksmiths). The carpet is seriously in need of replacement. Light switches that do nothing, TV remote that does not work, no TV guide or Chanel listing, broken desk chair. Bedding of questionable cleanliness. The place is a dump. I will not be staying here again.

author: SharonLynn1956
title: give a little manager
text: Stay here quite often. Everyone is super nice. Reason I stay is because of the rates. They are great. I think that Sam the manager could be a little more business oriented in the fact that I asked for him to comp me a room due to the fact that I stay there so often. They are running a stay 2 night get one free promotion and I did not do it that way I paid daily so he would not give me the deal . He stated he has nothing to do with the promotions. Was not to pleased that he did not care if I returned even though as a elite diamond member, he could care less. Thank You . Otherwise everyone else at the hotel was superb.

author: /undefined
title: Unsanitary
text: We checked into the Oceanside super 8 on Saturday at around 11. The clerk was very nice and helpful. However when we got into our room the first thing we noticed were the stains on the carpet that resembled blood. There was a sewing needle stuck in the lampshade, a roach in the bathtub, and cigarette burns in our comforter. We had no choice but to sleep here because every motel was booked up and all of their rooms were full. Once we checked out we called super 8 corporate mainly because I couldn't get ahold of their manager (shocker). I am still waiting on a response as i think 64 dollars for this Disgusting room is way too much. Thumbs down.

author: 105janen
title: ok
text: We typically stay here several times a year since they offer free breakfast. Overall experience is 6 out of 10 stars. The staff is very friendly, the breakfast buffet is ok. Nice fluffy pillows. Some rooms have plumbing issues such as slow drain, toilet problems;our current stay, the sink area carpet was always wet. Also, the neighbor room talked too loud til 3 am. Very convenient location to legoland and the beach. The prices are very affordable for a family of 4. Great for families on a tight budget.

author: Beth_az
title: Do not believe the three star rating.
text: Rude staff only put our three reserved rooms in the same "building" after several requests. The rooms are filthy and smell terrible. Like numerous other reviewers, we saw many cockroaches and thought the customer service was poor. We went to the continental breakfast 30 minutes after it started and saw many empty serving containers from items running out. Terrible stains on the ancient carpet and trash, cigarette butts and a small bag for drugs scattered in front of our room for our entire stay. Our room had no coffee maker, fridge or ironing board, although the other rooms did. All rooms appear to be labelled non-smoking but smell terrible- like old cigarette smoke and body odor. Manager- please do not bother replying to this review by trying to explain away issues, just address them within the hotel. Pest control needs to be increased and linens/cleaning service needs to be improved immediately. We will never stay at another Super 8 after this experience.

author: DisabledVetWheelchai
title: August 2013
text: SADLY, Ms Anna made cancel my 2nd reservation for 2 days (exchange from room 303 to 302) but refusing to offer me a wheelchair desabled shower chair as negotiated on my arrival to the property by Ms. Maria. I contacted Ms Anna prior to my check-out time (to confirm I could employ said chair [from room 303 over to room 302] and she left me waiting for her response for over 33mins)... By 11:35am, I contacted Mr Sam, who explained I couldn't not transfer the chair, therefore I requested to please cancel my 2nd reservation on the basis of being a wheelchair person whoo could not stand to shower, much less on a slipery tub surface. Ms Maria was fantastic! Ms Anna and Mr Sam need training to prevent the property from loosing disabled veteran's business. Will try them again one more time... Will report their performance soon! ~Disabled Combat Vet (wheelchair)

author: amandan2013
title: Fine if you just need a place to crash.
text: We did not go to this motel thinking it was a Ritz Carleton, but there are definitely a few things that could be improved. The continental breakfast could use a few more items and the WiFi absolutely needs to be updated. It's not even worth spending time to log in. Our room was clean and the bed was comfortable. It could use some new carpeting and the outside could be cleaned up a bit. Also, our room had a gas fireplace, but no carbon monoxide detector. This has got to be against code. We didn't really spend much time at the motel as we were out sightseeing. If we had, I might be a little more upset. It was a good place just to have somewhere clean to sleep and take a shower.

author: /undefined
title: Lego landbvacation
text: Overall the room was ok. There were broken lamp shade the kept falling down; should have been replaced. The room was not cleaned when we entered. No plastic bags for the trash so we used our own. Other than that the hotel was fine. Pool area was nice. Recommendation: needs elevator for disabled guest. I requested a ground floor floor and did get it. Satisfied ioverall.

author: /undefined
title: Met our needs - big room, close to Legoland
text: This hotel worked out great for us. We booked the family suite & it was by far the cheapest in the Oceanside/Carlsbad area. The family suite was very large & had two bathrooms - a definite bonus. The hotel is old, but clean. The location was good (5 min. to Oceanside Pier, 7 min. to Legoland) and the room & breakfast gave us everything we needed for a very affordable price. The staff was also helpful & friendly. The pool was available, but we didn't use it.

author: /undefined
title: Oceanside Getaway
text: The hotel was pleasant. It is located close to Legoland (7mins by car), easy access to route 76 and I5 & beach. The grounds seemed a little dirty, but the room was clean and the beds & pillows were very comfy.Shower worked great..coffee pot in room, fridge & micro. Cable TV-plenty of channels.
