It seemed like there were many "party" people at night making noise. Our room didn't have a latch for security, only a lock. Cont'l brkfst included, but we didn't get to enjoy. Pool looked well taken care of. Handicapped equiped, too. I would stay again...great price!

author: /undefined
title: Oceanside mini vacation
text: IWe couldn't use the shower. The hot water would not turn on because the knob was loose. The smoke detector went off when I plugged in the iron and it started smoking. The coffee maker had leftover grinds in it from the previous guest. The refrigerator was unplugged and so was the bedside lamp. There security chain was missing on the door. The housekeeper turned off the the air conditioner while I was out. The room temp was over 90 degrees when we came back. Had to go to the front desk and ask for towels and pillows.

author: CalifRusk
title: Good Value
text: About 8 miles from the Water. A good value for the $. We reserved a Smoking Queen & the reservation was not correct. We were offered a smoking room with two double beds but the room was in an area that had not yet been re carpeted / remodeled & it was not up to our standards. We had printed and showed the confirmed reservation. The staff was very apologetic and the manager went out of his way to accommodate our needs by suggesting a King balcony so we could step outside & smoke on the balcony & he gave it to us for the same price. The breakfast buffet was continental & acceptable. I would recommend this hotel they are a cut above the norm and customer responsive.

author: /undefined
title: Could have been better
text: Maria, at check in, was very helpful. (note my rating below was for check-in!) The morning desk crew were less friendly, helpful, or interested. Your WI-FI was not compatible with our Mac system and worthless to us during our stay. The 'business office' facility, i.e. printer, was unusable. Breakfast offerings were meager and not for one on a wheat free regimen. Oatmeal was a possibility but there was only one packet and it was the same 'only' packet on our second morning . We will not stay in another Super 8 (tho we have often in the past) unless we can be assured that these two areas of difficulty have been corrected.

author: /undefined
title: Training Course Stay
text: I stayed as part of an training course offered onsite. The room was upstairs and overall OK, however, the tub constantly would not drain and I informed the staff. It was worked on but it continued to be plugged. Shampoo and soaps were very minimal. Continental breakfast was pretty good and saved a lot time and money. A car did get vandalized in the parking lot next to mine which was a rental. Place was quiet other than that. Price was good. Training room was too small, even for just 7 students and an instructor.

author: dancys2015
title: Promises not kept :(
text: First let me say that we stay at this hotel 3 or 4 times a month due to location and we like some of the staff . Faith at the desk is very nice and tries hard to meet our needs. We have had a problem with the beds being too hard. A couple of weeks ago I asked for a diifferent room but was put in the same room again. Last week I was promised a room but when we arrived it was taken. I was told I would get a discount for the inconvenience, BUT DID NOT. Prior to this a month or so ago there was a party in the community center that kept us up until after 10:30pm. When I called to complain the next day I was told " It was rented for a party" NOT I'm sorry....NOTHING I was very upset.

author: daveb878
title: Typical budget hotel
text: Rooms are nothing special. Shady area. No issues with security. Pool area would be left open later. I was pleasantly surprised to find the hot tub after a couple days of being on my feet all day. Checking in was strange. The very cordial front desk clerk had me checked in before I got there. She had to look in my room as well as one my associates, to see if someone was in the rooms. "Computer issues." Overall, it served its purpose.

author: /undefined
title: nice stay in a wonderful area.
text: A color other than bright yellow would have made the outside and first impression a little better. The lobby was very nice and the staff were great at check in and check out. The pool area was nice although we didn't have time to use it. The room was very nice for the price range and the price was right. The area had many nice amenities and shopping opportunities. There were many nice restaurants and grocery shopping when needed. I loved having a microwave and fridge in the room. The housekeeping staff were outstanding and very responsive. It was centrally located to all the fun areas. I would recommend this hotel to others..

author: adrianbarajas
title: A/C Saved My Life!
text: My family and I stayed at Super 8 Marty's Valley Inn during last month's heat wave. My house felt like an oven and because of that my baby was inconsolable, I needed to get out quick. (I was also tired of having to go to local stores for their a/c) Staff was very polite and friendly. The room was spotless and to my surprise the beds were extremely comfortable. The a/c unit worked like a charm and the cool room put my baby to sleep within minutes. Internet was ok, but after all it was free. For breakfast they had a variety of items to choose from there was cereal, orange juice, apple juice, coffee and even waffles. I would definitely be back. My only complaint is that someone was smoking in the parking lot and the smoke was coming in through the bathroom window, yuck!

author: Closetpuddlejmpr
title: Disgusting room
text: After first walking in we thought it was nice, but once we took a closer look we saw filth everywhere. There was blood spatters on the wall in the bathroom. The hand towels had brown markings. There were no pillow cases on the pillows. The carpets had stains all over. They didn't supply the room with any bath towels and after asking for some they still didn't give enough for everyone in the room. The man upfront was not interested in even speaking to us. For the price we paid ($125 after all was said and done) we were expecting a cleaner room. There were teenagers running around pounding on our door and running away and the pool area had a party going on all night that was very loud. We will not be coming back.

author: ToddS478
title: Low price didn't compensate for major downfalls
text: Arrived late and the front desk was very friendly, but the location was questionable, to say the least. It was withing 45 minutes of arriving that we had a BED BUG crawl across the bed after my son had done some bouncing on the squeaky mattress. Within that moment, we packed it all up and left immediately. To the credit of the front desk employee, she was very instrumental in getting us set up at our new location. However, I was not reassured that the problem would truly be rectified as they didn't act overly surprised and mentioned closing off the room for 24 hours. That would still indicate the presence of bugs 24 hours later. Nontheless, the price was low, but I would spend more and stay elsewhere. Still, their assistance in moving us OUT of that hotel was appreciated!

author: Cashmeredog
title: Impressive!
text: This hotel is very clean and the rooms are spacious. The location is great! It's also convenient that it is right on the Breeze bus line, and there is a bus stop right in front of the hotel. We were at the beach in 10 minutes and didn't have to worry about parking or driving to the beach. For the price I would recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a clean, safe and convenient place to stay. I will definitely stay here again! I may even make it my new summer home! :)

author: MI6007
title: Great Deal for the Price
text: This Super 8 is a super good deal. Was in Oceanside to visit Camp Pendleton, this hotel was very close to base. Room was clean (put Super Clean sign on door and the maids do a great job, if you dont they do a quick fix up) Room had microwave and fridge, high speed internet included for 65 bucks. Cant beat that!! Breakfast was also included which had waffle maker, cereals, coffee and juice. Although we stocked up on food to utilize the fridge and microwave so not sure how good the free breakfast was. The hotel is in and around little fabricating shops like a wood shop etc. Some noise during workdays but remember...its 65 bucks!! Overall I would stay there again, no problem.

author: Berkeley_DaveS
title: Would stay again. Typical Super8.
text: I would stay at this hotel again. It is a Super8 which means you can expect free Wi-Fi and at least a reasonable free, expanded continental breakfast. It is not fancy. But the rooms are clean, the hot water hot and the bids reasonably comfortable. The breakfast was not as good as many of the Super8 breakfasts I have had, but it was within the range: hard-boiled eggs, white bread for toasting, some prepackaged Danish, a variety of popular cereals, juice, milk, and coffee. Plus they had a make your own Belgian waffle. The pool was heated, but not really heated enough. The spa was very hot. The only real negative surprise was the Wi-Fi: good enough for e-mail and a little web surfing, but must have been set up to foil iTunes and other bandwidth hogs. Nevertheless, it was a good deal about what I expected and more than adequate.

author: leroy67
title: Forgetaboutit
text: My daughter made res.4 days in advance for 2 rooms adjoining for the end of July. She was traveling to Oceanside for a family get together with her 5 kids and husband. The deal was pay for 2 nites get 3 rd free. I was going to get a rm for one nite. She called the day before and the day she was going to check to confirm. She gets there at 2pm and the have no adjoining rooms . No I'm sorry, clerk just saying.. "WE CAN'T BE HOLDING ROOMS " She had given credit card when the rooms were first "reserved" She called the following day to make sure they knew she wasn't staying there. Clerk said OK and nothing else. clerk said OK

author: claudio78roma
title: Horrible! - Please, don't waste your money!
text: I reserved a non-smoking room and even though the sign on the door said "no smoking" the smell inside was unbearable, plus a bad smell of pet's urine!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! When I went immediately to the reception the girl said "I am sorry" and did nothing!!! The carpet was plenty of spot I did not dare to walk with bare feet. I started looking for another hotel although I checked in at 2.00am. Please don't waste your money. Check comments on any lodging you plan to go. I did not, fool of me!!!! The worst stay ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: aseasease
title: terrible hotel
text: When we checked into our first floor room we opened the door to blood stains on the carpet outside the bathroom door, dirty walls, stains on the curtains and a smell that sent my allergies off the charts. We asked to move to a new room and had to wait for the manager to inspect our issues. When we finally were given a new room it was on the second floor with no elevator access, so we had to lug six bags up the stairs. The second room was better, but still dirty appearing. When we went to the pool and spa area we found a spa that was yellow green and very coudy, a veritable bacteria bath. All this and the gangsta car parked in the in the parking lot playing rap music with such foul language it sent my children and I running upstairs. Ugh! We may as well have been staying in South Central LA. Never stay here.

author: theresag269
title: Overnight for convention
text: Reserved at discount through Priceline. Our first room had a stopped-up sink. It drained extremely slowly, at a trickle. One of the floor tiles was broken out in the bathroom (did not take photo). We were immediately issued another room, the plumbing issue would be reported to maintenance. There was a very strong, undesirable odor when we walked into the second room and noticed wrinkled sheets and bedcover. (That could have been from being left in the dryer too long.) We were immediately issued a third room, which we found comfortable and acceptable. The receptionist was very friendly, helpful, apologetic, and addressed our concerns without delay. Good man!

author: NearlyRetired68
title: Excellent Room
text: After traveling for several weeks, we have had all sorts of hotel experiences. This Best Western was one of the best. The room was bright, which seems to be unusual lately; it was relatively large; it had a refrigerator with a freezer; and it had a microwave. Everything in the room worked fine. It was clean. The shower was fabulous with great water pressure. The breakfast was fine, typical of hotel breakfasts. We would definitely stay here again.

author: david23662
title: Hurricane from hell
text: Old tattered facility. No elevators. Internet did not work. Stairways dim dirty. Toliet barely flushed. A/c old. Good water pressure however. Tub had repair to floor but mold evident. Would recommend newer hotels by major competitors across the street

author: tah52
title: Needs TLC
text: This place is ok for the money, but it sure does need a lot of help. Every room and every part of this hotel needs new paint, new. Carpet and to become an all NO SMOKING hotel. The smell was horrible and very offensive. We were attending a funeral and all of our clothes smelled like cigarette smoke just from hanging in the hotel room. They also need an elevator. But for the money it was merely a place to lay our head at night. We will be staying at a different hotel next time.

author: adavici
title: Very Nice Hotel East of Huntington
text: The Best Western is a nice place to stay if you are visiting the Huntington area. It’s about 10 miles east of the downtown area and an easy drive. The front desk clerk was very friendly and helped get us checked in quickly. Our room had 2 beds and they were clean and comfortable. The linens are nice too. The hotel sits in the parking lot of a mall, which seems odd, but really isn’t. There’s plenty of safe parking too. This hotel is recommended for sure!

author: amyo672
title: Good place to stay!
text: We had 3 rooms for the night. All nice rooms. Beds clean. Smelled fresh. Bathroom clean. Breakfast was good, nice variety offering. Easy access to interstate. Many restaurants & stores nearby. Good place to bring a family.

author: voiceofpizza
title: Great location, comfy spot!
text: This is a great Best Western with super friendly staff. Really love the outdoor pool as it’s a great time of year to be outside. Comfy and down to earth decor with a really nice lobby. Rooms were very clean; I enjoyed the premium toiletries and comfortable beds. Super solid continental breakfast with all the favorites. This hotel is in a killer location with everything imaginable food and shopping wise in walking distance, also right off of the interstate. Plenty of parking for larger vehicles. Super quiet. We had a great experience and will definitely come back.

author: dunera
title: Very ordinary would not stay again
text: An unattractive bare appearance, small site no grassed area just parking all around the building. Very well received at reception. Very small public area. Rooms standard size, bed ok pillows small size filled, your head bounces off them. Many hotels now have the larger pillow with less filling very soft. Small outdoor pool just looks like an after thought. Breakfast one of the poorest I have had after travelling for 18 days. The plus point is there is a good restaurant next door!

author: 888robynd
title: Just passing through - asthmatics, read
text: Pros: fast, easy check-in, the man was very nice. The bed is good. Pillows are floofy, and since apparently we aren’t doing Spring this year, the heater is on and extremely efficient. Cons: The building is quite old, and nothing is ever going to get rid of the smell of cigarettes. The room does not smell of cigarettes initially, but I smell it now. Could be that the folks next door are smoking, though. There is no elevator, and the stairs didn’t see the back side of the broom today. Decision: If you are just passing through and don’t use an inhaler, it’s adequate. If you do, this is not the place. Also, I picked couples because “passing through” isn’t an option.

author: jsfmiller
title: Overnight stay for a conference
text: I chose this hotel because it was close to the interstate and to the location where the conference I was attending. As it was just myself, I wasn't looking for something overly expensive or showy. This hotel was pretty much all of that. The front staff were polite and quickly checked me in (I had preregistered so it was just a matter of verifying myself and providing a credit card in case). The room was fine for myself - two full-size beds, flat screen TV, refrigerator, microwave, desk for using with my laptop, Wi-Fi that came with the room, and bathroom. The bathroom was kind of small compared to other places I have stayed, but it would work for a single person visiting. Breakfast also came with the room price - kind of typical for what I have experienced under similar circumstances with other hotels that offer this amenity. It was a hot breakfast (fried eggs, though looked like they had been made in a mold, sausage, biscuits, gravy and other offerings). So, it served my purpose - a room for the night near to where I was actually going.

author: ProbablyNot87
title: Cozy, Comfortable, Convenient & Cordial
text: Conveniently located right off of Highway 64 in gorgeous Barboursville, WV, with a fine selection of eateries (Outback Steakhouse, Sonic), gas stations, and nightlife hotspots (Uncle Bill's Pub & Grill) ALL within walking distance, the Best Western Huntington Mall provided not only a comfortable and cozy place to sleep, their staff was so friendly and helpful to all of our needs. On top of that, I cannot say enough times how incredible the water pressure was in their shower. Very invigorating. For those looking to get a nice workout, please visit their wonderful fitness center. The continental breakfast had some much to offer, a delicious and extensive spread of food and gourmet coffee. Upon checkout, we hit the road feeling incredibly well rested, energized and grateful. If you're ever in the Barboursville, WV area and are in need of a cozy safe haven for the evening, the Best Western Huntington Mall delivers. Wins all across the board.

author: Biggie82
title: Bed bugs
text: I stayed here quite a few times and one time I found a couple roaches in my room.. apparently they thought I was lying and sent someone to check and came back and said they found nothing ,even though I caught one of them in a cup... the next time was the same except it was bed bugs... gave them the cup with the live bed bug in it and I was pretty much called a liar and was put on a “do not rent room” list for complaining about the bugs. Worst hotel I’ve ever been to... I definitely will not go back to that poorly run place again. Read the reviews.. it’s all saying sorry we will improve.. check the dates also.. how long does it take to get it together??

author: Mitzys531
title: Tv cable VERY inAdequate
text: 2nd time in a week at best western; the other in Kentucky. Both hotels tv cable was CHEAP and inadequate. No online TV guide. Had to scroll up and down remote constantly. Channels mostly old shows, news channels, sports, home shopping, hgtv etc. will NEVER stay at BW again. After a long day, we want to relax and watch some decent tv. If owner that CHEAP, we won’t spend our money there either. Would rate no stars if possible.

author: stepheno963
title: Overnight stay
text: Great check in and check out experience. The staff was helpful with our schedules. Appreciated the carts for luggage and the access to the room. They were accommodating for our special needs. thank you! I appreciated the location and the room was very comfortable. The beds were comfortable which I am sensitive to due to health issues. Everyone was friendly. Made our stay very good. I would recommend this as a great place to stay if traveling through or there for a business visit.

author: bagspacked123
title: Not far from highway
text: Check in was a little confusing as there were a few at the front desk conversing with each other but we got our room. Not sure if there was an elevator - just told to take the stairs to our room. Room was clean and beds comfortable. It is not near or next to a mall. The pool was nice but you have to ask for towels at the front desk - there is no signs on where to get towel and there is no place to turn them in except drop them off at front desk. Pool water was cold. You can hear people and dogs barking in adjoining rooms. Breakfast was okay. Walk across the parking lot for an excellent dinner.

author: tiedrose
title: Fine stay for travelers driving through
text: We needed a place to stay as we were traveling from PA to KY and wanted to stay outside Charleston. There are many options, but this one was rated well and inexpensive, a good option for a short stay. Our room was on the second floor (no elevator, so they made sure we were ok with taking stairs.) The room is updated well enough. It was clean and the AC worked fine. My only complaint was that it was musty, as other reviews stated. Our room didn't feel like it was smoked in recently, but at some point. Breakfast was good (and included.) coffee was good, biscuit and sausage sandwiches were provided, as well as a waffle station. They had a few cereal options and oatmeal. Not many gluten free options, but fruit and yogurt was provided. A fine place to stay if you need close to the highway, free breakfast, a warm bed and inexpensive.

author: Bkwrm
title: ADA review: Not bad for a night
text: This has a number of advantages--it is an easy off, easy on from interstate and you can walk across the parking lot to a couple of decent restaurants which is nice after a day of driving. We stayed here on our way to Washington, DC. Got late afternoon, early evening. TV was ok, room seemed clean and bed was comfortable. Breakfast did not seem particularly great, but was ok. Coffee was ok, but needed to have half & half available. Parking lot was rather rough for my mobility scooter. The accessible shower was good! We did have our sleep disturbed by a group of motorcyclists who roared in parking right outside our window, but not much the hotel can do about that.

author: 735janellm
title: Lots of choices in this area....
text: I found this to be a clean, neat and well lit property. I was impressed by the amount of doors to access different parts of the property with plenty of parking. You didn't have to walk far no matter where your room was located. My room was spacious and clean. I had all the amenities I'm use to having at a BW. Breakfast had a good variety and well taken care of. You could walk to a bar/grill for dinner if you didn't feel like driving. Shopping close by, too. Quiet stay.

author: K9936ZAbrians
title: Select this hotel
text: Very good hotel. Pleasing staff. Location is excellent. Safe place. Comfortable and clean. Good value. I have spent many many nights here. Check out the local shops and restaurants and especially Uncle Bills Pub

author: mrs_shopthe
title: Last Minute Booking While Traveling
text: We booked this room while we were on the road. We just needed a place to rest for the night. The price was right and it was close to the interstate. The front desk staff was VERY friendly and check-in was smooth and quick. Our room was just ok, nothing spectacular. The cleanliness was average, but the bed was very comfortable! There was plenty of hot water for showers in the morning and the water pressure was awesome! Although our room was a non-smoking room, we could smell smoke coming in from either another room or outside. Breakfast was very good, choices were plentiful and everything seemed fresh.

author: MrsMcCann1010
title: Nice stay. Thin walls.
text: My husband and I stayed here for 1 night for a concert in Charleston (we decided to save some money and hit up the mall the next day). Breakfast was delicious. Staff was very nice. Everything seemed pretty clean. Bed was comfy. The only problem I had was VERY thin walls. We could hear the lady in the room next to us cough all night long. Besides that my stay was nice.

author: bettyj0t
title: Great stay and convenient
text: Excellent location on I-64 for proximity of Huntington at the Huntington Mall. We literally walked from the hotel across the parking lot to restaurants and shopping. Friendly staff, comfortable bed with plenty of pillows. Great water pressure in the shower and the sink. Room has been updated with flat screen TV, bathroom granite countertop, and nice bedding. Still dated carpeting but room was freshly painted and well maintained. Complimentary breakfast consisted of scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, bacon, fried potatoes, sausage gravy, biscuits, bread, bagels, danishes, muffins, cereals, yogurt, juices, coffees. The dining area was of good size and easy to configure tables and chairs for 2 people or families. Staff was constantly refilling items so rarely out of anything. Outdoor pool, but not open now (October) Would definitely stay here again next time we're in the area.

author: optionsottawa
title: Great Hotel at Great Value
text: We had the pleasure of staying here recently and enjoyed our stay. We found the rooms to be spacious and well appointed, and the beds are super comfortable. We were in a king room, which came equipped with a small fridge, coffee maker, microwave and blow dryer. Towels and bathroom amenities are generous. The hotel is showing it's age a little, but it is clean and the staff work very hard to make sure that all needs are looked after. The breakfast has a good variety and is well cared for. The only reason that I didn't give it 5 stars is because the noise from the neighbouring rooms is loud when the water is turned on. Would definitely return when back in the area.

author: tancej
title: Business at Barboursville
text: This Best Western is great. The rooms are very clean and the staff are great. The front desk staff in particular are very courteous and willing to help. I will definitely stay here again. I was here on Business and needed to fax some things and the front desk personnel were willing to help me and very nice. Erica and Amanda were great. The breakfast is good and plenty of room to move around. The rooms are big too and clean. The internet worked great.

author: lisas533
title: Stay away
text: Oh my gosh! Horrible. The outside door was fixed where it wouldn't shut and lock so anyone off the street could get in. Our room stunk like it hadn't been cleaned in a month. I went to the front desk they showed me another room and it smelled like a bathroom. I demanded my money back and went across the road to the Hampton inn and suites. What a world of difference. Staff was nice.would never recommend this place to anyone! Supposed to have wifi but wouldn't work.

author: ALFREDOG235
title: Summer Vacation
text: The hotel staff were caring, efficient, courteous and friendly. We had a good sleep due to: quiet air condition, good pillows, soft beds but preferred firm beds. The TV channels were great with so many choices. Breakfast was good but fresh fruits were not available. The outdoor swimming pool was good but would be better to see a drinking water (fountain). Internet connection was reliable and fast. Pitcher of water was not enough near the breakfast area. We would love to see a water dispenser or filtered water machine.

author: davideU1948WX
title: Nice for an over night stay
text: Room was very clean. Staff were very nice and helpful. Would stay again. It is only a short ways from Huntington Mall and plenty of places to eat. Easy access from I64. Very quiet. Beds very comfortable. 3 pillows on each bed. Bathrooms very clean, with plenty of towels, shampoo and soat.

author: karensB8298PC
title: Comfy Room
text: I only stay at Best Western. The rooms are nice. Always clean. Service is great. Always enjoy the breakfast. Great Coffee! I always sleep good because the beds are nice and comfy. Overall a great place to stay.

author: michaeloW1602YL
title: Gone Skiing
text: We stayed at this hotel for the location. We were headed to Canaan Valley Resort, WV from West Tennessee and wanted to break up the drive, so I found this Bestwestern which was just right. There was a Mall, a Walmart, and plenty of restaurants to select from all within a mile of the hotel. The hotel staff and service were all friendly and helpful. Our room was okay and clean. The toilet was slow flushing, but not a big deal. We had a hot breakfast which was also okay. I couldn't had been any happier about the price as it was free with my Bestwestern points I had earned through other stays. I did look at the price for the room before booking and it was a reasonable rate.

author: Rascaljay
title: Much less than expected
text: I'm surprised Best Western allows this property to use it's name. It is closer to a budget inn. Paper thin walls, sounded like the woman next door was in my room with me. Beds are subpar. I'm used to Best Western having pillow top beds. This wasn't even close. The Internet is slow, it was hard to get anything done. Had I an inkling of what this was like, would have driven another 50 miles to a better hotel. It's probably a good value for the money (75 rack price) but I expect better from a Best Western. "Disappointed Diamond member"

author: oldfirechief
title: Football Game Visist
text: In town for football game and visit with family, so this place was in the right place to accomplish both with minimal driving. Check in was fast and friendly. Room was spacious and clean. Breakfast was more than I had expected with eggs, sausage, potatoes, juices and coffee. The only knock on breakfast is the continuous toaster is set too fast--even two passes through did not begin to color/heat the bread. But the quality and quantity of the rest of the offerings more than made for the rather pale toast. Other reviews of this property mention traffic noise, but I had a room on the highway sign and barely heard ONE truck go by--and it had a bad muffler. If in the area for similar visits, this will be the place I stay.

author: joshg756
title: Fantastic stay!
text: Clean well kept rooms. Good breakfast. Friendly staff. They have guest laundry (two loads washing and drying was only $6) and an exercise room. Located near good restaurants. A big mall and movie theatre just down the road. What more could you ask for! Plenty of parking available for cars up to 18 wheelers. I will definitely stay here again if I find myself in the area.

author: 262WilliamC
title: Great location near I-64.
text: They provided great service and easy check in and out. I was surprised by the size of the hotel with several entry doors. I think it has the most rooms in the area. This hotel has easy access to I-64 and very close to the Huntington Mall for many dining choices. The complementary breakfast was very good including cereal, toast, muffins, fruit, biscuits & gravy, and make your own waffles. It was a nice large room with two beds. It was relatively quiet. I was on the second floor. I would stay there again when I am in the area.

author: X573CCjamess
title: Family Vacation
text: The experience was great. The family totally enjoyed this hotel and the location was perfect for us. The rooms were clean and very nice. The breakfast was very good and the staff worked hard to make sure there was always plenty for everybody and that the breakfast area was kept very clean and presentable. I had some minor problems with the air conditioner unit in my room but the staff was very prompt in addressing the issue when I brought it to their attention. The housekeeping staff was very pleasant and always did an excellant job every morning. The pool was great and was the highlight of my grandsons stay. I reccomend this hotel to anyone wanting a nice place to stay and I plan to stay there again.

author: Keven_Fry
title: Did Not Measure Up
text: Huntington Mall is not in Huntington, so this hotel is not actually in the town we had planned on staying in - we lunched within Huntington, 11 miles from our hotel. The hotel is clean but worn and it has a pretty nice outdoor pool. The room is nice and spacious and the WIFI worked for the computer but not for our smart phones. The TV was pretty modern with HDMI but was not set up with the capability to input from external source such as my computer. The room had two beds which were full size as opposed to queen size as found in most hotels of comparable category. The ice machine on our floor was out of order, as was the vending machine in the laundry room. The hotel has several entrances so that you can park fairly near your room regardless of where it is situated within the building. However, lugging heavy bags up the stairs could be a bother since there is no elevator.

author: michaelbZ5829TP
title: Great Spot
text: As many of you know Best Westerns are independently owned and operated. This I'm sure has its challenges but the upgrades and Plus options are really starting to make a difference for the customer. This Best Western has an incredible location just East of Huntington. In the parking lot besides the Outback Steakhouse there are 8 restaurants within a 5 minute walk. The pool was closed for Maintenance over the Memorial Day weekend but will be open later this week. Friendly helpful staff, and good value for BW. If you have issues with 2nd hand smoke and pets you should probably look for a different location. For adults travelling and looking for a basic place to stay with convenience and value around $100 room, I give it a 4 out of 5. If you're looking for somewhere to take your kids, no indoor pool so unless it is during the summer months and you're looking to relax a bit on the drive I give it a 3 out of 5.

author: 321charlesf
title: Great
text: I stay at this Best Western often. The price is reasonable and it is comfortable. The quality of air is important to me. I have stayed at a less expensive motel on occasion but I had trouble with the quality of air. The rooms are large and the beds are comfortable. Internet is important to me as well. Download speeds during my most recent stay were 11 mb/s. That's prettyy decent for a hotel.

author: 408lindalees
title: nice and convenient- good value
text: Hotel is very near shopping, restaurants ( 3 right across the parking lot) the room was very comfortable and had the fridge and micro I needed. Beds very comfortable as were the pillows. Quiet at night. Breakfast was served in a pleasant room and there was variety- note: no fried eggs, but hard boiled were available. Service was good- i.e., lady in charge got me Mayo when I needed it. Good value and would stay there again. Negatives: no elevator so if you are unable to climb stairs ask for a first floor room...stairwell and stairs need cleaning. Other than those things very pleasant place.

author: Stephanie787
title: Great experience!
text: My family travels through the area a couple of times a year and we have stayed at the Best Western several times. We usually use a walk-in coupon which is readily accepted and we get a great rate.The rooms are comfortable and clean and staff is helpful and friendly. We stayed a few days ago and I forgot a pillow that I need due to a back injury. The staff found the item and shipped it to me at home! Awesome customer service! The only downside to this hotel is the lack of an elevator. All the pros I've mentioned plus a good breakfast, make up for that though. We will definitely continue to stay here when we pass through. Thank you Best Western staff!

author: lisas4
title: A Little to "Hillbilly"
text: We walked in and the girl behind the counter was wearing pink camouflage.....really?!?! Seemed pretty unprofessional. Walls were absolutely paper thin. We could actually hear what the people next door were saying and when someone started up the hair dryer in the next room it sounded like it was in our bathroom. Room was clean and bed was comfortable. Went down for breakfast and the new girl behind the counter was wearing an oversized hoodie. Breakfast was ok. Cheap room...you get what you pay for.

author: GaryH722
title: Average as Hotels go.
text: Went with a group of Senior Citizens on field trip riding in a bus. Had a room on 2nd floor. First of all no elevators. Bus load of seniors and no one there to help with their luggage. Our room had holes in wall near a/c unit. Exhaust fan in bathroom not working. Tears in carpet. Room smelled of alcohol HEAVY alcohol. The only restaurant other then going across a 6 lane highway was outback steak house.. There are restaurants near bym but all involve crossing a busy street.

author: TomN255
title: These folks appreciate your business !
text: When you travel enough for business you look beyond the superficial . You come to value what leads to a good night's sleep. The BW - Barboursville rooms are comfortable, the furniture easy to relax on and sleep in. Proximity is convenient enough to downtown Huntington and Marshall ( car needed but close enough ). Restaurant ( Outback Steakhouse ) directly across the parking lot - have a substantial meal, a few drinks, and walk back to your room. Shoppers will appreciate the closeness of the nearby mall ( along with its selection of eateries ). Included in the very reasonable rate are a hearty breakfast bar, swimming pool, wi-fi , and all that which you come to expect. But what sets BW - Barboursville apart for me is the staff and, especially, the manager , Mike. I had scheduled my last stay erroneously but , to my advantage, my mistake was adjusted away. Yes, these folks appreciate your business and I will continue to make this my Huntington area "home away from home".

author: JVZ1948
title: Nice people and gaood accomodations.
text: The Hotel was clean and the staff friendly and helpful. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. The WiFi worked well. The only minute negative was the popcorn machine was down. We had a pleasant stay overall. The shower was good and the towels typical of hotels, that is rough. Fabric softener would be a nice touch. The cost of the stay was enhanced with a coupon from a travel guide which made this stay an excellent value.

author: herdjohnson
title: Not flawless, but worth the money
text: We stayed for two nights this weekend in town for the Marshall game. It was a clean hotel for the most part, and the staff was very polite. The room was clean and didn't have the whiff of smoke I was afraid of. We didn't take advantage of the breakfast bar (When you live 8 hours away from Huntington, you eat Tudors any chance you get!), but it looked pretty good for free. The only negative things I can think of would be the lack of an elevator, and the stairwell had a pretty musty smoky smell to it. The beds were not the most comfortable, but they're what I expected for 80-90 a night. Would definitely come back - I've stayed in the Holiday Inn right down the street a couple of times, and bang for the buck, this place wins out. Also walking distance to Fat Patty's is a big plus for post game dinner and drinks!

author: 337peggyw
title: Property Needs To Be Updated
text: This property is tired and in dire need of updating. They are in the process of updating the bathrooms but they are still quite small bathrooms. It is definitely an older property. The carpet and furniture need updating. The rooms were noisy especially when other guests used their bathroom shower. Sounded like it was our bathroom. We had a bathtub that was not draining and a celing light cover that was missing. Both were fixed by the time we returned that night, Breakfast was ok. The hotel staff were pleasant. The room cost less than any other hotel we stayed in during this trip, but we would not stay at the property again.

author: 164ac
title: Don't make this mistake - keep driving
text: Should have kept going to Charleston. Non-smoking room reeked of cigarettes. The AC leaked all over the rug. The highway noise kept me up all night. When I arrived at 4:30 I had to wait 30 minutes for a room. I booked the room 3 months ago. Nowhere to walk a dog though they are a pet friendly hotel. Not worth the price. Should have a budget hotel price.

author: Teeroe1
title: Nice stay
text: This stop was part of our cross country motorcycle trip. Parking is a bit of a challenge and this is a very busy area. Several dining options in this area too. Room was clean and spacious with refrigerator, coffee pot and microwave in it. Big outdoor swimming pool but no hot tub. Staff was friendly. Breakfast was typical for motel. This place was packed out with people the night we were there. It's just off the interstate which makes it very easy to get in and out of. I would stay again if back in that area.

author: buddyringo
title: Nice place
text: This is a pretty good hotel for the money. Just a tiny bit too expensive for what you get. They serve a good breakfast for free. They are in the middle of a remodel but still in good shape. Staff very nice. Putting all new Carpet in the halls. Pool is small and a hot tub would improve the place. Left something there and they kept it for me until I came back.

author: Jlakb
title: Exactly what we needed!
text: Traveling from Ohio to Florida, we needed a place to get something to eat, and a good night sleep before the next day's drive. When we arrived (unannounced), the front desk woman thought they might be full, but she searched around in the computer and managed to find a room for us. The room was clean and spacious. When I told her we needed to order a pizza, she gave me flyers for 3 pizza places that delivered (this was around 9:30 pm so we did NOT want to get back in the car and drive!). I was the only one who made it to the morning breakfast as the rest of my family wanted to sleep in, but I must say, while the breakfast foods were what I would expect (cereal, toast, homemade waffle iron), the staff again impressed. I believe the name was LaDonna? She was very busy making everyone feel at home, I heard her having conversations with several of the guests, between clearing their plates, getting them more napkins and offering to make the waffles for anyone else that came in! It certainly felt like she was truly welcoming us to her home.

author: jessicag241
title: Conference Meeting
text: I stayed at Best Western for 3 nights for a business conference. Best Western was clean, comfortable, and the location was good. The only issue I seemed to have was noise of other customers and vehicles outside the hotel. Overall it was a great place. The breakfast was also great. I liked having the mini fridge and microwave in the room for snacks. I would stay there again. :)

author: 318marshallg
title: Business traveler
text: It was a good experience. Staff was very good. Breakfast was what you would expect. Nothing really bad just very limited. The location was convenient to where I needed to be . Rooms were updated. and very comfortable. Would stay here again.

author: GregC364
title: Excellent motel for the price
text: We stayed here with an Orbitz discount and paid around $51 for the room. The Hampton Inn across the street was more than twice that. We were pleased with the quality here for that price. The rooms were sizable, the beds comfortable, everything worked, they had flat-screen TVs, fridge and microwave. The breakfast was fine, nothing great but acceptable. The motel was generally quiet, clean, modern. There is a mall nearby and a Fat Patty's restaurant right up the street (I recommend a trip to Fat Patty's). If we come back I think this is where we'll stay again. It's a nice area but only a 10 minute drive to Huntington. If you come in from the north make sure you stop at Hillbilly Hot Dogs on your way in!

author: 321charlesf
title: Best Western Barboursville, WV
text: Loved it. It was right next to the mall which turned out to be really convenient. It had a nice desk and a lounge chair with a foot stool. The room was really nice. Great location. The bed was great. I didn't want to get up. And my internet speed was 9 M/ps!

author: 503jills
title: Great Hotel & Value
text: I had never stayed at a Best Western but read other reviews on this site and chose this for our visit. I couldn't be happier. They were accommodating for early check in and with our large dogs. The décor is a little outdated but the room was clean and the staff was so nice. That is worth more than décor any day to me. They are located right off the interstate and near alot of restaurants and the mall so that is helpful. And I loved that they didn't have any breed or weight restrictions for the dogs. Also, the fee for the dogs was very reasonable. Would definitely stay here again.

author: krissibx
title: 2 night stay
text: I stayed for 2 nights I have no complaints. The room was clean and large the bathroom was nice breakfast room was large and served a decent breakfast. Housekeeping was really nice they always stopped and said hi even I f you passed them 5 times a day. I will say there's no elevator and even though I stayed on the first floor; rm 136 my room was a haul from the doors so I can imagine if my room was on the second floor how inconvient the walk would be with luggage. They have a laundry but nowhere to fold or a table to put anything on. I didn't get to the pool. Overall n ot a bad place. The strip club a few doors away left a lot to be desired but that's git nothing to with the hotel.

author: kellyc333
title: Extremely Pet Friendly
text: We have stayed here several times while visiting relatives. The staff is always very friendly and helpful. They are very pet friendly and you are liable to meet many new furry friends. It is an older hotel and could use a little re-vamping the hallways have a bit of a lingering smell from ancient cigarette smoke, the hallway carpet could be replaced. Have never noticed it inside the rooms. All in all a decent palce to stay for the price. also right next tothe interstate and Huntington Mall. Lots of dining choices.

author: Vacationnthree
title: Not too impressed
text: We stopped here because I found a coupon in a Hotels Coupon book, I looked up reviews and it didn't look too bad. I would have been disappointed paying the full price of the room, that night was $89 I think. We had a coupon for $65. Which is closer to what they should charge for rooms here. I wasn't too impressed with the hotel, but not too disappointed either. Our room was average at best. There are some nice restaurants within walking distance. The gal at the front desk check in was very nice even though she was crazy busy. They do not have a elevator, which doesn't bother us since we use steps even if there is a elevator, but I know this bothers some customers. Breakfast was OK.

author: LindaR923
title: away for a long week end
text: We had rm 114, I am disabled and this was an accessible room. It appeared very clean when we fist walked into the room. We found a used Q tip under the desk, and the carpet was saturated by the bathroom door. I slid, almost falling, across the bathroom floor after getting my feet wet on the carpeting. We told the hotel desk clerk about it, but she had an I don't care attitude. Other than that, it was a nice stay. Breakfast was alright. Being a diaberic, they didn't have much to suit me.

author: lilangel44
title: Will never stay agian!
text: I brought my family here to see my husband on buisness. The piping is extremely loud...the walls are paper thin. The people next to us kept us up till midnight then were up at 6am.. you can here everything throughthe walls. The rooms were not the cleanest. The refridgerator did not work. Also the hotel smelt moldy and gross especially when walking in the front lobby. .

author: roamingcamper
title: Very nice property
text: Better than most Best Westerns. Very nice property. Lobby and rooms exceeded our expectations. Very clean and well maintained. Breakfast was pretty good although limited options. Very friendly staff. A bit away from Huntington. Great rate. I recommend this hotel for sure!

author: Suzi-Q
title: A good night's sleep at a great value
text: We stopped over for one night on a recent trip. The staff was very helpful - we hadn't slept well at our previous hotel, and I asked the desk clerk for a quiet room, and he delivered! The hotel is not fancy, but the room was clean, quiet and had a comfortable bed. It is an older property and does have smoking rooms, so there was a smoky smell in the hall and public spaces sometimes, but it wasn't bad. (I'm a non-smoker.) We enjoyed the breakfast. The offerings were pretty typical. The stay was a good value for the money. As others have said, it's next door to Outback and across the street from Cracker Barrel, so there are dining choices within walking distance if you're just tired of being in your car...

author: lchs65
title: Nice Experience
text: We stayed one night at this hotel while attending a graduation at Marshall University in Huntington. The large room was clean and the public spaces were nice. The breakfast bar was clean and well stocked. There was a flat screen TV, coffee pot, hair drier, iron and ironing board in the room. The wireless internet in our room was adequate. There are restaurants and places to shop near by. The hotel was quiet and we had a good night's sleep and felt safe there. We had some problems using our key card in the outside door and it took several attempts get the door to open. The desk clerk was apologetic, quickly fixed the problem and told us that carrying the cards too close to a cell phone could deactivate the card. I would definitely stay there again.

author: BeckyR246
title: Awesome Hotel
text: We always stay at the Best Western at the Huntington Mall when we are in Huntington. On Christmas day we were there, yes Christmas day, most all business were closed.The management at Best Western had purchased lunch meat and everything to fix sandwiches for the guest that wanted something to eat. What an awesome, thoughtful thing to do!!! The staff is always nice. Jeff was on duty that day and he was as friendly, helpful and happy as if it were just another day, the rooms are very clean, the breakfast is kept at the correct temperature. We can not say enough about this Hotel. We plan to be there in Feburary 2012 and other dates already scheduled. We have always had a great stay at this Best Western. Give this Best Western a try, see for yourself. Becky and Russ

author: Seniorcitizen72
title: Good deal
text: We "earned" this one as a free night's stay Best Western package deal. We were there on a Wednesday and it was not crowded. Room on ground floor- easy access. Clean, nice bed. Usual free Best Western breakfast. Staff was pleasant. Many restaurants nearby. Some within walking distance. Yes, we would stay there again.

author: hoverton
title: Nice Clean place to stay. Friendly Staff
text: Our AC went out and we needed to stay here for three nights during heatwave. Granddaughter & I had traveled from FL and got in late on a Fri evening. My husband had reserved the room and was waiting for us in this wonderfully cool room! Housekeeping did not clean room on Saturday, but we got fresh towels from the front desk and it was cleaned on Sunday. Apparently they were short handed, and because of the heatwave were completely booked, along with all motels in the area. Front desk personnel and housekeeping staff we encountered were very friendly and accommodating. Overall this was a good experience. Pool area was clean and granddaughter (age 8 yrs) enjoyed swimming and playing in the pool very much.

author: Tasay65
title: A very nice place!!
text: This is a nice place to stay and everyone was so nice and friendly. My husband, daughter and I were traveling to NC and this was just an over night stay. The ladies at the front desk were very friendly and polite. The room was nice and very clean. The bathroom was a little small, but okay. There are lots of places to chose from to eat. Outback, Cracker Barrel, Bob Evans, Olive Garden, Applebees, Chick-Fil-A, and Famous Daves BBQ. We chose to eat at Famous Daves (in the same parking lot as hotel) for dinner and Cracker Barrel (just across the street) for breakfast and both places were awesome. The hotel is also very convenient to shopping, with the mall and WalMart very close by. We would definately stay again.

author: OfcWolfe
title: Great for the money
text: Me and my family stayed at this location on Memorial weekend. We took advantage of the Camden Park package. My children enjoyed the outdoor pool although it was cold considering it had only opened up that weekend. This hotel is clean and the staff is very friendly. I had stayed in this hotel 2 years ago on business and my experience was the same. They also have a fantastic breakfast with anything you could want. This hotel is not located very close to Camden Park but for the price it was well worth the drive. We ate at Outback Steakhouse which is located in the same parking lot of the hotel.. My family had a wonderful time staying at the hotel.

author: Lindyb1410
title: Good hotel with friendly staff
text: Stayed for 3 nights whilst in the area for MotoGP. All staff were very helpful and friendly, nothing was too much trouble especially the young man working on Reception (sorry no name as they didn't wear name badges) We only had breakfast which was very good, plenty off choice, especially for cakes and pastries. Coffee is made fresh for you not just from a machine, cafe latte was particularly good! Room was clean although not very big which is standard for Italian rooms, adequate for 2 people though. No UK tv channels, not that we were in the room much but would have been good to hear a bit of news. Could easily get a sun bed around pool in the afternoon. Good location on the edge of the resort, close to amenities, beach etc but not noisy. Would definitely stop here again.

author: JamR0LL
title: Ok hotel for a weekend stay
text: My wife, my daughter and I stayed here one night at the beginning of September, the hotel is located roughly at the west end of the two main central roads in Cattolica, via Carducci and via Dante so if you like a central location this is not ideal. The staff was welcoming and kind. The hotel is a bit dated overall and should be modernized, there was a strange smell in the lobby, the cost of an espresso coffee at the bar was €2. The room we were given (310) wasn’t too good, the door was creaking and there was a horrible smell in the bathroom, we went down to reception to report it, a cleaner turned up after a few minutes and put some perfumed bleach in the vent on the floor but the issue was only resolved partially so we re-complained to reception and asked to be relocated to another room, which they did promptly, the second bedroom was ok, only it seemed that they had not hoovered under the bed for ages as there was quite a lot of dust. Later on we learned the issue in the first bedroom seemed to be common in the rooms 110, 210, 310, 410 etc, so avoid these if you stay here. Also, the bedroom walls seemed to be quite thin as we could hear all the neighbours were saying, thank God we had quiet neighbours after the relocation. Breakfast was quite good with sweet and savoury choices, (the bacon was very fatty and greasy, though) but more sweet than savoury (why so many cakes for breakfast?). There is a swimming pool shared with the hotel next door, we didn't use it so I can't really comment on that, the pool area was overall ok but again, a bit dated and in need of modernization. The price of the room was very good considering we had booked the night before but all in all I’m not quite confident I would stay here again.

author: Dmills32mx
title: Moto GP holiday
text: Great little hotel, close to all amenities. 10 minute drive to misano circuit. Staff are so friendly and helpful. Less than a five minute walk to the beautiful beach. Lots of restaurants close by . Room was tidied daily. Plenty of choice at the buffet breakfast. Second time here and will use again

author: 235Mod
title: Quality for price
text: We spent a nice week in the Hotel Alexander in August 2014. Me and my husband spent our holiday for the second time in that hotel and we are satisfied with what we got for our money. The room was nice, quiet, view on the sea and clean. The hotel staff was friendly and helpful. We were on half-board and both breakfast and dinner were delicious and plentiful. We were more than pleased with the pool-party organized each week, with special Italian food offered. The hotel is situated in a quiet part of Cattolica, just we wanted to. Shopping facilities, restaurants, cafés bank, are just a couple of minutes to walk. We have spent our summer holidays in Italy for years, this was our prefered hotel. We shall return for sure.

author: garybL2101XQ
title: Very nice rooms!
text: The lobby is a little dated, but the rooms were great. The swimming pool was the cleanest and clearest I've seen on our 10-day trip! Check-in staff was friendly, and my only complaint was in the morning we had a 400+ mile drive, and we wanted to start early, at 6 a.m., However, the breakfast didn't start until 6:30. (We could have gone on and stopped somewhere, but we thought this would be faster.) We could plainly see that the breakfast things were all set up and ready to go at 6 a.m., but at 6 a.m. the morning desk staff could have cared less about our plight and just said no, it wasn't possible to go in any earlier. Wouldn't it have been good PR to at least have offered to step across the hallway and ask the cook what was possible? They were totally unhelpful and unfriendly, and we went away with a bad feeling about our stay. For that reason, I didn't give the full star rating.

author: KandFRedmond
title: Clean, Quiet, Helpful Front Desk
text: The hotel is in a convenient location. It is near many restaurants but a short drive from downtown. Bi-Mart is next door and Fred Meyer and Wal-Mart are a short drive away. The hotel needs an update and rumor has it that the update is coming this winter. Nonetheless, the rooms and furnishings are not shabby. The breakfast is a standard HI Express breakfast. We found the front desk to be more than helpful. If you are hungry, I recommend Italianna's Ristorante and Gelateria.

author: davekris
title: Real enjoyment and comfort...
text: We were on the road when heading to Klamath Falls for an introductory visit. We were able to make good connections and a reservation with this hotel. The staff was very accommodating and helpful with great and valid recommendations (places to eat and sites to see). We were directed to a great restaurant named "Nibbley's". Their food and service was so good we came back for breakfast the next day. The staff was not reluctant to share the information the had with several recommendation to restaurants, depending on you taste and wants. We will certainly be back. The bed was like sleeping on air and offered a great nights sleep.

author: ericsG28TD
title: Clean hotel
text: Like many of the other Holiday Inn Express hotels that I have stayed at, this one was nice, clean, seemed newer and had a nice breakfast included. My daughter and I enjoyed the pool and hot tub. Pool water was just the right temperature with the pool being about 25 feet long by 10-15 feet wide. The hot tub could probably fit six people. Our room had two queen beds, as well as a kitchenette. We paid an extra $10 for a rollaway bed for my son. The room was comfortable. The receptionist provided a restaurant recommendation of Nibblies, just a half mile easy walk from the hotel. Bring a big appetite if you go there. Big portions at reasonable prices.

author: kristen49
title: Clean room, great breakfast
text: We reserved a larger suite room, and our room was on the 3rd floor. It is definitely spacious, and clean. However, the room had a very weird smell - a bit hard to describe, but as if a wet dog had been in there & then masked with some sort of very strong carpet cleaner. We kept the window open & the fan on, but it only helped some. I wish we hadn't had that experience, but the rest was just fine. Clean room, friendly staff, and probably one of the best hotel breakfasts we've ever experienced. The cinnabon cinnamon rolls are delicious! We stayed on graduation weekend & felt the $$ was a bit high, although I suppose expected.

author: 218LindaB
title: Treated very well
text: I usually stay at Hilton properties being a Hilton Honors member but there are no Hilton properties in Klamath Falls where I was working. Staying there is making me consider changing to Holiday Inn. We were warmly welcomed and had a nice room on the 3rd (out of 4) floors. We upgraded and got a bigger room which had a sitting area - well worth the $20 extra. The room was clean and quiet. The hotel shares a parking lot with Sizzler and Comfort Inn, so parking is a little tight. The property is close to a lot of restaurants and shopping. There is a laundry room on each floor. All the staff were so friendly and helpful. I will definitely stay here again!

author: 465RobertH465
title: Lovely hotel with a nice atmosphere
text: Warmly greeted a front desk. Gave us a very nice room on the top floor, that overlooked one of the mountains, and was very quiet. The hotel was very clean throughout. Breakfast was very good. Variety of choices, and constantly being stocked. The biscuits were excellent! Breakfast lady did a great job. Also had outdoor sun beds, and table and chairs. We found this to be ideal for relaxing, after a long drive.

author: haraldl605
title: New, knowledgable and clean!
text: If not new, by golly it sure looks new and is kept new looking. Personnel? ALL were most helpful and very knowledgeable about the Klamath Falls area. And CLEAN! WOW! My-oh-my do they keep a neat, clean and tidy establishment. When in town do the HI Express. They will not disappoint.

author: H8603MGbrianb
title: Nice place
text: Location is easy to find. The receptionist at the front desk very cordial. The room was clean with all the supplies ready. Breakfast area spotless with tasty food well presented and with a good selection. In the breakfast area, I noticed the the attendant, Jaqueline, was always cleaning, checking the food, coffee and condiments to make sure everything perfect. She also was quick to help customers with any request. Nice job by her. We would stay here again if in the area. Thanks. Brian & Joyce Napa, CA

author: Dede2travel
title: TRIED to stay here
text: Although my review is only about my phone experience with your hotel, it speaks volumes about your service. As we pulled into town, I called your hotel, since I like HI Express for great beds and usually, their cleanliness. I am a rewards member, and try to be loyal. The desk clerk that answered your phone let me know quickly that you were sold out, and when I asked if there were any rooms held for IHG members, she rudely snapped at me with the same statement, as if I'm deaf and dumb. Needless to say, Hilton got our business for the following nights. I will never be checking with you again on any return trips to Klamath Falls. Kindness goes a long way. Use it!

author: E4140JIbobb
title: Excellent experience
text: This is a clean, comfortable hotel with very attentive front desk staff. The breakfast was good with a wide variety of hot and cold food. Check in was fast and easy. The bed was comfortable. The room was spacious. The location is right in town with walking distance to some restaurants. I really had no complaints. It was a pleasant experience.

author: cklonowski
title: Very Nice, Well Located
text: We were returning from viewing the Eclipse and spent one night at this excellent hotel. Agree that the parking was a bit limited, but everything else met or exceeded expectations. Greeted as a Gold Elite, room was even marked with our IHG Rewards status, lol. Large, spacious, clean rooms with Keurig coffee, microwave and fridge. Comfy bed. Close to markets and stores if you want to stock up on food or drink. Did not try the fitness room but it looked clean and well maintained. Breakfast was standard HI fare, and well stocked. Would recommend and stay again!

author: Houstonian2008
title: One of the cleanest Holiday Inns we have stayed at...
text: The hotel is probabaly recently built, at least it seems like that from the inside. Very clean and well designed. The front desk staff was very helpful in getting us checked in quickly. They had taken the extra efforts to mark our room door with a welcome sign indicating our "membership" level with IHG. I could see other doors in the hallway marked with their respecitive membership level. Parking is shared with the nearby hotel but, there is sufficient available. The location of the hotel is apparently on the "main" street as we could find Strabucks and other places to eat very close by. Nice experience.

author: debbieg775
title: Clean, Large and Friendly
text: We stayed one night while passing through Klamath Falls. The hotel staff was so friendly and helpful both when checking in and out. They gave us a map of the area and directions to our next stop. The room was large, we had a 2 queen room with the sofa bed. It was nice, clean and very comfortable. The bed was wonderful. The room had it's own thermastat so the temperature was easily controlled. The breakfast was good, and had a lot of usual options including "cook your own" waffles. We didn't use the pool or hot tub, but the breakfast room was large and clean.

author: ForeverDiscerning
title: Best hotel in Klamath Falls
text: Took the family including children and grandchildren . We occupied two rooms side by side. We were in K Falls for bird watching in the lower Klamath area. The birds did not disappoint and neither did Holiday Inn. Staff were helpful and friendly, breakfast was especially good with an outstanding hostess! Rooms and bedding were first class. One minor suggestion. If you like to take baths I suggest you bring a bath tub vinyl pillow as the back of tub is straight vertical.

author: Zeppy123
title: FANTASTIC
text: We had a great stay. This hotel appears pretty new. It is decorated well, impeccably clean and everything is in good working order. It was really quite at night, and the beds are really comfortable. The included breakfast is better than what is well above average. Our room had a hair dryer, fridge, microwave, Kuerig coffeemaker, Flatscreen and a DVD Player. The location is convenient. The bath is large. At $112/night for 2 queens, it is a good value.

author: G8888UEjohnd
title: Got a couple of surprises at this hotel.
text: We were traveling from Reno to Tualatin and this was about half way and made a convenient place to stop. Klamath Falls is nice small town. So we checked in and it took a little while but the lady on reception was great, so we go up to our room stick the card in the door and as we were opening it we hear a guys calling out he was in the room. That was the first surprise. So we go down to reception and the nice lady was shocked and was so apologetic about it we just had to laugh. She gave me hospitality points and the goodie bags. Next morning I had some nice holiday inn express breakfast but my wife was not hungry but the lady in the restaurant made her take some food with her for the drive. That was our second surprise which was just how nice the staff were. Oh and the room was fine as well.

author: 170lorig
title: Klamath Falls
text: This is such a nice place to stay. New and clean. Friendly staff. Comfortable bed. Good food. Nothing negative to say. Asked for first floor away from elevator and that is what I got. Also got a military discount because we were there for my son.

author: JimM466
title: Comfortable hotel
text: The Holiday Inn Express at Klamath Falls is a decent place to stay. The staff were enthusiastic and helpful. The room we had was huge and it had a small lounge area. The shower was very good and the bed was comfy. There's a coin-operated laundry on site, which we found to be handy. The hotel has an indoor heated pool and a small gym, plus there's plenty of parking on-site. A self-serve breakfast is available in the breakfast room, with a fair bit of choice. The coffee wasn't so crash hot but plenty of people seemed happy to drink it. The walls between rooms are pretty thin, so if you have inconsiderate neighbours you could have your sleep disturbed.

author: SandiG680
title: Ok hotel, nothing spectacular, but was clean
text: We stayed here due to a fire at our parents home, did we love it...no, but we also didn't hate it. Con. Air conditioning unit either froze you out or roasted you. We had the wall thermostat set to 72 degrees, the room got to 80 before it kicked on, and then down to 62 before it shut off. It made it impossible to sleep through the night. Pro. Location to our needed was perfect, it was clean and staff very friendly. Breakfast was a nice large spread with a big assortment. We were only able to stay 3 night because they were full. Had to move to hotel next door for the remainder of our stay.

author: amandamE8698SM
title: No glasses
text: This is a nice Holiday Inn. We had never been in this area so can't say much about the city, although not impressed with what I saw. I'm sure there are nice areas of town, I iust did not see any. The hotel is clean and conveniently located. The pool is clean and nice. Gave it four stars because they don't offer glassware in the rooms...only plastic. We even asked at the front desk only to receive more plastic cups. Oh well, overall a nice place!

author: mel_rainbowchildcare
title: Lovely hotel, great breakfast
text: We stayed here being IHG members you know that this brand is normally great, and it was. The hotel is at the top end of the town. The is a shell garage about 3 minutes walk away and a resteraunt next door. The hotel was very clean and there is an indoor pool on the ground floor. The rooms are modern and spacious and very clean. My only criticism is that our room was directly above the pool, room 205, and there was a large family in there who were quite loud and we could here this very clearly in our room. Breakfast was great. There is plenty of choice from cereals and breads, as well as yogurt and fruit. The staff member that was in the dining room was really cheery and pleasant. Overall would definitely recommend staying here.

author: thebeatgoeson
title: Very Nice Hotel
text: The Holiday Inn was perfect. It was very clean and quiet. The room was very well furnished. It was a good size for a standard room. Good size bathroom. There was plenty of free parking. Breakfast was included. The young girl who was being trained at the reception was was friendly. I will most certainly stay here again I would not think of staying any where else.

author: squareboy001
title: Not bad not fantastic
text: Older Holiday Inn express. Nothing fancy. Hard to get to off the highway. My mom left her jacket hanging in the closet in accident. Of course when we called it wasn't found. Shame on us for accidentally leaving it. All in all it was a late night stop over nothing fancy. The room was clean.

author: JanuaryA_12
title: First Visit
text: First visit to Klamath Falls and the Holiday Inn Express. I was pleased with both. We were in town to visit an acquaintance. I was impressed with every aspect of our stay at the Klamath Falls Holiday Inn Express. From check in to check out. The friendliest staff, especially the lady at the breakfast, I wish I would've gotten her name, she was so kind and pleasant. The front desk staff was as well and quick with check in/out. The room was large, clean, and well appointed. Included a nice kitchenette type set up too. Don't know when I might return to Klamath Falls, but if I do...I know where I'm staying!

author: Birddog06
title: Nice little Gem in Klamath Falls
text: We were in town over a long weekend for the State Bowling Tournament. Overall impression of the hotel was good. Front desk was great during check and throughout our stay.. Room was comfortable and clean , beds were comfortable offering two pillow types ( soft and firm) , nice touch! Free WiFi worked perfectly , and the business center suited my needs for a few quick minutes related to work. Pool area was OK, it was kept clean and was well maintained , your typical indoor pool, overall the grounds were nice and parking was never a problem for our accord. Breakfast was decent offering several choices , your typical complimentary breakfast choices ( cereal / biscuits gravy / pancakes / yogurts) , it filled the need. The staff during breakfast attended to all our needs, we were very pleasantly surprised with their attention to detail (Special call out to Mellisa) as they kept our tables clean , our coffee warm and if we needed anything they would find it for you , this made our breakfast mornings a pleasure! For the price it was a decent stay , no real complaints over the 3 nights we were their , thanks for a great stay and would recommend.

author: skidoocarol
title: Loved It!
text: This hotel was amazing! We stayed two nights (which it could have been longer) and very completely satisfied. The staff is friendly and does an awesome job. The rooms clean and cheery decor. Great breakfast and the lady that runs it, an angel! Never ran out of food and she was busy, always smiling and friendly. Great workout room and pool. Perfect location! When we go back, this is where we will stay!

author: 560BrianR
title: Nice and clean
text: What you always expect from this chain. Easy to find and near downtown. Room was clean and quiet, staff was friendly. Breakfast was typical. Price was typical for area. Easy return to highway. Place was relatively new. Restaurants nearby.

author: Jim77406
title: Best Thing About This Hotel...
text: The morning breakfast was always awesome and the lady that worked the morning breakfast was super friendly and helpful. She deserves a raise!! The front desk staff was always friendly and helpful. Our room was comfortable but the beds have had too many kids jumping on them. Room 301 if you are interested. Best thing about the hotel...it's right next door to a Sizzler which has take out if you want it. The Shell station is right next door to the Sizzler and within waking distance if you need a cold beer or bottle of wine. I would definitely stay here again if we are in the area again.

author: OutdoorBoomer
title: Clean, comfortable and quiet
text: What you would expect from a hotel in this chain. Everything was as it should be. Clean. Nice staff. Decent breakfast for a hotel breakfast. Quiet. The WiFi worked fine. Convenient to highway and dining.

author: MariaK374
title: Very Good stay
text: We stayed here for Labor Day weekend. It was completely full which isn't surprising since it was a holiday weekend. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They could have gotten the lady doing breakfast some help though because she was beyond busy. She handled it very well though. She did a great job. The walks are very thin send noise between rooms and the hall was bad. Over all though it was a very good stay.

author: Janban53
title: Excellent choice for a comfortable stay
text: Stayed in a suite. Impeccably clean large room and bathroom, Check-in staff were very polite, courteous and helpful. The elevators and general entrance area are very clean. Hot breakfast was adequate. Indoor swimming pool is a plus in a city where days are hot outside. Centrally located with eating places and shops within walking distance. Wifi worked very well. I would recommend this place for anyone who wants a comfortable stay in a classy place which is a level higher than most motels.

author: gmbasa
title: Great place to crash after a long drive.
text: Totally enjoyed this hotel in Klamath Falls. Nice big room with comfortable bed, also had a hottub in our room which we didn't use. We did use the main hot tub and indoor swimming pool and had the chance to socialize with other people. Refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, WiFi and internet, hot breakfast, extremely helpful friendly staff. Centrally located in town and easy walk to restaurants and businesses. If I had the time I would gladly stay another night or two. Definetly will stay again in the future. What more could you want?

author: Wahiawakid
title: Fine for one night
text: We spent one night in K Falls after touring Crater Lake. The hotel was fine. Nothing extraordinarily positive. Typical breakfast; usual noise of neighboring guests shutting-slamming doors and talking in hall well after 10 PM; Wi-fi so-so. Wi-fi access is erratic, therefore frustrating. The connection was sketchy when we checked in, non-existent before we went to sleep, then fast and powerful the next morning. If you're depending on access while there, you'd best bring a cable or ask for one at the desk. The room and bathroom were nicely decorated, but the bathroom lighting was very dark.

author: Zumwalt
title: About what you'd expect
text: Room was clean. Staff was pretty friendly. The free local paper in the lobby area was nice. The lady in the breakfast area was especially nice, I didn't eat anything there besides drinking some milk because I'm not a big fan of the food they serve but she did make you feel welcome. The one thing that was somewhat annoying was that I was placed in a room right next to the elevators which tend to be the nosier area of the hotel. Not being familiar with the hotel it would have been nice to have known about the placement of the room prior to check in and offered a chance to upgrade or even offered a free one. They weren't that busy and most other hotels I frequent tend to upgrade without me even asking. Overall not too bad.

author: SFOFrequentTraveler
title: Excellent propery
text: This is a great property. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room is spacious and very clean. My room had a microwave and small refrigerator. The bathroom is also large and very clean. The hallways are well lit and clean. The breakfast selections were somewhat slim, but sufficient. I would definitely stay here again.

author: 811hung
title: A restful stay on the way to Crater Lake
text: From the San Francisco Bay Area, there are two main routes to Crater Lake - one through Ashland and Medford in the west, and Klamath Falls in the east. We decided on Klamath Falls as it was a bit closer to Crater Lake and easier to get to if we stayed overnight there. Unlike Medford, Klamath Falls appears to be much smaller town, and hotels were a bit more sparse. At the end of the day, after looking at smaller mom-and-pop hotels, we chose Holiday Inn for its reputation as a well established brand, and weren't disappointed. The hotel, although located a bit farther away from the downtown area, offered safe, clean, and modern accommodations. This meant pretty good value for the buck, with plentiful free parking and free wi-fi. The hotel staff was very friendly, and overall, we did not have any issues with room noise. The hotel is located right across the street from a Safeway, so it was easy to stock up on snacks and drinks as we needed.

author: SeniorExplorer
title: Excellent Location
text: My wife and I stopped at this Klamath Falls Holiday Inn Express for the night while traveling to Crater Lake, Oregon. Centrally located this newer hotel is located near several eating establishments that are all a short walk from the hotel. A large shopping center is also within walking distance.
