The hotel is clean, parking plentiful and a very friendly and accommodating staff. The rooms are very nice and clean and just what you would expect from this chain. Crater Lake itself is a little over an hour away and an easy drive. Once you leave Klamath Falls the conveniences other than gasoline are few so you may want to obtain those needed items before proceeding out of the general area. Almost directly across the street from the hotel is a Subway sandwich shop which allowed us to pack a lunch before reaching the old volcano. We would not hesitate to stay at this hotel if we should be passing through in the future.

author: rparsons1000
title: Second visit, good as usual
text: Holiday Inn Express properties can be good or excellent. This particular property is in between as far as being clean, amenities, etc. However, on this visit they really shined when it comes to staff. Everyone one awesome. Monique assisted me with some travel changes saving me nearly $200 and jesika in the meal area blew my mind. She actually prepared boxes of cinnamon buns for me and my guest as my hands were full at the time, put them in a bag and put that in my hand. Way cool. Kudos to the staff here.

author: bodeineHR
title: Everything we wanted and more!
text: Stayed here as a base for Crater Lake trips. This hotel appears to be brand new. The staff was very friendly and accomodating. The woman who ran the breakfast room was attentive, bustling and intent on providing us a real breakfast complete with motherly concern. The room was clean, modern and wonderfully comfortable. The value for the money was so spot on, I hesitate to write this review lest I have trouble making a reservation next visit. I am a Platinum Marriott Member and I'd rather stay here. Convenient location to highway, Klamath Falls Creamery Brewery, downtown, food market, Walmart...everything a traveling family needs. Thanks to the staff for a wonderful stay.

author: barbaraw911
title: Nice hotel
text: My two sisters and I stayed here before joining our Klamath Falls family. The desk staff were welcoming and friendly. We were "upgraded" to a room on the fourth floor. The double queen beds were very comfortable, with very nice linen and the TV channels plentiful. We had a refrigerator in the room - great to keep our left-over Chinese food. The pool and hot tub were indoors...didn't use the pool but the hot tub was clean, didn't smell of mildew (one of my huge complaints about hot tubs in general) and provided a way to relax the back muscles after sitting/driving for hours. Complimentary breakfast was ample with a variety of options...loved the cinnamon rolls. I definitely would stay here again and recommend it to other travelers.

author: Slmpneverest
title: Pretty good.
text: There was nothing particularly bad about our 4 night stay at this hotel, but it was not impressive compared to our 5 night stay was had just before this at a Marriott of similar price per night. This holiday inn had the same terrible and cheap breakfast food that we have all come to expect from Holiday Inn and most other hotel chains. As usual the styrofoam plates were a big turnoff (why don't people understand that paper plates leave much less of a footprint in landfills and polution?). The plumbing fixtures in this hotel were cheap and Chinese built, not Koehler as they should be. The Wi-Fi didn't work at all except for our first night. Most importantly, the rooms were clean and quite. Room service kept everything well. There was a fridge and a small bar sink in the main room.

author: DKNBJ
title: Nice room, poor internet
text: The room was large, clean, and spacious ... Couldn't ask for a better room. Service was fine, and the food was as a Holiday Inns are. The internet wifi was marginal at best. Kept cutting out on basic applications... lucky to get this review written. Would stay here again tho because of the large rooms.... wish it was closer to downtown.

author: TerreG
title: Great Overnight Place to Stay
text: This Holiday Inn Express was a very pleasant surprise. The building/rooms are new, comfortable, very clean, and have roomy bathrooms. We had a "suite" which included a sofa couch, microwave and frig. The staff was friendly and helpful. The breakfast was in a spacious room that included coffee, juices, muffins, oatmeal, eggs, bacon, cereal, biscuits and gravy. The downsize is that is a ways from business 97, but is worth it. There is a Sizzler Restuarant (which we didn't try) right on the property. It was also very quiet and all rooms are non smoking.

author: BrendaE202
title: Wonderful
text: Stayed at the Holiday Inn in Klamath Falls for the first time this last weekend. We were welcomed to the hotel my a gal who you could tell enjoyed her job. She was pleasant, helpful and a joy to talk to. The rooms were very nice, beds were oh so comfortable. The pool was a welcome sight after being cooped up in the car for some time. Breakfast that is served was the only thing that wasn't quite what I expected. They served a omlet, but found it to be kind of rubbery. Coffee a little strong for my liking, but may be pleasant to someone else. Overall, very good experience. Would welcome another stay there!!

author: loonqueen
title: Enjoyed our Stay
text: On the road for several hours and stayed here. What a wonderful treat! The young man who checked us in was extremely cordial and helpful. The room was huge and exceptionally clean. We had a huge indoor pool all to ourselves. The fitness room was nice. Breakfast was good too. Would stay here again just for the kindness of the front desk clerk alone! The hotel was full, but no noise and comfortable beds.

author: carolynkernow48
title: excellent value and very comfortable stay
text: Stayed here at the end of a long road trip and found it very comfortable. Great help from the receptionist who went above and beyond the call of duty we had wondered whether to stay two nights and if we would find anything to do. She told us about the Lava Beds national Park only 40 miles away. We found our way there and were so glad we did, fascinating highly recommended to all who have time to spare. Wear sensible shoes as going into caves is involved! I didn't realise and wished I had and could have done more. We have found this chain of hotels to be very reliable always clean and comfortable beds, and excellent value. We also went to the cinema only about 10 minutes away in the car and easy to find, map provided by the hotel.

author: Nrgyxtra
title: Nice and comfy!
text: Oh so comfy at the end of the day. Never go wrong. Great staff. Bed was comfy. Slept like a baby. Breakfast was good. Thanks for a great night stay. Easily accessible to great restaurants in the area.

author: 715pattyp
title: Older, sort of dreary building; few guests; untoward kitchen staff
text: Receptionist was courteous, seemed like he might have been a new employee. I aSked for a non-pillowtop bed, but the manager said all Holiday Inn Expresses have only pillowtops. There were very few guests and the lobby was large, drab and empty feeling. We ate at Red's BBQ, which was terrible. Walked to nearby Rite-Aid store to shop. We slept well, had good temp control. Two problems: Very dim bathroom lighting and a kitchen employee who was loudly telling another guest about her personal problems....pregnant unmarried daughter, which she seemed to brag about, being overworked, etc. It was super disgusting to hear all this. I may have gotten the details of her story wrong, but just know I didn't like what I was hearing. I suggest the manager have a talk with her re leaving her family lore at home.

author: nextmike
title: Deceptive Policies
text: As a Priority Club member, for the first time ever I can say I am literally "outraged" by the policy of a member hotel. Upon arriving with my dog I am told that there is a deposit of $100 required for my dog. Oh, and that this deposit is non-refundable? Say what?! The hotel claims its a deposit but it's not anything of the sort. It's a PET FEE of $100. This hotel is listed as pet friendly and that's a crock. The manager refused to accommodate me, a regular Holiday Inn customer. I immediately cancelled my reservation on the spot and went to a nice local establishment which charged me a reasonable $16 pet fee.

author: Winegirl6
title: Very decent place to stay
text: THis place took us in after the Olympic Inn screwed up our reservation and had no availability. Front desk treated us kindly even though he was slammed with checkins (they should have more than one person at the front desk). Room was spacious and clean and easily fit all of us with a rollaway. Don't expect any good views, its located right in the middle of the town. Close to food, Safeway and all shopping. Swimming pool and spa was scary and dirty. Over chlorinated and light in the spa kept flickering (electrical problems and water definitely don't mix). It's a perfect place for a one night stopover while getting to Crater lake. Morning breakfast was surprisingly good and plenty of food.

author: ilovetouring
title: Great Room but Noisy Air conditioning
text: A relatively new hotel that had plenty of space. We were asked which floor we would like and ended up on the fourth. Great reception for free wi fi. Went to ask for recommendations for a restaurant and the clerk mentioned several. The thing that stood out in this room was the height of the loo and the exceptionally clean bathroom. Unfortunately the air - conditioning was so noisy that I had to turn it off and rely on opening the window for a breeze of fresh air. The complimentary breakfast was fresh and very tasty. Tables were quickly cleared and the staff were very attentive.

author: NorthCountryWriter
title: Finally a decent chair!
text: We work as we travel and a good eronomic chair is a must. This place had one and it even adjusted in height. The only one we came across in our month on the road! But again here was the heavy quilt with no blanket in the room as an option. Kind of forces a person to rev up the air conditioning. PLASTIC CUPS again. Hate 'em. If management must resort to this measure, could they please provide a recycling facility in the room. And please remove the 'we care so much about the environment' signs at the same time.

author: RAirStreamers
title: Clean and Comfortable
text: Stayed 1 night at this property after visiting Crater Lake National Park. Very clean and comfortable, with a Sizzler Restaurant across the parking lot. Property was clean and well-maintained. Good breakfast, although they had run out of breakfast meat and did not refill it. Great cinnamon rolls. Staff was friendly enough, although the desk clerk "disappeared" for about an hour during the early evening when we needed some assistance. However she re-appeared a little later and was able to help us with what we needed. All in all this was a pleasant stay. Typical Holiday Inn Express, which is actually a pretty good thing.

author: SFtransplant
title: New Modern Hotel
text: Very nice modern hotel. Rooms were large with a separate sink/microwave/frig area outside of the bathroom. Extra large bathroom with granite counter tops. New beds were firm and comfortable. The room was quiet and the staff was professional. Great spot to visit both Crater Lake National Park (north) and Lava Beds National Park (south). Each park is about an hour away. Several restaurants nearby the hotel to choose from. Will come back again soon. Nice business area, exercise room, indoor pool and sauna.

author: debbiejo
title: Very Nice Hotel
text: This hotel is brand new and very nice. My room was very large with a microwave and fridge. The bed was really comfortable. The bathroom was not huge, but it was modern. There is a business center with 2 computers, although they do charge for printing which I did not like. There is a small gym and an indoor pool (which is also small) and a hot tub. Breakfast was adequate with hot and cold choices. There are stores close by and although the hotel is on a main street, I heard no street noise at all. The hotel is only 3 miles from the airport which is also convenient. I would definitely stay there again if I was ever in th area.

author: espressoHE
title: Functional
text: A rather drab, functional hotel just on the edge of the Bonn city centre. The rooms are absolutely fine and comfortable enough. The bathrooms are small and dated. Breakfast, however, is excellent - lots of choice. What I think is missing is some management attention to detail and staff training: 1 bathrobe and pair of slippers in a room booked for 2, no spoons to go with the in room tea and coffee making facilities. And reception staff are unable to answer basic questions like how do I get the bus to the airport or basic questions about local transport. It’s as if they’ve never been to Bonn or had no training whatsoever - really surprising for a Hilton. In terms of room tips - avoid being located near the lifts which are noisy. I wouldn’t recommend the Bonn Hilton.

author: Ivanmil
title: Nothing is real
text: This is something looking like a hotel but it is not. In a hotel it is at least warm and cause - here it is cold and unfriendly. The temperature in the rooms is 20 degrees. I tried 3 days to convince the staff to do something but I was not able to. Everyone says that it is not his job. There is not a mini bar in the rooms. My room smells terribly as obviously it has been for smokers before - but nobody asked me if I want a smoker room. At the end they tried to charge me for the parking but I was without car. Do you thing that this looks like a hotel?

author: lthammari
title: Great Hotel, Friendly Staff
text: I enjoyed my stay here. The front desk staff were very friendly and spoke english perfectly. The room was comfortable and quiet. The morning breakfast buffet was great with a good variety of hot options. The gym was small but the sauna was nice. The hotel is located in a good area where you can run along the river banks or tour the downtown area. I would stay here again and recommend for other travelers. Parking in the garage was easy as well.

author: wasaloadie
title: Second time here, a warm welcome
text: This is my second time staying at the Hilton in Bonn. You always receive a warm welcome here. The hotel is ideally situated on the banks of the Rhein, easy walking distance into the city centre. The staff are all cheerful and seem to really enjoy working here which builds a good atmosphere in the hotel and helps make the stay more enjoyable. Excellent gym facility with plenty of machines and weights. Nice pool (approx. 7m square, sauna available in the evening. The breakfast is superb! excellent choice and they will cook most things to order if requested. Having stayed in other hotels in the city, this is my preferred hotel which is why I have returned.

author: karimiirungu
title: Great Business Hotel
text: The Hilton Hotel in Bonn is just a few minutes away from the convergence of transportation in Bonn. It is a great hotel if you are visiting for business. This would mean that you are not really in the hotel not of the time. It is very clean, great lighting, great ambiance and spacious, and the cleaning staff cleaned the rooms we were staying in very fast and well, just missing out on a few details like shower gel and body lotion (we had to get some from the spa the first day we checked in!). I would recommend that they include a few more perks for first time visitors (which I was), including free WiFi and water if you are staying in the hotel, as we had to register as hotel card members to get water. I would also recommend that the attention to visitors be better, especially when they are not feeling well. Also things like hotel-arranged tours of the city for first timers or old-timers 😉 could go a long way in showing the hospitality reminiscent of a great hotel. The food was great and the location is right where you can access a hospital, eating sites and just to walk around and see the sights. All in all, it was a great stay that I had, despite being unwell, and hope to go back soon.

author: K1869RGtomm
title: Excellent hotel and a great location for runners
text: Easy to get too and from as bus stop from Cologne/Bonn airport within sight of the hotel and a tram stop approx 200m away Had a nice big twin room with a coffee machine, good internet, reasonable aircon, a safe and good WiFi. Large flatscreen TV. Breakfast was good but pricey at Euro 25 unless you paid in advance in which case Euro 20. However the breakfast was good. A nice bar area in the hotel foyer and lots of bars/restaurants within walking distance. I believe the hotel has a gym and pool but the weather was nice when I was there so I ran outside. The hotel is right alongside the Kennedy Bridge and looking up river the next bridge is just over 2 miles away so you can run on the river bank there and back for 4 miles. Going down river you can run across the bridge, down the other side of the river, cross the bridge and run back to the hotel for a 4.25 mile run. There was a good supply of Taxis always at the front door. Check in/out was fast so 5 stars.

author: Markpicc
title: Very nice hotel - close to the action
text: Stayed here for a couple nights during a recent business trip. Very nice hotel. Front desk staff very pleasant and helpful. Rooms are clean. Well appointed. Walking distance to many of Bonn’s attractions. Would certainly stay again. Good choice.

author: tal27
title: Very pleasant stay
text: Stayed two nights in May. We had a room on the fourth floor (which have small balconies) and on the quiet side of the hotel (away from the road that leads to the bridge). Good location and walking distance to everything. The decor is the usual Hilton style, predictable and inoffensive. I found the bed comfortable although the bathroom was little cold and clinical. Good TV selection with some English news channels. Best parts were the service which was uniformly very good, and the breakfast which was excellent. Only reason for the 4 stars was that housekeeping was a little lax (not replacing towels etc). All issues were strictly rectified, but for the small inconvenience I deducted one point.

author: ArmenGrigoryan
title: Calm and clean in a good location
text: Hotel is located in the city center, by the river, 5 min walk to old town and 15 min walk to the train station. Airport bus stop is within 5 min walk. Rooms are not very spacious, but not small either. Depending on the room windows will look in the courtyard or street. Few things to note: mini bar was empty and you could pick up staff from the reception if you wanted to. How about being thirsty at 2 in the morning in your underwear? Another thing is that there was no shoe horn. I realize this is not a mandatory accessory, but for a Hilton is probably a must. And the last BIG thing is that make sure your room is close to the wifi router. Mine was not and the internet was VERY bad.

author: MichaelD109
title: Superb Experience
text: This Hilton has great comfortable rooms and is located within 300 feet from the Rhine River. Very friendly staff with quick response times when you need something. Great fitness room swimming pool anf sauna as well. Walked 5 min to a great breakfast cafe. Located in center of Bonn. 10 min walk to Beethoven Museum. Definetly worth the stay. They loan you an umbrella if needed esch day also for free.

author: GYWX
title: Good value and location and breakfast
text: We stayed in the Hilton in Bonn just after Christmas, best value of the trip. Room had a view of the Rhine, Full-service hotel and reasonable for 110/night B&B for two. Busy place. Very convenient to old town and 66 bus line to Museum Mile. Excellent breakfast choice including an omelette made to order. I used the gym facilities, not the sauna. Wifi is free only if you are a HHonors customer – become one simply by giving them your email address. The SB self-service laundry is only a 15 min walk away. The Bonn Regio Welcomecard is sold by the Tourist office for one day's travel and free or discounted entrance to museums.

author: allichka
title: Great hotel close to Christmas market
text: Great hotel on the river. As a Hilton diamond member, I received an upgraded room with a view of the river. Only minor complaint was that the sink started draining extremely slowly. I let the staff know when I checked out. They thanked me for telling them and said they would have maintenance address it immediately. Breakfast was a lovely spread. The location was prefect. It was a very short was to the Christmas market. I would definitely stay here again.

author: zeinabelle
title: Enjoyable stay
text: My husband was on a business trip but I joined him. The room we stayed in was lovely and nicely furnished and decorated and very clean (I am OCD). The club lounge located on the first floor is a great and relaxing place to have tea or spend the afternoon or have an evening snack. The food served in the lounge in the afternoons is amazing. The train station is a walking distance from the hotel. The hotel is also located next to the Rhine river. We had many enjoyable walks by the river. I highly recommend this lovely hotel.

author: DadaGee
title: Professional
text: As soon as we arrived at the Hilton Bonn, we knew we were getting a better class of service. Warmly greeted by Mohammed at the door, despite being hot and sweaty on our bikes, we were effortlessly checked in, taken to the cycle store, and then shown to our rooms. A large room with everything you could want - comfortable bed, great bathroom, wifi, kettle, air conditioning, fridge, loads of space, and the bonus of our own sound system. The pool was wonderfully cooling and calm (bathrobes, towels and slippers are provided). We had the hotel breakfast next morning - a typical business-class German hotel breakfast buffet, with literally everything - from make-your-own smoothies, through fruit, breads, pastries, cooked meals and sparkling wine. All in all, our stay certainly lived up to expectations - a calm and professional overnight in a large city centre hotel. A special mention for the smiling and efficient Lisa who always seemed to ready to help at the front desk. €110 for the room was certainly good value for money. Breakfast is an extra €20, and well worth it if you are looking for something to set you up for the day. Definitely recommended.

author: Travelling722
title: Perfect!
text: Hilton quality is THE QUALITY. Large rooms nice services. Fantastic SPA and gym. We had the upgrade for free and it means you can have lots of additional benefits. Staff was pleasant. The hotel is close to the river and to the city center. Basically you can walk to the most popular places. Everything was ok.

author: 60yarsofage
title: Really nice hotel
text: Stayed for three night in a spacious twin room. Really nice and quiet although it faced the street. Breakfast good and staff friendly. You can easily walk to the city centre with shops, museums and restaurants. And the trams to e.g. The MuseumMile, the railway and other parts of the town and to towns along the Rhein are only a few minutes' walk from the hotel, if you do not arrive by car. Swimming pool and fitness area clean and nice, too. Only thing to critizise: one of the two lifts in our wing of the hotel did not seem to work - we waited for a l o o n g time, every time we needed to get to or from our room!

author: 791karenn
title: Nice
text: My room faced the street and the river and I loved it. There is not much traffic so very little noise. The hotel is a 2 minute walking distance to shops and restaurants, as well as to the boat rides on the river.My only surprise was the late check in: 12 noon which meant sitting in the lobby for about an hour, exhausted from a 12 hour journey. Some of my co-participants had sat there even longer! The staff are great: everyone greets you with a big smile and any issues are handled fast and efficiently. The biggest downer was lack of drinking water: there were bottles for sale at 4 euro! I have never been in a hotel that does not offer one complementary bottle of drinking water! The mini bar was absolutely empty (I thought having stuff in the fridge was a marketing gimmick?)

author: ArgentineTango
title: Really good hotel with lovely staff
text: I had a very pleasant stay at the Hilton. The location was really good for the city. I was checked in by a particularly helpful and pleasant gentleman who was full of helpful information. The room was very comfortable with a large bed and a well equipped bathroom. I always like the bath products in the Hilton chain. The room was quiet and had good wifi connections. I had some food from room service which was excellent. It was well presented and promptly delivered. The breakfast was also very nice with lovely fresh juices, pastries and a really good muesli. I would definitely stay here again and think it's a lovely example of the Hilton chain.

author: Tirilalli
title: Excellent hotel. Great location
text: The hotel is perfectly located near the Rhine river and 5 minutes walk from old town. Some rooms don't have river view but even when directly on the street they are very calm. Also some rooms are smoking. Rooms are spacious and very well equiped with complementarity coffee and tea making. Bathroom is spacious and well equipped with all what is needed even body lotion. The breakfast buffet directly by the river is excellent and offers a wide variety of food. Didn't have time to try the pool and fitness club so can't say much about it. As an overall this hotel was an excellent experience.

author: febit_12
title: Great Stay
text: We are Hilton Honors member, usually we checked in via Hilton App, but this time we did not do it via App, because all the rooms that they offered via App were not interesting (all of them are facing the streets). Our checked in at the hotel went smoothly and efficiently. LISA took care of us very well, she accommodated my request for a quiet & refurbished room. Furthermore, we love the room; everything is new, spacious and very comfortable. The breakfast buffet satisfied our needs; highlight on the tasty & fluffy eggs. The location are perfect for us. We enjoyed to stroll along the Rhein river with our dog. In short, we really enjoyed our stay and we might come back again for a short break. Hopefully when we come back, all the staffs will have Lisa's charm and warm attention towards the guests.

author: GoeieWitte
title: Convenient, Crisp, Clean
text: Conveniently located for a jog along the Rhine or a walk to center city. Onsite (expensive) parking. I had a reservation and was quickly greeted and checked in. The whole hotel looks crisp and clean. Room was clean and neat with all amenities functional. Room looks neutral standard. The breakfast self serve is great with a lot of variety in options. While the indoor seating area feels fine, patio breakfast during warmer weather must be a treat. Friendly service by all staff.

author: jolier787
title: Great location, great staff
text: Great Hilton in Bonn. Comfortable and in a great location - walking distance to everything. The hotel staff were exceptional, getting us checked in quickly to the adjoining rooms we requested. Breakfast was lovely, a good selection. Awesome shower. The pool is small, but not terrible. The on site massage therapist was fabulous and stayed late on a Saturday. Parking is extra but we were able to leave out car there while we took a river cruise even though we had checked out of the hotel already. Will stay again.

author: Cosmin2010
title: Excellent staff, refurbishment should be considered
text: Stayed at this Hilton a couple of nights. The staff is fantastic, great help especially Lisa always smiling and very nice. Breakfast is very good - it has many options and the staff is again very nice and helpful. The only negative about this hotel is that a serious refurbishment should be considered. Room was clean but overall it looks like the '90s. However the staff compensates by far this inconvenient. The hotel is very convenient for reaching city center and has it's own restaurant which is good and also access to other restaurants which are also very good (Olive - greek specific) which is in walking distance. Will I be back? Most probably, Yes!

author: Pomerols
title: Consistently good
text: The Hilton Bonn is a good hotel with an outstanding location and a good restaurant. Some rooms have great views of the Rhine some of the town. The service is always very efficient and professional. The lounge is not very "cozy" being on the main level where the front desk is, but the beers are very good! The parking underneath is very big and well lighted. I have arrived there with a rental car at 10 pm and felt very safe because of the safety gate (a "curtain" goes up and down) at the entrance of the parking. The elevator takes you at the main level of the hotel. The parking entrance is located on Josephstrass at the back of the hotel.

author: TomD205
title: First time
text: There is a lot to be said about Bonn Hilton, but most of it is very positive. After a long discussion about the extra tourist tax which is levied in Bonn and many other cities in Germany. The different was that the Mayor of Bonn and his fellow compadres at the local IRS demands that you fill in a special form for this tax which I have never experienced in any other Hotel/Town in Germany. That means bad grades for the Mayor. However everything turned out nicely and we received a room with a view of the River Rhine. The room was not very b ig but had all you need including excellent maintenance. The best part was a young blond lady at the front desk who did everything that could be done to make our stay enjoyable. I do not remember her name but there could not be that many blondes working at the front desk. She should be commended.

author: AGGlobalTraveler
title: The best in Bonn
text: Booked a night at the Hilton Bonn Hotel, during a weekend visit to Germany to enjoy the Christmas markets. The hotel is located not far from the city center, and most of the attractions are within walking distance or a quick tram ride. Train station is also a few minutes away in the tram. We received received a very warm welcome from Lisa, who made sure our questions were answered and quickly processed the check-in. Overall we had a great stay. The room was very spacious and had an amazing view of the river. The staff was very courteous and always had a smile. Check-out process was also very fast. We did not try any of the facilities (sauna, pool, gym), but they looked in very good shape.

author: PETERY229
title: Short trip, first time in Bonn, nice hotel!
text: Very typical Hilton, very clean. It's in a nice little part of town, super quiet, even at 2am on a Friday. The only complaint I have is the awful dubstep playing on repeat in the lobby non-stop. I don't know how the workers handle it, it's really awful! The front desk workers were amazing, the beer was decently-priced, but the rum was exorbitant. I didn't select this hotel, I came here with myself and 10 co-workers, and we all had a nice, comfortable time. Bed was hard, but comfortable. Shower was impeccably clean. Would definitely stay again!

author: 3CTraveler
title: Very Nice
text: I stayed here two different nights. The first was excellent starting with a pleasant reception. I arrived early from my flight and my room was ready at noon. As a Diamond member I was upgraded to a very large suite. The second stay was also a nice reception and although the clerk said I was getting an upgrade, the room was not very large. Trying to put the coffee pot on the counter with the expresso machine was a challenge...they should have left one out. The lobby bar was okay but the barkeeper left frequently leaving the patrons alone. Breakfast was great with a good selection. Being right on the river was very nice for a afternoon walk.

author: IanDunstan
title: A great night in Bonn
text: Everything went perfectly. A lovely night spent in the hotel. Very easy to find with a nice river view. Very very friendly and helpful staff who we ultra quick and efficient. Quick to check in and out and never more than a minute wait at the bar. Rooms are nice a clean and a good size. Parking is expensive for an overnight but worth it for a secure garage. Will go back when next in Bonn.

author: JoachimH690
title: An extraordinary guest experience
text: This is a great whenever at the Rhine area around Cologne/Bonn. Very convenient located at the river Rhine but also close to the downtown area of Bonn. Rooms are excellent at a reasonable price level. However, the most important experience for us was the excellent friendliness of the Hotel staff which really counts for everybody from the reception until the housekeeping. My special positive experience was with the "Chef of the Restaurant", called Jana. My son did not wake in time for the breakfast and I come at the early afternoon and asked if we can get some food for him and Jana organized without hesitation (and no extra costs) something for him. Outstanding and she saved my day. Thank you.

author: gridiron62
title: Could be much better
text: Good things first: Very nice staff aims to please. Good breakfast but lacks omelette station. Unfortunately, aircon is iffy particularly at night when they turn it way down and that allows humidity to invade your room. I have observed this tactic before at other properties to "save money." Made August sleeping stuffy and uncomfortable. One day had no hot water. Showers are oddly designed so that you need to take care not to flood the bathroom. As mentioned elsewhere, Internet is barely usable. You are also limited to 3 devices - difficult with 2 people in a room on business. A good meeting and a butt kicking or two would improve this place a lot.

author: roslynb736
title: Hilton In Bonn
text: This hotel is a five star! Excellent staff, very professional and helpful. The facility is very clean and welcoming. It has a great gym, pool, saunas, and a spa. The hotel is in an excellent location to shopping areas and restaurant. Also in the back of the hotel is Rhine River a great place to spend time walking, biking, rollerblading alongside the path of the river. Or just sitting enjoying the view. I highly recommend this Hotel.

author: BillM439
title: reasonable.
text: this was one of the most expensive hilton's I've stayed in and not the best. It's quite a small hotel so maybe that had something to do with it. I also didn't get an upgrade which started off the stay poorly 😜 The Rhine view rooms are not great, at least the one I was in on the ground floor - trees obscure the view and it's too low to get a great view. would have been nice to have a bar on a higher floor with a nice view. On the positive side, breakfast, rooms, tv were perfect. the bar was very reasonably priced and probably Bonn's liveliest bar when I stayed. Public transport was also very accessible. Overall, I would stay here again.

author: JasperC532
title: Dissapointment
text: Hilton Bonn is past it! The rooms are out date and not well maintained. Same goes for the sauna and pool, the sauna was cold when we wanted to make use of it (during reg. Opening hours). Some of the staff are friendly but not committed to what they are doing. At check out they assumed we've had breakfast wich we didn't, someone probably by accident had mentioned a wrong room no. We felt treated as liers. When the issue was resolved we got a stiff 'goodbye', without even checking wether we enjoyed our stay.

author: LoneRanger701
title: Weekend break with friends
text: Booked Hotel for long weekend with friends, to celebrate a 40th birthday event. Although we arrived well before the allocated check in time of 2pm, the very friendly staff happily found us rooms early. I stayed in a Kings double on the 4th floor and found it to be spacious, clean and very comfortable. Breakfast selection was really good. Everything was fresh and regularly stocked. The gym had all you needed to work off the calories and we enjoyed using the pool and saunas. If you need a dressing gown and slippers for sauna, ask reception and they will have one delivered to your room. Bring a CD if you want to listen to music in gym or sauna as there is only a CD player !. Hotel is located within minutes walk to the city centre and all the main points of interest, making it a great base for any trip to Bonn. Overall, we had a wonderful 4 days at this Hotel and would recommend it to any of my friends planning to visit Bonn.

author: ChiantiSister
title: Very good hotel, great location, friendly staff
text: Recently spent two nights at this hotel. Room was lovely with a river view . Bed amazingly comfortable. Would recommend to couples and families . Good accessibility into Bonn City centre on foot. Central location helps with all transport. Short journey to the main station and further trips to Cologne etc . Free wifi an added bonus !!

author: travelkevin
title: Average, no complaints.
text: I stayed at the Hilton Bonn for one night to visit the Christmas markets. My stay was just fine. The room was OK. The service was unremarkable. The wifi worked. The lounge offered a place to relax with a beer in the evening. There is nothing exciting about this hotel. As another recent reviewer stated, it is a boring hotel. I didn't experience any problems.

author: MrRedLondon
title: Some Good and Some Bad, not as good as Dusseldorf or Cologne!
text: I spend about 10-15 nights a year in this region, as a Gold Honors member i usually pick a Hilton and have used both Hilton Dusseldorf and Hilton Cologne in the past, both of which i'm afraid are far superior to Bonn. There are some good things and some bad things about this hotel so i'll just list my experience, you can decide what is important and what isn't. The Good: Location- right on river and short walk from town centre. Bed- Very comfortable Shower- Powerful and hot Staff ( except reception, see below)- Helpful, friendly and happy Decor-Modern Hilton The Bad: Reception- No mention of being honors member, no upgrade, no welcome, no information about city, looked totally uninterested and unhelpful!, just took details, gave us our key and pointed us to the lift. Breakfast- Chaotic, items always running out, overcrowded, understaffed ( on all 3 days), no-one seemed in control of situation. Room- Basic, old TV/phone, No honors touches ( bathrobe/slipper/water etc), nothing! Car Park- So expensive! Housekeeping-Poor!, room dirty and dusty, bathroom not very clean. Overall, having experienced just how good both Cologne and especially Dusseldorf Hiltons are when it comes to service, standards and facilities, i won't be returning to Hilton Bonn as it just lacks the basic standards .A shame as it is a beautiful city with great people and wonderful atmosphere but Hilton Bonn is no more than a 3 Star hotel, in my opinion.

author: Elle_01234
title: Great hotel but should offer free wifi in rooms
text: All the good things mentioned in other reviews are correct. The hotel is ideally situated in the city center. The rooms are very clean, spatious, and beautiful. The breakfast is great, clean and with lots of variety. I was on the 3rd floor with a view of the garden which was great. The reception was polite and very helpful. Wifi connection if the public areas was very good. However I would suggest that they offer free wifi to the rooms as well. Other than that I have no other comment to make. I would highly recommend this hotel.

author: CAugustSand
title: Correct but boring
text: Standrd hotel with good swrvice. Extra plus for big garage with high ceiling. Room of a standard size. Wifi not included but can be had for extra charge. Most things are actually extra charge if you are not a member it seems. The continental breakfast cost 16 euros and was below standard. Really awful coffee and croissants that was very very dry. Was greeted very bad in the restaurant in the basement called The Grill. Very snobby and slippery which made us turn at the door.

author: FilmStudent15
title: Clean and Comfortable.
text: Clean and Comfortable. Looking for familiarity? Bonn Hilton is the place to be. Sometimes on holiday you just want the comfort of a clean and modern hotel. Hilton is great at achieving that look no matter where you are in the world. While I was there they were remodeling their bar, so it's looks awesome now. Comfy beds. You'll be pleased and fairly well priced for Hilton.

author: albertl775
title: Service, Comfort & Breakfast
text: Upon arrival at the airport I had problems with my phone GPS. The front desk associate provided excellent directions for which I am very grateful. Throughout my 2 week stay, interraction with any of the hotel staff (from housekeeping to fromt desk to restaurant manager) was pleasant. The room was clean and comfortable (bed and temperature). And finally, breakfast. Whether cooked to order, continental or full buffet, or Sunday brunch, everything was great. My favorites were the little sausage links and meatballs. Yum.

author: suetb
title: Good Experience
text: My standard room felt just a tad small but overall still a great place to stay. The hotel is right next to the Rhine. My room was on the second floor facing outward but I could not see the Rhine. Perhaps you have to be on a higher floor ... I am not sure. Since I was here on business, I did not spend much time in my room so the view did not really matter to me. The hotel is walking distance to the center of town so it's very convenient to get to restaurants and shops. Hotel is clean and staff helpful and professional. Breakfast buffet was very good and plentiful.

author: Pomerols
title: Good business hotel, great location
text: A very good business hotel, the Hilton Bonn has an incredible location right on the Rhine. It is also located in town so it is easy to walk everywhere, from shops to restaurants, to museums to the train station. If you have a car the hotel parking is usually not busy. A little bit expensive at €26, there is also the option (100 yards away) of the Opera parking at around €16,50 per day. The rooms are comfortable, the bathrooms updated. The staff is always pleasant. Very good breakfast where the hostess always remembers our last name every day and every time we are there! Great personal touch. A great option in Bonn!

author: 010bertv
title: Always the right place to stay
text: Went to Bonn for a summer concert at the park. The hotel is next to the river and I took the bicycle along so it was a very pitoresque ride along the water. This area along the Rhine is so nice, you can drive your bike, or jog, or hike along the river. There are many bridges and ferry boats, so you can take a trip of any lenght you like. Just five minutes from the hotel there's a number of cruise ship companies. Also just around the hotel on a five or ten minutes walk you'll find many differtent kinds of restaurants, but because I had already had a hot meal earlier in the day I decided to take a sandwich from the hotel's 'Snax' restaurant and enjoyed it on the patio along with a glass of wine. It tasted great, I like the Snax concept (never seen it at any other Hilton), you can order sandwiches, burgers and pasta at a very moderate price and it tastes just delicious because it's being prepared by the same chefs that server the 'real' restaurant. To 'eat in' or to go. Like I said, I enjoyed mine on the patio before I went to the concert. At other times I would probably have used the well equiped fitness center or the small pool, but I didn't have time for it this time.

author: patmar58
title: Summer Trip 2015
text: This is a lovely hotel on the Rhine. We had a deluxe room which was very nice with a river view. Lovely light room even the wardrobe lit up when opened. Very pleasant staff. The breakfast room has river views which is a lovely way to start the day. The breakfast itself was very good it serves the best hotel cooked scrambled eggs we have ever had. We have stayed here before and would again. The only downside is the parking fee of 26 euros a night.

author: 247davea
title: Great place to stay.
text: Stayed for 4 nights in August. Initially it was because we were going to an event in Cologne but that area was fully booked. Bonn meets to criteria of being easy to get to Cologne by car or train. But I had underestimate Bonn as an area as it was interesting, friendly and had lots of character. The hotel was great too. Friendly efficient and very professional. Rooms of good quality. Good facilities. Even the cleaners did a great job. Breakfast is an expensive add on (if not included) but was fantastic and definitely recommended.

author: KRC53
title: 100% perfect!
text: We stayed for 3 nights and everything was completely perfect from check-in to check-out. The staff were so helpful, polite and friendly. Our room, with balcony and a view of the Rhine, was adequately spacious and the bed and pillows very comfortable. There was a coffee maker and also a kettle with assorted tea and coffee and a fridge for our use, which was very useful as the weather was extremely hot! All the public areas were very clean and provided a relaxing ambiance. The breakfast was superb, far too much to mention in detail but everything you could want, including champagne! I highly recommend the Hilton, Bonn and sincerely hope to revisit. Well done everyone there! xx

author: michellep554
title: Great family holiday stay in Bonn Hilton lovely staff
text: Stayed 22/7/15 as a family of six, two teenagers, two younger children. Hilton Bonn is a pleasant 10-15 min walk from the main station, quite a big hotel on the banks of the Rhein. We had two inter-connecting twin rooms with an additional bed in each. Beds were set up in advance with additional toiletries. Front desk staff were lovely, got us checked in quickly and we were happy with our rooms, used the swimming pool and our children were welcomed into a regular water pilates class there which they found great fun. Although this hotel does not have an exec lounge (I am a diamond member) they offered a choice of sandwiches and snacks for diamonds, and they have a promotion for all Hilton honors members each month, there is a business lounge for printing out of boarding cards etc. open to all. Free wifi, and contrary to other posts, there did not seem to be any segregation for breakfast (cooked or continental). Everything worked, everything was as good/better as expected, and every member of staff we met was lovely, friendly and helpful - we have been in Germany for 7 nights, and stayed in 4 different hotels of a similar standard, but the friendly staff in the Hilton Bonn made the difference - nothing was a problem.

author: YKeness
title: A very nice hotel lacking the "Hilton glamor"
text: We booked 2 rooms for 3 nights making use of the B+B prepaid non-refundable package 5 months in advance of our trip and got a fair price unbeaten by similar hotels of the same price category in Bonn. We asked explicitly to be assigned rooms away from the elevator on an elevated floor. On the evening prior to our arrival I checked the Hilton website and came to realize non of the wishes had been followed. It was only after I phoned the hotel that this was amended. Otherwise we were quite happy: the parking for 26 Euro/day is expensive but extremely convenient and you can come and go as often as you want for this price as long as you pay through your room bill. The Breakfast buffet was very generous and tasty and dining room rather stylish, however they had an open bottle of Chamagne which I asked to be refilled however to no avail... Rooms modern, big and clean. During our stay in Bonn temperatures rose to 37 degrees but the airconditioning could't quite keep pace...Front desk staff very nice, efficient, forthcoming and patient. While reconfirming your room over the website you can order extras (food, drinks) for an acceptable price: an excellent idea. We ordered a cheese plate and some beer since we checked in late at night however, since it had been such a hot day and the cheese was kept at room temperature for some time they didn't charge us a cent for it which I thought to be a sign of the hotel's aspiration to excellency ...

author: UKyazz
title: Excellent business stay
text: Hiltons can be a bit hit and miss but this one is a gem. It has a calm and relaxed vibe to it but the staff are very attentive and on the ball. An issue at check-in was rapidly and professionally resolved. The rooms are clean and the bed comfortable. The bathroom showed some signs of wear and tear but it was clean, functional and spacious. Breakfast was good with a wide choice of hot and cold food, attentive service at the tables and good coffee. It was incredible to see just how business-focused this hotel is, with 95% of breakfast guests in suits. A tourist might have felt out of place! The location of this hotel is just brilliant - it is next to the Rhine where I enjoyed watching a stunning sunrise and a 5 minute walk to the quaint town centre with ample bars and restaurants to choose from on a night out. Having flown into Bonn-Cologne, the taxi journey was just 15 minutes, and 40 Euros.

author: Andrezed
title: OK - Just because of location.
text: Hilton Bonn feels tired and a bit expired. The service is as expected for a large chain hotel with all the comforts of quality beds. WIFI was only available in the lobby, unless you paid extortion level fees to have it in your room. The two things going for this hotel are the breakfast which is extensive. And the required fitness center (with rowing machine and free weights). My only suggestion is to update with a few kettle bell weights and medicine balls. Good to note that there is easy access to running/walking paths along the Rhine. And short walking distance to the old city.

author: TAF8
title: A superb hotel
text: We loved our stay at this hotel. Our room was luxurious and very comfortable. Breakfast was excellent and the hotel staff were extremely welcoming. The pool area was lovely and we made great use of the leisure facilities. We would definitely stay at this hotel again. Our only one small 'niggle' was that we were travelling with our 2 year old daughter and the hotel provided a crib for her, but no bedding. When we queried this with the hotel reception, they told us that this was hotel policy. Luckily this issue was resolved by another staff member to whom we are immensely grateful. As I said, a small niggle really in what was overall a very enjoyable stay.

author: MisterPeeTee
title: Great service and great location
text: I stayed here for nearly a week on business and I have to say the service was exceptionally good from the front desk to the bar staff. Friendly and helpful. The rooms are a good size and nicely furnished. Breakfast was excellent, a wide variety and high quality food. A couple of small gripes; I would like complimentary water in the room and I don't expect to pay extra for wifi these days. Other than these two things, the Hilton Bonn is a very good hotel. Evening meal in the Grill restaurant was also very good and better than expected. Would return if visiting the Bonn/Cologne area. Airport is about 25-30 mins by car.

author: 793garyl
title: Good hotel on the banks of the Rhine
text: I stayed here as part of a quick run around Europe. It was easy enough to find, it being a hearty 15 minute walk through the city centre. The location is immediately striking as you are literally on the banks of the Rhine and this was heartening. It was also well located for the team stops and Bonn theatre. Upon arrival The colleague who I travelled who's card we used to book was as surprised as I was when asked for a €50 deposit off the card as security against damage in the room, Something worth thinking about when booking. We went to our room and were very impressed with the corridor width. The room itself was excellent with empty minibar but we used it as a fridge! Tv channels in 4 different languages, clean and functional bathroom and a view that was superb. Would stay here again

author: thelfm
title: Hotel very nice, let down badly by it's internet capability
text: The hotel itself is fine, rooms have all you would require, bed is comfy, staff are friendly, gym facilities etc. Nothing wrong in those departments. However, charging 15 euros a night for 1mg internet connection and 20 euros a night for 3mg is astonishing in this day and age. The idea of artifically limiting a connection speed is something I thought was stopped a decade ago when broadband became ubiquitous. The idea of an international hotel chain in the (former) german capital doing is wrong. Personally being here for business but not being able to work means I would never stay here again. If the option is working from a bedroom with reduced levels of comfort or staying in the office, there is no choice. This will make me nervous of staying at a Hilton anywhere.

author: gorgil
title: Xmas market trip
text: We booked this hotel for a short break with our grand daughter. The staff on reception were very helpful and nothing was too much trouble. We had a lovely room with a balcony overlooking the river. In fact every aspect of the hotel was above reproach. One of our party was poorly and they could not have been more understanding and helpful. The food was very good. The only thing that might put someone off is the cost of parking €26.00 per night but we booked knowing that. Still worth it. Small pool but enjoyable.

author: ndsci
title: Great location but over-priced
text: The a la carte nature of this hotel can be something of a distraction. 20 euros a day for a average-speed internet connection? 26 euros a day to park a car? 25 euros per person for buffet breakfast? Added these items to an already expensive though modestly-sized hotel room puts it firmly into "over-priced" territory. The proximity of the hotel to the Rhein, Beethoven Halle, and Theater-Bonn are all nice - but a little research will reveal more attractive options for the informed traveler. There were lots of burned-out lights in halls and elevators, window fixtures were seized or damaged, and the convenience of the mini-bar has been replaced with a system that seems more convenient to the hotel's operators. The hotel staff I encountered were, for the most part, efficient but somewhat curt and unfriendly. Sadly, this all seems to be business-as-usual at every Hilton I've stayed in for the past couple of years. If you haven't already done so, try a Sheraton or Dorint hotel for a more pleasant 4 star grade hotel.

author: calvino
title: Mostly pretty good
text: The desk staff were pleasant and helpful. The location is good, and the views too. Lots of nice restaurants within 10 minutes' walk. The room was decent sized and clean. The internet gasped sometimes, but between these it was OK, actually pretty good for a European hotel. The only reason this rating is three bubbles instead of four: this hotel has got to get rid of the officious young man tending bar. Real rude. Not OK.

author: TerrySliva
title: A Great Place to Stay!
text: We arrived mid-morning of the day of our reservation. We knew an early check-in probably wasn't possible. However, the front desk staff person said she would call housekeeping and see if they could clean our rooms as soon as possible. We had only waited about thirty minutes when she came and told us our rooms were ready. All staff members from the front desk personnel to housekeeping people to the waiters in the restaurant were very friendly and helpful. We asked for a restaurant recommendation and of course they recommended the restaurant in the hotel. We were suspect but decided to try it anyway and we definitely were not disappointed. All of us ordered different entrees and we couldn't decide which dish was best as they all were very tasty and prepared to perfection. If we ever make it to Bonn again, we will definitely stay at this hotel!

author: scritti23
title: No free wifi in room is unacceptable
text: We stayed only one night but had a really good experience. Great newly renovated stylish and modern room. Very good customer service and extremely friendly staff. The barkeeper even advised us that the beer could be bought cheaper at the welcome desk. The only downside was: No free wifi in the room! Internet would cost 20 Euros extra for 24h! We wonder: in what universe is the german management living? We spend a lot of time in hotels in other countries and free wifi in the room is a modern standard. This is unacceptable, especially for a group like Hilton and in this price range. And this is also the reason for our poor rating.

author: Easwara
title: Great Location but very unfriendly staff
text: Our Family Stayed in this Hotel twice. From 31st of March 2013 to 7th of April 2013 and from 12th of August to the 19th of August 2012. We had 2 joining room at both occasions. Rooms were nice. Second time, when we asked maid to change the sheets she went berserk and started yelling at us in German. She didn’t realise that my daughters know German. We reported it to the front desk but never got any feedback. Front desk personnel are not friendly at all. Without shame, they would serve their white guest first even though we are in line! Very comfortable rooms, great location and easy parking.

author: fnaanurag
title: Exellent Hotel at a very goo dlocation
text: I stayed in this hotel for one week including the weekend. And I would say the service and the staff are exceptional. If I go to Bonn agaian, I would definitely stay here. I got the room with Balcony on the 4th floor and everything was exceptional. Breakfast was good (may have some changes every day otherwise it becomes a bit boring to see the same stuff everyday but not so sure if that can be done). The bar is good and the staff at the bar are too good. Very Very enjoyable Stay. Location - couple of minutes walk to city center and many restaurants very nearby.

author: MJ_Beijing2014
title: Fantastic location, staff attitude worst experienced in global Hilton Hotels
text: The location in Bonn was excellent, Bonn is a fantastic city and the people are very welcoming. The city is a couple of minutes walk away with lots of restaurants, al-fresco bars, markets, shops, history, river and more. We had a very enjoyable experience and the locals were very helpful. Stayed almost 400 nights in global Hilton hotels over last 3 years and never felt so insulted by the customer facing staff (exception being room cleaning team who were very friendly). Despite complaining, the problems seemed to continue. There was a lack of awareness towards the customer. Real shame because the hotel location is excellent, nice rooms with river view which really was pretty. Little customer recover shown. Will not return to this hotel - shame - nice location, poorly trained and managed staff

author: 12rocklily
title: Surprise package
text: We thought we wanted to stay in a small gastoff. We'd left the autobahn to try and locate one but after three hours we gave up and headed for Bonn. I thought this city was a "new town" , like Milton Keynes in the. UK. How wrong I was. We nabbed a bargain at the Hilton nod set off on a short walk to enjoy the wonderful Christmas Markets. Ate a yummy dinner in the main square, slept soundly in our bedrooms that overlooked the Opera House and set off on our journey south following a wonderful breakfast the next morning. What was not to love?

author: billc114
title: Fabulous Hotel Stay
text: I booked into the Hilton in Bonn on my way from the UK to Bavaria. I'm certainly glad I did. I had booked in advance, so received a very competitive rate for a King Room Junior Suite. It was absolutely stunning with two separate rooms and three floor to ceiling window with views of the Rhine. The room was beautifully decorated and the staff were friendly and polite. The only slight fly in the ointment is that you still have to pay an outrageous fee for WiFi in Hilton hotels and the parking was expensive. I did manage to catch the free WiFi signal from the lobby up in my room, but it was patchy. All in all, a really great stay.

author: olealexandero
title: Great hotel
text: I stayed one night at the Hilton Bonn Hotel January. I had a very nice and modern hotel room. It is that sort of room where you would like to bring back the furnitures... The location is also good. It takes about 5-10 minutes to walk to the city center in Bonn. On the negative side I have to mention the price for breakfast. Since it was not included in my reservation I have had to pay € 25, which I did not do. Even if the wi-fi was free in the lobby area it was a fee to use it in your room. It is by the way a very good Thai-resturant just next door to the hotel. I will definitively consider Hilton Hotel also next time I visit Bonn.

author: dinoSwindon
title: Pleasant stay
text: Stayed here for two nights. Super friendly welcome at reception was appreciated. Room on the first floor had recently been refurbished. Room was a good size with plenty of space with well stocked bathroom. Breakfast buffet was good with plenty of choice and again a warm welcome with friendly staff. There was a bar nearby as the hotel bar did lack atmosphere and a good Thai restaurant opposite. There was a problem with the wi-fi which was expensive at 20 Euros however the connection did not work . When I complained it was removed from the bill without an issue. As a regular visitor to Bonn I would certainly use this hotel again

author: chrisbH8120XM
title: Right on the Rhine
text: My family and I were visiting friends and we wanted a hotel brand that we could trust. It was Hilton in Bonn. Situated right on the Rhine, we loved the location and the parking. The check-in was swift and efficient, and our rooms were adjoining so that our daughters were close by! Exceptional. The fitness center was OUT-standing...top 3 in my 30+ years of stays abroad...will go BACK to the Spa and Fitness. Only issue was breakfast...it was crowded and the wait staff was too bored or disinterested to help us find a table. Otherwise, excellent!

author: CraigAitchison
title: Great staff and perfect location.
text: I stay here regularly and I have to say this is one of my favourite hotels. The gym is great and always free. The restaurant does great food. Three of the reception staff always provide amazing service and help me with any issues I have. Thank Nathalie, Lisa and Ingo. Finally id like to thank Pascal at the Kennedy bar for the best bar service I've experienced. I find it wonderful when the staff become a friend and he has always known what drink I need and been an excellent source for intelligent conversations. Merry Christmas to the Hilton Bonn staff. I look forward to my next visit in 2014

author: eloisehawking
title: Great service, good location, rooms a bit tired
text: Overall, I recommend this hotel for its location and great staff. Positives: This Hilton is a in a good central location, close to the historical sites in Bonn. There are restaurants and shops close by - a couple of minutes walk (none immediately beside the hotel). A tram stop is located about 3 minutes walk from the hotel. The front desk staff were lovely and helpful and gave a complimentary late check-out of 4pm. The room was a good size, with standard Hilton furnishings, and very clean. Hotel has gym and pool (I didn't use them). Internet is included in the hotel charge if you are a member of HHonors. Negatives: The bathroom was in need of a renovation, particularly the shower. I could not get the room cool enough (in October) even with the air conditioning at its coldest setting.

author: TBiird
title: Great Hotel, Multilingual Staff, Great Location
text: The Hilton Bonn is ideally situated right on the Rhine, about a 10 minute walk to the cit center. There is free wi-fi in the lobby of the hotel. To access your room, you have to use the key card in the lift. Each room has a hair dryer, safety box, iron with ironing board, coffee maker and flat screen tv. The double beds are 1 bed like in the US (hard to find in Europe). Breakfast was good and was located downstairs - buffet style...everything you can think of, they basically had (eggs, meat, rolls, cakes cereal, etc). I stayed in a deluxe room (room 414). It had a small balcony which was nice. I recommend this hotel...especially for American Travelers...as the rooms are a decent size, as are the bathrooms and the bedding is very standard to American beds.

author: T_T_80_T
title: Good choice
text: I went to Bonn for business. Choice of accommodation was very important. Nice hotel with good service. On-site gym, good lobby bar. Close to everything. Safe area. Easy access to any part of the city. Prices are not low, but for the quality you pay for.

author: pluskat
title: Lost 1 star
text: The nice twin room had good bedding, bathroom ok and you can open windows. Front desk staff kind and helpful. Location next to the river fine. Easy access car parking (pull a ticket, no intercom necessary). Italian restaurant is above average for chain hotel. Breakfast average, blunt knives and a cranky staffmember refused to arrange a table for four by combining 2-2. But a stunning 20 euro for WiFi in your room... Sorry Hilton, but you just lost my four star rating there. And the car parking is expensive too (26 euro a day), the Opera car parking around the corner is much cheaper.

author: NTXAV8R
title: Mediocre Hilton Experience
text: Front desk reception seems to be overworked and understaffed. Very friendly employees; waited about 20 minutes to check in on a Wed evening. Everything was extremely overpriced: €20 per day for WiFi access? Come on....racket. €23 per day to park your car €20 breakfast worth about €7 Best thing about this hotel was location. Right on the river, close to CGN. Nice running trail on river. Bed was very comfy, decor was extremely modern. Mediocre Hilton experience.

author: WarwickT_13
title: Top Hotel without Rate Overkill
text: Fantastic hotel in a beautiful city. Located by the river and close to the Old Town. Room is beautifully furnished, bedding is heavenly. Staff are very polite and helpful. Breakfast is of very good standard, in terms of quality and service. We really enjoyed our dinner here, highest compliment to the chef. We booked online direct, real good value for what's offered. Better than other hotel group. Will come back to stay here and have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to friends and relatives.

author: piernicola
title: Good property, great location, average service
text: I stayed 4 nights at the Hilton Bonn in a suite with my wife and 2-y.o. boy, and first of all we loved the space. The suite is very comfortable, and the ideal for us with a baby. Since it was cold outside we really made a good use of the living room area. Having said that, I was astonished by the very sloppy housekeeping that doesn't fit with the overall service of the hotel. Our sheets never got changed in 4 days, and the suite was properly cleaned only once. Just to give you an example, I threw my pijama on the floor (bad habit, I know) and I found it there. It seemed that 3 in 4 days housekeeping only limited the work to doing the bed, cleaning cups and changing towels. Disappointing, especially since the first impression on the hotel was extremely satisfying.

author: Schorpion
title: Exelent stay
text: I stayed in this great hotel on Saturday 26 January 2013. I was in Bonn for the TCB concert. The TCB band is the original Elvis band. Concerning the Hilton hotel in Bonn it was a nice hotel, with a perfect location close to the center. Located right on the Rhine, The breakfast was fantastic with many choices of good food. The rooms are big and very clean. And there is also a safe car parking under the hotel. Will stay here again next time I will visit Bonn.

author: KellyB517
title: Couldn't fault it
text: Stayed overnight at this hotel whilst on a weekend break to visit the Xmas markets in Bonn. Beautiful view over looking the river Rhine. Short walk to Bonn centre (5mins) and bus and tram stops along the road. Rooms very clean as was pool and sauna. Great choice at breakfast and plenty of it. Staff went out of their way to be helpful and their English was amazing. I needed medication from a Pharmacy and most shut on a Sunday in Bonn but the receptionist rang round loads until she found one open then gave me directions to get there. Very helpful! Also free wifi! Would not hesitate to return.

author: runsammie
title: Nice hotel next to the Rhine
text: My husband and I stayed at the Hilton in Bonn for a night in November 2012. Our room was quiet, comfortable and inline with what you would expect from a 4-star hotel. The room-furnishings seemed relatively new and everything was in working order. The complementary bottle of Evian water was a nice touch. The reception staff were excellent, as were the hospitality staff. Breakfast was good with a decent range of hot and cold foods. The only issue that we encountered during our stay was with the housekeeping staff as they did not knock before entering our room, which I thought was a bit rude. The location is great, next to the Rhine and a 5-minute walk to Bonn's old town. We booked last minute with Hilton.com and got a good rate which included breakfast.

author: Bob_Creek
title: Internet works or doesn't?
text: During check-in, I've been informed by Sabine a the reception that I could access the internet for 1 hour at the hotel lobby free of charge. She even gave me the access code for it. Next day I had to pay a couple of bills and I tried to use the given access code, when I found out that it was not working ("invalid code" was the message I got). Once again I spoke to Sabine and she said that this access code works "sometimes", but I told her that the issue was not the service, but the access code itself which was wrong. My expectation was that she would call someone and provide me with the correct access code, solving the issue and delivering the advertised service. But instead she asked me to contact their internet service provider, which I immediately refused to do, since that was a problem for the hotel to solve, not for the guest. Customers pay a premium for staying at Hilton hotels and they expect superior service for this extra money. This message should be also part of the employee training at the Hilton in Bonn, which apparently isn't at this time.

author: Donalyndoy
title: Good hotel, good service, good location
text: When my German business colleagues booked me here, I was pleasantly surprised. The hotel was everything I would expect from a Hilton. Their morning breakfast buffet was quite good. The room was lovely, with a large flat-screen tv that included many channels in all languages. The service was very helpful. The location of the hotel is right along the Rhine riverwalk,and about 2 blocks from the city centre, where I was able to do plenty of shopping. My negative was that the pillows and mattress were not very comfortable and I woke up stiff and with a backache. However, all in all a good experience.

author: Coyle5
title: Perfect Choice
text: Just returned from a quick work trip to Bonn where two of us stayed at the Hilton. We were made to feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The receptionists were fantastic nothing was too much trouble and their warm professionalism shone through. They made it look so easy to make people feel at home. Breakfast was really nice and the service again just right. The rooms (212 and 214) seemed newly refurbished and were very clean and stylish. We both had views of the Rhine and were able take a very pleasant short walk in to town. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a place to stay in Bonn. Thanks you for giving us such a positive experience.

author: Passenger810645
title: Good location along the Rhine
text: I spent 3 nights in this hotel. The hotel is standard for this level, which is qutie good. However, what I like the most is location along the river. The Rhine river is beautiful and there is a long boardwalk that you can jog or walk, or bike. It is the most pleasurable activity after the whole day of conference. The hotel is an easy walk to downtown and the tramline is nearby. Breakfast is very good, probably expensive, but it is included in my room charge. Internet is charged which is annoying. However, there is so many choices this day to get contact without paying unneccesary charge to Hilton. Overall, it is a great hotel to stay in Bonn, which is a nice, small, peaceful city.

author: jmb06
title: Lovely room in a great location
text: Check-in was efficient and friendly. We were given a beautiful newly renovated room, which was spacious, modern with a good shower, amenities, coffee/tea maker, etc. We faced the road (not motorway) in front of the hotel, but we did not hear any traffic noise at all. We did not have breakfast at the hotel, so cannot comment on that, but had a nice drink and service in the bar. The pool and spa area are also great--clean, quiet, and relaxing. The location was perfect -- across from the river promenade and very near the lovely old town. We really enjoyed our stay in Bonn...and the Hilton. The only negative, which others have mentioned, is that the hotel charged for wifi

author: elidez
title: great hotel, excellent service
text: stayed only one night while working at CGN airport. it's same distance as Cologne Hilton and half the price. excellent service and recently renovated so v clean and comfy beds, feather pillows and duvet. Centrally located. As in all Hiltons, breakfast is abundant, but for 22 euro, a bit pricey. I'd avoid the sausages, too salty... else all is excellent. love the pretzel brodchen

author: Indy_traveler-111
title: Good Choice in Bonn
text: I have traveled to Bonn for several years on business but this was my first stay at this hotel. I was pleasantly surprised. The location is good, on the river and by mass transit. My room was very nice, perhaps recently remodeled. My only complaint is that they don't have free wifi even in the lobby. The daily rate was 9 Euro which is less than some other German hotels. That said, wifi should be included in the rate for this quality hotel. All things considered I will stay here again for sure.

author: HIE_WARRIOR
title: On the Rhine surrounded by history.
text: It's hard to beat a Hilton property. Having said that, this property is better than most. Wonderful Breakfast buffet, Beautiful rooms and a more than courteous staff will make you smile, even when you pay your bill. We met a friend that lives in Bonn and went on a walking tour. We saw castles, and beautiful churches and much more and never got into a vehicle. I also highly recommend the rail pass if you visit europe. The trains in Germany are clean, fast and scheduled often. I can't say the same about the trains in Italy. In conclusion, the Hilton Bonn will leave happy with your choice.

author: whiteprince
title: Top class Hotel and value.
text: Very well positioned next to the Rhine and short walking distance to City centre with its attractions and great shopping centre. We were lucky enough to have a room that overlooked the River. Lovely room with nice large bed and facilities. Super service and support from the reception staff. Fantastic pool, sauna and gym facilities included in the price. Excellent breakfast, probably one of the best I have encountered in a European city break. Convenient parking under the Hotel. Cannot be faulted, a big thank you for making our visit that more special.

author: kanga41
title: well placed comfortable hotel
text: I have just been to Bonn for the Christmas Markets and stayed at the Bonn Hilton. This was a good choice as it was just out of the centre so within easy walking distance of the Christmas Markets and plenty of good places to eat and drink. My room was large and well appointed, as it should be as a 4 star hotel. They failed to leave an information booklet in the room but one was left in my room later in the day after I requested one. There was a bit of road noise with the window open but not enough to keen me awake. The buffet breakfast was very good with just about everything you could wish for and the coffee pot was refilled whenever we asked. If you wanted an omelette or eggs fried you had to ask but it was no problem. The people on reception were very helpful as were the bar staff when we arrive back about midnight wanting drinks. With your drinks you get salted nuts, dry roasted nuts and small greenish things that are wasabi or horseradish coated nuts and very hot - avoid. WIFI very expensive and I did not use anything from the mini bar as there was no price list.

author: spottyladybird
title: Great Breakfast but hotel need urgent renovation
text: We came to Bonn to visit our German's friends. They suggested Hilton because it meant to be cosy. The hotel need urgent renovation. The bathroom keeps leaking every time we take shower. Pools of water on the bath floors which is really annoying and unsafe. But the breakfast is great. The service isnt great but the food quality and the amount is great. The hotel best breakfast in Europe.

author: PugetSoundGirl
title: Best Euro breakfast buffet we've ever seen! Wonderful rooms too.
text: The Hilton Bonn is a perfect base to explore the Rhine river valley and wine country or the historic towns of Bonn, Koln etc. The rooms are pristine and have contemporary furnishings inside a gorgeous French provincial style-exterior overlooking the Rhine. But the most stand-out thing about this hotel, to us, was the European breakfast buffet. Splurge and get the full hot and cold. It is a spare no expense buffet with 6 stations - 1) homemade breads of all kinds, 2) the typical Euro coldcuts, smoked salmon - one with dill and one plain, cheeses, brie table 3) hot breakfast with the most incredible creamy scrambled eggs, sauteed mushrooms, parmesan baked tomatoes and delightful German sausages. 4) a table full of about 15 assorted homemade jams/jellies and of course Nutella and fresh honeys, 5) a dairy and cold bar with 2 or 3 of the freshest yogurts, granolas, and fruit and 6) sweets and sweet pastries. Finally, there is the obligatory self-serve espresso area and plenty of fresh juices. The spread is common in European breakfasts, but the quality and freshness of the food is amazing. Love the hotel and even though Bonn may not be the most scenic town (although it is cute), we would base ourselves here just for the great accommodations. A sure thing!

author: Fortysomething7
title: Largely Faultless
text: The only reason that the Hilton Bonn does not get 4 stars is because I am mean - 5 out of 5 is reserved for those truly awesome experiences, that are really rather rare. The basics - very clean, excellent service (with the possible exception of a slightly surly barman on one night), large and well appointed rooms, within 5 minutes walk of the city centre, and a truly outstanding breakfast spread. It also has that typical, slightly anodyne, Hilton design and style, but in a hotel of this size, that only enhances the feeling of calm. The only fault was that the TV menu didnt work during our 4 night stay, but that was hardly a major issue. A small tip - dont expect dazzling excitement, throbbing nightlife or grand architecture. Bonn is a pleasant enough town, and it rather grew on us during our stay. However, you have to take a bit of a hint when the Tourist Information start to suggest that you might want to go elsewhere to make the most of your stay...
