And finally - dont believe all the stereotype images of Germans. They were unfailingly polite, friendly and charming, and walking around Cologne was not (unlike some places in London), like entering the terraces at White Hart Lane.

author: Ibadan
title: An excellent Hilton
text: We stayed for 2 nights at the weekend and can only confirm all the accolades that have previously appeared. We also found the hotel clean,comfortable,welcoming,conveniently situated and with a friendly staff. As others have noted, breakfast could not be faulted, but not so far noted was the quality of the evening meal. We ate in L'Oliva on both evenings, and, no doubt because of the weekend, the dining room was quiet with only a small number of tables set. However, the quality of the food was excellent, the meals very attractively presented and the pricing very reasonable for the standard attained.. As in every Hilton we have so far experienced, the wine list was far too expensive. This is an excellent hotel where one is able to drive into a secure underground garage and explore the adjacent city on foot or by public transport using the value-for money Bonn card. When one finds a place as good as this, why look elsewhere ?

author: Travelling4Toffee
title: Completely Faultless Hotel
text: Are you searching for a good hotel in Bonn? Then this is the one for you. We stayed two nights over Easter and it was completely faultness. Our room was spacious with all modern conveniences and an enormous comfortable bed. The room, along with the whole of the hotel is spotlessly clean coupled with attentive, courteous young staff. The breakfast buffet is fabulous - one of the best I have ever seen - furthermore on sunny days there is the opportunity to eat out on the terrace overlooking the Rheine. Underground car parking is a bonus in the centre of a city along with all the shops/bars/restaurants being a 5 minute stroll away. Small swimming pool, well equipped gym, sauna, thermium with lots of fluffy white towels all again spotlessly clean. Perfect location, perfect hotel complimented by exemplary service.

author: SJT999
title: Amazing Breakfast
text: The hotel's breakfast has to be one of the best Hilton Breakfasts I have ever seen - so much variety and good quality offerings. This hotel is situated in the city centre about a 5 minute walk from the main shopping district. It is also close to a tram stop so the rest of Bonn is easily accessible. As a Gold member I got upgraded to a top floor room with balcony and Rhine view - very nice. The staff were all very helpful. I completed the guest comment card on the way back to Frankfurt airport and posted it there. Upon opening my e mails a couple of days later there was a personalised e mail from the Guest relations manager thanking me for my comments waiting in my inbox - a nice personal touch I thought. The swimming pool is quite small but each time I used it I was the only persomn there. All in all a good Hilton property.

author: RollingStone2
title: A real nice Hilton
text: I stayed at the Hilton Bonn when travelling from southern Germany over to the Netherlands. I arrived late and was pleasantly surprised by the clean well- lighted underground parking garage. Check-in was quick and very friendly and as a diamond member I got an upgrade. The lobby area was very busy - seemed like a place a lot of people come for a drink or light meal. The room was very clean and well appointed. Breakfast the next morning was a very good buffet with the usual items and a few specials. They had a outdoor seating area which would have been nice on a warmer day. Check out was also fast and efficient. Overall a great, although short, stay.

author: skibuff
title: Great Hotel
text: We spent three nights at the Bonn Hilton and were very pleased with the Hotel. As we had not planned to stay in Bonn, it was a quick decision to stop and stay. We were quite happy with the Hotel and its location which is a short walk to the main pedestrian shopping and sight seeing areas. A Side benefit was the hotel was the location of an Audi Dealer review of their new cars which we were allow to see. The room had a view overlooking the Rhine and towards town. We appreciated the fact the windows could be opened for fresh air. The dining areas were good and reasonably priced. Service was very good and the front desk personnel were extremely helpful and courteous. If you find yourself in Bonn, I would make this a first choice for a full service hotel.

author: hansv296
title: A simple hotel. Perfect for one night.
text: A simple hotel. Perfect for one night. Clean rooms with toilet. The breakfast is simple but good for this price. There is a private car park. There is a supermarket nearby. And also a gas station. There was no wifi in our room.

author: 773teddys
title: Best Place in Kennebunkport
text: We stayed here for our first time this past weekend. We travel to Kennebunkport at least once per year and have stayed at different inns an hotels in the area. The Capt Jefferds Inn is by far the best place we have stayed!!! They are absolutely wonderful!! They really make it a home away from home. This place is our new favorite an we would recommend to anyone to try it an experience the facility. You won’t be disappointed!! The breakfast alone is worth the trip!!

author: chrislK3164QM
title: Everything you need
text: Great location. The breakfasts were outstanding. Our room was very large. Nice linens and great pillows. Walking distance to town. Rooms were very clean. Loved the sun porch. You can't go wrong with this inn. The staff was excellent.

author: C8819VJandreav
title: Another wonderful stay at Captain Jefferds Inn
text: This was our fifth year visiting the Captain Jefferds Inn. We wouldn't imagine staying anywhere else in Kennebunkport, ME. You can't go wrong with any room that you choose. The afternoon tea is delightful, the staff is beyond courteous and the Innkeepers are a joy. The breakfast is delicious and we hate to say goodby to the inn each year. Captain Jefferds is walking distance to town and Walker's Point. The town has quaint shops and plenty of restaurants to choose from. Our only regret is that we don't stay longer each time!

author: 683cherylz
title: Perfect Kennebunkport location
text: Loved the Captain Jefferds Inn. It is located a couple blocks from all the shops and restaurants of Dock Square. The breakfasts are amazing--each day different and delightful. The Inn is very well maintained and very clean. Staff is friendly and helpful. They even have printouts for local attractions and restaurants in a large file box. Afternoon tea in the sun room has delicious cookies, cheese and crackers and for our fall visit mulled cider. They seem to have thought of every little detail to make your stay perfect. We had one of the smaller rooms which was fine and well designed with room for 2 chairs and a dresser. Next time will opt for one of the king size rooms.

author: 151katherinem
title: Kennebunkport and Captain Jefferds Inn are Fabulous
text: We just did a 2 week Fall Foliage trip through New England. Captain Jefferds was at the top of the list of the places we stayed. From the moment we arrived in our sunlit room with soft piano music playing, to the wonderful treats available day and night, to the amazing full breakfasts, it was sheer perfection. The location is superb -- walking distance from central Kennebunkport. It is on a quiet, tree lined residential street but a stones throw from shops and restaurants. The staff are friendly and accommodating and you will love the softness of the sheets on the bed. This old home has been beautifully restored with plenty of electrical outlets, a great shower and fireplace in the room we had (Chatham). And make sure you get some of the chocolate chip cookies and lemon bars. To die for!!

author: smptjp
title: Charming and Convenient Location
text: We stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn for 2 nights at the beginning of our Coastal Maine road trip. This was our first time to stay in a B&B. Also our first visit to Maine. From the moment we arrived were happy with our choice. They make you feel special and the inn is well furnished and maintained. We really enjoyed going down to breakfast a little early and meet other guests to share travel stories. Very nice breakfast. Location was good to walk to the village area for dinner both nights.

author: 78carried
title: Beautifully accommodating!
text: My husband and I visited for two nights, just a quick get away. We could have stayed here for a month! The inn is so historic, beautiful, and well located to town. The staff at the inn is very kind, helpful, and great to chat with. The highlight of this B&B is the sunroom. It is a great gathering spot for all guests to sip tea/coffee and snack on yummy cookies and appetizers in the afternoon. We had the best time chatting with other guests throughout the day as we were in and out of Captain Jefferds. Our room was well decorated and stocked with everything you need plus extra special touches. This bed and breakfast thinks of everything! I’m not sure we will be able to top this stay ❤️

author: Janet3471
title: Wonderful!
text: We had a wonderful stay at the Captain Jefferds. It is truly a home away from home but with extra attention, gourmet breakfasts and access to both the ocean and town. We were able to walk along Ocean Avenue or town on any given day. We have stayed in the inn several times , in different rooms. All our rooms have been well appointed , relaxing and lovely. There are many amenities, access to cold beverages, coffee, fresh baked sweets just to name a few.There is a very sunny indoor porch and outdoor patios for all to sit and relax. Captain Jefferds is very welcoming. The staff and owners are the best!!!!

author: cooperc350
title: Our Ideal Vacation Destination
text: We were traveling with our dog, so our options for a hotel in Kennebunkport were very limited.The hotel where we stayed previously no longer accepts pets. Fortunately for us,that worked out for the best ,and we found the perfect place . We loved our pet friendly room , and the staff was friendly and helpful. The service was impeccable. We would take a morning walk and our room was always made up when we returned.The location was perfect: a short walk to town; next to a public park; within walking distance of the beach;and across the street from another park on the river. We have been to Kennebunkport several times, and any future stays will definitely be at Captain Jefferds Inn. Upon checking out this year , we already made our reservations for a full week at the same time next year to be sure that our favorite pet friendly room, the Baxter, would be available. I could not recommend Captain Jefferds Inn highly enough to anyone planning to visit Kennebunkport highly enough whether with or without their dog.

author: utjb106
title: Our favorite B&B
text: What a lovely inn! My husband and I frequent B&Bs across the country and this is by far one of our favorites. Sarah and the staff are exceedingly friendly, the beds and sheets are some of the most comfortable we have found (I’m 7 months pregnant and haven’t slept well in weeks...until we got to CJ Inn), and it was as though the team there anticipated every need we had. I love espresso but haven’t had much of it during pregnancy - they had decaf espresso every morning. As we were going to our room with a bottle of wine for my husband, I thought it would be nice to share some (but cant obviously); when we opened the door we found chilled sparkling cider. The list of things like this goes on and on. Breakfast is delicious and includes sweet and savory courses plus a bread course. Beautiful place to stay and we cant wait to come back!

author: 676reneeb
title: A heavenly weekend in a perfect place!
text: Everything about Captain Jefferds Inn is perfection! The grounds are manicured meticulously. The Inn is bright and modern enough for comfort without losing the charm of a historic building. Our room was spacious and comfortable. Breakfast was delicious and we loved mingling with the other guests. The innkeepers were friendly and gracious hosts. The location was ideal being just a couple minutes away from the shops and restaurants. We can't wait to return!

author: ColtsGal76
title: Wonderful stay!
text: Stayed for 3 nights. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. Room was clean and comfortable. Breakfast was lovely with a nice variety; every 3-part meal had a fruit concoction. They did allow you to substitute if needed. There was a beautiful lounge with cookies, coffee, tea, and beverages that was perfect for socializing (we met some lovely people). The soap smelled wonderful! We would absolutely stay again.

author: BMLM11
title: This the place to relax and play in Kennebunkport
text: Though it was business that took us to Kennebunkport, we could not have been more relaxed than we were by staying at the Captain Jefferds Inn. Set a couple of blocks away from Dock Square, the inn is located on a quiet side street but less than a 6 minute walk from all the happenings in town. Incredibly comfortable with spacious guestrooms offering king beds, fireplaces, and updated amenities, we wanted for nothing. And it is absolutely spotless!!! Kudos to the housekeeping and maintenance people for keeping this historic home so pristine. We also enjoyed an unhurried multi-course breakfast which is served each morning in a bright and sunny dining room. Sarah & Erik have made Capt Jeff more than just a bed to sleep in while visiting Kennebunkport. They have made their home an integral part of a relaxing getaway experience. And we are most grateful for their hospitality!

author: rsmegpat
title: No need to look any further....
text: If you are looking to get away and have never been - Captain Jefferds will not disappoint. It is very clean. I've stayed in four different rooms - all which were lovely. The staff is helpful whenever needed. The breakfast is delicious .... if they are preparing something you may not like they will always find something for you. In walking distance to so many great restaurants. Have gone in different seasons and each has it's charm in its on way. I highly recommend CJI

author: 809elysen
title: Just what we were looking for! The perfect B&B.
text: My husband and I spent two nights at this bed and breakfast the week of Thanksgiving and we had a lovely experience. The inn keepers were so sweet and welcoming. The breakfasts were delicious, where we spent some time with other guests. They also had apple cider and cookies, hot chocolate mid day. The fire was super cozy and I loved that they had loose leaf tea to make! The room was very comfortable and charming. We will definitely be back. Kennebunkport is a sweet little town, this is the only place we will stay there! It's exactly what I was looking for, like what you see in the movies :)

author: joanng985
title: Warm welcoming well appointed Inn two minute walk from town
text: We had a fantastic stay at the Captain Jeffords Inn. The owners do all they can to provide the comforts of home. The full serve breakfasts were delicious. There is always coffee, tea, water, hot chocolate and soda available. Fresh baked cookies are put out every afternoon. We had the New Hampshire room which is really a suite. The bed was very comfortable and there were plenty of places to put all of the clothes we brought with us - which was a lot. The Inn is beautifully appointed with comfortable sitting rooms and pretty property with benches and other outdoor seating to relax on. We highly recommend Captain Jeffords and will return.

author: Iraz-ny
title: Wondeful Inn!
text: Perfect inn when visiting Kennebunkport. A short walk to the town (3-4 small blocks)makes the location fantastic. It is nestled in a residential area which made the morning walk before breakfast a great option. The inn itself was comfortable and very homey with a large sun room as well as living room to rest and do some quick reading in. Our room (Connecticut) was cozy but quite nice. Sarah the innkeeper was helpful, informative and a pleasure to talk with. It was a great added touch that a bottle of wine was left for my wife since we were celebrating her birthday. Loved the inn and would definitely return. Only thing I might add is a larger TV since the small TV made it difficult to see from the bed. Must admit that we did not have much time for TV so it was not an issue.

author: aeldridge17
title: I prefer to keep this a secret
text: Since Captain Jefferds does everything with such excellence, I feel compelled to celebrate them. We have been staying with CJI annually for 17 years. Each year they find something to improve on. Their warm welcome is something that cannot and should not change. You feel like you are part of their family. Their breakfasts are fabulous, rooms are comfortable with great mattresses, water pressure, towels, robes, etc. They have common rooms with snacks and ready advice/conversation. Please, don't reserve their last rooms! We need our CJI fix at least once a year! Close to beach & town.

author: 130diannh
title: Celebrated our 30th wedding anniversary at the Inn and we will definitely be back!!!
text: My husband and I absolutely LOVED Captain Jefferds Inn!! We were never in Maine before and decided to stay two nights in Kennebunkport, 2 nights in Rockland and finishing with 2 nights in Bar Harbor. We LOVED Kennebunkport!!! Everyone was so nice and welcoming! Steve, the Inn Keeper at Captain Jefferds was a true delight!! (Thank you for the champagne...we were both so surprised and appreciative!!!!) Our room was perfect...actually everything was perfect. The staff was wonderful and the breakfasts were delicious. The grounds were stunning...so well kept! We will definitely be back!!!!

author: joelw169
title: First timers
text: My wife and I have never been to Maine. We just loved the ambiance and history of Kennebunkport. The Captain Jefferds was a very enjoyable experience. Everything was perfect! You can walk easily back and forth to town. Our room was quiet and very comfortable with high quality amenities. The highlight was the breakfast each morning. A gourmet experience worth returning for. These people really know how to do a high-end, B&B experience!

author: NJNP
title: Every detail perfect!
text: I think I found a piece of heaven!! The bed and bedding were hypnotizing !! Our room was quiet, very comfortable with wonderful views from windows. All windows opened easily and we had our own thermostat had we wanted to use it. We enjoyed coffee and conversations in the sun room with other quests. The owners and staff were so very helpful and kind. Outstanding service. Perfect location! I can't wait to go back!

author: GeorgiaGirl710
title: Exceptional!
text: We are very picky, sometimes hard to please people. Therefore, stating that our two night stay at the Captain Jefferds Inn was perfect, is a big compliment. Our first contact was with Christina, when we called for information and a possible reservation. Her wonderful demeanor and helpful attitude set the stage that our high expectations would be met! Everything we judge an accommodation on was a ten out of ten. Cleanliness, location, quiet & good Individual A/C, parking, food, decor, ambience, attention to detail...all 10s. Stop looking. Stay here.

author: marykvida
title: Recent stay at Captain Jefferds Inn
text: We recently stayed at the Inn and not knowing what to expect, found ourselves entranced by the elegance, warmth and welcoming ambiance. Our breakfasts were fabulous, afternoon treats a nice way to unwind and the attention to detail and service by the staff and owners was impeccable. What a rare find and we will be back as our time permits. The perfect setting to spend time unwinding, decompressing and enjoying the Kennebunkport area. Our only regret is that we did not have more time to stay. Next time we will make a point of booking a longer stay and explore the area. Our hats off to Sarah and Erik the Innkeepers for providing us and all their other guest and unique and exceptional experience. From the Sunny shores in the south, to the clean, fresh air of the Northeast! An adventure and memories for a life time. We highly recommend Captain Jefferds to any and all

author: myoung131
title: WARM INVITING INN -WALK TO EVERYTHING
text: we have enjoyed the Captain Jefferds Inn for 10 years - it is the go to place for our annual trip to Maine from California. Sarah and Eric are most helpful in providing you with any information on local venues and call and arrange for all visits. We had front row seats at the Vinegar Theater. They arrange all dinner reservations, sailing trips, etc. Steve greets you with a smile and answers all questions and Christina begins your morning with a warmth that is contagious. We have met so many wonderful friends over the years and stay in touch via email with all. Enjoy a walk along Ocean Ave. down to Walker Point . Savor a gourmet breakfast. Nothing gets better -- relax on the patio or sun room -it doens't get any better.

author: 796ellene
title: Celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary over the weekend!
text: We could not have picked a better place to stay this weekend for our 25th Wedding Anniversary. Captain Jefferd's Wiscasset room was perfect for us, with it's comfortable bed of luxurious sheets, a fireplace that we used just to warm up after a cool night, and our complitmentary champagne. The breakfasts were beautifully done, won't forget the artichoke frittata. The sun porch was our favorite place to grab tea, coffe, fresh squeezed lemonade and treats, and then sit out on the patio over looking the garden. The house is exquisitely decorated and uniquely built. The open doors and windows let in the ocean air and classical music softly plays throughout the house. The staff is friendly, helpful and thinks of everything. We used the bikes every day, and biked all through town, to the beaches and up the coast, that was a bonus having bikes at our pleasure. We cannot wait to come back next year, there is no other place we would rather stay! Thank you Sarah and Eric.

author: BevC614
title: First class accommodations, service & location
text: This was our first stay in Kennebunkport. My husband & I came with another couple after a family wedding for relaxation. We had 1st floor room off entrance. Bedding was comfortable & towels were wonderfully soft! Guests entering late were respectful, so that wasn't an issue for us. They post the next morning's breakfast the night before, so if anyone has allergies you can make other arrangements. No one in our party needed this, and we enjoyed the food very much! They serve a full breakfast with large portions, so we ended up doing a late lunch, then just had for appetizers for dinner. We checked out their bikes and rode all over the city. It was great!!

author: elubas
title: Best dog friendly Inn ever!
text: This Inn is beautiful, welcoming, and spotless (look under your bed)! I visited with a friend for a birthday weekend with our two dogs. We arrived to a Happy Birthday welcoming gift as well as numerous lovely surprises for the dogs! The breakfasts were amazing and the Inn is central to everything. We were on the second floor with access to a spacious screened in porch shared with the adjoining room. There was a refrigerator, plush robes, and coffee, water, etc. In the main house they put out lovely snacks in the afternoon as well as cold drinks, tea, and coffee. I have stayed in a lot of dog friendly places but none compare to Captain Jefferds. Thoroughly enjoyable and we will most definitely be returning!

author: michellepC4620KA
title: Last summer stay
text: My husband and I spent two wonderful days here with our dog. This is a very beautiful Inn. Very very clean. Dogs are allowed and dog sitters are available so you can go out in the evening for dinner. For guests without a dog be assured you will not feel you are going to be in chaotic noisy environment. This is a clean and beautiful inn that you will find calm and restful. We are looking forward to our return visit this fall. Michelle and David

author: francineflorarose
title: Our Stay Will Be Remembered a Lifetime
text: We were really impressed by the Captain Jefferds Inn and the staff. My siblings and I took our parents there to celebrate their 50th Anniversary, we stayed in 4 very uniquely different rooms. We had planned activities but ended up staying put at the Inn. Every room, common or private, was perfectly suited to relax and enjoy your time. The Inn is spotless, inviting, warm and bright. The staff was always friendly and present to serve, entertain or maintain our needs. The breakfast was delicious and the sheets were the most amazing I've ever felt! We left with memories that will last a lifetime!

author: MaquamVt
title: A lovely way to spend easter
text: After a bit of a whirlwind set of trips in the past month, we ended by spending 3 days at Captain Jefferds. The innkeepers came highly recommended by other innkeepers we know and we were not disappointed. Our room was in the front of the house but the little street is one-way and no real traffic comes through. So glad this was off season as we had the run of Kennebunkport without all of the tourists. The inn is very well situated right down from the main shopping area of quaint shops and fantastic restaurants. The rooms are very well-appointed, the beds wonderfully soft and wifi and TV in each room. Breakfast is also excellent. While we don't care for having breakfast at a table for 8, the few other couples there kept the conversation going. Erik and Sarah are wonderful hosts and we can't wait to return.

author: d_tesini
title: Birthday weekend
text: Absolutely fantastic weekend! A beautiful bottle of wine and cheese platter were waiting for us in our stunning room the night we arrived with a handwritten note. My husband raved over the luxurious sheets and towels. Steven was so welcoming and very helpful with restaurant recommendations. Loved the sunroom with the vast selection of teas and coffee as well as the homemade cookies. The breakfast was a delicious 3 course meal. We were full for hours! It was lovely meeting the owners Erik and Sarah. It is clear that the owners and staff take great pride in their job and it shows as this inn is thoughtfully maintained. This will be a birthday weekend we will remember and we hope to return to stay again.

author: MichaelfromPA
title: New Years Eve 2017
text: Have stayed here many times over the past year. Sarah & Erik are fantastic hosts. They make their home ( the Inn ), feel like it's yours. Great staff also! Every room is decorated differently and they are all very comfortable and relaxing. They fireplace in the living room is our favorite spot along with the sunroom. Great selection of Teas, coffees and snacks. If your your going to stay in Kennebunkport, this is the place to be!!!! Mike & Steph

author: rdatk
title: Just a beautiful Inn.
text: We stayed during the Christmas Prelude event in Kennebunkport. There were tours of the Inns going on and wet learned a lot about the history of the inn listening to the owner guiding people around. The room was perfect. They spared no expense on the bedding It felt like you were sleeping on Angels wings. We sat in the living room in front of the fire and just relaxed after a long day of visiting the shops in town. The breakfast was top notch. Three courses of fruits, breads and eggs. I don't give 5 starts out easily, I highly recommend the Captain Jeffords Inn.

author: IPL_Innkeeper
title: Friendly Owners, Fantastic Property!!
text: We stayed for two nights as a get away just before the Thanksgiving rush. Sarah and Erik were wonderful hosts and their team made sure we were comfortable with every aspect of our stay. We reserved the Camden room and it was wonderful, just what we expected, bright and well appointed, lovely fireplace, comfortable sitting area, clean and roomy bathroom. Breakfasts were a treat with nice variety and good company to chat with. Our favorite feature was the tea room with huge windows and lovely cabinetry - very impressive. This was a very well run inn, efficient and accommodating, with lots of comfortable common areas in which to relax. The Maine coast has many attractions and nice areas to visit. Kennebunkport is a perfect base of operations with a fun town area with great dining and shopping and sights. The Captain Jefferds is a wonderful place to stay to when in the area. Thanks to Sarah, Erik, and Team for a wonderful little get away that exceeded our expectations!

author: JakeGunnerHarley
title: Absolutely Stunning
text: This bed and breakfast is the most beautiful place we have ever been to. There were tons of subtle touches that made this stay amazing from the fresh case of flowers in the room, to the throw blanket on the back of the sitting chair to the robes available in the room. The bedding was luxurious and was the best nights sleep we have had in awhile. The fire place the the gentle water fountain in the Wiscasset room made the ambiance even that much more delightful. There is this gentle music playing when we arrived that naturally relaxed us and set the tone. There were fresh made treats available on our arrival with a guest coffee/tea station. Breakfast was amazing and the owners Eric and Sarah were very friendly. They hosted a cocktail reception for all of their guests in celebration of Veteran's Day. This is truly a place you could spend much time at and we will be back!

author: ppmains
title: great fall vacation
text: Stayed october 24-0ctober 27 in the Baxter room and enjoyed every minute of our wonderful 3 night vaca. The accommodations were so romantic! Large wonderfully comfortable bed (slept like a dream),great spa hot tub,beautiful radio tuned to lovely classical music, a gas fireplace,refridge.....couldn't ask for more and everything was spotless! Sarah (owner)was a delight.! Eric was out of town on a trip so didn't get to meet him.She was ready with advice or just to chat and made us feel right at home. The breakfast were a great start to everyday...delicious and filling! Would go back and hope to in the future. Enjoyed the town and the many photo ops of Maine. All in all made for a very relaxing fall getaway! IF you go,bring a coat...ams in october are a bit chilly!

author: InessaV_13
title: Memorable Stay
text: This inn offers comfort, yummy breakfasts, coffee/selection of teas/desserts anytime of the day, great decor, beautiful gardens. The staff works tirelessly to make it happen. Rooms are clean and beds are comfortable. I enjoyed reading book while sipping tea in one of the rooms. The inn is conveniently located on a quiet street with beautiful historic houses. We got up in am to photograph sunrises over the bay. This town is walkable and has a lot of great restaurants. All in all: restful stay:)

author: I1180MMdonnam
title: Perfection!
text: From the moment we walked through the door of the Captain Jerrerds Inn we felt very welcomed. Steve has such a nice easy way. Our room was charming and immaculate. The entire staff was friendly and professional. Captain Jefferds location is a short walk to a busy town, and a short drive to many wonderful attractions. Starting each day with a breakfast that was absolutely delicious with the appearance of something right out of a magazine made our stay more than we could have imagined. I can honestly say this experience will be hard to beat. We cannot wait to visit again.

author: kmrebisz0613
title: Wonderful Anniversary Trip!
text: We stayed in the River Green room. It was a great little room. You have your own air conditioner, so you control how your room feels. And there was a window on the ceiling above the bed, so you can admire the beauty of the Maine sky. The only complaint I had was that the bed was a little squeaky. Breakfast was absolutely wonderful and there was always snacks and drinks open to you any time. Every person I came in contact was so friendly and helpful. For a nice dinner, I recommend Mabel's! It was a little expensive, but delicious!

author: jgerry2
title: Perfect Honeymoon Spot
text: We spent 4 nights at the Captain Jefferd's Inn to celebrate our honeymoon and we couldn't be happier with our choice! The owners made a special effort to help us enjoy our honeymoon with a gift of champagne upon our arrival. The breakfasts were always delicious and the staff was excellent. We stayed in the Wiscassett room and it was beautiful! The only thing was that the water feature didn't work. We were also at the inn for y 30th birthday and my new husband arranged for the waitresses to bring us breakfast in bed instead of us going to the dining room. They even put a candle in my scone just for that little added touch! I honestly cannot recommend a place more than the Captain Jefferd's. Kennebunkport is beautiful and relaxing and staying at the Inn just makes the trip that much more special! A big thank you to owners Eric and Sara and their staff for showing us such a great time!

author: Ciaociao
title: Perfect...again!
text: I have high standards for where/how I spend my vacation dollars. And this was our seventh or eighth visit. We hardly need to say more than that...but I'll give you a few clues: It's a stunning setting with a friendly staff. All the little touches--cozy robes, fresh flowers, truffle on your pillow, spotless rooms, delightful breakfasts (more spicy sweet bacon, please!!!)---make this a five star property over and over again. Do you realize how rare it is to maintain an excellent rating from so many travelers with different expectations? Sarah and Erik do it with style and grace. Kudos to their entire staff. We'll be back!

author: bb1120
title: Highly recommend!
text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights in July. We loved being able to walk into town or through the adjoining neighborhood. The Inn, the rooms and the grounds are absolutely gorgeous and immaculate. The Inn keepers were friendly and helpful and as stated by others, the breakfasts were superb! There was nothing about this experience that wasn't top notch, I only wish we had more time! We stayed ( by choice) in the Carriage House in the Vermont room and we really enjoyed being detached from the main house and having our "almost" private screen porch to sit out on and relax. While it is probably not as "fancy" or "refined" as the rooms in the main house it was nicely decorated, spotlessly clean and comfortable and we enjoyed having the extra sitting room. We would highly recommend it. We hope to be back next year. Thank you Sarah and Erik!

author: AlwaysGrateful1166
title: Perfect stay in every way...
text: My mom and I spent 2 nights this past weekend at Captain Jefferds B&B and enjoyed every second we were there! The owners, Sarah & Eric, went above and beyond to make our mother and daughter trip extra special! This was our first time visiting Kennebunkport. Their home and our room was impeccable with nice touches like robes, calming garden in our room, incredible breakfast, snacks and refreshments in the afternoon, & bikes for guest use. Their home is 2 blocks from great shopping. The beach is about a mile a way. Everything is within walking distance! Sarah and Eric take great pride in their inn and were so kind to my mom and I. Special thanks to all of their exceptional staff for taking care of our every need. Look no further, make your reservation now!

author: Butch619
title: Can we give it more than 5 stars?
text: When looking for a place in Kennebunkport, we were recommended Captain Jefferds. Best choice ever made! The place is absolutely fantastic from many aspect: the architecture of the Inn, the decoration of the common areas, the decoration of the room (we were in the Wiscasset room), the quality of the bathroom, the location of the Inn close to Kennebunkport main activities, the quality of the breakfast (they serve a tasteful hot and cold breakfast either at 8h15 or 9h30, with the menu changing each day... so no ordinary and repetitive buffet...), the general services (check-in, tour of the place upon arrival, small bottle of champagne given to us and waiting for us in the room upon arrival to celebrate our anniversary, check-out), refreshments and coffee/tea and cookies available at all time, wine bottles available for purchase, easy parking, electric charging available for electric cars, and I must forget other things. Obviously, quietness in a B&B is a lot dependent on who is also at the B&B while you are there, but we stayed on the 3rd (and last floor) and we did not hear a thing from any rooms nearby. This was worth every penny!!! Looking forward to our next stay. Thanks!

author: RHH_8
title: Superb Breakfast
text: We stayed here for 1 night on our 2 week tour of northern New England and found it to be a delightful place and wished we could have stayed longer. We never actually met the owners but all the staff who dealt with us were very friendly and keen to meet our every need. Although the breakfast was set and of limited choice it was of a very high standard, unusual but delicious, well presented and original. Despite the breakfast being set they were still able to produce an equally delicious and inventive breakfast for my vegetarian wife. Breakfast was served at a large communal table which made it easy and enjoyable to share our travelling experiences with the other guests. Our room was clean, comfortable and well stocked with quality toiletries. The inn is well located within easy walking distance of the village shops and restaurants. We would love to return there at some point in the future.

author: juliel438
title: Perfection!!!!
text: A Truly amazing inn! Our Wonderful host Sarah just does everything so right and nothing is too much trouble. Genuinely warm and welcoming. Our room was fantastic and everything was so spotless. Location wise is excellent and just a few minutes walk from Dock Square with a wonderful choice of restaurants and nice shops. Lovely gardens and a nice decking area to enjoy the Kennebunkport sunshine. Breakfast was out of this world - all 3 courses were absolutely delicious! Only bad thing about this Inn was having to leave!!! Would recommend Captain Jefferds Inn to anyone and would love to go back sometime.

author: maryshilling
title: Outstanding Experience!
text: We could not have had a more wonderful experience at the Captain Jefferds Inn. The warm welcome we received from Sarah and the staff was like entering someone's personal home. Our room and location in the historic district made it easy for us to walk to the town center and local restaurants. We loved walking the streets nearby! A highlight for us was the pleasure of a wonderful breakfast, beautifully presented around a central dining room with a fireplace ablaze. We so enjoyed talking with the other guests and the communal exchange that brought us all together. We could have stayed on much longer than planned. Can't wait to return! Mary and Tom

author: taleoftwokitties
title: First time at a B&B and will return!
text: This was our fIrst attempt at a B&B and we will definitely return! Easy walk to center shops and restaurants. Our room (The Baxter) was amazing and private. Big and roomy with a gas fired "wood" stove. Very quiet and homey just what we were looking for! Breakfast every morning and tea time in the afternoon. Everyone was super friendly. Hated to leave!

author: DougChappaqua
title: Run Don't Walk...
text: Run, don't walk, to book your stay in KBPort's Captain Jefferds Inn. To simply say that you will absolutely love this B & B is a monument to understatement, honestly! The genuine friendliness of the owners, Eric & Sarah, & their ever wonderful staff, is only exceeded by the pristine, unique elegance of this 1804 classic beauty. As soon as you enter, you will sense a foreshadowing of being immersed in Captain Jefferds' mantra; to demand the total satisfaction of each guest by going beyond the task at hand regardless of the norm. Breakfasts are not to be believed, unlike any B & B I have known...yes, chef Eric is proud & happy to comply with your recipe requests. Captain Jefferds raises the bar on memorable travel, it is beyond just an experience, it is a travel event. Even my dog, very fussy and stubborn indeed, gives it 4 paws up! She loved her private cottage suite.

author: patj923
title: Winter Wonderland Perfection
text: I just returned from the best B&B experience I have ever had..The Jefferds Inn is a gem in Kennebunkport. Upon arriving late there was light music playing in my room and a fireplace aglow in the corner of the room. The room was appointed in the finest quality furnishings. The beds are so comfortable with the best of sheets. No detail is overlooked,with even velour robes in the closet. In the morning coffee was served in their bright sun patio complete with a Currier & Ives view outdoor. The breakfast was sumptuous served in a formal dining room complete with rolling fire; Everwhere you looked the wall is adorned with art and memorabilia of when The Captain must have lived there. Eric and Sarah are gracious hosts who make you feel so welcome in their inn. I look forward to returning there soon again.

author: rpjwalter
title: Wonderful stay!
text: Just returned from a quick overnight trip down to Kennebunkport. I can't say enough good things about the Captain Jefferds Inn. These folks love what they do and it shows in their attention to detail. The inn itself is a beautiful historic home that is impeccably maintained. We stayed on the 3rd floor in the Wiscasset room. This large spacious room contained absolutely everything you could think of. The bedding is so comfortable you won't want to get out! Our hosts, Sarah and Eric were incredibly gracious as was all the staff. We can't wait to go back!

author: 834JohnB
title: Great B&B, fantastic breakfast
text: My wife and I have stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn several times. The Inn is immaculate. All the rooms have their unique character to them. The Camden room has been our favorite on the second floor. We have stayed on the third floor room also and those are very quiet and a bit more private. The innkeepers are super friendly. They keep the property in excellent shape. The breakfast is incredible. We like the off season as Kennebunkport is a little less crowded and most stores and restaurants are still open. One of our certain favorite places to stay for a night or more.

author: karrieo902
title: Wonderful stay
text: My husband and I stayed here Verterns Day. Erik and Sarah open their home to Veterns free of charge and we were so grateful that we were able to spend a night here. From the moment we arrived we were welcomed. Our room was beautiful, cozy and so peaceful. Erik and Sarah had a cheese and wine reception for all the Veterns staying there. They and their staff went out of their way to make it a very special stay. Breakfast was absolutely delicious. Thank you for a wonderful night away and for all you both do for Veterns. We appreciate it. Sincerely Karrie and Tony O'Regan

author: debswitzerburns
title: Lovely Place
text: We had the opportunity to come to Kennebunkport for the weekend and stayed at Captain Jefferds Inn. It was a lovely place. We were greeted by Steve who made us feel welcome upon our arrival. We stayed in the quaint Hideaway room that was nicely decorated and clean. The sheets were very soft as well as the towels - very fluffy! Erik and Sarah, the Inn Keepers were able to accommodate an earlier breakfast for us. The breakfast was delicious and nicely presented - and always fresh coffee available. The Inn is very light and bright and really makes you want to sit in the sun room and enjoy your cup of coffee! I highly recommend this place and hope to go back and see more of the area. The location to town was perfect!

author: giteauboisjoli
title: One of the Greatest Inns!
text: Four nights at Captain Jefferd's Inn was a real treat, the summum of a late Fall short vacation. Professionalism, warmth, and very welcoming is how personnel greets their guests and treats you from the moment you come in to the day you leave. Impeccable! Rooms are dressed for a most comfortable stay, from the nice furniture, to the fireplace (we had the Montpelier, a previous stay, the Arundel room), to the luxurious bedding. The distinguished owners pay attention to the smallest details such as the quality of the soap, nice magazines, great chocolates, high quality teas, etc. They offer itineraries, and go out of there way to make restaurant reservations, recommendations for activities and more. The Inn is very well located in the very center of Kennebunkport town and you can stroll to the boutiques as you please. This place is well kept, a gem created by people who care and know what people look for when going on a special, peaceful and upscale vacation near the ocean. Make sure to take a short 15 minute ride southward to have the most wonderful views of the sea from the famous Marginal Way.

author: path954
title: A two day getaway
text: When travelling with my husband on business to Boston, we decided to take a couple of extra days and find a bed and breakfast for some rest and relaxation. We saw this inn on trip advisor and decided to call and see if there would be any room available at the last minute. There was and we decided to make the trip into Maine. We were so glad that we did! It is a beautiful inn and very clean. The breakfast was delicious and the presentation was beautiful. We loved visiting with people from all over the country. We stayed in the Arundel room and it was spacious and very romantic. We loved it and wished we could have stayed longer.

author: bhayslip
title: Delightful!
text: Captain Jefferds Inn was the highlight of our girl's trip through the New England states. Gracious and friendly innkeepers and staff. Two of us stayed in the Garden Room which was very tastefully appointed. Very comfortable beds, nice linens, two comfy armchairs with ottoman to relax after a day of exploring the area. Bathroom had large, soft towels and a shower with plenty of hot water. One out of party stayed in the Terrace Room and was very pleased with that room as well. The breakfasts were delicious and there are always some type of snack and beverage available throughout the day. The Inn is located a block off the main ocean road and just a few blocks' walk from great restaurants and shopping. I would highly recommend Captain Jefferds Inn to anyone visiting the Kennebunkport area.

author: travelers2NewEngland
title: Nice but not all clean
text: We stayed in the Garden Room, airy nice quality linens, comfy bed. After a long trip to Maine a warm shower was much welcome only to find a mold and mildew infested shower tub area. The next morning we addressed the problem with the housekeeper only to be told that it was an ongoing problem and not mildew but paint/grout turning color when wet. We let it be, stayed three nights and addressed the innkeeper on our last morning. She was taken aback by the housekeeper's comments, gave us a 20 percent discount and was much apologetic. She was most gracious. That said, this is the number one rated Inn in Kennebunkport and we were expecting much more attention to very basic cleanliness. Perhaps we are not a match for the Jefferds.

author: pathman98
title: go no further
text: Our time at the CJI was simply a pleasure. The inn was tastefully arranged. Very tidy and clean. The food was wonderfully prepared. The atmosphere was very welcoming and friendly. The location for going into town could not be better. We have stayed in a number of Band B's and this place ranks right at the top. We would stay again without hesitation.

author: edm175
title: Pampering At It's Best.
text: We spent several nights at the inn. Being greeted by name started our stay on a good note. The room was luxurious, the bed very comfortable. Snacks and coffee are available 24 hours a day. Note: Coffee cups are provided that were on warmer beforehand! Public rooms are large and well appointed, particularly the enclosed porch. Two electric car charging points are available. Town center is but a three minute walk away. We would certainly recommend the inn to friends.

author: SherylTravelGirl
title: Top Notch
text: This place is awesome. My daughter and I visited for two nights during a girls getaway. The staff is welcoming and attentive.The breakfasts were amazing. Room was perfect and extremely spacious and comfortable. They even have bikes to borrow and we rode the island, stopped at the beach then had lobster at the local lobster pound. After dinner both nights we enjoyed the immense spread of loose tea in the giant sunroom. During breakfast we met such interesting people. Capt. Jefferds is just a short walk from the bustling town of Kennebunkport but far enough to be serene. This is the Ritz Carlton of B & B's we will be back.

author: 469loric
title: Quaint, Friendly .... Perfect!
text: We have stayed with Captain Jefferds Inn on several occasions over the years. It is located in a great area, within walking distance to town and Mabel's Lobster Claw, which is a local "must" for lobster lovers! The rooms are quaint, clean, .... the staff is friendly, enjoyable! The town is perfection! Been going to Kennebunkport Maine for 30 years .... one of our favorite trips! Long weekends are the best!

author: 551sue
title: First trip to Maine
text: Our stay was wonderful! The owner and staff were great. We felt like we were at home. We would definitely return. Breakfast was superb and sharing it with fellow guests was our favorite time, sharing stories and meeting new friends. The Inn is perfect and has everything you could possibly need. Shops and dining are in walking distance and we found everyone in town to be friendly and helpful. Awesome stay! Linda C

author: CallieCapeCod
title: Perfection!
text: Perfect place to stay! You will feel like family. Loved every minute! Everything is with in walking distance do you don't have to drive anywhere if you don't want to. So nice to get together with other people for breakfast. Makes life more interesting. Congratulations to Nick and Allison on their engagement! That was a highlight that they shared that with all of us. Love the Captain Jeffred's, will definitely return!

author: michelebT3604AB
title: Amazing Time in Kennebunkport at Captain Jefferds Inn
text: Being a first time traveler to Kennebunkport, I was unsure where to stay, and what the proximity to the different lodging options were to the downtown area. My husband and I were thrilled when we drove up to Capt. Jefferds that not only is the Inn as beautiful as the pictures, but it was a 5 minute walk to the shops and downtown area. It is just enough to stay out of the busy areas, but close to get there for lunch, shopping, sightseeing or dinner. The property is absolutely gorgeous, the house is exquisite and the owners are wonderful. We stayed in the Garden House adjacent to the house and loved the beautiful room. Would def. stay here again, loved everything about this wonderful B&B.

author: 574SusanR574
title: Four Times A Charm
text: This was our 4th trip to the Inn in the past two years, and it did not disappoint. Our room was very comfortable and beautifully appointed. Sarah, Erik, Steve and team were as gracious as ever. Quite frankly we feel more and more at home with each stay. Love the fact that the Inn is a short walk to the center of Dock Square. Overall an A+ in our book. Would prefer it, though, if the breakfast menu offered simpler, more traditional fare. We may be the only two that feel this way because everyone else seems to thoroughly enjoy the morning meal. Not a biggie. All breakfasts, by the way, are served in the Inn's beautiful dining room on a table that is elegantly set.

author: SuperTraveller23
title: Attention to detail ensures memorable stay
text: A recent stay at the Captain Jefferds Inn was a highlight of a recent visit to the region. Spotless rooms, elegant touches like quality linens, guest bathrobes, soft music playing upon arrival, and chocolates and available wines elevate the typical B&B experience. Tucked in a quiet neighborhood, the main part of town is just a stroll away, making shopping convenient. Breakfast service is a formal affair, with two seatings each morning, and which should not be missed—the menus each day are creative, interesting, and beautifully presented. Don't hesitate to mention any allergies or dietary preferences when booking, as the innkeepers accommodate. Coffee and tea, as well as homemade snacks are available throughout the day. The grounds are beautifully maintained and housekeeping excels. The innkeepers have honed their craft and it shows.

author: 662lynnb
title: Perfection
text: I fell in love the moment we walked through the front door. The Captain Jefferds Inn is a gorgeous Inn, expertly cared for and beautifully appointed. Our room was lovely, nicely furnished with fine bedding and linen. Everything was immaculately clean, many nice touches like coffee, tea and other refreshments and snacks all day and night. Breakfasts were served in a beautiful dining room and were delicious. Sarah and Erik were friendly and gracious as was their staff. We stayed in three beautiful inns during our Maine vacation, all highly rated and listed in the Select Registry but I have to say Captain Jefferds Inn was my favorite. What a beautiful way to end our first trip to Maine. We hope to return soon.

author: luvwinnie
title: Wonderful dog-friendly Inn!
text: It's so hard to find a truly clean and charming place that is dog friendly. We don't vacation without our bulldog, Ella. We come to Maine 2-3 times per year. So happy we have found this lovely inn to add to our list of choices. We stayed in the Baxter room which has a nice screened in porch with a small table. Perfect for our takeout meals. The staff could not have been more accommodating. They even heated up Ella's food for her. Just a lovely, peaceful place.

author: lmmcclint
title: Wish we could have stayed longer
text: My boyfriend and i stayed in The Katahdin room for 1 night during our vacation. It was a very cozy room on the 3rd floor. It wasn't busy since it was off season so it felt like we had the whole place to ourself. Breakfast was wonderful!! Sweet and spicy bacon, marinated pears, and raspberry pancakes. YUM!! The innkeepers and staff were so nice. I would highly recommend this b&b and we hope to return one day, this time for a longer stay.

author: AliMarMaine
title: Fabulous!
text: This was my first visit to the Captain Jefferds Inn, but it certainly won't be the last. I loved staying in this 1804 inn—so beautifully maintained and graciously furnished. My room was quiet and lovely—fireplace, wingback chairs for sitting by the fire, huge and comfortable bed. The staff couldn't have been friendlier or more accommodating—Eric, Sarah, Steve, everyone. The three-course breakfasts were fabulous, the only downside being it's been a little rough settling back into a bowl of cereal now that I'm home! I enjoyed the breakfast conversations with other guests. It was fun to be so close to Dock Square (five minutes' walk) in a picturesque, historic neighborhood and also be accessible to beaches for long walks. Everything was top notch. I can't wait for my next visit.

author: jacquelinew692
title: Could not have been better!
text: What an incredible experience. From the moment I booked the room with Steve to the welcome we received from Rachel, we could have not have even imagined a lovelier time in Maine. The Inn itself is beautiful, the room spacious and spotless and the fireplace was one of the highlights of our stay. My significant other and I were celebrating an anniversary and the Inn provided a flawless atmosphere for our occasion. We enjoyed time in our room in front of the fireplace, in the town where, although many locations in town were closed for the season, we were able to have coffee and a pastry, find a local grocer and have a lovely dinner. But what really makes this Inn special, beyond the beautiful room, was the people. Sarah and Erik are a rare duo that have curated an Inn that is second to none with an exceptional staff. I feel so grateful to have stumbled upon such a gem. Thank you for such a wonderful getaway, Sarah!

author: Hokie24
title: Perfect Overnight Getaway
text: My husband and I were in Boston in mid-November for business and decided to take a last-minute drive up the coast to Kennebunkport, where I vacationed every summer as a child. We started calling inns and B&Bs in town along the way to secure a place to stay for the night. We spoke with Steve, who was extremely friendly and welcoming, and decided to stay at Captain Jefferds Inn right away. From check-in to check-out we had a wonderful time in this beautiful historic inn. Our room was warm, well-designed, clean and beautifully decorated. The bed was extremely comfortable. We felt welcome from the moment we arrived, and enjoyed the complimentary tea, coffee and treats by the fire and in the sunroom. The three-course breakfast was delicious - the best popovers we've ever had! The Inn is very convenient to the center of the village and walking distance to shops and restaurants. We highly recommend Captain Jefferds Inn, and look forward to our next stay!

author: MEB1968
title: A very special B&B
text: We stayed at the Captain Jefferd's Inn for the first week of our honeymoon 3 years ago and it was simply wonderful. We just stayed there again this past weekend for a post-holiday getaway and it was just as good! Erik and Sarah and their staff are so friendly and relaxed - nothing pretentious or stuffy at all - down to earth, wonderful people. We stayed in Baxter in the Carriage House - which is dog friendly - and it is so cozy! Everything about this room says "relax and enjoy". The breakfasts are delicious and it is so close to the center of Kenneunkport with all the quaint, lovely shops - I would recommend this Inn to anyone - especially around Christmas…it was decorated so beautifully. We love the Capt. Jefferds Inn!

author: susandC9203YO
title: THE BEST!!!
text: Captain Jefferds Inn has been in our family for many years now. We've celebrated early Christmas and landmark birthdays here with our growing family house in 3 to 4 suites and rooms. We feel so at home in our suites as well as the common rooms in the main house. Nothing quite as lovely as sitting in the living in front of the fire Steve or Erik has stoked for us while we spend time enjoying our family. All this and amazing Chef Erik breakfasts! No lunch needed on these stays. Town is a short walk away as are scenic strolls. Cozy, clean rooms with all the well thought out extras provided. Just a first class, well run Inn that makes us want to return year after year.

author: 23Diane711
title: A very special place
text: This inn is a very special place. As soon as you walk through the front door you know you will have an amazing experience. Erik, Sarah and their entire staff will end up feeling like family by the time you leave. they are so pleasant, friendly and helpful....your any wish is their command. The Inn itself is a splendid old house so beautifully restored and appointed....each room having it's own special charm. We stayed in the Chatham Room on the first floor ...So warm and bright with a wonderful fireplace and large bathroom.... the common rooms are also beautifully appointed with comfortable furniture and fireplaces, all lit as it was a winter visit...but the best room of all is the magnificent sunroom with wall to wall windows. in this room you will find coffee, hot cider, a wonderful assortment of herbal teas and home made cookies. Although the Inn sells wine, they had no problem with us bringing our own wine and snacks to enjoy a late afternoon cocktail hour with our friends. The Inn is also very well situated to shops and restaurants in town which are all within walking distance.

author: GeorgeP405
title: Mid week getaway
text: We always drove by this Inn and wondered how it would be to stay there. Luckily we booked a couple of days mid week in December and pretty much had the place to ourselves. Sara the innkeeper was very attentive to our needs. Even though it was just us and one other couple cookies and crackers and cheese were put out for an afternoon snack. She also helped us with our diner reservations. The Inn is very unique with its architecture and our room was great. My wife loved the bed and sheets. I highly recommend staying at this Inn

author: jkarennj
title: A classic
text: This is the quintessential New England inn experience. A grand property in top condition. A solicitous staff taking good care of you. Wonderful food (snacks, breakfast, coffee, etc.). The Arundel Room was very nice - spacious and elegant. Loved the fireplace. A great stay. I hope to be back.

author: BMLM11
title: The place to stay in Kennebunkport!
text: This inn was terrific in every way. Firstly, the inn is gorgeous, immaculate, and oh-so-comfortable. The innkeepers & staff are SO warm & friendly. Our room was beautiful and well appointed - fantastic gas fireplace (viewed from both the bedroom & the massive bathroom). Loved the huge shower w/ dual shower heads. Chef Dan presented great breakfasts each morning. Location is perfect - walking distance to all the great shops, restaurants, and attractions. We look forward to returning to this awesome inn.

author: 04Traveler26
title: Romantic place to stay
text: This was a wonderful experience. The inn was gorgeous and inviting. The innkeepers and staff were warm and welcoming. The wine and cheese reception was delicious., as was the three course breakfast. Our room had a whirpool tub and separate shower. The room also had a fireplace, with all these amenities the room was cozy and romantic. It was a beautiful,clean place to stay. I would not hesitate to stay here again and would recommend it highly.

author: TrekkerMom
title: Simply Amazing
text: This is one of the first times I feel compelled to write a review even before I leave a property. This Veteran's Day the Captain Jefferds Inn opened their lovely bed and breakfast so veterans could have a complimentary stay. The inn is exceptional in every way. The staff is amazing and very personable. The owners went out of their way to welcome their guests with a wine and cheese reception to honor the veterans in attendance. Everything was well planned from a warm and welcoming fire in the parlor to hot mulled cider and home baked cookies on arrival. Our room, the Monticello, was beautiful and I had the opportunity to peek into a few of the other rooms that were equally well appointed. Quite frankly, this is one of the most beautiful bed and breakfasts that I have ever stayed in. I can't wait to see what breakfast will be like and I certainly cannot wait to return for another stay. Thank you to the owners for acknowledging and honoring our veterans...this family is so grateful for your hospitality and generosity.

author: regularjoe75
title: One of the better b&bs I've stayed in
text: The Captain Jefferds Inn is easily one of the nicer experiences I've had at a b&b. The house is quite large, and there are quite a number of places to relax, whether by a roaring fire or outside on the grounds near a stunning water feature under some trees. The staff were very welcoming, the amenities are ample, and the room was spectacular. It was quite a large room with a fairly modern bath considering the house is over 200 years old. Linens were top notch, and everything about the experience there was tranquil and comforting. The location is wonderful too, just steps from the river, and art galleries and the town. I'd go back there again without hesitation. My only regret is that I didn't stay for another night.

author: Mummygi
title: First inn we stayed in
text: Wow,what a great place. First trip to the States,first Inn we stayed at. Couldn't have made a better impression. Lovely hosts and staff,every comfort provided,excellent breakfast. It was great to chat to other guests in the lounge and over breakfast. It really was such a friendly and relaxing place,ideally situated to wander into the lovely town of Kennebunkport. Well done guys! PS only because my eyesight is so bad a magnified makeup mirror would be good in tha bathroom but truly you've thought of everything else.

author: mummafish
title: Excellent Place to Stay
text: We would class this B&B as a small hotel, never the less it was excellent. The staff were lovely and very professional. The room was spacious, décor was very good in New England style. En suite was spotless, bed really comfortable, lovely linen. The breakfast was really good, consisting of three courses which were served to you. Also perfect location for exploring Kennebunkport and the surrounding area. We had a meal in the Cape Arundel Inn overlooking the ocean whist we were there which was amazing, not cheap but for a special occasion definitely the place to go. We stayed in four B&B's during our trip to New England and this is one we would definitely recommend.

author: herculepoirot
title: Choose your room carefully!
text: I adore this Inn and have stayed there many times in many different room types. Most of them are nicely furnished. However, there a few that are really in need of updating and you'll be wondering if you got robbed - from the squeaky, lumpy beds to the dated furniture and/or cheap furnishings. The pictures are accurate so that isn't the issue. My complaint is they are charging close to $300 for these rooms when you can go two blocks either way and find much a much better, newer room for the same price. And don't expect an upgrade, even when the expensive rooms go empty. There's a lot competition here. The innkeepers are lovely though and the inn and grounds are immaculate.

author: dismac123
title: AN OUTSTANDING HOME AWAY FROM HOME
text: From the moment you walk up the brink walkway, you stay at the Captain Jefferds Inn will be a day to day delight. Sarah and her staff make every move to make your time with them enjoyable and unforgettable. The Inn, its rooms, and the grounds are a place you will love to enjoy for a short or longer visit. And be sure to savor the fantastic breakfast served each morning. This is a wonderful place away from home that made our stay in Kennebunkport a memory we will never forget. Oh, and thanks to Sarah and her encouragement, my partner and I were married right on the beautiful grounds. It wasn't planned, but Sarah made it happen. Thanks Sarah, you are one special lady.... Paul and Bill

author: gilbertems
title: Amazing Labor Day Weekend
text: Staying at Capt Jefferds is the place to stay in Kennebunkport. Just a short walk to the main street for dining and shopping. The hosts were wonderful and very accommodating. We brought our 10 month old with us and we were provided with a garden room with a portable crib, baby blanket and rubber ducky. The garden room was very private with our own separate entrance so we didn't feel like we were bothering all the adult couples who wanted a restful stay. It also meant no lugging baby stuff up the stairs! The breakfasts were delicious - of course blueberry pancakes were my favorite. Would love to return another time.

author: 123Madison
title: A Real Gem on Pearl Street
text: This was our 2nd trip to Kennebunkport, and this visit was much more enjoyable thanks to our choice of The Captain Jefferds Inn. The Inn itself, the Innkeepers, Sarah and Erik, and the other guests all made the stay memorable. We had a lovely king room on the 3rd floor (Asissi) and we thoroughly enjoyed the accommodations. We also loved the 3 course breakfast every morning (we chose the 8:15 AM seating) The Inn is situated in a very nice residential street just a short walk into town for shopping and restaurants. The Inn supplied us with beach chairs, towels and even a beach umbrella for our trip to Goose Rocks Beach. They also have bicycles to use (which we did), and cookies, snacks etc available all day long, and coffee and other beverages available 24/7. We spent quite a bit of time relaxing with coffee, tea or even some afternoon port on the porch just off the dining room. Best of all, everyone who works at The Inn was wonderful: friendly welcoming, engaging and genuinely interested in helping us enjoy our stay. We couldn't have chosen a more perfect spot for our Maine vacation.

author: meredithk764
title: Charming Historic Inn
text: Capt. Jefferds Inn took us back in time. It is a beautifully restored early 19th century home in a residential area, walking distance to many restaurants and shops. Our first floor room had a fireplace and large windows overlooking the gardens. There was a sunny porch where various teas, coffee, lemonade and snacks were served. Breakfast was lavish and delicious. For dinner, we walked a block to a waterside restaurant to enjoy, of course, a large lobster! We also enjoyed the complimentary bicycles offered. The inn was all that I had hoped it would be and I would recommend it enthusiastically.

author: Juliede
title: Great location in Kennebunkport!
text: Captain Jefferds is a very nice B&B very close to the center of town. It was a few blocks away from shopping and restaurants. The Inn was very "homey" and clean. We appreciated the many extras that were included- bikes we could use to ride around town, water, tea,soda and coffee available all day, and cookies, lemonade and snacks. The room was nicely decorated and comfortable except for a noisy room air conditioner. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The Innkeepers were difficult to get a hold of and we had very little interaction with them. The breakfasts were very good except you had to commit to a seating time. Despite a few upsets, our stay was great and we would recommend Captain Jefferds and we would stay here again.

author: N7286KCrichardl
title: Captain Jefferds Inn
text: Excellent accommodations, superb and friendly staff. You could not find a better Bed and Breakfast. Their attention to the finest details were truly amazing, totally exceeded our expectations. The ambiance is so soothing you'd think you stepped back in time to the colonial era. Our only regrets are that we couldn't spend more time. The owners and the staff are extremely gracious. The location is excellent, one block from Dock Square. We plan on being repeat customers and would highly recommend this Inn.

author: Dougie7_12
title: Friendly New England Elegance
text: We had a warm welcome to Kennebunkport in Maine thanks to Sarah and especially Kathleen (our new friend across the pond) - who looked after us so well and gave us excellent information on how to avoid parking tickets. The inn looks good on the internet and the real thing did not disappoint. This was the start of our holiday in New England and boy did they set the bar high. Often the word excellent is over used but not in this case when used to describe our breakfasts - announced and described each morning. The sun lounge is a lovely place to relax and meet other guests or to sit quietly and read. There was always complimentary cookies and drinks available. The other bonus is that the inn is only a 5 minute walk to the centre of Kennebunkport. I would thoroughly recommend 'Jefferds' and we will certainly stay here again next time we visit Maine. Thank you to all the staff for a memorable time.

author: greenberg
title: Best Inn ever
text: We have been fortunate over the years to have stayed in a number of inns and B&Bs, and none compares with Captain Jefferds. From the moment you walk through the front door you know you are entering a very special place. But the furnishings are just the beginning. Each room is uniquely decorated. Sara and Eric and the staff are always very welcoming and helpful. The grounds are so beautifully manicured and the breakfasts are amazing. Add to this the lovely people you meet when staying at this inn and you have the ingredients for a delightful and relaxing vacation. We've been to Captain Jefferds 3 or 4 times and hope to return often. Phyllis and Murray, Miami

author: GeoffCle
title: Perfect Location and Stay
text: This was our first trip to Kennebunkport. We decided to take our first trip without our baby. After dropping him off in NJ with his grandparents, we checked in Wednesday, July 2nd. Steve warmly greeted us and provided a tour of the beautiful inn. Each morning breakfast was delicious and a nice opportunity to meet the other guest. Each afternoon, treats were provided in the sunroom. We stayed in the Camden room, and the bed was luxuriously comfortable. The inn is located a block from downtown. It's a perfect location. We highly recommend the Captain Jefferds Inn.

author: DanaM258
title: A wonderful place to experience Kennebunkport
text: This was our first trip to Maine, and we couldn't have had a better place to stay than the Captain Jefferds Inn. The location is perfect for walking into town or to local restaurants. We never had to drive the car when in town. The room was spacious and elegantly appointed. The sheets are amazing... The breakfasts served were very good and plentiful. The inn keepers were very helpful with directions and recommending outings and things to do in the area. We would highly recommend the Captain Jefferds Inn for your next visit to Kennebunkport Maine. We definitely will be back!

author: GoingNewPlaces
title: Best B&B I've ever visited!
text: Captain Jefferds is absolutely beautiful, immaculately clean, spacious and wonderful original, yet restored historic details. Staff was very friendly. The breakfast was amazing, but so much I couldn't eat it all. Location couldn't be better. It's a 5 minute walk to the charming downtown with food, shopping & river views. We stayed in Wyeth room that had a great 5 jet shower. I hope to be back soon! Be sure to look under your bed too :)

author: AandJD
title: Excellent POTENTIAL
text: This property is gorgeous. The staff is so attentive and sweet. The owners, however, may need a vacation. The husband walked by us at least 5 times and didn't speak. I don't think he even made eye contact more than once. The wife was stand-offish and almost seemed nervous. It was strange. Perhaps because this Inn is so beautiful they don't feel they really need to try that hard. Too bad, really as our little room was $400/night and we wouldn't stay here again as there are many beautiful places in Kennebunkport that are much less expensive and just as lovely.

author: Exhaustedspouse
title: Great place to stay with or without Dogs
text: We spent 5 days at Captain Jefferds and we did walk away with the feeling that we were leaving a friend's home. We made our reservation after reading the reviews on several websites and am happy to say that our hosts Sarah and Erik along with their cheerful staff Steve and the rest of their very pleasant staff exceeded our expectations. The outstanding service and suggestions they thoughtfully provided made our trip truly memorable. Our dogs were greeted with large personalized cookies (wolfed down in a few seconds) in serving plates, bowls were placed on a little mat and ample towels and sheets were provided to cover furniture and dry the dogs when we returned from our walk to the beach. We stayed in the Baxter room which has a cottage feel to it. It is spacious and has its own screened porch through which the dogs could look out on the village green. The gardens are beautifully maintained and there are two water features including a soothing waterfall that we could hear from our room. Breakfast was definitely very delicious (they are not kidding when they say "gourmet" and three course) and warmly served every morning by a very conscientious staff! They never repeated a single course during our five days, which was a rare treat in itself. We give Captain Jefferds Inn our highest recommendation!

author: KarlH693
title: Hospitality Central in Kennebunkport ME
text: Our recent 3 night stay over Memorial Day weekend at this fantastic B&B in downtown Kennebunkport Maine was just the perfect getaway. The accommodations were wonderful, our room was comfy, quiet and clean. The innkeepers were gracious, helpful and made you feel like you were at home. Sarah can tell you what's going on in town, the good restaurants and stores, just a little bit about everything when she visits at breakfast. The setting, the décor, the common areas, the gardens, all were taken care of so well it really made you feel extremely comfortable. The location just a block up from the hustle and bustle of the village was convenient if you wanted something from in town, but tucked away so there was never a lot of traffic or noise going by. The view from our room was great. It was just a wonderful stay, and we got to me such wonderful people while we were there.

author: NancyG-818
title: Best Bed & Breakfast in Kennebunkport
text: Once again, we had a fun and relaxing weekend at The Captain Jefferds Inn. Everything about our stay was perfect ... from the absolute spotlessness to the comfort of the bed to the spacious and modern bathroom to the sunny sunroom (where you can sit and enjoy coffee, tea, cider and the best homemade cookies) to the location ... just a short walk to the "downtown" with best collection of shops (clothing, souveniers, collectibles, galleries, and of course restaurants). One of our favorite things about CJI is Steve, who is very friendly and attentive, willing to help you out in any way. We also enjoy sitting in the beautiful dining room and having breakfast with the other guests, some of whom we've come to know from previous stays. It definitely feels like family when you stay at The Captain Jefferds Inn. We have recommended CJI to several friends, and everyone has loved it enough to go back. It's a "sure thing"!

author: 574SusanR574
title: Second Time Around
text: It has been 6 months since our last visit, and quite frankly we couldn't wait to return. Though the weather was less than hospitable, the accommodations and the Inn itself were just as inviting and comfortable as we remembered it. We didn't stay in the main house's elegant Arundel room this time. Instead, we chose the more rustic (and very comfortable) Baxter in the Carriage House. We loved the privacy of the Baxter and would choose it again if we decided to return with our dog. But sans pooch, we prefer staying in the main house. Last but certainly not least, we asked Steve to make dinner suggestions and then reservations for us. His recommendations were excellent and exactly what we asked for (The Hurricane in town and Joshua's in Wells). Would we go back--in a heart beat! This jewel of an inn, with its very polished atmosphere and personal service, is on par with the best hotels the country has to offer.

author: Kimmeekay
title: Had the best time.
text: We recently stayed with Sarah and Eric at the Captain Jefferds Inn. What a treat. The have the best sun room that I just couldn't stay out of. Our room had a water feature, a fireplace and a king bed. We were so comfortable we could have just moved right in. They also have the best sheets ever in the history of inns. It's a wonder I got out of bed at all. Breakfast was great and we had the best time chatting with other guests. Truly we were so comfortable and felt so welcome, I didn't want to leave.

author: Susannegt
title: May be pet friendly - but at a price.
