text: We arrived at the Inn with our Havanese Paco - there was a dog cookie waiting with his name on it and dog bowls at the ready. The room, however, compared unfavorably with those of the previous two Inns where we had stayed prior to our arrival at the Jefferds. The decor was dated and tired. The bed needs replacing and the bathroom is cramped. We were asked about dietary restrictions when we reserved the room. I have celiac disease so cannot eat glutin. The glutin- free breakfast was disappointing - it was glutin free but only in as much as the glutin was eliminated from the breakfast served other guests with the addition of a commercial glutin free muffin. The room was very expensive perhaps setting up higher expectations.

author: sylviafly
title: Amazing generosity
text: We were able to stay here with the Bed and Breakfast for Veterans Day program. Erik and Sarah opened up their Inn to 10 veterans and their spouses and the generosity of these kind people amazed me. Their Inn is absolutely gorgeous. Our room (Chatham) very clean and tastefully decorated and well maintained and very close to the shops in town. The room was extremely comfortable with robes, beautiful sheets, fireplace, and it had a large bathroom with all the amenities. I cannot say enough good things about this Inn. The breakfast was beautiful and delicious and the service was fantastic. The wine and cheese reception was so nice in that we got to meet the other veterans and hear their stories. It was over and above Erik and Sarah and Jeff and I thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We wish you the very best of health and we will recommend the Captain Jefferds Inn to everyone.

author: 638junem
title: A beautiful and charming retreat
text: If you want a relaxed yet luxurious place to stay then look no further than Captain Jefferds in Kennebunkport. My husband and I stayed here for 4 nights at the end of a tour of New England in the fall. It was the perfect place to relax. Our room at the top of the house- Florida- was well appointed and exceptionally clean, although the sloping ceilings in this particular room might be difficult for taller guests. The 3 course breakfasts are beautifully served and quite delicious- and there is a good selection of teas and coffees for you to enjoy at any time just off the dining room. It was also really helpful that you could get a bottle of water from the fridge whenever you wanted. Afternoon teas in the conservatory or outside on a wicker rocking chair are an added treat, as is the log fire in the lounge at night. Shops and restaurants are an easy stroll away and the staff all went out of their way to help us plan days out or answer any questions we had. There was a lovely atmosphere to the place, which meant guests could chat easily or find a peaceful space.Highly recommended.

author: Roger0150
title: A wonderful place to stay - Top Quality
text: My wife and I enjoyed a 2 night B&B stay here on our self drive tour of New England. From the warm welcome we received on arrival to our departure everything about this place was just brilliant. We had the Katahdin room on the top floor and it was lovely, comfortable and very clean with lovely bedlinen, TV, clock radio etc and good quality toiletries. The lounges and dining room are delightful and the attention to detail throughout the place has to be seen to be believed. The standard of food is excellent including the complimentary afternoon tea. Complimentary tea, coffee and bottled water is always available as is brandy and port. This beautiful building is ideally positioned just a short walk from the centre of the charming little town of Kennebunkport where there are a handful of restaurants plus shops. The only downside for people who are perhaps not as sociable as ourselves may be the fact that breakfast, which is served in 2 sittings, is served on a (rather grand) dining table seating eight so, unless you can grab one of the other, smaller, tables you may have to engage in some early morning conversation!

author: DavidR787
title: Great Place!!!
text: A very warm welcoming Inn. Charming upscale facilities, especially at the mid and upper priced level. All rooms are more than adequate and my wife and I would willing stay in any one of them. Afternoon tea is splendid and the three course breakfasts are real treats. We have stayed there four different times and are planning to return next October. Kennebunkport and the surrounding area is quite attractive that time if year and the summer crowds are gone but most everything is open. The Inn seems to be a favorite place for visitors from the United Kingdom, most of whom have spend time in the USA before. You will not be disappointed if you chose to stay there.

author: skyking1776
title: Love it, love it, love it!
text: We visit Kennebunkport every Fall and fell in love with this B & B. The family that owns and runs it are absolutely wonderful. It's all about the details, and 'The Captain Jefferd's' excels. From the professional staff, who, by the way, have been there since we started visiting, to afternoon tea and snacks - everything is just perfect; and if it isn't, it will be in a blink. The average guest tends to be very very well travelled - many from the UK. All in all, just a lovely experience and a great location to tour. Also, the grounds are amazing. If you garden, you'll love it.

author: JIntorcio
title: We love this place!
text: My wife and I returned to this Inn for our second time in celebration of our wedding anniversary - the 21st this time around! We stayed in "The Hideaway" this time - one of the less expensive rooms in the Carriage House attached to the main Inn. While smaller than the main house room we'd stayed in last year, we found its quirky entrance, warm wood finishes, drenching shower, and big comfy quilt most welcoming and comfortable. The common rooms of the Inn are gorgeous - the coffee-equipped "Sun Room" being our favorite. We even borrowed the Inn's bikes for a ride through town! Breakfast here is to die for! Multiple course of delicious fruits, breads, and breakfast entrees that leave on totally satisfied. All served before a warm fire at a big table that encourages camaraderie among the guests. This place is really a treat!

author: paris_traveller2013
title: First time at Captain Jefferds, surely not the last one
text: I spent one night at Captain Jefferds with my family and we were not disappointed. The inn is perfectly located at only 5 minutes walk to Kennebunkport town. We stayed in the Vermont suite which has a master and a small room. They were both extremely comfortable. The bathroom was very clean and fully equipped. As underscored by many reviewers, the inn offers an amazing 3 courses breakfast which is more than a plus. Altough we had very limited interaction with the staff, the impression is that of being served by professionals who like what they do and care about their inn. Overall, a great experience!

author: Mompot
title: Delightful New England Inn
text: Our stay at the Captain Jefferds Inn was our second visit. It is a lovely well kept former sea captain's property. The staff is extremely attentive to the details that create an exceptional visit. It is clean, comfortable and updated. One of the most enjoyable pleasures is the three course served breakfast which is beautifully presented in the dining room. It is shared with other guests and nice to meet other travelers most of whom were repeat customers. The grounds are well maintained and there are several sitting areas inside and outside. It is nice to be able to walk to the village and enjoy the many restaurants without driving. We hope to return next fall.

author: Jshmd
title: "Relaxing experience"
text: The Captain Jefferds Inn in Kennebunkport is a wonderful place to stay. The decor is lovely and the feel of the Inn is so relaxing. The location is convenient but yet peaceful. You are in walking distance of shopping, sight seeing and eating. The staff was extremely helpful and accomodating. Breakfast was amazing and the afternoon teas looked very inviting. We had such a good time but our visit was much to short. The town and people of Kennebunkport were so welcoming. We hope to visit again soon.

author: love603
title: Good location for staying in Kennebunkport
text: This was our second time to the Capt. Jefferds Inn. The room we had on this visit was very small, though clean. However, we did book last minute so did not have a choice of rooms. The room we had previous was large and very comfortable. Unlike other inns we have been to, they do community seating at breakfast. It's a nice change and gets the guests talking with each other. Afternoon tea and breakfast are both enjoyable and food is good. Service is good, though didn't see the Inn Keepers as much this visit as we did our first time there. Perfect location for walking downtown.

author: sfree3
title: Captain Jeffereds Inn our favorite B & B!
text: We spent 5 wonderful nights at Capt. Jefferds Inn. We picked because of proximity to Portland and much to do in the area without lengthy drives. In fact we walked all the time which was perfect. Breakfasts are terrific and the service is that of a 5 star hotel. All staff are helpful; place is immaculately clean and the sheets are like silk, softest i have ever slept in. Tea in afternoon is welcoming and there are lots of nooks and crannies to hang out in all kinds of weather. Music is peaceful and inviting in the background. You can walk everywhere in Kennebunkport and the Inn is ideally located for short day trips all over southern Maine. We will be back to experience another season there!

author: thomasc648
title: Simply Perfect!!
text: My wife and I spent the weekend in Kennebunkport for a wedding. this was our first time there, and we chose the Capt Jefferts in because of reviews that we read on TA, and it's location. Wow, the Inn Exceeded our expectations in every way. The accomodations, public rooms, breakfast, and ambiance was the best we have experienced anywhere, and we travel alot. The owners, Sara and Erik take a tremendous amount of pride in their establishment, and the personal touch is evident everywhere. We had several friends try to save a few dollars by staying at further out location, but the money they spent on taxi's, parking, breakfast, etc. more than made up the difference in cost. Thank you Sara and Eril and the rest of the staff for making our stay so pleasant...we will return! Tom C Naples Florida

author: 98lauriec
title: Mother-daughter overnight
text: Captain Jeffords is conveniently located in a quiet neighborhood within walking distance of the restaurants and shops in town. I took my daughter for a surprise over night as a treat before school started. We loved the hidden room located at the top of a staircase in the carriage house. The room was small but perfect for relaxing! We enjoyed afternoon tea and all the sweets that accompanied it. The gardens are beautiful. Breakfast the next morning was delicious and we enjoyed the company of the other guests. We were sad to leave after only one night but the excellent directions to the local beach softened the blow. My daughter wants to make it a yearly tradition!

author: Ciaociao
title: Second stay, just as amazing as last year's
text: We stayed here last year to celebrate our anniversary and returned again this summer. The property is immaculate, well-situated and beautifully maintained. The staff is accommodating. The breakfast is outstanding. We cannot say enough good things about this inn and staff. We also travel with our small dog, and it's nice that they don't relegate you and your pet to some uncomfortable, dowdy room like some properties do. Though there is a nightly fee for pets (which, admittedly, does add up over the course of many nights), they are not just pet-tolerant; they are pet-friendly. They welcomed our girl with her own personalized treat, welcome letter, towels for wet paws, and sheets to protect furniture from fur. Overall, a fabulous experience. Keep up the good work!

author: Vincent_Metcalfe
title: Beautiful and peaceful!
text: We had a great stay at Captain Jefferds. The room was beautiful and very well decorated. The bed was absolutely amazing. Every breakfast was tasty and different. Our hosts were very helpful during the entire stay. It was great to have access to bikes and parking permits for all beaches. We would recommend this hotel to anyone. One thing to note, you are not walking distance from the beach, but a few minutes from the village.

author: BucketListTraveler88
title: A Wonderful Maine Vacation
text: We stayed 3 nights at Captain Jefferds Inn while vacationing in Maine, This was our first time in Maine and our first time staying at a Bed & Breakfast. Our experience could not have been better. From the time we arrived we felt right at home. We stayed in the Terrace room and it was beautiful and immaculate. The sheets on the bed were the best! And the robes were an added bonus! Each breakfast we had was delicious and served by a friendly staff. The location of the Inn was perfect. It was with-in walking distance from everything in town, yet in a quiet neighborhood. If we return to Kennebunkport, we will definitely stay at Captain Jefferds Inn!

author: nztraveler1
title: Welcoming and Beautiful Historic Home -
text: From the moment I parked my car - and walked toward the welcoming "candle" lights in the windows - I knew I had arrived at a special place, indeed. Welcomed by another guest no less - and immediately followed by a gracious welcome from Steve - I felt relaxed and at home. Steve did a seamless check-in for me and took me to my wonderful little Hideaway where I had the good fortune of staying for three nights. The rooms are immaculate - well tended - exuding warmth and comfort. And - the breakfasts are just over the top - beautifully prepared - lovingly served - and we always had to be asked to finally leave we all got so involved in conversations with one another. (There are two seatings - so it you choose the first seating - you do have to be finished within an hour). While I have lived away for 30 years now - the Kennebunks are "home" where I grew up and went to school. It is a pleasure to come back and experience the delightful hometown feeling where even though changes have been many - the gentle graciousness and strong history of the area still remain. The current owners have embraced this graciousness and history and added their wonderful touches and amenities to the Inn - touches I am sure would make Captain Jefferd proud to know his legacy is in such thoughtful hands.

author: rsmith71399
title: Perfect place to relax
text: This made our fourth visit to this fantastic inn. Staff is very friendly, knowledgeable and constantly went out of their way to make our stay very enjoyable. We were lucky to be able to spend four nights in the Adare suite. Very comfortable and unbelievably clean room. Fruit and cheese tray with sparkling wine was waiting for us when we arrived. Sarah and Erik even went above and beyond to obtain a special variety of roses for me for my wife and my 14th anniversary. Breakfasts were fantastic and different. Service was outstanding especially with Tina tending to everything and remembering how you like things done, like how you like your coffee. Steve was like talking to a friend about the local cuisine each evening when we came back "home". Thanks for a having such a special place.

author: Scootyburger
title: Wonderful place to stay
text: My wife & I had the pleasure of staying at this wonderful B&B recently. Our only regret was we didn't stay longer. On arrival we were welcomed in a friendly manner & were made to feel like home. We were personally shown to our room. We stayed in the Florida room which was on the 3rd floor & overlooked the lovely gardens that surround this lovely B&B. Our room was comfortable, with lovely furnishings, reasonable sized bathroom & comfy queen sized bed. Breakfast was also a highlight with well cooked meals using locally grown Maine produce. The Inn is located perfectly with a short walk to town to all the restaurants. This was our first visit to Kennebunkport & we could not of picked a better place to stay. We would love to return one day.

author: jconviser
title: Everything we wanted and more!
text: It was a typical early summer New England weekend with weather which ranged from cold and rainy to warm and sunny however it was always warm and inviting at the Captain Jefferd's. Although initially the Captain Jefferd's was not our first choice we are very glad we stayed there. The atmosphere is warm and cozy while been bright and full of light. Owners Erik and Sarah are great and can't do enough for you. A highlight is the formal breakfast in the beautiful dining room where we were seated the other guests. It was a nice friendly way to start the day and get to know the other guests. Starting the day with coffee (always available) in the sunroom or on the back deck was a relaxing way to start the day. The location can't be beat as it is a quick 5 minute walk to Dock Square. We absolutely would recommend the Captain Jefferd's to anyone looking for a nice getaway to Kennebunkport.

author: bluelobster001
title: Exactly What You Want From A B&B
text: 1. Great location — easy walk to the shops and restaurants of downtown Kennebunkport. 2. Great building — a wonderfully restored antique home transformed into a spotlessly clean and tremendously comfortable B&B environment. 3. Excellent service — everyone we encountered from the moment we walked in until the moment we walked out was friendly, welcoming and upbeat without being intrusive. Add it all up, and you've got the formula for an extremely successful B&B experience. Good stuff, all the way around.

author: scanna283
title: Relaxing time for a long weekend
text: My husband and I stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn for 2 nights to relax before my Maine Coast Marathon. I have to say that the atmosphere and surroundings are perfect for making you fall asleep, and I mean that in the best possible way. After we checked in, we decided to read a book before heading to dinner since we had 3 hrs to kill. Well, as soon as my head hit the pillow, I fell asleep into a deep relaxing "nap" that lasted around 2 hrs! After dinner, I actually slept like 9 hrs. So, needless to say, this is the place to rest up before a 26.2 race! Breakfast was yummy, and we were always surrounded by treats, tea and coffee, juices in the sun room area. The building is gorgeous, high ceilings, large rooms, and beautiful landscaping. The walk to restaurants and stores is a block away, soo close! Definitely stay here, you won't regret it!

author: HeatherW779
title: Amazing B&B
text: We just returned from a 4 day babymoon! This beautiful B&B was immaculate! You would really miss out if you passed up the opportunity to stay in this quintessential, historic Kennebunkport home. The Breakfast every morning was fit for a king and the service was top notch. Erik and Sarah went out of their way to make sure every guest was satisfied. We will definitely be visiting Captain Jefferd's again!! P.S. The sheets are like heaven!!!

author: EdA425
title: Spectacular Home away from Home
text: Erik and Sarah and their staff were all excellent in making this truly a home away from home. My wife and I were in Kennebunkport for a conference held at the Captain Jefferds Inn. Our room, the Chatham, was excellent! Little unexpected treats like: a comfortable wing back reading chair that also was a recliner; wooden storm windows that could be closed at night to make the room really dark for a great night's rest; and tons of horizontal space on which to place our stuff, made the room special. Breakfasts were terrific! At the Captain Jefferds, "breakfast" is firmly in place in the name "bed & breakfast". Common areas were very comfortable, accessible, and felt like home. But most of all, the friendly, welcoming, and accommodating Erik, Sarah, and staff made the stay among the very best B&B experience we've ever had!

author: DonnaL568
title: Wonderful 44th Anniversity at a spectacular Inn
text: My husband and I just returned home from 2 days of relaxation at the Captain Jefferds Inn. When we arrived, there was a bottle of champagne and a note congratulating us on our 44th wedding anniversary from our host, Eric and Sarah. What a lovely couple and Eric's cooking is amazing. Staff member Rachel was very knowledgeable of the places to see in the area. We enjoyed a delicious breakfast and hot tea and homemade cookies in the evening, after a great meal in town. We so enjoyed the walks we took including Beach Avenue and Ocean Road. The accommodations are wonderful, the silky sheets and the view from the Florida Room out onto the garden that Mrs. Bush planted. Thank you, Eric and Sarah for making our 44th anniversary a wonderful success.

author: MSFbostonarea
title: Excellent B&B
text: My husband & I stayed at Captain Jefferds for a mini-honeymoon following our wedding. The Inn is beautiful and the staff are so friendly and down-to-earth. You feel pampered being there...from the delicious breakfasts to the evening cookies and cider...not to mention the beautiful rooms. The Arundel room that we stayed in was really impressive - and the cleaning staff were kind enough to let us peek in a few other rooms after other guests had checked out, so we could see that so many of the rooms have such a comfortable yet elegant Victorian charm to them. We stayed there in the off-season, but were still able to enjoy some of the local shops and had a fun horse-drawn sleigh ride at a nearby farm. The staff were very helpful with dinner recommendations and accomodating about dietary restrictions for breakfast too. The other guests we met were friendly and it was nice to chat with them at the group breakfasts - though if you get to breakfast early enough there are a couple private tables for two if you're looking for a more intimate breakfast experience. We recommend this B&B for any season, any occasion. -The Boston-area newlyweds

author: TheresaS325
title: Our Favorite
text: We have visited Kennebunkport many times and stayed in a number of b&bs in the area. The Captain Jefferds Inn is by far our favorite! Everything is amazing at this inn! The rooms as well as the common areas are beautiful and welcoming. Breakfasts are delicious! The owners and staff are so warm and hospitable. Can't imagine staying anywhere else! Looking forward to returning later this year for what will be our 6th stay at this incredible inn!

author: MainePeter
title: Top Notch
text: This was our second time at the Captain Jefferds. We last came in the summer, and this visit was the week between Christmas and New Years. We stayed in the Arundel Room (again), which is very spacious and has both a jacuzzi and a gas fireplace. Very comfortable. The entire inn was tastefully decorated for the holidays. The living room had a nice fire going, although the primary attraction seems to be the Garden room, even in the winter months. The staff was very friendly, the food was excellent, and there were always snacks and beverages available. It snowed twice while we were there, and the staff did an excellent job of keeping the walks and parking lot clear. Having been here twice now, we feel safe in saying that there is a consistency of quality that demonstrates a real commitment to service on the part of the owners. Can't wait to return!

author: 630JustinC
title: One last night away....
text: We have been to multiple BB"s in Kennebunkport and CJI is the best!!! we wanted to get away for one last night before having our second child and we couldn't have been happier. The service from initial check in to checkout was incredible. nice homemade baked goods and fresh Warm Mulled cider, cracking fire and peaceful music make for a very relaxing afternoon.. Nice large BB but Erik and Sarah have done a great job to make it feel very warm and inviting. Breakfast was incredible, baked spiced pears with fresh raspberries, right out of the oven popovers with homemade blueberry jam, and an artichoke frittata...Delicious! the Camden room was very warm and sunny, very comfortable queen size bed and a nice fire crackling to drift asleep to. Location was very convenient as well, my wife who is full term pregnant and I had no issues walking to town,just a block away! would love to come back next year!!!

author: sueleeuk
title: Welcoming friendly well appointed accommodation
text: Historic building beautifully maintained, good location. Laptop for guest use very helpful. Wonderful guest pantry with all day tea , coffee, snacks etc. Log fires, soft music, all add the the full guest experience. Most helpful and obliging staff. We were just a little disappointed in the shower which was cramped and average performance. The set breakfast which changes daily. It would be helpful to know in advance what is being served and have an alternative I found everything over sweet. Howver I would still recommend this Inn as a good place to stay.

author: Blacktieranch
title: Everything a B&B should be
text: This is a marvelous 200 year old home filled with history and charm. It is everything you would hope to find in a New England B&B. The gathering rooms are very comfortable and inviting. Fabulous fireplace in the living room, the perfect place to relax and visit. Our room was very nice with super comfy bedding, a nice fireplace, and fabulous shower and bath towels. The staff were very pleasant and eager to make our stay enjoyable. It is an easy walk into the little town of Kennebunkport where you will find some terrific shops and restaurants. We had lunch at Hurricane (yummy lobster chowder) and dinner at One Doc, one of the best meals of our trip. Lots to enjoy here!

author: Menne123
title: Top Notch!!
text: We arrived early for our stay at Captain Jefferds. The staff could not have been more friendly and accomidating. They suggested a restaurant for lunch and, also, bicycles to ride to see the sights. The home and gardens are meticulously cared for. The bedding is amazing! The baked goods, tea and warm cider in the sunroom were wonderful. The breakfast was not only delicious but so nice to sit at the dining room table meet some of the other guests. We wish we could have stayed for a longer time.

author: lauriesullivans
title: The Capt. Jefford Inn - Home in Kennebunkport!
text: Wow- what an experience! My husband and I took a last minute Maine getaway and found the Capt. Jeffords Inn online. What a delightful surprise! We loved everything about it - afternoon tea and lemmonade and homemade sweets in the sunroom, a fridge filled with bottled water, soda, and a cookie jar always full of their signature oatmeal/oatmeal cookies (they'll even give you a recipe if you ask!). Beautiful accommodations - each room decorated in period furniture, many antiques, that suit this 1803 year-old inn. Home cooked breakfasts at a mahagony comunal table, some couples tables in corner nooks. Looking forward to going back next year!!!

author: ExphilipX
title: Excellent atmosphere and service
text: This B&B was somewhat more expensive than what I would normally go for but the tripadvisor reviews sounded very good and i got the sense in my research that price levels are a bit up in Kennebunkport. The service was excellent and the impression was given that everything had been thought through and taken care of. I am not one for communal breakfast but it works well given the ambience and the people it attracts. They were very friendly in terms of providing towels, parking permit, etc on the day of my checkout which is not often met. Lovely garden and lovely house. Plus good location. The room was a little small and it was heavy lifting getting my luggage up there. Did get some help though. I would recommend this place and like to spend more time there. Good place to decompress

author: MainePeter
title: Great B&B!!!
text: This is a terrific property. We spent 2 nights in the Arundel room. It was quite spacious and very comfortable. The entire inn was very well kept and wonderfully decorated. The breakfast was excellent and the staff were all friendly and helpful. The inn is in a quiet neighborhood about a 5 minute walk from the shops and restaurants. Overall, well worth the price. We will be abck for sure!

author: CourtneyO919
title: Perfect stay in Kennebunkport
text: My husband and I spent two nights at the Captain Jefferds Inn and could not have picked a better b&b. We stayed in The Hideaway, the inn's cosiest room and almost most budget-friendly. It was small, as expected, but just what we wanted. Comfortable bed fitted with luxurious sheets (everyone raves about them) and a skylight overhead. Three-course breakfasts were top-notch (one morning blueberry pancakes and ham; the next, sausage quiche). The hostess always tended to vegetarians, or those with special dietary needs. The inn is conveniently located to the center of town, a very easy walk. However, the grounds are so beautiful and tranquil, you may not want to leave the inn!

author: PosiTerily
title: Most Relaxing B&B!
text: This was our first try at a B&B and we absolutely LOVED this place! Our beautiful suite was wonderfully appointed with many luxury touches. The inn keepers were friendly, hospitable and very informative about the area. The B&B offers rental bicycles, which we took advantage of and had a wonderful time biking the area, using the handy maps offered by Eric. ! And I could not say enough wonderful things about the 3 course breakfast! You must stay here for the delicious breakfast and afternoon treats themselves!! Overall a wonderful experience and we will be sure to come back. 5 Stars from Teri & Roland PS We have a small Terrier and this is the only Inn in the area that has a few rooms that can accommodate a dog. Mikey (our Terrier) had a wonderful stay as well

author: grad30
title: A perfect visit!
text: My husband and I visited the inn over the Memorial Day weekend. It was challenging to find an inn in the area that would accept a 2 night stay. We hit the jackpot with Captain Jefferds! The room was meticulously clean. The location is ideal - a short walk to town, a nice walk to Colony Beach. Although the inn in so close to town, it is very peaceful and quiet. Steve was more than accommodating and everyone that we came into contact with was courteous and professional. I am a coffee addict so it was great that they had fresh coffee available until late morning and a Keurig machine at the guests' disposal the rest of the time. We definitely plan to visit here again - we loved it!

author: TP443
title: "Our Favorite"
text: We have been visiting the Captain Jefferds Inn for approximately 8 years. Whether celebrating special events such as anniversaries and birthdays, visiting our nearby college student or just the need for some down time, it is our favorite destination. In our travels we have not found another inn to compare, and quite simply we don’t want to. Erik, Sarah and staff do a phenomenal job making you feel welcome. Their hospitality and genuine friendliness will always set their inn apart from others. They have created such a welcoming atmosphere, we are relaxed the minute we walk through the front door. The rooms and gardens are beautiful. The experience of meeting and talking to fellow guests at breakfast is always a highlight. We look forward to returning time and time again!

author: cmpdavid
title: Perfect Location!
text: We stayed in the Assisi Room; it was light, roomy, and very clean. Staff could not have been more accommodating. Town was close enough to walk to easily enough. Breakfast was at 8:15 (or you could go to the second seating a little later). Everyone sits around a large dining room table and is served the same thing (no choices offered). Fruit compote/blueberry muffins/French toast with berry syrup already poured on (no maple offered)/ham slices/coffee/tea/juice. A nice breakfast touch/alternative would have been to offer something low fat (oatmeal perhaps--easy enough to make and keep a batch going and certainly less expensive maybe--for those who don't need or want the carbs & fat). All in all it was a great B&B, and I would return. Owners are very friendly and helpful.

author: redtree
title: A delightful visit with all the right touches!
text: Could not be any better when traveling with your dog or without! Our Bella had a gift bone waiting for her with her name on it, dog bowls, a basket of toys to pick from and her own ball. We had a lovely room right off a brick terrace, I had mentioned what a lovely place for breakfast...next morning our breakfast was already set there right on the table on the terrace.. The bedding is silky and top quality, breakfast from the plates, fabulous coffee, to our server was absolutely delightful. Look forward to the homemade afternoon cookies, port and cheese selection. A truly wonderful stay and we will look forward to returning! As innkeepers ourselves we know how well Captain Jefferds Inn is well run and deserves only high marks!!! Thank you so much.

author: MarkusSchriewer
title: Brilliant
text: Cozy and warm place to stay. Beautifully located. Nice building and rooms. Liked it very much. Certainliy a place to go again. Breakfast was very interesting ;-), but they have been flexible to cook something different quickly. Very helpful in solving our requests. Can only recommend this place. Kennebunkport is a nice place to stay, very good located at the coast. Even in early spring it was lovely.

author: dlfg
title: Just Perfect
text: My husband and I spent our anniversary, with our dog, at Captain Jefferds this past February. This was our second time at the inn. As usual the room was simply lovely! Sara and Eric are exceptionally warm hosts. To add to the wonderful experience, we were the only guests at the inn which made it feel even more cozy and special. Brandon, the assistant inn, keeper was wonderful and helpful too! Our little doggy loves this inn as much as we do! It truly is a very special place! We hope to be back soon.

author: TA111
title: Captain Jefferds is Awesome!
text: This was our second stay at Captain Jefferds Inn. Our first stay was a special weekend as we celebrated our wedding vows there surrounded by our kids and grandkids, all of whom stayed at the Inn and enjoyed a superb dinner orchestrated entirely by CJI staff. Erik and Sarah and all their very caring assistants at CJI made that weekend extraordinarily warm, fun, and memorable. Recently, on the occasion of our first anniversary, they and the CJI team welcomed us back with even greater enthusiam and friendly care. The rooms are cozy and comfortable. The location is very convient to quaint "downtown" Kennebunkport. The service is outstanding. A respite at Captain Jefferds Inn is a truely a first rate experience, and we wouldn't even dream of staying anywhere else when visiting the south coast of Maine.

author: Hattie50
title: beds full of luxuriant comforters
text: I recommend the Inn without hesitation. We went with a group of girl friends on a January weekend and enjoyed drinks, cheese and crackers by the fire in the parlor both nights. Breakfast is outstanding with fresh fruit in yogurt, muffins, scones or pop overs all made by the proprietor fresh that morning! and either stuffed herb crepes or apricot stuffed french toast (which could be my indulgent favorite). Tea, coffee and home made cookies are available 24/7 The guest rooms are very special with beds full of luxuriant comforters the finest sheets and enormous pillows. Each room is decorated in a fashion befitting a successful merchant from a past era but containing all the amenities required by the modern public. The modest flat screen TV in our room sat on a white desk and was therefore white and unobtrusive. But I did not wait around for to watch TV. I went to Kennebunkport for the fun shops, fine food and antique shops on Rte 1 (still open on Friday, Sat and Sun.)

author: vacationfun2011
title: 5 STARS
text: My husband and I are repeat customers over the Christmas and New Year season. The inn is charming and beautiful. The location is perfect! A short walk to town. The three course breakfast was excellant. We have found the inn keepers to be helpful, warm and friendly, all our needs where met with a smile. Each room is beautifully appointed and so wonderful! 5 Stars a vary special place indeed so charming! Craig and Brenda McElhaney Bristol, RI

author: debposk61
title: one of the nicest B&B's I've stayed at
text: The place is beautiful, with such attention to detail. We were greeted by Steve, at 7 pm, who was expecting us (actually knew our names as we arrived and knew we were the last guests of the night to arrive). He gave us a quick tour and orientation to the house. 24/7 coffee/beverages and ice were nice and cookies and desserts in the sitting room all evening were really appreciated. We were there for a "girls' weekend", three of us and we had a suite with two bedrooms. Each were nice size, the bathroom was plenty big and the accomodations were very comfortable. The breakfast was gourmet in my opinion, a three course meal each day. The food was served on beautiful china, with excellent wait service. The location is fabulous, just 4 blocks from downtown Kennebunkport, and plenty of off-street parking. Can't think of anything negative to say.

author: Cmbnova
title: Lovely Friendly B&B
text: Recently stayed here after spending a few days the week prior at Captain Lord Mansion just across the street. Both inns are great and totally different. Captain Jefferds is smaller and more intimate--with active involvement by owners/innkeepers (Erik and Sarah) and it seems like you are "guests" in their house. He does the cooking (a past chef) and much of the upkeep while she provides much of the hospitality. Lovely common areas--with our favorite a back first floor windowed Florida room where coffee, tea and snacks are always available. Wide selection of rooms that are not as period decorated as the Captain Lord across the street but offer good values and variety. Nice front and back patios. Pets only allowed in outside access rooms which keeps the main inn off limits for pets--which we think is a good idea. Quick walk into town or a slightly longer walk to Mabels. Lovely residential area--and beautiful property with the best part being the friendliness and hospitality of the owners and the small staff.

author: SandyB553
title: Relaxing Get-a-Way
text: My husband and I have been coming to Captain Jefferd's Inn since 2004. We come with our dog and always stay in either the cozy New Hampshire or Vermont Suite. We LOVE the warm family feeling we always receive from the inn keepers and the staff. The gormet breakfast is always such a treat for us and my husband loves the afternoon tea-time. The rooms are spectacular.... each one is so beautifully decorated. The location is close to shops, beaches and other dog-friendly places to walk our dog. We can't wait to come back next year!

author: AEATR
title: disappointed- our dissatisfaction was not taken care of
text: we booked a beautiful room which was described with "bright" with many other things. we of course did not interpret it as that the room does not have curtains/blinds and you will be waken up by "bright" sun rise early at some ridiculous time, like 5am?. we could not sleep afterwards. this wasted our entire next day, since we were sleep deprived. curtains are basic necessities that even any motel provides. after the trip we received an email from them asking to complete a nice review for them if we liked the experience with a link provided for tripadvisor; but, if we were unhappy we should contact them directly. so, we contacted them. they said the room was advertised as "bright" (??!!!), -they warned us-, so they can't do anything other than give us 10% discount in our next stay! next time will not happen. if I am paying $300 for a room, I should be able to sleep at least!

author: P4302ORwillb
title: A truly wonderful stay at a very special place.
text: Sarah greeted us and showed us to our wonderful room. It was our fifth wedding anniversary, and she had a bottle of champagne waiting on ice. The bed was very comfortable, and the oversized tub was incredible! We could not have been more relaxed. She helped us with our dinner plans and gave us directions. In the morning we enjoyed a wonderful three course breakfast and an excellent tea that afternoon. This truly is a very special place, and we hope to stay here again soon! We have stayed in B & B's around the world and would put this up with any of the top places we have stayed. You will be very happy with your experience.

author: mike_crowther
title: Brilliant attention to detail and a great place to stay
text: My wife and I booked in for 2 nights on our travels around America. We have stayed in some quality B&B's in other parts of America and this was right up there with the best. It was our 30th Wedding Anniversary and we were greeted with a complimentary bottle of sparkling wine. The room was spotless and the bathroom sink and shower fittings were top quality. The 3 course breakfasts were excellent, brilliantly presented by the very attentive staff. All eating at one table enabled us to get to know lots of the guests and we all shared some great stories and made some really good friendships in our brief stay. The advice we receieved on places to visit was spot on and they even rang to make bookings for us - top service. The attention to detail is evident and we had a great stay with some wonderful people.

author: Hawkeye4888
title: Captain Jefferds Command Respect!
text: Make your reservations as soon as possible, as the Inn fills up quickly--and for good reason! Operated by a warm, friendly couple--Sarah and Erik Lindblom--the facility is pristine! It was due to Trip Advisor's reviews that my wife and I booked the Inn, and we're so glad we did! All your needs are met by an excellent staff, and the sumptuous three-course gourmet breakfasts are to die for! Located in the historic section of Kennebunkport, the grounds are beautifully manicured and the property is well-maintained. Caution! If you get the Terrace, like we did, there is a slight step (more of a lip) outside the step-up/down into the room. I tripped over this despite Steve's warning to "Watch your step!" (I thought he meant the big step, not the lip.).

author: BUNHTRAVELER
title: No words other than Perfection!
text: The ultimate Bed & Breakfast! We stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn for our 20th anniversary and from start to finish, the experience was fantastic. The simple beauty and history of the inn would be enough to warrant a return, but the way we were treated by the owners (thanks Erik & Sarah!) and our host, Steve, really made this establishment stand out from the rest. We stayed in the Monticello room which was both lovely & inviting. A welcoming bottle of champagne & a personal note congratulating us on this milestone put the trip off to a perfect start. The bed was so comfortable that I was able to enjoy a rare Saturday afternoon nap. We were able to explore the inn and enjoyed spending time in the sunroom, eating a gormet breakfast with a fun group of other guests & walking the lush grounds & surrounding village. The inn is steps away from Kennebunkport center. To conclude, while my husband & I aren't usually B&B people, we have no doubt that we will return to Captain Jefferds for many years to come. Erik, Sarah & Steve have set the standard for all future travel.

author: emeronyck
title: The only place to stay while visiting Maine
text: My family and I took a trip to Maine this past February after the passing of our grandmother. We thought no better way to get our minds cleared and celebrate her life than to do what she loved doing and travel. My mother had always wanted to visit Maine in the winter after spending many of our summer visiting the beautiful state. Upon arrival at Captain Jefferds we immediately fell in love. The house was still had the winter greens decorating the outside and made it seem as if we should be pulling up in our horse drawn carriage. The inside was just a cozy and beautiful. Each morning we sat in the sunroom enjoying hot tea and coffee before an amazingly delightful and delcious breakfast. After returning from our daily adventures we would sit by the fireplace and play cards, read books, laugh, and enjoy some quality family time. The rooms were immaculate and felt very much like home. Our hosts were an absolute delight and anytime we return to Maine this is surely the place we will be staying.

author: Harwells
title: Everything an elegant historic B&B should be...and more.
text: The Captain Jefferd's Inn is a greater pleasure every time we go. The innkeepers have a wonderful eye for historic touches, and have a wonderful sense of elegant detail. The linens are exquisite, The robes are fluffy. The rooms are immaculate and beautifully done, each in its own particular style. The breakfasts are served on china and the food is as tastefully presented as it is well prepared. The garden is gorgeous. The living room and sun room are welcoming. And it's a short walk to the center of town.

author: dandl157
title: Quintessential New England Inn Experience
text: This is a beautiful Inn, lots of light in a wonderful decor. We stayed in the Adare room. Very comfortable with a lovely double sided fireplace. The double shower has glass bricks that the Sun flows thru in the morning bathing you in warm light. The owners Eric and Sarah are lovely people and went out of their way to make our stay pleasant. Breakfast was delicious: Baked grapefruit, Raspberry muffins, and Eggs Florentine all prepared from scratch. Not to mention the real fire in the Living room. Stay here and you will enjoy!!

author: MickeMouse911
title: Can`t Wait to go back!
text: This was my first time in ME. I am so happy we stayed here. The Inn was WONDERFUL. The BREAKFAST was amazing. Eric , Sarah and the Staff are so nice. The Inn is so clean so are the rooms and bathrooms.I dont know how they do it. We loved it. I cant wait to go back again. Alma & Mike from PA

author: 201marybethw
title: Relax surrounded by New England history
text: Steve greeted us as we arrived and proceeded to carry our bags and make us feel welcome in every way possible. This is an immaculately clean inn. The gathering spaces include a living room with a wood burning fireplace; a dining room with a gas fireplace; and a luscious sun room that you never want to leave with all of todays newspapers (local Maine paper, Wall Street Journal and the New York Times). Each room warm and comfortable while impeccably designed. Great art work throughout individual rooms as well as public spaces. Artist Edward Gordon painted an image of the sun room with a print of this image in the dining room. Great breakfast food and conversation. I will be back....

author: vacationfun2011
title: Charming, beautiful, clean, warm and friendly! 5 STARS!
text: Our visit to the Captain Jefferds Inn was charming in everyway. Our room was bright, beautiful and polished clean. The inn keepers where warm and friendly. We wanted for nothing! We would recommend the Captain Jefferds Inn to anyone looking for a beautiful, polished exceptional bed and breakfast! We are already looking forward to our next visit! We give this INN 5 STARS! FYI our pets where pampered as well and just like us they didn't want to leave!

author: skyking1776
title: Too good to divulge
text: We hesitate to tell the world just how good the Capt. Jefferds Inn is. We found the Inn by accident, lucky us, and have returned every year since. The owners, have gone out of their way to make sure everything is perfect. From the perfectly cared for grounds, to the authentic English/Irish afternoon tea, this is the real deal in Maine B & Bs. With an easy walk to Kennebunkports town center and a, just as easy, drive past the Bush compound, the Capt. Jefferds is a great jumping off point for day trips. If you would like to see what civility and down-home good manners used to be like, try this special place.

author: LindaCH2010
title: The Best"
text: My husband and I recently spent 4 nights at Capt. Jefferds. Innkeepers Sarah and Erik have created a wonderful inn that offers comfort, elegance and warmth, all of which provide a relaxing respite! Their attention to detail and genuine interest in guests' comfort make any stay at Capt Jeffereds a unique experience. Each day starts with a 3 course breakfast, served at either of two sittings. Located in a historic neighborhood just two blocks from the center of town, you will have access to beach chairs, beach umbrella, bikes, beach towels, bottled water, afternoon snacks, coffee, tea, lemonade....and the Inn's beautiful sun room, porches and garden. I have been going to inns and B and B's for many years and rank this #1. Linda

author: vacationerBoston_MA
title: Yes!!!
text: I got back from a 3 day stay at the Captain Jefferds in today - what a beautiful B&B! We stayed in the Baxter room, which is in the carriage house, not the main house, making it the most private room and it was perfect. We had a cute little private screened in porch and everything. The inn was quiet, yet still sociable. We were able to walk to all of the nearby restaurants/downtown area very easily. Breakfast was yummy, too. Overall, a wonderful experience and I would absolutely return. I'd even like to check it out in the winter too, seems like a nice place to get snowed in.

author: buttercupjd
title: Fabulous service and food!
text: I stayed here with a friend in the smallest room in the inn. It was well-kept, quaint, and clean. The inn itself is gorgeous, with a room where they serve tea and cookies in the afternoons and a nice back porch. Every morning we had breakfast at the big dining table with the other guests -- the food was delicious and the company was great. The owners of the inn are both exceptionally friendly and go out of their way to make you feel at home. They even picked us up from the airport so that we wouldn't have to pay for a cab. They also provided beach towels and let us use their beach chairs so we could read on the beach. The inn is a hike from the beach (but doable) but it is within easy walking distance of the "downtown" area of Kennebunkport, and you can spend a few days there without a car.

author: enr12
title: Delightful stay in a great location
text: This was our second stay in a Bed and breakfast, and we were assigned to the montecello room which was large, with a lot of good light. The bathroom was a little on the small side, but overall the facilities were very good. Afternoon tea was served in a very bright and charming room and you almost felt like you were out doors with all the glass around. We were welcomed to breakfast the next morning to a set meal that was very good. Breakfast was done in two sittings. If we were not on schedule, I would take the 9:30am second sitting for a more relaxed time. The room and the whole facilities were spotlessly clean, and within a couple blocks from the main town. I would come back here again, and spend a little more time to see the area.

author: CtCatten
title: An Excellent Getaway
text: We stayed at Capt Jefferd's last week for a short Labor Day getaway and were made to feel very welcome and comfortable. We chose a dog friendly suite so we could bring our Golden Retreiver . They welcomed her with everything she needed from blanket, towels, bowls, tennis ball and a bone with her name on it. Though the dog suites are not quite as beautifully appointed as the other rooms, it was absolutely clean and fresh and we were more than happy. Breakfasts are done in one or two sittings in their lovely dining room.The food is freshly prepared and garnished with beautiful little flowers which are a treat to the eye. Unfortunately, if you don't like the main entree, there's not a second choice offered. Even a toast is out of the question. The location of this inn is absolutely perfect, being a two minute walk into the town with all the shopping and restaurants. Its very quiet at the same time nicely tucked into a little side street with a lovely green and gorgeous gardens surrounding. We will definitely return next year with or without the dog.

author: DogLoverNH
title: A Girls Weekend with our dogs!
text: I stayed in Baxter one of the dog friendly rooms for a weekend of fun at the beach, shopping, and good food. The room and the inn itself was both elegant and comfortable. In our room we were greeted with fresh flowers as well as chocolates next to the King sized bed. Another plus is the gas fireplace and large two person jacuzzi tub. As it was an unseasonably warm April weekend, we did not need the gas fireplace however we certainly did take advantage of the jacuzzi tub. The jacuzzi is surrounded by natural stones with a peaceful mural painted on the wall behind it and it was big enough to fit both my friend and I comfortably in our bathiing suits! As a dog owner, I was also delighted to see it equipped with bowls, dog towels, extra sheets and even a Moose dog cookie! The staff was friendly and the innkeepers were happy to recommend shops and good restaurants in the area. We spent most of the day enjoying the beach, which is a short drive away, as well as local shops which are easily walked to. The inn is an excellent place for a romantic weekend or a weekend shopping and hanging out at the beach with just the girls!

author: UnderwoodATL
title: Beautiful Stay at Captain Jefferds
text: I just returned from a 2 night stay at Captain Jefferds, and I couldn't have been more pleased. I stayed in the Vermont Suite, and the room was absolutely beautiful. Beautiful music was playing in the room when we arrived, and we had a wonderful screened porch overlooking a water feature at the back of the property. The gardens on the property are spectacular, and you can't beat the location. The innkeepers were very helpful, and we thoroughly enjoyed the time socializing with the other guests in the afternoon over coffee/tea and delicious homemade treats. Breakfast was exquisite. My favorite was the 2nd morning when we enjoyed peaches & cream, popovers with delicious blueberry preserves and herb crepes. I would highly recommend this Inn and would absolutely stay there in the future.

author: GinnyN
title: Loved every minute!
text: From the first minute I walked in, I was treated like family. My bedroom had classical music playing when I arrived, and was spotless, very pretty and the bedding was wonderful and comfortable. The candles in the windows were also a homey touch. The breakfasts were very good and sitting at one large table with everyone, made it easy to make new friends, which I did. They booked a schooner cruise for me and even made dinner reservations, too. The sunroom was a great gathering place - all the other guests were so friendly and this was a really nice way to end the day. The grounds are beautiful and it was just a couple of minutes to the dock area. The surrounding homes are so beautiful too, that I never wanted to leave!

author: JetPlane06
title: Lovely Inn!
text: I recently stayed at Captain Jefferds Inn. We loved staying here and had a great time in Kennebunkport. The Inn was really pretty. We had a very nice room with a large bathroom. The breakfast each morning was delicious. All of the staff at the inn were very friendly and helpful with anything that we needed. The location of the inn was also great. We had a car which we used to go out to some of the beaches that were located a few miles away, but everything else (restaurants, shops) were within short walking distance which we really liked. Overall- wonderful experience at CJI!

author: traveler0717
title: Loved this Inn
text: The inn is located in a great location, just a few blocks from Dock Square, allowing us to walk everywhere and leave our car in the parking lot. The inn is beautiful and clean. We stayed in one of the smaller rooms, but it was quite lovely. I "peeked" in some of the rooms that were not occupied, and each room is just lovely. I don't think you'd be disappointed in an any room. They supplied a full and delicious breakfast. Try it- you'll love it!!! Sharon in Newport, RI

author: NEReviewer
title: Wonderful weekend getaway
text: Three of us (parents and our 16 year old) headed to Kennebunkport for a long weekend away during the off-season in late March. After being overwhelmed by the number of B&Bs on Tripadvisor receiving great reviews and remaining undecided, we drove up and visited several places to make a decision on the spot. We were warmly welcomed by Erik, who showed us several room choices that would serve us. We checked a few other B&Bs after that, but quickly returned to Captain Jefferds to check in. We stayed in a lovely suite with a room for us, a separate room with a daybed for our daughter, and the bathroom in the center, so we didn't have to go through each other's rooms to access it. Everything was spotless, and even though this was a room that allowed pets, nothing smelled "doggy" at all, which was a plus for us. As we experienced an unexpected snowstorm, the large soaking tub was a nice way to warm up at the end of the day. Breakfasts were delicious, and cookies, teas, hot chocolate, mulled cider, and one evening - wine and cheese - provided snack opportunities at other times of the day. We enjoyed a great dinner at Bandaloop at Erik and Sarah's recommendation, and appreciated that we could walk to so many places. We will definitely return and highly recommend this relaxing B&B!

author: JackieOntario
title: highly reccommended
text: On a short notice stay in Kennebunkport, my husnamd and I needed accomodations. After a reference from On the Marsh restaurant, we decided to look into the Captain Jefferds Inn. Even without reservations, The innkeeper, Chris, was very accomodating and showed us to the Hideaway room. While quaint in size, it was extremely accomodating and cozy. We had the best night's sleep in a long time! Breakfast was a treat. The pancakes were out of this world, and conversation with other guests around the dining room table was pleasent. Looking forward to another trip to Maine and Captain Jeffards!

author: addie_dog
title: Felt Right at Home
text: My husband and I stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn in late July and we just loved it! The house is beautiful and the grounds are just perfect for enjoying a summer afternoon. We stayed in the smallest room in the inn (the Hideaway) and it was bigger than we expected and adorably decorated (although it did get a tad hot at times, even with the air on). Every day from late afternooon on there were delcious cookies and other desserts for the guests, and all day long some of the best coffee and tea I ever had was available. We brought our dog along with us and she was provided with her very own treats, food bowls, placemat, and blankets. She even got to play with the inn dog, Eloise, who is just the sweetest little thing. The innkeepers were incredibly friendly, providing us with towels and beach chairs for our trip to the beach, carrying an ironing board and iron up to our room when we needed it, and just simply making us feel at home the entire time we were there. I definitely recommend this inn to anyone staying in Kennebunkport!

author: flmama
title: Excellent Inn!
text: Absolutely wonderful expience at Captain Jeffords. We frequent B&B's and this is the best one yet. Comfy bed, great food and great hospitality! Also, a great location- walking distance to "downtown" Kennebunkport. Since they are technically an inn, they accept children- a rarity at B&B's. We brought our 8 month old daughter, and they treated her as another valued guest. We're already planning a trip for next fall. Can't wait to return!

author: Namaste928
title: Good choice
text: Very nice inn. Beautiful rooms and dog friendly if you are a well behaved owner (and you should be!). We used to go when Dick B owned it. We enjoyed it much more then. Dick and his wife were very sweet and the rooms were reasonable. The new owners are nice but a bit standoffish. The room rates are significantly higher and I'm not sure it's worth the extra $$. The breakfasts have been scaled down significantly. It's very close to Kennebunkport though and as I've said the rooms are beautiful and the whole inn emanates peace.

author: stonetravel
title: The Best B&B
text: Captain Jefferds was a fantastic B&B. They are ideally located, within walking distance to town, and the accommodations were excellent. Probably the best B&B we've ever stayed in. We were there for our anniversary and they had a half bottle of champagne on ice in our room when we arrived. They were very accommodating and honest on restaurant reservations and recommendations. We loved reading and relaxing by the fireplace with some wine in the evenings, and the breakfasts were excellent and filling. The afternoon snacks, cookies, tea and hot cider were a nice touch. Highly recommend this B&B!!

author: WHH
title: Captain Jefferds is a keeper!
text: Just returned from three nights at this first class B&B. The innkeepers were gracious and extremely helpful and eager to please. There is an acute attention to detail at this establishment in a positive and relaxing manner. The location is PERFECT for walking into town, sightseeing and dining. Parking at the B&B is sufficient for most activities. The rooms are thoughtfully appointed without the "cuteness" and clutter found in some places. The breakfasts were delicious and bountiful. Overall a very good value and a place to which we shall return.

author: CaptainJJG29
title: Great Place, Location and People!!!
text: My fiance and I stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn for a long weekend in August. We stayed in a little room they call "Bilbo's Hideaway." It was there smallest room, but was awesome. The room had a lot of character with a private entrance and all the amenities of the inn. The innkeepers and help was great. Everyone was always at your service and constantly ensuring that the guests needs were exceeded. The breakfast and afternoon tea was far beyond what we have experienced at other bed and breakfasts throughout new england. The inn is in an ideal location just a few steps from the downtown and a short walk to the beach and Bush compound. I would highly recommned this inn to anyone who would like to get away from everything and relax.

author: Connector21135
title: maine
text: Just got back from two nights at the captain jefferds inn. It was a wonderful experience. The inn is very clean, breakfast delicious, and within walking distance to the town. The owners help with reservations and suggestions for dinner. Great outlet mall about 45 min. north in freeport. Recommend Allison's for the best lobster roll in town. Stayed in the Manhattan room and it was very nice.

author: permaeagle
title: Classic
text: My husband and I stayed at the Captain Jefferd's Inn for three nights in celebration of our first wedding anniversary. The service was top notch, the breakfasts were absolutely delicious, and our fellow guest were a jovial bunch. Rooms were very clean, and the Inn, itself, is in a tremendous location in relation to downtown Kennebunkport. My husband and I didn't use our car once. If you are serious walkers like us, you won't have to use your car either. The only gripe that you might have with the Inn is the fact that you are pretty much required to socialize each morning over breakfast. You can opt to enjoy your morning coffee by yourself in the backyard, but you can't eat breakfast on your own. If you are a not a morning person, this will not be much fun for you. Oh, and the bedspreads and wallpaper are a bit dated. But otherwise, this is a lovely and charming Inn that will not disappoint!

author: GrandTour14693
title: Pretty close to a perfect place
text: Certainly one of the best B&Bs we've ever stayed in. Nicely decorated room, very clean and with all the charming details. Absolutely delicious breakfast. (Even took home the recipe.) We've never met a nicer, more accomodating staff. The location couldn't be better. Once you check in, you can leave your car in the parking area and walk to most places. Can't say enough about what a wonderful place the Captain Jefferds Inn is. You do need to be aware that they allow people to bring their dogs. Although we didn't bring our dog, we had plenty of fun meeting other guests and their dogs. Will definitely be going back and highly recommending the Captain Jefferds Inn.

author: Jhon1_2013
title: Beyond our expectations.
text: We agree with all the steller reviews. We would choose this Inn as our vacation destination in the future, as we could not imagine staying anywhere else. The rooms are unique, as each room has it's own insperation. We have stayed in two very different rooms and the feeling you leave with is like going to a new location of the world each time. The breakfast is to die for as are the linens. If we didn't have to get to our amazing breakfast we may have just stayed in our room all day. The location is perfect for getting to all the shops, restuarants and the local sights. A must visit.

author: KatieMK
title: Great Place
text: At the recommendation of friends who are in the know about Kennebunkport, we have stayed at the Captain Jefferds Inn, twice in fact. It is an absolutely wonderful B&B; they pay attention to EVERY detail. Rooms are authentic and beautifully decorated; great linens; comfortable (and very new) bathrooms. The breakfasts are over the top; a great treat. You will also enjoy the community areas of the home which are very open and airy, and find that the owners are very accommodating. You will LOVE the Captain Jefferds Inn, guaranteed. PS when you are in K-B don't miss out on having a lobster dinner at Mabels! Katie

author: bishopbriggs1128310
title: Beatiful Hotel
text: The outlook, décor and general style of the place is fabulous. One standout is the staff - they are consistently welcoming and friendly. I was offered a vegetarian cooked breakfast and the buffet was great too. Looks like it would be the perfect place for a wedding - the view of the sea from the function rooms is breathtaking. The trouble was, as is often the case in hotels, I was travelling alone. All these wonderful reviews of non-single occupancy rooms make me feel quite jealous. There was a few small but easily-remedied flaws in the room - quite big chips in the paintwork, stains on the bed linen, a dirty light cord in the shower room (not a bathroom as it had no bath), the shower had a lot of black mold in the cabinet base, there was no toilet roll holder, towel rail and the mirror light didn't work. The room was a bit of a disappointment after the lovely surroundings on the way in. Like any other time I've travelled alone to a hotel, I was left feeling like an afterthought as a solo traveller. There were so many great things about the Brisbane House Hotel, it would be a lovely place to stay in a group.

author: T1539ZEkarenm
title: Excellent hotel, staff, food and location
text: My husband and I bought an Itison deal for our Christmas for DB&B. For an extra £25 we upgraded to the executive suite and for £100 in total we got incredible value for money. The suite was beautiful, well decorated and spacious, overlooking the sea. The 3 course meal included in the deal was excellent, something I’d happily pay full price for if I was to return. The breakfast was lovely, with plenty to choose from hot or cold. The staff were lovely, very attentive - nothing was too much trouble for them. The hotel itself is beautiful, recently renovated to a high standard and it’s literally in the centre of Largs with shops and pubs right on your doorstep. We’ll most definitely be back. Thanks to all the hardworking staff at the Brisbane, keep up the great work!

author: GlasGal549
title: Wonderful stay
text: We booked the Brisbane on a dinner bed and breakfast deal and were not disappointed. We had a super room overlooking the sea. Clean and very spacious. The meal included with the deal was super. As it was December it was a Christmas Dinner with all the trimmings. We all enjoed our meal and my husband said it's the best Christmas Dinner he's had in a long time. Breakfast was fabulous too. It was just what we needed, a nice relaxing stay. The staff were very friendly. We will definitely be back.

author: holland21
title: Reasonable overnight stay, but...........
text: The hotel looked okay from the outside and the receptionist was welcoming and friendly, there was a wedding receptionist going on and so the entrance was quite busy as was the car park. However as we made our way to our room we noticed that there were a few cosmetic improvements needed and this continued into our room. Our room was at the front of the hotel with great views across the bay to Isle of Cumbrae, unfortunately there was a heavy mist! Other than the minor irritations of cosmetic flaws the room was reasonably comfortable and we never experienced noise problems from the wedding reception. Our evening meal started off positively but was let down massively by the staff and I believe that deserves it’s own review! I certainly would not rush back to eat there again that’s for sure! Breakfast was reasonable, a good choice of cereal and the hot food menu seemed okay. On the whole the staff were really friendly and we would go back for a night as a base but not eat in Oscars!

author: hma
title: Comfortable hotel with friendly staff
text: My wife & I had a lovely 2 nights at the hotel and paid extra for a seaview suite which was very good value for money. The room was very large and the bathroom was also huge with a spa bath and space-age shower. Tea & coffee facilities are provided in -room, and there are adequate on site parking spaces. We would have no hesitation in returning to the hotel. Our only slight concern is the lack of a lift or even a stairlift, as my wife struggled with the spiral staircase. But, in the end, she liked the hotel so much that she would return in a heartbeat. But, for a wheelchair bound person it might not be possible to stay - unless there are ground floor rooms. Our overall opinion is very positive and we loved it.

author: 924gregors
title: Great over night stay
text: We were given our room key on arrival, room 106. But when we got there the sounds coming from the kitchen fans, vents extractor fans was loud. We asked at reception about this and were assured they would go off after the kitchen closed for the night. After returning to the hotel after a walk the girl on reception upgraded our room. We had a great stay, the room was very nice with a sea view. All staff were friendly and helpful. Food was great big portions. We will be back

author: 637MaryM
title: Fantastic Stay!
text: Thoroughly enjoyed an overnight stay here with 3 course evening meal using an Itison deal. First class from check in to departure this morning. Very friendly and helpful staff in all depts. - a special mention for Pauline who was very kind and efficient. We had a front facing room on 1st floor which was both comfortable and spacious. Both dinner and breakfast were delicious with good choice of menus. A real treat - only disappointment was the rain - but it is November!! We would have no hesitation recommending this hotel to friends and family.

author: tomsG6123WN
title: Best in area. Just a notch or two away from 5 star billing.
text: Delicious Scotch rolls for breakfast. But disappointed by the scented tea. Not to this customer's taste. Told it wasn't Earl Grey and there was no alternative. Funny. I got a pot of Tetleys the morning before during a slight staffing hitch. The room's hot water supply was close to boiling so perhaps the thermostat on the tank had been maladjusted. As always in Scotland the friendliness of the staff outweighed any other misfortune.

author: Paul1875
title: Business meeting
text: We had an overnight meeting. The location was very central. The accommodation was wonderful. The food was excellent. The staff were phenomenal. This overnight stay surpassed anything that we could have asked for. The breakfast was individually prepared which meant that you got only what you wanted and it was made fresh. Would recommend it anytime.

author: Timallalone
title: Average - should be much better at this price and in this location
text: We stayed two nights at the hotel during our nostalgia tour of Largs. It has a superb location and apparently does a good trade in weddings. Next door is the famous Nardini Cafe. We found the breakfast very average, although redeemed by the excellent and helpful waiting staff. The room attendants do a good job. The same cannot be said of the receptionists (there seemed to be two); one is perfunctory and unfriendly, the other OK. I suggest that some staff movement might be a good idea - put the room attendants on the front desk. No internet in our room - really quite astonishing in a hotel billed as the best in twon, and hardly cheap. Most of the clientele seems very old, and this may be part of the reason, but not acceptable in 2018.

author: M3624SKjackiem
title: Coffee / meals
text: Have been meeting friends weekly or more for coffee and scones for six years now. I'm gluten free and have repeatedly asked for a GF option but eighty visits down the line and nothing. They are not even apologetic. I either bring my own food or resign myself to watching the rest of the group eating. Service is patchy and has been downright unpleasant at times. The improvement in recent years in GF provision has been marked in most shops and eateries in Largs but not at the Brisbane. They do have some GF meal options but they are pretty limited and never change. It's such a pity as Oscars itself is a very pleasant place to meet.

author: MollyB3LL3
title: Not good.
text: As soon as i checked in to the Brisbane I had my doubts. The most unfriendly welcome I’ve ever had, the girl on the desk barely raised her head for me. The room its self was a bit drab the mattress has seen better days, the tea making facility was poor. I decided to have dinner on the premises, the service was to say the least very poor, food nothing to write home about, the serving staff were there in body but certainly not in soul. The breakfast was on par with a funeral, terribly morbid background music served by a rather stressed out looking woman who was running around like maniac. Ive sat and read the reviews and the management responses. More or less every review response starts with “sorry we fell short”????? Sorry Brisbane I won’t be back nor will i recommend.

author: Jacqandrews1
title: Bar and restaurant review
text: We didn’t stay at the hotel but we enjoyed the bar and restaurant over a few days whilst staying nearby. It was lovely to find such a nice place with the beautiful setting overlooking the sea. The drinks were served well and there is a decent and nicely varied food menu. There was a really efficient and helpful lady working in the bar each of the three days we went there. Her name might be Nicky? You are an asset to the hotel. We were the group who unfortunately caused a bit of a mess when a kids toy broke open and powder went all over the area we were sat at. Thanks for being helpful and kind to us throughout but especially then. (Sorry for the mess that had to be cleared up). Would definitely look forward to returning when we are back in the area and would recommend.

author: nikkilevel27
title: Nice to look at..
text: Stayed here the night before a wedding. The wedding was a great day and had no complaints there. However we stayed in the Glen suite the night before and it was the worst nights sleep I have ever had. I slept on the pull out sofa bed which was really uncomfortable with 1 pancake flat pillow. My friend was on a single bed which collapsed and she ended up sleeping with the mattress on the floor. I have no idea what was underneath the room but all you could hear was banging of doors all night long. Would not recommend this room! However we did enjoy the wedding and had a great day and night. Food was ok. The hotel does look lovely but I wouldn't want to stay overnight again.

author: Muireall
title: Average
text: We booked a room on impulse and based on good reviews on another website. Our stay was ok but also just that. The restaurant staff was nice and attentive and the food was nice. But the receptionist could have been a lot friendlier. In our room there was a used towel behind the bathroom door, a used bar of soap in the shower, the sink stopper was blocked and required some force to open, there was no hot water in the sink although the shower was ok and working. The kettle had been unplugged and we had a hard time plugging it in again in the most awkward and hardly accessible place behind the desk. These are complaints which one would expect the maid to notice when cleaning the room - if not it would be for the person checking to become aware. Also, availability of the hotel Wifi ranged from totally random and unstable to not available and utterly unreliable.

author: 35vivianv
title: Short 2 day visit to largs
text: My husband and I had a very long journey from Canada to largs, and after checking in, with our cases, we realized that there was no lift and we were on the 2nd floor. There was no offer to help us with our bags, We arrived in the room which faced on to the sea front. Nice room, however, we wanted to have a shower to freshen up but, the shower pressure was almost nil. The internet access was not good either. Very frustrating indeed! The receptionist was very nice over the 2 days that we were there, and the restaurant staff were very efficient and friendly. The breakfasts were excellent. Not sure that I would pay the price that I was charged for this hotel again!

author: J8974FDronaldm
title: Great experience
text: We had an overnight stay using an Itison voucher. The hotel is in a lovey location, practically on the beach and near town center.. It is bright modern and very welcoming. The staff were very friendly and efficient. The food was excellent and the breakfast was served HOT, which doesn't happen in some hotels. They had a mini breakfast on the menu as well as the large, which suited my wife, as she doesn't eat the full breakfast. Our room (203) was spacious, clean, and bright. The bathroom, which was quite big had a walk in shower. Superb. Will definitely return.

author: 77PaulaM
title: Great friendly stay
text: We stayed overnight as 2 couples on Mothering Sunday on itison vouchers DBB. Staff friendly and welcoming with plenty of banter had by all. We ordered from the al la Carte menu and paid the extra as most had steaks. The food was enjoyed by us all. Nikki and her team did the hotel proud and added to our overnight stay. Our rooms were clean and modern. We paid for the upgrades and our friends loved the suite they got. Our sea view room was compact with what was required. Only downside is stairs are rather steep and anyone with a disability in climbing stairs or breathing difficulties would find bedroom access hard as there is no lift. We would return again to this lovely friendly hotel to either stay or pop in for lunch.

author: 325jeanm
title: Wedding review
text: The Brisbane House Hotel is spacious, friendly and expert at the whole wedding venue organisation. Most family had booked for the weekend, taking up a lot of the hotels accommodation!
