On the Friday night most ate in the bar, the meal was very good and good value for money! Breakfast was fresh and very good, on both mornings! The wedding organisation was superb and the mistress of ceremonies was very efficient, friendly and fun! While photographs were being taken guests were offered a variety of snacks, which were fresh and plentiful and very tasty! The wedding meal was standard fair for a wedding reception, served quickly and efficiently! The reception room was well lit and spacious! We were booked in and out efficiently and both receptionists I met were very pleasant! My only complaint, and not for my benefit, was the lack of a lift!

author: lancer2009
title: Once again... BRILLIANT
text: Our 3rd time staying at this hotel, this time with an "Itison" deal... room, three course dinner, breakfast and a glass of proseco for a ridiculously cheap price. On arrival, they kindly upgraded us to their Celebration Suite double room. This was really nice as it was our 28th anniversary. Room, facilities, view, food, service - all absolutely excellent. Every single member of staff from receptionist to the dinner waiting staff, the morning waiting staff, the cleaners and not forgetting the lovely girl who brought us our proseco were friendly, professional and made us feel super welcome. I reviewed this hotel a few years ago - I thought it was excellent then, but our latest visit just topped everything and exceeded our highest expectations. I think the hotel has undergone some improvements recently, so it certainly deserves a new and up to date review. Just keep doing what you are doing guys, You are an absolute credit to Largs.

author: L38IPjamesm
title: VFM! 👍😁
text: This was another itison deal and for the price, brilliant value for money! There were no rooms left, when we tried to book for Sunday 25th Feb, so we went for Monday 26th Feb, plus an upgrade £10. Our Room 103 was bang in the centre of the hotel and sea view from the windows..was hidden! (Asked if could be moved, but informed by Reception...Hotel was full! 🤔) Good size room etc and bed was huge! ..room hot though and plumping in bathroom, needed scented, but slept well and food at evening meal of 3 courses, was very good as was the breakfast in the morning, where you order your cooked breakfast, rather than everything cooked ages ago, on hot plates. Staff in bar and eating area, were young and overall, helpful and helpful. Over all, The Brisbane for us, was a great place to stay so central to Largs and plenty of car park places and would we come back....YES! 🤗 Thank you for a pleasant wee break and timed nicely...HEAVY SNOW ❄️ next day!

author: paul_quarmby
title: Avoid at all costs at weekends
text: I am currently working in the area, and my partner wished to come up to visit for the weekend, so we booked a night here. After a 6 hour train ride we were hoping for a peaceful evening, nice meal and a good nights sleep, but unfortunately we didnt get one minutes sleep. On booking, i received an email stating that they host weddings during the weekends and therefore be aware there may be extra noise generated from the funcion rooms etc, which was fair enough. This it turns out is their get out clause for any disturbances during the night no matter how loud they are. We were kept awake from 11pm till i had to get up for work at 7am, by residents screaming and shouting and running up and down the corridors, all night long, mentioning having guns in his room when challenged by the night porter. The night porter it seems, has tried and failed all night to sort this out, which he admitted to me when i went to leave in the morning, and admitted this often happens when there's a wedding on (every weekend!). I have subsequently lodged a complaint, however the initial email sent out is their get out clause, even though there is marked difference between increased noise levels from a function room in the same building, to a crazed man screaming all night long. Therefore no offers to refund the cost of the room. A reply which i waited a week to receive. Add to this the shower couldnt decided whether to be on or not, and the evening meal was distinctly average, made for a disaster of a stay, and I certainly will not be attending again.

author: dempsey382
title: Don't bother at weekends
text: If your after a peaceful getaway to enjoy then make sure this place hasn't a wedding on, I got to sleep at 2am after the "rave" downstairs had ended and they switched their noise off. I thought it would be OK as I had earplugs but my bed was shaking with it. Breakfast was ok. Receptionist in the morning, Heather was very unskilled and didn't have a clue how to do the receipt right so if your a contractor and need your receipts then sort it on arrival as the hotel take multiple payments and chuck them on one bill.... So annoying. I used this place as a last resort as all the good places in Largs were full. I'll give it a miss next time. To all you people who like to stay up all night.. Get in there you will love it.

author: faraway78
title: Family wedding.
text: I arrived at this hotel on Friday afternoon to check in, I'd made the reservations for 2 family rooms and a double room over a year ago for my cousins wedding. 7 of us traveled in 3 different cars for over 3 hours to arrive here. On arrival I was informed that no booking was made, it definitely was as I had made it myself booking us to stay Friday and Saturday night because we had children in our party one of which was in the wedding party and up early for this on the Saturday morning. We had to start looking for alternative accommodation on Friday and told we would be given priority early check in on Saturday of 12pm. The wedding was in the hotel at 2pm and we eventually got given the keys to our rooms after 1pm! The staff didn't indicate where the rooms were and this caused us to use up even more of the little time we had to get ready. A member of staff then informed us that it looked like our booking had been moved!! Please anyone staying in this hotel double check and then check again. The incompetency ruined our weekend and plans we had made for a stress free event. I'd like to comment on the hotel but unfortunately with the little time spent here it isn't possible.

author: NeilG1927
title: All flash no substance
text: Ok, looks lovely from outside and possibly is in some rooms. Checked in, was asked to pay again for some reason ( I refused and showed the lass the email). Got her to also order a cab for the morning (which I found out at 8 am she had failed to do). Room Small, noisy ( hear the neighbours toilet/ tv etc) and generally not good. Tip #1 use the teabag in 2 mugs to get a cuppa.... as you are provided with thimbles. Breakfast: Very good. This is the reason it's a 3 not a 1.5! Largs: Lovely! Ps, this was a warm sunny day that are apparently quite rare ;) Tip#2 check out the 1970's staircase, stunning!

author: aileenm308
title: Lovely overnight stay
text: My husband, 2 young children and I stayed overnight at the Brisbane House Hotel, which was a Christmas gift to us. On arrival, we were greeted by Francesca who was very informative and attentive to the boys, and our check-in was very smooth and quick. We were staying in the 'Glen Room' which was the family room. This room was lovely with a living room area and bedroom area, and was almost like a self contained apartment. The only downfall we had was with the shower, which blocked every time it was used, meaning that we had to shower quickly or risk flooding the bathroom! The floor tiles also need a bit of tlc, as these are currently secured with tape. I have only mentioned this as it has previously highlighted in another review. The food for both dinner and breakfast was excellent - as was the service! I would thoroughly recommend a stay at this hotel - and we will definitely return sometime soon!

author: 726jillianb
title: So so
text: The hotel it's self was amazing! Super clean and the executive suite Is just amazing! The only couple things that let it down was the noise, walls seem to be paper thin and you can hear every little detail of people being outside your room door and walking up and down! We were never told how to work the phone and there was no menu for room service! And lastly, the food was mediocre, not the best food for an uptown hotel that it is! We asked for a few different things off the menu and we were told there was nun available, including a tom Collins cocktail! They Couldn't do any type of chicken started but could do chicken fajitas? The breakfast we received was very cold also! The restaurant staff were a bit slow and lackadaisical as if they didn't know what hey were doing! I will say one good thing, the hotel receptionist at the front door was hilarious :-) the very good rating is for the room not the food that's for sure!

author: 150lesleym
title: Honeymoon Suite
text: I recently returned to the Brisbane House as part of an Itison deal. We paid an extra £25 for a suite when booking. On arrival we were pleasantly surprised to see the room (101) had been refurbished since our last visit. A suggestion to the hotel would be to update the website as this does not reflect the new rooms. A few minutes after check in we received two glasses of prosecco delivered to our room. The room itself is stunning and very modern with a lovely view. The bathroom is perfect.. mood lighting, jacuzzi bath and walk in shower. The food was delicious albeit the service a little slow. I would definitely recommend this hotel and will return again.

author: shazzer14
title: Christmas present
text: Have been to this hotel twice . The service on arrival was quick & effiecent.. we got the sea view that we had upgraded to... the room was very clean spacious .. the enquire was clean & modern, jacquzzi bath & big spacious shower with I took full advantage of...Dinner in the resteraunt was as good as the last time we were there. Most enjoyable..reception, bar & resteraunt staff were very friendly & helpful not to forget the staff that cleans the rooms , although they are not front of house they should be commended for their attention to detail on doing their daily tasks.. I will be back for sure...totally recommended.. thank you.. Brisbine..

author: alexmO6837QZ
title: Last minute
text: Due to the bad weather the golf competition I was meant to be playing in was cancelled,so at the last minute I called the hotel and they had a couple of rooms available. On arrival the receptionist allocated us our room we had been given a free upgrade. It's a very smart looking small hotel it looks as if there has been recent decorating done. The decor is modern. The rooms are nicely laid out and pretty modern as is the bathroom. The room itself was spotless with tea making facilities. There was a good choice for breakfast also. There are plenty of local pubs in the area, but if you don't want to venture out there is a restaurant and bar in the hotel. If you are visiting the Ayrshire coast then it would be an ideal base as the hotel is of a good standard and very reasonably priced. I would definitely use this hotel again.

author: Cthorb73
title: Extremely Disappointing
text: We stayed here overnight on 28/12/16 (3 couples) with an Itison deal. We stayed here 2 years ago and had a lovely time, however this time we were very disappointed. We had booked dinner for 6.15pm, we eventually left the restaurant at 8.45pm after painfully slow service and lukewarm food. Half of our party had to leave before dessert arrived as we had arranged to meet friends. The rooms were OK, but the bathrooms are very dated, our room (116) had a cracked sink and stained bath. The breakfast was good however this didn't redeem the hotel and we won't be back. I left a review on their Facebook page on 29/12 to which they replied to say my comments would be passed onto the General Manager the following day and he would be in touch with me. Nearly 2 weeks later I am still awaiting his response, shockingly poor service.

author: debbiemoore1963
title: Great stay!
text: We have just returned from a very enjoyable stay at the Brisbane House Hotel. We had booked a small double room at the rear of the hotel, however when we arrived we were given a lovely large room at the front with a seaview. Very impressed! As it was the 1st January hardly any pubs/restaurants were open in Largs so we decided to have a meal in the hotel and were very glad we did as the food was great. We had two courses for £11.50, excellent value! The breakfast in the morning was also very good, great choice and plenty of it! All the staff we encountered were extremely pleasant. Our only regret was that we were only staying for one night so we will definitely be making a return visit!

author: weddingbelle17
title: Up Coming Wedding
text: After visiting numerous venues and trying to find somewhere that suits us a couple, I made contact with Brisbane and put an enquiry in. From the initial Facebook message to meeting Marion I have been very satisfied with the customer service and trying to accommodate meeting myself and partner. We were keen to nail down a date as this venue does fill up fast and their current package is hard to beat. Given this time of year for any hospitality venue is manic, I did not expect to be dealt with so soon and for that I am very appreciative and thankful. At time of booking the hotel was setting up for its Hogmanay ball and we got a little perspective on what to expect on our day. I can't wait to go on the journey with Brisbane and welcome our friends and family to the hotel. We have people flying in from different parts of the world to attend and I'm sure they will enjoy it. And just to step aside from wedding talk, I have ate at the hotel and the food is very good and well presented. Prices are hotel prices and standard policies do apply for alcohol consumption etc. A great experience so far.

author: 998douglast
title: Awful
text: Had a visit to fawlty towers/Brisbane House with my wife and another 2 couples. Rooms are ok but mattresses are as old as the hotel and the bathroom had a cracked sink and stained bath. Shower was awful, and had random holes cut into ceiling. We booked through itison as we had visited here a couple of years ago and our visit then was ok. Booked our meal for 18:15 but the service was appauling, starters took forever to come and were luke warm at best, drinks were almost impossible to obtain from the staff that were 6 feet behind us at the bar and seemed to stare at the pumps willing them to pour themselves and at one point took over 30 mins to get a pint after I had complained. Next came the main course which took about another hour to arrive, tasted ok but everything we had was luke warm and one of the party had to send her tikka back as the sauce was ice cold, it was then microwaved and returned to her luke warm!. Final straw was the sweet which 3 of us didn't get as it took so long to come and we had to leave to meet friends, the others said the crumble tasted of vomit, the hot fudge cake could be poured(including ice cream) the rest wasn't very nice. It is worth noting that we left at 20:20 and still didn't get our sweet and is honestly the worst service I have ever recieved. I would strongly advise anyone looking at this hotel for a visit or wedding to look else where as it was absolutely awful. If you could give less than a 1 star rating I would have.

author: mandjScotland
title: Christmas party night
text: Booked this party night very last minute for our work night out and so glad we did. The staff were friendly and efficient. The meal was well presented and a portion size good. Also no problem to accommodate vegetarian choice. The tables were decorated and had balloons, streamers and Tooters to get the party started. The DJ got the games going and the floor full all night. Great fun. The manager Marion was extremely efficient,professional and organised her team well. It turned out a great last minute decision. Would recommend for the food, dancing and Christmas fun.

author: Aberbud
title: Surprisingly enjoyable stay
text: I'm sorry if the review title sounds like I'm being sarcastic, I'm really not. I'd been put off staying here by colleagues but gave it a go and I'm glad I did. The bedrooms and public rooms look as though they have recently been given a makeover and I have absolutely no complaints about the accommodation. Big room, very comfortable bed, no noise whatsoever. That's all I ask from a hotel room. I ate in the restaurant both nights and the food was fine but not amazing. The hotel is literally next door to Nardini's so I'll probably eat there next time. All the staff I met with were friendly and helpful. I'll definitely stay here again.

author: tomscotty
title: A joke from start to finish.. avoid like the plague
text: Booked it on Booking.com When we got there, they didn't have our booking (although it was clearly on booking.com) Showed us a tiny room at the back and said they would do us a deal £75 BnB Advised us that there was a wedding on in the hotel Fighting our way through the crowd of smokers at the front door, we went into Largs for dinner. As we wanted to stay in Largs, we accepted the compromise, we got back from dinner 10 ish and hoped for a quiet drink in the bar... but the wedding guests were constantly to and fro-ing (even though they had their own bar/ function room) To bed at 11pm, they had put us on the 1st floor so the noise from the wedding was awful. But we accepted there was a wedding and hoped for peace at Midnight. No chance, I called down to reception and they told me the music would be that loud until 1am! (not even a turn down in volume after 12 midnight) By this time 30 after midnight, terribly stuffy small room; very noisy. We decided to check out and drive home to Glasgow. Reception advised us we would be refunded the next day, guess what 5 days later and no refund! I cannot be bothered to call them and complain about the lack of refund; in fact if they had honoured their promise of refund, I might have looked upon the experience as a near miss.

author: Paisleypunters
title: Nice Hotel and great Wedding Venue
text: I attended a wedding here (August 2016) and must say I was really impressed with the Hotel. I had made a reservation and contacted the hotel to explain that I was part of the wedding party and asked if they would help us out. A problem occurred and after speaking with the hotel manager Marion (I believe that was her name) they were very helpful and accommodating. The front facing room we had was very spacious and the bath was also a Jacuzzi which added to the experience. Breakfast was great and made fresh. The wedding venue looked onto the sea and luckily the sun came out and made a memorable day for everyone attending. The venue was great and staff were friendly, approachable and very efficient. Will definitely visit again

author: Krustee
title: Well worth a visit!!.
text: After dining here on a few of our visits to Largs, my wife & I took advantage of a really outstanding Itison offer for BB&EM. We did not expect anything too outstanding given the price of the voucher. On the day of our arrival Largs was very busy with day trippers enjoying the hot weather & car parking would have been a problem, so it was great to drive straight into the hotel grounds & enjoy fuss free parking. We were greeted by a friendly receptionist who gave us our room key. To our surprise we were allocated a VERY spacious spotless room with windows looking out over the bay, and to top things off the en-suite was just as spacious with a beautiful walk-in shower. It was obvious there had been a lot of refurbishment carried out on the rooms & hallways throughout the hotel as you could smell the newness of the fittings. After a lovely day spent in the tropical heat of the resort we returned to the Brisbane to get showered & shifted for our evening meal where it was a total pleasure to sit down to a lovely 3 course meal in the pleasant air-conditioned restaurant with a great view through the panoramic windows over the bay. While chatting to Francesca at reception later that day, my wife & I were introduced to Bryan the hotel chef who has to be commended on his food as do the staff who work tirelessly serving it with a pleasant smile to the diners. Our only regret is that we didn't book more than one night at the Brisbane. Thanks to Itison & all at the hotel for a really enjoyable stay.

author: Thefreckledone
title: Great stay
text: A great night stay. Evening meal, overnight stay and breakfast. This was purchased using ITSON. There is modernisation work going on but we where given a lovely room at the front. Very comfortable with a fantastic bathroom. The evening meal and the breakfast could not be faulted. Friendly staff. I will recommend this hotel to friends and I will plan a return visit

author: 395jeand
title: Staff great
text: Have stayed here a few times. This was with itison so great value. We were in front roo with sea view which was good it was still in process of being redecorated but considering what we paid was fine. Good bed and bathroom. Dinner was included both nights and couldn,t fault it. We had my five year old granddaughter with us and they were so lovely to her. Special mention to the girl who served breakfast she is a real asset to the hotel but all the staff were very good. I had a small problem with Bill when I left and they sorted it out by writing off the difference. Great location for everywhere in Largs would not go anywhere else will definitely return

author: 370lorrainec
title: great overnight stay
text: Had a great night food great service excellent. We have been once before wil l certainly be back. Booked a suite certainly worth it. Great choice of food great variety. Breakfast all you needed. Weather was good as well. Can't wait to go back next time but will do a couple of nights. Excellent.

author: LoobyLou050
title: Dissapointing
text: Stayed on a voucher deal which was a birthday gift. DBB and a bottle of Prosecco. This hotel has great potential due to the location on Largs seafront, some money has obviously been invested in upgrading the facade, public areas, restaurant and function rooms, unfortunately the accommodation is very tired. On arriving early we left the car in the car park and caught the ferry to Millport to walk round the Island, returning about 4pm we tried the shower to find no hot water, we reported this and it was checked immediately, however we still had no hot water at 6:30pm, or when we returned from dinner or the next morning. To be honest had we not had a couple of drinks during a late lunch in Millport, we would have had an early dinner, packed up and driven home without staying overnight. We had our drinks on the patio area outside before dinner, the view is nice, however staff were very slow to clear tables, empty ashtrays etc. The food in the restaurant was better than expected given the standard of the accommodation, good pub grub though, not fine dining, and we enjoyed our meal. We opted for a room service breakfast which was ok and delivered on time but with 2 empty fruit juice glasses. Overall impression of staff was that they lacked training and motivation and weren't interested in their customers. Wouldn't stay here again.

author: MCLEANI2
title: Family evening
text: Booked an overnight stay for my wife and I. Also dinner for seven. The meal was good no complaints and as we were celebrating our golden wedding expected to enjoy a convivial evening in the bar. Lo and behold the bar staff left around 10pm and the night porter took over. Well there was no draught beer all fonts and pumps shutdown at 10pm. A bit like Fawlty Towers what a disappointment although we sat on it was quite strange on a Friday night to be in a beautiful bar with absolutely no atmosphere.Obviously I doubt I will be back. Room and breakfast were no better than ordinary especially behind a gorgeous facade. Definitely overpriced.

author: AshMac26
title: Better than expected
text: I attended a wedding here at the weekend (Saturday 16th April) and I was dreading it given all the negatives reviews. I have to say I was pleasantly surprised, I had room 102 which was a little twin room with a great view. Bathroom was lovely and modern with a big shower. Room was clean, beds were mega comfy so no complaints there. The wedding was fantastic and the meal was lovely, they really put a lot of effort in and Marion(I think her name is) the wedding planner was so lovely. It's obvious the place is being refurbished but I didn't even pay attention, I was too busy enjoying the wedding. Staff were lovely, as I cut my foot on glass late on (dancing drunk ha!) and I was bandaged up by the staff and sent back to get on with my night. Great place and I had a fantastic stay!

author: catherinemullen9
title: Relaxing stay
text: Initially a bit disappointed because our booking said "front facing room" and when we arrived we had a restricted Seaview!.... no big deal though as we could technically see the sea!!! Room was spotlessly clean and exceptionally spacious! Stairway and hallways could do with a bit of sprucing up.... but again.... no biggy! Staff were pleasant and attentive..... food was typical seaside pub grub but perfectly acceptable! All in all a very enjoyable stay!

author: Rosaleen56
title: Disappointed....Big Time!!!
text: Hotel is situated in a lovely spot on the waterfront, it looks great from the outside but unfortunately that was the best thing about the hotel. We went there for a wedding and stayed overnight...... big mistake! Bedroom and bathroom in poor condition,furniture very shabby and the room was not clean. As for the bed, what can I say? Dreadful, appalling,? I certainly didn't sleep. It was overpriced at £90.

author: elliottf214
title: Hostel
text: Went to a so called hotel and God was I shocked. Please do not go to this flee pit. Cost 135 would pay £5 for staying here. Room was shocking and was meant to be a delux family room. Would have been better sleeping in a tent. Manager wasn't there to sort out left it to a cleaner. Got refund and went back home. So if your used to sleeping ruff this is the place to go.

author: AmandaChristison
title: Great Hotel - Horrible Morning After!
text: Had a lovely night at the hotel. Shona served us in the restaurant and was lovely. Very accommodating to my friends dietary requirements. Friendly night porter as well. Food was pretty good - breakfast lovely. Only problem was that at 8am there was an awful drilling noise! The room right upstairs from us was being refurbished and it was impossible to sleep. Spoke to the reception and management - who refused to tell them to stop so had to leave early. Really nice start to the stay but very disappointing departure.

author: JimS87A
title: Great Value
text: Booked a £69 DB&B deal with Itison. Very happy to be given a complimentary upgrade to a sea view room ( Room 207) Room spacious and spotless with roomy bathroom. It is obvious that the proprietors are in the middle of upgrading their rooms and this one was lovely. The meal in the dining room was excellent and free of the usual supplements for everything but basic dishes which is becoming common practice in hotels. Very nice, freshly cooked and hot three course meal with a glass of wine included. The service from all staff , reception and dining was exemplary. Great location right on sea front. We will certainly consider returning and I cannot understand some of the negative reviews. We would certainly recommend this hotel.

author: Machabbie
title: First Class
text: Booked a deal for BBEM, and had a fantastic time last Saturday night. Twin room at front with great views of the snow and sleet across the sea.!! Room was warm and cozy, spotlessly clean, beautiful spacious bathroom, with luxurious shower and complementary toiletries. Everything we needed including usual tea, coffees etc. Meal booked for 7.30pm, varied choice of 3 courses served with a nice chilled wine. Enjoyed everything, good quality well cooked and presented. Breakfast in morning just as good with choice of a full English or continental. Staff pleasant, efficient and helpful. Exceeded expectations. Look forward to returning.

author: ElizaB50
title: Christmas lunch with colleagues
text: Christmas lunch out with work colleagues. We were placed in back restaurant which is not as picturesque as main room with its lovely view. However, as a noises bunch, probably a good move for other diners! Lovely atmosphere with delicious set lunch. Oh menu available. Good value, varied choice and great service. Efficient but not obtrusive. Would highly recommend!

author: douglasc931
title: Mr
text: Had a lovely overnight stay after attending a full day wedding in the hotel. What a fantastic day, the wedding was perfect followed by a lovely dinner. I could not find anything negative about the wedding or the service. The staff were first class. Even the breakfast the next morning was very good. One point I must add my partner has to eat gluten free. At the dinner and at breakfast they went out of their way to give an alternative. The only negative point and it's not that bad is behind the seance, the stairs and the corridors are tired and need a touch of paint and a bit of an upgrade. All in all a lovely place for a wedding or an overnight.

author: AndreanaB
title: Room for Improvement
text: We stayed here for one night as part of an itison deal. First impressions of the hotel were excellent but we were disappointed with the room. We paid a supplement for a sea view and were given room 103 which is located right behind the reception foyer roof and so our view was of a concrete block! We just about managed a sea view if we looked to the side. Also, the room is in serious need of TLC as the skirting boards were flaked, the runner on the bed had missing buttons,the bed was actually two single beds pushed together and there was a large ridge down the middle of the mattress, there was a damp patch on the ceiling, the main ceiling light was full of dust and, most importantly, was a dangerous fire hazard as there was no pendant rose and the light was hanging by loose exposed wires! Now for the positives, the food was excellent. Portions were ample and the food was very tasty so compliments to the chef. The staff were very courteous and helpful especially Danny the barman, he was very informative and cheery and even played Devil's Advocate when we involved him in our lively debate! Danny is a definitely an asset to this hotel and definitely deserves a payrise! I have seen the comments that the rooms are due to be upgraded, I would say this can't happen soon enough but you should not be taking supplements for Room 103 (and possibly the neighbouring rooms) for a seaview when the main view is obliterated by the reception roof.

author: Blitzmiz
title: Astounding Value for Money
text: A group of old school chums and I booked in here on a dbb Itison deal at a rate so low we were expecting something very basic. Was therefore very pleasantly surprised to be greeted in a clean, tidy and we'll kept mid-range hotel with friendly and helpful staff. The real surprise was the included dinner which was excellent and generously portioned and came with a huge glass of decent house wine. The hotel is on Largs seafront and far too handy for Nardinis next door. Meal and drinks prices were very reasonable. The bedrooms we had were supposed to be singles but were all kitted out with double beds. The rooms were basically decorated but spotlessly clean with aircon, adjustable heating, telly and the kit for tea and coffee. The only reason I have only given this amazing value short break 4* and not 5* is because the mattress was extremely firm, even hard, creaked and squeaked and clearly needed replacing. Otherwise a great stay at a fabulous price. Thanks!

author: aileen57
title: 4 amigos
text: A fabulous itison overnight stay with DBB and glass of wine on arrival. We got a complimentary upgrade to seaview rooms which was much appreciated. Rooms lovely and clean, comfortable mattress, large bathroom but a few creaky floor boards. Eclectic mix of furniture - absolutely charming. Food fantastic homemade fare - compliments to the chef,good choice and we ended up staying for lunch the next day too!! Wine and liqueurs yummy. Staff fantastic -everyone was so friendly and nothing was too much trouble - they even looked after our luggage after checkout so we could go for a wander about largs. We would highly recommend this wee bit old,wee bit new hotel and cannot wait to return! Staff are a credit to the hotel. X

author: Lynn-e-2011
title: never dissapointed
text: Have visited here many times. Last time was on an itison offer and actually have another to use soon. It was for lunch and there was a nice choice , we were pleased with what we chose , I had salmon which was cooked to perfection. A nice children's menu for my grandson. Only let down was that a soft drink was included in child's menu but when we asked for a fizzy drinks for him we should have been told a diluting drink was included as we paid for the fizzy but weren't offered the included drink. It was a young member of staff possibly a student who was very nice and not his fault but these are things that need to be taught. Anyway food lovely as usual. They also do a nice special for a roll and hot drink in the morning and another for a scone and hot drink in afternoons. Nice to sit out in summer although not many chances of that left this year.

author: janeydeelite
title: Wedding overnight visit
text: Stayed overnight last weekend for wedding reception. For £115 it was well over priced. Room of good size not bad view but in need of decor and in this day and age 2 single beds dont make a double room. Bathroom was quite nice but dissspointed no hairdryer which I would expect for this price. Reception area not very organised looking like day guests got table covers and decent position while night guests shoved in at the cheap seats. On the positive side the the food in the bar area was really nice, good prices and very large portions. Not quite sure where they got wine in bar area or reception suite but it was very unpleasant ie the chardonay. I.d go back if in the area for bar food but certainly wouldnt stay again. Probably get away with prices as function/wedding guests stay rather than travel at end of long day.

author: 614mayg
title: Wedding
text: We stayed here for a wedding, It was ok but I really don't think it's worth £115.00 a night. The reception room was very small and cramped, while setting up for night guests to arrive the tables did not even have table covers on them. Some of the day guest had been sitting here waiting on the reception room being prepared and the bar staff had not even wiped the tables . We had to do that ourselves.Where we were sitting (only seats left) you could not see the DJ as there was a wall blocking him. One of the guests at my table was a bit upset as she said it was as if being slapped in the face for being just a night guest. The breakfast was ok not the best I've had. Black pudding & potato scone very overcooked(hard). I would not stay here again as though it very over priced for a 3*.

author: greenmole
title: Could be so good
text: This hotel could be a really good one but it lets itself down with small details and maintenance. The last twice we stayed we got back rooms and were very disappointed. First room was small, scruffy, dark and had opaque glass in the window and no remote for the TV. Second room was a lovely size but the door looked as if it was for a store room. Inside the wardrobe had no handle, the mattress was too small for the wooden bed frame and the TV had bad reception. The bathroom had obviously had a new suite but it had been installed on broken tiles and the paint was coming off the door in chunks. On the plus side, dinner was extremely good and the Irish receptionist was friendly and helpful. We would stay again but only if we got a front room.

author: Jordanaanflump
title: Great location and restaurant, disappointing room
text: This hotel is in a great location, right next to the beach and amenities. We found the downstairs area, reception and restaurant lovely, but the upstairs area lets it down. As soon as you make your way onto the first floor the heat hits you. They are desperately in need of air-conditioning. Our room was spacious and clean but quite shabby, had no air-conditioning and was extremely warm and stuffy at times. The restaurant is nicely decorated and the food was good. Staff are friendly too. Not a terrible experience but for me the room really let it down and wasn't worth how expensive it is.

author: DANDYDON1_9
title: Brisbane Experience
text: Stayed for 2 nights and on entering car park the hotel looks really nice and modern. On entering the reception area you get the wow factor really nicely decorated and that's where it ends. Our room was a superior room overlooking the bay and what a lovely view. Okay the room 212 was needing some decorating and floor boards squeaked every time you walked across the room. The bed was clean, big and very comfortable and the bathroom was also big and recently renovated. The breakfast was just okay not the best quality product and your stuck in room with no windows. I suggest breakfast should be served in front of house with views over the bay. Once the hotel is finished with renovations of all rooms we would consider returning.

author: kazzakaz
title: Rooms poor but wedding venue good. Do not book on line you need to see room 1st.
text: Took money for room on arrival now i know why. Daughters pre wedding night in room 202, totally disgusted. Wallpaper peeling off damp mouldy wall, curtains looked like the edges had gone through a shredder, a big hole in the wall and broken furniture. To put a bride to be in such a room what the hell where they thinking, there have been other complaints and house keeping must clean this room blind not to notice. My own room 205 also had broken furniture, shower just a trickle although clean but rest of room filthy. Stairs to top floor smells damp and carpets threadbare in lots of places. Mouldy bread at breakfast, cheap sausages and beans. Premier inn is a hundred times better. However, wedding coordinator Nicky was amazing and meal good, downstairs venue clean you could see where the money has been spent. If thinking of wedding here check other rooms as well the bridle suite BEFORE YOU OVER PAY FOR OUT DATED SHABBY NESS.

author: Clairejohnmiah
title: Gorgeous views with tasty food
text: This restaurant is a must if your visiting Largs with family or friends. It looks out onto the gorgeous sea front and serves delicious scottish grub! I take my family here every time we go. The steak pie was lovely and the steak just tore away. We then indulged in the special chocolate fudge cake sundae.. We were not dissapointed. Very child friendly and staff are polite and attentive. Would highly reccomend

author: HelenB997
title: A wee overnight
text: I booked this overnight for my has and and myself and then found I was unable to go owing to getting a hospital cancellation for surgery. The manager could not have been more helpful and allowed me to change the booking twice, owing to complications. We finally were able to go and I must say we had a lovely stay. We had a sea view which was great as it turned into an awful stormy day and only a duck would have gone out. The room was well proportioned with tea/coffee nibbles etc every thing a traveller needed was in the room. We used the dining room for our evening meal. The food and service was excellent and I would definitely recommend it. We will go back again.

author: donnaa25
title: Nice location and great value food.
text: We stayed one night with an itison deal which was excellent value. The entrance to the hotel is really nice with the sparkly floor tiles and chandeliers and the welcome at reception was good. (Replacing the mat at reception should be a priority though). The hotel room was disappointing - it was very tired. We had upgraded to a seaview room which was worthwhile for the view alone and it was a nice size of room, but furniture was dated and worn as was the decor. The restaurant was busy and had a nice atmosphere, staff were friendly and attentive and the service was very quick. We were very impressed with the price of the three course deal and couldn't fault the food. Breakfast was fine, not a huge choice for the Continental option but the cooked breakfast was tasty. This hotel has a lot of potential just needing some TLC.

author: 304GeorgeM
title: Poor customer service in average hotel
text: Stayed for one night as an itison deal, upgraded to an "executive" room for an extra £22. Having never stayed in the hotel before, wasn't sure what to expect, however the outside and reception area looked nice so our expectations were high, unfortunately the rooms, food and service let the hotel down. On arriving we were "welcomed" by the receptionist ( didn't get her name, however she was older and had blond hair and not to be mixed up with the other friendly dark haired girl) when she eventually acknowledged us, she hardly spoke, gave no general information on the hotel( dinner or breakfast times etc) didn't tell us where or how to get to our room and certainly wasn't the friendly face of the hotel as expected from reception staff. On finally finding our room, it had a great sea view and a lovely newly fitted bathroom, however the rest of the room was shabby, requiring some upgrading, with scuffs, broken furniture and damp patches on the ceiling. The food within the restaurant was average "pub grub" and we were over charged ( however got this refunded the next day). Food at breakfast very limited and ran out of many things waiting for this to be replenished on a few occasions). staff again not very friendly, apart from our server the previous night in the restaurant ( didn't get his name ). Considering the price paid for a "discounted room" feel this was over priced and feel the hotel lets itself down very badly with poor customer service. Would not recommend, which is a shame as a few small changes would make a great improvement to the hotel.

author: welsby6
title: value for money?
text: Externally this hotel is most inviting, however the list of poor quality, broken or worn fixtures and fittings is almost endless once you walk into the banquet area or your room. Many of the chairs were badly stained and tables chipped. In the bedroom costing £115 a night was a gross miss match of tired old furniture, there was wallpaper peeling off the wall, both bedside lamps didn't work and a standard lamp was also broken. The bathroom looked nice other than obvious poor cleaning and the power shower didn't work correctly. When I called reception I was told that this was due to the hotel being old and air often gets into the system. I had to go through a set of procedures to get it to work, although only on a narrow jet as anything else just didn't work. I was attending a function and therefore had a meal. I can really only describe it as very medioca . I didn't even bother to go for breakfast in the morning as I really didn't want to start the day with poor food.

author: FR26
title: Really bad rooms wont stay here again👎
text: Stayed here for our friends wedding. Wedding great and so was the food. More bar staff required. Room was terrible had to complain as water in the sink in bathroom wouldn't run away. Black damp patch above the shower and shower could be doing with a good scrub to get rid of the dirt. The mattress is very poor as i could feel every spring in it. rooms crap wouldn't stay here again. Wish i had read trip advisor before staying here.

author: annej850
title: Don't stay in this hotel!!!
text: My family came from the USA to my Son's wedding, they stayed in the family room and the 4 of them couldn't take a shower because it was.blocked. This was reported but not fixed. The communal areas leave a lot to be desired, too much to mention.Friends stayed here also, we have all been disappointed, and does not justify the price they charge. It's very tired, not clean, damp, double glazed units gone, and definately needs a refurb. One of the rooms I paid for was £115 per night and the other was £135 per night. £500.00 for a 2 night stay. I have e-mailed the general manager with my concerns but to no avail. If there are any potential wedding guests out there find somewhere else to stay!!

author: 28jillianw
title: Friends wedding
text: Will start by saying the location is amazing for sunsets photos (wether permitting). The inside is very clean and well kept. The room for the meal was a good size but the only thing I found was the table was set for 1 person to meany. This may have been the bride and grooms choice. The meal was outstanding and the service from staff was 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟. The only thing I would say that need to change is maybe a few extra bar staff for weddings. Would recommend for wedding. 👍

author: StephanieJ1404
title: In need of refurbishment & very tired
text: I staying at the Brisbane the 3/8 for my friend's wedding. The wedding was a great success however the room which cost £135 was nowhere near the same quality. My expectations were high but this was far from delivered, we stayed in the Glen Suite. I was disappointed in the tarnish walls, scratched skirting boards, the bed was squeaky and gouged names were carved into the wood. The doors were scratched and cracked and overall in need of refurbishment . The view was not any brighter with a discarded fridge and various other items dumped items as the principal view. As it was a close friends wedding I waited untill i left and emailed the manager expressing my concern. The respond was not welcomed and was very dissmissive and overall rude. Comments included : Prices for wedding accommodation range from £80 and I note from your booking (10th April) that you were advised as to the costs and size of bedroom. The Glen Room is one of our largest rooms, in that up to 4 guests have a sleeping area, a seperate lounge area and large bathroom and is priced as such on a bed and breakfast basis You must uderstand that in any hotel rooms are subjected to a certain amount of wear and tear I would not recommend staying here, as the rooms are poorly maintained and further to this I recieved very poor service.

author: Lucy25520
title: Tired decor, great location and friendly staff
text: Stayed here for 2 nights whilst attending the games. Was a bit unsure about what to expect after ready some of the reviews, but was not disappointed. Hotel is in a great location, easy access to the train station with regular trains to Glasgow. The bedrooms are tired and definitely in need a of some TLC, but good size rooms and clean. All the staff were friendly and pleasant, made us very welcome. Breakfast choice was very good and nicely cooked, lunch in Henry's was delicious........would definitely recommend the king prawns with ginger noodles! Late bar, so could relax with a night cap. Would stay again :)

author: Kmcpxx
title: Stay for a wedding.
text: This hotel from outside and within main areas is lovely all upto date, elegant & modern looking. This doesn't follow onto the rooms unfortunately ... Booking a superior room for quite a steep price you expect a nice room - the carpets in the rooms where horrid & the actual furniture in the room was old ... The room was huge & the bathroom very modern & pretty. The bed however was noisey, creaky and a little hard for my liking. The covers however where wonderful. Which made for some comfort. There was a few questionable moments thought the visit/stay but I wouldn't hesitate to book again for a wedding or to go to the hotel for dinner. I think from other reviews the hotel are very aware what they need to do and when it's done this will be an all round amazing venue.

author: P12HAL
title: Worth a visit
text: Spent a week at this hotel as I was attending a training course, and I was pleasantly surprised. My room was large, comfortably warm, and clean. Decor was a little tired, but I understand that the hotel is midway through updating the rooms, and my room, although one of those still to be updated, was well above average. En-suite facilities were bright, clean, and fully functioning. The food that I was served during my stay (breakfast, snacks, lunch and dinner), was well cooked, well presented, varied, and makes a visit to the Brisbane well worth a visit. Staff were all extremely friendly, helpful, and courteous. Views across the Clyde, towards the islands of Cumbrae and Bute, are outstanding. If you're visiting this area, I would recommend the Brisbane House Hotel, and even if you don't intend to stay, it's worth a visit for a reasonably priced meal.

author: VinceL173
title: Beautiful views
text: Didn't book but got a room with a view. There is not elevator so be prepared to walk up 3 flights of stairs with luggage! Room quite nice, furniture needs updating but clean. Beautiful bathroom, obviously has been renovated. Henry's bar downstairs was nice and a great meal. Staff excellent and very helpful. The view of the Isle of Cumbrae and Bute is incredible even on a cloudy evening. There was a wedding reception on in the evening and we were warned about it being noisy, but even on the third floor we could dance to the music. Give it a try.

author: DaveMcL82
title: Awful
text: Stayed at the Brisbane House Hotel for 2 nights for a wedding. Whilst the wedding facilities and bar/reception area are all to a high standard, the rooms are most certainly not. Both ourselves and another couple booked a room each with ours being the 'deluxe' option. Both rooms were far below standard and not nearly worth the £80 & £100 charged respectively per night. The decor was tired and dated, stains on the walls and ceilings, dirty linen, taps coming off as you use them and terrible water pressure in the shower amongst other things. It seems the hotel has been upgraded but they have forgotten to finish off the 2nd floor rooms and landing areas. 'All fur coat nay knickers'. Also when we asked for a first aider or first aid kit their response was 'we don't have that here'!!! Overall: Good - Wedding facilities, bar area and location Bad - Everything else Stay somewhere else!!

author: Bryan264
title: Poor value for money
text: I stayed at Brisbane Hotel late November '13, this was my first experience of the hotel and the second time my wife had stayed here. The hotel has a lovely setting overlooking Largs beach, the entry to the hotel is very modern and welcoming, as were the reception staff who quickly dealt with the oversight of a travel cot not being assigned to our room. The room itself, for me, was a massive let down. The room was extremely small in size with virtually no space for the small travel cot making the stay uncomfortably squashed, the decor was little better than average however it was certainly clean. I can only assume the room was situated above the main function room within the hotel as the noise levels were incredible, in fairness there was a wedding on however I felt it impossible to actually sleep until the music stopped around 2am. I had called reception on two occasions however I got no reply each time. Thankfully my 2yr old son didn't find any problem in sleeping. In fairness to the hotel, I didn't make them aware of my complaint the following morning as I left for work very early the next morning and didn't have the time. Due to this I am also unable to rate the breakfast - which I'm told was nice. My rating is largely based on the room size/quality, especially considering the cost, and the noise within the room - if it was a Premier Inn I'd certainly be looking for my 'no sleep' money back.

author: KarenandNeilC
title: Wonderful wedding venue
text: A massive thank you to all at the Brisbane House Hotel. We were married here on Friday and had the perfect day, exceeded my expectations at every turn. The wedding planners Liz & Marion are so professional, lovely and helpful, the most stress free wedding ever. We were made to feel special from start to finish nothing was too much trouble. Everything ran so smoothly. The food was lovely, service was fast - again perfect! All our guests have been saying its the best wedding they have ever been to, praise indeed, For anyone looking to book a wedding venue I honestly couldn't recommend the Brisbane House hotel any higher. amazing venue with wonderful staff who will ensure you also have the perfect day. Many many thanks!!! Mr & Mrs Crossan

author: KatyB444
title: One night very good value with ITISON voucher
text: Stayed here recently having purchased it through an ITISON deal for dinner, bed and breakfast. The room was very spacious with good views of the sea. Could do with being touched up in places but was very comfortable. The bathroom, with shower and jacuzzi was however excellent - very modern and clean. Staff were all very nice and helpful. There was a huge amount of choice for dinner, and the food was fine - came extremely quickly, felt more microwaved than home-made, but was tasty anyway. Pudding, especially the banoffee pie, was amazing! Breakfast was good too, cooked or continental. Nice location, would recommend this hotel to friends.

author: IanGardiner
title: Not perfect but much better than some reviews suggest!
text: I've come to learn not to pay too much attention to tripadvisor horror stories but even still I was apprehensive because of the sheer volume of them. That being said when we arrived the hotel made an excellent first impression. The staff where very welcoming, the reception was very tastefully decorated and the room was clean with plenty of storage space for anyone staying for several nights. The bathroom was modern and had a very spacious shower. My partner and I had dinner and breakfast in the restaurant and had no complaints with any of the food we were served. My only complaint which stopped my review for this hotel being more positive was just how stuffy the room was. Even with the radiator off the general temperature of the hotel was quite uncomfortable. To make matters worse when faced with no option but to open the windows there was a humming sound from what looked like power generators just outside the window. Overall I would say this hotel is better than recent posts suggest but something should definitely be done about the temperature as I noticed I am not the first to complain about the heat.

author: andreak681
title: Conference
text: I had the pleaure of organising a conference at Brisbane House, Martin was more than happy to help with every request I made. Unfortunately we did not arrive until 11.15pm, however upon arrival we were greeted with a smile by Mhairi and quickly checked into our rooms. My room was beautiful, spacious and clean and the bed was bed was extremely comfortable. Breakfast was also superb. During the conference Martin could not have been more attentive, the service was impeccable. The refreshments and food were served on time every time and the standard was fantastic. I can honestly say I would definitely book Brisbane House again whether for a conference or a personal trip, the staff were great, the service was brilliant set in a beautiful location. Well done and thank you.

author: doogly5262
title: Ok for the price paid.
text: We stayed here on a special deal which was ok. Room(106) quite small, with very noisy floorboards outside and above the room. Room clean enough, bathroom could do with a bit of an overhaul, mixture of old and new fittings. Did not like that the window had frosted glass for more than half of it, if you wanted to see out you would have to stand on chair. Food ok, nothing spectacular, dining area quite cold décor, as was the room. Staff were very pleasant and very helpful, nothing a bother. Plenty of car parking. With a polishing of the edges could be excellent as that's all it would need.

author: Weeangel77
title: Disappointed!!!
text: I attended a friends wedding reception and was very let down by staff. Staff were very rude and abrupt, especially one woman in particular who looked to be in charge. Having now read other reviews I think there is a serious issue with staff service!! As a venue for a wedding I wouldn't recommend it as it is very small and cramped. 3 out of the 6/7 tables that could seat 16 each had no view of the dance floor and everyone had to cramp round an opening to see the bride and grooms first dance. We were not allowed to sit in other bar where it was a little cooler and you had room to sit and chat. I explained there were no seats left in room where reception was held and the womans reply was 'The party is in the other room'. She completely ignored me! I had to ask 3 times for someone to bring more chairs!! Seriously let down!

author: 300joyces
title: Could do better
text: The receptionist was not friendly and welcoming and didn't ask if we enjoyed our stay. In fact, she wasn't really interested in us at all as we had interrupted her private phone call. We had two deluxe rooms with sea views one of which (room 103) had a view of the canopy over the entrance to the hotel therefore we struggled to see the sea! The general décor is tired with wrinkled carpets, torn wallpaper and dirty windows. The disabled parking spaces in the car park were blocked off as work was being carried out at the front of the hotel which meant we had to park further down the car park. On a good note, the breakfast was really nice and well cooked . The waiter who served us breakfast was working hard to serve everyone himself and did a great job. Not sure why it's a four star rated hotel. Would I use this hotel again? Probably not!

author: simonbill1
title: Just the business
text: Only stayed for one night on a business trip. 14th August. I booked on line and although I did select one adult the booking ended up for two and I was given a vary spacious room 115 to the rear of the hotel. The room was very clean and bathroom was compact but adequate (not much room to open your legs whilst sat on the toilet). My only complaint was the room was hot. although outside it was heavy rain the room was sticky hot to the extent i slept on top of the bed. I got a breakfast deal for £80 and i could have ate double the portion. I'm not into hash browns and potato scones which once removed did not leave much on the plate. For example a recent visit to the Crown Plaza in Glasgow for the same price offered a massive breakfast buffet. I would stay at this hotel again

author: holidaychick_7
title: Good setting for a wedding
text: I stayed at the Brisbane House Hotel on the 7th of July for a friends wedding. I couldn't check in until after the wedding ceremony because check in was 2pm and so was the wedding. You can pay to check in early but its an extra £20 on top of the £125 for the room. The hotel is excellent for a wedding venue, the views are stunning and there is a section for guests to sit outside and enjoy a drink. Drink is expensive, it was £7.50 for a bottle of Budweiser and blue Wkd, so if you're going to a wedding take plenty of money. The meal at the wedding reception was amazing, tasty and plenty of, so you don't go hungry. The room its self had a lovely sea view, and was comfortable, but was very warm, some rooms do have aircon, but not all of them. The breakfast was lovely, you have choice of cereals, fruit, yoghurts, toast, fruit juices, tea and coffee plus a full cooked breakfast. Would I stay here again? probably if it was for a wedding otherwise no.

author: Mandi_2304
title: Very disappointing
text: A beautiful setting for a hotel and the entrance doesn't disappoint either, however the hotel rooms are appalling. The room we stayed in was very dusty and the decoration very shabby. The shower room looked quite new and impressive but the toilet was broken and the shower had very low water pressure. We weren't informed when we booked that there would be a wedding going on. We could hear everything the band said or played and closing the windows made little difference to the noise. My husband had to get up to take family to the airport at 5am so got very little sleep. This was also made worse by the fact that the toilet was constantly filling up which was like Chinese water torture and every time I had to get up I would wake him with the incredibly squeaky floorboards. I wouldn't choose or recommend to stay here again. This was definitely a 2 star hotel charging 4 star prices.

author: Diamond280
title: Pleasant experience but not one I ll return to
text: Setting lovely,decor beautifully modernised. Bar area cramped with little atmosphere. Staff ok but hardly accommodating.....perfunctory in my opinion. Bar menu ok and food ok. Nothing special. Venue seems popular which is great to see. Not my kind of place so I won't return. Nothing wrong but personal preference.

author: 193LauraM193
title: Food let it down
text: Stayed here on a Groupon deal with my fiance. We had received it as an engagement present. Deal included DBB with dinner including a bottle of wine. Neither of us drink and were only offered juice as an alternative (other places offer free desert). On hindsight I'm glad we weren't offered any more food than the two courses. We ordered the chilli & the lasagne both of which lacked any flavour and it's quite possibly the cheapest minced meat I've ever tasted. We decided to skip breakfast as it wasn't worth the risk. On the plus side we had upgraded our room to an executive suite which was very spacious with lovely views. Four poster bed which looked the part but we both woke up with sore backs. The staff were very friendly and helpful but the food unfortunately is what we will remember this hotel for.

author: ValentinoLargsUK
title: Golden Wedding Celebration
text: We decided to hold our Golden Wedding Anniversary celebration at the Brisbane House Hotel on the 23rd February 2013. Marion, one of their event planners met with us three times and made it all so easy as she was able to suggest all kinds of ideas to make the night special, which it really was. The meal was exceptional and with three choices for each course, it made it hard to choose because they were all equally delicious and the meal was accompanied by red or white wine. The service was faultless and the staff were friendly and very efficient which made it a very successful evening. We have received thank you cards from many of our guests thanking us for such a wonderful evening and saying how much effort we must have put into arranging the evening, but in actual fact, it was the Brisbane House Hotel staff that did all the work. We want to thank all of them and say that we would highly recommend this venue for any wedding or anniversay celebration. The big surprise of the evening was the bill. It was very much lower than we had anticipated which was very nice indeed.

author: thomsji1
title: WINTER OVERNIGHT BREAK
text: We visited this hotel about 10 years ago but didn't recognise it this time round following its complete refurbishment. This was an online deal which was a post xmas treat. It was a treat. The staff were most welcoming and friendly. The food was as good as we've had for some time and was well worth the price. We were given a 2nd floor room (no lift) we were ok but anyone with a walking problem could have found it tiring. The room was warm and comfortable with a great view, the bathroom very modern, big walk-in shower but no bath. On the negative side a number of minor problems ; the floors creaked a lot, the shower pressure was adequate but could have been a bit better , the wifi didn't work in my room and there was no residents lounge although not a problem for an overnight.

author: SteveH124
title: Music to my ears!
text: I travel a lot to follow my main hobby of going to gigs - and as I live off the beaten track, I am often on the road to Glasgow and all points south. Whenever I'm in or around Largs I make a point of visiting the Brisbane House: it's worth it for the excellent cappuccino alone! My review is prompted by my first overnight stay at the hotel, which was every bit as good as my passing visits. I knew I would be arriving late after a gig but that was no problem and I was made to feel extremely welcome at an hour when most people would be either asleep or grumpy! My room was exactly what I would look for in a hotel, but far and away the best aspect of the hotel in my opinion is its staff. Always friendly, they have the knack of getting the balancing act between not attentive enough and too attentive spot on! Compared with the characterless but functional hotel chains which proliferate, the Brisbane House is a breath of fresh air - literally in this case with its views out across the water. But don't just take my word for it: try it for yourself. I thoroughly recommend the experience.

author: NANNYIZZY
title: Wedding
text: My son held his wedding here on Aug 10th 2012. Absolutely fabulous venue for a wedding. Beautiful location, beautiful hotel, lovely food and lovely staff! The wedding planner done a 1st class job. The wedding meal was absolutely brilliant and many of the guests said to me it was the best wedding they've ever been to! We had a lovely family sized room overlooking the beach. Only complaint I would have was the rooms were way too hot! Of course it was on one of the hottest days.....not a problem to open windows wide though!

author: CazaGlasgow
title: Tired rooms, don't stay!! Needs some TLC!!!
text: We booked to stay for a wedding and had a sea view twin room at a cost of £115, I was expecting luxury for this price but didnt get it and was very dissapointed. The room was big but had damp patches all over the ceiling and even a hole in the wall that the hotel had tried to hide with a piece of wood! The furniture was tired and marked and neede replaced and I had the pleasure of cleaning the toilet, something they had forgot to do! It was hot and the windows would not stay open and I had to use the spare toilet rolls to prop them open. It was such a dissapointment. The ony positive thing about the hotel was the food! The food at the wedding was lovely and being able to get breakfast to the room but that cost more so took our bill to £121. I definitly won't be back and have let everyone know!

author: sweety123654
title: Fantastic stay
text: I stayed at the Brisbane while visiting relatives. From my booking to departure all was dealt with courteously and professionally. Our room 105 was a complimentary upgrade, was beautiful with a four poster bed and plenty of space for us to entertain. The bathroom was to die for with a shower and a jaccuzzi bath. The Restaurant served a wide variety of foods. The fish'n' chips was more of a whale!!! and my husbands noodles were just right. We will certainly return next time visiting our relatives

author: setojet
title: Overpriced room
text: From the outside and upon entering, the hotel presents itself as a quality place to stay. We stayed for two nights as we were attending a wedding at the hotel, imagine our disappointment when we viewed the decorative condition of the hallway we passed through on the way to our room....nice wallcovering but in need of some adhesive as the paper was coming away from the walls. Upon entering our room the view from the window was excellent and would sell the room many nights over, however, when we looked around the room the same problem existed with the wall coverings (in need of adhesive) and the bathroom had a crack running from wall to wall across the tiled floor. We received a discount on the room rate as we were atttending the wedding but at £100.00 per night (B&B) we felt that the room was over priced for what it offered. Having said all of that the wedding was excellent and the staff could not have been any more helpful & professional. Led by the wedding manager Liz they provided the marriage room and very quickley re arranged the room following the service to allow guests to use it for drinks and canapes prior to the reception. The food was very good and served promptly ensuring that guests and wedding party more or less ate at the same time avoiding that embarassing situation of the top table waiting for the next course whilst some of the tables were still at the previous course. The rating we have given is based on the condition of the room we occupied and the price asked not on any other aspect of the hotel. We would not pay the rack rate as the accommodation did not offer value for that level of expenditure.

author: IrishRomantic
title: Disappointing for the price
text: We arrived on spec and were offererd a sea view room for £100 or an executive suite for £135 - as we were only overnighting we went for the former. The receptionist was extremely pleasant and helpful (having read someone got their room for £65 I felt we overpaid, particularly as this was 6pm and unlikely they would let it - £65 in my opinion was the value of the room) - we should have haggled a bit as we noticed the town does a lot of seinor citizen deals!) The sea view turned out to be from a small window at the back of the room by the broken fridge and some sort of storage cupboard. The room was nicely furnished and the bathroom was fine, however, no shower cap provided. As with another reviewer breakfast was not a memorable experience - again, to have to get your own tea and coffee for £100 per night is a bit much. There was no yoghurt, one other guest asked for some but was told there was no more available .. The cooked breakfast was vey nice. For our last night in Scotland it was rather disappointing.having stayed at places for similar prices and far superior. To sum up it looks good on the outside but not so good when you go further.

author: momac_3
title: Lovely Hotel - Will be back
text: My partner and I booked this hotel on their own web site and got a great deal. On arrival we received a really freindly welcome. We had a lovely front facing room with a fantastic bathroom. The room was spotless. As we had travelled all day we decided to eat in the Hotel. We had the special two course menu. The food was well presented and of very good proportions. The whole staff went out of their way to ensure we had a great weekend. If I had a niggle (and I mean a small niggle) there was a function on the second night and the bar got very busy. Really enjoyed ourselves.

author: bluebird224
title: Pleasant hotel near the centre of Largs
text: I stayed here for a few nights while on business in mid December. My room was situated at the rear of the hotel. Part of the window was obscured by frosted glass which might be a problem for some during the summer but for a dark winter night it did not matter. The room was small but comfortable, warm and clean. The hotel has been extended in recent years and from the front overlooks the sea. It is only a short walk from the centre of Largs where there are a variety of restaurants and bars. The hotel restaurant was serving an enjoyable Christmas themed evening menu. A full Scottish breakfast was freshly cooked and promptly served to order. Staff were pleasant and helpful.

author: Steviem71
title: looks great from the outside but...
text: stayed there for a wedding and while the front of the hotel looks great the rest of the place sin't quite as good. We had a room facing the front with a nice view unfortunately the walls were paper thing so as soon as the guests next door checked out we could hear the housemaids hoovering and talking about their night out. Not good on a hangover. Breakfast is a disgrace. There was one boy on duty who was also doing room service. Our eggs benedict had hard boiled eggs and one even had shell in. The toaster wasn't positioned right so any bread that went in shot down the back and onto the floor. Coffee must have been brewed the night before, even when we asked for fresh coffee...and that's with a huge expresso machine on the counter. All in all it's very much style over substance

author: binkyman
title: Great Value for Money. Beautiful Location but food not great.
text: My 4 friends and I visit Largs fairly frequently and usually use a b&b but someone found this hotel on the internet and found that they did a room that would sleep 5 of us for only £135. This included full scottish breakfast. The hotel is in a great location, central but with a beautiful outlook towards the Clyde. The room had a double bed which was very comfortable, 2 sofa beds and a single bed. Whilst the sofa beds weren't great, they weren't the worst. The room was large and there was an enormous flat screen tv, although only 4 channels. The bathroom was beautiful with a double shower. We didn't eat in the hotel because I had eaten there on a previous occassion and the food really wasn't great. However breakfast was okay. Overall, this is a nice hotel and well worth the money.

author: ScotlandGourmet
title: Great external appearance/location but poor quality dining.
text: We had used this Hotel many times over the years and had enjoyed the previous Conservatory dining and the piano bar but after our visit at the end of April 2009, following the major refurbishment, we vowed never to return due to the drop in service standards. First impressions on arrival were very promising and our room was large with a modern spacious en-suite bathroom but the decor of the bedroom itself was dull and dated. The previous sophisticated dining set-up has been replaced by a downmarket, noisy bar/diner with large screen television. The tables/chairs were inferior compared with the past and the menu/wine list had been cheapened to a much lower quality. Worse still was the food as my wife's main course of chicken cesar salad looked like the size of a starter! When I drew this to the attention of the waitress she reurned with a larger portion but my wife eventually gave up with the chicken pieces as they were covered in a thick skin. This was pointed out when the waitress returned to clear the table with the result that we were not charged for the bottle of wine. To sum up a great looking Hotel but appearances sadly deceive !

author: zilerog
title: Surpised at the exterior changes.
text: This is not my first trip to Scotland and the Brisbane House Hotel and each time I come back I find some new and imporoved features. The outside of the hotel is spectacular, the views through the front windows while have a meal or casual drink is breathtaking. Well done. I also stayed in one of your newly refitted rooms and the experience was one I will never forget, from the beautiful drapery right through to the stunning bathroom. Staying here has always been one of my high points and as a well travelled business man I will be recommending this hotel to not only my collegues but to my friends. Next time I will be bring my wife for an extended business trip. P.S. I like what you have done with your menu, a bit of local favourites and a few North American favourites as well. Keep up the good work and I will be seeing you all soon.

author: MrsCB1977
title: Clean, Friendly Accommodation
text: Stayed at the hotel for 1 night as friend was having wedding reception there. The hotel itself is still being renovated and some parts are exposed to these renovations (ie. reception area). I requested on booking a refurbished room as had read other reviews that other rooms weren't so nice. We were pleasantly surprised by the decor in the room, although a bit on the small side, it was beautifully decorated. The bathroom had still to be done though and was quite dated. Breakfast the next morning was lovely, but only went onto 9.30am!!! The function suite was lovely and the newly done toilets were clean and of a high standard. All in all, for £80b&b for the 2 of us, no complaints.

author: shanecI5390AV
title: Great room, good Staff, great stay, good breakfast....
text: The staff were very friendly, the room was very comfortable and clean. The morning breakfast was great (the coffee was perfect) and easy to hit on the way out. I was hoping it would open earlier due to my schedule, I did manage to hit it a few times when I had a later work start. Also, there are Keurig coffee makers in the room, I could have brought my favorite cups (they do supply some coffee and tea). Good water pressure and hot water for the shower (plenty of towels). The bed was very comfortable and the sheets and pillows were very nice. I was here for a short stay for work and really look forward to staying here again when in Winnemucca. There are other hotels in Winnemucca, but this should be your first choice.............Shane

author: Genevacarman
title: Loved the spa , but not the spider 🕷
text: After driving for 12 hours thru the mountain range . We had to stop. Check in was easy . It was inexpensive and the jacuzzi tub was the highlight of this room .. bed was ok. But there was a wood spider in the bathroom that my travel companion had to battle. I can’t deal with the 8 legged creatures .. lots of grass for pets and pet friendly

author: JD845
title: Our stay was average but expensive!
text: This is par with what is expected of a Holiday Inn Express with included breakfast. The room was clean. The bathroom was on the small side but clean. (Bathroom lighting was dim). Beds were comfortable. Breakfast filled us up and was acceptable. The only thing that truly shocked us was the price for the night. Realizing this is a remote stop with not much around still didn't warrant a price that was almost double that of other Holiday Inn Express hotels we stayed at.

author: gallalunis
title: Unexpected Charges
text: This hotel charged us for an additional 5 nights. We were part of a fire fighting crew assigned in the area. We had to check out early when we were reassigned to another fire assignment. We checked out with their staff, but when we check the charges made to the credit card it had an additional 5 days charged for all 6 members of the party. We tried to resolve it with the manager of the hotel. They claimed that we did not check out and refused to credit the charges. Had to dispute charges with my credit card company. It has yet to be resolved. I recommend avoiding this hotel if at all possible. This has been the worst customer service I have ever dealt with in my 18 years of service as a federal fire fighter.

author: sdegaine1
title: Skip this one
text: I have stayed in other Holiday Inn Express locations and have generally been happy with my stay’s, not so here. The room was adequate, bed was a little hard, but the big disappointment was breakfast. We were told breakfast was served until 10:00 on Sunday. At 9:30 we were downstairs only to find every breakfast tray empty. No eggs, no sausage, no bacon, no Cinnabon’s, coffee was empty except for decaf, pancake machine was out of batter, sausage gravy was there but no biscuits. I had to track someone down to complain and then it took 20 minutes for her to bring more food out. Note to hotel - if you tell guests upon checkin that breakfast is open until 10, you should have food out until that time! I will not be back.

author: 366kathia
title: Two Night Stay
text: In Winnemucca for an event ,we stayed 2 nights at the Holiday Inn Express. We had a reservation; check-in was easy and the warm cookies upon arrival were a bonus! The hotel is fairly new, all areas were clean and well maintained. The bed was comfortable, bathroom was pristine... all as it should be.
