Breakfast had the usual offerings.The eating area was a bit small for the number of guests, but the staff was very nice and food was fresh and of the appropriate temperature. The desk clerk was really helpful and even gave us some milk in the evening. All staff members we encountered were very nice. We had snow each night and there were men out shoveling snow from the parking lot.The only negative was that the room wasn't quite as soundproof as I'd have liked, but it could have been just that there were some exceptionally loud guests near our room. I'd choose this hotel in Winnemucca again.

author: Evanston_WYBikeboy
title: Very nice hotel and spacious room
text: My wife and I stayed here one night on our way home. We wanted a nice comfortable hotel after a long days drive. Everywhere seemed to be busy but we stopped here after trying a couple of other places and found this place to be out a ways from the center of Winnemucca and have a suite available for the evening. We were not disappointed with the suite, it was spacious and comfortable for the two of us. It was clean and the bath area was really nice and spacious as well. I feel the price was on par with the size of the room. The continental breakfast was also a little above average for the selection. They had elevators and luggage carriers to assist taking luggage up to the room. We have no complaints about this place and would stay here again.

author: MarinaRon
title: Nice room, decent choice
text: Room was nice. Normal HI Express standards. Fridge. Pool. Hot tub. Free breakfast. I'd call it a very typical HI Express. Not the best, not nearly the bad. Strange lobby attached to a casino, small breakfast area and expensive for a place like Winnemucca on a Sunday in late Sept but I would stay here again and more importantly, so would my wife. Front desk young woman was very nice and recommended a nice Mexican restaurant Chihuahua.

author: k1200lt2010
title: Nevada
text: I have had a good night here. Friendly reception. Clean room. Friendly to M/C's. Average hotel breakfast. Good cookies in the evening. Easy checkin and out. Has all the advantages that you would expect at a Holiday Inn.

author: -MyLifeOfTravel-
title: Pick room carefully
text: Probably your best option for the location and I'd guess where your room is located makes a huge difference on your experience. We were located on the main floor, and apparently next to some mechanical room with a very loud compressor that came on and off all night. Even with ear plugs it was still bothersome. The Keurig pot didn't work in our room (part was jammed so it wouldn't open), and the small refrigerator froze all my food overnight. Breakfast is what you would expect for a HIE. Room was clean. Bed was OK. Price super high for HIE - when we went it was listed at $170/night.

author: ML512RFA
title: No Complaints!
text: We went in with no expectations and were quite pleasantly surprised. Lobby had fresh baked cookies and incredibly refreshing, ice cold lemon/cucumber water. The room was spacious and clean. Plenty of outlets for device charging. The shower was tall and great water pressure! The bed was very comfortable with lots of pillows. The Keurig coffees were a perfect start of our day, too! Nice little casino next door where my husband and I left with a little more cash than we started with! BONUS!

author: lsS5037YS
title: Not the best
text: I stayed at this Holiday Inn Express as part of a cross country road trip following 4 nights at other Holiday Inn Express locations across America. Comparatively, this one was the worst. The bedside outlets were unreliable, leading my phone to die in the middle of the night. The hotel could not provide an extra pillow. Both phones in the room were broken. And overall the hotel had a dingy/dark feel to it. Additionally, a staff member went around knocking on doors at 8am, mine included, when I did not request a wake up. On a positive note, the staff were friendly and eager to help.

author: BobL331
title: One of the nicer hotels in Winnemucca
text: After a day of driving from San Francisco we were ready to stay in a nice, quiet hotel for a good night's rest. Many of the hotels and motels in Winnemucca are quite old but the Holiday Inn Express is newer looking, clean and attractive. We took a room with two queen size beds. The room was large and very nice, and came with a microwave, a small refrigerator and a Keurig coffee maker. Even though we were located above a casino, the room was quiet and very comfortable. The included breakfast was well stocked and had a reasonably good selection. There is a Mexican Restaurant on site which will be discussed in another review. Our only criticism of the hotel is that it is fairly expensive, but that is probably due to the fact that there are not a lot of choices between Reno and Elko. When converted to Canadian dollars, the room was about $200.00 per night.

author: aimeeh255
title: Passing through...
text: Chose to stay at the Holiday Inn because of the indoor swimming pool. Had a great stay at this hotel. Updated, clean, comfortable, and modern. The staff was very kind and courteous. The facilities are clean and well-maintained. The breakfast area was well stocked and clean. It was very good for a free hotel breakfast. I have many hotel breakfast's and this was one of the better ones. I completely recommend this hotel when passing through Winnemucca.

author: craigcouto
title: Vacation
text: Very nice hotel. Great breakfast and very clean rooms. We will definitely be back. Breakfast is fantastic as well. Casino is attached and convenient. Shower was great with the water pressure. Staff is very friendly and nice. A must stay.

author: Lindak1221
title: Try to find something better
text: Landed in Winnemucca with no hotel plans. This one had restaurant and casino and HI express has a good name so we picked this. It was not a cheap price either. Would not stay here again. The room was somewhat dated and very dimly lit. Found a hair in the sheets. The breakfast was not good. The Mexican restaurant food was average. The casino was very smoky but they did give me free drinks while I gambled.

author: 2Vegans2wheels
title: Great place to stay - Highly recommend
text: We were just passing through on our way to Zion and other parks in Utah. We had 1000 miles of desert to ride across and this was the perfect place at half-way. Like all the Holiday Inn Expresses we have visited, this is a like new property. Maintenance & housekeeping must be a high priority and we've gotten spoiled. The parking lot was well lit and we felt safe leaving our motorcycle. The check in was friendly and quick which was welcome as we needed to get off the desert and out of hot riding gear. The rooms have a refer, microwave and are perfectly cleaned. We went to dinner at the attached Mexican restaurant and had wonderful fajitas. Pool & hot tub are on our daily use agenda were spotless. We look forward to the free breakfast and it was spot on once again.

author: Rust-E-Junque
title: Decent room , could use updating a bit , and it was a little noisy from room above and traffic
text: Despite a mix up in when we were going to be there , they had a room - One thing though , Holiday Inn should have a system to keep you from booking a room 300 miles from the room you are staying in on the same night! We drove about 7 hours to find we'd booked our room for the night before when we were in Bend! Oh , well .. Breakfast was ready a full hour before the stated time , we usually get up early , and hope for coffee and a muffin , got down at about 5:15 AM , and found everything was ready! Thanks!! Book said ready at 6:30 on weekends , desk said 6 AM , and evidently they had it out by 5 AM! Well done! Tried Holiday Inn customer care about the mix up on dates , and got an idiot! They could work on that , too!

author: Roots1972
title: In the end, manager took care of us!
text: Nice building, nice view, nice workers. Our room AC worked fine all afternoon, but then about 5:30pm, it began blowing warm air. It worked intermittently for the next two hours. I went down to complain/switch rooms at about 7:30pm and waited in line behind people checking in. The front desk worker told me she would be up in a few minutes. At 9pm, the AC seemed to be working again and she had not come up yet, so I went down again. She apologized greatly because she had been very busy. She said she contact the manager and would give us a discount and that our bill would be correct in the morning...it wasn't. I went back down and the manager on duty DID credit us part of our stay. Big hassle, but no other complaints about the place.

author: grandma43050
title: One of my favorite places!
text: One motel had no pool or laundry, one motel had no pool & one had no rooms at all, so we came to this Holiday Inn! So glad we did! We had to take a suite as it was the only one left! Super nice staff! One lady went out of her way to get me quarters for the laundry. Room was beautiful, clean & comfortable with a king size bed, a pull out for the kids & a Jacuzzi. Nice pool & hot tub! Great breakfast choices. Will definitely stay here again if in the area!

author: 229RobertD
title: Good sleep
text: We needed it after a long day of driving. The road in from the north to the south is a long one. Some would say it was boring but I enjoyed the scenery and the coyote who crossed the road in front of us and then looked back. The hotel had good beds, was clean and had a friendly staff. The breakfast was better then average though the room was packed at 6:30 am. A little too small for the early morning crowd. Mostly from Oklahoma, I think. They were there to play at the casino. Bottom line: sleep is good.

author: dee4406
title: Cross country trip
text: Great hotel, lives up to our expectations for Holiday Inns. Was able to book our room from on the road, convenient to get to, right off of 80. Hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. Bed was comfy, room was clean as well. Breakfast is always a bonus. Stopped in the casino that is attached to the hotel for a short time and won $40. We always look for a Holiday Inn as we are never disappointed!! Thanks for a great stay! ~ Denise Brown

author: csilverdale8
title: Nice place after a long drive in in high dessert
text: At the registration desk, there is refreshing infused water with ciucumber, lemon and mint waiting for guests. Really quench your thirst. The suit we stayed at is huge with two nice beds. We did have to ask for more towels and toiletries which was given right away. The restaurant has entrance from hotel which is convenient after being on the road with high , cold winds - was on the 40s all day long! The smoke from the casino still infiltrates the restaurant. However, we really did not want to go out in the cold. The breakfast was pretty good..The eggs are real eggs and the buisuits and gravy was good. I was not trilled with the pancake its like rubber..hard to cut. One thing bring allergy meds bec we were put in a room that had pets before though we ask for room with no pets.

author: MaryD630
title: Wonderful Staff
text: This Holiday Inn always has the nicest staff and super clean rooms ! Have stayed here many times and always look forward to returning . The rooms are big nicely decorated and extremely clean . The third floor is the top floor and the most quiet .!! They have an indoor pool also which is very nice and even a great room to read a book in if u don't want to swim... The freshly made cookies are yummy !! They serve breakfast included and it always good ! Highly recommended hotel

author: 114blakew
title: I love the pool
text: The pool was awesome. Hot tub relaxing. Great for families. I had to kids with me and they loved the breakfast. Rooms are comfy and I had 4 pillows to choose from. 2 were soft 2 were firm. Slept well. They also had free cookies at the check in desk. They were very friendly and close to restaurants and fast food.

author: vilasyang
title: Pit Stop
text: It was 6-8 F outside, but the lobby was warm and cozy. The front desk lady is nice and she help me to get coins for laundry machine. The laundry machine is big enough (may be 3-4 loads) and inside the machine is clean. The lobby is connected to the casino on the other side. This hotel has a nice indoor swimming pool and Jacuzzi. It's feel great after long drive and also nice to have a swim before back to the road. Wifi was terrible (on-off-off-off). They really need to improve this. I met a lot of dogs in the hotel, but the hotel and my room is clean. Great place to rest and relax for long journey

author: HarleyB997
title: Customer Service needs to improve
text: This hotel needs some guidance on Customer Service. I had a headache in the middle of the night and went downstairs at 3 am and asked if I could get an aspirin or anything, (done this before at other hotels) and the lady at the front desk was an #@$ and said just go across the street to Flying J. That was the first of it. We booked the hotel so we could have a nice rest at the hot tub that evening, low and behold it does not work!! The next morning the coffee was cold, yes cold in two of the coffee pots, and I asked the lady why they were cold and she got mad and took my coffee, and said she would microwave it! Everyone at this hotel seemed to have a bad attitude. PLEASE people, we buy a room at a high price and we deserve better than you! Other than that, the room was ok, bed seemed different than other Holiday Inns, but acceptable. This hotel is overpriced for a Holiday inn and what you get.

author: WSCTraveler
title: Nice after a long drive
text: This motel is a nice property and well maintained. There is a small non-smoking casino and restaurant attached. Rooms are neat and very clean and it is far enough away from the road and interstate so you do not get much noise. Breakfast area is small however. It seems that some people come down to the area to watch tv and have coffee and never leave making it seem crowded all the time. The only problem I had was that the young lady at the desk could not make me a reservation for another Holiday Inn at a different location. She reported that they used a different computer system and could not do it. She did however find the number for me and told me I could do it myself. Overall a good clean place to stay

author: SD-CJ
title: Clean, but overpriced ($200 for one person)....
text: If I would have more time, I would have researched more lodging options. $200 dollars for one person and a night is overpriced! Front desk staff was friendly and knowledgeable. The room was average to what I have experienced with other HIE options. Rooms need a bit of updating but were clean. Breakfast was decent. I opted for the Mexican restaurant in the hotel. I would eat in the restaurant instead at the bar like I did. The bartender provided no customer service (horrible). Opt for a beer, as cocktails any in tiny glasses and are overpriced.

author: Cheryl5656
title: Was OK
text: When I decided to stay here it was because of the pool, hot tub, and breakfast. These areas were OK. Breakfast area is small and cramped. Pool and hot tub are located right off the lobby, in fact when you walk into the very nondescript lobby People in the pool is what you see. The lobby is set up in a way I was not sure where to check in at and it was not inviting at all. Plus side is the beds were comfy, room was clean. The Casino next door was handy and the Mexican restaurant was very good. I would stay here again just because the price was good and I have stayed in way worse places.

author: hpisles
title: Nice surprise after long drive
text: After the long drive through the dessert, it was nice to reach this Holiday Inn Express. It was right off the highway and close to downtown Winnemucca. I was surprised to see a small casino and a large restaurant attached to the hotel. I didn't expect to see a casino attached to a Holiday Inn Express. The room was spacious, clean and the staff was efficient and helpful. Since we are enrolled in the Frequent Stay Program, it was nice to be greeted with gift bags of bottle water and munchies. The room contained a mini refrigerator (very helpful), flat screen tv, numerous outlets, good wifi, iron, ironing board, hair dyer, etc. Breakfast was the usual selection at the Holiday Inn Express but good and filling.

author: anameineed
title: We will look for someplace else next time
text: Hard to believe that this was the most expensive hotel we stayed in during a month-long trip, and sorry to say that to us it was not worth it. It seemed to be an older hotel that has been updated but it still had a rather worn feeling. The stairs had carpeting that had been torn and stapled back into place, our bath mat was frayed, the hot tub was closed for maintenance the evening we were there, we could not get one of the two computers to work in their business center and the printer had no ink (the girl at the reception desk was very sweet but said she had no access to printer ink to solve the problem.) There was a sickly sweet air freshener or cleaner smell throughout the hallways that bothered both of us every time we left our room. There was no tea provided in our room (I suppose most people are coffee drinkers but most hotels offer the alternative...pretty easy to add a couple of tea bags to the selection.) The worst thing about this hotel for us was the noise level. We could hear traffic, water running and voices constantly. Apparently our neighbor had an unhappy cat next door, and we got to listen to it crying for hours (by the way, we love cats but it was sad and annoying to listen to it all evening.) Breakfast was fine, although the OJ was empty and never refilled during the time we were there. There was a woman who was refilling food items, but we only saw her come out from the back room once and the rest of the time we could hear her chatting with a coworker in the back room. We wiped down our own table before we could eat. The hotel room was clean and comfortable enough, but given the price and other problems, we would definitely pick another hotel for a future stay.

author: DoloresfromIdaho
title: I've been here a number of times
text: The last time I wrote a review for this hotel the pool heater was out..so I'd like to report that it is fixed (yay) and was wonderful and warm. I use pools to get my work outs in and was so happy to see it was fixed this visit. The staff was great. No hesitation to accommodate a special request. I love that. The room was on the road side so a bit noise but as a seasoned traveler I have learned to bring ear plugs and I sleep like a baby. Do ask about the Basque restaurant in town by the railroad tracks. Fun place to eat.

author: Jildatheonly
title: Nice business visit
text: Winnemucca is a bit startling in that it is in the middle of nowhere, hours and hours to drive to the next place. I stopped here on a trip from Oregon back to Reno and spent the night. The room was very, very clean and had a fridge, microwave and coffee maker. The tv was large and the bed super clean and comfortable. I ate at the Mexican restaurant, and fell promptly asleep in the room. The beer in the restaurant was cold and good, and helpful! Breakfast was plentiful and I ate a lot of fruit, shared a pancake with another woman traveling alone. The eating area was small, but sufficed. The hotel is right off the freeway, so easy to find. I thought it was quiet.

author: Marsbr_540
title: Not as advertised but clean
text: We booked a room with a king size bed. if your used to a king size bed then you will soon realize that Holiday inn express king size is not king size. The hotel was clean. Check in was simple. the breakfast area is not beg enough but then like the beds i think this is a money saving thing. if the area is super busy with people falling over each other then you won't get comfortable and eat much. Would I stay again? Yes. I know what it is now, its fine, and that is a lot better than most in the area.

author: ontimecourier
title: Great staff
text: This hotel has just finished it renovation. Wonderful new colors and lighting. The whole front of the building has been redone. The rooms are standard Holiday Inn Express. Larger breakfast area and new workout room. The indoor pool is the best I have found in town. If you are pulling a RV or moving van look out the back door after check in from the lobby to see if there is parking for you. Some have no idea that there is room back there. Yes I have been here many times in many years.

author: 160vikv
title: "Great Hotel; Great Food; Even Better Staff!"
text: Fresh off my trip to Reno,NV and I must say... I stayed at the Holiday Inn Express on business and I couldn't be happier. The room was quiet, beds comfortable, and I was shocked at the size of my suite! Loved that I had a microwave and refrigerator in my room. And I can't forget: MORE CHANNELS THAN EVER IMAGINED! I could go on and on about my experience, but to wrap it up, A+ stay. The staff was very helpful and quite pleasant. This will definitely be the place I'll stay when traveling through NV!

author: Sona26
title: Very disappointing stay
text: I had read through a lot of reviews on Tripadvisor and decided to book this hotel for our road trip. We were traveling from Bay Area and reached the hotel around 2am in the morning. We hit the bed soon only to be woken up with people running around in the floor above ours at 6am in the morning. I think this entire hotel is built in a very poor material as a result of which we could feel the entire ceiling of our room creak. We had to call the front desk twice to finally have them take action but the sound still never completely went away. To make our experience worse, our room started stinking of something rotten. We had to cover our nose while walking in the hallway and while we were in our room - the stench was unbearable. The breakfast was sufficient and good. This was the first time I was staying in a Holiday Inn Express hotel (have stayed in Holiday Inn before). Highly disappointed!!

author: SharonC727
title: Pleasant stay
text: We arrived at this hotel after a long day of travel and no reservation. We were warmly greeted and although no regular rooms were available, we were offered a suite for $10 more. Can't really call it a suite though since it had no extra amenities, not even pen and paper, but was a corner room and larger in size. However the room was comfortable and we had a good overnight. We did not wait for the complementary breakfast but were happy to have 24-7 coffee. With just a few touches this could be a 3 plus star hotel. But we'd stay there again if every enroute. Warm and welcoming staff extra nice.

author: SKG109
title: Pleasant Surprises!
text: Decided to spend the night here on my way to Salt Lake City. Given the construction near the lobby, I was a bit worried. However, thanks to status, they upgraded me to a large junior suite. It even had a fridge and microwave. The toiletry was nicely done with plenty of stuff and towels. The room was quiet and the staff pleasant. Next morning I checked outta 0545 and the hot and cold breakfast was fully laid out - even earlier than the promised 6:00am. Definitely recommended.

author: AndeaAnderson
title: fabulous breakfast choices at a pet-friendly place
text: We stayed here twice in one week (it was the halfway point for us between San Jose and Salt Lake City). This was our first time travelling with our new dog and the HIE did not disappoint. We received a room on the first floor as requested and there was a place right outside to walk the dog. We enjoyed the indoor pool and jacuzzi, although the pool was a bit cold (but not so cold that you couldn't swim). The breakfast had so many options that I didn't have time to try them all: pancakes, omelettes, bacon, Canadian bacon, cinnamon rolls, yogurt, hard-boiled eggs, cereal, bagels, toast, milk, three kinds of juices, and of course coffee and hot chocolate. The staff was exceptionally friendly and helpful. Even though there was a lot of construction going on while we were there, we were not inconvienced in any way, nor did we hear any of the work. I would stay here again and would recommend it to anyone!

author: CharC147
title: Great place to stay without having to walk through a casino
text: Having family in Boise, with me living in Reno, Winnemucca is a perfect almost-halfway-point to meet. We did just that the weekend of the 9th and 10th. We had a suite room (HUGE!) for my granddaughters, daughter and I while my daughter-in-law and grandson had a room just across the hall. More than enough room in which to have a birthday party for all 3 grandkids. It was clean, the free breakfast for all of us was extraordinarily good and the indoor pool was fantastic! We had a hiccup involving construction which created a slight issue, however the management was very quick to make it right. Things happen and how the issue is handled is huge and the manager here gets an A+ for a quick and appreciated response. We will stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: TinaKayAlameda_CA
title: A veritable oasis amid this dusty landscape...
text: Sometimes, all you want is a clean room, comfortable bed, air conditioning that works, and friendly staff. Well, on those points, this motel scored home runs. But, when your room is nicely decorated, has a variety of pillow types, has an in-room fridge and almost non-stop cookies coming out of the oven in the dining area, you have a place that exceeded our expectations. We were only there for a night with our aged chihuahua and didn't partake of the breakfast, hot tup or pool. But it was such a nice experience that I won't mind staying there again. It does cost a pretty penny--almost as much as the Doubletree in Colorado--but it's the nicest motel in the area so we didn't mind forking over some cash for a nicer place. The staff is also very accommodating; from the great gals who checked us in, to the the morning kitchen help who offered us some fresh cookies upon checking out. Everyone was just swell. I could not recommend this place more highly.

author: RichardD367
title: Clean, Convenient, Paper This Walls
text: This was an unplanned stop after a long day on the road. The room was very clean and service was good. The included breakfast had a lot of variety, bagels, eggs, sausage, yogurt, cereal, fruit & more. We stayed on the first floor on the west end and our room was handicap accessible. The room was spacious and clean. Warning. our neighbors were not noisy people but we could hear a lot through the paper thin walls. By far, this is the least peaceful hotel I have ever stayed at. I could hear a lot of noise from the hall and near by guests.

author: sfRebecca
title: WiFi is worthless
text: The rooms are okay, and the pool is nice, but I travel on business and need Internet access. First of all they have a convoluted logon procedure that I've never seen in a $100-a-night hotel. Last month it was barely working at all it was so slow. Had to carry my laptop to the front desk and they finally admitted something was wrong and called their service provider. All they could say was something about a tower somewhere, and suggested I use the computer in the lobby. This month again the service is so slow that it makes my work very difficult. And, when I checked in for my flight Online this morning it took so long that I ended up with a B boarding pass on Southwest. Nice place for families, but not business friendly. Also, $100 a night for Winnemucca is a bit high and not worth it, except for the indoor pool during the winter.

author: VivianaS266
title: " Cleanest Hotel to Stay "
text: We stayed at this holiday Inn Express while we were waiting for our home to be ready. I stayed for about a week. This was the cleanest hotel I stayed in the room was so nice and clean everyday. Lobby was so clean and welcoming. And the breakfast Bar had a pancake machine so cool. I enjoyed the spa and clean towels. Very Very Nice Place to stay. I really recommend anyone to stay.

author: janiewall
title: Good stay but expensive
text: Since there are no towns before or after Winnemucca if you're crossing Nevada, you have to take what you can get. If you don't book very early and are not willing to chance it, the Holiday Inn Express is often the only thing left with a vacany other than little mom-and-pop places that don't show up on the internet. That said, if you book here, you know what you will get because the beds, linens, breakfast, etc. never vary with this chain. Freshly baked cookies were in a basket by the desk as we checked in. We spent some time in the indoor pool. The room was comfortable and quiet. There is a casino attached which was a bit strange but the entrance is outside the hotel and there was no noise or other disturbance from it.

author: PJSNv
title: Excellent Stay
text: Upon arriving, we were greeted by the most pleasant front desk clerk. The hotel was busy but he was very personable and interested in us despite that fact. It was hot outside - about 100 degrees - but the room was wonderfully cool and welcoming. It was clean and comfortable with lots of space. I have no negative comments about the hotel. We had an end room and it was very quiet. We slept really well. In the morning, the hair dryer quit working. It was replaced right away by yet another friendly desk clerk. The location was great.

author: Details_20
title: held captive in chemical-saturated elevator!
text: At about 9:00, when coming down to breakfast, as I got into the elevator, there was an EMPLOYEE wearing 3"+ spike heels, mini-skirt and blouse unbuttoned so low that you-know-what were falling out. She proceeded to spray two different cleaning products in the confined space, and then kept the doors from closing for 45-55 seconds while she cleaned and waited for another employee to get into the elevator. Having lungs that are irritated and inflamed by aerosol sprays, I commented that it might be better to do the cleaning when paying guests were NOT in the elevator. She rudely retorted that in 7 months no one had ever complained. I later learned that she was also in charge of replenishing the breakfast food, when I pointed out that all three of the milk pitchers were empty. Again, in a haughty, rude manner, she informed me that she would get around to refilling them after she was finished with her cleaning. Upstairs on the floor, I observed several guests unable to maneuver the luggage carts because the hallway was clogged with maid's carts parked in the middle. We had the same experience. And, if the maids came at all, they were very slow to move their carts out of the way. The clear message that pervaded this property - employees come first and paying guests are a distant second.

author: LesliJ1966
title: Most helpful staff
text: I stayed here for a week for work and had a very pleasant stay. The front desk staff were very professional and helpful. One desk clerk even spent an hour trying to help my husband with some computer problems. The breakfast was on time and fresh. The restaraunt next door was good with a friendly staff as well. Room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. Although, you need to bolt the door as the maids don't always read the 'Do Not Disturb' sign. Overall, very nice.

author: CandJGriffith
title: Great Hotel
text: We really enjoyed our stay here. We were just passing through, but it was short and sweet. The room was very clean and comfortable. We checked for bed bugs and didn't find any. It was very comfortable and we loved the free breakfast. The lobby did have a strong smoke smell, but that was only due to the casino that was next door, and there are doors to the lobby that let the smell in. In the room, however, there was no smoke smell. The only real complaint is that when we got to the hotel and went to check in there was no one at the front desk and we had to wait a couple minutes for someone to get there. However, it was late and there was only one person there. Anyway, overall it was great.

author: jimillym
title: Worst value for our money of any hotel we have stayed in
text: Traveling back to WA from AZ, we had spent 1 night at a La Quinta in Flagstaff and 3 nights in St. George UT in a lovely condo. Did a lot of sightseeing: Sedona, Grand Canyon, Lake Powell, Zion, Bryce Canyon, etc. It was a great trip. We did not go to Winnemucca as a destination, but as a stopping point in our travels home. The entire town looked old and tired and no hotels looked particularly good; so we chose Holiday Inn Express as we knew what to expect (supposedly!) Checking in, we felt the price was high as we had to pay $140+ tax (total about $160) for a room that turned out to be very subpar for the chain...very small room, 2 queen beds that were not their usual quality (they were very low to the ground and linens not highest quality), old style bathroom with only one towel bar, etc. We asked for a list of restaurants...desk girl had none.( A local resident directed us to a place that was just satisfactory) The casino was so smoky we couldn't go in there, and the breakfast area was very crowded the next morning. We won't go back to Winnemucca if we can help it; and if we must, we will never stay at that Holiday Inn Express again. I don't mind paying for a nice hotel with quality amenities..and we have stayed in worse hotels, but we agreed that this was the worst value we had ever gotten for the price. Very disappointing.

author: doslobos
title: Pricy
text: We drive I-80 about 6 times a year and have stayed here a number of times. The price a bit of a premium but its one of the most modern hotels in town and we got a comfortable, clean, and well maintained room every time. Because of the price we adjusted our trip to only stop in Winnamucca in one direction. When I planned this trip the price was $15 higher so we intended on going to Elko. Unfortunately, car troubles cost us a few hours and we stopped here again. The office people told me that there were various activities in town and that was the reason for the increased price. Other than the price, this hotel has been fine. In the future, we will probably continue on to Reno or Elko where there is much more competition.

author: cj6bonnie
title: Clean expensive bare bones
text: Rooms were standard holiday inn express. Old tv. Little bit noisy in morning. Hotel does a great job of containing smoke smell to casino. Parking is terrible. Cost was high $ 170 for king including the $40 pet fee. They're the only nice chain hotel between reno and salt lake that takes pets so they've got you over a barrel. Breakfast was the same as other holiday inn expresses, but didn't seem as nice. Industrial setting for breakfast area, had to bus own table. Older hotel.

author: redshoetraveler
title: 2nd & 3rd Stays Here
text: We stayed here once before & found it to be the best place we've stayed (so far) in Winnemucca, so we decided to stay here again both going & coming back from California. The staff was more helpful this time, finding us a room on a busy night and meeting all our requests. We stayed on the 3rd floor, where it was much quieter than on our previous stay on the 1st floor. The pool was a nice temperature. We again enjoyed the typical Holiday Inn Express breakfast. Our only complaint this time was the toilets - they are easily clogged! We will definitely stay here again next time through Winnemucca. Now if they could only get a decent restaurant in town....

author: babyboomer64
title: noisy but clean
text: If you are looking for a comfortable bed and quiet room, don't stay here. The bed was too firm and the air conditioner needed a new filter, too much dust or mold for me. On the plus side, the room was very clean, the staff was courteous and the price reasonable. The expanded breakfast was good. It is a reasonable price for what you get. Just bring ear plugs for the noise of neighbors and the trucks with their jake breaks. Food at the restaurant on site was okay and reasonably priced. Watch out for the hot salsa!

author: RcInNorCal
title: Really, it's OK - and dog friendly too...
text: This was a surprisingly decent night's rest. On the road between the bay area and Yellowstone we broke our journey right off I-80 at the Holiday Inn Express in Winnemucca. Figuring we'd bed down in a number of no-tel motels over the course of our journey, I had packed a small bag with Clorox wipes, Fabreeze, Glade candles, etc. As it turned out, I didn't have to open it at this stop. The room was spacious and bright with a clean bath, firm, supportive bed and it was dog-friendly. We had a great complimentary breakfast the next day. My only minor critique is that for a dog-friendly property there really is no place to walk a dog. They even manage to effectively control the cigarette smoke by reserving a non-smoking floor. Yay!!!

author: DisneyTrips4us
title: Nice Renovations
text: This is the third time I have stayed at this hotel when traveling through Winnemucca. I was nicely surprised to see the rooms had recently been renovated with crisp white comforters and refrigerators and microwaves in the rooms. Also, the hot breakfast bar was much better than on previous trips with individual bottles of milk/chocolate milk, yogurt, and hard-boiled eggs in a fridge. The hot food was actually "hot" and tasted pretty good. They had flavored coffee creamers too. The hotel was very clean and comfortable. On a previous stay, I had noted the rooms to be a little run down, but now they have done a great job on the renovation. Also, the location of the hotel is great. It's right off I-80 at the West end of town, so it's easy to get on and off the highway. On a trip through Winnemucca, this is the place to stay!

author: loveshoppinglv
title: holiday inn express winnemucca nevada
text: love it. real clean. the cutest casino attached to it, nice indoor pool nothing more to ask for. I felt very safe in this hotel. would highly reccomend. I was quite nervous staying in winnemucca because most of the small towns in nv are so tiny you can blink and miss them. not this one. this one was a nice size with a walmart next door to the hotel. Very convenient and would stay here again in a heartbeat.

author: Retto22
title: Wonderful staff and a comfortable room
text: This review is for the hotel only. The room we stayed in was downstairs and it was comfortably sized with high ceilings and a nice shower (especially important after those sandy beach days!). The powerful AC and fan kept us very cool during the warm days. They provided beach towels too which were a huge plus! Staff at the hotel were really wonderful and friendly. Always with bright cheerful smiles greeting us each day. They had great recommendations for restaurants and things to do/see in the area and were happy to make reservations for us. They also helped us with our rental car. We arrived in the morning before check in time and were fortunate enough to be able to check in to the room early. The front desk also kindly held our baggage after we checked out.

author: I7095LFstephanieh
title: Great Introduction to Willemstad and Curacao
text: I booked three nights here for my husband and I on our first trip to the island. I chose a three-room suite on the second floor, overlooking the neighborhood and it was beautiful. We could have stayed here comfortably for weeks since it had a full living room, kitchen, and balcony to enjoy the weather. The suite was probably twice as big as our NYC apartment, and beautifully decorated. We found the restaurant to be a decent option but would suggest venturing out further for better cuisine, and definitely taking breakfast elsewhere. Drinks at sundown at the restaurant were lovely, however. All the staff we had contact with, from housekeeping to restaurant servers to front desk, were extremely friendly and competent. We'd stay here again on our next trip to Curacao!

author: rashlp2016
title: Curacao
text: I stayed at Bijblauw in October 2018 to celebrate my birthday. One of the best decision ever made. The staff was welcoming and facilitated a smooth airport transportation. The staff was very accommodating and readily available to give tips on things to do on the island. The view from my room was peaceful, serene and memorable. Very boho chic!The hotel also has a restaurant on site that serves yummy food! I should add that the hotel is conveniently located in a safe neighborhood, and is within walking distance of the town. A must stay, if you plan to visit Curacao. A big thank you to the staff!!

author: UK-Colorado
title: 2 day business trip
text: The hotel is in a renovation area about 10 minutes walk from the center of Willemstadt. Many of the former colonial homes and mansions have been renovated and turned into hotels, restaurants and small boutique shops. Many other buildings are still dilapidated but the area is safe to walk into town. The hotel is long and narrow with a bar / restaurant area facing the sea. Room was old traditional in style but well decorated. Internet service was good speed in room but sometimes patchy in other areas. Staff were ultra friendly and accommodating. Good selection of bars and restaurants a short walk away (including the cool St Tropez hotel with great infinity pool and bar next door). The hotel has a narrow lap pool in the bar area. The sea area in this location is rocky so this is not a family beach type destination but it was great for my requirements.

author: TravellerDutchman
title: Superb boutique hotel!
text: Checking in: warm and friendly welcome to start your amazing experience. Room: very spacious, clean room with a nice view. Bathroom nice and modern. Bed big and comfortable. Best sleep ever! Coffee machine in the room was a big plus. Hygiene: very high standard of cleanliness Atmosphere: classy Service overall: they really look after you and make you feel welcome and special. Even the security makes sure you are safe. Recommendation: highly recommended ✌️😎

author: Goldenlover3139
title: An incredible place to stay in Curaçao
text: Our trip to Curaçao was fabulous, not the least of which was our lodging at Bij Blauw in Willemstad. The building is a lovely renovated old-style building along Pietermaai, within easy walking distance to the central waterfront of Willemstad and the Pontoon Bridge. The hotel restaurant is at the water's edge, and provides a wonderful tranquil ambience for breakfast or dinner. The food is also excellent and quite unique - they even had interesting options for a vegetarian. The room was very clean and bright, with many windows looking out over Pietermaai that could be opened as an alternative to available A/C for breezy nights. However, the most amazing attribute is the staff. It includes many interns from Holland, who were a great source of information and went way out of their way to be helpful - making numerous calls for information and arranging anything we needed or wanted. I have never experienced such caring, proactive staff in a hotel or B&B before. I highly recommend this location for any stay in Curaçao, and expect to return myself next year.

author: Individually-twisted
title: My third stay here
text: Very nice room, friendly staff, great location. We will always stay here if a room is available. Did not eat at restaurant since so many choices around but very nice dining area overlooking the water. That said, some of the restaurants where we had dined at on past visits were not up to their previous standards so i wished that we had dined at the hotel. Note, drinks there are a little expensive. We had two different rooms during our week stay. The second room had a balcony overlooking main street. Hopefully we will be able to return next New Year for some more fun.

author: jakoba2014
title: Just the place with great 'nordic' style, not to forget the food...!!!!!
text: Welcomed with a smile, that is the synopsis of the entire stay. Wonderful waterfront view for a bit of solitude with that perfect sundowner. Very comfortable and very clean rooms with simple, but in elegant style. Beds are large and soft, while the showers are a dream. NOW, the food just lifts it to that bit of heaven. Everything from that quiet coffee (of your particular taste) in the morning or amazing salad at lunch, to the coup de gras of fresh fish in the evening. And there's more! The service is amazing and having only been there twice, I will have to find yet another excuse for a visit and next time not alone. Thank you!

author: EdoA650
title: Romantic gem directly at the sea
text: This is really an outstanding boutique hotel in Willemstad. It is located directly at the sea. The restaurant is very good. The rooms are beautifully decorated. If you like the interior design you can buy some of the stuff at the hotel shop, which has also nice clothes and beach bags. For swimming you can either use the small private pool or the small public beach next door. If available choose room number 9 which has a beautiful terras facing the ocean. You can even have your romantic dinner served up there. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Simone Huisman for all her help and advice.

author: 684Tom
title: Very nice place, good location but...
text: We arrived during the dinner time and the place looks fabulous. Old colonial style building, fully renovated, with the rustic style. We went to the restaurant for the dinner, restaurant and hotel are located just in front of the sea with the amazing view. Very romantic atmosphere. We had small but very nice equipped room with the big bathroom. Can you imagine how we were disappointed when next day at the morning we stopped the fun which was working all the night and was hanging at the ceiling. It was almost black from the dust... I'm sure that they never cleaned it. In this kind of places it is unacceptable. Service during the breakfast also is a little bit too slow and the breakfast is overpriced but with the amazing presentation

author: SusanE291
title: Fully Taken Care Of!
text: There is nothing better about a vacation than completely checking out and letting your hotel staff handle the details. My Mom and I stayed at BijBlauw for 5 nights and could not have been treated any better. The staff made sure that all of our requests were handled. I had just come from a week in Colombia and needed to reset with laundry and such and they made it all so easy. The food was also the best that we had on the island. We would ask - "where should we go for dinner"? They always had a great list of ideas - however the night we stayed in and are at the hotel was the best of all. Thanks again - you will see us again for sure! Susan & Diane.

author: MGB724
title: Comfort Double
text: The staff at this hotel really go above and beyond to ensure that you have an excellent stay! They are very friendly and offer tips and recommendations that make your trip enjoyable. Upon arrival, someone sat with us and reviewed a map of Curacao and marked points of interest. Our room was small but comfortable. The only thing I would have liked to have in our room would have been a full length mirror, but all in all the room was great! We loved being able to walk to Willemstead, the trip took about 10-15 minutes. The restaurant was also very good and the view was beautiful! Travelled as a couple.

author: jinjuo2017
title: Our first trip in Curacao
text: Being our first time at Curaçao, my boyfriend and I did not know exactly what to expect, but because of their extremely high ratings, we had no doubts this hotel would be amazing. Upon arrival, the staff were extremely inviting and eager to show us around the hotel, giving us tips about the island, and points of interest they recommend we give a visit. (Also a complimentary drink!) The location of this hotel is conveniently located within about 7 minute walking distance from the City Center where lots of shops, restaurants, the floating market and the Queen Emma bridge is located. Although not situated with a large pool to swim into, a 2 minute walk to Saint Tropez hotel offers passes to travelers who want their fulfill of swim. And, the nearest beach is only about a 12 minute walking distance to Avila Beach. We found ourselves eager for their breakfast every single morning, and the view behind our food is the cherry on top. Highly recommend dining during dinner time at least once, the ambiance along with the staff and most importantly, the food is all around amazing. The rooms are modern, showers and the bed were kept extremely clean and the TV were filled with many American channels. Overall, we were extremely relieved our first stay in Curaçao had been at BijBlauw hotel. We would definitely recommend to other travelers and would definitely stay again, the next time we are back.

author: josephgianetti
title: My Stay at the BijBlauw
text: I stayed at the Bij Blauw from December 31st, 2016 to January 5, 2017. This was my first trip to Curacao. The hotel is in a perfect location. The staff was welcoming, friendly, knowledgeable, and helped with everything from car rental, day excursion reservations, and restaurant/nightlife recommendations. I felt comfortable immediately upon arrival. The room was very nice; I stayed in the “Comfortable Small.” It was very modern and there was more than enough space. The restaurant at the hotel was also great. Highly recommend that you have breakfast and dinner there at least once. Overall, The Bij Blauw was amazing and made my trip to Curacao perfect! Highly recommend!

author: Dravel60
title: Great little hotel and restaurant
text: I stayed for two nights at the BijBlauw hotel over a weekend and absolutely loved my stay there! This made for an extremely enjoyable and relaxing weekend. This is a relatively small, "boutique", hotel with a lot of charm and character, which I personally find much more enjoyable than a big and more impersonal resort. The hotel is well located, within a short walking distance from the iconic and colorful center of Curacao, while also benefiting from being in a quiet neighborhood. The room was very clean, functional and very comfortable. The terrace used for breakfast, lunch and dinner is absolutely fantastic, with an open kitchen, a great decor and ambiance and, more importantly, a gorgeous view on the sea. Food and wine were great as well and very decently priced. The staff, both at the hotel and at the restaurant, was very friendly, competent and helpful. Overall this was a lovely experience that I thoroughly enjoyed. I would definitely stay there again if I was to ever go back to Curacao in the future!.

author: voterobot
title: Would return for more...
text: Welcoming and informative staff--helpful, friendly and on-point. Hassle-free check-in/check out. Clean rooms, sleek decor/design, though more appropriate for couples/romantic getaways than for friends. Awesome rain shower. Beach view of Caribbean from bar/restaurant--though, not a beach to dip into the water. Hotel restaurant greeted us with a complimentary drink (non-alcoholic). Had great cappuccinos, food = meh (at least the bagel lochs spread left more to be desired). Great location--check out Fishalicious nearby (horrible name, but great food).

author: yvenal2016
title: Relaxing Last Day in Curacao
text: After a busy week filled with wedding events, our stay at BijBlauw was the perfect retreat. Our family and friends had left the island and we spent our last night in the charming boutique hotel in the center of the Pietermaai district. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Upon arrival, our bags were taken up to our room and we were sat on the terrace for a complimentary welcome drink. The terrace is beautiful and overlooks the ocean, adorned in swanky but minimalist decor. Our room was a two bedroom apartment with a huge deck overlooking the terrace. It was very cute and even came with a nepresso machine! The hotel is well located and we enjoyed a delicious dinner at Fishalicious, per staff recommendation. For breakfast we walked a few doors over and ate at the Scuba Lodge which was another great recommendation. All in all, we enjoyed our stay and look forward to the next time!

author: FerEnglert
title: Peace and a great view
text: What a pleasant surprise Bijblauw was to us. The pictures on internet were already very good but when we arrived at the hotel and entered our room, or was stepping into paradise. Book room#9 and you'll definitely feel the same - giant room, excellent bathroom and the greatest balcony entire for you. The restaurant is facing the blue sea, so every meal will be a relaxing and beautiful experience - and the food is delicious. At night, book a table in advance because the restaurant is very popular! The staff is the best part. All young, beautiful and very well educated people with lots of interesting tips for you. Ask them to book a tour with Quincly and to rent an old jeep with Mr Paradise (you'll need a car on the island). The location couldn't be better, walking distance from the handelskade street (colourful houses) and the Queen Emma Bridge. Go to Curaçao and stay at the Bijblauw!

author: MarieA631
title: Delightful Hotel
text: Honestly, I fell in love with BijBlauw before I arrived. They arranged airport transportation for me, recommended day trips and kept me informed via email. BijBlauw is a small hotel with a BIG heart. Check in was easy and everyone made certain I was comfortable. I enjoyed breakfast and lunch there and found the food to be delicious. I needed a hairdryer and one was quickly provided. They answered all my questions but still gave me the privacy and relaxation I needed. I would highly recommend this location as it is a short walk to town, and in a very interesting neighborhood.

author: RhiannonGarforth
title: Gorgeous hotel
text: I was staying in the hotel for 9 nights with my friend. Everything was lovely, boutique style hotel and room, great bathroom, lots of wardrobe space, we could see the sea through our shutters, Nespresso machine in room... Near perfect. The only thing missing was a full length mirror, but a very minor issue. The outside area had a very relaxing feel and a great place to watch the sunset. The food, wonderful! Initially we found the island (not just the hotel restaurant) expensive, but eating other places which were the same price proved to us the quality of the BijBlauw restaurant, for both lunch and dinner. The gin and tonics were excellent! The staff were friendly and informative, willing to help with anything we needed in both the hotel and the restaurant. Couldn't recommend it more!

author: 578gavind
title: A Botique hotel that becomes a holiday home!
text: Situated in Pietermaai, Willemstad,Curacao, is the Boutique Hotel BijBlauw.It is more than a Boutique Hotel it becomes your home, owned and managed by husband and wife Tita & Ruud van Dijk, you are made welcome the moment you step foot in the door, You become a guest of the family treated by the owners and staff alike as friends, you are made to be part of a family. The hotel has a ground and first floor, there is no lift so you do have to climb up the stairs unless you have one of the few ground floor rooms, ( I must point out that as this is a listed building and so the owners are very limited on what changes can be done) If you wish a room on the top floor make sure you are ok climbing stairs. We stayed in the front studio which faces on to a busy road, but after a couple of days you don't notice the noise,( well we did not) then there are 3 more smaller rooms and another large studio apartment facing the Caribbean sea. For further infogo to info@bijblauw.com The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, and I can recommend the restaurant for all meals; there is something on the Menu for everyone. If you decide to have your evening meal it is recomended you make a reservation as dinner is popular at this restaurant, plus you get a lot of walk ins, and some of these walkins are more than two people at times. The beds and rooms are clean and comfortable, there is a safe and coffee machine,Wi Fi TV's and A/C provided, if there is anything you need extra just ask, they do their utmost to oblige. For us our stay at BijBlauw is and was memorable for all the right reasons, as it could be for you. For anyone with disabilities, do check first with the hotel before making any decision to comfirm or make a booking.

author: MinStoon
title: A GEM in the heart of Curacao!
text: Bit of a late review but stayed at this lovely boutique hotel end of January 2016. The people who manage and work there are fantastic - very kind and accommodating. The room was perfect and the location superb as we walked into the restaurant/shopping/port area daily. We also had a rental vehicle and parked for free just out front and saw the entire island. The restaurant at the BijBlauw is very good with an amazing atmosphere as you overlook the ocean. I would definitely recommend you stay here as you won't regret the experience. Thank you BijBlauw for being part of our memorable stay in Curacao. LOVE it there! Michelle & Shawn

author: crader
title: Lovely Respite to /from Bonaire
text: We couldn't make the flights work out to get us to Bonaire in a single day so we stayed on Curacao at the BijBlauw for a night at each end of our trip. The front desk and restaurant staff were wonderfully friendly, helpful and caring. They arranged for taxi pick up at the airport. We had two different rooms on the first floor - both clean and elegant, in a simple, uncluttered way. They provided us with a free welcome drink (not alcoholic) which felt nice after the 30 minute taxi ride from the airport. The view from the two level bar/dining waterfront area is lovely - sea spray and then some was hitting the lower level on the first day we arrived but the second time we were there it was open and folks were dining there. So the hotel is on the waterfront, but there is no beach to speak of. You can see tankers and cruise ships entering and leaving the nearby harbors. Easy walk to the "swinging lady" (bridge), touristic shops, cafes and restaurants.

author: VanMalenstein
title: Best hotel on Curaçao
text: Enthusiastic people are running this hotel that doesn't feel like a hotel, it's more like visiting a home. Bedrooms are very clean and cosy and the hotel employs friendly and professional people. We stayed for 10 days and did absolutely enjoy our stay! Keep in mind that this hotel does not have a private beach, in order to visit one, you definitely need to hire a car. We parked the car directly in front at the hotel. BijBlauw is located walking distance from the center of Willemstad and easily accessible by car. BijBlauw features a delicious breakfast and has also possibilities of lunch and dinner. Definitely recommending this place and will return for sure when visiting Curaçao again!

author: rhondaCalgary
title: The only place to stay in Curacao
text: Wow, what a lovely gem the BijBlauw Hotel is. Where do I begin, The staff is so friendly and so helpful. We stay in the Seaside Rendez-vous, the room is amazing and so was the view, you have your own private terrace, the staff even came up and took our dinner order and served it on the terrace. We never wanted to leave our private "oasis ". The restaurant is the perfect place for breakfast/lunch/dinner or just a cocktail. The best spot on the island to watch the sunset. The location is great you can walk everywhere. Thanks again for taking such great care of us, we will be back. Rhonda and Jim Calgary, Canada

author: 177meredithd
title: Wonderful Hospitality & Great Location!
text: We stayed at BijBlauw for 3 nights as part of our trip to Curacao and had a wonderful stay. The hotel is centrally located and walking distance to downtown Willemstad and some great restaurants. We also enjoyed dinner one night at the hotel as well as a couple breakfasts by the sea. The food was delicious! One of the best parts of the hotel was the staff. They helped us when we had issues with our rental car upon arrival, with directions to some of the beaches, and with restaurant recommendations. They were incredibly helpful and made our stay extremely comfortable. This is the perfect hotel if you want to explore the city and some of the islands beaches during the day!

author: Jerianne2013
title: Romantic Getaway
text: I wanted to celebrate our belated valentines day with their Romantic Getaway Package. It was worth every penny!! Dinner was delicious, the main course could have been accompanied with an extra side dish, but it was nonetheless delicious. The View and atmosphere were perfect. The staff very attentive. Room was cozy and good size. Breakfast the next day was beyond our expectation. And eventhough there was only one server, the service was superb. All in all a very very good deal! Thank you Bijblauw 😆

author: Boeddhie
title: BijBlauw is always a treat!
text: Very nice small scale and welcoming accommodation with a superfriendly touch. It is located directly at the rocky ocean shore, providing a very nice breeze; very welcome in the warm and sunny climate. It's adjacent restaurant bearing the same name is a must go. The delicious food is made with local ingredients and passion. If you are a group of 4-6 people, you must try the chef's table (reservations are necessary). Chef Mischa will cook up a delicious storm, not to be missed! BijBlauw is in very short walking distance of the hustle and bustle of the historic center of Willemstad (waterfront restaurants, Pontjesbrug which connects Punda and Otrobanda for pedestrians). The Pietermaai itself is a nice historic area in which buildings have been restored/rebuild or are in the process of this with nice restaurants, small hotels, (coffee)bars and some shops.

author: 465cindyt
title: I would give a higher rating if I could:)
text: I spent one night in Curacao as I was on my way to Jamaica and it was truly an incredible experience. The service was exceptional. As I was unsure if I would have made it to the restaurant before closing, the staff kindly had my pre ordered dinner ready on my arrival at the hotel. The food was delicious and everything was cooked to perfection:) From my welcome to dinner, everyone was courteous, efficient and pleasant. My room was simply beautiful (I really loved the decor), the bed was soft and comfortable and it felt like a home away from home. The seafront restaurant, the tranquility and general cleanliness of the establishment (it was pristine) simply added to an overall positive experience there. Thanks BijBlauw! I hope to visit again:)

author: -foodie_watch-
title: Simple hotel
text: The hotel is very simple with basic decorations and furniture. One can tell that the renovation is already lived in. The hotel is a good alternative for those that do not want to stay in one of the big all-inclusive hotels on the island. Those who are seeking a quiet and relaxing vacation, however, will face a number of problems. The windows and doors are not well isolated. The restaurant downstairs in the evening and the cleaning staff in the morning will cause a lot of commotion. Discount the presence of a pool completely when deciding whether to book the hotel, you will not be able to use it. It is located on the side of the hotel's restaurant and makes it weird to use while other people are having their meal in front of your nose. All in all, if I went to Curacao again I would choose to stay elsewhere.

author: andeloke
title: Very nice, good location
text: We had a nice 4 night stay in november. Very convinient location, several nice restaurants just nearby, and just 10-15 min walk to the old town. Mostly nice service, but a few problems regarding a pricing of a rental car (through a third party). Was allowed late checkout, so we could make a quick trip to the beach and come back and take a shower before leaving on our last day. The pool is very small, and feel a bit like it is in the middle of the restaurant. Might feel weird to swim there during lunch/dinner. But overall very nice. Very nice bathroom.

author: frankr83
title: Excellent hotel for a relaxing week.
text: The room was was comfortable and clean with a king size bed. The Hotel location is excellent for exploring Willemstad and we also rented a car via the hotel for a couple of days to explore the island. The service was outstanding throughout our stay. The staff, both at reception and in the restaurant, gave us lots of helpful suggestions for places to visit and nothing was too much trouble. The bar/restaurant is on a terrace looking out over the sea with a lovely breeze, the perfect spot for breakfast, dinner or drinks with friends. The food at the restaurant was consistently very good. A perfect spot for a getaway and we would definitely stay there again. My only suggestion for improvement would be to have a few loungers by the small pool.

author: parth
title: Very good boutique hotel
text: This is a small, simple but tastefully decorated hotel. The rooms are basic but more than adequate, the location is great and the staff is very helpful. The restaurant overlooks the ocean and is a great place to have a sunset drink. Close to the hotel, there are two great live music joints (mundo bizzaro and miles) and a few other good places to eat; also close by is a public market with a great local food. The best part though, is the staff. They are friendly and warm. I travelled alone and chatting with them felt like I was with friends or colleagues. I dropped my phone in water (kids, don't snorkel with your phone in your pocket) and when they found out they rushed to get a hair dryer and a jar full of rice. Don't know what worked but the phone still does :) I'd go back.

author: bevcat
title: Outstanding staff, beautiful room
text: My husband and I stayed 2 nights in the oceanfront room- it was a beautifully decorated with a large terrace overlooking the ocean. The service and staff were exceptional. When we arrived we were warmly welcomed and given drinks on the terrace restaurant. We enjoyed a delicious breakfast there. My husband had a medical crisis that necessitated a trip to the emergency room and then to a doctor's office. The staff (in this case Britt) offered to drive ahead of me to lead me to the doctor's. The drive was 15 or 20 minutes from the hotel and I would have gotten lost without Britt's help. The people at the front desk- Britt, Edwin and a young woman from the Netherlands- were all exceptionally helpful and kind. After we left I received an email asking how my husband was doing. I can't say enough positive things about my experience at this hotel.

author: jeanettyj2017
title: Boutique Hotel with friendly, helpful staff!
text: Staying at BijBlauw was the best decision we made for our wonderful holiday in Curacao. The location was perfect allowing us to walk to the city centre of Willemstad, and park our rental car for free so we could use it to tour the entire island. The staff was so friendly and helpful, not only answering our questions, but also booking trips for us and giving us advice on any part of the island we wished to explore. They went above and beyond and this was greatly appreciated. We choose a room with a king sized bed and it was modern and very clean. Loved the expresso machine as well. We highly recommend Bij Blauw, a small boutique hotel, and a trip to Curacao where you can enjoy the beaches and a variety of cultural experiences so unique to this island. Be assured that the staff will help make your time in Curacao, a great holiday to remember! Thanks to the staff. We loved our stay.

author: UrsJamestown
title: perfect all around
text: We were at BijBlauw at the end of April for 4 nights, staying in beautiful second floor room with its own private patio facing the ocean. The patio was furnished with a table, stools and a sitting area - complete with candles and cushions - and the views of the ocean were stunning. The room had hardwood floors, AC and 2 fans, was clean, spacious, and very tastefully decorated (rustic, shabby chic), as was the entire hotel. The bathroom was sufficient in size and clean, featuring a rain shower and –very appreciated- enough shelf and storage space. My only suggestion for improvement would be to have a hairdryer available in every room instead of having to ask for it every time. The staff was exceptionally friendly, helpful and knowledgeable and gave us great advice which beaches to visit during our stay. The location of the hotel is perfect,just a short (10 min leisurely) walk from downtown with lots of nice bars and restaurants in walking distance, and still very quiet at night (if you don’t count the sound of the surf which to us was a very welcome backdrop). We had breakfast at the hotel only once; the big breakfast ($16) was a good value, European style including a variety of breads, cheese and ham, fruit salad, egg, jam, orange juice and coffee/tea. We could not have wished for a better hotel and, should we return to Curacao, would definitely want to stay there again.

author: jolineh2015
title: Superb!
text: We already loved to go to the restaurant for breakfast on Sunday mornings. Now we had a chance to stay. The room was perfectky decorated. Loved how they combined the old with the new. The bed slept really well, and once you close the sutters, you don't even know where you are. Dinner was superb. We had a 3 course meal and each and everyone was well presented and tasted deliciously! Would love to go back an other time

author: baylenlinnekin
title: Fun and memorable stay
text: My partner and I stayed here for her birthday. It's a fantastic hotel. You'll find great, friendly service everywhere you turn--from the efficient checkin to the excellent restaurant to the expert bartender to the warm owners. Great base for exploring. An easy walk or a short cab ride to everything in Willemstad. Nice little pool for cooling off. Trendy shopping on site. Occasional fashion shows. If you want great beaches, rent a car and head west.

author: 001ad
title: Exceptional Customer Service
text: I had spoken with a young woman over the phone to inquire about availability, and although no rooms were available, she made wonderful alternative suggestions. I promised I would visit the restaurant and boutique hotel to meet her for future reference since we travel on business to Curacao and she had been charming over the phone. She made the time to visit with us and had the kitchen prepare appetizers for us. The view is spectacular all day, especially at sunset. What separates this boutique hotel from the rest is the staff's attention to customer service: we are foodies and never did the word "no" enter their vocabulary. If we asked for something that was not on the menu, their reply was, "let me ask the chef what he can do". To our party of four, the experience was so enchanting that, after visiting most of the establishments in this most up and coming district and architectural gem, we agreed theirs was the best in every sense. Be sure to visit ... the bartender, by the way, prepared excellent watermelon mojitos and, again, the young man took pride in his work and even showed my friend the trick to preparing our own back home! I wish everyone at the BijBlauw continued success and we look forward to visiting you next time we're in Curacao.

author: NowVoyager63
title: Excellent Stay in Charming Boutique Hotel
text: This is a very nice boutique hotel in a wonderful and hip part of the city. The overall design of the hotel is very modern and stylish while at the same time organic and cozy, blended in that way that only the Dutch can do it. My stay was very relaxing and peaceful. This is a small hotel and is very laid back and quiet during the day, but the staff is never far away if you need help or questions. The food at the restaurant was very reasonable priced for the quality and presentation. The black pasta with seafood was excellent. What was surprising (not mentioned on the website) was that on many nights there was live music in the restaurant. The music varied from night to night (jazz, reggae, folk rock, etc...) and performances were of the quality that you'd expect to have to pay to see, yet it was free and felt like we were having private shows. Marleen was great at arranging transportation to and from the airport and also secured a private day tour. I would stay at this hotel again.

author: Michaelman73
title: Great location
text: A very nice hotel in a great location; within walking distance of most of Willemstad. Excellent and attentive staff bent over backwards to assist my wife, who was sick for the first two days of our vacation. Although there's no room service per se, I went to the restaurant numerous times of day and night and they fixed food and drink to our liking and helped carry it up to the room. There is a beach within walking distance—10 minutes—at the Avila Hotel. There's a small fee for a beach pass and towels, but we spent a wonderful day enjoying the sun and water. The BijBlauw's restaurant was excellent and there are numerous upscale restaurants and bars within walking distance. My only complaint (reason for 4 stars and not 5) is that the street in front of the hotel is very busy all times of the day and night. Thankfully, the hotel windows could be closed to block out most of the noise. Very clean; no bugs; satellite TV (we could watch the NFL playoff games); a quiet and very efficient AC unit and ceiling fans; and a staff who would answer any question or find someone who could. A great place to stay if you're not looking for all-inclusive hotels.

author: Suziecups
title: Great spot, great people
text: We had a great time here. The staff was amazing and they gave us great recommendations and even some advice on our next stop, Bonaire. The room we had was small but cozy, clean and the bed was so comfortable. The A/C and fans were a definite plus in the balmy weather of Curaçao. Breakfast was European style with deli meat, cheese, bread, butter, eggs, smoothies etc. The coffee was incredible as was the view. Very nice way to spend the morning. We would recommend this to anyone who wants to stay at a cozy, hip, boutique hotel at a reasonable price. Its within walking distance to many shops and restaurants and BijBlauw has its own bar that goes late into the evening.

author: 400vanessav
title: Amazing!!!!
text: We had our wedding ceremony at Bijblauw in August and could not have been more pleased with how the event went! We are from Curacao so we had many locations to chose from but Bijblauw delivered on all our requirements and exceeded our expectations. This is a family run hotel and it shows in terms of the personal touch and care! The setting is amazing and the owners Titia and her family went out of their way to make sure everything went smoothly. They were very accommodating and flexible which made for a really relaxed atmosphere. The food was wonderful and our guests left happy. We spent the night at the hotel in the honeymoon suite and it was gorgeous. All very stylish yet different which makes it so special. I could not recommend this hotel more. Especially if you are looking for a venue for your wedding but it is also wonderful if you are looking for a boutique hotel in unique location on the island.

author: Daeena
title: Nice location, great restaurant
text: Good location. We did stay for 2 days, wanted to be in the city. Excellent service once booked through web, instant personal reply, did arrange dinner for us on Sunday evening, since most of the restaurants are closed on Sunday. The restaurant is great, great food for dinner, lovely breakfast, lovely view, great combo with the accomodation. Parking was available in front of hotel. The room was nice, although we did make a lot of jokes on 2 things: one was the room was below the stairs (looked like from Harry Potter), the other were the bathroom doors (did not give much privacy, but you have to see it to believe, window in the bathroom doors to room, I thought it is really funny). The only thing was the toilet was broken on the second day when we did return from the day at beach and they were not able to fix this till our exit. One day and night us not a big deal, since they have public restrooms, but yes, could not give a 5 star...

author: StevieC_8
title: Perfect Location and Great Room
text: We opted to pay a bit extra and go for the best room, with terrace. The price is well worth it, for the terrace alone which is massive and has sweeping sea views; lying in bed looking at the sea, perfect. The room itself is pretty large and tasteful; fridge, good cable TV, great Wi-Fi, lots of room and storage and excellent air con (ceiling fans and air con unit). There is only a shower, no bath, and the toiletries are limited - little pots with little in them, so bring your own shampoo and shower gel. The breakfast / restaurant area is quiet with great sea views and the breakfast offered are really nice (continental style - no fry ups). The location is perfect, short walk to centre and most of the best restaurants are within a five minute walk, ideal when you don't want to walk far in those hot evenings (tip - bring mosquito repellant, as lots of mosquitoes - of course this isn't an issue for the hotel, but wanted to mention)! Driving is fine and the hotel will organise a rental for you, with a big, secure car park just opposite (at a small cost) - very convenient. This isn't a big, chain hotel, so don't expect the usual conveniences (gym, room service, 24 reception etc) - but what you do get is a friendly, boutique hotel, with most things you could want, in a perfect location! So pleased we listened to the reviews and chose here! Thanks to all for a lovely stay :)

author: 105kitr
title: beautiful and friendly staff
text: Went on an AA vacation and picked this hotel for the location. We really loved most of the hotel. The staff was wonderful! The location excellent....it is not on a beach, but it is on the water. There are a few additions that could be added to make it excellent for Americans....but we are spoiled, so it was lovely. Love the location with the restaurant attached. The location is a "developing" neighborhood, so a couple of places close by are sketchy, but not scary. I would go back in a heartbeat and would most likely stay here again!!

author: zerverovers
title: BijBlauw is a hidden gem!
text: We were in Curacao for one week. Booked 3 nights with BijBlauw and 3 nights by Playa Lagun. We were so disappointed that we could not stay with BijBlauw for longer! it is just so very relaxing there! Our room, a "Cosy" had 10 foot ceilings...perfect! ...we had a wonderful stay here...all of the staff were more than helpful...we enjoyed breakfast on the terrace by the water...the pool is divine....the setting and sunsets are priceless...and the proximity to Everything is superb! There are lots of cafes and excellent places to dine and drink, or listen to music...within walking distance of BijBlauw. We would love to return to BijBlauw for another stay. The team here, make you feel very welcome and comfortable.

author: H181BUscotth
title: Personal, Comfortable, Excellent Stay!
text: Our vacation to Curacao was amazing, especially thanks to BijBlauw, When we arrived, our room was extremely clean and prepared for us (very nice modern design, by the way). Both the receptionist and owner greeted us, and told us the best spots to go on the island for beaches, and where to get food around Pietermaai.
