It was a perfect location for us because we wanted to drive around the island and explore all of the beaches, but we could come back to the city in the afternoon / evening for an excellent bite to eat either at BB or anywhere close. And the accommodations were very comfortable and brand new (unlike many many other places on the island outside of the city). They always helped us if we had questions navigating the island and finding things, also providing beach towels for us, etc. They got to know our names on the first day and were very cordial. If you are looking for a posh all-inclusive experience where you don't leave the hotel, do not stay here. There are plenty of other resorts like Santa Barbara for you. But if you are looking for a great place to stay on the island (good value, great accommodation) and a little adventure, book at BijBlauw,

author: macbigddaddy
title: A perfect home away from home
text: I happened on BijBlauw quite by accident, and glad I was. A Boutique Hotel doesn't do it justice. Greeted by a Dutch diva with bountiful smile I immediately felt at home. Melissa gave me great directions for activities such as sailing, the BEACH and directed me to the LODGE DIVE RESORT where I found camaraderie and dive partners to explore the island with. The hotel was very comfortable and recently upgraded. Natural teak abounded along with great artwork. The owners offer a night out for couples and give their children a lovely room full of crafts, guidance, food and fun. That was the ultimate feel, that this was a family hotel--quaint, nice, friendly, quiet, right on the water and affordable. I loved my stay here and when I return I hope to be greeted by another beautiful and friendly smile that will say, welcome home, we've awaited your return! I can't say enough good things about this remarkable place and its personnel.

author: AVE1963
title: Beautiful place at perfect location
text: Fantastic hotel, located in two recently renovated small buildings at the seaside of Pietermaai and only 10 minutes walking distance away from Punda. Very enthusiastic, friendly and attentive crew. The room is clean, complete and offers all you need after an exciting day in the sun: lush dubble bed, rich shower in stylish bathroom, TV, airco and fan. Valuables can be stored in your own locker in your room. There's also free WIFI available. The terrace offers a spectacular sea view, with waves breaking gently while having breakfast or an evening drink. The inhouse kitchen, located at the terrace serves excelent food. Staying at BijBlauw has definitly contributed to an unforgettable stay at Curacao. I found the pricing most reasonably. If you want to omit the larger hotels for your stay, I'd recommend this place.

author: 911jyls
title: A beautiful hotel with the best food!
text: We had originally booked another hotel, but due to an unfortunate miscommunication regarding the date we had to find another hotel last minute. We were directed towards BijBlauw, which only opened two weeks beforehand and luckily had a last minute room available. We had no idea what to expect, but we were absolutely astounded when we walked into our room. It's open and beautiful, with a completely modern design that plays on the contrast of different materials. We were also given a large terrace that has amazing view of the ocean and sunset. The food here is absolutely spectacular, and is the best I've eaten on my Bonaire/Curacao trip so far. Another plus is that it's only a ten minute walk to the downtown area, and it's located on a street full of colorful, picturesque houses. The hotel owners and staff are incredibly friendly, and our room had internet and air conditioning. As it turns out, we were incredibly lucky that our first hotel was misbooked, as it led us to BijBlauw.

author: Tony10Cambs
title: Spring Break
text: Just returned after 9 nights here. Wanted to give 3.5 stars but not an option so went for 4 stars. Lots of people give this 5 stars which l do not understand, the hotel is very clean and staff are really good but overall it does not warrant 5 stars. Plus points Centrally located Reasonably priced bar drinks Very good staff Rooms very clean Free room safe Negatives Food is typical 3 star as per official hotel rating. Average choice and quality. Small swimming pool. No entertainment day or evening Very small bathroom 5 x 7 feet 1 tv channel in English I would probably go again for a break, but as an experienced traveller 5 star it is not. Hotel ratings are judged on more than location, cleanliness and the very good staff.

author: U3905AIpaulb
title: Return Visit
text: The word "Central" describes this hotel. My third visit and yet to be disappointed. From the Manager through to the staff who have been there since my first visit are a credit to this establishment. A 3* with a 4/5 star attitude. They have changed their English style "Carvery" dinner buffet to more traditional Cypriot buffet, I believe this concept will be more appreciated by it's patrons. The cafe is under refurbishment and should be complete within weeks and will again offer a variety of meals/snacks and drinks. The hotel just keeps getting better and better. I look forward to my next visit in November 2019.

author: janetrevor2001
title: Dionysos Hotel
text: Very good Hotel for a 3 Star. Room is large, bed comfortable. It is nice to have a fridge in the room. Tea/coffee making facilities. Room cleaned well and fresh towels provided daily if you wish. The food in the restaurant is good, plenty of choice. Not always my choice of desserts. The staff are all very pleasant, helpful and courteous. Nadia in particular very helpful. We visited there some years ago, the Upgrade certainly has made the hotel.

author: JackB289
title: Alright!
text: I would probably rate the hotel 7/10, if possible. Booked our stay at the Dionysos in September, as a last minute deal. The location was good as we were only a short walk to the promenade and the bars and restaurants. We arrived just after midnight so all the bars were closed (except for the notorious bar street). The hotel room was a decent size, with free air-con, safe and fridge. The reception area was modern but could have done with air-con. Outside, the pool area was desperately in need of renovation, and the young man playing the music thought he was entertaining his friends, with some awful dance music, when all the sunbathers were over forty. Other than that, no complaints.

author: haptonbob
title: Golfing Holiday and Family Wedding.
text: Fantastic location for this Hotel with a small private car park. Loads of bars and restaurants nearby and a few minutes walk to the sea front. Really nice sea view room with a decent sized balcony to view the sun set. Good breakfast and a superb buffet evening meal is available. The fantastic staff are friendly helpful and efficient. There is loads of comfortable lounge space with a nice residents bar. Nice swimming pool and sun terrace. I would highly recommend this family Hotel.

author: paulgS8286ST
title: Disappointing Hotel
text: We stayed at this hotel first two weeks of september.Firstly this hotel is not suitable for disabled or people with mobility problems.There are steps everywhere and those in reception area are in an area that is poorly lighted.We were staying on the first floor and there were even steps up to our room.On the first floor corridor on our way to our room there was a low ceiling where the steps accend.I banged my head on this twice going down the steps in the corridor. There was no signage or hazard warning on this low area of ceiling. The lift was very small and should have accomodated four people but would only hold three people before the overwieght alarm activated and would not move.The handrail on the stairs coming down to reception was loose. We were on a bed and breakfast board .The breakfast was very disappointing. The variety of breakfast items was minimal .The quality of the food was very disappointing and was not appetizing at all.There was no air conditioning at all in the reception and breakfast area only fans running full blast. The rooms were clean and tidy and were cleaned well every day so no complaints there.What i dont understand was there was a see through glass door to the bathroom.The towels that were provided for our room were grey and thread bare. Reception staff were very friendly and helpful . Would not stay at this hotel again.

author: kimcullen2018
title: Cyprus
text: Just enjoyed a 10 break at this hotel. Clean modern rooms, good maid service. Plenty of beds round the pool. Good location not noisy as some people have stated. Food was good always plenty of it. The reception staff Valentina and Nadia are a asset always happy to help and greet you with a warm welcome. The waiting staff were also very good. Would recommend this hotel we will be back.

author: nataliehunter61
title: Brilliant
text: Visited for my 30th! best holiday iv had rooms perfect, food good, staff are lovely! we got a deluxe room would of been nice to have a sea view- as the front gets noisey but its manage-able and doesnt disturb sleep. beds comfy, robes, slippers complimentary wine and fruit, air con was a saviour! such a lovely hotel and atmosphere. We have been home a week and our return is already booked 😊 sunbeds could do with a cussion but thats it. the food was good and for a family who are fussy like us thats great some of our holidays the food has been diar!! Everything you need is within walking distance such a great place i cant wait to go back neither can my little girl she really loved it

author: barried43
title: Unbelievable previous reviews.
text: Booked this hotel based mainly on the reviews seen on TripAdvisor. Whilst not doubting the authenticity of the reviews I am beginning to wonder if I was at the same hotel. To summarise: * Beds were small and very firm, with thin hard pillows. Unable to open balcony doors and cool the room due excessive external noise; the swinging ceiling fan competed with the boy racers and the returning early morning drinkers for noise dominance; air conditioning was not available until the final night of our stay. Basically, sleeping was a real challenge and we returned home exhausted. * Neither myself or my wife can be termed as fussy eaters, however, in our opinion, which was shared by a number of other guests, the food was unappetising and dull with the emphasis on penny pinching low quality produce; even the salad bar was pathetic. * Some reviewers make much of the `friendly staff`. Whilst the majority were pleasant and helpful, we and other guests experienced some aggression in rapid plate and table clearance when end of allocated meal times were nearing; in one of a number of instances a waiter actually tapped his watch and made his disapproval clear as we continued chatting at the table with a full ten minutes to go before the end of meal time. A notable exception was `Emi`, who acted as a smiling calming influence and helped to make our stay bearable. From conversations with regular visitors to the hotel, the standard has dropped significantly in recent times, which may explain the previously good reviews.

author: kathrynscollan
title: Lovely staff.
text: The staff, particularly those on the front desk, were excellent. There was nothing they would not do to help and they were always cheerful and friendly. The food, especially the choice of foods at breakfast, were of a good standard. The cleanliness and decor was excellent. We had a lovely stay at this hotel. One down side is that rooms on the front of the hotel can sometimes be noisy as there are bars out front. This could be a problem during the high season, though all noise stopped after 10am. There is safe and fabulous sea swimming 5 minutes walk from the hotel. This is a lovely hotel.

author: LollyB44
title: Great location
text: A lovely hotel in a great location, just a minutes walk to the sea front. It has a nice comfortable feel to it and is not as big as many of the new hotels around. The welcome gift of a bottle of wine and a basket of fruit is a nice touch, as are the use of a spa type dressing gowns and slippers. The reception staff were all extremely friendly and helpful. The rooms were cleaned every day and the air con and safe were free. There is also a fridge as well as tea and coffee making facilities with tea and coffee supplies too. The Wi Fi has a good reception throughout the hotel and poolside and we even got it when we had a drink in the bar next door. The food was ok, self service and a choice of about four or five different dishes in the evening but it's quite cheap to eat out. You could choose to eat either inside the restaurant or go outside in the garden area which was very nice.The pool area has a small terrace above with sunbeds and there was a nice area to sit to have lunch from the pool bar. This isn't a fancy hotel but a relaxing stay near to everything.

author: M1339DDangelad
title: Consistently Good
text: Second time that we have been to this Hotel. This time half board. Breakfasts and dinners were fine, we tended to have breakfast but after three dinners we dined out because we like the local restaurants . The rooms are comfy and clean. Beds are huge with firm mattresses another plus. Fridge and safe at no extra charge. Television was on the wall, only get BBC news channel. It's a very quiet relaxing hotel. Pool area peaceful no problems with beds etc. For us, best location in Pathos.

author: L0llyD
title: Did not disappoint
text: Fabulous location. Near enough to walk to restaurants, bars and the harbour Small friendly hotel. Look small but adequate and plenty of lounges. Liked that you could get a drink and ice cream from the pool bar. Breakfast nice. Evening meal ok. So we chose to eat out a couple of nights. Very friendly staff. Clean rooms. Would definitely stay again.

author: jocN1439PK
title: Perfect Winter Break
text: The hotel is perfectly placed for the town, seafront and harbour. Stayed 18th February for 7 days in a Garden view room. Requested quiet room which we had on the 3rd floor. All hotel staff were extremely friendly, courteous and hard working. The rooms were lovely with complementary robes and slippers, wine, water, fruit, fridge and safe. Our room had morning sun until about midday and was quite spacious. We stayed half board. Breakfast had plenty of choice with fresh fruit and various yoghurts, full English and continental. Dinner was soup, a good variety of salads, hot cooked dishes which always included a freshly carved roast. Desserts were a bit of a let down but certainly didn't spoil our stay.

author: BarbsG
title: Deserves more than 3 stars
text: We stayed in this hotel for two weeks over the Christmas and New Year period. We found the hotel to be very comfortable and very professionally run. We paid extra for a Luxury Sea View Room and it was worth it, sun on the balcony all day. The room was lovely, very well fitted out, very comfortable and my only comment would be the lighting was very dim and a mirror in either the bathroom or bedroom with a light would have made it perfect. The reception, housekeeping and restaurant staff are all very helpful, friendly and obliging. We were half board and enjoyed our meals very much along with a good gala buffest at Christmas and New Year. We did not get bored with the food as the variety was good. We always tended to eat later when the rush had gone and it proved to be a good move, quieter and plenty of fresh food - good to see lots of fresh fruit and vegetables. I would certainly recommend the hotel if you want a comfortable central position hotel - it is not 5 stars but I feel it deserves more than 3 stars.

author: owens396
title: Lovely well located medium sized hotel
text: Just spent 2 weeks (11 to 25 Nov) at this very pleasant hotel. On arrival one cannot fail to be impressed by the lovely entrance, reception and lovely lounge area, The one drawback is the number of steps both inside and outside which could a drawback for the infirm. The deluxe rooms are very nice and well equipped with free fridge .free wifi.frree safe and frree very limited TV. A nice touch is free welcoming bottle of wine and bowl of fruit. The staff right through from reception to cleaning staff are really very good and very frienly. The hotel could not be located, close to beach, shops and old harbour. Our one complaint about the Dionysos is limited choice of evening meals. Almost without exception everything is covered in sauces, highly spiced or stuffed with something. My wife only likes plain food and found it very difficult as she could not even find a plain UNDRESSED salad. Overall though we would highly recommen this lovely hotel.

author: 766cathyf
title: Very enjoyable stay
text: We enjoyed our 10 days at the Dionysos Central very much. The location is good for the beach, shops and local buses. The hotel is clean, has a friendly atmosphere and all the staff are polite and helpful. Our booking was for a deluxe room and did not disappoint. Complimentary bottle of wine, bowl of fruit, also we had tea and coffee making facilities and a little fridge, which was most helpful. Our room overlooked the front of the hotel onto the street and the bars opposite, which unfortunately a little noisy at the weekend, but apart from that a pleasant outlook, not too hot either as it was not facing the full sun of the day, making the room cooler than a room overlooking the pool. We would definitely stay again. The only disadvantage we could see was there are a lot of steps at the entrance and inside leading to reception and restaurant areas, not too good if one has difficulty in negotiating steps.

author: 65carolec
title: Fantastic service
text: We recently stayed here for 11 nights. Could not have asked for more where the staff were concerned. Very friendly, efficient, hardworking. Made friends with Daniel from day one the lovely barman. Fantastic location, easy walking distance to local harbour, bars and restaurants. Peaceful surroundings considering where it's situated. Food choice abundant. Could not fault anything. Definitely stay here again.

author: BrundallbazNorwich
title: Perfect location, decent hotel
text: Stayed here for a week on a B&B package. Room was very good, excellent bathroom, looked as though it had been refurbished, had a garden room which gives you a view over the outside breakfast area. The breakfast was ok, Fairly standard self service fare but a week was probably about enough. The breakfast area itself was pretty hot with just a few ceiling fans but there was plenty of outside space to eat so wasn't a problem. Glad we didnt opt for the all inclusive package as there was only the pool bar open which closed at 10:30. Absolutely nothing going on in the hotel in the evenings so you would probably want to go out even if you had already paid for it. The hotel is perfectly situated near to the harbour with lots of bars and restaurants nearby within easy walking distance. We did worry thay maybe there would be noise in the evenings from nearby establishments but we never had any disturbances. The staff were very friendly and helped us out by phoning the local brewery for us when we were trying to arrange an excursion.

author: Odyssey439158
title: Amazing holidays
text: We were here just for 4 nights, but it was really cool. Fresh hotel with great stuff guys. Thanks to Milena - she is always nice and helpful. We wish to have more different food, but for 3 stars - it's really great. We were lived in room 014, it's deluxe room, and it was good. New bed, fresh fruits, bottle of wine. Ogh, and hotel placed in center, there is a lot of magazines and shops. I don't know what else to say. Mb just thank you.

author: rosemarieb5
title: a few tweaks and the hotel could be classed perfect
text: Perfect location, lovely clean rooms, friendly staff, Daniel the pool barman needs to stay in the bar rather than wandering around, you had to wait for him to return and he also needs to remain cheerful as some days he was lovely and other days, really miserable. The hotel had some strange rules though, on the all-inclusive package, you cold have wine, beer or soft drinks with you meal but no coffee afterwards, you had to leave and go to the pool bar to get it. The chairs all around the hotel were most uncomfortable, no cushions on any of them and they leaned back too much in the dining areas. The food was ok, nothing special, but deserts were awful, fruit salad which was really just chopped up sour apples and some awful cake or coloured sickly cream - they really need to sort this out. The hotel guests all got on during the day, but the evenings were boring as the bar closed at 10.30 so everyone went out. The pool tiles do need cleaning and quick - the dirt is above the water line so I think it would be easy enough to do. The reception could have some literature on local attractions as I had to Google to see what was around in the area, especially as most guests book independently, not through a holiday company and therefore, there was no holiday rep. Other than these few little gripes, we had a lovely holiday, but it could have been a great one!

author: Cinderella2204
title: Summer holiday
text: This hotel is located perfectly. We had a room on the front and it could be noisy however, it was so hot that we couldn't sleep with balcony doors open anyway. Doors closed, AC on and no problems with the noise. Rooms are good enough but breakfast was a bit boring. Small buffet with everyday the same. Im glad we only had breakfast and not all-inclusive. There are so many restaurants in the area. The hotel, rooms and pool area are clean. In short, price/quality is good.

author: lupiedeb
title: lovely hotel central for everything
text: lovely hotel we couldn't fault it for cleanliness and friendly. We stayed half board had lovely meals the only thing I think they could improve on is the desserts, they were always the same. Clean room and cleaned each day with towels if we wanted them. Central for everything and only 5 minute walk to the beach and bars, plenty of shops to browse. Wifi was good. They could have done with extra help at the pool bar as there was often four or five people waiting to get served. Pool area was lovely and the pool lovely and warm too. Would we go again? yes we would, but at an earlier time of the year, as it was very hot :)

author: GRANDAD55FA
title: Back again in September.
text: We had a lovely holiday in June. Stayed b&b. We stopped by the dining room a few times and have decided to go half board in September. Service was great. Reception staff handled any questions with patience and courtesy, especially Nadia. First time in 40 years we have returned to a holiday hotel. Restaurants and shops of a variety of quality near at hand. Roll on September, and thanks to everyone at the Dionysos Central.

author: rachelrpugh
title: Perfect central location, lovely deluxe room
text: The location is perfectly central if you want to be situated within the main hub of restaurants, which is also near the harbour and surrounding beaches. Our deluxe room had a peaceful and private balcony but was opposite Flairs Bar which stays open until 1.30am blasting music which is noisy on the balcony from around 7/8pm but the room itself was pretty much sound proof with the door shut. It actually provided us with ideal predrinks music perfect for young couples who want to go out fairly lateish. The beds were very comfortable. It was also spotless and cleaned every day, we couldn't fault hygiene rating apart from a few cockroaches but we're aware this is hard to prevent in hot countries. Free wifi but only one device could connect at a time, with a free safe also. Breakfast was tasty and provided a lot of variety including hot English breakfast. Pool area was satisfactory, a little too small for the amount of people and rough around the edges in parts. It was also too warm and the sunbeds were a little uncomfortable but otherwise it was alright. Apart from other minor issues we had a comfortable stay and couldn't recommend this hotel enough for other young couples wanting a central location.

author: Val023_10
title: Little gem
text: Currently staying at this lovely hotel. Spotlessly clean and tidy. Very central to all the bars and shops by the castle area of pafos. Hotel has English plugs so you don't need the European plugs. Staff friendly and can't do enough. Rooms are light and airy with a decent hairdryer beside the mirror. Everything very well thought out. Already looking at prices for another visit

author: RDOld
title: Much better than 3 star
text: Just returned from 7 days at Dionysos Central. The Hotel as the name suggests is ideally positioned in the centre of Pathos. On arrival we were greeted by the excellent reception staff, check in was smooth we were given the key to the safe deposit & remote control for TV at no cost. We had a basket of fruit, bottle of water & bottle of wine on arrival in our spacious room. The beds were comfy the shower great & all the room facilities 5 star. Breakfast was all you could ask. we were on b&b so can not comment on meals. Always sun beds available - no need for the early morning towel on bed routine. We dined a couple of times at Viva Cyprus 500yds up Poisedon road from the Hotel probably best value 3 course with wine meal in Pathos. The hotel in my view is excellent

author: John44Dimond
title: A Lovely Hotel
text: We stayed for a fortnight in March and were very impressed with the hotel. The atmosphere was very relaxed, and has a convenient location. The big plus is their excellent staff. Everyone - receptionists, chefs, waiters and waitresses, cleaners and bar staff worked extremely hard to ensure the hotel ran smoothly. They were all very friendly and efficient at all times. We got to know them well. The food was well prepared using fresh local ingredients with plenty of choice. We always looked forward to our breakfast and evening meal. This hotel thoroughly deserves its Certificate of Excellence.

author: richardcG4911AM
title: Great value hotel, rooms clean and great location
text: We stayed here as a family after booking a very last minute deal through Thomson holidays for the February half term week. The hotel is situated in a street just set back from the seafront in Paphos within just a few minutes walk of the harbour. The hotel rooms were clean and beds comfortable, rooms were cleaned every day. The hotel staff were friendly and helpful. The food in the hotel was as you would expect for a hotel of this standard, reasonable quality but quite a limited and "samey" selection. The puddings were the most disappointing being almost the same every night - a little more imagination required from the chef, and maybe some basics like ice cream would go down well. We drank house wine with our meals which was reasonably priced and very drinkable. The dining room is quite small and tended to get quite crowded during peak times, this meant occasionally having to queue for the more popular dishes and the coffee machine. We only stayed in the hotel bar area for one evening but enjoyed going across the courtyard to the other bar which had nice seating, open fireplaces and very good prices on drinks (This is the bar that give you a free welcome drink voucher when you arrive). The pool area is very small and we didn't use it at all

author: 824PeterB
title: Very good for off season trips
text: The Dionysos is a modern stylish hotel located near the promenade in Paphos Kato. Rooms are a good size, nicely decorated and well-appointed, including, balcony, a fridge and safe. There's reliable free WiFi. There's a comfortable lounge / bar, a pool and sun deck and a pleasant garden. There is a good selection at the hot and cold buffet breakfast. Evening meals are buffet style and offer a reasonable selection of Cypriot dishes. The adjacent Royal Cafe is convenient and reasonably priced for snacks or lunch. It is well located for walks along the sea front and to archeological sites with Roman mosaics, rock tombs and early churches. We stayed out of season and it was quiet at night. Unfortunately the number tourist bars in the area suggests that this may not be the case in high season.

author: 725RogerF
title: Paphos package at a central hotel
text: We changed our package to the Dionysos after the original booking advised of major works being completed. In every way the Dionysos package was superior to the original. Much of the hotel has been recently refurbished and to a high standard. Food is good buffet style with dishes always hot and regularly replenished. My only criticism is that much of the foyer/lobby area is comparitively dimly lit. The flooring is dark green marble composite and there are several different levels with a few stairs in between them. The edges of the stairs are not readily visible. Owing to the number of different levels entering this hotel, in the foyer/lobby and also in the accommodation areas this is NOT a hotel for anybody with mobility restrictions or issues. The management are aware of this and have passed the information to the tour companies - who seem to have disregarded it. We had a deluxe room with sea view and balcony, other than a slightly 'compact' bathroom the room, service and food could not be faulted at the prices charged.

author: Dragmel
title: Ok hotel Horible holiday!
text: We were in paphos for work last year ! it is a nice city and the hotel is fine regarding the cleaness position but NOT the staff!or some of them anyway! our stay was a nightmare ,,We had a meal in the indian restaurant across the road call Jaganta or something simmilar,My misses had food poison and she was very ill for few days..I went to complain and the blond woman managing the place throw me out and told me if i dare write a review i will be in troubles! I told my wife and we mention it to the reception , who recommened to us!but she did not really bother! we decide to change hotel . We end up in Sofianna hotel furture up , it was much better , but i end up with toamy problem this time ,,i am vegan and we tried the place call " Saint Paul Pillars" . when we went in there we count more cats that people , the chef never stop smoking inside the kitchen! well , since we could not affort to change hotel again ,we decide to keep quiet and just wait until we go!as you can understand not the best stay in Paphos! If the staff was more supportly to us we would have give better rate ..but we can not!

author: SylviaE424
title: The gem of small hotels
text: This hotel is situated close to the beach and harbour in paphos. It is spotlessly clean. The food is excellent. The staff are very friendly and efficient. There is a small pool area and a large sun terrace. It is obvious that it is very well managed and I would thoroughly recommend it to anyone except wheelchair users as there is no easy wheelchair access. I think mainly this is a hotel for adults. We had a deluxe room with free safety deposit box and a fridge. We had a wonderful 3 weeks and we thought it was excellent value for money.

author: oldboyIpswich
title: Very helpful
text: This is a small hotel by the standard of those around it. Located no more than a hundred metres from the sea in the very centre of the tourist area. This was our third visit to the hotel which has been recently modernised. The standard of the food on a half-board basis was very good and we thought there was a very good choice. We booked directly via the manager by email and got a deal for eight days which obviously the standard tour companies could not do. The hotel arranged our pickup from the airport. The staff was still the same friendly group that we had encounted on previous visits. For the price I thought it was an excellent deal

author: rosamundb2014
title: Dionysus revisited
text: First time visited since refurbishment. Remains small friendly family hotel. The rooms are clean and comfortable and staff friendly and helpful. At this time of year it was quiet and many of the attractions/restaurants around were closed for the winter. The food was excellent with a good choice for all, buffet style restaurant. Our visit was arranged through the manager of the hotel, this time we brought my son and we were very pleased with everything provided. We had been to this hotel several times before and were really pleased and would like to go again! Hire car reasonable prices plenty of places around hotel to hire from. Wifi not good in room but usually obtainable in reception area.

author: RINGLET55
title: Winter break..
text: Stayed here for a week beginning of January,unfortunately We were not lucky with the weather and it was quite cold.. The Bar area had a log fire which they only lit at night,and the wifi in rooms was really bad,we did ask about this,but by the looks of how many people were in reception area we were not the only ones having trouble!! not much better there so had to go next door to check e.mails etc.. Our bed was 2 singles together my side was new but my partners side was stained and well passed it,we did complain and instead of changing mattress they folded some blankets and layed them on top... + Close to everything. Restaurant staff very efficient. - Bad wifi. Noticed lots of little black insects on tables in restaurant and by seating area in reception and one night by the food!! a bit off putting..

author: L3587USalans
title: Christmas break
text: We stayed in room 213, room cleaned every day with clean towels. Fruit bowl and bottle of wine is a nice welcome touch. Aircon with heater easy to operate and hot water at all times. Good size bed made up daily. Free safe and fridge in room. Free Wi-Fi but worked better down stairs in reception. Bath slippers and robes, hair dryer. Many thanks to all the staff who worked extremely hard putting in long hours to make our holiday one to remember, Bad bits were..no lighting on balcony for evening drink, 13 steps just to get to reception so could be a problem for disabled, no shaver point in bathroom, glass sliding door to toilet and bathroom so no privacy, no plugs by desk to plug the kettle into so had to make do with the little table and put the kettle in the corner of the room. Not many Tv channels in English.

author: brianpK446GY
title: Really Central
text: We booked this hotel based on it's apparent central location and we were not disappointed. It was right amongst all Paphos amenities and just a few minutes from the harbour, bus station and archeological sites. We paid the supplement for a deluxe room with pool/sea view and were pleased with the décor, comfort and facilities. The fruit and wine awaiting our arrival was a nice touch. The public areas were immaculate and the reception, bar, restaurant and cleaning staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Breakfast was lovely with plenty of options but dinner choices were not as extensive as you would see at larger hotels. However, what was available was delicious. We would definitely make a return visit next time we look to travel to Paphos.

author: ellenm269
title: Holiday
text: We were apprehensive at first reading trip advisor reviews before we went but we have just came home from staying here for a week. The staff are very happy and pleasant from the first meeting at reception to the staff in the restaurant and bar they can't do enough for you. The food was lovely we had different meal each night. Some people complained about it but we found it really nice. Desserts could be a little more variety as same cake each night but not really a complaint as it taste lovely. To enter your room with a bowl of fruit and bottle of wine and water sitting there was a nice welcome. We had a dressing gown and slippers on the bed to. These little touches were nice. We were in a good spot near the harbour so in the best area. We thoroughly enjoyed our holiday and will be returning again

author: WackyWyatt
title: WINTER WARMER
text: Wanted a winter warmer holiday so chose Cyprus as temperatures around 24 - 25 degrees. Thomson were offering a good price on half board for a week at Dionysos Hotel, Paphos - so we booked! Lovely spacious entrance to hotel and smiling, helpful receptionist. Very nice, clean room with balcony, tea and coffee-making facilities, fridge, safe and large shower. Spacious lounge area downstairs with very well stocked bar and tempting cocktails. Pretty pool area and plenty of sun loungers. Food tasty and plentiful - standard hotel fare. We were able to eat in the charming outside dining area for all our meals. Finally, the staff were brilliant - always smiling, courteous and helpful. We would highly recommend this hotel.

author: SaintMartin56
title: September at the Dionysos Central
text: Great hotel with friendly staff and a great location in Pafos. Positioned metres from the seafront promenade which gives you a nice flat walk eventually to the harbour with it's castle and range of restaurants. Also positioned with some nice bars/restaurants directly opposite the entrance. Room was clean, modern with superb air con (which was used extensively during our stay) our room was in the main building on the first floor and was perfect for us. We stayed on a BB basis and couldn't fault the buffet breakfast. Hot or cold buffet, always plenty and always fresh, were able to sit outside most mornings under the trees which was nice. Quite a small pool, but plenty of loungers around and on the top tier. We loved it here and wouldn't hesitate to use the Dionysos again.

author: 2013slp2013
title: lovely friendly hotel
text: my husband and I have just returned from the hotel lastnight and want to say thankyou to the manager and all the staff at this lovely hotel for making us have a memorable holiday and making us feel important to them. when we first arrived we were greeted with smiling reception,we went to our room and there was a fruit bowl and a bottle of wine to welcome us,this is in all rooms not only ones if paid more for.we were very impressed with the moderness of it all and couldn't believe there was dressing gowns and slippers too,dont forget this is 3 star..tv on the wall,ok ,only news channel in English but who wants tv on holiday.there was a kettle with tea/ coffee each day filled..,a hairdryer .safe,free....aircon free...fan free.....rooms cleaned everyday...the balcony had table and chairs and our view was over the restaurant and I went immediately to see if there was a higher room with a view..the reception said to go back next day....I went back and was taken to the managers office where I was greeted very friendly and concerned...he checked all his rooms and said there was one available next day higher floor and facing the church,lovely view,he said if this was ok we could move if not he would show as available,however it was very nice so we moved...next day was my husbands birthday and we came back to the room to see balloons on the door and a greeting card and inside was another basket of fruit and another bottle of wine for him..how kind and thoughtful thankyou. breakfast was very nice and something for everyone,cooked breakfast everyday.staff in restaurant also verynice and friendly.it is immaculate throughout.nothing at all can be said in a bad way...pool,sunterrace,reception,bars,everywhere in this hotel is marble,glass and steel,it is beautiful. they go out of there way to help in anything and you are made to feel you are a special guest not just another one... the hotels location is excellent..it is 1 minute to the harbour.restaurants ,bars,walks all.... I would recommend this hotel 150% and want to again say thankyou to you all. it is a sign of good management when the staff are all happy. well done you make a great team and we hope to meet you all again . wishing you much success ,you deserve it. sue and edd parker

author: winfred2014
title: Best Hotel Yet
text: This really was the best hotel we have stayed in yet. There was a bottle of red wine, a bowl of fruit, bathrobes and slippers on arrival. Coffee and tea making facilities too. Free wifi and safe. Spacious room, comfortable beds and very clean. Food was delicious too although we tended to go out quite a lot for meals to explore area. Staff were very helpful and friendly. Pool area was great with plenty of room to sunbathe.Would definitely recommend this hotel if you are going to Paphos.

author: 736bethc
title: Fabulous holiday
text: My boyfriend and I stayed at the Dionysos Central hotel for a week in June and we had a fantastic holiday and a big part of that was due to the hotel. From the moment we arrived to the minute we left all staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful, nothing was too much trouble. The room was lovely and modern, excellent air con which was free, balcony, powerful shower etc. The pool is small but perfectly adequate and there are plenty of sunbeds and seating around the pool. The food was nice, yes it got a bit repetitive but what can you expect from a 3 star all inclusive? There was always something we both liked and it was tasty. We did eat out occasionally too as we like to try different cuisine. Finally the location was excellent, right in the middle of bars, cafes and a nice stroll away from the harbour. Would 100% recommend this hotel and hopefully will return in the future. Thank you to everyone at dionysos for making our holiday fantastic.

author: 461elint
title: Perfectly locatef
text: This hotel couldn't have been better located.. Right in the heart of paphos with great restaurants on the door step. Pool area was always clean with lots of room and available sun beds. There's also a terraced area which naturally was quieter than the pool area with the hotel being a child friendly one. Hotel pool bar was very reasonably priced and a good variety of meals, ice creams drinks and cocktails. The hotel itself is very basic but for the price we thought it was fantastic! Really good value and modern clean rooms with friendly and helpful staff. Would definitely return and recommend to a friend!

author: 947alana
title: Holiday
text: Read a few negative reports of this hotel after booking to go. We went on the 15th June 2016 returning on the 29th June 2016. We stayed in the deluxe room, free bottle of wine and fruit on arrival. Free bathrobes and slippers. The room had a free safe, fridge, air con, and 32in TV. The bathroom had a walk in shower with an overhead as well as a wall shower. The staff were all very friendly and aimed to please. Breakfast had all the choice you needed. The only grumble was that at the evening meal the choice of sweet was always the same would have liked ice cream. Would I return certainly we will?

author: nadasamen
title: Syncharitirio
text: The wife and I had a marvelous time in Paphos and we met very nice people for the business we targeted. But above all, we had the most pleasant stay in Dionysos Hotel. The atmosphere is great, it's calm, serene and homy. The service is excellent. The receptionists Olga and Julia are so warm welcomers and go beyond to assure the best service. The Manager Mr. Costa, is a sweet man, under his serious managerial appearance. He is very considered and efficient. The Hotel is well decorated and the rooms are a 3 stars+. As for its location, it's very well centered and close to heavenly surrounding.

author: MarioForjazSecca
title: Very nice low price hotel in Paphos
text: This hotel is a small three star hotel with very reasonable prices and very well located within 100 m of the beach and the main restaurantes of Paphos. The rooms have been recently refurbished are are very nice. The only VERY serious problem is that the beds are too short!!! I am 1.86 cm tall and the beds are only 1.80m!! This means that I had to sleep with my feet hanging out of the bed and did not sleep very well! Breakfast is ok but not that fantastic but the coffee is appalling! I know breakfast coffee is normally very bad in most hotels but here it was particularly bad. I could not drink to all all!

author: 639uria
title: Horrible service, strange pricing method & weird toilet.
text: The hotel has an annoying pricing method - the room has a fair price (for us it was 55), but roughly 20% more for "PERKS". I.e. internet access = 4 euro, tea kit = 4.5 euro, key to the safe = 2 euro... and so on. We were lucky enough to get TV remote for free. The stuff is not interested at all in helping (we decided we want the tea kit in 22:00, it was too hard for them to walk 7 meters to bring it). The toilet door is transparent!!! Yes, transparent. I don't know what the the designer had in mind, but I can NOT think of one person I wish to travel with and have a transparent door for the toilet (spouse, sibling, parent, business partner, friend, BFF, Santa Claus...). Must admit that the location is great and the shower was one of the best we had in Cyprus.

author: Lomond2015
title: Very good value
text: Really nice hotel. I had a deluxe room which was equipped with a fridge, two nice white fluffy robes with toweling slippers. Bed was a proper double (not two singles bolted together) and was comfortable. Staff were pleasant and helpful and the pool area - lovely. Food could have been a good deal better frankly but maybe all inclusive draws the short straw. Lunches were served next door at the Cafe Royal and were good. Drinks at both were good standard. Would return here - wonderfully close to the harbour and shops.

author: chrish0lidays
title: DIONYSOS HOTEL , PAFOS
text: This is a very well run, clean and efficient hotel. Staff are friendly and helpful. Rooms are kept spotlessly clean and are well provisioned. We had room 121, a deluxe room on the first floor. Although not large, it had much more facilities expected of a 3 star hotel as for example bathrobe , slippers ,wine & fruits on arrival etc .Breakfast was plentifu, catering for all tastes and nutritional needs. The pool area is small but very clean and very well maintained. A delightful and relaxing experience. Highly recommended!

author: bengi1623
title: The hotel just gets better each year.
text: My wife and I have just returned from a two weeks holiday at the Dionysos, this being our fourth time at this hotel. The hotel is still in the process of upgrading, each year for the last three years or so we have noticed many changes. All for the better for the guests, it would take me to long to mention them all but most of the rooms have been upgraded to a good standard and the bathrooms also. My one and only one concern in the bathroom, is that it could do with a light above the mirror as I had a problem shaving, it was quite dark.The food in the restaurant on an evening is good with a variety of Cypriot and English dishes, there is usually something for all tastes to enjoy. The hotel Manager ( Costas ) is a very, very helpful, polite and friendly person, if he can assist you, he will, the staff behind the reception desk are very helpful and polite also. The breakfasts are very good there is all the normal things such as eggs, fried, scrambled and boiled, beans, sausages and bacon. Fruit juices, tea and coffee ect. Breakfast and the Evening meal is on a buffet style so you can eat as much as you like. The pool bar is run well by friendly and polite staff and has a few Happy Hours which is good, Julian and Elena staffed the pool bar when my wife and I were there and they were brilliant.The hotel is situated in a very good location, just a very short distance from the beach,shops,restaurants and the redeveloped Harbour. Just over the road from the hotel is a nice Taverna called Mandra and a nice little bar called The Flintstones ,give them a try for a change.

author: robertj284
title: Paphos tourist area
text: The hotel is in a convenient location for many of the attractions of this popular holiday resort. The promenade to the harbour with the boat trips leaving from just a few hundred yards away and in the evening the street of the bars is a hundred yards in the other direction. The breakfast is good. If you arrive at 7 o'clock though there is just continental style but is you leave it to get there after 7.30 you will find that the hot things have arrived. The evening meal is however a bit hit and miss for ingredients and quality. The woman on the reception, when I arrived was a bit abrupt but mellowed during my fortnight stay and even attempted a joke on the morning that I was leaving. All in all a reasonable place to stay especially if you speak Russian. 90% of the guests were from Russia and spoke no English including good morning so I found out how to greet the Russians in the morning and even then I only occasionally received the reply. The wifi is a bit hit and miss and the television is all Greek except the BBC world news which gets repeated every 15 minutes through the day and one other news programme.

author: Jool
title: Perfect Location
text: We love this hotel, it is situated just a few minutes walk from Paphos harbour in Kato Paphos. The hotel has been given a full makeover, our room was lovely the balcony overlooked the pool and sea, bathrooms have been made into wet rooms really nice, the only downside for me was the bathroom door was glass and only two small sections were frosted, not a lot of privacy there. rooms are clean, beds are new and very hard, but we did get used to that, only problem the pillows were of poor quality and very uncomfortable. The pool is fabulous, checked and cleaned daily. Breakfast is a bit hit and miss with choices, but very nice, as we only ever stay b & b I cannot comment on the rest of the food. All in all a lovely, clean hotel in an enviable location. Staff are lovely. We will certainly be booking again.

author: SylviaE424
title: still here
text: Shortly be entering our third week at this lovely small and friendly hotel. It is situated one minute away from the sea. We came with mercury direct two weeks half board, one week bed and breakfast. Having recently stayed in 5 star hotels in paphos we thought we would give this very central hotel a try. We are very impressed. It is spotlessly clean, bedding changed regularly, the towels also. The meals are waiter serviced by Demetrious in the evening, who will bend over backwards to help with your requirements, and Nicholas at breakfast time. The only downside of the evening meals is the menu is repeated weekly and maybe should be fortnightly. We will definitely be returning to this hotel next year. It has been wonderful.

author: 995janet
title: This hotel grew on me during the week ...
text: Although initially disappointed with my room, by the end of the week it had grown on me. It was clean and spacious, but rather basic and dated decor. My problem was that I was in the annexe which has not been updated. If you're in the main block, you'll be OK as these rooms are modern and quite impressive. My room had no kettle, it had a fridge but you had to pay extra for this, it was very noisy at night from the all the discos in the area which went on till at least one in the morning! and the view was uninspiring - satellite dishes and water tanks! However, the staff are friendly, helpful and hardworking, and as I say, I felt a bit better about the hotel after a few days than when I first arrived. Food was average - good choice but average quality. Breakfasts better than dinners. The hotel is in a great location - 2 mins walk from seafront and shops.

author: J2737IZrichards
title: Hotel Dionysos Paphos
text: Stayed in this hotel for 10 nights from 13th July 2014, on a half board basis. The recent refurbishment was of a good standard with excellent Air Conditioning.We upgraded to the Superior Room, which included complimentary Wifi (a little slow at times), Safe and fridge. Also included in the room was a free bottle of wine, basket of fruit, slippers and gowns. My only complaint was there was no light above the mirror in the bathroon, which made shaving a little awkward. The staff are all very friendly, helpful and nothing was too much trouble for them. Service in the restaurant was excellent .This hotel is ideally situated in Paphos for the numerous shops, bars and restaurant, and a short walk to the harbour. Considering the location, It is also one of the quietest hotels I've ever stopped in. I would recommend this hotel

author: 91barrys
title: dionysos hotel
text: my wife and I have been to this hotel on many occasions. the hotel is centrally situated in Paphos. It is a lovely hotel and the staff and management are very pleasant and helpful..On our recent visit it was our 53rd. wedding anniversary and when we went to our room later that day there were balloons on our door with a sign wishing us a happy anniversary. On entering the room there was a bottle of Champagne and the maid had placed our towels on the bed in the shape of a heart. It was a lovely and much appreciated surprise. We would definitely recommend this hotel. Barry & Dorothy

author: mjohnsonma
title: Don't do all inclusive
text: I don’t normally write reviews but am disappointed in the all inclusive package at this hotel. Don't get me wrong the hotel itself is central and we had deluxe sea view room which was good. The food however - you may only eat at certain restaurants at certain times. Evening you can eat at La Place Royal (which is the best of the bunch) once only. The other alternative is the Italian restaurant which is diabolical. Drink and food menus are given to you on arrival so you may only eat certain meals at the Royal but not from the Al a carte. Drinks you can't have local Keo beer but can have their cheaper and worse counterpart Leo?? Cocktails are questionable not too much alcohol in there I gather. Very annoying seeing as I paid a lot of money to go A/I. Don't bother there's very reasonably priced excellent food and drink around the area.

author: Scorpiochris
title: Good budget accommodation
text: Stayed here for 4 nts. Lovely room. Basic but very clean. Good central location. Pool let this hotel down but lovely beaches made up for this. Would go back for reasonable price alone. Stayed bed and breakfast. Nice breakfast. Restaurant very clean.

author: ProfPatLondon
title: Mixed impressions of the Dionysos
text: We have recently returned from a delightful week at the Dionysos. After a disastrous first night in the annexe when we didn’t sleep because of the noise from a nearby disco, we were moved to a quieter and newly refurbished room which was clean and comfortable. The reception staff were invariably pleasant and helpful. We were on an organised tour and took the half-board option, so we ate breakfast and dinner in the hotel’s newly refitted and attractive dining area. The generous buffet ensured that there was plenty of choice but, unfortunately, noone seems to have told the chef that these days some people are vegetarians. During our stay, although we ate dinner in the hotel every evening, and there were invariably several meat/fish choices, he failed to prepare a single vegetarian hot dish, so our options were restricted largely to salads, and even these sometimes had ham in them. Furthermore, the refusal of the waiters either to serve us unbottled water or let us bring our own water into the dining room, even though one of us had a nasty cough, added to the annoyance. Other irritants were the charges made for use of the safe and fridge in our room. But despite such issues, given its central location near the sea and harbour, its attractive facilities and comfortable rooms, and friendly staff, the Dionysos deserves high praise. If it could only address the minor niggles (no nonsense over water in restaurant, some veg food, labelling of food contents, no charges for safe or fridge), it would be really excellent.

author: bengi1623
title: Give this hotel a try, " Highly Recommended "
text: My wife and I have just arrived back from the Dionysos after a 2 week stay, this is only our second stay at this hotel but we have already booked up again for next year as we enjoyed our stay at the Dionysos very much. The Manager Costas is very helpful and will listen to any problems you may have and will sort them out if he can, and he usually does. His staff are all so friendly and polite and will also help you with any problems if they can. Julias who works at the pool bar every day is great, nothing is a problem for him he is so good at his job and the lager is not bad either, more so when it's happy hour. The rooms are very clean and big enough for most people, if i had to do anything to the rooms, i would update the bathrooms but that's only a minor thing. The food in the hotel is good, breakfast is a mixture of continental and British ie, fried eggs, bacon, sausage , beans, scrambled eggs ect, the meals on an evening are very good also with a good choice of dishes. The hotel is situated in the heart of Kato Paphos about two minutes walk from the beach, the beach near to the hotel is a man made beach but is well worth a visit. There are many bars and restaurants within a few minutes walk of the hotel but as i said earlier the food in the hotel is good and you can have a three course meal for about twelve euro's. The hotel has had a few alterations carried out since the last time we stayed at the hotel but they are all for the good of the guests, like a third floor with modern and updated facilities to the rooms. We spoke to a couple who were staying in one and they told us that they were very happy to be in one of the new rooms.

author: leonardh478
title: Highly recommended
text: When holidaying in Paphos, Cyprus for about the last 16 years we always stay at the Dionysos Central Hotel, because of the friendly atmosphere. The manager, Costas, and his staff are always ready to give any help and assistance that you may require to make your stay an enjoyable one. The rooms have been refurbished with all new furnishing including beds, which are very comfortable. The food is of a high quality both for breakfast and evening meal with a lot of choice. It is a very clean hotel which includes the good sized swimming pool. We have stayed at the hotel in past years with friends that have travelled with us who were also very pleased with all aspects of the Dionysos Hotel. The Hotel is well located with restaurants, shops within the surrounding streets. The sea with an area of sunbeds are across the road to the front of the Hotel. We spent 14 nights at the hotel in early September 2013, and are returning again this October.

author: pamy133
title: Perfect
text: This hotel is fantastic, everything about it is just superb. The rooms are very clean and modern. Staff are very helpful and go out of their way to help you. The pool is very clean. We were staying at another hotel but couldn't stay there any longer and then we found this hotel and the manager was so accommodating to me and my family. It's the ideal location for everything you need. Thanks to all the staff for making us feel welcome. I would recommend this hotel to anyone. See you next time!

author: holiday46140
title: disapointed
text: Rooms are clean but poor quality beds and furniture. Food is very basic luke warm and unappetizing. Very poor selection of evening meals. At times to try and get a drink is impossible waiting up to 40 mins to be served. Although staff are friendly management appear to pay little interest to complaints or resolving them . What was worse is that our complaint was doubted. We paid for a deluxe room only to be told that the wifi was not included although when checking travel agent web page it states it is. We would not recommend this hotel.

author: Rose471
title: Do not let the photos fool you
text: I have got to say I stayed in this hotel in March, this was the in the middle of a refurbishment, I would not mind if it was just a paint and decorating job, but this was a whole new floor being built on top of the second floor, banging, drilling at 7am ,dust and debri all over the patio and the pool area, no green netting to protect the guest, while they sat around the pool not that many people did because the noise was rediculous. I am not very happy with the company I went through because they must have known this work was going on. The security was not good, changed my room after the first night, you had to pay for 20 euros for the remote for the tv which there was only 1 programme BBC world news for the British, 20 euros for the safe, 10 euros for the fridge which did not even work, I was passed complaining at this stage because no one was listening to you. The receptionist were very rude, they even said to me at one point when I complained about the building work (what building work), like they knew nothing. The reception staff need to go on a course for customer services. The bar was a joke when it was open just before dinner you would ask for your drinks and the bar man would get the glasses and go into another room for the drinks looks really nice on the photos just like everything does. The breakfast was the same every day and not even hot, the food was the same at dinner not hot to make it worse the plates were cold, so any warm food soon got cold,at dinner time there was a cover put on the drinks machine so we could not have any warm drinks with our meal we were half board I at lease expected to have a coffee with my evening meal. This was just a money making machine at this hotel charging for every little thing. Be aware of the noise at night from the disco and night life around. The only good thing was being central as Cyprus is beautiful.

author: ChickenCrazy073
title: Enjoyable break at Dionysos
text: Had a week at the Dionysos in Pafos. Great location for this intimate boutique type hotel - right in the middle of town. Easy walk to the sights, the harbour and archealogical sites. Some refurbishment work being completed during the stay but staff worked hard to keep disruptions to a minimum. The work is nearly finished and the good news is the hotel will be even better. My group of friends thoroughly enjoyed their time here. The staff in the bistro were helpful and all had a great sense of humour adding to our fun. Will be back next year.

author: Lindadx
title: Good value hotel with excellent location
text: Spent 2 weeks in the Dionysos for the second year running. The reception staff are very helpful and friendly. We came half board this year and were pleased with the food choice and quality of the evening meals. Plenty of choice for breakfast as well. Food is constantly being topped up so it is fresh. The rooms are clean and what you expect from a 3 star hotel. All staff are very friendly and helpul. If you have a problem the manager is always available to help. Will most certainly be booking again for next year.

author: irenep178
title: Great Hotel, ideal for holidays!!
text: The location was great. The staff were very friendly, helpful and polite. We received a welcome drink and fruits on arrival. The rooms were clean, tidy and comfortable! Breakfasts were delicious with a great variety. Nice pool area although we did not use it because of the weather. We really enjoyed our coffee time (and some delicious crepes) at Cafe Royale next to the hotel, which belongs to the hotel. Would really recommend and will be visiting again!!

author: cyrprus
title: dtb123
text: Hotel not suitable for people with walking problems as steps everywhere! Walk from coach as cannot get up to hotel door. requested a quiet low floor room, received a room on ground? floor, was about 12 steps to reach it in another building!! think all the children or families were put there as well as noise from them and from discos round corner. Paid for a pool view, got a partial view of pool and view of roof of buildings. Julia in reception was lovely and very friendly. Food acceptable. Pasta in Italian was gorgeous but main courses not brilliant, lamb was all bone not much meat. Lovely situation for shops etc and lovely beach beyond Alexander the Great Hotel.

author: bengi1623
title: very friendly hotel and in a great location
text: My wife, myself and two friends stayed at the Dionysos in June for 2 weeks and found the manager and all the staff were very helpful and friendly. The hotel is clean and the rooms are kept clean and tidy on a daily basis. The restaurant on the hotel grounds was a nice place to eat, with a good menu, we ate there a couple of times and found it very good and reasonably priced. As for the location, you could not get a better placed hotel, only a few minutes walk from most of the places to eat, drink, do a bit of shopping and sight seeing. There is a taverna just over the road from the main entrance , called " Mandra " give it a try, its very very popular and is very friendly. Next to the "Mandra" is a lovely little bar called the "Flintstones" this is a nice little bar to have drink before a meal and also to relax after a meal. Me and my good friend Fred used to enjoy a few very, very good pint of beer from the pool bar in the hotel on an afternoon, believe me it was great, just thinking about it makes my mouth water. The pool is a bit small if the hotel is full but the beach is only a few minutes walk, if you would like a change from the pool, but usually you can get a sun bed , no bother.

author: catwoman67
title: can't wait to go back next June!!!!
text: My sister and I have just returned from our fourth visit to this hotel. The hotel may need a little updating around the pool area but everything is clean and tidy. The staff are friendly and helpful apart from one lady in the palace royale cafe!!! We had a pool room and it was quiet and comfortable with clean sheets and pillowcases daily. Breakfast is adequate and has everything needed to set you up for the day. The hotel is in a good central location near a variety of shops anf restaurants (though the hotels own resturant is well worth a visit). The seafront is approx half a minutes walk away. i wish Costas and his staff a good summer and have already re-booked for next June!!!

author: blondielala
title: never again
text: This was the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. Our room was very gloomy and the balcony was never in the sun. The bathroom was in serious need of updating, the grout all needed renewing and there was a chip in the wash basin. The food was very unsatisfactory. On the menu was "a varied selection of desserts." - Every day it was 1 portion of cake, red jelly, orange blancmange-like concoction and fruit salad which always comprised apple, orange and red grapefruit. The meat dishes were really horribly unappetising; on 2 occasions I had a complete slice of pure fat covered in glutenous sauce. This was supposed to be gammon. The reaction of the rep - Mercury Direct - was that "everyone likes different things." When I said I didn't think anyone would want to chew on pure fat, she said that her husband would.The staff in the restaurant were extremely unfriendly and didn't even respond to a smile and "Good morning" from guests. We had no contact with other members of the hotel staff. The only good point about the hotel is its location, within easy reach of the promenade facilities.

author: 186338sunseekerJon
title: Clean, friendly and amazing location
text: This was not the hotel I had wanted to book but my preferred choice was full when I came to book. I was worried about this hotel by some of the reviews but if I was going back to Paphos, I wouldn't entertain staying anywhere else. Yes there are some things which could do with a bit of tlc like some of the shutters and not a great selection of channels on tv in the rooms. But the rooms were very clean every day (which I think is the most important thing - couldn't stand having to stay in something that felt grubby), some of the staff were incredibly friendly, more than anywhere I have ever stayed, guests were also very friendly to each other and there was a very good atmosphere in the hotel. The breakfast was great (I was on b&b). The location was second only to the Annabelle (which is actually right next door but is directly on the beach and costs about 3 times as much). Because the location is so central, beware of being given a room right at the back where there can be a lot of noise from one of the nightclubs. Excellent value, very clean, good atmosphere and very welcoming.

author: jellyCheshire
title: medium budget recommended
text: Just returned from Dionysos. Excellent location for harbour, bars, restaurants and shops. Superior room recommended with tea/coffee making facilities, fridge, air con, T.V. and safety deposit box. Breakfast served too early for us but we went once and there was a varied and tasty selection. Polite staff and no hassle. Some night noise from surrounding bars but excellent double glazing! Daily maid service. Good evening meals.

author: lm1Barnsley
title: Very friendly staff
text: Booked here through TravelRepublic (who I would not recommend). The hotel is a reasonable quality 3 star with good sized rooms. It is very centrally located in Pahpos and so very convenient for all the major sites as well as for taxis and buses. We got rooms as asked for to suit my mother and the staff throughout our stay were helpful and friendly - whatever their nationality. They have showers available for people to use on their departure day and a large comfortable lounge area to wait in. Being in the centre it is naturally noiser than the outskirts as there is a disco nearby - more audible from some rooms than others - it wasn't too bad as it stopped at 2am prompt. The worst thing about the hotel is the coffee in the morning - not good otherwise the buffet breakfast is reasonable to good. We would happily recommend the hotel

author: sasherwani
title: Best location in Paphos.
text: The best part about this hotel is its amazing location. Right in the heart of Paphos; at the harbor. It's surrounded by tons of restaurants and bars. I suggest you rent a quadbike while you stay here and ride all around the city. Apart from the location, the hotel is just alright. I would give it a 3.5 star for its cleanliness and ambience. The location is a definite 5 star. They serve free breakfast in the morning and its really good.

author: susie50-uk
title: Great Staff, a good value basic hotel.
text: The hotel is well placed, making exploring the town and harbour a pleasure. While the rooms were quite basic and a little on the small side they were clean and comfortable. What made the stay for us was how good the staff were, dealing with queries, questions and requests readily, with a smile and a good humour. We would certainly go back and recommend it to other people. It represents good value for money - but it's not luxurious. The breakfast buffet was basic but with a reasonable selection and choice of food. We were there on a B&B basis and so can't comment on other meals. One thing I would highly recommend is taking a cab up into the old town to have dinner. We did this every night but 2 and had wonderful local food at literally half the price of similar meals we ate in the ' tourist' area around the harbour. Particularly good places are Fettas Taverna and the Mezze House which are more of less opposite each other.

author: kungfu45
title: Suits the brits in the sun
text: The hotel is in need of a refurb, the rooms are tired. But as you are only sleeping you should overlook this minor issue, the rooms are cleaned daily the staff are helpful, unless you ask for a wakeup call, (asked for on mon for tues and received on thurs) Prior to arrival, it would pay to contact hotel direct to ask for a quiet room, as some of the rooms could be noisy. I did this myself and manager of hotel responed quickly and room was in a very quiet area of hotel. The breakfasts are Ok, make sure up early though, tables cleared bang on 9.30am. The other resturants attached to hotel sell basic standard brits in the sun fair, no real local food, will suit most people as they don't have to think. Pool is ok, bar prices are high but is generally in line with all bars in Paphos. In summary, if you like to go to the sun but don't like being too far removed from British creature comforts, don't mind a hotel thats a little old fashioned that serves standard holiday food, this place is for you. You will not see the real cyprus staying here, but you will get a good tan.

author: MX19
title: super location
text: I have just returned from a week at the Dionysos on a bed and breakfast basis. The parts of the hotel I saw have had a refurb since my last stay a few years ago and everywhere was clean and most things worked. The buffet breakfast had an excellent selection and tables were always cleared promptly. The outside areas were very pleasant but the pool water was quite murky and there was debris in the bottom. I stayed in 212 which was over the kitchen so quite noisy and no view apart from tree branches and a flat roof. The wooden shutters needed to be closed at night to limit the noise from the cafes and bars which went on until 3am some nights. Marble tiled floors in the rooms also added to the noise level although corridors were carpeted. The bed was clean and comfortable and the bath water was always hot and plentiful. The room was cleaned daily. Good value for the price and central location.

author: Cranholme
title: Cyprus experience
text: We have just returned from a two week stay here, and overall were quite happy with the hotel. Normally we would have stayed at one of the quieter places away from the town but, due to health reasons, I needed not to have to walk too far. After reading some reviews just before we left for Cyprus, I was very apprehensive, as we are used to self-catering in very good accommodation. While it was obvious that the hotel could do with a paint job, it is the end of the season, and we were happy with the cleanliness of the room we were allocated. The staff were all very friendly and helpful. During the high season the room would have been extremely noisy as it overlooked the discos and bars, but we were never kept awake , even though there was still a lot of music being played until the early hours. We did wish we had booked bed and breakfast instead of half-board. The breakfasts were fine - plenty of choice, but the evening meals were not up to the standard of Greek restaurants we have visited in other places. Overall, although we will not go back, we were reasonably satisfied with the hotel.

author: RickandIlsa
title: Avoid the disco wing
text: Right in the town centre. The positives were friendly, helpful staff, many from Eastern Europe; good breakfast buffet; clean and tidy; handy for the Café Royale, by far and away the best watering hole in Paphos for the 50-somethings. An excellent Indian restaurant 50 metres away. The negatives concern the position. One wing juts into the night-club and diso heartland of Paphos; if you are really unlucky on room allocation you will find yourself 20 metres away from three bar/discos pumping out music at 120dbs until the small hours. You won't sleep much, but you will become an expert at 'Name that Tune'. The problem is compounded by underpowered airconditioning forcing a nasty choice between sleep deprivation by noise (windows open) or heat (windows closed). The offending rooms start with the numbers 5 and 6 and are to be avoided.

author: Bernadine70
title: GOOD CHOICE OF A CENTRAL HOTEL
text: We were delighted with our choice of hotel. We had a corner room on the second floor and had three different views from the windows. Really nice to watch the Kafky head statue from the window. We loved the modern style of the room, enormous with minimal furniture, but everything you need. The bed was huge with decent linen and pillows. The bathroom was beautiful,with a modern bath tub and our most important feature in an hotel, a separate huge powerful shower. Everything in this hotel is clean, new and modern. The breakfasts in the restaurant attached to the hotel were very good and the coffee was too. The location is perfect, you are able to get everywhere on foot, and it also has a metro on the last floor of the shopping centre directly opposite the hotel. We highly recommend staying at this hotel

author: I802IGstefanov
title: Woundeful
text: Woundeful boutique hotel in the center of town. Super location easy to access to all the town. My room was a bit smaller but ok for a single person. Room are clean and comfortable. Service from the staff are really good. Breakfast in closer restaurant offer you a right selection of choice. Price right for the offer. Very recommend!

author: Mbmcl1
title: Hidden Gem
text: We loved the staff, Timur in particular was so friendly and knowledgeable. He made sure to inform of us of all the key spots we should visit when he warmly welcomed us to the hotel. Anytime you passed the desks staff always made sure to say hello. The hotel itself is very clean and has lovely modern rooms. Our room had a balcony and bath and these really made our stay. Breakfast at the hotel is served right up ro 10.30am, the breakfast itself is very good especially the scrambled eggs. This hotel's location is second to none. We did not have to use transport once with our longest walk being around 25mins to Lazne na Lodi but with so much to see on the way we did not notice. Even though the hotel is in a suberb location it is down a little side street so it is nice and quiet at night. We would most definitely stay here again.

author: Tomas_sthlm
title: Lovely hotel
text: Me and my partner spent Christmas holidays, 4 days in total, in this beautiful little hotel. Placed very centrally, you can basically walk to most of the main tourist attractions. We took tram only to the castle. Metro and tram stations are just minutes away. Hotel itself is newly renovated, very clean and welcoming. We stayed in the corner room overlooking small square with Franz Kafka statue. Room itself was big, really nicely decorated, with super comfy bed. Staff helpful, speaking good english. Breakfast was served in the adjacent restaurant LOVE IT and was quite good with decent choice of hot and cold food. And some amazing cakes :) I'd highly recommend the hotel, and would stay there again.

author: janiewi
title: Christmas Market short break
text: Excellent location. Walking distance of Old Town and Wenceslas Sq. Great meal in restaurant opposite. First visit to Prague, I'd stay here again. Excellent staff, although room wasn't serviced on my second night and airport chauffeur service, driver was terrible. Drove dangerously fast. We did the 'hop on off' bus and although problematic finding the stops (as they aren't marked) and service was mediocre, I'm glad we did it. Oh and hunt out Lennons Wall. It was quite cool!

author: 22suzannel
title: Excellent
text: We have a excellent stay in Hotel Golden Crown. Good place to discover Prague. Perfect location. A 15 minutes walk to the train station and from there we take the bus to the airport. Excellent building. Nice rooms with perfect beds. The breakfast in restaurant love it was very good. A lot of choices and very friendly staff. Also the reception staff was very friendly and helpfull. We come back again.

author: 19prakashp
title: Crown Of Prague
text: We were on a Europe Tour and this was the last hotel we stayed on the trip and it turned out to be the Best one. The staff is courteous and very helpful & the best thing here was the 24/7 reception. Room was clean & had good lighting. And the bathroom was very spacious. Well located & walkable distance from Old Town / Charles Bridge / City Centre. Very close to public transport stops & Uber cabs. (Not good to travel by the Yellow Cabs.
