They charge anything ) Overall a great experience staying here.

author: MarcAaron12
title: Lovely stay at the Golden Crown
text: We booked a standard double for 3 nights in July 2018 at the Golden Crown, Prague. The room was small but well equipped and kept very clean. Nice to have teas and coffee in the room (which you can sometimes struggle to get). The bathroom had a large shower with a drencher head that had excellent water pressure and temperature. The supplied toiletries were all of a good standard and replenished daily. The hotel staff were very friendly and efficient. We only had breakfast there, overall there was a decent selection of food and drinks, however the hot food was a bit lacking in vegetarian/vegan options, basically beans. There could have been included mushrooms, hash browns or a vegetarian sausage to widen the choice and be a bit more inclusive. The location felt very central, really close to the Narodni Trida tram and metro stops, a small shopping mall (with atm machines) across the street and restaurants close by. If coming back to Prague we'd definitely consider booking again.

author: dalcat68
title: Perfect hotel
text: Hotel Golden Crown was a great choice for my daughter and I during our three days in Prague. It is close to the metro as well as the trolley cars so acclimating to public transportation was very easy! The staff was extremely helpful and friendly, from the desk clerks to the doorman to the waitressing staff in the breakfast room. The rooms were small(as most European rooms are) but extremely clean and comfortable. It had the best shower which was much appreciated after a long day of sightseeing. The buffet breakfast in the morning was expansive with many different options to fit many different tastes. The made to order coffee selection was a perfect start to early morning. I highly recommend this quintessential European hotel if you are visiting Prague. We will definitely stay there again if our travels bring us back to the Czech Republic.

author: JJDB1400
title: Very Nice!
text: We booked the corner balcony room and weren’t disappointed! The room was huge with king bed and large windows. Also had a clean modern bathroom with hair dryer. Location is great. 10 min walk to main square. Across the street is a large building with shopping and food court. There is a small laundromat about 10 doors down. Also a pub with good food. Staff was friendly, and breakfast had a good variety.

author: jennchiu
title: LOVED THIS HOTEL!
text: Great location. Staff excellent. Rooms are HUGE compared to most EU hotels at this price. We booked the room including breakfast but we didn't think it was worth it. Mostly cold breakfast and we barely ate any of it. You could easily walk half a block to a much better breakfast cafe. There is a mall directly across the hotel, literally steps away with cafes, grocery store, shopping and anything else you would need! Would definitely stay again....without the breakfast. :)

author: yaelshapira
title: Excellent location but ....
text: The hotel is situated in a perfect location. Walking distance from all the important places including a mall just infront and metro station in it. The hotel is quite new. The staff are very friendly and available but the room need some improvements. We received an under the roof room which was big but there was a window in the ceiling not fully cover and therefore we suffered from the sun light very early in the morning. Another issue was the bathroom. Open bath, no shower, built in a way that everything gets wet when you take one. Breakfast was very nice. Great coffee

author: cityofgentlemen
title: Very Special Birthday
text: It was my girlfriend's birthday and I wanted to make it extremely special for her. Since I live in America and she lives in Norway, meeting up is always an adventure. Prior to our arrival, the hotel emailed me asking if there was any special occasion as to why I was visiting Prague. I explained to them the above reasons and they stated they would have champagne and balloons ready for her and if I could think of anything else then they'd help arrange it. I arrived a day earlier than her so I also picked up some flowers. I asked the front desk if they could arrange the flowers along with everything else at a certain time while we were away at dinner so she'd be surprised when we arrived back at the room. Of course she was floored when she saw everything that had been arranged. So kudos to Golden Crown for going above and beyond.

author: LEY12345
title: Very Good
text: The bedroom and bath were very nice and large. Great tub. However there was a sewer type smell in the bathroom. Parts of the bedroom curtains were coming off there hinges at top. It is a nice location if you want to be away from Old Town but close. It does not have the charm of Old Town at all though. It is across from the Kafka Head which is interesting and a shopping mall if you like that. Breakfast is good in a basement room with no windows if you don't mind that.

author: 587carls
title: City break to Prague
text: We decided to book a last minute city break and chose to go back to the beautiful city of Prague. Found the Golden Crown through Expedia and found it to be perfect for our visit. The room was spacious, with excellent en-suite facilities and very comfortable double bed. We had booked breakfast and was pleased with the variety and quality. The staff were very courteous and helpful. The hotel is in lovely condition and is still in the process of some refurbishment, which was not an inconvenience. All in all, a Hotel in a perfect location, within walking distance of most of the city. Also there’s an amazing moving statue of Franz Kafka just in front of the hotel that is mesmerising...

author: samsammillar
title: Fantastic
text: We stayed 2 nights in this hotel. For the price we paid for flights and hotel together we werent expecting much. However, i cannot fault anything! Service was great, helpful and friendly staff. Room was clean and modern. Comfortable bed and great shower! Location was good. Close to bars and restaurants and some shopping too. Would recommend.

author: denizrenk77
title: Perfect for business trip
text: I have stayed 2 nights at this hotel during my business trip to Prague, and I will definitely pick this hotel for my next stay. Never before my expectations were met 100 % in any other hotel in Czech Republic. Room was spotless, great design, very quite and with a comfortable bed - all you need after a busy conference day. Good breakfast with a decent variety of food. Brilliant personnel, helpful and smiley, very welcoming! This is the way the hotels should work. To sum up, I would highly recommend this hotel to everyone and have already recommended to my friends. Thank you for making my stay so comfortable!

author: Devillavy
title: Beautiful hotel
text: I was most impressed by the style of this hotel. Reception area was very welcoming and staff was very friendly. Hotel is located right in front of a small mall, with supermarket open til late night and with metro station in the basement! Old town, Wencesles square, river all within short walking distance. Room was very spacious, high ceiling was especially impressive. Clean and modern, cant say enough good thing about this hotel. Breakfast was almost good, they tried to serve different fruits everyday. All in all highly recommended, I would definitely stay in this hotel again when back to PRG for business trip.

author: manshaus
title: Perfect
text: My wife and stayed four nights at hotel Golden Crown. It was an utmost pleasure from the start to the end. It is a total professional hotel all over. Among the items I would like to mentioned the very warm welcome from the personell at the reception, the result of the cleaning work and the standard of the breakfast. Unfortunately the neighbour next door had construction work going on. It sometimes include some noise at daytime. Without any complains the hotel offer us free transportation to the airport. Perfect!

author: Antje07
title: New and high standard hotel
text: We spent 4 nights at the Golden Crown hotel in Prague. We had a beautiful and spacious roof top room. Everything is very new. Very good bed! Nice and helpful staff. Breakfast is good, you have everything you need, even espresso coffee! The hotel is very well located, next to metro, tram and a shopping centre. It is in between the old and new town, everything on walking distance. We enjoyed our stay and would take this hotel afpgain when we go back to Prague.

author: David_Ro
title: Excellent Room, Good Breakfast, Good location just away from the crowds
text: My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights. Our room, 202, faced West and overlooked the square and an intriguing revolving statue of a mans head. The room was very spacious with adequate facilities for clothes and cases. The bathroom was modern, large and spotless. It is about a 10 minute level walk to the old town square. This is just far enough away to not be troubled the very large number of visitors to the beautiful city but within easy reach of plenty of places to eat. Breakfast served in the sub basement offered a good selection of fresh produce. Judging by the position that people were sitting many would have preferred not to have had the television on in the breakfast room - it was tuned to BBC World Service. Good Air Con to defeat the heat from the afternoon sun.

author: Vinny227
title: Perfect Hotel for a Prague Vacation
text: This is a very high-class hotel property in an absolutely perfect location. There is a mall right across the courtyard in front of the building (where the Franz Kafka statue is), and the Metro stop is in the lower level of the mall (the stop is Narodni Trida on the B line, which connects to the stop in the lower level of the enormous Palladium mall). On the other side of the mall is a tram stop, and across that street from there you are entering the historic center of Prague. It is a short walk to the astronomical clock, and right between two of the city's main opera houses. My room was one of the smaller rooms on property, yet the floor plan was easily 12x15 feet, with twelve foot ceilings, hardwood floors, natural stone shower and sink, generous closet space, refrigerator, desk, bathrobes, slippers, and tastefully modern decor. The lobby has beautiful white arches with original art deco details intact with splendid gold leafing. In addition to the lovely wrought iron staircase there is also an elevator. Breakfast is served in the lower level of the hotel, and the offerings are very complete, with eggs, coldcuts, cheese, yogurts, breads, pastries, juices and coffe made to your liking. The staff was most helpful, and my stay was simply a pleasure.

author: igor6aro
title: Great overall, simple, quiet and comfortable.
text: The hotel has very experienced Staff and they welcomed us with the best way we could imagine, with a city map/guide and quick all-around update. this hotel just loves to say "yes" to anything you ask them for. perfect. the room was upgraded to one with a balcony with no extra charge. The room itself was nice and tidy, smelling fresh, clean, quiet and well heated. the breakfast was nice with everything you need to start your day, nothing too fancy but just right. the location was great, 1-2 min walk from any Transportation you may need. and the best part is that your 3-4 min away from Wenceslas street/square. if you looking for a quiet place to go back after a long day of walking around in town, this romantic hotel will be a wonderful choice.

author: tsebap
title: Great hotel
text: Excelent hotel. Great breakfast. Super clean near the center all in walking distance. Safe enviroment. Huge bedroom. And cheap. I got a room for 50 usd with breakfast. The staff was super friendly. The transfer that hotel provide to airport is a little bit pricy (27 eu) finally i called an uber and it cost 14 eu to airport

author: w0rkingt0travel
title: Excellent Modern Hotel
text: Fantastic location; 3 minute walk from Wenceslas Square and 12 minutes from Old Town Square. Very quiet but lots of good bars, restaurants and shopping nearby. Rooms are big, beds are very comfortable and excellent modern clean bathroom. Breakfast is pretty good; lots of variety but cooked bits could be hotter, very brown fruit salad and there aren't enough tables at busy times...but for the price you pay, it's very fair. There is no bar at the hotel but there is a minibar in each room. Staff are nice and helpful. We would definitely stay there again. My only tip is not to book concert tickets through the hotel-they are much cheaper if you book them directly.

author: Mags0118
title: Best of Bohemia
text: Just returned from a surprise birthday weekend in Prague. First timers and wasn't sure what to expect. Golden Crown was excellent as a base. Perfect location and wonderful external old style but modern boutique feel inside. We arrived pretty early but staff let us check in early (unusual and very welcome. Funky rooms, very helpful staff an perfect location to wander and explore all of the town centre. Great views and sound proofing was excellent. Nice breakfast but only downside is that the hot food could have been warmer. Great coffee choice. We highly recommend this for a stay.

author: 99kostass
title: a really nice place to stay in Prague.
text: the location is amazing. in a very beatiful plaza (next to the tram station) the hotel is really quiet. very close to the old city, restaurants and sightseeings. the staff is kind and polite with the clients. the breakfast was also good. the bathroom is huge. clean and decent rooms. the mini bar shall be less expensive.

author: christinat869
title: Cozy, Clean, Comfy!
text: Loved this hotel, it was clean, designed very nicely and with friendly staff! Though the hotel is small and has limited amenities, it is located minutes from old town square (perfect location for me), and minutes from tube\metro station! It is a great base in order to explore prague! Breakfast is great with vast variety from cooked english breakfast, to cold hams and cheeses to fresh fruit and croissants! All in all great hotel, value for money, and would def. stay here if ever in prague again! Only minor negative was that there were no english speaking channels on tv, but who cares? Your there to explore a city not to watch tv & wifi links were good so you could watch something online if you really wanted to!

author: Femke_0905
title: Great place to stay in Prague
text: We stayed in a two person room for four days. The room was beautiful and not too small. The service was great. The wifi worked very good. The breakfast was really good, a lot of choice and great service here as well. The location of the hotel is perfect. It is nearby almost everything. We had a great stay!

author: nokyo
title: Great place to stay! Def. will recommend it!
text: We stayed this weekend at the Golden Crown and were fully satisfied. The room had a nice view out to the square with the turning Franz Kafka head. The room itself was clean and spacious. Nice furniture and a great bathroom. All the people from the front desk to the girls at the breakfast, were all very friendly and nice! Breakfast is not huge but really good! The location is great to go around town as everything is nearby. We walked everywhere, even with a baby and babystroller no problem! All in all, a great stay and I will be back!

author: JGP-Barcelona
title: Great stay in Prague
text: The hotel is a nice boutique hotel with big room, even a nice balcony in my room 401. Modern decoration, comfortable bed, big bathroom,... Great location, walking distance to everywhere. Also infron small shopping mall. Friendly staff. I will definately come back and recomend that hotel. Quiet hotel, not big so I like it like this. Much more calm.

author: edwyer4
title: Wonderful experience
text: The location was perfect. My sister and I stayed there for three days before going to Salzburg and again on our way home. The staff was super friendly and helpful and gave us an upgrade on our return trip. Breakfast was wonderful, nice variety and staff in breakfast room were very accommodating and remembered us each day. Always felt very welcome and safe. Would definitely stay there again if I am lucky enough to return to Prague. Rate was perfect for sisters on a budget. We especially appreciated the energy efficiency hall and room lights.

author: 76honesty
title: A perfect place to stay at in Prague
text: We had a great stay during New Years at this lovely hotel. We had a deluxe corner room, which was very spacious and modern and that bathroom was one of the best I’ve experienced at a hotel. Everything was spotless. Wi-Fi at hotel was also working perfectly at all times. Location was great, breakfast was ok, but a bit sad that it seemed like only one person knew how to manage the coffee machine, when she wasn’t there a sign that said out of order were put up… The staff at the front desk were very nice and made our stay perfect. The Italian restaurant across the square was also very nice. About 5-10 minutes walk to the old town, which is a must. Prague is a very beautiful city. Would absolutely stay at the Golden Crown again.

author: scottwY9192OU
title: Awesome hotel in Prague...an absolute must stay!
text: I stayed at this great hotel for two nights while in Prague. The hotel was brand new, super clean and very relaxing. The breakfast was excellent. The staff were extremely helpful and polite. A special thanks goes out to Antonio at the front desk. What an awesome guy, he knew exactly where to send us to have a great time. It was like having my own personal tour guide. The beds were super comfortable, quiet for sleeping and very clean. Next time in Prague I assure you this will be my hotel of choice. Thanks Golden Crown!!

author: claudiadN5713TE
title: Perfect Location!
text: The location of this hotel was 10/10, you're close to the nightlife, all amenities and the top tourist spots eg... charles bridge, old town hall, w.square. Plus the shopping centre is directly opposite! I cannot fault the hotel, my boyfriend and i had a standard room with a huge double bed, bizarrely they had put out two single duvets (he didnt mind as im a sheet hogger) Our bathroom was perfect sized with a modern and clean feel to it, the shower was easy to use and powerful! We were both impressed with breakfast, its their take on a full english! They also had options of different cereals, pastries, continental meats etc... The staff were so kind also!! Someone was always available to talk to! There was no problem with leaving our luggage downstairs whilst we walked round the city one last time after we'd checked out!! Just a heads up about the aircon in the rooms, they are all fine and dandy however every morning when my partner and i woke up we were bunged up and had a soar throat, not too sure why...

author: alonam981
title: very good hotel in the center of Prague
text: We stayed in the hotel 4 days. It's very nice hotel in the center of Prague. 5-15 minutes from all places.We didn't use the metro. We had very good room all included+ very nice design of the room.Nice to wake up in this hotel and to have a breakfast like it. It's very clear hotel. The hotel is situated in Mustek station(metro) and near the mall. The stuff helped us in all situations. I wish to everybody visit it!

author: BarboraA
title: Very nice hotel BUT housekeeping is the worst
text: The only reason I give this nice new hotel 1* is that the housekeeping does NOT do the job! I hope some one from the hotel will read this, because if the manager or someone responsible do not take action, the hotel will go down big time! The floor in the room is constantly dirty, never cleaned. I stayed for 5days so I know it wasnt just coincidenve. The tabs in the bathroom always dirty, and because of this the corners in the bathroom are beginning to grow mold! I stayed one more before for two nights and the housekeeping was very bad, but this time you could see how will it ruin the very very nice hotel. On the other had this hotel is very nice, nicely decorated, kind staff, perfect location. Breakfast needs some more improvement. Do not let this hotel to die in mold and dirt. All the best.

author: Monc444
title: Lovely hotel with great value for the money!
text: I had a room on the forth floor with a small balcony, just wished I was there in a time when I could used it more than December. Great location just opposit the Kafka statue, a short walk from Old town. Very good breakfast with a good selection, easy and efficient check in and out, no problem to store the luggage, so a plus for the staff as well. No bar or restuarant in the hotel, but that's not a problem for me, plenty of that in the area. Had good nights sleep in the comfortable bed and a very nice and well decorated room with a huge and fantastic bathroom! Only problem was that the internet turned out to be a bit slow, couldn't download or send any emails during my stay, always timedout,when while logging in on any restaurant at town it all came through.Wifi was working well otherwise though, to use facebook, instagram, tripadvisor etc worked perfectly. Easy to walk to all sights, so I never needed to use public transport. Overall a hotel with a luxurious feeling for a very reasonable price, would definetly consider staying here again if/when I go back to see more of this lovely city,

author: YouriD24
title: nice hotel with good location
text: A pleasant hotel. Polite staff. Tasty, but a bit monotonous Breakfast buffet. Good comfortable rooms. The hotel is located close to the metro and super close to major attractions. The rooms are fairly quiet, with high ceilings. Design stylish. Drawback - washbasin in the form of a stone well. Better to take rooms with view on the head of Kafka.

author: Toscana-frelst
title: Nice and central hotel in Prague
text: We booked a deluxe room at this hotel first weekend in December 2015. The room was really nice, must be more than 4 meters to the roof. Interior new and fresh, however a strange smell in the bathroom (room 103) - like rotten cabbage. But - the hotel was centrally located in front of the "Turning Head" (Kafka?) and Quadrio Shoppingcenter, and perhaps 4-500 meters to the center of town with clock tower, Tyn church etc. Breakfast ok, in the basement of the hotel. Will absolutely recommend this hotel, without the smell in the bathroom I would have given a 5star. Receptionist very helpful, Englishspeaking. Good idea to use CKroner 700 for at shuttle from and to the airport as the hotel suggested. Would absolutely come back to this hotel in this quiet area again. Do not be afraid if you look up this address on Google Maps - Things are really different in 2015 :-)

author: PortyAL
title: Great hotel in a great location.
text: We stayed 3 nights in the Golden Crown Hotel in a Superior room and could find no fault whatsoever. The room was spacious, modern and very clean, as was the bathroom. Tea / coffee making facilities were provided and there was also a minibar which could double up as fridge. The hotel has free wifi and we got a strong signal in our 3rd floor room. Breakfast was excellent with both hot and cold foods. The hotel is ideally located in the centre of the city directly opposite a shopping centre which includes a 6 floor Tescos! Any staff we met were very helpful and friendly. We would have no problem recommending this hotel as it is one of the best we have stayed in.

author: sarahnN3342HA
title: perfect christmas city break
text: We arrived to the hotel at 10am which was too early to check in but the lovely receptionest gave us a map and showed us all the local attractions and took our bags. The room was spotless. We had a room in the loft it was beautiful. We could control how light/ dark the room was. We even got our own dressing gowns. The hotel is right in the city centre. We had to only walk for 10 minutes and we was in the old town square. If we are ever in prague again we will definately return.

author: nancye558
title: Sistas traveling by the seat of your pants.
text: Thank You Rick Steves for recommending this hotel. All was perfect from the room to the breakfast/lunch provided. We stayed two nights at the start of our journey and the last two nights also. The staff also was so helpful from calling a taxi for us when needed and great advice and directions around your beautiful city. Your city is so clean. Take note USA. We thank all at The Golden Crown Hotel. Nancy and Liz

author: 866hanaj
title: Excellent hotel choice!
text: My daughter and me just got back from a 5 days stay in the Golden Crown Hotel (end of September 2015). It was a great experience! The location is just superb - walking distance of just everything, but slightly out of the hassle and bussle. The hotel itself is gorgeous. An old building that has being refurbished in such a tasteful manner, of modern and old. Rooms are comfortable, beautiful and well equipped. The staff is very welcoming, very helpful, they surely went out of their way to accommodate us with a late check out. Breakfast is very nice... In other words I highly recommend staying in the Golden Crown Hotel!!

author: 516hilak
title: Excellent hotel!!! Great location!!
text: Visited the hotel for a week! Very modern hotel , great breakfast ! Very Clean! The location is supper. I had very good time! The stuff are very helpful! And I'm very happy that my friends are gonna visit there next month! Thank you golden crown!

author: lyadz
title: A great place to stay
text: Stayed there with my wife for 3 nights. The hotel is relatively new and it shows. The hotel is very clean, modern with great atmosphere. Our room was very comfortable and contained everything we needed. Breakfast was excellent although the buffet was a bit small. Unlike other places that put a coffee machine, this hotel provides fresh espresso and cappuccino so you can start your day happy :) The location is also great, near the old city, a walking distance from every touristic spot. There are both metro and tram stations near the hotel which make travelling the city real easy. My only complaint is that when breakfast started - we could smell it. In sum, this is a really nice hotel with great location.

author: 277aleksandral
title: Nice hotel at good location.
text: We stayed at Golden Crown for 5 days. It was very nice room with modern bathroom. Very clean, big and comfy beds, air condition which was the best thing ever. Very good breakfast with sweet and salty things, big choice. Friendly staff. Located in quiet area but still in coty center. Close to everything, shopping center with Tesco on the other side of street. We paid ~350 euro for superior room with reservation made 2 months before. Would visit again.

author: youleeah
title: Beautiful boutique hotel with great location
text: I would definitely recommend this hotel! The location is perfect for strolliing around in the city (Narhodny Street, Jungmann Sq, and Wazlaw Sq are only a few minutes away). Rooms are very modern, clean and rather big for a down town hotel, high ceilings, cool bath rooms. 3 rooms offer a tiny balcony > ask for them if you like opening the balcony door when coming "home". Staff is very helpful if you write them an email. The reception staff is not very friendly but seems to be normal in Prague. Breakfast room is small but bright, clean and offers what you need for a healthy, good breakfast. I appreciated a lot the entrance to the lobby - it smelled of the fresh lilys on the lobby table :-)

author: 119patrickf
title: Clean, modern decor in a traditional building
text: Stayed at the Golden Crown for 5 nights in April 2015. The room was modern, stylish and very well equipped, as was the bathroom. The place was very clean and well maintained. There was a buffet breakfast each morning in the basement. This was well stocked with good quality food and a reasonably good variety. The location is very quiet but yet only a short walk from all the main attractions. There is no bar or restaurant in the hotel so this makes it ideal for those who want a quiet stay. It's straight across the road from a large shopping mall.

author: 512kristinaf
title: Chique new hotel with high potential, but lot of work to do
text: Chique new hotel with excellent location, short walking distance to the absolute city center, metro station, shopping center and restaurants. The rooms are quiet, of good size and very trendy. If you are into the modern, clear and tasteful decor, this hotel has definitely a lot to offer. The breakfast is very good, offering a wide selection. What the hotel would definitely need to improve is the staff, especially their proactive interest in guests ´ needs and wishes, promptness of reaction and communication (both at the front desk and at the breakfast). There was a heavy drainage smell on the lower level rooms. Though the staff offered to check it, no solution/remedy was offered. Just a detail, the hotel does not sell public transportation tickets, which is a pitty. So overall, perfect location, chique hotel, great potential, but there is a long way to go to be excellent.

author: Ameryh11
title: Classy spot...will return
text: Before we travelled to Prague...we booked this hotel and then after didn't find reviews. Instant worry came upon us.and was it all for nothing. We got off the plane and a lovely girl at tourist information directed.us.to the number 100 bus To town where then we got metro on yellow line 10 stops to Mustek. From there the hotel is down a Lane way. No distance from the main streets...Wescelas Square and old town square are a very short walk away. On arrival..We were met by a very nice gentleman who was accommodating and informative. The room was v big....large bed...air con....minibar and all usual mod cons...and then a bath robe added for extra comfort. Of hotels I have stayed in...and for value for money...we were very Impressed. Would recommend this new boutique hotel to anyone

author: Q4955FPmarias
title: Great location right on the beach
text: Libertalia is a beautiful and well maintained hotel/lodge with excellent bungalows located right on the beach. Good breakfast, but limited menue options for lunch and dinner. Very nice and super-helpful staff. There is a lovely infinity pool, too. Excellent whale watching tours are arranged from the hotel in cooperation with the Ceta Mada organization. The only negative here are the uncomfortable beds. For some reason, matresses are covered with thick plastic, which is noisy and quite unpleasant to sleep on. With more comfortable sleep, this would definitely be a five-star place.

author: jonik172
title: Heaven On Earth
text: We loved our visit to this island and the hotel staff was extraordinarily gracious and helpful. Take the excursion to see the natural pool (a wild wave wonderful bay) at the north of the island. Our guide, Augustino, was lively and fun. We also rented bikes and rode for miles in the rain....we loved every minute and every smiling face along the way! The hotel is like a slice of heaven and we didn't mind the loss of water and electricity for a few hours each morning. The infinity pool and boardwalk to the rock island more than made up for that slight inconvenience. The rooms are clean and simple and the views are startling! I highly recommend staying here.

author: crabsallover
title: Wished we could have stayed longer - will have to return!
text: Our visit was shorter than expected due to cancelled flight from Tana but was still excellent. Huge room with very large bathroom and a safe right on the seafront and we loved having visits from the 2 local cats. The jetty leads to a little island and is a great place to relax and read. The sunset views from the restaurant are amazing and great food and music. Staff are very efficient and friendly. We had initially been disappointed as by arriving a day late we missed the chance to go whale watching - one of the reasons for going to the island - but the staff pulled out all the stops and managed to find us places on another trip which was INCREDIBLE, an absolute must if you get the chance and there at the right time. Also walk to the Pirates Cemetery just down the road and don't be persuaded to have a guide, far better to do it on your own and cheaper. There was a local disco one night which played music into the wee hours but fortunately not too close to cause major problems.

author: X9151KIcristinad
title: Great place to stay
text: We stayed at Libertalia for 3 nights and we regret not having more time to spend there. They have very nice and clean bungalows, whith a great view of the ocean. They have an infinity pool and a deck which goes out to the rock. They have sunbeds, hammocks and swings. The staff is very nice and more professional than in other places, they offer their help with places you can visit and ordering tuktuks or taxis. All the drinks and the food we had at their restaurant were very good. They can offer you beach towels and snorkeling equipment and they have a souvenir shop. Be sure to also visit Ile Aux Nattes for a few hours, the beach is amazing!

author: oodle1
title: Gorgeous beach front property
text: We had a lovely time for 6 days at Libertalia. The rooms were located right on the beach, service was good. The staff were very very helpful and sweet. Whale watching for us was ok. It was quite cold, rainy and windy but we did see whales. We saw great whale watching right from the restaurant! I would definitely recommend this hotel. Also when our air Madagascar flight was cancelled they were very helpful and actually bumped us up to a villa for the extra day we had to stay.

author: adig67
title: Winter in Madagascar
text: The best place I stayed in Madagascar. The bungalows are very nice, built using palm leaves and are very cozy with nice architecture. Food was excellent and you can easily find other nice restaurant in the area (Bord d'Eau). Try the house massage! It's awesome! The room maids are very good, arranging the bed twice a day (for the mosquito network). Not too many international drinks (I couldn't drink Campari). Very nice girls speaking English. Friendly and client oriented.

author: Verohanta
title: Libertalia the cherry on the cake (Sainte-Marie Island)
text: Time to unwind and to feel "elsewhere" yet stil "here" (thanks to WiFi 24/7 @ Libetatlia) - Rooms or more of bungalows all facing the sea. Hotel very cleaned and well maintained. Martine & Didier are going out of their ways to make one's stay as pleasant as possible ! Food is very good. Gourmet type of serving ! Massage is excellent after a day trip around the island. Trips are advised and suggested by Didier. Everyone made an effort to speak English to my friends who came along with us ! - Sainte-Marie itself is a little paradise tucked away, best place to unwind from "Civilisation" ...

author: ConnieS230
title: Luxury relaxation!
text: We stayed 2 nights at Hotel Libertalia, and enjoyed every minute! Sophie, the manager, was so excited that our bungalow had just been remdeled and enlarged for the 3 of us. They finished the morning of our arrival. The restaurant meals were superb, as was the rum punch! I took a rest in the hammock right on the beach. We swam in the ocean near the small island at the end of the pier. We took a pirogue to Ille Aux Nattes, an even tinier island, where we were treated to fresh coconut by an islander. We went whale watching. We relaxed! It was difficult to leave, but we had more Malagasy adventures awaiting!

author: KaiWindhoek
title: Good hotel, busy location in St Marie
text: The hotel was good, rooms were clean and comfortable with a nice view on the ocean, good swimming and snorkeling and excellent french food. For those tourists that aren't french speaking language may be an issue. Sophie the manager speaks reasonable English, but neither the owner nor most of the staff understands or speaks even a small amount of English. Sophie was very helpful and friendly and assisted with all our bookings for day excursions. The idyllic pictures of the place however belies the fact that there is a busy road right behind the hotel which interferes with peace and quiet and especially long afternoon naps. The road quits down in the evenings so night time sleeping is fine. Also since the hotel is so close to the main town one should not expect long idyllic deserted beaches to walk on since it is in a very populated area. This is however an advantage in terms of being close to amenities and getting transport easily to popular destinations on the island. For more remote and peaceful locations on the island rather find a place on the east coast or the north or on Illegal au Natte.

author: 765danh
title: A great stay in a beautiful place
text: This hotel/bungalow complex on the beautiful Ile Sainte Marie was a highlight of our trip. The bungalows are all of a good standard and right by the ocean, you can hear the sea lapping against the shore as you fall asleep. The hotel dining is excellent with a large breakfast and half board option. The menu changes daily with excellent local dishes at reasonable prices. Libertalia organises whale watching trips several times a week, with an excellent chance of seeing these magnificent creatures. They occasionally even approach the shore. The hotel puts on a whale briefing on the evening before the trip which is fun and interactive. Our hosts could not do enough for us, and we would recommend this to absolutely anybody

author: SanuCookie
title: Beautiful location, excellent value and outstanding hospitality!
text: Our stay at the Hotel Libertalia (late May, early June 2013) was wonderful. The bungalows are clean, well appointed and safe. The food was quite good and the restaurant has a very cozy atmosphere. All of the staff were very helpful and friendly and we had little trouble bridging the language gap. Can't say enough about how wonderful Sophie was! She provided information and advice when we initially booked our three night stay, kept in contact via email to help us deal with logistics prior to our arrival and made tour arrangements while we were there. There is plenty to see and do on the island and everything is within walking distance or a short tuktuk ride away. Highly recommend visiting the island and staying at the Hotel Libertalia. An excellent value and an all around fun place to stay.

author: traceys647
title: You will never want to leave!
text: As I'm writing this we are actually sat in front of the most beautiful ocean view waiting for our last meal of our stay at Hotel Libertalia. When you book half board you expect the typical buffet choice changing every day, however, this is certainly NOT the case here. We have sampled everything from lobster to crab to delicious Zebu steak! The food here is honestly the finest we have ever had and we have travelled and eaten in many different places! Sainte Marie and Madagascar is a gem of a place to find adventure, relaxation and wonderful weather and this hotel just made the whole trip perfect. The rooms/bungalows are perfectly sized with a great big hot (or cold if you wish) and powerful shower. The seaview from every bungalow is amazing especially at sunset. Entertainment is provided on some nights which really captures the traditions and spirit of this wonderful island. The service is unlike anything else in the world, Even with minimal to no french, the staff were on hand to answer every question we had and helped make our short stay magnifique!

author: adamw279
title: Great restaurant and great relaxing place to hang out!
text: So, we didn't actually get a chance to stay here. But we came for the restaurant. The food was excellent and well-priced for Sainte Marie and the staff were super friendly. The area for hanging out near the hotel was spectacular! There were loads of comfortable beach chairs, hammocks, swings for kids... a great atmosphere! The little rock island bridge and deck was also fun to visit and would be a great place to relax, for the hotel's visitors. Though we didn't see inside any of the rooms, we could see this would really be an ideal place to stay at Ile Sainte Marie.

author: WanderingWillow
title: A lovely place to lounge...
text: We stayed at the Libertalia for 5 nights. The manager was great, helpful and welcoming. The bungalows were lovely, the lounge/dining area beautiful and the view pretty. Just for those (like me) that likes to know I'm in the nicest place on an island - I was a little disappointed when I showed up and discovered there was a road right behind this place, making it a little noisy in the bungalows - so I explored and discovered that the road runs behind every hotel on the west side and makes them all a little noisy. We rode our bikes around the island and only if you go on the east side (more remote) or up past the main town, do the hotels get off the road. In the balance of things, the location of this hotel (walkable distance to town, near other hotels/restaurants) and the dock that takes you out to beautiful swimming water (all hotels are located on a beach with water that gets very shallow at low tide) makes it near the best on the island. AND, the managers husband is involved in the local precious stone business, working with local people and using all local products, and will design beautiful jewelry on request. I got an amazing green sapphire ring - stunning! I would recommend this place over all others on Isle Sainte-Marie (except maybe the princess Bora which was closed while we were there, so I can't comment) but if you want quiet I recommend Isle aux Nattes.

author: rondabay1227
title: Great stay atthe Hyatt Place Sarasota
text: We really enjoyed our stay there. The staff was professional and pleasant and helpful with suggestion regarding our questions. The breakfast was very good. Better than those offered at other hotels. The rooms, pool and hotel in general was very clean and had a modern look and feel to it. The location - which is just across the street to the entrance to the airport was great for our purposes. Everywhere we went while in Sarasota was no more than 25 minutes away in a car - even getting to Lido beach or the aquarium. We would definitely stay at this or another Hyatt Place again.

author: Paradise30308946227
title: Terrible
text: Dirty rooms. Poor service. Horrible free breakfast. No pool towels. Incorrect room type. Hair on the sheets and towels. Dirty sinks. Pull out couch contain dirty food. No cleaning service. Worst two nights for a 1 and 3 year old.

author: suewY8878TC
title: Perfect!
text: I stayed here on a getaway trip by myself. Very walkable to the Ringling. Room was very clean. The whole place is quiet and serene even tho it is right across from airport entrance. It's easy to get into and out of. All staff were so friendly and very welcoming. Actually made me personally feel they were glad I was there. Highly recommend this location.

author: Roxie210
title: Don’t stay here for the breakfast!
text: We stayed here during Spring Training. The room was great, but the breakfast was TERRIBLE,! Nothing hot was edible. The eggs were runny and bacon was fatty. Pancakes were previously frozen and too tough to cut. Sure am glad we didn’t pay anything for it because it was worthless! Stayed 4 nights, but only ate breakfast once. There are 2 Sage Biscuits in the area and they are. GREAT!

author: 230juditha
title: Love this hotel!
text: This was our second stay. We love this hotel because it is conveniently located, very clean, very friendly staff, and has 24/7 bar and food service. A pool, jacuzzi and exercice equipment are included. There is free breakfast service, but the hotel is changing its service to Hyatt members only starting November 1, 2019. Just join before going. My only complaint is not about the hotel, but the corporation. When checking in and out the staff seems to needlessly announce our registration was through a third party. I reminded the staff at checkout that if it wasn't for that third party I would not have found their hotel. Thank you Expedia.

author: CapeCodFrank
title: Great hotel ... reasonable rates ... good location
text: Can’t say enough about this hotel, the Hyatt Place. The room layout is fantastic, as it allows me to watch tv at night while not disturbing my wife. The shower is luxurious. Eliminating the never-used tub in favor of a huge shower was a great idea. And the free breakfast, while usually nothing to write home about, wasn’t bad. Fresh fruit, eggs, bacon, toast... all the essentials. We have stayed at three of these on our drive from Cape Cod to Florida, and they have become our road hotel of choice. This hotel is very close to the Ringling Circus Museum, everything you need on Route 41, and a 15 minute drive to downtown.

author: beejust53
title: Great hotel by the airport
text: First let me say, there is no airplane noise, we were worried about that since it’s right across from the airport. We needed a place to stay with our dogs while tenting our house for termites. This place was very pet friendly. A bedroom area with a living room area, very spacious. Pool area very nice. Breakfast is free and plentiful. I’m so glad we found this place, would definitely recommend it. Close to Sarasota without having to pay Sarasota prices.

author: CeeJay000
title: Repeat customer!
text: What I really like about this place is everything! The front desk staff is amazing; professional, friendly, helpful and always there. The availability of free breakfast each money is a HUGE plus for me. And having counter food, snacks, coffee, etc throughout the day is a nice if you don't want to leave the hotel. The rooms are very spacious and comfortable. I couldn't hear any airport traffic. The housekeeping staff is even personable. Although it's not a fancy hotel, it really has a nice feel to it and I prefer to stay here each visit to the area.

author: ChathamMass
title: Spacious and Super Clean
text: Next to the Ringling Museum in North Sarasota and while by the airport, this place is quiet, comfortable and extremely convenient for walks and a relaxing getaway. The food and Starbucks coffee are better than at most of these types of chain hotels. Our room/suite is very large with a separate sitting area. We like it so much that we are staying two extra days. While there are few restaurants nearby, Barnacle Bill’s Seafood Restaurant is pretty good and close by. There are plenty of places to eat within five miles but a number of traffic lights in between so it takes a while to get around. The excellent reviews about this property are well deserved. We highly recommend it!

author: judy2241
title: Ringling Getaway.
text: Spent 2 nights at the hotel. Room was a 2Q beds, second floor. Had a nice big extra sitting area, which the grand daughter took over for her own! The room was clean, and very nice! Only "stand out" thing is that the hallway was freezing! It really woke you up on the stroll to breakfast. Breakfast area was well kept, had fruit, milk, coffee, BACON and eggs, etc. So close to Ringling you could probably just walk. A very nice pool/jacuzzi area out side. Really liked this place.

author: 388edwardt
title: Suburban Phila couple who love Hyatt !!!
text: This is a marvelous gem of a Hyatt Place..... I mean a clear winner of all choices near the Sarasota Airport we only choose to stay here,, We are greeted by warm and terrific faces whatever time of day we check in..... Kat, the front desl MGR is a peach.... Collin the asst GM makes anything happen if you have special needs as i do w 2 artif knees and cannot Hoist to higher profile beds//// That we are top tier status w Hyatt is a bonus as well.. The entire staff is simply marvelous!!! I do suggest you try this Hyatt Place. clean updated, great rooms... you will not ever go wrong ... This is a the diamonf of a Hyatt property !

author: StevenJ57
title: Comfortable and Quiet
text: One of the best hotels I have stayed at near Sarasota Airport. Check in was simple. The staff was helpful, polite and extremely courteous. The room was large and quiet. I did not hear any noise from other rooms or the hallway. Although I do not eat breakfast, there was a very large and really nice continental breakfast with hot and cold food. Checkout was simple. I did express checkout when I received an email.

author: L7827HUjeffc
title: Very nice
text: Enjoyed our stay. Very clean. Typical of most Hyatt Place hotels. Would absolutely stay here again. Having a hideaway bed was nice addition for a teenager to use. My wife used to Jim and found the equipment to be in very nice shape. Poole looked clean and well taken care of. A tad on the smaller side but functional And not a typical of a lot of hotels these days. Very convenient location for travel.

author: BroderickSantiago
title: Very Satisfied!!!
text: My family of 5 recently took a short vacation to Siesta Key and chose this hotel because of a previous great experience with this brand in another city. We were very pleased with this selection. Though the hotel is directly across from the airport, it was very quiet. The rooms were big and very clean. The staff was amazing!!! JT was very patient and extremely helpful and always had a smile on his face. The breakfast was incredible and the location was perfect. Though not on the beach, very short and easy drive to Lido Beach or Siesta Beach. After a long day at the beach it was very nice to take a dip in the heated pool or grab a cocktail from the bar area. I highly recommend giving this hotel serious consideration for your next stay in Sarasota.

author: janice12371
title: Exceptional quality at a good price!
text: Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay at the Hyatt. I am very fussy when it comes to the cleanliness of hotel rooms. Our room could not have been any cleaner than it was. The beds were comfortable and we did not experience any noise from the other guests. The front desk was exceptionally friendly and eager to please. Breakfast is included. It is not made to order but the entrees offered were hot and fresh. There certainly were enough options to satisfy everyone. A short drive to major attractions and the beaches.

author: michrocks
title: Felt like home!
text: Looking for a hotel that didn't break the bank, offered breakfast and convenient to local beaches. We found all of that in a wonderfully peaceful location, as well. It has an outdoor pool and hot tub, which looked inviting but, sadly, we weren't able to take advantage of. The hotel is very clean and well maintained. There were plenty of restaurant choices in the area and it was quite close to the Ringling museums, which were well worth doing when we wanted a day out of the sun. Breakfast offered plenty of choices and was healthy as well. Staff could not have been nicer - kudos to everyone for their very pleasant and helpful attitudes. The only down side to this hotel was while the drive on paper is not that bad to various beaches, the traffic was worse than we expected. Plan to spend a little more time on the road in order to see everything - but know that you'll likely spend a lot more for that convenience elsewhere.

author: m0rganv56
title: Super clean rooms!
text: My friend and I stayed the night after working a wedding. We had the standard 2 queens room. Our room was HUGE! Also, our too was so clean! I almost felt bad un-doing the bed to get in it lol the staff was super nice and extremely accommodating. I didn't get to try the cafe food but it looked delicious! Also, the location is awesome! It's literallly RIGHT ACROSS THE STREET from the airport! Also less than 5 miles from The Mall, The Square, The Shoppes, and The Marketplace at UTC. Wonderful stay!

author: zoeh59
title: Great hotel close to Ringling Collegeof Art + Design
text: We have been staying at the Hyatt Place Sarasota-Bradenton Airport every time we are at Ringling College of Art + Design. We typically visit 3-4 times per year and the hotel is only a mile or two away from the campus. It is also directly across the street from the airport, with a complimentary shuttle. Every stay has been excellent. The rooms are spacious, comfortable, quiet, and a good value. The complimentary breakfast is excellent also, with a variety of foods ( healthy choices I might add). The staff is always very professional and attentive. All in all, a great hotel in Sarasota close to Ringling College of Art + Design and downtown Main Street where there are many lovely shops and restaurants.

author: arukind
title: Consistent Hyatt Place Experience -- wonderful staff!
text: Great place to stay. I have really taken a liking to the Hyatt over this 2 week road trip vacation. Kayla at the check-in desk was so kind and provided top notch customer service. Room was awesome, big, super clean and full of amenities. Quiet and beds are so comfortable. Nice (small) pool area, super breakfast. Nothing but great things to say from the 3 of us. We will be back to the Hyatt.

author: MarieN66
title: Super Comfortable Stay
text: Clean, newly furnished rooms with a great mattress. We stayed one night since we drove down from New Port Richey to visit the Ringling Plaza venues. It's only 1/4 miles away and if you wanted to you could walk. The staff was most polite and accommodating. I would have given it a 5 stars, but the drink we had at the bar was expensive and terrible. My husband ordered a gin and tonic and I had a run and Pepsi; no stirrer or lemon or lime for the drinks. The bartender was curt and robotic about his job. I would stay here again, but no drink from the bar.

author: lgspears
title: Renovations underway
text: Our stay was ok, just know that renovating is going on. This impacted room availability. Our first room smelled like burned rubber masked by perfume. The refrigerator was also loud. Our second room was much better but the sink was clogged the entire time (even though we reported it immediately). This was a recently renovated room so had a slight odor of newness. Not at all bothersome for us, though. Eric was great and most of the staff was friendly. Jeffrey was not.

author: 137christinap
title: Great Place to Tour Sarasota
text: We attended a wedding in Sarasota. This was one of the hotels that had a block of rooms reserved. Being a Hyatt Rewards member, I selected it. So glad I did. The room was very nice. Very comfortable Bed. Great shower. Wonderful complimentary breakfast.

author: travlnewb
title: Incredible value and quality
text: This place is really a gem. Very convenient to the Sarasota airport; literally across the street. Our king room had a huge sectional sofa in a sitting room area with a desk and dry bar. The vanity was sizable and separated from the toilet and shower area, and both were very nice. Bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was plentiful and quite good for a free hotel breakfast. You can even order food from the front desk 24 hours a day! I didn't use the outdoor pool or hot tub but they looked like they would provide a nice chance to relax. I did use the little fitness center which was small but all I needed for a weekend away.

author: 52787John
title: Spring Training
text: For any baseball fan this hotel is excellent, for going to Spring training games with MLB teams. The hotel is four miles north of the Orioles's Ed Smith Stadium in Sarasota, and ten miles south of the Pirates's Lecom Stadium in Bradenton. It is one mile south of the Sarasota/Bradenton Airport, about four miles east of the beaches, and two miles west of the mall and shopping centers. The hotel was clean,comfortable and their staff was always pleasant and helpful. They had a free breakfast, hot, not just cereal and juice. The offering were different very morning. Parking was free, you are close to all the major highways. I will return when doing anything in that area. Thank you.

author: cewags
title: Terrible Customer Service
text: My husband and I enjoy staying at Hyatt's and are reward members with the hotel, but we are incredibly disappointed with the experience with this hotel. My husband and I had a destination wedding on Lido Beach last summer and spent thousands of dollars at the Hyatt Regency Hotel down the street, where our wedding party and family stayed. When we made reservations for one of our guests, Hyatt Reservations accidentally booked a room at the Hyatt Place instead of the Hyatt Regency. We were then charged for a room that we never stayed in, never booked, and was no fault of ours. Ashley, the General Manager, at the Hyatt Place, promised us multiple times over the course of 3 months that we would be reimbursed, and it never happened. Apparently, the time has now been too long for the hotel to reimburse the credit card, and they can only give us a free night stay at their hotel in Sarasota, which we are not going to in the near future. We simply wanted our credit card reimbursed for room we never booked or stayed in. The managers will not return our phone calls and I have not heard from Hyatt Corporate on the manner, either. This is disappointing as we spent not only much money with Hyatt Regency for our wedding, but we honeymooned at a Hyatt in Cancun, which we loved. I would not recommend staying at this Hyatt Place under the current management.

author: sarahro33
title: Beach vacation/spring training
text: We stayed here tues-tues and had a great stay. Room was clean. Hotel offered breakfast every day until 9:30 and 10 on the weekends. Great selection and usually had 4 hot options which included Waffles, French toast, breakfast potatoes, hash browns, omlets, breakfast sandwiches, bacon, sausage links, sausage patties and every day cereal, fruit, yogurt, danishes, cottage cheese, bagels, English muffins, juice, coffee, milk, and toast. Front desk was very helpful with giving us things to do while we were there especially Jeffrey and I forget the other mans name that was working with him. Smugglers golf in Sarasota and Bradenton was a lot of fun. Ed smith stadium was only 4miles away which was one reason we went to Sarasota. We went to siesta beach, lido beach and Anna Maria island. All were different style beaches but we liked them all. We rented chairs at all of them and they all had a snack bar.

author: mitchl542
title: Excellent Value!
text: This was our second stay at the Hyatt Place Sarasota in less than a year and we don't want to go anyplace else. The staff is friendly and professional. The breakfast bar is very good with lots of choices. The pillows and sheets are soft, the mattresses are very comfortable, and for the most part the hotel is quiet. It is kept up well. No dank smells or run down appearances like so many of the budget hotels. We haven't found anything to complain about. We had a fantastic stay thanks to the Hyatt and their staff.

author: N2283DLdeborahk
title: Sarasota Invitational
text: Regatta visit. Have stayed here for years. Very reliable and clean. Spatious rooms. Hopefully can keep late checkout. Like having breakfast and coffee. Just improve oatmeal to steel oats. Love the mini bar for happy hour 🍾🍾🍾

author: 750michelez
title: Enjoyed Our Stay
text: This Hyatt is very clean and has a super friendly staff. We stayed as a team during the Elvis weekend and had a surprisingly amazing time. The girls on the field hockey team loved the experience and the Elvis group and hotel staff were extremely friendly and welcoming during this time. There is no noise at all from the airport. The pool is clean and private from the parking lot. Rooms are large and clean. The complimentary breakfast was good. All around very nice place to stay.

author: Lulicupcake
title: Dawn is the best. So helpful and sweet!!!
text: Stayed here for the first time for a weekend business trip. My husband came for birthday weekend. We usually stay at Hyatt Regency downtown, but season prices are outrageous. We got a beautiful suite for 3 nights for under $100 a night. The hotel staff made this stay amazing. Dawn, Ian, Collin, and Jeffery are the few names I can remember and that really stood out, but all were very accommodating and pleasant. Location is not the greatest, but they do have a shuttle that will take you downtown that runs till 11:30 pm. Also the breakfast is one of the best complimentary breakfast I've ever had.

author: /undefined
title: Hidden Gem
text: With short notice, we needed to find a hotel room to attend our daughter's field hockey tournament. We must've looked through a large number of hotels and this Hyatt Place seemed to have the cheapest rate, by far. We've stayed a HP once before, so we booked a room for 3 nights, with expectations not too high. To our very pleasant surprise, the hotel seemed like it was new. Very clean. Staff bent over backwards to be courteous and glad that we were staying there. And the room was spotless and much bigger than my daughter's room in another name brand hotel she had to share with 3 other teammates. We enjoyed breakfast each morning. And an unexpected treat was an Elvis impersonator singing in the lobby on Friday and Saturday night. We highly recommend this Hyatt Place.

author: /undefined
title: Great value!
text: The hotel was clean and quiet. The rooms were very adequate - nothing fancy but with all of the necessary amenities. Check-in was a breeze! Hotel staff were friendly and eager to please. The hotel was convenient to Asolo Rep and the Ringling Museum. The variety of breakfast choices was ample! The fitness room was small with not much equipment, so you may have to wait to get on a treadmill. All in all, a perfect hotel for a business trip of weekend in Sarasota!

author: Stay601638
title: You cannot go wrong by staying here!
text: I was referred to this hotel because my surgeon has an outstanding preferred rate with the hotel, and I was scheduled for major surgery and was seeking a quiet retreat for a week post op. I cannot emphasize enough how accomodating every member of the staff & mgmt were with me. The manager with whom I booked the reservation (via phone,months earlier) personally checked to make sure I was comfortable and delivered food right to my room,as well as being concerned with my comfort and care. The staff also respected my request for quiet, and understood that I would request housekeeping when I was ready and able to walk about, it was so easy to rest and recuperate, without the expected knock and call out of "house-keeping". The hotel was very clean, smelled great. the beds super comfy, nice amenities, great 24/7 food host & menu, lovely full service breakfast area, beautiful outdoor pool and workout area. I have visited this area in years previously and stayed at higher end hotels that were seriously lacking in most areas at a considerably higher price. I couldn't have been more pleased with my treatment at Hyatt Place, and can truly say that by choosing this hotel, (as opposed to any other mid luxury hotel brand)I had a more restful, carefree post-op recovery experience than my previous hotel stays.

author: 366jeanned
title: One night stay
text: The Hyatt hotel is very nice. Beds were comfortable. I love that there is a large couch to lounge on. Most Hyatts have a good breakfast. I was disappointed in the breakfast at this Hyatt. The hot food was not that good. Waffles were very hard. And, the bread for toasting was smashed, bagels didn't look good and there was only one stale looking English muffin. There was a big variety though.

author: Yolotravel
title: Value for a bit more class
text: This hotel is located not very far from downtown Sarasota. There are restaurants very close like Barnacle Bills Seafood which their complimentary shuttle service is willing to take you as well as downtown. The lobby has a mini Starbucks and pastries. Also complimentary breakfast in the morning. Pool is adequate and 24 hr workout room. The rooms have very large living room space with wet bar and huge pull out couch. Bathrooms are average and it y room was clean and well maintained. Staff were very accommodating and check in and check out simple. It's worth the value of staying here as a good safe choice for your stay in Sarasota.

author: slocam
title: Excellent stay!
text: Really impressed...used priceline to book the room. Got a quiet first floor room that was really nice. Way more than expected and the price was great. The room had a nice living area with a sectional, 2 comfy queen beds, nice bathroom, nice decor. The front desk staff were exceptional. They were very helpful and courteous. Big thumbs up to them. Breakfast was nice, gym looked very nice although we didn't use it. Would certainly stay here again. Great location near the airport.

author: Sid_and_Roxy
title: A great respite from crowds, sun and our on the go vacation.
text: Checking in to the hotel went smoothly and was very informative. Getting to the room we found it well appointed. However, there wasn’t a separate sink by the refrigerator as we have seen in other Hyatt Places. On a positive note, even though the shower and toilet are separate the shower door here seemed to try to address the small size of that room. The bathroom setup while functional doesn’t seem to flow very well in practice with the small shower/toilet room and a separate small sink/vanity with an offset sink. However, sleep quality in the room is good and it everything was clean and very nicely presented. Breakfast was very good even if it was a little chaotic. The one lady that was servicing the breakfast area seemed flustered and seemed sometimes to be spouting off sarcastically, however her interactions with us directly were positive. All in all this was a good value in the Sarasota area, we slept good and our room was comfortable respite from our on the go vacation.

author: babyjohnson
title: Thanks for the warm welcome and looking after us !
text: Our stay was excellent. The staff at the hotel were excellent - all of them. They always wanted to please us and were friendly, nothing was too much trouble.Thanks to Betsy and Michelle especially, who we looked forward to chatting to in the morning at breakfast area ! The lobby area was clean and airy and we were always welcome to sit there any time of day. Loved the complimentary chilled lemon water too ! The room was large with plenty of storage space. The hairdrier was great and didn't keep cutting out like most hotel hairdriers do !! The shuttle service to the 'gym' was efficient and very helpful.Thanks Cassandra and Ricardo ! The housekeeping staff were also excellent and kept our rooms clean and up to date with towels etc. Very well done, we will come and stay again next year !

author: GADawgNic
title: Good hotel
text: My son's lacrosse team stayed at this hotel for a tournament at IMG Academy. Very clean rooms. Breakfast was good. Staff helpful and friendly. Loved the lobby where the parents could hang out. Happy hour 2 for 1 drinks! A live oak with Spanish moss drapes the limbs and overlooks the pool. The only complaint is that pillows were a bit small - more of a square. But the mattress was comfortable. However, it's nice having a sitting area in the room.

author: Ida18
title: Soccer Weekend
text: The hotel was very close to the airport. Jeffrey at the front desk was friendly and very helpful. The rooms very very spacious and clean. Beds were comfortable and a/c cooled amazing. Washer and dryer was available on my floor. Rooms had small refrigerator. Full breakfast till 10am on the weekends. No complaints. Will return if in area.

author: Bob_Loretta
title: Good experience
text: Staff was friendly and accommodating. Free breakfast was bountiful and delicious. Room was spacious and clean. Room layout was best suited to single traveler, or people who wake at the same time - sink was relatively close to bed, etc. Tap water had an odd taste and smell. Fridge in the room was a welcomed bonus. Although adjacent to the airport, I heard little noise. I would stay here again.

author: NikitaWorld07
title: Terrible!
text: Don't let the reviews here fool you. This place is simply HORRIBLE. It isn't even close to other Hyatt Place locations I stayed. Unfortunately I was stuck here but not by choice (the company I work for booked it). Arriving late night after a long work day, believe me, this is the last place you want to stay to rest. The hallways smelled like a dead animal was there, the fabric on the sofa was dirty with stains and had holes, the bathroom was so small you had to get in to be able to close the door. I found hair on the sheets, the phones were untouchable full of grease. The bed was uncomfortable, and I can keep going. Don't waste your money or precious time coming to this place.

author: 813darrylc
title: Very Nice Stay.
text: Was very pleased with this hotel. the price was very affordable and the room was very spacious and clean. would recommend staying to everyone. will stay again next time. Keep in mind we were on vacation and looking for a relaxing place. I think we found it and then some. Only complaint would be the pillows were a little too soft, but other than that, no other complaints. we asked for a quiet room and received just that.

author: Chaump
title: Great one night stay.
text: We had a one night stay at the Hyatt Place Sarasota / Bradenton Airport. The hotel is easy to find, modern and clean. We were visiting The Ringling so the location was perfect. We were worried about the location being close to the airport, but we heard no airport noise. The staff was attentive and professional. The rooms are very spacious with a great sitting area. They have a nice coffee and liquor bar in the lobby. The breakfast was plentiful and fresh. My only complaint was the pool area, it was pretty basic and the AC units in the room are pretty loud. We always bring earplugs, but the front desk actually provides them, nice touch!

author: GinnelleE
title: Fabulous!
text: Great room. Lovely size. Very clean. The pool was nice and there was also a hot tub. The breakfast had real fruit and a good selection of food. It was about a 20 minute drive to Siesta Key, which was voted the best beach in America. The staff was friendly. Easy check in and check out. Good stay.

author: billiek762
title: Great place for the money!
text: Nice very well appointed rooms. Most comfortable hotel bed I have ever slept in. Woke up with no backache which says a lot when traveling. Free breakfast was fantastic. Free coffee. Fantastic place for a little over $100 a night. Rated as 4star. Not sure about that. Very comparable to a three star. The Holiday Inn down the street was nicer with more amenities.

author: dowden14
title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed one night for weekend. Reasonable price. Room was nice and clean. Beds are comfy. Hot breakfast was great. We had sausage, eggs, pancakes. Wifi in the room was surprisingly fast. Will surely come back again if we need to stay in Sarasota.

author: bassguygg
title: Great Place for Family Fun!
text: Went here for a wedding with the family and took out about ten rooms. The hotel was extremely accommodating giving us rooms near each other. They even let us use the breakfast area for our "after party" once the wedding ended. The place was clean, the service impeccable; staff friendly and eager to please. Free breakfast was slightly better than average. The pool was small but nice. The best part was the convenient location, literally next to the airport. Loved it! Highly recommended.

author: rmthom
title: Comfortable,Clean and Friendly,
text: The Hyatt Place Hotel is located just across the street from the Sarasota Bradenton Airport, which makes it great if you have an early flight or are coming in late or just need a really nice place to stay. We always stay here if we have an early flight, You can just drive across the street and park in long term or short term parking. We have even left our car at the hotel without a problem. They have a shuttle service ,which works well. Our room was comfortable and clean. We had dinner at the hotel. They have a limited menu,which is really quite adequate for a short term stay.The staff is always very friendly and helpful. We will stay here again.

author: debbiesJ2324ZK
title: Convenient exceptional hotel
text: Convenient to everything. Large clean room with a semi-separate comfortable sitting room. The sectional sofa and ottoman were perfect to lounge on while watching TV. The sea salt pool was clean and just the right temp. Washing machine and dryer were available which was convenient since we stayed a week. Front desk had detergent and dryer sheets available. A mini Starbucks at the front desk with many food options. The airport is right across University Parkway but you would never know it. The breakfast offered everything included fresh cut fruit as well as whole fruit.

author: InveterateExplorer
title: A Mediocre Hotel Not Worthy of the Hyatt Name!
text: Where to begin? The poorly trained and dressed front desk staff? The loud aggressive chambermaids who knocked loudly on the door despite prominently displayed DO NOT DISTURB sign? The small pool? The worn out bed? The breakfast buffet made with really poor quality produce--gristly sausage, etc., etc. And to add insult to injury, this place is expensive, and especially so for what it is. Avoid at all costs, and Hyatt, for shame on this one!

author: C2953VGjohnb
title: Terrific hotel- nicely located
text: This is the second time we've stayed at this hotel. It's located about 5 minutes from the airport and two minutes away from a main road that leads downtown in about 15 minutes. It's not far from the Orioles ball park and a bit longer from the Pirates home field in Bradenton. We liked its convenience and the breakfast, inside or out on the patio and there's loads of free parking. You can practically walk to the Ringling Museum and the Asolo Theater, both a five minute drive away and Monday, the museum and grounds are free. It's not located in downtown Sarasota-- which, to us, was fine but the downtown area was very accessible. The hotel attracted many baseball fans in mid-March when we spent a week in this culture-rich area. The theater and the Sarasota Opera were world-class-- we saw some wonderful performances- and the restaurants in town are numerous. We took advantage of the Whole Foods salad bar, downtown, for many meals prior to attending ball games or cultural events.

author: ExpertTravelers
title: Convenient to Airport but "run of the mill"
text: We've stayed at the Hyatt Place Sarasota in the past and found it to be well managed. On our most recent trip we checked out after 2 nights of a booked 7 nights stay. Our first room had a sink faucet which was loose and sink was blocked ...we called, someone apparently fixed it while we went to dinner...but whatever was done, it was made worse. Called the front desk, they told us they would send maintenance man in the morning. When on one showed by 3PM we called front desk again and they sent someone up who after working on it for almost an hour told us he had to leave to get some chemicals and it would be maybe 2 more hours before sink would be fixed. At that point we requested a change of room....which the front desk willingly accommodated. Unfortunately the room we got had such an old and lumpy mattress that we were not able to sleep. In the morning we told the front desk about our experience and they told us that some of the mattresses had been changed but not all and they would change our that day. At which point we checked out. The hotel charged over $200./night for what we would consider to be at best a mediocre managed hotel and one that we would not recommend.

author: Dancemom29
title: Business Trip
text: My husband had to see some clients on Long Boat Key and so we chose this hotel for its convenience and price. The staff was very friendly. Our room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast was excellent. The only issue that we had is that they had steam cleaned the carpeting in our room that day and the carpeting was still very damp. Fortunately both my husband and I had sandals with us to wear in the room. We could not be too critical as I have read some tips about traveling and learned that hotels in general do not clean the carpeting in their rooms very often! So at least we knew it was clean!!

author: 479peggys
title: Siesta keys
text: We spent the weekend of August 7th. It is a very quiet and comfortable space. It was not crowded with people. The location was perfect. The staff very friendly and helpful. The rooms were very clean. The only issue we had was the AC unit. It made a horrible motor noise. It became very difficult to sleep at night. We stayed on the 3rd floor corner room which was very private and quiet.

author: vishal_lalani
title: one of my favourites
text: i have been staying here regularly since 2009, and there is some nostalgic factor involved too, since my first visit was tied to an important event in my life. i come to sarasota a few times every year, and stay at multiple hotels ( based on price) and this one is definitely my favourite. the rooms are really nice and spacious, its almost like a suite. the other thing i really like is the breakfast area, which is designed to give the feel of your kitchen at home. the breakfast is very nice, and now in recent years they have also added some hot skillet items. the staff is very warm and cordial too. there's a small swimming pool and hot tub. a mini-gym where a TV would help. also the stepper machine seemed to be misbehaving.

author: dahnesmom
title: The staff is amazing...service impeccable but I will NEVER stay again.
text: I've stayed here numerous times and it's a great hotel. The staff is friendly and will go out of their way to help with any request you may have. The rooms are clean and the location is conveinient to the business that I'm here for. My dissapointment came when after staying for 18 days.. I find out that since my trip was booked through travelocity that I don't get ANY credit for not 1 day spent in this hotel toward my Hyatt "Gold Passport". WHY would I even bother to stay here again when there are literally 5 other hotels that i can actually see out my window. what would be my incentive. Totally dissapointed in HYATT not my experience with this hotel BYE BYE HYATT. The next 220 days of work travel will not have your name written in my itinerary.

author: 119olgar
title: Great hotel
text: Staff very friendly and professional. Breakfast was great. Happy hour! Rooms are very comfortable and very clean. Early checking. Recommend very highly. They are pet friendly. Airport across and you can't tell.

author: Reisefee12
title: Great location, clean and nice service
text: we stayed here for 2 nights, even that the hotel was completly booked it was very nice to stay and not loud or roudy. We got a nice room on the 3rd floor with a big King and a sleeping couch. The rooms are big and they got a great breakfast downstairs, with great coffee, fresh fruits, cereals, pancakes .... They have a complimentary shuttle in 3mile range, so we used it to see the Ringling Museum. We walked back from there and it was just a 15min walk. The beaches are about 20-30min away. University Mall about 20min. We would come back and stay there again.

author: 8kristyy
title: Great stay!
text: Really well run and very clean. Everyone on the staff has been friendly and helpful. My room is very comfortable. The bed and the bathroom are absolute standouts.
