Salads and sandwiches available 24/7. No real restaurant but the shuttle will take you anywhere within 3 miles of the hotel anytime. Pool area is beautiful and well maintained. Really great room for a reasonable price

author: Rubinger
title: Hyatt Place Sarasota
text: This hotel was conveniently located to the airport and the Ringling Museum. It was approximately 10 minutes from St. Armands Circle and the beaches. The rooms were spacious and immaculately clean. All the staff were pleasant and accomodating. Breakfast was adequate and the coffee was good. Our room was large enough to spread out for a family of five. All in all it was a pleasant stay for a family wedding weekend.

author: miguelmW3220WO
title: Clean
text: Nice clean hotel! Nice staff...Nice clean hotel! Nice staff...Nice clean hotel! Nice staff...Nice cNice clean hotel! Nice staff...lean hotel! Nice staff...Nice cNice clean hotel! Nice staff...lean hotel! Nice staff...

author: AshM344
title: Good stay
text: Clean rooms. The pool was crowded, but nice. If you are flying into Sarasota, the airport is literally across the street. Despite being so close to the airport, the room was quiet. Lido beach is a 15-20 minute drive, Siesta Key is a bit longer than that. I felt like I overpaid ($289/night) for the overall value and service, but that is likely due to Spring Break. Breakfast was included and was okay; if you don't go early enough, not much would be left. Ordered the nachos off the menu (no room service, but you can order food 24/7 and pickup at the lobby downstairs), and it was better than expected.

author: fun2be
title: Lovely hotel close to the airport and Ca d'zan.
text: Stayed 3 nights at the hotel, originally were worried about the noise as it is so close to the airport - the soundproofing is excellent, could not hear any outside noises. Bathrooms are small and the sinks are outside the bathrooms, but everything is functional. Very clean, awesome staff, great breakfast included with your stay, very clean rooms and attention to details throughout. High speed internet works great. Not far from Ca d'Zan and Ringling museum and 5 min from the airport. Heated pool and hot tub are lovely. The only drawback is the pool is in the shade most of the time, so suntanning is challenging. Room service is not available but if you call in, there is a menu to chose from as long as you don't mind picking it up at the front desk. Had absolutely no concerns about the hotel, would highly recommend.

author: SanibelViews
title: Very nice, we'll stay again!
text: We stayed overnight at the Hyatt Place intending to go the Ringling Museum the next morning. We didn't have time to get to the Ringling -- which is within easy walking distance -- but we'll stay at the Hyatt Place again the next time we're in Sarasota. The hotel is right across the street from the entrance to the airport, not far from downtown Sarasota. The hotel is very pleasant. Rooms are nice, with space to put things down and spread out, lots of outlets for chargers. The bed is very comfortable. Easy and free Wi-Fi. The breakfast buffet is one of the best we've had at any similarly-priced hotel. The staff was very nice.

author: KatiRosado
title: Amazing service!!
text: The staff (especially Paul) went above and beyond for my and my husband to make us feel more welcome after we had our car break down while visiting photographing a wedding. They were super nice and treated us like guests in their home. The hotel was beautiful, the rooms were so clean, and the bed was the comfiest bed I've ever laid in. The food was also really good! We got a quesadilla and a burger and both were amazing! I do think they should hire a few more people to work at the bar and run the front desk as it doesn't seem fair to the employees to be running around like crazy, but they did a great job keeping up with everything. We will definitely stay here again!!! We love every Hyatt Place we have stayed at.

author: shelbyduncan
title: Hot breakfast free, BIG screen TV
text: Nice overall. My room had a huge TV screen with the ability to plug your own things into it, and the screen pivots for viewing while you're on the couch or in bed. Hot breakfast sandwiches were good, but it seemed like everyone took their food back to their rooms. They offer other food during the day though there is no restaurant seating; you come out to pick it up and take it back to your room. I noticed there is a bar, however. The ac was loud and too close to the bed. This was the only place I've stayed that does NOT slip your bill under your door at night, which meant I had to stand in line for a zero balance bill for my employer. People were nice. It was convenient to New College. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

author: vinceG768
title: Hyatt place is always quality
text: The last couple of years we stayed a couple of times at a Hyatt place. This time we booked the hotel by bidding on priceline and we're very pleased with winning a Hyatt Place. The staff is always very friendly and helpfull, also here. The rooms are great and very spacious. I love it that there is a separate sitting area and also a huge TV. The complimentary breakfast is great. Lots of choice and for everyone something. Location is great if you flying from or to sarasota/bradenton airport. beach also very nearby! Wifi was fast and very stable.

author: Baguette9910
title: Great place, good location.
text: I stay here every year for a week or so visiting family in the area. This year I was back again with more family (wedding)and it was, as always, excellent! I was concerned since I was the one who insisted on this hotel, but I needn't have been worried. Great service, good breakfast, and a decent bar. It's easy to get anywhere in Sarasota or Bradenton from this location, and the staff is helpful with recommendations. The rooms are very nice, spacious, and always very clean. Free internet works beautifully! The only problem I've ever had is that my cell phone sometimes cuts out in the room. I'll keep going back every year, or any time I need to be in the area.

author: bprairie
title: My go to place in Sarasota
text: My wife and I stayed here for one night September 25. This was probably my 4th or 5th time staying at this hotel. All my stays here have been great. The rooms are very nice as is the whole lobby area. The breakfast is GREAT! I love the fresh cut up fruit they serve. The coffee is excellent and the orange juice tastes like real orange juice. The hot food is fresh and delicious. Nice clean ample seating area.

author: Murdochsmom
title: We were treated like royalty!
text: I arranged a group who traveled to Sarasota for the weekend with everyone making their own hotel arrangements. Angela Baker & the staff could not have been kinder, more helpful or more accommodating. We were cheerfully shuttled to attractions & dinners. We enjoyed time at the pool. My room was large enough to sleep 6 & had a refrigerator. The staff even put us all on the same floor in the same area. I will gladly stay there again & certainly recommend it to anyone heading to the Sarasota area! Plus, it is only a few blocks from the Ringling property.

author: jennacoyd
title: Perfect place to stay
text: There were four of us staying in one room. We had been traveling for seven days and we were so tired. Our other stops were nice but this place was unbelievable. We were amazed and delighted with our room which was spacious, beautiful, and so clean. Our breakfast was tasty and they served Starbucks coffee for breakfast. Starbucks was even offered 24 hrs a day for a charge of course. The staff was great as well. We will book with them again.

author: sarahcH3779EG
title: We wanted to stay longer!
text: The two queen bedroom was more space than we could have ever needed (which is great when there are two twenty-something women in the room). The beds were so comfortable that we did not want to get up. The staff was extremely friendly, even offering us different floor choices. The location is not ideal unless you need access to the airport, but we definitely couldn't complain otherwise. They even have chargers to borrow and nail polish to buy on premises. Wish we had time to use the pool because it looked excellent. Booked off Priceline for an AMAZING deal. We will stay again if we have the chance!

author: JHS_12
title: Good hotel. Lousy loyalty program.
text: This has generally been my go-to hotel in Sarasota. It's got everything you'd want (fast, easy wifi) and none of the useless crap (tip-mongering bell boys, mints on the pillow). The rooms are spacious with big couches and giant flat screens. The staff is nice. The free breakfast is pretty good, though I must admit that my last stop at their buffet gave me a bit of upset belly. To be sure, it is all ready-made heat-and-serve food. One complaint is that they didn't honor my Hyatt Gold points because I'd booked through another web site. Hyatt does not understand how to operate a proper loyalty program.

author: DEELUU
title: Nice Time
text: We stayed here for five nights and we had a good time. There were four of us. Two adults and two kids. We all loved the area very much. It is a good location with the beaches about ten minutes away and downtown about five minutes away. There are plenty of food choices in the area. But with free breakfast buffet in this little hotel, we saved a lot of money. We will stay here again in the future. PS the customer service in this hotel is very very good!!!!!!!!!

author: 1KarenR
title: Stayed 12 nights on business - great place!
text: This was a very nice hotel with a friendly staff. Bed was comfortable, room was quiet. Huge sectional in the "living" room - not really a suite, but a nice transition wall dividing the space. Good hot breakfast (although it didn't really change, there was a lot to choose from). Starbucks coffee in the lobby - always a plus. Restaurant food was good. Good location for my purpose plus directly across the street from rental car return. I stayed on top floor and very rarely heard a plane. I would recommend this hotel.

author: Fdamsen
title: Outstanding Value
text: We stayed at the Hyatt Place Sarasota for three days over President's day weekend. Our daughter was on a college visit. We paid $89/night which included breakfast and wifi. The property is pretty, well maintained and very clean. We had a room with two queen beds and it was a very large room. Breakfast was average for a business class hotel of this type compared to other competitors. Hyatt needs to think about upgrading its offering and the quality. Service at the hotel was outstanding. Hard to beat for the money.

author: Bizztravel
title: Airport Convenient and Quiet
text: This is a good Sarasota hotel if you don't need to be on the beach. You should have a car though, as there are not many restaurants in walking distance. Downtown restaurants are 5 minutes away, Longboat and SIesta Key are 10-15 minutes drive. You can easily walk to the Ringling Museum, or the Sarasota Classic Car Museum. The airport is not that busy and the runway is far enough away that airport noise wasn't noticeable for me, a medium to light sleeper. I dropped my rental car off the night before flying home, and walked back to the hotel (10 minutes, sidewalk didn't exist all the way). I used the hotel shuttle in the morning, reserve a seat at the front desk. Very nice HP. I really like the extra space in the room with the couch, desk, and refridgerator. It is great to spread out when travelling with family.

author: FamilyTravellerMI
title: Best HP so far
text: I've stayed in about seven different Hyatt Place properties in the past year. This property gets my vote for best in service, attention to detail and genuine caring about guests. The property, across the street from the airport, was not my first choice. However, it is located near the interstate and local routes making it highly convenient. You receive Hyatt value for a very reasonable price. No ocean view, but you aren't paying for it either. The exercise room, breakfast room and food service are better than most HP properties. And I can say that the staff, to a one, were all genuinely interested in making sure we had a great experience at every turn. We will be back.

author: tx_bella_travel
title: excellent service- staff went out of their way to please
text: In Sarasota for a conference at the Hyatt Regency. We stayed at the Hyatt Place because there were no more room at the Hyatt Regency. The Hyatt place shuttled us over to the Regency daily and picked us up. The rooms were clean a spacious. One of us had a cold and asked if they could stop at a drug store on the way back. The driver called the hotel to check to see if they had what we needed and they did! Excellent service! My only negative comment is they only served Pepsi products....yuk!

author: judyc937
title: Large rooms!
text: We didn't need it but they provide free shuttle service to the airport. The room was like a small apartment. It was huge with a sitting area with a couch & ottoman& large screen t.v. There was a desk area, bar area,large vanity. The breakfast buffet was the best we had on this trip. Everyone was friendly & helpful. The only complaint we had was the bathroom was too small & definitely needed sound proofing! Each morning we received a complimentary newspaper. Beds were comfortable & all was clean except housekeeping was a little sloppy---didn't replenish some things we needed & didn't remove used towel on floor. All in all it still was pretty good--would stay there again.

author: Bolly-and-Billy
title: Fine place to stay
text: We stayed at the Hyatt last November, it's a really nice place to stay for a couple of days. At arrival we were invited for a "show" of the hotel amenities. This is not happened to us at other hotels. We find this sort of welcome very nice, it gives you a really welcome feeling. At the arrival we received a corner room, unfortunately this room wasn't quiet because the roof airco was very loud. We decided to complaint about this and asked for another room. The desk clerk was very helpful and go with us to inspect and hearing the noise, she understand our "problem" and went back to the front desk to see if there's another room available. She gave us another room on the same level, and this was a nice and quiet room with a pool view. The breakfast was better than expected, very nice and clean and lots of items to choose from. So we definitely would stay again when we are visiting Sarasota.

author: comfytraveler43
title: Great place to stay! Great staff!
text: I am in the travel industry and was more than pleasantly surprised at the great service by the evening security guard who happen to overhear me talking to the late night desk clerk at check in about lack of parking and showed up in the back lot to walk/help me to my room at midnight! Wish I had known they had such a great little bar/ grill that was open that late I went miles looking for something open before checking in to grab something. I took advantage of it the following night though.. I wanted to thank Denise, George & Flavia who provided exceptional service.. I am not sure if they are all the same but I will definitely stay at another Hyatt Place if I can't use my own accommodations in the future. Great rooms, really well designed, ... Only suggestion - flavored creamer coffee station in lobby.. Thank you for such a great experience!

author: wwcaterson
title: Convenient and Classy
text: I booked a weekend at the Hyatt while doing a show at the convention center. The location is convenient for the business traveler: Right across from the airport and nestled between Sarasota and Bradenton. Popular destinations like the convention center, Ringling, downtown Sarasota and St. Armands Circle are just a short drive away. My room, a small suite, was stylish and spotless as were the common areas. The hot breakfast is a plus for both business travelers and families with ample seating for all. The hotel also features free parking, free wi-fi, fitness room and a nice pool area with spa. The only thing that would make this already excellent facility better would be microwaves in the rooms (which have refrigerators). I plan on staying here the next time my work takes me to Sarasota.

author: 428STEPHENW
title: Our favorite place in Sarasota
text: This was our second, my third stay here. We've come to Sarasota once or twice a year for 20 years and have staying in most of the lodging nearby. This is by far the best value and IMHO equals or surpasses the sister Hyatt property in town. The staff goes out of their way to be helpful and friendly. The rooms and public areas are spacious & spotless: clearly this is a management that cares! We participated in a conference which had two catered lunches which were superb, with chocolate chip cookies are to die for. Breakfasts were superb as well. My only minor complaint is an awkwardly placed commode in the shower compartment: it's definitely one person at a time! Thanks for making us feel so comfortable here.

author: AF_Pil0t
title: Comfortable Stay
text: My daughter and I recently visited sarasota for Ringlin's College of Art and Design open house. The hotel was less than 10 minutes from the campus and far enough away from the beaches that it was reasonably priced. It took about 30 minutes (just under) to get to Siesta Key beach and about 20 minutes to get to Lido beach. You could also go North up to Bradenton area beaches in about 25 minutes. The room had 2 queen beds and was pretty spacious (with a couch, desk, mini fridge, desk etc). The staff was friendly and accomodating. The breakfast was pretty good--cereals, scrambled eggs, sausage, pancakes (french toast the other morning), yogurt, fruit, and juices. If I go back to the area, I will stay there again.

author: Traveldiva1207
title: Definite Returning Guest
text: Friendly desk agents - Clean lobby. Spacious room - very clean. Great quality for the price. Impressed with the location, which is actually right across the street from SRQ. We did get a chance to eat the hotel continental breakfast. It included - eggs, sausage, ceral, assortment of breads & fruit as well as coffee & juice. There were other variety of items as well. Great hotel - location - bed quality and price. Very Pleased!

author: TDFCN
title: Exceeded Expectations
text: This was the first experience staying at a Hyatt Place and the experience exceeded expectations. Upon arrival we were greeted by Duana at check-in who made the process simple and seamless and who displayed a strong customer service sense. The room was spotless and spacious to allow for a greater sense of home away from home - a small refrigerator, desk and internet access. The morning breakfast, included in the room rate, was comprehensive including fresh fruit and juices, eggs, breakfast sandwiches, donuts, cereal...just about anything you could have wanted. The tables and serving counters were clean and food presentation fresh and appealing. Betsy and Greg who worked at check-in and dining areas, were delightful to be around and exhibited a sense of commitment to the customer. There were additional food options for purchase for lunch or dinner. The fresh chocolate cookies were delicious! Keep up the good work!

author: jag33437
title: Like staying at a small B&B
text: We were pleasantly surprised by the friendliness of the staff, particularly Betsy who watched over us. She gave us good information on where to eat, what to see and what to do. Had a friendly smile and greeting every day. The breakfast is good and filling if simple. The coffee was great. They even have some fresh baked muffins and cookies to purchase. The rooms are comfortable and roomy with everything you need for a brief stay. Even though the hotel is across from the airport there is no aircraft noise. It is well situated across from the Ringling complex so it is easy to make that a morning stop and then go elsewhere during the day.

author: GGreyhame
title: Huge rooms. nice stay overall
text: We asked for a room on the third floor and the room came with two queen beds and a large sofa with a divider in between. It was a huge room, although the bath and toilet were a bit small. The air conditioner worked fine in this room and in the third floor hallway. Really nice TV, large selection of channels, terrific complimentary breakfast. The bathtub drain clogged up but we called the front desk and a maintenance guy came right up and declogged the drain, The front desk also called back afterwards to see how it went, which I thought was a nice touch. The area is convenient for visiting the Ringling College of Art and Design, which is why we were there. it's also right next to the airport. We knew beforehand that the area was more or less a high crime area, although it looks fairly nice. We didn't experience any problems, however, Overall, an excellent experience.

author: 862JohnB
title: Awesome!
text: I spent seven nights at the Hyatt while my son attended a soccer camp up the road. The property, while next to the airport, was extremely quiet. The building frames the pool area, which shuts out most of the noise from the airport. The rooms are very, very large, and quite comfortable. The breakfast area was the best I've seen in a buffet style breakfast. The best thing is the staff. They seem happy, and are very friendly. It's tough to spend a week at a hotel, yet this place is pretty awesome.

author: mdb4906
title: Good value for Sarasota.
text: Spent two nights while visiting Sarasota. Much less expensive than the beach hotels, and about 15 min drive to Siesta Key beaches. Breakfast was okay... good selection of breakfast sandwiches, but all products were previously frozen and just heated up (as the hotel staff told us). The room was spacious and clean. Downside was the A/C unit right next to the bed. It was a bit noisy and cold air blew directly on us. Shower door is only a half door, so it's difficult to shower without ending up with water all over the bathroom floor. Overall, I would say this is a good bargain for a hotel in Sarasota. I would stay again, but I'll bet you could find a better breakfast and shower in town.

author: JackBlack1952
title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text: Friendliest staff, very cool and clean and like a NYC boutique hotel. I'm very tough on motels and hotels and have had my reviews turned down at tripadvisor because of my honesty. And I can tell you, this is a great place. Friendliest staff in the business. Very accommodating. I'm a clean freak and was very satisfied. Smart large rooms accommodated all my digital needs with large tv swinging between bed and lounge area with hdmi hookup etc. Thanks Hyatt for making this a restful stay. Very quiet.

author: Chictraveler37
title: Superb hotel for a budget price
text: This is our second time staying at this hotel located just outside of the Bradenton/Sarasota airport (although we've never heard a plane fly over). Every room comes equipped with a mini fridge, hi def flat screen tv, and the usual hotel amenities. Each room is like a mini-suite with the bed separate from a small sectional sofa living area which is perfect for hanging out while in the room. Breakfast is FREE and it's really a nice spread for a continental breakfast: fruit, yogurt, cereal, milk, juice, coffee, tea, breads and donuts, pancakes, and egg & bacon english muffin sandwiches. The staff is very attentive and the hotel has a hot tub and heated pool. This is a great place for families and is a quiet and clean hotel. It's really a great value for the price (I got ours on hotels.com for $86/night). I've stayed in much more expensive hotels and have not been as pleased overall.

author: tarynr725
title: Great stay!
text: I spent 5 nights at this hotel, plenty of time for something to go wrong... and nothing did! Everything was more than fantastic. Dana Scott, the sales manager, was so kind and helpful as well all staff members I came in contact with. The hotel is very pleasing to the eyes and clean, huge plus! The hot breakfast bar in the mornings was delicious. They have a continental-like spread as well as hot dishes such as eggs, sausage, french toast, and breakfast sandwiches. My overall experience with this hotel was great and I would stay here again without question. Two thumbs up!

author: jralta
title: Sarasota trip
text: We spent three nights for a graduation/family reunion. The staff was very helpful. The check in desk doubles as a bar so after a long trip you can get checked in and have a drink. Nice touch. The breakfast was hot and had a good variety. The pool area was pleasant and had a bocce court. The rooms were good size with a sitting area and they were quiet. The location is pretty central to downtown Sarasota, New College and the lido.

author: btroxel18
title: Great value
text: Very friendly and helpful staff for our entire 8 night stay. Very clean. Great free breakfast (most other included hotel breakfasts are awful). Free wifi was fast (streamed live HD sports). Fitness center small but nice equipment. Large rooms that are laid out well (you don't hear your neighbors). Great place to stay and save money to spend elsewhere on your vacation. Enjoy!

author: Dorscot
title: This hotel is a gem!
text: We stayed 2 nights and can't say enough good about this hotel. It has a modern appearance, is very clean, our room was spacious, and the staff couldn't have been more helpful and pleasant. The breakfast was varied a little each day and was good. Starbucks coffee a plus too. Fresh cold water with slices of citrus fruits a welcome treat when returning from a day of exercise and sightseeing. A shuttle van to take us to downtown Sarasota was a very nice amenity. Wifi connection easy to access. Hotel very reasonably priced. We loved this hotel and would stay here again.

author: PamelaL32
title: Nice relaxing stay with modern flair
text: What a great Hotel. It had a modern flair and was very clean and quiet. Staff was wonderful and the price was great too. My husband and I stayed New Year's Eve. Staff was wonderful and it was so nice to be shuttled and not have to drive. We were very impressed with the entire stay!!! Room was very nice and clean and the bed was very comfortable too. We will be back for sure.

author: Anuta27
title: great hotel for the price
text: We stayed in Sarasota for 7 nights, it was a great hotel for the price. centrally located from restaurants and the beach. Takes about 10 minutes to get to Lido Beach, and about 20-25 minutes to Siesta Keys. The breakfast here is excellent, many choices, especially breakfast sandwiches! However, make sure to get there early as those are gone pretty quickly! One complaint I had is that the bathroom did not have a working fan, so one day we forgot to leave the bathroom door closed, and the whole room smelled like mildew. Beds at this hotel were a little harder than other Hyatt's I've stayed at. Woke up sore a few times.

author: HappyC713
title: Good place to stay!
text: Stayed at the hotel for several nights. Good location, close to the local airport, restaurants, stores and I-75. I liked the room, which was spacious and divided in two useful spaces. The WiFi connection worked well from the room. The room was very clean and had everything necessary for a nice vacation. We didn't use the pool but it looked nice and not crowded. The breakfast selection was good, the only problem is that it was the same selection every day. However, it had a good choice of fruit, morning starches and protein. Would stay there again.

author: LisaF98
title: Great hotel
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our time at Hyatt Place. We arrived rather late in the evening, and hadn't had dinner. We got a lovely dinner from downstairs to bring up to our room to enjoy. The room itself was gorgeous, and had every possible amenity you could want. Enjoyed a delicious breakfast the next morning. As we were getting ready to leave at check out, we asked to have two coffees to go from their coffee bar. The woman at the desk said, "Yes, for a cost." Fine, we bought something less expensive down the street. Not a way to leave your guests with a good impression. We wrote a letter to Hyatt management, which was left unanswered. We will not be staying here again.

author: krav3211
title: Very Pleased
text: Came to Sarasota with the family (two teens) for a quick spring break. The hotel was located about 30 minutes (drive) to Siesta Key Beach; not bad at all. We decided we weren't staying on the beach, so a little drive wasn't a problem. The staff was extremely, and I mean big time extremely friendly and pleasant. They certainly provide excellent personal service. The hotel was very clean, rooms were nice, and breakfast was good. The pool was nice, a bit on the smaller side, but we certainly didn't plan to use it much anyway; not with the beaches in the area. For a family looking to have an affordable "home base" for visiting Sarasota or the Keys, I'd definitely recommend this hotel. They have a shuttle for a 3 mile radius; but there really isn't too much to experience in the direct area...a car rental is essential. Overall it was a quiet, comfortable hotel with a great staff and good food and drink options.

author: 728MichelleD728
title: What a find!
text: Clean, comfortable rooms, quiet, great staff, free breakfast, all for a reasonable price. Stayed here for the past few years - we run the First Watch Half marathon each March, but also came back for a longer stay in November. We have never been disappointed. Can get to downtown Sarasota, Armond Circle, or travel the other direction towards the Lakewood Ranch area - great restaurants/shops in all directions! The best is flying into Sarasota/Brandenton airport. Hotel is across the street from airport yet no noise from planes. A great find! You can't go wrong!

author: BrownBalto
title: Nice hotel but out of the way
text: We picked this hotel based on reviews on Trip Advisor. The hotel itself was fine. The staff was all very friendly and helpful. The rooms were large with a bedroom and living room area. The bathroom had a separate toilet/shower room and while that room itself was just about big enough, it was difficult to open or close the door without stubbing a toe. As the entire space was so large, it would have been nice if that one area could have been a bit larger. But the biggest drawback for our family was that you had to drive to get to pretty much any attraction in Sarasota. We tend to like a hotel where we can walk to at least some restaurants, attractions, or just have a nice place to walk, and that wasn't the case. But as I said before, the hotel itself was nice.

author: KellieB191
title: Great choice for small meetings
text: I've just returned from Sarasota, where I spent 4 nights while attending a conference. The staff was extraordinarily helpful. I'd like to commend, Betsy, in particular. She anticipated our needs and was so personable. The free WiFi is a terrific feature. The shuttle service they provide is very handy for getting out to restaurants in the evening. I highly recommend this property for business travel. Kellie Charlottesville, Va

author: dhoffm
title: Sarasota - the place to stay
text: Very modern AND very well run. Workers actually care about their job. Pool one of the best ever. Warm without being too hot. And there is a hot tub if you want hot. Noticed they farm out the job of checking chlorine levels to a professional company instead of having a towell maid guess. Breakfast food great, all you want, again served and made by ptople who care. For only a bit more than $100 a night, can't be beat.

author: LKByrd
title: Far exceeded our expectations - A+
text: You will not be disappointed staying here. We visited the Sarasota/St.Armand's Circle area and decided to try Hyatt Place after reading positive AAA reviews - they were spot on. The hotel is modern, clean and customer focused. Mini fridge, great shower head, huge tv and ample space made the room user friendly and memorable. Don't miss the breakfast! Beautifully laid out, attended by staff and offers more than the norm. We are picky individuals and can't come up with one negative thing to say about our stay at Hyatt Place. Well done!

author: annaboat
title: Exceeded expectations
text: Lovely new, fresh, clean hotel. Our room is quite large with an extra sofa area, nice coffee /tea making area, desk. Comfy beds, fridge in room. The breakfast was nice, better than, say, a Holiday Inn Express, for what that's worth. The best thing for me is the free shuttle service. We go downtown at night via shuttle, they pick us up later after dinner--so easy. The pool looks nice, tho i didnt use it. I will stay here again the next time I am in Sarasota.

author: magginine
title: They have it 100% right!
text: From the drive up to the beautiful, clean property, to the modern immaculate lobby, to the warm and courteous greeting from JT at reception, we knew this hotel was a real winner. The rooms are modern, spacious, relaxing and very well appointed. We got the suite with two queen beds plus a pull-out sofa. Great linens, nice mattress. Wet bar, tv, separate vanity from bath area. The complimentary breakfast was top-notch from the Starbucks brewed coffee to the fresh fruit and gourmet breakfast sandwiches. Free wi-fi and parking. We only wish all the hotels we stay at were like this one! Well done management and staff, this is a great property in the Hyatt chain!

author: SpartanGirl3
title: Great value and close to everything
text: We stayed here recently as we had some free nights to cash in. The hotel is new, clean and close to everything. The staff is very nice and the complimentary breakfasts are actually nicer than at some of the other comparable hotels. The pool was also really nice and well kept. We enjoyed it quite a bit when it was too chilly to go to Siesta Key Beach. You do need a car though, if you are in town to hit the beach. Its across the street from the airport, 5 minutes from Jungle Gardens (a nice place for the kids) and 10 minutes from downtown Sarasota and the Key Beaches. We would stay there again.

author: prlcal
title: Modern, clean, excellent value & close to NCF
text: We booked the Hyatt Place for one night while on a college tour to visit New College of Florida (NCF). This was our first experience at a Hyatt Place property and we will definitely seek out this brand again. Staff is very friendly and helpful. The property is modern, rooms are well equipped, comfortable and quiet. We did not encounter any noise from the nearby Sarasota airport. The fitness room is small, but our kids got a decent workout with the treadmills and free weights. Breakfast was awesome - great selection of Starbucks coffee and tea, freshly made egg muffins, fruit, oatmeal, breads, juices, etc. The proximity to NCF was perfect and we were able to use the college's discount on the room rate (the discount code is on the NCF web site). Highly recommend this property!

author: McSmile
title: Nice room, good service.
text: We stayed for three nights. Room 321. The room was a good size and very clean. My only gripe with the room was the size of the bathroom. Had a hard time closing the door while standing inside. The staff was friendly and helpful. The hotel has a decent size pool and hot tub, especially since it's so close to the ocean. We didn't utilize the fitness center though it looked pretty standard. We would definitely stay there again.

author: HCABraz
title: It doesn't even look like a Hyatt... Except for the room!
text: My title already says everything I think about the Hyatt Place Sarasota. The outside, including restaurant, staff, etc, looks more a friendly 3 star hotel than the great Hyatt. The thing is (and this I found out later), there is another Hyatt in Sarasota (the regular one). So, this so called Hyatt Place is a cheaper version of the great Hyatt, LOL. Bottom line is: when you got inside the room, it is probably even better than the regular Hyatt and totally different of other Hyatt Places (I've stayed in the Hyatt Place Miami also and it is not good at all). Bottom line? You don`t mind in not having a bar or a pool, this is your hotel. Fair price and great room!!

author: emsgal4401
title: Came for Business and Stayed for Fun
text: I came for a business training and extended my stay throughout the weekend. The rooms were very spacious and clean. They were also very quiet. There was a small fridge in my room and the local supermarket was close by, was nice to stock with drinks, etc... The breakfast in the morning was very nice and fresh. The staff was friendly and accommodating. The hotel is located a short drive to the beach and St. Armands Circle. When I visit Sarasota again I will definately stay at this hotel.

author: meab
title: A great base for a family to explore Sarasota
text: Hyatt Place was a great choice for our Sarasota long-weekend. We spent most of our time visiting the area beaches (Siesta Key, Lido Beach, Anna Maria), as well as attractions around town, so we weren't in the room that much. Hyatt Place served as a perfect base for us - the room was large (though for a room that technically accommodates 6 people, the bathroom is a little bit small!), and we loved the free breakfast (convenient!) and free wi-fi. Staff was very friendly and helpful, and accommodating in every way. Room was clean, large, and modern. We used the pool one time, and the water was pleasantly warm, and the pool area wasn't crowded. Though it's located near the airport, just a few miles north of the downtown area, it was well-worth the minor inconvenience of having to drive to places to eat and things to do. A great value! We'd definitely stay at Hyatt Place again.

author: lacitypro
title: Beautiful, Romantic, and Quiet Stay!
text: Stayed here with my fiance for my birthday. The room was absolutely gorgeous and well appointed. The decor was modern and contemporary. The location was minutes away from the best beach in the U.S. and restaurants. Breakfast was far from the usual continental options at most hotel chains. I enjoyed a spinach and cheese croissant with egg whites and fresh waffles. I will definitely choose Hyatt again!

author: DRPeroli
title: Great hotel, terrific service!
text: Spent 16 nights at Hyatt Place Sarasota end of April/mid-May 2012. This was first visit to this hotel in Sarasota--we'd previously spent about 50 nights in another highly rated hotel over the past year. Decided to try the Hyatt Place because of their Trip Advisor ratings, large rooms, and newer hotel. We are so glad we did. The rooms are quite nice and extremely clean (and I am a picky look in the corner and don't want to see any mold whatsoever person), and the wooded hotel setting is nice, despite being right by SRQ. Marija was my first point of contact--by phone answering my questions before I booked, and then in person when we arrived the next day. She and Betsy (delightful) were bright spots throughtout the trip. Housekeeping was very good and helpful in meeting our special needs (extra hangers for a very long stay, cleaning room while were out) and really thorough in their cleaning. I've stayed in about 15 different hotels in the past year, including 4 and 5 star places in NYC, Boston, and Paris. Hyatt Place Sarasota may not be rated 4 or 5 star, but it was the best of all in cleanliness, comfort, and welcoming staff.

author: SharonG733
title: Great Conference Venue
text: The compact lay out of Hyatt Place makes it very user friendly. The gallery staff are trained in every customer service area, so all are capable & glad to assist. Meals were delicious and the stoneware & flatware add an elegant touch. The meeting rooms were comfortable. The hotel rooms are like an efficiency apt. (sans oven/stove). The housekeeping staff do a great job & are also friendly. With gorgeous beaches & art museums nearby, this is also a great place for a relaxing getaway. Hats off to Hyatt for coming up with this great business model , a la boutique hotel style.

author: Daveloves7of9
title: Clean and modern
text: Beautiful hotel, clean and comfortable. The shower was gorgeous, the sitting area featured a large flat screen tv that was on a swivel so you could watch it from the couch or the bed. The bed was made with very nice feather down pillows. The pool area was clean and had towels available at the pool entrance. The staff was friendly and very helpful. The breakfast had a nice selection but I would recommend sticking to the cold cereal and donuts. The breakfast sandwiches were tasteless and the biscuits for the sausage gravy was cold. But I was quite happy with the selection of juice and fruit . When I visit Sarasota again, I will definitely be staying here.

author: bdenitto
title: Clean and comfortable
text: We spent two weeks at the Hyatt due to a family emergency. The room was perfect for my husband, me, and our 7 month old daughter. We enjoyed that the room was split into a living space and a sleeping space. My husband could work. I could watch tv and the baby could nap in the same room. The room was clean. The staff was friendly and helpful during a very stressfull time. Their breakfast was pretty good for a hotel. We would stay again.

author: BAB144
title: Nice room
text: My husband and I went to Sarasota at the end of March. We were not planing on staying at this hotel but because of the time of year most places were booked. We were pleasantly surprised. Staff was very friendly, hotel was clean and the room was very comfortable. I would recommend this hotel for business people as the bathroom was part of the room and quite small . The sink was located two feet away from the bed. However, there was a walk in shower and we loved that. There was no noise from the airport that was across the street. and the hotel was tucked away in a quiet setting. everything in Sarasota was easily accessible .

author: retirado2019
title: Nice 3 Star Hotel
text: My wife and I really liked this clean three star hotel. The rooms are very spacious. The bed was big and very comfortable. Even though the hotel is across the street from the airport, we didn't hear any airplanes. The free Wi-fi in the room was also nice. One thing I didn't like about the room was the fact that there aren't enough power outlets on each side of the bed. The free breakfast was good. It is within walking distance from the Ringling Museum, which you must visit if in Sarasota. You have to drive to the beaches but we didn't mind that as we were just trying to visit several places in the area. There are plenty of restaurants within 2-3 miles of the hotel.

author: sferaverde
title: Excellent for a short stay
text: The Hyatt Place Sarasota at Bradenton Airport is in convenient location for those who arrive by air and by car. It's right across from the airport and minutes (by car) from downtown Sarasota. Despite its close proximity to the airport, it's quiet and I have never experienced sleep interruptions. The hotel is nicely appointed, with spacious, comfortable rooms and very comfy beds. The free and fast WiFi is a definite asset. Breakfast is included in the room price and offers sufficient choices for this hotel class. There's also a little gym and a swimming pool. Service is courteous and efficient. Overall, a really good place to stay for a few days.

author: kernersville
title: Great place in Sarasota
text: For our recent stay in Sarasota, we booked the Hyatt Place near the airport. We were more than happy with this hotel. Although it is located right near the airport, a very handy spot for folks who are flying, because we were driving, we worried about the noise level. That was not a problem at all! In addition, our room was an excellent size with separate seating, desk, dry bar, shower/stool, and vanity areas. The decor of the hotel is modern and sleek, and the included breakfast was great. In addition, the hotel is located just down the street from the Ringling Estate where we spent a very enjoyable day. We highly recommend this hotel!

author: DDTexas
title: Amazing small hotel with huge rooms
text: We were in the area on family business and just needed something reasonably priced and comfortable. We use Priceline quite a bit and that's how we ended up here. The rooms are huge--sitting area, desk area, fridge area, and none of these are in the sleeping area. Shower/commode area small, but sink area roomy. Really, about twice the square footage of the usual 3 star hotel. Nicely designed lobby area, included standard "do it yourself" breakfast, but eggs and couple of other items available for very reasonable prices. Also, casual lunch and dinner choices if eating in is more convenient. Small coffee/cocktail bar, small gym, nice looking pool area, but space where I really want it--in the room. Also, walking distance to the Ringling Museum I visited years ago and enjoyed then. (Don't go to Barnacle Bill's.) Will definitely be on the lookout for other Hyatt Place hotels.

author: jjjym
title: Great for 5 !
text: We stayed at the Hyatt Place Sarasota for 5 days, all 5 of us ! The suite was gorgeous, comfy, clean and above all roomy : plenty of space for all of us, enough large towels for 3 long haired teenaged girls, swimming pool & terrace just perfect ! Breakfast (included) was varied enough to keep all of us happy. We greatly appreciated the real china & cutlery - much more ecological ( and more pleasant to use) than cardboard & plastic. The only thing missing - as in most US hotels- is a blue recycling bin in each room, for all paper/plastic bottles/cans - but they did take care of our recyclable stuff at the reception desk. Very clean laundry room on our floor was a bonus, made for clean swimsuits/beach towels everyday, a pleasure ! Not to worry : even if the hotel is across the street from the airport, we never heard a plane - very peaceful sleep ! Conveniently located, a 10 minute easy drive to classy downtown & beautiful Lido beach, we certainly would book with them again next time !

author: Jackquito
title: Clean, Comfortable and near attractions/Beaches
text: My girlfriend and I stayed here to visit for the first time the famous Sarasota Beaches. Since we have never been to Sarasota we decided not to spend much with the Beach Front hotels that are available. The hotel staff is friendly and helpful, they do seem knowledgeable of the city and restaurants. Beaches are not far (Siesta Key and Lido Key are about a 10-15min drive). The only negative we saw was the room itself. The distribution between the bathroom, living room and bedroom were a bit too European for us. The toilet and shower were located in this small "closet" looking room, while the sink was right in front of the the bed. This is our first time staying at a Hyatt, but if you don't mind the styling then this is a good choice. Next to the airport might make you think there would be a lot of noise but we heard none. Breakfast is at par with the Star level of this Hotel, they do have warm breakfast but for that you have to pay extra.

author: HBeatty
title: "Great Hotel, Great Service, Great Location"
text: This was my first stay at a Hyatt Place hotel. Our family group (4 adults, one child, 1 enfant) stayed here while visiting the nearby Siesta Key public beach (one of the "top 10" in the nation). Entering the hotel I was struck by the welcoming feel and nice decor. After a quick check-in by efficient staff, I was given briefing and tour of many of the common areas and guest amenities. This includes ample parking, free wi-fi throughout hotel, guest computer area, guest pantry, small bar and 24-hour food service area that offers small meals and Starbucks coffee, "Grab-and-Go" food items, pool and sauna, daily hot breakfast (with additional breakfast items for sale). The clean rooms were well appointed with comfortable beds, compact refrigerator, small office desk area, and "42" flat screen TV. The highlight of our visit was the very helpful staff. Every need was anticipated and every request (including room changes to better accomodate our group) were handled promptly and efficiently. If you're looking for a great hotel with great staff and prime location, this is a place to seriously consider.

author: leemoreau
title: Great hotel, good location and very good price
text: While on a week in Florida my partner and I stayed here for 3 nights when we were in Sarasota. This is a great Hyatt Place. It's near the airport but everything is so close in Sarasota. It takes maybe 10-15 minutes to drive to Siesta Key, and even less to go to the downtown Sarasota area and main shopping area (can't remember what it's called at the moment but it's the big tourist spot). It's a no frills hotel, you check yourself in but there's free breakfast and wifi which was actually really fast unlike at the Hyatt Place in Fort Lauderdale. Overall great experience and would highly recommend. The rooms are great because they all have a separate bar type area with a mini fridge and a sink with a desk for work etc. The TVs are all LCD and have the great Hyatt Plug on the side which easily lets you connect literally any type of device to it from an iPod to Laptop.

author: guamgirl53
title: Great place, great price
text: Stayed 2 nights for a family wedding- party of 15. staff was always pleasant and accomodating. motel was very clean, attention to detail. complimentary breakfast was pleasing to all - nice dishes - unlike some chains where you are gicen styroforam plates, cups, plastic utensils. always a variety of food to purchase if one so chooses. in walking distance of the airport. close driving distance to st armands circle and lido beach. could not have asked for a nicer place to stay for such a happy occasion. thank you hyatt place for contributing to an awesome family celebration

author: Carol0731
title: Extremely enjoyable stay
text: Great hotel location -- just outside Bradenton/Sarasota Airport and 1/2 mile from Ringling Museum. About 5-6 miles to St. Armands Circle and Lido Beach. Hotel serves continental breakfast (coffee, juice, bagels/muffins, fresh fruit, cereal) and should you desire more, eggs, etc. are available for purchase. Also, sandwiches, salads and pastry items are available for purchase 24 hrs. Rooms have a sectional sitting area with separate desk and counter with built-in refrigerator. Staff is very helpful in assisting with directions and special requests. Definitely a value for the price.

author: guestRelationsSav
title: Best hotel on our trip
text: I was amazed by this place. It looked brand new, however it had been opened two years. Very reasonably priced, clean modern rooms. Our kids were comfortable on the sleep sofa, so for just over $100 we had the whole family in the hotel plus a great hearty breakfast. The breakfast was a treat, not the full gourmet type but far more than the continental one is so used to. Free papers, a bouche ball game, a clean nice pool, great wine etc etc, the list was endless. But the best part of it all was the staff, friendly and helpful, I saw them spend over an hour helping one couple with a finance problem they had, they wanted to stay but their credit card company had put a hold on their card. Both times we stayed there it was full, people have found out this gem, so book ahead for what must be one of the best deals in Florida. One last note, the manager was peerless and he was going back to Brazil as I write, I hope Hyatt find someone as good

author: maarola
title: Clean, comfortable, convenient and quiet
text: A great value for the money. One of the quietest locations we stayed. You would never know there was an airport right across the street. Would definitely stay again. Very convenient location, easy access to US41, US301 or I-75 any of which will get you to great beaches and shopping. Don't miss Siesta Beach, Lido Beach or St Armand's Circle. Nice Farmer's Market on Saturday's downtown Sarasota. Plenty of free parking. If you like wings be sure to try Wings 'n Things, just a short drive from the hotel to 7640 Lockwood Rdg Rd in Sarasota.

author: Lrob247
title: Wonderful experience for our High School Baseball Team's spring trip
text: I stayed here with our high school baseball team and we could not have been more pleased. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel was modern and clean. The breakfast area was nice and there was a wide variety of food for our athletes to choose from. The rooms were perfect for the teenage boys, 2 queen beds and a pull out sofa. They loved the big screen T.V. and the heated pool. Thank you Ashleigh Gonzalez for all of your help. Your staff made us feel very welcome.

author: ans1723
title: Great Rooms and Value
text: Stayed hear for a wedding on Siesta Key Beach. Loved the layout of the room. It was a seperate seating area with sectional couch and ottoman. Very cozy. The place was very cleanly. Wouldn't have minded a tub in our room, but the shower was one of the best I have seen in hotels...clean, modern, nice sized shower head, etc...TV was AWESOME!Staff was wonderful. Best part, we only payed around 40 a night! What a deal! 5 stars for getting your money's worth!

author: Ambassador246
title: One of the best overall values I have every had
text: This hotel was a great deal. During spring break time, we were able to get this for $47 a night through Priceline, plus used the Entertainment Book coupon for $10 off per night to make it even cheaper. 42" LCD in room w/ HD programing, excellent divided siting area with sectional and ottoman. Hot tub was nice, pool was too, although a little cool to swim much in. Traffic was a pain when you head towards the beaches, making the drive long at times, but mainly from Spring Break. Staff was nice, and they were ok with swimming after hours provided you were quiet. Way better deal than staying on the beach, which we did after our 3 day stay. That is partially due to weather, though.

author: knothead1
title: Impeccably Clean
text: Stayed one night only but wish we could have stayed longer. The hotel appears very new, is spotlessly clean, stylish and even smells good. The staff was friendly and efficient, the workout equipment is state of the art and the 42" LCD was great . The bed and pillows were very comfortable and the shower very spacious. The free breakfast included the basic stuff I eat at home.....yougurt, fruit, cereal and very good coffee. There is also hot food available at an extra charge. Like a couple of other reviews have noted, the HVAC unit was kinda loud but wasn't really an issue since I always sleep with earplugs when traveling. The outdoor heated pool and hot tub looked inviting, but we weren't able to use these because of very bad weather. The price was right and we'd stay here again in a minute!

author: 2fromTrona
title: Generally very good
text: Modern,clean hotel with good sized rooms and very comfortable beds. As another reviewer mentioned the A/C is a little on the loud side but not too bad. Great 42" LCD TV with wide selection of HD channels. Service was very pleasant. Right over the road from the airport but the rooms are well insulated so noise was an issue. Only negatives were lack of hot water in the shower one morning and a general problem keeping the breakfast buffet stocked both days (several people commented they had the same problem in previous days). Overall good place to stay. Would come back.

author: janep2wn
title: Wonderful Spot & a Great Value
text: We found the Hyatt Place to be an excellent hotel. It is a new facility and spotlessly clean. The room was spacious and comfortable. The furnishings were attractive and of high quality. The staff was friendly and helpful. The fitness equipment are high end new models. One staff person, Alex, provided exceptional service to arrange for a box to be shipped home for us. One minor gripe is the $2.40 it cost for a bottle of water. This was more expensive then the airport across the street. Ouch!!

author: jimmySarasota
title: This place is Awesome
text: My partner & I had our wedding reception here & it was a lot of fun. The hotel is very nice with a Great staff. We had all 55 people that came to our wedding stay at the hotel & everyone enjoyed it. I would recommend this hotel to anyone that has an event in Sarasota. The hotel will try to meet all of your needs. All you have to do is ask. I could not have asked for a better place. Keep up the great work Hyatt Place!!!!!!

author: roughout
title: Clean and very accomodating
text: Have been returning to SRQ every other week to visit mother in hospital. Got an excellent rate at HP. Brand new, very clean and a great staff. I love the layout of HP and try to stay there when given the opportunity. Staff is great here. Marcus checked me in early and gave me an room close to the front of the building. I have a feeling some people are never happy and complain about the tiniest of details. If you do your homework you can find out exactly what to expect before you arrive at this hotel. I was very happy with HP/SRQ. I have already booked my next two return trips.

author: Scousemat
title: Great wedding venue
text: Attended my nieces wedding here and cannot fault the venue. The staff were excellent especially the bar and waiting on staff. Most worked an extremely long day but kept up the excellent service. The food was extremely good for both the wedding reception and the night time do. A sit down meal was served with a minimum of fuss with three excellent courses. The nigh time buffet had a Mexican theme but also a hotpot. There were two separate bars and outside seating area. The bar prices were good and not the rip off you sometimes get at hotels. I would highly recommend this venue.

author: EmmaW3461
title: Lovely hotel, great breakfast and good service
text: We booked one of the smaller rooms that is flagged on the website and potentially loud at weekends as they are over the main function room. As it was a Monday we didn’t have that issue. The room was slightly small, but still had adequate space and was stylishly decorated, as was the rest of the hotel. The lady on reception when we checked in was extremely friendly and helped us out with some directions for Blackburn city centre. The breakfast in the morning was great. There was a great selection and we went for the full English, which was one of the best we’ve had while holidaying here. While we were staying we experienced a small issue, which the hotel acknowledged and then resolved satisfactorily. Top marks good customer service, which makes so much difference. Would definitely stay here again if in the area.

author: Maureen650
title: Mother’s Day
text: I visited here on Mother’s Day with my daughter (Joanne and her family). This was my first visit to Sparth House, but certainly will not be my last. Nigel the owner was the perfect host, making time to greet customers. The staff including the chef, front of house and reception were amazing. We also had an amazing meal, everything was done and presented to perfection. I can not recommend this highly enough. Most definitely worth a visit. You certainly will not be disappointed. Thank you all so much. Best wishes.

author: EastLancsSam
title: Meeting Friends
text: Needed a place to stay whilst I caught up with friends back in the old home town. The price was important to me as I only required the bed for the night and not much else. It’s a shame I couldn’t make more from my stay in the hotel as it is a fabulous place in fantastic surroundings. The attic room was great for what I required, it was cosy, clean and had a comfy bed. The hotel itself was very clean and looked lovely. The staff were friendly and extremely helpful. The included breakfast was lovely also. Will definitely stay here again when returning ‘home’.

author: 360jacquelinec
title: The first Christmas meal of 2018
text: This review can only be full of superlatives. On entering Sparth House you are treated to the incredible Christmas decor. The lady who buys the ornaments has wonderful taste. The staff there are so friendly and organised. It is no surprise they have just won an important award for their wedding functions. The food was absolutely faultless when it arrived. All piping hot and cooked to perfection. I don’t think I’ve ever had a better Christmas lunch anywhere and at such a reasonable price. Congratulations to everyone at Sparth House for making this venue one of the best in the area.

author: TMCLondonUK
title: Another return visit
text: I have been coming to this hotel for the past 8 years and have written a few reviews over that time. This year I stayed in room 20 which is the 1st room you come across when reaching the 1st floor. I had stayed in this room before and I noted in a prior review that it was a bit drab and needed a bit of TLC. Well it looks like the management took note as the room has had a good makeover and is much improved. The only thing in my opinion that's needs addressing is that the room is still quite dark even with all the lights on. As for the rest of the hotel there's no real change which is a good thing. The staff are all very friendly and helpful, the public areas are clean and welcoming. Breakfast was freshly cooked and a full English will fill you up for the rest of the day. There's ample car parking and 24 hr reception. I can't see any reason why I wouldn't continue to use this hotel in the foreseeable future.

author: SarahE474
title: Another happy stay at this friendly and welcoming hotel
text: I am an Accrington Stanley supporter who lives 200 miles away, alas, and over the years Sparth House has become a home-from-home. The staff are friendly and helpful, and 'our' room upstairs is spacious with a comfortable bed and a lovely, long bath in the en-suite. There is a generous selection of tea, coffee and hot chocolate on the hospitality tray, plus bottled water. Breakfast, included in the room rate, offers a good choice on the cold buffet while the hot food is cooked to order. There is ample parking on-site. We didn't dine in on this occasion as there was a hospitality event and match at the Stanley ground but we did have a couple of drinks in the bar, which is a comfortable area accessed through the lounge with its fire, which was lit as the weather has turned chilly and is always a welcoming sight. PS Stanley won - 4-1. Yes!

author: dawncM5782EA
title: solo traveller
text: I have stayed here twice in the last few months and cannot commend Sparth House enough. This will now be a regular stay for myself to visit family in the surrounding area. The staff are extremely welcoming and very friendly. The beds are very comfortable and I can honestly say I haven't slept as well in other hotels I have stayed. I can highly recommend the Sunday menu. Superb food at a reasonable price. See you all again in November! Dawn Fox

author: Road770458
title: Great hotel!!
text: I stayed here for 2 nights, along with my husband and 2 year old daughter. I had requested a room with a king size bed when we had booked but on arrival had been given a double bed. The receptionist on at the time (Anabelle) was quick to rectify this and we were given a lovely big room with a larger bed. Breakfast was great. Ordered off the menu on the Sat morning, but more of a buffet style on the Sunday. Plently of choice. All the staff were so friendly and helpful and had lots of knowledge for things to do in the surrounding areas. We would definately stay here again in the future!

author: markmcdowell71
title: Was good until?
text: Had a great time at Sparth house hotel, positives are good car parking. Staff friendly. room was clean. Bar area nice. However my stay was spoilt next morning at breakfast. As I began to eat my cooked breakfast I found a massive hair on my plate. Being bald myself not guilty lol. I pointed it out to a member of staff. She was apologetic but very quickly blamed the hair on the butcher that supply Sparth house hotel meat. She offered me another breakfast but I felt sick as I’d eaten some meat before I seen it, I declined her offer.

author: madeleinem119
title: Shopping Trip
text: Fabulous hotel! Lovely food. Polite and attentive staff. Couldn’t praise it enough! Our room was in the attic, it was spacious and clean. However the age of the building means no air conditioning. A portable fan maybe the solution. I would stay again if I am in the area.

author: LondonWaynef
title: Dinner
text: We had a great dinner on the 6th January.. 2018. Excellent food First class service. Strongly recommend for events too. We had a wonderful Christmas luncheon here for my company in December. Roast Chicken Dinner Good choice of cheeses Raspberry dressing was too thick Braised beef was delicious Profiteroles were enormous Prawn starter... a little oily Pate was awesome Champagne could have done with being more chilled, more ice in the ice bucket please Merlot wine was delicious. Restaurant was quiet but service most attentive, Given a tour of the hotel and very impressed with the interior design... well done sparth house, you deserve GREATER success.

author: whovian2015
title: Works Christmas Party
text: My work booked here for our Christmas party this year and I was rather happy about that. It was fancy dress(not my thing) but everyone was welcoming as ever. The sit down was somewhat later than expected but when food came it came out quickly with plenty of waiting staff. The meal was good. The choices had been made before and were, of course, limited, but the food was good quality. I had pate with toasted panini, braised beef ( a bit tough, surprisingly but they were cooking high volumes ) and pana cotta. Portion sizes were just about right for a party. The following disco was really good with the DJ picking some really good tunes that everyone seemed to love. I will definitely return but for a more subdued family meal next time.

author: hallskaren
title: Mixed feelings
text: Perfect venue for a wedding or any non residential event I am sure as the public rooms are gorgeous and welcoming. The food is superb, both breakfast and dinner. Staff are great too, very helpful and efficient. It was lovely to have our luggage carried to our room when we arrived. I can’t give the hotel five stars because of the room. Very small with no window, just a sky light. I also had to ask at least twice for basic stuff, more towels, toiletries etc. One towel plus one tiny bottle of shampoo does not serve two people for two nights! Having said that I would probably stay again but would book a superior room based on other reviews.

author: kate12342017
title: Wonderful Weekend Stay
text: We recently spent two nights at the Sparth House and had an absolutely fantastic time. We were there with other members of our family and friends to celebrate a special birthday. We were made to feel extremely welcome by the owners and their staff and nothing was too much trouble. We were in room 22 which overlooked the garden and it was absolutely gorgeous. The decor, the furnishings (especially the stunning metal four poster bed!), the attention to detail were all second to none. We ate at the hotel on Friday and Saturday evening and the food was incredible. Special mention should go to the canapes - quails egg scotch eggs, brie and cranberry bruschetta, pate and chutney - all absolutely delicious. Not much room left for the delicious curry and late night buffet (with bigger scotch eggs!) but I managed somehow. We also had breakfast both mornings and opted for the full English which was lovely. The service throughout was brilliant and I would recommend the Sparth to anyone looking for a family run hotel with the personal touch.

author: 769tonyh
title: Oh...
text: Sparth House was recommended to me by a dear friend. I think he was sparthing a joke when he said it was great. The service etc is fine. But it's just old, old, old. The bathroom was an 80s affair and the bedrooms were creaky with old furnishing. When someone asked where I stayed the night before, after I told them they screwed up their face. Tells you what the locals think! To be fair it's not that bad. The breakfast is great and it's in the perfect location to explore Accrington.

author: Vickymihar
title: Afternoon tea
text: We had an absolute fantastic afternoon tea. Booked it on line & a quick response from Matthew and all our requests has been provided. We were looked after by Callum & Olivia made sure we are all happy with the food & everything. The owner Nigel came over to check how we are too. We were truly spoilt that day. It was a very affordable & delicious food. Definitely we will book it again soon. Highly recommended.

author: truda1823
title: Wonderful Wedding at Sparth House
text: Thank you to everyone at Sparth House! We couldn't have imagined a better venue. All of the staff were wonderful, not only were they professional but always made us feel very welcome. Olivia is fantastic! She made us feel very at ease from day 1 with her enthusiastic and personable manner and she was quick to reply with any help or advice when needed. On the day everything ran really smoothly and the food was UNBELIEVABLY good! All of our guests commented on the high quality of the food and the friendly nature of the staff. The grounds were perfect for our photos and garden games and we had full exclusivity of the house which made it even more special. I highly recommend this venue to anyone getting married, we couldn't have had a better day!

author: ShrianeFamily
title: Lovely Afternoon Tea!
text: Our party of 2 adults and 2 children attended Sparth House for their afternoon tea yesterday and were very impressed. Sparth House is a beautiful Georgian manor house with lovely gardens to front and rear. Inside the decor is classy and stylish and we were welcomed with a smile by their friendly staff and seated immediately. Great customer service. Although it was afternoon tea the children wanted hot chocolate instead which the staff sorted without any extra charge or fuss. Our sandwiches, scones and cake treats were all delicious and beautifully presented. We had a lovely time in luxurious surroundings and highly recommend to all. Thank you Sparth House!!!

author: Areeff
title: Good value
text: Stayed one night in a standard room whilst working in the area. The room was spotlessly clean, although small and in the attic area. This is clearly stated on the website so wasn't a surprise to me. The bathroom was a bit dated but again very clean. The room was well heated and bed was comfortable with good quality bedding. I very much enjoyed breakfast which was cooked to order and in a very pleasant dining room. I think at £60 the value for money is excellent and I would stay again. Staff were helpful and friendly.

author: sharonb105
title: Wedding Venue
text: This hotel is an excellent wedding venue. I had an issue with the table set up which was rectified as soon as I brought it to there attention. The food was top class at the reception the staff are really nice and very efficient. All my guests commented that the food was really good and staff were excellent. One guest even went as far as saying she had been at a wedding in the local area a much more expensive venue and Sparth House is much better. The honeymoon suite is large and very nice. Breakfast is also great all fresh produce. The prices are very reasonable. All in all we had excellent day all our guests were impressed and this is all thanks to the great team at Sparth House well done. Thanks very much Dave and Sharon

author: coleenk950
title: Excellent Christmas Meal
text: On Wednesday14th December 2016, I and 9 friends had a Christmas lunch at Sparth House. It was excellent in all respects! Professional, efficient, knowledgable and friendly staff. The hotel was magnificently decked out for the season. The food was delicious and just the correct quantity. Nothing was too much trouble. The manager, Matthew, was especially helpful and knowledgable about wine and cheese! We enjoyed our meal so much, that our group has booked for afternoon in January!

author: lisajlb
title: Hotel and dinner first class
text: We have visited twice in the last 2 weeks, once for a private social event that was held there and once to stay for the night whilst at another event elsewhere. The social event was quite large with about 140 people all having a 3 course sit down meal with choices. Personally I am gluten free and they had no issues accommodating that. The food was excellent and hot and all served at the same time. The staff was amazing very attentive and it was a pleasure to be served by them. Last night we stayed, booked online and upgraded. We stayed on the top floor in room 25 and I have to say the room is beautiful, but the really the stand out part was the bedding, I have no idea what they use but it was the most softest and comfortable bedding I have ever slept in and I have stayed in many hotels all over the world. At breakfast this morning they accommodated my gluten free diet with ease and the food was excellent. Overall, whether you want a fantastic nights stay or want to hold a large event this is the place to go.

author: SteveO791
title: overnight stop - great food lovely staff, bit noisy
text: Stayed here for 2nd year on the trot, and will come back. Rooms quite small, but we were a group of 10 paying golf locally and needed somewhere to stay. We were pre-warned that there was a function on and it may be noisy, so we prepared for that. Rooms were over the function room and were a bit noisy, but the music stopped at midnight prompt. we had a fab time though. Set us a room aside for a meal for our group of 10. Staff so friendly and the food was fab at night, and lovely full breakfast in the morning . Good free wifi, and ample parking.

author: B2249CUsaraht
title: Just okay but mind the shower!
text: My partner and I stayed at Sparth House for a family wedding. We booked an Executive House double for a little extra. I wouldn't like to know what the standard double was like as the executive was small and dark. Lighting is an issue with a tiny window with wooden slats rather than cozy curtains. The bed was comfortable enough however the bathroom was so cramped, you couldn't swing a cat in there. My partner went to have a shower first thing in the morning and it obviously hadn't been cleaned in a while... an actual slug came out of the shower head. A slug! Needless to say I saved my shower until I got home.

author: lindaandsteve2014
title: Family Wedding
text: Stayed for one night following my sons wedding.We had a suite which was a lovely light spacious room overlooking the front gardens. Bathroom was quite small but adequate and very clean.The wardrobe was huge and enough drawer space to stay for a fortnight.The furniture was a little dated ,although we liked it, but it had apparently come from the Olympic,the sister ship to the Titanic.so that would explain the age. We had a look at the rooms others in the party were staying in .Family rooms on the top floor were a good size plenty of room for a family of four. The bridal suite was huge with a lovely bed and two sofas.Also the biggest mirror i have ever seen.Bathroom much bigger than those in the other rooms. The evening reception for my son and new daughter-in-law was set in a side extension which gave you a big room for tables and a dance floor plus an attached conservatory with a bar and doors opening out to a decked seating area and a garden that the children could safely run about in.A really good space. Staff were pleasant and tolerant of the children,a bit overexcited at times,and moved tables around so we could eat breakfast together. Breakfast was fine with a choice of cereals juices and yogurts and a freshly cooked Full English that was very nice.Fresh coffee and toast finished it off well. Having put our drinks on a tab during the reception we were nervous going to settle the bill,however the bar bills were fine and no more than you would pay anywhere else. I would recommend Sparth House for a short stay or a wedding reception and i understand they have a very nice wedding room although we did not see it.

author: benmelling2016
title: My Excellent Wedding
text: I have recently stopped at the Sparth House for my wedding on Friday 3rd June & it was probably the best time I have spent in a hotel/venue. From the first minute we spoke to Julie (who couldn't have been more helpful & made our whole experience amazing) about organising our wedding there & the last minute speaking to Jess when we where checking out I have never dealt with staff as helpful in the way that they dealt with me & my new wife. All the staff from Olivia (who was amazing on the day of our wedding looking after everything), Emma, Calum, Jamie, Julie, Jess, Chef (sorry can't remember your name) & all the others that helped but can't remember your names. Also Nigel the Owner was very hands on & forthcoming with his support for our wedding. We stopped for a number of nights & the rooms we stopped in were fantastic & very fitting fir the type of hotel. Everything was clean & we couldn't have asked for better rooms. I would recommend the Sparth House as a fantastic wedding venue & an excellent hotel to stop in. These are probably not enough words to say how good it was but hopefully the above will go some way. Thanks Ben

author: M3260QHlauram
title: Wedding venue and extended stay
text: We chose the Sparth House for our wedding reception on Friday 3rd June 2016 and from the first moment we walked through the door and met Julie we knew we had made the right choice. Sparth House is a stunning venue with beautiful gardens, we all felt so welcomed and relaxed every time we visited. The whole planning of our reception was amazing, Julie supported us every step of the way with all details covered and both Olivia and Jess were terrific on our day. They knew exactly what we wanted and nothing was too much trouble, every request and favour we asked was done. The room was stunning, the food was delicious and portion sizes were huge, many of our guests commented on the food. The bar staff and waiting on staff were superb, big shout out to Callum who was great and always had a smile on his face. We stayed for 4 nights and had the most amazing time. Bedrooms are comfortable, relaxing and tastefully decorated, and we didn't want to come home. I really wish we could do it all again as our day was so perfect. Huge thanks again and we are truly grateful for everything, we couldn't have asked for a better venue x

author: PatriciaH675
title: Very disappointed
text: After having booked a baby shower in the past and been very pleased, we booked a birthday tea. To say we were disappointed is an under estimation. The food was lack lustre and boring and insufficient for 10 persons. We are charged £4 per person extra for a private room which was not requested. Several of our party complained to management who were indifferent to our complaints. The organiser of the booking has been contacted by management regarding this matter and the matter is still unresolved . We would not be using this establishment again and most certainly not recommend them. 10 People cannot all be wrong

author: MickA859
title: Brief Visit, Lovely Stay
text: I stayed in Sparth House for one night midweek, with my son. We needed to be near Accrington for football. In summary, what a find! I cannot fault the hotel, with its great history. The breakfast was superb and the entire staff and management welcoming and friendly. To see original Waring and Gillow fitted furniture in our room was a treat.
