Even though we came back to the hotel after midnight, the night manager was a perfect host. No hesitation whatsoever, in recommending this fine traditional hotel.

author: Safari289827
title: Dated room, no curtains... Saved by breakfast
text: Stayed at the hotel whilst attending a wedding in another location. Very disappointed with dated dirty bedroom. The room we stayed in could really benefit from an update as the hotel itself has a lovely feel. A light was hanging out the ceiling, there were stains on the bed sheet, the shower adapter was broken and gunk came out of the cold tap. We were awake by 6am due to the light coming in through the skylight. We then tried to sleep with tops over our faces after a late night, it was very disappointing as a first night away for us in a long time. The hotel breakfast was great, staff lovely... Just so disappointed by the room 🙁

author: DenCorless
title: Friendly Hotel
text: We attended a 21st birthday party here and decided to stay over night! We arrived at approx. 3.30 and were greeted by a member of staff who quickly checked us in and provided us with all the important information we needed for the evening and the following morning. We were helped to take decorations for the party into the room and also helped with our bags up to our bedroom. We were also warned that there was a wedding taking place in the hotel and that we would probably be able to hear the celebrations if we went to our rooms before midnight (this wasn't a problem for us!!). Our room nor bathroom was the biggest I've ever stayed in however it was really clean, nicely decorated with all the facilities available. The room we had the 21st party in was perfectly sized for the number of guests in attendance. The buffet was really tasty too and everyone had a thoroughly enjoyable evening. Breakfast the following morning was delicious and served with a smile. A great hotel run by what appeared to be caring staff who simply wanted us to enjoy our stay.

author: L4289OTjamesb
title: Warm welcome
text: A group of 60 plus pensioners arrived at the Sparth House Hotel on a cold wet lunch time in November. We could not have asked for a warmer welcome from Olivia (house manageress). The room we were shown into was warm and nicely decorated for Christmas. We had a selection for all three courses which had been picked previously, by our members. Even though the staff were quite busy they found time to put out an extra table for one of our frail members who needed to be looked after. Altogether the meal was superb and I have not heard any bad comments from any of our members. Thanks to Nigel and all his staff for a good afternoon they all worked hard and all had a friendly smile. Nothing was to much trouble. I will personally go back again.

author: RLZM
title: Wonderful wedding weekend
text: We cannot praise the hotel enough. From Olivia and Nigel who welcomed us and organised the wedding whilst keeping us informed and calm throughout the process, to Emma, Julie and their team who looked after us so well the whole weekend. We were given lots of freedom to organise the reception room how we wished and the hotel were happy for our young guests to play in their grounds. We booked a big family meal the night before and also again the day following the wedding. Nothing was too much trouble for the team who were all friendly, efficient and professional. Our wedding was relaxed, happy and well organised. The food was tasty and the rooms and facilities were bright, clean and well maintained. We would have no hesitation in recommending the Sparth House Hotel, not only as a wedding venue but as a great place to stop. Thank you to everyone there who made our wedding day and weekend so special

author: carolea259
title: Perfect wedding
text: Brilliantly organised wedding of our daughter. The accommodation was stylish, beautiful and extremely clean throughout. The staff were helpful and very friendly but also very professional. Olivia's attention to detail ensured that everything went off without a hitch. The food was not only excellent quality but very impressive portion sizes. Drinks were served quickly at very affordable prices. Checkout was handled with calm efficiency by the very pleasant manager. I cannot recommend highly enough this family run hotel. My thanks to the owners and all of the staff who made our two day wedding so brilliant and effortless.

author: 410paulg
title: Overnight stay
text: Was booked in here overnight on business. The staff wee extemely helpful and friendly. Communal areas are fresh and well decorated. I had a room at top of the house. It was a good size with two comfortable twin beds. The bathroom was clean and well equipped. Breakfast was excellent. Great place for a quick overnight stay

author: beckybM5506FU
title: Lovely Hotel, Brilliant Staff & Great Food!
text: As I work away from home a lot I always try to find nice hotels rather than the standard chains. I got recommended Sparth house by a colleague and decided to book it. As soon as I arrived the lady on reception was exceptionally welcoming. The room itself was a good size and the bed was really comfy. I had a great couple of nights sleep. The breakfast is brilliant with a great choice of cooked breakfast, cereal, yoghurt and juices. We had dinner a couple of evenings and I can honestly say it's the best steak I have ever had! I would highly recommend staying here. Thank you :)

author: 43kayf
title: Wedding
text: We held our wedding at this Hotel. We had the most wonderful day. The staff were very attentive and catered for our every need. From beginning to end they ensured that everything ran smoothly. The food for our wedding breakfast was both hot and delicious. The Bridal Suite was superb for getting ready in with my bridesmaid and family. Most of our guests stayed overnight and they all agreed it was the perfect hotel for holding a small, intimate wedding. And that the breakfast was delicious. We would definitely recommend this hotel for your wedding day.
